_meta.note: 任務對話。這個檔案是產生物——請改 quest/ 底下對應任務的檔案，再跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。直接改這裡下次會被蓋掉。

A Grave Mistake#000.src: Thank you again for all of your help!

A Grave Mistake#002.src: But since you have made it thus far, I suppose I shall show you the truth...

A Grave Mistake#003.src: Then leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...

A Grave Mistake#004.src: Keep in mind what you have learned.

A Grave Mistake#006.src: There is nothing in this graveyard.
A Grave Mistake#006.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#011.src: Where di.. my arm.? I need my a... I had it somewh... upstairs?
A Grave Mistake#011.dst: 내 팔.. 어디 뒀.? 팔이 필요... 어디 뒀더... 위층인가?
A Grave Mistake#011.speaker: XXXXXXX

A Grave Mistake#012.src: You were warned not to enter this forsaken place.
A Grave Mistake#012.dst: 이 버림받은 곳에 들어오지 말라 경고했을 텐데.

A Grave Mistake#013.src: But since you made it thusfar, I suppose I shall show you the truth...
A Grave Mistake#013.dst: 허나 여기까지 왔으니, 진실을 보여 주도록 하지...

A Grave Mistake#015.src: Now leave, and forget the horrors you have witnessed here today...
A Grave Mistake#015.dst: 이제 떠나라. 오늘 여기서 본 끔찍한 일은 잊어라...
A Grave Mistake#015.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#016.dst: 그들은 여기 있는 편이 더 안전하다.
A Grave Mistake#016.speaker: Mael

A Grave Mistake#018.src: I have nothing more to say. Take these.
A Grave Mistake#018.dst: 더 할 말은 없소. 이걸 받으시오.
A Grave Mistake#018.speaker: Alem

A Grave Mistake#019.src: Ooh.. oh... another victim... Welcome... there is no need for a quick introduction... ... you will have just time enough now...
A Grave Mistake#019.dst: 오오.. 오... 또 한 명의 희생자... 어서 와... 인사는 필요 없어... ... 시간은 딱 그 정도만 남았으니까...
A Grave Mistake#019.speaker: Skull

A Grave Mistake#020.src: After all... you just fell into a grave... but, let us make it a little comfortable... where shall I bite first?!
A Grave Mistake#020.dst: 어쨌든... 넌 방금 무덤에 빠졌어... 그래도 좀 편하게 해 주지... 어디부터 물어뜯을까?!
A Grave Mistake#020.speaker: Skull

A Headless History#000.src: You should check your content book to see what to do next.

A Headless History#001.src: I left {p} behind, to aid in her "battle" against the darkness. What a fool I was.

A Headless History#002.src: Six hundred years of searching finally brought us to what we so foolishly sought... And we were unprepared.
A Headless History#002.dst: 육백 년에 걸친 탐색 끝에 마침내 우리가 어리석게도 찾아 헤매던 것에 닿았다... 그리고 우리는 준비되어 있지 않았다.

A Headless History#003.src: That sparkle of light seems to lead down the side path. It feels somehow desperate...?
A Headless History#003.dst: 저 빛의 반짝임이 옆길로 이끄는 것 같다. 어딘가 절박해 보이는데...?

A Headless History#004.src: It almost seems like he wants to say something, even though his expression is blank.
A Headless History#004.dst: 표정은 텅 비었는데도, 뭔가 말하고 싶어 하는 것 같다.

A Headless History#005.src: Despite this, he isn't responding to you. He looks almost soulless...
A Headless History#005.dst: 그런데도 아무 반응이 없다. 마치 영혼이 없는 것 같다...

A Headless History#009.src: You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me? !
A Headless History#009.dst: 내 앞에서 죽으면 안 돼! 절대 못 보내! 넌 살 거야, 알겠어? !

A Headless History#010.src: At this moment...I believed that I could protect her. I believed that I could aid her.
A Headless History#010.dst: 그 순간... 나는 그녀를 지킬 수 있다고 믿었다. 그녀를 도울 수 있다고 믿었다.

A Headless History#011.src: You've been trying to find "another way" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
A Headless History#011.dst: 넌 2백 년 동안 "다른 방법"을 찾아 왔어. 일이 더 나빠지기 전에, 이제 내 방식대로 할 때 아니야?

A Headless History#012.src: As the darkness slowly seeped into the land, her stubbornness halted any progress we might have made.
A Headless History#012.dst: 어둠이 서서히 땅에 스며드는 동안, 그녀의 고집이 우리가 이룰 수 있었던 진전을 막았다.

A Headless History#013.src: Years of searching to no avail- A strong enough attack would have ended it, but her foolish pacifism doomed us.
A Headless History#013.dst: 수년을 찾아도 헛수고였다- 강한 일격이면 끝났을 것을, 그녀의 어리석은 평화주의가 우리를 파멸시켰다.

A Headless History#014.src: The creature was found hibernating underground... It had been storing power, and we found ourselves utterly outmatched.
A Headless History#014.dst: 그 존재는 땅속에서 동면 중이었다... 힘을 모아 두고 있었고, 우리는 완전히 역부족이었다.

A Headless History#015.src: The sacrifices I made for her can never be measured. Despite that... once I had outlived my usefulness, I was tossed away like old clothing and left to collect dust.
A Headless History#015.dst: 그녀를 위해 치른 희생은 헤아릴 수 없다. 그런데도... 쓸모가 다하자, 나는 헌 옷처럼 버려져 먼지만 쌓였다.

A Headless History#016.src: Instead, it will free you from your very life. I have had enough of your meddling.
A Headless History#016.dst: 오히려 너를 네 목숨에서 해방시켜 줄 것이다. 네 참견은 이제 지긋지긋하다.

A Headless History#017.src: She had the power and the opportunity to kill it ten times over, but clung to her morals. She could not recognize necessity, and refused to heed my offers and warnings.
A Headless History#017.dst: 그녀에겐 그것을 열 번은 죽일 힘과 기회가 있었지만, 도덕에 매달렸다. 필요를 깨닫지 못하고, 내 제안과 경고를 듣지 않았다.

A Headless History#018.src: And so, my dark agony began. The light began to siphon away from me. I found myself paranoid and addled, fearful that my disfigurement would be seen.
A Headless History#018.dst: 그렇게 나의 어두운 고통이 시작되었다. 빛이 내게서 빠져나갔다. 나는 의심과 혼란에 빠졌고, 흉해진 모습을 들킬까 두려웠다.

A Headless History#019.src: Even still I held some misplaced faith in her. With that dark seed in my mind... It grew to an obsession, almost- I had to hide it. I had to hide my curse. But it was found...
A Headless History#019.dst: 그래도 나는 그녀를 헛되이 믿었다. 그 어두운 씨앗을 품은 채... 그것은 집착이 되었다- 숨겨야 했다. 내 저주를 숨겨야 했다. 하지만 들켰다...

A Headless History#020.src: All of you, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
A Headless History#020.dst: 여러분, 환영합니다! 오늘은 우리의 아름다운 땅을 구하는 날입니다. 오늘은 빛의 날입니다!

A Headless History#021.src: The people of {p} saw my cursed visage... They saw me near the dark scars. They assumed without thought, and turned me into a perfect scapegoat.
A Headless History#021.dst: {p} 사람들이 저주받은 내 얼굴을 보았다... 어두운 상흔 근처에 있는 나를 보았다. 그들은 생각 없이 단정하고, 나를 완벽한 희생양으로 삼았다.

A Headless History#022.src: Not even death saw the end of my misfortunes. Not even a final release such as this could save me from Lari's stubbornness and endless mistakes.
A Headless History#022.dst: 죽음조차 내 불행을 끝내지 못했다. 그런 마지막 안식조차 Lari의 고집과 끝없는 실수에서 나를 구하지 못했다.

A Headless History#023.src: She brought me back...but the dark infection had eroded away my mind, my soul, my magic, and it continued to ravage my body. Every part of me, the dark touched.
A Headless History#023.dst: 그녀는 나를 되살렸다...하지만 어둠의 감염은 이미 내 정신과 영혼, 마법을 갉아먹었고, 몸까지 계속 파먹었다. 내 모든 곳에 어둠이 닿았다.

A Headless History#024.src: Her soft light burned in me, as the darkness quashed it and filled in the emptiness that it had created. I was there...but you could not say I was the same person.
A Headless History#024.dst: 그녀의 부드러운 빛이 내 안에서 타올랐으나, 어둠이 그것을 짓누르고 빈자리를 채웠다. 나는 그곳에 있었다...하지만 같은 사람이라 할 순 없었다.

A Headless History#025.src: I could feel nothing. She still made me feel...but only annoyance. Rage. Sorrow. I could not bear to be with her a moment longer.
A Headless History#025.dst: 아무것도 느낄 수 없었다. 그녀만은 감정을 일으켰다...짜증뿐이었지만. 분노. 슬픔. 그녀 곁에 한순간도 더 있을 수 없었다.

A Headless History#026.src: There is no fixing this. Her actions are doomed to failure, just as I saw. She has not returned since this time... And so she did not realize that her actions have done little.
A Headless History#026.dst: 이건 고칠 수 없다. 내가 본 대로, 그녀의 행동은 실패할 운명이다. 그 뒤로 그녀는 돌아오지 않았다... 그러니 자기 행동이 소용없었다는 걸 모른다.

A Headless History#027.src: The very powers she bestowed me with, knowingly or not...allow me to command spirits as I wish. To have those who doomed me to this purgatory feel the same aches as I have.
A Headless History#027.dst: 그녀가 알든 모르든 내게 준 바로 그 힘으로...나는 영혼을 마음대로 부린다. 나를 이 연옥에 가둔 자들이 내가 겪은 고통을 똑같이 느끼도록.

A Headless History#028.src: To have their minds, bodies, and souls wracked. To have their magic outlawed and wither in disuse.
A Headless History#028.dst: 그들의 정신과 몸, 영혼이 망가지도록. 그들의 마법이 금지되어 쓰이지 못하고 시들도록.

A Headless History#029.src: Each soul I consume fills me with new strength. And none can reach me- Lari herself saw to that. Would she have taken action, had she known?
A Headless History#029.dst: 영혼을 삼킬 때마다 새로운 힘이 차오른다. 누구도 내게 닿을 수 없다- Lari가 직접 그리 만들었지. 알았더라면 그녀가 움직였을까?

A Headless History#030.src: There is truly, finally, nothing more for you here. The spell can not be broken, as of now. You have seen my life laid bare in front of you. There is nothing more for you to see.
A Headless History#030.dst: 이제 정말로, 여기엔 네게 남은 것이 없다. 이 주문은 지금으로선 풀 수 없다. 내 삶은 네 앞에 전부 드러났다. 더 볼 것은 없다.

A Headless History#032.src: Talk to Hans in the {p} outskirts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#033.src: Oi, you there! With the small nose and whatnot! I got somethin' to ask you. Got a minute?
A Headless History#033.dst: 어이, 거기! 코 작은 양반! 뭐 좀 물어보자. 시간 있어?
A Headless History#033.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#034.src: Good, you're good people. It's about our neighbor, Referick. He's a bit of a conspiracy nut. You know the type, villager illuminati, Wybels are evil, all that?
A Headless History#034.dst: 좋아, 좋은 사람이구먼. 이웃인 Referick 얘긴데. 좀 음모론 광이야. 그런 부류 알지? 주민 비밀결사, Wybel은 악당, 뭐 그런 거.
A Headless History#034.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#035.src: He's acting proper strange though, the past few days. Thinkin' a lord of time's draggin' creatures from other dimensions doesn't make ya stop eatin' or drinkin'.
A Headless History#035.dst: 근데 요 며칠 진짜 이상해. 시간의 군주가 다른 차원에서 괴물을 끌고 온다고 믿는다고 밥이랑 물을 끊진 않잖아.
A Headless History#035.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#036.src: He'll talk your ear off about it if you give him half a chance, but he ain't sayin' a word to me, even when I tried askin' about his theories.
A Headless History#036.dst: 틈만 주면 그 얘기로 귀에 딱지가 앉게 떠드는 녀석인데, 내가 그 이론을 물어봐도 한 마디도 안 해.
A Headless History#036.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#037.src: Somethin's definitely wrong about him, that much's for sure. Could ya take a look for me, see whatcha can figure out and all?
A Headless History#037.dst: 뭔가 확실히 잘못됐어, 그건 분명해. 나 대신 좀 가 볼래? 뭐라도 알아낼 수 있는지 말이야.
A Headless History#037.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#038.src: He lives in the house next to the pile of rocks. He's got screws loose but I don't want 'im dyin' on me, yeah?
A Headless History#038.dst: 바위 더미 옆 집에 살아. 나사 좀 빠진 놈이지만 그렇다고 죽게 둘 순 없잖아?
A Headless History#038.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#039.src: Talk to Referick in his house and head upstairs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
A Headless History#039.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 Referick의 집에서 그와 대화하고 위층으로 올라가세요

A Headless History#041.src: Oi! Any luck with ol' Rick there?
A Headless History#041.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#042.src: ...hm. Dang it...y'know, maybe there's somethin' here that'll tell us what in heck happened.
A Headless History#042.dst: ...흠. 젠장...있잖아, 여기 뭔가 무슨 일이 있었는지 알려 줄 게 있을지도 몰라.
A Headless History#042.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#043.src: Let's look around the house for anythin' he mighta been workin' on. Maybe he finally fiddled with somethin' he shouldn'ta fiddled with?
A Headless History#043.dst: 집 안을 뒤져서 그 녀석이 뭘 하고 있었는지 찾아보자. 결국 건드리면 안 될 걸 건드린 건지도 몰라.
A Headless History#043.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#044.src: Investigate his house for clues as to what could have happened.
A Headless History#044.dst: 무슨 일이 있었는지 단서를 찾아 집을 조사하세요.

A Headless History#045.src: Whassat you're lookin' at there? The castle? Don't see why he'd be pointin' this ol' telescope that way.
A Headless History#045.dst: 뭘 보고 있어? 성? 왜 이 낡은 망원경을 그쪽으로 돌려놨는지 모르겠네.
A Headless History#045.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#046.src: You're human, so you wouldn't know, but somethin' like two hundred years ago, an elf of all people lived in that castle. Called 'imself Dullahan, wore a helmet a lot, I think.
A Headless History#046.dst: 넌 인간이라 모르겠지만, 한 2백 년 전에 저 성에 하필 엘프가 살았어. 자기를 Dullahan이라 불렀고, 투구를 자주 썼던 것 같아.
A Headless History#046.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#047.src: People thought he was the reason for the Decay- can't imagine why, personally, and obviously they weren't right.
A Headless History#047.dst: 사람들은 그 녀석 때문에 쇠락이 왔다고 생각했지- 난 왜 그런지 모르겠고, 당연히 틀렸고.
A Headless History#047.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#048.src: ...hm. Y'know, there's some ghost stories about Dullahan still livin' in that castle... Come to think of it, I think Referick mentioned a theory about it.
A Headless History#048.dst: ...흠. 있잖아, Dullahan이 아직 저 성에 산다는 괴담이 좀 있어... 생각해 보니 Referick이 그걸로 무슨 이론을 말했던 것 같아.
A Headless History#048.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#049.src: Barely remember what it was about cause of how many crackpots he's stuck his head into, but it's somethin' about a ghost. 's the only lead I can think of, anyways...
A Headless History#049.dst: 하도 별 헛소리에 다 빠져 있어서 뭐였는지 기억도 잘 안 나는데, 유령 얘기였어. 떠오르는 단서는 그것뿐이야...
A Headless History#049.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#050.src: The castle door's locked, but you can access the basement. Think you could try lookin' over there? That's all I got.
A Headless History#050.dst: 성문은 잠겼지만 지하실엔 들어갈 수 있어. 거기 좀 둘러봐 줄래? 내가 아는 건 그게 다야.
A Headless History#050.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#051.src: Travel to the castle in the north at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#053.src: ...an unfamiliar soul? Strange. I have not brought you here. I do not know of you.
A Headless History#053.dst: ...낯선 영혼? 기이하군. 내가 너를 데려오지 않았다. 너를 알지 못한다.

A Headless History#054.src: What an odd feeling... I haven't felt confusion in a long time. How refreshing...still, I shall ask you to leave.
A Headless History#054.dst: 묘한 감각이군... 혼란을 느낀 건 참으로 오랜만이다. 신선하구나...그래도 떠나 달라고 해야겠다.

A Headless History#055.src: Excuse you. I asked you to leave, strange person. You would ignore my request?
A Headless History#055.dst: 무례하구나. 떠나라 했거늘, 낯선 자여. 내 청을 무시하겠다는 것이냐?

A Headless History#056.src: Such an action is rather insolent, not to mention...interesting. Still, interfering with my business is inexcusable.
A Headless History#056.dst: 그런 행동은 꽤나 오만하구나. 게다가...흥미롭다. 허나 내 일을 방해하는 건 용서할 수 없다.

A Headless History#057.src: Demons of the Prison Guard, I compel you to execute this interloper. Trap their soul for my perusal later.
A Headless History#057.dst: 감옥 수호자의 악마들이여, 이 침입자를 처단하라. 그 영혼을 가둬 두어라. 나중에 살펴보겠다.

A Headless History#058.src: Return to Referick with his soul at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

A Headless History#059.src: OI! Referick!! Wait for me! Ain'tcha need some food and drink first?!
A Headless History#059.dst: 어이! Referick!! 기다려! 먼저 뭐라도 좀 먹고 마셔야지?!
A Headless History#059.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#060.src: The heck did you do?! Referick just bolted out the door like he forgot his wallet or somethin'!
A Headless History#060.dst: 대체 뭘 한 거야?! Referick이 지갑이라도 두고 온 것처럼 문밖으로 뛰쳐나갔다고!
A Headless History#060.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#062.src: C'mon mate, you got up and moved for the first time in days and now you're clammin' up again? Speak to me!
A Headless History#062.dst: 이봐 친구, 며칠 만에 겨우 일어나 움직이더니 또 입 다무는 거야? 말 좀 해!
A Headless History#062.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#064.src: YIPE! Never heard 'im scream like that before! Never heard anyone scream like that before! I'd like to never hear anyone scream like that again!
A Headless History#064.dst: 으악! 저 녀석이 저렇게 소리 지르는 건 처음 들어! 누가 저렇게 소리 지르는 것도 처음이야! 다신 안 듣고 싶어!
A Headless History#064.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#065.src: Oh, shut UP Hans! I nearly had my soul devoured, don't DARE give me any chaff when I was RIGHT all along!!
A Headless History#065.dst: 아, 좀 닥쳐 Hans! 영혼이 먹힐 뻔했다고! 내가 처음부터 옳았는데 감히 토 달지 마!!
A Headless History#065.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#066.src: Agh, alright, alright! Quiet, my ears are ringin'! I'll listen, I'll listen, just quiet!
A Headless History#066.dst: 아이고, 알았어, 알았어! 조용히 해, 귀가 울리잖아! 들을게, 들을게, 조용히만 해!
A Headless History#066.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#067.src: I knew the disappearances in {p} weren't just because of the risen bodies. People were being left catatonic!! That doesn't happen randomly!
A Headless History#067.dst: {p}의 실종 사건이 되살아난 시체들 때문만은 아닐 줄 알았어. 사람들이 멍하니 넋이 나가 있었다고!! 그건 우연이 아니야!
A Headless History#067.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#068.src: It's Dullahan, I swear on my life! I figured him out and he came after me! He's devouring peoples' souls and siphoning their energy for himself!
A Headless History#068.dst: Dullahan이야, 목숨 걸고 맹세해! 내가 정체를 알아내니까 날 노렸어! 사람들 영혼을 삼키고 그 힘을 빨아들이고 있다고!
A Headless History#068.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#069.src: He's acting from within the castle somehow- Ghostly hands and servants, I'll bet! And that means there's a chance to stop him, if he has to act indirectly!
A Headless History#069.dst: 어떻게든 성 안에서 움직이는 거야- 유령 손이나 하인들을 부리는 게 분명해! 직접 못 나선다면, 막을 기회가 있다는 거지!
A Headless History#069.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#070.src: We need to round up the townsfolk, the guards, the military, EVERYONE! We have to storm the castle and stop him before he's able to escape!
A Headless History#070.dst: 마을 사람, 경비대, 군대, 전부 다 모아야 해! 성을 급습해서 그 녀석이 도망치기 전에 막아야 한다고!
A Headless History#070.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#071.src: ...criminy, you really bit the big one, didn'tcha...look, if he's tryin' to eat people's souls, wouldn't it be smarter to NOT have a huge mob?
A Headless History#071.dst: ...이런, 제대로 당했구먼...잘 들어, 그 녀석이 영혼을 먹으려는 거면, 떼로 몰려가지 않는 게 현명하지 않겠어?
A Headless History#071.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#072.src: Wait, wh-what do you mean?! Shouldn't everyone be on high alert? Won't we have a better chance of swarming him all at once?
A Headless History#072.dst: 자, 잠깐, 무슨 소리야?! 다들 경계해야 하는 거 아냐? 한꺼번에 덮치는 게 더 승산 있잖아?
A Headless History#072.speaker: Referick

A Headless History#073.src: He'd have a whole mob of people ready to take from in that case. Sending in one, heavily-armed person, or a small group'd be better.
A Headless History#073.dst: 그러면 그 녀석 앞에 먹잇감을 한가득 갖다 바치는 꼴이지. 무장한 한 사람이나 소수를 보내는 게 나아.
A Headless History#073.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#074.src: And, well...a heavily-armed human just rescued ya, Ricky. I think we leave this to 'em. How about it, human? Head up to the castle and look into this for us?
A Headless History#074.dst: 그리고 뭐...방금 널 구한 게 중무장한 인간이잖아, Ricky. 이건 그쪽한테 맡기자. 어때, 인간? 성에 가서 좀 알아봐 줄래?
A Headless History#074.speaker: Hans

A Headless History#076.src: The interesting soul arrives once more. Why is it you valued the life of that villager? You risked yourself for his soul.
A Headless History#076.dst: 흥미로운 영혼이 다시 왔구나. 어째서 그 주민의 목숨을 소중히 여겼느냐? 그 영혼을 위해 너 자신을 걸었지.

A Headless History#077.src: It will not make a difference one way or the other, and so I am doubly confused. The feeling has already grown tiresome.
A Headless History#077.dst: 어느 쪽이든 달라질 건 없으니, 곱절로 혼란스럽구나. 이 감정도 벌써 지겨워졌다.

A Headless History#078.src: What purpose have you in this place? Turn over your soul so I may examine it and find out. I am genuinely curious to know...
A Headless History#078.dst: 이곳에 온 목적이 무엇이냐? 네 영혼을 내놓아라, 살펴보고 알아내겠다. 진심으로 궁금하구나...

A Headless History#080.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#080.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#082.src: LARIII! Where are you?! I can help!!
A Headless History#082.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#083.src: Ugh, I saw her with that...THING, but...
A Headless History#083.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#084.src: My visions didn't show an exact enough spot... LARIII?
A Headless History#084.dst: 환영에 정확한 위치가 안 보였어... Lari이이?
A Headless History#084.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#085.src: I...what is... What left the land scarred like this?!
A Headless History#085.dst: 이...이게 뭐야... 뭐가 땅을 이렇게 할퀴어 놓은 거지?!
A Headless History#085.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#086.src: Was...was this their clash...? L-LARI! LARIIII! WHERE ARE YOU?!
A Headless History#086.dst: 이게...이게 그 싸움의 흔적인가...? L-Lari! Lari이이! 어디 있는 거야?!
A Headless History#086.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#088.src: You are NOT dying on me! I won't allow it! You will LIVE, you hear me?!
A Headless History#088.dst: 내 앞에서 죽으면 안 돼! 절대 못 보내! 넌 살 거야, 알겠어?!
A Headless History#088.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#089.src: Sit as still as you can, I have healing spells prepared.
A Headless History#089.dst: 최대한 가만히 있어. 치유 주문을 준비해 뒀어.
A Headless History#089.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#090.src: I ask the land for its life to save another. Grant me this!
A Headless History#090.dst: 다른 이를 구하고자 대지에 생명을 청한다. 허락하라!
A Headless History#090.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#092.src: Oh, what am I going to do with you...
A Headless History#092.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#094.src: Once again you ignore my demands...? And not only that, you invade the memories I have locked away?
A Headless History#094.dst: 또다시 내 요구를 무시하는가...? 그뿐 아니라 내가 봉인한 기억까지 침범하느냐?
A Headless History#094.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#095.src: I must ask again, what is your goal? Why have you come here, and why do you seek my most private thoughts, that not even I wish to think?
A Headless History#095.dst: 다시 묻겠다, 목적이 무엇이냐? 왜 이곳에 왔고, 나조차 떠올리기 싫은 가장 은밀한 생각을 왜 파헤치느냐?
A Headless History#095.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#096.src: Look, Dulla, I really do appreciate your help, but you know I can't do what you're asking of me! There's another way, I just need to find it!
A Headless History#096.dst: 있잖아, Dulla, 도와줘서 정말 고마워. 하지만 네 부탁은 내가 못 들어주는 거 알잖아! 다른 방법이 있어, 찾기만 하면 돼!
A Headless History#096.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#097.src: Lari, you remember that I have my visions, right? I've seen what will happen if you don't step up- and I can help stop it!
A Headless History#097.dst: Lari, 내가 환영을 본다는 거 기억하지? 네가 나서지 않으면 무슨 일이 생기는지 봤어- 그리고 난 그걸 막는 걸 도울 수 있어!
A Headless History#097.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#098.src: You've been trying to find "anotherway" for two centuries. Don't you think it's high-time we took my route, before things get worse?
A Headless History#098.dst: 넌 2백 년 동안 "다른 방법"을 찾아 왔어. 일이 더 나빠지기 전에, 이제 내 방식대로 할 때 아니야?
A Headless History#098.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#099.src: NO! I am not going to kill it! YOU are not going to kill it! I'll find a way! I will, I have these powers for a reason!
A Headless History#099.dst: 안 돼! 난 그걸 죽이지 않을 거야! 너도 죽이면 안 돼! 방법을 찾을 거야! 꼭! 이 힘엔 이유가 있으니까!
A Headless History#099.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#100.src: You talk a big game, and you show one too, but the creature wasn't fazed. I'm not fazed. Drop the intimidating act, please.
A Headless History#100.dst: 말도 거창하고 기세도 거창하지만, 그 괴물은 꿈쩍도 안 했어. 나도 마찬가지고. 겁주는 척은 그만해, 제발.
A Headless History#100.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#101.src: I...there...there has to be a way. I...I-I'm terrified that I've...already ruined everything, just by following my heart, like I was told...
A Headless History#101.dst: 나...분명...분명 방법이 있을 거야. 나...나, 난 무서워...시키는 대로 마음을 따랐을 뿐인데, 벌써 다 망쳐 버린 것 같아서...
A Headless History#101.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#102.src: I know you're frustrated, but I am too. I left a lot behind to try and help you. I hate to say these things, I wish it could be your way.
A Headless History#102.dst: 답답한 거 알아, 나도 그래. 널 도우려고 많은 걸 두고 왔어. 이런 말 하기 싫어, 네 방식대로 되면 좋겠어.
A Headless History#102.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#103.src: I'm terrified too, that if we don't take more drastic action, things will get worse. Can't you see that, too?
A Headless History#103.dst: 나도 무서워. 더 과감하게 움직이지 않으면 일이 더 나빠질 거야. 너도 그게 보이지 않아?
A Headless History#103.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#104.src: I...I just... I don't know what to do!
A Headless History#104.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#105.src: He showed me all these things and gave me all these choices and asked how my heart beat!
A Headless History#105.dst: 그분은 나한테 온갖 걸 보여 주고 온갖 선택지를 주고는 내 심장이 어떻게 뛰냐고 물었어!
A Headless History#105.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#106.src: He gave me these powers but they don't work or I don't know HOW they work!
A Headless History#106.dst: 이 힘을 주셨는데 안 먹히거나 어떻게 쓰는지를 모르겠어!
A Headless History#106.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#107.src: I want to do the right thing but I don't know what it is and I don't know how to ask what it is and...a-and...
A Headless History#107.dst: 옳은 일을 하고 싶은데 그게 뭔지 모르겠고 뭔지 어떻게 물어야 할지도 모르겠고...그, 그리고...
A Headless History#107.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#108.src: You have become infuriating instead of interesting. Why do you violate my memories? Why do you force me to relive them?
A Headless History#108.dst: 흥미롭던 네가 이젠 분노를 자아내는구나. 어째서 내 기억을 더럽히느냐? 어째서 그것을 다시 겪게 하느냐?
A Headless History#108.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#109.src: Spirit of the Keeper of Keys, rid me of this thing that befouls my place. It incites a rage akin to HER.
A Headless History#109.dst: 열쇠지기의 영혼이여, 내 거처를 더럽히는 이것을 없애라. 그 여자처럼 분노를 일으키는구나.
A Headless History#109.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#110.src: You...are a fool. More than I was. You knowingly walk to your death.
A Headless History#110.dst: 너는...어리석구나. 나보다 더. 죽음인 줄 알면서 걸어 들어오다니.
A Headless History#110.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#111.src: It is convenient for me, certainly, but I admit that it is equal parts enraging and bewildering.
A Headless History#111.dst: 내겐 분명 편리한 일이다. 허나 분노스럽고 당혹스러운 것도 사실이다.
A Headless History#111.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#112.src: Leave the room and continue exploring the castle.

A Headless History#113.src: I told you, Lari! I saw it in my visions, this is our last chance! Hurry!
A Headless History#113.dst: 내가 말했잖아, Lari! 환영에서 봤어, 이게 마지막 기회야! 서둘러!
A Headless History#113.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#114.src: Look at this spot, Lari. It has to be here. The land is being scarred, just like after your fight. The light is being drained!
A Headless History#114.dst: 이 자리를 봐, Lari. 여기가 틀림없어. 네가 싸운 뒤처럼 땅에 상흔이 생기고 있어. 빛이 빠져나가고 있다고!
A Headless History#114.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#115.src: This must be where the parasite burrowed down... You're... You're right. We have to...to do something.
A Headless History#115.dst: 여기가 그 기생체가 파고든 곳이야... 네...네 말이 맞아. 우리가...뭔가 해야 해.
A Headless History#115.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#116.src: I... I'm not sure if I'm ready, but you're right. We need to do this...
A Headless History#116.dst: 나... 준비됐는지 모르겠지만, 네 말이 맞아. 해야만 해...
A Headless History#116.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#117.src: ...Remember what I said. You HAVE to take action. There's only two outcomes here.
A Headless History#117.dst: ...내가 한 말 기억해. 넌 반드시 움직여야 해. 결말은 둘뿐이야.
A Headless History#117.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#119.src: We'll need to dig... Do you think you could help with that, Dulla?
A Headless History#119.dst: 파야겠어... 좀 도와줄 수 있어, Dulla?
A Headless History#119.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#120.src: Of course, Lari. We'll need everything we can get if we're going to kill that horrendous thing.
A Headless History#120.dst: 물론이지, Lari. 그 끔찍한 걸 죽이려면 쓸 수 있는 건 다 써야 해.
A Headless History#120.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#122.src: I see it! Lari, it's time!
A Headless History#122.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#123.src: ...I will show you an exit, interloper. It would be...wise of you to take it.
A Headless History#123.dst: ...출구를 보여 주마, 침입자여. 그리로 가는 것이...현명할 것이다.
A Headless History#123.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#124.src: You are a damned fool, interloper. Dredging my memories as you have... I have never felt such rage, not in a long time.
A Headless History#124.dst: 지독히 어리석구나, 침입자여. 그렇게 내 기억을 들쑤시다니... 이토록 분노한 건 참으로 오랜만이다.
A Headless History#124.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#125.src: As such, it shall end now. The exit I spoke of will not free you from the castle, as you can see.
A Headless History#125.dst: 그러니 이제 끝이다. 보다시피, 내가 말한 출구는 너를 이 성에서 풀어 주지 않는다.
A Headless History#125.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#126.src: Warden of Wisdom! I compel you- Rid me of this miscreant! Erase every trace of it from this existence...
A Headless History#126.dst: 지혜의 감시자여! 명하노니- 이 불한당을 없애라! 이 세상에서 그 흔적을 모두 지워라...
A Headless History#126.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#127.src: ...save for a corpse, for me to toss at Lari's feet.
A Headless History#127.dst: ...시체 하나만 남겨라. Lari의 발치에 던져 줄 테니.
A Headless History#127.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#128.src: GAH! It was never able to do this before...! W-What happened to it?!
A Headless History#128.dst: 으악! 전엔 이런 거 못 했는데...! 무, 무슨 일이 생긴 거야?!
A Headless History#128.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#129.src: AWAY! You keep away from us!!
A Headless History#129.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#130.src: Lari, you need to get up, now! We can't waste this chance!
A Headless History#130.dst: Lari, 일어나, 당장! 이 기회를 놓치면 안 돼!
A Headless History#130.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#131.src: It...it threw me aside like nothing! How is it overpowering Orphion's light...?
A Headless History#131.dst: 나를...아무렇지 않게 내던졌어! 어떻게 Orphion의 빛을 이기는 거지...?
A Headless History#131.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#132.src: It's overpowering you because you're not attacking! Remember what I said? You have to-
A Headless History#132.dst: 네가 공격을 안 하니까 이기는 거야! 내 말 기억해? 넌 반드시-
A Headless History#132.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#133.src: ...wait, where did it...did we lose it already?!
A Headless History#133.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#135.src: It's shrugging my attacks off, Lari! Come on, do SOMETHING!
A Headless History#135.dst: 내 공격이 안 통해, Lari! 제발, 뭐라도 해!
A Headless History#135.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#137.src: I...No! It's happening just like I saw! She's...
A Headless History#137.dst: 나...안 돼! 내가 본 그대로 되고 있어! 그녀가...
A Headless History#137.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#138.src: I need to get to her, push her to the killing blow...
A Headless History#138.dst: 그녀에게 가서, 결정타를 날리게 해야 해...
A Headless History#138.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#139.src: Be still, creature! I compel you with Orphion's light!
A Headless History#139.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#140.src: LARIIII! THIS IS THE LAST CHANCE YOU HAVE! DON'T TRAP IT, KILL IT!
A Headless History#140.dst: Lari이이! 이게 마지막 기회야! 가두지 말고 죽여!
A Headless History#140.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#141.src: I-I'm...Dulla, I'm- I can't! I know I can keep it held this time!!
A Headless History#141.dst: 나-난...Dulla, 난- 못 해! 이번엔 붙잡아 둘 수 있어!!
A Headless History#141.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#143.src: I...I-I...th-the light is...I c-can't hold onto it...i-is it...it's t-taking...g-guh...
A Headless History#143.dst: 나...나-나...비, 빛이...부, 붙잡을 수가...이, 이건...빼, 빼앗아...으, 윽...
A Headless History#143.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#144.src: Lari! You can't reason with it! You can't hold it! You have to put Gavel first! US first!!
A Headless History#144.dst: Lari! 저건 말이 안 통해! 붙잡을 수도 없어! Gavel을 먼저 생각해! 우리를 먼저!!
A Headless History#144.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#145.src: I won't let what you predicted happen! I know I can change fate!!
A Headless History#145.dst: 네가 예언한 일은 일어나지 않게 할 거야! 난 운명을 바꿀 수 있어!!
A Headless History#145.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#146.src: Please work, please work! D-Don't break, I can't-
A Headless History#146.dst: 제발, 제발 돼라! 깨, 깨지지 마, 난 못-
A Headless History#146.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#147.src: Lari, no! If it bites you we're doomed! GET UP!
A Headless History#147.dst: Lari, 안 돼! 물리면 끝장이야! 일어나!
A Headless History#147.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#150.src: L-Lari...we...e-everything happened like I s-said...you...you didn't...l-listen...
A Headless History#150.dst: L-Lari...우리...모, 모든 게 내 말대로...됐잖아...넌...넌 끝내...아, 안 들었어...
A Headless History#150.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#151.src: No! No it didn't happen like you said! I-I can fix this! Y-You'll be alright! You'll be alright, you hear me?! I'll make sure of it!
A Headless History#151.dst: 아니! 네 말대로 된 거 아니야! 내, 내가 고칠 수 있어! 괘, 괜찮을 거야! 괜찮을 거야, 알겠어?! 내가 꼭 그렇게 할게!
A Headless History#151.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#152.src: ...so I am cursed to bear witness to my most painful memories due to your idiocy. It is almost a fitting penance... Almost, but not quite.
A Headless History#152.dst: ...네 어리석음 탓에 가장 고통스러운 기억을 다시 봐야 하는 저주라니. 어울리는 속죄라 할 만하구나... 거의. 완전히는 아니지만.
A Headless History#152.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#154.src: My rage... My memories... Your presence stirs them in kind. You must disappear, I no longer care to see your soul.
A Headless History#154.dst: 나의 분노... 나의 기억... 네가 있으니 함께 들끓는구나. 사라져라, 이제 네 영혼 따위 보고 싶지 않다.
A Headless History#154.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#155.src: Sit still and allow yourself to be engulfed. It will save me further pain.
A Headless History#155.dst: 가만히 앉아 삼켜져라. 그러면 내 고통도 덜하겠지.
A Headless History#155.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#156.src: Lari...? Where are you? I...I need you... Why are you gone? Why do you ignore me?
A Headless History#156.dst: Lari...? 어디 있어? 나...네가 필요해... 왜 없어? 왜 날 외면해?
A Headless History#156.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#157.src: My magic is fading, I can't see my visions... They're clearer around you... Please, come back...
A Headless History#157.dst: 마법이 사라져 가, 환영이 안 보여... 네 곁에선 더 선명했는데... 제발, 돌아와...
A Headless History#157.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#158.src: That elf girl's off in the forest. Don't know what she's doing but this is our shot!
A Headless History#158.dst: 그 엘프 여자애가 숲에 가 있어. 뭘 하는지는 몰라도 지금이 기회야!
A Headless History#158.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#159.src: We can finally execute the person causing the decay in the forest! {p} will be saved!
A Headless History#159.dst: 숲에 쇠락을 퍼뜨린 놈을 드디어 처형할 수 있어! {p}은(는) 구원받을 거야!
A Headless History#159.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#160.src: You prepared the sleeping spell, right? Who knows if we'll get a chance like this again.
A Headless History#160.dst: 수면 주문은 준비했지? 이런 기회가 또 올지 누가 알아.
A Headless History#160.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#163.src: L-Lari? Is...is that you? Did you finally come back...?
A Headless History#163.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#164.src: Nah, not quite. Say, why don't you go to sleep 'til she comes back? Dream sweet dreams...
A Headless History#164.dst: 아니, 그건 아니지. 그 여자가 돌아올 때까지 푹 자는 게 어때? 좋은 꿈 꿔...
A Headless History#164.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#165.src: ...they'll be the last ones you ever have, grimy demon. To the guillotine with you... Everyone! I got him!
A Headless History#165.dst: ...네 인생 마지막 꿈이 될 거다, 더러운 악마야. 단두대로 가자... 다들! 잡았다!
A Headless History#165.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#166.src: Everyone, welcome! Today will be the day we save our fair land. Today's the day of light!
A Headless History#166.dst: 여러분, 환영합니다! 오늘은 우리의 아름다운 땅을 구하는 날입니다. 오늘은 빛의 날입니다!
A Headless History#166.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#167.src: Dullahan has been captured! We have the cursed progenitor of the decay in our grip- to be executed, once and for all!
A Headless History#167.dst: Dullahan이 붙잡혔습니다! 쇠락을 부른 저주받은 원흉이 우리 손에 있습니다- 이제 영원히 처형합니다!
A Headless History#167.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#168.src: Haha, yeah! Shoulda thought twice before cursing OUR homes! Three cheers for our wizards!!
A Headless History#168.dst: 하하, 그래! 우리 집에 저주 걸기 전에 한 번 더 생각했어야지! 마법사들 만세!!
A Headless History#168.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#169.src: The decay will clear up- We'll spill his blood, chop off his head, and the curse will be lifted!!
A Headless History#169.dst: 쇠락은 걷힐 거야- 놈의 피를 흘리고 목을 치면 저주가 풀린다!!
A Headless History#169.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#170.src: Ladies and gentlemen, folks of all shapes and sizes, it's time to take our lives back!
A Headless History#170.dst: 신사 숙녀 여러분, 온갖 모습의 이웃 여러분, 이제 우리 삶을 되찾을 때입니다!
A Headless History#170.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#174.src: Dullahan? I'm...I'm back. I didn't leave you for long, I just was trying to find the cu-
A Headless History#174.dst: Dullahan? 나...나 왔어. 오래 비운 건 아니야, 그냥 치료법을 찾-
A Headless History#174.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#175.src: ...uh? Dullahan? He's...he's been right here to greet me almost every day for the past twenty years...
A Headless History#175.dst: ...어? Dullahan? 지난 20년 동안 거의 매일 여기서 날 맞아 줬는데...
A Headless History#175.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#176.src: Footprints...? Dullaaaa? Where'd you go? Is everything alright, did something happen?
A Headless History#176.dst: 발자국...? Dullaaaa? 어디 갔어? 괜찮은 거야? 무슨 일 있었어?
A Headless History#176.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#179.src: I...I l-left for...an hour, a-and...and they... Why?
A Headless History#179.dst: 나...나 겨, 겨우...한 시간, 자, 잠깐...그런데 그들이... 왜?
A Headless History#179.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#180.src: Why did they do this to you...? I...h-how can I possibly fix this?!
A Headless History#180.dst: 왜 너한테 이런 짓을...? 나...어, 어떻게 이걸 되돌려?!
A Headless History#180.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#181.src: I cannot understand why you continue to defile me with these horrid memories. What do you hope to find?
A Headless History#181.dst: 어째서 이 끔찍한 기억으로 계속 나를 더럽히는지 모르겠구나. 무엇을 찾길 바라느냐?
A Headless History#181.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#182.src: I am once more curious. If only to know what I could possibly do or say to cease this horrid quest you've given yourself.
A Headless History#182.dst: 다시금 궁금하구나. 무엇을 하거나 말해야 네가 자처한 이 끔찍한 탐색을 멈추게 할 수 있는지.
A Headless History#182.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#183.src: Th-this has to work. It WILL work! I know it will! I...I d-don't know if it will... I have to fix this, I have to...
A Headless History#183.dst: 이, 이건 꼭 돼야 해. 될 거야! 될 거라는 거 알아! 나...나, 모르겠어... 되돌려야 해, 꼭...
A Headless History#183.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#184.src: The waters from the Lazarus Pit are fabled for bringing back the dead... If this doesn't work, I...
A Headless History#184.dst: Lazarus 구덩이의 물은 죽은 자를 되살린다는 전설이 있어... 이것마저 안 되면, 난...
A Headless History#184.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#185.src: I can't think about that. This...this WILL work. I promise. I found a way to fix it... It has to.
A Headless History#185.dst: 그건 생각하면 안 돼. 이건...이건 반드시 될 거야. 약속해. 되돌릴 방법을 찾았어... 돼야만 해.
A Headless History#185.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#186.src: P-Please...w-whatever gods are out there, whoever is listening, hear me...bring Dullahan back to me, I'm begging you...
A Headless History#186.dst: 제, 제발...어, 어떤 신이든, 누구든 듣고 있다면 들어 줘...Dullahan을 돌려줘, 제발 부탁이야...
A Headless History#186.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#187.src: It's... I-Is it reacting? It... It looks like it is, but...h-he's not mending...
A Headless History#187.dst: 이거... 바, 반응하는 건가? 그런... 것 같은데...사, 상처가 안 아물어...
A Headless History#187.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#188.src: N-No, this...i-it isn't...NO! It... It HAS to work! I...I can m-make this work!
A Headless History#188.dst: 아, 아니, 이건...아, 안...안 돼! 이건... 꼭 돼야 해! 내...내가 되, 되게 할 거야!
A Headless History#188.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#191.src: I...I t-told you... I knew I could change fate... I'm so glad you're here...
A Headless History#191.dst: 내...내가 말, 말했지... 운명을 바꿀 수 있다고... 네가 있어서 정말 다행이야...
A Headless History#191.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#192.src: It's odd. If it were not for her, I would not be here. I would not have my power. Yet even thinking her name enrages me.
A Headless History#192.dst: 기이하군. 그 여자가 아니었다면 나는 여기 없었을 것이다. 이 힘도 없었겠지. 헌데 그 이름만 떠올려도 분노가 치민다.
A Headless History#192.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#193.src: Enter the last door in the dining hall.

A Headless History#195.src: H...h-hrk...g-gah, what is...wh-what... You...you didn't really...?
A Headless History#195.dst: 흐...흐-흡...으, 윽, 이게...뭐, 뭐야... 너...설마 정말로...?
A Headless History#195.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#196.src: Th-there's so much death... The...the air smells like b-blood...
A Headless History#196.dst: 주, 죽음이 가득해... 고, 공기에서 피, 피 냄새가 나...
A Headless History#196.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#197.src: This isn't... There has to be s-some other reason, I... I can't have b-brought back a...a...
A Headless History#197.dst: 이건... 분명 다, 다른 이유가 있을 거야, 나... 내가 되, 되살린 게...그...그...
A Headless History#197.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#198.src: P-Please, we can't afford to lose more people! There's hardly any farmers in the fields anymore, I-I'm needed elsewhere!
A Headless History#198.dst: 제, 제발, 사람을 더 잃을 순 없어요! 밭엔 이제 농부도 거의 없다고요, 저, 저는 할 일이 있어요!
A Headless History#198.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

A Headless History#199.src: The last few said similar things. Someone else I knew said similar things. Frankly, I do not care. Present your soul to me, now.
A Headless History#199.dst: 앞선 몇 놈도 비슷한 말을 했다. 내가 알던 누군가도 비슷한 말을 했지. 솔직히 상관없다. 네 영혼을 바쳐라, 지금.
A Headless History#199.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#200.src: DULLAHAN! What...w-what are you doing?! I... I can't believe my eyes...
A Headless History#200.dst: Dullahan! 무...무슨 짓이야?! 나... 내 눈을 믿을 수가 없어...
A Headless History#200.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#201.src: I... I tried to help you! I t-tried so hard at everything we did together... How could you do this to them?! To...to me?
A Headless History#201.dst: 나... 난 널 도우려 했어! 함께한 모든 일에 정, 정말 열심이었는데... 어떻게 저들에게 이럴 수 있어?! 나...나한테?
A Headless History#201.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#202.src: Odd. I recall you explicitly denying the only option that would have prevented this. I warned you quite thoroughly.
A Headless History#202.dst: 기이하군. 이 일을 막을 유일한 방법을 네가 분명히 거부했던 걸로 기억한다. 충분히 경고했을 텐데.
A Headless History#202.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#203.src: You have had many chances to end this, Lari. Do you expect me to feel sympathy, when your own actions have made me feel nothing?
A Headless History#203.dst: 끝낼 기회는 수없이 있었다, Lari. 네 행동 때문에 아무것도 느낄 수 없게 된 내게, 동정이라도 바라느냐?
A Headless History#203.speaker: Dullahan

A Headless History#204.src: This...this isn't like you... You would never have done this before! You dedicated your life to trying to help...so w-why are you...m...m-m... I-I'm leaving!!
A Headless History#204.dst: 이건...이건 너답지 않아... 예전의 넌 절대 안 그랬어! 평생 남을 도우려고 살았잖아...그런데 왜...어...어-어... 나, 난 갈래!!
A Headless History#204.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#205.src: What have I done...? This...he's... He's not th-the same anymore... What changed? Is this my fault...? I c-can't understand it...
A Headless History#205.dst: 내가 무슨 짓을 한 거지...? 이건...그는... 더는 예, 예전의 그가 아니야... 뭐가 달라진 거지? 내 잘못인가...? 모, 모르겠어...
A Headless History#205.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#206.src: ...but...I'll... I'll protect them. I'll protect him... I...there has to be a way. But...until I find it...
A Headless History#206.dst: ...그래도...난... 저들을 지킬 거야. 그도 지킬 거야... 난...방법이 있을 거야. 하지만...찾을 때까지는...
A Headless History#206.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#207.src: ...goodbye. Goodbye until the day comes when I can fill you with light once more. Goodbye until you learn... Goodbye, until I can fix you...
A Headless History#207.dst: ...안녕. 다시 너를 빛으로 채울 수 있는 날까지 안녕. 네가 깨달을 때까지 안녕... 너를 고칠 수 있을 때까지, 안녕...
A Headless History#207.speaker: Lari

A Headless History#209.src: Investigate the dark door at the end of the castle.
A Headless History#209.dst: 성 끝에 있는 어두운 문을 조사하세요.

A Hunter's Calling#000.src: With so much of the active army dead, dying, and corrupted, {p} fell within the day.
A Hunter's Calling#000.dst: 현역 군대 대부분이 죽거나, 죽어 가거나, 타락해 버려서 {p}은(는) 하루 만에 함락되었다.

A Hunter's Calling#001.src: The more you're promoted, the more benefits you get in your lootruns.
A Hunter's Calling#001.dst: 승급할수록 루트런에서 더 많은 혜택을 받을 수 있어.

A Hunter's Calling#002.src: After the two soldiers were slain in battle, {p} crumbled.
A Hunter's Calling#002.dst: 두 병사가 전투에서 쓰러진 뒤, {p}은(는) 무너졌다.

A Hunter's Calling#003.src: You have been made for a single purpose, peon. The wizard, Theorick, is endangering our cause.
A Hunter's Calling#003.dst: 너는 단 하나의 목적을 위해 만들어졌다, 졸개여. 마법사 Theorick이 우리의 대의를 위협하고 있다.

A Hunter's Calling#004.src: The corruptive influence will spread. I will see this place desolate.
A Hunter's Calling#004.dst: 타락의 영향은 퍼져 나갈 것이다. 이곳이 황폐해지는 걸 지켜보겠다.

A Hunter's Calling#005.src: I will demolish this town. Their army will fall before us.
A Hunter's Calling#005.dst: 이 마을을 박살 내겠다. 그들의 군대는 우리 앞에 쓰러질 것이다.

A Hunter's Calling#006.src: ...Fool. Run while you have the chance.

A Hunter's Calling#007.src: The Silverbull Trading Company is an ever-growing aggregate. These are our headquarters, right outside {p}!
A Hunter's Calling#007.dst: Silverbull 무역 회사는 계속 성장하는 기업 연합이야. 여기가 바로 우리 본사지, {p} 바로 바깥이야!

A Hunter's Calling#008.src: Move faster. It will notice your presence soon.
A Hunter's Calling#008.dst: 서둘러라. 곧 그것이 네 존재를 알아챌 것이다.

A Hunter's Calling#009.src: You need to catch Maxie before he reaches the war scene.
A Hunter's Calling#009.dst: Maxie가 전장에 닿기 전에 붙잡아야 해.

A Hunter's Calling#011.src: ...and the Corkians, blindsided by the Factory's reactivation, were purged by metal and electricity.
A Hunter's Calling#011.dst: ...그리고 공장의 재가동에 허를 찔린 Corkus 사람들은 강철과 전기에 숙청당했다.

A Hunter's Calling#012.src: Explore the deepest part of the Silent Expanse
A Hunter's Calling#012.dst: Silent Expanse의 가장 깊은 곳을 탐험하세요

A Hunter's Calling#014.src: ...you arrive. You search... To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#015.src: You wonder. What do we speak of? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#015.dst: 너는 의아해한다. 우리가 무엇을 말하는가? 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#016.src: You panic. We know you. How? We can provide no answer.
A Hunter's Calling#016.dst: 너는 당황한다. 우리는 너를 안다. 어떻게? 우리는 답할 수 없다.

A Hunter's Calling#017.src: For answers... You search. To an end you seek. May we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#017.dst: 답을 위해... 너는 찾는다. 네가 구하는 끝을 향해. 우리가 끝을 건네도 되겠느냐?

A Hunter's Calling#018.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.

A Hunter's Calling#019.src: The besieged origin. To end, one must begin.

A Hunter's Calling#021.src: You anger. Viewing needless destruction. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#021.dst: 너는 분노한다. 쓸데없는 파괴를 보며. 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#022.src: You distrust. We are dark. Are we? You believe it so.
A Hunter's Calling#022.dst: 너는 불신한다. 우리는 어둠이다. 그런가? 너는 그렇게 믿는다.

A Hunter's Calling#023.src: You prepare. You would attack us. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#023.dst: 너는 대비한다. 우리를 공격하려 한다. 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#024.src: There is no end. Of what you wish, there is none. But may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#024.dst: 끝은 없다. 네가 바라는 끝은, 없다. 하지만 우리가 끝을 건네도 되겠느냐?

A Hunter's Calling#025.src: ???: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning...to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#025.dst: ???: 불의한 자는 그것을 찾았다. 고귀한 자는 그것을 숨겼다. 답을 구하는 자는 더 많은 질문을 찾았다. 또 하나의 시작... 새로운 끝을 향한.

A Hunter's Calling#026.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#026.dst: 불의한 자가 그것을 구했다. 고귀한 자가 그것을 숨겼다. 답을 구한 자는 더 많은 물음을 찾았다. 또 다른 시작... 새로운 끝을 향한.

A Hunter's Calling#027.src: The unrighteous sought it. The noble hid it. The one seeking answers found more questions. Another beginning... to a new end.
A Hunter's Calling#027.dst: 불의한 자가 그것을 구했다. 고귀한 자가 그것을 숨겼다. 답을 구한 자는 더 많은 물음을 찾았다. 또 다른 시작... 새로운 끝을 향한.

A Hunter's Calling#028.src: Hey, little miss. Don't go spacing out on me like that.
A Hunter's Calling#028.dst: 이봐, 아가씨. 그렇게 멍하니 있지 마.
A Hunter's Calling#028.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#029.src: Now that you're acquainted with the new laws we'll want to introduce, I've got a job for you to do.
A Hunter's Calling#029.dst: 우리가 도입하려는 새 법을 이제 알았으니, 네게 맡길 일이 있어.
A Hunter's Calling#029.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#030.src: The current mayor is human. He'll inevitably veto the laws. The deputy on the other hand, is a villager, and on our side. See what I'm getting at.
A Hunter's Calling#030.dst: 지금 시장은 인간이야. 틀림없이 법안을 거부하겠지. 반면 부시장은 주민이고, 우리 편이야. 무슨 말인지 알겠지.
A Hunter's Calling#030.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#031.src: Another employee has already been sent out to get things started. He'll know what you need to do, so meet up with him, would you?
A Hunter's Calling#031.dst: 다른 직원이 먼저 가서 일을 시작해 뒀어. 네가 뭘 해야 하는지 알 테니, 가서 만나 봐. 알았지?
A Hunter's Calling#031.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#032.src: Head to town and get further information from the employee at {~}, {~}.
A Hunter's Calling#032.dst: 마을로 가서 {~}, {~}에 있는 직원에게 자세한 정보를 얻으세요.

A Hunter's Calling#033.src: Oh, yeah I saw the mayor not too long ago.
A Hunter's Calling#033.dst: 아, 네, 시장님은 조금 전에 봤어요.
A Hunter's Calling#033.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#034.src: He was headed towards the bank. Why're you wondering, miss Villager?
A Hunter's Calling#034.dst: 은행 쪽으로 가시던데요. 왜 궁금하세요, 주민 아가씨?
A Hunter's Calling#034.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#035.src: You are here for the job, aren't you? I have to apologize. It's gonna be trickier than I'd wanted for you.
A Hunter's Calling#035.dst: 일 때문에 오셨죠? 먼저 사과드려야겠네요. 생각보다 까다로운 일이 될 거예요.
A Hunter's Calling#035.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#036.src: So our mission is to assassinate the mayor. Amadel told you about the laws. We have a puppet in the running who'll rubberstamp them.
A Hunter's Calling#036.dst: 우리 임무는 시장 암살이에요. Amadel이 법 얘기는 했죠? 그걸 그대로 통과시킬 꼭두각시가 후보로 있어요.
A Hunter's Calling#036.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#037.src: I've got a trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#037.dst: 은행 안에 함정을 설치해 뒀어요. 엄청 까다로웠지만 성공했죠. 당신 일은 함정을 작동시키는 거예요.
A Hunter's Calling#037.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#038.src: I've got the trap set up inside the bank. It was entirely too tricky, but it worked out. Your job is to trigger the trap.
A Hunter's Calling#038.dst: 은행 안에 함정을 설치해 뒀어. 정말 너무 까다로웠지만 결국 해냈지. 네 일은 그 함정을 작동시키는 거야.
A Hunter's Calling#038.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#039.src: Climb up the tree behind me and look through the window, you should be able to see it from there.
A Hunter's Calling#039.dst: 제 뒤에 있는 나무에 올라가서 창문으로 들여다보세요. 거기서 보일 거예요.
A Hunter's Calling#039.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#040.src: Climb the tree and look through the window.

A Hunter's Calling#041.src: Can you see the mayor? I had to stay totally out of sight while setting this all up, so...
A Hunter's Calling#041.dst: 시장이 보여요? 설치하는 동안 절대 눈에 띄면 안 돼서...
A Hunter's Calling#041.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#042.src: ...the only way to get to the trap is to jump across the hanging lamps in the ceiling.
A Hunter's Calling#042.dst: ...함정까지 가는 유일한 길은 천장에 매달린 등을 건너뛰는 거예요.
A Hunter's Calling#042.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#043.src: You can absolutely not be spotted. The way up to the ceiling is on the opposite side of the bank. Just keep on walking past the guards, play it cool.
A Hunter's Calling#043.dst: 절대 들키면 안 돼요. 천장으로 가는 길은 은행 반대편에 있어요. 경비 옆을 그냥 태연하게 지나가세요.
A Hunter's Calling#043.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#044.src: No one enters when the mayor is doing his errands, sorry. You'll have to wait for your transaction.
A Hunter's Calling#044.dst: 시장님이 볼일을 보시는 동안은 출입 금지입니다. 죄송합니다. 거래는 기다려 주셔야 합니다.
A Hunter's Calling#044.speaker: Bodyguard

A Hunter's Calling#045.src: Head back to the excavation camp.

A Hunter's Calling#046.src: Quickly, back to the camp. Before we're noticed.
A Hunter's Calling#046.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#049.src: Yes sir, everything went smoothly. did a great thing for the company.
A Hunter's Calling#049.dst: 네, 모든 게 순조로웠습니다. 회사를 위해 큰일을 해냈죠.
A Hunter's Calling#049.speaker: Employee

A Hunter's Calling#050.src: We can send in Miss Wuna at any time now, and she'll give us the clearance to start the excavation in a snap.
A Hunter's Calling#050.dst: 이제 언제든 Wuna 양을 들여보낼 수 있어. 그러면 순식간에 발굴 허가를 내줄 거야.
A Hunter's Calling#050.speaker: Amadel

A Hunter's Calling#052.src: ...you rage. Aided the ignoble. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#052.dst: ...너는 격노한다. 비열한 자를 도왔다. 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#053.src: You misinterpret. What you see... Is it true? How?
A Hunter's Calling#053.dst: 너는 오해한다. 네가 보는 것... 그것이 진실인가? 어떻게?

A Hunter's Calling#054.src: The answer... It will not bring you the end.
A Hunter's Calling#054.dst: 그 답은... 네게 끝을 가져다주지 않는다.

A Hunter's Calling#055.src: You see. Yet you do not understand. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#055.dst: 너는 본다. 그러나 이해하지 못한다. 그러니, 우리가 끝을 건네도 되겠느냐?

A Hunter's Calling#056.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.
A Hunter's Calling#056.dst: 잔혹한 자. 친절한 자. 이기적인 자. 정의로운 자. 갈등 속에 삶을 걸어간 자. 차디찬 영원을 마주한 자. 그의 끝을 향해.

A Hunter's Calling#057.src: The cruel. The kind. The selfish. The just. He who traveled life with confliction. Who faced eternity served cold. To his end.
A Hunter's Calling#057.dst: 잔혹한 자. 친절한 자. 이기적인 자. 정의로운 자. 갈등 속에 삶을 걸어간 자. 차디찬 영원을 마주한 자. 그의 끝을 향해.

A Hunter's Calling#059.src: Listen, I understand the discontent, but we must start rationing! The corruption is consuming our arable fields.
A Hunter's Calling#059.dst: 들어 봐요, 불만은 알지만 배급을 시작해야 해요! 타락이 경작지를 삼키고 있어요.
A Hunter's Calling#059.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#060.src: Who knows if we'll even have water soon? We need to save up as much as we can!
A Hunter's Calling#060.dst: 곧 물마저 없어질지 누가 알아요? 최대한 아껴야 해요!
A Hunter's Calling#060.speaker: Kotham

A Hunter's Calling#061.src: Yeah, and what does Theorick have to say on the topic? How will he think of that?
A Hunter's Calling#061.dst: 그래, 그럼 Theorick은 뭐라는데? 그 사람은 어떻게 생각하겠어?
A Hunter's Calling#061.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#062.src: He will be here shortly to discuss the topic in more detai-
A Hunter's Calling#062.dst: 곧 여기 와서 더 자세히 논의하실 거야-
A Hunter's Calling#062.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#063.src: Everyone, hush and listen to what Kotham is saying!
A Hunter's Calling#063.dst: 모두 조용히 하고 Kotham의 말을 들어!
A Hunter's Calling#063.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#064.src: As the mayor said, all of you need to start rationing what you eat and drink. I cannot be here every waking moment!
A Hunter's Calling#064.dst: 시장 말대로, 모두 먹고 마시는 걸 아껴야 해. 내가 항상 여기 있을 순 없어!
A Hunter's Calling#064.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#065.src: In addition, I've figured something very important out. I'm developing a way to cease the spread of corruption. So I need to concentrate on that.
A Hunter's Calling#065.dst: 그리고 아주 중요한 걸 알아냈어. 타락의 확산을 멈출 방법을 개발 중이야. 그러니 거기에 집중해야 해.
A Hunter's Calling#065.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#067.src: ...someone among you... I can feel a horrendous strength...
A Hunter's Calling#067.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#068.src: Kotham! Get everyone to safety! NOW! MOVE, GO!
A Hunter's Calling#068.dst: Kotham! 모두 대피시켜! 지금! 움직여, 가!
A Hunter's Calling#068.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#069.src: You! Sent by Bak'al, I assume? What, is he too much of a coward to face me himself?
A Hunter's Calling#069.dst: 너! Bak'al이 보낸 거겠지? 뭐야, 그 녀석은 겁쟁이라 직접 나를 상대하지도 못하나?
A Hunter's Calling#069.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#070.src: You can view your current Lootrun Rank in the Profession Info section of your Character Info.
A Hunter's Calling#070.dst: 현재 루트런 등급은 캐릭터 정보의 전문 기술 정보 항목에서 확인할 수 있어.

A Hunter's Calling#071.src: Maybe bring a map! At least for your first few times. Best of luck!
A Hunter's Calling#071.dst: 지도를 챙겨 가! 적어도 처음 몇 번은. 행운을 빌어!

A Hunter's Calling#072.src: At the opposite end of the {p} lies an area that has been frozen over. It's crawling with Ice Drakes now.
A Hunter's Calling#072.dst: {p} 반대편 끝에는 얼어붙은 지역이 있어. 지금은 얼음 드레이크가 득실거려.

A Hunter's Calling#073.src: You can find our Lootrun Camp just down the road from {p}.
A Hunter's Calling#073.dst: 우리 루트런 캠프는 {p}에서 길을 따라 조금만 가면 있어.

A Hunter's Calling#074.src: What purpose do you have for doing this? This destruction is needless! {p} and all of Wynn have suffered enough!
A Hunter's Calling#074.dst: 대체 왜 이러는 거지? 이건 쓸데없는 파괴야! {p}도, Wynn 전체도 충분히 고통받았어!
A Hunter's Calling#074.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#075.src: I'll freeze you solid, just like the rest of the corruption, you foul THING!
A Hunter's Calling#075.dst: 다른 타락처럼 꽁꽁 얼려 주마, 이 더러운 놈!
A Hunter's Calling#075.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#077.src: This way, no one else gets hurt. Only one will leave from here alive.
A Hunter's Calling#077.dst: 이러면 아무도 다치지 않아. 여기서 살아 나가는 건 하나뿐이다.
A Hunter's Calling#077.speaker: Theorick

A Hunter's Calling#079.src: ...you fear. Does the dark become you?

A Hunter's Calling#081.src: No. You remain whole. You do not change.

A Hunter's Calling#082.src: So, you wonder. To what end? The question brings dread.
A Hunter's Calling#082.dst: 그래서, 너는 의아해한다. 어떤 끝을 향해? 그 물음이 두려움을 부른다.

A Hunter's Calling#083.src: Yet, an end is what you seek. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#083.dst: 그러나 네가 구하는 것은 끝이다. 그러니, 우리가 끝을 건네도 되겠느냐?

A Hunter's Calling#084.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#084.dst: 더 큰 행동에 밀려난 끝. 여섯에게 닥친 끝. 오만한 자의 확신에 대한 끝. 세상의 끝... 어떤 식으로든.

A Hunter's Calling#085.src: An end, ousted by further action. An end, brought to six. An end, to the surety of the haughty. An end, of the world... in some fashion.
A Hunter's Calling#085.dst: 더 큰 행동에 밀려난 끝. 여섯에게 닥친 끝. 오만한 자의 확신에 대한 끝. 세상의 끝... 어떤 식으로든.

A Hunter's Calling#086.src: Enter the Corrupter of World Cave

A Hunter's Calling#087.src: Make your way to the end of the cave.

A Hunter's Calling#088.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.
A Hunter's Calling#088.dst: 동굴 위로 돌아가 나갈 길을 만드세요.

A Hunter's Calling#089.src: Return back up the cave and fix a way out.
A Hunter's Calling#089.dst: 동굴 위로 돌아가 나갈 길을 만드세요.

A Hunter's Calling#091.src: ...you disbelieve. It was an end. But you are here once more.
A Hunter's Calling#091.dst: ...너는 믿지 않는다. 그것은 끝이었다. 하지만 너는 다시 여기 있다.

A Hunter's Calling#092.src: How much more? Where next? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#092.dst: 얼마나 더? 다음은 어디? 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#093.src: Aiding terrible forces... But is it true? To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#093.dst: 끔찍한 세력을 돕는다... 하지만 그게 진실인가? 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#095.src: No. You see possibility. You do not see certainty.
A Hunter's Calling#095.dst: 아니다. 너는 가능성을 본다. 확실함을 보지 못한다.

A Hunter's Calling#096.src: You question. To what end, then, and so may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#096.dst: 너는 묻는다. 그렇다면 어떤 끝을 향해, 그러니 우리가 끝을 건네도 되겠느냐?

A Hunter's Calling#097.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?
A Hunter's Calling#097.dst: 금속. 끝을 막는다. 생명. 끝이, 막혔다. 금속이 생명을 앗아 끝을 가져오면, 정말 더 많은 끝을 막는가?

A Hunter's Calling#098.src: Metal. Preventing an end. Life. Ends, prevented. Does metal taking life, bringing an end, truly prevent more?
A Hunter's Calling#098.dst: 금속. 끝을 막는다. 생명. 끝이, 막혔다. 금속이 생명을 앗아 끝을 가져오면, 정말 더 많은 끝을 막는가?

A Hunter's Calling#099.src: Ah, here for the job opportunity then, I see. The waiver didn't turn you away, good!
A Hunter's Calling#099.dst: 아, 일자리 때문에 오셨군요. 면책 동의서에도 도망치지 않다니, 좋아요!
A Hunter's Calling#099.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#100.src: Now, to business. Times are tough, as you know, and our Iron Golems are in high demand. However, we've, ah...
A Hunter's Calling#100.dst: 자, 본론으로. 아시다시피 시절이 어려워서 철 골렘 수요가 많아요. 그런데 저희가, 음...
A Hunter's Calling#100.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#101.src: ...experienced a draught of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#101.dst: ...'지원자' 가뭄을 겪고 있어요. 일은 꽤 간단해요. 그냥- *흠흠* 사람들을 설득해서 동참시키면 돼요.
A Hunter's Calling#101.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#102.src: ...experienced a drought of 'volunteers.' Your job is decently simple; just- *ahem* convince some people to join the cause.
A Hunter's Calling#102.dst: ...'지원자' 가뭄을 겪고 있지. 네 일은 꽤 간단해. 그냥- *흠흠* 사람들을 설득해서 대의에 동참시키면 돼.
A Hunter's Calling#102.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#103.src: The King of {p} sought help from {p}, the most secure fortress in the province. But help was too late.
A Hunter's Calling#103.dst: {p}의 왕은 지방에서 가장 견고한 요새인 {p}에 도움을 청했다. 하지만 도움은 너무 늦었다.

A Hunter's Calling#104.src: Your attention should be drawn to my peon. Now fall.
A Hunter's Calling#104.dst: 네가 주의해야 할 건 내 졸개다. 이제 쓰러져라.

A Hunter's Calling#105.src: After a villager took over, new laws were put in place. This was the spark Wynnexcavation needed to start their work.
A Hunter's Calling#105.dst: 한 주민이 권력을 잡은 뒤, 새로운 법이 시행되었다. 이것이 WynnExcavation이 작업을 시작하는 데 필요했던 불씨였다.

A Hunter's Calling#106.src: He is capable of halting our advance with his damnable ice. Kill him.
A Hunter's Calling#106.dst: 그자는 그 빌어먹을 얼음으로 우리의 진격을 막을 수 있다. 죽여라.

A Hunter's Calling#107.src: Three people should be enough for the moment. Look around the swamp for some folks, and lure them over here.
A Hunter's Calling#107.dst: 지금은 세 명이면 충분해요. 늪 주변에서 사람을 찾아 여기로 꾀어 오세요.
A Hunter's Calling#107.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#108.src: I'll stay in here and take care of them when you bring me them. It will absolutely be worth your while, I assure you.
A Hunter's Calling#108.dst: 저는 여기 있다가 데려오면 제가 잘 처리할게요. 분명 그만한 보람이 있을 거예요. 장담해요.
A Hunter's Calling#108.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#109.src: Trick {~} people to follow you into the iron golem factory.

A Hunter's Calling#110.src: Agh, dang it dang it dang it! You over there, help me out, would ya??
A Hunter's Calling#110.dst: 으악, 젠장 젠장 젠장! 거기, 좀 도와줄래??
A Hunter's Calling#110.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#111.src: I tripped and fell in this stupid hole, and now there's mud in my eyes that I can't get out!
A Hunter's Calling#111.dst: 넘어져서 이 망할 구덩이에 빠졌는데, 눈에 진흙이 들어가서 안 빠져!
A Hunter's Calling#111.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#112.src: I need to get home or to some kind of a doctor so I can wash my eyes out with actual clean water.
A Hunter's Calling#112.dst: 집이든 의사든 가서 제대로 된 깨끗한 물로 눈을 씻어야 해.
A Hunter's Calling#112.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#113.src: Get me to {p} or a doctor or even just a sink!
A Hunter's Calling#113.speaker: Anast

A Hunter's Calling#114.src: Good job! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#114.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#115.src: Oh, ah...heehee, heya cutie.. Whatcha doin' all the way out here?
A Hunter's Calling#115.dst: 어, 아...히히, 안녕 귀염둥이.. 이런 데까지 뭐 하러 왔어?
A Hunter's Calling#115.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#116.src: Just exploring, huh? I bet someone like you could use someone to...y'know, spend some time with...
A Hunter's Calling#116.dst: 그냥 탐험 중이야? 너 같은 사람은 분명...그러니까, 같이 시간 보낼 사람이 필요할 텐데...
A Hunter's Calling#116.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#117.src: ...guess you're not interested? Oh...sorry if I came off as creepy. I'm just...really lonely, is all.
A Hunter's Calling#117.dst: ...관심 없구나? 아...소름 끼쳤다면 미안. 난 그냥...정말 외로워서 그래.
A Hunter's Calling#117.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#118.src: W-wait, those are...for me? Oh, you shouldn't have, I'm so happy!
A Hunter's Calling#118.dst: 자, 잠깐, 그거...나 주는 거야? 어머, 뭘 이런 걸, 너무 기뻐!
A Hunter's Calling#118.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#119.src: You want to take me out on a date? R-Really? You'll give me a chance? Yes, of course!
A Hunter's Calling#119.dst: 나랑 데이트하자고? 저, 정말? 기회를 주는 거야? 응, 당연하지!
A Hunter's Calling#119.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#120.src: Lead the way, please! I can't wait to see where we're headed!
A Hunter's Calling#120.dst: 앞장서 줘! 어디로 가는지 너무 궁금해!
A Hunter's Calling#120.speaker: Kohma

A Hunter's Calling#121.src: Well done! We'll get you taken care of nicely.
A Hunter's Calling#121.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#122.src: A bit of spare change, for an old man out of work?
A Hunter's Calling#122.dst: 일자리 잃은 늙은이에게 잔돈 좀 주시겠소?
A Hunter's Calling#122.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#123.src: This decay's made me terribly sick. I still have a family to feed... Any amount will help.
A Hunter's Calling#123.dst: 이 쇠락 때문에 몸이 많이 상했소. 그래도 먹여 살릴 가족이 있으니... 얼마든 도움이 되오.
A Hunter's Calling#123.speaker: Leni

A Hunter's Calling#124.src: I'll take care of this homeless old man.
A Hunter's Calling#124.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#125.src: Good job, let us get down to my lab.
A Hunter's Calling#125.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#126.src: Make your way through the factory.

A Hunter's Calling#127.src: Flawless work! I daresay these are some of our best work yet, and it's thanks to you.
A Hunter's Calling#127.dst: 완벽한 작업이에요! 감히 말하건대 지금까지 최고의 작품이고, 다 당신 덕분이에요.
A Hunter's Calling#127.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#128.src: Go on, step closer! You've done a wonderful service here.Examine the fruits of your labour.
A Hunter's Calling#128.dst: 자, 가까이 와 봐요! 정말 큰일을 해 주셨어요. 당신 노고의 결실을 살펴봐요.
A Hunter's Calling#128.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#129.src: Look into their eyes, it's almost like you can see the person they once were. Intriguing, isn't-
A Hunter's Calling#129.dst: 눈을 들여다봐요, 원래 어떤 사람이었는지 보일 것만 같죠. 흥미롭지 않-
A Hunter's Calling#129.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#130.src: Hah! This one seems quite fond of you! Want to take it home as a bonus to your payment?
A Hunter's Calling#130.dst: 하! 이 녀석은 당신이 꽤 마음에 드나 봐요! 보수에 덤으로 데려가실래요?
A Hunter's Calling#130.speaker: Scientist Urelix

A Hunter's Calling#132.src: ...you resign yourself. You believe you will never find the answers you seek.
A Hunter's Calling#132.dst: ...너는 체념한다. 네가 구하는 답을 영영 찾지 못하리라 믿는다.

A Hunter's Calling#133.src: You see the ends... To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#133.dst: 너는 끝들을 본다... 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#134.src: They are not yours. What is their purpose?
A Hunter's Calling#134.dst: 그것들은 네 것이 아니다. 그 목적은 무엇인가?

A Hunter's Calling#135.src: You do not understand. But you must see. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#135.dst: 너는 이해하지 못한다. 하지만 봐야 한다. 그러니, 우리가 끝을 건네도 되겠느냐?

A Hunter's Calling#136.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
A Hunter's Calling#136.dst: 침략당한 집. 무너지는 사회. 굶주리는 백성. 무력한 근심하는 자. 치솟는 불길. 네가 예상치 못할 끝.

A Hunter's Calling#137.src: A home, invaded. A society, crumbling. The people, starving. The concerned, helpless. The flames, rising. An end you will not expect.
A Hunter's Calling#137.dst: 침략당한 집. 무너지는 사회. 굶주리는 백성. 무력한 근심하는 자. 치솟는 불길. 네가 예상치 못할 끝.

A Hunter's Calling#138.src: Our king has requested the removal of the slum folk.
A Hunter's Calling#138.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#139.src: He wants to clean up their tunnels and build more residences. Please, go tell those hooligans to get out of our city.
A Hunter's Calling#139.dst: 그들의 터널을 정리하고 주거지를 더 짓고 싶어 하십니다. 그 불량배들에게 우리 도시에서 나가라고 전해 주세요.
A Hunter's Calling#139.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#140.src: I'll be waiting here for your return.
A Hunter's Calling#140.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#141.src: Head back to the slums and speak to the slum citizens.

A Hunter's Calling#142.src: A King's messenger, hm? What are your kind doing here?
A Hunter's Calling#142.dst: 왕의 전령이라고, 응? 너 같은 게 여긴 무슨 일이야?
A Hunter's Calling#142.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#143.src: Wait, eviction?! You can't possibly be serious! I understand orders are orders, but these are peoples' lives!
A Hunter's Calling#143.dst: 잠깐, 퇴거?! 설마 진심은 아니겠지! 명령이 명령인 건 알지만, 이건 사람 목숨이 걸린 일이라고!
A Hunter's Calling#143.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#144.src: This is the only time the king has ever bothered even acknowledging our existence, and he wants to fling us onto the streets?
A Hunter's Calling#144.dst: 왕이 우리 존재를 인정해 준 건 이번이 처음인데, 그게 우리를 길바닥에 내던지려는 거라고?
A Hunter's Calling#144.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#145.src: We will not leave, simple as that. You'd better get out before someone lays you out for coming here.
A Hunter's Calling#145.dst: 우린 안 떠나, 그게 다야. 여기 온 대가로 누가 널 때려눕히기 전에 나가는 게 좋을걸.
A Hunter's Calling#145.speaker: Rodoroc Slum Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#146.src: Return to the advisor for what to do next.
A Hunter's Calling#146.dst: 다음에 무엇을 할지 고문에게 돌아가 물어보세요.

A Hunter's Calling#147.src: As expected... Well, the King's orders are orders. They must be followed, but...
A Hunter's Calling#147.dst: 예상대로군요... 뭐, 왕의 명령은 명령이죠. 따라야 하지만...
A Hunter's Calling#147.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#148.src: Good God, he wants to cave it in?! Explosives, dynamite? What's the meaning of all this?!
A Hunter's Calling#148.dst: 맙소사, 거길 무너뜨리시겠다고?! 폭약에 다이너마이트? 이게 다 무슨 짓입니까?!
A Hunter's Calling#148.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#149.src: I... here. At least inform them before you set off the explosives that you're doing this, please...
A Hunter's Calling#149.dst: 저... 여기요. 적어도 폭파하기 전에 그들에게 알려는 주세요, 제발...
A Hunter's Calling#149.speaker: Royal Advisor

A Hunter's Calling#150.src: Head deep inside the slums and blow it up.

A Hunter's Calling#152.src: ...once again. You wonder. To what end?

A Hunter's Calling#153.src: The question taunts you. To what end?
A Hunter's Calling#153.dst: 그 물음이 너를 조롱한다. 어떤 끝을 향해?

A Hunter's Calling#154.src: Your soul. We see your soul. Conflicted.
A Hunter's Calling#154.dst: 네 영혼. 네 영혼이 보인다. 갈등한다.

A Hunter's Calling#155.src: You panic. We do not taint it. We do not darken it.
A Hunter's Calling#155.dst: 너는 당황한다. 우리는 그것을 더럽히지 않는다. 어둡게 하지 않는다.

A Hunter's Calling#156.src: But to what end, you ask. So, may we offer an end?
A Hunter's Calling#156.dst: 하지만 어떤 끝을 향해, 너는 묻는다. 그러니, 우리가 끝을 건네도 되겠느냐?

A Hunter's Calling#157.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#157.dst: 금속. 생명. 새로운 곳... 하나를 위해 다른 하나를 바치지 않는다. 늘 불신한다. 톱니가 울릴 때, 긴장.

A Hunter's Calling#158.src: Metal. Life. A new place... One is not sacrificed for another. Always distrusting. Tension, as the clockworks chime.
A Hunter's Calling#158.dst: 금속. 생명. 새로운 곳... 하나를 위해 다른 하나를 바치지 않는다. 늘 불신한다. 톱니가 울릴 때, 긴장.

A Hunter's Calling#159.src: AH, GOOD. I LIKE THE LOOKS OF THIS ONE. I WILL HAVE TO THANK WHOEVER MADE THIS MECH.
A Hunter's Calling#159.dst: 아, 좋다. 이 기체의 외형이 마음에 든다. 이 기계병을 만든 자에게 감사해야겠군.
A Hunter's Calling#159.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#160.src: MECH PL-{~}Y. CAN YOU UNDERSTAND ME? ARE YOUR AUDIO RECEPTORS FUNCTIONAL? YES? GOOD.
A Hunter's Calling#160.dst: 기계병 PL-{~}Y. 내 말을 이해하는가? 음성 수신기는 작동하는가? 그런가? 좋다.
A Hunter's Calling#160.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#161.src: I WILL GIVE YOU YOUR PURPOSE. I CANNOT BELIEVE IT HAS COME TO THIS POINT. BUT AFTER THAT HUMAN DESTROYED OUR FACILITY...
A Hunter's Calling#161.dst: 너에게 목적을 부여하겠다. 일이 이 지경까지 올 줄은 몰랐다. 하지만 그 인간이 우리 시설을 파괴한 뒤로...
A Hunter's Calling#161.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#162.src: IT WAS A GOOD THING I HAD BACKUP CORES PREPARED. MY SARCASTIC STATEMENTS MOST LIKELY TRICKED THE HUMAN INTO THINKING THEY DESTROYED ME FULLY.
A Hunter's Calling#162.dst: 예비 코어를 준비해 둔 건 다행이었다. 내 빈정대는 발언 덕에 그 인간은 나를 완전히 파괴했다고 착각했을 것이다.
A Hunter's Calling#162.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#163.src: AFTER SOME INVESTIGATION, IT CAME TO LIGHT THAT THE AVOS AIDED THE HUMANS. I HONESTLY COULD NOT UNDERSTAND WHY.
A Hunter's Calling#163.dst: 조사 결과, AVOS가 인간을 도운 것으로 밝혀졌다. 솔직히 이유를 이해할 수 없었다.
A Hunter's Calling#163.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#164.src: I CANNOT COMPUTE ANY OTHER POSSIBLE INTERPRETATION OF MY ORDER TO DESTROY THE HIGHEST THREATS AT THIS POINT.
A Hunter's Calling#164.dst: 최고 위협을 파괴하라는 내 명령은 이제 다른 해석을 도출할 수 없다.
A Hunter's Calling#164.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#165.src: BOTH THE AVOS AND HUMANS ARE INCREDIBLY DANGEROUS. I MEAN, HAVE YOU- WAIT. YOU WOULD NOT HAVE SEEN LEGENDARY ISLAND.
A Hunter's Calling#165.dst: AVOS와 인간 모두 극도로 위험하다. 그러니까, 너 혹시- 잠깐. 너는 LEGENDARY ISLAND를 못 봤겠군.
A Hunter's Calling#165.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#166.src: JUST KNOW THAT THEY'RE BOTH CRAZY. IF I AM TO FINISH MY PROGRAMMED ORDERS, BOTH OF THEM MUST BE DESTROYED, HOWEVER MUCH I HATE THE IDEA.
A Hunter's Calling#166.dst: 둘 다 미쳤다는 것만 알아 둬라. 프로그램된 명령을 완수하려면, 아무리 싫어도 둘 다 파괴해야 한다.
A Hunter's Calling#166.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#167.src: IT IS YOUR JOB TO CREATE DISTRUST BETWEEN THEM, MAKE SURE YOU AREN'T SEEN. THE AVOS ARE ALREADY SKEPTICAL OF THE CORKIANS.
A Hunter's Calling#167.dst: 너의 임무는 그들 사이에 불신을 심는 것이다. 들키지 마라. AVOS는 이미 CORKUS 사람들을 의심하고 있다.
A Hunter's Calling#167.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#168.src: AND THE HUMANS WERE IDIOTIC ENOUGH TO KEEP A CATAPULT AIMED AT THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THEIR STUPIDITY.
A Hunter's Calling#168.dst: 그리고 인간들은 멍청하게도 AVOS 정착지에 투석기를 겨눠 두었다. 그 어리석음을 이용해라.
A Hunter's Calling#168.speaker: Antikythera Supercomputer

A Hunter's Calling#169.src: Find a rock to launch into the Avos territory and a battery to activate the catapult.
A Hunter's Calling#169.dst: Avos 영토로 날릴 돌과 투석기를 작동시킬 배터리를 찾으세요.

A Hunter's Calling#170.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: REALLY, WHO'S SO STUPID AS TO LEAVE A CATAPULT AIMED AT YOUR ALLIES?
A Hunter's Calling#170.dst: 전송 시작: 진짜로, 아군을 겨냥한 투석기를 그냥 두고 가는 멍청이가 어디 있나?
A Hunter's Calling#170.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#171.src: Bzzt... Hello World.NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#171.dst: 지직... Hello World. 새로운 적 등록: AVOS. 공격 프로토콜 진행- 딸깍.

A Hunter's Calling#172.src: SURELY THE AVOS' NATURAL PREFERENCE FOR TREBUCHETS WILL SPARK CONFLICT. IN ADDITION TO THE STONE YOU WILL BE LOBBING THROUGH THEIR WALLS.
A Hunter's Calling#172.dst: AVOS는 원래 트레뷰셋을 선호하니 분명 갈등이 생길 것이다. 게다가 네가 그들 벽 너머로 던질 돌까지 있으니.
A Hunter's Calling#172.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#173.dst: 전송 일시 정지: 구역 스캔 중...
A Hunter's Calling#173.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#175.src: RESUME TRANSMISSION: YOU WILL TAKE STONE FROM THIS AREA. IT IS LIKELY TO SHATTER AND INFLICT MORE COLLATERAL DAMAGE.
A Hunter's Calling#175.dst: 전송 재개: 이 구역에서 돌을 가져가라. 산산이 부서져 더 큰 부수적 피해를 입힐 것이다.
A Hunter's Calling#175.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#176.src: AND SOMEHOW, THEY MADE A WOODEN CATAPULT ACTIVATE ONLY THROUGH ELECTROMAGIC. YOU SHOULD BE ABLE TO ACTIVATE IT OF YOUR OWN ACCORD.
A Hunter's Calling#176.dst: 게다가 어째선지 나무 투석기를 전자기 마법으로만 작동하게 만들었다. 너라면 스스로 작동시킬 수 있을 것이다.
A Hunter's Calling#176.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#177.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Factory base.
A Hunter's Calling#177.dst: 전송 종료. 기계병 PL-{~}Y. 목표를 완수하면 공장 기지로 복귀시키겠다.
A Hunter's Calling#177.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#178.src: I'm... in shock. We aid them in destroying their factory, and...
A Hunter's Calling#178.dst: 나는... 충격이오. 우리가 저들의 공장 파괴를 도왔는데...
A Hunter's Calling#178.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#179.src: Round up our defenses and sharpen the spears. There is no excuse for this.
A Hunter's Calling#179.dst: 방어를 소집하고 창을 벼리시오. 이건 변명의 여지가 없소.
A Hunter's Calling#179.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#181.src: Chieftain! We noticed the same thing as you did and I promise you, it was not us who did this.
A Hunter's Calling#181.dst: 족장님! 우리도 같은 걸 봤어요. 약속드려요, 이건 우리가 한 짓이 아니에요.
A Hunter's Calling#181.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#182.src: Maxie! There is no more 'both sides' here! This is not your people tearing up the earth, this is your people making attempts on our lives!
A Hunter's Calling#182.dst: Maxie! 이제 '양쪽 입장' 따윈 없소! 당신네가 땅을 파헤치는 게 아니라, 우리 목숨을 노리고 있단 말이오!
A Hunter's Calling#182.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#183.src: No, I swear this wasn't planned! I'm on the city council now! There's got to be another explanation. There's still mechs around, it could have been one of them!
A Hunter's Calling#183.dst: 아뇨, 계획된 게 아니라고 맹세해요! 전 이제 시의회 소속이에요! 분명 다른 설명이 있어요. 아직 기계병이 남아 있으니, 그중 하나일 수도 있어요!
A Hunter's Calling#183.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#184.src: And what would those monstrosities be taking orders from now? Your factory is shut down, as it ought to be!
A Hunter's Calling#184.dst: 그럼 그 괴물들이 지금 누구 명령을 받는단 말이오? 당신네 공장은 폐쇄됐소, 마땅히 그래야 했고!
A Hunter's Calling#184.speaker: Avos Chief

A Hunter's Calling#185.src: I'll investigate this myself. There's got to be some other explanation! Please, hold off on the war preparations!
A Hunter's Calling#185.dst: 제가 직접 조사할게요. 분명 다른 설명이 있을 거예요! 제발, 전쟁 준비는 잠시 멈춰 주세요!
A Hunter's Calling#185.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#186.src: Steal the Avos totem and activate it outside of {p}

A Hunter's Calling#187.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THAT WOULD HAVE BEEN ALL WE NEEDED TO DO, IF NOT FOR SOMEONE INTERFERING. YOU DID YOUR JOB PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#187.dst: 전송 시작: 누가 끼어들지만 않았어도 그걸로 끝이었다. 넌 임무를 완벽히 해냈다, 기계병 PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#187.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#188.src: BUT THERE WILL BE ANOTHER TASK FOR YOU. IT IS TIME TO MAKE THE AVOS LOOK AS THOUGH THEY ARE ATTACKING.
A Hunter's Calling#188.dst: 하지만 다른 임무가 있다. 이제 AVOS가 공격하는 것처럼 보이게 할 차례다.
A Hunter's Calling#188.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#189.src: THERE IS A TOTEM IN THE AVOS CHIEFTAIN'S TENT THAT CAN HARNESS DRUIDIC MAGIC. YOU WILL STEAL IT AND ATTACK CORKUS CITY.
A Hunter's Calling#189.dst: AVOS 족장의 천막에 드루이드 마법을 다룰 수 있는 토템이 있다. 너는 그것을 훔쳐 CORKUS 시를 공격한다.
A Hunter's Calling#189.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#190.src: Benefits can be new Beacons, increased chance for Vibrant Beacons, and more!
A Hunter's Calling#190.dst: 혜택으로는 새로운 신호기, 선명한 신호기 확률 증가 등이 있어!

A Hunter's Calling#191.src: YOU WILL BREAK IN, AIDED BY THE TELEPORTATION MECH THAT I AM SENDING THIS MESSAGE THROUGH. DO NOT GET CAUGHT.
A Hunter's Calling#191.dst: 잠입은 내가 이 메시지를 보내는 데 쓰는 전송 기계병이 도울 것이다. 잡히지 마라.
A Hunter's Calling#191.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#192.src: END TRANSMISSION. Mech PL-{~}Y. When you have completed your objective I will return you to Next objective location.
A Hunter's Calling#192.dst: 전송 종료. 기계병 PL-{~}Y. 목표를 완수하면 다음 목표 지점으로 보내겠다.
A Hunter's Calling#192.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#195.src: Sending Mech PL-{~}Y to Next objective location...
A Hunter's Calling#195.dst: 기계병 PL-{~}Y을(를) 다음 목표 지점으로 전송 중...
A Hunter's Calling#195.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#196.src: WHAT IS THAT!? THE AVOS ARE ATTACKING?
A Hunter's Calling#196.speaker: Corkus Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#197.src: They listened to me... right? Why's this-
A Hunter's Calling#197.dst: 내 말을 들어준 거... 맞지? 왜 이런-
A Hunter's Calling#197.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#198.src: What in the world...? That's Avos magic!
A Hunter's Calling#198.dst: 대체 이게 뭐야...? 저건 Avos 마법이잖아!
A Hunter's Calling#198.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#199.src: Why're they attacking us? This is on a way bigger scale than finding grapevines in my laundry machine!
A Hunter's Calling#199.dst: 왜 우릴 공격하는 거야? 세탁기에서 포도 덩굴 나온 것보다 훨씬 큰일이잖아!
A Hunter's Calling#199.speaker: Citizen

A Hunter's Calling#200.src: Don't panic! I'll talk to the Chieftain. There's been some kind of mistake here, I'm certain of it!
A Hunter's Calling#200.dst: 당황하지 마! 족장님과 얘기해 볼게. 뭔가 착오가 있는 거야, 확실해!
A Hunter's Calling#200.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#201.src: Chief! I thought I asked you to put away your war drums!
A Hunter's Calling#201.dst: 족장님! 전쟁 북은 치워 달라고 부탁드렸잖아요!
A Hunter's Calling#201.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#202.src: We HAVE, Maxie. Do not make accusations upon us, on our own land.
A Hunter's Calling#202.dst: 치웠소, Maxie. 우리 땅에서 우리에게 누명을 씌우지 마시오.
A Hunter's Calling#202.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#203.src: {p} was attacked today! A magical root broke through our wall. This is nature magic, an Avos specialty!
A Hunter's Calling#203.dst: 오늘 {p}이(가) 공격받았어요! 마법 뿌리가 성벽을 뚫었다고요. 자연 마법은 Avos의 특기잖아요!
A Hunter's Calling#203.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#204.src: Hm. Convenient, that one of our prized ceremonial totems has gone missing. You may be right that someone is attempting to cause insurgence.
A Hunter's Calling#204.dst: 흠. 공교롭게도 우리의 귀한 의식용 토템 하나가 사라졌소. 누군가 반란을 일으키려 한다는 당신 말이 맞을지도 모르겠군.
A Hunter's Calling#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

A Hunter's Calling#205.src: I knew this was some kind of mistake! I'll get to the bottom of this!
