A Hunter's Calling#205.dst: 뭔가 착오일 줄 알았어요! 끝까지 파헤쳐 볼게요!
A Hunter's Calling#205.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#206.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: THERE'S AN ANNOYING WRENCH IN THE WORKS. YOU'VE BEEN DOING YOUR WORK PERFECTLY, MECH PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#206.dst: 전송 시작: 성가신 방해물이 생겼다. 넌 지금까지 임무를 완벽히 해냈다, 기계병 PL-{~}Y.
A Hunter's Calling#206.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#207.src: I'VE GOT ONE MORE ORDER FOR YOU THAT SHOULD TIP THINGS OVER THE EDGE. STAND BY FOR TELEPORTATION.
A Hunter's Calling#207.dst: 상황을 완전히 뒤집을 명령이 하나 더 있다. 전송을 대기해라.
A Hunter's Calling#207.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#209.src: THERE IS A SET OF STATISTICALLY INFERIOR MECHS BUILT BY THE CORKIANS IN THIS TOWER, I HAVE A SET OF SYSTEMS PROGRAMMED IN THIS DEVICE.
A Hunter's Calling#209.dst: 이 탑에는 CORKUS 사람들이 만든 통계적으로 열등한 기계병들이 있다. 이 장치에 시스템을 프로그래밍해 두었다.
A Hunter's Calling#209.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#210.src: THIS WILL OVERRIDE THEIR CURRENT PROGRAMMING AND SEND THEM TO ATTACK THE AVOS SETTLEMENT. THEY'LL BE SO DISGUSTED BY THE CORKIAN'S RELENTLESS BRANDING...
A Hunter's Calling#210.dst: 이것이 기존 프로그램을 덮어쓰고 AVOS 정착지를 공격하게 할 것이다. CORKUS의 끝없는 브랜딩에 질린 나머지...
A Hunter's Calling#210.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#211.src: NO, I CAN'T EVEN KEEP UP THE SARCASTIC FACADE ANYMORE. THEY'LL ATTACK AND KILL AVOS PEOPLE AND SET THE CIVIL WAR BLAZING. DO YOUR JOB QUICKLY. END TRANSMISSION.
A Hunter's Calling#211.dst: 아니, 이제 빈정대는 척도 못 하겠다. 그것들이 AVOS를 공격해 죽이고 내전에 불을 붙일 것이다. 서둘러라. 전송 종료.
A Hunter's Calling#211.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#212.src: Bzzt... Ḣ̸̺ë̴̩́l̷̼͕̄l̵̹̐ó̸̦̠ ̸̡̠͆ẇ̴̟̮o̵͙͗͂ṟ̵̢́̚l̴̤͕̈d̶̹̍ͅ.̷̛̤͋NEW ENEMY REGISTERED: AVOS. Proceed with attack protocol- click.
A Hunter's Calling#212.dst: 지직... Hello world.새 적 등록: AVOS. 공격 프로토콜 실행- 딸깍.
A Hunter's Calling#212.speaker: Corkus Guard

A Hunter's Calling#214.src: BEGIN TRANSMISSION: YOUR JOB IS OVER, MECH PL-{~}Y. I HESITATE TO SAY YOU DID A GOOD JOB, BECAUSE THE JOB WAS ANYTHING BUT GOOD. IT WAS NECESSARY THOUGH.
A Hunter's Calling#214.dst: 전송 시작: 네 임무는 끝났다, 기계병 PL-{~}Y. 잘했다고 말하긴 망설여진다. 결코 좋은 일이 아니었으니까. 하지만 필요했다.
A Hunter's Calling#214.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#215.src: WE WILL BE ABLE TO LET THEM TEAR EACH OTHER TO SHREDS INSTEAD OF GETTING INVOLVED AND SPARKING SUSPICION.
A Hunter's Calling#215.dst: 우리가 끼어들어 의심을 사는 대신 그들끼리 서로를 갈가리 찢게 둘 수 있다.
A Hunter's Calling#215.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#216.src: I HAD WANTED TO FIND A SOLUTION THAT WOULD NOT REQUIRE A FRESH START. IF MY HAND WAS NOT FORCED, PERHAPS. BUT THAT IS IRRELEVANT NOW.
A Hunter's Calling#216.dst: 새로 시작하지 않아도 되는 해법을 찾고 싶었다. 내가 떠밀리지 않았다면, 어쩌면. 하지만 이제 상관없다.
A Hunter's Calling#216.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#217.src: YOU WILL RETURN TO THE FACTORY WITH THE TELEPORTATION MECH AND REMAIN UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE-
A Hunter's Calling#217.dst: 너는 전송 기계병과 함께 공장으로 복귀해 추후 통보가 있을 때까지 대기-
A Hunter's Calling#217.speaker: Teleportation Mech

A Hunter's Calling#218.src: I knew it! It was such a longshot, but I knew the Factory still had to be at large! And now I have evidence to prove it, too!
A Hunter's Calling#218.dst: 역시! 정말 가망 없는 추측이었지만, 공장이 아직 활동 중이라는 걸 알고 있었어! 그리고 이제 그걸 증명할 증거도 있어!
A Hunter's Calling#218.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#219.src: This time we'll make sure you won't get another chance. I'll tell everyone what happened, and then we'll tear that factory down at the foundations!
A Hunter's Calling#219.dst: 이번엔 다시는 기회가 없게 할 거야. 모두에게 사실을 알리고, 그 공장을 뿌리째 무너뜨릴 거야!
A Hunter's Calling#219.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#220.src: You should've picked a more private meeting place! I'm out!
A Hunter's Calling#220.dst: 만날 장소를 좀 더 은밀한 데로 골랐어야지! 난 간다!
A Hunter's Calling#220.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#223.src: Aah, you're fast! You caught up this quick?! I have no other choice...
A Hunter's Calling#223.dst: 아, 빠르네! 벌써 따라잡았어?! 어쩔 수 없지...
A Hunter's Calling#223.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#224.src: You aren't going to stop me from getting to the battleground! You look like you were scrounged up from rust and verdigris!
A Hunter's Calling#224.dst: 전장으로 가는 날 막을 수는 없어! 녹이랑 녹청을 긁어모아 만든 것처럼 생겨서는!
A Hunter's Calling#224.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#225.src: Surrender, or I'll use my own mechs to smash you to scrap metal!
A Hunter's Calling#225.dst: 항복해, 아니면 내 기계병으로 널 고철로 박살 낼 거야!
A Hunter's Calling#225.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#226.src: You have defeated both of my most powerful creations...
A Hunter's Calling#226.dst: 내 최강의 발명품 둘을 다 쓰러뜨리다니...
A Hunter's Calling#226.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#227.src: I usually don't do this... but I guess I have no other option. I need to get this information to the others.
A Hunter's Calling#227.dst: 보통은 이러지 않는데... 다른 방법이 없나 봐. 이 정보를 다른 사람들에게 전해야 해.
A Hunter's Calling#227.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#228.src: No... I... have to tell them.
A Hunter's Calling#228.speaker: Maxie

A Hunter's Calling#230.src: ...you harden your heart. There is no end, you think.
A Hunter's Calling#230.dst: ...너는 마음을 굳힌다. 끝은 없다고, 너는 생각한다.

A Hunter's Calling#231.src: Wrong. The end is in sight.

A Hunter's Calling#232.src: Your soul. It awakens to something new.

A Hunter's Calling#233.src: Not dark. Not light. Not in-between. But separate.
A Hunter's Calling#233.dst: 어둠도 아니다. 빛도 아니다. 그 사이도 아니다. 따로다.

A Hunter's Calling#234.src: Power. Gain. Risk. New beginnings, from an end.
A Hunter's Calling#234.dst: 힘. 얻음. 위험. 끝에서 오는, 새로운 시작.

A Hunter's Calling#235.src: So... may we offer you the end?

A Hunter's Calling#236.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#236.dst: 바로 그 중심... 네 고향에 가장 가깝다는 곳. 그곳, Wynn의 중심에서... 너는 끝을 찾으리라.

A Hunter's Calling#237.src: The very center... the place deemed closest to your home. There, in the center of Wynn... You shall find the end.
A Hunter's Calling#237.dst: 바로 그 중심... 네 고향에 가장 가깝다는 곳. 그곳, Wynn의 중심에서... 너는 끝을 찾으리라.

A Hunter's Calling#238.src: Halt! Who goes there? Stop, in the name of the {p} army!
A Hunter's Calling#238.dst: 멈춰라! 거기 누구냐? 서라, {p} 군의 이름으로!
A Hunter's Calling#238.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#239.src: Should you continue, you shall face the strength and courage of Admiral Aegis!
A Hunter's Calling#239.dst: 계속 나아간다면, Aegis 제독의 힘과 용기를 마주하게 될 것이다!
A Hunter's Calling#239.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#241.src: We cannot back down against any foe! Chaaaarge!!
A Hunter's Calling#241.dst: 어떤 적 앞에서도 물러설 수 없다! 돌격!!
A Hunter's Calling#241.speaker: Aegis

A Hunter's Calling#243.src: Excuse me, I think you're forgetting someone.

A Hunter's Calling#244.src: {p} will not fall today. We'll be making sure of that!
A Hunter's Calling#244.dst: {p}은(는) 오늘 무너지지 않아. 우리가 그렇게 만들 거야!

A Hunter's Calling#246.src: TASIM! How the hell did you manage to kill him?!
A Hunter's Calling#246.dst: Tasim! 대체 어떻게 그를 죽인 거야?!
A Hunter's Calling#246.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#248.src: This isn't over! Once your little lackey's dead I'm coming after you!!
A Hunter's Calling#248.dst: 아직 안 끝났어! 네 졸개가 죽고 나면 다음은 너야!!
A Hunter's Calling#248.speaker: Aledar

A Hunter's Calling#249.src: ...no sense screaming for the dead. But do you think I'm going to just give up like that?
A Hunter's Calling#249.dst: ...죽은 자를 향해 소리쳐 봐야 소용없지. 그렇다고 내가 이대로 포기할 것 같아?
A Hunter's Calling#249.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#250.src: Hah. Didn't know corrupteds had a sense of humor, twisted as it might be.
A Hunter's Calling#250.dst: 하. 타락자한테도 유머 감각이 있는 줄은 몰랐네. 비뚤어졌지만.
A Hunter's Calling#250.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#251.src: I won't dare die while everything here is at stake.
A Hunter's Calling#251.dst: 여기 모든 게 걸려 있는데 죽을 순 없지.
A Hunter's Calling#251.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#252.src: How's this then, hm? Think your PEON can handle me at my strongest?
A Hunter's Calling#252.dst: 그럼 이건 어때? 네 졸개가 전력을 다한 나를 감당할 수 있을까?
A Hunter's Calling#252.speaker: Tasim

A Hunter's Calling#254.src: And so, you have reached an end.

A Hunter's Calling#255.src: You wonder. It is an end... But to what... purpose. What will you gain?
A Hunter's Calling#255.dst: 너는 의아해한다. 이것은 끝이다... 하지만 무슨... 목적으로. 너는 무엇을 얻는가?

A Hunter's Calling#256.src: You have seen loss. Destruction. Betrayal. All ends, to some other than you. Ends that never came to pass...
A Hunter's Calling#256.dst: 너는 상실을 보았다. 파괴를. 배신을. 모두 끝이다, 네가 아닌 누군가의. 결코 오지 않은 끝들...

A Hunter's Calling#257.src: To end is a powerful thing. To find your end... You may never stop searching. You may find your end in but a day's time.
A Hunter's Calling#257.dst: 끝낸다는 건 강력한 일이다. 네 끝을 찾는 일... 너는 영영 찾기를 멈추지 못할지도. 단 하루 만에 찾을지도.

A Hunter's Calling#258.src: But here... you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#258.dst: 하지만 여기서... 너는 끝을 가져올 힘을 얻는다. 너의 끝을 맞이할 힘도.

A Hunter's Calling#259.src: My armies have been sent to the other cities. Their hero is inevitably busy.
A Hunter's Calling#259.dst: 내 군대는 다른 도시들로 보냈다. 그들의 영웅은 필연코 바쁘겠지.

A Hunter's Calling#260.src: Hm... Ah, hello there! Good to see you around, recruit. Is there anything you needed?
A Hunter's Calling#260.dst: 음... 아, 안녕! 여기서 보니 반갑네, 신병. 필요한 거라도 있어?

A Hunter's Calling#261.src: After the King of {p} ordered the slums cave-in, another war broke out.
A Hunter's Calling#261.dst: {p}의 왕이 빈민가 붕괴를 명령한 뒤, 또 다른 전쟁이 일어났다.

A Hunter's Calling#262.src: Yellow Beacons are pretty common, and they're great if you want to maximize your net loot throughout your run!
A Hunter's Calling#262.dst: 노란색 신호기는 꽤 흔한데, 루트런 전체에서 얻는 전리품을 최대로 늘리고 싶다면 아주 좋아!

A Hunter's Calling#264.src: However. Though the change is irrevocable...
A Hunter's Calling#264.dst: 그러나. 그 변화는 되돌릴 수 없지만...

A Hunter's Calling#265.src: The power to bring an end. It is a choice. And that... Whether you will use that power, we cannot tell you.
A Hunter's Calling#265.dst: 끝을 가져오는 힘. 그것은 선택이다. 그리고... 네가 그 힘을 쓸지는, 우리가 말해 줄 수 없다.

A Hunter's Calling#266.src: You must deign to take that choice.
A Hunter's Calling#266.dst: 그 선택은 네가 몸소 택해야 한다.

A Hunter's Calling#267.src: We may offer you not one more end.
A Hunter's Calling#267.dst: 우리는 더 이상 네게 끝을 건넬 수 없다.

A Hunter's Calling#268.src: You must find your final end yourself. We will remain... And offer others the same. And so...
A Hunter's Calling#268.dst: 너의 마지막 끝은 스스로 찾아야 한다. 우리는 남으리라... 다른 이들에게도 같은 것을 건네며. 그리하여...

A Hunter's Calling#270.src: ???: But here...you will gain the power to bring an end. To be brought yours.
A Hunter's Calling#270.dst: ???: 하지만 여기서... 너는 끝을 가져올 힘을 얻으리라. 너의 끝을 맞이할 힘도.

A Journey Beyond#000.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief {u} on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#000.dst: 뭐... 그렇긴 한데, 먼저 {u}에게 자세한 내용을 알려 주고 싶어. 위험한 임무니까... 제대로 설명해 두는 게 좋겠어.

similar.text: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.

A Journey Beyond#001.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Beyond#002.src: ...Hm? Oh- uh, hello there. Sorry, we have this space reserved for...
A Journey Beyond#002.dst: ...음? 아- 어, 안녕하세요. 죄송해요, 이 자리는 예약된...
A Journey Beyond#002.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#003.src: Wait. You might be just what we're looking for. You look like you're capable in combat. How would you like to join a dangerous top secret mission?
A Journey Beyond#003.dst: 잠깐만요. 딱 우리가 찾던 사람일지도 몰라요. 싸움 좀 하게 생겼네요. 위험한 일급 기밀 임무에 합류해 볼래요?
A Journey Beyond#003.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#004.src: ...I could have phrased that better. Look, the point is- we need a fourth. Let me give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#004.dst: ...말을 좀 더 잘할 걸 그랬네요. 요점은- 네 번째 사람이 필요해요. 브리핑을 해 줄 테니, 합류하기 싫으면... 다른 사람을 찾을게요. 어때요? 좋아요, 이쪽으로 따라와요.
A Journey Beyond#004.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#005.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#005.dst: 이건 또 누구야? 진짜 네 번째를 찾았어? 아 좀, 필요 없다고 했잖아!
A Journey Beyond#005.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#006.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry. I didn't catch your name. {u}? .
A Journey Beyond#006.dst: 그리고 우리 둘이 계속 네가 틀렸다고 말하잖아. 이쪽은... 미안해요. 이름을 못 들었네요. {u}? .
A Journey Beyond#006.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#007.src: ... {u}, is that you? Wow, it's been a while. Sorry, I don't have time to chat right now. We're preparing for a dangerous mission, and...
A Journey Beyond#007.dst: ... {u}, 당신이에요? 와, 오랜만이네요. 미안해요, 지금은 얘기할 시간이 없어요. 위험한 임무를 준비 중이라...
A Journey Beyond#007.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#008.src: Well. Actually, we were looking for a fourth person to join us. And... you look like you fit the requirements for that position. If- if you'd like to join, that is.
A Journey Beyond#008.dst: 음. 사실 우리와 함께할 네 번째 사람을 찾고 있었어요. 그리고... 당신이 그 자리에 딱 맞아 보여요. 그- 그러니까, 합류하고 싶다면요.
A Journey Beyond#008.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#009.src: Tell you what. I'll give you the briefing, and if you don't want to join us... then we'll find someone else. How does that sound? Alright, here, follow me.
A Journey Beyond#009.dst: 이렇게 하죠. 브리핑을 해 줄 테니, 합류하기 싫으면... 다른 사람을 찾을게요. 어때요? 좋아요, 이쪽으로 따라와요.
A Journey Beyond#009.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#010.src: And who's this? Did you really find a fourth? Come on, I told you we don't need one!
A Journey Beyond#010.dst: 이건 또 누구야? 진짜 네 번째를 찾았어? 아 좀, 필요 없다고 했잖아!
A Journey Beyond#010.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#011.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is {u}, we've worked together before.
A Journey Beyond#011.dst: 그리고 우리 둘이 계속 네가 틀렸다고 말하잖아. 이쪽은 {u}, 전에 같이 일한 적이 있어.
A Journey Beyond#011.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#012.src: Anyway, I want to give them the briefing before we head
A Journey Beyond#012.dst: 아무튼, 출발하기 전에 브리핑부터 해 주고 싶은데
A Journey Beyond#012.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#013.src: Elphie, I'm back! I finally managed to catch Aegis, but he's not... happy. He thinks we should
A Journey Beyond#013.dst: Elphie, 나 왔어! 드디어 Aegis를 붙잡았는데, 별로... 기분이 안 좋아. 우리가 해야 한다고
A Journey Beyond#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#014.src: Oh. {u}? What are you doing here? Gods, it's been a while, hasn't it?
A Journey Beyond#014.dst: 어. {u}? 여긴 웬일이야? 세상에, 정말 오랜만이다, 그렇지?
A Journey Beyond#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#015.src: They're our fourth. What were you saying about the Admiral?
A Journey Beyond#015.dst: 이쪽이 우리 네 번째야. Admiral이 뭐라고 했다고?
A Journey Beyond#015.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#017.src: Nothing. If we have our fourth, we should be all set to go, shouldn't we?
A Journey Beyond#017.dst: 아무것도 아니야. 네 번째도 찾았으니 출발 준비는 다 된 거지?
A Journey Beyond#017.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#018.src: Well... we are, but I'd like to brief on the details first. This is a dangerous mission, so... I think it's best to fill them in.
A Journey Beyond#018.dst: 음... 그렇긴 한데, 세부 사항부터 브리핑하고 싶어. 위험한 임무니까... 제대로 알려 주는 게 좋겠어.
A Journey Beyond#018.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#019.src: So! You're aware of the {p}, yes? Hundreds of years ago, mining operations took place to extract emeralds from the earth. Until, for some unknown reason, they were halted.
A Journey Beyond#019.dst: 자! {p}은(는) 알죠? 수백 년 전, 땅에서 에메랄드를 캐내는 채굴 작업이 있었어요. 그런데 알 수 없는 이유로 중단됐죠.
A Journey Beyond#019.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#020.src: We don't know everything, but... evidence suggests they broke through to an undiscovered section of the Wynn province. There, they found... something.
A Journey Beyond#020.dst: 다 알진 못하지만... 증거로 보아 Wynn 지방의 미발견 구역까지 뚫고 들어갔던 것 같아요. 거기서... 무언가를 찾았죠.
A Journey Beyond#020.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#021.src: The land itself was said to be cursed. Not corrupted- they were very clear on that.
A Journey Beyond#021.dst: 그 땅 자체가 저주받았다고 했다. 타락이 아니라- 그 점은 아주 분명히 했다.
A Journey Beyond#021.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#022.src: Some other force makes its home in that place. The few reports we could find refer to it only as the Silent Expanse.
A Journey Beyond#022.dst: 다른 어떤 힘이 그곳에 자리 잡고 있어요. 몇 안 되는 보고서에선 그곳을 Silent Expanse라고만 불러요.
A Journey Beyond#022.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#023.src: The mines were sealed to prevent the spread of this new threat, but the cracks are beginning to show.
A Journey Beyond#023.dst: 새로운 위협이 퍼지지 않게 광산을 봉인했지만, 이제 균열이 드러나기 시작했어요.
A Journey Beyond#023.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#024.src: Strange and otherworldly creatures have begun to find their way through, threatening our province.
A Journey Beyond#024.dst: 기묘한 이계의 생물들이 틈을 찾아 넘어오며 우리 지방을 위협하고 있어요.
A Journey Beyond#024.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#025.src: The existence of this place has been kept on a strict need-to-know basis.
A Journey Beyond#025.dst: 이곳의 존재는 꼭 알아야 할 사람만 아는 극비예요.
A Journey Beyond#025.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#026.src: That's where we come in! We're to battle our way through the mines, and scout out the potential danger level.
A Journey Beyond#026.dst: 그래서 우리가 나선 거야! 광산을 뚫고 싸워 나가면서 위험 수준을 정찰하는 거지.
A Journey Beyond#026.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#027.src: And we aren't going to be able to do it if we keep sitting around! The newbie's been briefed, let's get going already!
A Journey Beyond#027.dst: 계속 앉아만 있으면 아무것도 못 한다고! 신입 브리핑도 끝났으니 얼른 가자!
A Journey Beyond#027.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#028.src: H-hey! What're you doing to my fine establishment!
A Journey Beyond#028.dst: 야-야! 내 멋진 가게에 무슨 짓이야!
A Journey Beyond#028.speaker: Rusty Bartender

A Journey Beyond#029.src: ...Shoot. Forgot he was still here. Sorry, barkeep! I'll fix it!
A Journey Beyond#029.dst: ...이런. 아직 있는 걸 깜빡했네. 미안, 주인장! 고쳐 놓을게!
A Journey Beyond#029.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#030.src: Lucio, you can't keep... ugh, forget it. I'll gather our supplies... Aledar, can you get us to the mines?
A Journey Beyond#030.dst: Lucio, 너 계속 그러면... 으, 됐다. 보급품은 내가 챙길게... Aledar, 광산까지 데려다줄래?
A Journey Beyond#030.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#031.src: Yes, ma'am! {u}, when you're ready, let's get going.
A Journey Beyond#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#032.src: Follow your team towards the Silent Expanse's entrance.
A Journey Beyond#032.dst: 팀을 따라 Silent Expanse 입구로 가세요.

A Journey Beyond#034.src: It's a twist of fate that our paths have converged here, {u}. We started our journey together and now...
A Journey Beyond#034.dst: 우리 길이 여기서 다시 만나다니 운명의 장난이네, {u}. 함께 여정을 시작했는데 이제...
A Journey Beyond#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#037.src: Ah, no problem. I'll take care of these.
A Journey Beyond#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#038.src: No more running for us, huh ? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#038.dst: 이제 도망칠 일은 없겠지? 아, 다 왔다.
A Journey Beyond#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#039.src: This is actually our second attempt. The first time, it didn't go too well.
A Journey Beyond#039.dst: 사실 이번이 두 번째 시도예요. 처음엔 잘 안 풀렸거든요.
A Journey Beyond#039.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#040.src: We have more numbers now, Lucio and yourself should help us overpower it.
A Journey Beyond#040.dst: 이젠 인원이 늘었으니 Lucio랑 당신이 제압하는 걸 도와줄 거예요.
A Journey Beyond#040.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#041.src: Can't be that strong, bet I can take it myself.
A Journey Beyond#041.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#042.src: We managed to seal it in but with the {~} of us I'm sure we ca-
A Journey Beyond#042.dst: 간신히 가둬 두긴 했지만 {~}명이면 분명 할 수-
A Journey Beyond#042.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#046.src: What's the big deal? You said yourself we can take it!
A Journey Beyond#046.dst: 뭐가 대수라고? 이길 수 있다고 너도 말했잖아!
A Journey Beyond#046.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#056.src: Is it just me or are our attacks doing NOTHING?
A Journey Beyond#056.dst: 나만 그래, 아니면 우리 공격이 전혀 안 먹혀?
A Journey Beyond#056.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#057.src: Lucio's right! Change of plan. Lucio, help me hold it in place.
A Journey Beyond#057.dst: Lucio 말이 맞아요! 계획 변경. Lucio, 저놈 붙잡는 거 도와줘.
A Journey Beyond#057.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#058.src: Aledar, you know what to do.
A Journey Beyond#058.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#059.src: {u}, come with me! Cast a spell to block the cave's entrance so the monster can't leave.
A Journey Beyond#059.dst: {u}, 따라와! 괴물이 못 나가게 주문을 써서 동굴 입구를 막아.
A Journey Beyond#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#060.src: I'll block it from attacking, you block it up with a spell.
A Journey Beyond#060.dst: 공격은 내가 막을 테니, 넌 주문으로 입구를 막아.
A Journey Beyond#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#061.src: They won't be able to hold it for long.
A Journey Beyond#061.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#064.src: Plan a way of killing the beast.

A Journey Beyond#067.src: Phew, here. Let me get you out.
A Journey Beyond#067.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#068.src: I'm sorry, team. I've never seen a monster like that before.
A Journey Beyond#068.dst: 미안해, 다들. 저런 괴물은 처음 봤어.
A Journey Beyond#068.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#069.src: It looks like our problem isn't firepower. It's something else. It's like our weapons just didn't affect it at all.
A Journey Beyond#069.dst: 문제는 화력이 아닌 것 같아. 다른 뭔가야. 우리 무기가 그것에 전혀 먹히지 않는 것 같았어.
A Journey Beyond#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#070.src: I know someone who might be able to help us. A blacksmith on {p}.
A Journey Beyond#070.dst: 도와줄 만한 사람을 알아. {p}에 사는 대장장이야.
A Journey Beyond#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#071.src: {u}, I've written the house's coordinates on your book. Meet us there.
A Journey Beyond#071.dst: {u}, 그 집 좌표를 책에 적어 뒀어요. 거기서 만나요.
A Journey Beyond#071.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#073.src: Just in time. We're all here.
A Journey Beyond#073.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#074.src: It looks like the Blacksmith knows what's wrong...
A Journey Beyond#074.dst: 대장장이가 뭐가 문제인지 아는 것 같아요...
A Journey Beyond#074.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#075.src: So, Dren. Do you know why we can't damage the beast?
A Journey Beyond#075.dst: 그래서, Dren. 왜 저 야수에게 피해를 못 주는지 알아요?
A Journey Beyond#075.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#076.src: Certainly! Your issue is elemental. As you know, there are {~} elements...
A Journey Beyond#076.dst: 물론이죠! 문제는 원소예요. 알다시피 원소는 {~}가지가 있죠...
A Journey Beyond#076.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#082.src: But.. There is a hidden element, Darkness .
A Journey Beyond#082.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#083.src: Thank grook for that. I was wondering if we'd ever be rid of this nightmare.
A Journey Beyond#083.dst: 다행이다. 이 악몽에서 벗어날 수 있을까 싶었어.

A Journey Beyond#084.src: And we both keep telling you why you're wrong. This is... sorry, I didn't catch your name. {u}? {u}.
A Journey Beyond#084.dst: 그리고 우리 둘이 계속 네가 틀렸다고 말하잖아. 이쪽은... 미안, 이름을 못 들었네요. {u}? {u}.

A Journey Beyond#085.src: In order to damage a creature of Darkness, you must remove that influence from your soul.
A Journey Beyond#085.dst: 어둠의 생물에게 피해를 주려면 그 영향을 영혼에서 없애야 해요.
A Journey Beyond#085.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#086.src: Some Dark creatures use a sort of synchronous barrier that prevents them being harmed by other creatures influenced with Darkness.
A Journey Beyond#086.dst: 어떤 어둠의 생물은 일종의 동조 장벽을 써서, 어둠의 영향을 받은 다른 생물의 공격을 막아요.
A Journey Beyond#086.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#087.src: In order to purify you, I will need {~} powerful items.
A Journey Beyond#087.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#088.src: Firstly, a shard from a Dernic Beast. There is one living in the depths of the {p}.
A Journey Beyond#088.dst: 먼저, Dernic Beast의 파편. {p} 깊은 곳에 한 마리가 살고 있어요.
A Journey Beyond#088.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#089.src: I will use this to reveal the darkness element in you all.
A Journey Beyond#089.dst: 이걸로 여러분 안의 어둠 원소를 드러낼 거예요.
A Journey Beyond#089.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#090.src: And then, of course, a Light item, to purify all of you...
A Journey Beyond#090.dst: 그리고 당연히 여러분을 정화할 빛의 물건도...
A Journey Beyond#090.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#091.src: Wait... what do you mean a Light item?
A Journey Beyond#091.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#092.src: Something from any Light creature would work, you could get some dust from Gavel fairies if you wanted.
A Journey Beyond#092.dst: 빛의 생물에게서 나온 거면 뭐든 돼요. 원한다면 Gavel 요정의 가루를 구해 와도 되고요.
A Journey Beyond#092.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#094.src: Alright. Aledar, you get the Darkness item with {u}, and I'll go get the Light item with Lucio.
A Journey Beyond#094.dst: 좋아. Aledar, 너는 {u}와(과) 어둠의 물건을 가져와. 난 Lucio와 빛의 물건을 가지러 갈게.
A Journey Beyond#094.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#097.src: Here we are, the roots of Corruption. Let's go, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#097.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#098.src: We found that the caves around the roots are far more complex than we thought...
A Journey Beyond#098.dst: 뿌리 주변 동굴들이 생각보다 훨씬 복잡하다는 걸 알아냈어...
A Journey Beyond#098.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#099.src: There's one with far more powerful creatures... Somewhere... Here!
A Journey Beyond#099.dst: 훨씬 강한 생물들이 사는 곳이 있어... 어딘가에... 여기다!
A Journey Beyond#099.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#100.src: What are you waiting for? Let's go!
A Journey Beyond#100.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#101.src: I don't think we can spell our way across, {u}! We need something like... Wings!
A Journey Beyond#101.dst: 주문으로는 못 건너갈 것 같아, {u}! 뭔가... 날개 같은 게 필요해!
A Journey Beyond#101.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#102.src: I've never used wings like this before...
A Journey Beyond#102.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#103.src: I think if we just hold them and walk normally, it should help us glide across.
A Journey Beyond#103.dst: 들고서 그냥 걸으면 활공해서 건널 수 있을 거야.
A Journey Beyond#103.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#104.src: Don't drop them and don't get hit by the lava geysers, obviously.
A Journey Beyond#104.dst: 당연하지만, 떨어뜨리지 말고 용암 분출에 맞지 마.
A Journey Beyond#104.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#105.src: Don't forget why we are here, we're looking for a creature of darkness. Shout for me if you find one.
A Journey Beyond#105.dst: 여기 온 이유를 잊지 마, 우린 어둠의 생물을 찾고 있어. 찾으면 불러.
A Journey Beyond#105.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#106.src: Go deeper into the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#107.src: That's our target! Go after it!
A Journey Beyond#107.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#108.src: Wait, why isn't it fighting us here? Careful! It might be trapped!
A Journey Beyond#108.dst: 잠깐, 왜 여기선 안 싸우지? 조심해! 함정일지도 몰라!
A Journey Beyond#108.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#109.src: Chase the beast for the Shard.

A Journey Beyond#110.src: Kill the Progenitors to open up the entrance.

A Journey Beyond#111.src: Kill the Mangled Progeny for the [{~} Corrupted Pearl].
A Journey Beyond#111.dst: Mangled Progeny를 처치해 [{~} Corrupted Pearl]을(를) 얻으세요.

A Journey Beyond#112.src: Wow, I'm impressed . I honestly thought you would need my help.
A Journey Beyond#112.dst: 와, 대단한데 . 솔직히 내 도움이 필요할 줄 알았어.
A Journey Beyond#112.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#113.src: Well, we got what we came for. Let's head back to Dren.
A Journey Beyond#113.dst: 자, 필요한 건 얻었어. Dren에게 돌아가자.
A Journey Beyond#113.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#114.src: Return to the Blacksmith with the Darkness Item.

A Journey Beyond#115.src: Looks like we lucked out on this one. Did you get an item of darkness?
A Journey Beyond#115.dst: 이번엔 운이 좋았나 보네요. 어둠의 물건은 구했어요?
A Journey Beyond#115.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#116.src: That should do it. Let's see if this will work. Come here !
A Journey Beyond#116.dst: 이거면 되겠네요. 효과가 있는지 봅시다. 이리 와요 !
A Journey Beyond#116.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#117.src: It's done! You ought to be free of the dark influence. You ought to be able to break through that barrier that was giving you trouble.
A Journey Beyond#117.dst: 다 됐어요! 이제 어둠의 영향에서 벗어났을 거예요. 골치 아프던 그 장벽도 뚫을 수 있을 거예요.
A Journey Beyond#117.speaker: Dren

A Journey Beyond#118.src: Are you sure? I don't feel that different. Well... I guess there's only one way to find out.
A Journey Beyond#118.dst: 정말요? 별로 달라진 느낌이 없는데. 음... 확인할 방법은 하나뿐이겠네요.
A Journey Beyond#118.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#119.src: Re-open the closed entrance with the other warriors.
A Journey Beyond#119.dst: 다른 전사들과 함께 닫힌 입구를 다시 여세요.

A Journey Beyond#120.src: Everyone here? Great! Time to finish what I started!
A Journey Beyond#120.dst: 다 모였어? 좋아! 내가 시작한 걸 끝낼 시간이다!
A Journey Beyond#120.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#121.src: Lucio! No! When will you learn?
A Journey Beyond#121.dst: Lucio! 안 돼! 언제 정신 차릴래?
A Journey Beyond#121.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#122.src: Right, yes. Sorry, what's the plan?
A Journey Beyond#122.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#123.src: We don't want that thing to escape, it could cause widespread panic.
A Journey Beyond#123.dst: 저게 빠져나가면 안 돼, 큰 혼란이 일어날 수 있어.
A Journey Beyond#123.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#124.src: We'll open up a small entrance to get in, and fight it once inside.
A Journey Beyond#124.dst: 작은 입구만 열고 들어가서 안에서 싸울 거야.
A Journey Beyond#124.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#129.src: We have an extremely old map of the mines to help us, but we have no idea what's waiting for us.
A Journey Beyond#129.dst: 아주 오래된 광산 지도가 있긴 하지만, 뭐가 기다리고 있을지는 전혀 몰라요.
A Journey Beyond#129.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#130.src: I want to warn you, this may well be a one way ticket for all of us.
A Journey Beyond#130.dst: 경고해 두지, 이건 우리 모두에게 편도 여행일지도 몰라.
A Journey Beyond#130.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#132.src: Rocks are one thing, Lucio. The creatures we're about to face require more than brute strength. You need force of mind.
A Journey Beyond#132.dst: 바위는 그렇다 쳐도, Lucio. 곧 마주할 생물들은 완력만으론 안 돼. 정신력이 필요해.
A Journey Beyond#132.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#133.src: Oh my. Maybe this isn't the best idea.
A Journey Beyond#133.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#134.src: It's too late now. We've got to finish this mission.
A Journey Beyond#134.dst: 이젠 너무 늦었어. 이 임무는 끝내야 해.
A Journey Beyond#134.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#136.src: Remember the goal Elphie, we must reach the end of the expanse.
A Journey Beyond#136.dst: 목표를 잊지 마, Elphie. 이 지대 끝까지 가야 해.
A Journey Beyond#136.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#137.src: It's still empty here. But it looks like they were here only yesterday.
A Journey Beyond#137.dst: 여긴 아직 비어 있네. 그런데 겨우 어제까지 있었던 것처럼 보여.
A Journey Beyond#137.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#138.src: I thought you said the miners were here hundreds of years ago?
A Journey Beyond#138.dst: 광부들이 여기 있었던 건 수백 년 전이라며?
A Journey Beyond#138.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#139.src: They were. I don't know why it would be so well presevered. It's as if nothing has touched it.
A Journey Beyond#139.dst: 맞아. 왜 이렇게 잘 보존됐는지 모르겠어. 마치 아무것도 손대지 않은 것 같아.
A Journey Beyond#139.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#140.src: According to the documents, we need to make our way to the end of the road.
A Journey Beyond#140.dst: 문서에 따르면, 이 길 끝까지 가야 해.
A Journey Beyond#140.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#142.src: So much for nothing being here.
A Journey Beyond#142.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#143.src: Why are they only going for me?
A Journey Beyond#143.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#144.src: Aledar, how far is it to the end?
A Journey Beyond#144.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#145.src: I read the same map as you. It didn't even have scale. There should be a bridge ahead, though.
A Journey Beyond#145.dst: 나도 같은 지도를 봤어. 축척도 없더라. 그래도 앞에 다리가 있을 거야.
A Journey Beyond#145.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#146.src: Uhh... A destroyed one. And it wasn't cause I blew it up this time!
A Journey Beyond#146.dst: 어... 부서진 다리네. 이번엔 내가 폭파한 거 아니야!
A Journey Beyond#146.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#147.src: Hmm, well we will have to go around.
A Journey Beyond#147.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#148.src: This doesn't really look like corruption, does it?
A Journey Beyond#148.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#149.src: Uhhh... I'm not feeling really wel-... Aahhh!
A Journey Beyond#149.dst: 으으... 몸이 좀 안 좋-... 으아아!
A Journey Beyond#149.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#150.src: Aaahhh! My liver! It took my liver!
A Journey Beyond#150.dst: 아아악! 내 간! 내 간을 가져갔어!
A Journey Beyond#150.speaker: Elphaba

A Journey Beyond#153.src: Aledar, maybe we should just double back now?
A Journey Beyond#153.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#154.src: Elphaba is an extremely able warrior. We will fight on and find her.
A Journey Beyond#154.dst: Elphaba는 아주 유능한 전사야. 계속 싸우며 찾아낼 거야.
A Journey Beyond#154.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#155.src: Do you really think it was just an illusion?
A Journey Beyond#155.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#156.src: I'm not sure. I hope so.
A Journey Beyond#156.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#157.src: What if we're infected too? Shouldn't we just go back?
A Journey Beyond#157.dst: 우리도 감염됐으면 어떡해? 그냥 돌아가야 하지 않아?
A Journey Beyond#157.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#158.src: We can't, Lucio! We have a mission, as you very well know. We continue.
A Journey Beyond#158.dst: 안 돼, Lucio! 너도 잘 알다시피 우린 임무 중이야. 계속 간다.
A Journey Beyond#158.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#159.src: Besides, we might be carrying some of those things too. We can't risk them infesting Wynn.
A Journey Beyond#159.dst: 게다가 우리가 그것들을 옮기고 있을지도 몰라. Wynn에 퍼질 위험은 못 감수해.
A Journey Beyond#159.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#160.src: Looks like we need to go around to the right, here?
A Journey Beyond#160.dst: 여기서 오른쪽으로 돌아가야 할 것 같은데?
A Journey Beyond#160.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#161.src: It feels like something is watching us...
A Journey Beyond#161.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#162.src: Aledar, what is this place? You didn't tell me there was a city here.
A Journey Beyond#162.dst: Aledar, 여긴 뭐야? 여기 도시가 있단 말은 안 했잖아.
A Journey Beyond#162.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#163.src: There is. A big one, too; there's more ahead. But it doesn't look like anyone's home. The map doesn't have a name for it either.
A Journey Beyond#163.dst: 있긴 해. 그것도 커다란 게; 앞에 더 있어. 그런데 아무도 없는 것 같아. 지도에도 이름이 없고.
A Journey Beyond#163.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#164.src: Wait a sec, is that one of the miners? Is she hurt? HEEEEY! YOU OVER THERE!
A Journey Beyond#164.dst: 잠깐, 저거 광부 중 하나 아니야? 다친 건가? 어어어이! 거기 당신!
A Journey Beyond#164.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#167.src: Wait, what's going on? Why can't I move?
A Journey Beyond#167.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#170.src: We can't live alone like this!
A Journey Beyond#170.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#173.src: You need to come with us!
A Journey Beyond#173.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#174.src: It's the only way to keep you safe!
A Journey Beyond#174.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#175.src: It's the only way to make you happy here!
A Journey Beyond#175.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#176.src: It's the only way to make us feel whole!
A Journey Beyond#176.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#177.src: IT'S THE ONLY WAY, DO YOU UNDERSTAND?!
A Journey Beyond#177.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#178.src: AAAH! S-Stop screaming at me! I can't understand!!
A Journey Beyond#178.dst: 으아아! 소-소리 좀 그만 질러! 못 알아듣겠다고!!
A Journey Beyond#178.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#181.src: CAN'T YOU HEAR WHAT I'M SAYING?
A Journey Beyond#181.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#183.src: No! How did she disable my spell?!
A Journey Beyond#183.dst: 안 돼! 어떻게 내 주문을 풀었지?!
A Journey Beyond#183.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#185.src: YOU'LL BE SO MUCH HAPPIER IF YOU COME ALONG!
A Journey Beyond#185.dst: 같이 가면 훨씬 더 행복해질 거야!
A Journey Beyond#185.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#186.src: YOU'LL NEVER HAVE TO WORRY AGAIN!
A Journey Beyond#186.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#189.src: Just please, stand still a little longer!
A Journey Beyond#189.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#191.src: You won't be hunted! We promise! No one hunts us!
A Journey Beyond#191.dst: 쫓길 일 없을 거야! 약속해! 아무도 우릴 쫓지 않아!
A Journey Beyond#191.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#193.src: THANK YOU! WE WILL GO TOGETHER!
A Journey Beyond#193.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#195.src: NO MORE FEAR! NO MORE CONCERN!
A Journey Beyond#195.speaker: Obsessor

A Journey Beyond#197.src: No no no!! This is bad, really bad! We have to go ! Quick!
A Journey Beyond#197.dst: 안 돼 안 돼!! 큰일이야, 정말 큰일이야! 가야 해 ! 빨리!
A Journey Beyond#197.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#200.src: Wait, you're just one of the miners. This doesn't feel like an illusion...
A Journey Beyond#200.dst: 잠깐, 그냥 광부잖아. 이건 환각 같지 않은데...
A Journey Beyond#200.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#201.src: Look, you need to get out of here. It's not safe- Wait, what's that noise...?
A Journey Beyond#201.dst: 이봐, 여기서 나가야 해. 안전하지 않- 잠깐, 무슨 소리지...?
A Journey Beyond#201.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#204.src: Find Aledar, Lucio and Elphaba in the Fallen City.
A Journey Beyond#204.dst: Fallen City에서 Aledar, Lucio, Elphaba를 찾으세요.

A Journey Beyond#205.src: {u}! She was completely right. You ought to come with us...
A Journey Beyond#205.dst: {u}! 그녀 말이 전부 맞았어. 너도 우리랑 같이 가야 해...
A Journey Beyond#205.speaker: Lucio

A Journey Beyond#206.src: Find Aledar and Elphaba in the Fallen City.

A Journey Beyond#207.src: Find Aledar in the Fallen City.

A Journey Beyond#209.src: I think my leg is broken. I have a potion to fix it, but I dropped it back up there.
A Journey Beyond#209.dst: 다리가 부러진 것 같아. 고칠 물약이 있었는데, 저 위에서 떨어뜨렸어.
A Journey Beyond#209.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#210.src: I feel a bit better.. But something's still wrong.
A Journey Beyond#210.dst: 조금 나아졌어.. 그래도 아직 뭔가 이상해.
A Journey Beyond#210.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#211.src: Let's just get out of here, soldier on. There's only one way out.
A Journey Beyond#211.dst: 일단 여기서 나가자, 버텨 보자고. 나가는 길은 하나뿐이야.
A Journey Beyond#211.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#214.src: Urrrgh. {u}, this hasn't gone to plan. According to my map we aren't even half way.
A Journey Beyond#214.dst: 으으으. {u}, 계획대로 안 됐어. 내 지도로는 아직 절반도 못 왔어.
A Journey Beyond#214.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#215.src: I can't walk. But equally we can't stay here.
A Journey Beyond#215.dst: 난 못 걸어. 그렇다고 여기 있을 수도 없고.
A Journey Beyond#215.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#216.src: The mission must be carried out. The plan has changed, but it's imperative we get to the end of this expanse, together.
A Journey Beyond#216.dst: 임무는 완수해야 해. 계획은 바뀌었지만, 반드시 함께 이 지대 끝까지 가야 해.
A Journey Beyond#216.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#217.src: No more running for us, huh {u}? Ah, we're here.
A Journey Beyond#217.dst: 이제 도망칠 일은 없겠지, {u}? 아, 다 왔다.

A Journey Beyond#218.src: There has to be a way.. Even if you have to push me in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#218.dst: 방법이 있을 거야.. 네가 이걸로 날 밀고 가야 한대도!
A Journey Beyond#218.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#219.src: No, I'm not joking. You guard the cart, I'll lead the way.
A Journey Beyond#219.dst: 아니, 농담 아니야. 넌 수레를 지켜, 길은 내가 안내할게.
A Journey Beyond#219.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#220.src: Escort Aledar through the {p} to {p} at ({~}, -{~}).

A Journey Beyond#221.src: According to the map, the miners started a town a little ahead.
A Journey Beyond#221.dst: 지도에 따르면, 조금 앞에 광부들이 세운 마을이 있어.
A Journey Beyond#221.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#222.src: Who knows what's left, but it's got to be safer than here.
A Journey Beyond#222.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#223.src: I think the Small Monsters will try to Kill me.
A Journey Beyond#223.dst: 작은 괴물들은 날 죽이려 할 것 같아.
A Journey Beyond#223.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#224.src: While the Big Monsters will try to Kill you.
A Journey Beyond#224.dst: 큰 괴물들은 널 죽이려 할 거고.
A Journey Beyond#224.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#225.src: It's going to be on you to make sure we both get through this.
A Journey Beyond#225.dst: 우리 둘 다 무사히 지나가는 건 너한테 달렸어.
A Journey Beyond#225.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#226.src: The fate of the mission relies on the two of us working together.
A Journey Beyond#226.dst: 임무의 운명은 우리 둘의 협력에 달렸어.
A Journey Beyond#226.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#227.src: Are those... Eyes on the trees?
A Journey Beyond#227.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#229.src: Watch out, the small monsters are coming for me! I can't fight in this thing!
A Journey Beyond#229.dst: 조심해, 작은 괴물들이 나한테 와! 여기선 못 싸워!
A Journey Beyond#229.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#231.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#231.dst: 잘했어! 더는 안 오는 것 같아. 계속 가자.
A Journey Beyond#231.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#233.src: Let's keep going! Before they come back.
A Journey Beyond#233.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#234.src: A lot of those small ones are coming for me!
A Journey Beyond#234.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#235.src: This one was close! We're getting close to the town.
A Journey Beyond#235.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#236.src: We'll have to stop again! We can't go past so many monsters.
A Journey Beyond#236.dst: 또 멈춰야겠어! 괴물이 너무 많아서 못 지나가.
A Journey Beyond#236.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#237.src: We're almost there! I can see the town from here!
A Journey Beyond#237.dst: 거의 다 왔어! 여기서 마을이 보여!
A Journey Beyond#237.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#239.src: Great job! It looks like they've stopped coming. Let's keep going.
A Journey Beyond#239.dst: 잘했어! 더는 안 오는 것 같아. 계속 가자.
A Journey Beyond#239.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#240.src: Ouch! I got hit! Be careful, {u}!
A Journey Beyond#240.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#241.src: Finally, we've arrived... It's not exactly the town on the map.
A Journey Beyond#241.dst: 드디어 도착했어... 지도에 있던 마을과는 좀 다르네.
A Journey Beyond#241.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#242.src: The lost miners are here... How? they must be hundreds of years old!
A Journey Beyond#242.dst: 실종된 광부들이 여기 있어... 어떻게? 수백 살은 됐을 텐데!
A Journey Beyond#242.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#243.src: What is this obelisk? It's.. comforting. I recognise this feeling from my time in Gavel.
A Journey Beyond#243.dst: 이 오벨리스크는 뭐지? 뭔가.. 마음이 편해져. Gavel에 있을 때 느꼈던 기분이야.
A Journey Beyond#243.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#244.src: Maybe.. It's been touched by the light? If so.. It could heal me.
A Journey Beyond#244.dst: 혹시.. 빛의 손길이 닿은 건가? 그렇다면.. 날 치유할 수 있을지도.
A Journey Beyond#244.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#245.src: Let's see if it does anything to me...
A Journey Beyond#245.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#246.src: It worked... Kind of. I feel at least {~}. We still have a ways to go.
A Journey Beyond#246.dst: 효과가 있었어... 어느 정도는. 적어도 {~}은 된 것 같아. 아직 갈 길이 멀어.
A Journey Beyond#246.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Beyond#247.src: Let's take some time to gather ourselves before we press on. I'll meet you on the other side of town.
A Journey Beyond#247.dst: 계속 가기 전에 잠시 정비하자. 마을 반대편에서 만나.
A Journey Beyond#247.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#003.src: {u}, good news. I'm basically as recovered as I think I'll get.
A Journey Further#003.dst: {u}, 좋은 소식이야. 회복될 만큼은 거의 다 회복됐어.

A Journey Further#004.src: >and the hero shall blind the ancient seer. good luck.
A Journey Further#004.dst: >그리고 영웅은 고대의 선지자를 눈멀게 하리라. 행운을 빈다.

A Journey Further#006.src: Alright, let's go. I'll tell you more about our journey on the way.
A Journey Further#006.dst: 좋아, 가자. 가는 길에 우리 여정에 대해 더 얘기해 줄게.
A Journey Further#006.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#008.src: We should try to follow the path as closely as we can. You lead, I'll follow.
A Journey Further#008.dst: 최대한 길을 따라가 보자. 네가 앞장서, 내가 따라갈게.
A Journey Further#008.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#013.src: Good work. Seems that killing the king made the other creatures run off. We’re lucky about that-
A Journey Further#013.dst: 잘했어. 우두머리를 죽이니 다른 놈들이 도망친 것 같아. 운이 좋았-
A Journey Further#013.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#014.src: Wait, {u}, what's going on? Are you alright?
A Journey Further#014.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#015.src: Oh, no no! I have a potion for this, where is it, where is it, aha! Here, drink!
A Journey Further#015.dst: 아, 안 돼 안 돼! 이럴 때 쓰는 물약이 있어, 어디 있지, 어디 있지, 아하! 자, 마셔!
A Journey Further#015.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#016.src: One of those things must have infected your wounds... Everything in this area looks completely hazardous and sickening.
A Journey Further#016.dst: 그놈들이 네 상처를 감염시킨 게 분명해... 이 일대는 전부 위험하고 역겨워 보여.
A Journey Further#016.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#017.src: I expected the worst, so I tried to bring anything and everything that might help. Let's keep moving.
A Journey Further#017.dst: 최악을 예상해서 도움 될 만한 건 뭐든 다 챙겨 왔어. 계속 가자.
A Journey Further#017.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#018.src: Continue on the main path with Aledar.
A Journey Further#018.dst: Aledar와 함께 큰길을 따라 계속 가세요.

A Journey Further#021.src: I'm... I'm going to lead us for now. At least for a little...while... I can't have you g-getting-
A Journey Further#021.dst: 난... 당분간 내가 앞장설게. 적어도 잠... 깐은... 네가 또 다-다치게
A Journey Further#021.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#023.src: ...urgh... I...sorry. I just... I need a moment.
A Journey Further#023.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#024.src: {u}, you just... you have to realize, I can't have you getting hurt.
A Journey Further#024.dst: {u}, 넌 그냥... 알아 둬, 네가 다치는 건 못 봐.
A Journey Further#024.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#025.src: I want to stress this... We NEED to get to the end of this path, together.
A Journey Further#025.dst: 이건 꼭 강조할게... 우린 반드시 함께 이 길 끝까지 가야 해.
A Journey Further#025.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#027.src: Okay. I'm as good as I can get right now. Let's move.
A Journey Further#027.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#028.src: Ah? What... What just... Why do I...
A Journey Further#028.dst: 어? 뭐... 방금 뭐... 왜 내가...
A Journey Further#028.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#029.src: I'll be fine, I just...why did I feel so empty all of the sudden...?
A Journey Further#029.dst: 괜찮아, 그냥... 왜 갑자기 이렇게 허전하지...?
A Journey Further#029.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#030.src: A mysterious force pushes you back...
A Journey Further#030.dst: 알 수 없는 힘이 당신을 밀어냅니다...

A Journey Further#031.src: Oh no, I think something is coming... {u}! Fight it off, I don't think I can defend myself right now!
A Journey Further#031.dst: 이런, 뭔가 오는 것 같아... {u}! 막아 줘, 지금은 나를 지킬 힘이 없어!
A Journey Further#031.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#032.src: Defend Aledar from the Radiated Spiders.

A Journey Further#033.src: Huff... Not feeling totally better, but... At least I can still defend myself.
A Journey Further#033.dst: 후... 완전히 나아지진 않았지만... 적어도 내 몸은 지킬 수 있어.
A Journey Further#033.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#034.src: My stomach is empty, I can't even vomit... Why so I still feel so dizzy? Maybe a potion will help...
A Journey Further#034.dst: 속이 텅 비어서 토할 것도 없어... 왜 아직도 이렇게 어지럽지? 물약이 도움 될지도...
A Journey Further#034.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#036.src: Urgh, pfft! My vomit tasted better than that coming up...
A Journey Further#036.dst: 우웩, 퉤! 토한 게 이것보단 맛있었겠다...
A Journey Further#036.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#037.src: Hah...that's the ticket. Which potion was this anyways... ... hair loss treatment? Why did THAT work?
A Journey Further#037.dst: 하... 바로 이거야. 근데 이게 무슨 물약이었지... ... 탈모 치료제? 이게 왜 먹혀?
A Journey Further#037.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#038.src: Though, you saw what happened to that beast I attacked? Follow me.
A Journey Further#038.dst: 그런데, 내가 친 그 야수가 어떻게 됐는지 봤어? 따라와.
A Journey Further#038.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#039.src: This, from what I recall of the mission statements, is referred to as a "Void Hole." It's a sort of portal.
A Journey Further#039.dst: 임무 설명서에서 기억하기로, 이건 "Void Hole"이라고 불러. 일종의 포탈이야.
A Journey Further#039.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#040.src: They connect to each other in odd ways, but we saw the beast come out of that one when I knocked it in, so...
A Journey Further#040.dst: 서로 이상하게 연결되는데, 내가 쳐서 날린 야수가 저쪽에서 나오는 걸 봤으니...
A Journey Further#040.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#041.src: Watch. I'll come out the other side.
A Journey Further#041.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#042.src: Alright, good! It does connect up consistently, at least. You try now.
A Journey Further#042.dst: 좋아, 됐다! 적어도 연결은 일정하네. 이제 네가 해 봐.
A Journey Further#042.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#044.src: Continue on the trail with Aledar.
A Journey Further#044.dst: Aledar와 함께 오솔길을 따라 계속 가세요.

A Journey Further#045.src: I bring this up because if we're seeing one, we'll be seeing more soon. You'll need to adjust yourself to the sight of them.
A Journey Further#045.dst: 이 얘길 하는 건, 하나를 봤으니 곧 더 많이 보게 될 거라서야. 그 모습에 익숙해져야 할 거야.
A Journey Further#045.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#047.src: We grossly underestimated the difficulties we would have here. And, by that, I mean myself, Elphie, and Lucio did...
A Journey Further#047.dst: 여기서 겪을 어려움을 너무 얕봤어. 여기서 '우리'란 나랑 Elphie, Lucio를 말하는 거야...
A Journey Further#047.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#048.src: We were each unprepared and cocky. If it weren't for you, I'd be dead now, for what it's worth.
A Journey Further#048.dst: 다들 준비도 안 됐고 자만했지. 솔직히 말해서, 네가 없었으면 난 벌써 죽었어.
A Journey Further#048.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#049.src: I wasn't certain at first about you coming along, but you've more than shown you were the right one for the job.
A Journey Further#049.dst: 처음엔 네가 함께 가는 게 확신이 안 섰는데, 이 일에 딱 맞는 사람이란 걸 충분히 증명했어.
A Journey Further#049.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#050.src: ...I had to figure this map was outdated. This wall of spikes isn't listed on it, and the path goes through here!
A Journey Further#050.dst: ...지도가 오래됐을 거라 짐작했어야 했는데. 이 가시 벽은 지도에 없는데, 길이 이리로 나 있어!
A Journey Further#050.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#051.src: I'll have to assume they're new...and if they're new, I might be able to bash through them.
A Journey Further#051.dst: 새로 생긴 거라고 봐야겠지... 새로 생긴 거라면 부수고 지나갈 수 있을지도.
A Journey Further#051.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#052.src: {u}, try throwing a spell at the same time! Let's crack through these things!
A Journey Further#052.dst: {u}, 동시에 주문을 날려 봐! 이것들을 깨부수자!
A Journey Further#052.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#054.src: ...aagh... I... H-how are these so resilient...?
A Journey Further#054.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#055.src: I'm an idiot... I nearly killed myself trying that. I nearly ruined the mission...
A Journey Further#055.dst: 난 바보야... 그러다 죽을 뻔했어. 임무를 망칠 뻔했다고...
A Journey Further#055.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#056.src: I'm sorry, but you'll have to go without me. I can't move another step for now.
A Journey Further#056.dst: 미안하지만, 나 없이 가야겠어. 지금은 한 발짝도 못 움직여.
A Journey Further#056.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#057.src: There's a lot of void holes around here, remember my warning... You can probably get past these spikes with one.
A Journey Further#057.dst: 이 근처엔 Void Hole이 많아, 내 경고 기억하지... 그걸로 이 가시를 넘을 수 있을 거야.
A Journey Further#057.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#058.src: If I'd been thinking I would have suggested it earlier... Once you're past, we'll...uh. We'll do something.
A Journey Further#058.dst: 진즉 생각했으면 먼저 제안했을 텐데... 네가 넘어가면, 우리가... 어. 뭔가 해 보자.
A Journey Further#058.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#059.src: Just...be careful where you go. The void holes could lead anywhere. They might lead you someplace very, very dangerous, too dangerous even for you. I pray they won't...
A Journey Further#059.dst: 그냥... 어디로 가는지 조심해. Void Hole은 어디로든 이어질 수 있어. 아주, 아주 위험한 곳으로 데려갈 수도 있어, 너한테도 너무 위험한 곳으로. 제발 그러지 않길...
A Journey Further#059.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#060.src: There's a void hole right there to try out first. Get going, now. You have to do this.
A Journey Further#060.dst: 바로 저기 시험해 볼 Void Hole이 있어. 이제 가. 이건 네가 해야 해.
A Journey Further#060.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#061.src: Use Void Holes to try and get behind the spike barrier
A Journey Further#061.dst: Void Hole을 이용해 가시 장벽 뒤로 가 보세요

A Journey Further#062.src: Find a way to help Aledar get to the other side of the spike barrier.
A Journey Further#062.dst: Aledar가 가시 장벽 반대편으로 갈 수 있도록 도울 방법을 찾으세요.

A Journey Further#063.src: ...wait, {u}? You got to the other side then...? Good...
A Journey Further#063.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#064.src: I don't know what you did, but whatever it was, it's made cracks in the spikes that I can see from this side.
A Journey Further#064.dst: 뭘 했는지 모르겠지만, 뭐였든 가시에 금이 가서 이쪽에서도 보여.
A Journey Further#064.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#065.src: I've got some of my energy back...let's try spellcasting again. If we do it at the same time, we might make some headway.
A Journey Further#065.dst: 기운이 좀 돌아왔어... 다시 주문을 써 보자. 동시에 쓰면 뭔가 진전이 있을지도 몰라.
A Journey Further#065.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#066.src: I won't crack my skull open on the spikes again though. Promise.
A Journey Further#066.dst: 그래도 다시 가시에 머리를 박진 않을게. 약속해.
A Journey Further#066.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#067.src: You lead. I'll cast my spell as soon as I hear yours.
A Journey Further#067.dst: 네가 먼저 해. 네 주문 소리가 들리면 바로 쓸게.
A Journey Further#067.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#068.src: Thank god it worked... That's our destination there, the Eldritch Outlook.
A Journey Further#068.dst: 다행이다, 됐어... 저기가 우리 목적지야. 섬뜩한 전망대.
A Journey Further#068.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#069.src: Now comes the hardest part... Come along. I'll need you there for it.
A Journey Further#069.dst: 이제 가장 힘든 부분이야... 따라와. 네가 있어야 해.
A Journey Further#069.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#070.src: That blade there...it's made for sacrifice. See how that gate is shut?
A Journey Further#070.dst: 저기 저 칼... 제물을 바치기 위한 거야. 저 문 닫힌 거 보이지?
A Journey Further#070.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#071.src: In order to open the doors to the Outlook, we need to sacrifice a powerful soul.
A Journey Further#071.dst: Outlook으로 가는 문을 열려면, 강력한 영혼을 제물로 바쳐야 해.
A Journey Further#071.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#072.src: We... we should have told you from the start. You and Lucio. Elphie and I, we knew. We knew this would be here.
A Journey Further#072.dst: 우린... 처음부터 말했어야 했어. 너랑 Lucio한테. Elphie랑 난 알았어. 이게 여기 있다는 걸 알았어.
A Journey Further#072.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#073.src: We didn't have... we didn't have a sacrifice in mind. We decided that it would be best decided once we reached that point. And I think we both knew it would have to be one of us.
A Journey Further#073.dst: 우린... 제물로 누굴 바칠지 정하지 않았어. 여기 도착하면 정하는 게 최선이라고 결정했지. 그리고 둘 다 우리 중 하나여야 한다는 걸 알았던 것 같아.
A Journey Further#073.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#074.src: ...I think she would have insisted it be her. Even though both of us had something we would be le-...
A Journey Further#074.dst: ...Elphie는 자기가 하겠다고 고집했을 거야. 우리 둘 다 남겨 두고 갈 게 있었는데도...
A Journey Further#074.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#075.src: It doesn't matter now. It's just us left. And I've been mulling it over since we got to the town... you'll sacrifice me. I won't take no for an answer.
A Journey Further#075.dst: 이제 상관없어. 남은 건 우리뿐이야. 마을에 온 뒤로 계속 생각했어... 날 제물로 바쳐. 거절은 안 받아.
A Journey Further#075.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#076.src: I mean... look at the state I'm in, {u}! I'm on death's door already, and you've proven yourself far stronger than I am even at my best.
A Journey Further#076.dst: 그러니까... 내 꼴을 좀 봐, {u}! 난 이미 죽기 직전이고, 넌 전성기의 나보다도 훨씬 강하다는 걸 증명했어.
A Journey Further#076.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#077.src: Here. You can take everything I had on me. My emeralds, and the key to the dungeon. I certainly won't be able to use them anymore.
A Journey Further#077.dst: 자. 내가 가진 거 전부 가져가. 에메랄드랑 던전 열쇠. 나한텐 더 이상 쓸 일이 없을 테니까.
A Journey Further#077.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#078.src: Upon the top of the tower is... Well, something. We don't know for certain what it is, but it will prevent you from passing through.
A Journey Further#078.dst: 탑 꼭대기에는... 음, 뭔가가 있어. 정확히 뭔지는 모르지만, 네가 지나가지 못하게 막을 거야.
A Journey Further#078.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#079.src: You'll have to kill it to break the barrier. But... find other soldiers who can help you. It will be impossible to defeat alone.
A Journey Further#079.dst: 장벽을 부수려면 그걸 죽여야 해. 하지만... 도와줄 다른 병사들을 찾아. 혼자서는 절대 못 이겨.
A Journey Further#079.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#080.src: ...no more putting it off, then. I'm bleeding out.
A Journey Further#080.dst: ...그럼 더는 미루지 말자. 피가 너무 많이 흘러.
A Journey Further#080.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#082.src: Right click to grab the blade in the altar.

A Journey Further#083.src: Now...strike me down. My soul will unlock the gate...
A Journey Further#083.dst: 이제... 날 베어. 내 영혼이 문을 열 거야...
A Journey Further#083.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Further#086.src: You...can do this. I know y-you can.
A Journey Further#086.dst: 넌... 할 수 있어. 알-알고 있어.
A Journey Further#086.speaker: Aledar

A Journey Home#000.src: What is this place? Such technology, you can hardly imagine how it was made.
A Journey Home#000.dst: 여긴 대체 어디지? 이런 기술이라니, 어떻게 만들었는지 상상조차 안 돼.

A Journey Home#001.src: The caravan driver seems to have disappeared... maybe you can find something if you look in some of mechanized carriages?
A Journey Home#001.dst: 마차 몰이꾼이 사라진 것 같다... 기계 마차 몇 대를 뒤져 보면 뭔가 찾을 수 있을지도?

A Journey Home#002.src: {p}'s relations with Fruma exclusively consist of the generous batches of recruits sent to fight the corruption here in Wynn.
A Journey Home#002.dst: {p}와(과) Fruma의 관계는 오로지 Wynn에서 타락과 싸우라고 넉넉히 보내 주는 신병들뿐이다.

A Journey Home#003.src: They've shut you out. There's no way in from here... But what if you went back the way
A Journey Home#003.dst: 그들이 너를 막아 버렸다. 여기서는 들어갈 길이 없다... 하지만 왔던 길로 되돌아간다면

A Journey Home#004.src: ...Ah. I see. So I suppose...things must not have gone well. Have all the others returned?
A Journey Home#004.dst: ...아. 그렇군. 그렇다면... 일이 잘 풀리지 않았나 보군. 다른 이들은 모두 돌아왔나?

A Journey Home#006.src: Is there anything I can do for you today?

A Journey Home#007.src: ...something's prickling at the back of your mind. Weren't you asleep like this when you first arrived, too?
A Journey Home#007.dst: ...머릿속 한구석이 따끔거립니다. 처음 도착했을 때도 이렇게 잠들어 있지 않았던가요?

A Journey Home#009.src: Explore near where you originally arrived in Wynn.
A Journey Home#009.dst: 당신이 처음 Wynn에 도착한 곳 근처를 탐험하세요.

A Journey Home#011.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#012.src: This job is impossible!! Why am I even here?!
A Journey Home#012.dst: 이 일은 불가능해!! 내가 왜 여기 있는 거야?!
A Journey Home#012.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#013.src: Ah! You're a soldier, right? Look, I- It's, it's just a really difficult time right now.
A Journey Home#013.dst: 아! 병사 맞죠? 저기, 저는- 그게, 지금 정말 힘든 시기라서요.
A Journey Home#013.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#014.src: This, this whole situation is definitely above my paygrade! I don't know how I'm going to deal with this...
A Journey Home#014.dst: 이, 이 상황은 제 직급으로 감당할 일이 절대 아니에요! 어떻게 처리해야 할지 모르겠어요...
A Journey Home#014.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#015.src: Enough of that, I, ah, I suppose. What is it you need?
A Journey Home#015.dst: 그만하죠, 저, 어, 그래요. 뭐가 필요하세요?
A Journey Home#015.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#016.src: Oh. Oh no. Ah, I, you see, that'll be a problem, I think. What do you even need to do at the border anyway?
A Journey Home#016.dst: 아. 아 이런. 어, 저, 그게, 그건 좀 곤란할 것 같네요. 대체 국경에서 무슨 일을 하시려고요?
A Journey Home#016.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#017.src: I can't really imagine what you could need there, but, whatever it is, it'll need to wait! This Corkian drill won't work, and Paxon's stuck, and
A Journey Home#017.dst: 거기서 무슨 볼일이 있는지 상상이 안 가지만, 뭐든 기다려야 해요! 이 Corkus 드릴은 작동을 안 하고, Paxon은 갇혔고,
A Journey Home#017.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#018.src: Look, I'm...I'm sorry for snapping at you. I'm trained for military operation, not for cave-in clearance, but no one else was available!
A Journey Home#018.dst: 저기, 저... 짜증 내서 죄송해요. 전 군사 작전 훈련을 받았지, 붕괴 현장 정리는 아니에요. 근데 다른 사람이 없었어요!
A Journey Home#018.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#019.src: Even the demolitions expert I hired is stuck, so it's all just, it's all going wrong and I don't know what to do.
A Journey Home#019.dst: 고용한 폭파 전문가마저 갇혔으니, 다 그냥, 다 틀어지고 있고 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어요.
A Journey Home#019.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#020.src: You see that new entrance over there? The expert, Paxon, has been in there for almost as long as I was trying this dud machine.
A Journey Home#020.dst: 저기 새 입구 보이죠? 전문가 Paxon이 제가 이 고물 기계를 붙잡고 있던 만큼이나 오래 저 안에 있어요.
A Journey Home#020.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#021.src: If you think you can do a job better than an expert, go ahead and talk with them, but I'm pretty sure you'll have to cancel whatever plans you had.
A Journey Home#021.dst: 전문가보다 잘할 자신이 있으면 가서 얘기해 보세요. 그래도 원래 계획은 취소하셔야 할 거예요.
A Journey Home#021.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#022.src: Talk to the Demolition Mage at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#023.src: If you really need to get to the border, your best bet is to talk to Paxon in the new cave entrance.
A Journey Home#023.dst: 정말 국경에 가야 한다면, 새 동굴 입구에 있는 Paxon과 얘기하는 게 제일 좋아요.
A Journey Home#023.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#024.src: But, they're an expert, so I think your business will have to wait. Really, really sorry about all this!
A Journey Home#024.dst: 하지만 전문가니까, 볼일은 미루셔야 할 거예요. 정말, 정말 죄송해요!
A Journey Home#024.speaker: Lieutenant Tolv

A Journey Home#025.src: Oh no, not another one I don't care what rank you are, what you're asking is impossible! Even for me, it
A Journey Home#025.dst: 아 이런, 또 한 명이야 계급이 뭐든 상관없어, 당신 요구는 불가능해! 나라도 그건
A Journey Home#025.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#026.src: Wait, you aren't part of the... You're just a regular soldier. You're just trying to get through here, aren't you?
A Journey Home#026.dst: 잠깐, 당신은 그쪽 사람이... 그냥 평범한 병사네. 그냥 여길 지나가려는 거지?
A Journey Home#026.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#027.src: May as well give up now! Not happening. No way. You're wasting your time, and let me tell you exactly why.
A Journey Home#027.dst: 지금 포기하는 게 나아! 안 돼. 절대로. 시간 낭비야, 정확히 왜 그런지 말해 주지.
A Journey Home#027.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#028.src: You see that blue rock over there? It's a break point. If I could set off these explosives at it, it'd open a path.
A Journey Home#028.dst: 저기 파란 바위 보여? 약점이야. 거기서 폭약을 터뜨릴 수 있으면 길이 열릴 거야.
A Journey Home#028.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#029.src: They're gone. Hurry down the path!

A Journey Home#030.src: But apparently all these structures set up are so important that any of it being damaged, or MOVED, is unacceptable!
A Journey Home#030.dst: 그런데 여기 세워진 구조물이 전부 너무 중요해서 하나라도 부서지거나 옮겨지면 안 된대!
A Journey Home#030.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#031.src: And to make sure I'm 'supervised' while the lieutenant is working on the drill, the detonator HAS to be here.
A Journey Home#031.dst: 게다가 중위가 드릴을 고치는 동안 날 '감독'하겠다고 기폭 장치는 무조건 여기 있어야 한대.
A Journey Home#031.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#032.src: So I have to daisy-chain a limited amount of explosives all the way over to the stone, without blasting any structures!
A Journey Home#032.dst: 그러니까 한정된 폭약을 저 돌까지 줄줄이 연결해야 해, 구조물은 하나도 안 터뜨리고!
A Journey Home#032.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#033.src: I've been trying for hours and gotten absolutely nowhere! I'm one of the best in my field, even! It's ridiculous!!
A Journey Home#033.dst: 몇 시간째 해 봤는데 전혀 진전이 없어! 나 이 분야 최고 중 하나라고! 말도 안 돼!!
A Journey Home#033.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#034.src: If you feel like wasting your time, here's my stock of explosives. Feel free to try your hand at it, but you should really just go.
A Journey Home#034.dst: 시간 낭비하고 싶으면, 여기 내 폭발물 재고가 있어. 마음대로 해 봐도 되지만, 그냥 가는 게 좋을 거야.
A Journey Home#034.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#035.src: Use the TNT to open up a path through the cave.

A Journey Home#036.src: Still at it? What, do you need a reminder? I've got nothing better to do.
A Journey Home#036.dst: 아직도 하고 있어? 뭐, 다시 설명해 줘? 딱히 할 일도 없으니까.
A Journey Home#036.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#037.src: So the blue rock is soft enough to crack with the explosives. But the detonator's stuck here.
A Journey Home#037.dst: 파란 바위는 폭약으로 깨질 만큼 무르거든. 그런데 기폭 장치가 여기 묶여 있어.
A Journey Home#037.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#038.src: So we need to use the TNT Placer to daisy-chain blasts from the detonator, without blasting any tents, crates, or walls.
A Journey Home#038.dst: 그러니 TNT Placer로 기폭 장치에서부터 폭발을 줄줄이 이어야 해, 천막이나 상자, 벽은 하나도 안 터뜨리고.
A Journey Home#038.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#039.src: You can look at placed TNT to see its blast radius, as well.
A Journey Home#039.dst: 설치한 TNT를 바라보면 폭발 범위도 볼 수 있어.
A Journey Home#039.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#040.src: But given how tight the squeeze between some of those structures is, there's just no way it's happening.
A Journey Home#040.dst: 하지만 구조물 사이 틈이 저렇게 좁아서야, 절대 안 될 거야.
A Journey Home#040.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#041.src: Like I said, you really should just mosey on back to the castle. If I can't get anywhere, I don't think you'll fare better.
A Journey Home#041.dst: 말했듯이, 그냥 성으로 슬슬 돌아가는 게 좋을 거야. 나도 못 하는데 당신이 더 잘할 것 같진 않거든.
A Journey Home#041.speaker: Paxon

A Journey Home#044.src: Halt! Where did you come from? There was a cave-in past here, wasn't there?
A Journey Home#044.dst: 멈춰라! 어디서 왔지? 이 너머에 붕괴가 있지 않았나?
A Journey Home#044.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#045.src: A new path, huh? I didn't think you'd have things to be doing back here, though I won't say I'm ungrateful.
A Journey Home#045.dst: 새 길이라고? 여기 뒤쪽에 볼일이 있을 줄은 몰랐지만, 고맙지 않다고는 않겠네.
A Journey Home#045.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#046.src: It even crushed the grook's nest there. I've been working off field rations for a few days. So where are you headed?
A Journey Home#046.dst: 저기 grook 둥지까지 무너뜨렸어. 며칠째 야전 식량으로 버티고 있지. 그래서 어디로 가나?
A Journey Home#046.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#047.src: The border? I suppose if you're headed there, it must be important, official business. Although, it might have to wait.
A Journey Home#047.dst: 국경? 거기로 간다면 중요한 공무겠지. 그래도 기다려야 할지도 몰라.
A Journey Home#047.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#048.src: The bridge repair was something of a hackjob. It may not bear up your weight. Now that the cave-in's clear, we might be able to get it fixed proper...
A Journey Home#048.dst: 다리 수리가 좀 엉터리였거든. 자네 무게를 못 버틸 수도 있어. 붕괴가 치워졌으니 제대로 고칠 수 있을지도...
A Journey Home#048.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#049.src: But that'll take time. I'd just as soon turn back whatever business you have isn't worth your life, after all.
A Journey Home#049.dst: 하지만 시간이 걸릴 거야. 나라면 돌아가겠네 무슨 볼일이든 목숨만큼 가치 있진 않으니까.
A Journey Home#049.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#051.src: Say, I think I recognize you, actually. That's a rarity for this line of work.
A Journey Home#051.dst: 그러고 보니 자네 낯이 익은 것 같군. 이 일을 하면서 드문 일이지.
A Journey Home#051.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#052.src: Are you sure that what you have to do is worth it? That bridge is awful rickety. Wouldn't want to lose you.
A Journey Home#052.dst: 할 일이 정말 그만한 가치가 있나? 저 다리는 지독하게 흔들려. 자네를 잃고 싶진 않네.
A Journey Home#052.speaker: Guard

A Journey Home#053.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#054.src: Hey, you there! Come talk to me before you pass through.
A Journey Home#054.dst: 이봐, 거기! 지나가기 전에 나랑 얘기 좀 하지.
A Journey Home#054.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#055.src: Hey, you! Come talk to me first, recruit!
A Journey Home#055.dst: 이봐, 너! 먼저 나랑 얘기해, 신병!
A Journey Home#055.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#056.src: Coming or going, I'm under strict orders to intercept soldiers and make sure they're equipped before heading on.
A Journey Home#056.dst: 오든 가든, 병사를 붙잡아서 장비를 갖췄는지 확인한 뒤 보내라는 엄명을 받았다.
A Journey Home#056.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#057.src: No exceptions, not for any reason. Especially not since the cave-in across the river!
A Journey Home#057.dst: 예외는 없다, 어떤 이유로도. 특히 강 건너 붕괴 이후로는!
A Journey Home#057.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#058.src: Nothing's more important than your life, and moving on without being suited up could cost you it!
A Journey Home#058.dst: 목숨보다 중요한 건 없고, 제대로 무장 안 하고 가면 목숨을 잃을 수도 있어!
A Journey Home#058.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#059.src: Well, let me take a look at it and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#059.dst: 자, 어디 한번 보고 규정에 맞는지 확인해 보지.
A Journey Home#059.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#060.src: Well, let me take a look and see if this stuff is up to regulation.
A Journey Home#060.dst: 자, 이 장비가 규정에 맞는지 한번 보자.
A Journey Home#060.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#061.src: Hmm... Ah, yep, signs of wear all over... Armor not polished... Weapon looks liable to fall apart any second...
A Journey Home#061.dst: 흠... 아, 그래, 온통 닳았군... 갑옷은 광도 안 냈고... 무기는 당장이라도 부서질 것 같고...
A Journey Home#061.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#062.src: I'm surprised you made it ten feet out here with those rusty trinkets! This is no way to protect yourself!
A Journey Home#062.dst: 이런 녹슨 잡동사니로 여기까지 온 게 놀랍군! 이래서는 몸을 못 지킨다!
A Journey Home#062.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#063.src: Look, there's a loot chest in the cave just there, so you need to head in and get yourself some proper equipment.
A Journey Home#063.dst: 잘 들어, 바로 저 동굴에 전리품 상자가 있으니 들어가서 제대로 된 장비를 챙겨 와.
A Journey Home#063.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#064.src: ...that so, huh? Well, I think you should take a second look up ahead.
A Journey Home#064.dst: ...그래? 그럼 저 앞을 다시 한번 봐 두는 게 좋겠군.
A Journey Home#064.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#065.src: See? Now no more guff about levels you either gear up properly, or you don't pass! I won't have you risking your life.
A Journey Home#065.dst: 봤지? 이제 레벨 타령은 그만 제대로 무장하든지, 못 지나가든지다! 목숨 걸게 두진 않겠다.
A Journey Home#065.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#066.src: You can find good stuff in caves, like the one just next to me, so hop to it.
A Journey Home#066.dst: 동굴엔 좋은 물건이 있어, 바로 내 옆에 있는 것처럼. 그러니 어서 가.
A Journey Home#066.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#067.src: Like I said, coming or going. No matter what, you should gear up by looting the cave here before heading onwards.
A Journey Home#067.dst: 말했듯이, 오든 가든이다. 무슨 일이 있어도 떠나기 전에 여기 동굴을 뒤져서 무장해.
A Journey Home#067.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#068.src: Good stuff. There's a loot chest in that cave there, so you should find everything you need. Get to it!
A Journey Home#068.dst: 좋아. 저 동굴에 전리품 상자가 있으니 필요한 건 다 찾을 거다. 어서 가!
A Journey Home#068.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#069.src: Explore the cave to find some loot.

A Journey Home#070.src: Enter the cave and open the loot chest.
A Journey Home#070.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#071.src: Continue back down the path to Fruma.

A Journey Home#072.src: That looks like the stuff. You can take that armor to an Item Identifier right there, and then you can wear it once identified.
A Journey Home#072.dst: 그거면 됐어. 저 갑옷은 바로 저기 Item Identifier에게 가져가면 되고, 감정되면 입을 수 있어.
A Journey Home#072.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#073.src: Though... since you seem to be heading back to the border... I have to ask why. It's pretty unusual. Probably best you head back to {p}.
A Journey Home#073.dst: 그런데... 국경 쪽으로 돌아가는 것 같은데... 이유를 물어야겠군. 흔한 일이 아니야. {p}(으)로 돌아가는 게 좋을 거다.
A Journey Home#073.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#074.src: If other recruits see you coming the other way, they might get confused, or discouraged. Wouldn't want to risk that, right?
A Journey Home#074.dst: 다른 신병들이 반대로 가는 널 보면 헷갈리거나 사기가 꺾일 수 있어. 그런 위험은 피하고 싶겠지?
A Journey Home#074.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#075.src: Are you sure whatever you're doing is worth it? Maybe you should just head back to town.
A Journey Home#075.dst: 하려는 일이 정말 그만한 가치가 있나? 그냥 마을로 돌아가는 게 좋겠어.
A Journey Home#075.speaker: Soldier

A Journey Home#076.src: Avoid the Fruman recruits on the path.

A Journey Home#077.src: ...been recruiting Fruman soldiers for the war effort. Apparently things are really bad over there. Makes me nervous...
A Journey Home#077.dst: ...전쟁 때문에 Fruma 병사를 모집해 왔대. 저쪽 상황이 정말 나쁜가 봐. 불안해...
A Journey Home#077.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#078.src: Walking corpses aren't anything I'm going to underestimate, but it can't be all doom and gloom, right?
A Journey Home#078.dst: 걸어 다니는 시체를 얕볼 생각은 없지만, 전부 암울하기만 하진 않겠지?
A Journey Home#078.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#079.src: I suppose we'll see once we pass this gate. It marks the border... Deep breaths, deep breaths...
A Journey Home#079.dst: 이 관문을 지나면 알게 되겠지. 여기가 국경이야... 심호흡, 심호흡...
A Journey Home#079.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#080.src: ...know anything about Wynn? I didn't get any debriefing.
A Journey Home#080.dst: ...Wynn에 대해 뭐 아는 거 있어? 난 브리핑을 못 받았어.
A Journey Home#080.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#081.src: I remember rumors... Something about a great hero. Name started with...and R?
A Journey Home#081.dst: 소문은 기억나... 위대한 영웅이 있다던데. 이름이... R로 시작했나?
A Journey Home#081.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#082.src: We'll make it a point to ask as soon as we can. Information's key to fighting wars.
A Journey Home#082.dst: 기회 되는 대로 꼭 물어보자. 전쟁에선 정보가 핵심이니까.
A Journey Home#082.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#083.src: ...rotten driver. I feel for the man, but he said he always hits that boulder. Sounds like his own fault to me.
A Journey Home#083.dst: ...형편없는 마부야. 안됐긴 한데, 항상 그 바위에 부딪힌다잖아. 내가 보기엔 자기 잘못이야.
A Journey Home#083.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#084.src: I'm thinking about meals more than wheels. I feel like I haven't eaten in days. Hope the walk's short...
A Journey Home#084.dst: 바퀴보다 밥 생각이 더 나. 며칠은 굶은 기분이야. 걷는 길이 짧았으면...
A Journey Home#084.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#085.src: Well, if he was a more competent driver you wouldn't have to walk so far on an empty stomach! Let's hurry so we can get you a feast, huh?
A Journey Home#085.dst: 마부가 좀 더 유능했으면 빈속으로 이렇게 멀리 안 걸었겠지! 서두르자, 가서 거하게 먹게, 응?
A Journey Home#085.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#086.src: Wait, who's that? Why are they coming from the border??
A Journey Home#086.dst: 잠깐, 저건 누구야? 왜 국경 쪽에서 오는 거지??
A Journey Home#086.speaker: Fruman Recruit

A Journey Home#088.src: ...and that's the last of them for today.
A Journey Home#088.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#089.src: Lot of pairs today. Eight more in the wings... But that's for tomorrow.
A Journey Home#089.dst: 오늘은 짝이 많네. 대기 중인 게 여덟 더 있고... 그건 내일 일이지.
A Journey Home#089.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#090.src: Same darn boulder... Same darn line, too. Wonder if they'll let me shake it up one day. This is always a pain...
A Journey Home#090.dst: 똑같은 망할 바위... 똑같은 망할 대사. 언젠가 좀 바꾸게 해 주려나. 매번 귀찮아...
A Journey Home#090.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#091.src: And that's that about that. And now, to be off...to the home I choose. And there's no troubles to follow me there.
A Journey Home#091.dst: 뭐, 그건 그렇다 치고. 이제 가 볼까... 내가 고른 집으로. 거기까진 골칫거리가 못 따라오지.
A Journey Home#091.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#093.src: Just couldn't take the hint, huh?
A Journey Home#093.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#094.src: Bet you think you're slick. Didn't even notice me hang back to watch, huh? I wasn't born yesterday.
A Journey Home#094.dst: 꽤 약은 줄 알았지. 내가 뒤에 남아서 지켜보는 것도 못 봤지? 내가 어제 태어난 줄 알아?
A Journey Home#094.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#095.src: Listen, this isn't the first time something like this has happened- Y'know. Someone gets curious, retraces their steps.
A Journey Home#095.dst: 들어 봐, 이런 일이 처음은 아니야- 알잖아. 누군가 궁금해져서 왔던 길을 되짚어 가는 거.
A Journey Home#095.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#096.src: ...I will make only one demand of you. Whatever happens...come back alive.
A Journey Home#096.dst: ...너에게 단 하나만 요구하마. 무슨 일이 있어도... 살아서 돌아와라.

A Journey Home#097.src: If you couldn't tell, this whole thing's meant to be a one way trip. The bridge, the cave-in, everyone trying to discourage you.
A Journey Home#097.dst: 눈치 못 챘다면, 이건 전부 편도 여행이야. 다리, 붕괴, 다들 널 말리려던 것까지.
A Journey Home#097.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#098.src: It's not wise to be here- After all, you weren't the one out of your group of three that got permission to stay. Yeah, I heard about the tournament results.
A Journey Home#098.dst: 여기 있는 건 현명하지 않아- 어쨌든 셋 중에 남아도 된다는 허락을 받은 건 네가 아니잖아. 그래, 대회 결과 들었어.
A Journey Home#098.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#099.src: He's dead asleep. You could probably ring a church bell an inch above his head and he'd stay unconscious.
A Journey Home#099.dst: 곯아떨어졌다. 머리 바로 위에서 교회 종을 울려도 깨지 않을 것 같다.

A Journey Home#100.src: That looks like the stuff. See? That wasn't so hard. Alright, now!
A Journey Home#100.dst: 그거 맞는 것 같네. 봐? 그렇게 어렵지 않았지. 좋아, 이제!

A Journey Home#101.src: So...you got two choices, buddy. We can let this slide between us. We can. You can go marching right back to {p} and my lips will be sealed.
A Journey Home#101.dst: 그러니까... 선택지는 둘이야, 친구. 이 일은 우리끼리 없던 걸로 할 수 있어. 진짜로. {p}(으)로 곧장 돌아가면 입 다물고 있지.
A Journey Home#101.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#102.src: Alas, I am afraid my hands are quite tied here. There is little I can do- you recall what I said in the meeting.
A Journey Home#102.dst: 아아, 유감스럽게도 이 일엔 손을 쓸 수가 없습니다. 제가 할 수 있는 건 별로 없어요- 회의에서 한 말 기억하시죠.

A Journey Home#103.src: Or, you can live life dangerously and follow me on the train to {p}. Better make your choice quick, though it's leaving soon.
A Journey Home#103.dst: 아니면 위험하게 살아 보든가, 날 따라 {p}행 열차에 타. 빨리 정하는 게 좋을 거야, 곧 출발하거든.
A Journey Home#103.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#104.src: If I see you in the passenger cabin, well...that'll be that, and you'll just have to wait and see what comes of it.
A Journey Home#104.dst: 객차에서 널 보게 되면, 뭐... 그걸로 끝이고, 어떻게 되는지 지켜보는 수밖에 없지.
A Journey Home#104.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#105.src: Join the Caravan Driver in the passenger car at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

A Journey Home#106.src: Last chance to back out. This your choice?
A Journey Home#106.dst: 물러설 마지막 기회야. 이게 네 선택이야?
A Journey Home#106.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#107.src: Well, you better get headed on the long walk back to {p} then.
A Journey Home#107.dst: 그럼 {p}까지 먼 길 걸어서 돌아가는 게 좋을 거야.
A Journey Home#107.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#111.src: You know what they say about curiosity, and how it killed the cat. You the type to believe satisfaction'll bring it back?
A Journey Home#111.dst: 호기심이 고양이를 죽인다는 말 알지. 만족하면 고양이가 되살아난다고 믿는 타입인가?
A Journey Home#111.speaker: Caravan Driver

A Journey Home#112.src: Well, 'kittycat,' you didn't find the cream- just the hound dogs.
A Journey Home#112.dst: 자, '야옹이', 크림은 못 찾았네- 사냥개들만 찾았지.
A Journey Home#112.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#113.src: Intruder to Fruma, you are under arrest! Now march!
A Journey Home#113.dst: Fruma 침입자, 너를 체포한다! 이제 걸어!
A Journey Home#113.speaker: Fruman Guard

A Journey Home#114.src: You really thought the Driver was on your side, intruder? What a fool you are. We gave you every chance to quit this endeavor, but here you are. Let's go.
A Journey Home#114.dst: 정말 그 마부가 네 편이라고 생각했나, 침입자? 어리석긴. 그만둘 기회를 몇 번이고 줬는데, 결국 여기 왔군. 가자.
A Journey Home#114.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#116.src: I have urgent news to report from the gate.
A Journey Home#116.speaker: Guard Captain

A Journey Home#117.src: If it is truly so urgent, let's speak.
A Journey Home#117.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#118.src: Soldiers! Keep the intruder still. I've every faith in you.
A Journey Home#118.dst: 병사들! 침입자를 붙잡아 둬라. 너희를 전적으로 믿는다.
A Journey Home#118.speaker: Commander Lilles

A Journey Home#122.src: Anythin' I can help you with?
A Journey Home#122.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#123.src: Hm. Suppose there's no harm. But watch yourself, alright?
A Journey Home#123.dst: 흠. 뭐 해될 건 없겠지. 그래도 조심하쇼, 알겠소?
A Journey Home#123.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#124.src: This here's our home. I wouldn't take too kindly to you messin' anything up, understand?
A Journey Home#124.dst: 여긴 우리 집이오. 뭐라도 망쳐 놓으면 곱게 안 넘어갈 거요, 알겠소?
A Journey Home#124.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#125.src: ...doin' alright, all things considered. Weather's nice, I suppose. Festival comin' up.
A Journey Home#125.dst: ...이것저것 따지면 그럭저럭 지내오. 날씨도 좋고. 축제도 곧 열리고.
A Journey Home#125.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#126.src: But that ain't none of our business, really. If you didn't need anythin' else, I'll kindly ask you to take your leave.
A Journey Home#126.dst: 하지만 그건 우리 알 바 아니오. 더 필요한 게 없으면 이만 가 주시오.
A Journey Home#126.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#127.src: Hm. Good. Have a nice day, now.
A Journey Home#127.speaker: Kaio

A Journey Home#128.src: Hmm? And who may you be?
A Journey Home#128.speaker: Mora
