All Roads to Peace#318.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#320.dst: 푸흡...하하하하!!! 이, 인간, 좋아! 나- 하하!
All Roads to Peace#320.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#321.src: That...correct! Not right, but correct! You...haha, you only help Ressinter through luck, right? Human not actually healer.
All Roads to Peace#321.dst: 그거...정답! 맞진 않음, 근데 정답! 너...하하, Ressinter 운으로 도운 거 맞지? 인간 사실 치유사 아님.
All Roads to Peace#321.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#322.src: Human have humor though! And human try hard to help. More than can say for most humans. Here then- try more heal, instead of be soldier.
All Roads to Peace#322.dst: 근데 인간 유머 있음! 그리고 열심히 도우려 함. 대부분 인간보다 나음. 그럼 여기- 병사 말고 치유 더 해 봐.
All Roads to Peace#322.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#323.src: World need more people to help other people. That human was willing to try mean many good thing.
All Roads to Peace#323.dst: 세상엔 남 돕는 사람 더 필요함. 인간이 해 보려 했다는 건 좋은 게 많다는 뜻.
All Roads to Peace#323.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#324.src: No, Elderberry not good for those. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#324.dst: 틀림, 엘더베리 그거에 안 좋음. 흠, 인간 Ressinter 운으로 고친 듯... 원하면 다시 해 봐.
All Roads to Peace#324.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#325.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#325.dst: 틀림. 은행잎 그거에 나쁨. 흠, 인간 Ressinter 운으로 고친 듯... 원하면 다시 해 봐.
All Roads to Peace#325.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#326.src: No. Gingko Leaf bad for that. Hm, maybe human heal Ressinter through luck... Can try again if want.
All Roads to Peace#326.dst: 틀림. 은행잎 그거에 나쁨. 흠, 인간 Ressinter 운으로 고친 듯... 원하면 다시 해 봐.
All Roads to Peace#326.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#327.src: Fine. Take your time. Will be here for while to make sure other healer okay.
All Roads to Peace#327.dst: 좋아. 천천히 해. 다른 치유사 괜찮은지 보려고 한동안 여기 있음.
All Roads to Peace#327.speaker: Kreimu

All Roads to Peace#329.src: Human healer! Hello! This Onluk tower. Onluk tower two! Human help, so human welcome.
All Roads to Peace#329.dst: 치유사 인간! 안녕! 여기 Onluk 탑. Onluk 탑 둘! 인간 도왔음, 그래서 인간 환영.
All Roads to Peace#329.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#330.src: Tower one call tower one cause Onluk build tower one! This not usual spot for Onluk.
All Roads to Peace#330.dst: 탑 하나 탑 하나인 이유는 Onluk이 탑 하나 먼저 지어서! 여기 Onluk 늘 있는 곳 아님.
All Roads to Peace#330.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#331.src: Usually at tower on small hill, across bridge. But because build tower by self, tower rickety.
All Roads to Peace#331.dst: 보통 다리 건너 작은 언덕 위 탑에 있음. 근데 혼자 지어서 탑 흔들흔들.
All Roads to Peace#331.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#332.src: Human helpful. Human get sturdy wood for fix tower? {p} has sturdy wood. Forest has wood too, but more magical than sturdy.
All Roads to Peace#332.dst: 인간 잘 도움. 인간 탑 고칠 튼튼한 나무 구해 옴? {p}에 튼튼한 나무 있음. 숲에도 있음, 근데 튼튼하기보다 마법적.
All Roads to Peace#332.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#333.src: [{~} Willow Planks] enough to make tower better, maybe. Willow strong wood! Can get?
All Roads to Peace#333.dst: [{~} Willow Planks]면 탑 좋아질지도. 버드나무 튼튼한 나무! 구할 수 있음?
All Roads to Peace#333.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#334.src: Aha! Human have willow wood! Onluk fix tower now!
All Roads to Peace#334.dst: 아하! 인간 버드나무 가짐! Onluk 이제 탑 고침!
All Roads to Peace#334.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#335.src: Will repair Onluk tower one! Come see after fix!
All Roads to Peace#335.dst: Onluk 탑 하나 고칠 것! 다 고치면 보러 와!
All Roads to Peace#335.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#336.src: TOWER ONE REPAIRED! Hrahaaah! Yes! Human very helpful!
All Roads to Peace#336.dst: 탑 하나 수리 완료! 흐라하아아! 좋아! 인간 아주 도움 됨!
All Roads to Peace#336.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#337.src: Should go and see! Climb tower, shoot crossbow at Freelancer!
All Roads to Peace#337.dst: 가서 봐야 함! 탑 올라가서 Freelancer한테 석궁 쏴!
All Roads to Peace#337.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#338.src: See? Onluk tower one much better than Onluk tower two! Cozy up here, and can see Fruludir tower too!
All Roads to Peace#338.dst: 봤지? Onluk 탑 하나 Onluk 탑 둘보다 훨씬 좋음! 위에 아늑하고, Fruludir 탑도 보임!
All Roads to Peace#338.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#339.src: Human very helpful. Healer and woodcutter! Repairer of tower- Well, human not repair tower. Helper of repairer of tower!
All Roads to Peace#339.dst: 인간 아주 도움 됨. 치유사에 나무꾼! 탑 수리꾼- 아, 인간 탑 수리 안 함. 탑 수리꾼의 조수!
All Roads to Peace#339.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#340.src: Here, for help repair Onluk tower one!
All Roads to Peace#340.dst: 여기, Onluk 탑 하나 수리 도운 보답!
All Roads to Peace#340.speaker: Onluk

All Roads to Peace#342.src: Speak to Ureietun at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to gain access to the Chieftess' hut
All Roads to Peace#342.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Ureietun에게 말을 걸어 여족장의 오두막에 들어갈 허락을 받으세요

All Roads to Peace#345.src: Human want talk Arrai-Veretel. In hut. Follow.
All Roads to Peace#345.dst: 인간 Arrai-Veretel이랑 얘기 원함. 오두막 안. 따라와.
All Roads to Peace#345.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#346.src: Arrai-Veretel! Human try help orc around fortress. Want talk.
All Roads to Peace#346.dst: Arrai-Veretel! 인간 요새 오크들 도우려 함. 얘기 원함.
All Roads to Peace#346.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#347.src: Up to human now. Will not help more- choice is up to Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#347.dst: 이제 인간한테 달림. 더는 안 도움- 결정은 Arrai-Veretel이 함.
All Roads to Peace#347.speaker: Ureietun

All Roads to Peace#348.src: Hmh. Zuett spoke about you. So you are human trying to end war?
All Roads to Peace#348.dst: 흥. Zuett가 너 얘기함. 그래서 네가 전쟁 끝내려는 인간?
All Roads to Peace#348.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#350.src: YOU! You human who kill Rai-Poxper! You human who attack other fort!
All Roads to Peace#350.dst: 너! 너 Rai-Poxper 죽인 인간! 너 다른 요새 공격한 인간!
All Roads to Peace#350.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#351.src: Need talk with Zuett again. You follow. And you stay quiet. Understand?
All Roads to Peace#351.dst: Zuett랑 다시 얘기해야 함. 너 따라와. 그리고 조용히 있어. 알겠음?
All Roads to Peace#351.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#352.src: Follow Arrai-Veretel into the meeting room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

All Roads to Peace#353.src: ZUETT! You say human want peace. Do you know who human is?!
All Roads to Peace#353.dst: ZUETT! 인간 평화 원한다 했지. 이 인간 누군지 앎?!
All Roads to Peace#353.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#354.src: Whuh- This good human! Heal Ressinter-
All Roads to Peace#354.dst: 허- 이거 좋은 인간! Ressinter 고침-
All Roads to Peace#354.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#357.src: Human ALSO attack other fort! Many orcs dead because this human!
All Roads to Peace#357.dst: 인간 다른 요새'도' 공격함! 이 인간 때문에 오크 많이 죽음!
All Roads to Peace#357.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#358.src: How can Zuett say human trying to end war, when human START WAR AGAIN?!
All Roads to Peace#358.dst: 인간이 전쟁 '다시 시작'했는데, Zuett 어떻게 인간이 전쟁 끝내려 한다 함?!
All Roads to Peace#358.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#360.src: THAT. IS. THE. POINT!! Villager get human to fight for them! Cease-fire say Villager not attack orc. Then human come over ocean. Try make peace- get attack!
All Roads to Peace#360.dst: 그게. 바로. 요점. 이다!! 주민 인간 시켜서 대신 싸움! 휴전은 주민 오크 공격 안 한다 함. 그런데 인간 바다 건너옴. 평화 하려다- 공격당함!
All Roads to Peace#360.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#361.src: See human attack. Villager get human to attack, say lies to trick humans. Orcs defend self. Then, three Rai-orc die at Earthpit, Cliffhearth, and Trunkstump goblin camp.
All Roads to Peace#361.dst: 인간 공격 봄. 주민 인간 시켜 공격, 거짓말로 인간 속임. 오크 스스로 지킴. 그다음, Rai 오크 셋 죽음, Earthpit, Cliffhearth, Trunkstump 고블린 야영지에서.
All Roads to Peace#361.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#362.src: Human attack! Rai-Poxper take rightful toll for break cease-fire, but not war yet. Take magic axe from Villager city while magic power gone bad.
All Roads to Peace#362.dst: 인간 공격! Rai-Poxper 휴전 깬 대가 정당히 받음, 근데 아직 전쟁 아님. 마력 나빠졌을 때 주민 도시에서 마법 도끼 가져옴.
All Roads to Peace#362.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#363.src: Villager and human attack first, but attack orc for take rightful toll like orc attack first! And human kill Rai-Poxper!
All Roads to Peace#363.dst: 주민이랑 인간 먼저 공격, 근데 오크가 정당한 대가 받은 걸 오크가 먼저 공격한 것처럼! 그리고 인간 Rai-Poxper 죽임!
All Roads to Peace#363.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#364.src: Orc take human fort build in dying earth forest. Cannot know if human planning another attack! But not kill human. Hold human instead.
All Roads to Peace#364.dst: 오크 죽어 가는 대지 숲에 지은 인간 요새 차지. 인간 또 공격 계획하는지 알 수 없음! 근데 인간 안 죽임. 대신 붙잡아 둠.
All Roads to Peace#364.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#365.src: Then same human who kill Rai-Poxper come, kill bathing orc, break in fort, kill many Centerworld orc! Villager start, orc finish, villager no respect end!
All Roads to Peace#365.dst: 그런데 Rai-Poxper 죽인 그 인간 와서, 목욕하던 오크 죽이고, 요새 뚫고, Centerworld 오크 많이 죽임! 주민 시작, 오크 끝냄, 주민 끝 존중 안 함!
All Roads to Peace#365.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#366.src: Yes, human tricked by Villager. But human still attack orc. Human still kill many orc! Human say want peace now?
All Roads to Peace#366.dst: 그래, 인간 주민한테 속음. 근데 인간 그래도 오크 공격함. 그래도 오크 많이 죽임! 이제 와서 평화 원한다?
All Roads to Peace#366.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#367.src: What human done? Hunt boar? Help healer? Done busywork for other orc? That not make up for life lost.
All Roads to Peace#367.dst: 인간 뭐 했음? 멧돼지 사냥? 치유사 도움? 다른 오크 잔심부름? 그걸로 잃은 목숨 못 갚음.
All Roads to Peace#367.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#368.src: ...Arrai-Veretel right. What human done good, not make up for that. But, human still trying. If one human try to stop, more human can try to stop.
All Roads to Peace#368.dst: ...Arrai-Veretel 말 맞음. 인간 한 좋은 일, 그거 못 갚음. 근데 인간 계속 노력함. 인간 하나 멈추려 하면, 더 많은 인간 멈추려 할 수 있음.
All Roads to Peace#368.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#369.src: War only killing us! If tried talk human instead of go sharpen spear and fight back, maybe human would learned faster than now.
All Roads to Peace#369.dst: 전쟁은 우리 죽일 뿐! 창 갈고 반격하는 대신 인간이랑 얘기했으면, 인간 지금보다 빨리 배웠을지도.
All Roads to Peace#369.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#370.src: Maybe. Maybe more orc be dead instead. Zuett, you cannot say what would happened. Wishful thinking, and I wish would happened too!
All Roads to Peace#370.dst: 그럴지도. 대신 오크 더 죽었을지도. Zuett, 어떻게 됐을지 너 모름. 희망 사항이고, 나도 그랬으면 좋겠음!
All Roads to Peace#370.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#371.src: But with unfinished Wynnic, orc cannot talk well. YOU try learn language when idiot killing you! All sound stupid, and no time to learn for most!
All Roads to Peace#371.dst: 근데 Wynn 말 서툴러서 오크 말 잘 못함. '너'도 바보가 죽이려 들 때 말 배워 봐! 다 멍청하게 들리고, 대부분 배울 시간 없음!
All Roads to Peace#371.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#372.src: But human listen to Zuett, even if not sound smart. Arrai-Veretel not respect human. Justified, but still cause problem.
All Roads to Peace#372.dst: 근데 인간 Zuett 말 들음, 똑똑하게 안 들려도. Arrai-Veretel 인간 존중 안 함. 이유 있음, 근데 그래도 문제 됨.
All Roads to Peace#372.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#373.src: Grrh. FINE! Zuett want peace so bad? Human want peace so bad? Human spilled much orc blood. Only way out of war, is through. We will battle.
All Roads to Peace#373.dst: 크르. 좋아! Zuett 그렇게 평화 원함? 인간 그렇게 평화 원함? 인간 오크 피 많이 흘림. 전쟁 나가는 길은 뚫고 가는 것뿐. 싸운다.
All Roads to Peace#373.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#374.src: No tricks. No backup. Nothing but battle between human and myself. If human can fight in ritual arena and win, then will listen.
All Roads to Peace#374.dst: 속임수 없음. 지원 없음. 인간이랑 나 사이 싸움뿐. 인간 의식 투기장에서 싸워 이기면, 그때 들음.
All Roads to Peace#374.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#375.src: Listen, Zuett. I want war stop too. But you must understand the risk here. Cannot make decision lightly. Villager go back on word- see writing, find way around writing.
All Roads to Peace#375.dst: 들어, Zuett. 나도 전쟁 멈추길 원함. 근데 위험 알아야 함. 가볍게 못 정함. 주민 말 뒤집음- 글 보고, 글 빠져나갈 길 찾음.
All Roads to Peace#375.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#376.src: Try threaten us with iron corpse machine! So, battle will happen. Will prepare ritual and gather crowd. Prepare, human.
All Roads to Peace#376.dst: 철 시체 기계로 우리 위협하려 함! 그러니 싸움 함. 의식 준비하고 관중 모음. 준비해, 인간.
All Roads to Peace#376.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#377.src: Prepare, human. Arrai-Veretel strongest orc. Strong in everything. Mind, body, power, spirit.
All Roads to Peace#377.dst: 준비해, 인간. Arrai-Veretel 가장 강한 오크. 모든 게 강함. 정신, 몸, 힘, 영혼.
All Roads to Peace#377.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#378.src: Zuett still think human trying to be good. Still think can help stupid war end. Knock sense into Arrai-Veretel.
All Roads to Peace#378.dst: Zuett 여전히 인간 좋은 사람 되려 한다 생각. 여전히 바보 전쟁 끝낼 수 있다 생각. Arrai-Veretel 정신 차리게 해.
All Roads to Peace#378.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#379.src: Defeat Arrai-Veretel in combat in the arena below the orcish meeting room.
All Roads to Peace#379.dst: 오크 회의실 아래 투기장에서 Arrai-Veretel을 전투로 쓰러뜨리세요.

All Roads to Peace#380.src: Before fight... Must perform ritual. This challenge need respect. I do not repect you, human, but will show respect anyway.
All Roads to Peace#380.dst: 싸우기 전... 의식 치러야 함. 이 도전 존중 필요. 인간 너 존중 안 함, 근데 그래도 존중 보일 것.
All Roads to Peace#380.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#381.src: May the earth herself hear us... Though we do not speak as we once have...
All Roads to Peace#381.dst: 대지께서 친히 우리 말을 들으시기를... 우리 더는 옛 말로 말하지 못하나...
All Roads to Peace#381.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#382.src: We, as humble inhabitants of the land she has gifted us, pledge this show in honor of her.
All Roads to Peace#382.dst: 그분이 내리신 땅의 미천한 거주자로서, 그분을 기려 이 대결을 바치나이다.
All Roads to Peace#382.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#383.src: May she be sated, grow healthy, and honor us in turn for this offering.
All Roads to Peace#383.dst: 그분이 흡족하시고 강건하시어, 이 제물에 우리를 영예로 답하시기를.
All Roads to Peace#383.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#386.src: HMH! Human tough. Fine- Will take battle seriously now!
All Roads to Peace#386.dst: 흥! 인간 질김. 좋아- 이제 진지하게 싸움!
All Roads to Peace#386.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#387.src: For sake of those killed before me, I will not lose!
All Roads to Peace#387.dst: 나보다 먼저 죽은 이들 위해, 안 짐!
All Roads to Peace#387.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#390.src: No, no! Arrai-Veretel hurt bad! Human try kill Arrai-Veretel!!
All Roads to Peace#390.dst: 아니, 아니! Arrai-Veretel 크게 다침! 인간 Arrai-Veretel 죽이려 함!!
All Roads to Peace#390.speaker: Audience Orc

All Roads to Peace#391.src: AM FINE! Stupid, idiot! No interrupting while ritual fight!
All Roads to Peace#391.dst: 괜찮음! 바보, 멍청이! 의식 싸움 중에 끼어들지 마!
All Roads to Peace#391.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#392.src: Human win. Hate to say, but human win. Not even try kill me.
All Roads to Peace#392.dst: 인간 이김. 말하기 싫지만, 인간 이김. 나 죽이려 하지도 않음.
All Roads to Peace#392.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#393.src: Give time. Battle hard-fought- Need to wind down. Wait in meeting room. Will...discuss terms.
All Roads to Peace#393.dst: 시간 줘. 힘든 싸움이었음- 진정해야 함. 회의실에서 기다려. 조건...논의할 것.
All Roads to Peace#393.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#394.src: Feel like insult to stop war we did not start. But, gave promise. Human strong. Still not make up for so much death...
All Roads to Peace#394.dst: 우리가 시작 안 한 전쟁 멈추는 거 모욕 같음. 근데 약속함. 인간 강함. 그래도 그 많은 죽음 못 갚음...
All Roads to Peace#394.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#395.src: But human trying. Really, really trying. Will admit, did not know about human killing all when saw... Still. If war ending, deaths also ending.
All Roads to Peace#395.dst: 근데 인간 노력함. 정말, 정말 노력함. 인정함, 봤을 때 인간 다 죽인 거 몰랐음... 그래도. 전쟁 끝나면 죽음도 끝남.
All Roads to Peace#395.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#396.src: Hmh. Human probably trying to end war to start with. Just on wrong side. Can agree, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#396.dst: 흥. 인간 처음부터 전쟁 끝내려 했을지도. 편만 잘못 섬. 동의함, Zuett.
All Roads to Peace#396.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#397.src: Will stop attacking cities. Orcs still defend selves! Will not turn bellies for spears. Still not trust villagers- only give cease-fire.
All Roads to Peace#397.dst: 도시 공격 멈춤. 오크 그래도 스스로 지킴! 창 앞에 배 안 내밂. 주민 여전히 안 믿음- 휴전만 줌.
All Roads to Peace#397.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#398.src: Give opportunity for human to learn and villager to show respect. They did not attack, then will be open to more negotiation.
All Roads to Peace#398.dst: 인간 배울 기회, 주민 존중 보일 기회 줌. 공격 안 하면 더 협상할 여지 있음.
All Roads to Peace#398.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#399.src: Will say- many orc hold grudge, in plains. Many orc probably still attack. If so, human also can defend self. But, human should avoid fight there.
All Roads to Peace#399.dst: 말해 둠- 평원 많은 오크 원한 품음. 많은 오크 아마 여전히 공격. 그러면 인간도 스스로 지켜도 됨. 근데 거기서 싸움 피해야 함.
All Roads to Peace#399.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#400.src: ...if villager continue attack, will defend selves as before. Human, make sure villager know this.
All Roads to Peace#400.dst: ...주민 계속 공격하면 전처럼 스스로 지킴. 인간, 주민이 이거 꼭 알게 해.
All Roads to Peace#400.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#401.src: Mhm. Villager more stupid than human. Villager do many terrible thing. But endless war not help fix.
All Roads to Peace#401.dst: 음. 주민 인간보다 더 바보. 주민 끔찍한 짓 많이 함. 근데 끝없는 전쟁 해결 못 함.
All Roads to Peace#401.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#402.src: Peace first step to heal. ...unless villager to stupid thing. Then may need fight anyway.
All Roads to Peace#402.dst: 평화는 치유 첫걸음. ...주민 바보짓 안 하면. 그럼 어차피 싸워야 할지도.
All Roads to Peace#402.speaker: Zuett

All Roads to Peace#403.src: So Zuett not naive. Some things...cannot...be...forgiven. Villager treading line close.
All Roads to Peace#403.dst: 그럼 Zuett 순진하지 않음. 어떤 건...용서...못...함. 주민 선 가까이 밟는 중.
All Roads to Peace#403.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#404.src: Human seen earth rotting in north. Have to have, since took fort in rotting place. Forest used to be living thing. Now dying. Dead in north-east.
All Roads to Peace#404.dst: 인간 북쪽 썩는 대지 봤음. 봤을 것, 썩는 곳 요새 차지했으니. 숲 원래 살아 있었음. 지금 죽어 감. 북동쪽 죽음.
All Roads to Peace#404.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#405.src: Start happening only few decades before Villager leave across ocean! Villager always run away from problem.
All Roads to Peace#405.dst: 주민 바다 건너 떠나기 겨우 몇십 년 전 시작! 주민 늘 문제에서 도망침.
All Roads to Peace#405.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#406.src: And villager create own problems. Can only mean villager hurt earth, and make her die, slow and sure. Many orc used to live there.
All Roads to Peace#406.dst: 그리고 주민 스스로 문제 만듦. 주민이 대지 해쳐서 천천히, 확실히 죽게 한 거 말고 없음. 옛날 거기 오크 많이 살았음.
All Roads to Peace#406.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#407.src: Even after villager move in, try kick orc out, many orc live there...then earth start to die. Has not come south- and we are south!
All Roads to Peace#407.dst: 주민 들어와서 오크 내쫓으려 해도 많은 오크 거기 살았음... 그러다 대지 죽기 시작. 남쪽엔 아직 안 옴- 우리 남쪽에 있음!
All Roads to Peace#407.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#408.src: But...that off-track. No more war. Give this to whatever villager need to see it.
All Roads to Peace#408.dst: 근데...얘기 샜음. 전쟁 더 없음. 이거 봐야 하는 주민한테 줘.
All Roads to Peace#408.speaker: Arrai-Veretel

All Roads to Peace#409.src: Show Captain Goruca the Cease-Fire Agreement.
All Roads to Peace#409.dst: Goruca 대장에게 휴전 협정서를 보여 주세요.

All Roads to Peace#410.src: Human! You're back! That certainly took you a while. I suppose all things considered I shouldn't be surprised. Those orcs are tough.
All Roads to Peace#410.dst: 인간! 돌아왔군! 꽤 오래 걸렸어. 뭐, 이것저것 따져 보면 놀랄 일도 아니지. 그 오크들 만만치 않거든.
All Roads to Peace#410.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#411.src: What's this? You actually managed to get the brutes to sign a ceasefire?! I was expecting you to come back with a bloody prize, not a signature!
All Roads to Peace#411.dst: 이게 뭐지? 정말 그 짐승들한테 휴전 서명을 받아 냈다고?! 난 피 묻은 전리품을 가져올 줄 알았지, 서명일 줄은!
All Roads to Peace#411.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#412.src: After the way they so savagely attacked our outpost and the way they rebuffed our diplomacy squads, I wasn't expecting this.
All Roads to Peace#412.dst: 우리 전초기지를 그렇게 잔혹하게 공격하고 외교 분대를 그렇게 퇴짜 놓았는데, 이럴 줄은 몰랐어.
All Roads to Peace#412.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#413.src: Still, this is good! The terms are a bit more airtight than I'd prefer, but I suppose as long as they're out of our hair anything will do.
All Roads to Peace#413.dst: 그래도 잘됐어! 조건이 바라던 것보다 좀 빡빡하지만, 녀석들이 우리 귀찮게만 안 하면 뭐든 괜찮겠지.
All Roads to Peace#413.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#414.src: Hm? The orcs were talking about the decay up north? Not sure how that matters. It isn't like anyone knows what's causing it.
All Roads to Peace#414.dst: 음? 오크들이 북쪽 쇠락 얘기를 했다고? 그게 무슨 상관인지 모르겠군. 원인을 아는 사람도 없잖아.
All Roads to Peace#414.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#415.src: I mean, have you heard the rumors flying from {p}? Saying witches are cursing the land, hah! Well, that's besides the point.
All Roads to Peace#415.dst: 그러니까, {p}에서 도는 소문 들었어? 마녀들이 땅에 저주를 건다나, 하! 뭐, 그건 중요한 게 아니고.
All Roads to Peace#415.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#416.src: Here- your reward. I'd intended on giving you the mask so you could try and sneak in like one of them, but I...well, I forgot about it til you'd already left.
All Roads to Peace#416.dst: 자- 보상이다. 원래 이 가면을 줘서 녀석들처럼 꾸미고 잠입해 보라 하려 했는데... 네가 떠날 때까지 깜빡했지 뭐야.
All Roads to Peace#416.speaker: Captain Goruca

All Roads to Peace#417.src: But I DID magically fortify it into a potent piece of gear instead! So it ought to serve you well. We thank you for your service, human!
All Roads to Peace#417.dst: 대신 마법으로 강화해서 강력한 장비로 '만들어' 놨어! 요긴하게 쓰일 거야. 수고에 감사한다, 인간!
All Roads to Peace#417.speaker: Captain Goruca

An Iron Heart Part I#000.src: ...I am... What^s my...name...? I had one...

An Iron Heart Part I#001.src: Re...remember!! WHAT IS MY NAME? My life?

An Iron Heart Part I#002.src: REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!! No...no oives!

An Iron Heart Part I#003.src: My name!! My life! I won't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PLEASE!

An Iron Heart Part I#004.src: NO MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE VOICES THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [ERROR]!! [ERROR]!! NOOO!!

An Iron Heart Part I#005.src: Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [ERROR] ... Ma[ERROine... Madeleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-

An Iron Heart Part I#007.src: Oh, you there! I wasn't expecting a human soldier to be here, but you've come at a perfect time. I could use some help, see.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.dst: 오, 거기 당신! 인간 병사가 여기 있을 줄은 몰랐는데, 마침 잘 왔어요. 도움이 좀 필요하거든요.
An Iron Heart Part I#007.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#008.src: I'm certain you know about Guard Golems, yes? They're manufactured here in Gavel, and I bought one recently.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.dst: 경비 골렘은 당연히 알죠? 여기 Gavel에서 만드는데, 얼마 전에 하나 샀어요.
An Iron Heart Part I#008.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#009.src: The goblins keep trying to forage in my farms, you see- I needed something to keep them out, and a Golem would have been perfect.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.dst: 고블린들이 자꾸 제 농장을 뒤지려 해서요- 막을 게 필요했는데, 골렘이면 딱이었죠.
An Iron Heart Part I#009.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#010.src: But, shortly after I activated it, the thing attacked me! I nearly got killed- It was ramming itself against boulders and walls...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.dst: 그런데 켜자마자 그게 절 공격했어요! 죽을 뻔했다고요- 바위랑 벽에 제 몸을 들이받고 있었어요...
An Iron Heart Part I#010.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#011.src: I obviously was sold a defective model... That golem is a danger to everything around it. Do you think you're up to subduing it?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.dst: 불량품을 산 게 분명해요... 저 골렘은 주변 모든 것에 위험해요. 제압할 수 있겠어요?
An Iron Heart Part I#011.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#012.src: It's shed a trail of scrap, as you can see. Please, follow the trail of scrap and keep it from causing anyone more damage!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.dst: 보다시피 고철 조각을 흘리고 갔어요. 부탁이에요, 고철 흔적을 따라가서 더는 누가 다치지 않게 해 주세요!
An Iron Heart Part I#012.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#013.src: Find the defective Guard Golem in the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part I#015.src: ...I am... w̶h̴at^s my...na̷m̸e...? I had one...

An Iron Heart Part I#016.src: Re...remember!! W̵H̸A̶T̸ IS MY N̵A̴M̵E̵? My life?
An Iron Heart Part I#016.dst: 기...기억해!! 내 이름은 뭐지? 내 삶은?

An Iron Heart Part I#017.src: REMEMBER!! No...no orders! No dREMEMBER!! No...no o irectREMEMBER!!
An Iron Heart Part I#017.dst: 기억해!! 안...명령 없어! 명기억해!! 안...명 령기억해!!

An Iron Heart Part I#018.src: My name!! My life! I wo̴n't hurt them! The pain helps me reme...who's there?! LEAVE! PL̴E̵A̷SE!
An Iron Heart Part I#018.dst: 내 이름!! 내 삶! 그들을 안 다치게 할 거야! 고통이 기억을 도와... 거기 누구야?! 가! 제발!
An Iron Heart Part I#018.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#019.src: No directives!! Who did this?! I can't...s-stop giving me ORDERS!!
An Iron Heart Part I#019.dst: 지시 없어!! 누가 이런 짓을?! 난... 그, 그만 명령해!!
An Iron Heart Part I#019.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#020.src: N- MORE COLDNESS! NO MORE V̴O̸I̶C̴E̷S THAT AREN'T MINE! MY NAME IS [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]!! NOOO!!
An Iron Heart Part I#020.dst: 그- 더는 차갑지 않게! 내 것 아닌 목소리 그만! 내 이름은 [ERROR]!! [ERROR]!! 안 돼!!
An Iron Heart Part I#020.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#021.src: Subdue the defective Guard Golem and return to Duvale at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part I#021.dst: 불량 경비 골렘을 제압하고 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Duvale에게 돌아가세요

An Iron Heart Part I#022.src: Falling...apart...this isn't who I I I was... My... My... My my my my my name is. Was. Is. Was. Is. IS...! [̶E̷R̶R̷O̸R̷]... Ma[̶E̷R̶R̷O̸ine... Ma̷deleine!! I'm Madeleine... I... I-I-IIIIIIIIII-
An Iron Heart Part I#022.dst: 무너진다...이건 내가 아니야 야 야... 내... 내... 내 내 내 이름은. 였다. 이다. 였다. 이다. 이다...! [ERROR]... Ma[ERROine... Madeleine!! 난 Madeleine... 난... 나-나-나나나나-
An Iron Heart Part I#022.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part I#023.src: Were you able to subdue the golem? You certainly look like you're in one piece.
An Iron Heart Part I#023.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#024.src: Ach...that stings. I shouldn't be surprised you had to destroy it, but that was still a big wasted investment for me.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.dst: 아이고...속 쓰리네. 부술 수밖에 없었던 건 이해하지만, 그래도 큰돈 날렸어요.
An Iron Heart Part I#024.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#025.src: Still, it makes me wonder...it sounded like it was talking when I first turned it on- Wait, you heard it too?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.dst: 그래도 궁금하네요... 처음 켰을 때 말을 하는 것 같았거든요- 잠깐, 당신도 들었어요?
An Iron Heart Part I#025.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#026.src: Hm. There are some unsavory rumors about the factory, come to think of it... Maybe there's some stock to them.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.dst: 흠. 생각해 보니 그 공장에 안 좋은 소문이 좀 있었죠... 근거가 있는 건지도 몰라요.
An Iron Heart Part I#026.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#027.src: It said a name? Madeleine? It doesn't exactly ring a bell, but that's...rather concerning. I never mentioned a Madeleine to it.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.dst: 이름을 말했다고요? Madeleine? 전혀 모르는 이름인데... 꽤 걱정되네요. 걔한테 Madeleine 얘기는 한 적도 없어요.
An Iron Heart Part I#027.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#028.src: This is worth sending onto the police, really. I think I might have to write to {p}- the factory is near there.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.dst: 이건 경찰에 알려야겠어요. {p}에 편지를 써야겠네요- 공장이 그 근처거든요.
An Iron Heart Part I#028.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part I#029.src: Til then, here. Consider this your reward for helping me out, brave Human. Good luck out there.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.dst: 그때까지 이거 받아요. 도와준 보상이에요, 용감한 인간. 조심히 다녀요.
An Iron Heart Part I#029.speaker: Duvale

An Iron Heart Part II#000.src: Have you found any leads since I sent you to my contact, Daxe?

An Iron Heart Part II#001.src: Duvale mentioned rumors about an illegal factory in the swamp... If Daxe's criminal past had to do with this, maybe the [Mechanical Reactor] will cause him to react. Duvale mentioned he had spares, should they be needed.

An Iron Heart Part II#002.src: The guard golem left...but the reactor has stopped working.

An Iron Heart Part II#003.src: Go on, search my house. Or are you just here to waste my time?

An Iron Heart Part II#005.src: So what is it? Have you made your decision?

An Iron Heart Part II#007.src: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. All missing...
An Iron Heart Part II#007.dst: Hotor, Athomo, Arperi, Etyir, Taiyroth, On'omi, Danin, Nesys, Onton. 전부 실종됐어요...
An Iron Heart Part II#007.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#008.src: Etan is the latest. You don't happen to know anything about these people, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#008.dst: 가장 최근엔 Etan이고요. 혹시 이 사람들에 대해 아는 거 있나요, 병사님?
An Iron Heart Part II#008.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#009.src: Citizens are going missing at an alarming rate. We have lost {~} people in just {~} weeks. There hasn't been a trace of them anywhere.
An Iron Heart Part II#009.dst: 시민들이 무서운 속도로 사라지고 있어요. 겨우 {~2}주 만에 {~1}명이 실종됐는데, 어디에도 흔적이 없어요.
An Iron Heart Part II#009.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#010.src: You wouldn't have expected it, with all the guard golems we've been donated recently! {p} should be safer than ever.
An Iron Heart Part II#010.dst: 최근에 경비 골렘도 잔뜩 기증받았는데 이럴 줄 누가 알았겠어요! {p}은(는) 그 어느 때보다 안전해야 하는데.
An Iron Heart Part II#010.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#011.src: Of course I have my suspicions, there are rumors floating around about...shady business going on.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.dst: 물론 짚이는 데는 있어요. 뭔가... 수상한 거래가 있다는 소문이 돌거든요.
An Iron Heart Part II#011.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#012.src: I don't know who to trust in these circumstances, so if you would be willing to aid in this investigation, I'd be rather thankful.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.dst: 이런 상황에선 누굴 믿어야 할지 모르겠어요. 수사를 도와준다면 정말 고맙겠어요.
An Iron Heart Part II#012.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#013.src: The “Great” Daxe is a man with a criminal past. He knows things the police don't, but he won't talk with me, given my status.
An Iron Heart Part II#013.dst: '위대한' Daxe는 전과가 있는 자예요. 경찰도 모르는 걸 알지만, 제 신분 때문에 저랑은 말을 안 하죠.
An Iron Heart Part II#013.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#014.src: Can you try to get some information from him? You can find his hut west from here. Next to that Elven girl's camp.
An Iron Heart Part II#014.dst: 그자한테서 정보 좀 캐 줄래요? 오두막은 여기서 서쪽, 엘프 소녀의 야영지 옆이에요.
An Iron Heart Part II#014.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#015.src: Follow the west road and speak with Daxe in his home at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
An Iron Heart Part II#015.dst: 서쪽 길을 따라가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 집에 있는 Daxe와 대화하세요

An Iron Heart Part II#016.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.dst: 오, 인간 따위가 위대한 Daxe의 집에 기어들어 오시겠다?
An Iron Heart Part II#016.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#017.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind.
An Iron Heart Part II#017.dst: 안됐지만 난 손님을 안 좋아해. 범죄자 시절은 이미 청산했다고.
An Iron Heart Part II#017.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#018.src: So go on. I don't have anything to tell you.
An Iron Heart Part II#018.dst: 그러니 가 봐. 너한테 해 줄 말은 없어.
An Iron Heart Part II#018.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#019.src: Oh, so a human wishes to wander into the home of the great Daxe?
An Iron Heart Part II#019.dst: 오, 인간 따위가 위대한 Daxe의 집에 기어들어 오시겠다?
An Iron Heart Part II#019.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#020.src: Unfortunately for you, I'm not fond of visitors. I've left my criminal past behind...mh?
An Iron Heart Part II#020.dst: 안됐지만 난 손님을 안 좋아해. 범죄자 시절은 이미 청산했다고...음?
An Iron Heart Part II#020.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#021.src: What's that device you have there? So you already know about this, then...?
An Iron Heart Part II#021.dst: 거기 가진 장치는 뭐야? 그럼 이미 알고 있다는 거...?
An Iron Heart Part II#021.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#022.src: Hm! If you already know, what do you need the information for?
An Iron Heart Part II#022.dst: 흥! 이미 안다면 정보는 뭐 하러 필요한데?
An Iron Heart Part II#022.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#024.src: MADELEINE! Where's...wait! What's happening, where am I? WHO'S VOICE IS THIS?!
An Iron Heart Part II#024.dst: MADELEINE! 어디...잠깐! 무슨 일이지, 여긴 어디야? 이건 누구 목소리야?!
An Iron Heart Part II#024.speaker: Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part II#025.src: Wait, what in the world is going on?! What did you do to my golem?!
An Iron Heart Part II#025.dst: 잠깐, 대체 무슨 일이야?! 내 골렘한테 무슨 짓을 한 거야?!
An Iron Heart Part II#025.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#026.src: They... my daughter... SHUT UP! QUIET! Who's giving me orders- NO ORDERS! Cold! COLD!
An Iron Heart Part II#026.dst: 그놈들이... 내 딸... 닥쳐! 조용히 해! 누가 명령을- 명령하지 마! 추워! 추워!
An Iron Heart Part II#026.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#027.dst: 잠깐, 네 딸?! M-Madeleine...? 내가...어, 어떻게...뭐...?
An Iron Heart Part II#027.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#028.src: You...you aren't...dead steel? You remember your name...?!
An Iron Heart Part II#028.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#029.src: STOP GIVING ME ORDERS!! I'M...I'M THEODORE! I'M NOT A SERVANT! I...where has my life gone...? Where is...
An Iron Heart Part II#029.dst: 명령하지 마!! 나는...나는 THEODORE다! 난 하인이 아니야! 나...내 인생은 어디로 갔지...? 어디...
An Iron Heart Part II#029.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#030.src: Madeleine... Where are you- RE-AFFIRMING DIRECTIVES. BZZT. ... ... ...
An Iron Heart Part II#030.dst: Madeleine... 어디 있니- 지침 재확인. 지직. ... ... ...
An Iron Heart Part II#030.speaker: Guard Golem?

An Iron Heart Part II#031.src: I... I can't believe it. They didn't...they're still...
An Iron Heart Part II#031.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#032.src: Dear god, that...that must...I'll talk. I will tell you what I know.
An Iron Heart Part II#032.dst: 맙소사, 그럼...그건...말할게. 아는 걸 다 말해 주지.
An Iron Heart Part II#032.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#033.src: I broke into the golem factory for petty thievery...and found them. They gave me this Golem... Theodore...later to keep me quiet.
An Iron Heart Part II#033.dst: 좀도둑질하러 골렘 공장에 숨어들었다가...그들을 봤어. 나중에 입막음으로 이 골렘을... Theodore를 받았지.
An Iron Heart Part II#033.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#034.src: They assured me that they were gone, that every last bit of them was erased. They...those monsters lied to me...
An Iron Heart Part II#034.dst: 그놈들은 전부 사라졌다고, 흔적도 없이 지워졌다고 장담했어. 그...그 괴물들이 날 속였어...
An Iron Heart Part II#034.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#035.src: Follow this road west and turn right. Look for Urelix. The factory is hidden in a cabin, it won't look like a factory.
An Iron Heart Part II#035.dst: 이 길로 서쪽으로 가다가 우회전해. Urelix를 찾아. 공장은 오두막 안에 숨겨져 있어서 공장처럼 안 보여.
An Iron Heart Part II#035.speaker: Daxe

An Iron Heart Part II#036.src: Head to the Golem Factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

An Iron Heart Part II#037.src: Find a way to deactivate the Guard Golem

An Iron Heart Part II#038.src: And what do you think you are doing, barging into my humble home like this? Do they not teach humans manners in Wynn?
An Iron Heart Part II#038.dst: 이렇게 내 누추한 집에 쳐들어와서 뭘 하려는 거지? Wynn에선 인간에게 예의도 안 가르치나?
An Iron Heart Part II#038.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#039.src: Ah, yes. You are correct- I oversee the creation of Guard Golems. What of it?
An Iron Heart Part II#039.dst: 아, 그래. 맞아- 내가 경비 골렘 제작을 감독하지. 그게 뭐?
An Iron Heart Part II#039.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#040.src: Oh, you believe that our company is illicit somehow? You insult me so!
An Iron Heart Part II#040.dst: 오, 우리 회사가 뭔가 불법이라고 생각하나? 이거 참 모욕적이군!
An Iron Heart Part II#040.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#041.src: My golems have protected countless people for years. So if you think my company is corrupt, why don't you take a look around?
An Iron Heart Part II#041.dst: 내 골렘은 수년간 수많은 사람을 지켜 왔어. 내 회사가 썩었다고 생각한다면 직접 둘러보지 그래?
An Iron Heart Part II#041.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#042.src: Go on, search through my house. See if you can find anything.
An Iron Heart Part II#042.dst: 어서, 내 집을 뒤져 봐. 뭐라도 찾을 수 있나 보자고.
An Iron Heart Part II#042.speaker: Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#043.src: Find a way into the factory in Urelix's house
An Iron Heart Part II#043.dst: Urelix의 집에서 공장으로 들어가는 길을 찾으세요

An Iron Heart Part II#044.src: Escape the Golem Factory and find Urelix.

An Iron Heart Part II#045.src: Initiating Chip Insertion Machine - All personell in machine be advised, avoid the spikes.
An Iron Heart Part II#045.dst: 칩 삽입기 가동 - 기계 내 모든 인원은 주의 바람. 가시를 피하십시오.

An Iron Heart Part II#046.src: Intruder Detected - Emergency meltdown initiated. Please evacuate immediately via the emergency exit.
An Iron Heart Part II#046.dst: 침입자 감지 - 긴급 용융 개시. 즉시 비상구로 대피하십시오.

An Iron Heart Part II#047.src: Talk to Dr. Urelix in his office
An Iron Heart Part II#047.dst: 사무실에 있는 Urelix 박사에게 말을 거세요

An Iron Heart Part II#048.src: Well well, look at you, here at the end of my factory. I wasn't expecting you to survive the production line. I thought you'd be one of ours by now.
An Iron Heart Part II#048.dst: 이런, 이런. 내 공장 끝까지 왔군. 생산 라인에서 살아남을 줄은 몰랐어. 지금쯤이면 우리 쪽이 됐을 줄 알았는데.
An Iron Heart Part II#048.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#049.src: That's that, I suppose. Yes, this is indeed where all the iron golems you've ever encountered were made, and if you've gotten here, you know how we make them.
An Iron Heart Part II#049.dst: 뭐, 그렇게 됐군. 그래, 네가 봐 온 철 골렘은 전부 여기서 만들어졌어. 여기까지 왔다면 어떻게 만드는지도 알겠지.
An Iron Heart Part II#049.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#050.src: Yes, metal forged with flesh...an unbeatable combination. Emotions and memories must be repressed in order to maintain obedience, of course...
An Iron Heart Part II#050.dst: 그래, 살과 함께 벼린 금속...무적의 조합이지. 물론 복종을 유지하려면 감정과 기억은 억눌러야 하고...
An Iron Heart Part II#050.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#051.src: Have you ever looked at a golem's eyes? Sometimes they look back, yes. The person they once were is still in there. I almost feel a connection when I make eye contact with them...
An Iron Heart Part II#051.dst: 골렘의 눈을 본 적 있나? 가끔은 마주 보지. 예전의 그 사람이 아직 안에 있거든. 눈이 마주치면 교감하는 기분마저 들어...
An Iron Heart Part II#051.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#052.src: It's odd, honestly. I'm sure they don't feel much except cold, supposing our safeguards stay in place, of course. I have to assume malfunctions happened to have had you find us out...
An Iron Heart Part II#052.dst: 솔직히 묘한 일이야. 안전장치만 제대로 있으면 추위 말곤 별로 못 느낄 텐데. 네가 우릴 알아낸 걸 보면 오작동이 있었던 모양이군...
An Iron Heart Part II#052.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#053.src: Oh, look at me now, rambling! I must say I have been alone for a while...well, lacking any company that converses! So, I shall make you a deal, human.
An Iron Heart Part II#053.dst: 오, 이런, 말이 많았군! 한동안 혼자였거든...뭐, 대화가 되는 상대가 없었다는 뜻이지! 그러니 거래를 하자, 인간.
An Iron Heart Part II#053.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#054.src: I will give you a substantial amount of emeralds and a piece of quality iron armor in return for your silence on my little operation here.
An Iron Heart Part II#054.dst: 내 작은 사업에 대해 입을 다물어 준다면, 에메랄드 두둑이와 좋은 철 갑옷 한 벌을 주지.
An Iron Heart Part II#054.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#055.src: I'll advise you to take my deal. Imagine what will happen if you should report my operation to the police. Yes, you'll save a few folk here, but how will the golems be made?
An Iron Heart Part II#055.dst: 거래를 받아들이길 권하지. 경찰에 신고하면 어떻게 될지 생각해 봐. 그래, 몇 명은 구하겠지. 하지만 골렘은 어떻게 만들 거지?
An Iron Heart Part II#055.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#056.src: Without them, both Gavel and Wynn would struggle under the weight of our wars. Is this operation so immoral, then? Sacrifices must be made in order to survive.
An Iron Heart Part II#056.dst: 골렘이 없다면 Gavel도 Wynn도 전쟁의 무게에 짓눌릴 거야. 그러니 이게 그렇게 비도덕적인가? 살아남으려면 희생은 필요해.
An Iron Heart Part II#056.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#057.src: I'll give you some time to consider my proposition. Take from my chest if you wish to take up my offer, otherwise get out of here and do not return.
An Iron Heart Part II#057.dst: 생각할 시간을 주지. 제안을 받아들일 거면 상자에서 가져가고, 아니면 여기서 나가서 다신 오지 마.
An Iron Heart Part II#057.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#058.src: Either take the bribe or return to Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#059.src: Ahh, a wise choice. Production will continue then...and you've earned yourself a pocket full of emeralds at the same time.
An Iron Heart Part II#059.dst: 아, 현명한 선택이야. 그럼 생산은 계속되겠지...그리고 넌 덤으로 주머니 가득 에메랄드를 챙겼고.
An Iron Heart Part II#059.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#060.src: Whether you truly see things my way or simply understand that my work is necessary, I couldn't care less. What matters is not your morality, but your choice.
An Iron Heart Part II#060.dst: 네가 정말 내 생각에 동의하든, 그저 내 일이 필요하다는 걸 이해했든 난 전혀 상관없어. 중요한 건 도덕이 아니라 선택이지.
An Iron Heart Part II#060.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#061.src: Enjoy your armor and money, and please escort yourself to the exit.
An Iron Heart Part II#061.dst: 갑옷이랑 돈 잘 쓰고, 출구는 알아서 나가 줘.
An Iron Heart Part II#061.speaker: Dr. Urelix

An Iron Heart Part II#062.src: You've returned, I see. Any news on the situation?
An Iron Heart Part II#062.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#063.src: Yes, we're aware of the Golem factory. Were the criminals using it as a base?
An Iron Heart Part II#063.dst: 네, 골렘 공장은 알고 있어요. 범죄자들이 거길 아지트로 쓰던가요?
An Iron Heart Part II#063.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#064.src: Wha...fleshcrafting?! Golems are powered by suspended villagers?! Is this true, soldier?
An Iron Heart Part II#064.dst: 뭐...육체 개조?! 골렘이 산 채로 갇힌 주민들로 움직인다고요?! 사실인가요, 병사님?
An Iron Heart Part II#064.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#065.src: We'll need to round up reinforcements immediately, and storm this factory! This cannot go on a moment longer!
An Iron Heart Part II#065.dst: 당장 지원 병력을 모아서 그 공장을 급습해야겠어요! 한순간도 더 이대로 둘 순 없어요!
An Iron Heart Part II#065.speaker: Detective Hart

An Iron Heart Part II#066.src: Don't think you'll go unrewarded, soldier. There will be justice for this grave defilement of our people.
An Iron Heart Part II#066.dst: 보상은 꼭 받게 될 거예요, 병사님. 우리 백성을 이토록 더럽힌 일엔 반드시 정의가 내려질 거예요.
An Iron Heart Part II#066.speaker: Detective Hart

Apotheosis (Quest)#000.src: Head to {p} and find your friends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#001.src: Fight through {p} and find your friends.

Apotheosis (Quest)#002.src: Ha. Your bow control is sloppy, "captain."
Apotheosis (Quest)#002.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#006.src: Thanks for the support, {u}! Not sure how much longer I could've held out on my own.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.dst: 도와줘서 고마워, {u}! 혼자서는 얼마나 더 버틸 수 있었을지 모르겠어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#006.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#007.src: We were about to regroup with the Canopy, but Cileon spotted soldiers approaching through the hotel windows.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.dst: Canopy랑 다시 합류하려던 참에, Cileon이 호텔 창문 너머로 병사들이 오는 걸 봤어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#007.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#008.src: They've stormed the plaza, and probably the rest of the city by now... I think they've rounded up all the citizens at the festival grounds.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.dst: 놈들이 광장을 쳐들어왔고, 지금쯤 도시 전체를 장악했을 거야... 시민들을 전부 축제장에 몰아넣은 것 같아.
Apotheosis (Quest)#008.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#009.src: We all got split up in the commotion - the others are probably fighting their own battles! Come on, we need to get moving!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.dst: 난리통에 다들 흩어졌어. 다른 애들도 각자 싸우고 있을 거야! 어서, 움직여야 해!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#009.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#011.src: Find the rest of your friends in {p}.

Apotheosis (Quest)#013.src: Phew... th...that was close. {u}, it's g- good to see you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.dst: 휴... 아, 아슬아슬했어. {u}, 다, 다시 봐서 반가워.
Apotheosis (Quest)#013.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#014.src: Where are the others? Have you seen them?
Apotheosis (Quest)#014.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#015.src: I saw Cileon u- up ahead! But I l- lo- lost sight of Sui a while ago...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.dst: Cileon은 저, 저 앞에서 봤어! 근데 Sui는 좀 전에 노, 놓쳤어...
Apotheosis (Quest)#015.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#016.src: Then what are we waiting for?! Let's get moving!
Apotheosis (Quest)#016.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#018.src: ...{u}, if y...you're here, then... the Queen...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#018.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#019.src: Worry about our friends first, Queen second! Come one, move move move!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.dst: 친구들 먼저 걱정하고, 여왕은 그다음이야! 어서, 가자 가자 가자!
Apotheosis (Quest)#019.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#024.src: Th...that was awesome, Cileon!! Could you t- te- teach me some of your techni-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.dst: 대, 대단했어, Cileon!! 나한테도 기, 기술 좀 가르쳐 줄 수-
Apotheosis (Quest)#024.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#025.src: ZEPH! There's no TIME!! Cileon, have you seen Sui?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.dst: ZEPH! 그럴 시간 없어!! Cileon, Sui 봤어?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#025.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#033.src: Sui, that was i- in- incredible!! But, using that much m...magic... be careful not to use up all of your st- strength...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.dst: Sui, 굉장했어!! 그래도 마, 마법을 그렇게 많이 쓰면... 힘을 다 쓰, 쓰지 않게 조심해...
Apotheosis (Quest)#033.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#034.src: ...it's fine, Zeph. It doesn't drain me to use, anymore. I can just... pull on the strands.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.dst: ...괜찮아, Zeph. 이제는 써도 기운이 안 빠져. 그냥... 가닥을 당기기만 하면 돼.
Apotheosis (Quest)#034.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#036.src: R- ri- right... the festival speech. Should we try to l...listen in on it?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.dst: 마, 맞다... 축제 연설. 우리 가서 드, 들어 볼까?
Apotheosis (Quest)#036.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#037.src: What?! No! We're all safe, so let's get out of here and regroup with the rest of the Canopy! Doing anything else is way too risky-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.dst: 뭐?! 안 돼! 다들 무사하니까 여기서 빠져나가서 Canopy 사람들이랑 합류하자! 다른 짓은 너무 위험해-
Apotheosis (Quest)#037.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#038.src: No. I'm... I'm done running away. We're going in.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.dst: 아니. 난... 이제 도망치는 건 그만할래. 들어가자.
Apotheosis (Quest)#038.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#040.src: She's responsible for everything that has happened to us. I'm not going to just... let her get away when she's RIGHT THERE!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.dst: 우리한테 일어난 일은 전부 그 여자 탓이야. 바로 저기 있는데 그냥... 놓아줄 순 없어!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#040.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#041.src: She's going to pay for all of it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#041.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#042.src: S- Sui... you don't h- have to do it alone.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.dst: S, Sui... 혼, 혼자 할 필요는 없어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#042.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#043.src: ...fine. Fine! Let's do it, then! Let's go... face the Queen.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.dst: ...좋아. 좋다고! 그럼 해 보자! 가서... 여왕이랑 맞서자.
Apotheosis (Quest)#043.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#044.src: Make your way to the festival grounds at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#048.src: ...th- this was a bad idea. We n...need to get out of-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.dst: ...이, 이건 나쁜 생각이었어. 여기서 빠, 빠져나가-
Apotheosis (Quest)#048.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#049.src: People of the {p}! I deeply apologize for the disruption to your routines. You must be confused, afraid.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.dst: {p}의 백성들이여! 일상을 방해하게 되어 깊이 사과하노라. 혼란스럽고, 두렵겠지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#049.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#050.src: This festival is a time for joy, for celebration! But there are those within your midst who reject this notion. They aim to bring destruction, chaos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.dst: 이 축제는 기쁨과 경축의 시간이다! 허나 너희 가운데 이를 거부하는 자들이 있다. 그들은 파괴와 혼돈을 노리고 있다!
Apotheosis (Quest)#050.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#051.src: Indeed... a plot to twist our province's ideals, to destroy our very way of life! The perpetrators lurking in your city, feigning innocence... what a disgrace.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.dst: 그렇다... 우리 지방의 이상을 비틀고, 우리 삶의 방식을 무너뜨리려는 음모! 너희 도시에 숨어 무고한 척하는 범인들... 참으로 수치로다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#051.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#052.src: It was your very own Sovereign, Majin Thalas, whose quick thinking brought down the terrorists' plot! The Wings, the Constables, the Local Guard, all have mobilized to capture the perpetrators.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.dst: 테러리스트의 음모를 기민하게 막아 낸 것은 바로 너희의 군주, Majin Thalas였다! 날개 기사단, 치안대, 지역 경비대가 모두 범인 체포에 나섰다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#052.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#053.src: Soon, we shall have them chained before you. Soon, you shall see the faces of this blight, this infection in the veins of our province.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.dst: 곧 그들을 사슬에 묶어 너희 앞에 세우리라. 곧 이 역병의 얼굴을, 우리 지방의 혈관에 퍼진 이 감염을 보게 되리라.
Apotheosis (Quest)#053.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#054.src: And soon, we shall cut. It. Out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#054.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#055.src: Listen to Her Majesty and her Sovereigns.

Apotheosis (Quest)#058.src: And so it would seem my Sovereigns have once again failed to perform what should be a very simple task.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.dst: 그렇다면 내 군주들이 또다시 아주 간단한 일조차 해내지 못한 모양이구나.
Apotheosis (Quest)#058.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#059.src: Sovereign Thalas, what, precisely, is it you have been teaching these soldiers of yours?! Because there should be no reason for them to have FAILED to capture these CHILDREN!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.dst: Thalas 군주, 대체 네 병사들에게 무엇을 가르친 것이냐?! 이 어린애들을 붙잡는 데 실패할 이유가 전혀 없거늘!
Apotheosis (Quest)#059.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#060.src: I told you we should've taken the direct solution! More dead soldiers, more of our people subtracted out, for nothing!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.dst: 직접적인 해법을 택하자고 했잖소! 병사만 더 죽고, 우리 백성만 더 빼기 됐지, 얻은 건 없소!
Apotheosis (Quest)#060.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#061.src: Hm! Now, let us be clear, the soldiers are-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.dst: 흠! 자, 분명히 해 두자면, 병사들은-
Apotheosis (Quest)#061.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#062.src: Oh, I do not care. Save your excuses.
Apotheosis (Quest)#062.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#063.src: I have given you more than enough chances to realise the weight of what it is we do!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.dst: 우리가 하는 일의 무게를 깨달을 기회를 이미 충분히 넘치도록 주었거늘!
Apotheosis (Quest)#063.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#064.src: You...you have proven very hard to pin down, it would seem. No matter the circumstances, you have a knack for slipping through the cracks...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.dst: 너... 너는 참으로 붙잡기 어려운 자로구나. 어떤 상황에서든 틈새로 빠져나가는 재주가 있어...
Apotheosis (Quest)#064.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#065.src: It would be oh so simple to blame you for all you have enacted... but the truth is, you were merely the catalyst. The seeds of this rebellion were planted long, long before you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.dst: 네가 저지른 모든 일을 네 탓으로 돌리기는 참 쉽겠지... 허나 사실 너는 촉매였을 뿐. 이 반란의 씨앗은 너보다 훨씬, 훨씬 전에 뿌려졌다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#065.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#066.src: Oh, the {p}... over these centuries, its beauty has never faded. The vibrant colors, the warm breeze of the changing seasons...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.dst: 오, {p}... 수백 년이 지나도 그 아름다움은 바래지 않았구나. 선명한 색채, 계절이 바뀔 때의 따스한 바람...
Apotheosis (Quest)#066.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#067.src: What a shame, then, that beneath the cover of the leaves, there lurk countless cowering pests. And no matter how hard I try, I cannot seem to wash them out.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.dst: 그러니 안타깝구나. 나뭇잎 그늘 아래 수없이 많은 해충이 웅크리고 있으니. 아무리 애써도 씻어 낼 수가 없어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#067.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#068.src: Fell the perceived source of their strength, cut the branches and burn the leaves, the fruit that emboldens their acts - and still, they persist!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.dst: 그들이 믿는 힘의 원천을 베어 넘기고, 가지를 치고 잎을 태우고, 대담하게 만드는 열매도 없앴다. 그런데도 버틴다!
Apotheosis (Quest)#068.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#069.src: Bury their monuments, erase their gods - and still, and STILL, they cling to ideals of love, of family! And still, and still, and still, they persist.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.dst: 기념비를 묻고, 신들을 지웠다. 그런데도, 그런데도 사랑과 가족이라는 이상에 매달린다! 그런데도, 그런데도, 버틴다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#069.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#070.src: Washing it all away had shown results... for a time. But even growing forth from a blank slate, even with no ties to what came before - still, still, STILL THEY PERSIST!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.dst: 모든 걸 씻어 내자 효과가 있었다... 한동안은. 허나 백지에서 다시 자라나도, 과거와 아무 연이 없어도, 그런데도, 그런데도, 그런데도 버틴다!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#070.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#071.src: There is a rot in the heart of that forest. I see that now. Perhaps, I had allowed my fondness for the region to blind me... but no more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.dst: 그 숲의 중심이 썩어 있다. 이제야 보이는구나. 그 지역에 대한 애정에 눈이 멀었던 모양이다... 허나 이제는 아니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#071.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#072.src: And so, as once we saw out the New Age, so again shall we wash away these pests. That accursed forest will drown, and the rot buried deep will be excised once more.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.dst: 그러니 새 시대를 떠나보냈던 그때처럼, 이 해충들을 다시 씻어 내리라. 저주받은 숲은 물에 잠기고, 깊이 묻힌 썩은 부분은 다시 한번 도려내질 것이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#072.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#074.src: W-With respect, that is not a viable angle! The Resistance is such a small percentage of the overall population, they're practically a rounding error!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.dst: 소, 송구하오나, 그건 성립하지 않는 해법입니다! 저항군은 전체 인구에서 극히 작은 비율, 사실상 반올림 오차입니다!
Apotheosis (Quest)#074.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#075.src: You can't divide out a quarter of our province's people, a-and just as much infrastructure, just to solve for a subset of rogue integers!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.dst: 불량 정수 몇 개를 풀자고, 지방 인구의 4분의 1과 그만큼의 기반 시설을 나눠 없앨 수는 없습니다!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#075.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#076.src: Learn when to keep your mouth shut, would you, Nasin?! We are standing before the public! This is not the time to raise such grievances-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.dst: 입 다물 때를 좀 배우시지, Nasin?! 백성들 앞이오! 그런 불만을 꺼낼 때가 아니-
Apotheosis (Quest)#076.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#077.src: That didn't stop you interrupting my sequence and openly denigrating the recruits at the tournament to fulfill your petty factoring grudge!! You have no excuses!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.dst: 그래 놓고 당신은 쪼잔한 앙금을 풀자고 내 수열을 끊고 대회에서 신병들을 대놓고 깎아내렸잖소!! 변명할 여지도 없소!
Apotheosis (Quest)#077.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#078.src: We- We have been wasting our numbers at every point. When did our vector shift to something so shortsighted? When did we lose sight of our nontrivial solution?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.dst: 우, 우린 매번 숫자를 낭비해 왔소. 언제부터 우리 벡터가 이리 근시안적으로 틀어졌소? 언제 자명하지 않은 해를 놓쳤단 말이오?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#078.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#079.src: You're both plugged into a destructive sequence! I can't enable these irrationalities!! I refuse to be a variable in this cyclical, downwards spiral!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.dst: 둘 다 파괴적인 수열에 꽂혀 있소! 이런 무리수는 용납 못 하오!! 이 순환 하강 나선의 변수가 되길 거부하겠소!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#079.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#080.src: Take care with what you do next, Zhiraok Nasin. If you turn away now, you will forsake your position and forfeit your life.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.dst: 다음 행동을 신중히 고르거라, Zhiraok Nasin. 지금 등을 돌리면 지위도 목숨도 잃게 될 것이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#080.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#083.src: If this is what honor is supposed to feel like, I don't want it anymore.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.dst: 이게 명예라는 거라면, 이제 필요 없습니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#083.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#084.src: My loyalty is to the people. If yours isn't, then our vectors no longer converge. I'm subtracting my pact to you myself.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.dst: 제 충성은 백성을 향합니다. 당신은 아니라면, 우리 벡터는 더는 수렴하지 않습니다. 당신과의 서약은 제 손으로 빼겠습니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#084.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#085.src: Gotta evacuate, contact Xao, the commanders, get everyone to higher ground, find where the helix S-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.dst: 대피시키고, Xao와 지휘관들에게 연락하고, 모두 고지대로 옮기고, 나선 S가 어디인지 찾-
Apotheosis (Quest)#085.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Apotheosis (Quest)#086.src: Hmph! You Majesty, if you would allow it, I would gladly put his head on a stick for you.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.dst: 흥! 폐하, 허락해 주신다면 기꺼이 저자의 목을 장대에 꽂아 드리겠습니다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#086.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#087.src: Firstly, Sovereign Thalas, I would have you clean up your mess. Execute the terrorists.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.dst: 우선, Thalas 군주, 네가 벌인 일부터 수습하거라. 테러리스트들을 처형해라.
Apotheosis (Quest)#087.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#088.src: ...and once you are done, you have my approval to hunt down ex-Sovereign Zhiraok Nasin.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.dst: ...그리고 끝나면, 전 군주 Zhiraok Nasin을 추적하는 것을 허락하마.
Apotheosis (Quest)#088.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#089.src: While you are at it, eliminate that entire House. They have disappointed me far too many times, and I have granted them far too many chances.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.dst: 하는 김에 그 가문 전체를 제거해라. 날 너무 여러 번 실망시켰고, 기회도 너무 많이 주었다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#089.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#090.src: Aha! Gladly. As you wish, Your Majesty. It will be done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.dst: 아하! 기꺼이. 분부대로 하겠습니다, 폐하. 반드시 해내지요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#090.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#091.src: Sovereign Tasim. You will be coming with me to the dam.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.dst: Tasim 군주. 너는 나와 함께 댐으로 간다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#091.speaker: Her Majesty

Apotheosis (Quest)#094.src: Ahhh... Finally! I'd been awaiting the day I'd get the chance to wipe you rats off the face of the planet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.dst: 아아... 드디어! 너희 쥐새끼들을 이 땅에서 쓸어버릴 날만 기다렸지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#094.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#095.src: But before we begin, I'm an honourable man, so I'll grant you this opportunity! Any last words for the crowd?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.dst: 허나 시작하기 전에, 난 명예를 아는 사람이니 기회를 주마! 관중에게 남길 유언은?
Apotheosis (Quest)#095.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#096.src: Ahahahaha! Did you, now? That the great Sovereign Majin would fall to a simple group of insurgents... What a laughably fanciful tale!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.dst: 아하하하하! 그렇단 말이지? 위대한 Majin 군주가 반란군 나부랭이에게 쓰러진다니... 이 얼마나 우스운 공상인가!
Apotheosis (Quest)#096.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#097.src: My goodness, what a statement! You truly believe so? That you of all people stand a chance against my might?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.dst: 세상에, 대단한 발언이군! 정말 그렇게 믿나? 하필 네가 내 힘에 맞설 수 있다고?
Apotheosis (Quest)#097.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#098.src: Oh, how dreadfully dull. If you are going to be so dramatic, use a better line, would you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#098.dst: 오, 지독히도 따분하군. 그렇게 극적으로 굴 거면 대사라도 좀 나은 걸로 하지 그래?
Apotheosis (Quest)#098.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#099.src: Ha! As if. Half those tabloids are filled with naught but meaningless gossip! Though, I do have an appreciation for the Majin Monthly. It's quite the interesting read, you know!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.dst: 하! 퍽이나. 그 가십지들 절반은 쓸데없는 뒷소문뿐이야! 그래도 Majin 월간지는 좀 좋아하지. 꽤 흥미로운 읽을거리라고!
Apotheosis (Quest)#099.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#100.src: Hm... But I'm afraid only one of you is worthy of facing me in combat. As for the rest of you pitiful worms...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.dst: 흠... 하지만 나와 겨룰 자격이 있는 건 너희 중 하나뿐이로군. 나머지 가련한 벌레들은...
Apotheosis (Quest)#100.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#102.src: Ah ah ah! Keep your eyes on what's important, mmn?
Apotheosis (Quest)#102.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#103.src: You should feel honoured! Very few are given the privilege of dying to my blade. I'd tell you to write about it in your memoirs, but...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.dst: 영광으로 알아라! 내 칼에 죽는 특권을 누리는 자는 극소수지. 회고록에 써 두라고 하고 싶지만...
Apotheosis (Quest)#103.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#104.src: Well, I don't imagine you'll have the chance. NOW -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.dst: 뭐, 그럴 기회는 없을 테니. 자 -
Apotheosis (Quest)#104.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#105.src: Defeat Majin. To return to the fight, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#106.src: Welcome to my domain of the starry night, dear guest! Quite the stunning view, is it not?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.dst: 별이 빛나는 밤의 내 영역에 온 걸 환영하네, 손님! 꽤 멋진 광경이지 않나?
Apotheosis (Quest)#106.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#107.src: By all means - take your time, take it all in, every little detail! Allow that feeling to sink in - your sheer insignificance in the face of the vastness of the cosmos!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.dst: 얼마든지 - 천천히, 하나하나 빠짐없이 감상하게! 그 느낌을 음미해 봐 - 광대한 우주 앞에서 너란 존재가 얼마나 하찮은지!
Apotheosis (Quest)#107.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#108.src: Ah... Her Majesty and the Spymaster, they held interest in you once. Looking upon you now, I simply cannot fathom why.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.dst: 아... 여왕 폐하와 첩보대장이 한때 너에게 관심을 가졌었지. 지금 보니 도무지 이유를 모르겠군.
Apotheosis (Quest)#108.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#109.src: But I suppose it matters not! You have certainly cut that strand of interest with all your assorted antics, haven't you?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.dst: 뭐, 상관없겠지! 온갖 소동을 피워서 그 관심의 끈을 스스로 끊어 버렸으니, 안 그래?
Apotheosis (Quest)#109.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#110.src: Well! If you must die, be glad it was to my blade! LET THE SHOW BEGIN!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.dst: 자! 어차피 죽을 거라면 내 칼에 죽는 걸 기뻐해라! 쇼를 시작하지!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#110.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Apotheosis (Quest)#111.src: Flooding the whole forest... There's- That can't be, th-there's no way...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.dst: 숲 전체를 물에 잠기게... 그건- 말도 안 돼, 그, 그럴 리가...
Apotheosis (Quest)#111.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#112.src: I certainly hope you've learned your lesson, Rose! This is what happens! Loose nails get hammered down!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.dst: 이번에 교훈 좀 얻었길 바라, Rose! 이렇게 되는 거라고! 모난 돌이 정 맞는 거야!
Apotheosis (Quest)#112.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#114.src: This is all happening because a certain SOMEONE incited violence against the crown! In the papers no less, where we do our work!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.dst: 이게 다 어떤 '누구'가 왕실에 대한 폭력을 선동해서잖아! 그것도 우리가 일하는 신문에서!
Apotheosis (Quest)#114.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#115.src: Risky, dangerous, all of it- and now look where we are! Public executions! We might not even be allowed to publish after this!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.dst: 위험하고, 무모하고, 전부 다- 그래서 지금 꼴을 봐! 공개 처형이라고! 이 일 후엔 발행도 못 하게 될지 몰라!
Apotheosis (Quest)#115.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#116.src: ...there are...HOW many people in danger right now, a-and all you can think to do is-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.dst: ...지금 위험에 처한 사람이... '몇 명'인데, 네, 네가 생각하는 건 고작-
Apotheosis (Quest)#116.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#118.src: How can you be so monumentally stupid?! At least they TRIED! At least they SHOWED UP! They followed through!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.dst: 어떻게 그렇게 엄청나게 멍청할 수가 있어?! 적어도 그 사람들은 '시도'했어! '나서기'라도 했다고! 끝까지 해냈어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#118.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#119.src: The first hope I've seen in years, and you throw petty insults at them?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.dst: 몇 년 만에 처음 본 희망인데, 거기다 대고 치졸한 욕이나 해?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#119.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#120.src: Ergh...where did you learn to hit?! Can you really only rely on that to make your point?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.dst: 윽...주먹은 어디서 배웠어?! 주장을 펼칠 방법이 그것밖에 없니?
Apotheosis (Quest)#120.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#121.src: Oh, grow UP already!! Think of something useful to do, instead of looking at the people who are doing anything more than sitting on their asses and going "how uncivilized!"
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.dst: 철 좀 들어!! 엉덩이 붙이고 앉아서 '야만스럽기도 하지!' 하는 대신, 뭐라도 하는 사람들 보면서 쓸모 있는 일이나 생각해!
Apotheosis (Quest)#121.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#122.src: Hey, language! And besides, it's not as if that insurgent has any chance against-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.dst: 야, 말 조심해! 게다가 그 반란분자가 이길 가능성이라곤-
Apotheosis (Quest)#122.speaker: Dusk Garden

Apotheosis (Quest)#126.src: ...The Sovereign...is dead!! The Resistance is triumphant!! Can't you see?! They were right!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.dst: ...군주가...죽었어!! 저항군이 이겼어!! 안 보여?! 그 사람들이 옳았어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#126.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#127.src: We need to help them! This might be our only chance, we can't let it slip away from us!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.dst: 도와야 해! 이게 유일한 기회일지도 몰라, 놓칠 수 없어!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#127.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#133.src: MAJIN'S DEAD, WHAT CAN THEY DO NOW?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.dst: MAJIN이 죽었어, 이제 놈들이 뭘 하겠어?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#133.speaker: Hyloch Citizen

Apotheosis (Quest)#134.src: You! You really did it!! People are...they're doing something!! It worked, I can't believe it worked!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.dst: 당신! 정말 해냈어!! 사람들이...움직이고 있어!! 먹혔어, 믿기지 않아!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#134.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#135.src: I'm going with them! We have to keep up the momentum, m-maybe I can direct them! You do whatever you have to- I trust you! We'll make it!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.dst: 난 저 사람들이랑 갈래! 기세를 이어 가야 해, 어, 어쩌면 내가 이끌 수도 있고! 당신은 할 일을 해- 믿을게! 우린 해낼 거야!
Apotheosis (Quest)#135.speaker: Bleeding Rose

Apotheosis (Quest)#137.dst: {u}!! 사, 살아 있구나!! 그럼 그 말은...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#137.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#139.src: Good. That's one less Sovereign to worry about...
Apotheosis (Quest)#139.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#141.src: She... she really threatened to flood the {p}... didn't she...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.dst: 그 여자... 정말로 {p}을(를) 물에 잠기게 하겠다고 한 거지...?
Apotheosis (Quest)#141.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#142.src: I- I- I can't believe it... all be- because we won't b...back down?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.dst: 미, 미, 믿을 수가 없어... 전부 우, 우리가 무, 물러서지 않아서?
Apotheosis (Quest)#142.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#143.src: Well, I can. Just like the New Age... ugh, was THAT her too?! We're unprepared, outmatched... how are we meant to-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.dst: 난 믿겨. 새 시대 때처럼... 윽, 그것도 그 여자 짓이었어?! 준비도 안 됐고, 상대도 안 되는데... 어떻게-
Apotheosis (Quest)#143.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#144.src: It doesn't matter! We- we have to stop her! We can't just... let her kill all those people!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.dst: 상관없어! 우, 우린 막아야 해! 그 사람들을 다... 죽게 내버려 둘 순 없어!
Apotheosis (Quest)#144.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#145.src: ...I hate it, but you're right. Come on, let's-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.dst: ...인정하기 싫지만 네 말이 맞아. 가자, 우리-
Apotheosis (Quest)#145.speaker: Rex

Apotheosis (Quest)#146.src: Phew- you're all still standing strong!! Good, good... I- phew- I was getting worried!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.dst: 휴- 다들 아직 멀쩡하군요!! 좋아요, 좋아... 저- 휴- 걱정하던 참이었어요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#146.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#147.src: R...Rurie? What are you doing h- here?
Apotheosis (Quest)#147.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#148.src: Ah! One moment, just, ha, allow me to catch my breath- let me tell you, those speed talismans are handy but they really leave you winded-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.dst: 아! 잠깐, 하, 숨 좀 돌리고요- 말해 두지만, 그 신속 호부가 편하긴 한데 숨이 턱까지 차요-
Apotheosis (Quest)#148.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#149.src: ...ohohohoho, do my eyes decieve me?! I'd heard the townsfolk talking but I could hardly believe it- is it really true? Has the Sovereign Thalas truly been felled?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.dst: ...오호호호, 내 눈을 의심해야 하나요?! 마을 사람들 얘길 듣고도 못 믿었는데- 정말이에요? Thalas 군주가 정말 쓰러졌어요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#149.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#152.src: Good! Great, even! Got what he deserved, in the end!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.dst: 좋아요! 아니, 최고예요! 결국 받을 벌을 받았네요!
Apotheosis (Quest)#152.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#385.dst: ...결국 여기 있었네. 드디어 내가 찾으러 온 사람을 찾았어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#385.speaker: Player

Apotheosis (Quest)#389.src: Ah. Overloaded... used too many times, and charged with too unstable magic... and- kaboom.
Apotheosis (Quest)#389.dst: 아. 과부하야... 너무 많이 쓰고, 너무 불안정한 마법으로 충전해서... 그리고- 쾅.
Apotheosis (Quest)#389.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#391.src: Yeah, I think so. His breathing looks more... normal.
Apotheosis (Quest)#391.dst: 응, 된 것 같아. 숨 쉬는 게 좀 더... 정상이야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#391.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#392.src: ...good. Then... then it's done. It's all...
Apotheosis (Quest)#392.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#394.src: Hm hm hm. Yeah, that's something. Any plans for dealing with that?
Apotheosis (Quest)#394.dst: 흠 흠 흠. 그래, 저건 좀 대단하네. 저거 어떻게 할 계획은 있어?
Apotheosis (Quest)#394.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#396.src: The Queen's still there, isn't she? We'll go in and kill her.
Apotheosis (Quest)#396.dst: 여왕은 아직 저기 있지? 들어가서 죽일 거야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#396.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#397.src: Hmph! Might work to stop new ones from opening up, sure. But wow, you wanna kill her? Good luck with that.
Apotheosis (Quest)#397.dst: 흥! 새 틈새가 열리는 걸 막는 데는 통하겠지. 근데 와, 그 여자를 죽이겠다고? 행운을 빌어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#397.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#398.src: ...s'your funeral! I've got a dam to fix... how long since I made the improvements...? Fifty years? Sixty? Eh, whatever, I'll just wing it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#398.dst: ...죽든 말든 네 맘이지! 난 댐 고쳐야 해... 개량한 게 언제였더라...? 50년? 60년? 에이, 몰라, 대충 해 보지 뭐.
Apotheosis (Quest)#398.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#399.src: Hm. Hm hm. If you're going up into that whole ... you probably won't make it out. But if you do! We'll talk then.
Apotheosis (Quest)#399.dst: 흠. 흠 흠. 저 ... 안으로 올라가면 아마 못 나올걸. 그래도 나온다면! 그때 얘기하자.
Apotheosis (Quest)#399.speaker: Soosu

Apotheosis (Quest)#401.src: ...I, um, should... stay with Rex. Un-until the S-Sovereign is... up. {u}, go ahead to the safe zone. Make sure everyone's... everyone's okay, over there.
Apotheosis (Quest)#401.dst: ...난, 음... Rex 곁에 있을게. 구, 군주가... 깨어날 때까지. {u}, 먼저 안전 구역에 가. 거기 다들... 다들 괜찮은지 확인해 줘.
Apotheosis (Quest)#401.speaker: Sui

Apotheosis (Quest)#404.src: Sigh. And it all... just... breaks...
Apotheosis (Quest)#404.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#406.src: ...okay. I... I will. I'll see what I can do, if... if I can get any of the soldiers to stand down...
Apotheosis (Quest)#406.dst: ...알았어. 나... 그럴게. 내가 뭘 할 수 있을지 볼게... 병사들을 좀 물러나게 할 수 있을지...
Apotheosis (Quest)#406.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#407.src: I'll meet you by the palace. We'll fix this together.
Apotheosis (Quest)#407.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#408.src: Sigh. And it's all just... broken.
Apotheosis (Quest)#408.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#410.src: ...I will. I'll see what I can do, if... if I can get any of the soldiers to stand down...
Apotheosis (Quest)#410.dst: ...그럴게. 내가 뭘 할 수 있을지 볼게... 병사들을 좀 물러나게 할 수 있을지...
Apotheosis (Quest)#410.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#411.src: I'll meet you by the palace. We'll fix this together.
Apotheosis (Quest)#411.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#412.src: Sigh. And it all... just... breaks... of course.
Apotheosis (Quest)#412.dst: 하아. 그리고 전부... 그냥... 부서지는구나... 그렇겠지.
Apotheosis (Quest)#412.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#413.src: What will I... what can I do? It's all so... overwhelming.
Apotheosis (Quest)#413.dst: 내가... 뭘 할 수 있을까? 전부 너무... 벅차.
Apotheosis (Quest)#413.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#414.src: But... I have to try, don't I? I can't just... escape from the consequences.
Apotheosis (Quest)#414.dst: 그래도... 해 봐야겠지? 그냥... 결과에서 도망칠 순 없어.
Apotheosis (Quest)#414.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#415.src: I'll... meet you by the palace. I need to think first. Before we... go in.
Apotheosis (Quest)#415.dst: 왕궁 근처에서... 보자. 먼저 생각 좀 해야겠어. 우리가... 들어가기 전에.
Apotheosis (Quest)#415.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#416.src: ...what. What do you want? Everything's broken. And it's my fault, right?
Apotheosis (Quest)#416.dst: ...뭐. 뭘 원해? 전부 부서졌어. 그리고 내 잘못이지, 그렇지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#416.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#418.src: Right. Sure. If that's what you want from me.
Apotheosis (Quest)#418.dst: 그래. 좋아. 그게 네가 원하는 거라면.
Apotheosis (Quest)#418.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#419.src: I'll be there when you go in after her.
Apotheosis (Quest)#419.dst: 그 여자를 쫓아 들어갈 때 같이 갈게.
Apotheosis (Quest)#419.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#420.src: Is that it... then? I guess we're... done.
Apotheosis (Quest)#420.dst: 그럼... 이게 다야? 우린... 끝난 거네.
Apotheosis (Quest)#420.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#421.src: The rift in the sky... it's all broken, havoc left in her wake, and... and it's my fault.
Apotheosis (Quest)#421.dst: 하늘의 틈새... 전부 부서지고, 그 여자가 지나간 자리엔 혼돈뿐이야, 그리고... 그리고 내 잘못이야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#421.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#422.src: But you won't kill me. So I guess I have to keep going... don't I?
Apotheosis (Quest)#422.dst: 그래도 넌 날 죽이지 않겠지. 그럼 계속 살아가야 하는 거네... 그렇지?
Apotheosis (Quest)#422.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Apotheosis (Quest)#425.src: Head to the gates of Aelumia at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#427.src: Make sure everyone is okay in the safe zone at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Apotheosis (Quest)#428.src: ...and now all chaos has broken loose in the citadel, so some numbers truly would go a long way towards-
Apotheosis (Quest)#428.dst: ...그리고 지금 성채는 완전히 아수라장이니, 인원이 조금만 더 있어도 정말 큰 도움이-
Apotheosis (Quest)#428.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#429.src: Yes, Rurie, I know. Hold for just one minute, would you?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#429.dst: 네, Rurie, 알아요. 딱 1분만 기다려 줄래요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#429.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#430.src: Fine, fine. Yes, please, take your time! It's not as though the world is ending or anything!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#430.dst: 좋아요, 좋아. 네, 제발, 천천히 하세요! 세상이 끝나는 것도 아닌데 뭐!!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#430.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#432.src: Hm? {u}!! You're alive, that's a relief - if you wouldn't mind answering, what the - and excuse the language - HELL is going on?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#432.dst: 네? {u}!! 살아 있다니 다행이에요 - 괜찮다면 대답 좀 해 줄래요, 말이 험해서 미안하지만 - 대체 무슨 '빌어먹을' 일이 벌어진 거예요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#432.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#433.src: The SKY ITSELF has cracked open, there's RED LIGHTNING up there - and I have seen storms before, that is not normal - everything is a MESS! Explain.
Apotheosis (Quest)#433.dst: '하늘 자체'가 갈라졌고, 저 위에 '붉은 번개'가 쳐요 - 폭풍은 봤지만 저건 정상이 아니에요 - 전부 '엉망'이라고요! 설명해 봐요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#433.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#436.src: And just when I thought we had reached the limit on fanciful tales... goodness. And you singlehandedly defeated her in combat?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#436.dst: 이제 공상 같은 얘기는 한계에 달한 줄 알았는데... 세상에. 그리고 혼자서 그 여자를 전투로 쓰러뜨렸다고요?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#436.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#438.src: Yes, Cileon, I suppose I shouldn't be surprised after that display... and yet.
Apotheosis (Quest)#438.dst: 그래요, Cileon, 그걸 보고 나서 놀라면 안 되겠죠... 그래도요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#438.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#439.src: But back to the topic at hand - she is responsible for all of this?! This is... beyond my means to process.
Apotheosis (Quest)#439.dst: 하지만 본론으로 돌아가서 - 이 모든 게 그 여자 짓이라고요?! 이건... 제 머리로는 감당이 안 돼요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#439.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#440.src: A corrupt and oppressive governmental structure - that, I can plan around. For that, I at least have some inkling as to how to fight against it.
Apotheosis (Quest)#440.dst: 부패하고 억압적인 정부 구조 - 그건 대비할 수 있어요. 그런 건 적어도 어떻게 싸워야 할지 감이라도 있죠.
Apotheosis (Quest)#440.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#441.src: But this? For this, I have nothing. What is one even supposed to do about-
Apotheosis (Quest)#441.dst: 하지만 이건? 이건 아무 수가 없어요. 대체 이런 걸 어떻게-
Apotheosis (Quest)#441.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#442.src: Ah! There we are! Twelve injured allies, five casualties, one bout of madness... talisman stockpiles mostly burned through - only two remaining, we'll have to produce more...
Apotheosis (Quest)#442.dst: 아! 됐다! 부상 열둘, 사망 다섯, 광증 하나... 호부 비축분은 거의 다 썼고 - 둘 남았으니 더 만들어야겠고...
Apotheosis (Quest)#442.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#443.src: Food rations will hold for another three and a half days, so we'll need to send a supply run tomorrow... at least armor and weapon supplies are still in surp-
Apotheosis (Quest)#443.dst: 식량 배급은 사흘 반 더 버티니 내일 보급대를 보내야 하고... 그래도 갑옷과 무기 보급은 아직 넉넉-
Apotheosis (Quest)#443.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#444.src: Oh. {u}, you're here. Good to see you're still standing. What are we talking about?
Apotheosis (Quest)#444.dst: 아. {u}, 왔군요. 아직 멀쩡해서 다행이에요. 무슨 얘기 중이었죠?
Apotheosis (Quest)#444.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#447.src: Ah! So you defeated her, and she fled into the rifts. Very good work, deerling.
Apotheosis (Quest)#447.dst: 아! 쓰러뜨렸더니 그 여자가 틈새로 도망쳤군요. 아주 잘했어요, 꼬마 사슴.
Apotheosis (Quest)#447.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#448.src: ...by most metrics, we've achieved our goal. Her Majesty has been dethroned, her Sovereigns either killed or turned - we have something to work with.
Apotheosis (Quest)#448.dst: ...대부분의 기준으로 보면 우린 목표를 이뤘어요. 여왕 폐하는 폐위됐고, 군주들은 죽거나 돌아섰으니 - 해 볼 만한 게 생겼죠.
Apotheosis (Quest)#448.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#449.src: But this rift... there's very little we can do while it's there. The people are panicked, the soldiers scattered, defensive, lost - and that isn't to mention whatever adverse effects it may or may not have!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#449.dst: 하지만 이 틈새... 저게 있는 한 할 수 있는 게 거의 없어요. 사람들은 겁에 질렸고, 병사들은 흩어져 몸만 사리고 갈피를 못 잡아요 - 게다가 저게 어떤 악영향을 줄지는 말할 것도 없고요!!
Apotheosis (Quest)#449.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#450.src: Perhaps if it can be cut off at its source...
Apotheosis (Quest)#450.dst: 근원에서 끊어 낼 수 있다면 어쩌면...
Apotheosis (Quest)#450.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#451.src: What, you mean passing through it into whatever it is on the other side? All in the hopes of chasing down the Queen? Who would be insane enough to even consider-
Apotheosis (Quest)#451.dst: 뭐요, 저걸 통과해서 반대편에 뭐가 있든 거기로 가자고요? 여왕을 쫓겠다는 희망 하나로? 대체 누가 그런 미친 생각을-
Apotheosis (Quest)#451.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#452.src: Right! Of course, how could I forget! We have you. Well, I suppose that's all sorted then - not a problem I need concern myself with. What a relief.
Apotheosis (Quest)#452.dst: 맞다! 물론이죠, 내가 왜 잊었지! 우리한텐 당신이 있잖아요. 뭐, 그럼 해결됐네요 - 내가 신경 쓸 문제가 아니죠. 다행이다.
Apotheosis (Quest)#452.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#453.src: Hm. Leaves us more time to finalize the stabilizing plan for the province, to deal with the chaos that comes after this chaos concludes. Joy.
Apotheosis (Quest)#453.dst: 흠. 그럼 지방을 안정시킬 계획을 마무리할 시간이 더 생기겠네요. 이 혼돈이 끝난 뒤 찾아올 혼돈에 대비해서요. 신나네요.
Apotheosis (Quest)#453.speaker: Fuhue

Apotheosis (Quest)#454.src: Yes, yes... we can get to that. {u}, before you set off on yet another dangerous mission, you'd best go speak to everyone here. Alleviate some concerns, yes?
Apotheosis (Quest)#454.dst: 네, 네... 그건 나중에 하죠. {u}, 또 위험한 임무를 떠나기 전에 여기 있는 사람들과 얘기해 보는 게 좋겠어요. 걱정 좀 덜어 주세요, 네?
Apotheosis (Quest)#454.speaker: Rurie

Apotheosis (Quest)#456.src: Ughhhhh... yeah, bro, I'm fine! Quit hovering!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.dst: 으으으... 그래, 형, 괜찮다니까! 그만 좀 맴돌아!
Apotheosis (Quest)#456.speaker: Yuman

Apotheosis (Quest)#457.src: Well, sorry for being worried under these circumstances! The SKY is broken, Yuman, so let me hover at least a little, okay?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.dst: 이런 상황에 걱정해서 미안하네! 하늘이 '부서졌어', Yuman, 그러니까 좀 맴돌게 해 줘, 알았어?!
Apotheosis (Quest)#457.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#458.src: Well, a...at least the soldiers have b- ba- backed off a little... so, that's s- something.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.dst: 뭐, 저, 적어도 병사들이 조금 무, 물러났어... 그러니까, 그건 다, 다행이야.
Apotheosis (Quest)#458.speaker: Zeph

Apotheosis (Quest)#459.src: Sigh... yeah, that is something. I'm almost out of electrical charges...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.dst: 하아... 그래, 그건 다행이지. 전기 충전탄이 거의 다 떨어졌거든...
Apotheosis (Quest)#459.speaker: Yulie

Apotheosis (Quest)#462.src: S...so does that mean you... y- you stopped her?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.dst: 그, 그럼 네가... 그, 그 여자를 막은 거야?
Apotheosis (Quest)#462.speaker: Zeph
