Cowfusion#038.dst: 두 번째 우리도 비슷할 텐데, 그건 네가 알아서 풀 수 있을 거야.
Cowfusion#038.speaker: Suspicious Cow

Cowfusion#040.src: Find and enter the Secret Cow Hideout

Cowfusion#042.src: Oh, a new recruit? We weren't expecting anyone at this time. How'd you find your way in?
Cowfusion#042.dst: 어, 신입이에요? 이 시간엔 올 사람이 없는데. 어떻게 들어왔어요?
Cowfusion#042.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#043.src: Wait, you're different. Something's off about you. Like you've never been in a cow's body before.
Cowfusion#043.dst: 잠깐, 당신 좀 달라요. 뭔가 이상해요. 소 몸에 처음 들어온 것처럼요.
Cowfusion#043.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#044.src: Oh. Oh, this is not good. Uhm, you should talk to the boss. He'll probably know what to do with you.
Cowfusion#044.dst: 아. 아, 이거 큰일이네. 음, 대장님께 가 보세요. 어떻게 할지 아실 거예요.
Cowfusion#044.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#045.src: You'll find him in the big office at the very end of this facility. Just stick to the path and don't be nosey, okay?
Cowfusion#045.dst: 이 시설 맨 끝 큰 사무실에 계세요. 길만 따라가고 기웃거리지 마세요, 알겠죠?
Cowfusion#045.speaker: Receptionist

Cowfusion#046.src: Find the one who's in charge of the hideout

Cowfusion#048.src: Whoop, alright! Don't want you going anywhere, buddy! Uh... What are you doing here, exactly...?
Cowfusion#048.dst: 워워, 좋아! 어디 가면 안 돼, 친구! 어... 여기서 뭐 하는 거야, 대체...?
Cowfusion#048.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#049.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#049.dst: 너- 뭐? 세상에, 그게 어떻게 가능해? 그럴 만한 게 없었는데...
Cowfusion#049.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#050.src: Oh! You must've been snooping through my laboratory. That's... okay, we can talk about that later. Did you step into my machine?
Cowfusion#050.dst: 아! 내 실험실을 뒤지고 다녔구나. 그건... 괜찮아, 나중에 얘기하자. 혹시 내 기계에 들어갔어?
Cowfusion#050.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#051.src: It's not even meant to do that! Its purpose is to turn the exiles back into Wocs. So how does a Human become a cow...?
Cowfusion#051.dst: 그런 용도가 아닌데! 추방자들을 Woc으로 되돌리는 기계야. 근데 인간이 어떻게 소가 돼...?
Cowfusion#051.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#052.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#052.dst: 그래, 그래, 미안. 자, 어- 이 우리 내려 볼게. 망할 조작판... 왜 이렇게 엉망으로 만들었지?
Cowfusion#052.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#053.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?
Cowfusion#053.dst: ...어느 레버를 당길지 찾는 동안 네 얘기 좀 해 줘! 요즘 재밌는 일 있었어?
Cowfusion#053.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#054.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!
Cowfusion#054.dst: 너... 너였어? 너구나! 와, 다시 만나서 정말 반가워! Wynn에서 같이 사고 친 게 언제 적이야!
Cowfusion#054.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#055.src: This is great, actually! I- I can show you around this place! Introduce you to some of the folks we freed together! Oh, what fantastic timing this has been.
Cowfusion#055.dst: 오히려 잘됐다! 내- 내가 여기 구경시켜 줄게! 우리가 같이 구한 사람들도 소개해 주고! 와, 타이밍 끝내주네.
Cowfusion#055.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#056.src: I just need to figure out which switch to pull... I think it's this one! Probably. I really need to label these things. Alright, here goes!
Cowfusion#056.dst: 어느 스위치를 당길지만 알아내면... 이거 같아! 아마도. 이것들 이름표 좀 붙여야겠어. 좋아, 간다!
Cowfusion#056.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#058.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.
Cowfusion#058.dst: 난, 어... 하. 참 웃기네. 인간이라더니 소 흉내를 내?
Cowfusion#058.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#059.src: That's... fine. You know, I'm under quite a lot of stress right now. Working hard, day in and day out. I don't really need your attitude right now!
Cowfusion#059.dst: 그건... 괜찮아. 있잖아, 나 요즘 스트레스가 엄청나. 밤낮없이 일만 하고. 지금 네 그런 태도 필요 없거든!
Cowfusion#059.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#060.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.
Cowfusion#060.dst: 있잖아? 이런 태도 필요 없어. 너- 너 구덩이로 보내 버릴 거야. 내- 내 다른 실패작들이 있는 곳으로.
Cowfusion#060.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#061.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#061.dst: ...무기 있잖아. 어떻게든 되겠지! 나한테 받을 거 없어! 자, 아래가 마음에 드는지 봐!
Cowfusion#061.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#063.src: Okay. So you are just a regular cow. Not a Woc. Uh... Who let you in, little pal? I'm going to need to have to have a word about closing the doors...
Cowfusion#063.dst: 좋아. 그냥 평범한 소구나. Woc이 아니고. 어... 누가 들여보냈니, 꼬마야? 문 닫는 거 얘기 좀 해야겠네...
Cowfusion#063.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#064.src: Well, this is... awkward. So, then... cow. What's it like being... a cow?
Cowfusion#064.dst: 음, 이거... 어색하네. 그럼... 소야. 소로 사는 건... 어때?
Cowfusion#064.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#065.src: You- what? Oh gosh, how is that even possible? I don't think I had anything that could...
Cowfusion#065.dst: 너- 뭐? 세상에, 그게 어떻게 가능해? 그럴 만한 게 없었는데...
Cowfusion#065.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#066.dst: 아! 내 실험실을 뒤지고 다녔구나. 그건... 괜찮아, 나중에 얘기하자. 혹시 내 기계에 들어갔어?
Cowfusion#066.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#067.src: It's not even meant to do that! Its purpose is to turn the exiles back into Wocs. So how does a Human become a cow...?
Cowfusion#067.dst: 그런 용도가 아닌데! 추방자들을 Woc으로 되돌리는 기계야. 근데 인간이 어떻게 소가 돼...?
Cowfusion#067.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#068.src: Right, right, sorry. Here, uh- I'll try and get this cage down. Darn controls... Why did I design these so poorly?
Cowfusion#068.dst: 그래, 그래, 미안. 자, 어- 이 우리 내려 볼게. 망할 조작판... 왜 이렇게 엉망으로 만들었지?
Cowfusion#068.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#069.src: ...So while I try to figure out which lever to push, tell me about yourself! Anything interesting going on in your life?

Cowfusion#070.src: You... You are? You are! Oh, wow, it's great to see you again! It's been so long since our escapades back in Wynn!

Cowfusion#074.src: I, uh... Hah. Very funny. Tell me you're a human, then pretend to be a cow.

Cowfusion#075.dst: 그건... 괜찮아. 있잖아, 나 요즘 스트레스가 엄청나. 밤낮없이 일만 하고. 지금 네 그런 태도 필요 없거든!

Cowfusion#076.src: You know what? I don't need this attitude. I'm- I'm going to send you to The Pit. Where- where all my other mistakes lie.

Cowfusion#077.src: ...You have a weapon. You can probably manage! You don't need anything from me! Here, see how you like it down there!
Cowfusion#077.dst: ...무기 있잖아. 어떻게든 되겠지! 나한테 받을 거 없어! 자, 아래가 마음에 드는지 봐!
Cowfusion#077.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#079.src: Right. Okay. Figure I'd best let you go free.
Cowfusion#079.dst: 그래. 좋아. 그냥 풀어 주는 게 낫겠다.
Cowfusion#079.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#080.src: ...Unless. Unless. Nobody's... nobody's looking. I could just send you to The Pit... Nobody would know.
Cowfusion#080.dst: ...아니면. 아니면. 아무도... 아무도 안 보잖아. 그냥 구덩이로 보내도... 아무도 모를 거야.
Cowfusion#080.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#081.src: It's... easier this way. It's fine. Maybe you'll even- maybe you'll even make your way out. Good luck, little buddy.
Cowfusion#081.dst: 이게... 편하니까. 괜찮아. 어쩌면- 어쩌면 알아서 나올지도 몰라. 행운을 빌어, 꼬마야.

Cowfusion#085.src: ...Oh! You're the one Drale told us to look out for. Accidentally dropped into the Pit, huh?
Cowfusion#085.dst: ...아! Drale이 잘 찾아보라던 게 너구나. 실수로 구덩이에 떨어졌다며?

Cowfusion#089.src: ...You're a good friend of the boss, right? Would you be able to put in a good word for us? Gerald and I have been down here for a while, and we'd like to get back to our normal positions.

Cowfusion#159.src: So! What's... going on, little buddy? Any- any souvenirs? From the Pit...?
Cowfusion#159.dst: 자! 요즘... 어때, 꼬마야? 뭐- 뭐 기념품이라도? 구덩이에서...?

Cowfusion#161.src: So, uh... Human turned into a cow. Okay. How did you manage to get yourself stuck as a cow, anyway? I didn't think we had anything that could do that...

Cowfusion#162.dst: 내 기계. 그건- 그런 용도가 아닌데! 추방자를 Woc으로 되돌리게 만든 건데, 어떻게...

Cowfusion#163.src: Great. Of course it'd have that issue, and just when I thought I...

Cowfusion#164.src: Right. Right. Alright. We can work with this! Let's just take you back to that machine, put you in it, and see if it turns you back to normal!

Cowfusion#165.src: It'll work. Probably. I mean, I haven't ever tried it, so I can't really say for sure... Oh, yep, you're still here. Let's get moving.
Cowfusion#165.dst: 될 거야. 아마. 그러니까, 해 본 적이 없어서 장담은 못 하는데... 아, 응, 아직 여기 있네. 가자.

Cowfusion#166.src: Uh... Hm. Maybe- Maybe being a cow is affecting your brain somehow... That can't be good.
Cowfusion#166.dst: 어... 흠. 혹시- 혹시 소가 돼서 뇌에 무슨 영향이... 그건 안 좋은데.

Cowfusion#167.dst: 최대한 빨리 인간으로 되돌려야겠어. 자, 따라와.

Cowfusion#169.src: Well, alright. Let's just- get you in my machine, I guess. It worked for the exiles, so maybe it will work for you...?
Cowfusion#169.dst: 뭐, 좋아. 일단- 내 기계에 넣어 보자. 추방자들한텐 됐으니까, 너한테도 되지 않을까...?

Cowfusion#170.src: ...Don't look at me like that. Come on, let's get going.
Cowfusion#170.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#171.src: So... How have you been? It's been a while since our adventure at {p}, hasn't it?
Cowfusion#171.dst: 그래서... 어떻게 지냈어? {p}에서 같이 모험한 지 꽤 됐지?

Cowfusion#172.src: Well, you've been turned into a cow... Obviously... But besides that!

Cowfusion#172.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#173.src: Me? Well... heh. I've been doing pretty well, all thing considered. We've been gathering exiles from all over the province! Set up a city for us all while we work towards...
Cowfusion#173.dst: 나? 음... 헤헤. 이것저것 따지면 꽤 잘 지냈어. 지방 곳곳에서 추방자들을 모았거든! 다 같이 살 도시도 세웠고, 목표를 향해...

Cowfusion#175.src: And- and maybe if we can find our ship again, we'll be able to prove that we're not irredeemable. That whatever we went through- that it won't define us.

Cowfusion#175.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#176.src: ...Heh. Don't- don't worry about it too much. For now, this place is enough of a safe haven for us. It'll have to be enough until we succeed.
Cowfusion#176.dst: ...헤헤. 너- 너무 걱정하지 마. 지금은 여기가 우리한테 충분한 안식처야. 성공할 때까진 이걸로 버텨야지.
Cowfusion#176.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#177.src: We're so close. I can feel it. Just... Just a little while left to go.
Cowfusion#177.dst: 거의 다 왔어. 느껴져. 조금만... 조금만 더 가면 돼.

Cowfusion#186.src: It's a long story. I'm not sure how much of it I really want to tell you, heh. Especially considering... Yeah.
Cowfusion#186.dst: 얘기가 길어. 얼마나 털어놓고 싶은지 모르겠네, 헤헤. 특히나... 그래.
Cowfusion#186.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#187.src: But. This place is a safe haven for us exiles. A place for us all to live until we achieve our goals.
Cowfusion#187.dst: 그래도. 여긴 우리 추방자들의 안식처야. 목표를 이룰 때까지 다 같이 사는 곳.

Cowfusion#188.dst: 그리고- 야! 이제 우리 비밀도 봤잖아! 그럼 너한테도 안식처가 되는 거지, 그렇지? 헤헤.

Cowfusion#189.dst: 아- 엘리베이터. 다 왔어. 어... 들어가, 꼬마야? 위로 데려다줄 거야.

Cowfusion#193.dst: ...걱정되게 왜 그래. 자, 가자. 엘리베이터 타고, 원래대로 돌려놓자.

Cowfusion#198.src: Well I guess I could- talk at you. For a bit. If that's, heh, fine with you!
Cowfusion#198.dst: 뭐, 그냥- 혼잣말하듯 해도 되겠지. 잠깐만. 헤헤, 괜찮다면!
Cowfusion#198.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#199.src: It's been tough, recently. Working towards a goal I know is important, but still feels... out of reach.
Cowfusion#199.dst: 요즘 힘들었어. 중요하다는 걸 아는 목표를 향해 가는데, 여전히... 닿지 않는 느낌이야.

Cowfusion#200.src: And it doesn't seem like anybody else can see that! That this is important! They look at me like I'm going crazy, and-

Cowfusion#216.src: Maybe I can tell you more about what I've been up to! That'd be nice.
Cowfusion#216.dst: 그땐 내가 요즘 뭘 하는지 더 얘기해 줄게! 좋겠다.

Cowfusion#217.src: There you are! Back to norm...-

Cowfusion#218.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#219.src: Oh gosh, this has been... An awful reunion. I can't believe I dropped you into the Pit...
Cowfusion#219.dst: 세상에, 이건... 최악의 재회야. 내가 널 구덩이에 떨어뜨리다니...
Cowfusion#219.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#220.src: I'm so sorry for- for all of that. You should have told me! Oh...
Cowfusion#220.dst: 그- 그 모든 게 정말 미안해. 말을 했어야지! 아...
Cowfusion#220.speaker: Drale

Cowfusion#221.src: Okay, uh... Here, take this. As- as compensation for- for all of that.

Cowfusion#223.speaker: Drale

Creeper Infiltration#000.src: You had a piece of skin? Well, you don't seem to have it now, so I can't say I believe you.
Creeper Infiltration#000.dst: 가죽 조각이 있었다고요? 지금은 없는 것 같은데, 믿기 어렵네요.

Creeper Infiltration#002.src: Anyone! Can anyone- oh, hello. You look strong enough to help me.
Creeper Infiltration#002.dst: 누구 없어요! 누가- 아, 안녕하세요. 저를 도와줄 만큼 강해 보이네요.
Creeper Infiltration#002.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#003.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for a village in the Pigman Ravine. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#003.dst: 전 Thomas예요. 피그맨 협곡에 있는 마을의 물자 관리를 돕고 있죠. 그런데 문제가 좀 생겼어요...
Creeper Infiltration#003.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#004.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#004.dst: 주식으로 쓰는 협곡 곡물이 거의 떨어졌어요.
Creeper Infiltration#004.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#005.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#005.dst: 보통은 직접 구해 오는데, 최근에 성난 피그맨 무리가 곡식이 자라는 협곡 꼭대기로 가는 터널을 차지해 버렸어요.
Creeper Infiltration#005.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#006.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#006.dst: 지난번에 들어갔을 때 위에서 폭발음이 들렸어요. 피그맨들이 TNT로 곡물을 날려 버리는 것 같아요...
Creeper Infiltration#006.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#007.src: I came here to {p} to see if I could find help here, but I've had no luck. Until now, that is. Would you be willing to help?
Creeper Infiltration#007.dst: 도움을 구하러 {p}에 왔는데 영 소득이 없었어요. 지금까지는요. 도와주실래요?
Creeper Infiltration#007.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#008.src: You would? You're a life saver. I'll meet you at the village, just follow the path out of town and take the northern-most entrance to the ravines.
Creeper Infiltration#008.dst: 정말요? 생명의 은인이에요. 마을에서 봬요. 마을 밖 길을 따라가서 협곡 맨 북쪽 입구로 들어오세요.
Creeper Infiltration#008.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#009.src: Once you get there, keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#009.dst: 도착하면 협곡 오른쪽 벽을 따라 계단을 올라 입구로 가세요. 그리고 터널에선 조심하세요. 피그맨들이 돌을 던지거든요.
Creeper Infiltration#009.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#010.src: Oh, finally, someone has come to this hidden village!
Creeper Infiltration#010.dst: 아, 드디어 이 숨겨진 마을에 누가 왔네요!
Creeper Infiltration#010.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#011.src: I am Thomas, and I help manage the supplies for this ravine village. Though, I have a bit of a problem...
Creeper Infiltration#011.dst: 전 Thomas예요. 이 협곡 마을의 물자 관리를 돕고 있죠. 그런데 문제가 좀 생겼어요...
Creeper Infiltration#011.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#012.src: We're running low on ravine grains, which is our main staple we use for our food.
Creeper Infiltration#012.dst: 주식으로 쓰는 협곡 곡물이 거의 떨어졌어요.
Creeper Infiltration#012.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#013.src: We usually get it ourselves but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#013.dst: 보통은 직접 구해 오는데, 최근에 성난 피그맨 무리가 곡식이 자라는 협곡 꼭대기로 가는 터널을 차지해 버렸어요.
Creeper Infiltration#013.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#014.src: The last time we entered, I heard an explosion from the top. I fear the pigmen are blowing up our grain supply with TNT...
Creeper Infiltration#014.dst: 지난번에 들어갔을 때 위에서 폭발음이 들렸어요. 피그맨들이 TNT로 곡물을 날려 버리는 것 같아요...
Creeper Infiltration#014.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#015.src: You appear to be much stronger than I am, so maybe you could get past the tunnel pigmen and eliminate the explosions at the top.
Creeper Infiltration#015.dst: 저보다 훨씬 강해 보이시니, 터널의 피그맨을 뚫고 꼭대기의 폭발을 멈출 수 있을 거예요.
Creeper Infiltration#015.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#016.src: Just keep to the right wall of the ravine and climb up the stairs to reach the entrance. Also, be careful in the tunnel, as the pigmen throw rocks as a weapon.
Creeper Infiltration#016.dst: 협곡 오른쪽 벽을 따라 계단을 올라 입구로 가세요. 그리고 터널에선 조심하세요. 피그맨들이 돌을 던지거든요.
Creeper Infiltration#016.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#017.src: Enter the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and reach the top of the ravine

Creeper Infiltration#018.src: Bring back the [Creeper Skin] to Thomas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Creeper Infiltration#019.src: I didn't expect you to fall out of the sky like that. Are you okay, or should I go get the potion merchant to heal you?
Creeper Infiltration#019.dst: 그렇게 하늘에서 떨어질 줄은 몰랐어요. 괜찮아요? 물약 상인을 불러 치료해 드릴까요?
Creeper Infiltration#019.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#020.src: You're fine? Oh, good to hear. Did you manage to get rid of the pigmen and their explosives?
Creeper Infiltration#020.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#021.src: A green creature? A "creeper"? No such thing exists in this world, especially with the pigmen all around!
Creeper Infiltration#021.dst: 초록색 생물? "크리퍼"요? 이 세상에 그런 건 없어요. 게다가 사방에 피그맨인데!
Creeper Infiltration#021.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#022.src: Oh, you brought a piece of skin back. How odd, I've seen this skin before...
Creeper Infiltration#022.dst: 아, 가죽 조각을 가져오셨네요. 이상하네, 이 가죽 본 적이 있어요...
Creeper Infiltration#022.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#023.src: There's a large cave over to the south. I tried to enter it, but I got ambushed by green creatures...
Creeper Infiltration#023.dst: 남쪽에 큰 동굴이 있어요. 들어가 보려다가 초록색 생물들한테 기습당했죠...
Creeper Infiltration#023.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#024.src: I thought I was just dreaming, but these "creepers" you talk about...they might live in that cave.
Creeper Infiltration#024.dst: 꿈인 줄 알았는데, 말씀하신 "크리퍼"가... 그 동굴에 사는지도 몰라요.
Creeper Infiltration#024.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#025.src: I have an idea. I need to know for sure that they live there. A merchant can make you a mask with the skin and another material.
Creeper Infiltration#025.dst: 좋은 생각이 있어요. 거기 사는 게 확실한지 알아야 해요. 상인이 이 가죽과 다른 재료로 가면을 만들어 줄 거예요.
Creeper Infiltration#025.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#026.src: There's a Pigman Overlord that sometimes hangs in a cave nearby. If you can kill it, you can get a pigman hide strong enough to make the mask.
Creeper Infiltration#026.dst: 근처 동굴에 가끔 피그맨 대군주가 나타나요. 그걸 잡으면 가면을 만들 만큼 질긴 피그맨 가죽을 얻을 수 있어요.
Creeper Infiltration#026.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#027.src: If you continue on the western path past the tunnel entrance, you should find a camp where the Overlord is located.
Creeper Infiltration#027.dst: 터널 입구를 지나 서쪽 길로 계속 가면 대군주가 있는 야영지가 나올 거예요.
Creeper Infiltration#027.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#028.src: Go get the pigman hide, and then come back to me so I can tell you what to do next.
Creeper Infiltration#028.dst: 피그맨 가죽을 구해서 다시 오세요. 그다음 할 일을 알려 드릴게요.
Creeper Infiltration#028.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#029.src: Retrieve [{~} Pigman Hide] from the Pigman Overlord near [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return to Thomas
Creeper Infiltration#029.dst: [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}] 근처의 피그맨 대군주에게서 [{~1} Pigman Hide]를 얻어 Thomas에게 돌아가세요

Creeper Infiltration#030.src: I see you have the hide. This skin will work perfectly for my plan.
Creeper Infiltration#030.dst: 가죽을 구하셨네요. 이 가죽이면 제 계획에 딱 맞아요.
Creeper Infiltration#030.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#031.src: There is a Mask Merchant in this village. He can make you a mask with the two materials I have.
Creeper Infiltration#031.dst: 이 마을엔 가면 상인이 있어요. 제가 가진 두 재료로 가면을 만들어 줄 거예요.
Creeper Infiltration#031.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#032.src: With the mask, you can put it on and go undetected into the cave with these "creepers". Only then will we know the truth.
Creeper Infiltration#032.dst: 가면을 쓰면 들키지 않고 "크리퍼"들이 있는 동굴에 들어갈 수 있어요. 그래야 진실을 알 수 있죠.
Creeper Infiltration#032.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#033.src: To get to the creeper cave, follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
Creeper Infiltration#033.dst: 크리퍼 동굴에 가려면 서쪽 길을 따라가다 피그맨 야영지에서 왼쪽으로 꺾으세요.
Creeper Infiltration#033.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#034.src: Also, if you somehow lose the mask, the merchant can make you another one if you bring him another piece of skin and hide.
Creeper Infiltration#034.dst: 혹시 가면을 잃어버리면, 가죽과 피그맨 가죽을 하나씩 다시 가져가면 상인이 또 만들어 줄 거예요.
Creeper Infiltration#034.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#035.src: Here are the materials. Be careful out there. Who knows what those green monsters could do to you...
Creeper Infiltration#035.dst: 여기 재료요. 조심하세요. 그 초록 괴물들이 무슨 짓을 할지 모르니까요...
Creeper Infiltration#035.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#036.src: Buy the creeper mask from the merchant and enter the creeper hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#036.dst: 상인에게서 크리퍼 가면을 사고 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 크리퍼 은신처에 들어가세요

Creeper Infiltration#037.src: Bring Thomas [{~} Creeper Powder] to prove him creepers exist in Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Creeper Infiltration#037.dst: [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}]의 Thomas에게 [{~1} Creeper Powder]를 가져가 Wynn에 크리퍼가 있음을 증명하세요

Creeper Infiltration#038.src: So, what was in the cave? Were there really creepers in there?
Creeper Infiltration#038.dst: 그래서, 동굴에 뭐가 있었어요? 정말 크리퍼가 있었어요?
Creeper Infiltration#038.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#039.src: What's this? It smells like gunpowder...but more earthy. And this came from the cave?
Creeper Infiltration#039.dst: 이게 뭐죠? 화약 냄새가 나는데... 흙냄새가 더 강하네요. 이게 그 동굴에서 나왔어요?
Creeper Infiltration#039.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#040.src: This powder is definitely not native to this area. It has to have come from those creepers.
Creeper Infiltration#040.dst: 이 가루는 확실히 이 지역 것이 아니에요. 그 크리퍼들한테서 나온 게 분명해요.
Creeper Infiltration#040.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#041.src: I guess for now we'll leave them at peace. If they do exist, they don't need to be hunted down to extinction.
Creeper Infiltration#041.dst: 일단은 가만히 둬야겠네요. 정말 있다 해도, 멸종할 때까지 사냥할 필요는 없으니까요.
Creeper Infiltration#041.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#042.src: Besides, if they are composed of gunpowder, they could easily blow this ravine to pieces.
Creeper Infiltration#042.dst: 게다가 화약으로 이루어져 있다면, 이 협곡쯤은 쉽게 날려 버릴 수 있을 거예요.
Creeper Infiltration#042.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#043.src: Thank you for your help. I guess you deserve some sort of reward, considering you helped solve the ravine's big mystery.
Creeper Infiltration#043.dst: 도와줘서 고마워요. 협곡의 큰 수수께끼를 풀어 주셨으니 보상을 받으셔야죠.
Creeper Infiltration#043.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#044.src: Feel free to come back to our village any time. By then our food supply should be stable.
Creeper Infiltration#044.dst: 언제든 마을에 다시 들러 주세요. 그때쯤이면 식량 사정도 안정됐을 거예요.
Creeper Infiltration#044.speaker: Thomas

Creeper Infiltration#045.src: Ah, it's good to see you again, pal! I apologize for not inviting you to the celebrations, but you seemed rather busy!
Creeper Infiltration#045.dst: 아, 다시 만나서 반가워, 친구! 축하 자리에 초대 못 해서 미안해. 꽤 바빠 보였거든!

Creeper Infiltration#046.src: Oh, it's you! Aaaagghh... Thank you for what you did for us, it's... mmhhhgg... really appreciated...
Creeper Infiltration#046.dst: 오, 당신이군요! 으아아아... 우리를 위해 해 준 일, 정말... 으으으... 고마워요...

Creeper Infiltration#047.src: Anyone! Can anyone- oh, hello. You look strong enough to be able to help me.
Creeper Infiltration#047.dst: 누구 없어요! 누가- 아, 안녕하세요. 저를 도와줄 만큼 강해 보이네요.

Creeper Infiltration#048.src: We usually get it ourselves, but recently an angry group of pigmen took over the tunnel to the top of the ravine, where the grain grows.
Creeper Infiltration#048.dst: 보통은 직접 구해 오는데, 최근에 성난 피그맨 무리가 곡식이 자라는 협곡 꼭대기로 가는 터널을 차지해 버렸어요.

Creeper Infiltration#049.src: Have you been to the creeper cave? Just follow the western path and turn left at the pigman camps.
Creeper Infiltration#049.dst: 크리퍼 동굴에 가 봤어요? 서쪽 길을 따라가다 피그맨 야영지에서 왼쪽으로 꺾으면 돼요.

Creeper Infiltration#050.src: Oh, a visitor? Interesting. I thought I only knew about this cave, considering I was called crazy by my master.
Creeper Infiltration#050.dst: 오, 손님인가? 흥미롭군. 스승님께 미쳤다는 소리까지 들었으니, 이 동굴은 나만 아는 줄 알았는데.

Creeper Infiltration#051.src: I've lived down here for a while now, studying the creepers. They are mythical in this region, and I want to prove everyone wrong.
Creeper Infiltration#051.dst: 크리퍼를 연구하면서 한동안 이 아래에서 살았지. 이 지역에선 전설 속 존재지만, 모두가 틀렸다는 걸 증명하고 싶어.

Creeper Infiltration#052.src: Don't worry about being trapped in here, though. There's a magic doorway right outside my house that can teleport you out if you wish to leave.
Creeper Infiltration#052.dst: 그래도 여기 갇힐까 봐 걱정할 필요는 없어. 우리 집 바로 밖에 마법의 문이 있어서, 나가고 싶으면 순간이동시켜 줄 거야.

Crop Failure#000.src: Wha- You think those oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.

Crop Failure#001.src: They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman wanders into town with a "Miracle Cure" fertilizer.

Crop Failure#002.src: Just to prove that ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and you tell me if this is a "miracle!"

Crop Failure#003.src: Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth that he promised me!

Crop Failure#004.src: That Doubiss won't budge for my refund. I spent...so many emeralds...on this tripe! So that's where YOU come in.
Crop Failure#004.dst: Doubiss는 환불을 안 해 줘. 이 쓰레기에... 에메랄드를 얼마나... 썼는데! 그래서 네가 필요해.

Crop Failure#005.src: He's in the blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?

Crop Failure#006.src: Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell you what the issue is with my fertilizer...

Crop Failure#007.src: All the other farmers are usin' it right now, and look at their fields! Heck, I think the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!

Crop Failure#008.src: Y'know why? Next time ya pass a farm, take a good whiff o' the water, maybe a sip or two if you can manage. It'll be smelly and bitter.
Crop Failure#008.dst: 왜냐고? 다음에 농장 지나가면 물 냄새 좀 맡아 봐, 할 수 있으면 한두 모금 마셔 보고. 구리고 쓸 거야.

Crop Failure#009.src: The crops, when I got here, were lookin' pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.

Crop Failure#010.src: The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave near there.

Crop Failure#011.src: It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?

Crop Failure#012.src: The cave is on the little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!

Crop Failure#013.src: The buggers stick to the mountain caves. They don't come down this far usually...s'pose there's an exception fer everything.

Crop Failure#014.src: ...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found...what, slimes?! Why would the SLIMES be there?

Crop Failure#015.src: I wouldn't believe you if you weren't...well, uh...covered in the stuff. But that's definitely rancid.
Crop Failure#015.dst: 네가... 음, 어... 그걸 뒤집어쓰고 있지 않았으면 안 믿었을 거야. 근데 확실히 썩었네.

Crop Failure#016.src: So...that means that I've been...oh dear lord I'm an idiot.

Crop Failure#017.src: Just...do me a favor and use that money to buy some good soap and wash up. I'm thankful and all, but you stink to high heaven!
Crop Failure#017.dst: 다만... 부탁인데 그 돈으로 좋은 비누 사서 좀 씻어. 고맙긴 한데, 냄새가 하늘을 찔러!

Crop Failure#018.src: Trinkets for sale! Come buy yourself some cheap trinkets here!

Crop Failure#019.src: Ah, a customer! Welcome to my store of wares and trinkets!

Crop Failure#020.src: Is there anything that sticks out to you? Anything you'd like to purchase?

Crop Failure#021.src: ... The clock? That old piece of j-

Crop Failure#022.src: ... Yes, of course! Truly, this antique clock is very valuable! I'm sure you could find someone who would buy it for a high price!

Crop Failure#023.src: Taking a look at this clock... It's obviously broken. And yet, you can still hear a ticking sound coming from it...

Crop Failure#024.src: I can sell it to you for [{~} Emerald Blocks]. Truly an excellent price for such a... great item.

Crop Failure#025.src: ... Well, you don't have to decide now, of course! Feel free to come back when you've made your decision!

Crop Failure#027.dst: 크윽... 그 쓸모없고, 거짓말쟁이에, 사기꾼에, 도둑놈 같은... 으아악!
Crop Failure#027.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#028.src: You! Help me out over here! You aren't doing anything important right now, and this is urgent!
Crop Failure#028.dst: 너! 이리 와서 좀 도와! 지금 중요한 일 하는 것도 아니잖아, 이건 급하다고!
Crop Failure#028.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#029.src: I got a few questions for you, see? Question one: D'you think crops are supposed to look like THIS?
Crop Failure#029.dst: 몇 가지 물어볼 게 있어, 알겠지? 첫 번째: 농작물이 원래 '이렇게' 생겨야 한다고 생각해?
Crop Failure#029.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#030.src: Look at them. I don't think there's a way for 'em to look any more sorry than this.
Crop Failure#030.dst: 저것 좀 봐. 저것보다 더 처량해 보일 수는 없을 거야.
Crop Failure#030.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#031.src: Wha- You think the Oats over there look fine?! Pff. Yeah, right.
Crop Failure#031.dst: 뭐- 저기 Oats가 멀쩡해 보인다고?! 흥. 퍽이나.
Crop Failure#031.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#032.src: If that's the case, go grab a scythe and try harvesting those Oats yourself!!
Crop Failure#032.dst: 그렇다면 낫 들고 가서 저 Oats 직접 수확해 봐!!
Crop Failure#032.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#033.src: Go on, do it! I dare you! See how good they really are!!
Crop Failure#033.dst: 어서, 해 봐! 해 보라니까! 얼마나 멀쩡한지 봐!!
Crop Failure#033.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#035.src: See? What'd I tell ya? Rotten to the roots! Nothing here is ANY good!!
Crop Failure#035.dst: 봤지? 내가 뭐랬어? 뿌리까지 썩었다고! 여긴 멀쩡한 게 '하나도' 없어!!
Crop Failure#035.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#036.src: They were growing pretty slow this year, all my crops, and then some salesman walks into town with some "MiracleCure" fertilizer.
Crop Failure#036.dst: 올해 농작물이 다 더디게 자라던 참에, 웬 장사꾼이 "기적의 치료제" 비료를 들고 마을에 왔어.
Crop Failure#036.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#037.src: I shoulda known it was too good to be true, but he said everyone else tried it too, so I bought some and tried to salvage this mess.
Crop Failure#037.dst: 너무 좋은 얘기라 의심했어야 했는데, 다들 써 봤다길래 좀 사서 이 꼴을 살려 보려 했지.
Crop Failure#037.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#038.src: And here we are- me out half my savings and my fields as smelly and dead as an actual CORPSE!
Crop Failure#038.dst: 그래서 이 꼴이야- 모은 돈은 반 날리고, 밭은 진짜 '시체'처럼 냄새나고 죽어 버렸어!
Crop Failure#038.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#039.src: Just to prove this ridiculous phony Doubiss is a fraud- Here. I see some roots over here. Watch this, and tell me if this is a "miracle!"
Crop Failure#039.dst: 이 말도 안 되는 사기꾼 Doubiss가 사기꾼이란 걸 증명하지- 자. 여기 뿌리가 좀 있네. 잘 보고 이게 "기적"인지 말해 봐!
Crop Failure#039.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#040.src: Here we go, here comes the big phenomenal growth he promised me!
Crop Failure#040.dst: 자, 간다. 놈이 약속한 엄청난 성장이 온다!
Crop Failure#040.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#041.src: WOW, INCREDIBLE! AMAZING! It's almost like this is actual poison or something!!
Crop Failure#041.dst: 우와, 대단하다! 놀라워! 거의 진짜 독약 같잖아!!
Crop Failure#041.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#043.src: He's in that blue and gray tent by the bank. I don't care how you do it, but get my money back and we'll split it half-and-half, deal?
Crop Failure#043.dst: 은행 옆 파랗고 회색인 천막에 있어. 방법은 상관없으니 내 돈 받아 오면 반반 나누자, 어때?
Crop Failure#043.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#044.src: Find Doubiss the salesman in {p} near the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Crop Failure#045.src: Good day to ya! What is it ye be needin' from ol' Doubiss' stock?
Crop Failure#045.dst: 좋은 날이구먼! 이 Doubiss 영감 물건 중에 뭐가 필요한가?
Crop Failure#045.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#046.src: Oh. Oh, goodie. That idiot farmer's sendin' ya to get his money back, ain't he? Sweet baby bovine, this is ridiculous...
Crop Failure#046.dst: 아. 아, 좋구먼. 그 멍청한 농부가 돈 받아 오라고 보냈지? 아이고 맙소사, 말도 안 되는구먼...
Crop Failure#046.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#047.src: Since he obviously ain't gonna be listenin' to me anytime soon, lemme tell ya what the issue is with my fertilizer...
Crop Failure#047.dst: 그 양반은 당분간 내 말을 안 들을 테니, 내 비료에 무슨 문제가 있는지 말해 주지...
Crop Failure#047.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#048.src: Nothing! My fertilizer really does work! He probl'ly exaggerated how good I said it'd work, too! What'd he say, twice, three times the growth? More?
Crop Failure#048.dst: 문제없어! 내 비료는 진짜 효과가 있다고! 그 양반이 내 말을 부풀렸겠지! 뭐래, 두 배, 세 배로 자란대? 더?
Crop Failure#048.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#049.src: All the other farmers are usin' it right now and look at their fields! Heck, the only reason these crops ain't dead is because of my product!
Crop Failure#049.dst: 다른 농부들도 다 쓰고 있는데 그 밭들 좀 봐! 이 작물들이 아직 안 죽은 것도 내 물건 덕이라고!
Crop Failure#049.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#051.src: The crops, when I got here, were lookin' as pathetic as ya get. I ain't a gamblin' man, but I'd be willing ta bet something's up with the water here.
Crop Failure#051.dst: 내가 왔을 때 작물이 이미 한심하기 짝이 없었어. 도박꾼은 아니지만, 여기 물에 뭔가 있다는 데 걸겠어.
Crop Failure#051.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#052.src: The smell gets worse the closer ya get to the crypts in town, and while I ain't a native Oluxer, I've heard enough to know the wellspring is in the cave hear there.
Crop Failure#052.dst: 마을 묘지에 가까워질수록 냄새가 심해져. 난 Olux 토박이는 아니지만, 수원이 그 근처 동굴에 있다는 건 들었지.
Crop Failure#052.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#053.src: It'll prob'ly be best fer everyone if ya took a looksee. Maybe if ya find some evidence, ya can show that to the crazy farmer, have 'im quit pesterin' me, eh?
Crop Failure#053.dst: 자네가 한번 둘러보는 게 모두한테 좋을 거야. 증거를 찾으면 그 미친 농부한테 보여 주고, 날 그만 괴롭히게 해 줘, 응?
Crop Failure#053.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#054.src: The cave is on a little hill, next to the crypt. Careful ya don't go trippin' over a gravestone, now!
Crop Failure#054.dst: 동굴은 묘지 옆 작은 언덕에 있어. 묘비에 걸려 넘어지지나 말라고!
Crop Failure#054.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#055.src: Search the aquifer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for the problem with the water.

Crop Failure#056.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I'd figured I'd join ye, 'n see for myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#056.dst: 어이, 친구! 내 말 들었구먼? 나도 같이 가서 무슨 일인지 직접 보려고 왔지.
Crop Failure#056.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#057.src: And boy am I glad I bring me water in bottles. This stuff's rancid, full a' swamp slimes. No idea why they're here, though.
Crop Failure#057.dst: 물을 병에 담아 다녀서 참 다행이야. 이 물은 썩었어, 늪 슬라임 투성이야. 왜 여기 있는진 모르겠지만.
Crop Failure#057.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#058.src: The buggers stick to mountain caves. They don't come down this far, usually... suppose there's an exception fer everything.
Crop Failure#058.dst: 그놈들은 산속 동굴에 붙어 사는데. 보통 이렇게 내려오진 않아... 뭐든 예외는 있는 법이지.
Crop Failure#058.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#059.src: 's no wonder that Anast's crops ain't growin'. This is right under his farm! But we got some clear proof now, ain't we?
Crop Failure#059.dst: Anast 작물이 안 자라는 것도 당연하지. 바로 그 농장 밑이잖아! 그래도 이제 확실한 증거가 생겼구먼?
Crop Failure#059.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#060.src: Howzabout ya take care o' this? I ain't a fighter, but if ya mulch these slimes the water oughta clear up, I figure.
Crop Failure#060.dst: 이건 자네가 처리하는 게 어때? 난 싸움꾼이 아니지만, 이 슬라임들을 갈아 버리면 물이 맑아질 거야.
Crop Failure#060.speaker: Doubiss

Crop Failure#061.src: Kill the slimes in the aquifer and bring back [Polluted Slime] to Anast.
Crop Failure#061.dst: 대수층의 슬라임을 처치하고 [Polluted Slime]을 Anast에게 가져가세요.

Crop Failure#062.src: Pyyyyeww! Yeesh, kid! You smell worse than a pig's sty! What the heck happened to you, where've you been?!
Crop Failure#062.dst: 우웩! 어휴, 꼬마야! 돼지우리보다 더 냄새나잖아! 대체 무슨 일이야, 어디 갔다 왔어?!
Crop Failure#062.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#063.src: Ugh, eww! I don't want any of this sludge! I demand an explanation, now!!
Crop Failure#063.dst: 으, 우웩! 이 오물 필요 없어! 당장 설명해!!
Crop Failure#063.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#064.src: ...mhm, mhm...you went into the well cave...and found what, slimes?! Why would SLIMES be there?
Crop Failure#064.dst: ...음, 음... 우물 동굴에 들어갔더니... 슬라임이 있었다고?! 왜 거기 '슬라임'이 있어?
Crop Failure#064.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#066.src: So... that means I've been... oh dear lord I'm an idiot.
Crop Failure#066.dst: 그러니까... 내가 여태... 아이고 내가 바보였네.
Crop Failure#066.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#067.src: I guess I owe you some thanks anyway for trying to clear the sludge out. Suppose this year's harvest is just a bust.
Crop Failure#067.dst: 그래도 오물 치우려고 애써 줬으니 고맙긴 하다. 올해 수확은 그냥 망했나 봐.
Crop Failure#067.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#068.src: Can't sell what little I have, so I figure you can take it, and a bit of cash too, since you basically did an exterminator's job.
Crop Failure#068.dst: 얼마 안 되는 것도 못 팔 테니 네가 가져가. 돈도 좀 줄게. 사실상 해충 퇴치업자 일을 했잖아.
Crop Failure#068.speaker: Anast

Crop Failure#070.src: Oi, bucko! Took my advice, eh? I figured I'd join ye, 'n see fer myself what was goin' on.
Crop Failure#070.dst: 어이, 친구! 내 말 들었구먼? 나도 같이 가서 무슨 일인지 직접 보려고 왔지.

Dearly Departed#000.src: {#} Dexterity's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?

similar.text: 's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?

Dearly Departed#001.src: {#} Intelligence is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.

similar.text: is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.

Dearly Departed#004.src: Ah, looks like a fresh recruit! Did you see my posting? Good, good.
Dearly Departed#004.dst: 아, 신병이구먼! 내 공고 봤나? 좋아, 좋아.
Dearly Departed#004.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#005.src: You see, my dear father-in-law recently passed, and I had to bury him hastily out back. Couldn't get a priest here in time to bury him all properly...
Dearly Departed#005.dst: 실은 사랑하는 장인어른이 얼마 전 돌아가셔서 뒤뜰에 급히 묻었지. 제때 사제를 불러 제대로 모시지 못했어...
Dearly Departed#005.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#006.src: Unfortunately, it so happens that my wedding ring might have slipped off as I was putting him to rest...
Dearly Departed#006.dst: 그런데 공교롭게도 장인어른을 묻다가 결혼반지가 빠진 것 같아...
Dearly Departed#006.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#007.src: I need you to go back there and, well, recover the ring.
Dearly Departed#007.dst: 거기 가서, 음, 반지를 찾아와 줘.
Dearly Departed#007.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#008.src: It's nothing I couldn't handle myself, of course, but the wife already suspects something, and with her dear father passing so recently...
Dearly Departed#008.dst: 물론 나 혼자도 할 수 있지만, 아내가 벌써 뭔가 눈치챘고, 장인어른도 막 돌아가셨으니...
Dearly Departed#008.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#009.src: Well, you see the situation I'm in? Help a poor fellow out, just go and grab that [Muddy Shovel] over there, and then come back to me.
Dearly Departed#009.dst: 내 처지 알겠지? 불쌍한 사람 좀 도와줘. 저기 [Muddy Shovel]을 챙겨서 다시 와 줘.
Dearly Departed#009.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#011.src: The [Muddy Shovel] is just over there. I'd really appreciate the help, recruit.
Dearly Departed#011.dst: [Muddy Shovel]은 바로 저기 있어. 도와주면 정말 고맙겠네, 신병.
Dearly Departed#011.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#013.src: You've got the shovel? Great! You've got some sturdy armour and a weapon too, I presume?
Dearly Departed#013.dst: 삽 챙겼나? 좋아! 튼튼한 방어구랑 무기도 있겠지?
Dearly Departed#013.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#014.src: Good, good. Better safe than sorry... As I always say! Always, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#014.dst: 좋아, 좋아. 조심해서 나쁠 건 없지... 내가 늘 하는 말이야! 늘, 하하...
Dearly Departed#014.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#015.src: Oh, no reason really! Just making sure, ha ha... Should be perfectly safe back there, perfectly safe.
Dearly Departed#015.dst: 아, 별 이유 없어! 그냥 확인이야, 하하... 뒤뜰은 아주 안전할 거야, 아주 안전해.
Dearly Departed#015.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#016.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#016.dst: 스킬 포인트도 썼지? 무슨 일이 생기면 쓸모가 있거든.
Dearly Departed#016.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#017.src: Well, they're Skill Points! You gain them as you level up, then you can assign them to get bonuses in combat. Look, I'm no soldier, but even I know you really should be using them...
Dearly Departed#017.dst: 스킬 포인트잖아! 레벨이 오르면 얻는데, 배분하면 전투에서 보너스를 받아. 난 군인은 아니지만 그건 꼭 써야 한다는 건 알아...
Dearly Departed#017.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#018.src: There's five of them. Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Defence, and Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#018.dst: 다섯 가지야. 힘, 민첩, 지능, 방어, 재빠름. 각각 보너스가 달라.
Dearly Departed#018.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#019.src: You get it, or do you want me to tell you what they are?
Dearly Departed#019.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#020.src: is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#020.dst: 적을 쓰러뜨리기 힘들 때 유용해. 공격이 더 강해지거든, 간단하지.
Dearly Departed#020.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#021.src: 's a bit of a tricky one. The more of it you've got, the higher the likelihood is that your attacks will deal double damage. Neat, right?
Dearly Departed#021.dst: 조금 까다로워. 많이 찍을수록 공격이 두 배 피해를 줄 확률이 높아져. 괜찮지?
Dearly Departed#021.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#022.src: is for the spellcasters, it lowers the cost to cast spells and increases your max amount of mana.
Dearly Departed#022.dst: 주문을 쓰는 사람용이야. 주문 소모를 줄이고 최대 마나를 늘려 주지.
Dearly Departed#022.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#023.src: is your best bet if you're struggling with staying alive. Decreases the damage you take, 's about all.
Dearly Departed#023.dst: 살아남기 힘들다면 이게 최선이야. 받는 피해를 줄여 줘, 그게 다야.
Dearly Departed#023.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#024.src: Agility, now that one is for the risktakers. The more you have, the likelier you are to dodge incoming attacks, negating most of their damage.
Dearly Departed#024.dst: 재빠름, 이건 모험가 체질용이야. 많을수록 들어오는 공격을 피할 확률이 올라서 피해를 대부분 없애 주지.
Dearly Departed#024.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#025.src: Best part is, you can combine them however you want, no matter your class or style of fighting.
Dearly Departed#025.dst: 제일 좋은 건 직업이나 전투 방식에 상관없이 마음대로 조합할 수 있다는 거야.
Dearly Departed#025.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#026.src: Just open your compass to assign your Skill Points. Then, when you're ready, head in there and get my ring.
Dearly Departed#026.dst: 나침반을 열면 스킬 포인트를 배분할 수 있어. 준비되면 들어가서 내 반지를 찾아 줘.
Dearly Departed#026.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#028.src: Go on then, soldier! Show us the might of {p}'s army! Uh, I mean... get me that ring!
Dearly Departed#028.dst: 어서 가게, 병사! {p} 군대의 위력을 보여 줘! 어, 그러니까... 반지를 찾아와!
Dearly Departed#028.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#029.src: What's going on in there, soldier? Have you found the ring yet?
Dearly Departed#029.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#030.src: You really should hurry, before... nevermind! Just find the ring and get out of there!
Dearly Departed#030.dst: 정말 서두르는 게 좋아, 그 전에... 아니야! 그냥 반지 찾아서 나와!
Dearly Departed#030.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#031.src: Holy Bovine! It's... it's... he's back! Kill it, quickly!
Dearly Departed#031.dst: 맙소사! 저... 저... 그가 돌아왔어! 어서 죽여!
Dearly Departed#031.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#033.src: You did it! Come back here now, so I can finally get my ring back.
Dearly Departed#033.dst: 해냈구먼! 이제 돌아와, 드디어 반지를 되찾겠네.
Dearly Departed#033.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#035.src: Goodness, that was a little more exciting than I anticipated, hmph. Still, good work! I'm glad we were able to get rid of that monster...
Dearly Departed#035.dst: 세상에, 생각보다 좀 짜릿했구먼, 흠. 그래도 잘했어! 그 괴물을 없애서 다행이야...
Dearly Departed#035.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#036.src: I mean... poor father-in-law! I don't know how I'll explain this to the wife...
Dearly Departed#036.dst: 그러니까... 불쌍한 장인어른! 아내한테 이걸 어떻게 설명하지...
Dearly Departed#036.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#037.src: I'll take the ring now, it's rather precious to me...
Dearly Departed#037.dst: 반지는 이제 내가 받지. 나한텐 꽤 소중한 거라...
Dearly Departed#037.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#038.src: Anyhow, take this well-deserved reward for the, well, actions you took today. Perhaps, if you keep it up, you could even become a hero like Ragnar one day.
Dearly Departed#038.dst: 아무튼 오늘 한, 음, 일에 대한 정당한 보상이야. 이대로 계속하면 언젠가 Ragnar 같은 영웅이 될지도 모르지.
Dearly Departed#038.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Dearly Departed#039.src: Hello there, stranger. Was there something you wanted to speak to me about?
Dearly Departed#039.dst: 안녕하세요, 낯선 분. 저한테 하실 말씀이라도 있나요?
Dearly Departed#039.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#040.src: I should be angry but... I can't pretend to be surprised. He's always been such a forgetful oaf.
Dearly Departed#040.dst: 화를 내야 하는데... 놀란 척은 못 하겠네요. 원래 그렇게 잘 잊어버리는 멍청이예요.
Dearly Departed#040.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#041.src: But, it explains a lot... He's been acting weird lately, ever since dad passed. That must've been what happened, so thank you for telling me.
Dearly Departed#041.dst: 그래도 이제 이해가 돼요... 아버지 돌아가신 뒤로 이상하게 굴었거든요. 그래서였군요, 알려 줘서 고마워요.
Dearly Departed#041.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#042.src: That's right. The one and only, ha ha...
Dearly Departed#042.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#043.src: We're just simple farmers, trying to get by. We were taking care of my dad until... well... yeah...
Dearly Departed#043.dst: 그냥 먹고살려는 평범한 농부예요. 아버지를 모시고 살았는데... 음... 네...
Dearly Departed#043.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#044.src: Thank you... It all happened so suddenly. On the day I left for {p}, dad was as healthy as ever, but when I came back he was already buried. The sickness must have come so fast...
Dearly Departed#044.dst: 고마워요... 너무 갑자기 일어난 일이라. {p}에 가던 날만 해도 아버지는 정정하셨는데, 돌아와 보니 이미 묻히셨더라고요. 병이 참 빨리 왔나 봐요...
Dearly Departed#044.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#045.src: But at his age, I'm not surprised... It's just regrettable that we couldn't get a priest out here in time, dad was such a pious man.
Dearly Departed#045.dst: 그래도 연세를 생각하면 놀랍진 않아요... 신앙심 깊은 분이셨는데 제때 사제를 못 모신 게 아쉬울 뿐이에요.
Dearly Departed#045.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#046.src: Dad... Above all, he was kind and always generous. He left us this entire farm. And very pious too, a true believer. Maybe that's why he lived so long...
Dearly Departed#046.dst: 아버지는... 무엇보다 다정하고 늘 너그러우셨어요. 이 농장도 통째로 물려주셨죠. 신앙심도 깊으셨고요. 그래서 오래 사셨나 봐요...
Dearly Departed#046.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#047.src: Oh, dear... If I don't stop, I'm gonna start crying again.
Dearly Departed#047.dst: 아, 이런... 그만하지 않으면 또 울 것 같아요.
Dearly Departed#047.speaker: Farmer Kelri

Dearly Departed#048.src: You've used your Skill Points too, right? They could come in handy, should something happen.
Dearly Departed#048.dst: 스킬 포인트도 썼지? 무슨 일이 생기면 쓸모가 있을 거야.

Dearly Departed#049.src: There's five of them.  Strength,  Dexterity,  Intelligence,  Defence, and  Agility, each with different bonuses.
Dearly Departed#049.dst: 다섯 가지야.  힘,  민첩,  지능,  방어,  재빠름. 각각 보너스가 달라.

Dearly Departed#050.src: Why are you asking me that?

Dearly Departed#059.src: Now to see if you can find that ring Cevalus mentioned...
Dearly Departed#059.dst: 이제 Cevalus가 말한 반지를 찾을 수 있을지 보자...

Dearly Departed#060.src: You manage to pry the ring off the monster's finger...

Dearly Departed#063.src: {#} Strength is handy if you're having a tough time taking down enemies. It makes your attacks hit harder, simple as.
Dearly Departed#063.dst: {#} 힘은 적을 쓰러뜨리기 힘들 때 유용해. 공격이 더 강해지거든, 간단하지.
Dearly Departed#063.speaker: Farmer Cevalus

Death Whistle (Quest)#001.src: Hello! Hmm, armour, weapon, look of grim despair... You must be from the Wynn province!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.dst: 안녕하세요! 흠, 갑옷, 무기, 암울한 표정... Wynn 지방에서 오셨군요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#001.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#002.src: My name is Voer, and I'm an exotic plant merchant. I sell all kinds of, uh, perfectly legal goods to the magicians of Gavel.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.dst: 전 Voer, 이국 식물 상인이에요. Gavel 마법사들에게 온갖, 어, 완전히 합법적인 물건을 팔죠.
Death Whistle (Quest)#002.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#003.src: Lately, this Decay has been making business rather tough. The magical plants that used to grow here are dying.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.dst: 요즘 쇠락 때문에 장사가 영 힘들어요. 여기 자라던 마법 식물들이 죽어 가고 있거든요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#003.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#004.src: The need for magic has never been as big as it is now, and without supplies, the magicians of the swamp simply cannot operate!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.dst: 마법이 지금만큼 필요한 적이 없는데, 재료가 없으니 늪의 마법사들이 일을 못 해요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#004.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#005.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall that from that- er, my book.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.dst: 특히 Death Whistle이 필요해요. 이름만큼 위험하진 않아요- 옛날식 이름일 뿐이죠, 그- 어, 제 책에 따르면요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#005.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#006.src: It is a rather rare plant with all sorts of mystical properties, so much so that it can animate objects around it!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.dst: 온갖 신비한 성질이 있는 꽤 희귀한 식물인데, 주변 물건을 움직이게 할 정도예요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#006.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#007.src: Look for the highest mountain in the swamp south-east from here. The Decay hasn't reached the peaks yet, you see!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.dst: 여기서 동남쪽 늪에서 가장 높은 산을 찾아보세요. 쇠락이 아직 산꼭대기까진 안 닿았거든요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#007.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#008.src: Find the mountain at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and a way up on it.

Death Whistle (Quest)#009.src: Go to the top of the mountain and get {~} Black Whistle Leaf.
Death Whistle (Quest)#009.dst: 산꼭대기에 올라 Black Whistle Leaf {~}개를 얻으세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#010.src: Return to Voer at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with [{~} Death Whistle Leaf].
Death Whistle (Quest)#010.dst: [{~4} Death Whistle Leaf]를 가지고 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]의 Voer에게 돌아가세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#011.dst: 너, Voer! 배려 없는 도둑 같으니!
Death Whistle (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#012.src: You've no idea what you even have done, do you? Your thoughtless actions will cost lives!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.dst: 네가 무슨 짓을 했는지 모르지? 네 경솔한 행동에 사람이 죽을 거다!
Death Whistle (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#013.src: Uhm... Excuse me? What do you want, elf girl? We're in the middle of a deal here?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.dst: 음... 뭐라고요? 엘프 아가씨, 무슨 일이죠? 지금 거래 중인데요?
Death Whistle (Quest)#013.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#014.src: You sold Pink Pelulite! Have you forgotten its enraging properties? Or shall I read from that herbology book you "found" in my camp?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.dst: Pink Pelulite를 팔았잖아! 광란을 일으키는 성질을 잊었나? 내 야영지에서 "주운" 약초학 책이라도 읽어 줄까?
Death Whistle (Quest)#014.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#016.src: You can't even say for certain. This kind of carelessness has no place! If you refuse to exercise the proper thought and caution, then those around you suffer.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.dst: 확신도 못 하는군. 이런 부주의는 있어선 안 돼! 제대로 생각하고 조심하지 않으면, 주변 사람들이 고통받는다.
Death Whistle (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

Death Whistle (Quest)#018.src: Aaah, this is a disaster! Human, please, Pink Pelulite acts quickly and intensely... Follow the pink trail on the ground, the flowers shed their petals. Get it back before something bad happens!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.dst: 아아, 큰일 났다! 인간님, 제발요, Pink Pelulite는 빠르고 강하게 작용해요... 땅의 분홍색 흔적을 따라가세요, 꽃잎이 떨어지거든요. 사고 나기 전에 찾아와요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#018.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#019.src: Follow the path of residue to the buyer’s cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#019.dst: 잔여물 흔적을 따라 구매자의 동굴로 가세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#020.src: Ah, um, come back later please! Something strange is happening!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.dst: 아, 음, 나중에 와 주세요! 이상한 일이 벌어지고 있어요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#020.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#021.src: My body is a bit, um, not-in-my-control right now! I'd rather not hurt anyone!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.dst: 지금 몸이 좀, 음, 제 마음대로 안 돼요! 아무도 다치게 하고 싶지 않아요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#021.speaker: Witch

Death Whistle (Quest)#022.src: Remove the flower from the woman in the cave.
Death Whistle (Quest)#022.dst: 동굴 속 여자에게서 꽃을 떼어 내세요.

Death Whistle (Quest)#024.src: And what of the woman who bought it? Was she...?
Death Whistle (Quest)#024.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#025.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got in there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.dst: 아, 다행이다! 제때 들어가셨네요. 제 단골이에요- 미인이기도 하고요. 그 Lari 말이 어느 정도는 맞았네요...
Death Whistle (Quest)#025.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#026.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this... but I can't just quit selling the herbs.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.dst: 책을 가져간 건 맞고, 앞으로 이런 일은 더 조심해야겠지만... 약초 장사를 그만둘 순 없어요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#026.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#027.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource-rich region here! Especially not any more.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.dst: 먹고살아야 하는데, 이 늪은 자원이 풍부한 곳도 아니잖아요! 이제는 더더욱요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#027.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#028.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise... well, I would not think about it.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.dst: 그리고 그렇게 그냥 가 버리다니! 인간님이 있어서 다행이지, 아니었으면... 생각하기도 싫네요.
Death Whistle (Quest)#028.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#029.src: Regardless, you helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.dst: 아무튼 큰 도움이 됐어요. 재료도 구해 주고 단골 목숨도 구해 줬으니, 선물을 드릴게요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#029.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#030.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.dst: 제 상품 견본을 드릴게요. 전부 양조해도 안전하게 미리 손질해 뒀으니, 오늘 같은 사고는 없을 거예요!
Death Whistle (Quest)#030.speaker: Voer

Death Whistle (Quest)#031.src: I need Death Whistle in particular. It's not as deadly as it sounds, I promise- the name's just archaic, if I recall right from that- er, my book.

Death Whistle (Quest)#032.src: Wait, wh-what? A Pink PELULITE!? I sold that woman a Pink PELUTE for her luck charms! How dare- wait...wait, Pink Pelute has rounder petals... Oh no.
Death Whistle (Quest)#032.dst: 잠깐, 뭐- 뭐라고요? Pink PELULITE!? 전 그 여자분께 행운 부적용 Pink PELUTE를 팔았는데! 어떻게- 잠깐... Pink Pelute가 꽃잎이 더 둥근데... 이런.

Death Whistle (Quest)#033.src: I must...make a difficult choice, and leave this job to you. I've other things to tend to, though it pains me to leave a life in another's hands. Remember this, villager!
Death Whistle (Quest)#033.dst: 나는... 어려운 선택을 해야겠군. 이 일은 너에게 맡기겠다. 목숨을 남의 손에 맡기긴 괴롭지만, 다른 할 일이 있다. 명심해라, 주민!

Death Whistle (Quest)#034.src: You're back, I see...and you're shedding petals! You got the Pink Pelulite back?
Death Whistle (Quest)#034.dst: 돌아오셨네요... 꽃잎도 흘리면서! Pink Pelulite는 되찾았어요?

Death Whistle (Quest)#035.src: Oh, thank goodness! You got there in time. She's a regular of mine- and a bit of a looker, too. That Lari was right, to some extent, at least...

Death Whistle (Quest)#036.src: I did take her book, and I should be more careful in the future, regarding this...but I can't just quit selling these herbs.

Death Whistle (Quest)#037.src: I need an income, and the swamp isn't exactly the most resource rich region here! Especially not any more.

Death Whistle (Quest)#038.src: And how dare she just walk away like that! It's a good thing you were around, human, otherwise...well, I'd rather not think about it.

Death Whistle (Quest)#039.src: Regardless, you've helped me greatly. Got me my supplies and saved the life of a regular of mine, so I've got a gift for you!

Death Whistle (Quest)#040.src: I'll offer you a sampler of my stock. Everything in here is pre-primed to be safe for brewing, so there won't be any mishaps like today!

Death Whistle (Quest)#041.src: I've got to sharpen up these old eyes of mine. Can't make a mistake like that again.

Death Whistle (Quest)#042.src: Still, that Lari girl... I have to wonder what her problem is.

Deja Vu#000.src: Whatever that odd feeling was, it's over now. And there's Asher's shovel! Better return this to him.
Deja Vu#000.dst: 그 이상한 느낌이 뭐였든 이제 끝났다. 그리고 저기 Asher의 삽이 있다! 돌려주는 게 좋겠다.

Deja Vu#002.src: Whenever you're ready to save Asher, step through the rift.
Deja Vu#002.dst: Asher를 구할 준비가 되면 균열을 지나가게.

Deja Vu#005.src: Well well well, look who decided to come back with their tail between their legs.
Deja Vu#005.dst: 이런이런, 꼬리 내리고 돌아온 게 누군지 좀 봐.
Deja Vu#005.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#006.src: Two weeks now and you still haven't found it? Ugh, I can't believe I ever trusted you with such a simple task.
Deja Vu#006.dst: 2주나 지났는데 아직도 못 찾았어? 하, 이런 간단한 일을 너한테 맡겼다니.
Deja Vu#006.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#007.src: Who am I? WHAT DO YOU MEAN WHO AM I? You offered to help find my shovel, and I've been waiting two weeks!
Deja Vu#007.dst: 내가 누구냐고? 그게 무슨 소리야? 내 삽 찾아 준다며! 2주나 기다렸다고!
Deja Vu#007.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#008.src: Forget about your payment. Unless you either pay me back or get my shovel right now!
Deja Vu#008.dst: 보수는 잊어. 당장 돈을 물어내든지 내 삽을 찾아오든지 해!
Deja Vu#008.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#009.src: My shovel? That's why I sent you out in the first place! It's somewhere in {p}. I lost it while following a trail of flowers.
Deja Vu#009.dst: 내 삽? 그것 때문에 보낸 거잖아! {p} 어딘가에 있어. 꽃길을 따라가다 잃어버렸어.
Deja Vu#009.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#010.src: I think it was south west of the large ruined gate. Now go get it!
Deja Vu#010.dst: 커다란 폐허 관문 남서쪽이었던 것 같아. 얼른 찾아와!
Deja Vu#010.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#013.src: Well hello there, stranger! Welcome to {p}! Always nice to see a new face around here.
Deja Vu#013.dst: 어이, 낯선 사람! {p}에 온 걸 환영해! 새 얼굴은 언제 봐도 반갑다니까.
Deja Vu#013.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#014.src: Mad at you? Why would I be mad at you? We've never met.
Deja Vu#014.dst: 화났냐고? 내가 왜 화를 내? 우린 처음 보는데.
Deja Vu#014.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#015.src: I know this a bit forward, but I need to ask for your help with-
Deja Vu#015.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#016.src: Wait, is that-? It is! You've found my shovel! I recognize those markings anywhere.
Deja Vu#016.dst: 잠깐, 그거-? 맞아! 내 삽을 찾았구나! 저 무늬는 어디서든 알아보지.
Deja Vu#016.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#017.src: But why is it so rusty? Ah, no matter. Give that to me and I'll head inside to get you a nice reward.
Deja Vu#017.dst: 근데 왜 이렇게 녹슬었지? 뭐, 상관없어. 이리 줘, 안에서 보상 가져올게.
Deja Vu#017.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#018.src: Thank you. Now, about that reward-
Deja Vu#018.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#020.src: Oh dear, there he goes again. Poor fool ignored my warnings and touched that shovel.
Deja Vu#020.dst: 이런, 또 저러는군. 가엾은 녀석, 내 경고를 무시하고 그 삽을 만졌어.
Deja Vu#020.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#021.src: He's gone and got himself stuck in a loop.
Deja Vu#021.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#022.src: Head inside, soldier, and I'll explain what's happening here.
Deja Vu#022.dst: 안으로 들어오게, 병사. 무슨 일인지 설명해 주지.
Deja Vu#022.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#024.src: Without Asher, his house has vanished from time.
Deja Vu#024.dst: Asher가 없으니 그의 집도 시간 속에서 사라졌네.
Deja Vu#024.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#026.src: Let me explain why Asher disappeared...
Deja Vu#026.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#027.src: {p} was built many years ago by a long-lost civilization.
Deja Vu#027.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#028.src: They had odd powers. They ended up distorting time itself.
Deja Vu#028.dst: 그들은 기이한 힘을 지녔고, 결국 시간 자체를 비틀었지.
Deja Vu#028.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#029.src: The tools they used to make these structures are imbued with their power.
Deja Vu#029.dst: 이 건축물을 지을 때 쓴 도구엔 그들의 힘이 깃들어 있네.
Deja Vu#029.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#030.src: Asher found one of these tools: the shovel.
Deja Vu#030.dst: Asher가 그 도구 중 하나를 찾았지. 바로 그 삽일세.
Deja Vu#030.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#031.src: The shovel is tethering its time of influence to today. It keeps sending Asher back.
Deja Vu#031.dst: 삽이 자기 영향이 미치는 시간을 오늘에 묶어 두고 있어. 그래서 Asher를 계속 되돌려 보내지.
Deja Vu#031.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#032.src: The issue is, Asher died in the past. This creates a paradox.
Deja Vu#032.dst: 문제는 Asher가 과거에 죽었다는 걸세. 그래서 역설이 생기지.
Deja Vu#032.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#033.src: We can save him if I send you back to prevent his death. Go through this rift to join him in the past.
Deja Vu#033.dst: 자네를 과거로 보내 그의 죽음을 막으면 구할 수 있네. 이 균열을 지나 과거의 그에게 가게.
Deja Vu#033.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#034.src: Find a way to save Asher from his death.

Deja Vu#036.src: Usually this place is filled with workers.
Deja Vu#036.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#037.src: But no one's here. And this place is clearly not done.
Deja Vu#037.dst: 근데 아무도 없네. 게다가 여긴 딱 봐도 미완성이야.
Deja Vu#037.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#038.src: Whatever the case, I should probably find my shovel.
Deja Vu#038.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#039.src: If I were a shovel, where would I be?
Deja Vu#039.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#041.src: This place... There's so much going on but no one here.
Deja Vu#041.dst: 여긴... 온갖 게 돌아가는데 사람이 없어.
Deja Vu#041.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#042.src: What I don't understand, though, is why this place looks brand new.
Deja Vu#042.dst: 근데 이해가 안 되는 건, 여기가 왜 새것처럼 보이냐는 거야.
Deja Vu#042.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#043.src: This place looks like it's just being built!
Deja Vu#043.dst: 꼭 지금 짓고 있는 곳 같잖아!
Deja Vu#043.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#044.src: This must be something to do with the valley's magic. Wouldn't be the first time.
Deja Vu#044.dst: 분명 골짜기의 마법과 관련이 있을 거야. 처음 있는 일도 아니고.
Deja Vu#044.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#046.src: In fact, whenever I hold that shovel, this kind of stuff seems to happen.
Deja Vu#046.dst: 사실 그 삽만 쥐면 꼭 이런 일이 생기는 것 같단 말이야.
Deja Vu#046.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#047.src: Maybe it's sent me way back. Back to the construction of this place.
Deja Vu#047.dst: 어쩌면 한참 전으로 보내진 걸지도. 여길 짓던 시절로.
Deja Vu#047.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#048.src: Then why is no one here?
Deja Vu#048.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#049.src: Woah, that tree looks like it might fall over!
Deja Vu#049.dst: 우와, 저 나무 곧 쓰러질 것 같아!
Deja Vu#049.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#051.src: Uhf! How do they have a cannon? These guys must be super advanced.
Deja Vu#051.dst: 윽! 대포가 있다고? 이 사람들 엄청 발전했나 봐.
Deja Vu#051.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#052.src: I think I'm close now. I can just feel that shovel close by.
Deja Vu#052.dst: 거의 다 온 것 같아. 삽이 가까이 있는 게 느껴져.
Deja Vu#052.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#054.src: My my, a crushing defeat to be sure. You'll have to find a way to stop that.
Deja Vu#054.dst: 저런, 아주 납작하게 깨졌구먼. 그걸 막을 방법을 찾아야겠네.
Deja Vu#054.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#055.src: Go back through the rift and make sure Asher doesn't become a pancake this time.
Deja Vu#055.dst: 균열을 지나 돌아가서, 이번엔 Asher가 납작해지지 않게 하게.
Deja Vu#055.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#057.src: Well that was quite the explosive end to our friend there. There must be a way to prevent that.
Deja Vu#057.dst: 우리 친구가 아주 폭발적인 최후를 맞았구먼. 막을 방법이 있을 걸세.
Deja Vu#057.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#058.src: Head back in there. This time with less explosions.
Deja Vu#058.dst: 다시 가 보게. 이번엔 폭발은 좀 줄이고.
Deja Vu#058.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#059.src: Oh, so close on that try. Who could've guessed that was how our friend met his end?
Deja Vu#059.dst: 아, 이번엔 아깝구먼. 우리 친구가 그렇게 최후를 맞을 줄 누가 알았겠나?
Deja Vu#059.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#060.src: I'm sure you'll nail it this time. Not sure how you will stop a cosmic event, though.
Deja Vu#060.dst: 이번엔 분명 해낼 걸세. 다만 우주적 사건을 어떻게 막을지는 모르겠군.
Deja Vu#060.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#061.src: Oh there it is! My shovel!
Deja Vu#061.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#062.src: I'm surprised it took me back this far this time.
Deja Vu#062.dst: 이번엔 이렇게 멀리까지 보내질 줄은 몰랐네.
Deja Vu#062.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#063.src: Well, time to head on back-
Deja Vu#063.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#066.src: Asher, you remember when I allowed you to live in the valley, I told you not to touch any odd objects.
Deja Vu#066.dst: Asher, 골짜기에 살게 해 줄 때 이상한 물건은 만지지 말라고 했던 거 기억하나?
Deja Vu#066.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#068.src: You got yourself stuck hundreds of years ago. If it wasn't for this guard, you'd be removed from existence.
Deja Vu#068.dst: 자넨 수백 년 전에 갇혀 버렸네. 이 경비병이 아니었으면 존재 자체가 지워졌을 걸세.
Deja Vu#068.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#069.src: Oh... So that's where I am. I am so sorry Martyn. Please don't kick me out of the valley.
Deja Vu#069.dst: 아... 그래서 여기 있는 거군요. 정말 죄송해요, Martyn. 골짜기에서 쫓아내지 마세요.
Deja Vu#069.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#070.src: I know time travel can be tempting. But it's far more dangerous than you can ever understand.
Deja Vu#070.dst: 시간 여행이 솔깃한 건 아네. 하지만 자네가 상상하는 것보다 훨씬 위험하지.
Deja Vu#070.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#071.src: The valley is banned for most citizens. I watch over this timeline because of poor souls like Asher.
Deja Vu#071.dst: 골짜기는 대부분의 주민에게 금지된 곳이네. Asher 같은 가엾은 이들 때문에 이 시간선을 지키지.
Deja Vu#071.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#075.src: How did you get these powers? Are you even human?
Deja Vu#075.dst: 그런 힘은 어떻게 얻었어요? 사람은 맞아요?
Deja Vu#075.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#076.src: Oh you know. I've read a book or two in my time.
Deja Vu#076.dst: 오, 뭐. 살면서 책 한두 권쯤은 읽었지.
Deja Vu#076.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#077.src: {u}, I'm sorry I got you dragged into this. I wish I could have done it myself.
Deja Vu#077.dst: {u}, 이 일에 끌어들여 미안하네. 내가 직접 할 수 있었으면 좋았을 텐데.
Deja Vu#077.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#078.src: I probably could have gotten myself out...
Deja Vu#078.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#079.src: You died in the past. Multiple times.
Deja Vu#079.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#081.src: Yes. In some surprising ways too.
Deja Vu#081.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#082.src: {u}, I'm sure we will meet again... in time.
Deja Vu#082.dst: {u}, 분명 다시 만날 걸세... 때가 되면.
Deja Vu#082.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Deja Vu#086.src: I don't understand Martyn. He seems to know everything about the past. Here, come closer, I want to whisper something.
Deja Vu#086.dst: Martyn은 도통 모르겠어. 과거 일을 전부 아는 것 같아. 이리 와 봐, 귓속말할 게 있어.
Deja Vu#086.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#088.src: I think he might have known Bob. I saw some letters in his house.
Deja Vu#088.dst: 그 사람 Bob을 알았던 것 같아. 집에서 편지를 몇 통 봤거든.
Deja Vu#088.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#089.src: Weird, right? Bob was a hard guy to know.
Deja Vu#089.speaker: Asher

Deja Vu#090.src: Anyway, take this. It's the least I can do to pay you for saving me.
Deja Vu#090.dst: 아무튼 이거 받아. 날 구해 준 보답으로 이 정도는 해야지.
Deja Vu#090.speaker: Asher

Desperate Metal#003.src: A bunch of stupid mechs came here and just started ransacking!
Desperate Metal#003.dst: 멍청한 기계병 떼가 몰려와서 막 뒤지기 시작했어요!
Desperate Metal#003.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#004.src: Looks like a bunch of despermechs. That's what we call junk mechs, trying to survive.
Desperate Metal#004.dst: Despermech 무리 같네요. 살아남으려고 발버둥 치는 고물 기계병을 그렇게 불러요.
Desperate Metal#004.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#005.src: I count three different mech marks. Looks like they split up once they got their parts.
Desperate Metal#005.dst: 기계병 표식이 세 종류예요. 부품을 챙기고 나서 흩어진 것 같네요.
Desperate Metal#005.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#006.src: You got to help me here, I'm no warrior. Look they've dropped crates on their escape. Follow them and bring me back evidence that you destroyed them and I shall reward you.
Desperate Metal#006.dst: 도와줘요, 난 싸움꾼이 아니거든요. 봐요, 도망치면서 상자를 떨어뜨렸어요. 뒤쫓아가서 놈들을 부쉈다는 증거를 가져오면 보답할게요.
Desperate Metal#006.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#007.src: Three trails, three thieving despermechs. Be careful, they aren't to be underestimated.
Desperate Metal#007.dst: 흔적 셋, 도둑 Despermech 셋. 조심해요, 얕봤다간 큰일 나요.
Desperate Metal#007.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#008.src: Locate the {~} mechs by following the trails of tools, return to Phinas with evidence that you destroyed the mechs.
Desperate Metal#008.dst: 도구 흔적을 따라가 기계병 {~}기를 찾고, 파괴한 증거를 가지고 Phinas에게 돌아가세요.

Desperate Metal#009.src: You Wynn folk sure know your fights.
Desperate Metal#009.dst: Wynn 사람들은 확실히 싸울 줄 아네요.
Desperate Metal#009.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#010.src: You found all three? Let's take a look. Hm....
Desperate Metal#010.dst: 셋 다 찾았어요? 한번 봐요. 흠....
Desperate Metal#010.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#011.src: Wait. These aren't Despermechs.. The factory fell over two years ago. These are brand new. Handmade.
Desperate Metal#011.dst: 잠깐. 이건 Despermech가 아니에요.. 공장은 2년도 더 전에 무너졌어요. 이건 새것, 수제예요.
Desperate Metal#011.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#013.src: Would you look at that! Their code!
Desperate Metal#013.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#014.src: Here, have them back. Take a close look at the names of these parts.
Desperate Metal#014.dst: 자, 돌려줄게요. 부품에 적힌 이름을 잘 봐요.
Desperate Metal#014.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#015.src: Find out where to go by looking at the pieces of junk.
Desperate Metal#015.dst: 고철 조각을 살펴보고 어디로 갈지 알아내세요.

Desperate Metal#016.src: What are these? I have nothing to do with them!
Desperate Metal#016.dst: 이게 뭔데? 난 이거랑 아무 상관 없어!
Desperate Metal#016.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#017.src: Ahh.. Well now that I think of it writing my location on these parts was a bit stupid.
Desperate Metal#017.dst: 아.. 뭐, 생각해 보니 부품에 내 위치를 적은 건 좀 멍청했네.
Desperate Metal#017.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#018.src: Those mechs were my creation. Corkus can still live with machines.
Desperate Metal#018.dst: 그 기계병들은 내가 만들었어. Corkus는 아직 기계와 살 수 있어.
Desperate Metal#018.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#019.src: The factory was a disaster. That's what happens when a machine controls a machine.
Desperate Metal#019.dst: 공장은 재앙이었지. 기계가 기계를 조종하면 그렇게 되는 거야.
Desperate Metal#019.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#020.src: I am living proof that humans can control them. Make use of them.
Desperate Metal#020.dst: 내가 인간이 기계를 다루고 쓸 수 있다는 살아 있는 증거야.
Desperate Metal#020.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#021.src: The metal shortage has made it difficult to make my machines... Not to mention the new laws..
Desperate Metal#021.dst: 금속이 모자라서 기계 만들기가 힘들어졌어... 새 법은 말할 것도 없고..
Desperate Metal#021.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#022.src: If you want to turn me in fine. You'll find all the evidence you need under my pillow.
Desperate Metal#022.dst: 날 넘기고 싶으면 그러든가. 필요한 증거는 다 내 베개 밑에 있어.
Desperate Metal#022.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#027.src: I'm sorry it ended up like this, you should've just ignored that old man.
Desperate Metal#027.dst: 이렇게 돼서 미안해. 그 영감 말은 그냥 무시했어야지.
Desperate Metal#027.speaker: Nettik

Desperate Metal#029.src: I was made to be angry. I can't stop myself...
Desperate Metal#029.dst: 난 분노하도록 만들어졌다. 멈출 수가 없다...
Desperate Metal#029.speaker: Big Boss Mech-DM666

Desperate Metal#031.src: Did you find the source of those odd handmade mechs?
Desperate Metal#031.dst: 그 이상한 수제 기계병들의 출처는 찾았어요?
Desperate Metal#031.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#032.src: Nettik? The Light House owner? It's not overly surprising.
Desperate Metal#032.dst: Nettik? 등대 주인? 그리 놀랍진 않네요.
Desperate Metal#032.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#033.src: She always did complain about the mech ban.
Desperate Metal#033.dst: 그 사람은 늘 기계병 금지령에 불만이었거든요.
Desperate Metal#033.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#034.src: You see, many of the Corkian people rely on their machines. Have done for years.
Desperate Metal#034.dst: 있잖아요, Corkus 사람들 상당수가 기계에 의지해요. 몇 년째 그래 왔죠.
Desperate Metal#034.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#035.src: So when the factory fell and the new laws were introduced, people's lives changed..
Desperate Metal#035.dst: 그래서 공장이 무너지고 새 법이 생기자, 사람들의 삶이 바뀌었어요..
Desperate Metal#035.speaker: Phinas

Desperate Metal#036.src: People don't like change. Anyway, I can't thank you enough. Have this for your troubles.
Desperate Metal#036.dst: 사람들은 변화를 싫어하죠. 아무튼 정말 고마워요. 수고비로 이거 받아요.
Desperate Metal#036.speaker: Phinas

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.src: The report suggests that the two species would compete for space.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#002.dst: 보고서에 따르면 두 종족은 공간을 두고 경쟁하게 될 것이다.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#003.src: "Public opinion is firmly against removal of the natives..."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#005.src: Find out what's happening at the theatre.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.src: Interesting to see a Human wanting to see a Dwarven play!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.dst: 인간이 드워프 연극을 보고 싶어 하다니 흥미롭군!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#006.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.src: The only play we're performing is the annual Victory Festival.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.dst: 지금 공연하는 건 매년 하는 승리 축제뿐이야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#007.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.src: The entry cost is [{~} Emerald Block]
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#008.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.src: Just take a seat and enjoy the show.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#010.speaker: Lozeg

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.src: Wait, is that- Hey, {u}! It's so good to see you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.dst: 잠깐, 저거- 어이, {u}! 만나서 정말 반가워!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#011.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.src: Hello, to the people of Gavel, glad to see so many here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.dst: Gavel 여러분, 안녕하십니까. 이렇게 많이 와 주셔서 기쁩니다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#012.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.dst: 연극을 즐기시길, 그리고 아주 유익한 시간이 되길 바랍니다. 오늘 밤 해설은 제가 맡겠습니다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#013.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.src: I hope you'll enjoy the play, and that it'll be very educational too. I will be tonight's narrator.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.dst: 연극을 즐겨 주시길, 그리고 아주 유익한 시간이 되길 바랍니다. 오늘 밤 해설은 제가 맡겠습니다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#014.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.src: Pheeeew. I think we outran the villagers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.dst: 휴우우. 마을 사람들을 따돌린 것 같다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#016.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.src: I think we are safe here in the mountains. Oh look. Shiny ores. This is like a gold mine.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.dst: 이 산속이라면 안전하겠지. 오, 봐라. 반짝이는 광석. 여긴 금광 같구나.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#017.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.src: These nice minerals are very nice, let us start digging.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.dst: 이 멋진 광물들 참 멋지다. 파기 시작하자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#018.speaker: Dwarfi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.src: I am a dangerous monster and I will not let you mine these diamonds. We are the Doguns, and we will kill you!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.dst: 나는 위험한 괴물이다. 이 다이아몬드는 못 캐게 하겠다. 우리는 Dogun, 너희를 죽이겠다!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#020.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.src: Graoaoro. I will eat you all for my afternoon demon luncheon.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.dst: 그라오오오. 너희를 전부 오후 악마 점심으로 먹어 주마.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#021.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.src: MOAHAHAHA. WE WILL KILL ALL OF YOU.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#025.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.src: We need to forge better weapons so we can fight back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.dst: 반격하려면 더 좋은 무기를 벼려야 한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#026.speaker: Babbi

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.src: Good idea! We will use our intelligence to slay the demons.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.dst: 좋은 생각이다! 우리의 지성으로 악마를 무찌르자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#027.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.src: YOU CANNOT BEAT US, WE CAN SUMMON DRAGONS WITH OUR MAGIC.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.dst: 우리를 이길 수 없다. 우린 마법으로 용을 부른다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#028.speaker: Demon

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.src: Dragons are no match for us?? CHARGE!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.dst: 용 따위가 우리 상대가 되겠나?? 돌격!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#029.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.src: We have won. Hooray. And now we have established a great citadel, {p}!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.dst: 우리가 이겼다. 만세. 이제 위대한 성채, {p}을(를) 세웠다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#030.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.src: The dwarven intellect beat the sheer power of the demons magic.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.dst: 드워프의 지성이 악마 마법의 무식한 힘을 이겼다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#031.speaker: Gagly

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.src: I hope you enjoyed the show, and learned something new today!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.dst: 공연을 즐기시고, 오늘 새로운 걸 배워 가셨길 바랍니다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#033.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.src: We are continuing the celebration at the old Demon City. Follow the red banners outside {p} to get there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.dst: 축제는 옛 악마의 도시에서 이어집니다. {p} 밖의 붉은 깃발을 따라오세요.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#034.speaker: Narrator

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.src: Ugh, that was awful. Don't believe anything you see here, human. History is written by the victors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.dst: 으, 끔찍했어. 여기서 본 건 하나도 믿지 마, 인간. 역사는 승자가 쓰는 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.src: Make your way to the Dogun Festival by following the red banners outside {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#037.dst: {p} 밖의 붉은 깃발을 따라 Dogun 축제로 가세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.src: Welcome one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.dst: 모두 환영합니다! 드워프 형제자매 여러분, 손님과 방문객 여러분!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#038.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.src: Welcome, one and all! Dwarven brothers and sisters, guests and visitors!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.dst: 모두 환영합니다! 드워프 형제자매 여러분, 손님과 방문객 여러분!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#039.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#040.src: Axelus! You are under arrest for high treason!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.src: The cover crumbles a touch at your grip when you open it up. How old is this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#041.dst: 펼치려고 잡자 표지가 살짝 바스러진다. 이게 얼마나 오래된 걸까?

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.src: If I could draw your attention to the wooden stage in the north, we can begin.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.dst: 북쪽의 나무 무대를 봐 주시면 시작하겠습니다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#042.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.src: Welcome to the annual festival where we celebrate victory over the foul demons...The Doguns!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.dst: 사악한 악마... Dogun에게 거둔 승리를 기리는 연례 축제에 오신 걸 환영합니다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#043.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.src: Now, if I can get you to turn around to face the bonfire, we've prepared a lovely firecasting show for you all while we prepare!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.dst: 자, 모닥불 쪽으로 돌아서 주십시오. 준비하는 동안 멋진 화염 마법 공연을 마련했습니다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#044.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.src: Wow, I didn't know Dwarves could learn such magic! Beats the heck out of firecrackers!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.dst: 와, 드워프가 이런 마법을 배울 수 있는 줄 몰랐어! 폭죽보다 훨씬 낫네!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#045.speaker: Mahou

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.src: Magnificent! Thank you very much to our fire casters. Now, ladies and gents, your attention to the main stage please!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.dst: 훌륭합니다! 화염술사들께 감사드립니다. 자, 신사 숙녀 여러분, 주 무대를 봐 주십시오!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#046.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.src: For the last {~} years we have captured renegade Doguns that escaped the war, and this year is no exception!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.dst: 지난 {~}년간 전쟁에서 도망친 Dogun 잔당을 붙잡아 왔고, 올해도 예외는 아닙니다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#047.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.src: We shall now entomb the foul demon to join the ranks of the other Doguns on display.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.dst: 이제 이 사악한 악마를 봉인해, 전시된 다른 Dogun들의 대열에 합류시키겠습니다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#048.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.src: Note its magical might, its aggressive nature, its intense heat, and its fierce appearance.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.dst: 저 마법의 힘, 공격적인 본성, 뜨거운 열기, 그리고 흉포한 생김새를 보십시오.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#050.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.src: All no match for the ingenuity and comeradery of the Dwarven nations!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.dst: 그 무엇도 드워프 나라들의 재주와 전우애엔 상대가 안 되죠!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#051.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.src: M-Monsters... You all...are the demons here...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#052.speaker: Dogun
