Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.src: Every year, every year, every single YEAR you do this. You all need to open your god-blessed eyes for once!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.dst: 매년, 매년, 해마다 이 짓을 하지. 다들 제발 한 번이라도 눈 좀 떠 봐!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.src: Do you all really believe everything they tell you? Do you all just lap it up like dogs?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.dst: 저들이 하는 말을 정말 다 믿는 거야? 개처럼 넙죽넙죽 받아먹기만 할 거야?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.src: Our side won the war, but does that really mean we were in the right? I'll tell you right now, it doesn't!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.dst: 전쟁은 우리가 이겼지만, 그게 우리가 옳았다는 뜻일까? 지금 말해 주지, 아니야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.src: We all see it- The Doguns have feelings, family and thoughts, just like anyone else here!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.dst: 다들 알잖아- Dogun도 여기 누구처럼 감정도, 가족도, 생각도 있다고!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#056.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.src: You are encasing live Doguns for entertainment. Public execution! This twisted display is more demonic than they ever could dream to be!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.dst: 살아 있는 Dogun을 오락거리로 가두고 있어. 공개 처형이라고! 이 뒤틀린 전시가 저들이 꿈꾼 그 무엇보다 더 악마 같아!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.src: Guards! Get this propaganda spewing half pint to the Molten Core Prison, north side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.dst: 경비병! 선동이나 떠드는 저 땅꼬마를 북쪽 Molten Core 감옥으로 끌고 가라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#058.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.src: Come along, sir. Let's not make more of a scene.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#059.speaker: Dwarven Guard

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.src: Why would Axelus say something so blatantly wrong?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.dst: Axelus는 왜 저렇게 뻔히 틀린 말을 하지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#060.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.src: What was he talking about? That was all nonsense!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.dst: 무슨 소리를 한 거야? 다 헛소리였잖아!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#061.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.src: Are they really taking him to the Molten Core? You've heard the horror stories about there, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.dst: 정말 Molten Core로 데려가는 거야? 거기 끔찍한 얘기 들어 봤지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#062.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.src: Well, the expression 'no hope blows from the north' came from there, since it's on the north side...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.dst: '북쪽에선 희망이 불어오지 않는다'는 말이 거기서 나왔잖아, 북쪽에 있으니까...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#063.speaker: Crowd

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.src: Apologies, all. I shall provide us all with a quick way back to {p} on the floor here. We hope you enjoyed the show, despite the interruption!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.dst: 모두 죄송합니다. 여기 바닥에 {p}(으)로 바로 돌아가는 길을 열어 두겠습니다. 방해가 있었지만 공연을 즐기셨길 바랍니다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#064.speaker: Marock

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.src: Find out more about the hysterical dwarf in {p}'s prison.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#065.dst: {p} 감옥에 있는 흥분한 드워프에 대해 더 알아보세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.src: I see I got your attention. Interested in the truth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.dst: 관심을 끈 모양이군. 진실이 궁금한 거지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.src: I'm no conspiracy nut. The Dwarves have been lied to for hundreds of years about the war.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.dst: 난 음모론자가 아니야. 드워프들은 수백 년간 전쟁에 대해 속아 왔어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.src: I have seen the truth. But my word isn't enough, is it? Seeing is believing, after all.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.dst: 난 진실을 봤어. 하지만 내 말만으론 부족하겠지? 백문이 불여일견이니까.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.src: Hopefully I will see you soon, {u}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#069.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#070.src: Pick up Axelus' note and head to the location at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.src: Well, now you have read what I read. The truth...or the lie.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.dst: 자, 이제 내가 읽은 걸 너도 읽었어. 진실... 아니면 거짓을.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.src: My people are tyrants and conquerors...but they are also good. The people have been brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.dst: 우리 종족은 폭군이자 정복자야... 하지만 선하기도 해. 다들 세뇌당한 거지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#074.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.src: Many things are about to happen. If you want to know more, come to house number {~} in {p}. I'll be waiting.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.dst: 곧 많은 일이 벌어질 거야. 더 알고 싶으면 {p}의 {~}번 집으로 와. 기다릴게.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#076.src: Search for house {~} in {p} like Axelus said.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#077.src: Talk to Axelus in the Coalition Base.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.src: Ah, you made it. Come and meet Korzim
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.dst: 아, 왔구나. 와서 Korzim을 만나 봐
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#078.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.src: We...are those who...want peace. I am son...of the Dogun Chief... I have...been banished.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.dst: 우리는... 평화를... 원하는 자들이다. 나는... Dogun 족장의 아들... 추방당했다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#080.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.src: The coalition is a small group of believers in the truth. The Doguns aren't demons, and the Dwarves aren't all brainwashed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.dst: 연합은 진실을 믿는 소수의 모임이야. Dogun은 악마가 아니고, 드워프도 전부 세뇌된 건 아니야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#081.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won’t tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.dst: 하지만 물론, 우리는 숨어 살아야 해. Dogun은 드워프를 용납하지 않고, 드워프는 배신자와 "악마"를 사냥하니까.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#082.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.src: But of course, we have to live in hiding. The Doguns won't tolerate Dwarves and the Dwarves hunt traitors and "Demons".
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.dst: 하지만 물론, 우리는 숨어 살아야 해. Dogun은 드워프를 용납하지 않고, 드워프는 배신자와 "악마"를 사냥하니까.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#083.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.src: We would...melt the beds...they sleep in... After all...we are...molten rock.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#084.dst: 우리는... 그들이 자는... 침대를 녹일 거다... 어쨌든... 우리는... 녹은 바위니까.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.src: This hideout was created by the Doguns in minutes, when it would have taken us days!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#085.dst: 이 은신처는 Dogun이 몇 분 만에 만들었어. 우리였다면 며칠은 걸렸을 텐데!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.src: It's a control panel. It's futile to figure out how it works, perhaps brute force is necessary.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#086.dst: 제어판이다. 작동 방식을 알아내려는 건 헛수고다. 아마 힘으로 밀어붙여야 할 것 같다.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.src: Right now, we're trying to convince the public. But it's proving difficult, if not impossible.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.dst: 지금은 대중을 설득하려 하고 있어. 하지만 불가능까진 아니어도 꽤 어렵더라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#087.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.src: It isn't {~} years ago. We have the technology and supply chains to live here peacefully, but they just won't listen!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.dst: 지금은 {~}년 전이 아니야. 여기서 평화롭게 살 기술도 보급망도 있는데, 도무지 듣질 않아!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#088.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.src: We have...a plan... To win over...my people...that is.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.dst: 우리에겐... 계획이 있다... 내 종족의... 마음을 얻을.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#089.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.src: Korzim has told us that dragon bone is sacred to his people. We had to make some connections, but we have a way to get it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.dst: Korzim 말로는 용뼈가 Dogun에겐 신성한 거래. 연줄 좀 대느라 고생했지만, 이제 구할 방법이 생겼어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#090.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.src: If you want, you could come with us. We can explain more of the situation later. Exit's through the back.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.dst: 원하면 같이 가도 돼. 자세한 사정은 나중에 설명할게. 출구는 뒤쪽이야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#091.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#092.src: Follow the group on the mission.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.src: The others...are just up ahead. I'll let you through...our tunnel.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.dst: 다른 이들은... 바로 앞에 있다. 우리... 터널로 보내 주겠다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#094.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.src: We use.. earth and.. fire.. elements. It is slow... like us.. but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.dst: 우리는.. 대지와.. 화염.. 원소를 쓴다. 느리다... 우리처럼.. 하지만 강력하다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#095.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.src: We use...earth and...fire...elements. It is slow...like us...but powerful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.dst: 우리는... 대지와... 화염... 원소를 쓴다. 느리지만... 우리처럼... 강력하다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#096.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.src: We don't forbid...you humans to be here, but please leave... We don't want any...unwanted dwarves here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#097.dst: 우리는... 너희 인간이 여기 있는 걸 막지 않는다. 하지만 떠나 다오... 원치 않는... 드워프는 여기 필요 없다.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.src: We got this drill all the way from Corkus. Axelus had to pay a king's ransom to buy it, but this ought to work!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.dst: 이 드릴은 Corkus에서부터 가져온 거야. Axelus가 거금을 치르고 샀지만, 이건 먹힐 거야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#099.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.src: AAAAGH! Idiot Corkus swindlers! Damn it all! How many emeralds did we waste?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.dst: 으아아악! 멍청한 Corkus 사기꾼들! 젠장! 에메랄드를 얼마나 날린 거야?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#101.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.src: Ugh, do you have any experience with machines? You might have some idea of how in the hell to fix this hunk of junk.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.dst: 으, 기계 좀 다뤄 봤어? 이 고철 덩어리를 대체 어떻게 고치는지 알지도 모르잖아.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#102.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.src: Fantastic, {u}! We got the bone! Couldn't have done it without you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.dst: 끝내준다, {u}! 뼈를 얻었어! 네가 없었으면 못 했을 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#103.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.src: You can take it back to the coalition base. Barden and I will need to pack up before we join you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.dst: 그건 연합 기지로 가져가. 나랑 Barden은 짐 좀 챙기고 따라갈게.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#104.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.src: Just knock on the black block in front of the cave we arrived in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.dst: 우리가 들어온 동굴 앞의 검은 블록을 두드리면 돼.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#105.speaker: Barden

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#106.src: Head back to the Coalition Base through the tunnel.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.src: Dragon bone is one of the hardest substances in all the provinces. It's extremely rare.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.dst: 용뼈는 모든 지방을 통틀어 가장 단단한 물질 중 하나야. 엄청 희귀하지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#109.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.src: We're going to present this to the Dogun chief as tribute. We need to tidy it up.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.dst: 이걸 Dogun 족장에게 공물로 바칠 거야. 좀 손질해야 해.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#110.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.src: Could you get [{~} Repair Kit] from the eastern part of the base?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.dst: 기지 동쪽에서 [{~} Repair Kit] 좀 가져다줄래?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#111.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#112.src: Retrieve the [Repair Kit] in the eastern part of the base.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.src: There are voices behind this wall, and the trail ends here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#114.dst: 이 벽 너머에서 목소리가 들려. 흔적도 여기서 끊겼어.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.src: We have no vaults here. Must be traitors... The King really wants to see Axelus.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#115.dst: 여긴 금고가 없어. 배신자들이 분명해... 왕께서 Axelus를 무척 보고 싶어 하시지.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#116.src: Stand back! I'll ready the charges...

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.src: No, no, ignore the repair kit! There's no time to worry about that!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.dst: 아니, 아니, 수리 도구는 됐어! 그런 거 신경 쓸 시간 없어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#118.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.src: Our position has been compromised, they blew our doors wide open! We have to evacuate immediately.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.dst: 위치가 들통났어, 문을 활짝 날려 버렸다고! 당장 대피해야 해.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#119.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.src: We've never been caught like this before, they never knew we really had Doguns on our side.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.dst: 이렇게 들킨 적은 없었어. 우리 편에 진짜 Dogun이 있는 줄은 몰랐으니까.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#120.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.src: We need to get to safety right now! The least explored area is the Upper Heights.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.dst: 당장 안전한 곳으로 가야 해! 가장 덜 탐사된 곳은 Upper Heights야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#121.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.src: Everyone, out! Now! They won't follow through the rough terrain!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.dst: 다들 나가! 당장! 험한 지형까진 안 쫓아올 거야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#122.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#123.src: Find your way up to the Dogun Village through the tunnel.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.src: We'll stay around here, we aren't welcome in the village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.dst: 우린 이 근처에 있을게. 마을에선 우릴 반기지 않거든.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#124.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.src: But... bring them... the dragon bone as a gift... If they accept it... they might accept us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.dst: 하지만... 그들에게... 용뼈를 선물로 가져가라... 그걸 받으면... 우리도 받아들일지 모른다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#125.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.src: You are free to enter the village but we will stay back and wait until the coast is clear. Keep going.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.dst: 넌 마을에 들어가도 돼. 우린 뒤에서 안전해질 때까지 기다릴게. 계속 가.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#126.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.src: What is...that on the...cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#127.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.src: What is... that on the... cliff to the south?
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#128.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.src: Hey, aren't those...Doguns?! A whole settlement...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.dst: 이봐, 저거... Dogun 아냐?! 정착지가 통째로...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#129.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.src: They've been gathering forces! We must inform {p} immediately!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.dst: 병력을 모으고 있어! 당장 {p}에 알려야 해!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#130.speaker: Dwarven Scout

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.src: Human. Come talk to me... Now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#131.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.src: Human... That Dwarf, he saw us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#133.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.src: They will... destroy us... If he reports... back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.dst: 그가... {p}에 보고하면... 그들이... 우리를 파멸시킬 거다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#134.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.src: We need to...prepare our defenses. We need all the...help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.dst: 우리는... 방어를 준비해야 한다. 얻을 수 있는... 모든 도움이 필요하다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#135.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.src: If you want a ticket you'll have to pay me [{~} Emerald Block].
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#136.dst: 표를 원하면 [{~} 에메랄드 블록]을 내야 해.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#137.src: ...oh Lord, this must be why! D-Doguns?!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.src: Several rumours are suggested to be propagated amongst the population.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#138.dst: 주민들 사이에 몇 가지 소문을 퍼뜨릴 것을 제안한다.

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.src: He is consorting with the enemy! Axelus, they've tainted your soul!
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#139.dst: 그는 적과 내통하고 있다! Axelus, 그들이 네 영혼을 더럽혔구나!

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.src: They will...destroy us... If he reports...back to {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.dst: 그가... {p}에 보고하면... 그들이... 우리를 파멸시킬 거다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#140.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.src: "Any war could result in rioting in {p} and other established colonies."
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#141.dst: "어떤 전쟁이든 {p} 및 기타 기존 식민지에서 폭동을 불러올 수 있다."

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.src: We need to... prepare our defenses. We need all the... help we can get.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.dst: 우리는... 방어를 준비해야 한다. 얻을 수 있는... 모든 도움이 필요하다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#144.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.src: Wait... What are... you holding? Dragon bone...? Just what we need...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.dst: 잠깐... 손에 든 게... 뭐지? 용뼈...? 딱 필요하던 거다...
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#145.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.src: Human... if you promise to help us... I will grant you access to... our secret elevators... You can get up and... down the heights with those.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.dst: 인간... 우리를 돕겠다고 약속하면... 우리... 비밀 승강기를... 쓰게 해 주겠다... 그걸로 고원을... 오르내릴 수 있다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#146.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.src: Please return to... us when you reach level {~}. Take this... badge so the... others recognize you... as an ally. One of the elevators is... to the south.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.dst: 레벨 {~}이 되면... 우리에게 돌아와라. 이 휘장을... 가져가면 다른 이들이... 동맹으로... 알아볼 거다. 승강기 하나는... 남쪽에 있다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part I#147.speaker: Plario

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.src: The Royal Guards escort you and Axelus out of the palace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#000.dst: 왕실 근위병들이 당신과 Axelus를 궁전 밖으로 호송한다.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.src: Aval...would have us...leave the Heights... But we...would not survive...in large numbers.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#001.dst: Aval은... 우리더러... 고원을 떠나라 하지만... 우리는... 많은 수로는... 살아남지 못한다.

similar.text: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.src: Return to the Dogun village with a Dogun Badge of Trust and talk to the leader of the town
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#002.dst: Dogun Badge of Trust를 가지고 Dogun 마을로 돌아가 마을 지도자에게 말을 거세요

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.src: You are so young...to be fighting...a war so old. Still...it is appreciated.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.dst: 그렇게 어린데... 그토록 오래된... 전쟁을 치르다니. 그래도... 고맙게 여긴다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#003.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.src: Why...would we trust... Why...would we trust... you...of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#004.dst: 왜... 우리가 믿어야... 왜... 우리가 믿어야 하지... 하필... 드워프인 너를?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.src: The war...to you, it would be...ages ago. But...when one has lived for...{~} years...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.dst: 그 전쟁은... 너에게는... 까마득한 옛일이겠지. 하지만... {~}년을... 살아온 자에게는...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#006.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.src: Are you lost? Why would anyone ever come down here?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#007.dst: 길을 잃었어? 누가 대체 이 아래까지 내려오겠어?

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.src: We have... few options. We need to discuss... the few we have... available.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.dst: 우리에겐... 선택지가 적다. 남은... 몇 안 되는 길을... 논의해야 한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#008.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.src: I am sorry...to welcome you all...in such troubled times.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.dst: 미안하다... 이렇게 어려운 때에... 너희를 맞이하게 되어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#010.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.src: We thought... we could hide in safety... But there is... no place left to hide.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.dst: 우리는... 숨으면 안전할 줄... 알았다... 하지만 이제... 숨을 곳이 없다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#011.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.src: Aval... would have us... leave the Heights... But we... would not survive.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.dst: Aval은... 우리더러... 고원을 떠나라 한다... 하지만 우리는... 살아남지 못한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#012.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.src: We must...evacuate the settlement...immediately. They...are coming...again.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.dst: 우리는... 즉시... 정착지를 떠나야 한다. 그들이... 또... 오고 있다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#013.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#014.src: [New Quest Started: Dwarves and Doguns Part II]

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.src: If you can get up there you can help yourself to it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#015.dst: 저기까지 올라갈 수 있으면 마음대로 가져가.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.src: Please! You all know me, I'm not with the side of the government. Hear me out, we can fix this!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.dst: 제발! 다들 날 알잖아, 난 정부 편이 아니야. 내 말 좀 들어 봐, 바로잡을 수 있어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.src: Stop! I have been hiding from the Dwarves just as much as anyone here, they've been after me too!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.dst: 멈춰! 나도 여기 누구 못지않게 드워프들을 피해 숨어 왔어, 날 쫓고 있다고!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.src: Why... would we... trust you... of all Dwarves?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.dst: 왜... 우리가... 믿어야 하지... 하필 드워프인 너를?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#021.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.src: How...could you even help? They...won't listen to you.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.dst: 네가... 어떻게 돕겠다는 거냐? 그들은... 네 말을 듣지 않는다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#022.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.src: I know all the war strategies and weapon cache locations.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.dst: 전쟁 전략이랑 무기고 위치를 전부 알고 있어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.src: Treason... against your own kind...? How will you... manage this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#024.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.src: The human and I will sneak into the armoury and sabotage their equipment. Korzim will help you Doguns evacuate someplace safer.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.dst: 나와 이 인간은 무기고에 잠입해서 장비를 망가뜨릴게. Korzim이 Dogun들을 더 안전한 곳으로 대피시켜 줄 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#025.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.src: I am... yet wary of you... but we will... follow your plan... Dwarf. Korzim... lead us... to safety.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.dst: 아직... 너를 경계한다... 하지만 우리는... 네 계획을 따르겠다... 드워프. Korzim... 우리를... 안전한 곳으로.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#026.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.src: {u}, follow the southern road from {p}, towards the {p} entrance. I'll be waiting there for you near the armoury.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.dst: {u}, {p}에서 남쪽 길을 따라 {p} 입구 쪽으로 와. 무기고 근처에서 기다릴게.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#027.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.src: Shh! Get behind here, and look towards the armoury doors.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.dst: 쉿! 여기 뒤로 숨어서 무기고 문 쪽을 봐.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.src: We need to sneak in when they aren't looking, got it? But we need to be fast.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.dst: 저들이 안 볼 때 몰래 들어가야 해, 알겠지? 대신 빨라야 해.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#030.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.src: If they close that door, we'll only have one option left, and it's a huge risk. Those Dwarven gates are almost unbreakable.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.dst: 저 문이 닫히면 남는 방법은 하나뿐인데, 위험이 엄청 커. 드워프의 관문은 거의 부술 수 없거든.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#031.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.src: Alright boys, let's close this up and head to base B.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.dst: 좋아, 다들 여기 닫고 B 기지로 가자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#032.speaker: Rodoroc Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.src: Aaah! Charge them! HEY, STOP RIGHT THERE, SOLDIERS!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.dst: 아아! 덮쳐! 이봐, 거기 서, 병사들!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#034.src: Defeat the {p} Guards outside the armory.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.src: It's the traitor! Capture them, now! There's only one reason they would be near the armoury!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.dst: 배신자다! 당장 붙잡아! 무기고 근처에 올 이유는 하나뿐이야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#035.speaker: Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.src: Is that all of them? We're out of danger, at least, but they still shut the door, damn it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.dst: 다 처리했나? 일단 위험은 벗어났는데, 결국 문을 닫아 버렸어, 젠장!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.src: Gah, all that for nothing! You're not too banged up, are you?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.dst: 으, 헛수고였잖아! 너 많이 다치진 않았지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.src: Well, I said there's another way, but it's not a guarantee. Hurry, follow me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.dst: 다른 길이 있다고 했지만, 확실하진 않아. 서둘러, 따라와.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.src: Urgh, damn it. They almost never bother to close this door, and now of all times...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.dst: 으, 젠장. 이 문은 거의 안 닫는데, 하필 이럴 때...
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#039.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.src: There's nothing for it. They'll be sending reinforcements soon, we need a way through here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.dst: 어쩔 수 없지. 곧 지원군이 올 테니, 여길 뚫고 갈 방법이 필요해.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#040.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.src: Those black bricks look breakable...but that won't solve the door, will it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.dst: 저 검은 벽돌은 부술 수 있어 보이는데... 그래도 문은 못 넘잖아?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#041.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.src: Find a way to break through the black bricks outside the wooden door.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#042.dst: 나무 문 밖의 검은 벽돌을 부술 방법을 찾으세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.src: Alright, let's destroy these machines! You see the two cannons?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.dst: 좋아, 이 기계들을 부수자! 대포 두 대 보여?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#044.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.src: If you use rocks as ammo, you'll destroy the machine it's aiming at, but if you use tnt, it'll selfdestruct. Good luck
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.dst: 돌을 탄약으로 쓰면 조준한 기계를 부수고, TNT를 쓰면 대포가 자폭해. 행운을 빌어
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.src: Follow Axelus deeper into {p} and destroy the power source of the city, the {p} Power Core.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#046.dst: Axelus를 따라 {p} 깊숙이 들어가 도시의 동력원인 {p} Power Core를 파괴하세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.src: Nice work! That will slow them down. We're not done yet, we need to pay the king a visit. Let's head further into {p}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.dst: 잘했어! 이걸로 좀 늦춰지겠지. 아직 안 끝났어, 왕을 찾아가야 해. {p} 안쪽으로 더 가자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#047.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.src: Hurry! Through here, to the power core!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#048.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.src: This is a geothermal power core. If we can disrupt it, it should slow them down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.dst: 이건 지열 동력 핵이야. 이걸 망가뜨리면 저들을 늦출 수 있을 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#049.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.src: The hypocrites used Dogun magic to make this... It's lucky, honestly. I know how to work it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.dst: 위선자들이 Dogun 마법으로 이걸 만들었지... 솔직히 운이 좋아. 다루는 법을 알거든.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#050.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.src: ...hell, they already rallied?! That's the army!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.src: That sounds like an entire battalion!! How did they know I was going after this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.dst: 대대 하나가 통째로 온 소리야!! 내가 이걸 노리는 걸 어떻게 알았지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.src: Dogun magic is slow! Keep me defended, this'll take awhile!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.dst: Dogun 마법은 느려! 날 지켜 줘, 시간이 좀 걸려!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#053.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.src: Grr, this is harder than I thought!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#054.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.src: Ah! Don't let them get too close!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.dst: 아! 너무 가까이 못 오게 해!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#055.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.src: I hate that you're having to fight my people, but I wouldn't be asking for help if it weren't needed.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.dst: 내 동족과 싸우게 해서 마음이 안 좋아. 하지만 꼭 필요하지 않았다면 부탁 안 했어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#057.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.src: Hm...the slums should be behind this wall here. We'll lose them there.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.dst: 흠... 이 벽 뒤가 빈민가일 거야. 거기서 따돌리자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#058.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.src: The power's down, but...that cannon should do to get us through. You know how to operate it, right?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.dst: 동력은 끊겼지만... 저 대포면 뚫고 갈 수 있을 거야. 다룰 줄 알지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#059.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.src: Dwarvern society isn't as great as they make it out to be. The poorest are hidden away.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.dst: 드워프 사회는 떠드는 것만큼 대단하지 않아. 가장 가난한 이들은 숨겨져 있지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#061.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.src: The coalition has helped these people through some hard times, we can trust them.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.dst: 연합이 이 사람들이 힘들 때 도와줬어. 믿어도 돼.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#062.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.src: There's a reason I brought us here. The sewer system is connected to the royal palace. All the way to the kings bathroom.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.dst: 여기로 온 이유가 있어. 하수도가 왕궁과 연결돼 있거든. 왕의 욕실까지 쭉.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#063.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.src: We need to find a way to ignite this explosive. Can you take a look around?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.dst: 이 폭약에 불붙일 방법을 찾아야 해. 주변 좀 살펴봐 줄래?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#064.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#065.src: Find a way to enter the sewer system.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.src: If we can convince the king that it’s not worth the fight, he may back down.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.dst: 싸울 가치가 없다고 왕을 설득하면, 물러설지도 몰라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#066.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.src: I'm a little ashamed to admit I know my way round the sewers by now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.dst: 부끄럽지만 이젠 하수도 길을 훤히 알아.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#067.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.src: You have to understand.. The people truly think the Doguns are evil incarnate. But the king knows better.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.dst: 알아 둬.. 백성들은 Dogun이 진짜 악의 화신이라고 믿어. 하지만 왕은 진실을 알지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#068.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.src: Enter the Royal Palace through the sewer pipe and find the king.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#069.dst: 하수도 관을 통해 왕궁에 들어가 왕을 찾으세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.src: Don't let the guards catch you. Stay out of sight, got it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.dst: 경비병에게 들키지 마. 눈에 띄지 말고, 알겠지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#070.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.src: Sneak past the guards and talk to the Dwarven King.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#071.dst: 경비병을 몰래 지나쳐 드워프 왕에게 말을 거세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.src: I can't say I'm surprised, Axelus. Guards, let them be.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.dst: 놀랍다고는 못 하겠구나, Axelus. 경비병, 내버려 둬라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#072.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.src: You know why I'm here, father. We haven't got any more chances to stop this.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.dst: 제가 왜 왔는지 아시잖아요, 아버지. 이걸 막을 기회는 더 없어요.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#073.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.src: Axelus, you know why we have to maintain the lie. Think about the people, how they would react.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.dst: Axelus, 우리가 왜 거짓말을 지켜야 하는지 알 텐데. 백성들이 어떻게 반응할지 생각해 봐라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#074.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.src: We can not be responsible for the lies of our ancestors! This is ridiculous and you know it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.dst: 조상들의 거짓말을 우리가 책임질 순 없어요! 말도 안 되는 거, 아버지도 아시잖아요!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#075.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.src: Axelus, if the people found out, everything would descend to chaos. There would be riots, revolutions!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.dst: Axelus, 백성들이 알게 되면 모든 게 혼돈에 빠진다. 폭동이, 혁명이 일어날 거다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#076.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.src: If you hadn't turned traitor and gone gallivanting off with the Doguns, you would be in a better position to convince me.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.dst: 네가 배신자가 되어 Dogun들과 쏘다니지만 않았어도, 날 설득할 입장이 좀 더 나았을 거다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#077.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.src: As it is now, you are too little and too late. The war has already begun.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.dst: 지금 너는 힘도 없고 너무 늦었다. 전쟁은 이미 시작됐어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#078.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.src: The armoury that a certain someone decided to sabotage won't make any difference.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.dst: 누군가가 망가뜨리기로 한 그 무기고도 아무 차이를 못 만들 거다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#079.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.src: You will commit genocide so you don't have to face the consequences of your lies?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.dst: 거짓말의 대가를 피하려고 한 종족을 몰살하시겠다고요?
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#080.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.src: I will be the hero of our nation, and my name will forever be remembered as the King who brought peace.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.dst: 나는 나라의 영웅이 될 거다. 내 이름은 평화를 가져온 왕으로 영원히 기억되겠지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#081.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.src: I have nothing left to say to you. See yourselves out behind the throne. I'll let you use the trading tunnel to {p} in the southern caves, if you just step back and let me handle things.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.dst: 더 할 말은 없다. 왕좌 뒤로 알아서 나가라. 네가 물러서서 내게 맡긴다면, 남쪽 동굴에 있는 {p}행 교역 터널을 쓰게 해 주마.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#082.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.src: I'm not giving up on this. I'm going back in, I know he can be reasoned with!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.dst: 난 포기 안 해. 다시 들어갈 거야, 아버지도 설득할 수 있어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#084.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.src: Give this letter to Korzim in the Dogun village when you reach level {~}.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.dst: 레벨 {~}이 되면 Dogun 마을의 Korzim에게 이 편지를 전해 줘.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#085.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part II#086.src: I'm going to have one last talk with my father.
Dwarves and Doguns Part II#086.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.src: {u}...I take back my statement. They have already begun... There cannot be reasoning.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#000.dst: {u}... 내 말을 취소하마. 그들은 이미 시작했다... 설득할 여지는 없다.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.src: A door slamming open is heard in the distance...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#001.dst: 멀리서 문이 쾅 열리는 소리가 들린다...

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.src: Return to the Dogun Village with the letter and speak to Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#002.dst: 편지를 가지고 Dogun 마을로 돌아가 Korzim에게 말을 거세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.src: We...have an issue. A dire one... Where is...Axelus at a time...like this?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.dst: 우리에게... 문제가 생겼다. 심각한... 이런 때에... Axelus는 어디 있지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#003.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.src: Oh... From Axelus, then...? He could not find...a stone? That...does not bode well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.dst: 아... 그럼 Axelus가...? 돌도...못 찾았나? 그건... 좋지 않은 징조다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.src: He is trying to...reason with the Dwarven King? There is...no one else...then. You... You will have to...help.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.dst: 드워프 왕을... 설득하려 한다고? 그럼... 다른 이가... 없다. 네가... 네가... 도와야 한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.src: The chieftain is...desperate. He has enacted a...terrible plan. They are planning on summoning Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.dst: 족장은... 절박하다. 그가... 끔찍한 계획을 시작했다. 그들은 Garaheth를 소환하려 한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.src: If they succeed...we all die. Dwarves... Doguns... Possibly even Villagers...and then... Humans as well.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.dst: 그게 성공하면... 모두 죽는다. 드워프도... Dogun도... 어쩌면 주민도... 그리고... 인간도.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#008.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.src: Garaheth is a...horrible demon. We used to worship him...thousands of years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.dst: Garaheth는... 끔찍한 악마다. 수천 년 전...우리가 섬기던 존재다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#009.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.src: I only overheard parts... But enough to be certain. They are preparing...to the south. At a disused...ritual site.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.dst: 일부만 엿들었다... 하지만 확신하기엔 충분하다. 그들은...남쪽에서 준비 중이다. 버려진...의식 장소에서.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#010.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.src: Meet me there... Do not just attack. We may be able to...resolve it peacefully. I will wait...by the staircase.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.dst: 그곳에서 만나자... 바로 공격하진 마라. 평화롭게...해결할 수 있을지도. 계단 옆에서...기다리겠다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#011.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#012.src: Investigate the structure to the south.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.src: We shall take the east tower... Hide there...and watch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.dst: 우리는 동쪽 탑으로 간다... 거기 숨어서...지켜보자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#013.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.src: Interrupting...at this point will have...disastrous consequences. We must let them continue...and pray they fail.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.dst: 지금...끼어들면... 참혹한 결과가 온다. 계속하게 두고...실패하길 빌어야 한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#014.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.src: Reach into the darkness...and grasp the hand of Garaheth to purge the intruders...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.dst: 어둠 속으로 손을 뻗어라... Garaheth의 손을 잡고 침입자를 정화하라...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#015.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.src: This is a worst-case scenario... Meet me in {p}. We will talk more there...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.dst: 최악의 상황이다... {p}에서 만나자. 거기서 더 이야기하지...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#016.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#017.src: Travel to {p} and meet Korzim at the entrance. [{~},-{~}]

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.src: Hoho...! Over here...fine traveler! Join me at the gates!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#018.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.src: This dwarf voice is...horrible on my throat...but it is an effective disguise...is it not?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.dst: 드워프 목소리는...목이 너무 아프다... 하지만 효과적인 변장이다...그렇지 않나?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#019.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.src: We are headed to...a blacksmith in town. Follow me...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#020.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#021.src: Talk to the blacksmith in {p} at {~} {~} -{~}

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.src: ...Korzim...what in the name of all that is holy is that disguise?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#022.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.src: I'm flabbergasted you fooled anyone with that thing! How did you stop the beard from burning?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.dst: 그걸로 누굴 속였다니 기가 막히네! 수염이 타는 건 어떻게 막았어?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#023.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.src: But, erm...more importantly, who's the buck in the fancy armour there?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.dst: 근데, 음... 그보다, 저 번쩍이는 갑옷 입은 녀석은 누구야?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#024.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.src: An ally...of the coalition. No time...Edula. Doguns... summoning... Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.dst: 연합의...동맹이다. 시간이 없다...Edula. Dogun이... 소환한다... Garaheth를.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#025.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.src: So...so it's really down to that low, then. Burning your own house down to kill the rats.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.dst: 그래...정말 거기까지 몰렸구나. 쥐 잡으려고 자기 집을 태우다니.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#026.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.src: Good thing we've got this prepared. One fallout will prevent the next. Soldier, I've got a list of materials we need!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.dst: 준비해 둬서 다행이야. 이번 재앙이 다음 재앙을 막을 거야. 병사, 필요한 재료 목록이 있어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#027.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.src: You will need [{~} Fire Webs]. The Heatscar Spiders under the town make them, there's a cave right by the entrance arch.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.dst: [{~} Fire Webs]가 필요해. 마을 아래 Heatscar Spider가 만들어. 입구 아치 바로 옆에 동굴이 있어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#028.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.src: Then, [{~} Magmatic Crystals] from the {p} mines. I'd get them myself, but...I'm banned from there since the rubber mallet incident.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.dst: 다음은 {p} 광산의 [{~} Magmatic Crystals]. 직접 가고 싶지만... 고무망치 사건 이후로 출입 금지야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#029.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.src: Lastly, [{~} Crystallized Lava]. The closest source is in the lava lake just outside {p}. There's a protruding crater in the lake.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.dst: 마지막은 [{~} Crystallized Lava]. {p} 바로 밖 용암 호수가 제일 가까워. 호수에 솟은 분화구가 있어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#030.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.src: Bring back [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], and [{~} Crystallized lava].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#031.dst: [{~} Fire Webs], [{~} Magmatic Crystals], [{~} Crystallized lava]을(를) 가져오세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.src: The crystal formation... It is definitely here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#032.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.src: I will clear the lava... On my signal, move. And do not stop.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.dst: 내가 용암을 치우겠다... 신호하면 움직여라. 멈추지 마라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#033.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.src: Mhm, looks like everything's in order. Now, for a short explanation.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.dst: 음, 다 제대로 있네. 자, 간단히 설명할게.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#035.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.src: These materials go into crafting a special charm. It will allow you to resist demon fire.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.dst: 이 재료로 특별한 부적을 만들 거야. 악마의 불을 견딜 수 있게 해 주지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#036.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.src: We need to account for if they finish the summoning, so this'll help keep you safe if you end up having to square off with Garaheth.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.dst: 소환이 끝나 버릴 경우도 대비해야 해. 혹시 Garaheth와 맞붙게 되면 이게 널 지켜 줄 거야.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#037.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.src: You will need to craft it yourself, so its magic will bond to you. I've got a station just for it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.dst: 직접 만들어야 마법이 너와 이어져. 그걸 위한 작업대가 있어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#038.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.src: Right-click the crafting table in the back and put it together.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#039.speaker: Edula

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#040.src: Craft the amulet in the crafting table.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.src: We must... visit... Sanba... the enchanter.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.dst: 우리는... 마법 부여사... Sanba를... 찾아가야 한다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#041.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.src: Go to the enchanter and enchant the amulet.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#042.dst: 마법 부여사에게 가서 부적에 마법을 부여하세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.src: Erm...Korzim, what on earth are you doing here? It's not safe for you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.dst: 음...Korzim, 대체 여기서 뭐 해? 여긴 너한테 위험해!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#043.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.src: Wait, that amulet...oh no, really? Okay, I know what^s going on.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.dst: 잠깐, 그 부적... 설마, 진짜? 좋아, 무슨 일인지 알겠어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#044.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.src: We're going to need to give this a little extra kick if you're going to use this for what I think you are.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.dst: 내가 생각하는 용도로 쓸 거라면, 힘을 좀 더 실어 줘야겠어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#045.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.src: A pinch of fire scarab tail, splash of sulphur, exactly three ounces of old brimstone...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.dst: 불 풍뎅이 꼬리 한 줌, 유황 약간, 정확히 3온스의 묵은 유황석...!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#046.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.src: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.dst: Infunde hoc monile, alta intra monte. Magia!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#047.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.src: Meet me in the back, we can't talk out here. You never know who's listening...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.dst: 뒤쪽에서 만나. 밖에선 얘기 못 해. 누가 엿들을지 모르니까...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#048.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#049.src: Enter the storage room in the enchanter's house.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.src: Supposing you're here to help, Soldier. Garaheth's being summoned if you're getting this...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.dst: 도우러 온 거겠지, 병사. 이걸 들고 왔다면 Garaheth가 소환되고 있는 거야...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#050.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.src: Axelus prepped a contingency plan for this, but having to put it in action is surreal. Let me fill you in.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.dst: Axelus가 이런 때를 위해 비상 계획을 세워 뒀는데, 막상 쓰려니 실감이 안 나. 설명해 줄게.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#051.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.src: That dragon skeleton lying in the Heights belonged to an Ice Drake. Centuries ago, it was used in the Dogun wars.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.dst: 고원에 누워 있는 용 해골은 Ice Drake의 것이야. 수백 년 전 Dogun 전쟁에 쓰였지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#052.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.src: It had incredibly potent magic, particularly in its icy breath. The area it hit is still frozen to this day, and shows no signs of thaw.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.dst: 엄청나게 강한 마법을 지녔어, 특히 얼음 숨결이. 맞은 곳은 지금까지도 얼어 있고, 녹을 기미가 없어.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#053.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.src: According to Axelus' stories, its breath travelled through the tunnels and coalesced someplace deep within...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.dst: Axelus 얘기로는, 그 숨결이 터널을 타고 흘러 깊은 곳 어딘가에 뭉쳤대...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#054.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.src: ...becoming True Ice, a potent mixture of sheer cold and magic energy. That's what we will need to combat Garaheth.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.dst: ...그게 True Ice야. 극한의 냉기와 마력이 뒤섞인 거지. Garaheth와 싸우려면 그게 필요해.'
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#055.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garaheth in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.dst: [{~} True Ice]을(를) 가져오면 그걸 다룰 수 있는 지팡이를 만들 수 있어... Garaheth를 그 자리에 얼리는 거지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#056.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.src: If you bring me [{~} True Ice] I can make a staff capable of harnessing it...and we can freeze Garahath in its tracks.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.dst: [{~} 진정한 얼음]을 가져오면 그걸 다룰 수 있는 지팡이를 만들 수 있어... 그러면 Garahath를 그 자리에 얼려 버릴 수 있지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#057.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.src: Me and my husband will support the coalition as long as we live.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#058.dst: 나와 남편은 살아 있는 한 연합을 지지할 거야.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.src: Head north to the Freezing Heights and make your way to the top, now! We've got no time at all!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.dst: 북쪽 Freezing Heights로 가서 꼭대기까지 올라가, 당장! 시간이 전혀 없어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#059.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.src: Travel to the frozen heights and find {~} True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#060.dst: 얼어붙은 고원으로 가서 True Ice {~}개를 찾으세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.src: ... This... This used to be...a Dogun town. The Dwarves rendered it barren.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.dst: ... 여긴... 여긴 원래...Dogun 마을이었다. 드워프가 불모지로 만들었다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#061.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.src: They used the Drake... They chained it up and...forced it to attack. We had to kill it...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.dst: 그들은 Drake를 이용했다... 사슬로 묶어...공격하게 했다. 우린 그걸 죽여야 했다...
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#062.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.src: It... froze my town... as it died. I was there... {~} years ago.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.dst: 그것이... 죽으면서... 마을을 얼렸다. 나는 거기 있었다... {~}년 전에.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#063.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.src: I know the way... into the caves.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#064.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.src: The True Ice...is deep inside. I will struggle to...stay warm here.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.dst: True Ice는...깊숙이 있다. 여기선...몸을 데우기 힘들다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#065.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.src: I will try to run through...as quickly as possible. The ice is...painful.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#066.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.src: We must... move fast... or... we will both.... freeze.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.dst: 우리는... 빨리... 움직여야... 안 그러면... 둘 다.... 언다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#067.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.src: Maybe... I am... hotter than... I thought... do you.. Hear that?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.dst: 어쩌면... 내가... 생각보다... 뜨거운지도... 너.. 저 소리 들리나?
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#068.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.src: Oh no... I think... It's... COLLAPSING.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#069.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.src: My... feet are... solid... Keep... running.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#070.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.src: This is it... The thing that... Killed my families... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.dst: 이것이다... 내 가족을... 죽인 것... [{~} True Ice].
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#071.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.src: Return to the enchanter with the True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#072.dst: True Ice를 가지고 마법 부여사에게 돌아가세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.src: Impressive, you two. Must've been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.dst: 대단하네, 너희 둘. 그걸 얻기 힘들었겠어... Korzim에겐 두 배로 그랬겠지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#073.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.src: Impressive, you two. Must have been tough to get that...doubly so for Korzim.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.dst: 대단하네, 너희 둘. 그걸 얻기 힘들었겠어... Korzim에겐 두 배로 그랬겠지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#074.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.src: Here is the staff, {u}. Keep it safe, and don't you go dying on us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.dst: 지팡이 여기 있어, {u}. 잘 간수하고, 죽지나 마.
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#075.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.src: My husband and I will round up the coalition and get them to act now. We need to get going before-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.dst: 나랑 남편은 연합을 모아서 당장 움직이게 할게. 서둘러야 해, 그 전에-
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#076.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.src: ...that's the barracks door. That's the barracks door!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#077.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.src: Men! We have to meet for briefing on the surface, the war is due any hour now! Move faster!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.dst: 제군! 지상에서 작전 회의가 있다, 전쟁이 곧 시작된다! 서둘러라!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#078.speaker: Maex Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.src: They're already going?! We're out of time! Korzim is waiting for you just upstairs when you reach level {~}. Go train! NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.dst: 벌써 가는 거야?! 시간이 없어! 레벨 {~}이 되면 바로 위층에서 Korzim이 기다려. 가서 수련해! 당장!
Dwarves and Doguns Part III#079.speaker: Sanba

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...you have failed... We will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#000.dst: 조용. 드워프 애송이... 너는 실패했다... 우리는 조용히 사라지지 않는다. 깨어나라.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#001.src: {u}... Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.src: Return to Korzim on the second floor of the enchanter in {p} with the Amulet of Fire Resistance and the Staff of True Ice.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#003.dst: Amulet of Fire Resistance와 Staff of True Ice를 가지고 {p} 마법 부여사 집 2층의 Korzim에게 돌아가세요.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.src: ...Do you have...the staff? And the amulet...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#004.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.src: The war is starting... and Axelus... He has not returned.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.dst: 전쟁이 시작된다... 그리고 Axelus가... 돌아오지 않았다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#005.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.src: We can not go... Not without him. Find him... And bring him to the... Dogun village.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.dst: 우리는 못 간다... 그 없이는. 그를 찾아... Dogun 마을로... 데려와라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#006.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.src: I can not leave. The guard...it is on high alert. He was last at {p}...yes?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.dst: 나는 못 떠난다. 경비가...삼엄하다. 그가 마지막으로 있던 곳은 {p}...맞지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#007.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#008.src: Head to {p} and look for Axelus.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.src: The first group has already started their climb, let's hurry.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.dst: 첫 부대는 벌써 오르기 시작했어, 서두르자.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#009.speaker: Soldier

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.src: Hey! Everyone, the king has someone in the cage! It's been years since we used it!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.dst: 이봐! 다들, 왕이 우리에 누굴 가뒀어! 그거 쓴 지 몇 년 만이야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#010.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.src: Wait, that's Axelus up there!! The king locked up his son?! What in the world?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.dst: 잠깐, 저 위에 있는 거 Axelus잖아!! 왕이 아들을 가뒀다고?! 이게 무슨 일이야?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#011.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.src: I heard he was consorting with demons, but that can't possibly be true, can it?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.dst: 악마랑 어울렸다던데, 그게 사실일 리가 없잖아, 그렇지?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#012.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.src: For the last time, they are not demons!! Gods, I've been telling you this whole time! Not even my father will listen to reason!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.dst: 마지막으로 말하는데, 그들은 악마가 아니야!! 세상에, 내내 말했잖아! 아버지조차 이성적인 말을 안 들어!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#013.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.src: If I don't get freed we're doomed, you hear me?! We won't survive another war! As your prince I demand to be freed!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.dst: 내가 안 풀려나면 우린 끝이야, 알아?! 전쟁 또 나면 못 버텨! 너희 왕자로서 명한다, 풀어 줘!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#014.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.src: Listen, the statues are climbable and there's a control panel for the lava siphons near them! Now help me so we all don't die!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.dst: 잘 들어, 동상은 올라갈 수 있고 그 근처에 용암 흡입관 제어판이 있어! 다 같이 죽기 싫으면 도와줘!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#015.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#016.src: Free Axelus and escape the city.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.src: Wait, that human just defaced the hero's monument!! Are they working with the demons too?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.dst: 잠깐, 저 인간이 방금 영웅 기념비를 훼손했어!! 저놈도 악마랑 한패야?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#017.speaker: Rodoroc Citizen

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.src: {u}! I didn't think you'd be back, but we need to leave, now! Meet me outside!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.dst: {u}! 돌아올 줄 몰랐는데, 지금 당장 떠나야 해! 밖에서 만나!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#018.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.src: {u}! Over here, to the right! By the cannon! I'm commandeering this thing.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.dst: {u}! 여기, 오른쪽! 대포 옆이야! 이거 내가 징발할게.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#019.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.src: We need to get up to the Doguns before the Dwarves begin their assault, or before the Doguns take their last resort.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.dst: 드워프가 공격을 시작하기 전에, 아니면 Dogun이 최후의 수단을 쓰기 전에 올라가야 해.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#020.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.src: Get in the cannon, now! You've got your armour, you might end up charred and covered in soot but you'll be fine!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.dst: 대포에 들어가, 당장! 갑옷 있잖아, 새까맣게 그을리고 검댕투성이가 돼도 괜찮을 거야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#021.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.src: Don't tell anyone we shot ourselves out of a cannon, I'll never live it down. Now come on, to the Dogun village, hurry!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.dst: 대포로 날아갔다고 아무한테도 말하지 마, 평생 놀림받을 거야. 자, Dogun 마을로, 서둘러!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#022.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.src: If the Doguns are taking their last resort and summoning Garaheth, then we've got two sides to stop at once...basically, the odds are astronomically against us.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.dst: Dogun이 최후의 수단으로 Garaheth를 소환한다면, 두 쪽을 동시에 막아야 해... 한마디로 승산이 천문학적으로 낮다는 거지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#023.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.src: That means you do what you need to do, no matter what. Understood? If we can stop this madness then the casualties won't have died for nothing! Now move!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.dst: 그러니 무슨 일이 있어도 해야 할 일을 해. 알겠어? 이 광기를 멈추면 희생자들의 죽음이 헛되지 않을 거야! 가!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#024.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#025.src: Reach the portal and stop Garaheth.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#027.src: Quiet. Dwarven whelp...we will not go quietly. AWAKEN.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#027.dst: 조용. 드워프 애송이... 우리는 조용히 사라지지 않는다. 깨어나라.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#027.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.src: I can't believe this... That bone was part of the ritual?! Agh, how could we have been so STUPID! You're all lucky we prepared for this!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.dst: 말도 안 돼... 그 뼈가 의식의 일부였다고?! 아, 우리가 어떻게 그렇게 멍청했지! 우리가 대비해 둔 걸 다행으로 알아!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#028.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.src: You need to get inside him. He's still chained! The amulet will protect you from the heat! Freeze him from the inside out!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.dst: 그 몸속으로 들어가야 해. 아직 사슬에 묶여 있어! 부적이 열기를 막아 줄 거야! 안에서부터 얼려 버려!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#029.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#031.src: Find all {~} organs and destroy them.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#032.src: Leave Garaheth and exit his realm.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.src: EVERYONE, STOP THIS! RIGHT NOW!! IT'S OVER!!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#033.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.src: Open your eyes for once in your lives!! You see that?! Behind me! THAT was going to be the end result!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.dst: 평생 한 번이라도 눈 좀 떠!! 보여?! 내 뒤! 저게 결말이 될 뻔했다고!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#034.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.src: Garaheth would have killed every one of us, damn it! Are you that short-sighted that you can't see this?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.dst: Garaheth는 우리를 전부 죽였을 거야, 젠장! 이것도 못 볼 만큼 근시안이야?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#035.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.src: Everyone here is to blame, except the human who helped stop this! The Doguns were already exiled, they wouldn't have hurt anyone!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.dst: 여기 있는 모두의 잘못이야, 이걸 막은 저 인간만 빼고! Dogun은 이미 추방됐어, 아무도 해치지 않았을 거라고!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#036.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.src: But we couldn't just let ANYTHING be! You always need more glory, more, more, MORE! Don't you, Draani? I'm ashamed to be your lineage!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.dst: 그런데 우린 뭐 하나 그냥 두질 못했지! 늘 더 많은 영광을, 더, 더, 더! 그렇죠, Draani? 당신 핏줄인 게 부끄러워요!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#037.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.src: And you, Doguns! I...I pitied you. You were wronged, but you resort to this? You'd doom the world over to spite the Dwarves? Is that it?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.dst: 그리고 너희, Dogun! 난... 난 너희를 동정했어. 억울했겠지만, 이런 수를 써? 드워프에게 앙갚음하려고 세상을 망쳐? 그런 거야?!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#038.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.src: Whelp. You do not understand. To be persecuted...and see your people tortured...hunted.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.dst: 애송이. 너는 모른다. 박해받고...동족이 고문당하고...사냥당하는 것을.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#039.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.src: You all deserve it! You attacked our ancestors for sport! Eye for an eye, have you heard of it? It's only fair!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.dst: 너희는 당해도 싸! 재미로 우리 조상들을 공격했잖아! 눈에는 눈, 들어 봤어? 공평한 거지!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#040.speaker: Dwarven Commander

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.src: Imbeciles...your stories are not true. We... We lived through the war. You took everything...and suffered none.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.dst: 멍청이들...너희 이야기는 거짓이다. 우리는... 우리는 그 전쟁을 겪었다. 너희는 모든 걸 빼앗고...아무 고통도 없었다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#041.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.src: I've been trying to tell BOTH of you that the monarchy has been spreading lies for centuries! One bad king doesn't mean the whole species is a loss!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.dst: 왕실이 수백 년간 거짓을 퍼뜨렸다고 양쪽 다에 계속 말했잖아! 못된 왕 하나 때문에 종족 전체가 글러 먹은 건 아니야!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#042.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.src: Shut your mouth. Even now...you trample on the bones of our god... You have taken everything from us...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.dst: 입 다물어라. 지금도...너희는 우리 신의 뼈를 짓밟고 있다... 우리에게서 모든 걸 빼앗았다...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#043.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.src: This earth is stained by you. We...we shall burn you...and scatter your ash to the wind.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.dst: 이 땅은 너희로 더럽혀졌다. 우리는...너희를 불태워...그 재를 바람에 흩뿌리겠다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#044.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.src: DON'T YOU DARE! STOP, RIGHT NOW!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#045.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.src: You would... You would kill a savior...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#048.speaker: Korzim

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.src: No, no! No no no, this can't be happening! H-Hang on, we'll save you, I...I'll do something, I...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.dst: 안 돼, 안 돼! 안 돼 안 돼, 이럴 순 없어! 버, 버텨라, 구해 주마, 내가...내가 뭐든 하마, 내가...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#049.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.src: Y-You DEMONS! MONSTERS! I'll avenge you, Axelus, j-just give me time-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.dst: 이, 이 악마들! 괴물들! 원수를 갚아 주마, Axelus, 조, 조금만 시간을-
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#050.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.src: AGH, SHUT UP! SHUT...ack... Q-Quiet. Listen to one damn word from my mouth, Draani... For once in your miserable life
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.dst: 으악, 닥쳐요! 닥...컥... 조, 조용히. 제 말 한마디만 들어요, Draani... 그 비참한 인생에서 한 번만
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#051.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.src: Tell. The. TRUTH!! G-gaagh...you know that's th...the only way to stop this. Swallow your pride, you...old fool...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.dst: 진실을. 말. 해요!! 크, 크윽...그게... 이걸 멈출 유일한 길이란 거 알잖아요. 자존심 좀 버려요, 이...늙은 바보...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#052.speaker: Axelus

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.src: I...I... Axelus... He...he called me Draani...why did...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.dst: 나...나는... Axelus... 그 애가...날 Draani라고 불렀어...어째서...?
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#053.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.src: Men, stand down. This... This war is over! I will not have one more life lost! Touch the Doguns and I'll personally behead you!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.dst: 모두, 무기를 내려라. 이... 이 전쟁은 끝났다! 더는 한 명도 잃지 않겠다! Dogun을 건드리면 내가 직접 목을 치겠다!
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#054.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.src: Chief, I...I ask of you but an hour of your time. If you are willing to negotiate...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.dst: 족장, 나...나는 한 시간만 내어 주길 청하오. 협상할 뜻이 있다면...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#055.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#056.src: Speak with the King of {p} and the Dogun Chieftain.

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.src: Ah, you've arrived. I...actually remember you from earlier. So you and...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.dst: 아, 왔구먼. 나...실은 전에 본 자네를 기억하네. 그러니까 자네와...
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#057.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.src: ...you knew my son. Were helping him try to put an end to this, before everything was too far gone. Heh...apologies, for that.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.dst: ...자네는 내 아들을 알았지. 모든 게 손쓸 수 없게 되기 전에 끝내려는 그 애를 도왔고. 허...그 일은 미안하네.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#059.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.src: Paku and I have had a long discussion about the wisdom of youth over the old. You all were right. I needed to swallow my pride.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.dst: Paku와 나는 늙은이보다 젊은이가 현명하다는 걸 두고 오래 이야기했네. 자네들이 옳았어. 내가 자존심을 버려야 했지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#060.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.src: We agreed upon a peace treaty... A new city... The Dwarves will aid us in building it.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.dst: 우리는 평화 조약에...합의했다... 새로운 도시를... 드워프가 짓는 걸 도울 것이다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#061.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.src: All hostilities...will end. My people will...be free to roam the caverns. It has been...too long.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.dst: 모든 적대는...끝난다. 내 동족은...동굴을 자유롭게 누빌 것이다. 너무...오래 걸렸다.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#062.speaker: Dogun Chieftain

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.src: And the entombed Doguns at Courag will be reconstituted, as well, supposing that is a possibility.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.dst: 그리고 Courag에 봉인된 Dogun들도, 가능하다면 되살려 낼 걸세.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#063.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.src: Every king, since my so-far-great grandfather, Draani Thunderwill, has battled with their morality over the lies told to my people.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.dst: 먼 선조이신 Draani Thunderwill 이래 모든 왕이 백성에게 한 거짓말을 두고 양심과 싸워 왔네.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#064.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.src: It ends here, with the name Draani VIII. It will take time, but the bloodshed has proven things must begin to change now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.dst: 그건 Draani 8세의 이름으로 여기서 끝나네. 시간은 걸리겠지만, 흘린 피가 이제 변해야 한다는 걸 증명했지.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#065.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.src: You and the coalition have saved the Heights, and Gavel. In {p}, you will find a stall to trade valuable minerals. You will be granted special Dwarven privileges to purchase it now.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.dst: 자네와 연합이 고원과 Gavel을 구했네. {p}에 가면 귀한 광물을 거래하는 노점이 있을 걸세. 이제 그걸 살 수 있는 드워프 특권을 자네에게 주겠네.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#066.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.src: Though that is...almost certainly not enough a reward for everything you have done...sincerely. Thank you, Wynn soldier.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.dst: 물론 그건...자네가 해 준 모든 일에 대한 보상으로는 턱없이 부족하겠지만...진심일세. 고맙네, Wynn의 병사.
Dwarves and Doguns Part IV#067.speaker: King of Rodoroc

Dwelling Walls#000.src: I left a very precious journal inside of this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
Dwelling Walls#000.dst: 이 저택, 벽 안의 지옥에 아주 소중한 일지를 두고 왔어요. 증조할아버지 거였죠!

Dwelling Walls#002.src: Let's see here... mother's old vase... check!
Dwelling Walls#002.dst: 어디 보자... 어머니의 낡은 꽃병... 확인!
Dwelling Walls#002.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#003.src: Dining room table... got it here, check!
Dwelling Walls#003.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#004.src: Finally, the journal. It's out here somewhere, I assume. I'll look around.
Dwelling Walls#004.dst: 마지막으로 일지. 이 근처 어딘가 있겠죠. 좀 찾아볼게요.
Dwelling Walls#004.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#006.src: Hold on, what? The journal! I must have forgotten it inside the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#006.dst: 잠깐, 뭐라고? 일지! 저택 안에 두고 온 게 분명해요!
Dwelling Walls#006.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#007.src: You there! Would you mind doing me a deed?
Dwelling Walls#007.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#008.src: I left a very precious journal inside this mansion, a hell within walls. It was my great grandfather's!
Dwelling Walls#008.dst: 이 저택, 벽 안의 지옥에 아주 소중한 일지를 두고 왔어요. 증조할아버지 거였죠!
Dwelling Walls#008.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#009.src: The mansion was designed by a Corkian architect, and I was scammed into buying it.
Dwelling Walls#009.dst: 저택은 Corkus 건축가가 설계했는데, 전 사기당해서 샀어요.
Dwelling Walls#009.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#010.src: If you step inside the mansion just for a few moments, you'll understand why the sellers had to trick someone into investing in their god forsaken real estate!
Dwelling Walls#010.dst: 저택에 잠깐만 들어가 보면, 판매자들이 왜 누굴 속여서라도 이 몹쓸 부동산을 떠넘겨야 했는지 알 거예요!
Dwelling Walls#010.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#011.src: Navigating from room to room is nearly impossible, the rooms move around. I've only been in the mansion for a week and I'm already packing my bags and moving to {p}.
Dwelling Walls#011.dst: 방에서 방으로 가는 게 거의 불가능해요, 방이 움직이거든요. 들어온 지 일주일인데 벌써 짐 싸서 {p}(으)로 이사 가요.
Dwelling Walls#011.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#013.src: Navigate the mansion to the room holding the journal
Dwelling Walls#013.dst: 저택을 헤쳐 나가 일지가 있는 방으로 가세요

Dwelling Walls#015.src: The journal! You outsmarted the mansion!
Dwelling Walls#015.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#016.src: I must thank you, that journal was priceless to my family.
Dwelling Walls#016.dst: 정말 고마워요, 그 일지는 우리 가족에게 값을 매길 수 없어요.
Dwelling Walls#016.speaker: Leucsaa

Dwelling Walls#017.src: Let this be a life lesson to you. Never buy a house from a Corkian architect.
Dwelling Walls#017.dst: 이걸 인생 교훈으로 삼아요. Corkus 건축가한테선 절대 집 사지 마세요.
Dwelling Walls#017.speaker: Leucsaa

Echoes of Change#000.src: Third Division - Guarding Sovereign Soosu's mansion.

Echoes of Change#003.src: The painting has a note attached to it.

Echoes of Change#004.src: Attend the meeting to prepare for the plan in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#004.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Steel Feather에서 작전 준비 회의에 참석하세요.

Echoes of Change#006.src: I trust everyone has taken the time to process last night's announcement? I will let Syndra take over shortly, but first, I would like to thank each and every one of you.
Echoes of Change#006.dst: 다들 어젯밤 발표를 충분히 곱씹어 보셨으리라 믿어요. 곧 Syndra에게 넘기겠지만, 먼저 한 분 한 분께 감사드리고 싶군요.
Echoes of Change#006.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#007.src: I won't mince words. This is dangerous work. What we are planning puts us at great risk. But this is what it takes to change Fruma, to put an end to the crown's oppression!
Echoes of Change#007.dst: 돌려 말하지 않겠습니다. 이건 위험한 일이에요. 우리 계획은 큰 위험을 안고 있죠. 하지만 Fruma를 바꾸고 왕실의 압제를 끝내려면 이 길뿐입니다!
Echoes of Change#007.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#008.src: We will kill a God! And we will all be free. Now, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#008.dst: 우리는 신을 죽일 겁니다! 그리고 모두 자유로워지겠죠. 자, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#008.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#009.src: Thank you, Quill. To begin, allow me to give each group their assignment.
Echoes of Change#009.dst: 고마워, Quill. 먼저 각 조에 임무를 나눠 줄게.
Echoes of Change#009.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#010.src: Mora and Yuman, you will be infiltrating the guards' outpost in {p} to retrieve their schedules. Get in, note down the formations, and get out.
Echoes of Change#010.dst: Mora와 Yuman, 너희는 {p}의 경비 초소에 잠입해서 근무표를 가져와. 들어가서 배치를 적고, 바로 나오는 거야.
Echoes of Change#010.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#011.src: Mora, you're familiar with military structure, and Yuman knows his way around {p}. I expect you two should be able to make it work.
Echoes of Change#011.dst: Mora는 군 조직을 잘 알고, Yuman은 {p} 지리에 밝지. 둘이면 해낼 수 있을 거라 믿어.
Echoes of Change#011.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#013.src: Understood. However, I have a few concerns with the overall plans... I'll speak with you later.
Echoes of Change#013.dst: 알겠다. 다만 전체 계획에 몇 가지 걱정이 있어... 나중에 따로 이야기하지.
Echoes of Change#013.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#014.src: Yusanu and Sui, you'll be constructing explosives that we can use as distractions during the festival to draw guards away from the main stage.
Echoes of Change#014.dst: Yusanu와 Sui, 너희는 폭발물을 만들어 줘. 축제 때 소동을 일으켜서 경비병을 본무대에서 떼어 놓는 데 쓸 거야.
Echoes of Change#014.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#015.src: I trust Yusanu knows what he's doing, so Sui, you'll be acting as an assistant.
Echoes of Change#015.dst: Yusanu는 잘 알아서 할 테니, Sui는 조수 역할을 맡아 줘.
Echoes of Change#015.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#017.src: Works for me. I might already have some blueprints lying around somewhere...
Echoes of Change#017.dst: 난 좋아. 어디 설계도도 좀 굴러다닐 것 같은데...
Echoes of Change#017.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#018.src: Zeph and Rex, I want you to scout the city rooftops for potential spots where Rex and Yulie can provide aerial support... in case it's necessary.
Echoes of Change#018.dst: Zeph와 Rex, 도시 옥상을 정찰해서 Rex와 Yulie가 공중 지원할 만한 자리를 찾아 줘... 혹시 필요할 때를 대비해서.
Echoes of Change#018.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#019.src: Yeah, I c- c- can do that.
Echoes of Change#019.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#021.src: Quill and Yulie, you two know your way around the city. I'll need you to scout out potential escape routes from the city... again, in case things go badly.
Echoes of Change#021.dst: Quill과 Yulie, 둘은 도시를 잘 알지. 도시에서 빠져나갈 탈출로를 찾아 줘... 이것도, 일이 틀어질 때를 대비해서.
Echoes of Change#021.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#022.src: Ah, that should be a breeze.
Echoes of Change#022.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#023.src: ...yes. I think I have a few places in mind already.
Echoes of Change#023.dst: ...응. 이미 몇 군데 생각해 둔 곳이 있어.
Echoes of Change#023.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#024.src: Finally. {u}, I want you to be adaptable. Help out wherever it's needed - I'm sure your skills will come in handy.
Echoes of Change#024.dst: 마지막으로. {u}, 넌 유연하게 움직여 줘. 필요한 곳 어디든 도와줘. 네 실력이라면 분명 쓸모가 있을 거야.
Echoes of Change#024.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#025.src: Hey, if you're helping out wherever, you should come with me and Mora! Guard positions would be handy to know before finding escape routes.
Echoes of Change#025.dst: 야, 어디든 돕는다면 나랑 Mora랑 같이 가자! 탈출로를 찾기 전에 경비 위치부터 알아 두면 좋잖아!
Echoes of Change#025.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#026.src: I was about to suggest the same thing. Then let us adjourn this meeting. Good luck, everyone.
Echoes of Change#026.dst: 나도 같은 제안을 하려던 참이야. 그럼 회의는 여기까지. 다들 행운을 빌어.
Echoes of Change#026.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#027.src: Hum. {u} and Yuman, let us go our plans then.
Echoes of Change#027.dst: 흠. {u}, Yuman, 그럼 우리 계획을 논의하지.
Echoes of Change#027.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#028.src: Meet up with Mora and Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#029.src: Alright, guys! So, any plans? What're we cooking with here?
Echoes of Change#029.dst: 좋아, 다들! 그래서 계획은? 우리 뭘로 요리할 건데?
Echoes of Change#029.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#031.src: Hey, man, everything good? I'm uh, not that horrible to work with, am I? Haha.
Echoes of Change#031.dst: 야, 괜찮아? 나 뭐, 같이 일하기 그렇게 최악은 아니지? 하하.
Echoes of Change#031.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#032.src: Ah! My apologies. No, it is not you... I simply do not like Syndra's plan.
Echoes of Change#032.dst: 아! 미안하다. 아니, 네 탓이 아니야... Syndra의 계획이 마음에 안 들 뿐이다.
Echoes of Change#032.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#033.src: You must understand, I would trust her with my life... but that is precisely the issue. She will do anything to avoid putting us in danger.
Echoes of Change#033.dst: 이해해 줘. 난 그녀에게 목숨도 맡길 수 있어... 하지만 바로 그게 문제다. 그녀는 우리를 위험에 빠뜨리지 않으려고 뭐든 할 거야.
Echoes of Change#033.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#034.src: She treats us as her own children, but she is only a decade older than I am! She would put herself through all the suffering in the world, if only to avoid letting us help where it is most needed!
Echoes of Change#034.dst: 그녀는 우리를 자기 자식처럼 대하지만, 나보다 겨우 열 살 많을 뿐이야! 가장 필요한 곳에서 우리가 돕지 못하게 하려고 세상의 온갖 고통을 혼자 짊어질 사람이지!
Echoes of Change#034.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#035.src: She is willing to take the fall if the plan goes awry. But, this time... this time, I will not back off. I am not allowing her to put herself through that danger alone.
Echoes of Change#035.dst: 계획이 틀어지면 그녀는 혼자 책임질 각오야. 하지만 이번에는... 이번에는 물러서지 않겠다. 그녀 혼자 그 위험을 감수하게 두지 않아.
Echoes of Change#035.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#036.src: Yeesh. Didn't think you guys were that messy! I think I get it though.
Echoes of Change#036.dst: 으. 너희가 그렇게 복잡한 사이인 줄 몰랐네! 그래도 무슨 말인지 알 것 같아.
Echoes of Change#036.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#037.src: My bros... they mean well, yeah, but they never ask for help. They're always trying to do everything themselves, and... and it drives me nuts!
Echoes of Change#037.dst: 우리 형들도... 좋은 뜻인 건 알아. 근데 절대 도움을 안 청해. 맨날 전부 혼자 하려고 하고... 그게 진짜 미치겠어!
Echoes of Change#037.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#038.src: Like, man, just let me do something!! Anything!! It's so frustrating.
Echoes of Change#038.dst: 아니, 나도 뭐 좀 하게 해 달라고!! 아무거나!! 진짜 답답해.
Echoes of Change#038.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#039.src: Ha! I did not think we had this in common. Well then... perhaps we can both prove ourselves to our families, eh?
Echoes of Change#039.dst: 하! 우리한테 이런 공통점이 있을 줄은. 그렇다면... 우리 둘 다 가족에게 증명해 보일 수 있겠지?
Echoes of Change#039.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#040.src: Yeah!! I like the sound of that!!
Echoes of Change#040.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#041.src: Okay, well, I know where the guards' outpost is in {p}. Let's just go to it and take it from there!
Echoes of Change#041.dst: 좋아, 그럼, {p}의 경비 초소 위치는 내가 알아. 일단 가 보고 거기서 생각하자!
Echoes of Change#041.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#042.src: Ha, settle down a little. I think we need to be a bit more prepared than that. But, yes, time is of the essence, so let us head there first. I will attempt to think of a plan on the way.
Echoes of Change#042.dst: 하, 좀 진정해. 그보다는 준비를 더 해야 할 것 같다. 하지만, 그래, 시간이 없으니 먼저 그리로 가자. 가는 길에 계획을 생각해 보지.
Echoes of Change#042.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#043.src: Whatever, man! Too much planning often spoils the results... but, sure! Let's meet outside the tallest building in {p}. First tunnel to the right leads there!
Echoes of Change#043.dst: 아무렴 어때! 계획이 너무 많으면 오히려 일을 망친다고... 뭐, 좋아! {p}에서 제일 높은 건물 밖에서 만나자. 오른쪽 첫 번째 터널로 가면 돼!
Echoes of Change#043.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#044.src: Meet up with Yuman and Mora in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#046.src: Good grief, this town's a mess. How does anyone live here?
Echoes of Change#046.dst: 맙소사, 이 동네 엉망이군. 여기서 어떻게 사는 거지?
Echoes of Change#046.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#047.src: Eh, ya get used to it. Here, follow me.
Echoes of Change#047.dst: 에, 살다 보면 익숙해져. 자, 따라와.
Echoes of Change#047.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#048.src: See, {p} utilizes all the space it has... stacking things atop each other. For example, this so-called "skyscraper" is mainly an apartment building!
