Echoes of Change#500.dst: 셋이서 사람들을 진정시키고, 우리에게 맞서는 병사들을 물리치는 걸 도와줘.
Echoes of Change#500.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#501.src: Quill will remain here with the rest of the Steel Feather, and will prepare for the aftermath.
Echoes of Change#501.dst: Quill은 Steel Feather의 나머지 사람들과 여기 남아 뒷일을 준비할 거야.
Echoes of Change#501.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#502.src: I'm no good in a fight, I fear. I'd only slow you down on the battlefield.
Echoes of Change#502.dst: 난 싸움엔 영 소질이 없어서요. 전장에선 발목만 잡을 거예요.
Echoes of Change#502.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#503.src: Mora will be lurking in the crowd, and will help me if necessary.
Echoes of Change#503.dst: Mora는 군중 속에 숨어 있다가 필요하면 날 도와줄 거야.
Echoes of Change#503.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#504.src: Finally... I'll be stationed on a building above Her Majesty. When the time is right, I will strike her down!
Echoes of Change#504.dst: 마지막으로... 난 여왕 폐하 위쪽 건물에 자리 잡을 거야. 때가 되면 폐하를 쓰러뜨리겠어!
Echoes of Change#504.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#505.src: I hope you're all ready to make history. This won't be easy... but I believe we can pull through.
Echoes of Change#505.dst: 다들 역사를 만들 준비가 됐길 바라. 쉽진 않겠지만... 우린 해낼 수 있다고 믿어.
Echoes of Change#505.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#506.src: I cannot ensure everyone's safety. It is likely civilians will be injured, and some of us may be hurt as well... or... worse.
Echoes of Change#506.dst: 모두의 안전은 장담 못 해. 민간인이 다칠 수도 있고, 우리 중에도 다치거나... 혹은... 더 나쁜 일이 생길 수 있어.
Echoes of Change#506.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#508.src: Resistance and revolution comes at a cost. We need to accept that. I... pray it will not come to that, though.
Echoes of Change#508.dst: 저항과 혁명엔 대가가 따라. 그걸 받아들여야 해. 그래도... 그렇게까진 안 되길 기도할게.
Echoes of Change#508.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#509.src: Some of you are scared, nervous. You're right to be. This is dangerous, and risky... but know that I am so, so proud of each and every one of you here today.
Echoes of Change#509.dst: 무섭고 긴장되는 사람도 있을 거야. 당연해. 위험하고 무모한 일이니까... 하지만 오늘 여기 있는 모두가 정말, 정말 자랑스러워.
Echoes of Change#509.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#510.src: We will change Fruma for the better! We will tear down the crown's tyrannical rule, and we will free the people!!
Echoes of Change#510.dst: 우리는 Fruma를 더 나은 곳으로 바꿀 거야! 왕실의 폭정을 무너뜨리고 백성을 해방할 거야!!
Echoes of Change#510.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#511.src: Alright! Let us get to work! Find your teams, and meet up at your designated positions at the festival.
Echoes of Change#511.dst: 좋아! 일하러 가자! 각자 팀을 찾아서 축제의 지정된 위치에서 만나.
Echoes of Change#511.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#513.src: Meet up with your group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss before heading to the festival.
Echoes of Change#513.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 조원들과 만나 축제에 가기 전에 논의하세요.

Echoes of Change#515.src: Yeah. Got an extra battery as well.
Echoes of Change#515.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#516.src: Perfect. I left charges for you at each spot so when we get to {p} we can pick our positions.
Echoes of Change#516.dst: 좋아. 각 자리에 충전탄을 놔뒀으니 {p}에 도착하면 각자 자리를 고르면 돼.
Echoes of Change#516.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#520.src: Rex, I've never seen a better shot. You won't miss.
Echoes of Change#520.dst: Rex, 너보다 나은 사수는 본 적 없어. 안 빗나갈 거야.
Echoes of Change#520.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#521.src: Thank you, Yulie. I wish you the best of luck out there.
Echoes of Change#521.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#524.src: Syndra m- marked out some good spots for us, huh?
Echoes of Change#524.dst: Syndra가 좋은 자리를 표, 표시해 줬지?
Echoes of Change#524.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#525.src: She did. I'll make sure we stay out of danger! I know my way around those alleyways.
Echoes of Change#525.dst: 그러게. 우리가 위험에 안 빠지게 할게! 그 골목들은 내가 잘 알아.
Echoes of Change#525.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#526.src: Thank you... But I d- don't need a babysitter! I'll be f- fine.
Echoes of Change#526.dst: 고마워... 하지만 보, 보모는 필요 없어! 난 괜, 괜찮을 거야.
Echoes of Change#526.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#527.src: I know you can handle yourself. But seriously, Zeph. I'm not playing around.
Echoes of Change#527.dst: 네가 알아서 잘하는 거 알아. 근데 진지하게, Zeph. 장난 아니야.
Echoes of Change#527.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#528.src: I need you to be safe. We can't afford to get caught here.
Echoes of Change#528.dst: 네가 무사해야 해. 여기서 잡히면 안 되니까.
Echoes of Change#528.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#529.src: I've never s- seen you this serious before...
Echoes of Change#529.dst: 네가 이렇게 진지한 건 처, 처음 봐...
Echoes of Change#529.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#530.src: I'm just nervous. I've never done anything like this before.
Echoes of Change#530.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#531.src: Good thing I h- have then, p- pr- princess.
Echoes of Change#531.dst: 그럼 내가 해 봐서 다행이네, 고, 공주님.
Echoes of Change#531.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#532.src: Hi... are you two, um, ready?
Echoes of Change#532.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#533.src: I... ha, I'm not sure! It's... a lot, isn't it?
Echoes of Change#533.dst: 나... 하, 모르겠어! 이거... 좀 벅차지 않아?
Echoes of Change#533.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#534.src: I've been worrying about this new Sovereign... Tasim. {u}, I know you... know him.
Echoes of Change#534.dst: 새 군주가 계속 신경 쓰여... Tasim. {u}, 네가... 그를 안다는 거 알아.
Echoes of Change#534.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#535.src: It's... it's like Rex said the other day. The Sovereigns aren't our friends. If he joined the crown, then... I'm not sure we can trust him to do the right thing.
Echoes of Change#535.dst: 그러니까... 전에 Rex가 말한 대로야. 군주는 우리 편이 아니야. 그가 왕실에 들어갔다면... 옳은 일을 할 거라 믿을 수 있을지 모르겠어.
Echoes of Change#535.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#536.src: We can't just... sit around worrying about what could happen. We need to, um, stay focused.
Echoes of Change#536.dst: 그냥... 앉아서 무슨 일이 생길지 걱정만 할 순 없어. 우린, 음, 집중해야 해.
Echoes of Change#536.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#537.src: Syndra trusts us! We need to have faith in her plan.
Echoes of Change#537.dst: Syndra는 우릴 믿어! 우리도 그 계획을 믿어야 해.
Echoes of Change#537.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#538.src: Yeah... you're right. Let's take our positions then.
Echoes of Change#538.dst: 응... 네 말이 맞아. 그럼 자리 잡으러 가자.
Echoes of Change#538.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#539.src: The map says we're supposed to be stationed on top of a building...
Echoes of Change#539.dst: 지도에 따르면 건물 꼭대기에 있어야 하는데...
Echoes of Change#539.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#540.src: Head to your designated spot at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#541.src: So... this is our spot, then?
Echoes of Change#541.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#542.src: I think so, if I read the map correctly...
Echoes of Change#542.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#543.src: ... It feels weird. Just, um, standing by. Like... like we're not really, um, doing anything to, to help.
Echoes of Change#543.dst: ...기분이 이상해. 그냥, 음, 대기만 하니까. 마치... 마치 우리가, 음, 도, 돕는 게 없는 것 같아.
Echoes of Change#543.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#544.src: A bit... yeah. But like Syndra said, we'll be needed to help in the aftermath. Even if we're not really doing anything until then...
Echoes of Change#544.dst: 좀... 그렇지. 그래도 Syndra 말대로 뒷수습에 우리가 필요할 거야. 그때까진 딱히 하는 게 없더라도...
Echoes of Change#544.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#546.src: What's wrong? Something caught your eye?
Echoes of Change#546.dst: 왜 그래? 뭐 눈에 띄는 거라도 있어?
Echoes of Change#546.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#547.src: Oh, uh... just- it is the festival day, right? The city looks exactly the same as it did when we, um, arrived. No festivities? No stalls, no attractions?
Echoes of Change#547.dst: 아, 어... 그냥- 오늘 축제날 맞지? 도시가 우리가, 음, 도착했을 때랑 똑같아. 축제 행사도? 노점도, 볼거리도 없어?
Echoes of Change#547.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#548.src: Oh! Hahaha, you people have attractions in Auburn?
Echoes of Change#548.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#549.src: Um... yeah! Isn't that... the point of the festival?
Echoes of Change#549.dst: 음... 응! 그게... 축제의 핵심 아니야?
Echoes of Change#549.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#550.src: Maybe for you. Here... well, nobody has the time for any of that. The point, for most residents, is having a day off from work.
Echoes of Change#550.dst: 너희한텐 그렇겠지. 여기선... 뭐, 그럴 시간이 있는 사람이 없어. 대부분 주민들에겐 일 쉬는 하루가 핵심이야.
Echoes of Change#550.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#551.src: Oh! That's... nice, I guess. A little sad, though, that that's why, ha, people get excited about it...?
Echoes of Change#551.dst: 아! 그건... 좋네, 아마. 그래도, 하, 사람들이 그 때문에 들뜬다는 게 좀 슬프다...?
Echoes of Change#551.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#552.src: Yeah, a bit. That's the Roughworks for you, though.
Echoes of Change#552.dst: 응, 좀. 그래도 Roughworks가 원래 그래.
Echoes of Change#552.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#556.src: Working for the crown is complicated? Helping them oppress to people of Fruma is complicated?!
Echoes of Change#556.dst: 왕실 밑에서 일하는 게 복잡해? Fruma 사람들을 억압하는 걸 돕는 게 복잡하다고?!
Echoes of Change#556.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#557.src: Yes! I'd explain it to you, but we don't have time for it now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#557.dst: 그래! 설명해 주고 싶지만 지금은 시간이 없어- {u}, 내 말 좀 들어-
Echoes of Change#557.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#558.src: Sigh. You didn't need to do that. I'm not... being forced into anything, I'm just-
Echoes of Change#558.dst: 하아. 그럴 필요 없었어. 난... 강요받은 게 아니야, 그냥-
Echoes of Change#558.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#559.src: So you chose to work for the crown? Why?!
Echoes of Change#559.dst: 그럼 스스로 왕실 밑에서 일하기로 한 거야? 왜?!
Echoes of Change#559.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#560.src: I... have my reasons, trust me. Look, there's no time to explain right now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#560.dst: 나도... 이유가 있어, 믿어 줘. 들어 봐, 지금은 설명할 시간이 없어- {u}, 내 말 좀 들어-
Echoes of Change#560.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#561.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#561.dst: Sui, 뭐 하는 거야?! 그러면 시선만 더 끌어.
Echoes of Change#561.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#563.src: If you would just let me finish... I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised- I don't know how, exactly, but we know what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#563.dst: 끝까지 좀 들어 줘... 경고하러 온 거야. 너희 조직은 노출됐어- 정확히 어떻게인지는 모르지만, 오늘 너희가 뭘 하려는지 우린 알아.
Echoes of Change#563.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#565.src: It is. You need to call it off, or else-
Echoes of Change#565.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#566.src: ... Because we're still friends, at the end of the day. I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#566.dst: ...그래도 우린 결국 친구니까. 네가 다치는 건 싫어.
Echoes of Change#566.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#567.src: If only you hadn't been hiding... well, it doesn't matter now. We're out of time. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#567.dst: 네가 숨어 있지만 않았어도... 뭐, 이제 상관없어. 시간이 없어. 이 일이 끝나고도 무사하다면... 어떻게든 연락할게.
Echoes of Change#567.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#570.src: There's... something bigger than Fruma at stake.
Echoes of Change#570.dst: 그건... Fruma보다 더 큰 게 걸려 있어.
Echoes of Change#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#571.src: It doesn't matter. Not now, at least
Echoes of Change#571.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#572.src: Of course it matters! There's real people getting hurt by the crown, and you think it doesn't matter?!
Echoes of Change#572.dst: 당연히 상관있지! 왕실 때문에 진짜 사람들이 다치는데, 상관없다고?!
Echoes of Change#572.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#573.src: That's not what I said. I... we don't have time for this. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#573.dst: 그런 말이 아니야. 난... 이럴 시간 없어. {u}, 넌 반드시
Echoes of Change#573.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#575.src: I asked you not to. I don't need saving.
Echoes of Change#575.dst: 하지 말라고 했잖아. 구해 줄 필요 없어.
Echoes of Change#575.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#576.src: You being here, it's... making things harder things harder than they need to be.
Echoes of Change#576.dst: 네가 여기 있으니까... 일이 필요 이상으로 더 어려워지고 있어.
Echoes of Change#576.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#577.src: Harder for you?! You're the one siding with the crown, man!
Echoes of Change#577.dst: 너한테 어렵다고?! 왕실 편에 선 건 너잖아!
Echoes of Change#577.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#578.src: I...I don't have time for this right now. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#578.dst: 난... 난 지금 이럴 시간 없어. {u}, 넌 반드시
Echoes of Change#578.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#579.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#579.dst: Sui, 뭐 하는 거야?! 그러면 시선만 더 끌어.
Echoes of Change#579.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#582.src: I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised how, exactly, I don't know, but... the Crown knowns what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#582.dst: 경고하러 온 거야. 너희 조직은 노출됐어. 정확히 어떻게인지는 모르지만... 오늘 너희가 뭘 하려는지 왕실이 알아.
Echoes of Change#582.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#584.src: It is. Choose to believe me, or not, but
Echoes of Change#584.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#586.src: We're still friends, aren't we? I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#586.dst: 우린 아직 친구잖아? 네가 다치는 건 싫어.
Echoes of Change#586.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#587.src: If only you hadn't come after me, then... well, it doesn't matter now. You're here anyway. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#587.dst: 네가 날 쫓아오지만 않았어도... 뭐, 이제 상관없어. 어쨌든 넌 여기 왔으니까. 이 일이 끝나고도 무사하다면... 어떻게든 연락할게.
Echoes of Change#587.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#588.src: Just... please, don't proceed with your plan. Find a way to stop it. I just don't want to see anyone get hurt.
Echoes of Change#588.dst: 그냥... 제발, 계획을 진행하지 마. 멈출 방법을 찾아. 누구도 다치는 걸 보고 싶지 않아.
Echoes of Change#588.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#589.src: I need to go, even finding an excuse to step away for this long was difficult. Stay safe.
Echoes of Change#589.dst: 가 봐야 해. 이만큼 자리를 비울 핑계를 찾는 것도 힘들었어. 몸조심해.
Echoes of Change#589.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#591.src: What- what do we do? We need to, to get a message out! Where's Syndra, we have to-
Echoes of Change#591.dst: 어, 어떡해? 소식을, 소식을 전해야 해! Syndra는 어디 있지, 우리가-
Echoes of Change#591.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#592.src: Oh, no... I- I don't think we can. The... the festival's starting.
Echoes of Change#592.dst: 아, 안 돼... 나, 난 못 할 것 같아. 축... 축제가 시작됐어.
Echoes of Change#592.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#594.src: Citizens of the {p}, I extend my heartfelt gratitude for your remarkable attendance this year.
Echoes of Change#594.dst: {p}의 시민 여러분, 올해도 이토록 많이 참석해 주신 데 진심으로 감사를 표합니다.
Echoes of Change#594.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#595.src: Together, we shall celebrate yet another year of success and prosperity!
Echoes of Change#595.dst: 함께, 또 한 해의 성공과 번영을 축하합시다!
Echoes of Change#595.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#596.src: Your unwavering dedication and industrious spirit are deeply valued, and I hold a profound appreciation for your contributions to the strength and glory of our province.
Echoes of Change#596.dst: 여러분의 흔들림 없는 헌신과 근면한 정신은 매우 소중하며, 우리 지방의 힘과 영광에 기여한 여러분께 깊이 감사드립니다.
Echoes of Change#596.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#597.src: Production quotas for this year have been successfully achieved, and I am most pleased by this accomplishment.
Echoes of Change#597.dst: 올해 생산 할당량은 성공적으로 달성되었으며, 이 성과를 매우 기쁘게 생각합니다.
Echoes of Change#597.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#598.src: However, as Fruma continues to evolve and flourish, it is imperative that we strive for greater heights.
Echoes of Change#598.dst: 그러나 Fruma가 계속 발전하고 번성하는 만큼, 우리는 더 높은 곳을 향해 나아가야 합니다.
Echoes of Change#598.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#599.src: As such, we shall be raising production quotas for the coming year.
Echoes of Change#599.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#600.src: I have every confidence that you will continue to dedicate yourselves to the growth of Fruma.
Echoes of Change#600.dst: 여러분이 앞으로도 Fruma의 성장에 헌신하리라 굳게 믿습니다.
Echoes of Change#600.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#601.src: Let us now turn our attention to the year ahead, and to the improvements to the district's infrastructure that your Sovereign has prepared for your benefit.
Echoes of Change#601.dst: 이제 다가올 한 해와, 여러분의 군주가 여러분을 위해 준비한 지역 기반 시설 개선에 주목해 봅시다.
Echoes of Change#601.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#602.src: Sovereign Soosu has been hard at work these past months, and has developed an innovative technology designed to deliver cleaner and fresher water to our people.
Echoes of Change#602.dst: Soosu 군주는 지난 몇 달간 열심히 일하여, 우리 백성에게 더 깨끗하고 신선한 물을 공급하는 혁신적인 기술을 개발했습니다.
Echoes of Change#602.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#604.src: ... I th- th- think it's time. Let's do this.
Echoes of Change#604.dst: ...이, 이, 이제 때가 된 것 같아. 하자.
Echoes of Change#604.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#606.src: What was that?! Soldiers, investigate the commotion!
Echoes of Change#606.speaker: Timasca Captain

Echoes of Change#607.src: Hm? Worry not for the commotion, it is already being taken care of. Now, as I was saying...
Echoes of Change#607.dst: 음? 소란은 걱정 마십시오, 이미 처리 중입니다. 자, 하던 말을 계속하자면...
Echoes of Change#607.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#610.src: It's now or never... For Fruma!!!
Echoes of Change#610.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#616.src: Oh, but it is. Witness, citizens, the depravity and foolhardiness of those who turn against the crown!
Echoes of Change#616.dst: 오, 하지만 사실이다. 시민들이여, 보십시오. 왕실에 등을 돌린 자들의 타락과 무모함을!
Echoes of Change#616.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#617.src: Terrorists seeking to threaten the safety of our people, of our province! Aiding and abetting the Cursed, daring to make an attempt on my life, as your Queen!
Echoes of Change#617.dst: 우리 백성과 지방의 안전을 위협하는 테러리스트들! 저주받은 자를 돕고 감싸며, 감히 여왕인 나의 목숨을 노렸습니다!
Echoes of Change#617.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#618.src: We are fortunate that news of their plot reached the crown, and that our Sovereign Soosu could devise a construct to deceive them, to draw them out into the open.
Echoes of Change#618.dst: 다행히 그들의 음모가 왕실에 전해졌고, Soosu 군주가 그들을 속여 밖으로 끌어낼 구조물을 고안해 주었습니다.
Echoes of Change#618.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#619.src: Sovereigns, soldiers, to arms! Hunt down any terrorists or supporters you can find!
Echoes of Change#619.dst: 군주들, 병사들, 무기를 들라! 찾을 수 있는 테러리스트와 지지자를 모조리 사냥하라!
Echoes of Change#619.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#620.src: I should have expected you'd have some tricks left.
Echoes of Change#620.dst: 아직 수를 남겨 뒀을 줄 알았어야 했는데.
Echoes of Change#620.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#621.src: Oh, Syndra... you couldn't just stay put and leave things to rest, could you? To discard your safety, security... all for this?
Echoes of Change#621.dst: 오, Syndra... 가만히 있으면서 지난 일을 묻어 둘 수는 없었느냐? 안전과 안정을 버리면서까지... 겨우 이것을 위해?
Echoes of Change#621.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#622.src: I once saw great potential in you. Your strategic mind, your dedication... a pity you had to throw it all away.
Echoes of Change#622.dst: 한때 너에게서 큰 잠재력을 보았다. 전략적인 머리, 헌신... 그 모든 것을 내던지다니 안타깝구나.
Echoes of Change#622.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#623.src: Did you really believe it would be that easy to kill me? A single empowered strike? Have you forgotten who gave you that blessing in the first place?!
Echoes of Change#623.dst: 정말 나를 그리 쉽게 죽일 수 있다고 믿었느냐? 강화된 일격 한 번으로? 애초에 그 축복을 누가 내렸는지 잊었느냐?!
Echoes of Change#623.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#624.src: What a shame, that your rage and desperation blinded you to the truth. You never stood a chance.
Echoes of Change#624.dst: 분노와 절박함에 눈이 멀어 진실을 보지 못하다니, 딱하구나. 넌 처음부터 승산이 없었다.
Echoes of Change#624.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#625.src: No... no, no, no... what do we do?!
Echoes of Change#625.dst: 안 돼... 안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼... 어떡해?!
Echoes of Change#625.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#626.src: Damn it... we need to stick to the plan. Take the escape routes and regroup.
Echoes of Change#626.dst: 젠장... 계획대로 해야 해. 탈출로로 빠져서 다시 모이자.
Echoes of Change#626.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#627.src: What?! We can't just leave her behind! We, we have to help her! She's... I can't lose her.
Echoes of Change#627.dst: 뭐?! 그냥 두고 갈 순 없어! 우, 우리가 도와야 해! 그녀는... 그녀를 잃을 순 없어.
Echoes of Change#627.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#628.src: I know, I know! But... she knew this might happen. She told us to save ourselves first if anything goes wrong.
Echoes of Change#628.dst: 알아, 안다고! 하지만... 이렇게 될 수도 있다는 걸 알았어. 일이 틀어지면 우리부터 살라고 했잖아.
Echoes of Change#628.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#629.src: Besides, we... what could we even do? If Syndra can't kill her, what could we possibly do? Can't you feel it? This... this pressure?
Echoes of Change#629.dst: 게다가 우리가... 뭘 할 수 있겠어? Syndra도 못 죽였는데, 우리가 뭘 하겠어? 안 느껴져? 이... 이 압박감?
Echoes of Change#629.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#630.src: Is... is that coming from her? I, I felt something similar, during the Auburn festival...
Echoes of Change#630.dst: 저... 저게 그녀한테서 나오는 거야? 나, 나도 Auburn 축제 때 비슷한 걸 느꼈어...
Echoes of Change#630.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#631.src: She's furious... we need to get out of here. Quickly, let's head for the underground river escape route!
Echoes of Change#631.dst: 분노하고 있어... 여길 빠져나가야 해. 빨리, 지하 강 탈출로로 가자!
Echoes of Change#631.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#632.src: Escape using the underground river at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Echoes of Change#633.src: How is this possible? Why are there, ha, guards stationed here?!
Echoes of Change#633.dst: 어떻게 이럴 수가? 왜, 하, 여기 경비가 배치돼 있어?!
Echoes of Change#633.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#634.src: I- I don't know! They must have done some last minute schedule changes, or... or...
Echoes of Change#634.dst: 모, 모르겠어! 막판에 근무표를 바꿨나 봐, 아니면... 아니면...
Echoes of Change#634.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#635.src: Oh. Or they knew our whole plan. Ha... hahaha, we never stood a chance!
Echoes of Change#635.dst: 아. 아니면 우리 계획을 전부 알고 있었거나. 하... 하하하, 처음부터 승산이 없었네!
Echoes of Change#635.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#636.src: What are we going to do now? Yusanu, where's the next closest escape route?
Echoes of Change#636.dst: 이제 어떡해? Yusanu, 다음으로 가까운 탈출로는 어디야?
Echoes of Change#636.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#637.src: WE HAVE VOICES OVER BY THE CAMP SITE!! Requesting backup!
Echoes of Change#637.dst: 야영지 쪽에서 목소리가 들린다!! 지원 바람!
Echoes of Change#637.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#638.src: Ugh, there's more voices to the west! That mean the only route left is... is... oh, no.
Echoes of Change#638.dst: 으, 서쪽에서도 목소리가 들려! 그럼 남은 길은... 그건... 아, 안 돼.
Echoes of Change#638.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#641.src: What?! That'll just take us even further into danger!
Echoes of Change#641.dst: 뭐?! 그럼 더 위험한 곳으로 들어가는 거잖아!
Echoes of Change#641.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#642.src: Yeah, I know! But it's our only option left! We'll... we'll figure it out. Come on!
Echoes of Change#642.dst: 그래, 알아! 하지만 남은 선택지가 그것뿐이야! 어... 어떻게든 될 거야. 가자!
Echoes of Change#642.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#643.src: Escape using the Redwood gate at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Echoes of Change#645.src: Hey! We need to get out, now!
Echoes of Change#645.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#646.src: There's... barely any guards around. Zeph and Yuman must've really succeeded...
Echoes of Change#646.dst: 여긴... 경비가 거의 없어. Zeph랑 Yuman이 정말 성공했나 봐...
Echoes of Change#646.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#647.src: ...hold it. Something's wrong. They would never leave the gate unguarded...
Echoes of Change#647.dst: ...잠깐. 뭔가 이상해. 관문을 비워 둘 리가 없는데...
Echoes of Change#647.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#649.src: You're right. We wouldn't be that obtuse. But you were.
Echoes of Change#649.dst: 맞아. 우린 그렇게 둔하지 않아. 둔한 건 너희지.

Echoes of Change#652.src: I'll hand it to you, those were some unexpected variables you introduced for this plan of yours, but you should know how good I am at crunching the numbers.
Echoes of Change#652.dst: 인정하지, 너희가 이 계획에 예상 밖의 변수를 좀 넣긴 했어. 하지만 내가 계산에 얼마나 능한지 알아야지.
Echoes of Change#652.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#653.src: More to the point... YOU. Cursed. You just keep summing to your list of crimes! There's the Torann massacre, we can add every other soldier to the tally... And...the death of a Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#653.dst: 더 중요한 건... 너. 저주받은 자. 네 죄목은 계속 더해지기만 하는군! Torann 학살에, 다른 병사들까지 합산하고... 그리고... 군주 한 명의 죽음.
Echoes of Change#653.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#654.src: Let me ask. Do you know how it feels to die? Disposed of like yesterday's garbage? Do you know how exponentially more excruciating it is to feel IN REVERSE?!
Echoes of Change#654.dst: 하나 묻지. 죽는 게 어떤 기분인지 알아? 어제 쓰레기처럼 버려지는 거? 그걸 거꾸로 느끼는 게 기하급수적으로 얼마나 더 고통스러운지 알아?!
Echoes of Change#654.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#655.src: If dealing with you quickly wasn't magnitudes of order more important, I'd give you a lesson on the topic. Consider yourself lucky, cursed!
Echoes of Change#655.dst: 너를 빨리 처리하는 게 몇 자릿수나 더 중요하지 않았다면, 그 주제로 강의해 줬을 거다. 운 좋은 줄 알아, 저주받은 놈!
Echoes of Change#655.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#656.src: What... what's going to happen with Syndra?
Echoes of Change#656.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#657.src: ...an attempt on Her Majesty's life carries high consequences. Almost positive she'll be divided out...but that isn't my problem to solve.
Echoes of Change#657.dst: ...여왕 폐하 시해 미수의 대가는 크지. 거의 확실히 제거될 거야... 하지만 그건 내가 풀 문제가 아니야.
Echoes of Change#657.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#658.src: Weren't you... weren't you friends?! And you're just, going to let-
Echoes of Change#658.dst: 둘이... 친구 아니었어?! 그런데 그냥, 내버려 두겠다고-
Echoes of Change#658.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#659.src: NOT ONE MORE FACTORING WORD! How much do you think I enjoy this?! Do you think I want to hunt her down like a forgotten variable?!
Echoes of Change#659.dst: 인수분해할 말 한마디도 더 하지 마! 내가 이걸 즐기는 줄 알아?! 잊힌 변수처럼 그녀를 사냥하고 싶은 줄 알아?!
Echoes of Change#659.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#660.src: She chose to terminate our sequence! She threw that all away, used me for some irrational solution! She has as much value as any of you zeroes now!
Echoes of Change#660.dst: 우리 수열을 끝낸 건 그녀야! 전부 내던지고, 비이성적인 해답에 날 이용했지! 이제 그녀는 너희 같은 0이랑 다를 바 없어!
Echoes of Change#660.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#661.src: So why don't we accelerate this? Without that traitor misusing her blessing... Your number's up!!
Echoes of Change#661.dst: 그러니 가속해 볼까? 축복을 남용하던 배신자가 없으니... 너희 계산은 끝났다!!
Echoes of Change#661.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#663.src: I... I think I'm gonna be sick...
Echoes of Change#663.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#664.src: He's... he's dead. Again. We beat him... again.
Echoes of Change#664.dst: 그가... 죽었어. 또. 우리가 또... 이겼어.
Echoes of Change#664.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#665.src: Again?! So he was being literal about you killing him before?
Echoes of Change#665.dst: 또?! 그럼 네가 전에 그를 죽였다는 게 말 그대로였어?
Echoes of Change#665.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#666.src: ... Okay. Okay, so... probably not down for good. Great! That's just... great.
Echoes of Change#666.dst: ...그래. 그래, 그러니까... 아마 완전히 끝난 건 아니겠네. 좋아! 아주... 좋네.
Echoes of Change#666.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#668.src: I... I don't, um, have enough mana left to fight, anymore... s-so we should leave, before-
Echoes of Change#668.dst: 나... 난, 음, 싸울 마나가 더는 없어... 그, 그러니까 떠나자, 그 전에-
Echoes of Change#668.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#669.src: Uh... y- yeah, we should... get moving.
Echoes of Change#669.dst: 어... 그, 그래, 우린... 움직여야 해.
Echoes of Change#669.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#670.dst: ...크르르르아아아!! 우리... 수열은... 네가 끝나기 전엔... 안 끝나!!
Echoes of Change#670.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#671.src: H- how...? It, it took him way longer, last time...
Echoes of Change#671.dst: 어, 어떻게...? 지, 지난번엔 훨씬 오래 걸렸는데...
Echoes of Change#671.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#672.src: Nngh... You...miscalculated! I told you! You know how good I am at crunching the numbers! I prepared...hhhff...for this possibility!
Echoes of Change#672.dst: 으윽... 너희가... 계산을 틀렸어! 말했잖아! 내가 계산에 얼마나 능한지! 이 가능성도... 허억... 대비해 뒀지!
Echoes of Change#672.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#673.src: It was a calculated risk. Overloading the old Nasin charm... That could've broken it. But instead...my expected solution is here!
Echoes of Change#673.dst: 계산된 위험이었어. Nasin 가문의 낡은 부적을 과부하시키는 건... 부서질 수도 있었지. 하지만 결과는... 기대한 해답이 여기 있다!
Echoes of Change#673.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#674.src: A near-instant revival! And I heard your collaborator- All out of power now. I nearly had you in round one, even. Fight all you want- it'll sum to nothing, murderer!
Echoes of Change#674.dst: 거의 즉시 부활! 그리고 네 동료 말도 들었지- 이제 힘이 바닥났다고. 1라운드에서도 거의 잡을 뻔했어. 마음껏 싸워 봐- 합계는 0일 테니, 살인자!
Echoes of Change#674.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#676.src: ...Soosu. Thank you for taking me seriously. I didn't want you involved for the danger, but with both of us... We'll solve this problem in no time. Follow my le-
Echoes of Change#676.dst: ...Soosu. 내 말을 진지하게 받아 줘서 고마워. 위험해서 끌어들이고 싶지 않았지만, 우리 둘이면... 이 문제는 금방 풀 거야. 내 지시를 따-
Echoes of Change#676.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#677.src: GAAAH!! S-SOOSU?! You... What was...?! Nnh...
Echoes of Change#677.dst: 크아아악!! S-SOOSU?! 너... 방금 뭐...?! 으윽...
Echoes of Change#677.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#678.src: Soosu!! Th-These are the insurgents! The murderers!! You can't be- What did they- WHAT ARE YOU HOLDING OVER HER?! Soosu, I swear, you can get out of-
Echoes of Change#678.dst: Soosu!! 이, 이놈들이 반란군이야! 살인자라고!! 네가 그럴 리- 저놈들이 뭘- 무슨 약점을 잡은 거냐?! Soosu, 맹세코, 빠져나올 수 있-
Echoes of Change#678.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#679.src: Yeah, yeah... I know. But I think I'm sick and tired of trying.
Echoes of Change#679.dst: 그래, 그래... 알아. 근데 이젠 애쓰는 것도 지긋지긋해.
Echoes of Change#679.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#680.src: ...Soosu...you can't- I know you can be better, you can- I'll-
Echoes of Change#680.dst: ...Soosu... 넌 그럴 수 없- 넌 더 나을 수 있어, 넌- 내가-
Echoes of Change#680.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#681.src: It'll all be over soon, Z. Please... don't make me kill you again.
Echoes of Change#681.dst: 곧 다 끝날 거야, Z. 제발... 널 또 죽이게 하지 마.
Echoes of Change#681.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#684.src: Why- why are you helping us?
Echoes of Change#684.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#685.src: Just... go, Yus. You're wasting time.
Echoes of Change#685.dst: 그냥... 가, Yus. 시간 낭비하지 말고.
Echoes of Change#685.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#686.src: But... I was the one who stole your project. Why would you...
Echoes of Change#686.dst: 하지만... 네 프로젝트를 훔친 건 나였잖아. 왜...
Echoes of Change#686.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#687.src: Yes, Yus, I know! What does it matter why I'm helping you? Just... just take it and go. Before they realize you're here.
Echoes of Change#687.dst: 그래, Yus, 알아! 내가 왜 돕는지가 뭐가 중요해? 그냥... 그냥 받고 가. 네가 여기 있는 걸 들키기 전에.
Echoes of Change#687.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#689.src: Ugh, why are you so-! Fine! You - when I look at you, it's like I'm looking at myself, before... before I became this.
Echoes of Change#689.dst: 으, 넌 왜 그렇게-! 좋아! 너 - 널 보면 나 자신을 보는 것 같아, 내가... 이렇게 되기 전의.
Echoes of Change#689.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#690.src: Now, go! Run! Flee! Just, leave!
Echoes of Change#690.dst: 자, 가! 뛰어! 도망쳐! 그냥, 떠나!
Echoes of Change#690.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#691.src: If... If I leave you here. You, you-
Echoes of Change#691.dst: 만약... 만약 널 여기 두고 가면. 넌, 넌-
Echoes of Change#691.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#692.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu. I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#692.dst: 난 괜찮을 거야, Yusanu. 싸우는 것도 지쳤어. 내 의무에도 지쳤고. 이런 삶은 지긋지긋해.
Echoes of Change#692.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#694.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu, I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#694.dst: 난 괜찮을 거야, Yusanu, 싸우는 것도 지쳤어. 내 의무에도 지쳤고. 이런 삶은 지긋지긋해.
Echoes of Change#694.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#696.src: We... we need to go, Yusanu.
Echoes of Change#696.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#698.src: Well then, Syndra the Lioness. Nothing to say in response? Has a cat got your tongue?
Echoes of Change#698.dst: 자, 그럼, 암사자 Syndra. 할 말이 없느냐? 고양이가 혀라도 물어 갔느냐?
Echoes of Change#698.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#699.src: I have no words for you.
Echoes of Change#699.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#700.src: No, I suppose you were always more fond of the language of violence...
Echoes of Change#700.dst: 그래, 너는 늘 폭력의 언어를 더 좋아했지...
Echoes of Change#700.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#701.src: You'll notice the area has been cleared. You understand what this means for you, yes?
Echoes of Change#701.dst: 주변이 정리된 게 보이겠지. 그게 너에게 무슨 의미인지 알겠느냐?
Echoes of Change#701.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#702.src: The same as always. I kill you, or I die trying.
Echoes of Change#702.dst: 언제나처럼. 내가 당신을 죽이거나, 그러다 내가 죽거나.
Echoes of Change#702.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#703.src: Yuman... We n- n- need to find an escape route that w- wor- works!
Echoes of Change#703.dst: Yuman... 우, 우리 통, 통하는 탈출로를 찾아야 해!
Echoes of Change#703.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#704.src: Ugh, there are way more guards than we expected! We'll have to find a way to dodge them all...
Echoes of Change#704.dst: 으, 경비가 예상보다 훨씬 많아! 전부 피할 방법을 찾아야겠어...
Echoes of Change#704.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#706.src: I ca- ca- can't stand this... not h- hel- helping Syndra!
Echoes of Change#706.dst: Syndra를 도, 도, 돕지 못하는 게... 겨, 견딜 수가 없어!
Echoes of Change#706.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#707.src: Hey, man, have faith. She'll find a way out of there! But for now, we've gotta worry 'bout ourselves, 'kay?
Echoes of Change#707.dst: 야, 믿어 봐. 그 사람은 거기서 빠져나올 거야! 하지만 지금은 우리부터 챙겨야 해, 알았지?
Echoes of Change#707.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#708.src: Yeah... th- thanks, Yuman. Let's k- ke- keep moving.
Echoes of Change#708.dst: 응... 고, 고마워, Yuman. 계, 계속 가자.
Echoes of Change#708.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#709.src: Behold, citizens... the face of the insurgent group.
Echoes of Change#709.dst: 시민 여러분, 보십시오... 반란 집단의 얼굴입니다.
Echoes of Change#709.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#710.src: The two cursed ones who attacked us have been captured. However, there are still people out there who wish us harm. Please, stay on high alert!
Echoes of Change#710.dst: 우리를 공격한 저주받은 자 둘은 체포되었습니다. 그러나 여전히 우리를 해치려는 자들이 있습니다. 부디 경계를 늦추지 마십시오!
Echoes of Change#710.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#711.src: If you notice any suspicious behaviour, contact your local military. Together, we will prevail as a nation.
Echoes of Change#711.dst: 수상한 행동을 발견하면 지역 군대에 알리십시오. 함께라면, 우리는 한 나라로서 승리할 것입니다.
Echoes of Change#711.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#712.src: But do not worry. Even such an aggressive assault from the enemy stood no chance against our might. I will ensure everyone's safety!
Echoes of Change#712.dst: 하지만 걱정하지 마십시오. 적의 그토록 맹렬한 공격조차 우리의 힘 앞에선 가망이 없었습니다. 모두의 안전을 지키겠습니다!
Echoes of Change#712.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#713.src: Now. As punishment for attempting to assassinate me... I will execute Syndra, leader of the cursed terrorists, right here!
Echoes of Change#713.dst: 이제. 나를 암살하려 한 죄로... 저주받은 테러리스트의 수장 Syndra를 바로 이 자리에서 처형하겠습니다!
Echoes of Change#713.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#714.src: Her accomplice will be imprisoned and questioned for information on the remaining insurgents.
Echoes of Change#714.dst: 그녀의 공범은 투옥되어 남은 반란군에 대한 정보를 심문받을 것입니다.
Echoes of Change#714.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#717.src: I don't regret anything I've done. I know Fruma will change for the better. Maybe not today, or tomorrow! But change will come.
Echoes of Change#717.dst: 내가 한 일은 하나도 후회하지 않아. Fruma는 더 나아질 거야. 오늘도, 내일도 아닐지 모르지! 하지만 변화는 올 거야.
Echoes of Change#717.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#718.src: I regret that it had to come to this, Syndra... I draw no joy from your death. I wonder, whatever happened to that woman who held boundless potential within?
Echoes of Change#718.dst: 일이 이렇게까지 된 것이 유감이구나, Syndra... 네 죽음에서 기쁨은 없다. 무한한 잠재력을 품었던 그 여인은 대체 어떻게 된 것이냐?
Echoes of Change#718.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#720.src: I will find your children, Syndra. This tantrum of yours ends here with you.
Echoes of Change#720.dst: 네 아이들도 찾아내겠다, Syndra. 너의 이 투정은 너와 함께 여기서 끝난다.
Echoes of Change#720.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#721.src: Now, as for those Sovereigns of mine...
Echoes of Change#721.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#722.src: I know you, Soosu. Please, tell me what's wrong! This isn't an unsolvable problem! Don't make it so I lose two of my-
Echoes of Change#722.dst: 난 널 알아, Soosu. 제발, 뭐가 문제인지 말해 줘! 이건 풀 수 없는 문제가 아니야! 내가 둘이나 잃게 만들지-
Echoes of Change#722.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#723.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I cannot help but notice the obvious lack of captured terrorists, amidst the scene of a battle.
Echoes of Change#723.dst: Zhiraok 군주. 전투 현장에 체포된 테러리스트가 눈에 띄게 없다는 점이 눈에 들어오는군.
Echoes of Change#723.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#724.src: Your Majesty!! The insurgents, they must have blackmailed Sovereign Soosu, she-
Echoes of Change#724.dst: 폐하!! 반란군이 Soosu 군주를 협박한 게 분명합니다, 그녀는-
Echoes of Change#724.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#725.src: Silence. You have failed me twice, now. They have bested you in combat twice, Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#725.dst: 조용. 이제 두 번이나 날 실망시켰다. 전투에서 두 번이나 그들에게 졌지, 군주.
Echoes of Change#725.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#726.src: I- The cursed have greater cunning than I cal-
Echoes of Change#726.dst: 저- 저주받은 자들이 제 계산보다 교활해-
Echoes of Change#726.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#727.src: I am disappointed in your performance. You are now expressly forbidden from continuing to chase and track down these... rotten children.
Echoes of Change#727.dst: 네 성과에 실망했다. 이제부터 이... 썩어 빠진 아이들을 쫓고 추적하는 것을 명백히 금한다.
Echoes of Change#727.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#728.src: ...I. ... ...I alone take full responsibility for this failure, Your Majesty. Bu-
Echoes of Change#728.dst: ...저. ... ...이번 실패의 책임은 전적으로 제게 있습니다, 폐하. 하지-
Echoes of Change#728.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#729.src: Focus yourself on maintaining {p} operations in the absence of its Sovereign, would you? You have much experience already, I'm sure.
Echoes of Change#729.dst: 군주가 없는 동안 {p}의 운영 유지에나 집중하거라. 그 방면엔 이미 경험이 많을 테니.
Echoes of Change#729.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#730.dst: 없는... 동안- 안 돼- 폐하께서 빼시려는-
Echoes of Change#730.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#731.src: Now, stop standing there, and do something! Rally the soldiers, track down the remnants of that terrorist group still hiding!
Echoes of Change#731.dst: 자, 거기 서 있지 말고 뭐라도 해라! 병사들을 모아, 아직 숨어 있는 테러 집단 잔당을 추적하라!
Echoes of Change#731.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#734.src: As for you... do you think your little games will spare you from my wrath? Attacking a fellow Sovereign, allowing these targets to escape...
Echoes of Change#734.dst: 그리고 너... 그 하찮은 장난으로 내 분노를 피할 수 있을 줄 알았느냐? 동료 군주를 공격하고, 표적을 놓아주다니...
Echoes of Change#734.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#735.src: Bla, bla, whatever. Just get it over with. Kill me already, if I'm so worthless to you.
Echoes of Change#735.dst: 어쩌고저쩌고, 알 게 뭐야. 그냥 끝내. 내가 그렇게 쓸모없으면 그냥 죽이라고.
Echoes of Change#735.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#736.src: And allow you a peaceful death? After I gave you everything, and you turned around and betrayed me?!
Echoes of Change#736.dst: 편안한 죽음을 허락하라고? 모든 걸 준 나를 등지고 배신했는데?!
Echoes of Change#736.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#737.src: No, Soosu. You deserve no such mercy from me.
Echoes of Change#737.dst: 아니, Soosu. 넌 그런 자비를 받을 자격이 없다.
Echoes of Change#737.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#738.src: ...every last factoring person down here is charged with conspiracy. Her Majesty demands their capture, by any and all means.
Echoes of Change#738.dst: ...여기 있는 인수분해할 놈들 전부 공모죄로 기소한다. 여왕 폐하께서 어떤 수단을 써서라도 체포하라 명하셨다.
Echoes of Change#738.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#739.src: Get it done. Now. One of them must know what they did to Soo- ... I'll be questioning each of them. Personally.
Echoes of Change#739.dst: 처리해. 당장. 저놈들이 Soo한테 무슨 짓을 했는지 누군가는- ...한 명씩 내가 직접 심문하겠다.
Echoes of Change#739.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Elemental Exercise#000.src: Hm. Come looking for more training, have you? I'm afraid the next training session isn't for some time.

Elemental Exercise#001.src: If you'd like some more advice for combat, though, you could always speak to the soldiers down in the training room.

Elemental Exercise#002.src: They're honing their skills, and they'll gladly share some tips if you ask them.

Elemental Exercise#003.src: Did you know you can stash your items in your bank? You can even get them back at any other bank, any time!

Elemental Exercise#004.src: Now, I'm not sure how that works, but it's best to not ask any questions.

Elemental Exercise#005.src: I do have one. If our enemies are susceptible to the elements in this way, would that also apply to us?
Elemental Exercise#005.dst: 하나 있어요. 적이 이렇게 원소에 약하다면, 저희도 마찬가지인가요?

Elemental Exercise#006.src: Ah, yes. A fine observation. Indeed, you are also bound to the rules of the elements. Elemental defenses and weaknesses from your equipment will affect you in the very same way.
Elemental Exercise#006.dst: 아, 그렇지. 좋은 지적이야. 자네들도 원소의 법칙에 묶여 있네. 장비의 원소 방어와 약점도 똑같이 자네들에게 영향을 주지.

Elemental Exercise#007.src: However, you have another tool at your disposal in the form of your spells! Different spells will deal different elemental damage, even if your weapon does not use that element by default.
Elemental Exercise#007.dst: 하지만 자네들에겐 주문이라는 또 다른 도구가 있지! 무기가 기본으로 그 원소를 쓰지 않더라도, 주문마다 다른 원소 피해를 준다네.

Elemental Exercise#008.src: ...Oh! So my Bash spell will still deal  Earth damage even if my weapon only uses  Water , right?
Elemental Exercise#008.dst: ...아! 그럼 무기가  물 원소만 써도 Bash 주문은  대지 피해를 주는 거죠?

Elemental Exercise#009.src: Correct! Now, let's see... We have the two of you here. Why don't we have a friendly duel? A chance to test your battle skills in a safe environment.
Elemental Exercise#009.dst: 정답이야! 자, 보자... 여기 둘이 있으니 친선 결투를 해 보는 건 어떤가? 안전한 곳에서 실력을 시험할 기회지.

Elemental Exercise#010.src: The leader has been slain! Take out the stragglers, soldiers! The battle has been won!
Elemental Exercise#010.dst: 우두머리가 쓰러졌다! 남은 놈들을 처리하라, 병사들이여! 전투는 우리의 승리다!

Elemental Exercise#011.src: We've been seeing more attacks from {p} recently... good grief, when will that Graken do his job and sort it out?
Elemental Exercise#011.dst: 요즘 {p} 쪽에서 공격이 잦아졌어... 원 참, 그 Graken은 언제 제 할 일 해서 정리할 건가?

Elemental Exercise#012.src: Hmph. Well, regardless, the two of you fought well! The training seems to have paid off.
Elemental Exercise#012.dst: 흠. 뭐, 어쨌든 둘 다 잘 싸웠네! 훈련한 보람이 있군.

Elemental Exercise#013.src: Thank you, sir! That summoner was a tough foe, but it was nothing we couldn't handle... right, {u}?
Elemental Exercise#013.dst: 감사합니다, 대장님! 그 소환사는 까다로운 적이었지만 저희가 못 당할 정도는 아니었어요... 그렇지, {u}?

Elemental Exercise#014.src: Hm... Let us return to the barracks. I'll have to speak to the Admiral when he returns, and I'd like for the two of you to be present.
Elemental Exercise#014.dst: 흠... 병영으로 돌아가세. 제독님이 돌아오시면 말씀드려야 하는데, 자네 둘도 함께 있었으면 하네.

Elemental Exercise#015.src: He wants us to be there for a meeting with the Admiral...? Huh. What do you think that could be about?
Elemental Exercise#015.dst: 제독님과의 회의에 우리도 같이 있으래...? 흠. 무슨 일일 것 같아?

Elemental Exercise#016.src: ... Hopefully it's not anything bad. He did seem to approve of our combat prowess, but-... Nevermind. We should get going.
Elemental Exercise#016.dst: ... 나쁜 일이 아니면 좋겠다. 우리 전투 실력은 인정하시는 것 같았는데-... 아니야. 이제 가자.

Elemental Exercise#017.src: Ahem. Before you return to your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#017.dst: 에헴. 둘 다 돌아가기 전에 줄 게 있네. 오늘 일의 보수와 특별한 장비 하나야. 잘 쓰게.

Elemental Exercise#018.src: Talk to Captain Ragon in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#019.src: Ah! You must be one of the new recruits the Admiral told me to look out for! What was it... {u}, yes?
Elemental Exercise#019.dst: 아! 제독님이 눈여겨보라던 신병 중 하나로군! 이름이 뭐였더라... {u}, 맞나?
Elemental Exercise#019.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#020.src: You've done well to reach this city as quickly as you have, which must have required a great deal of fighting the undead.
Elemental Exercise#020.dst: 이렇게 빨리 이 도시에 오다니 잘했네. 오는 길에 언데드와 꽤 많이 싸웠겠지.
Elemental Exercise#020.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#021.src: Now, I've heard from Sergeant Van of your aid in his assault on our overtaken fort- which, good work, very well done...
Elemental Exercise#021.dst: Van 병장에게 들었네. 점령당한 요새 탈환을 도왔다지? 아주 훌륭했어...
Elemental Exercise#021.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#022.src: But the fact still stands that you lack experience. You can certainly fight, yes, but can you fight well?
Elemental Exercise#022.dst: 하지만 경험이 부족한 건 사실이지. 싸울 줄은 알겠지만, 잘 싸우나?
Elemental Exercise#022.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#023.src: Lucky for you, that's where I come in. You're just in time for today's training session! Come here, follow me.
Elemental Exercise#023.dst: 운이 좋군, 그래서 내가 있는 거지. 마침 오늘 훈련 시간이야! 이리 오게, 따라와.
Elemental Exercise#023.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#024.src: Follow Captain Ragon to the Training Room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#025.src: ...Oh! {u}, hello. Are you here for training as well?
Elemental Exercise#025.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#026.src: Ahem. Now, in front of you, you'll see five special training dummies. Each one finely imbued with elemental magic. You are aware of the elements, yes? There's five of them in total.
Elemental Exercise#026.dst: 에헴. 자, 앞에 특수 훈련용 허수아비 다섯 개가 보일 걸세. 각각 원소 마법이 정교하게 깃들어 있지. 원소는 알고 있겠지? 모두 다섯 가지야.
Elemental Exercise#026.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#027.src: I am! The elements are... Fire, Air, Earth, Thunder, and... Water?
Elemental Exercise#027.dst: 알아요! 원소는... 화염, 바람, 대지, 번개, 그리고... 물?
Elemental Exercise#027.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#028.src: That's right. And generally speaking, they're strong against each other in that order- Fire beats Air, Air beats Earth, and so on.
Elemental Exercise#028.dst: 맞네. 대체로 그 순서대로 서로에게 강하지. 화염은 바람을, 바람은 대지를 이기는 식으로.
Elemental Exercise#028.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#029.src: Elemental weaknesses may vary based on the enemy, but that order holds true in most cases.
Elemental Exercise#029.dst: 원소 약점은 적마다 다를 수 있지만, 대부분은 그 순서가 통하네.
Elemental Exercise#029.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#030.src: Enemies will take more damage from elements they're weak to, and take less damage from elements they resist. This change to your damage is always a flat value, and it varies from enemy to enemy.
Elemental Exercise#030.dst: 적은 약한 원소에 피해를 더 받고, 저항하는 원소에는 덜 받지. 이 피해 변화는 항상 고정값이고, 적마다 다르네.
Elemental Exercise#030.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#031.src: Now. For training purposes, you'll be given an elemental weapon to try out on these training dummies. Take note of how each elemental defense and weakness affects your damage dealt. Speak to me once you feel you understand the concept.
Elemental Exercise#031.dst: 자. 훈련을 위해 원소 무기를 줄 테니 이 허수아비들에게 써 보게. 원소별 방어와 약점이 주는 피해에 어떤 영향을 주는지 잘 보게나. 이해했다 싶으면 내게 말하게.
Elemental Exercise#031.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#032.src: Test out the elemental training weapons on the dummies, then speak to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Elemental Exercise#032.dst: 허수아비에게 원소 훈련 무기를 시험해 본 뒤 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Ragon 대장과 대화하세요.

Elemental Exercise#033.src: Well? Have you noted the effect of elemental defenses and weaknesses on your damage?
Elemental Exercise#033.dst: 어떤가? 원소 방어와 약점이 피해에 주는 영향을 확인했나?
Elemental Exercise#033.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#034.src: Excellent. I'll take those training weapons back from the two of you. Any questions?
Elemental Exercise#034.dst: 훌륭하군. 두 사람의 훈련 무기는 회수하겠네. 질문 있나?
Elemental Exercise#034.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#035.src: I do have one. If our enemies are susceptible to elements in this way, would that also apply to us?
Elemental Exercise#035.dst: 하나 있어요. 적이 이렇게 원소에 약하다면, 저희도 마찬가지인가요?
Elemental Exercise#035.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#036.src: Ah, yes. A fine observation. Indeed, you are also bound by the rules of the elements. Elemental defenses and weaknesses from your equipment will affect you in the very same way.
Elemental Exercise#036.dst: 아, 그렇지. 좋은 지적이야. 자네들도 원소의 법칙에 묶여 있네. 장비의 원소 방어와 약점도 똑같이 자네들에게 영향을 주지.
Elemental Exercise#036.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#037.src: One final note before we move on from the elements- your weapon may not always be as effective against an enemy as you would like.
Elemental Exercise#037.dst: 원소 이야기를 마치기 전에 마지막으로, 무기가 늘 원하는 만큼 적에게 효과적이진 않을 걸세.
Elemental Exercise#037.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#038.src: However, you have another tool at your disposal in the form of your spells! Different spells will deal different elemental damage, even if your weapon does use that element by default.
Elemental Exercise#038.dst: 하지만 자네들에겐 주문이라는 또 다른 도구가 있지! 무기가 기본으로 그 원소를 쓰지 않더라도, 주문마다 다른 원소 피해를 준다네.
Elemental Exercise#038.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#039.src: ...Oh! So my Bash spell will still deal Earth damage even if my weapon only uses Water, right?
Elemental Exercise#039.dst: ...아! 그럼 무기가 물 원소만 써도 Bash 주문은 대지 피해를 주는 거죠?
Elemental Exercise#039.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#040.src: Correct! Now, let's see... We have the two of you here. Why don't we have a friendly duel? A chance to test your battle skills in a save environment.
Elemental Exercise#040.dst: 정답이야! 자, 보자... 여기 둘이 있으니 친선 결투를 해 보는 건 어떤가? 안전한 곳에서 실력을 시험할 기회지.
Elemental Exercise#040.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#041.src: That sounds good to me! {u}, we've been traveling together for some time now... I can't say I haven't been curious to see how you fight. Let's see who comes out on top, shall we?
Elemental Exercise#041.dst: 좋아요! {u}, 우리 같이 여행한 지도 꽤 됐잖아... 네가 어떻게 싸우는지 솔직히 궁금했어. 누가 이기나 볼까?
Elemental Exercise#041.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#043.src: Alright. I'll be waiting here when you're ready!
Elemental Exercise#043.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#044.src: Go on, then. Just speak to me when you're ready to move on.
Elemental Exercise#044.dst: 그럼 가 보게. 다음으로 넘어갈 준비가 되면 말하게.
Elemental Exercise#044.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#045.src: Return to Tasim at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] for a duel.

Elemental Exercise#046.src: There you are! Are you ready for our duel?
Elemental Exercise#046.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#047.src: Alright! Let's see which of us is the better fighter!
Elemental Exercise#047.dst: 좋아! 누가 더 잘 싸우는지 보자!
Elemental Exercise#047.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#049.src: Fight Tasim in a friendly duel.

Elemental Exercise#051.src: Phew! That was a good fight. You did well, {u}. We'll have to do this again- and maybe we can get Aledar to join!
Elemental Exercise#051.dst: 휴! 좋은 승부였어. 잘했어, {u}. 또 하자. Aledar도 끼워 줄 수 있을지 몰라!
Elemental Exercise#051.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#052.src: Woo! You fought well, {u}, but it looks like I'm still better! Wait until Aledar hears about this...
Elemental Exercise#052.dst: 와! 잘 싸웠어, {u}. 그래도 내가 아직 한 수 위인가 봐! Aledar가 들으면...
Elemental Exercise#052.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#053.src: Yes, yes, fine work, the two of you. Now-
Elemental Exercise#053.dst: 그래, 그래, 둘 다 잘했네. 자, 이제...
Elemental Exercise#053.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#054.src: Captain! Captain Ragon! There's- there's corrupted forces! Advancing from {p}!
Elemental Exercise#054.dst: 대장님! Ragon 대장님! 타, 타락한 병력이! {p} 쪽에서 진격해 옵니다!
Elemental Exercise#054.speaker: Scout Evelyn

Elemental Exercise#055.src: Hm. And the Admiral is away... Very well. Mobilize the troops! We meet the forces at the north gate!
Elemental Exercise#055.dst: 흠. 제독님도 안 계신데... 좋아. 병력을 소집하라! 북문에서 맞선다!
Elemental Exercise#055.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#057.src: Captain- we're capable fighters too. Let us come along and help fight off these undead!
Elemental Exercise#057.dst: 대장님, 저희도 싸울 수 있어요. 같이 가서 언데드를 물리치게 해 주세요!
Elemental Exercise#057.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#058.src: Hm... As I see it, this is a fine opportunity for you to gain some firsthand experience! Very well. Prepare yourselves, and come to {p}' north gate when you're ready.
Elemental Exercise#058.dst: 흠... 내가 보기엔 직접 경험을 쌓을 좋은 기회로군! 좋아. 준비하고, 다 되면 {p} 북문으로 오게.
Elemental Exercise#058.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#059.src: This is exciting! But... I'm a little bit nervous, still.
Elemental Exercise#059.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#060.src: ... We'll be alright. Come on, let's go follow the captain.
Elemental Exercise#060.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#061.src: Follow Captain Ragon to {p}' north gate at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to face the undead forces.
Elemental Exercise#061.dst: Ragon 대장을 따라 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} 북문으로 가서 언데드 병력에 맞서세요.

Elemental Exercise#062.src: There you are! Ready for battle?
Elemental Exercise#062.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#063.src: I'm prepared as well. These corrupted won't stand a chance against us!
Elemental Exercise#063.dst: 저도 준비됐어요. 이 타락자들은 저희를 못 당해요!
Elemental Exercise#063.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#064.src: Yes, yes, very good. Now, it shouldn't be long until-
Elemental Exercise#064.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#066.src: Hm... Take note of the leader. I expect if we can defeat it, the rest of the forces will disperse.
Elemental Exercise#066.dst: 흠... 우두머리를 잘 보게. 저놈만 쓰러뜨리면 나머지 병력은 흩어질 걸세.
Elemental Exercise#066.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#067.src: Stronger foes such as this one will cast spells one after the other, in a specific order. These spell combos can be dangerous, so make sure to take note of them.
Elemental Exercise#067.dst: 이런 강한 적은 정해진 순서대로 주문을 연달아 쓰지. 이런 주문 연계는 위험할 수 있으니 꼭 잘 봐 두게.
Elemental Exercise#067.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#068.src: We'll be fighting all around you, so shout if you're in need of aid. Alright, soldiers, let's defend our city!
Elemental Exercise#068.dst: 우리가 사방에서 싸울 테니 도움이 필요하면 외치게. 좋아, 병사들이여, 도시를 지켜라!
Elemental Exercise#068.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#070.src: I understand. We have time until the corrupted forces arrive, so go prepare. Don't take too long, though.
Elemental Exercise#070.dst: 알겠네. 타락한 병력이 오기까지 시간이 있으니 준비하게. 너무 오래 걸리진 말고.
Elemental Exercise#070.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#071.src: Defeat the Corrupted Captain and the force threatening {p}.

Elemental Exercise#072.src: Return to the {p} Barracks and talk to Captain Ragon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Elemental Exercise#073.src: Ah, there you two are. Come here.
Elemental Exercise#073.dst: 아, 둘 다 왔군. 이리 오게.
Elemental Exercise#073.speaker: Captain Ragon

Elemental Exercise#075.src: Yes, my absence was never meant to take long. I was paying a visit to the desert city of {p}, for a meeting with an Admiral Amerigo...
Elemental Exercise#075.dst: 그래, 오래 자리를 비울 생각은 없었지. 사막 도시 {p}에 가서 Amerigo 제독과 회담을 했네...
Elemental Exercise#075.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#076.src: But I digress. I've been told the two of you were essential in the defense of our city! Excellent work.
Elemental Exercise#076.dst: 얘기가 샜군. 도시 방어에 자네 둘이 큰 몫을 했다고 들었네! 훌륭해.
Elemental Exercise#076.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#077.src: Our preparations for the assault on {p}' spider den are nearing completion. I'd like the two of you to join that mission.
Elemental Exercise#077.dst: {p}의 거미 소굴 공격 준비가 거의 끝나 가네. 자네 둘도 그 임무에 합류했으면 하네.
Elemental Exercise#077.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#078.src: Sir- are you certain? I mean, we'd be happy to join, but surely there are many others more worthy of such a task.
Elemental Exercise#078.dst: 제독님, 정말이세요? 기꺼이 가겠지만, 그 임무엔 더 적합한 분들이 많을 텐데요.
Elemental Exercise#078.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#079.src: Nonsense! Captain Ragon has assessed your skills, and has deemed them sufficient. And I trust the Captain's judgement.
Elemental Exercise#079.dst: 무슨 소리! Ragon 대장이 자네들 실력을 평가해 충분하다고 판단했네. 난 대장의 판단을 믿지.
Elemental Exercise#079.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#080.src: Now, I must be off. I'll see the two of you when it's time for the mission.
Elemental Exercise#080.dst: 자, 난 가 봐야겠네. 임무 때가 되면 다시 보세.
Elemental Exercise#080.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Elemental Exercise#081.src: A big mission to take out the spiders, huh... You know, even though I'm a little worried, I think I'm excited.
Elemental Exercise#081.dst: 거미 소탕 대작전이라... 있잖아, 좀 걱정되긴 하지만 설레는 것 같아.
Elemental Exercise#081.speaker: Tasim

Elemental Exercise#082.src: Ahem. Before the two of you return on your business, I have something for the two of you. Payment for your work today, and a special piece of equipment. Make good use of it.
Elemental Exercise#082.dst: 에헴. 둘 다 돌아가기 전에 줄 게 있네. 오늘 일의 보수와 특별한 장비 하나야. 잘 쓰게.
Elemental Exercise#082.speaker: Captain Ragon

Ensemble of Hope#000.src: Meet up with your friends in room number {~} in hotel {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#003.src: {u}'s here? Good, that means we can-
Ensemble of Hope#003.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#007.src: Ugh. ZEPH! Get out of there already!
Ensemble of Hope#007.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#008.src: C...coming! Jeez, Rex, g...give a man his p- pr- privacy...
Ensemble of Hope#008.dst: 가, 가는 중이야! 참, Rex, 사, 사생활 좀 지, 지켜 줘...
Ensemble of Hope#008.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#010.src: Rex. I'm f...fine. St- stop asking me that.
Ensemble of Hope#010.dst: Rex. 나 괘, 괜찮아. 그, 그만 좀 물어봐.
Ensemble of Hope#010.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#011.src: Okay! Okay. Gods forbid I worry about you for even a second...
Ensemble of Hope#011.dst: 알았어! 알았다고. 1초도 걱정하면 안 된다 이거지...
Ensemble of Hope#011.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#012.src: Rex. You had something to tell us.
Ensemble of Hope#012.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#013.src: Right, okay, I'll get to it. These past few days, I have been plotting. I have something... serviceable, I think.
Ensemble of Hope#013.dst: 그래, 알았어, 말할게. 요 며칠 계획을 짰거든. 꽤... 쓸 만한 게 나온 것 같아.
Ensemble of Hope#013.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#014.src: So, to start with, let's lay out our goal - the destruction of the Crown, the Queen and her Sovereigns included.
Ensemble of Hope#014.dst: 우선 목표부터 정리하자. 왕실의 파멸. 여왕과 군주들까지 전부.
Ensemble of Hope#014.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#015.src: We won't be able to do it ourselves - we're only four people. And we definitely won't be able to do it if their eyes are on us the whole time!
Ensemble of Hope#015.dst: 우리끼리는 못 해. 겨우 넷이잖아. 게다가 계속 감시당하는 상태면 절대 불가능하고!
Ensemble of Hope#015.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#016.src: Sui and {u}, you two worked with the Canopy while you were in the {p}. Do you think they have the people and resources to help us?
Ensemble of Hope#016.dst: Sui랑 {u}, 너희 {p}에 있을 때 수관이랑 같이 일했지. 그쪽에 우릴 도울 인력이랑 자원이 있을까?
Ensemble of Hope#016.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#017.src: They do. They've... been fighting openly against the crown for years and haven't been caught. So... they know what they're doing.
Ensemble of Hope#017.dst: 있어. 몇 년이나... 대놓고 왕실이랑 싸우면서 한 번도 안 잡혔어. 그러니까... 뭘 하는지 아는 사람들이야.
Ensemble of Hope#017.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#018.src: Good, we'll want to get in contact then. And Yusanu is with them, anyway... it'll be good to see him again.
Ensemble of Hope#018.dst: 좋아, 그럼 연락해 봐야지. 어차피 Yusanu도 거기 있고... 다시 보면 좋겠다.
Ensemble of Hope#018.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#020.src: But, uh, moving on. Zeph, you went out earlier and gathered some information on the {p}, right?
Ensemble of Hope#020.dst: 어, 그건 그렇고. Zeph, 아까 나가서 {p} 정보 좀 모아 왔지?
Ensemble of Hope#020.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#021.src: Y- yeah! P...people around here seem v- v- very excited for th...the festival. The C- Cr- Crown is gonna be b...busy with preparations for a wh...while.
Ensemble of Hope#021.dst: 으, 응! 이, 이 근처 사람들은 추, 축제 때문에 엄청 들떠 있어. 와, 왕실은 한동안 주, 준비로 바, 바쁠 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#021.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#022.src: B- but, uh, Rex, y...you wanted me to- to ch...check out the Dam E- Elevator, right?
Ensemble of Hope#022.dst: 그, 그런데, 어, Rex, 나한테 대, 댐 승강기 좀 사, 살펴보라고 했지?
Ensemble of Hope#022.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#023.src: I did, yep. What's the guards situation like? Heavily guarded, lightly guarded... somewhere in between?
Ensemble of Hope#023.dst: 그래, 맞아. 경비는 어때? 삼엄해, 허술해... 아니면 그 중간쯤?
Ensemble of Hope#023.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#024.src: S...somewhere in be- between, I think. Cl...closer to lightly guarded. I don't th- think they're ex- exp- expecting an... a- an attack.
Ensemble of Hope#024.dst: 주, 중간쯤인 것 같아. 허술한 쪽에 가, 가까워. 고, 공격을 예, 예, 예상하는 것 같진 않아.
Ensemble of Hope#024.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#025.src: Perfect. Perfect, perfect, perfect... so! How do we all feel about committing some light terrorism today?
Ensemble of Hope#025.dst: 완벽해. 완벽해, 완벽해, 완벽해... 자! 오늘 가벼운 테러 좀 해 보는 거 어때?
Ensemble of Hope#025.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#026.src: Okay, curb the enthusiasm a little. Let me explain why, first.
Ensemble of Hope#026.dst: 좋아, 흥분은 좀 가라앉히고. 이유부터 설명할게.
Ensemble of Hope#026.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#027.src: Ev- ever the optimist... R- Rex, why do you w...want to take the e- el-... the elevator?
Ensemble of Hope#027.dst: 여, 역시 낙천가야... R, Rex, 스, 승강기는 왜... 왜 점령하려는 거야?
Ensemble of Hope#027.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#028.src: Like we haven't done worse already... um, why the elevator, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.dst: 더한 짓도 해 놓고 새삼... 음, 왜 승강기야, Rex?
Ensemble of Hope#028.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#029.src: We need to get the Crown's eyes off of us. They won't expect us to try to return to the {p} - why would we? The enemy is right here.
Ensemble of Hope#029.dst: 왕실의 눈을 우리한테서 돌려야 해. 우리가 {p}에 돌아갈 거라곤 생각 못 하겠지. 적은 바로 여기 있으니까.
Ensemble of Hope#029.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#030.src: So what happens when we do? They'll start thinking. Why are we doing it? What do we have to gain?
Ensemble of Hope#030.dst: 그럼 막상 돌아가면? 고민하기 시작하겠지. 왜 저러지? 뭘 노리는 거지?
Ensemble of Hope#030.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#031.src: They'll start to pay attention to that elevator. And, if we're lucky, less attention on what we're actually doing.
Ensemble of Hope#031.dst: 그럼 승강기에 신경을 쓸 거고, 운이 좋으면 우리가 진짜 하는 일엔 덜 신경 쓰겠지.
Ensemble of Hope#031.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#032.src: ...and, well, maybe if we're fast, we could bring some friends up from Auburn to us. We could use all the help we can get.
Ensemble of Hope#032.dst: ...그리고, 음, 빠르면 Auburn에 있는 친구들을 여기로 데려올 수도 있어. 도움은 많을수록 좋잖아.
Ensemble of Hope#032.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#033.src: Th...that- that sounds nice... it- it's been s...so long already...
Ensemble of Hope#033.dst: 그, 그거 좋다... 버, 벌써 너, 너무 오래됐어...
Ensemble of Hope#033.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#035.src: Sui... do you think you and Zeph could handle getting the rest of the Leaves up here? Zeph'll need someone who knows how to find the Canopy, and I need {u} with me.
Ensemble of Hope#035.dst: Sui... Zeph랑 같이 남은 잎새들을 데려올 수 있겠어? Zeph한텐 수관 찾는 법 아는 사람이 필요하고, {u}는 나랑 같이 가야 해.
Ensemble of Hope#035.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#038.src: Well, we'll all be going to take control of the elevator anyway. We can... talk more there.
Ensemble of Hope#038.dst: 뭐, 승강기 점령은 어차피 다 같이 가니까. 자세한 얘긴... 거기서 하자.
Ensemble of Hope#038.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#039.src: {u}, after we've don that, I'll need you to take me to the Canopy. I want to familiarize myself with their leadership, and start working on an actual plan.
Ensemble of Hope#039.dst: {u}, 그게 끝나면 나를 수관에 데려가 줘. 지도부랑 안면도 트고, 제대로 된 계획을 짜기 시작하고 싶어.
Ensemble of Hope#039.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#040.src: Okay! I think that's everything. Let's all get ready, then head to that elevator on the southern side of the dam!
Ensemble of Hope#040.dst: 좋아! 이 정도면 다 된 것 같아. 다들 준비하고, 댐 남쪽 승강기로 가자!
Ensemble of Hope#040.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#043.src: Hi, {u}. Ready to fight more of the crown's soldiers?
Ensemble of Hope#043.dst: 안녕, {u}. 왕실 병사들이랑 또 싸울 준비 됐어?
Ensemble of Hope#043.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#047.src: We... have Rex and Zeph back. We're going to reunite with the people we left behind in Auburn. We're going to meet back with the Canopy.
Ensemble of Hope#047.dst: Rex랑 Zeph를... 되찾았어. Auburn에 두고 온 사람들이랑 다시 만날 거고. 수관이랑도 합류할 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#047.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#049.src: Really? And why would that be?!
Ensemble of Hope#049.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#050.src: It's not like- n-not like someone's MISSING! OR ANYTHING!!
Ensemble of Hope#050.dst: 누가 사라지기라도- 사, 사라지기라도 한 것도 아니고! 안 그래?!
Ensemble of Hope#050.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#051.src: So- s-so maybe I'm not. But it doesn't matter. We have things we need to get done, {u}! I don't have time to- to feel not fine!!
Ensemble of Hope#051.dst: 그, 그래 안 괜찮을지도 몰라. 근데 상관없어. 우린 할 일이 있잖아, {u}! 안 괜찮을- 여유 같은 거 없어!!
Ensemble of Hope#051.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#053.src: Don't push this... please? Just... let's follow Rex's plan.
Ensemble of Hope#053.dst: 더 캐묻지 마... 응? 그냥... Rex 계획대로 하자.
Ensemble of Hope#053.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#054.src: It's... fine. Solid plan, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#054.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#055.src: I couldn't think of anything better at least, so...
Ensemble of Hope#055.dst: 적어도 난 더 나은 건 생각 못 했으니까...
Ensemble of Hope#055.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#056.src: And, um, I'm not the- the tactician, anyway. I'm... glad I don't have to worry about that anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#056.dst: 그리고, 음, 난 어차피 전술가도- 아니고. 이제 그런 걱정 안 해도 돼서... 다행이야.
Ensemble of Hope#056.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#059.src: I... don't really want to face Yusanu again. After... um. You know.
Ensemble of Hope#059.dst: Yusanu를... 다시 마주하기 싫어. 그 일... 이후로. 알잖아.
Ensemble of Hope#059.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#060.src: But... I have to do it eventually. So.
Ensemble of Hope#060.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#061.src: Yeah. Let's... get a move on.
Ensemble of Hope#061.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#062.src: ...ready for phase one of the plan, {u}? Let's pack up quickly and head out.
Ensemble of Hope#062.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#064.src: You know... still awful. But, uh... better, I guess.
Ensemble of Hope#064.dst: 그게... 아직 엉망이야. 그래도, 어... 나아진 것 같아.
Ensemble of Hope#064.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#065.src: I haven't left the hotel these past few days... but even just getting real food has felt like... like a gourmet meal!
Ensemble of Hope#065.dst: 요 며칠 호텔 밖에 안 나갔는데... 제대로 된 음식만 먹어도... 무슨 고급 요리 같더라!
Ensemble of Hope#065.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#066.src: It's... hm. I've tried to not really... think about it too much. I'll have time for that when we're not still in danger.
Ensemble of Hope#066.dst: 그건... 음. 너무 깊이... 생각하지 않으려고 해. 위험에서 벗어나면 그때 생각할 시간이 있겠지.
Ensemble of Hope#066.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#067.src: But, Zeph... he's been isolating himself. Him and Sui both!
Ensemble of Hope#067.dst: 근데 Zeph가... 혼자 틀어박혀 있어. Sui도 그렇고!
Ensemble of Hope#067.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#068.src: Sigh... it's hard. Whenever I talk to him, he tries to put on his regular happy persona, but...
Ensemble of Hope#068.dst: 하아... 힘들어. 말을 걸면 평소처럼 밝은 척하는데, 그게...
Ensemble of Hope#068.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#069.src: I don't know. Obviously things have changed - I don't think you get out of - ha, what was it, weeks? - of imprisonment unaffected.
Ensemble of Hope#069.dst: 모르겠어. 뭔가 달라진 건 분명해. 그렇게- 하, 몇 주였지? 갇혀 있다 나오면 멀쩡할 리가 없지.
Ensemble of Hope#069.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#070.src: ...he's resilient. Sui too. We'll be able to work past this. It's just... going to take time.
Ensemble of Hope#070.dst: ...걘 강해. Sui도. 우린 이겨낼 수 있어. 그냥... 시간이 걸릴 뿐이야.
Ensemble of Hope#070.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#071.src: Still workshopping it! I have a couple of different ideas, but...
Ensemble of Hope#071.dst: 아직 다듬는 중! 몇 가지 아이디어는 있는데...
Ensemble of Hope#071.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#072.src: Well, it's hard to know which will work without knowing what the Canopy has. Too many different things to consider.
Ensemble of Hope#072.dst: 수관이 뭘 가졌는지 모르니까 뭐가 먹힐지 알기 어려워. 따질 게 너무 많아.
Ensemble of Hope#072.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#073.src: When we join up with them, I'm hoping I can fill in the gaps. And... I guess, get their opinions on it, too.
Ensemble of Hope#073.dst: 합류하면 빈틈을 채울 수 있으면 좋겠어. 그리고... 그쪽 의견도 들어 보고.
Ensemble of Hope#073.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#074.src: So- all that to say, I've got nothing for you! For now. I'll tell you later, okay?
Ensemble of Hope#074.dst: 그러니까- 결론은, 지금은 해 줄 말이 없다는 거! 일단은. 나중에 말해 줄게, 알았지?
Ensemble of Hope#074.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#076.src: I... don't know what to do. I really, really don't.
Ensemble of Hope#076.dst: 나... 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어. 진짜, 진짜 모르겠어.
Ensemble of Hope#076.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#077.src: We've... ugh, we've all lost people. Lots of Leaves got arrested for... this or that, over the years. It sucked, but... it happened.
Ensemble of Hope#077.dst: 우린... 으, 다들 누군가를 잃었어. 몇 년간 잎새도 이런저런 이유로 많이 잡혀갔지. 끔찍했지만... 그런 일이 있었어.
Ensemble of Hope#077.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#078.src: ...it's never been this bad before. Never anyone this close. I mean... sigh. Syndra and Mora. Gods.
Ensemble of Hope#078.dst: ...이렇게까지 심했던 적은 없어. 이렇게 가까운 사람은. 그러니까... 하아. Syndra랑 Mora. 세상에.
Ensemble of Hope#078.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#079.src: I want to help her get through this, but... she's closing herself off. And... we're still not home free just yet.
Ensemble of Hope#079.dst: Sui가 이겨내게 돕고 싶은데... 마음을 닫아 버렸어. 게다가... 아직 안전한 것도 아니고.
Ensemble of Hope#079.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#080.src: ...when it's over. When it's over. Everything will be okay when it's over.
Ensemble of Hope#080.dst: ...다 끝나면. 다 끝나면. 끝나기만 하면 다 괜찮아질 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#080.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#083.src: I'm r-ready to see my old friends again... I miss Kaio.
Ensemble of Hope#083.dst: 옛 친구들을 다, 다시 볼 준비 됐어... Kaio가 보고 싶어.
Ensemble of Hope#083.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#084.src: Was there s-something on your mind?
Ensemble of Hope#084.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#085.src: Ah... I... I don't want to lie to you.
Ensemble of Hope#085.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#086.src: So... I'm not d-doing great. Everytime I... I close my eyes I s-see that... face. The S-sovereign...
Ensemble of Hope#086.dst: 그러니까... 나 별로 괘, 괜찮지 않아. 눈을... 감을 때마다 그... 얼굴이 보, 보여. 그 군, 군주가...
Ensemble of Hope#086.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#087.src: Everytime I close my e-eyes I feel all that pain. All of it! All the m-memories!
Ensemble of Hope#087.dst: 눈을 가, 감을 때마다 그 고통이 다 느껴져. 전부! 그 기, 기억이 전부!
Ensemble of Hope#087.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#088.src: I was... okay with it all e-ending there.
Ensemble of Hope#088.dst: 그땐... 거기서 다 끄, 끝나도 괜찮았어.
Ensemble of Hope#088.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#089.src: I know that i-it's over. I know Gikyo is dead but... their ghost still h-haunts me.
Ensemble of Hope#089.dst: 끄, 끝난 건 알아. Gikyo가 죽은 것도 알지만... 그 망령이 아직 나를 따, 따라다녀.
Ensemble of Hope#089.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#090.src: I think it's a s-solid plan.
Ensemble of Hope#090.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#091.src: I j-just wonder how many from the Leaves in the Wind are willing to a-actually come all the way here.
Ensemble of Hope#091.dst: 바람 속 잎새에서 정말 여기까지 와 주려는 사람이 얼마나 될지 그, 그게 궁금할 뿐이야.
Ensemble of Hope#091.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#094.src: Well, here we are. The dam really is something to behold, isn't it...
Ensemble of Hope#094.dst: 자, 도착했다. 댐은 정말 볼 만하지 않아...
Ensemble of Hope#094.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#095.src: I- I always d..did wonder what it'd b- b- be like to... to t...take this elevator...
Ensemble of Hope#095.dst: 나, 나 늘 이 승강기를 타, 타, 타면 어떨지... 구, 궁금했어...
Ensemble of Hope#095.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#096.src: Well, you'll finally get your chance. Come on, let's just fight already.
Ensemble of Hope#096.dst: 드디어 기회가 왔네. 자, 그냥 싸우자.
Ensemble of Hope#096.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#098.src: What? We can't rush this? The longer we wait, the more suspicious they'll get.
Ensemble of Hope#098.dst: 뭐? 서두르면 안 돼? 오래 기다릴수록 저쪽만 더 의심할 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#098.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#102.src: Defeat the soldiers defending the elevator at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#104.src: Careful! Looks like they've got backup!
Ensemble of Hope#104.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#106.src: H...how many p- people can they fit in th- th- that elevator?!
Ensemble of Hope#106.dst: 저, 저 승강기에 사람이 대체 며, 몇, 몇 명이나 타는 거야?!
Ensemble of Hope#106.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#108.src: You're the insurgents everyone is on the lookout for! MEN, TO ARMS! CAPTURE THEM!
Ensemble of Hope#108.dst: 모두가 쫓는 반란분자들이 너희로구나! 전원, 무기를 들어라! 생포하라!
Ensemble of Hope#108.speaker: Wings Commander Kaezu

Ensemble of Hope#109.src: Talk to the group again at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#111.src: Sigh. Whatever. Let's go... get our people.
Ensemble of Hope#111.dst: 하아. 됐어. 가자... 우리 사람들 데리러.
Ensemble of Hope#111.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#114.src: Sui, are you INSANE?! You almost got SHOT!
Ensemble of Hope#114.dst: Sui, 너 미쳤어?! 화살 맞을 뻔했잖아!
Ensemble of Hope#114.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#116.src: You turned your back when there were enemies still around!! What do you think would have happened if we weren't here?
Ensemble of Hope#116.dst: 적이 아직 있는데 등을 돌려?! 우리가 없었으면 어떻게 됐을 것 같아?
Ensemble of Hope#116.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#118.src: Shot. If you were lucky, somewhere that wouldn't have killed - but after what they saw, would they have really taken that risk?!
Ensemble of Hope#118.dst: 화살 맞았지. 운 좋으면 안 죽을 데 맞았겠지만, 그 꼴을 본 놈들이 그런 위험을 감수했겠어?!
Ensemble of Hope#118.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#120.src: Sui, stop being so reckless. You're... you're strong, I get that, but... that doesn't mean you're invincible.
Ensemble of Hope#120.dst: Sui, 그렇게 무모하게 굴지 마. 넌... 강해, 알아, 근데... 그렇다고 무적은 아니야.
Ensemble of Hope#120.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#121.src: S...Sui, we don't w- want to l- lo- lose you too...
Ensemble of Hope#121.dst: S, Sui, 너, 너까지 이, 잃고 싶지 않아...
Ensemble of Hope#121.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#122.src: But if I'm not good enough, if I'm not f-fast enough, then- then- then I'll lose you, and- and I can't, I can't do that again, I-
Ensemble of Hope#122.dst: 근데 내가 부족하면, 내가 빠, 빠르지 못하면, 그럼- 그럼- 너희를 잃을 거고, 그건- 그건 또 못 해, 못 한다고, 난-
Ensemble of Hope#122.speaker: Sui

Ensemble of Hope#125.src: You don't need to prove yourself. You've always been good enough for us.
Ensemble of Hope#125.dst: 증명할 필요 없어. 넌 우리한테 늘 충분했어.
Ensemble of Hope#125.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#126.src: Whatever that- that Sovereign said to you, to make you think everything's that's happened to us is your fault? It's not true!
Ensemble of Hope#126.dst: 그- 그 군주가 무슨 말을 해서 우리한테 생긴 일이 다 네 탓이라고 생각하게 됐든, 그건 사실이 아냐!
Ensemble of Hope#126.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#127.src: Sui. Sui. Mora's death is not your fault!! We can blame the crown, blame the Sovereigns- hell, blame me for leaving him there!!!
Ensemble of Hope#127.dst: Sui. Sui. Mora가 죽은 건 네 탓이 아냐!! 왕실 탓, 군주들 탓- 젠장, 걔를 두고 온 내 탓을 해!!!
Ensemble of Hope#127.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#128.src: But it wasn't your responsibility to protect him. To protect us. We're a team - a family, and... and I don't want to see you burn yourself to ash like Syndra did.
Ensemble of Hope#128.dst: 걔를 지키는 건 네 책임이 아니었어. 우리를 지키는 것도. 우린 팀이야- 가족이고... Syndra처럼 네가 스스로를 재가 될 때까지 태우는 건 보기 싫어.
Ensemble of Hope#128.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#130.src: R...Rex is r- right, Sui. We can... f- fi- fight together, sh...shore up each o- oth... each other's w...weaknesses.
Ensemble of Hope#130.dst: R, Rex 말이 맞아, Sui. 우린... 가, 같이 싸우면서, 서, 서로의 야, 약점을 채워 줄 수 있어.
Ensemble of Hope#130.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#132.src: ...b- but we should pr...probably get going, Sui, b- before more backup sh...shows up.
Ensemble of Hope#132.dst: ...그, 그래도 지원군이 더 오기 전에 이, 이제 가야 할 것 같아, Sui.
Ensemble of Hope#132.speaker: Zeph

Ensemble of Hope#133.src: Sigh. Zeph's right. You guys hurry to the Leaves, while we have the chance. {u} and I will prepare for your return.
Ensemble of Hope#133.dst: 하아. Zeph 말이 맞아. 기회 있을 때 얼른 잎새한테 가. {u}랑 난 너희 돌아올 준비를 할게.
Ensemble of Hope#133.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#135.src: Y... yeah. You're right, we should go too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#135.dst: 그... 그래. 네 말이 맞아, 우리도 가야지. 가자, 수관 동굴에서 만나.
Ensemble of Hope#135.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#136.src: A little. But... I don't know how else to get through to her.
Ensemble of Hope#136.dst: 조금. 근데... 걔한테 닿을 방법을 모르겠어.
Ensemble of Hope#136.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#137.src: It's so... frustrating! Seeing her taking on all of Syndra's worst traits! I- I know what to look out for, this time, but...
Ensemble of Hope#137.dst: 진짜... 답답해! Syndra의 제일 나쁜 점만 다 닮아 가는 걸 보니까! 이번엔- 뭘 조심할지는 아는데...
Ensemble of Hope#137.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#138.src: ...but I still don't know what to do.
Ensemble of Hope#138.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#139.src: Ha. Maybe I should apply my own advice to myself...
Ensemble of Hope#139.dst: 하. 내 충고나 내가 새겨들어야 하나...
Ensemble of Hope#139.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#140.src: We should get moving too. Come on, let's meet at the Canopy's cave.
Ensemble of Hope#140.dst: 우리도 출발하자. 가자, 수관 동굴에서 만나.
Ensemble of Hope#140.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#141.src: Travel to the {p} and find the Canopy in their new hideout at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#145.src: Oh, good grief. Look more closely, foxes - these are familiar faces! Or rather, familiar face, I should say - welcome back to the Canopy, {u}! And who might this be?
Ensemble of Hope#145.dst: 어머나, 세상에. 잘 봐요, 여우들 - 아는 얼굴이잖아요! 아니, 아는 얼굴 하나죠 - 수관에 돌아온 걸 환영해요, {u}! 그리고 이분은 누구시죠?
Ensemble of Hope#145.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#146.src: ...you're Captain Rurie, right? Sui told us about you.
Ensemble of Hope#146.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#147.src: Did she! Then that must mean you are one of the dear captured friends - no no, don't tell me, I can figure it out... Rex, I assume?
Ensemble of Hope#147.dst: 그랬어요! 그럼 붙잡혔던 소중한 친구 중 하나겠군요 - 아니 아니, 말하지 마요, 맞힐게요... Rex, 맞죠?
Ensemble of Hope#147.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#148.src: Hm... now, I would bring you in, but then Fuhue might have my head for not following her many numerous protocols... and we certainly can't have that...
Ensemble of Hope#148.dst: 음... 들여보내고 싶지만, 그러면 수많은 규정을 안 지켰다고 Fuhue가 내 목을 칠지도... 그건 곤란하죠...
Ensemble of Hope#148.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#149.src: Ugh, just let them in, Rurie. We've been breaking initiation protocols left and right already, I can't be bothered enforcing them anymore.
Ensemble of Hope#149.dst: 으, 그냥 들여보내요, Rurie. 입단 규정은 이미 여기저기 다 어겼어요. 이제 지키게 할 기운도 없어요.
Ensemble of Hope#149.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#150.src: Well, would you look at that! Lucky you! Come on in, come on in. Our numbers have grown since last you were here, {u} - many more friendly faces hanging about!
Ensemble of Hope#150.dst: 어머, 이것 좀 봐요! 운이 좋네요! 들어와요, 들어와. 지난번 이후로 식구가 늘었어요, {u} - 반가운 얼굴이 훨씬 많답니다!
Ensemble of Hope#150.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#151.src: {u}, Rex!! Man, it's good to see you guys!!
Ensemble of Hope#151.dst: {u}, Rex!! 와, 너희 보니까 진짜 좋다!!
Ensemble of Hope#151.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#152.src: Yuman?! What're you doing here? I thought they had you locked up in-
Ensemble of Hope#152.dst: Yuman?! 여기서 뭐 해? 너 갇혀 있는 줄 알았는데-
Ensemble of Hope#152.speaker: Rex

Ensemble of Hope#153.src: In Deraj Prison, yup. Everything they say about it is true- and, and more! They get you workin' in the mines, if you're not... eh, y'know. Disappeared.
Ensemble of Hope#153.dst: Deraj 감옥에, 그래. 소문 전부 사실이더라- 아니, 그 이상! 안... 어, 알잖아. 사라지지 않으면 광산에서 굴려.
Ensemble of Hope#153.speaker: Yuman
