Ensemble of Hope#583.dst: 그래서 뭐!!! 내가 Flowers가 조금씩 조금씩 망가지는 걸 봐야 했으면 뭐!!! 그 여자가 날 영원히 영원히 영원히 여기 가둬 두면 뭐!!!
Ensemble of Hope#583.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#584.src: It's all just the same. Not alive, not dead, just STUCK!! Only this time, it's all out in the open for everyone to see.
Ensemble of Hope#584.dst: 다 똑같아. 살지도, 죽지도 않고, 그냥 갇혀 있어!! 이번엔 모두가 보는 앞에 드러났다는 것뿐.
Ensemble of Hope#584.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#585.src: So who cares. Really, who cares? Z'll run my district better than I ever did. That's all anyone cares about, anyway.
Ensemble of Hope#585.dst: 그러니 누가 신경 써. 진짜, 누가 신경 쓰냐고? Z가 내 구역을 나보다 잘 다스리겠지. 어차피 다들 그것만 신경 쓰잖아.
Ensemble of Hope#585.speaker: Soosu

Ensemble of Hope#587.src: Once more we meet, {u}. Though this time, it seems you have played the first hand.
Ensemble of Hope#587.dst: 또 만났군, {u}. 이번엔 네가 먼저 패를 낸 모양이군.
Ensemble of Hope#587.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#588.src: So, this is the path you wish to take? A risk, certainly... you cannot guarantee a favorable result.
Ensemble of Hope#588.dst: 그래, 이게 네가 택한 길인가? 분명 위험하지... 좋은 결과는 보장할 수 없다.
Ensemble of Hope#588.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#589.src: Will it pay off, I wonder? Or have you thrown your life away for nothing?
Ensemble of Hope#589.dst: 과연 보상받을까? 아니면 헛되이 목숨을 내던진 걸까?
Ensemble of Hope#589.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#590.src: ...I suppose we'll find out in due time.
Ensemble of Hope#590.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#591.src: These cells are quite the marvel, aren't they? A complex netting which suppresses all magic within. It's almost like a dead zone in the Weave... but not quite.
Ensemble of Hope#591.dst: 이 감방들은 대단하지 않나? 안의 모든 마법을 억누르는 정교한 그물. 직조 속 사각지대와 거의 같지... 완전히는 아니지만.
Ensemble of Hope#591.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#592.src: It's remarkable work, Soosu. I'd never seen anything like it before. It has certainly proven useful many times in the decades since its invention.
Ensemble of Hope#592.dst: 훌륭한 작품이다, Soosu. 이런 건 처음 봤지. 발명 이후 수십 년간 분명 여러 번 쓸모를 증명했고.
Ensemble of Hope#592.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#593.src: Have you reconsidered my proposal yet? The option remains open, as always.
Ensemble of Hope#593.dst: 내 제안은 다시 생각해 봤나? 선택지는 늘 그렇듯 열려 있다.
Ensemble of Hope#593.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#595.src: Hm. Well, regardless, I should inform you that Her Majesty is scheduled for another visit tonight.
Ensemble of Hope#595.dst: 흠. 뭐, 어쨌든 알려 두지. 오늘 밤 여왕 폐하께서 또 방문하실 예정이다.
Ensemble of Hope#595.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#598.src: You are very fortunate, {u}, that I'm the one here to collect you. You'll have your audience with Her Majesty.
Ensemble of Hope#598.dst: 운이 좋군, {u}. 널 데리러 온 게 나라서. 여왕 폐하를 알현하게 될 거다.
Ensemble of Hope#598.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#599.src: Let's see if your gamble pays off, shall we?
Ensemble of Hope#599.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#600.src: Follow Two and have a conversation with Her Majesty.

Ensemble of Hope#603.src: Oh, for heavens' sake- Spymaster, what is the meaning of this?! Why are they here?
Ensemble of Hope#603.dst: 어머, 맙소사- 첩보 대장, 이게 무슨 짓이죠?! 저자가 왜 여기 있어요?
Ensemble of Hope#603.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#604.src: They had requested an audience with Her Majesty. A possibility which had been communicated to them prior.
Ensemble of Hope#604.dst: 여왕 폐하 알현을 요청했다. 사전에 가능성을 전달해 둔 일이지.
Ensemble of Hope#604.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#605.src: What is this miscalculation?! We are all together with the murderer, they've got zero chance to win! Your Majesty, ple-
Ensemble of Hope#605.dst: 이게 무슨 계산 착오야?! 살인자랑 우리가 다 같이 있잖아, 놈의 승산은 0이야! 폐하, 부디-
Ensemble of Hope#605.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#606.src: Sovereign Nasin, I have just about had enough of your interruptions today. I will permit them this audience.
Ensemble of Hope#606.dst: 군주 Nasin, 오늘 네 끼어들기는 참을 만큼 참았다. 이 알현을 허락하겠다.
Ensemble of Hope#606.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#607.src: You have been a thorn in my side ever since you first arrived in my province, it would seem. Quite the annoyance.
Ensemble of Hope#607.dst: 내 지방에 처음 발을 들인 뒤로 줄곧 내 옆구리의 가시였던 모양이구나. 참으로 성가시다.
Ensemble of Hope#607.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#608.src: And it would seem it is indeed your presence which has galvanized each assorted group of petulant children into action!
Ensemble of Hope#608.dst: 게다가 온갖 떼쟁이 무리를 들쑤셔 움직이게 한 것도 결국 네 존재였던 모양이고!
Ensemble of Hope#608.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#609.src: So perhaps my dear Sovereign is right. Why should I grant you this allowance? I would be well within my right to execute you alongside your companions.
Ensemble of Hope#609.dst: 그러니 내 군주의 말이 옳을지도 모르지. 내가 왜 이런 아량을 베풀어야 하느냐? 네 동료들과 함께 처형해도 될 일이다.
Ensemble of Hope#609.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#610.src: And yet, certainly, you would prove a valuable ally in the coming days. You've proven your value in maintaining Their balance.
Ensemble of Hope#610.dst: 허나 앞으로 다가올 날에 너는 분명 귀한 동맹이 될 것이다. 그분들의 균형을 지키는 데 네 가치를 증명했으니.
Ensemble of Hope#610.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#611.src: But in the end, it falls on you to prove whether or not you are worth the effort. You have come here willingly, which is the first step. Now, take the second.
Ensemble of Hope#611.dst: 하지만 결국 네가 그만한 가치가 있는지는 네가 증명해야 한다. 제 발로 온 것이 첫걸음이다. 이제 두 번째 걸음을 내디뎌라.
Ensemble of Hope#611.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#612.src: Oh, I suppose it makes no difference if you know or not. Either you are aligned with us, or you are out of the picture entirely.
Ensemble of Hope#612.dst: 아, 네가 알든 모르든 상관없겠지. 우리 편에 서든가, 아니면 완전히 사라지든가.
Ensemble of Hope#612.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#613.src: What are we planning? To delve deep into the Dark's Claim itself, to root out the source of its added weight on the scales.
Ensemble of Hope#613.dst: 무엇을 계획하느냐고? 어둠의 영토 깊숙이 들어가, 천칭에 더해진 그 무게의 근원을 뿌리 뽑는 것이다.
Ensemble of Hope#613.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#614.src: It has acquired power beyond its means, and if it is not dealt with, that little parasite you killed will prove only the beginning of its conquest.
Ensemble of Hope#614.dst: 그것은 분수에 넘치는 힘을 손에 넣었고, 막지 않으면 네가 죽인 그 작은 기생충은 정복의 시작에 불과할 것이다.
Ensemble of Hope#614.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#615.src: Therein lies the reason for the tournament, all those weeks ago. To select a candidate for the task. Powerful, knowledgeable, loyal.
Ensemble of Hope#615.dst: 몇 주 전 그 대회를 연 이유가 거기 있다. 이 임무를 맡을 후보를 뽑기 위해. 강하고, 박식하고, 충성스러운 자를.
Ensemble of Hope#615.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#616.src: And so, for one final time, I will give this opportunity to you. Show me whether you may be considered an asset, or if you are nothing more than the nuisance you have shown yourself to be.
Ensemble of Hope#616.dst: 그러니 마지막으로 이 기회를 주겠다. 네가 자산으로 여길 만한 자인지, 아니면 지금껏 보여 준 대로 골칫거리에 불과한지 보여 봐라.
Ensemble of Hope#616.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#617.src: How, indeed... you have cost me two of my Sovereigns thus far, have disrupted the yearly Festival rotation, and have killed dozens of my soldiers.
Ensemble of Hope#617.dst: 어떻게라... 넌 지금껏 내 군주 둘을 잃게 했고, 매년 축제 순환을 어지럽혔고, 내 병사 수십을 죽였다.
Ensemble of Hope#617.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#618.src: It is no simple task, making up for such acts. And I would require significant assurance that it will not happen again.
Ensemble of Hope#618.dst: 그런 짓을 만회하기란 쉽지 않다. 그리고 다시는 그런 일이 없으리란 확실한 보증도 필요하다.
Ensemble of Hope#618.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#619.src: Perhaps, the truth of the matter is that you cannot. You have cause me far, far too many problems to simply-
Ensemble of Hope#619.dst: 어쩌면 사실 넌 그럴 수 없는지도 모르지. 네가 일으킨 문제가 너무, 너무 많아서 그저-
Ensemble of Hope#619.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#620.src: They are very simple. Denounce your allies, and allow this little rebellion to be washed away once more, as it has many times before.
Ensemble of Hope#620.dst: 아주 간단하다. 동료들을 저버려라. 그리고 이 작은 반란이 늘 그랬듯 다시 한번 씻겨 나가게 두어라.
Ensemble of Hope#620.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#621.src: You are not special, you know. The people do have the knack for rising up in such childish tantrums. But as has been proven time and time again, nothing is beyond my means to bury.
Ensemble of Hope#621.dst: 넌 특별하지 않다. 백성들은 그런 유치한 떼를 쓰며 들고일어나는 재주가 있지. 허나 몇 번이고 증명되었듯, 내가 묻어 버리지 못할 것은 없다.
Ensemble of Hope#621.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#622.src: So. What will it be? Have you come to your senses? Or-
Ensemble of Hope#622.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#623.src: A disappointing outcome... but not altogether unexpected. I did not think you would change your stance so quickly.
Ensemble of Hope#623.dst: 실망스러운 결과로구나... 전혀 예상 못 한 건 아니다만. 네가 그리 빨리 입장을 바꾸리라 생각지 않았다.
Ensemble of Hope#623.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#624.src: Truly, then, all you have done is wasted my time. And that, I am afraid I will not abide.
Ensemble of Hope#624.dst: 그렇다면 정말이지, 넌 내 시간만 낭비했구나. 그리고 그건 용납할 수 없다.
Ensemble of Hope#624.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#625.src: You will not see the light of day again, {u}. Your allies will fall, and you will not see it happen, but you will know-
Ensemble of Hope#625.dst: 다시는 햇빛을 보지 못할 것이다, {u}. 네 동료들은 쓰러질 것이고, 넌 그걸 보지 못하겠지만, 알게는 될 것이다-
Ensemble of Hope#625.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#626.src: Sovereigns! Your Majesty! The terrorists...they have launched an assault on the Citadel gates!
Ensemble of Hope#626.dst: 군주님들! 폐하! 테러리스트들이... 성채 정문을 공격하고 있습니다!
Ensemble of Hope#626.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Ensemble of Hope#627.src: And the people of {p}...they are in a panic from a dissident's proclamation...the imminent death of a Sovereign!
Ensemble of Hope#627.dst: 그리고 {p} 백성들이... 반역자의 선언에 공황 상태입니다... 군주 한 분의 죽음이 임박했다고!
Ensemble of Hope#627.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Ensemble of Hope#628.src: ANOTHER?! I swear, if we ignore a statement of that value-
Ensemble of Hope#628.dst: 또?! 맹세하는데, 그만한 값의 명제를 무시했다간-
Ensemble of Hope#628.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Ensemble of Hope#630.src: Commander, explain the situation on the way. Worry not, Your Majesty, I'll take care to ensure the fruition of our discussed plans for the festival.
Ensemble of Hope#630.dst: 사령관, 가면서 상황을 설명해요. 걱정 마세요, 폐하, 축제를 위해 논의한 계획은 제가 반드시 실현하겠어요.
Ensemble of Hope#630.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Ensemble of Hope#632.src: A clever ploy, I will grant you that. But I tire of these games. You have proven yourself a waste of effort. You will be afforded no more opportunities.
Ensemble of Hope#632.dst: 영리한 책략이군, 그건 인정하마. 허나 이런 놀음엔 질렸다. 넌 들인 공이 아까운 자임을 증명했다. 더 이상 기회는 없다.
Ensemble of Hope#632.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#633.src: Sovereign Two, I expect you to dispose of this problem of ours.
Ensemble of Hope#633.dst: 군주 Two, 우리의 이 문제를 처리하도록.
Ensemble of Hope#633.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#634.src: In the meantime... it would seem the populace has forgotten who holds control in this province. Perhaps they could use a reminder.
Ensemble of Hope#634.dst: 그동안... 백성들이 이 지방을 누가 다스리는지 잊은 모양이구나. 일깨워 줄 필요가 있겠다.
Ensemble of Hope#634.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#635.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, Sovereign Tasim. I expect the two of you to join me for the festival.
Ensemble of Hope#635.dst: 군주 Zhiraok, 군주 Tasim. 너희 둘은 나와 함께 축제에 가자.
Ensemble of Hope#635.speaker: Her Majesty

Ensemble of Hope#638.src: ...this is really where you choose to stand your ground?
Ensemble of Hope#638.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Ensemble of Hope#640.src: ...I hope you know what you're doing.
Ensemble of Hope#640.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Ensemble of Hope#643.src: How fortunate for you. It seems the cards keep falling in your favour.
Ensemble of Hope#643.dst: 운이 좋군. 패가 계속 네게 유리하게 떨어지는 모양이다.
Ensemble of Hope#643.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#644.src: Do not get ahead of yourself. I am still deciding.
Ensemble of Hope#644.dst: 앞서 나가지 마라. 난 아직 결정하는 중이다.
Ensemble of Hope#644.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#645.src: It would be simpler to dispose of you now. Every notion, each flaw - you have proven them true countless times over.
Ensemble of Hope#645.dst: 지금 널 처리하는 편이 간단하겠지. 모든 추론, 모든 결함 - 넌 수없이 그것들이 옳음을 증명했다.
Ensemble of Hope#645.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#646.src: What use do I have for an unpredictable actor, when there are many more reliable options resting in the wings?
Ensemble of Hope#646.dst: 대기 중인 믿을 만한 선택지가 훨씬 많은데, 예측할 수 없는 배우가 내게 무슨 쓸모지?
Ensemble of Hope#646.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#647.src: But now that you are a known variable, in your absence, it would seem the shards destabilize. Why? I cannot fathom the reason.
Ensemble of Hope#647.dst: 하지만 네가 알려진 변수가 된 지금, 네가 없으면 파편들이 불안정해지는 듯하다. 왜지? 이유를 헤아릴 수 없다.
Ensemble of Hope#647.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#648.src: Then I am left with only one option. It is unfavorable... but I suppose it will have to do.
Ensemble of Hope#648.dst: 그렇다면 남은 선택지는 하나뿐. 달갑지 않지만... 어쩔 수 없겠지.
Ensemble of Hope#648.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#649.src: You will bear witness to the uncountable shards of shattered futures. You will see the coming end. And you will prove to me you are a worthwhile alternative.
Ensemble of Hope#649.dst: 넌 산산이 조각난 미래의 셀 수 없는 파편을 목격할 것이다. 다가올 종말을 보게 될 것이다. 그리고 네가 가치 있는 대안임을 증명해라.
Ensemble of Hope#649.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#650.src: Enter Two's mirror. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#652.src: Is this your reflection? Emptiness? A bottomless well where your self should be stored?
Ensemble of Hope#652.dst: 이게 네 비친 모습인가? 공허? 네 자아가 담겨야 할 자리에 바닥 없는 우물이?
Ensemble of Hope#652.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#653.src: And yet, you seem hardly affected by the lack... how peculiar. Is this the source of your strength?
Ensemble of Hope#653.dst: 그런데도 그 결핍에 거의 흔들리지 않는군... 기이하다. 이게 네 힘의 원천인가?
Ensemble of Hope#653.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#654.src: How very troubling. But for now... it will do nicely. Perhaps you will finally come to understand.
Ensemble of Hope#654.dst: 몹시 곤란하군. 하지만 지금은... 이걸로 충분하다. 어쩌면 마침내 이해하게 되겠지.
Ensemble of Hope#654.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#655.src: Explore the mirror realm. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#656.src: A shard. Actions taken, decisions made, and the consequences that spiral outwards on and on and on.
Ensemble of Hope#656.dst: 파편 하나. 취해진 행동, 내려진 결정, 그리고 끝없이 바깥으로 소용돌이치는 결과들.
Ensemble of Hope#656.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#657.src: This should seem familiar. Will you put the pieces together?
Ensemble of Hope#657.dst: 낯익을 텐데. 조각들을 맞출 수 있겠나?
Ensemble of Hope#657.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#658.src: The Shade, the Neverending Night, the Darkness lurking in the deep... lying in wait for the right time to strike.
Ensemble of Hope#658.dst: 그림자, 끝나지 않는 밤, 깊은 곳에 도사린 어둠... 공격할 때를 기다리며 숨어 있지.
Ensemble of Hope#658.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#659.src: It holds the upper hand, you know. Even with your recent strikes against it. And oh, it has grown to hate you for that, hasn't it?
Ensemble of Hope#659.dst: 알겠지만 우위는 그쪽에 있다. 네가 최근에 타격을 줬어도. 그리고 아, 그 일로 널 증오하게 됐지, 그렇지 않나?
Ensemble of Hope#659.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#660.src: Do you expect it to hold back? Its nature is to take, consume, repurpose. And it finally holds the means.
Ensemble of Hope#660.dst: 그게 봐줄 거라 기대하나? 빼앗고, 삼키고, 제 것으로 바꾸는 게 그 본성이다. 그리고 마침내 수단을 쥐었지.
Ensemble of Hope#660.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#661.src: Explore the new mirror realm. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#661.dst: 새로운 거울 세계를 탐색하세요. 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}](으)로 가세요.

Ensemble of Hope#662.src: And another. Different actions, different decisions, yet the results remain conclusive. Mirrored, in all the ways which matter.
Ensemble of Hope#662.dst: 또 하나. 다른 행동, 다른 결정, 그런데도 결과는 확정적이다. 중요한 모든 면에서 거울처럼 같지.
Ensemble of Hope#662.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#663.src: Do you see? Do you see it now? The futility? The nigh-inevitability of the coming end?
Ensemble of Hope#663.dst: 보이나? 이제 보이나? 그 헛됨이? 다가올 종말이 거의 피할 수 없다는 게?
Ensemble of Hope#663.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#664.src: The Dawn, the Piercing Radiance, the Light which casts judgement from above. Blinding all who dare stand in its way.
Ensemble of Hope#664.dst: 새벽, 꿰뚫는 광휘, 높은 곳에서 심판을 내리는 빛. 감히 앞을 막는 모든 자의 눈을 멀게 하지.
Ensemble of Hope#664.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#665.src: It plays at divinity, claims benevolence... but its nature is no different from the Shade. It will discard the pieces on the board once they no longer serve a purpose.
Ensemble of Hope#665.dst: 신성을 흉내 내고 자비를 내세우지만... 본성은 그림자와 다를 바 없다. 판 위의 말이 쓸모없어지면 버릴 것이다.
Ensemble of Hope#665.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#666.src: Removing one actor is not enough. Removing both is near-impossible. What option does that leave?
Ensemble of Hope#666.dst: 한쪽을 없애는 것으론 부족하다. 둘 다 없애는 건 거의 불가능하지. 그럼 남는 선택지는?
Ensemble of Hope#666.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#667.src: Explore the new mirror realm. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#667.dst: 새로운 거울 세계를 탐색하세요. 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}](으)로 가세요.

Ensemble of Hope#668.src: And here, the final bitter truth. You claim to care for our province? For the people living within?
Ensemble of Hope#668.dst: 그리고 여기, 마지막 쓰디쓴 진실. 우리 지방을 아낀다고? 그 안에 사는 백성들을?
Ensemble of Hope#668.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#669.src: Then look upon this final outcome... and do not turn your gaze.
Ensemble of Hope#669.dst: 그렇다면 이 마지막 결말을 봐라... 그리고 눈을 돌리지 마라.
Ensemble of Hope#669.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#670.src: Through inaction, this is where the future leads. Dawn or Dusk, it matters not - all will fall to ruin.
Ensemble of Hope#670.dst: 아무것도 하지 않으면 미래는 여기로 향한다. 새벽이든 황혼이든 상관없다 - 모든 것이 폐허가 된다.
Ensemble of Hope#670.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#671.src: If not Her, who would tip the scales?
Ensemble of Hope#671.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#675.src: ...How long has it been, now? Years and years and years... all of it erased, destroyed, and still I remain.
Ensemble of Hope#675.dst: ...이제 얼마나 됐지? 몇 년, 몇 년, 또 몇 년... 전부 지워지고 파괴됐는데, 난 여전히 남아 있다.
Ensemble of Hope#675.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#676.src: It was the only choice I could have made, then. Anyone else would have done the same.
Ensemble of Hope#676.dst: 그땐 그게 내가 할 수 있는 유일한 선택이었다. 누구라도 그랬을 것이다.
Ensemble of Hope#676.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#677.src: Even now, knowing what I do... would I have followed through? Would I have still...?
Ensemble of Hope#677.dst: 지금도, 아는 걸 알면서... 끝까지 했을까? 그래도 여전히...?
Ensemble of Hope#677.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#678.src: I should not expect answers from ghosts. If it's all to be forgotten... so be it. They're my mistakes to bear.
Ensemble of Hope#678.dst: 망령에게 답을 바라선 안 되지. 전부 잊힐 운명이라면... 그러라지. 내가 짊어질 실수니까.
Ensemble of Hope#678.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#679.src: ...ah. I see now my error. Very clever, traversing the shards and reaching though the fractured web into my own past.
Ensemble of Hope#679.dst: ...아. 이제 내 실수가 보이는군. 참 영리하군, 파편을 넘나들며 금 간 그물 너머 내 과거에 손을 뻗다니.
Ensemble of Hope#679.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#680.src: But you are not entitled to this intrusion. And you will receive nothing more.
Ensemble of Hope#680.dst: 하지만 넌 이렇게 침입할 자격이 없다. 그리고 더 얻을 것도 없다.
Ensemble of Hope#680.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#683.src: A satisfactory showing. Perhaps you will manage to surprise me, after all.
Ensemble of Hope#683.dst: 만족스러운 결과다. 결국 네가 날 놀라게 할지도 모르겠군.
Ensemble of Hope#683.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#684.src: Then I will leave the rest to fate. Either you live, or you die. Both outcomes will resolve favorably.
Ensemble of Hope#684.dst: 그럼 나머진 운명에 맡기지. 살든, 죽든. 어느 결과든 유리하게 풀릴 것이다.
Ensemble of Hope#684.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#685.src: If you are so desperate to change this province... prove it.
Ensemble of Hope#685.dst: 그토록 이 지방을 바꾸고 싶다면... 증명해 봐라.
Ensemble of Hope#685.speaker: Sovereign Two

Ensemble of Hope#686.src: Escape from Her Majesty's royal palace. To return go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Ensemble of Hope#686.dst: 여왕 폐하의 왕궁에서 탈출하세요. 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}](으)로 가세요.

Ensemble of Hope#687.src: Talk to Rurie outside the palace at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#689.src: No time to stay and chat! Come with me.
Ensemble of Hope#689.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#690.src: Follow Rurie to the safe zone at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#691.src: ...phew! Finally, some time to breathe. "Lightly defended" is perhaps an understatement... though, that's just {p} for you!
Ensemble of Hope#691.dst: ...휴! 드디어 숨 좀 돌리네요. "경비가 허술하다"는 건 좀 과소평가였네요... 뭐, {p}이(가) 원래 그렇죠!
Ensemble of Hope#691.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#692.src: Ah... goodness. We're used to battling regional guards, or constables - perhaps a wing at most, rarely? But they simply do not compare to these gendarme.
Ensemble of Hope#692.dst: 아... 세상에. 우린 지역 경비병이나 순경 상대엔 익숙하죠 - 가끔 날개단 하나 정도? 그런데 이 헌병들은 차원이 달라요.
Ensemble of Hope#692.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#693.src: We have... learned that the hard way. Three casualties. Two foxes, and one owl.
Ensemble of Hope#693.dst: 우린... 뼈저리게 배웠어요. 사상자 셋. 여우 둘, 올빼미 하나.
Ensemble of Hope#693.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#694.src: Preparations are in order for burial rights, but we are still deep in the operation! No time to grieve just yet.
Ensemble of Hope#694.dst: 장례 준비는 하고 있지만, 아직 작전이 한창이에요! 슬퍼할 시간은 아직 없어요.
Ensemble of Hope#694.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#695.src: They knew the risks, as do we all. Joining the Canopy - properly, mind you, not like you did - comes with a willingness to die for the cause, if necessary.
Ensemble of Hope#695.dst: 그들도 위험은 알았어요, 우리 모두 그렇듯이요. 수관에 들어온다는 건 - 정식으로요, 당신처럼 말고 - 필요하면 대의를 위해 죽을 각오를 한다는 거죠.
Ensemble of Hope#695.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#696.src: ...but enough about that! You live! Standing before me, in one piece and not entirely disintegrated! I take it all went well on your end?
Ensemble of Hope#696.dst: ...그 얘긴 그만하고! 살아 있네요! 내 앞에, 멀쩡히, 완전히 분해되지도 않고! 그쪽은 잘 풀린 거죠?
Ensemble of Hope#696.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#697.src: Excellent! You know, you were beginning to worry us a little. You were in there quite a while longer than we expected.
Ensemble of Hope#697.dst: 훌륭해요! 있죠, 조금 걱정되기 시작했어요. 예상보다 꽤 오래 안에 있었거든요.
Ensemble of Hope#697.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#698.src: However well enough it was, it would seem it was plenty good enough for our needs! So, I suppose we can write this one off as a success.
Ensemble of Hope#698.dst: 얼마나 잘됐든, 우리한텐 충분히 잘된 것 같네요! 그럼 이번 건은 성공으로 쳐도 되겠죠.
Ensemble of Hope#698.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#699.src: Well, it could always be worse! As I mentioned- disintegration was one such proposed outcome... Fuhue really does have the strangest ideas about "fun."
Ensemble of Hope#699.dst: 뭐, 더 나빴을 수도 있죠! 말했듯이- 분해도 예상 결과 중 하나였거든요... Fuhue는 "재미"에 대한 생각이 참 특이해요.
Ensemble of Hope#699.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#700.src: Hm... well, I would think "not really" would mean "rotting in prison for all of time," but I suppose we have different definitions.
Ensemble of Hope#700.dst: 음... 난 "별로"라고 하면 "평생 감옥에서 썩는 것"인 줄 알았는데, 정의가 다른가 봐요.
Ensemble of Hope#700.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#701.src: In any case - welcome to the market square? Quite a lovely place, isn't it?
Ensemble of Hope#701.dst: 어쨌든 - 시장 광장에 온 걸 환영해요? 꽤 멋진 곳이죠?
Ensemble of Hope#701.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#702.src: We, ah... are holding some residents captive, in the hopes the crown will be less likely to go on a full offense! What with all the high-standing citizens around.
Ensemble of Hope#702.dst: 우린, 아... 주민 몇 명을 인질로 잡고 있어요. 왕실이 전면 공격을 덜 하길 바라면서요! 이 근처엔 신분 높은 시민이 많거든요.
Ensemble of Hope#702.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#703.src: Not to worry, though, we do not plan on hurting innocent people! Physically, at least - emotionally could not be helped, given the whole... holding hostage thing.
Ensemble of Hope#703.dst: 그래도 걱정 마요, 무고한 사람을 해칠 생각은 없어요! 적어도 몸은요 - 마음은 어쩔 수 없죠, 뭐... 인질극이니까.
Ensemble of Hope#703.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#704.src: You'll be happy to hear we recently received word from our owls that the gates assault group has returned to {p}! We'll be working to get them in here soon.
Ensemble of Hope#704.dst: 기쁜 소식은, 방금 올빼미들한테서 정문 공격조가 {p}에 돌아왔다는 연락이 왔어요! 곧 이리로 데려오려고 해요.
Ensemble of Hope#704.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#705.src: What else, what else... owls are stationed on a rotation to defend the walls and keep watch. Foxes are ready to defend the front gates at a moment's notice.
Ensemble of Hope#705.dst: 또 뭐가 있더라... 올빼미들은 교대로 성벽을 지키며 망을 봐요. 여우들은 언제든 정문을 지킬 준비가 돼 있고요.
Ensemble of Hope#705.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#706.src: If you'd like a detailed schedule, you'll have to find Fuhue - it's too much information to keep hold of, personally!
Ensemble of Hope#706.dst: 자세한 일정표가 필요하면 Fuhue를 찾아요 - 내가 다 기억하기엔 정보가 너무 많아요!
Ensemble of Hope#706.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#707.src: Speaking of, the others would surely be glad to hear you're safe! Go on and tell them, would you?
Ensemble of Hope#707.dst: 그러고 보니, 다른 사람들도 당신이 무사하단 걸 들으면 분명 기뻐할 거예요! 가서 알려 줄래요?
Ensemble of Hope#707.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#708.src: Get an update on how things went on their end.
Ensemble of Hope#708.dst: 그쪽 상황이 어떻게 됐는지 소식을 들으세요.

Ensemble of Hope#709.src: Well, go on! Find the others and tell them you're safe, would you?
Ensemble of Hope#709.dst: 자, 어서요! 다른 사람들 찾아서 무사하다고 알려 줘요, 네?
Ensemble of Hope#709.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#710.src: We need to get a plan established, and fast. Time is running out.
Ensemble of Hope#710.dst: 계획을 세워야 하오, 서둘러서. 시간이 얼마 없소.
Ensemble of Hope#710.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#714.src: Yeah? Can't say that's surprising, since... y'know. Dealing with the Queen.
Ensemble of Hope#714.dst: 그래? 놀랍진 않네, 왜냐면... 알잖아. 상대가 여왕이니까.
Ensemble of Hope#714.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#715.src: As for me... I got to join one of the Fox units. We're defending the zone from assaults from the crown!
Ensemble of Hope#715.dst: 난... 여우 부대 하나에 들어갔어. 왕실 공격으로부터 이 구역을 지키는 중이야!
Ensemble of Hope#715.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#716.src: It... feels good. Finally getting to get my hands dirty, and make a difference. Yulie never would've let me do something like this before.
Ensemble of Hope#716.dst: 그게... 기분 좋아. 드디어 직접 손을 더럽히고, 뭔가 바꿀 수 있어서. Yulie는 전엔 이런 거 절대 못 하게 했거든.
Ensemble of Hope#716.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#717.src: ...I don't think I'd have had the courage for it, if it wasn't for Zeph.
Ensemble of Hope#717.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#718.src: Like... I dunno. He barely even hesitated back in the Roughworks, before jumping in to help a random woman he didn't even know!!
Ensemble of Hope#718.dst: 그게... 모르겠어. Roughworks에서 걔는 모르는 여자를 도우려고 거의 망설이지도 않고 뛰어들었잖아!!
Ensemble of Hope#718.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#719.src: And... I want to be like that, y'know! Confident enough to do that sorta thing.
Ensemble of Hope#719.dst: 그리고... 나도 그렇게 되고 싶어, 알지! 그런 걸 할 만큼 자신 있는 사람.
Ensemble of Hope#719.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#720.src: ...don't, uh, tell him I said all that though!! Ha. It's a little embarrassing to actually say out loud.
Ensemble of Hope#720.dst: ...근데, 어, 내가 이런 말 했다고 걔한테 말하지 마!! 하. 입 밖으로 내니까 좀 쑥스럽다.
Ensemble of Hope#720.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#721.src: You're gonna head over to him and the others soon though, right? Tell him... uh... something. That I hope he's okay? I dunno, I'll come up with something.
Ensemble of Hope#721.dst: 곧 걔랑 다른 사람들한테 갈 거지? 걔한테... 어... 뭐라고 해 줘. 무사하길 바란다고? 몰라, 뭐 생각해 볼게.
Ensemble of Hope#721.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#722.src: Hey, have you talked to Azael yet? He's in the command center they've set up in the bank.
Ensemble of Hope#722.dst: 야, Azael한테 가 봤어? 은행에 차린 지휘 본부에 있어.
Ensemble of Hope#722.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#723.src: Oh, {u}, you're alright! That's a relief.
Ensemble of Hope#723.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#724.src: I'd ask you for more details... but somehow I've ended up with responsibilities here. Sigh.
Ensemble of Hope#724.dst: 자세히 물어보고 싶은데... 어쩌다 보니 여기서 책임을 맡게 됐어. 하아.
Ensemble of Hope#724.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#725.src: I've been trying to help Fuhue keep the owl units on schedule... but, DAMN!
Ensemble of Hope#725.dst: Fuhue 도와서 올빼미 부대 일정 맞추고 있는데... 아, 젠장!
Ensemble of Hope#725.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#726.src: Why is everything so precise?! The current squad needs to switch out at... exactly {~}:{~}! Why?! Who needs this level of specificity?!
Ensemble of Hope#726.dst: 왜 이렇게 다 정확해?! 지금 조는 정확히... {~}시 {~}분에 교대해야 한대! 왜?! 누가 이렇게까지 정확해야 하는데?!
Ensemble of Hope#726.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#727.src: ...have you talked to Azael and Quill yet? I think they were waiting for news about you, in the bank.
Ensemble of Hope#727.dst: ...Azael이랑 Quill한테 가 봤어? 은행에서 네 소식 기다리고 있을 거야.
Ensemble of Hope#727.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#728.src: Oh, not now. UGH! Where did those deers put today's evening rations?!
Ensemble of Hope#728.dst: 아, 지금은 안 돼요. 으! 사슴들이 오늘 저녁 배급을 어디 둔 거죠?!
Ensemble of Hope#728.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#731.src: Hm? No. Simply stating an observation.
Ensemble of Hope#731.dst: 네? 아뇨. 관찰한 걸 말했을 뿐이에요.
Ensemble of Hope#731.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#733.src: Either way. I had the deers bring rations and quipment with us, but in the chaos it seems they have not followed my established sorting system! Everything is a mess.
Ensemble of Hope#733.dst: 어쨌든. 사슴들한테 배급이랑 장비를 가져오게 했는데, 난리 통에 내 분류 체계를 안 따랐나 봐요! 전부 엉망이에요.
Ensemble of Hope#733.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#734.src: And now not only do I need to maintain schedules for the foxes and owls, because Rurie is a mess, but I also have to find where our supplies are!
Ensemble of Hope#734.dst: Rurie가 엉망이라 여우랑 올빼미 일정까지 내가 챙겨야 하는데, 이젠 보급품 위치까지 찾아야 해요!
Ensemble of Hope#734.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#735.src: At least Yulie has offered to help keep track of the owls' movements. That's one less thing to worry about.
Ensemble of Hope#735.dst: 그나마 Yulie가 올빼미 이동 관리를 돕겠다고 했어요. 걱정 하나는 덜었죠.
Ensemble of Hope#735.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#736.src: I need to get back to finding tonight's food supplies. Maybe you can go be useful elsewhere?
Ensemble of Hope#736.dst: 오늘 밤 식량 찾으러 돌아가야 해요. 다른 데 가서 쓸모 좀 있어 볼래요?
Ensemble of Hope#736.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#737.src: ... You could try telling Master Azael you're alive. He'll be in the command station in the bank.
Ensemble of Hope#737.dst: ... Azael 님께 살아 있다고 알려 드려요. 은행 지휘소에 계실 거예요.
Ensemble of Hope#737.speaker: Fuhue

Ensemble of Hope#738.src: Y'know, it's nice to finally get a break from guarding for a bit! I've been at it for hours...
Ensemble of Hope#738.dst: 있잖아, 드디어 경비 서다 좀 쉬니까 좋다! 몇 시간째 서 있었거든...
Ensemble of Hope#738.speaker: Yuman

Ensemble of Hope#739.src: Sigh... it's nearly time for the next unit rotation. Talk to you later.
Ensemble of Hope#739.dst: 하아... 곧 다음 부대 교대 시간이야. 나중에 얘기하자.
Ensemble of Hope#739.speaker: Yulie

Ensemble of Hope#741.src: Talk to the leaders in the bank at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Ensemble of Hope#743.src: Not yet, I am afraid. The festival will be starting within an hour or so, though...
Ensemble of Hope#743.dst: 유감이지만 아직이오. 축제는 한 시간쯤 뒤에 시작될 텐데...
Ensemble of Hope#743.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#745.src: Ah, how wonderful! You have survived. That makes three of four teams now accounted for.
Ensemble of Hope#745.dst: 아, 참으로 다행이오! 살아 돌아왔군. 이로써 네 조 중 세 조의 행방이 확인됐소.
Ensemble of Hope#745.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#746.src: Yes... it would seem the owls are struggling to get ahold of group {~}.
Ensemble of Hope#746.dst: 그렇소... 올빼미들이 {~}조와 연락이 닿지 않는 듯하오.
Ensemble of Hope#746.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#747.src: We did, shortly after the attack. But since then, owls have been struggling to make contact. They should have arrived at the hotel, but...
Ensemble of Hope#747.dst: 공격 직후엔 연락이 됐네. 하지만 그 뒤로 올빼미들이 연락을 못 하고 있어. 호텔에 도착했어야 하는데...
Ensemble of Hope#747.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#748.src: I'm starting to worry... I know we don't have instant communication, but even still, it's been a while...
Ensemble of Hope#748.dst: 걱정되기 시작했어요... 즉시 연락할 수 없는 건 알지만, 그래도 너무 오래됐어요...
Ensemble of Hope#748.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#749.src: Hmm. Military activity has increased drastically ever since we took control. We know the owls are struggling to move from here to {p}.
Ensemble of Hope#749.dst: 흠. 우리가 점령한 뒤로 군 활동이 크게 늘었소. 올빼미들이 여기서 {p}(으)로 이동하기 힘들다는 건 알고 있소.
Ensemble of Hope#749.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#750.src: It could be something, or it could very well be nothing. There is little we can do but wait.
Ensemble of Hope#750.dst: 무슨 일이 있을 수도, 아무 일 없을 수도 있소. 기다리는 것 말곤 할 수 있는 게 별로 없소.
Ensemble of Hope#750.speaker: Azael

Ensemble of Hope#751.src: Master Azael! Oh, ah, and others- news have arrived from the owls!
Ensemble of Hope#751.dst: Azael 님! 아, 다들- 올빼미들한테서 소식이 왔어요!
Ensemble of Hope#751.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#753.src: Bad, I fear. There's quite the commotion in {p} - the streets are crawling with soldiers, and the people of the city have been gathered on the festival grounds.
Ensemble of Hope#753.dst: 안타깝게도 나쁜 소식이에요. {p}이(가) 난리예요 - 거리엔 병사들이 우글거리고, 시민들은 축제장에 모였대요.
Ensemble of Hope#753.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#754.src: Ahead of schedule... do we know which Sovereigns are present?
Ensemble of Hope#754.dst: 예정보다 이르군... 어느 군주들이 와 있는지 아나?
Ensemble of Hope#754.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#755.src: Thalas, naturally. And likely the Queen as well, given the circumstances.
Ensemble of Hope#755.dst: 당연히 Thalas죠. 상황을 보면 여왕도 있을 거예요.
Ensemble of Hope#755.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#756.src: Damn it... we need to get people to {p}! Our- our friends, they're-
Ensemble of Hope#756.dst: 젠장... {p}에 사람을 보내야 해요! 우리- 우리 친구들이-
Ensemble of Hope#756.speaker: Yusanu

Ensemble of Hope#757.src: Yes, we must, but I cannot afford to leave my position here... and I don't believe we can spare any of our fighters...
Ensemble of Hope#757.dst: 네, 그래야죠, 하지만 난 여기 자리를 비울 수 없고... 전사를 한 명도 뺄 수 없을 것 같아요...
Ensemble of Hope#757.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#758.src: Ah! Yes, that will do. Come, I'll show you the way out of the citadel.
Ensemble of Hope#758.dst: 아! 그래요, 그럼 되겠네요. 와요, 성채 밖으로 나가는 길을 알려 줄게요.
Ensemble of Hope#758.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#759.src: {u}... good luck. We- aah- we cannot afford to lose any more of our people. Get them back to us safely...
Ensemble of Hope#759.dst: {u}... 행운을 비네. 우린- 으- 더는 누구도 잃을 수 없어. 그들을 무사히 데려와 주게...
Ensemble of Hope#759.speaker: Quill

Ensemble of Hope#761.src: Use this tunnel - it'll bring you near the entrance of the citadel. When you're done, use it from the other side to get back to us...
Ensemble of Hope#761.dst: 이 터널로 가요 - 성채 입구 근처로 이어져요. 일이 끝나면 반대편에서 이걸 타고 돌아오면 돼요...
Ensemble of Hope#761.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#762.src: ...though, ah, take care not to let any of the crown's soldiers follow you through? I'm not sure we can afford the stress!
Ensemble of Hope#762.dst: ...다만, 아, 왕실 병사들이 따라오지 않게 조심해요? 그런 스트레스는 감당 못 할 것 같거든요!
Ensemble of Hope#762.speaker: Rurie

Ensemble of Hope#763.src: We're nearing the end, just got to stick the landing. Now, go get 'em!
Ensemble of Hope#763.dst: 거의 끝이에요, 착지만 잘하면 돼요. 자, 가서 혼내 줘요!
Ensemble of Hope#763.speaker: Rurie

Enter the Dojo#000.src: The upturn of necromantic practices ended in {~} AP, with the outlawing of the technique. Defiling the dead and preventing their spirits from moving on...
Enter the Dojo#000.dst: 강령술의 유행은 {~} AP에 그 기술이 금지되며 끝났다. 죽은 자를 모독하고 그 영혼이 떠나지 못하게 하는 짓...

Enter the Dojo#001.src: It is best to not add too much to the tea, for too many conflicting tastes will leave it muddled and foul-tasting. Three ingredients is a fine benchmark.
Enter the Dojo#001.dst: 차에 너무 많이 넣지 않는 게 좋다. 맛이 서로 부딪치면 탁하고 역해지니까. 재료 세 가지가 적당한 기준이다.

Enter the Dojo#003.src: Oh hohoho! So a human has found their way to my humble dojo? Intriguing! I am called Sensei Miyagi. I welcome you.
Enter the Dojo#003.dst: 오호호호! 인간이 이 소박한 도장까지 찾아왔다고? 흥미롭군! 나는 Sensei Miyagi라네. 환영하네.
Enter the Dojo#003.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#004.src: This dojo- I have dedicated to honing skills in all of the arts- from mental prowess and mental acuity, to craftsmanship and artistry.
Enter the Dojo#004.dst: 이 도장은 모든 기예를 연마하는 곳이라네. 정신의 기량과 예리함부터 손기술과 예술까지.
Enter the Dojo#004.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#005.src: Many have come- traveled from all corners of the earth to this humble one's dojo to train themselves and grow stronger. I am to presume you are the same?
Enter the Dojo#005.dst: 세상 곳곳에서 많은 이가 이 늙은이의 도장을 찾아와 수련하며 강해졌지. 자네도 그런가 보군?
Enter the Dojo#005.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#006.src: Although, while I have enjoyed my life's work here, I cannot deny I am getting on in years. I seek a successor, a master of many skills to take my place.
Enter the Dojo#006.dst: 허나 평생의 일을 즐겨 왔어도 나이는 못 속이지. 내 자리를 이을 후계자, 여러 기예의 달인을 찾고 있다네.
Enter the Dojo#006.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#007.src: To the one who should master the arts, I would bequeath the Master's Gi, a symbol of resolute skill. Of course, do not feel pressured to take over for me, hoho!
Enter the Dojo#007.dst: 기예를 통달한 자에게는 굳건한 기량의 상징인 Master's Gi를 물려주겠네. 물론 내 뒤를 이으라는 부담은 갖지 말게, 호호!
Enter the Dojo#007.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#008.src: As long as I may teach others and bring them to new heights, I am satisfied. Whether your aim be merely to sharpen your skills or to allow me to retire, you are welcomed.
Enter the Dojo#008.dst: 남을 가르치고 새 경지로 이끌 수만 있다면 난 만족하네. 기량을 갈고닦든, 나를 은퇴시켜 주든, 자네를 환영하네.
Enter the Dojo#008.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#009.src: When you are ready to begin, purify yourself in the waters of the spring behind the dojo, and I will guide you to your first challenge.
Enter the Dojo#009.dst: 시작할 준비가 되면 도장 뒤 샘물에 몸을 정화하게. 그러면 첫 시험으로 안내하겠네.
Enter the Dojo#009.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#010.src: Jump down the water pit to begin the challenges.

Enter the Dojo#011.src: Ascend the Lufar Room in the physical strength challenge.
Enter the Dojo#011.dst: 체력 시험에서 Lufar의 방 꼭대기까지 오르세요.

Enter the Dojo#012.src: Here we are then- The Lufar Room. Here tests your agility! Even these old bones can scale this room in short order- how shall you fare?
Enter the Dojo#012.dst: 자, 여기가 Lufar의 방이라네. 자네의 몸놀림을 시험하지! 이 늙은 뼈로도 금방 오르는 곳인데, 자네는 어떨까?
Enter the Dojo#012.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#013.src: Fight your way through the Fiata Room in the combat challenge.
Enter the Dojo#013.dst: 전투 시험에서 Fiata의 방을 싸워서 돌파하세요.

Enter the Dojo#014.src: I recognize your skill, and you have passed the challenge of the Lufar Room! Hoho, but the next challenge has defeated many an apprentice.
Enter the Dojo#014.dst: 자네의 기량을 인정하네. Lufar의 방 시험을 통과했군! 호호, 하지만 다음 시험에선 많은 제자가 쓰러졌지.
Enter the Dojo#014.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#015.src: Now, comes the Fiata Room! Here, your combat prowess shall be put to the test. Martial skill comes easily to me...but what of your own?
Enter the Dojo#015.dst: 이제 Fiata의 방이라네! 여기선 전투 실력을 시험하지. 무예라면 내겐 쉬운 일이지만... 자네는 어떤가?
Enter the Dojo#015.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#016.src: I hear many things about human combat skill, so I believe I shall watch this challenger myself. Enter now, challenger!
Enter the Dojo#016.dst: 인간의 전투 실력에 대해 이런저런 얘길 들어서 말이야, 직접 지켜보겠네. 들어가게, 도전자여!
Enter the Dojo#016.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#017.src: Solve the puzzle of sight in the Cliste Room in the sight challenge.
Enter the Dojo#017.dst: 시각 시험에서 Cliste의 방에 있는 시각 퍼즐을 푸세요.

Enter the Dojo#018.src: And I am to recognize your combat skill, and to proclaim your passage of the Fiata Room. Well done!
Enter the Dojo#018.dst: 자네의 전투 실력을 인정하고, Fiata의 방 통과를 선언하네. 잘했네!
Enter the Dojo#018.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#019.src: Next, however, is not a challenge of physical skill, but of observation and logical reasoning, in this- the Cliste Room. Here, a puzzle awaits.
Enter the Dojo#019.dst: 허나 다음은 몸이 아니라 관찰력과 논리적 추론을 시험하지. 여기 Cliste의 방에서 퍼즐이 기다린다네.
Enter the Dojo#019.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#020.src: You must discern the path in order to bring the red block to the gold block. Simple in theory...complex in practice, as there are many things.
Enter the Dojo#020.dst: 빨간 블록을 금 블록까지 옮길 길을 찾아내야 하네. 이론은 간단하지만... 실제론 복잡하지, 세상일이 다 그렇듯.
Enter the Dojo#020.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#021.src: Remember this as you work- Change your perspective, and the reality changes.
Enter the Dojo#021.dst: 풀면서 이걸 기억하게. 관점을 바꾸면 현실도 바뀐다네.
Enter the Dojo#021.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#022.src: Become at one with nature in the Sitheach Room and Cavern.
Enter the Dojo#022.dst: Sitheach의 방과 동굴에서 자연과 하나가 되세요.

Enter the Dojo#023.src: And there, I recognize your mental acuity! You have passed the Cliste Room. You are doing quite well, but many have gotten to this point and had a single point stymie them.
Enter the Dojo#023.dst: 자네의 예리한 정신을 인정하네! Cliste의 방을 통과했군. 아주 잘하고 있지만, 여기까지 와서 한 가지에 막힌 이가 많았지.
Enter the Dojo#023.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#024.src: Welcome then, to the last challenge I offer you, held within the Sitheach Room and cavern.
Enter the Dojo#024.dst: 그럼 내가 내는 마지막 시험에 온 걸 환영하네. Sitheach의 방과 동굴에서 치러지지.
Enter the Dojo#024.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#025.src: Your task here, is to become tranquil, and at peace with nature. What that entails... I leave up to you.
Enter the Dojo#025.dst: 여기서 자네가 할 일은 마음을 고요히 하고 자연과 화합하는 걸세. 그게 뭘 뜻하는지는... 자네에게 맡기지.
Enter the Dojo#025.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#026.src: There are many paths to tranquility. Whatever you choose, you will know when you have reached the point of success.
Enter the Dojo#026.dst: 고요에 이르는 길은 많다네. 무엇을 택하든 성공에 닿으면 스스로 알게 될 걸세.
Enter the Dojo#026.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#027.src: Exit the Sitheach cave through the tunnel near the temple.
Enter the Dojo#027.dst: 신전 근처 터널로 Sitheach 동굴을 빠져나가세요.

Enter the Dojo#029.src: I see it now. The troubled heart you came here with is troubled no longer. I recognize your mastery of the Sitheach Room.
Enter the Dojo#029.dst: 이제 보이는군. 올 때 어지럽던 자네의 마음이 더는 어지럽지 않아. Sitheach의 방을 통달했음을 인정하네.
Enter the Dojo#029.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#030.src: Oh hoho... It is just like a human to do what cannot be done. That is each challenge of my humble dojo, completed!
Enter the Dojo#030.dst: 오호호... 안 되는 일을 해내다니, 과연 인간답군. 이로써 내 소박한 도장의 모든 시험을 마쳤네!
Enter the Dojo#030.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#031.src: So! While I did advise you not to feel pressured of it, I am curious, young master. Do you wish to take my place here, so I may sit these old bones down?
Enter the Dojo#031.dst: 자! 부담 갖지 말라곤 했지만 궁금하군, 젊은 달인. 내 자리를 이어서 이 늙은 뼈를 좀 쉬게 해 주겠나?
Enter the Dojo#031.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#032.src: Ah, of course not. Despite your mastery, this is merely a single step on your journey. Needn't worry, I understand completely.
Enter the Dojo#032.dst: 아, 물론 아니겠지. 통달했어도 이건 자네 여정의 한 걸음일 뿐이니. 걱정 말게, 충분히 이해하네.
Enter the Dojo#032.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#033.src: I am certain that I will find a suitable successor before my time comes- and equally as certain that I've many a year to go, hoho!
Enter the Dojo#033.dst: 때가 오기 전에 알맞은 후계자를 분명 찾을 걸세. 그리고 아직 살날이 한참 남았다는 것도 분명하지, 호호!
Enter the Dojo#033.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#034.src: Nevertheless, you have completed the challenges of this humble Sensei, as such, I will provide you what was promised.
Enter the Dojo#034.dst: 어쨌든 이 보잘것없는 스승의 시험을 모두 마쳤으니, 약속한 것을 주겠네.
Enter the Dojo#034.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enter the Dojo#035.src: Wear this [Master's Gi] with pride, and remember this final lesson- There is never a point in life that you will stop learning. See the world and its lessons every day of your life, young master.
Enter the Dojo#035.dst: 이 [Master's Gi]를 자랑스럽게 입고 마지막 가르침을 기억하게. 배움에 끝은 없다네. 평생 날마다 세상과 그 가르침을 보게, 젊은 달인.
Enter the Dojo#035.speaker: Sensei Miyagi

Enzan's Brother#000.src: Well, I'd best get back to my business. It was nice talking to you, traveler. Come around anytime.
Enzan's Brother#000.dst: 자, 이만 일하러 가 봐야겠군. 이야기 즐거웠네, 여행자. 언제든 들르게.

Enzan's Brother#001.src: Business is a touch slow today, but feel free to have a seat. Would you like a {p} Whiskey? On the house.
Enzan's Brother#001.dst: 오늘은 장사가 좀 한산하지만, 편히 앉게. {p} 위스키 한 잔 하겠나? 서비스일세.

Enzan's Brother#002.src: You can even take your pals along with you for free if you're in a party!
Enzan's Brother#002.dst: 파티에 있다면 동료들도 무료로 함께 데려갈 수 있어!

Enzan's Brother#003.src: You've joined that mission of theirs then, have you? Good luck. From what parts I overheard, it'll be quite treacherous.
Enzan's Brother#003.dst: 그럼 그들의 임무에 합류한 건가? 행운을 비네. 엿들은 바로는 꽤 위험할 것 같더군.

Enzan's Brother#005.src: He just got back. You can't... tell him now. You'll do it later, once he's settled in.
Enzan's Brother#005.dst: 그는 막 돌아왔다. 지금은... 말할 수 없다. 그가 자리를 잡으면 나중에 말하자.

Enzan's Brother#006.src: Welcome to the V.S.S. Seaskipper, from Seasail Enterprises! There's nothin' better than Seasail if you're lookin' to travel!
Enzan's Brother#006.dst: Seasail Enterprises의 V.S.S. Seaskipper에 어서 오쇼! 여행하려면 Seasail만 한 게 없지!

Enzan's Brother#007.src: Just hop on the boat and buy a pass so you can get goin' to almost anywhere on the ocean!
Enzan's Brother#007.dst: 배에 올라 승선권만 사면 바다 어디든 거의 다 갈 수 있다고!

Enzan's Brother#008.src: Talk to Enzan close to the exit of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Enzan's Brother#009.src: I see you want to venture into the wilderness!
Enzan's Brother#009.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#010.src: My name is Enzan, and I am now a retired knight. I've spent most of my life fighting for {p}'s army, just like you.
Enzan's Brother#010.dst: 내 이름은 Enzan, 지금은 은퇴한 기사야. 자네처럼 평생 대부분을 {p} 군대에서 싸웠지.
Enzan's Brother#010.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#011.src: I know how hard it must be to be a recruit at this time, so I've got something that could help you! Well, I don't have it, but my brother does!
Enzan's Brother#011.dst: 요즘 신병 노릇이 얼마나 힘든지 알아서 도움이 될 걸 준비했네! 음, 내가 아니라 동생이 갖고 있지만!
Enzan's Brother#011.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#012.src: Follow this road, he's just past the item identifier, you can't miss him. Just head to the big set of stairs, past the item identifier.
Enzan's Brother#012.dst: 이 길을 따라가면 Item Identifier 바로 너머에 있어, 못 찾을 리 없지. Item Identifier를 지나 큰 계단으로 가게.
Enzan's Brother#012.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#013.src: Tell him I sent you! He can be such a jerk to strangers sometimes, especially when he's focused on his stairs...
Enzan's Brother#013.dst: 내가 보냈다고 전하게! 가끔 낯선 사람한테 못되게 굴거든. 계단에 몰두해 있을 땐 특히...
Enzan's Brother#013.speaker: Enzan

Enzan's Brother#014.src: Find Enzan's brother near the Item Identifier on the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Enzan's Brother#014.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} Item Identifier 근처에서 Enzan의 형제를 찾으세요.

Enzan's Brother#015.src: Excuse me? Can't you see I'm busy?
Enzan's Brother#015.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#016.src: Oh, my brother? Sorry, I didn't know.
Enzan's Brother#016.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#017.src: Why yes, I actually have something that could help you...
Enzan's Brother#017.dst: 그래요, 사실 도움이 될 만한 게 있죠...
Enzan's Brother#017.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#018.src: But before I give it to you, why don't you help me with something first?
Enzan's Brother#018.dst: 그런데 주기 전에, 먼저 날 좀 도와주는 게 어때요?
Enzan's Brother#018.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#019.src: You see, there's a special kind of mushroom that grows in this cave. I hear it has certain... energizing properties.
Enzan's Brother#019.dst: 이 동굴에 특별한 버섯이 자라요. 뭐랄까... 기운이 솟게 하는 효과가 있다더군요.
Enzan's Brother#019.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#020.src: If you can bring me [{~} Energy Mushroom], I'll help you out. Enter the cave down the stairs, and bring me that mushroom!
Enzan's Brother#020.dst: [{~} Energy Mushroom]을(를) 가져오면 도와줄게요. 계단 아래 동굴에 들어가서 그 버섯을 가져와요!
Enzan's Brother#020.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#021.src: Descend into the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Energy Mushroom] to Therck
Enzan's Brother#021.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴로 내려가 [{~} Energy Mushroom]을(를) Therck에게 가져가세요

Enzan's Brother#022.src: Ah, you're back! Do you have the mushroom?
Enzan's Brother#022.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#023.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item! You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
Enzan's Brother#023.dst: 이 반지를 받아요. 장신구 아이템이에요! 근처 Item Identifier에서 감정할 수 있어요.
Enzan's Brother#023.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#024.src: It's a very good ring for someone starting out like you. There's just one small issue...
Enzan's Brother#024.dst: 당신 같은 초보한테 아주 좋은 반지예요. 딱 하나 작은 문제가 있는데...
Enzan's Brother#024.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#025.src: To wear it, you must help my friend back in {p}. He's been pestering me for days about needing help.
Enzan's Brother#025.dst: 끼려면 {p}에 있는 내 친구를 도와줘야 해요. 며칠째 도와달라고 날 들볶고 있거든요.
Enzan's Brother#025.speaker: Therck

Enzan's Brother#026.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u} .
Enzan's Brother#026.dst: 좀 더 강해지면 거기서 날 만나요. 그럼 또 봐요, {u}.

Enzan's Brother#027.src: Ah, you're back. Do you have the mushroom?

Enzan's Brother#028.src: Excellent... Now I might finally be able to climb these stairs...
Enzan's Brother#028.dst: 좋아요... 이제야 이 계단을 오를 수 있겠어...

Enzan's Brother#029.src: Who knows, maybe there's a treasure or something up there?
Enzan's Brother#029.dst: 누가 알아요, 저 위에 보물 같은 게 있을지?

Enzan's Brother#030.src: Take this ring. It's an accessory item. You can identify it at the nearby Item Identifier.
Enzan's Brother#030.dst: 이 반지를 받아요. 장신구 아이템이에요. 근처 Item Identifier에서 감정할 수 있어요.

Fallen Delivery#001.src: Aaah what am I gonna do what am I gonna do what am I gonna do what am I gonna doooo! There's no way I can solve this...
Fallen Delivery#001.dst: 으아아 어떡하지 어떡하지 어떡하지 어떡하지이이! 이걸 해결할 방법이 없어...
Fallen Delivery#001.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#002.src: Wh- HUMAN! No, no, no! I don't need a demolitions service! The airship downing over my house has done that enough- Hey, wait!
Fallen Delivery#002.dst: 뭐, 인간이다! 안 돼, 안 돼! 철거 서비스는 필요 없어! 비행선이 우리 집에 떨어져서 충분히 부서졌다고. 어, 잠깐!
Fallen Delivery#002.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#003.src: You all are a reckless lot, aren't you?! You can run through some burning wreckage, right? That isn't above your paygrade, right?! RIGHT?!
Fallen Delivery#003.dst: 당신들 원래 무모하잖아, 그렇지?! 불타는 잔해 좀 뚫고 지나갈 수 있지? 그 정도는 할 수 있잖아?! 그렇지?!
Fallen Delivery#003.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#004.src: Go through my house to the wreckage! Find any survivors you can! They might...I don't know! I don't know if they'll help but it's all I can think of right now!
Fallen Delivery#004.dst: 우리 집을 지나 잔해로 가! 생존자를 찾을 수 있는 대로 찾아! 그 사람들이... 모르겠어! 도움이 될진 몰라도 지금 떠오르는 건 그것뿐이야!
Fallen Delivery#004.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#005.src: Scale the house and search the fallen airship for survivors
Fallen Delivery#005.dst: 집을 올라가 추락한 비행선에서 생존자를 찾으세요

Fallen Delivery#006.src: Okay Bricot, your house is a loss, but...don't panic... Don't panic. Please tell me the crew is-
Fallen Delivery#006.dst: 좋아 Bricot, 집은 날아갔지만... 당황하지 마... 당황하지 마. 제발 승무원들은 무사하다고...
Fallen Delivery#006.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#007.src: ...urgh. I didn't want that sentence to end with DEAD! Aaagh, this is a disaster!!
Fallen Delivery#007.dst: ...으윽. 그 말이 '죽었다'로 끝나길 바란 게 아니었는데! 으아, 이건 재앙이야!!
Fallen Delivery#007.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#008.src: My farm's ruined, there's no good help- Hey, don't give me that look, I know what happened with Tolem!
Fallen Delivery#008.dst: 농장은 망했고, 쓸 만한 일손도 없고... 야, 그런 눈으로 보지 마, Tolem 일은 나도 알아!
Fallen Delivery#008.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#009.src: ...wait, that smell...that's sulphur. The airship engines don't use sulphur!
Fallen Delivery#009.dst: ...잠깐, 이 냄새... 유황이다. 비행선 엔진은 유황을 안 쓰는데!
Fallen Delivery#009.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#010.src: Gah, it didn't BREAK down, it got SHOT down!! Isn't the government going to DO something about all these mercenary groups?!
Fallen Delivery#010.dst: 으, 고장 나서 떨어진 게 아니라 격추된 거야!! 정부는 이 용병단들을 어떻게 좀 안 하는 거야?!
Fallen Delivery#010.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#011.src: Wait, what am I saying, there's a human here. Okay, new favor- go to the mercenary camp to the south there and do us ALL a favor, huh? Do what you do best!
Fallen Delivery#011.dst: 잠깐, 무슨 소리야, 여기 인간이 있잖아. 좋아, 새 부탁이야. 남쪽 용병 야영지에 가서 우리 모두를 위해 한 건 해 줘, 응? 제일 잘하는 걸로!
Fallen Delivery#011.speaker: Bricot

Fallen Delivery#013.src: Round up, fellas! There's an uninvited guest barging in!
Fallen Delivery#013.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#014.src: ...figures that you lot would be able to crack our defenses, huh? Alright, out with it. What do you want?
Fallen Delivery#014.dst: ...당신네라면 우리 방어선쯤은 뚫겠지, 그래? 좋아, 말해 봐. 원하는 게 뭐야?
Fallen Delivery#014.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#015.src: ...Oh, is that all? Somehow, for someone who chopped through my men like a knife through paper I'd have expected more of a demand.
Fallen Delivery#015.dst: ...아, 그게 다야? 내 부하들을 종이 베듯 썰어 버린 사람치고는 요구가 더 클 줄 알았는데.
Fallen Delivery#015.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#016.src: We were hired by an anonymous benefactor to shoot down the airship. Frankly, it was a ridiculous job- could've been done far cleaner.
Fallen Delivery#016.dst: 익명의 후원자한테 고용돼서 비행선을 격추했어. 솔직히 말도 안 되는 일이었지. 훨씬 깔끔하게 할 수 있었는데.
Fallen Delivery#016.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#017.src: The fellow wanted the mail being transported. Said we could take anything else that was left in the ship. But shooting it down only put everything at risk!
Fallen Delivery#017.dst: 그자는 운송 중인 우편물을 원했어. 배에 남은 다른 건 가져가도 된다더군. 근데 격추하면 전부 위험해지잖아!
Fallen Delivery#017.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#018.src: All the cargo, all the correspondence, it could've easily gone up in flames. I don't think the fellow was thinking straight- they just really wanted that airship downed.
Fallen Delivery#018.dst: 화물이며 편지며 전부 쉽게 불타 버릴 수 있었어. 그자는 제정신이 아니었던 것 같아. 그냥 비행선을 떨어뜨리고 싶었던 거지.
Fallen Delivery#018.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#019.src: Didn't even notice the great big hole in the sack they put the letters in. There's stray papers all over the ground. We have confidentiality with them, but...
Fallen Delivery#019.dst: 편지 넣은 자루에 큰 구멍이 난 것도 몰랐어. 바닥에 종이가 여기저기 흩어져 있지. 비밀 유지 약속은 했지만...
Fallen Delivery#019.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#020.src: At the same time, I've got my money, and they're an utter fool. If you want to catch them, follow the papers on the ground. I certainly won't stop you.
Fallen Delivery#020.dst: 한편으론 돈은 받았고, 그자는 완전 바보야. 잡고 싶으면 바닥의 종이를 따라가. 난 절대 안 막을 테니.
Fallen Delivery#020.speaker: Marden

Fallen Delivery#021.src: Follow the trail of papers to the bandit's house.
Fallen Delivery#021.dst: 종이 흔적을 따라 도적의 집으로 가세요.

Fallen Delivery#022.src: Find the envelope in the cellar and return it to the sender.
Fallen Delivery#022.dst: 지하실에서 봉투를 찾아 보낸 사람에게 돌려주세요.

Fallen Delivery#023.src: Oh, dang. Almost had it that time. Maybe the flux is out of sorts- Yes, of course! Need more Squirmle Residue to deal with that...
Fallen Delivery#023.dst: 아, 이런. 이번엔 거의 됐는데. 흐름이 틀어졌나... 그래, 당연하지! Squirmle 점액이 더 있어야 해...
Fallen Delivery#023.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#024.src: Quick, hand me the pliers! ...what? Yes, I know you aren't my assistant, but you've got two strong arms! Blessings of babylon! Pliers are easy to hand over, right?
Fallen Delivery#024.dst: 빨리, 펜치 좀 줘! ...뭐? 그래, 내 조수 아닌 건 알지만 튼튼한 팔이 두 개나 있잖아! 오 맙소사! 펜치 건네는 건 쉽잖아?
Fallen Delivery#024.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#025.src: Uh, buddy? This is a paper. Yes, there's writing on it, I see that, but what does that have to do with stabilizing the flux? Come on, think!
Fallen Delivery#025.dst: 어, 친구? 이건 종이잖아. 그래, 글씨가 쓰여 있는 건 보여. 근데 흐름 안정화랑 무슨 상관이야? 생각 좀 해 봐!
Fallen Delivery#025.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#026.src: ...wait a second, this is my handwriting. Hey, this was supposed to be in {p} two days ago! How in harbledee did you get this?
Fallen Delivery#026.dst: ...잠깐, 이건 내 글씨네. 이봐, 이건 이틀 전에 {p}에 도착했어야 했는데! 도대체 이걸 어떻게 구했어?
Fallen Delivery#026.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#027.src: The ship got shot down? That's no good. Could probably...wait, the Squirmle Residue would be perfect for this! A gel-based reinforcer, the cannonballs would bounce right off!
Fallen Delivery#027.dst: 배가 격추됐다고? 그건 큰일이군. 아마... 잠깐, Squirmle 점액이 딱이겠어! 젤 보강재라면 포탄도 그대로 튕겨 나갈 거야!
Fallen Delivery#027.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#028.src: Wait, focus on what's in front of you, Gawrick... The spell scroll isn't there...so. Hmm... Well, not to sound like a conspiracy theorist, but this might be the work of the airliners.
Fallen Delivery#028.dst: 잠깐, 눈앞의 일에 집중해, Gawrick... 주문 두루마리가 없어... 그렇다면. 흠... 음모론자처럼 들리긴 싫지만, 비행선 회사 짓일지도 몰라.
Fallen Delivery#028.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#029.src: It's a longshot, though. That scroll detailed a spell that allowed for unlimited teleportation. It could really compete with the airliner business for convenience alone!
Fallen Delivery#029.dst: 가능성은 낮지만. 그 두루마리엔 무제한 순간이동 주문이 적혀 있었거든. 편리함만으로도 비행선 사업이랑 경쟁할 수 있었지!
Fallen Delivery#029.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#030.src: At the same time, though... The airship representatives control the ships. It's in the job description. Why would they shoot down the ship instead of just filching the mail?
Fallen Delivery#030.dst: 그래도 말이야... 비행선 대표들이 배를 관리하잖아. 그게 그 사람들 일이고. 우편물만 슬쩍하면 되지 왜 배를 격추해?
Fallen Delivery#030.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#031.src: Well, it's a place to start! Why not talk with the airship representatives? They've got an office behind the customs desk in the airbase.
Fallen Delivery#031.dst: 뭐, 시작점으론 괜찮지! 비행선 대표들과 얘기해 보는 게 어때? 비행장 세관 창구 뒤에 사무실이 있어.
Fallen Delivery#031.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#032.src: It wouldn't make a whole lot of sense if they were behind it, so I'd just as soon scratch it off the list. Now, watch in amazement as I instantly teleport you to the office!
Fallen Delivery#032.dst: 그 사람들이 배후라면 말이 잘 안 되니 명단에서 지우고 싶긴 해. 자, 내가 순식간에 사무실로 보내 줄 테니 놀라지 마!
Fallen Delivery#032.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#033.src: Juuuust as soon as I grab the pliers...er, oops! Hand slipped! Um, hands and feet INSIDE the dimensional bridge please!
Fallen Delivery#033.dst: 펜치만 집으면 바로... 어, 이런! 손이 미끄러졌네! 음, 손발은 차원 다리 안에 넣어 주세요!
Fallen Delivery#033.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#034.src: Find the representative's office in the airship base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Fallen Delivery#036.src: No, it's been a while since Ernold's shown his face. He's in his office- said not to have anyone bother him.
Fallen Delivery#036.dst: 아뇨, Ernold가 얼굴 안 비친 지 좀 됐어요. 사무실에 있는데 아무도 방해하지 말랬어요.
Fallen Delivery#036.speaker: Office Manager

Fallen Delivery#037.src: So, you're out of luck. You'll probably not catch him today. Especially since he looked so frantic- when he gets like that...whoof.
Fallen Delivery#037.dst: 그러니 운이 없네요. 오늘은 못 만날 거예요. 특히 엄청 정신없어 보였거든요. 그럴 때면... 휴.
Fallen Delivery#037.speaker: Office Manager

Fallen Delivery#038.src: And, please don't try and sneak in and bother him either. I got my ears boxed last time someone got by me.
Fallen Delivery#038.dst: 그리고 몰래 들어가서 방해할 생각도 마세요. 지난번에 누가 날 지나쳐 들어갔을 때 된통 혼났거든요.
Fallen Delivery#038.speaker: Office Manager

Fallen Delivery#039.src: Find a way to enter the representative's office.

Fallen Delivery#042.src: STUPID! SCROLL! LET GO OF MY HAND!
Fallen Delivery#042.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#043.src: Why is this activated just by shaking it?! And why is it covered in this sticky residue?!
Fallen Delivery#043.dst: 왜 흔들기만 해도 작동하는 거야?! 그리고 왜 이런 끈적한 게 잔뜩 묻어 있어?!
Fallen Delivery#043.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#044.src: Wait, it- it's you! Garni! Help me out! This maniac's spell scroll is forcing me to teleport!!
Fallen Delivery#044.dst: 잠깐, 너, 너구나! Garni! 도와줘! 이 미치광이의 주문 두루마리 때문에 계속 순간이동된다고!!
Fallen Delivery#044.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#045.src: I can't grab the scroll without it getting zipped away! You have to catch me and grab the scroll!!
Fallen Delivery#045.dst: 잡으려고 하면 두루마리가 휙 사라져! 네가 날 붙잡고 두루마리를 뺏어 줘!!
Fallen Delivery#045.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#046.src: PLEASE! I've been stuck like this for five hours! Grab the scroll off me! I promise a pay raise if you do!!
Fallen Delivery#046.dst: 제발! 다섯 시간째 이러고 있어! 두루마리 좀 떼어 줘! 해 주면 월급 올려 줄게!!
Fallen Delivery#046.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#047.src: GWEH! You almost got it! But it's even worse now! Once more! Grab the scroll off of me!!
Fallen Delivery#047.dst: 으악! 거의 됐는데! 근데 더 심해졌어! 한 번 더! 두루마리를 떼어 줘!!
Fallen Delivery#047.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#048.src: Urp...hrk...guhh. Th-thank you, SO much, Garni-
Fallen Delivery#048.dst: 우웩... 흐윽... 끄응. 고, 고마워, 정말 고마워, Garni...
Fallen Delivery#048.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#049.src: Wait! You aren't the office manager! How did a human get in here?!
Fallen Delivery#049.dst: 잠깐! 너 사무장이 아니잖아! 인간이 어떻게 여길 들어왔어?!
Fallen Delivery#049.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#050.src: ...oh, perfect. I've been rumbled, I see. Fine- at least let me say my piece here, alright? I had a good reason for this!
Fallen Delivery#050.dst: ...아, 끝내주네. 들켰군. 좋아, 적어도 할 말은 하게 해 줘, 알았지? 나도 이유가 있었다고!
Fallen Delivery#050.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#051.src: For one thing, Gawrick's a damned maniac! This is clearly a danger- he's too erratic to trust his inventions!
Fallen Delivery#051.dst: 우선, Gawrick은 망할 미치광이야! 이건 딱 봐도 위험해. 너무 엉망이라 그 발명품은 못 믿어!
Fallen Delivery#051.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#052.src: For another, this was supposed to be a scroll of teleportation with no drawbacks whatsoever. Supposed to be, being the key words.
Fallen Delivery#052.dst: 그리고 이건 부작용이 전혀 없는 순간이동 두루마리여야 했어. '여야 했다'가 핵심이지.
Fallen Delivery#052.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#053.src: Do you have any idea what that would do to the airship industry? It's a nice thought surely, but think about how many people work in this airbase alone!
Fallen Delivery#053.dst: 그게 비행선 업계에 무슨 일을 일으킬지 알아? 좋은 생각이긴 하지만, 이 비행장에서만 일하는 사람이 몇인데!
Fallen Delivery#053.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#054.src: There'd be thousands jobless! I told him not to mail that scroll over, and I thought he listened! Then I heard him bragging in the street, and...well, I panicked.
Fallen Delivery#054.dst: 수천 명이 일자리를 잃을 거야! 두루마리를 부치지 말라고 했고 들은 줄 알았는데! 길에서 자랑하는 걸 듣고... 그래, 겁이 났어.
Fallen Delivery#054.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#055.src: I'll admit, hiring the mercenaries to shoot down the ship was hasty of me. But that scroll can NOT be made into a public commodity! Even if it's stable, which it ISN'T, it could ruin people's livelihoods!
Fallen Delivery#055.dst: 용병을 고용해서 배를 격추한 건 성급했어, 인정해. 하지만 그 두루마리는 절대 상품이 되면 안 돼! 안정적이라 해도, 안 그렇지만, 사람들 생계를 망칠 수 있다고!
Fallen Delivery#055.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#056.src: I'll relinquish it to you- I can tell you're expecting it. Maybe he'll listen to you...oh, what am I saying. Gawrick only ever listens to those voices in his head- or whatever drives his damned insanity.
Fallen Delivery#056.dst: 너한테 넘길게. 그거 받으러 온 거 알아. 네 말은 들을지도... 아, 내가 무슨 소리를. Gawrick은 제 머릿속 목소리만 듣는 놈이야. 아니면 그 망할 광기를 부추기는 뭔가든.
Fallen Delivery#056.speaker: Representative Ernold

Fallen Delivery#057.src: Bring the spell scroll back to Gawrick at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Fallen Delivery#058.src: Oh, so it WAS the airship people? What in the hell possessed them to shoot down their own ship then?!
Fallen Delivery#058.dst: 오, 그러니까 진짜 비행선 쪽 사람들이었어? 대체 무슨 생각으로 자기네 배를 격추한 거야?!
Fallen Delivery#058.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#059.src: Pah. That Ernold doesn't know a good idea when he sees it. As though anyone REALLY enjoys the airline food!
Fallen Delivery#059.dst: 흥. Ernold는 좋은 아이디어를 봐도 몰라봐. 누가 기내식을 진짜 좋아한다고!
Fallen Delivery#059.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#060.src: ...huh. It activated by shaking the paper? That wasn't supposed to happen. Did I put in too much Nimbuseeker rain...?
Fallen Delivery#060.dst: ...엥. 종이를 흔들어서 작동했다고? 그러면 안 되는데. Nimbuseeker 빗물을 너무 넣었나...?
Fallen Delivery#060.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#061.src: Well, looks like the ink got shook right off the paper, so it's useless anyways- and the notes I'd sent with the letter are missing too. Guess it's a secret lost to the ages now, cause I can't remember how it worked now.
Fallen Delivery#061.dst: 뭐, 흔들다가 잉크가 다 떨어졌으니 어차피 쓸모없어. 편지랑 같이 보낸 메모도 없어졌고. 어떻게 작동했는지 기억도 안 나니 영영 사라진 비밀이 됐네.
Fallen Delivery#061.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#062.src: Ah well. I figured how to transmute wine into cheese while you were gone anyways, so I've got a good money-making racket going anyways!
Fallen Delivery#062.dst: 아, 뭐 어때. 네가 없는 동안 포도주를 치즈로 바꾸는 법을 알아냈으니, 돈 벌 궁리는 잘 되고 있다고!
Fallen Delivery#062.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#063.src: ...mneh. I don't really care about a small man like him. I won't bother with the police on this one. It technically isn't on his hands anyways, but we'll just try and let him sleep with that on his head.
Fallen Delivery#063.dst: ...흥. 그런 소인배는 신경 안 써. 이번 건 경찰에 안 알릴 거야. 엄밀히 그 사람 손으로 한 것도 아니고. 그냥 그 짐을 지고 잠들게 두자고.
Fallen Delivery#063.speaker: Gawrick

Fallen Delivery#064.src: Hey, maybe you can help me out in another way! I had a DIFFERENT idea for teleportation scrolls anyways. Here- some free samples. Try 'em out for me, wouldja?
Fallen Delivery#064.dst: 이봐, 다른 방법으로 도와줄 수도 있겠어! 어차피 순간이동 두루마리에 대한 다른 아이디어가 있었거든. 자, 무료 샘플. 좀 써 봐 줄래?
Fallen Delivery#064.speaker: Gawrick

Fantastic Voyage#001.src: Let's go, just you and me! On a grand voyage across the sea!
Fantastic Voyage#001.dst: 가세, 자네와 나 둘이서! 바다 건너 큰 항해를 떠나서!
Fantastic Voyage#001.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#002.src: We'll go in search of a long-lost island, old chap! And here I have the guidance map!
Fantastic Voyage#002.dst: 오래 잊힌 섬을 찾아가세, 친구! 길잡이 지도는 여기 내 손에 쥐고!
Fantastic Voyage#002.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#003.src: The map, oh so grand! Why, I have it here in my hand!
Fantastic Voyage#003.dst: 이 지도, 얼마나 멋진가! 봐, 여기 내 손에 있지 않은가!
Fantastic Voyage#003.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#004.src: It's a map to a magical place! I sure hope it doesn't vanish without a tra-
Fantastic Voyage#004.dst: 마법의 장소로 가는 지도라네! 흔적도 없이 사라지지 않기를 바라...
Fantastic Voyage#004.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#005.src: Good grief! That raucous parrot is such a little thief!
Fantastic Voyage#005.dst: 이럴 수가! 저 시끄러운 앵무새, 작은 도둑이 따로 없네!
Fantastic Voyage#005.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#006.src: If we are to explore the ocean blue, that parrot you surely must pursue!
Fantastic Voyage#006.dst: 푸른 바다를 누비려거든, 저 앵무새를 쫓아가게나 어서 얼른!
Fantastic Voyage#006.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#007.src: Retrieve the map back from the parrot.

Fantastic Voyage#012.src: I'm doing j-just fine... Just... I'm just fine...
Fantastic Voyage#012.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#020.src: Uh... I-I'm sorry, I don't know who you m-mean...
Fantastic Voyage#020.dst: 어... 죄, 죄송해요, 누굴 말씀하시는지 모르겠어요...
Fantastic Voyage#020.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#025.src: L-L-Like a b-bird?! I l-love birds!
Fantastic Voyage#025.dst: 새, 새 같은 거요?! 새 좋, 좋아해요!
Fantastic Voyage#025.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#026.src: I will look for it... Human...
Fantastic Voyage#026.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#027.src: Y-you can count o-on me... I will find the bird.
Fantastic Voyage#027.dst: 저, 저만 믿으세요... 그 새를 찾을게요.
Fantastic Voyage#027.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#028.src: Welcome, welcome! How can I be of service to you, o' traveler?
Fantastic Voyage#028.dst: 어서 오게, 어서 와! 무엇을 도와줄까, 오 여행자여?
Fantastic Voyage#028.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#029.src: How can I be of service to you, o' traveler?
Fantastic Voyage#029.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#030.src: Hello... hello! You have said... hello!
Fantastic Voyage#030.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#031.src: Why, I am glad you asked, though I knew you would, of course!
Fantastic Voyage#031.dst: 오, 물어 줘서 기쁘군, 물론 물어볼 줄 알았지만!
Fantastic Voyage#031.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#032.src: For you see... I am gifted with foresight, the future's memories come to me like no other!
Fantastic Voyage#032.dst: 왜냐하면... 나는 예지력을 타고났거든. 미래의 기억이 누구보다 선명히 찾아온다네!
Fantastic Voyage#032.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#033.src: For the low, low price of [{~} LE], your future will be foretold!
Fantastic Voyage#033.dst: 단돈 [{~} LE]라는 헐값에 그대의 미래를 점쳐 주지!
Fantastic Voyage#033.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#034.src: What do you say? Ha-ha, I ask out of courtesy, for I know what you will choose.
Fantastic Voyage#034.dst: 어떤가? 하하, 예의상 묻는 거라네. 그대가 뭘 고를지 이미 아니까.
Fantastic Voyage#034.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#035.src: A wise choice, though expected, o' traveler!
Fantastic Voyage#035.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#036.src: Now... I must consult the spirits...
Fantastic Voyage#036.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#042.src: Aha! O' traveler! Your fortune is as clear to me as the sky on a very clear day!
Fantastic Voyage#042.dst: 아하! 오 여행자여! 그대의 운세가 아주 맑은 날의 하늘처럼 맑게 보이는군!
Fantastic Voyage#042.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#045.src: ...will grow a little bit older, very soon!
Fantastic Voyage#045.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#056.src: ...are going to get... a refund? What!? Oh, come on!
Fantastic Voyage#056.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#057.src: I am afraid you do not have enough, o’ traveler! Return with [{~} LE] to hear your fortune!
Fantastic Voyage#057.dst: 돈이 모자라는군, 오 여행자여! [{~} LE]를 가지고 오면 운세를 알려 주지!
Fantastic Voyage#057.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#058.src: Relend! Oh, the spirits have much to say of that man...
Fantastic Voyage#058.dst: Relend! 오, 영혼들이 그자에 대해 할 말이 많군...
Fantastic Voyage#058.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#059.src: More than most, he has seen... More than perhaps most should...
Fantastic Voyage#059.dst: 그는 누구보다 많은 걸 보았지... 아마 봐선 안 될 만큼...
Fantastic Voyage#059.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#060.src: Do not be fooled, o' traveler! Many a map has been snatched from his gnarled grasp...
Fantastic Voyage#060.dst: 속지 말게, 오 여행자여! 그 옹이진 손에서 빼앗긴 지도가 한둘이 아니라네...
Fantastic Voyage#060.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#061.src: ...perhaps your fortune shall reveal more! Worth a shot, hey?
Fantastic Voyage#061.dst: ...그대의 운세가 더 알려 줄지도 모르지! 해 볼 만하지 않은가?
Fantastic Voyage#061.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#062.src: Aha... another one who follows the winged reaper...
Fantastic Voyage#062.dst: 아하... 날개 달린 사신을 쫓는 자가 또 하나...
Fantastic Voyage#062.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#063.src: Yes... o' traveler... I have seen the parrot many a time... yes, indeed...
Fantastic Voyage#063.dst: 그렇지... 오 여행자여... 그 앵무새는 여러 번 봤다네... 그렇고말고...
Fantastic Voyage#063.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#064.src: Today, however, the wraith flies a unique way, one my eyes have not glimpsed.
Fantastic Voyage#064.dst: 허나 오늘 그 망령은 특이한 길로 날아가는군. 내 눈이 본 적 없는 길로.
Fantastic Voyage#064.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#065.src: The keeper of the Tavern by my southern stall-mate will know its whereabouts...
Fantastic Voyage#065.dst: 내 남쪽 이웃 노점 옆 선술집 주인이 그 행방을 알 걸세...
Fantastic Voyage#065.speaker: Jofash Clairvoyant

Fantastic Voyage#067.src: Howdy, welcome to Jo's Tavern. What can I get for ya?
Fantastic Voyage#067.dst: 어서 와요, Jo's Tavern입니다. 뭘 드릴까요?
Fantastic Voyage#067.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#068.src: What can I get for ya?
Fantastic Voyage#068.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#069.src: No worries, let me know if you need anythin'.
Fantastic Voyage#069.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#070.src: Oh, me? I'm doing just fine, mate.
Fantastic Voyage#070.dst: 아, 나요? 난 잘 지내요, 친구.
Fantastic Voyage#070.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#071.src: This place is pretty popular among sailors, so we get a decent amount a' traffic for such a small place.
Fantastic Voyage#071.dst: 선원들한테 꽤 인기 있는 곳이라, 작은 가게치곤 손님이 제법 많아요.
Fantastic Voyage#071.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#072.src: 's the only thing keeping me here, quite honestly. Lots'a crazies in this little town, it's nice to meet some normal folk, ya know?
Fantastic Voyage#072.dst: 솔직히 그거 말곤 여기 있을 이유가 없죠. 이 작은 마을엔 괴짜가 많아서, 평범한 사람 만나면 반갑다니까요.
Fantastic Voyage#072.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#079.src: Typical resident here, if you ask me, totally nuts.
Fantastic Voyage#079.dst: 내가 보기엔 전형적인 이 동네 주민이죠, 완전히 미쳤어요.
Fantastic Voyage#079.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#080.src: 's a weird one for sure, always speakin' in his little rhymes. Somethin's really snapped up there.
Fantastic Voyage#080.dst: 확실히 이상한 양반이에요, 맨날 운율 맞춰 말하고. 머리가 어떻게 된 게 분명해요.
Fantastic Voyage#080.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#081.src: I've had loads a' folk come in here real angry 'bout the guy.
Fantastic Voyage#081.dst: 그 양반 때문에 잔뜩 화나서 들어온 사람이 한둘이 아니에요.
Fantastic Voyage#081.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#082.src: 'pparently he takes 'em for joyrides 'round the sea and gets all sorts'a labor out of 'em, then just drops 'em back here.
Fantastic Voyage#082.dst: 듣자 하니 사람들을 바다 유람에 데려가서 온갖 일을 시키고는 여기다 그냥 내려놓는대요.
Fantastic Voyage#082.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#083.src: Ha! Guess he knows how to get some free work done, I'll give 'im that. Maybe he ain't so insane after all, eh?
Fantastic Voyage#083.dst: 하! 공짜로 일 시키는 법은 아는 모양이에요, 그건 인정하죠. 생각보다 안 미쳤는지도 몰라요, 그쵸?
Fantastic Voyage#083.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#084.src: ...Oh, you're goin' out with Relend, hey? You sure?
Fantastic Voyage#084.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#085.src: You know he's nuts, right mate? Y'not gonna find any treasure or anythin'.
Fantastic Voyage#085.dst: 그 양반 미친 거 알죠, 친구? 보물 같은 건 절대 못 찾을 거예요.
Fantastic Voyage#085.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#086.src: Well, whatever, mate. Yeah, the parrot's out on the patio, to the right of me, last I checked.
Fantastic Voyage#086.dst: 뭐, 알아서 해요, 친구. 그래, 마지막으로 봤을 땐 앵무새가 테라스에 있었어요, 내 오른쪽.
Fantastic Voyage#086.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#087.src: Have a nice trip, mate, if ya can catch it, that is. Heh...
Fantastic Voyage#087.dst: 좋은 여행 되길, 친구. 잡을 수 있다면 말이죠. 헤...
Fantastic Voyage#087.speaker: Tavern Owner

Fantastic Voyage#089.src: Hey-o, human! What can I do for ya?
Fantastic Voyage#089.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#090.src: What can I do for you?
Fantastic Voyage#090.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#092.src: Oh, you know me, pal, just doin' the rounds.
Fantastic Voyage#092.dst: 아, 나 알잖아, 친구. 그냥 한 바퀴 도는 중이지.
Fantastic Voyage#092.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#093.src: Waterin' the pots, starin' at the water, potterin' the sta-
Fantastic Voyage#093.dst: 화분에 물 주고, 바다 멍하니 보고, 계단에 흙 좀...
Fantastic Voyage#093.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#095.src: You know what, I’m glad you asked.
Fantastic Voyage#095.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#096.src: Lots of people these days are going crazy for that ‘all-natural, multiple grains, bred ethically’ garbage.
Fantastic Voyage#096.dst: 요즘 사람들은 '천연, 잡곡, 윤리적 재배' 같은 헛소리에 푹 빠져 있어.
Fantastic Voyage#096.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#097.src: Really, I wish some of those nutters sit down and take a good bite of some raw, authentic Rye, or a hearty whole-wheat.
Fantastic Voyage#097.dst: 진짜, 그 괴짜들이 앉아서 날것 그대로의 진짜 호밀이나 든든한 통밀 한 입 제대로 먹어 봤으면 좋겠어.
Fantastic Voyage#097.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#098.src: That’s the stuff that puts hairs on your chest, my pappy used to say. Good, strong, proper bread from out in the fields.
Fantastic Voyage#098.dst: 그런 게 사내를 사내답게 만든다고 울 아빠가 말하곤 했지. 들판에서 온 튼튼하고 제대로 된 빵 말이야.
Fantastic Voyage#098.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#099.src: We used to be farmers, you know. Out near {p}. WHEW! Glad I moved here though! Not many places serve better rum than good ol’ Jofash!
Fantastic Voyage#099.dst: 우리 원래 농부였어. {p} 근처에서. 휴! 그래도 여기 이사 와서 좋아! 좋은 옛 Jofash보다 럼 잘 내는 데는 별로 없지!
Fantastic Voyage#099.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#100.src: Back to the point at hand, though, bread. Man oh man I feel like I could go on forever about this.
Fantastic Voyage#100.dst: 그건 그렇고 본론으로, 빵. 와, 이 얘긴 끝없이 할 수 있을 것 같아.
Fantastic Voyage#100.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#101.src: You know what people always miss when talking about bread, the CONSISTENCY! The consistency is consistently the most im-
Fantastic Voyage#101.dst: 빵 얘기할 때 다들 놓치는 게 뭔지 알아? 바로 식감의 일관성! 일관성은 일관되게 제일 중...
Fantastic Voyage#101.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#102.src: Oh, haha, ‘consistently,’ didn’t even mean to do that. Heheh...
Fantastic Voyage#102.dst: 오, 하하, '일관되게'라니, 일부러 그런 거 아냐. 헤헤...
Fantastic Voyage#102.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#103.src: Ah, there you are! The ol’ train of thought gets derailed sometimes, you see.
Fantastic Voyage#103.dst: 아, 거기 있었네! 생각의 열차가 가끔 탈선하거든.
Fantastic Voyage#103.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#104.src: But I can tell that you’re a real enthusiast for bread!
Fantastic Voyage#104.dst: 근데 너 진짜 빵 애호가인 게 딱 보여!
Fantastic Voyage#104.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#105.src: Back to the topic at hand! Consistency! The consistency is consistently the most important part of any good loaf.
Fantastic Voyage#105.dst: 본론으로! 일관성! 일관성은 일관되게 좋은 빵에서 제일 중요한 부분이야.
Fantastic Voyage#105.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#106.src: Overusin’ so-called “refined” grains is a sure and done way to get runny slop that’s not fit for the pigs.
Fantastic Voyage#106.dst: 소위 '정제' 곡물을 너무 쓰면 돼지도 안 먹을 질척한 죽이 되는 건 확실해.
Fantastic Voyage#106.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#107.src: Come to think, you shouldn’t feed pigs refined grains anyway. It’s hard on their digestion.
Fantastic Voyage#107.dst: 생각해 보니 돼지한테도 정제 곡물은 먹이면 안 돼. 소화에 안 좋거든.
Fantastic Voyage#107.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#108.src: Of course! Digestion. A topic I’ll get to later!
Fantastic Voyage#108.dst: 그렇지! 소화. 그 얘긴 나중에 할게!
Fantastic Voyage#108.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#109.src: Anyway, whole grains are where the money’s at! I’d swear it on these plants.
Fantastic Voyage#109.dst: 어쨌든 돈 되는 건 통곡물이야! 이 식물들에 걸고 맹세하지.
Fantastic Voyage#109.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#110.src: What you want is a thick-crusted, chewy loaf that you can savor! Not some frail morsel that collapses under its own weight. Why, the things I’ve seen...
Fantastic Voyage#110.dst: 원하는 건 껍질 두껍고 쫄깃해서 음미할 수 있는 빵이야! 제 무게에 주저앉는 허약한 조각 말고. 아, 내가 본 것들이란...
Fantastic Voyage#110.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#111.src: In particular, have you seen some of the scraps sold at {p}? Ridiculous!
Fantastic Voyage#111.dst: 특히 {p}에서 파는 부스러기 봤어? 말도 안 돼!
Fantastic Voyage#111.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#112.src: I’ll let you in on a little secret. The Sky’s Kitchen is great and all, but what passes for bread there is intolerable. No substance at all!
Fantastic Voyage#112.dst: 비밀 하나 알려 줄게. Sky's Kitchen이 훌륭하긴 한데, 거기서 빵이라고 내놓는 건 못 참겠어. 알맹이가 하나도 없어!
Fantastic Voyage#112.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#113.src: What you’ll want to do is get it straight from the fields, right from the soil! Well, not literally, but from the countryside! Leave breadmakin’ to those who’ve been workin’ with grain before they could walk on two legs!
Fantastic Voyage#113.dst: 빵은 들판에서, 흙에서 곧장 가져와야 해! 뭐, 말 그대로는 아니고 시골에서 말이야! 빵 굽기는 두 발로 걷기 전부터 곡물을 만진 사람들한테 맡기라고!
Fantastic Voyage#113.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#114.src: Heck, I bet even I could do better than those snobby sauciers.
Fantastic Voyage#114.dst: 참나, 그 잘난 소스 요리사들보단 나도 더 잘하겠다.
Fantastic Voyage#114.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#115.src: Right. Digestion. The fiber in whole-grain bread is a lifesaver.
Fantastic Voyage#115.dst: 그래. 소화. 통곡물 빵의 섬유질은 생명의 은인이야.
Fantastic Voyage#115.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#116.src: Did you know that whole-grain bread has four times the fiber of white bread? Now you do!
