Fantastic Voyage#116.dst: 통곡물 빵에 흰 빵보다 섬유질이 네 배나 많은 거 알았어? 이제 알았지!
Fantastic Voyage#116.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#117.src: Helps keep you full and fit. Want to avoid lookin’ like a loaf of white bread yourself? Fiber’s your man.
Fantastic Voyage#117.dst: 배부르고 건강하게 해 줘. 너 자신이 흰 빵 덩어리처럼 되기 싫어? 섬유질이 답이야.
Fantastic Voyage#117.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#118.src: Nothin’ beats a rich, fresh-ground fresh-baked loaf with a slab of flat-iron steak. Red meat and fiber make a real man, as my pappy once said.
Fantastic Voyage#118.dst: 갓 빻아 갓 구운 진한 빵에 두툼한 스테이크만 한 게 없지. 붉은 고기와 섬유질이 사내를 만든다고 울 아빠가 그랬어.
Fantastic Voyage#118.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#119.src: Oh, how time flies. Where was I? Right, white bread.
Fantastic Voyage#119.dst: 아, 시간 참 빠르다. 어디까지 했더라? 그래, 흰 빵.
Fantastic Voyage#119.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#120.src: That stuff’s poison, I tell you! Not a lick of nutritional value!
Fantastic Voyage#120.dst: 그건 독이야, 진짜로! 영양가가 눈곱만큼도 없어!
Fantastic Voyage#120.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#121.src: It’s more milk and sugar than bread! Hardly somethin’ you’d want to eat, never mind something for which you’d pay extra!
Fantastic Voyage#121.dst: 빵이라기보다 우유랑 설탕 덩어리야! 먹고 싶지도 않은데, 돈을 더 내고 사 먹는다니 말도 안 되지!
Fantastic Voyage#121.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#122.src: Those hawkers can pretend that it’s an upper-crust good all they want, but we all know that it’s just a waste of dough.
Fantastic Voyage#122.dst: 장사꾼들이 아무리 고급품인 척해도, 다들 알잖아. 그냥 반죽 낭비, 돈 낭비라는 거.
Fantastic Voyage#122.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#123.src: Heheh, I did it again! Sorry, sorry, I’ll get the train back on track. Heh...
Fantastic Voyage#123.dst: 헤헤, 또 그랬네! 미안, 미안, 열차를 다시 선로에 올릴게. 헤...
Fantastic Voyage#123.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#124.src: Blendin' grains? Why jumble the flavors and textures? Just make two loaves of bread instead of one! Or several, if we're talkin' about more than two types of grain.
Fantastic Voyage#124.dst: 곡물을 섞는다고? 맛이랑 식감을 왜 뒤섞어? 빵을 두 덩이 구우면 되잖아! 곡물이 두 종류 넘으면 여러 덩이 굽고.
Fantastic Voyage#124.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#125.src: Say, that reminds me! Bread’s probably the most versatile food. You can make it from just about any type of grain.
Fantastic Voyage#125.dst: 그러고 보니 생각났다! 빵은 아마 제일 다재다능한 음식일 거야. 거의 모든 곡물로 만들 수 있거든.
Fantastic Voyage#125.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#126.src: But just because you can doesn’t mean that you should. Who could stomach somethin’ like “Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight”? WHO WOULD EVEN MAKE BREAD OUT OF OATS?!
Fantastic Voyage#126.dst: 하지만 할 수 있다고 해야 하는 건 아니지. '오트밀 밀기울 퓨전 딜라이트' 같은 걸 누가 먹어? 대체 누가 귀리로 빵을 만들어?!
Fantastic Voyage#126.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#127.src: Just a waste of food, in my opinion. Sure, it may be like the hottest new culinary sensation now, but it’ll die out like any other idiotic fad in just days. I’m positive that nobody’s eatin’ it for the taste, that’s for sure. Like “Seven Colors of the Grainbow,” or “Hearty Hemp-tastic,” or...
Fantastic Voyage#127.dst: 내 생각엔 그냥 음식 낭비야. 그래, 지금은 제일 핫한 요리 유행일지 몰라도, 다른 멍청한 유행처럼 며칠이면 사그라들 거야. 맛으로 먹는 사람은 없다고 확신해. '곡물 무지개 일곱 빛깔'이나 '든든한 대마 판타스틱'이나...
Fantastic Voyage#127.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#128.src: ...and don’t get me started on “Pain au {p}”! But really, Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight is among the worst. Oh! That reminds me about a better use for oats.
Fantastic Voyage#128.dst: ...'Pain au {p}'는 말도 꺼내지 마! 근데 진짜 오트밀 밀기울 퓨전 딜라이트가 최악 중 하나야. 오! 귀리의 더 좋은 쓸모가 생각났다.
Fantastic Voyage#128.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#129.src: If you want to avoid bein’ three sheets to the wind after a busy night of Jofash Rum, then eat a hearty bowl of oatmeal.
Fantastic Voyage#129.dst: Jofash 럼을 퍼마신 밤 뒤에 곤드레만드레 안 되려면 오트밀을 든든하게 한 그릇 먹어.
Fantastic Voyage#129.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#130.src: Sounds crazy, I know. But it actually works. Take it from me; I’ve tried it!
Fantastic Voyage#130.dst: 미친 소리 같지, 알아. 근데 진짜 효과 있어. 내 말 믿어, 해 봤거든!
Fantastic Voyage#130.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#131.src: While anythin’ made of grain helps, oats are particularly good at this.
Fantastic Voyage#131.dst: 곡물로 만든 건 다 도움이 되지만, 귀리가 특히 좋아.
Fantastic Voyage#131.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#132.src: And I’d bet my bread that you’d rather eat oatmeal than Oatmeal-Bran Fusion Delight, whatever that’s supposed to be.
Fantastic Voyage#132.dst: 그리고 내 빵을 걸고 장담하는데, 오트밀 밀기울 퓨전 딜라이트가 뭐든 간에 그냥 오트밀이 낫지.
Fantastic Voyage#132.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#133.src: Though, it seems like you can’t just get a good loaf of bread nearby. Sure, there’s sailin’ biscuits, but that hardly qualifies!
Fantastic Voyage#133.dst: 근데 이 근처에선 제대로 된 빵을 구할 수가 없는 것 같아. 항해용 비스킷이 있긴 한데, 그건 빵 축에도 못 껴!
Fantastic Voyage#133.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#134.src: I can’t stomach the fancy stuff, so I just make my own. Not only is it cheaper, but it also tastes much better.
Fantastic Voyage#134.dst: 난 비싼 건 못 먹겠어서 직접 만들어. 더 싸기도 하고, 맛도 훨씬 좋아.
Fantastic Voyage#134.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#135.src: It isn’t too difficult. Besides the obvious, you’ll just need some salt and yeast. Grab something to write with, y’hear? Take some notes!
Fantastic Voyage#135.dst: 별로 안 어려워. 당연한 재료 말고는 소금이랑 효모만 있으면 돼. 쓸 거 좀 챙겨, 알았지? 받아 적어!
Fantastic Voyage#135.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#136.src: Ready? Right, let’s get started! The less ingredients you use, the closer you’ll be to makin’ a real loaf! Not the wannabe poundcakes eaten by wannabe spendthrifts.
Fantastic Voyage#136.dst: 준비됐어? 좋아, 시작하자! 재료를 적게 쓸수록 진짜 빵에 가까워져! 허세꾼들이나 먹는 짝퉁 파운드케이크 말고.
Fantastic Voyage#136.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#137.src: There’s a common misconception that you need sugar for the yeast to start risin’. Not true!
Fantastic Voyage#137.dst: 효모가 부풀려면 설탕이 필요하다는 흔한 오해가 있는데, 틀렸어!
Fantastic Voyage#137.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#138.src: Give it some time, and bread without sugar will rise just as well. If you want somethin’ good, you need to put in the time and effort for it!
Fantastic Voyage#138.dst: 시간만 주면 설탕 없는 빵도 똑같이 잘 부풀어. 좋은 걸 원하면 시간과 노력을 들여야지!
Fantastic Voyage#138.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#139.src: Get it right, and you’ll have the perfect taste and texture for nothin’ more than a few hours of your time!
Fantastic Voyage#139.dst: 제대로만 하면 몇 시간만 들여서 완벽한 맛과 식감을 얻을 수 있어!
Fantastic Voyage#139.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#140.src: Let me make it clear: you don’t want sugar in your bread. It’ll do a number on its taste and your teeth.
Fantastic Voyage#140.dst: 확실히 말해 둘게. 빵에 설탕은 넣으면 안 돼. 맛도 이도 망가뜨려.
Fantastic Voyage#140.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#141.src: I’ll cover the taste first. The sugar fights with the raw, savory flavors of an otherwise respectable loaf of bread.
Fantastic Voyage#141.dst: 맛부터 얘기하자. 설탕은 괜찮은 빵의 날것 그대로의 고소한 풍미와 충돌해.
Fantastic Voyage#141.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#142.src: It also fights with your teeth. Bread’s quite sticky as it is, and the sugar doesn’t do it any favors.
Fantastic Voyage#142.dst: 이하고도 충돌하지. 빵은 원래 끈적한데, 설탕은 전혀 도움이 안 돼.
Fantastic Voyage#142.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#143.src: Why, I can still remember the time that I got a cavity. Cried my eyes out, I did.
Fantastic Voyage#143.dst: 아, 충치 생겼던 때가 아직도 기억나. 펑펑 울었지, 진짜로.
Fantastic Voyage#143.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#144.src: Eventually, my pappy had enough, and he went for the ol’ string-on-a-doorknob trick. He got me good there, though it took him a few tries.
Fantastic Voyage#144.dst: 결국 울 아빠가 참다못해 문고리에 실 묶는 옛날 수법을 썼어. 몇 번 만에 확실히 뽑아 줬지.
Fantastic Voyage#144.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#145.src: Ah, it seems like I got distracted. Back to the topic at hand.
Fantastic Voyage#145.dst: 아, 또 딴 데로 샜네. 본론으로 돌아가자.
Fantastic Voyage#145.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#146.src: You aren’t goin’ to get quite as much of an effect on your digestion than coarse-ground whole-grain bread. It keeps most of the fiber intact, after all.
Fantastic Voyage#146.dst: 굵게 빻은 통곡물 빵만큼 소화에 효과를 보진 못할 거야. 그건 섬유질을 거의 그대로 간직하니까.
Fantastic Voyage#146.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#147.src: You know how fruit juice contains next to no fiber because none of it goes into the juice? It’s the same deal with white bread.
Fantastic Voyage#147.dst: 과일 주스엔 섬유질이 거의 안 들어가서 섬유질이 없잖아? 흰 빵도 똑같아.
Fantastic Voyage#147.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#148.src: Fruit juice was banned in my household. As my pappy liked to say, a real man only drinks hard spirits and the sweat runnin’ down his face! Though I wasn’t allowed to have the former, not yet at least! Heheh! So I drank milk instead.
Fantastic Voyage#148.dst: 우리 집에선 과일 주스가 금지였어. 울 아빠 말로는 진짜 사내는 독한 술과 얼굴에 흐르는 땀만 마신대! 난 술은 아직 안 됐으니까! 헤헤! 그래서 우유를 마셨지.
Fantastic Voyage#148.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#149.src: Say, if you haven’t done so already, try bread dipped in milk! Go on! There’s nothin’ quite like it. Don’t accidentally drop the bread into the milk, of course.
Fantastic Voyage#149.dst: 그러고 보니, 아직 안 해 봤으면 빵을 우유에 찍어 먹어 봐! 어서! 그만한 게 없어. 물론 빵을 우유에 빠뜨리진 말고.
Fantastic Voyage#149.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#150.src: You’ll end up with a bloated mess with the consistency of a sponge. And you should know by now that consistency is everythin’!
Fantastic Voyage#150.dst: 스펀지 같은 식감의 퉁퉁 불은 덩어리가 될 거야. 이제 알겠지만 식감의 일관성이 전부라고!
Fantastic Voyage#150.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#151.src: While we’re on the subject of milk, do you know some folks can’t drink it? Oh, yes, they can try, but sooner or later their belly will protest.
Fantastic Voyage#151.dst: 우유 얘기가 나온 김에, 우유를 못 마시는 사람도 있는 거 알아? 아, 마실 순 있지. 근데 조만간 배가 항의할 거야.
Fantastic Voyage#151.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#152.src: It’s the same deal with bread! Stick with whole-grain, nothin’ added. That way, you don’t have to worry about surprise milk appearances and whatnot.
Fantastic Voyage#152.dst: 빵도 똑같아! 아무것도 안 넣은 통곡물을 고집해. 그러면 갑자기 우유가 튀어나올 걱정 같은 건 없지.
Fantastic Voyage#152.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#153.src: You got that? Let me know when you’re ready for more. Say, you know what? I oughta talk a bit slower to help you digest what I’m sayin’. Oh! “Digest”! I did it again! Heheh...
Fantastic Voyage#153.dst: 알겠어? 더 들을 준비 되면 말해. 아, 그러고 보니 내 말을 소화하기 쉽게 좀 천천히 말해야겠다. 오! '소화'! 또 했네! 헤헤...
Fantastic Voyage#153.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#154.src: Right, then, somethin’ that really peeves me is people who use bakin’ powder. What’s wrong with some good ol’ yeast?
Fantastic Voyage#154.dst: 좋아, 그럼 진짜 짜증 나는 건 베이킹파우더 쓰는 사람들이야. 좋은 옛 효모가 뭐가 어때서?
Fantastic Voyage#154.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#155.src: Too little of it, and it’ll go plum flat in the oven. Just a little too much of it, and your bread’s going to be as bitter as wormwood!
Fantastic Voyage#155.dst: 너무 적으면 오븐에서 납작해져. 조금만 많아도 빵이 쑥처럼 써진다고!
Fantastic Voyage#155.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#156.src: The only way to get a size that’s just right is the long way! Wait until the yeast works its magic, and bake it right as it reaches its good size.
Fantastic Voyage#156.dst: 딱 맞는 크기를 얻는 방법은 느긋하게 하는 것뿐이야! 효모가 마법을 부리길 기다렸다가, 알맞게 부풀면 바로 구워.
Fantastic Voyage#156.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#157.src: There’s also nothin’ quite like the smell of yeast as it causes the dough to rise! Works up quite the appetite, it does.
Fantastic Voyage#157.dst: 효모가 반죽을 부풀릴 때 나는 냄새만 한 것도 없어! 식욕이 확 돋는다니까.
Fantastic Voyage#157.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#158.src: Some people put the cart before the horse and think that yeast works like bakin’ powder. Try that, and you’ll end up with scorchin’-hot bricks in your oven.
Fantastic Voyage#158.dst: 어떤 사람들은 순서를 거꾸로 알고 효모가 베이킹파우더처럼 작용한다고 생각해. 그러면 오븐에서 뜨거운 벽돌만 나와.
Fantastic Voyage#158.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#159.src: No, you have to do it right, and doin’ it right means leavin’ some of the work to the yeast.
Fantastic Voyage#159.dst: 아니, 제대로 해야 해. 제대로 한다는 건 일부는 효모한테 맡긴다는 거고.
Fantastic Voyage#159.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#160.src: Unless you like flat breads. I can’t see why anyone would, though. Bread’s supposed to be puffy and chewy, not some dough jerky!
Fantastic Voyage#160.dst: 납작한 빵을 좋아하면 몰라도. 근데 누가 좋아하는지 모르겠어. 빵은 폭신하고 쫄깃해야지, 반죽 육포가 아니라고!
Fantastic Voyage#160.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#161.src: Though that may not be the case for other pastries. For one, I’ve never once heard of a pie with a chewy crust.
Fantastic Voyage#161.dst: 다른 과자류는 아닐 수도 있지만. 일단 난 껍질이 쫄깃한 파이는 들어 본 적이 없어.
Fantastic Voyage#161.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#162.src: Really, the beauty in bread lies with it’s simplicity! No complicated steps, no chances for the dough to rebel. Certainly not as fickle as somethin’ like a cream puff.
Fantastic Voyage#162.dst: 진짜로, 빵의 아름다움은 단순함에 있어! 복잡한 단계도 없고, 반죽이 반항할 틈도 없지. 슈크림처럼 까다롭지도 않고.
Fantastic Voyage#162.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#163.src: If you treat the dough with respect, the bread will respect you in turn. It’s simple stuff, really! No finnickin’ around with stiff peaks, or needin’ half a dozen bowls to mix in, or getting a flaky dough just right, or...
Fantastic Voyage#163.dst: 반죽을 존중하면 빵도 널 존중해 줘. 진짜 간단하다니까! 머랭 뿔 세운다고 씨름할 필요도, 그릇 여섯 개 쓸 필요도, 페이스트리 결을 딱 맞출 필요도 없고...
Fantastic Voyage#163.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#164.src: ...and not to mention that just about everythin’ needs butter in some shape or form! Really, what’s with it? It’s not like the stuff grows on trees!
Fantastic Voyage#164.dst: ...게다가 거의 모든 게 어떤 식으로든 버터가 필요하잖아! 진짜 왜 그래? 버터가 나무에서 열리는 것도 아닌데!
Fantastic Voyage#164.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#165.src: Makin’ the pastry shiny. Makin’ it taste rich. Makin’ the dough thick. There’s no end to it! Bread’s so much simpler to handle.
Fantastic Voyage#165.dst: 반짝이게 하려고. 진한 맛 내려고. 반죽 두껍게 하려고. 끝이 없어! 빵은 다루기가 훨씬 간단하지.
Fantastic Voyage#165.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#166.src: Though some people insist upon puttin’ butter in the bread. Not just on it, but in it! There’s more butter than bread at that point!
Fantastic Voyage#166.dst: 근데 굳이 빵에 버터를 넣겠다는 사람들이 있어. 위에 바르는 게 아니라 안에! 그쯤 되면 빵보다 버터가 많아!
Fantastic Voyage#166.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#167.src: I don’t have anythin’ against butter itself, mind you. It’s great on toast! Just I think it oughta stay on the toast rather than in it.
Fantastic Voyage#167.dst: 오해 마, 버터 자체엔 불만 없어. 토스트에 바르면 최고지! 다만 토스트 안이 아니라 위에 있어야 한다는 거야.
Fantastic Voyage#167.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#168.src: Not to mention that there’s a time, place, and occasion for it. If you put butter on everythin’, you’re goin’ to get sick of it real quickly. Eat it in moderation! Your tongue and your emerald pouch will thank you.
Fantastic Voyage#168.dst: 게다가 버터에도 때와 장소와 상황이 있지. 뭐든 버터를 바르면 금방 질려. 적당히 먹어! 혀랑 에메랄드 주머니가 고마워할 거야.
Fantastic Voyage#168.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#169.src: Of course, there’s always margarine, but why settle for somethin’ inferior? You shouldn’t settle for anythin’ less than the quality you’d expect from your bread!
Fantastic Voyage#169.dst: 물론 마가린도 있지만, 왜 못한 걸로 만족해? 빵에 기대하는 품질보다 못한 건 절대 타협하지 마!
Fantastic Voyage#169.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#170.src: Though, now that I look at it, bread does get a reputation for bein’ a breakfast food. That’s ridiculous! It’s got a place in every meal of the day!
Fantastic Voyage#170.dst: 근데 보니까 빵은 아침 식사용이라는 인식이 있어. 말도 안 돼! 하루 모든 끼니에 빵 자리가 있다고!
Fantastic Voyage#170.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#171.src: Sandwiches? They’ve got bread in ‘em. Casseroles? Any respectable one has it as a shell. Breadsticks? It’s in the name for cryin’ out loud!
Fantastic Voyage#171.dst: 샌드위치? 빵 들어가지. 캐서롤? 제대로 된 건 빵으로 감싸. 브레드스틱? 세상에, 이름에 빵이 있잖아!
Fantastic Voyage#171.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#172.src: Done right, and it’s also great as a side. I already mentioned having a fresh-ground fresh-baked loaf of whole-grain with a slab of flat-iron steak, but really, a well-sliced loaf and some dippin’ butter can transform a family dinner into a banquet!
Fantastic Voyage#172.dst: 잘 만들면 곁들이로도 최고야. 갓 빻아 갓 구운 통곡물 빵에 스테이크 얘긴 벌써 했지만, 진짜로 잘 썬 빵에 찍어 먹을 버터만 있으면 가족 저녁이 연회로 바뀐다니까!
Fantastic Voyage#172.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#173.src: They’re almost as versatile as potatoes! Actually, even more so, I’d say!
Fantastic Voyage#173.dst: 감자만큼 다재다능해! 사실 그보다 더하다고 봐!
Fantastic Voyage#173.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#174.src: As my pappy liked to say, a real man’s got to earn his daily bread through his own toilin’. As you can see, I’ve taken his advice to heart!
Fantastic Voyage#174.dst: 울 아빠 말로는 진짜 사내는 제 노동으로 일용할 빵을 벌어야 한대. 보다시피 난 그 말을 새겨들었지!
Fantastic Voyage#174.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#175.src: ...I feel that I’m missin’ somethin’ important that I wanted to discuss. Hang on for a bit, would you?
Fantastic Voyage#175.dst: ...얘기하고 싶던 중요한 걸 빠뜨린 것 같아. 잠깐만 기다려 줄래?
Fantastic Voyage#175.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#176.src: Ah, of course! I can’t believe that I forgot! I wanted to cover some thoughts about bread consistency.
Fantastic Voyage#176.dst: 아, 그렇지! 그걸 잊다니 믿을 수가 없네! 빵 식감의 일관성에 대해 할 말이 있었어.
Fantastic Voyage#176.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#177.src: Namely, the two extremes: too chewy, and not chewy enough. I already spoke on hardly chewy bread plenty, but there’s such a thing as too much of a good thing.
Fantastic Voyage#177.dst: 말하자면 두 극단이야. 너무 쫄깃한 것과 덜 쫄깃한 것. 거의 안 쫄깃한 빵 얘긴 많이 했지만, 좋은 것도 지나치면 문제거든.
Fantastic Voyage#177.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#178.src: And in this case, bread chewiness is a good thing. You don’t want your bread to be too chewy, got it?
Fantastic Voyage#178.dst: 이 경우엔 빵의 쫄깃함이 좋은 거야. 빵이 너무 쫄깃하면 안 된다고, 알겠지?
Fantastic Voyage#178.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#179.src: Too chewy’s a step right towards bread that’s outright rubbery. Your teeth’ll bounce right off it!
Fantastic Voyage#179.dst: 너무 쫄깃하면 완전 고무 같은 빵으로 한 걸음이야. 이가 그대로 튕겨 나갈걸!
Fantastic Voyage#179.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#180.src: Sure, too much give in the dough’s awkward and sets you up for bitin’ your own tongue, but too firm of a loaf can lead to much of the same.
Fantastic Voyage#180.dst: 그래, 반죽이 너무 물러도 곤란하고 혀를 깨물기 쉽지만, 너무 단단한 빵도 결국 마찬가지야.
Fantastic Voyage#180.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#181.src: They always say never bite off more than you could chew, but you oughta be careful not to bite off any less than that, either!
Fantastic Voyage#181.dst: 씹을 수 있는 것 이상은 베어 물지 말라고들 하지만, 그보다 덜 베어 무는 것도 조심해야 해!
Fantastic Voyage#181.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#182.src: No, just right and chewy’s what you want. Don’t settle for anything more or less!
Fantastic Voyage#182.dst: 그래, 딱 알맞게 쫄깃한 게 네가 원하는 거야. 그 이상도 이하도 타협하지 마!
Fantastic Voyage#182.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#183.src: Hmm, come to think. You seem really interested in discussin’ bread with me!
Fantastic Voyage#183.dst: 흠, 생각해 보니. 너 나랑 빵 얘기하는 데 진짜 관심 많아 보인다!
Fantastic Voyage#183.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#184.src: Lean in for a second, would you? I’ve got somethin’ important to say.
Fantastic Voyage#184.dst: 잠깐 가까이 와 볼래? 중요한 할 말이 있어.
Fantastic Voyage#184.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#185.src: Listening? Right! Ah, sorry, I didn’t mean to shout in your ear.
Fantastic Voyage#185.dst: 듣고 있어? 좋아! 아, 미안, 귀에 대고 소리 지를 생각은 없었어.
Fantastic Voyage#185.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#186.src: You’re just about the only person that I’ve been able to have an honest conversation about bread with.
Fantastic Voyage#186.dst: 너는 내가 빵에 대해 솔직하게 얘기할 수 있었던 거의 유일한 사람이야.
Fantastic Voyage#186.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#187.src: Usually, bread gets brushed off as some kind of dull fodder. Dismissed as too borin’ and too plain, I tell you! That’s what leads to unnecessary excess as people try to make it into something that it’s not.
Fantastic Voyage#187.dst: 보통 빵은 따분한 사료 취급을 받지. 너무 지루하고 밋밋하다고 무시당한다니까! 그래서 사람들이 빵을 빵 아닌 걸로 만들려다 쓸데없이 과해지는 거야.
Fantastic Voyage#187.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#188.src: But us? We’re different, we’re visionaries, and we know the truth about what really makes a good loaf!
Fantastic Voyage#188.dst: 하지만 우리? 우린 달라. 우린 선견지명이 있고, 좋은 빵을 만드는 진실을 알지!
Fantastic Voyage#188.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#189.src: Tell ‘em off, I say! They can’t follow the thoughts of bread enthusiasts like you and I otherwise!
Fantastic Voyage#189.dst: 따끔하게 말해 줘! 안 그러면 너랑 나 같은 빵 애호가의 생각을 못 따라온다고!
Fantastic Voyage#189.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#190.src: Ah! Right, never did I get to answerin’ your question. About my favorite type of bread, that is...
Fantastic Voyage#190.dst: 아! 맞다, 네 질문에 답을 안 했네. 내가 제일 좋아하는 빵 말이지...
Fantastic Voyage#190.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#192.src: Sure, it may be simple, but if you were payin’ any attention at all, you’d know for sure why that’s everythin’ that I’m lookin’ for.
Fantastic Voyage#192.dst: 그래, 단순하지. 하지만 조금이라도 귀 기울였다면 왜 그게 내가 찾는 전부인지 확실히 알 거야.
Fantastic Voyage#192.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#193.src: And that just about sums up the basics! Let me know if you want to hear anythin’ more.
Fantastic Voyage#193.dst: 기초는 대충 이 정도야! 더 듣고 싶으면 말해.
Fantastic Voyage#193.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#194.src: Let’s continue! Have you ever seen a baker wearin’ a fancy hat? Have you ever wondered how that corresponds to how well they bake bread compared to somethin’ else?
Fantastic Voyage#194.dst: 계속하자! 멋진 모자 쓴 제빵사 본 적 있어? 그게 다른 것에 비해 빵을 얼마나 잘 굽는지와 무슨 관계인지 궁금했던 적은?
Fantastic Voyage#194.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#195.src: Hah! That crazy coot, you're chattin' with that feller?
Fantastic Voyage#195.dst: 하! 그 미친 영감이랑 얘기하고 있다고?
Fantastic Voyage#195.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#196.src: He's wack-o, y'know... Singing his songs all day, somethin's not right upstairs.
Fantastic Voyage#196.dst: 그 양반 제정신이 아니야... 하루 종일 노래나 부르고, 머리가 좀 이상하다고.
Fantastic Voyage#196.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#197.src: You do you, buddy, but I'd steer clear.
Fantastic Voyage#197.dst: 알아서 해, 친구. 난 멀리할 거야.
Fantastic Voyage#197.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#198.src: A parrot? You know where you are, right?
Fantastic Voyage#198.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#199.src: I see plenty parrots every day, I don't keep track.
Fantastic Voyage#199.dst: 앵무새야 매일 잔뜩 보는데 일일이 기억 못 해.
Fantastic Voyage#199.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#200.src: I'll keep an eye or two out for one, though, sound peachy?
Fantastic Voyage#200.dst: 그래도 한두 번 눈여겨봐 줄게, 괜찮지?
Fantastic Voyage#200.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#202.dst: 보, 보, 봤어요!!! 그 새, 새를!!!
Fantastic Voyage#202.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#203.src: IT'S IN T-THE TREE, HERE! IT'S HERE!!!
Fantastic Voyage#203.dst: 나, 나무에 있어요, 여기! 여기 있어요!!!
Fantastic Voyage#203.speaker: Jofash Resident

Fantastic Voyage#206.src: You have the map! Thank you for the assistance!
Fantastic Voyage#206.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#207.src: Now let us set sail, and cover some distance!
Fantastic Voyage#207.dst: 자, 이제 돛을 올리고 멀리 가 보세, 바다로!
Fantastic Voyage#207.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#208.src: I'm sorry, new friend, to be of haste!
Fantastic Voyage#208.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#209.src: However I sense power in you, and we have no time to waste!
Fantastic Voyage#209.dst: 허나 자네에게서 힘이 느껴지니, 시간 낭비 말고 어서!
Fantastic Voyage#209.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#210.src: So off we go, to find an old friend, that would be ideal.
Fantastic Voyage#210.dst: 그럼 떠나세, 옛 친구를 찾으러, 그게 제일일세.
Fantastic Voyage#210.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#211.src: I'll captain the ship up at the steering wheel.
Fantastic Voyage#211.dst: 나는 저 위 조타륜에서 선장을 맡겠네.
Fantastic Voyage#211.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#212.src: Speak to Captain Relend aboard the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#212.dst: Little Wing에 탄 Relend 선장과 대화하세요.

Fantastic Voyage#213.src: Welcome aboard, I suppose I can consider you my first mate. Although, it appears we now have a problem on our plate.
Fantastic Voyage#213.dst: 어서 타게, 자네를 일등 항해사로 삼겠네. 헌데 우리 앞에 문제가 하나 생긴 것 같네.
Fantastic Voyage#213.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#214.src: You see those spikes all around my boat? Well, we're about to ram into them like a goat!
Fantastic Voyage#214.dst: 배 주위 저 가시들 보이나? 염소처럼 들이받기 직전이라네, 이거 큰일 아닌가!
Fantastic Voyage#214.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#215.src: I'd steer around them, but it appears the wheel is all smashed. I need you to craft a new one before we both get splashed!
Fantastic Voyage#215.dst: 피해 가고 싶지만 조타륜이 박살 났다네. 둘 다 물에 빠지기 전에 새로 하나 만들어 주게!
Fantastic Voyage#215.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#216.src: There's a Crafting Table at the front near all the crates. Now hurry up, else the ocean floor awaits!
Fantastic Voyage#216.dst: 앞쪽 상자들 옆에 제작대가 있다네. 서두르게, 안 그러면 바다 밑바닥이 기다린다네!
Fantastic Voyage#216.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#217.src: Bring a Wooden Board, a Center Piece, and a String to the Crafting Table.
Fantastic Voyage#217.dst: 나무판, 중심 부품, 끈을 제작대로 가져가세요.

Fantastic Voyage#218.src: Bring the Steering Wheel to Captain Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#219.src: Ah, thank you for helping me in my time of need. Let's maneuver through these spikes at a steady speed!
Fantastic Voyage#219.dst: 아, 어려울 때 도와줘서 고맙네. 이 가시들 사이로 천천히 빠져나가 보세!
Fantastic Voyage#219.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#220.src: Although, at the last minute, there is something I have to confess. I have never captained a ship with any success.
Fantastic Voyage#220.dst: 헌데 막판에 털어놓을 게 하나 있네. 나는 배를 제대로 몰아 본 적이 없다네.
Fantastic Voyage#220.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#221.src: I think before we get into any real danger, we should turn around. Could you man the wheel and get us back to solid ground?
Fantastic Voyage#221.dst: 진짜 위험해지기 전에 돌아가야겠네. 자네가 키를 잡고 단단한 땅으로 데려다주겠나?
Fantastic Voyage#221.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#222.src: Man the wheel of the Little Wing.

Fantastic Voyage#223.src: Now you're the captain, hope the sea's not making you nauseous. Steer this ship, but you'll have to be cautious!
Fantastic Voyage#223.dst: 이제 자네가 선장일세, 뱃멀미는 안 하길. 이 배를 몰되, 조심 또 조심하길!
Fantastic Voyage#223.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#224.src: Nice steering, although your maneuvers are a bit brash. Hey, watch out! I think we're about to-
Fantastic Voyage#224.dst: 잘 모는군, 조금 거칠긴 하지만. 이봐, 조심해! 우리 곧 부딪...
Fantastic Voyage#224.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#225.src: Find Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#225.dst: Little Wing의 잔해 안에서 Relend를 찾으세요.

Fantastic Voyage#226.src: As you can see, my ship has become a shipwreck! Now please help me, I am trapped in the lower deck!
Fantastic Voyage#226.dst: 보다시피 내 배가 난파선이 됐네! 도와주게, 아래 갑판에 갇혔다네!
Fantastic Voyage#226.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#227.src: Amazing work, seems you got below deck rather quickly! You're going to have to get through this wreckage to free me!
Fantastic Voyage#227.dst: 대단하군, 갑판 아래로 금방 내려왔네! 날 꺼내려면 이 잔해를 뚫고 와야 한다네!
Fantastic Voyage#227.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#228.src: Wow, so you managed to work your way through after all! Maybe to free me, you can use that cannonball?
Fantastic Voyage#228.dst: 와, 결국 뚫고 왔군그래! 날 꺼내려면 저 포탄을 써 보면 어떻겠나?
Fantastic Voyage#228.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#229.src: Save Relend inside of the wreck of the Little Wing.
Fantastic Voyage#229.dst: Little Wing의 잔해 안에서 Relend를 구하세요.

Fantastic Voyage#230.src: Thank you for freeing me, now let's leave this mess! Although, I don't know how to do that, I have not even a guess.
Fantastic Voyage#230.dst: 꺼내 줘서 고맙네, 이 난장판을 떠나세! 헌데 어떻게 떠날지는 짐작도 안 가네.
Fantastic Voyage#230.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#231.src: When the ship crashed, it was buried beneath the sand! But the good news is that we're finally back on land!
Fantastic Voyage#231.dst: 배가 부딪칠 때 모래 아래 묻혀 버렸네! 그래도 좋은 소식은 마침내 땅을 밟았다는 거라네!
Fantastic Voyage#231.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#232.src: We should probably get of this place, it feels rather small. Perhaps you can try to break through that weak spot in the wall?
Fantastic Voyage#232.dst: 여긴 좀 좁으니 빠져나가는 게 좋겠네. 저 벽의 약한 곳을 뚫어 볼 수 있겠나, 자네?
Fantastic Voyage#232.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#234.src: It looks like we're going to be stuck here for a while. Come and speak to me so we can find a way off of this isle!
Fantastic Voyage#234.dst: 한동안 여기 갇혀 있게 생겼군. 와서 말 걸게, 이 섬을 벗어날 방법을 찾아보세!
Fantastic Voyage#234.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#235.src: Speak to Relend on the beach.

Fantastic Voyage#236.src: Gateway Island... we've finally arrived. I'm just thankful that we survived.
Fantastic Voyage#236.dst: Gateway Island... 마침내 도착했네. 살아남은 것만으로도 감사하네.
Fantastic Voyage#236.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#237.src: Well, all this adventuring has me hungry for stew. We'll need ingredients, whatever's on the island will have to do.
Fantastic Voyage#237.dst: 모험을 했더니 스튜가 먹고 싶네. 재료가 필요한데, 섬에 있는 걸로 해야겠네.
Fantastic Voyage#237.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#238.src: Meat is definitely something we need to reap, try and get [{~} Raw Mutton] from those sheep.
Fantastic Voyage#238.dst: 고기는 꼭 필요하니 챙겨 보세, 저 양들에게서 [{~} Raw Mutton]을(를) 구해 오게.
Fantastic Voyage#238.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#239.src: And perhaps you could get [{~} Edible Mushrooms] from the western cave, just make sure not to get the kind that will send me to my grave.
Fantastic Voyage#239.dst: 서쪽 동굴에서 [{~} Edible Mushrooms]도 구해 오게, 다만 날 무덤으로 보낼 버섯은 캐지 말게.
Fantastic Voyage#239.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#240.src: I feel like something is missing from this medley. Oh, how about you get [{~} Coconut] from atop that tree?
Fantastic Voyage#240.dst: 이 모둠에 뭔가 빠진 것 같네. 오, 저 나무 꼭대기에서 [{~} Coconut]을(를) 따 오겠나, 자네?
Fantastic Voyage#240.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#241.src: And if you could fetch [{~} Berries], that would just make me merry!
Fantastic Voyage#241.dst: [{~} Berries]까지 가져오면, 내 기분이 아주 좋아지겠네!
Fantastic Voyage#241.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#242.src: Check your quest book if you ever need a recap. And to make sure you don't get lost, take this map.
Fantastic Voyage#242.dst: 다시 확인하려면 퀘스트 북을 보게. 길 잃지 않게 이 지도도 가져가게.
Fantastic Voyage#242.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#243.src: Give the Odd Stew to Relend.

Fantastic Voyage#244.src: Well, this stew has a rather odd flavor. But any food we can get here I shall savor.
Fantastic Voyage#244.dst: 음, 이 스튜 맛이 좀 이상하군. 그래도 여기선 뭐든 음미해야겠군.
Fantastic Voyage#244.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#245.src: What remains of my ship won't protect us very well. We'll need to find shelter, as you can clearly tell.
Fantastic Voyage#245.dst: 내 배의 잔해론 우릴 잘 지켜 주지 못하네. 보다시피 피난처를 찾아야 하네.
Fantastic Voyage#245.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#246.src: To the east, I can just barely make out a tent. Go and look for my friend there. I'm simply hellbent!
Fantastic Voyage#246.dst: 동쪽에 천막이 어렴풋이 보이네. 거기서 내 친구를 찾아보게. 난 꼭 찾아야겠네!
Fantastic Voyage#246.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#247.src: Check out the tent to the east.

Fantastic Voyage#249.src: So the tent was all empty and run-down? All of this bad news is making me frown.
Fantastic Voyage#249.dst: 천막이 텅 비고 다 낡았다고? 나쁜 소식뿐이라 얼굴이 절로 찌푸려지는군.
Fantastic Voyage#249.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#250.src: Allow me to borrow your map for a second. We'll have to find him somewhere else, I reckon.
Fantastic Voyage#250.dst: 지도 좀 잠깐 빌려주게. 다른 곳에서 그를 찾아야겠네, 내 짐작엔.
Fantastic Voyage#250.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#251.src: I know we can come up with a solution using our wits. Perhaps we can use an explosive to blow that big rock to bits!
Fantastic Voyage#251.dst: 머리를 쓰면 해결책이 나올 걸세. 폭약으로 저 큰 바위를 산산조각 내 보세!
Fantastic Voyage#251.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#252.src: Let's think of some materials we can get here. There isn't much on this island, I fear...
Fantastic Voyage#252.dst: 여기서 구할 재료를 생각해 보세. 이 섬엔 별게 없을 것 같네...
Fantastic Voyage#252.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#253.src: First we're going to need [{~} Gritty Sand]. Where to get it? Try the beach at the back of the island.
Fantastic Voyage#253.dst: 먼저 [{~} Gritty Sand]가 필요하네. 어디서 구하냐고? 섬 뒤편 해변을 찾아보게.
Fantastic Voyage#253.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#254.src: Next up is [Sawdust], you'll need three. I think the best place to search would be the largest tree.
Fantastic Voyage#254.dst: 다음은 [Sawdust], 세 개 필요하네. 가장 큰 나무를 찾아보는 게 제일 좋겠네.
Fantastic Voyage#254.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#255.src: Finally, [{~} Black Powder], found in a place that is very unique. You'll have to brave your way to the volcano's peak.
Fantastic Voyage#255.dst: 마지막은 [{~} Black Powder], 아주 특별한 곳에 있네. 용기 내서 화산 꼭대기까지 올라가야 하네.
Fantastic Voyage#255.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#256.src: You'll need those items you craft the bomb, I just told you where to look. If you forget what you need to find, check your quest book.
Fantastic Voyage#256.dst: 폭탄을 만들려면 그 재료들이 필요하네, 어디 있는지는 방금 말했네. 뭘 찾아야 할지 잊으면 퀘스트 북을 보게.
Fantastic Voyage#256.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#257.src: Bring {~} Gritty Sand, {~} Saw Dust, and {~} Black Powder to the Crafting Table.
Fantastic Voyage#257.dst: {~} Gritty Sand, {~} Saw Dust, {~} Black Powder를 제작대로 가져가세요.

Fantastic Voyage#258.src: Use the explosive on the boulder.

Fantastic Voyage#259.src: Incredible, The explosive blew right through the stone!
Fantastic Voyage#259.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#260.src: Let us progress into this mysterious zone.
Fantastic Voyage#260.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#263.src: For adventurers like us, an incredible cave, perfect to explore.
Fantastic Voyage#263.dst: 우리 같은 모험가에게 딱 맞는 굉장한 동굴일세, 탐험하기에 제격일세.
Fantastic Voyage#263.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#264.src: Surely where my old friend ventured - just as I swore!
Fantastic Voyage#264.dst: 분명 내 옛 친구가 왔던 곳일세, 내가 맹세했던 대로일세!
Fantastic Voyage#264.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#265.src: Long ago, a strong adventurer like yourself reached out to me for a wonderful sail. It truly is a gripping tale!
Fantastic Voyage#265.dst: 오래전, 자네처럼 강한 모험가가 멋진 항해를 청해 왔네. 정말 손에 땀을 쥐는 이야기였네!
Fantastic Voyage#265.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#266.src: We became best friends on our quest. But then he vanished, oh how he was the best.
Fantastic Voyage#266.dst: 그 여정에서 우린 절친이 되었네. 그런데 그가 사라졌지, 아, 최고의 친구였는데.
Fantastic Voyage#266.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#267.src: And we've finally made it to where he'd been. I can't wait to see him again, I don't know where to begin!
Fantastic Voyage#267.dst: 그리고 마침내 그가 왔던 곳에 이르렀네. 어서 다시 보고 싶네, 어디서부터 말해야 할지 모르겠네!
Fantastic Voyage#267.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#268.src: A mystical portal! This must be where my old friend got lost!
Fantastic Voyage#268.dst: 신비한 차원문이군! 내 옛 친구가 여기서 사라졌나 보군!
Fantastic Voyage#268.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#269.src: We must go through and find him, whatever the cost.
Fantastic Voyage#269.dst: 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 들어가서 그를 찾아야 하네, 반드시!
Fantastic Voyage#269.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#270.src: I can't believe it! I simply can't speak!
Fantastic Voyage#270.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#271.src: I always told the others I wasn't a freak. Old friend, I'll look for you until the bitter end!
Fantastic Voyage#271.dst: 난 괴짜가 아니라고 늘 말했지. 옛 친구여, 끝까지 자네를 찾을 걸세, 반드시!
Fantastic Voyage#271.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#272.src: Find Relend in the strange place

Fantastic Voyage#273.src: A foreign land filled with danger, to the brim...
Fantastic Voyage#273.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#274.src: It must be where he vanished to, regardless of how grim.
Fantastic Voyage#274.dst: 아무리 음산해도 그가 사라진 곳은 여기일 거야, 분명히.
Fantastic Voyage#274.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#275.src: My friend... Where do you think we are?
Fantastic Voyage#275.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#276.src: Whatever it is, I feel that we're being overseen from afar.
Fantastic Voyage#276.dst: 뭐가 됐든, 멀리서 누가 지켜보는 것 같지 않나.
Fantastic Voyage#276.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#277.src: With all this danger, I still hope my good friend is still okay.
Fantastic Voyage#277.dst: 이 모든 위험 속에서도 좋은 친구가 무사하길 바라네.
Fantastic Voyage#277.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#278.src: My goodness! Keep your wits about, we may be in for a fray!
Fantastic Voyage#278.dst: 세상에! 정신 바짝 차리게, 한바탕 싸움이 벌어지겠네!
Fantastic Voyage#278.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#279.src: Aagh... New friend... are you there?
Fantastic Voyage#279.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#280.src: Don't...give up... we must find him, I swear...
Fantastic Voyage#280.dst: 포기... 하지 말게... 반드시 그를 찾아야 하네, 맹세코...
Fantastic Voyage#280.speaker: Relend

Fantastic Voyage#281.src: I promise I'll find him, I'll do it, without a single scar!
Fantastic Voyage#281.dst: 약속하네, 그를 찾겠네, 해내겠네, 상처 하나 없이 말일세!
Fantastic Voyage#281.speaker: Relend

Fate of the Fallen#000.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to learn more of this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#000.dst: 아, {p} 군대 분이군요. 이 얼어붙은 봉분에 대해 더 알아보려는 중인데, 도움이 필요해요.

Fate of the Fallen#002.src: If you don't remember what I said, I remember you writing something in your book. Try looking there.
Fate of the Fallen#002.dst: 제가 한 말이 기억 안 나시면, 책에 뭔가 적으시는 걸 봤어요. 거기 한번 보세요.

Fate of the Fallen#003.src: You should head back to the mage with the wand.

Fate of the Fallen#004.src: This is the Temple of Time...

Fate of the Fallen#005.src: Here you can visit the memories of this land...
Fate of the Fallen#005.dst: 여기서 이 땅의 기억을 찾아갈 수 있다...

Fate of the Fallen#006.src: The altar requires an item from the time you desire to access...
Fate of the Fallen#006.dst: 제단에는 가고자 하는 시대의 물건이 필요하다...

Fate of the Fallen#007.src: You will access a memory as if you were present, but when you return it will be as if you were never there.
Fate of the Fallen#007.dst: 그 자리에 있는 것처럼 기억 속에 들어가지만, 돌아오면 마치 그곳에 간 적이 없었던 것처럼 된다.

Fate of the Fallen#008.src: You should stick around to find out how to reverse the spell.
Fate of the Fallen#008.dst: 남아서 주문을 되돌리는 방법을 알아내는 게 좋겠다.

Fate of the Fallen#009.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too far gone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#009.dst: 크아악... 모두에게... 전해라. 이곳을 얼리겠다. 난... 너-너무 늦었어. 이 땅은 치유할 시간이... 내 힘도 억눌러야... 얼려서...

Fate of the Fallen#010.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#010.dst: 그 참을 수 없는 녀- ...Mael한테서 배운 게 있다면... 이유 없는 죽음은 영혼을 떠돌게 한다는 거다. 난... 그 녀석을 더 힘들게 하고 싶지 않아.

Fate of the Fallen#011.src: Wha... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true that this place has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#011.dst: 뭐라고요... 이런 사실들이... 얼음 마법이 타락을 막는다고...? 확실히 여긴 지방의 다른 곳보다 타락 피해가 적었죠...

Fate of the Fallen#012.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... It was to protect everyone... but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#012.dst: 세상에... 우린 내내 완전히 오해했어요... 모두를 지키려던 거였다니... 정신이 멀쩡했다면 누군가에게 의도를 말했을 텐데요!

Fate of the Fallen#013.src: Soldier! I'm not sure it is wise to be here... An icy death awaits you if you proceed. A death that I will cause..
Fate of the Fallen#013.dst: 병사여! 여기 있는 건 현명하지 않을 텐데... 더 나아가면 차가운 죽음이 기다린다. 내가 내릴 죽음이..

Fate of the Fallen#014.src: I have many regrets of my time spent alive in Wynn. I do not wish for my lingering mistakes to harm anyone else. Turn back.
Fate of the Fallen#014.dst: 나는 Wynn에서 살던 시절에 후회가 많다. 남은 내 과오가 다른 이를 해치길 원치 않는다. 돌아가라.

Fate of the Fallen#016.src: You must think you can save me? There is no cure for what I have.
Fate of the Fallen#016.dst: 날 구할 수 있다고 생각하나? 내 병엔 치료법이 없다.

Fate of the Fallen#017.src: Unless.. You want to set me free?

Fate of the Fallen#020.src: I froze this land to allow it to heal.. People did not understand.. They came for me here, seeking revenge.
Fate of the Fallen#020.dst: 이 땅이 치유되도록 얼린 것이다.. 사람들은 이해하지 못했지.. 복수하려고 여기까지 날 찾아왔다.

Fate of the Fallen#021.src: Of course, just like you.. They can not leave. Their souls are stuck here. For the spell must not be broken.
Fate of the Fallen#021.dst: 물론, 너처럼 말이지.. 그들은 떠날 수 없다. 영혼이 이곳에 묶여 있다. 주문이 깨져선 안 되니까.

Fate of the Fallen#023.src: Even if you think you can cure me.. I can not allow you to try for if it were to fail my corrupted body would wreak havoc on the world!
Fate of the Fallen#023.dst: 날 치료할 수 있다고 생각해도.. 시도하게 둘 순 없다. 실패하면 타락한 내 몸이 세상을 파멸시킬 테니!

Fate of the Fallen#024.src: It will be dangerous...perhaps your toughest fight yet...but it must be done. If you need time to prepare, do so. But you must end Theorick's pain.
Fate of the Fallen#024.dst: 위험할 거예요... 어쩌면 지금까지 중 가장 힘든 싸움일지도... 하지만 해야만 해요. 준비할 시간이 필요하면 하세요. 하지만 Theorick의 고통은 꼭 끝내 주셔야 해요.

Fate of the Fallen#025.src: Don't you just love fishing? The little waves in the river, the wind and the rewarding feeling when you catch something, those are my favorite things about it.
Fate of the Fallen#025.dst: 낚시 정말 좋지 않아요? 강의 잔물결, 바람, 그리고 뭔가 낚았을 때의 뿌듯함, 그게 제가 제일 좋아하는 점이에요.

Fate of the Fallen#027.src: You can not return until your goal is fulfilled...
Fate of the Fallen#027.dst: 목표를 이루기 전까지는 돌아갈 수 없다...

Fate of the Fallen#028.src: Talk to Telvu the mage at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Fate of the Fallen#029.src: Ah, a member of the {p} army. We're trying to gain entry to this frozen barrow. We could use your aid.
Fate of the Fallen#029.dst: 아, {p} 군대 분이군요. 이 얼어붙은 봉분에 들어가려는 중인데, 도움이 필요해요.
Fate of the Fallen#029.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#030.src: Are you familiar with the story of Theorick and {p}?
Fate of the Fallen#030.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#031.src: Probably not. Well, you see, {p} was not always frozen.
Fate of the Fallen#031.dst: 모르시겠죠. 사실 {p}은(는) 원래 얼어 있던 곳이 아니에요.
Fate of the Fallen#031.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#032.src: During Theorick's time, this place was like the Wynn plains, warm and arable.
Fate of the Fallen#032.dst: Theorick 시절, 이곳은 Wynn 평원처럼 따뜻하고 비옥했죠.
Fate of the Fallen#032.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#033.src: For some reason, Theorick Twain used his immense power to freeze the land before exiling himself here.
Fate of the Fallen#033.dst: 웬일인지 Theorick Twain은 엄청난 힘으로 이 땅을 얼리고, 스스로 이곳에 유배됐어요.
Fate of the Fallen#033.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#034.src: We need to find out why so we can reverse this spell. Presumably, the source of that spell's magic would lie within the barrow... but we don't want to go in empty-handed.
Fate of the Fallen#034.dst: 그 이유를 알아야 이 주문을 되돌릴 수 있어요. 주문의 근원은 아마 봉분 안에 있겠지만... 빈손으로 들어가고 싶진 않네요.
Fate of the Fallen#034.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#035.src: As such...have you heard of a place called {p}? We could use it to go back in time, to try to learn more about Theorick's actions.
Fate of the Fallen#035.dst: 그래서 말인데... {p}(이)라는 곳을 아세요? 거길 이용하면 과거로 가서 Theorick의 행적을 더 알아볼 수 있어요.
Fate of the Fallen#035.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#036.src: Well...in a way, at least. There are laws to this sort of magic. For one, you need an item from the specific time we want to see. Second, you can witness the past, not change it.
Fate of the Fallen#036.dst: 음... 어떤 의미로는요. 이런 마법엔 규칙이 있어요. 첫째, 보려는 시대의 물건이 필요해요. 둘째, 과거는 볼 수만 있고 바꿀 순 없어요.
Fate of the Fallen#036.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#037.src: One of Theorick's staves is on display in the {p} bank. Presumably, it should work for what we need. Could you retrieve it somehow?
Fate of the Fallen#037.dst: Theorick의 지팡이 하나가 {p} 은행에 전시돼 있어요. 그거면 될 거예요. 어떻게든 가져와 주실래요?
Fate of the Fallen#037.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#039.src: Aha, quick job. I see you've got the wand. Must've needed a sharp tongue to get the bankers to give it up.
Fate of the Fallen#039.dst: 하하, 빠르시네요. 지팡이를 구하셨군요. 은행원들을 설득하려면 말솜씨가 좋아야 했을 텐데.
Fate of the Fallen#039.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#040.src: Now, it is a long walk to {p}. Needn't take that walk, though, as I can teleport you there. Hopefully.
Fate of the Fallen#040.dst: {p}까지는 먼 길이에요. 하지만 걸어갈 필요 없어요. 제가 순간이동시켜 드릴게요. 아마도요.
Fate of the Fallen#040.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#041.src: Once you're there, enter the Temple of Time. You should know what to do once you are there. Careful dealing with time travel, friend... No idea what you might find.
Fate of the Fallen#041.dst: 도착하면 Temple of Time에 들어가세요. 가 보면 할 일을 알게 될 거예요. 시간 여행은 조심하세요, 친구... 무엇을 만날지 몰라요.
Fate of the Fallen#041.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#043.src: Should anything go wrong, I'll stay here to teleport you back to the temple.
Fate of the Fallen#043.dst: 문제가 생기면 제가 여기서 신전으로 다시 보내 드릴게요.
Fate of the Fallen#043.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#044.src: Enter the portal the mage made.

Fate of the Fallen#045.src: Enter the Gate of Time at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and travel back in time.
Fate of the Fallen#045.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Gate of Time에 들어가 과거로 가세요.

Fate of the Fallen#048.src: Woah, your weaponry and armour is so advanced!
Fate of the Fallen#048.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#049.src: Are you another Twain? Only the Twains know magic like that.
Fate of the Fallen#049.dst: 당신도 Twain인가요? 그런 마법은 Twain 가문만 쓰는데.
Fate of the Fallen#049.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#051.src: He's busy fighting in the war, shouldn't you be doing the same?
Fate of the Fallen#051.dst: 그분은 전쟁에서 싸우느라 바빠요. 당신도 그래야 하지 않아요?
Fate of the Fallen#051.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#052.src: He went west. There was some kind of emergency.
Fate of the Fallen#052.dst: 서쪽으로 가셨어요. 무슨 급한 일이 있었나 봐요.
Fate of the Fallen#052.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#053.src: We've been fighting the corruption for years, it seems like it might finally engulf {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#053.dst: 몇 년째 타락과 싸우고 있는데, 결국 {p}까지 삼켜 버릴 것 같아요.
Fate of the Fallen#053.speaker: Psern

Fate of the Fallen#054.src: Find Theorick in the forest west of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#055.src: I could've sworn she had gone this way... Oh, what now, more imbeciles? This forest isn't safe to travel!
Fate of the Fallen#055.dst: 분명 이쪽으로 갔는데... 뭐야, 또 멍청이야? 이 숲은 함부로 다닐 데가 아니다!
Fate of the Fallen#055.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#056.src: If you need help, lodge a complaint with the guards. I'm busy and I can't exactly break away from saving this god-blessed province to chill your milk!!
Fate of the Fallen#056.dst: 도움이 필요하면 경비병한테 민원이나 넣어. 난 바빠. 이 빌어먹을 지방을 구하다 말고 네 우유나 식혀 줄 순 없다고!!
Fate of the Fallen#056.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#057.src: Are your ears full of wax?! I said-
Fate of the Fallen#057.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#058.src: Urgh, the things followed you! See what happens?! STAND ASIDE.
Fate of the Fallen#058.dst: 으, 놈들이 너를 따라왔잖아! 봤냐?! 비켜.
Fate of the Fallen#058.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#059.src: As though I needed TWO people to save! Now get out of here, I have to find that woman who went missing!
Fate of the Fallen#059.dst: 구할 사람이 둘이나 필요했던 것처럼! 이제 가, 실종된 여자를 찾아야 해!
Fate of the Fallen#059.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#060.src: HEEEELP! I can't outrun them!!! Guards! Someone!!
Fate of the Fallen#060.dst: 살려줘요! 도망칠 수가 없어요!!! 경비병! 누구든!!

Fate of the Fallen#061.src: Whuh! That's her voice! Where is she?! I just cleared this area!
Fate of the Fallen#061.dst: 헉! 그 여자 목소리다! 어디 있지?! 방금 여길 정리했는데!
Fate of the Fallen#061.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#063.src: Ugh, is she dragging them over from the west?! You there, If you don't want to end up frozen, GET BEHIND ME, NOW!!
Fate of the Fallen#063.dst: 으, 서쪽에서 놈들을 끌고 온 거야?! 거기 너, 얼어붙기 싫으면 당장 내 뒤로 와!!
Fate of the Fallen#063.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#064.src: Phew... You're out of danger now. If you hadn't left town, though, you wouldn't have been IN any danger at all!
Fate of the Fallen#064.dst: 휴... 이제 안전해. 그런데 애초에 마을을 안 나왔으면 위험할 일도 없었잖아!
Fate of the Fallen#064.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#065.src: Don't bother apologizing to me, just get back to town. Now.
Fate of the Fallen#065.dst: 사과할 필요 없어. 마을로 돌아가. 당장.
Fate of the Fallen#065.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#066.src: Next time you feel like picking flowers in the forest or whatever you were doing, remember you have a life to live, hm?!
Fate of the Fallen#066.dst: 다음에 숲에서 꽃이나 따고 싶어지면, 목숨은 하나라는 걸 기억해, 알겠어?!
Fate of the Fallen#066.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#067.src: Every day, more corrupteds, more deaths... There is only one thing for it. I have to tackle it myself. Cut the roots...and kill this hellish weed.
Fate of the Fallen#067.dst: 매일 타락자는 늘고, 죽는 사람도 늘고... 방법은 하나뿐이야. 내가 직접 처리해야 해. 뿌리를 잘라... 이 지옥 같은 잡초를 없애야지.
Fate of the Fallen#067.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#068.src: Still here? Well, listen up. Myself and a few others are planning something risky. Damned be it if our minds are lost, I need to go through that portal.
Fate of the Fallen#068.dst: 아직 있냐? 그럼 잘 들어. 나랑 몇 명이 위험한 일을 꾸미고 있어. 정신을 잃더라도, 난 그 포털을 넘어가야 해.
Fate of the Fallen#068.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#069.src: You look heavily geared, so I'm conscripting you. Meet us at our base, immediately. Follow the river south and you'll see a house on the right side.
Fate of the Fallen#069.dst: 장비가 든든해 보이니 널 징집하겠다. 당장 우리 기지로 와. 강을 따라 남쪽으로 가면 오른편에 집이 보일 거야.
Fate of the Fallen#069.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#070.src: Head to the base of the operation south of {p} [{~}, {~}, {~}].

Fate of the Fallen#071.src: Well, I'll give you this. You're prompt to listen to orders, at least. We're headed to the {p}.
Fate of the Fallen#071.dst: 좋아, 이건 인정하지. 적어도 명령은 빨리 듣는군. 우린 {p}(으)로 간다.
Fate of the Fallen#071.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#072.src: The last man that entered the portal and returned became Bak’al... But if there is even a fraction of a chance this could work, we must take it at this point.
Fate of the Fallen#072.dst: 마지막으로 포털에 들어갔다 돌아온 자는 Bak’al이 됐다... 하지만 조금이라도 가능성이 있다면, 이제는 해 봐야 해.
Fate of the Fallen#072.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#073.src: Let's get moving. We'll be taking no breaks on the trip, so I hope you were prepared.
Fate of the Fallen#073.dst: 출발하자. 가는 길에 쉬지 않을 거니까, 각오는 했길 바란다.
Fate of the Fallen#073.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#074.src: Now. The sheer cold I command can stave off corruption itself. Somehow I doubt any of you can say the same. I'll go in alone.
Fate of the Fallen#074.dst: 자. 내가 다루는 혹한은 타락 자체도 막아 낸다. 너희 중에 그런 놈은 없겠지. 나 혼자 들어간다.
Fate of the Fallen#074.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#075.src: When I enter... If I had to make an assumption, corrupteds will swarm the portal after me. Your job? Slay them. I can't have distractions in there.
Fate of the Fallen#075.dst: 내가 들어가면... 짐작건대 타락자들이 날 쫓아 포털로 몰려들 거다. 너희 임무? 놈들을 처치해. 안에서 방해받을 순 없어.
Fate of the Fallen#075.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#076.src: You will not be leaving your post here until I exit that portal. Understood?
Fate of the Fallen#076.dst: 내가 포털에서 나올 때까지 자리를 뜨지 마라. 알겠나?
Fate of the Fallen#076.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#079.src: ...no, no, no no no NO!! DAMN IT ALL!!
Fate of the Fallen#079.dst: ...안 돼, 안 돼, 안 돼!! 빌어먹을!!
Fate of the Fallen#079.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#080.src: You know what happened?! I lost!! I will destroy the province if I turn completely! GET AWAY, NOW! DO YOU HEAR ME?! RUN!!
Fate of the Fallen#080.dst: 무슨 일인지 알아?! 내가 졌어!! 완전히 변하면 지방을 파괴할 거다! 떨어져, 당장! 들려?! 도망쳐!!
Fate of the Fallen#080.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#081.src: I... C-calm yourself, Theorick...don't...don't lose yourself to it...there's...yet a solution...one way...
Fate of the Fallen#081.dst: 나... 지-진정해라, Theorick... 휩쓸리지... 마라... 아직... 방법이... 하나...
Fate of the Fallen#081.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#082.src: Oh...you again...the others...dead? Run off? Cowards...urgh...
Fate of the Fallen#082.dst: 아... 또 너냐... 다른 놈들은... 죽었나? 도망갔나? 겁쟁이들... 으...
Fate of the Fallen#082.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#083.src: You live...so...eyes up. Listen to me. If I turn...w-when...when I turn...n-no, can't...gaaah, I'll destr- Nggh...
Fate of the Fallen#083.dst: 살아 있군... 그럼... 똑바로 봐. 들어. 내가 변하면... 아니, 변할 때... 아-안 돼... 크아악, 파괴하- 으윽...
Fate of the Fallen#083.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#084.src: I won't last, you can tell... Right now...killing me is an impossibility, you idiotic weakl- Agh, GET OUT OF MY MIND!!
Fate of the Fallen#084.dst: 오래 못 버티는 거 알겠지... 지금은... 날 죽이는 건 불가능해, 이 멍청한 약골- 악, 내 머릿속에서 나가!!
Fate of the Fallen#084.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#085.src: Gaaah... Tell...everyone. I will freeze this place. I...t-too fargone. It needs time to heal...and my powers m-must be dampened...frozen...
Fate of the Fallen#085.dst: 크아악... 모두에게... 전해라. 이곳을 얼리겠다. 난... 너-너무 늦었어. 이 땅은 치유할 시간이... 내 힘도 억눌러야... 얼려서...
Fate of the Fallen#085.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#086.src: All worthless... Urgh, no...they yet deserve life...and this spell...it will surely claim some. Please, let them know why...
Fate of the Fallen#086.dst: 다 쓸모없는... 으, 아니... 그들도 살 자격이 있다... 이 주문은... 분명 누군가의 목숨을 앗아가겠지. 부디, 이유를 알려 줘...
Fate of the Fallen#086.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#087.src: If I have learned anything from that insufferable f- ...from Mael...deaths without reason lets spirits to linger. I would...prefer against giving him a harder time.
Fate of the Fallen#087.dst: 그 참을 수 없는 녀- ...Mael한테서 배운 게 있다면... 이유 없는 죽음은 영혼을 떠돌게 한다는 거다. 난... 그 녀석을 더 힘들게 하고 싶지 않아.
Fate of the Fallen#087.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#088.src: K-keep advancing. Your things, if everyone was as strong as you...we may stand a chance. This could end me, in time, once I am weaker.
Fate of the Fallen#088.dst: 계-계속 나아가라. 네 장비... 모두가 너만큼 강하다면... 승산이 있을지도. 내가 약해지면, 언젠가 이걸로 날 끝낼 수 있겠지.
Fate of the Fallen#088.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#089.src: Let it be known...Theorick Twain is not dead. He cannot be killed...all will burn...until future days. Here, in this accursed place. Find me...and end it all.
Fate of the Fallen#089.dst: 알려라... Theorick Twain은 죽지 않았다. 죽일 수 없다... 모든 게 불탄다... 먼 훗날까지. 이 저주받은 곳에서. 날 찾아... 끝내라.
Fate of the Fallen#089.speaker: Theorick

Fate of the Fallen#090.src: Tell Telvu the mage what happened.

Fate of the Fallen#091.src: You must have succeeded, or you would be yet in the memory of the past. I can feel some potent magic on you.
Fate of the Fallen#091.dst: 성공하셨군요. 아니면 아직 과거의 기억 속에 있었겠죠. 강력한 마력이 느껴져요.
Fate of the Fallen#091.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#092.src: So, you met Theorick? He was always said to have fallen from heroism after the great freezing.
Fate of the Fallen#092.dst: 그래서, Theorick을 만났나요? 대빙결 이후 영웅에서 타락했다고들 했죠.
Fate of the Fallen#092.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#093.src: Were you able to figure out why it was he froze this place, at least?
Fate of the Fallen#093.dst: 적어도 그가 왜 이곳을 얼렸는지는 알아내셨나요?
Fate of the Fallen#093.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#094.src: What... so many revelations... ice magic staves off corruption...? It is true this palce has seen less corrupted threats than other places in the province...
Fate of the Fallen#094.dst: 뭐라고요... 이런 사실들이... 얼음 마법이 타락을 막는다고...? 확실히 여긴 지방의 다른 곳보다 타락 피해가 적었죠...
Fate of the Fallen#094.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#095.src: Dear gods... We've had it all wrong this whole time... This was to protect everyone...but surely he would have told someone his intentions if he was of that sound a mind!
Fate of the Fallen#095.dst: 세상에... 우린 내내 완전히 오해했어요... 모두를 지키려던 거였다니... 정신이 멀쩡했다면 누군가에게 의도를 말했을 텐데요!
Fate of the Fallen#095.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#096.src: All this time, spent buried alive, wrestling with the corruption. The thought horrifies you, as well, judging by your face. Killing him would be a mercy.
Fate of the Fallen#096.dst: 그 긴 세월을 산 채로 묻혀 타락과 싸우다니. 표정을 보니 당신도 끔찍하게 느끼는군요. 그를 죽이는 게 자비겠죠.
Fate of the Fallen#096.speaker: Telvu

Fate of the Fallen#097.src: Here. Use this. It may help protect you within the Ice Barrows... Please, soldier. Be Theorick's guardian angel. Free him from this torment.
Fate of the Fallen#097.dst: 여기요. 이걸 쓰세요. 얼음 봉분 안에서 지켜 줄지도 몰라요... 부탁해요, 병사님. Theorick의 수호천사가 되어 주세요. 고통에서 풀어 주세요.
Fate of the Fallen#097.speaker: Telvu

Finding the Light#000.src: Every night, I hear lightning strike the exact same spot. I wonder what it could mean...

Finding the Light#001.src: Most of the pages are filled with religious verses. At the very end of the book, there's a card separate from the rest of the pages.

Finding the Light#002.src: I covered over the way down to that giant archive like you asked. It shouldn't be reachable now.

Finding the Light#003.src: It'd take something really heavy to crack open the foundation- Frankly, that gold church bell might do it if it's not maintained.

Finding the Light#004.src: I left ladders and platforms as access to the bell tower- Make sure you keep it in good condition! I don't want to have to do that kind of work again.

Finding the Light#005.src: What, are you thinking "oh, let's follow the funny elf girl and see her FAIL, OVER and OVER AGAIN!?" IS THAT IT?!
Finding the Light#005.dst: 뭐, "어이, 웃기는 엘프 계집애 따라가서 계속, 계속 실패하는 거나 구경하자!?" 이런 생각이야?! 그런 거냐고?!

Finding the Light#006.src: This is enough, Lari. I waken. And thus, your task is complete, {u}. You have done as Orphion asked.

Finding the Light#007.src: What connection does a primordial force have with the moral leanings of mortals- or even immortals?

Finding the Light#008.src: For now, {u} must learn what you have learned, of the nature of realms. They must know what you know if they are to aid you fully.

Finding the Light#009.src: Allow me to show you our reality, {u}. It is difficult to properly present its scale... So here is an approximation.

Finding the Light#010.src: The balance shifts, and Orphion grows weary. Angered, desperate. He called to you as a last plea- and you have done admirably, for what he has asked of you.

Finding the Light#011.src: Enter the portal, {u}. I shall show you the Gateway to Light... And I shall wish you luck.
Finding the Light#011.dst: 포털로 들어가라, {u}. 빛의 관문을 보여 주마... 그리고 행운을 빌겠다.

Finding the Light#012.src: What you have done may not have been the right thing, by anyone's account. However, it was necessary. You have thrown off your bonds, in a sense.
Finding the Light#012.dst: 누가 봐도 옳은 일은 아니었을지 모른다. 하지만 꼭 필요한 일이었다. 어떤 의미로는, 너는 속박을 벗어던졌다.

Finding the Light#013.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light IV - Finding the Light
Finding the Light#013.dst: 새 퀘스트 시작: 빛의 영역 IV - 빛을 찾아서

Finding the Light#014.src: That should have cracked open the foundation! You should check to see if you can reach the archive mentioned by the note card.
Finding the Light#014.dst: 저 정도면 토대가 깨졌을 것이다! 쪽지에 적힌 기록 보관소에 갈 수 있는지 확인해 봐야겠다.

Finding the Light#015.src: The door down below should open, now that you've activated the mechanisms.
Finding the Light#015.dst: 장치를 작동시켰으니 아래쪽 문이 열렸을 것이다.

Finding the Light#016.src: Some of the few pages are ripped out. It seems to be describing an event occurring with the Guardian of the Forest until the first missing page.
Finding the Light#016.dst: 몇 장이 뜯겨 나갔다. 첫 번째로 빠진 장까지는 숲의 수호자에게 일어난 일을 서술하는 것 같다.

Finding the Light#017.src: The rest of the book is in perfect condition- Who could've done this if the archives were locked away? Did someone enter before you?
Finding the Light#017.dst: 나머지는 멀쩡하다- 기록 보관소가 잠겨 있었는데 누가 이런 짓을? 누군가 먼저 들어왔던 걸까?

Finding the Light#018.src: ...so it returned, asleep and unwakeable. The light has spoken of a time when the Guardian shall grace us with its presence once more...
Finding the Light#018.dst: ...그리하여 그것은 돌아와, 깨어나지 않는 잠에 들었다. 빛은 수호자가 다시 모습을 드러낼 날을 예언했으니...

Finding the Light#019.src: ...but such a time is centuries off, and will require great effort. The spell included is vital to the process.
Finding the Light#019.dst: ...그날은 수백 년 뒤이며, 큰 노력이 필요하리라. 동봉한 주문은 그 과정에 꼭 필요하다.

Finding the Light#020.src: The light also warns- If the darkness should encroach and reach the Guardian's roots, it shall never wake... But it seems we will not have to worry of that.
Finding the Light#020.dst: 빛은 또한 경고했다- 어둠이 스며들어 수호자의 뿌리에 닿으면 영영 깨어나지 못하리라... 허나 그럴 걱정은 없을 듯하다.

Finding the Light#021.src: There's another loose page here, with more High Gavellian text on it. Lari should be able to translate this.
Finding the Light#021.dst: 여기 떨어진 쪽이 또 있다. 고등 Gavel어가 더 적혀 있다. Lari라면 번역할 수 있을 것이다.

Finding the Light#022.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thus far, it seems.
Finding the Light#022.dst: ...그럼 어서 해. 지금까진 난 그냥 통역사로만 필요한가 봐.

Finding the Light#024.src: The voice of the Light told you to pursue her. You shouldn't stop now, should you?
Finding the Light#024.dst: 빛의 목소리가 그녀를 쫓으라고 했다. 이제 와서 멈출 수는 없지 않은가?

Finding the Light#025.src: The building looks climbable... You can probably eavesdrop on the conversation if you climb up the walls.
Finding the Light#025.dst: 건물을 오를 수 있을 것 같다... 벽을 타고 올라가면 대화를 엿들을 수 있을지도.

Finding the Light#027.src: You got the plant! You should return by the Guardian of the Forest to proceed.
Finding the Light#027.dst: 식물을 얻었다! 숲의 수호자에게 돌아가 진행하자.

Finding the Light#028.src: I DON'T CARE ANYMORE! STOP STEALING MY LIFE LIKE THIS!!!
Finding the Light#028.dst: 이제 상관없어! 이런 식으로 내 삶을 빼앗지 마!!!

Finding the Light#030.src: ...GRAAAAAUGH!! TELL ME HOW THIS IS "ENOUGH!" TELL ME, NOW!

Finding the Light#031.src: To do something "dark," you are about to say, and to that I say you have not.
Finding the Light#031.dst: "어두운" 짓을 했다고 말하려는 게지. 나는 아니라고 하겠다.

Finding the Light#032.src: For a thousand years or more of your own thoughts, I understand that you are conflicted.
Finding the Light#032.dst: 천 년 넘게 홀로 생각해 왔으니, 네 마음이 갈등하는 것도 이해한다.

Finding the Light#033.src: However... You have, in that time, made a grave error. You have grown to realize an incorrect assumption.
Finding the Light#033.dst: 허나... 그 세월 동안 너는 큰 실수를 했다. 잘못된 가정을 진실로 믿게 되었지.

Finding the Light#034.src: Dark and Light... They oppose. They clash. They create a cloying pox. But, allow me to ask.
Finding the Light#034.dst: 어둠과 빛... 둘은 대립한다. 충돌한다. 숨 막히는 역병을 낳는다. 허나, 묻겠다.

Finding the Light#035.src: Is the axe evil for chopping the tree? Is the wood evil for resisting the metal?
Finding the Light#035.dst: 나무를 베는 도끼는 악한가? 쇠에 저항하는 나무는 악한가?

Finding the Light#036.src: Are the flames evil for burning up the leaves? Is the water evil for dousing the fire?
Finding the Light#036.dst: 잎을 태우는 불꽃은 악한가? 불을 끄는 물은 악한가?

Finding the Light#037.src: Is a victim evil for striking back against those that have struck them?
Finding the Light#037.dst: 자신을 때린 자에게 반격하는 피해자는 악한가?

Finding the Light#038.src: And most importantly... Are any of these things light, or dark?
Finding the Light#038.dst: 그리고 무엇보다... 이 중 무엇이 빛이고, 무엇이 어둠인가?

Finding the Light#039.src: I will not ask you to. You must understand that Orphion has no moral bearings- He simply needs action.
Finding the Light#039.dst: 그러라고 하진 않겠다. 알아 둬라, Orphion에겐 도덕적 기준이 없다- 그저 행동이 필요할 뿐.

Finding the Light#040.src: I admit, such a thing is a conundrum. I agree that it is a tragedy to kill, in many instances.
Finding the Light#040.dst: 인정하마, 그건 난제다. 대개의 경우 살생은 비극이라는 데 동의한다.

Finding the Light#041.src: Yet when such an action could save the lives of others, it becomes a conundrum with no answer. An impossible value to weigh.
Finding the Light#041.dst: 허나 그 행동이 다른 이들의 목숨을 구할 수 있다면, 답이 없는 난제가 된다. 저울질할 수 없는 가치지.

Finding the Light#042.src: Despite the circumstances, you have done the best you could. I cannot fault you for your thoughts and morals.
Finding the Light#042.dst: 그 상황에서 너는 최선을 다했다. 네 생각과 도덕을 탓할 수는 없다.

Finding the Light#043.src: And so... As you are now proven, as I am awoken, the gateway to the Light shall reveal itself to you. Lari... You must prepare for your journey to the Realm of Light.
Finding the Light#043.dst: 그리하여... 네가 증명되고 내가 깨어났으니, 빛으로 가는 관문이 네게 모습을 드러내리라. Lari... 너는 빛의 영역으로 떠날 채비를 해야 한다.

Finding the Light#044.src: I do not blame you for it. By the time you have composed yourself, your ally will be ready. Understand that they are as necessary as you are.
Finding the Light#044.dst: 너를 탓하지 않는다. 네가 마음을 추스를 즈음 동료도 준비될 것이다. 그들도 너만큼 필요하다는 걸 알아라.

Finding the Light#045.src: I must ask you to pay close attention. I shall present it simply- though the enormity of this cannot be understated.
Finding the Light#045.dst: 잘 들어 주길 바란다. 간단히 말하겠다- 그 무게는 결코 가볍지 않지만.

Finding the Light#046.src: This is our world, the world we stand in right now. The physical plane of existence.
Finding the Light#046.dst: 이것이 우리 세계, 지금 우리가 서 있는 세계다. 존재의 물질계지.

Finding the Light#047.src: Only a select few are aware that there is more of the world than this. Even the astronomers and those who view the enormity of the sky cannot understand.
Finding the Light#047.dst: 세상이 이게 전부가 아님을 아는 자는 극소수다. 하늘의 광대함을 보는 천문학자들조차 이해하지 못한다.

Finding the Light#048.src: For, you see, this realm, this plane- It is mirrored upon a second plane, as the embodiments of Realms clash.
Finding the Light#048.dst: 보아라, 이 영역, 이 차원은- 두 번째 차원에 비치고 있다. 영역의 화신들이 충돌하는 곳이지.

Finding the Light#049.src: This is the Plane of Influence, comprised of many realms. There are three you must know- But only one you must pay attention to.
Finding the Light#049.dst: 그것이 영향의 차원, 여러 영역으로 이루어진 곳이다. 알아야 할 것은 셋- 허나 주의할 것은 하나뿐이다.

Finding the Light#050.src: The Realms of Influence are connected to the physical plane, tied inexorably so to it. This is why even those gazing at the cosmos cannot grasp the enormity of it.
Finding the Light#050.dst: 영향의 영역들은 물질계와 떼려야 뗄 수 없게 이어져 있다. 그래서 우주를 바라보는 자들도 그 광대함을 헤아리지 못한다.

Finding the Light#051.src: These realms are in a constant push and pull- Battles that could not be seen by those of this world, waged constantly.
Finding the Light#051.dst: 이 영역들은 끊임없이 밀고 당긴다- 이 세계의 자들 눈엔 보이지 않는 싸움이 쉼 없이 벌어진다.

Finding the Light#052.src: However, they can be felt. Wide-scale changes to the balance of one realm or another are reflected on the physical plane.
Finding the Light#052.dst: 허나 느낄 수는 있다. 한 영역의 균형이 크게 변하면 물질계에 그대로 드러난다.

Finding the Light#053.src: The Realms of Influence are, themselves, reflections of a Beast- They themselves, a physical manifestation of their realm, as their realm is a manifestation of them.
Finding the Light#053.dst: 영향의 영역들은 그 자체로 야수의 투영이다- 야수는 제 영역이 물질로 드러난 것이고, 영역은 야수가 드러난 것이다.

Finding the Light#054.src: So surely, you must know- As Gavel has decayed, it must mean that the Realm of Light is in peril, and thus that Orphion is, as well.
Finding the Light#054.dst: 그러니 알겠지- Gavel이 쇠락했다면, 빛의 영역이 위험에 처했고 Orphion 또한 그렇다는 뜻이다.

Finding the Light#055.src: The Light is infected- That abominable parasite has breached the Realm of Light, and sought Orphion to leech away his light.
Finding the Light#055.dst: 빛이 감염되었다- 그 가증스러운 기생충이 빛의 영역을 뚫고 들어가, Orphion을 찾아 그의 빛을 빨아먹고 있다.

Finding the Light#056.src: And so, as the sun is forced to set, the land of Gavel grows dark. As the dark parasites spread and devour the minds of those here, so too is Orphion subject to this torture.
Finding the Light#056.dst: 그리하여 해는 억지로 저물고 Gavel 땅은 어두워진다. 어둠의 기생충이 퍼져 이곳 사람들의 정신을 삼키듯, Orphion도 같은 고통을 겪는다.

Finding the Light#057.src: Now, you must enter the Realm of Light, and aid Lari in purging the parasite, before its work is finished and Orphion's mind is consumed.
Finding the Light#057.dst: 이제 너는 빛의 영역에 들어가, 기생충이 일을 끝내고 Orphion의 정신을 삼키기 전에 Lari를 도와 없애야 한다.

Finding the Light#058.src: You must ready yourself before this, of course. To venture to another realm is a lofty task.
Finding the Light#058.dst: 물론 그 전에 채비를 해야 한다. 다른 영역으로 가는 건 쉽지 않은 일이다.

Finding the Light#059.src: I will bestow upon you two things that will surely aid you in this, however. First, I shall provide you the way to the Gateway to Light.
Finding the Light#059.dst: 허나 분명 도움이 될 두 가지를 내리겠다. 먼저, 빛의 관문으로 가는 길을 알려 주마.

Finding the Light#060.src: Once you have reached it, I shall bestow upon you a personal blessing of mine, in the hopes that your path will become clear.
Finding the Light#060.dst: 그곳에 닿으면 너의 길이 밝아지길 바라며, 나의 축복을 직접 내리겠다.

Finding the Light#063.src: ...ah. {u}. So you are needed here too, then?
Finding the Light#063.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#064.src: I am... TRYING... To awaken the Guardian of the Forest to receive its guidance, but it refuses to budge! Even the voice of Orphion provides no reaction.
Finding the Light#064.dst: 난... 지금... 숲의 수호자를 깨워 인도를 받으려는데, 꿈쩍도 안 해! Orphion의 목소리에도 아무 반응이 없어.
Finding the Light#064.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#065.src: I beg once more of you, awaken! Us two... Us two seek your wisdom!
Finding the Light#065.dst: 다시 한번 부탁할게, 깨어나! 우리 둘은... 우리 둘은 네 지혜를 구하고 있어!
Finding the Light#065.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#066.src: I present you Orphion's barest light- Please, respond!
Finding the Light#066.dst: Orphion의 희미한 빛을 바칠게- 제발, 대답해!
Finding the Light#066.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#067.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can effect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#067.dst: 으윽... 봤지? 아무 일도 안 일어나. 뭘 해야 할지 모르겠어. 네가 전에 해낸 일들을 생각하면, 네가 뭔가 바꿀 수 있을지도 몰라.
Finding the Light#067.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#068.src: Urgh... See? Nothing is happening. I'm at a loss of what to do. Maybe you can affect some change, considering what you've done before.
Finding the Light#068.dst: 으윽... 봤지? 아무 일도 안 일어나. 뭘 해야 할지 모르겠어. 네가 전에 해낸 일들을 생각하면, 네가 뭔가 바꿀 수 있을지도 몰라.
Finding the Light#068.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#069.src: My pulse, it is time. I shall shine my light upon the roots of the Guardian. You and she must learn now.
Finding the Light#069.dst: 나의 맥동이여, 때가 되었다. 수호자의 뿌리에 나의 빛을 비추겠다. 너와 그녀는 이제 배워야 한다.

Finding the Light#070.src: Read the inscription at the bottom of the big tree.
Finding the Light#070.dst: 큰 나무 밑동에 새겨진 글귀를 읽으세요.

Finding the Light#071.src: An inscription! That wasn't there before! It was... That was completely instant. How did you even...?
Finding the Light#071.dst: 글귀잖아! 아까는 없었는데! 이건... 순식간에 생겼어. 대체 어떻게...?
Finding the Light#071.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#072.src: But, still! I knew I could be useful, let me translate this for you! As a stranger to Gavel you wouldn't know High Gavellian...
Finding the Light#072.dst: 그래도! 내가 쓸모 있을 줄 알았어, 번역은 내가 해 줄게! Gavel에 처음 온 넌 고등 Gavel어를 모를 테니까...
Finding the Light#072.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#073.src: It says... Secrets uncovered in the oldest of libraries in {p}.
Finding the Light#073.dst: 이렇게 적혀 있어... {p}에서 가장 오래된 도서관에 숨겨진 비밀.
Finding the Light#073.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#074.src: ...of course. A place that Elves aren't allowed, but humans are. {u}, you'll have to find this library on your own, it seems.
Finding the Light#074.dst: ...그렇겠지. 엘프는 못 가고 인간은 갈 수 있는 곳. {u}, 이 도서관은 너 혼자 찾아야겠다.
Finding the Light#074.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#075.src: Find the Church Library in the city of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Finding the Light#076.src: Find a way up to the church bell at the top of the church.
Finding the Light#076.dst: 교회 꼭대기의 종까지 올라갈 방법을 찾으세요.

Finding the Light#077.src: Explore the secret library and find a way to wake up the tree.
Finding the Light#077.dst: 비밀 도서관을 탐험하고 나무를 깨울 방법을 찾으세요.

Finding the Light#079.src: Do you reject the light of Orphion? Waken, please!
Finding the Light#079.dst: Orphion의 빛을 거부하는 거야? 제발, 깨어나!
Finding the Light#079.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#080.src: Urgh... {u}, please tell me you were able to make some progress. The Guardian still refuses... To... WAKE!
Finding the Light#080.dst: 으윽... {u}, 제발 뭔가 알아냈다고 말해 줘. 수호자는 아직도... 안... 깨어나!
Finding the Light#080.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#081.src: What is this? A spell scroll- Of the Waking Forest?! In {p}, of all places? Where it would have been... Impossible for me to go...
Finding the Light#081.dst: 이게 뭐야? 주문 두루마리- 깨어나는 숲의?! 하필 {p}에서? 내가... 절대 갈 수 없는 곳인데...
Finding the Light#081.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#082.src: So I am Orphion's chosen, yet I would not have been able to do what was asked of me. That... No, I can't dwell on that, let me see the scroll.
Finding the Light#082.dst: 난 Orphion의 선택을 받았는데, 맡은 일도 못 해냈을 거라니. 그건... 아니, 거기 매달리면 안 돼. 두루마리 좀 보자.
Finding the Light#082.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#083.src: ...hm. It says, The seeker must rest these words upon those of the Guardian.
Finding the Light#083.dst: ...흠. 구도자는 이 말을 수호자의 말 위에 두어야 한다, 라고 적혀 있어.
Finding the Light#083.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#084.src: I suppose that means you need to place it by the inscription. So yet another task that you must finish...
Finding the Light#084.dst: 글귀 옆에 놓으라는 뜻 같아. 결국 또 네가 해야 하는 일이네...
Finding the Light#084.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#085.src: ...go on, then, do it. I'm just needed here to be a translator for you thusfar, it seems.
Finding the Light#085.dst: ...그럼 어서 해. 지금까진 난 그냥 통역사로만 필요한가 봐.
Finding the Light#085.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#086.src: Use the spell on the inscription under the tree.

Finding the Light#087.src: Let me go ahead and read this, too. This will be tedious, I fear...
Finding the Light#087.dst: 이것도 내가 읽어 볼게. 꽤 지루하겠지만...
Finding the Light#087.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#088.src: It says... Awakening the Guardian of the Forest requires more than just magic. The home of the elves will house the answers and revelations...?
Finding the Light#088.dst: 이렇게 적혀 있어... 숲의 수호자를 깨우려면 마법 이상의 것이 필요하다. 엘프의 고향에 답과 계시가 있으리라...?
Finding the Light#088.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#089.src: That... This is finally my time! I still have a hand in this!! Finally, I can do something more than just holding stasis here!
Finding the Light#089.dst: 그건... 드디어 내 차례야! 나도 할 일이 있어!! 드디어 여기서 버티기만 하는 것 말고 뭔가 할 수 있어!
Finding the Light#089.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#090.src: Listen, {u}. Achara... This is my time. I can finally help you more directly. I know the elders of {p}- They're sure to have answers!
Finding the Light#090.dst: 들어 봐, {u}. Achara... 이번엔 내 차례야. 드디어 너를 직접 도울 수 있어. {p} 장로들을 알거든- 분명 답을 알 거야!
Finding the Light#090.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#091.src: You truly have been helpful, even through my own worries. I must thank you, but you can relax now! I will be the one this time!
Finding the Light#091.dst: 내가 걱정만 할 때도 넌 정말 큰 도움이 됐어. 고마워, 그러니 이제 쉬어도 돼! 이번엔 내가 할게!
Finding the Light#091.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#092.src: You can continue doing...whatever else it is you need doing. I have seen you helping in various places- Concern yourself with those for now. I can handle this.
Finding the Light#092.dst: 넌... 네가 해야 할 다른 일을 계속해. 여기저기서 돕는 걸 봤어- 지금은 그쪽에 신경 써. 이건 내가 할 수 있어.
Finding the Light#092.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#093.src: Pursue her, my pulse. She must take dire action- Alone, her light shall illuminate nothing. You must provide her direction.
Finding the Light#093.dst: 그녀를 쫓아라, 나의 맥동이여. 그녀는 극단적인 행동을 해야 한다- 홀로는 그 빛이 아무것도 못 밝히니, 네가 길을 알려라.

Finding the Light#094.src: Enter the portal Lari left behind

Finding the Light#095.src: Go to the hut Lari entered.

Finding the Light#096.src: W-What? You- Why did you follow me? I can handle this! I can finally be useful again! Do you...not trust me?
Finding the Light#096.dst: 뭐-뭐야? 너- 왜 따라왔어? 이건 내가 할 수 있어! 드디어 다시 쓸모 있어질 수 있다고! 넌... 날 못 믿는 거야?
Finding the Light#096.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#097.src: Please, just respect my wishes! If I need your help, I'll go find you- For now, just leave! You don't need to worry about this!
Finding the Light#097.dst: 제발, 내 뜻 좀 존중해 줘! 도움이 필요하면 내가 찾아갈게- 지금은 그냥 가! 이건 신경 쓸 필요 없어!
Finding the Light#097.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#098.src: Find a way to sneak into the hut.

Finding the Light#099.src: ...if this human has truly done what you have said, then why do you spurn their aid? It is unlike you.
Finding the Light#099.dst: ...이 인간이 정말 네 말대로 해냈다면, 왜 도움을 뿌리치느냐? 너답지 않구나.
Finding the Light#099.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#100.src: I know, I know. I just am in disbelief. They've been contacted by Orphion himself, allowed into the Taproot, they have a symbol of Orphion's blessing!!
Finding the Light#100.dst: 알아요, 알아요. 그냥 믿기지 않아요. Orphion이 직접 말을 걸었고, Taproot에도 들어갔고, Orphion의 축복 표식까지 있다고요!!
Finding the Light#100.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#101.src: They just...walked up, after a thousand years of my putting my entire life into trying to save this province, and do everything I couldn't, in the span of weeks at most!
Finding the Light#101.dst: 제가 이 지방을 구하려고 천 년 동안 평생을 바쳤는데, 그 인간은 그냥... 나타나서 제가 못 한 일을 길어야 몇 주 만에 다 해냈다고요!
Finding the Light#101.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#102.src: Do you understand how infuriating this is? Can you comprehend such a thing, not having been in my position yourself?
Finding the Light#102.dst: 이게 얼마나 화나는지 아세요? 제 처지가 돼 본 적도 없으면서 이해하실 수 있어요?
Finding the Light#102.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#103.src: No. I cannot understand. But I also cannot understand how you are not grateful for this aid.
Finding the Light#103.dst: 아니. 이해할 수 없다. 허나 네가 이 도움에 감사하지 않는 것도 이해할 수 없구나.
Finding the Light#103.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#104.src: I know I should be! It's all I've been able to think about. I should be ecstatic! The light will be saved, it should be everything I've dreamed of...
Finding the Light#104.dst: 감사해야 한다는 거 알아요! 그 생각뿐이었어요. 기뻐 날뛰어야죠! 빛이 구원받을 거예요, 제가 꿈꾸던 전부인데...
Finding the Light#104.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#105.src: But it makes me feel like a complete failure. Like everything I have done has been for naught, that I have somehow been doing everything wrong!
Finding the Light#105.dst: 그런데 제가 완전한 실패자 같아요. 제가 한 모든 일이 헛수고였던 것 같고, 뭔가 다 잘못해 온 것 같아요!
Finding the Light#105.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#106.src: I know I have made mistakes. Dullahan would still be... Still be himself, if I had taken faster action, but I can't have done nothing right. I can't accept that.
Finding the Light#106.dst: 실수한 건 알아요. 제가 더 빨리 움직였다면 Dullahan은 아직... 자기 자신이었겠죠. 그래도 제가 한 일이 전부 틀렸을 리 없어요. 받아들일 수 없어요.
Finding the Light#106.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#107.src: This is my chance to prove I can still be useful- that Orphion choosing me wasn't a fluke! Please, the inscription said you would know where to go!
Finding the Light#107.dst: 아직 쓸모 있다는 걸 증명할 기회예요- Orphion이 절 고른 게 우연이 아니라는 걸요! 제발, 장로님이 갈 곳을 아실 거라고 글귀에 적혀 있었어요!
Finding the Light#107.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#109.src: ...even after a millennium, there is so very much for us all to learn. Fine then.
Finding the Light#109.dst: ...천 년이 지나도 우리 모두 배울 것이 참 많구나. 좋다.
Finding the Light#109.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#110.src: But promise me to accept the aid you receive. This opportunity cannot be wasted, Lari.
Finding the Light#110.dst: 허나 받는 도움은 받아들이겠다고 약속해라. 이 기회를 낭비해선 안 된다, Lari.
Finding the Light#110.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#111.src: ...I have to do at least one thing right. I can't just keep up this holding pattern. I'll do whatever is necessary!
Finding the Light#111.dst: ...적어도 하나는 제대로 해야 해요. 계속 제자리걸음만 할 순 없어요. 필요한 건 뭐든 할게요!
Finding the Light#111.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#112.src: You must seek the Canned Abis plant, then. It rests within a cavern shaded by giant fern leaves.
Finding the Light#112.dst: 그렇다면 통조림 Abis라는 식물을 찾아라. 거대한 고사리 잎이 가린 동굴 속에 있다.
Finding the Light#112.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#113.src: Thank you. I can finally do what I was meant to do! I won't let anything stop me this time!!
Finding the Light#113.dst: 감사합니다. 드디어 제가 해야 할 일을 할 수 있어요! 이번엔 아무것도 절 막지 못해요!!
Finding the Light#113.speaker: Lari

Finding the Light#114.src: ...Human, I can see you. Consider yourself lucky that she did not. Come talk to me.
Finding the Light#114.dst: ...인간, 다 보인다. 그녀가 못 본 걸 다행으로 여겨라. 이리 와서 이야기하자.
Finding the Light#114.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#116.src: So you are Orphion's new chosen, then. It is both surprising and not- Humans have an interesting reputation.
Finding the Light#116.dst: 그래, 네가 Orphion의 새 선택받은 자로구나. 놀랍기도, 아니기도 하다- 인간은 평판이 흥미롭거든.
Finding the Light#116.speaker: Elder

Finding the Light#117.src: Often said as being able to get anything done, without limits, be it completing impossible tasks or breaking moral tenets.
Finding the Light#117.dst: 흔히 무엇이든 해낸다고들 하지. 불가능한 일을 이루든, 도덕의 계율을 깨든, 한계 없이.
