From the Mountains#021.dst: 아하! 여기 문제가 있네. 그냥 작은 Fleris야. 음, 설명하자면 원래 Heights에 사는 녀석들이야.
From the Mountains#021.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#022.src: Pretty affectionate, good if you can stand the heat, but if you take them away from their mounds they get spooked.
From the Mountains#022.dst: 꽤 애교가 많아서, 열기만 견디면 좋은 친구지. 근데 자기 둥지 언덕에서 떼어 놓으면 겁을 먹어.
From the Mountains#022.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#023.src: One fleris could have kept setting this man's house on fire, but all the other fallout... there's certainly more where this one came from.
From the Mountains#023.dst: Fleris 한 마리로도 이 집에 계속 불이 날 순 있지만, 다른 피해들을 보면... 분명 이 녀석 말고도 더 있어.
From the Mountains#023.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#024.src: Let's go talk to the villager outside. He might've seen where the others got off to, or where they came from.
From the Mountains#024.dst: 밖에 있는 주민한테 가서 얘기해 보자. 다른 녀석들이 어디로 갔는지, 어디서 왔는지 봤을지도 몰라.
From the Mountains#024.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#025.src: Sir, I figured out why your house kept re-igniting and solved that issue, but tell me, have you seen any moving sludgy things around here?
From the Mountains#025.dst: 선생님, 집에 계속 불이 붙던 원인을 찾아서 해결했어요. 그런데 이 근처에서 움직이는 끈적한 뭔가 보셨나요?
From the Mountains#025.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#026.src: Uhm, I don't really know. I've been trying to douse my house so many times over that I haven't really paid attention!
From the Mountains#026.dst: 음, 잘 모르겠어요. 집에 붙은 불을 끄느라 몇 번이고 물을 끼얹느라 제대로 볼 겨를이 없었거든요!
From the Mountains#026.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#027.src: I remember seeing some tar-looking stuff dripping from the mountains behind my house, but that's it!
From the Mountains#027.dst: 집 뒤 산에서 타르 같은 게 뚝뚝 흘러내리는 건 봤어요. 그게 다예요!
From the Mountains#027.speaker: Arnod

From the Mountains#028.src: Sounds concrete enough to me. Let's check out what's going on on top of the mountain ridge. Check that book of yours if you need directions.
From the Mountains#028.dst: 그 정도면 충분히 확실하네. 산등성이 꼭대기에서 무슨 일인지 확인해 보자. 길을 모르겠으면 네 책을 봐.
From the Mountains#028.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#029.src: Go to the path at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and follow it up to the top of the mountain.

From the Mountains#030.src: Hm, you're a pretty quick climber. I thought I'd get ahead of you. Well, this looks like the scorched area down in the valley... Hm! I thought so.
From the Mountains#030.dst: 흠, 꽤 빨리 오르네. 내가 앞설 줄 알았는데. 자, 여기도 골짜기 아래 그을린 곳이랑 비슷해... 흠! 역시 그렇군.
From the Mountains#030.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#031.src: There's only one reason I can think of that there would be so many Flerisi around here... If that wagon's reinforced, then...
From the Mountains#031.dst: 이 주변에 Flerisi가 이렇게 많은 이유는 딱 하나밖에 생각이 안 나... 저 수레가 보강돼 있다면, 그럼...
From the Mountains#031.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#032.src: Gah, I knew it. Traffickers! And incompetent ones, too, considering they couldn't hold the things.
From the Mountains#032.dst: 크, 역시나. 밀매꾼이야! 그것도 녀석들을 붙잡아 두지도 못한 서투른 놈들이지.
From the Mountains#032.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#033.src: There's a black market issue in the {p}. Things that you can't find anywhere else is harvested in the Heights for their high value.
From the Mountains#033.dst: {p}에는 암시장 문제가 있어. 다른 데서 못 구하는 것들을 비싸게 팔려고 Heights에서 잡아 가거든.
From the Mountains#033.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#034.src: Flerisi are one of them. In the Heights, they're kept as pets. They're relatively friendly, keep your house warm, and don't need much care...
From the Mountains#034.dst: Flerisi도 그중 하나야. Heights에선 애완동물로 길러. 비교적 순하고, 집을 따뜻하게 해 주고, 손도 별로 안 가지...
From the Mountains#034.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#035.src: ...But if you take them away from a warm place, they burn everything. To think- Some people use the things as weapons. Can't leave well enough alone...
From the Mountains#035.dst: ...하지만 따뜻한 곳에서 떼어 놓으면 뭐든 다 태워 버려. 게다가 이걸 무기로 쓰는 놈들도 있다니. 가만히 두질 못하는군...
From the Mountains#035.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#036.src: We'll need to catch these Flerisi. Here, take this net. While you catch them, I'll repair the cart so we can put them in there later.
From the Mountains#036.dst: 이 Flerisi를 잡아야 해. 여기, 이 그물 받아. 네가 잡는 동안 난 수레를 고칠게. 나중에 거기 넣을 수 있게.
From the Mountains#036.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#037.src: Capture all of the rogue Flerisi and bring them to Axelus.
From the Mountains#037.dst: 날뛰는 Flerisi를 모두 잡아 Axelus에게 데려가세요.

From the Mountains#038.src: I've got the cart all repaired and ready, did you get all the Flerisi? Come over to the cart then. There's still have work to do.
From the Mountains#038.dst: 수레는 다 고쳐서 준비됐어. Flerisi는 다 잡았어? 그럼 수레로 와. 아직 할 일이 남았어.
From the Mountains#038.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#039.src: I'll keep the Flerisi in a smaller fire to keep them calm, see if I can't get them back to the Heights when this is done.
From the Mountains#039.dst: Flerisi는 작은 불 속에 둬서 진정시킬게. 이 일이 끝나면 Heights로 돌려보낼 수 있을지 봐야지.
From the Mountains#039.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#040.src: For now, I want to see if I can find anything on who these traffickers were. Let's see if they left anything in the front of the cart.
From the Mountains#040.dst: 일단 이 밀매꾼들이 누군지 단서가 있나 찾아보고 싶어. 수레 앞쪽에 뭘 남겼는지 보자.
From the Mountains#040.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#041.src: ...oh. Well, didn't notice that the fire went THAT far earlier. That's a problem, isn't it?
From the Mountains#041.dst: ...아. 음, 아까는 불이 그렇게까지 번진 줄 몰랐네. 이거 문제지, 안 그래?
From the Mountains#041.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#042.src: To explain, Flerisi aren't all as tiny as the ones we've found here. They feed of cinders and fire... And for this much damage to be caused, well...
From the Mountains#042.dst: 설명하자면, Flerisi가 다 여기서 찾은 것처럼 작은 건 아니야. 불씨와 불을 먹고 살거든... 이 정도 피해를 내려면, 음...
From the Mountains#042.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#043.src: Methinks this one's getting a bit out of control. This is right next to that big forest, too. Could be a problem if we leave this one be.
From the Mountains#043.dst: 이 녀석은 좀 통제를 벗어난 것 같아. 게다가 바로 옆이 저 큰 숲이야. 그냥 두면 큰일 나겠어.
From the Mountains#043.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#044.src: We're going to have to track it down and subdue it. Here, follow me. I'll dig us down to the valley. Watch a dwarf at work!
From the Mountains#044.dst: 추적해서 제압해야겠어. 자, 따라와. 골짜기까지 땅을 파서 내려갈게. 드워프가 일하는 걸 잘 봐 둬!
From the Mountains#044.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#047.src: Not bad, eh? Anyways, dunno what that huge gate's for, but it looks like our Fleris friend has commandeered it for a bonfire.
From the Mountains#047.dst: 나쁘지 않지? 아무튼, 저 거대한 문이 뭔지는 모르겠지만, 우리 Fleris 친구가 모닥불로 쓰려고 차지한 모양이야.
From the Mountains#047.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#048.src: At least it's a little more contained than I thought, being in that cave, but we still have to catch it. Lead the way. I'm right with you.
From the Mountains#048.dst: 동굴 안이라 생각보단 좀 덜 번졌지만, 그래도 잡아야 해. 앞장서. 바로 뒤에 있을게.
From the Mountains#048.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#049.src: What the...?! It inflamed the creatures in this cave! Fend 'em off!
From the Mountains#049.dst: 뭐야...?! 동굴 속 생물들한테 불을 붙였어! 막아!
From the Mountains#049.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#050.src: There are more of them coming! Get to the end of the cave!
From the Mountains#050.dst: 더 오고 있어! 동굴 끝까지 가!
From the Mountains#050.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#052.src: Both of us stopping is going to make it take too much time, the traffickers might come back!
From the Mountains#052.dst: 둘 다 멈추면 시간이 너무 걸려. 밀매꾼들이 돌아올지도 몰라!
From the Mountains#052.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#053.src: Listen up. I'll handle these things, while you go after the Fleris. If it's a big one like we think, it'll be a downhill battle- It should shrink if you attack it!
From the Mountains#053.dst: 잘 들어. 이놈들은 내가 맡을 테니 넌 Fleris를 쫓아. 생각대로 큰 녀석이면 갈수록 쉬워질 거야. 공격하면 작아질 테니까!
From the Mountains#053.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#054.src: Alright, time for a little royal rumble!
From the Mountains#054.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#056.src: Phew, you're alright! Charred and covered in soot, but that's to be expected. Subdued the Fleris, too! I have the net with me, so allow me.
From the Mountains#056.dst: 휴, 무사하구나! 그을리고 검댕투성이지만, 그건 예상했어. Fleris도 제압했네! 그물은 나한테 있으니 내가 할게.
From the Mountains#056.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#057.src: Well, this is probably a bit of thankless work we just did, but so is a lot of work. Let's get out of here. We can talk outside.
From the Mountains#057.dst: 뭐, 방금 한 일은 아마 알아주는 사람 없는 일이겠지만, 세상 일이 대개 그래. 여기서 나가자. 밖에서 얘기해.
From the Mountains#057.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#058.src: Exit the cave and talk with Axelus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

From the Mountains#059.src: Well, I say the work is thankless, but that won't stop me, anyways. Thank you for the help, human- This would've been overwhelming alone.
From the Mountains#059.dst: 알아주는 사람 없는 일이라 했지만, 그래도 난 안 멈춰. 도와줘서 고마워, 인간. 혼자였으면 감당 못 했을 거야.
From the Mountains#059.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#060.src: I'll ask the local police force if they've found the traffickers. If they cut and run, well... I got a free cart for the ride home. There's thing for me to attend to there.
From the Mountains#060.dst: 현지 경비대에 밀매꾼을 찾았는지 물어볼게. 도망쳤다면, 뭐... 집에 타고 갈 공짜 수레는 생긴 셈이지. 거기서 처리할 일이 있거든.
From the Mountains#060.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#061.src: Oh, where are my manners? Never even introduced myself this whole time. The name is Axelus. And yours?
From the Mountains#061.dst: 아, 내 정신 좀 봐. 여태 내 소개도 안 했네. 난 Axelus야. 넌?
From the Mountains#061.speaker: Axelus

From the Mountains#062.src: {u}, huh? I'll try and remember that. For now, take this armor for the trouble. Safe travels, {u}!
From the Mountains#062.dst: {u}, 그렇구나? 기억해 둘게. 우선 수고했으니 이 갑옷 받아. 조심히 가, {u}!
From the Mountains#062.speaker: Axelus

Frost Bite#001.src: Are you here to cross the Great Bridge as well?

Frost Bite#002.src: I fear you'll have to wait, the warning wasn't without merit.

Frost Bite#003.src: The {p} military has issued an official warning to all travelers wishing to cross the Great Bridge.

Frost Bite#004.src: No one should use the bridge until they have dealt with the... underlying issue.

Frost Bite#005.src: I ignored the warning at first, since the bridge is the only path into the jungle...

Frost Bite#006.src: But attempting to cross the bridge proved unbearable. Even out here, can't you feel that intense heat?

Frost Bite#007.src: I wouldn't blame anyone for not wanting to venture further, let alone meet whatever is causing this heat!

Frost Bite#008.src: And so I've been waiting here with my assistant all day... We're potion makers, you see, and we were headed to the grand city of {p} to sell supplies.

Frost Bite#009.src: If you want to ignore the military's warning, I suppose you might benefit from buying some our stock first. Our potions are stronger than any sold in {p}, after all!

Frost Bite#010.src: From the look of your equipment... I'd say you might have a better chance of making it across than us.

Frost Bite#011.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up and take a look at the drill, would you?

Frost Bite#012.src: Now you've obtained the key, you can enter Theoricks mansion

Frost Bite#013.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, I have a carriage for it.

Frost Bite#014.src: Sir Theorick, if you, um...if you have a moment? Your tribute is here...

Frost Bite#015.src: ...good. Thank you. Good to see some who honestly respect what I'm trying to do for all of you. Was there anyone else?

Frost Bite#016.src: Ah...no. There...there wasn't. Not this time. They feel like you're taking too much from them, which I don't agree with, but-

Frost Bite#017.src: ...ask them, if they would prefer their money, or their lives. Am I not protecting them? Is it really so much to ask that I get something in return?

Frost Bite#018.src: We...we know. We told them that, too...we're sorry.

Frost Bite#019.src: You aren't the ones who need to apologize! I'm aware it's a voluntary contribution, but do they have any idea how difficult it is to cast magic like this regularly?!

Frost Bite#020.src: This is unbeliveable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.

Frost Bite#021.src: There must be some way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.

Frost Bite#022.src: Wow, even by todays standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
Frost Bite#022.dst: 와, 지금 기준으로 봐도 어마어마한 돈이에요. 수백 년 전엔 얼마나 큰돈이었을지 생각해 봐요.

Frost Bite#023.src: Find Eppo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The entrance to his cave can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Frost Bite#026.src: Darn. The drill just won't start.
Frost Bite#026.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#027.src: Hey, Guard! Do you know anything about Electromagic? Come up here to the drill, maybe you can take a look?
Frost Bite#027.dst: 이봐요, 경비병! Electromagic에 대해 좀 알아요? 드릴 있는 데로 올라와서 한번 봐 줄래요?
Frost Bite#027.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#028.src: Oh! Never mind, it lit up, back up!
Frost Bite#028.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#029.src: For the love of Bob... Why won't you just break?
Frost Bite#029.dst: Bob을 봐서라도... 왜 안 깨지는 거야?
Frost Bite#029.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#030.src: This ice was created by Theorick, a Twain who defended this area many many years ago.
Frost Bite#030.dst: 이 얼음은 아주 오래전 이 지역을 지키던 Twain, Theorick이 만든 거예요.
Frost Bite#030.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#031.src: When the corruption got too much... He froze everything, including the people. Do you see them in there?
Frost Bite#031.dst: 타락이 걷잡을 수 없게 되자... 그는 모든 걸 얼려 버렸어요. 사람까지요. 저 안에 사람들 보이죠?
Frost Bite#031.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#032.src: We've tried desperately to get them out, but we've tried all the equipment we had, including this Corkian drill.
Frost Bite#032.dst: 어떻게든 꺼내려고 이 Corkus 드릴까지 가진 장비는 전부 써 봤어요.
Frost Bite#032.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#033.src: Maybe we should get more destructive... The demolition expert, Rhudya, is further down the cave.
Frost Bite#033.dst: 좀 더 과격하게 가야 할지도... 폭파 전문가 Rhudya가 동굴 더 안쪽에 있어요.
Frost Bite#033.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#034.src: It's a long shot, but worth a try. Would you be able to get it while I clear this space?
Frost Bite#034.dst: 가능성은 낮지만 해 볼 만해요. 제가 여길 치우는 동안 가져다줄 수 있어요?
Frost Bite#034.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#035.src: Go deeper into the cave and speak to Rhudya.
Frost Bite#035.dst: 동굴 더 깊이 들어가 Rhudya와 대화하세요.

Frost Bite#036.src: Whup! You're on private property, y'know! Oh, Eppo sent ya? That's fair enough.
Frost Bite#036.dst: 워! 여긴 사유지라고! 아, Eppo가 보냈어? 그럼 됐지.
Frost Bite#036.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#037.src: You'll be needing this TNT then, make sure not to drop it though, whup!
Frost Bite#037.dst: 그럼 이 TNT가 필요하겠네. 떨어뜨리진 마, 워!
Frost Bite#037.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#038.src: Just travel through this cave and you'll be returned to Eppo easy-peasy!
Frost Bite#038.dst: 이 동굴만 지나면 Eppo한테 금방 돌아갈 수 있어!
Frost Bite#038.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#039.src: Return to Eppo with the tnt.

Frost Bite#040.src: Very nice, this might do the trick.
Frost Bite#040.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#041.src: Back up, I'll ignite the explosive.
Frost Bite#041.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#043.src: NOTHING? Not even a scratch. I don't understand Theoricks ice.. It's not real.
Frost Bite#043.dst: 아무것도? 흠집 하나 없잖아. Theorick의 얼음은 이해가 안 가요.. 진짜가 아니에요.
Frost Bite#043.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#044.src: I'm not sure what else we can do then...
Frost Bite#044.dst: 그럼 더 뭘 할 수 있을지 모르겠네요...
Frost Bite#044.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#045.src: HEY. Eppo, over here! Near the cave!
Frost Bite#045.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#046.src: Did the explosive not work? I found this old mineshaft on the way back from the cave, it leads to an old lava cavern.
Frost Bite#046.dst: 폭탄 안 먹혔어? 동굴에서 돌아오다가 옛 갱도를 찾았는데, 오래된 용암 동굴로 이어져.
Frost Bite#046.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#047.src: Might be a long shot, but this lava looks different. Why not give it a try?
Frost Bite#047.dst: 가능성은 낮을지 몰라도, 거기 용암은 좀 달라 보여. 한번 해 보는 게 어때?
Frost Bite#047.speaker: Rhudya

Frost Bite#048.src: Travel to the lava springs through the mineshaft.

Frost Bite#049.src: Complete the puzzle and bring the lava back to Eppo.

Frost Bite#050.src: I don't understand how you can hold lava in a bucket.. But here we are.
Frost Bite#050.dst: 용암을 양동이에 어떻게 담는지 모르겠지만.. 어쨌든 이렇게 됐네요.
Frost Bite#050.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#051.src: Truth is.. We're not retrieving these bodies for no reason.
Frost Bite#051.dst: 사실은.. 이유 없이 시신을 꺼내려는 게 아니에요.
Frost Bite#051.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#052.src: We believe one of these people worked for Theorick, and has a key to his mansion
Frost Bite#052.dst: 이 사람들 중 하나가 Theorick 밑에서 일했고, 그의 저택 열쇠를 갖고 있다고 봐요
Frost Bite#052.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#053.src: We in {p} think Theorick has a lot to answer for. We want to redistribute his wealth among those he hurt.
Frost Bite#053.dst: {p} 사람들은 Theorick이 책임질 게 많다고 생각해요. 그가 해친 사람들에게 그의 재산을 나눠 주고 싶어요.
Frost Bite#053.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#054.src: Right, I've dipped this stick in the magical lava. Just hold the rod and walk into the ice to melt it.
Frost Bite#054.dst: 자, 이 막대를 마법 용암에 담갔어요. 막대를 들고 얼음 속으로 걸어가면 녹을 거예요.
Frost Bite#054.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#055.src: Look for the corpse with a key, it might be above you. Good luck!
Frost Bite#055.dst: 열쇠를 가진 시신을 찾아요. 위쪽에 있을지도 몰라요. 행운을 빌어요!
Frost Bite#055.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#056.src: Melt the ice and find the Servant's corpse.

Frost Bite#057.src: Is that the right one? You got it? Brilliant! Now come back down.
Frost Bite#057.dst: 그게 맞아요? 찾았어요? 훌륭해요! 이제 내려와요.
Frost Bite#057.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#058.src: Lets travel to the mansion together. Here, lets take my horse.
Frost Bite#058.dst: 같이 저택으로 가요. 자, 제 말을 타고 가죠.
Frost Bite#058.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#059.src: While we ride, let me explain a little more about what we're doing. Let's go.
Frost Bite#059.dst: 가는 동안 우리가 뭘 하는지 좀 더 설명할게요. 가죠.
Frost Bite#059.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#060.src: As I mentioned before, there is a reason this land is frozen, and it's not natural.
Frost Bite#060.dst: 아까 말했듯이 이 땅이 얼어붙은 데는 이유가 있고, 자연적인 게 아니에요.
Frost Bite#060.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#061.src: Many years before Bob was around, Wynn was in ruins due to the corruption war.
Frost Bite#061.dst: Bob이 있기 훨씬 전, Wynn은 타락 전쟁으로 폐허가 됐어요.
Frost Bite#061.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#062.src: In those times there used to be a group of naturally gifted individuals called the Twains. They defended us all with elemental magic.
Frost Bite#062.dst: 그 시절엔 Twain이라 불리는 타고난 재능을 가진 사람들이 있었어요. 원소 마법으로 우리 모두를 지켰죠.
Frost Bite#062.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#063.src: Theorick was one of those Twains. He harnessed unnaturally powerful ice based magic. He used it to protect the land surrounding the mansion.
Frost Bite#063.dst: Theorick도 그 Twain 중 하나였어요. 비정상적으로 강한 얼음 마법을 다뤘고, 그 힘으로 저택 주변 땅을 지켰죠.
Frost Bite#063.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#064.src: Theorick.. Wasn't like the other Twains. He wanted the people he protected to pay and feed him as way of thanks.
Frost Bite#064.dst: Theorick은.. 다른 Twain들과 달랐어요. 자기가 지켜 준 사람들에게 감사의 뜻으로 돈과 음식을 바치게 했죠.
Frost Bite#064.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#065.src: After years, Theorick was rich while the people he protected lived in poverty and fear - not only of the monsters, but in fear of Theorick himself.
Frost Bite#065.dst: 몇 년 뒤 Theorick은 부자가 됐지만, 그가 지킨 사람들은 가난과 공포 속에 살았어요 - 괴물뿐 아니라 Theorick 자신도 두려워하면서요.
Frost Bite#065.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#066.src: He punished those who disobeyed his curfews and would get angry if anyone tried to move away. The people felt trapped.
Frost Bite#066.dst: 통금을 어긴 사람은 벌을 받았고, 누가 떠나려 하면 화를 냈어요. 사람들은 갇힌 기분이었죠.
Frost Bite#066.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#067.src: Eventually, just like the other Twains - Theorick fell to the corruption. Not before he had the last word.
Frost Bite#067.dst: 결국 다른 Twain들처럼 - Theorick도 타락에 굴복했어요. 하지만 마지막 한 수는 남겼죠.
Frost Bite#067.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#068.src: He froze the land entirely, killing almost everything and everyone left outside in it. Hundreds of lives were lost.
Frost Bite#068.dst: 그는 이 땅을 통째로 얼려서, 밖에 남아 있던 거의 모든 것을 죽였어요. 수백 명이 목숨을 잃었죠.
Frost Bite#068.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#069.src: It turns out the ice slowed the spread of corruption across the land to almost a standstill. It's been this way ever since.
Frost Bite#069.dst: 그런데 그 얼음 덕에 이 땅에서 타락이 퍼지는 게 거의 멈췄어요. 그 뒤로 쭉 이 상태예요.
Frost Bite#069.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#070.src: Now that we can get in his mansion we hope to uncover the secrets of his ice magic so we may undo it, and share the wealth he hoarded from the people. Ah, we're here.
Frost Bite#070.dst: 이제 저택에 들어갈 수 있으니, 그의 얼음 마법의 비밀을 밝혀 되돌리고, 사람들에게서 긁어모은 재산도 나누고 싶어요. 아, 다 왔네요.
Frost Bite#070.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#072.src: This place looks frozen in time.. The grandure.. Well he did just take and take from everyone around him.
Frost Bite#072.dst: 시간이 얼어붙은 것 같네요.. 이 호화로움.. 뭐, 주변 모두에게서 빼앗고 또 빼앗았으니까요.
Frost Bite#072.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#073.src: So, I'm not sure where to start, but I'm guessing he has some protection in place.
Frost Bite#073.dst: 어디서부터 시작할지 모르겠지만, 뭔가 방어 장치를 해 뒀을 것 같아요.
Frost Bite#073.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#074.src: This is unbelievable.. He was such a greedy- AAAAH.
Frost Bite#074.dst: 믿을 수가 없네요.. 정말 탐욕스러운- 으아아악.
Frost Bite#074.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#075.src: ... I don't think we should insult him..
Frost Bite#075.dst: ... 그를 모욕하면 안 될 것 같네요..
Frost Bite#075.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#076.src: Find the riches in Theorick's mansion.

Frost Bite#077.src: Oof! Wasn't expecting that. That just proves everything I said about him. Punishing people who insult him.
Frost Bite#077.dst: 윽! 이건 예상 못 했어요. 제 말이 다 맞았다는 증거죠. 자길 모욕하면 벌을 내리는 거예요.
Frost Bite#077.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#078.src: Anyway, we should look around for some kind of secret entrance.
Frost Bite#078.dst: 아무튼, 비밀 입구 같은 게 있는지 둘러봐야겠어요.
Frost Bite#078.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#079.src: Trust Theorick to booby trap his own house the paranoid frozen gro-
Frost Bite#079.dst: 역시 Theorick답게 자기 집에 함정을 깔았네, 이 의심 많은 얼어붙은 늙은-
Frost Bite#079.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#080.src: That really isn't fun at all. I can't see a thing. Where are we now, a dead end?
Frost Bite#080.dst: 이건 전혀 재미없네요. 아무것도 안 보여요. 여긴 어디죠, 막다른 길?
Frost Bite#080.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#081.src: Well we know that insults result in punishment. Maybe a compliment will make him happy?
Frost Bite#081.dst: 모욕하면 벌을 받는다는 건 알았으니, 칭찬하면 기뻐하지 않을까요?
Frost Bite#081.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#082.src: Oh Theorick, strongest of all the Twains, you really are a hero.
Frost Bite#082.dst: 오 Theorick, Twain 중 가장 강한 분, 당신은 정말 영웅이에요.
Frost Bite#082.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#084.src: Looks like we finally found his private quarters, look at that vault door.
Frost Bite#084.dst: 드디어 그의 개인 거처를 찾은 것 같아요. 저 금고 문 좀 봐요.
Frost Bite#084.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#085.src: There must be a way to open it. Look around and see what you can find.
Frost Bite#085.dst: 열 방법이 있을 거예요. 주위를 둘러보고 뭘 찾을 수 있나 봐요.
Frost Bite#085.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#086.src: Find your way into the vault.

Frost Bite#088.src: Wow, even by today's standards, this is a huge amount of money. Just think how much this was hundreds of years ago.
Frost Bite#088.dst: 와, 지금 기준으로 봐도 어마어마한 돈이에요. 수백 년 전엔 얼마나 큰돈이었을지 생각해 봐요.
Frost Bite#088.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#089.src: Grab a little for yourself, too, we wouldn't have been able to get here without you.
Frost Bite#089.dst: 당신도 좀 챙겨요. 당신 없이는 여기까지 못 왔을 거예요.
Frost Bite#089.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#090.src: Wait, look at this. It seems to be a piece of Theoricks armour.
Frost Bite#090.dst: 잠깐, 이것 좀 봐요. Theorick의 갑옷 한 조각 같아요.
Frost Bite#090.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#087.src: You did it! We have access to the vault.
Frost Bite#087.speaker: Eppo

Frost Bite#091.src: Surprised it even managed to fit over his fat head.
Frost Bite#091.dst: 이게 그 큰 머리에 들어갔다니 놀랍네요.
Frost Bite#091.speaker: Eppo

General's Orders#000.src: Speak to Private Tylas outside of Kitrios Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
General's Orders#000.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Kitrios Barracks 밖에서 Private Tylas와 대화하세요

General's Orders#003.src: ...wh...? Oh...OH! Oh oh oh! Ahem! Yes, um! Absolutely sir! Right away sir! I don't think you're crazy at all sir!
General's Orders#003.dst: ...뭐...? 오...오! 오오오! 흠흠! 네, 음! 물론입니다! 당장 하겠습니다! 전혀 미치신 것 같지 않습니다!
General's Orders#003.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#004.src: ...oh. Wait, you're just one of those heavily armored human types. Cripes, I thought you were Lecade... Even nuts as he's gotten I'd get the thumbscrews if he caught me napping.
General's Orders#004.dst: ...아. 잠깐, 넌 그냥 중무장한 인간 부류구나. 맙소사, Lecade인 줄 알았네... 그렇게 미쳐도 낮잠 자다 걸리면 난 끝장이거든.
General's Orders#004.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#005.src: Hum...well, hey. You humans like doing work, right? I hear about it from folks in the army that you lot are pretty zealous about your favors.
General's Orders#005.dst: 음... 그래, 저기. 너희 인간들은 일하는 거 좋아하지? 군대 사람들한테 들었는데, 너희는 부탁 들어주는 데 엄청 열성이라며.
General's Orders#005.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#006.src: Then I think today might be your lucky day, because General Lecade is running out of free hands to push asinine tasks onto. No one knows what in the world's gotten into him.
General's Orders#006.dst: 그럼 오늘은 네 운 좋은 날일지도. General Lecade가 황당한 일을 떠넘길 한가한 사람이 바닥났거든. 대체 뭐에 씌었는지 아무도 몰라.
General's Orders#006.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#007.src: Between you and me, I'm using this time to work on sleep instead. I mean, honestly! He wants me to dance with the other privates to greet visitors! We don't even ALLOW visitors normally.
General's Orders#007.dst: 우리끼리 얘기지만, 난 이 시간에 잠이나 잘 거야. 아니, 진짜! 손님 맞으라고 다른 이병들이랑 춤을 추래! 원래는 손님을 받지도 않는데.
General's Orders#007.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#008.src: So if you want to eat up a few hours, talk with Lecade. Up the hill and into the barracks. I'm going to try and do my actual guard duty here instead of doing the funky Grook.
General's Orders#008.dst: 그러니 몇 시간 때우고 싶으면 Lecade랑 얘기해. 언덕 위 막사로 들어가. 난 그 신나는 Grook 춤 대신 여기서 진짜 경비나 서 볼게.
General's Orders#008.speaker: Tylas

General's Orders#010.src: Hey, hey, hey! What is this person? Why is it in my administrator's? New work! New work! Get this person out of the administrator's!
General's Orders#010.dst: 헤이, 헤이, 헤이! 이 사람은 무엇인가? 왜 그것은 나의 행정관의 안에? 새 일! 새 일! 이 사람을 행정관의에서 꺼내라!
General's Orders#010.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#011.src: Wait. Wait, you. Wait right there. Don't move until someone comes to get you. Order! I order it!
General's Orders#011.dst: 기다려. 기다려, 너. 거기서 기다려. 누가 데리러 올 때까지 움직이지 마라. 명령! 나는 그것을 명령한다!
General's Orders#011.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#013.src: ...okay, person. No one wants to bring you from administrator's, so instead I will give you another orders! Listen, listen, listen!
General's Orders#013.dst: ...좋다, 사람. 아무도 너를 행정관의에서 데려가기 원하지 않으니, 대신 나는 너에게 다른 명령들을 준다! 들어라, 들어라, 들어라!
General's Orders#013.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#014.src: You intended to firstly? Convenient! Here is my order then- Check the war tools. They need to be maintained for use!
General's Orders#014.dst: 너는 첫째로 의도했나? 편리하다! 그럼 나의 명령이다- 전쟁 도구를 점검하라. 그것들은 사용을 위해 유지되어야 한다!
General's Orders#014.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#015.src: Cannons and catapults, fortifications and barriers. A barracks needs to be armed to the tooth! I order it! Bad weapons are no weapons!
General's Orders#015.dst: 대포와 투석기, 요새화와 방벽. 막사는 이빨 하나까지 무장되어야 한다! 나는 그것을 명령한다! 나쁜 무기는 무기가 없음이다!
General's Orders#015.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#016.src: Armaments are to be stored outside fort walls at all times. To the left path leaving the walls. There will be Smithy stationed.
General's Orders#016.dst: 군비는 언제나 요새 벽 밖에 보관되는 것이다. 벽을 떠나는 왼쪽 길로. 대장장이가 배치되어 있을 것이다.
General's Orders#016.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#017.src: Move along! I have many orders to make! Return when the task is concluded!
General's Orders#017.dst: 이동하라! 나는 만들 명령이 많다! 임무가 결론되면 돌아오라!
General's Orders#017.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#018.src: Go check on the malfunctioning equipment at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

General's Orders#020.src: Hey, hey, hey! Person is in my administrator's again! This means the armaments are maintained! That is right?
General's Orders#020.dst: 헤이, 헤이, 헤이! 사람이 다시 나의 행정관의 안에! 이것은 군비가 유지되었다는 뜻! 그것이 맞는가?
General's Orders#020.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#021.src: Convenient! Very convenient! Now I will give you another orders! I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#021.dst: 편리하다! 매우 편리하다! 이제 나는 너에게 다른 명령들을 준다! 나는 잠시 숙고해야 한다.
General's Orders#021.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#023.src: Here is my new work then- Find the coin. A soldier has dropped a lucky coin in the wastewater!
General's Orders#023.dst: 그럼 나의 새 일이다- 동전을 찾아라. 한 병사가 행운의 동전을 폐수에 떨어뜨렸다!
General's Orders#023.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#024.src: All is confused without fortune. Soldiers must not be confused, or else I cannot give orders! Generally orders must be given!
General's Orders#024.dst: 행운 없이는 모두가 혼란이다. 병사는 혼란하면 안 된다, 아니면 나는 명령을 못 준다! 장군적으로 명령은 주어져야 한다!
General's Orders#024.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#025.src: The coin has been pushed into the sewage. My orders are convenient, as there is accessibility! The aqua ducts have means of entrance.
General's Orders#025.dst: 동전은 하수에 밀려들어갔다. 나의 명령은 편리하다, 접근성이 있기 때문이다! 물의 도관들은 입장의 수단을 가진다.
General's Orders#025.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#026.src: Outside, the cracked aqua ducts have Sergeant nearby. It shall mark accessibility for you. Return when the charm is gotten!
General's Orders#026.dst: 밖에, 금 간 물의 도관들은 근처에 중사를 가진다. 그것이 너를 위해 접근성을 표시할 것이다. 부적이 얻어지면 돌아오라!
General's Orders#026.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#027.src: Recover the Good-Luck Charm from the sewers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

General's Orders#028.src: My, what an odd task to give to the chief advisor of the general...
General's Orders#028.dst: 세상에, 장군의 수석 보좌관에게 이런 기묘한 임무를 주시다니...
General's Orders#028.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#029.src: You see, human, I was told to dig an extension to the sewer with my own hands.
General's Orders#029.dst: 보세요, 인간. 저는 하수도를 제 손으로 직접 연장해 파라는 명령을 받았어요.
General's Orders#029.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#030.src: And at that, it's supposed to just loop right around back in to the pipe.
General's Orders#030.dst: 게다가 그건 한 바퀴 돌아서 원래 관으로 다시 이어져야 한대요.
General's Orders#030.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#031.src: I think the General is starting to snap under the stress. If you need to return to the fort, just follow along.
General's Orders#031.dst: 장군님이 스트레스로 무너지기 시작한 것 같아요. 요새로 돌아가려면 그냥 따라가세요.
General's Orders#031.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#032.src: Return to General Lecade with the Good-Luck Charm.
General's Orders#032.dst: 행운의 부적을 들고 General Lecade에게 돌아가세요.

General's Orders#033.src: Hey, hey, hey! Administrator's has person once more! The charm has been gotten! That is right?
General's Orders#033.dst: 헤이, 헤이, 헤이! 행정관의가 한 번 더 사람을 가진다! 부적은 얻어졌다! 그것이 맞는가?
General's Orders#033.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#034.src: Yipy! Soldier will get returned the coin very soon! Person, the actions you take are convenient! I appreciate your help. I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#034.dst: 야피! 병사는 곧 동전을 돌려받아질 것이다! 사람, 네가 하는 행동들은 편리하다! 나는 너의 도움을 감사한다. 나는 잠시 숙고해야 한다.
General's Orders#034.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#036.src: Here is my new work then- Show your love. You have made me smile wide through your tasks! The other soldier would appreciate you too!
General's Orders#036.dst: 그럼 나의 새 일이다- 너의 사랑을 보여라. 너는 임무들로 나를 넓게 웃게 만들었다! 다른 병사도 너를 감사할 것이다!
General's Orders#036.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#037.src: Walk jauntily across the tight rope, and make the other soldier smile as well! Soldiers must be happy at life.
General's Orders#037.dst: 팽팽한 줄을 경쾌하게 걸어 건너고, 다른 병사도 웃게 만들어라! 병사들은 삶에 행복해야 한다.
General's Orders#037.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#038.src: The tight rope is right from administrator's- stairs are nearby the passage. Return when the soldier is happy!
General's Orders#038.dst: 팽팽한 줄은 행정관의 바로 오른쪽이다- 계단들은 통로 근처다. 병사가 행복하면 돌아오라!
General's Orders#038.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#040.src: Well I'll be, the soldier's crossing the tightrope.
General's Orders#040.speaker: Barkeeper

General's Orders#041.src: Convenient! So convenient! Many cheers for person!
General's Orders#041.dst: 편리하다! 너무 편리하다! 사람을 위한 많은 환호를!
General's Orders#041.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#042.src: I think he might actually make it across...
General's Orders#042.speaker: Advisor

General's Orders#043.src: Gah, what in blazes are you thinking, Lecade?! First this confounded contraption, then...grumble, grumble...
General's Orders#043.dst: 크, Lecade, 대체 무슨 생각인 거요?! 처음엔 이 망할 기계에, 그다음엔... 투덜, 투덜...
General's Orders#043.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#045.src: Very, very, very happy! The tight rope has been walked! I saw the task!
General's Orders#045.dst: 매우, 매우, 매우 행복하다! 팽팽한 줄은 걸어졌다! 나는 그 임무를 보았다!
General's Orders#045.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#046.src: The soldier is very happy now! A smile is brightening the room! Yet the day still is dark. Why this is, I must ponder for a moment.
General's Orders#046.dst: 병사는 지금 매우 행복하다! 미소가 방을 밝히고 있다! 그러나 하루는 아직 어둡다. 왜 이것인지, 나는 잠시 숙고해야 한다.
General's Orders#046.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#048.src: I have devised my plan! I have observed the hills are naked. That must be why the soldiers become upset.
General's Orders#048.dst: 나는 나의 계획을 고안했다! 나는 언덕들이 벌거벗은 것을 관찰했다. 그것이 병사들이 속상해지는 이유임이 틀림없다.
General's Orders#048.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#049.src: Here is my new work then- Dress the hill. It is bare and trashy. No good! Trashy hills mean our day is trashy.
General's Orders#049.dst: 그럼 나의 새 일이다- 언덕에 옷을 입혀라. 그것은 헐벗고 쓰레기스럽다. 안 좋다! 쓰레기 언덕은 쓰레기 하루다.
General's Orders#049.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#050.src: Turn the hill purple! I order it! Purple is King's color! The fortress will feel a castle and we will feast for a hundred!
General's Orders#050.dst: 언덕을 보라색으로 바꿔라! 나는 그것을 명령한다! 보라색은 왕의 색이다! 요새는 성을 느끼고 우리는 백 명 잔치한다!
General's Orders#050.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#051.src: Previously, Springy were introduced. They will make easy accessibility! Person will find Springy past the tight rope.
General's Orders#051.dst: 이전에, 뿅뿅이가 도입되었다. 그것들은 쉬운 접근성을 만들 것이다! 사람은 팽팽한 줄 너머에서 뿅뿅이를 찾을 것이다.
General's Orders#051.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#052.src: Paint the mountain by using the trampolines at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

General's Orders#054.src: WOOO!! Finally! Someone to help- Hey, look over here!!
General's Orders#054.dst: 우오오!! 드디어! 도와줄 사람이- 이봐, 여기 좀 봐!!
General's Orders#054.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#055.src: Gosh, what a stroke of luck! I finally beat the Bantisu monks to one of you lost fellas!
General's Orders#055.dst: 와, 이런 행운이! 드디어 Bantisu 수도승들보다 먼저 길 잃은 사람 하나를 찾았어!
General's Orders#055.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#056.src: I'm here searching for soldiers lost in the canyon, you're the first person I've found!
General's Orders#056.dst: 협곡에서 실종된 병사들을 찾고 있었는데, 네가 처음 찾은 사람이야!
General's Orders#056.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#057.src: This propeller hat is great, by the way. At first it seemed sort of silly, but it works a treat, and it's real fun, too!
General's Orders#057.dst: 그나저나 이 프로펠러 모자 끝내주지 않아? 처음엔 좀 우스워 보였는데, 기가 막히게 잘 되고 진짜 재밌어!
General's Orders#057.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#058.src: That aside, just stand under me, and I'll lift you down! Come on now!
General's Orders#058.dst: 그건 그렇고, 내 밑에 서 있기만 해. 내려 줄게! 어서!
General's Orders#058.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#060.src: There you go, fella! It's back to the skies for me! Best orders ever!! WOOO!!
General's Orders#060.dst: 다 왔어, 친구! 난 다시 하늘로 간다! 최고의 명령이야!! 우오오!!
General's Orders#060.speaker: Rescuer

General's Orders#061.src: Hey, hey, hey! Person has returned to Administrator's! The hill is King's color now! That is right?
General's Orders#061.dst: 헤이, 헤이, 헤이! 사람이 행정관의로 돌아왔다! 언덕은 이제 왕의 색이다! 그것이 맞는가?
General's Orders#061.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#062.src: Convenient, convenient, convenient! Our day will no longer be trashy. Good tasks have been concluded!
General's Orders#062.dst: 편리하다, 편리하다, 편리하다! 우리 하루는 더는 쓰레기스럽지 않다. 좋은 임무들이 결론되었다!
General's Orders#062.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#063.src: However, tasks must be serious. Person's next work is very important. Mister "Gren" needs of help.
General's Orders#063.dst: 그러나, 임무들은 진지해야 한다. 사람의 다음 일은 매우 중요하다. "Gren" 씨는 도움의 필요가 있다.
General's Orders#063.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#064.src: "Gren" Lieutenant has worked on task for many days. He needs assistance, fast- Time is required of a machine!
General's Orders#064.dst: "Gren" 중위는 여러 날 동안 임무에 일했다. 그는 도움이 필요하다, 빨리- 기계의 시간이 요구된다!
General's Orders#064.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#065.src: Here is my new work then- Assist "Gren." It is important work. Science machines are complicating.
General's Orders#065.dst: 그럼 나의 새 일이다- "Gren"을 도와라. 그것은 중요한 일이다. 과학 기계들은 복잡화하다.
General's Orders#065.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#066.src: Build the machine with time! "Gren" is left outside Administrator's. Assist Lieutenant!
General's Orders#066.dst: 시간으로 기계를 지어라! "Gren"은 행정관의 밖에 남겨져 있다. 중위를 도와라!
General's Orders#066.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#068.src: ...hm? Oh, the madman's roped you into this too?! I asked for a Corkian engineer, not- Urgh. Look, have you got any technical knowhow?
General's Orders#068.dst: ...음? 아, 그 미치광이가 당신까지 끌어들였소?! Corkus 기술자를 달라 했더니- 으. 이보시오, 기술 지식은 좀 있소?
General's Orders#068.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#069.src: He wants me to construct him a time machine!! Why does he even need more time when there's plenty about?
General's Orders#069.dst: 나더러 타임머신을 만들라는 거요!! 시간이야 널리고 널렸는데 왜 더 필요하다는 건지?
General's Orders#069.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#070.src: Well, beggars can't be choosers. If you think you have any ideas on how to get it functioning, step inside and see what you can do.
General's Orders#070.dst: 뭐, 찬밥 더운밥 가릴 처지가 아니지. 작동시킬 방법이 떠오르면 안에 들어가서 해 보시오.
General's Orders#070.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#071.src: ...wait. It's ticking. Does that mean- Wait, no! HUMAN! GET OUT OF THERE-
General's Orders#071.dst: ...잠깐. 째깍거리는데. 그 말은- 잠깐, 안 돼! 인간! 거기서 나와-
General's Orders#071.speaker: Lieutenant Gren

General's Orders#073.src: Investigate the mysterious prison within the fort.

General's Orders#074.src: Who goes there?! What, come and try to finish the job, you beast?! ...wait...a human?! Whatever reason you're down here for, you need to listen!
General's Orders#074.dst: 거기 누구냐?! 뭐, 끝장내러 왔나, 이 괴물아?! ...잠깐... 인간?! 여기 왜 왔든 내 말을 들어야 한다!

General's Orders#075.src: I am General Lecade of the Kitrios Barracks! While you are on my ground, you must follow my orders!
General's Orders#075.dst: 나는 Kitrios Barracks의 General Lecade다! 내 영지에 있는 동안은 내 명령을 따라야 한다!
General's Orders#075.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#076.src: Soldier, I order you to unlock this door! They tossed the key behind that desk; we'll be able to discuss this once I'm out.
General's Orders#076.dst: 병사, 이 문을 열 것을 명령한다! 놈들이 열쇠를 저 책상 뒤로 던졌다. 내가 나가면 얘기할 수 있을 거다.
General's Orders#076.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#077.src: Good. Thank you, soldier. There's a lot to explain. I'll tell you everything along the way.
General's Orders#077.dst: 좋아. 고맙다, 병사. 설명할 게 많다. 가면서 전부 말해 주지.
General's Orders#077.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#078.src: For now, though, we should get out of this dilapidated prison. Let's go.
General's Orders#078.dst: 하지만 지금은 이 낡은 감옥에서 나가야 한다. 가자.
General's Orders#078.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#081.src: You...! You're... What is the meaning of this, why do you look like me?!
General's Orders#081.dst: 너...! 너는... 이게 무슨 짓이냐, 왜 나와 똑같이 생긴 거지?!
General's Orders#081.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#082.src: Trashy liar! No escape! I order it! Generally orders must be done! Return to the room!
General's Orders#082.dst: 쓰레기 거짓말쟁이! 탈출 없음! 나는 그것을 명령한다! 장군적으로 명령은 행해져야 한다! 방으로 돌아가라!
General's Orders#082.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#083.src: What nonsense...! I'll wrestle that costume off of you, you impostor!
General's Orders#083.dst: 헛소리를...! 그 변장을 벗겨 주마, 이 사칭꾼아!
General's Orders#083.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#084.src: Agh... As insane as you sound, you're a tough fight... Human, you need to finish this thing off!
General's Orders#084.dst: 윽... 말은 미친 소리 같아도 싸움은 만만치 않군... 인간, 이 녀석을 끝장내라!
General's Orders#084.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#085.src: Person! I have new work for you- Knock down the fake soldier! Assist fast!
General's Orders#085.dst: 사람! 너에게 새 일이 있다- 가짜 병사를 쓰러뜨려라! 빠르게 도와라!
General's Orders#085.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#086.src: What folly! A doppelganger calling ME a fake! How about you go ahead and prove yourself!
General's Orders#086.dst: 어리석긴! 도플갱어가 나를 가짜라고 부르다니! 그럼 네가 진짜임을 증명해 봐라!
General's Orders#086.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#087.src: Hey, hey, hey! Smart thoughts from fakeman! Our home- we called it Gravel!
General's Orders#087.dst: 헤이, 헤이, 헤이! 가짜남의 똑똑한 생각! 우리 집- 우리는 Gravel이라 불렀다!
General's Orders#087.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#088.src: Gravel? I've never heard something more outlandish, it's called Gavel!
General's Orders#088.dst: Gravel? 그렇게 터무니없는 소린 처음 듣는군. Gavel이다!
General's Orders#088.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#089.src: Are the rumors about humans being brainless mercenaries REALLY true?!
General's Orders#089.dst: 인간이 머리 빈 용병이라는 소문이 정말 사실이었나?!
General's Orders#089.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#090.src: What!? Books have told me this home is hilly and crumbly!
General's Orders#090.dst: 무엇!? 책들은 나에게 이 집이 언덕지고 부스러진다고 말했다!
General's Orders#090.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#091.src: Do you even know where we are...? How about this then, who's the private that guards the entrance?
General's Orders#091.dst: 여기가 어딘지는 알기나 하나...? 그럼 이건 어떠냐. 입구를 지키는 이병은 누구지?
General's Orders#091.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#092.src: Tiger! The soldier with dance is Tiger!
General's Orders#092.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#093.src: Tiger?! His name is Tylas!! A tiger is an exotic animal, not some drowsy private!
General's Orders#093.dst: Tiger?! 그 녀석 이름은 Tylas다!! tiger는 이국의 동물이지, 졸린 이병이 아니야!
General's Orders#093.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#094.src: No wonder he was asleep, it seems he was even too lazy to give you his name!
General's Orders#094.dst: 잠이나 자더라니, 너한테 이름 알려 주는 것조차 귀찮았나 보군!
General's Orders#094.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#095.src: Weak worm!! Person has been convenient with work- Why do stupid things?!
General's Orders#095.dst: 약한 벌레!! 사람은 일에 편리했다- 왜 멍청한 것들을 하는가?!
General's Orders#095.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#096.src: AHA! I have pondered- say where Springy is held!
General's Orders#096.dst: 아하! 나는 숙고했다- 뿅뿅이가 어디 보관되는지 말하라!
General's Orders#096.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#097.src: What in the... Springy- What in the world are you talking about?! We don't store springs in the fort!!
General's Orders#097.dst: 이게 대체... 뿅뿅이- 도대체 무슨 소리냐?! 요새에 스프링 같은 건 보관 안 한다!!
General's Orders#097.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#098.src: Weak fake soldier!! Springy is held to sleep! Springy is held on top of the pillar!!
General's Orders#098.dst: 약한 가짜 병사!! 뿅뿅이는 잠자기로 보관된다! 뿅뿅이는 기둥의 꼭대기에 보관된다!!
General's Orders#098.speaker: Lecade 1

General's Orders#099.src: Human!! What are you thinking?! He's speaking utter nonsense!!
General's Orders#099.dst: 인간!! 무슨 생각이냐?! 저건 완전히 헛소리다!!
General's Orders#099.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#100.src: What even is a springy?! He's speaking utter nonsense!
General's Orders#100.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#101.src: Enough of this! Soldier, you can't possibly believe that fraud, we have to team up on him!
General's Orders#101.dst: 그만! 병사, 설마 저 사기꾼을 믿는 건 아니겠지. 함께 놈을 상대해야 한다!
General's Orders#101.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#102.src: Fine then- If I'm alone on this, it's time for the classic Lecade Power Play!!
General's Orders#102.dst: 좋다 그럼- 나 혼자라면, 전통의 Lecade 파워 플레이를 보여 줄 때다!!
General's Orders#102.speaker: Lecade 2

General's Orders#104.src: Inconvenient! Person is trashy! Terrible fake! I will not intend the victim on returning to home!
General's Orders#104.dst: 불편하다! 사람은 쓰레기스럽다! 끔찍한 가짜! 나는 피해자가 집으로 돌아가는 것을 의도하지 않는다!

General's Orders#106.src: I did fine work! I generally performed tasks to soldiers! There's nothing wrong!
General's Orders#106.dst: 나는 좋은 일을 했다! 장군적으로 병사들에게 임무를 수행했다! 잘못은 없다!

General's Orders#107.src: Too much! Too much! Too much! Escape! Need escape! Too strong!
General's Orders#107.dst: 너무 많다! 너무 많다! 너무 많다! 탈출! 탈출 필요! 너무 강하다!

General's Orders#108.src: Damn! He's gone... I don't think we'll be able to catch him on foot at this rate.
General's Orders#108.dst: 젠장! 사라졌군... 이대로면 걸어서는 못 잡겠어.
General's Orders#108.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#109.src: I can't believe you actually trusted him, but I couldn't hold a grudge about it. The thing's gone, anyways.
General's Orders#109.dst: 네가 놈을 정말 믿었다니 믿기지 않지만, 원망할 순 없지. 어차피 놈은 사라졌으니.
General's Orders#109.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#110.src: It wouldn't be right to leave you empty handed over it. Perhaps you can find a use for that odd slime it left behind.
General's Orders#110.dst: 그 일로 빈손으로 보내는 건 옳지 않겠지. 놈이 남긴 그 이상한 점액을 쓸 데가 있을지도 모르겠군.
General's Orders#110.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#111.src: Well soldier, I'll be checking out what degree of havoc he's wreaked on this fort.
General's Orders#111.dst: 자, 병사. 그자가 이 요새를 얼마나 쑥대밭으로 만들었는지 확인하러 가겠네.
General's Orders#111.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#112.src: I couldn't leave you unrewarded for your efforts though. You seem resourceful- Perhaps you can find a use for that odd slime it left behind.
General's Orders#112.dst: 그래도 수고한 보상은 해야지. 넌 수완이 좋아 보이는군. 놈이 남긴 그 이상한 점액을 쓸 데가 있을지도 모르겠어.
General's Orders#112.speaker: Lecade

General's Orders#113.src: Some clay I see! I'll take that off of you. Not without compensation of course!
General's Orders#113.dst: 점토가 보이네! 그건 내가 받아 가지. 물론 공짜로는 아니고!
General's Orders#113.speaker: Private

Grand Youth#001.src: Oh, what am I to do...? How am I to be our next elder if I cannot even help him... Oh? Ehm, hello, stranger.
Grand Youth#001.dst: 아, 어쩌면 좋을까...? 그분도 못 돕는데 어떻게 다음 장로가 되겠어... 응? 음, 안녕하세요, 낯선 분.
Grand Youth#001.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#002.src: You most likely heard me. Our elder has fallen ill of some vile disease... I am to be our next elder, but I am not yet ready.
Grand Youth#002.dst: 아마 들으셨겠죠. 저희 장로님이 몹쓸 병에 걸리셨어요... 제가 다음 장로가 될 사람이지만, 아직 준비가 안 됐어요.
Grand Youth#002.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#003.src: We have tried everything we can think of, but our healers and shamans have failed to cure him. We had some hope, however...
Grand Youth#003.dst: 생각나는 건 다 해 봤지만, 치유사도 주술사도 그분을 고치지 못했어요. 그래도 희망이 좀 있었는데...
Grand Youth#003.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#004.src: A man in your city, {p}, insists that he sells healing water that could cure him, but he is selling it for an exorbitant price that we cannot afford!
Grand Youth#004.dst: 당신네 도시 {p}에 사는 어떤 남자가 그분을 낫게 할 치유의 물을 판다고 하는데, 너무 비싸서 저희는 살 수가 없어요!
Grand Youth#004.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#005.src: I do not know where else to turn. I must ask you for help. If you can purchase it, I am sure that we could find a way to repay you.
Grand Youth#005.dst: 달리 기댈 곳이 없어요. 도움을 부탁드려야겠어요. 사 주실 수 있다면 꼭 보답할 방법을 찾을게요.
Grand Youth#005.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#006.src: I have written directions for you in your content book...please help our village.
Grand Youth#006.dst: 콘텐츠 북에 길을 적어 드렸어요... 부디 저희 마을을 도와주세요.
Grand Youth#006.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#007.src: Visit the Salesman in {p} near the fountain.

Grand Youth#008.src: Oh, why hello there! Come for my patented healing water, have you? Any problem instantly cured! Sniffles beware!
Grand Youth#008.dst: 오, 어서 오세요! 제 특허받은 치유의 물을 사러 오셨죠? 어떤 병이든 즉시 완치! 콧물감기야 물렀거라!
Grand Youth#008.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#009.src: You're quite lucky, I only have a couple of bottles left, so it won't go cheap, but this is the good stuff! Only [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
Grand Youth#009.dst: 운이 좋으시네요, 몇 병 안 남아서 싸게는 못 드려도 진짜 좋은 물건이에요! 단돈 [{~} Liquified Emeralds]!
Grand Youth#009.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#010.src: What? Don't give me that look! This is the real stuff, very valuable and rare! What do ya take me for, some guy who'd sell lake water for a fortune?!
Grand Youth#010.dst: 뭐요? 그런 눈으로 보지 마요! 이건 진짜배기예요, 아주 귀하고 희귀하다고요! 날 뭐로 보는 거예요, 호숫물을 비싸게 파는 사람으로?!
Grand Youth#010.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#011.src: Agh, agh! Put away the weapon! Put it away! Jeez, buddy! Alright, I admit it, I'm a fraudster! But, I do know where you get the real stuff, I ain't lying about that much.
Grand Youth#011.dst: 으악, 으악! 무기 치워요! 치우라고요! 맙소사, 친구! 좋아요, 인정해요, 사기꾼이에요! 그래도 진짜를 어디서 구하는지는 알아요, 그건 거짓말 아니에요.
Grand Youth#011.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#012.src: There's this group of mages out in Dernel who know how to get the stuff. They're a bunch of tightwads and wouldn't get give me any real healing water to sell.
Grand Youth#012.dst: Dernel에 그걸 구하는 법을 아는 마법사 무리가 있어요. 구두쇠들이라 팔 만한 진짜 치유의 물은 하나도 안 주더라고요.
Grand Youth#012.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#013.src: I doubt you'll have any better luck with it, but go on, try your luck.
Grand Youth#013.dst: 당신이라고 더 잘될 것 같진 않지만, 뭐, 운을 시험해 봐요.
Grand Youth#013.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#014.src: Those tightwad mages are out in Dernel, on the lake with the big island. I doubt you'll convince them to give you any healing water, though.
Grand Youth#014.dst: 그 구두쇠 마법사들은 Dernel에, 큰 섬이 있는 호수에 있어요. 치유의 물을 달라고 설득하긴 어렵겠지만요.
Grand Youth#014.speaker: Salesman

Grand Youth#015.src: Talk to Isfurus in Dernel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Grand Youth#016.src: Hm, hm...if it really does that, then...oh, is someone there? Erisk?
Grand Youth#016.dst: 흠, 흠... 그게 정말 그렇게 된다면... 오, 누구 있나요? Erisk?
Grand Youth#016.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#017.src: Oh, a tourist. Heard about the healing water, I presume? Well, if you are here to make a quick buck, you can turn right back around from where you came.
Grand Youth#017.dst: 오, 관광객이군요. 치유의 물 얘길 들었나 보죠? 한몫 챙기러 왔다면 온 길로 그대로 돌아가세요.
Grand Youth#017.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#018.src: Hm...ah. Iboju's sister settlement...I see. I will trust this is an honest venture, then. The tribesmen are honourable.
Grand Youth#018.dst: 흠... 아. Iboju의 자매 마을이라... 그렇군요. 그럼 정직한 일이라 믿죠. 그 부족민들은 명예를 아니까요.
Grand Youth#018.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#019.src: I will provide you a specially-prepared bottle to hold the water in. My colleague, Erisk, is within the fountain here. He can fill up the bottle for you.
Grand Youth#019.dst: 물을 담을 특별히 준비한 병을 드리죠. 제 동료 Erisk가 이 샘 안에 있어요. 그가 병을 채워 줄 거예요.
Grand Youth#019.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#020.src: There are a few animals in the fountain, however. They're wild and will most likely attack, but you look well-armoured. I doubt you'll have trouble.
Grand Youth#020.dst: 다만 샘 안에 동물이 좀 있어요. 야생이라 아마 공격하겠지만, 무장을 잘 갖춘 것 같으니 문제없을 거예요.
Grand Youth#020.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#021.src: The entrance to the heart of the fountain is right below us. Take a deep breath and dive right in.
Grand Youth#021.dst: 샘의 중심으로 가는 입구가 바로 우리 아래에 있어요. 숨을 깊이 들이쉬고 뛰어드세요.
Grand Youth#021.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#022.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#022.dst: 길은 콘텐츠 북에 있어요, 친구. 곤란할 땐 언제든 확인하세요.
Grand Youth#022.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#023.src: Get the bottles filled by Erisk in the heart of the fountain to give Isfurus.
Grand Youth#023.dst: 샘의 중심에 있는 Erisk에게 병을 채워 받아 Isfurus에게 주세요.

Grand Youth#024.src: And who might you be? We certainly don't get many visitors down here.
Grand Youth#024.dst: 누구신가요? 여기 아래엔 손님이 거의 안 오거든요.
Grand Youth#024.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#025.src: Aha, Isfurus referred you. Yes, let me bottle this up for you, then. Once I do, make sure you don't drop them! Both the bottles and the water are valuable and difficult to replace.
Grand Youth#025.dst: 아하, Isfurus가 보냈군요. 네, 그럼 담아 드릴게요. 담고 나면 절대 떨어뜨리지 마세요! 병도 물도 귀하고 다시 구하기 어려워요.
Grand Youth#025.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#026.src: But what a marvel this place is...water to cure all ailments, even aging! I even hear there is a similar fountain someplace in Gavel, can you believe?
Grand Youth#026.dst: 그런데 여긴 정말 놀라운 곳이에요... 모든 병을, 심지어 노화까지 고치는 물이라니! Gavel 어딘가에도 비슷한 샘이 있대요, 믿어져요?
Grand Youth#026.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#027.src: Oh, I nearly forgot. Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave! There is just one more step to the process he has to take care of.
Grand Youth#027.dst: 아, 깜빡할 뻔했네요. 떠나기 전에 꼭 Isfurus에게 다시 들르세요! 그가 처리해야 할 과정이 하나 더 남았거든요.
Grand Youth#027.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#028.src: Just make sure to check back in with Isfurus before you leave!
Grand Youth#028.dst: 떠나기 전에 꼭 Isfurus에게 다시 들르세요!
Grand Youth#028.speaker: Erisk

Grand Youth#030.src: Aha. You had no trouble, I assume? Hand the bottle here, I'll finish the seal and remove the impurities...
Grand Youth#030.dst: 아하. 별일 없었죠? 병을 이리 주세요, 봉인을 마무리하고 불순물을 없앨게요...
Grand Youth#030.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#031.src: ...done. There is much potential here...ancient tribal markings repeat the word "youth" over and again. It could be used, or abused...
Grand Youth#031.dst: ...됐어요. 여기엔 큰 잠재력이 있어요... 고대 부족 문양에 "젊음"이란 말이 거듭 되풀이되거든요. 쓰일 수도, 악용될 수도 있죠...
Grand Youth#031.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#032.src: Anyways, you have your water. Not to be rude, but I must ask that you leave me to my research now. You have your delivery to make anyway, correct?
Grand Youth#032.dst: 아무튼 물은 받았네요. 실례지만 이제 연구하게 해 주세요. 어차피 배달할 게 있잖아요, 그렇죠?
Grand Youth#032.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#033.src: Your directions are in your content book, friend. Always consult it if you are in a bind.
Grand Youth#033.dst: 길은 콘텐츠 북에 있어요, 친구. 곤란할 땐 언제든 확인하세요.
Grand Youth#033.speaker: Isfurus

Grand Youth#034.src: Bring back the bottle of healing water to Monte.
Grand Youth#034.dst: 치유의 물이 든 병을 Monte에게 가져가세요.

Grand Youth#035.src: You have returned, I see. Have you the healing water?
Grand Youth#035.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#036.src: Aha, perfect! If this not work, then...no, I must have faith.
Grand Youth#036.dst: 아하, 완벽해요! 이게 안 통하면... 아니, 믿어야 해요.
Grand Youth#036.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#037.src: From the bottom of my heart, thank you. I know we surely will not be able to compensate you for the price of the water...
Grand Youth#037.dst: 진심으로 감사드려요. 물값을 저희가 도저히 갚을 수 없다는 건 알지만...
Grand Youth#037.speaker: Monte

Grand Youth#038.src: ...but here. This is the summation of our village's riches. For aiding us, consider it yours.
Grand Youth#038.dst: ...여기요. 저희 마을 재산을 전부 모은 거예요. 도와주신 보답으로 받아 주세요.
Grand Youth#038.speaker: Monte

Green Gloop#000.src: However, the slimes have gotten stronger about a month ago. I'm unable to retrieve it any more, I^ve come close to getting killed a few times!
Green Gloop#000.dst: 그런데 한 달쯤 전부터 슬라임들이 강해졌어요. 더는 못 구하겠어요, 몇 번이나 죽을 뻔했다고요!

Green Gloop#001.src: I'll need [{~} Slimey Goo] since we'll need a big batch of drinks. If you help, I'll be sure to tell my friend, and he^ll probably let you into his shop.
Green Gloop#001.dst: 음료를 잔뜩 만들어야 해서 [{~} Slimey Goo]가 필요해요. 도와주시면 친구한테 꼭 말할게요. 아마 가게에 들여보내 줄 거예요.

Green Gloop#002.src: Ah, you've got the scooper! Head into the cave now - remember, I need [{~} Slimey Goo] to make the drink!
Green Gloop#002.dst: 아, 국자를 구하셨네요! 이제 동굴로 들어가세요. 잊지 마세요, 음료를 만들려면 [{~} Slimey Goo]가 필요해요!

Green Gloop#004.src: Oh, hey! You, adventurer over there! Would you mind helping me?
Green Gloop#004.dst: 오, 저기요! 거기 모험가님! 좀 도와주실래요?
Green Gloop#004.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#005.src: You see, this cave behind me has been troubling me for the past while now.
Green Gloop#005.dst: 그게, 제 뒤에 있는 이 동굴 때문에 요즘 골치가 아파요.
Green Gloop#005.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#006.src: There are special slimes that live in there, and they drop a certain goo that is quite a delicacy when brewed into a drink!
Green Gloop#006.dst: 안에 특별한 슬라임이 사는데, 걔들이 떨구는 끈적이를 음료로 우리면 꽤 별미거든요!
Green Gloop#006.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#007.src: They are called Gooey Slimes, and should be at the very back. A friend of mine drinks the stuff like water, and he refuses to work without it.
Green Gloop#007.dst: 끈적 슬라임이라고 하는데, 맨 안쪽에 있을 거예요. 제 친구가 그걸 물처럼 마시는데, 그게 없으면 일을 안 하겠대요.
Green Gloop#007.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#008.src: However, the slimes have gotten stronger about a month ago. I'm unable to retrieve it any more, I've come close to getting killed a few times!
Green Gloop#008.dst: 그런데 한 달쯤 전부터 슬라임들이 강해졌어요. 더는 못 구하겠어요, 몇 번이나 죽을 뻔했다고요!
Green Gloop#008.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#009.src: You, however, seem much better equipped than I. Hopefully you can do it.
Green Gloop#009.dst: 그래도 모험가님은 저보다 장비가 훨씬 좋아 보여요. 해내실 수 있길 바라요.
Green Gloop#009.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#010.src: If you decide to help me, you'll need to obtain a special device for retrieving it, as the slime will dry up quickly in the air.
Green Gloop#010.dst: 도와주실 거라면 채집용 특수 도구가 필요해요. 끈적이는 공기에 닿으면 금방 말라 버리거든요.
Green Gloop#010.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#011.src: A...less fickle glassblower, Yodbon, can make it for you. He should be living in a house in front of the {p} bank.
Green Gloop#011.dst: 좀... 덜 까다로운 유리공 Yodbon이 만들어 줄 거예요. {p} 은행 앞 집에 살고 있을 거예요.
Green Gloop#011.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#012.src: I'll need [{~} Slimey Goo] since we'll need a big batch of drinks. If you help, I'll be sure to tell my friend, and he'll probably let you into his shop.
Green Gloop#012.dst: 음료를 잔뜩 만들어야 해서 [{~} Slimey Goo]가 필요해요. 도와주시면 친구한테 꼭 말할게요. 아마 가게에 들여보내 줄 거예요.
Green Gloop#012.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#013.src: Find Yodbon near the {p} Bank at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Green Gloop#014.src: Welcome to Yodbon's Glass Blowery, what can I do f-
Green Gloop#014.dst: Yodbon 유리 공방에 어서 오세요, 뭘 도와드-
Green Gloop#014.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#016.src: So many've been coming up to me recently, askin' for a bloody Slime Scooper...
Green Gloop#016.dst: 요즘 죄다 나한테 와서 빌어먹을 슬라임 국자를 달라더군...
Green Gloop#016.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#017.src: Izzat brother o' mine stopped workin' again? I swear, he's addicted to that slop...
Green Gloop#017.dst: 내 동생 놈이 또 일 안 하냐? 진짜, 그 녀석 그 꿀꿀이죽에 중독됐다니까...
Green Gloop#017.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#018.src: Anyways, for me to make you a scooper you'll need to get [{~} Soft Sand].
Green Gloop#018.dst: 아무튼, 국자를 만들어 주려면 [{~} Soft Sand]를 구해 와야 해.
Green Gloop#018.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#019.src: Come back to me once you've gotten ahold of it. You can dig it up from those sand piles 'round the desert.
Green Gloop#019.dst: 구하면 다시 와. 사막 여기저기 있는 모래 더미에서 파낼 수 있어.
Green Gloop#019.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#020.src: Bring [{~} Soft Sand] from enemies in the desert to Yodbon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#020.dst: 사막의 적에게서 [{~} Soft Sand]를 얻어 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Yodbon에게 가져가세요

Green Gloop#022.src: A'ight, fork 'em over and I'll make you the scooper.
Green Gloop#022.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#023.src: ..There you go. No idea why he wants that stuff though. Maybe it's an acquired taste...
Green Gloop#023.dst: ..자, 여기. 걔가 왜 그걸 찾는지 모르겠네. 먹다 보면 맛들이는 건가...
Green Gloop#023.speaker: Yodbon

Green Gloop#025.src: Fetch [{~} Slimey Goo] for Eluzterp from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Green Gloop#025.dst: [{~} Slimey Goo]를 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴에서 구해 Eluzterp에게 가져가세요

Green Gloop#026.src: Oh, you're back! Good to see you were able to get through there. Have you got a full Slime Scooper?
Green Gloop#026.dst: 오, 돌아오셨네요! 무사히 다녀오셔서 다행이에요. 슬라임 국자는 가득 채우셨어요?
Green Gloop#026.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#027.src: Hmm, yes, everything seems to be in order. Perfect!
Green Gloop#027.dst: 음, 네, 다 괜찮아 보이네요. 완벽해요!
Green Gloop#027.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#028.src: Thank you very much. Finally, I'll be able to get him in gear again... Why are all Villagers so fickle like that?
Green Gloop#028.dst: 정말 고마워요. 드디어 그 녀석을 다시 일하게 만들 수 있겠어요... 주민들은 왜 다 저렇게 변덕스러울까요?
Green Gloop#028.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#029.src: Well, I suppose that's beside the point. I'll be sure to let him know you got him his most recent fix.
Green Gloop#029.dst: 뭐, 그건 중요한 게 아니죠. 이번 물량을 모험가님이 구해 줬다고 꼭 전할게요.
Green Gloop#029.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#030.src: He hangs around in a little black stall in the bazaar, there's a basement to it. He should let you inside now.
Green Gloop#030.dst: 시장의 작고 검은 가판대에 늘 있는데, 거기 지하실이 있어요. 이제 들여보내 줄 거예요.
Green Gloop#030.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#031.src: And, for your troubles, a little something from me as well.
Green Gloop#031.dst: 그리고 수고하셨으니 제가 드리는 작은 선물이에요.
Green Gloop#031.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#032.src: Ah, hello again. This latest batch of drinks apparently really revitalized him. He said he's looking to make some great craft.
Green Gloop#032.dst: 아, 또 뵙네요. 이번 음료가 그 녀석을 정말 되살렸나 봐요. 대단한 물건을 만들어 보겠대요.
Green Gloop#032.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#033.src: Those Villagers are a little bit crazy though... I have no idea what kind of material it is that he insists he needs for it.
Green Gloop#033.dst: 그래도 주민들은 좀 이상하다니까요... 그걸 만드는 데 꼭 필요하다는 재료가 뭔지 전혀 모르겠어요.
Green Gloop#033.speaker: Eluzterp

Green Gloop#034.src: Oh, it's you again. Yes, my brother there just loves makin' his little trinkets. He oughta make somethin' useful out of his glass instead...
Green Gloop#034.dst: 아, 또 너냐. 그래, 내 동생은 자잘한 장신구 만드는 걸 아주 좋아하지. 그 유리로 쓸모 있는 거나 만들 것이지...
Green Gloop#034.speaker: Yodbon

Haven Antiquity#000.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#001.src: Hey there adventurer, can I speak with you for a second? I need you to do a spot of detective work for me.
Haven Antiquity#001.dst: 안녕하세요, 모험가님. 잠깐 얘기 좀 할 수 있을까요? 탐정 노릇을 좀 해 주셨으면 해서요.
Haven Antiquity#001.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#002.src: My grandfather once told me how beautiful this place was, and how to visit here if I wanted to relax.
Haven Antiquity#002.dst: 할아버지께서 이곳이 얼마나 아름다운지, 쉬고 싶으면 여기 오라고 말씀하시곤 했어요.
Haven Antiquity#002.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#003.src: But as you can see, this island is the least bit relaxing. It is a sorrowful place, corrupted and dark.
Haven Antiquity#003.dst: 그런데 보시다시피 이 섬은 전혀 편안하지 않아요. 타락하고 어두운, 슬픈 곳이죠.
Haven Antiquity#003.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#004.src: This can't be right. My grandfather was an honest man, he wouldn't have lied.
Haven Antiquity#004.dst: 이상해요. 할아버지는 정직한 분이셨어요. 거짓말하실 리가 없어요.
Haven Antiquity#004.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#005.src: I figure something must have happened. I really want to know how it got like this.
Haven Antiquity#005.dst: 분명 무슨 일이 있었을 거예요. 어쩌다 이렇게 됐는지 정말 알고 싶어요.
Haven Antiquity#005.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#006.src: There's an old creepy man living up on that hill in a big mansion who seems just old enough to know what happened. It might be a good place to start.
Haven Antiquity#006.dst: 저 언덕 위 큰 저택에 음침한 노인이 사는데, 무슨 일이 있었는지 알 만한 나이 같아요. 거기서 시작해 보세요.
Haven Antiquity#006.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#007.src: Investigate Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Haven Antiquity#008.src: What do you want? I'm busy. Brewing potions takes focus, you know....
Haven Antiquity#008.dst: 무슨 볼일이냐? 난 바빠. 물약 달이는 데는 집중이 필요하단 말이다....
Haven Antiquity#008.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#009.src: Oh, you want to know about the island's history? Well you certainly came to the right man. I've lived here for a very long time.
Haven Antiquity#009.dst: 오, 이 섬의 역사가 궁금하다고? 제대로 찾아왔군. 난 여기서 아주 오래 살았으니까.
Haven Antiquity#009.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#010.src: There is a way for you to see for yourself what happened here. It's quite... an interesting tale, too.
Haven Antiquity#010.dst: 여기서 무슨 일이 있었는지 직접 볼 방법이 있지. 꽤... 흥미로운 이야기이기도 하고.
Haven Antiquity#010.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#011.src: I'd sit and tell you, but I think you might get a better experience first hand....
Haven Antiquity#011.dst: 앉아서 들려줄 수도 있지만, 직접 겪어 보는 편이 더 나을 게다....
Haven Antiquity#011.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#012.src: Using some of the more... frowned upon methods in the alchemists library I am able to send you into the 'memory' of a dead person that lived here at the time.
Haven Antiquity#012.dst: 연금술 서고의 좀... 꺼림칙한 방법을 쓰면, 그 시절 여기 살았던 죽은 자의 '기억' 속으로 널 보낼 수 있지.
Haven Antiquity#012.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#013.src: It will require a little work from you though, if you wish to proceed....
Haven Antiquity#013.dst: 계속하고 싶다면, 네가 조금 수고를 해 줘야 한다....
Haven Antiquity#013.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#014.src: Bring me [{~} Umbral Essences] and I will be able to cast a spell on you which will allow you to pass into the 'memory' of the deceased.
Haven Antiquity#014.dst: [{~} Umbral Essences]를 가져오면 죽은 자의 '기억'으로 들어갈 수 있게 주문을 걸어 주마.
Haven Antiquity#014.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#015.src: Acquire [{~} Umbral Essences] for Old Siwel
Haven Antiquity#015.dst: Old Siwel에게 [{~} Umbral Essences]를 구해 주세요

Haven Antiquity#016.src: Excellent. You acquired the ingredients. Just give me a second and I'll prepare you for your journey into the mind of the dead.
Haven Antiquity#016.dst: 훌륭하군. 재료를 구해 왔어. 잠깐만 기다려라, 죽은 자의 정신으로 떠날 준비를 해 주지.
Haven Antiquity#016.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#019.src: There, look into my eyes. Yes, you're ready. Ah, there is a drawback though....
Haven Antiquity#019.dst: 자, 내 눈을 봐라. 그래, 준비됐군. 아, 그런데 부작용이 하나 있다....
Haven Antiquity#019.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#020.src: Once you are inside the memory, it will feel like you are actually there. You won't be able to return until you have succeeded in your task.
Haven Antiquity#020.dst: 기억 속에 들어가면 실제로 그곳에 있는 것처럼 느껴질 게다. 임무를 마치기 전엔 돌아올 수 없어.
Haven Antiquity#020.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#021.src: To enter the memory, you need to find the dead man at the end of the crypt in the graveyard.
Haven Antiquity#021.dst: 기억에 들어가려면 묘지 지하 묘실 끝에 있는 죽은 자를 찾아야 한다.
Haven Antiquity#021.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#022.src: The dead roam those caves in heavy numbers, so watch your step.
Haven Antiquity#022.dst: 그 동굴엔 망자가 득실거리니 발밑을 조심해라.
Haven Antiquity#022.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#023.src: Oh and one more thing, If you die in the memory, you die in reality too....
Haven Antiquity#023.dst: 아, 하나 더. 기억 속에서 죽으면 현실에서도 죽는다....
Haven Antiquity#023.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#025.src: Locate the Crypt under the church at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and pass through a dead man's memory
Haven Antiquity#025.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 교회 아래 지하 묘실을 찾아 죽은 자의 기억을 통과하세요

Haven Antiquity#026.src: Investigate Siwel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] on Alive Island

Haven Antiquity#027.src: Oh, hello there. Would you mind helping me with something for a second?
Haven Antiquity#027.dst: 아, 안녕하세요. 잠깐 뭘 좀 도와주실 수 있을까요?
Haven Antiquity#027.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#028.src: Recently, some strange things have been happening to the miners around here. New diseases, unexplained disappearances, and things like that.
Haven Antiquity#028.dst: 요즘 이 근처 광부들에게 이상한 일이 생기고 있어요. 새로운 병, 설명할 수 없는 실종 같은 것들요.
Haven Antiquity#028.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#029.src: The villagers have been getting very worried. So, in an attempt to protect the island, I bought a strange egg and placed it in a cave close to town.
Haven Antiquity#029.dst: 주민들이 무척 걱정하고 있어요. 그래서 섬을 지키려고 이상한 알을 사서 마을 근처 동굴에 뒀죠.
Haven Antiquity#029.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#030.src: The egg, however, isn't what I thought it was. It is producing monsters and giving off some sort of dark aura.
Haven Antiquity#030.dst: 그런데 그 알은 제 생각과 달랐어요. 몬스터를 만들어 내고 어두운 기운을 내뿜고 있어요.
Haven Antiquity#030.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#031.src: I want you to go check out that egg. See if you can get rid of whatever it is producing. Bring me [{~} Monster Hides] as evidence.
Haven Antiquity#031.dst: 그 알을 살펴봐 주세요. 거기서 나오는 걸 없앨 수 있는지 봐 주시고요. 증거로 [{~} Monster Hides]를 가져와 주세요.
Haven Antiquity#031.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#032.src: Confront the cave under the mansion at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and retrieve [{~} Monster Hides] for Siwel from the monsters within
Haven Antiquity#032.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 저택 아래 동굴에 맞서, 안의 몬스터에게서 Siwel에게 줄 [{~} Monster Hides]를 얻으세요

Haven Antiquity#033.src: You're back! Were you able to stop that egg?
Haven Antiquity#033.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#034.src: No? Well, I guess we'll have to wait and see what it hatches into.
Haven Antiquity#034.dst: 못 막으셨다고요? 그럼 뭐가 부화할지 기다려 봐야겠네요.
Haven Antiquity#034.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#035.src: I see you got some rather rare dark monster hide. Maybe I could use those in a potion for something, maybe to prolong life.
Haven Antiquity#035.dst: 꽤 희귀한 어둠의 몬스터 가죽을 구하셨네요. 물약에 쓸 수 있겠어요. 어쩌면 수명을 늘리는 데도요.
Haven Antiquity#035.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#036.src: Some of the villagers believe that it is unwise for myself to dabble in the dark arts, dealing with mysterious eggs and brewing potions of death.
Haven Antiquity#036.dst: 몇몇 주민은 제가 흑마술에 손대는 게 현명하지 않대요. 수상한 알을 다루고 죽음의 물약을 만드는 것 말이에요.
Haven Antiquity#036.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#037.src: I'll outlive them all, you'll see!
Haven Antiquity#037.dst: 두고 봐요, 다들보다 오래 살 테니!
Haven Antiquity#037.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#038.src: As for you, you have done what I asked. You may return to your personal affairs now.
Haven Antiquity#038.dst: 당신은 제가 부탁한 일을 해 주셨어요. 이제 하시던 일로 돌아가셔도 돼요.
Haven Antiquity#038.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#039.src: Thank you for your work, though. Only time will tell what that egg will hatch into.
Haven Antiquity#039.dst: 그래도 수고해 주셔서 고마워요. 그 알에서 뭐가 나올지는 시간만이 알겠죠.
Haven Antiquity#039.speaker: Siwel

Haven Antiquity#040.src: Return to Old Siwel in the dead Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Haven Antiquity#040.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 죽은 저택에 있는 Old Siwel에게 돌아가세요

Haven Antiquity#041.src: What? You... you made it back? Oh... Very well. Alchemy can be a... dangerous practice.
Haven Antiquity#041.dst: 뭐? 너... 돌아왔다고? 아... 좋다. 연금술이란 건... 위험한 기술일 수 있지.
Haven Antiquity#041.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#042.src: Anyone who tried to find out the island's history came to me at some point, and I sent them on a one way street to a memory. But not you....
Haven Antiquity#042.dst: 섬의 역사를 캐려던 자들은 결국 다 나를 찾아왔고, 난 그들을 돌아올 수 없는 기억 속으로 보냈지. 하지만 넌 아니군....
Haven Antiquity#042.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#043.src: So now you know my dreadful secret, I am racked with guilt and cursed with eternal life.
Haven Antiquity#043.dst: 이제 내 끔찍한 비밀을 알았겠지. 난 죄책감에 시달리며 영원한 삶의 저주를 받았다.
Haven Antiquity#043.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#044.src: There is no need to fight me, I am suffering enough for what I... wrought on this island.
Haven Antiquity#044.dst: 싸울 필요는 없다. 내가 이 섬에... 저지른 일로 이미 충분히 고통받고 있으니.
Haven Antiquity#044.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#045.src: I could not destroy the egg. It hatched into a... monstrous beast that cursed this island until this very day.
Haven Antiquity#045.dst: 난 그 알을 없애지 못했다. 알에서 나온... 끔찍한 짐승이 오늘날까지 이 섬을 저주했지.
Haven Antiquity#045.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#046.src: A powerful warrior from... {p} slew the beast, yet the island did not rejuvenate....
Haven Antiquity#046.dst: {p}에서 온... 강한 전사가 그 짐승을 죽였지만, 섬은 되살아나지 않았다....
Haven Antiquity#046.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#047.src: I leave the bones of the beast as a reminder of my failure, the destruction it brought still... lingers in the monsters it left behind.
Haven Antiquity#047.dst: 실패를 잊지 않으려 짐승의 뼈를 남겨 뒀다. 그것이 불러온 파멸은 아직도... 남은 몬스터들 속에 깃들어 있지.
Haven Antiquity#047.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#048.src: So adventurer, now you have the knowledge of what I have done. You may tell the others down in the village, as it is no longer a secret.
Haven Antiquity#048.dst: 그러니 모험가여, 이제 내가 무슨 짓을 했는지 알겠지. 마을 사람들에게 말해도 좋다. 더는 비밀이 아니니까.
Haven Antiquity#048.speaker: Old Siwel

Haven Antiquity#049.src: Talk to {p} on the docks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] about the mystery

Haven Antiquity#050.src: So, did you find out what happened?
Haven Antiquity#050.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#051.src: Siwel was the one who caused this sorrow? He does have a very dark presence about him, doesn't he?
Haven Antiquity#051.dst: Siwel이 이 슬픔을 불러온 장본인이라고요? 확실히 아주 어두운 분위기를 풍기긴 하죠?
Haven Antiquity#051.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#052.src: Thank you for your work! I know it must have been tough getting that out of him.
Haven Antiquity#052.dst: 수고해 주셔서 고마워요! 그 사람한테서 그걸 알아내기가 쉽지 않았을 거예요.
Haven Antiquity#052.speaker: Cinfras

Haven Antiquity#053.src: Now that this mystery is solved I will be returning home. I hope we will meet again!
Haven Antiquity#053.dst: 수수께끼가 풀렸으니 이제 집으로 돌아가려고요. 또 만나면 좋겠네요!
Haven Antiquity#053.speaker: Cinfras

Heart of Llevigar#000.src: Gweh, a visitor?! Get out of here! The plant is shut down for maintenance- wait, are you the electromagic expert we're paying for?
Heart of Llevigar#000.dst: 으악, 손님?! 나가세요! 발전소는 점검 중이라 멈춰- 잠깐, 우리가 돈 주고 부른 전자기 마법 전문가세요?

Heart of Llevigar#001.src: We didn't even need to get Corkian consultation on this! We had this system all figured out ourselves, but now nothing's working right!
Heart of Llevigar#001.dst: Corkus 사람들한테 자문도 안 받았어요! 우리끼리 다 알아서 만든 시스템인데, 지금은 제대로 되는 게 없어요!

Heart of Llevigar#003.src: Come on now, hurry! There is an entrance to the power plant opposite the bank, go there and meet with the Head Engineer already!
Heart of Llevigar#003.dst: 자, 서둘러요! 은행 맞은편에 발전소 입구가 있으니 거기 가서 얼른 수석 기술자를 만나세요!

Heart of Llevigar#004.src: My grandfather and his engineers jury-rigged this whole system. A reset should fix all this, but as a security measure, I need to be here to oversee the reset.
Heart of Llevigar#004.dst: 우리 할아버지랑 기술자들이 이 시스템 전체를 임시변통으로 짰어. 초기화하면 다 고쳐질 텐데, 보안상 초기화할 때 내가 여기서 지켜봐야 해.

Heart of Llevigar#005.src: I have to stay put here, so get through the system and find the reset button for me. These holes in the walls are tunnels that'll lead you around the generator rooms!
Heart of Llevigar#005.dst: 난 여기 꼼짝 말고 있어야 하니, 네가 시스템을 통과해서 초기화 버튼을 찾아 줘. 벽에 난 이 구멍들은 발전기실을 돌아가는 통로야!

Heart of Llevigar#006.src: Maybe you can find a way to reset the system. That ought to do it...
Heart of Llevigar#006.dst: 시스템을 초기화할 방법을 찾을 수 있을지도 몰라. 그러면 될 거야...

Heart of Llevigar#007.src: ...what, are you asleep or something? Of course there was a bug, we just fixed it!
Heart of Llevigar#007.dst: ...뭐야, 잠이라도 덜 깼어? 당연히 버그가 있었지, 방금 고쳤잖아!

Heart of Llevigar#008.src: D'you really care about getting his name right, or what? Anyways, the exit's through the water cooling system back the way you got here, it hooks up to the sewer exit.
Heart of Llevigar#008.dst: 이름 제대로 부르는 게 그렇게 중요해? 아무튼 출구는 네가 온 길을 되짚어 수냉 시스템 쪽이야. 하수도 출구로 이어져.

Heart of Llevigar#009.src: Glad you got here when you did though! Some phony came through saying he was the expert. Clearly, he was just here to take your contract money...
Heart of Llevigar#009.dst: 그래도 딱 맞춰 와 주셔서 다행이에요! 어떤 사기꾼이 와서 자기가 전문가라고 하더라고요. 분명 당신 보수를 가로채려던 거죠...

Heart of Llevigar#010.src: Find Zenam in the {p} power control center at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Heart of Llevigar#011.src: Aaah, no no no! This doesn't make any sense, what in the world is going on?! Nothing's working!
Heart of Llevigar#011.dst: 으아아, 안 돼 안 돼! 말도 안 돼, 대체 무슨 일이야?! 아무것도 안 돌아가잖아!
Heart of Llevigar#011.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#012.src: Gweh, a visitor? Get out of here! The plant is shut down for maintenance- wait, are you the electromagic expert we're paying for?
Heart of Llevigar#012.dst: 으악, 손님? 나가세요! 발전소는 점검 중이라 멈춰- 잠깐, 우리가 돈 주고 부른 전자기 마법 전문가세요?
Heart of Llevigar#012.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#013.src: You are, right? Right?! Cause we can't wait any longer! This system was supposed to be unbreakable, a flawless design!
Heart of Llevigar#013.dst: 맞죠? 맞죠?! 더는 못 기다리거든요! 이 시스템은 절대 고장 안 나는 완벽한 설계였다고요!
Heart of Llevigar#013.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#014.src: We didn't even need to get Corkian consultation on this, we had this system all figured out ourselves, but now nothing's working right!
Heart of Llevigar#014.dst: Corkus 사람들한테 자문도 안 받고 우리끼리 다 알아서 만든 시스템인데, 지금은 제대로 되는 게 없어요!
Heart of Llevigar#014.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#015.src: You're seeing all these sparks and hearing all this crackling? We have no idea what could possibly be going wrong with this! That's why you're needed here!
Heart of Llevigar#015.dst: 이 불꽃이랑 지지직 소리 보이고 들리죠? 대체 뭐가 잘못됐는지 전혀 모르겠어요! 그래서 당신이 필요한 거예요!
Heart of Llevigar#015.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#016.src: We don't have much time until full meltdown! There is an entrance to the power plant opposite the bank, go there and meet with the Head Engineer!
Heart of Llevigar#016.dst: 완전히 녹아내리기까지 시간이 얼마 없어요! 은행 맞은편에 발전소 입구가 있으니 거기 가서 수석 기술자를 만나세요!
Heart of Llevigar#016.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#017.src: Enter the sewers opposite of the bank of {p}.

Heart of Llevigar#018.src: Find the head engineer at the {p} power plant

Heart of Llevigar#019.src: Whew, finally Zeman found a guy for the job. I told him weeks ago this was a two-person task...
Heart of Llevigar#019.dst: 휴, Zeman이 드디어 사람을 구했구먼. 이건 두 사람이 할 일이라고 몇 주 전에 말했는데...
Heart of Llevigar#019.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#020.src: Wait, it's Zenam? Eh, what does it matter? You knew who I was talkin' about. Lemme give you the lowdown real fast.
Heart of Llevigar#020.dst: 잠깐, Zenam이라고? 에, 뭐 어때? 누군지 알아들었잖아. 빠르게 상황을 설명해 주지.
Heart of Llevigar#020.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#021.src: About a month ago, there was a big blackout, and the generator here started acting up. Power surges, appliances overloading...heck, some of our lights turned purple!
Heart of Llevigar#021.dst: 한 달쯤 전에 대정전이 있었는데, 그 뒤로 여기 발전기가 말썽이야. 전력 급증에 가전 과부하... 젠장, 전등 몇 개는 보라색이 됐다니까!
Heart of Llevigar#021.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#022.src: My grandfather and his engineers jury-rigged the whole system. A reset should fix all this, but as a security measure, I need to be here to oversee the reset.
Heart of Llevigar#022.dst: 우리 할아버지랑 기술자들이 시스템 전체를 임시변통으로 짰어. 초기화하면 고쳐질 텐데, 보안상 내가 여기서 지켜봐야 해.
Heart of Llevigar#022.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#023.src: So that's your job- get through the system and find the reset button. These holes'll lead you around the generator rooms. Better get going!
Heart of Llevigar#023.dst: 그러니 네 일은 이거야- 시스템을 통과해서 초기화 버튼을 찾아. 이 구멍들이 발전기실을 돌아 안내해 줄 거야. 어서 가!
Heart of Llevigar#023.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#024.src: Try to find a way into the machine

Heart of Llevigar#025.src: Find a way to proceed to the inner parts of the machinery
Heart of Llevigar#025.dst: 기계 내부 깊숙이 나아갈 방법을 찾으세요

Heart of Llevigar#026.src: Reach the center of the restricted area

Heart of Llevigar#028.src: Report back to the Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#029.src: Alright, that should do it- Ah, you're back. The system reset just fine, like I said. Everything should be winding down now.
Heart of Llevigar#029.dst: 좋아, 이제 됐을- 아, 돌아왔군. 내 말대로 시스템이 잘 초기화됐어. 이제 다 잠잠해질 거야.
Heart of Llevigar#029.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#030.src: It's purging the excess energy now- might have a few more power surges and crackles for a while, but it'll go back to normal soon enough.
Heart of Llevigar#030.dst: 지금 남는 에너지를 빼내는 중이야- 한동안 전력 급증이랑 지지직 소리가 좀 더 나겠지만, 곧 정상으로 돌아올 거야.
Heart of Llevigar#030.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#031.src: Hm? What, there was a bug in the system? ...what, are you asleep or something? Of course there was a bug, we just fixed it!
Heart of Llevigar#031.dst: 응? 뭐, 시스템에 벌레가 있었다고? ...뭐야, 잠이라도 덜 깼어? 당연히 버그가 있었지, 방금 고쳤잖아!
Heart of Llevigar#031.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#032.src: Well, anyways, Zebra should have our payment all settled. You go on ahead- I still need to stay down here to make sure everything stays smooth.
Heart of Llevigar#032.dst: 뭐, 아무튼 Zebra가 보수를 다 정리해 뒀을 거야. 먼저 가 봐- 난 여기 남아서 다 잘 돌아가는지 봐야 하거든.
Heart of Llevigar#032.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#033.src: ...oh, it's Zenam? D'you really care about getting his name right, or what? Anyways, the exit's through the water cooling system, it hooks up to the sewer exit.
Heart of Llevigar#033.dst: ...아, Zenam이라고? 이름 제대로 부르는 게 그렇게 중요해? 아무튼 출구는 수냉 시스템 쪽이야. 하수도 출구로 이어져.
Heart of Llevigar#033.speaker: Head Engineer

Heart of Llevigar#035.src: Whew...welcome back. The power is back online- Everything is running at full capacity again. I think the system is just running excess through right now.
Heart of Llevigar#035.dst: 휴... 어서 오세요. 전력이 복구됐어요- 전부 다시 최대로 돌아가요. 지금은 시스템이 남는 전력을 흘려보내는 중인 것 같아요.
Heart of Llevigar#035.speaker: Zenam
