Heart of Llevigar#036.src: Glad you got here when you did though- some phony came through saying he was the expert. Clearly he was just here to take your contract money...
Heart of Llevigar#036.dst: 그래도 딱 맞춰 와 주셔서 다행이에요- 어떤 사기꾼이 와서 자기가 전문가라고 하더라고요. 분명 당신 보수를 가로채려던 거죠...
Heart of Llevigar#036.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#037.src: Though, I was panicking so much I probably would've believed him... Speaking of which, here's your cut of the pay, and something extra for the trouble.
Heart of Llevigar#037.dst: 사실 너무 당황해서 그 말을 믿었을지도 몰라요... 아무튼, 여기 당신 몫의 보수랑 수고비 조금 더 얹었어요.
Heart of Llevigar#037.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#038.src: Here's to hoping that the system won't run into any more trouble in the future. I don't want to be faced with an impending cataclysm like that again...
Heart of Llevigar#038.dst: 앞으로 시스템에 더는 문제가 없길 바라야죠. 그런 대재앙이 코앞에 닥치는 일은 다시 겪고 싶지 않아요...
Heart of Llevigar#038.speaker: Zenam

Heart of Llevigar#039.src: Aah, this is bad, where's the keys to my toolbox?! Zenam said it was important, I need to find them!
Heart of Llevigar#039.dst: 으아, 큰일이다, 내 공구함 열쇠 어디 갔지?! Zenam이 중요한 일이라고 했는데, 꼭 찾아야 해!
Heart of Llevigar#039.speaker: Electromagic Expert

Heart of Llevigar#040.src: I still can't believe it, a human has done my job and taken my emeralds... Just because I lost my keys...
Heart of Llevigar#040.dst: 아직도 못 믿겠어, 인간이 내 일을 하고 내 에메랄드를 가져가다니... 열쇠 좀 잃어버렸다고...
Heart of Llevigar#040.speaker: Electromagic Expert

Hollow Serenity#000.src: Something seems off in the abandoned manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Hollow Serenity#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 버려진 저택에서 뭔가 이상한 기운이 느껴집니다

Hollow Serenity#005.src: Head to the forest village east of the manor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and ask its residents about a man named Garvan.
Hollow Serenity#005.dst: 저택 동쪽 숲 마을 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가서 주민들에게 Garvan이라는 남자에 대해 물어보세요.

Hollow Serenity#006.src: Hello soldier! Welcome to this... hick village. I presume the neighbor's kid has been stealing apples again, hmm?
Hollow Serenity#006.dst: 안녕하세요, 병사님! 이... 시골 마을에 오신 걸 환영해요. 옆집 애가 또 사과를 훔쳤나 보죠?
Hollow Serenity#006.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#007.src: Oh, Ann... Your voice is so delicate, so soothing that- Ah, soldier! Are you here for something... or someone?
Hollow Serenity#007.dst: 오, Ann... 당신 목소리는 참 섬세하고 포근해서- 아, 병사님! 뭘... 아니면 누굴 찾으러 오셨나요?
Hollow Serenity#007.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#011.src: We're the best couple in the entire forest! Nobody can match our love!
Hollow Serenity#011.dst: 우린 이 숲 전체에서 제일가는 부부예요! 우리 사랑을 따라올 사람은 없죠!
Hollow Serenity#011.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#012.src: Do you have someone special to you like we are, human? A handsome little man? Or a pretty little woman? Or... neither? We won't judge.
Hollow Serenity#012.dst: 인간님도 우리처럼 소중한 사람이 있나요? 잘생긴 남자? 예쁜 여자? 아니면... 둘 다 아닌가요? 뭐라 안 할게요.
Hollow Serenity#012.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#013.src: Absolutely we're married! Everyone finds it very hard to believe, but I don't blame them! It's a tough would... we... live in, yes!
Hollow Serenity#013.dst: 당연히 결혼했죠! 다들 잘 안 믿지만 탓하진 않아요! 우리가 사는 건 험한 세... 상이... 니까요, 네!
Hollow Serenity#013.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#014.src: Four years it has been, since we kissed under the starry sky amidst the blossoming fields near {p}. I can still see it in my dreams...
Hollow Serenity#014.dst: {p} 근처 꽃 핀 들판, 별이 가득한 하늘 아래서 입맞춘 지 4년이 흘렀죠. 아직도 꿈에서 그날이 보여요...
Hollow Serenity#014.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#015.src: Yeah, what Qunit said! We've been married for {~} years! And soon that number is gonna go up to infinity!
Hollow Serenity#015.dst: 네, Qunit 말대로예요! 우린 결혼한 지 {~}년 됐어요! 그리고 곧 그 숫자는 무한대가 될 거예요!
Hollow Serenity#015.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#017.src: Oh! Sorry about Qunit, he doesn't like thinking about our... circumstances.
Hollow Serenity#017.dst: 아! Qunit은 신경 쓰지 마세요, 우리... 처지를 떠올리는 걸 싫어하거든요.
Hollow Serenity#017.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#018.src: We're in heavy debt to the government. We can't afford to live anywhere else.
Hollow Serenity#018.dst: 우린 정부에 빚이 많아요. 다른 데서 살 형편이 안 돼요.
Hollow Serenity#018.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#019.src: This forest is also safe from their prying eyes, which has inarguably caused certain... opinions to fester here...
Hollow Serenity#019.dst: 게다가 이 숲은 정부의 감시에서 벗어나 있어서, 확실히 어떤... 생각들이 여기서 곪아 가고 있죠...
Hollow Serenity#019.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#020.src: Yeah, yeah! It doesn't matter why we're here, soldier! Haha! We're here, and we love each other! That's all that matters. Yes.
Hollow Serenity#020.dst: 네, 네! 우리가 왜 여기 있는지는 중요하지 않아요, 병사님! 하하! 우린 여기 있고, 서로 사랑해요! 그게 전부죠. 네.
Hollow Serenity#020.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#021.src: Yes, actually. There's something dark to the north. There are parasites in it. It's dangerous.
Hollow Serenity#021.dst: 네, 사실 있어요. 북쪽에 어두운 무언가가 있어요. 안에 기생충이 있어요. 위험해요.
Hollow Serenity#021.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#022.src: O-oh! Don't worry about what Qunit's saying. He's been having this recurring dream of a big worm creature laying dark eggs inside of a weird cave. He won't let it go, either!
Hollow Serenity#022.dst: 어- 어머! Qunit 말은 신경 쓰지 마세요. 큰 벌레 괴물이 이상한 동굴 안에 검은 알을 낳는 꿈을 계속 꾼대요. 그걸 잊지도 못하고요!
Hollow Serenity#022.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#023.src: It's not a fantasy, Ann. I've told you this.
Hollow Serenity#023.speaker: Qunit

Hollow Serenity#024.src: Shh, honey... we'll talk about this later, not in front of the soldier... Who probably has much more important things to do, hah!
Hollow Serenity#024.dst: 쉿, 여보... 그 얘긴 나중에 해요, 병사님 앞에서 말고... 훨씬 중요한 일이 있으실 텐데, 하!
Hollow Serenity#024.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#027.src: See? We're both on the same wavelength! Neither of us have met this person! We're... so in love, darling...
Hollow Serenity#027.dst: 봤죠? 우린 마음이 딱 통해요! 둘 다 그 사람을 만난 적 없어요! 우린... 정말 사랑하죠, 자기...
Hollow Serenity#027.speaker: Ann

Hollow Serenity#029.src: An outsider? Here? We don't get many of you people often...
Hollow Serenity#029.dst: 외지인? 여기에? 너 같은 사람은 여기 잘 안 오는데...
Hollow Serenity#029.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#031.src: The name's Aunoa. I'm a farmer. Not much else to say.
Hollow Serenity#031.dst: 난 Aunoa야. 농부지. 더 할 말은 없어.
Hollow Serenity#031.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#032.src: I've got a kid, but he doesn't live here. His mother took him away to live in {p} a while back. Don't have any other family.
Hollow Serenity#032.dst: 애가 하나 있는데 여기 안 살아. 얼마 전에 애 엄마가 데리고 {p}(으)로 갔지. 다른 가족은 없어.
Hollow Serenity#032.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#033.src: This village is the only family I have.
Hollow Serenity#033.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#034.src: It's my home. The people I know and trust live here. It's a dump, but it's still my damn home.
Hollow Serenity#034.dst: 내 집이니까. 내가 알고 믿는 사람들이 여기 살아. 엉망인 곳이지만 그래도 내 빌어먹을 집이야.
Hollow Serenity#034.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#035.src: Wish I could leave, though. This forest is awful. The crops are in horrible condition. Government doesn't give a damn about us either.
Hollow Serenity#035.dst: 떠날 수 있으면 좋겠지만. 이 숲은 끔찍해. 작물 상태도 형편없고. 정부도 우리 따윈 신경도 안 써.
Hollow Serenity#035.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#036.src: Apparently the House of Talor has a massive crypt somewhere underneath its floors. Rich people used to be buried there.
Hollow Serenity#036.dst: House of Talor 바닥 아래 어딘가에 거대한 지하 묘실이 있대. 옛날에 부자들이 거기 묻혔다더군.
Hollow Serenity#036.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#037.src: There's probably some rare artifacts down there. Go take a look if you want, but everyone here has tried and failed to find it.
Hollow Serenity#037.dst: 아마 거기 희귀한 유물이 좀 있을 거야. 원하면 가 봐. 근데 여기 사람들 다 찾으려다 실패했어.
Hollow Serenity#037.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#038.src: Yes, I do. But I probably can't stop you. Humans like you have a thing for invading privacy whenever you feel like it.
Hollow Serenity#038.dst: 그래, 신경 쓰여. 하지만 막을 수도 없겠지. 너 같은 인간들은 내키면 남의 사생활을 멋대로 침범하니까.
Hollow Serenity#038.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#039.src: And I'm too weak to stop you. You've got all of that strong gear on you, and I barely know a lick of magic. We're not on equal footing.
Hollow Serenity#039.dst: 게다가 난 널 막을 힘도 없어. 넌 좋은 장비로 무장했고, 난 마법이라곤 쥐꼬리만큼 알아. 상대가 안 되지.
Hollow Serenity#039.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#040.src: So... don't go in, but I won't stop you if you do anyways.
Hollow Serenity#040.dst: 그러니까... 들어가지 마. 그래도 들어가겠다면 말리진 않을게.
Hollow Serenity#040.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#041.src: No clue who that is. If someone like that lived here, then they're dead.
Hollow Serenity#041.dst: 누군지 몰라. 그런 사람이 여기 살았다면 이미 죽었겠지.
Hollow Serenity#041.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#042.src: Ask someone else about him if you want; I don't really care about this Garvan guy you're looking for.
Hollow Serenity#042.dst: 궁금하면 다른 사람한테 물어봐. 네가 찾는 Garvan인지 뭔지 난 관심 없어.
Hollow Serenity#042.speaker: Aunoa

Hollow Serenity#043.src: Hey, you! Got any money? If you give me {~} Liquified Emeralds, I'll give you a spot of dust from the underside of my floorboards!
Hollow Serenity#043.dst: 야, 너! 돈 있어? 액체 에메랄드 {~}개 주면 우리 집 마룻바닥 밑 먼지 한 줌 줄게!
Hollow Serenity#043.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#046.src: I'm Bip! Yeah, Bip! The greatest guy to ever grace the entertainment industry!
Hollow Serenity#046.dst: 난 Bip이야! 그래, Bip! 연예계를 빛낸 최고의 사나이지!
Hollow Serenity#046.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#047.src: Oh... I was... Man, I miss my glory days! I used to be a big time man, you know? I was living it up in {p}, but now I have to live in this dump!
Hollow Serenity#047.dst: 아... 난 예전에... 아, 화려했던 시절이 그립다! 나 한때 거물이었거든? {p}에서 떵떵거리며 살았는데 이제 이런 촌구석에 살아야 해!
Hollow Serenity#047.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#048.src: Damn this world! I blame them for all of this! Everything has been nothing but trouble after trouble. Now everyone can't see how much of an honest guy I am!
Hollow Serenity#048.dst: 빌어먹을 세상! 다 그놈들 탓이야! 사고에 사고만 이어졌지. 이젠 아무도 내가 얼마나 정직한 사람인지 몰라줘!
Hollow Serenity#048.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#049.src: B-BE QUIET! I don't like living here, so don't remind me!
Hollow Serenity#049.dst: 조-조용히 해! 여기 사는 거 싫으니까 상기시키지 마!
Hollow Serenity#049.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#050.src: I don't even truly have my own place! I've gotta live with some crony who owns the house I'm staying in right now.
Hollow Serenity#050.dst: 제대로 된 내 집도 없어! 지금 사는 집 주인인 웬 녀석이랑 같이 살아야 한다고.
Hollow Serenity#050.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#051.src: One day, I'll get out of here, though! I'll be a big time man again, and I'll reclaim my status in society, just you wait!
Hollow Serenity#051.dst: 그래도 언젠가 여길 벗어날 거야! 다시 거물이 돼서 사회적 지위를 되찾을 거라고, 두고 봐!
Hollow Serenity#051.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#052.src: Rumors? Do I look like a gossiper to you??
Hollow Serenity#052.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#053.src: Well, human... I'm an honest entertainer, so don't worry. Good 'ole Bip will tell you a bit of something!
Hollow Serenity#053.dst: 뭐, 인간... 난 정직한 연예인이니 걱정 마. 착한 Bip이 뭐 좀 알려 주지!
Hollow Serenity#053.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#054.src: So, apparently there's a WITCH... living in LEXDALE! OOOOOO, spooky...
Hollow Serenity#054.dst: 그러니까, LEXDALE에... 마녀가 산대! 우우우우, 무섭지...
Hollow Serenity#054.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#055.src: But the thing is, she's causing... the Decay... dun dun DUUUN!!! Uhh... I don't know, her house is decaying, or something.
Hollow Serenity#055.dst: 근데 문제는, 그 마녀가... 쇠락을 일으킨대... 두둥 두둥 두두둥!!! 어... 몰라, 집이 쇠락하는 중이라던가.
Hollow Serenity#055.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#056.src: So now, she's gonna die. The end! Didja like that story, human? Every relation to in-real life people was {~} intentional, 'cuz this is actually happening.
Hollow Serenity#056.dst: 그래서 이제 그 마녀는 죽을 거야. 끝! 이야기 어땠어, 인간? 실존 인물과의 유사성은 {~} 의도한 거야, 진짜로 일어나는 일이니까.
Hollow Serenity#056.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#057.src: Oh yeah! That's the name of the guy who FIRED ME! DAMMIT!!!-
Hollow Serenity#057.dst: 아 그럼! 그게 날 해고한 놈 이름이야! 젠장!!!-
Hollow Serenity#057.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#058.src: ...Oh, wait, no. Sorry human, I was thinking about Gavin. I don't know who this Garvan guy is! Ask someone else; I can't entertain you with that knowledge.
Hollow Serenity#058.dst: ...아, 잠깐, 아니다. 미안, 인간, Gavin 생각했어. Garvan은 누군지 몰라! 딴 사람한테 물어봐. 그 얘기론 널 즐겁게 못 해 주겠어.
Hollow Serenity#058.speaker: Bip

Hollow Serenity#066.src: {p} apparently has something hidden inside of it.
Hollow Serenity#066.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#067.src: The chains have something to do with it.
Hollow Serenity#067.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#068.src: I dunno what else to say.
Hollow Serenity#068.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#069.src: ...You know what? Neither do you! You've said, like, {~} sentences in the last {~} minutes!
Hollow Serenity#069.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#070.src: I just don't like talking, sheesh! My voice gets way more tense if I don't keep my words short. And it hurts.
Hollow Serenity#070.dst: 난 말하는 게 싫을 뿐이야, 참 나! 말을 짧게 안 하면 목소리가 훨씬 긴장돼. 그리고 아파.
Hollow Serenity#070.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#071.src: What, are you offended? Well, I am, too! You'd be mad if some random human walked into your village and egged you into damaging your vocal chords!
Hollow Serenity#071.dst: 뭐, 기분 상했어? 나도 그래! 웬 인간이 네 마을에 쳐들어와서 성대 상하게 말 시키면 너도 화날걸!
Hollow Serenity#071.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#073.src: ...You poor soul. Go buy one. Unless you're one of those guys who owns those flying land bits.
Hollow Serenity#073.dst: ...불쌍하긴. 하나 사. 저 떠다니는 땅 쪼가리 가진 녀석들 중 하나가 아니라면.
Hollow Serenity#073.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#075.src: He knows most of the things here.
Hollow Serenity#075.speaker: Runo

Hollow Serenity#076.src: Huh, weird. Whatcha doing all the way out here, human? We don't see a lot of your kind often.
Hollow Serenity#076.dst: 어라, 이상하네. 이런 데까지 뭐 하러 왔어, 인간? 너희 같은 사람은 잘 안 보이는데.
Hollow Serenity#076.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#078.src: My name's Vera. I'm a farmer, but you probably already guessed that. That's all this damn village is good for anyways.
Hollow Serenity#078.dst: 난 Vera. 농부야, 뭐 이미 짐작했겠지만. 이 빌어먹을 마을은 어차피 그거밖에 쓸모가 없거든.
Hollow Serenity#078.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#079.src: I also deal with getting supplies from other towns! Pretty cool, huh?
Hollow Serenity#079.dst: 다른 마을에서 물자 받아 오는 일도 해! 꽤 멋지지?
Hollow Serenity#079.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#080.src: Uhh... all my life, actually! Too damn poor to go anywhere else, so I've just hunkered down here and decided to stick it out until I'm dead.
Hollow Serenity#080.dst: 어... 사실 평생! 너무 가난해서 딴 데 갈 수가 없어서, 그냥 여기 눌러앉아 죽을 때까지 버티기로 했지.
Hollow Serenity#080.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#081.src: It's bad, living out here, but once you get used to it some of the edge is taken off. This village is all I've really known, and I owe it to everyone here to stick around, you know what I mean?
Hollow Serenity#081.dst: 여기 사는 건 힘들지만 익숙해지면 좀 무뎌져. 내가 아는 곳은 이 마을뿐이고, 여기 사람들을 봐서라도 남아야 해. 무슨 말인지 알지?
Hollow Serenity#081.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#082.src: Still... adventuring sounds like fun, sometimes... The furthest I've ever gone from here is halfway through {p} County.
Hollow Serenity#082.dst: 그래도... 가끔은 모험이 재밌을 것 같아... 내가 가 본 제일 먼 곳이 {p} County 중간쯤이야.
Hollow Serenity#082.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#083.src: I bet you have some pretty good stories to tell from adventuring, ain't that right human?
Hollow Serenity#083.dst: 넌 모험하면서 꽤 멋진 이야깃거리가 많겠지, 안 그래, 인간?
Hollow Serenity#083.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#084.src: You know the massive prison near {p}? Yeah, the {p} Penitentiary.
Hollow Serenity#084.dst: {p} 근처 거대한 감옥 알아? 그래, {p} 교도소.
Hollow Serenity#084.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#085.src: So, apparently... the place is actually really corrupt. They arrest innocent people every other day, and they never come back out.
Hollow Serenity#085.dst: 근데 말이야... 그곳이 사실 엄청 부패했대. 툭하면 무고한 사람을 잡아가는데, 다시는 안 나온대.
Hollow Serenity#085.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#086.src: Gavel's government hasn't done anything about it, but everyone in the forest knows damn well something shady is going on there. I'd watch myself around that place if I were you!
Hollow Serenity#086.dst: Gavel 정부는 아무것도 안 했지만, 숲 사람들은 거기서 수상한 일이 벌어지는 걸 다 알아. 나라면 그 근처에선 조심할 거야!
Hollow Serenity#086.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#088.src: Get to talking, human! You can't just leave off like that! Tell me, are the rumors about that place true?
Hollow Serenity#088.dst: 얘기 좀 해 봐, 인간! 그렇게 말 끊으면 안 되지! 말해 줘, 그곳 소문이 사실이야?
Hollow Serenity#088.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#091.src: Oh my word... and you saw it with your own eyes?
Hollow Serenity#091.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#092.src: Human... thanks for letting me know. You gotta tell more people about this, though! You could probably publish a book about it once you spread the word! You'd be rich!
Hollow Serenity#092.dst: 인간... 알려 줘서 고마워. 근데 더 많은 사람한테 알려야 해! 소문이 퍼지면 책도 낼 수 있을걸! 부자 되겠다!
Hollow Serenity#092.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#093.src: ...Well, I'm not gonna believe you if you're saying it all forced like that, you know.
Hollow Serenity#093.dst: ...음, 그렇게 억지로 말하면 안 믿을 거야.
Hollow Serenity#093.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#094.src: I won't push it, though; it was probably just too awful to talk about, right? You don't have to go into detail if you don't wanna.
Hollow Serenity#094.dst: 그래도 캐묻진 않을게. 너무 끔찍해서 말하기 힘든 거지? 싫으면 자세히 얘기 안 해도 돼.
Hollow Serenity#094.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#095.src: Just stay well away from that place, and make sure nobody else goes near there, alright?
Hollow Serenity#095.dst: 그냥 그곳엔 절대 가까이 가지 말고, 다른 사람도 못 가게 해, 알았지?
Hollow Serenity#095.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#096.src: Uh... no. That doesn't ring a single bell.
Hollow Serenity#096.dst: 어... 아니. 전혀 짚이는 데가 없어.
Hollow Serenity#096.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#097.src: You could probably ask some other people, though! I'm only the youngest guy in the village, so the older people here would probably know who this Garvan guy is!
Hollow Serenity#097.dst: 그래도 다른 사람들한테 물어봐! 난 마을에서 제일 어리니까, 나이 든 사람들은 Garvan이 누군지 알 거야!
Hollow Serenity#097.speaker: Vera

Hollow Serenity#098.src: S-Sheesh! You scared me, human! Don't you know that you shouldn't walk into people's houses out of nowhere?
Hollow Serenity#098.dst: 깜, 깜짝이야! 놀랐잖아, 인간! 남의 집에 불쑥 들어오면 안 되는 거 몰라?
Hollow Serenity#098.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#099.src: You know there are creepy guys out here who rob people like that? You should be more careful!
Hollow Serenity#099.dst: 밖에 그런 식으로 사람 털어 가는 수상한 놈들 있는 거 알지? 좀 더 조심해!
Hollow Serenity#099.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#101.src: I'm nobody. No, I'm serious, I literally don't have a name. Parents just didn't bother to name me.
Hollow Serenity#101.dst: 난 아무도 아니야. 아니, 진짜로. 이름이 아예 없어. 부모님이 이름 붙이는 걸 귀찮아했거든.
Hollow Serenity#101.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#102.src: Apparently that's considered sacrilegious around here, so I was taken away from them and I now work for Pastor Arwes.
Hollow Serenity#102.dst: 여기선 그게 신성 모독이라나 봐. 그래서 부모님한테서 떼어져서 지금은 목사 Arwes 밑에서 일해.
Hollow Serenity#102.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#103.src: What do the others call me? Uhh... Big-nosed girl. Yeah, I know, a bit on the nose–
Hollow Serenity#103.dst: 다른 사람들이 날 뭐라고 부르냐고? 어... 코쟁이. 그래, 알아, 코 얘기라니 너무 대놓고–
Hollow Serenity#103.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#104.src: ...That sailed right over my head. But it's true, though! I have the biggest nose in the village.
Hollow Serenity#104.dst: ...무슨 말인지 하나도 모르겠네. 그래도 사실이야! 마을에서 내 코가 제일 크거든.
Hollow Serenity#104.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#105.src: What should you call me? Hm... I don't know... maybe... Eua?
Hollow Serenity#105.dst: 뭐라고 부르면 되냐고? 음... 글쎄... 어쩌면... Eua?
Hollow Serenity#105.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#106.src: I know it won't matter anymore, but sure. Call me Eua. That sounds like a nice name.
Hollow Serenity#106.dst: 이제 와서 상관없겠지만, 좋아. Eua라고 불러. 괜찮은 이름 같아.
Hollow Serenity#106.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#107.src: This one's not necessarily a rumor, but... have you ever heard of someone that they call the Wanderer?
Hollow Serenity#107.dst: 소문이라고 하긴 좀 그렇지만... 방랑자라고 불리는 사람 들어 봤어?
Hollow Serenity#107.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#108.src: He's a weird guy who just... wanders. He's completely despondent, and doesn't really interact with anyone. Even a lot of the dangerous creatures around here just tend to ignore his presence. He's almost like... a ghost.
Hollow Serenity#108.dst: 그냥... 떠돌아다니는 이상한 남자야. 완전히 넋이 나가서 아무하고도 어울리지 않아. 이 근처 위험한 생물들도 대부분 그를 무시해. 거의... 유령 같지.
Hollow Serenity#108.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#109.src: You've probably seen him before in the forest. Hooded guy, doesn't talk at all? That's who they call the Wanderer.
Hollow Serenity#109.dst: 숲에서 본 적 있을 거야. 두건 쓰고 말 한마디 안 하는 남자? 그게 바로 방랑자야.
Hollow Serenity#109.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#110.src: Well, he doesn't really hurt anyone, so I don't really worry about him too much, but still... it's spooky...
Hollow Serenity#110.dst: 뭐, 딱히 누굴 해치진 않으니 크게 걱정은 안 하는데, 그래도... 으스스해...
Hollow Serenity#110.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#111.src: Wait, THAT manor? Nah. No one goes near there anymore, not since it was abandoned. What, do you not know what happened there?
Hollow Serenity#111.dst: 잠깐, '그' 저택? 아니. 버려진 뒤로는 아무도 근처에 안 가. 뭐야, 거기서 무슨 일 있었는지 몰라?
Hollow Serenity#111.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#112.src: It used to be owned by a family of nobles called the Faltachs. Big, important people in the forest, very rich.
Hollow Serenity#112.dst: 원래 Faltach라는 귀족 가문 소유였어. 숲에서 꽤 대단한 사람들이었지, 엄청 부자였고.
Hollow Serenity#112.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#113.src: Well... a lot of stuff happened with them. The mistress of the family supposedly went insane and killed her husband at some point, or something like that...
Hollow Serenity#113.dst: 음... 그 집안엔 일이 많았어. 안주인이 미쳐서 언젠가 남편을 죽였다던가, 뭐 그런 얘기가 있어...
Hollow Serenity#113.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#114.src: There's a lot to unpack there, human. And you honestly shouldn't unpack it.
Hollow Serenity#114.dst: 파헤칠 게 한둘이 아니야, 인간. 솔직히 파헤치지 않는 게 좋아.
Hollow Serenity#114.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#115.src: Hmm... No, can't say I have. Whoever this person is, they certainly don't live here.
Hollow Serenity#115.dst: 음... 아니, 모르겠어. 누군진 몰라도 여기 사는 사람은 확실히 아니야.
Hollow Serenity#115.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#116.src: And nah, it's not me, either, even if I don't have a real name. I wouldn't even be here if my parents had named me something manly like Garvan anyways.
Hollow Serenity#116.dst: 그리고 아니, 나도 아니야. 진짜 이름이 없긴 하지만. 부모님이 Garvan 같은 남자다운 이름을 지어 줬으면 난 여기 없었겠지.
Hollow Serenity#116.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#117.src: Ask around, though! I'm sure others probably know him.
Hollow Serenity#117.dst: 그래도 여기저기 물어봐! 분명 아는 사람이 있을 거야.
Hollow Serenity#117.speaker: Villager

Hollow Serenity#118.src: You're new... we don't see a lot of youngsters around these days... especially humans.
Hollow Serenity#118.dst: 처음 보는 얼굴이군... 요즘은 젊은이를 보기 힘들지... 특히 인간은.
Hollow Serenity#118.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#120.src: Very on the nose, whippersnapper. My name is Lokno. I'm what's left of this town during its olden days...
Hollow Serenity#120.dst: 아주 대놓고 묻는구먼, 풋내기. 내 이름은 Lokno. 옛 시절 이 마을의 마지막 남은 사람이지...
Hollow Serenity#120.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#121.src: Mhm. This village... has definitely seen better days. This Decay stuff has ruined us, just take a look around! Nothing here has been suitable for living for over {~} years...
Hollow Serenity#121.dst: 음. 이 마을은... 확실히 좋은 시절이 있었지. 이 쇠락이란 게 우릴 망쳐 놨어, 둘러봐! {~}년 넘게 사람 살 만한 곳이 하나도 없었지...
Hollow Serenity#121.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#122.src: Hah... well, right now, it's a crowd of shacks, but before the Decay came along, we used to do great...
Hollow Serenity#122.dst: 하... 지금은 판잣집 무더기지만, 쇠락이 오기 전엔 아주 잘 지냈다네...
Hollow Serenity#122.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#123.src: We always had enough food to go around, we could sell off what we didn't need to eat, and everything was thriving.
Hollow Serenity#123.dst: 먹을 건 늘 넉넉했고, 남는 건 내다 팔았지. 모든 게 번창했어.
Hollow Serenity#123.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#124.src: My great-grandmother, Aki, always told me stories about this place. Our little village. I wish I could have been around to live in it then.
Hollow Serenity#124.dst: 증조할머니 Aki께서 늘 이곳 이야기를 해 주셨지. 우리 작은 마을 말일세. 그 시절에 살아 봤으면 좋았을 텐데.
Hollow Serenity#124.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#125.src: She was always convinced though... that if the rightful rulers of Gavel returned, all of these issues could easily be squashed.
Hollow Serenity#125.dst: 그래도 할머니는 늘 확신하셨지... Gavel의 정당한 통치자가 돌아오면 이 모든 문제가 쉽게 해결될 거라고.
Hollow Serenity#125.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#126.src: To be honest... I believe the same. The government has abandoned us. So... why not bring back the old one?
Hollow Serenity#126.dst: 솔직히... 나도 그렇게 믿네. 정부는 우릴 버렸어. 그러니... 옛 통치자를 되돌리면 안 될 이유가 있나?
Hollow Serenity#126.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#127.src: I may not be the most religious villager around here, but it would feel more right to be ruled by someone who has the heavens' approval.
Hollow Serenity#127.dst: 내가 이 근처에서 가장 신앙심 깊은 주민은 아니지만, 하늘의 인정을 받은 자가 다스리는 게 더 옳다고 느껴지네.
Hollow Serenity#127.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#128.src: Nope. I don't deal with that kind of stuff, bahaha! Sorry human; you're out of luck.
Hollow Serenity#128.dst: 아니. 난 그런 건 안 해, 하하하! 미안하네, 인간. 운이 없구먼.
Hollow Serenity#128.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#129.src: G... Garvan... yes. I know that name.
Hollow Serenity#129.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#130.src: He isn't here, though. I don't know his whereabouts, what he's doing, or if he's even alive. He's... just nonexistant.
Hollow Serenity#130.dst: 하지만 여기엔 없네. 어디 있는지, 뭘 하는지, 살아는 있는지도 몰라. 그는... 그냥 없는 사람이야.
Hollow Serenity#130.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#131.src: I don't know why you're chasing after him, but... if you want a place to start, look at the abandoned laboratory on top of that hill, just west to the of here.
Hollow Serenity#131.dst: 왜 그를 쫓는지는 모르겠지만... 시작할 곳을 원한다면 여기서 바로 서쪽, 언덕 위의 버려진 실험실을 살펴보게.
Hollow Serenity#131.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#132.src: Fair warning, though... My great-grandmother is the only reason I know about him, and even then... she was always put off by him, and told me to stay away from him. I'd be wary, if I were you.
Hollow Serenity#132.dst: 그래도 경고하지... 내가 그를 아는 건 증조할머니 덕분인데, 할머니조차... 늘 그를 꺼리셨고 가까이하지 말라 하셨네. 나라면 조심하겠어.
Hollow Serenity#132.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#133.src: Or don't. He sounds like a nice man. You're strong, as well. I'm sure you'll be fine.
Hollow Serenity#133.dst: 아니면 말고. 좋은 사람 같기도 하니까. 자네도 강하고. 괜찮을 걸세.
Hollow Serenity#133.speaker: Old Man

Hollow Serenity#134.src: Investigate the contents of the abandoned laboratory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Hollow Serenity#136.src: Return to the Faltach Manor and find the entrance to the secret study at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#136.dst: Faltach 저택으로 돌아가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 비밀 서재 입구를 찾으세요.

Hollow Serenity#137.src: Uncover the secrets of the study.

Hollow Serenity#138.src: Investigate the unlocked room in the study.

Hollow Serenity#140.src: Dammit, Katarin! I'm not dealing with that loonie anymore! It's been years since I hired that scientist, and he STILL has nothing! If he doesn't find a cure soon, then I'll just get rid of him!
Hollow Serenity#140.dst: 젠장, Katarin! 그 미치광이는 더 이상 못 봐주겠소! 그 과학자를 고용한 지 몇 년인데 아직도 성과가 없어! 곧 치료제를 못 찾으면 없애 버리겠소!
Hollow Serenity#140.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#141.src: Y-Yorman, you can't be serious! What we're asking him to do is heavily unresearched, firing him for taking time on that wouldn't be a good idea!
Hollow Serenity#141.dst: Y-Yorman, 설마 진심은 아니죠! 우리가 맡긴 건 거의 연구된 적 없는 일이에요. 오래 걸린다고 내쫓는 건 좋지 않아요!
Hollow Serenity#141.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#142.src: Woman, have you SEEN the state that cretin is in?? Even if it does take long, he's in no damn shape to deal with it! Now, stop arguing with me, and help me get rid of him-
Hollow Serenity#142.dst: 부인, 그 얼간이 꼴을 봤소?? 오래 걸리는 건 그렇다 쳐도 그 상태론 감당도 못 해! 이제 그만 따지고 그놈 치우는 걸 도우시오-
Hollow Serenity#142.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#144.src: This is too far, Yorman! Garvan MUST stay! You will do this if you still love me!
Hollow Serenity#144.dst: 너무하잖아요, Yorman! Garvan은 반드시 남아야 해요! 아직 날 사랑한다면 그렇게 해요!
Hollow Serenity#144.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#145.src: ...Why do you even care so much?? Some lunatic scientist like him isn't good for anybody! We both know that we'd save more time and money by letting him run off!
Hollow Serenity#145.dst: ...대체 왜 그렇게까지 신경 쓰는 거요?? 그런 미친 과학자는 누구에게도 득이 안 돼! 내보내는 게 시간도 돈도 아낀다는 거 둘 다 알잖소!
Hollow Serenity#145.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#146.src: I still have faith in him, unlike you! I'll talk to him to see what's going on if I must, but I will NOT tolerate you throwing him out simply because you're too eager for results!
Hollow Serenity#146.dst: 당신과 달리 난 아직 그를 믿어요! 필요하면 내가 직접 얘기해 볼게요. 하지만 성과에 급급해서 그를 내쫓는 건 절대 용납 못 해요!
Hollow Serenity#146.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#147.src: Fine. But know this; I will see it to MYSELF that his head is taken off of his shoulders if that man continues to waste my time, understand??
Hollow Serenity#147.dst: 좋소. 하지만 명심하시오. 그자가 계속 내 시간을 낭비하면, 그 목이 어깨에서 떨어지는 걸 내가 직접 보고 말 거요, 알겠소??
Hollow Serenity#147.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#148.src: ...I'm leaving to take care of some matters in {p}. Ask one of the maids to make sure that Eileen goes to bed. I'll be back before midnight.
Hollow Serenity#148.dst: ...{p}에 볼일이 있어 나가 보겠소. 하녀에게 Eileen이 잠자리에 드는지 확인하라고 하시오. 자정 전엔 돌아오겠소.
Hollow Serenity#148.speaker: Yorman

Hollow Serenity#149.src: ...That... was close... I can't have him getting between us anymore.
Hollow Serenity#149.dst: ...방금... 아슬아슬했어... 더는 그이가 우리 사이를 막게 둘 수 없어.
Hollow Serenity#149.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#150.src: I-I am here, Katarin. You wished to s- speak with me...?
Hollow Serenity#150.dst: 와, 왔습니다, Katarin. 저와 이, 이야기하고 싶으셨다고요...?
Hollow Serenity#150.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#151.src: Yes, love. Yorman is becoming suspicious of you. He thinks you're not making any progress on the cure and wasting his time. Any more of this, and he may attempt to get rid of you.
Hollow Serenity#151.dst: 네, 여보. Yorman이 당신을 의심하기 시작했어요. 치료제에 진척도 없이 자기 시간만 낭비한다고 생각해요. 이대로면 당신을 없애려 할지도 몰라요.
Hollow Serenity#151.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#152.src: I just wanted to check on you, love. Are... you doing alright? Is your work coming along well?
Hollow Serenity#152.dst: 그냥 당신이 어떤지 보고 싶었어요, 여보. 괜찮...아요? 연구는 잘되고 있어요?
Hollow Serenity#152.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#165.src: F-Fine. I am fine. I appreciate the concern, but... It truly is u-unwarranted. I'm q-quite close to finding a cure to the disease, y-yes.
Hollow Serenity#165.dst: 괘, 괜찮습니다. 괜찮아요. 걱정은 고맙지만... 정말 부, 불필요합니다. 병의 치료제를 거, 거의 찾았어요, 네.
Hollow Serenity#165.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#166.src: Ah! That is good to hear. Now then... How are things? We haven't had many chances to catch up recently.
Hollow Serenity#166.dst: 아! 다행이네요. 그럼... 요즘 어때요? 최근엔 이야기 나눌 기회가 별로 없었잖아요.
Hollow Serenity#166.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#167.src: ...Wonderful. I've met... many peers. Recently. They give me the strength I need to advance my progress. Now... how is our daughter, Eileen?
Hollow Serenity#167.dst: ...아주 좋습니다. 최근에... 동료들을 많이 만났어요. 연구를 진척시킬 힘을 주더군요. 그럼... 우리 딸 Eileen은 어떻습니까?
Hollow Serenity#167.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#168.src: She's doing great. She takes a lot after you, actually. Intelligent, beautiful, an inquisitive mind. I just hope this Decay can be dealt with and we don't need to live in fear any longer.
Hollow Serenity#168.dst: 아주 잘 지내요. 당신을 많이 닮았어요. 똑똑하고, 예쁘고, 호기심도 많고. 이 쇠락만 해결돼서 더는 두려움 속에 살지 않았으면 좋겠어요.
Hollow Serenity#168.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#169.src: Wonderful. And... is our eternal bond safe? The gemstone? Has... Yorman found out about it?
Hollow Serenity#169.dst: 다행입니다. 그리고... 우리의 영원한 인연은 안전합니까? 그 보석 말입니다. Yorman이... 알아챘나요?
Hollow Serenity#169.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#170.src: Yes, it has stayed hidden. As long as it's kept intact, our souls will stay bound to it. You just need to take care of your little project and we'll ride into the sunset, just like you said, mhm?
Hollow Serenity#170.dst: 네, 잘 숨겨져 있어요. 그게 온전한 한 우리 영혼은 거기 묶여 있을 거예요. 당신은 그 작은 연구만 마무리해요. 그럼 당신 말대로 함께 석양 속으로 떠나는 거예요, 응?
Hollow Serenity#170.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#172.src: We... I will not risk her life for our love. She has a future in {p}, Garvan! She isn't a part of this, and I don't think she-
Hollow Serenity#172.dst: 우리... 난 우리 사랑 때문에 그 애 목숨을 걸진 않을 거예요. 그 애는 {p}에서 미래가 있어요, Garvan! 이 일과는 상관없고, 그 애가-
Hollow Serenity#172.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#173.src: Eileen... She is a shining star in this world. Her noble blood and natural talent makes her something truly special.
Hollow Serenity#173.dst: Eileen... 그 아이는 이 세상에서 빛나는 별입니다. 고귀한 혈통과 타고난 재능이 그 아이를 특별하게 만들지요.
Hollow Serenity#173.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#174.src: Do you realize, Katarin? Our daughter is a gift from the heavens! Once she has matured, she will accomplish things that Gavel has never seen! Bring back the holy and royal that was lost-
Hollow Serenity#174.dst: 알겠습니까, Katarin? 우리 딸은 하늘이 내린 선물입니다! 자라면 Gavel이 본 적 없는 일을 해낼 겁니다! 잃어버린 신성과 왕가를 되찾고-
Hollow Serenity#174.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#175.src: ...Forgive me, I-I'm rambling once more. I... must leave now, research calls. Goodbye, my love. Great things will happen, sooner or later.
Hollow Serenity#175.dst: ...용서하세요, 제, 제가 또 횡설수설하는군요. 전... 이제 가야 합니다, 연구가 부르네요. 안녕, 내 사랑. 머지않아 위대한 일이 일어날 겁니다.
Hollow Serenity#175.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#177.src: Make your way to Garvan's old research outpost at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#177.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 Garvan의 옛 연구 전초기지로 가세요.

Hollow Serenity#178.src: Gather as much pieces of evidence as you can in the research outpost.
Hollow Serenity#178.dst: 연구 전초기지에서 최대한 많은 증거를 모으세요.

Hollow Serenity#180.src: Ah... N-now you're finally here. I... need you, my darling. We- no... I can cure this Decay with you.
Hollow Serenity#180.dst: 아... 드, 드디어 왔구나. 난... 네가 필요하단다, 얘야. 우리- 아니... 너와 함께라면 이 쇠락을 치료할 수 있어.
Hollow Serenity#180.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#181.src: W-What do you mean...? I-I don't like this... I-I w-wanna go home. It's getting late and mother-
Hollow Serenity#181.dst: 무, 무슨 말이에요...? 이, 이거 싫어요... 지, 집에 가, 갈래요. 늦었고 엄마가-
Hollow Serenity#181.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#182.src: Ssshhh... This will only take a moment.
Hollow Serenity#182.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#183.src: W-What is that thing?? M-Mister Garvan, I-I don't understand...
Hollow Serenity#183.dst: 저, 저게 뭐예요?? G, Garvan 아저씨, 모, 모르겠어요...
Hollow Serenity#183.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#184.src: Hush, my daughter. I-I'm doing this for your s-sake... You'll t-thank me later, once it... g-grows acclimated to you.
Hollow Serenity#184.dst: 쉿, 내 딸아. 이, 이건 다 너를 위, 위해서란다... 그것이... 네게 저, 적응하고 나면 나중에 고마워할 거야.
Hollow Serenity#184.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#186.src: Hello, my love. I-It's... been a while.
Hollow Serenity#186.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#187.src: You... G-Garvan... Why are you here? And what's happened to Eileen? She has been sick for days!
Hollow Serenity#187.dst: 당신... G-Garvan... 여긴 왜 왔어요? 그리고 Eileen은 어떻게 된 거죠? 며칠째 아프다고요!
Hollow Serenity#187.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#188.src: Mmmm... I... Ha-a-have a bit of a... how should I phrase this... a confession to make.
Hollow Serenity#188.dst: 음... 저... 할, 할 말이 좀... 뭐라고 해야 할지... 고백할 게 있습니다.
Hollow Serenity#188.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#189.src: W-Well... I-I've done... I've...done Eileen a great service... she will live forever, just like we do. Thanks to what I have done.
Hollow Serenity#189.dst: 그, 그러니까... 제, 제가... Eileen에게... 큰 은혜를 베풀었어요... 그 애는 우리처럼 영원히 살 겁니다. 제가 한 일 덕분에요.
Hollow Serenity#189.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#190.src: Y-you... Bound her soul?? Garvan, no, I told you she wasn't part of this!! WHY??
Hollow Serenity#190.dst: 다, 당신... 그 애 영혼을 묶었어요?? Garvan, 안 돼, 그 애는 상관없다고 했잖아요!! 왜??
Hollow Serenity#190.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#191.src: No, no no no no. I've done much b-b-better. She has something now. In her brain... Don't worry about the s-sorry state she's in now. The parasite will need time to acclimate to her flesh.
Hollow Serenity#191.dst: 아뇨, 아뇨 아뇨 아뇨. 훨, 훨씬 나은 걸 했어요. 그 애 안에 이제 뭔가 있어요. 뇌 속에... 지금 딱, 딱한 상태는 걱정 마세요. 기생체가 그 애 몸에 적응할 시간이 필요할 뿐이에요.
Hollow Serenity#191.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#192.src: I-I realized... a cure. My work is done, love... Eileen will be cured. The Decay can be s-stopped. It's wonderful-
Hollow Serenity#192.dst: 제, 제가 깨달았어요... 치료제를. 제 일은 끝났어요, 여보... Eileen은 나을 거예요. 쇠락도 멈, 멈출 수 있어요. 멋지죠-
Hollow Serenity#192.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#193.src: WHAT DID YOU DO TO MY DAUGHTER?? WHAT IS WRONG WITH YOU??
Hollow Serenity#193.dst: 내 딸한테 무슨 짓을 한 거야?? 당신 대체 왜 그래??
Hollow Serenity#193.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#194.src: Aaaahhhmmmm... True... I might have stepped out of line. But it's for the best.
Hollow Serenity#194.dst: 으으음... 그렇군요... 선을 넘었을지도 모르겠네요. 하지만 이게 최선입니다.
Hollow Serenity#194.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#195.src: OUT OF LINE?? This is too far, Garvan! What even happened to you?? You've been acting like this for so, so long! I-I can't take it anymore!
Hollow Serenity#195.dst: 선을 넘어?? 이건 너무하잖아요, Garvan! 대체 무슨 일이 있었던 거예요?? 이렇게 군 지 정말, 정말 오래됐어요! 더, 더는 못 참아요!
Hollow Serenity#195.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#196.src: You've changed, Garvan! I-I can't even recognize you anymore!! I'm... I'm DONE! GET OUT! STAY AWAY FROM MY FAMILY!
Hollow Serenity#196.dst: 당신 변했어요, Garvan! 이, 이젠 알아보지도 못하겠어요!! 난... 난 끝이에요! 나가요! 내 가족한테서 떨어져요!
Hollow Serenity#196.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#197.src: You again... W-What do you want from me this time...? You've... already ruined me.
Hollow Serenity#197.dst: 또 당신들이군... 이, 이번엔 또 뭘 원하는 거지...? 이미... 날 망쳐 놨잖아.
Hollow Serenity#197.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#198.src: It doesn't matter. You've accomplished what we've planned for, and that is perfect. The girl will grow into a suitale leader... Now then, we have some questions for you.
Hollow Serenity#198.dst: 상관없다. 넌 우리가 계획한 일을 해냈고, 그거면 완벽하지. 그 소녀는 적합한 지도자로 자랄 거다... 자, 그럼 몇 가지 묻겠다.
Hollow Serenity#198.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#199.src: Tell me Garvan... Where is the heir?
Hollow Serenity#199.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#200.src: I... will not tell you. I have lost Eileen and my love thanks to you. If I am to lose her... then you shall lose her as well.
Hollow Serenity#200.dst: 난... 말하지 않겠다. 너희 때문에 Eileen도, 내 사랑도 잃었어. 내가 그 아이를 잃어야 한다면... 너희도 잃게 될 거다.
Hollow Serenity#200.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#201.src: ...Lunatic. You; take him in. Keep him alive.
Hollow Serenity#201.dst: ...미치광이 같으니. 너, 저자를 데려가. 살려 두고.
Hollow Serenity#201.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#203.src: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. I think there's a misunderstanding here. You are in no place to defy us.
Hollow Serenity#203.dst: Garvan. Garvan, Garvan. 뭔가 오해가 있는 것 같군. 넌 우리에게 맞설 처지가 아니다.
Hollow Serenity#203.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#204.src: Now then... You will tell us where the rightful heir to the throne is... No matter the cost.
Hollow Serenity#204.dst: 자 그럼... 왕좌의 정당한 후계자가 어디 있는지 말하게 될 거다... 어떤 대가를 치르더라도.
Hollow Serenity#204.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#205.src: Return to the Manor and search for any clues as to Eileen's whereabouts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hollow Serenity#205.dst: 저택으로 돌아가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 Eileen의 행방에 관한 단서를 찾으세요.

Hollow Serenity#206.src: It seems you've arrived. F-Forgive me... I-I'm not quite used to talking anymore. It's been quite a while.
Hollow Serenity#206.dst: 왔구나. 요, 용서해 줘... 마, 말하는 게 좀 익숙하지 않아서. 꽤 오래됐거든.

Hollow Serenity#207.src: ...Nevermind. I d-don't want your forgiveness in particular. In fact, w-why do you even care? The forest has died, generations have lived on... and yet... You just had to tear the scar open, didn't you?
Hollow Serenity#207.dst: ...됐어. 딱히 네 용서를 바라는 것도 아니야. 애, 애초에 네가 왜 신경 쓰지? 숲은 죽었고, 세대는 흘러갔어... 그런데도... 굳이 그 흉터를 헤집어야 했나?

Hollow Serenity#208.src: My sins... You do not need to see them... all the things I've done wrong. H-How I destroyed the bonds tying me and my love together.
Hollow Serenity#208.dst: 내 죄... 넌 볼 필요 없어... 내가 저지른 모든 잘못을. 내, 내가 어떻게 나와 내 사랑을 잇던 인연을 부쉈는지.

Hollow Serenity#209.src: ...Y-Yes... I mean her. Katarin. She's watching us as we speak, no? A-and with that, I suppose it's obvious what lies under this veil.
Hollow Serenity#209.dst: ...그, 그래... 그녀 말이야. Katarin. 지금도 우릴 보고 있잖아? 그, 그렇다면 이 베일 아래 뭐가 있는지는 뻔하겠지.

Hollow Serenity#210.src: Greetings... I-I'm s-sure you're well acquainted with me, by now. I-It was me all along. Quite the- well, it was a predictable twist, I suppose...
Hollow Serenity#210.dst: 반갑군... 이, 이제 날 잘 알겠지. 처, 처음부터 나였어. 꽤나- 뭐, 뻔한 반전이었겠지만...
Hollow Serenity#210.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#211.src: ...B-But... I take it you don't have the full story. So... so so so so so so... Let me explain to you, human... The bitter end to our shared tale.
Hollow Serenity#211.dst: ...하, 하지만... 전말은 모르는 모양이군. 그러니... 그러니 그러니 그러니... 설명해 주지, 인간... 우리가 함께 나눈 이야기의 쓰디쓴 결말을.
Hollow Serenity#211.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#212.src: AAAAAAAGGGHHH!!!! F-FINE! I-I'll tell you... I-I'll tell y-you where Eileen is...
Hollow Serenity#212.dst: 으아아아아아악!!!! 조, 좋아! 마, 말하지... Eileen이 어디 있는지 마, 말해 주지...
Hollow Serenity#212.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#213.src: S-She... is with her mother. At the Faltach Manor. T-That is all. Just s-stop...
Hollow Serenity#213.dst: 그, 그 애는... 어머니와 함께 있어. Faltach 저택에. 그, 그게 다야. 그, 그만해...
Hollow Serenity#213.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#214.src: ...Good. This had better not be a lie. You; tell the others that we are heading there now. Kill everyone at the manor and any witnesses; leave the heir alive.
Hollow Serenity#214.dst: ...좋다. 거짓말이 아니어야 할 거다. 너, 다른 자들에게 지금 그리로 간다고 전해. 저택 사람과 목격자는 전부 죽이고, 후계자는 살려 둬라.
Hollow Serenity#214.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#216.src: N-NO! GET BACK HERE! DON'T YOU DARE HARM THEM! I'LL KILL YOU!! DO YOU HEAR ME???
Hollow Serenity#216.dst: 아, 안 돼! 돌아와! 그들을 해치기만 해 봐! 죽여 버리겠다!! 내 말 들려???
Hollow Serenity#216.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#217.src: ...M-Mother... why d-do I have to stay here?
Hollow Serenity#217.dst: ...어, 엄마... 왜 여, 여기 있어야 해요?
Hollow Serenity#217.speaker: Eileen

Hollow Serenity#218.src: It's for your own good dear. Now, remember to stay put. Garvan won't be able to use you if you're kept inside of here...
Hollow Serenity#218.dst: 다 널 위해서란다, 얘야. 자, 꼭 가만히 있어. 여기 안에 있으면 Garvan이 널 이용하지 못해...
Hollow Serenity#218.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#220.src: Yorman won't be bothering us anymore, sweetheart. He wouldn't understand, so... J- just don't worry about what happened to him. It's irrelevant-
Hollow Serenity#220.dst: Yorman은 더는 우릴 괴롭히지 않을 거야, 아가. 그이는 이해 못 했을 테니... 그, 그이가 어떻게 됐는지는 신경 쓰지 마. 중요하지 않아-
Hollow Serenity#220.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#221.src: L-LADY KATARIN! T-THERE ARE INTRUDERS- AAAAAAHHHHHH!!!
Hollow Serenity#221.dst: K, Katarin 마님! 치, 침입자가- 으아아아아악!!!
Hollow Serenity#221.speaker: Servant

Hollow Serenity#223.src: Step aside, Katarin Faltach. This will be much simpler if you just stand down and tell us where your daughter is.
Hollow Serenity#223.dst: 비켜라, Katarin Faltach. 순순히 물러나서 딸이 어디 있는지 말하면 훨씬 간단해질 거다.
Hollow Serenity#223.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#224.src: ...Come again? No. YOU WON'T TOUCH HER! GET OUT OF MY SIGHT-
Hollow Serenity#224.dst: ...뭐라고? 싫어. 그 애한텐 손끝 하나 못 대! 내 눈앞에서 사라져-
Hollow Serenity#224.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#225.src: You're not the one making demands here... You all, search the house and find the child.
Hollow Serenity#225.dst: 여기서 요구하는 건 네가 아니야... 너희, 집을 뒤져서 아이를 찾아라.
Hollow Serenity#225.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#226.src: There she is. Hmm... it seems that the parasite injection worked well. Garvan wasn't so useless after all.
Hollow Serenity#226.dst: 저기 있군. 흠... 기생체 주입이 잘된 모양이야. Garvan이 그리 쓸모없진 않았군.
Hollow Serenity#226.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#227.src: Oh? Too terrified to speak? Worry not, Eileen Faltach. You won't be harmed... too much. You're quite important to us, you see.
Hollow Serenity#227.dst: 오? 너무 무서워서 말도 못 하나? 걱정 마라, Eileen Faltach. 다치진 않을 거다... 많이는. 넌 우리에게 꽤 중요하거든.
Hollow Serenity#227.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#228.src: N-NO! STAY AWAY FROM MY DAUGHTER!
Hollow Serenity#228.dst: 아, 안 돼! 내 딸한테서 떨어져!
Hollow Serenity#228.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#229.src: You have little choice in the matter, Miss Faltach. Stand your ground.
Hollow Serenity#229.dst: 당신에겐 선택의 여지가 별로 없어, Faltach 부인. 거기 가만히 있어.
Hollow Serenity#229.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#230.src: GET AWAY FROM HER, DO YOU HEAR ME??? RAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGGGGGGGGHHHHHH!!!!
Hollow Serenity#230.dst: 그 애한테서 떨어져, 내 말 안 들려??? 으아아아아아아아아아아아악!!!!
Hollow Serenity#230.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#231.src: Tch... Some people will never understand what we do for the world. Thank you for protecting us from her, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#231.dst: 쯧... 우리가 세상을 위해 하는 일을 끝내 이해 못 하는 자들이 있지. 저 여자로부터 지켜 줘서 고맙다, Aki.
Hollow Serenity#231.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#232.src: I will deal with the heir myself. You all can head back to our village. Thank you for your help today.
Hollow Serenity#232.dst: 후계자는 내가 직접 처리하지. 너희는 마을로 돌아가라. 오늘 도와줘서 고맙다.
Hollow Serenity#232.speaker: Mysterious Leader

Hollow Serenity#233.src: ...I should have known. I-I... my love... y-you're gone.
Hollow Serenity#233.dst: ...알았어야 했는데. 내, 내... 사랑... 다, 당신이 떠났군요.
Hollow Serenity#233.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#234.src: DAMN IT! DAMN IT DAMN IT DAMN IT AAAAALLLL!!!!
Hollow Serenity#234.dst: 젠장! 젠장 젠장 젠장 다 젠자아아앙!!!!
Hollow Serenity#234.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#235.src: This is... W-why did this have to happen? ...I-I can't... this can't end like this...
Hollow Serenity#235.dst: 이건... 왜, 왜 이렇게 돼야 했지? ...나, 난 못... 이렇게 끝날 순 없어...
Hollow Serenity#235.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#236.src: T-This will be enough. You have a wonderful grave, m-my love...
Hollow Serenity#236.dst: 이, 이 정도면 충분해요. 아름다운 무덤이에요, 내, 내 사랑...
Hollow Serenity#236.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#237.src: W-We won't be separated, though. I-I will leave our true selves here, as well.
Hollow Serenity#237.dst: 그, 그래도 우린 떨어지지 않을 거예요. 우, 우리의 진정한 자아도 여기 남겨 둘게요.
Hollow Serenity#237.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#238.dst: 내 영혼... 그리고 다, 당신 영혼을.
Hollow Serenity#238.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#239.src: T-This is our final act of love, K-Katarin... This stone will keep us here. Eternal, and in bliss.
Hollow Serenity#239.dst: 이, 이게 우리의 마지막 사랑이에요, K-Katarin... 이 돌이 우릴 여기 붙잡아 둘 거예요. 영원히, 행복하게.
Hollow Serenity#239.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#240.src: I-It's like nothing ever h-happened, right?
Hollow Serenity#240.dst: 마, 마치 아무 일도 어, 없었던 것 같지?
Hollow Serenity#240.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#242.src: N-Now you understand. T-this is... all my fault. I have ruined everything. E-everything I touched, I destroyed.
Hollow Serenity#242.dst: 이, 이제 알겠지. 이, 이건... 전부 내 잘못이야. 내가 다 망쳤어. 내, 내가 손댄 건 전부 부서졌지.
Hollow Serenity#242.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#243.src: Have I not repented enough? Have I not suffered enough for decades in this god-forsaken forest?? And why did you have to-
Hollow Serenity#243.dst: 아직도 속죄가 부족한가? 이 신에게 버림받은 숲에서 수십 년을 고통받은 걸로 부족한가?? 그런데 왜 네가-
Hollow Serenity#243.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#244.src: No... You know too much. B-But I can't kill, not again. I-I can make things right. I-I'm going to fix this. I'm going to fix this. I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to...
Hollow Serenity#244.dst: 아니... 넌 너무 많이 알아. 하, 하지만 죽일 순 없어, 다시는. 바, 바로잡을 수 있어. 고, 고칠 거야. 고칠 거야. 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야...
Hollow Serenity#244.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#245.src: I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to I'm going to-
Hollow Serenity#245.dst: 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야 고칠 거야-
Hollow Serenity#245.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#247.src: Get to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#248.src: K-Katarin! My l-love... is that you?
Hollow Serenity#248.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#249.src: My word... I-It is you! I missed you, love... and I'm s-so sorry... for all of this!
Hollow Serenity#249.dst: 세상에... 다, 당신이군요! 보고 싶었어요, 여보... 그리고 저, 정말 미안해요... 이 모든 게!
Hollow Serenity#249.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#250.src: I realize n-now, thanks to this h-human's efforts. What I've done has t-torn us apart... I hurt you and our l-little girl so much...
Hollow Serenity#250.dst: 이 이, 인간 덕분에 이, 이제야 깨달았어요. 내가 한 짓이 우릴 가, 갈라놓았어요... 당신과 우리 어, 어린 딸을 너무 아프게 했어요...
Hollow Serenity#250.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#251.src: I-I'm so sorry, Katarin! P-Please, forgive me! Let us f-fix all of thi-
Hollow Serenity#251.dst: 저, 정말 미안해요, Katarin! 제, 제발 용서해 줘요! 우리 이 모든 걸 바, 바로잡-
Hollow Serenity#251.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#255.src: What... What do you mean?? Speak, my love! I don't understand.
Hollow Serenity#255.dst: 뭐... 무슨 뜻이에요?? 말해 줘요, 여보! 모르겠어요.
Hollow Serenity#255.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#256.src: ...Forgiveness...? You... beg for me... to forgive... you?
Hollow Serenity#256.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#257.src: I... Yes, yes! P-Please, my love! I-I know I've have spent the last century and a half running away from u-us, but...
Hollow Serenity#257.dst: 저... 네, 네! 제, 제발요, 여보! 지난 한 세기 반 동안 우, 우리에게서 도망쳐 온 건 알지만...
Hollow Serenity#257.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#258.src: It was all my fault, from the beginning! I was wrong! W-We can fix this...! We can make everything go back to normal, j-just like it was before!
Hollow Serenity#258.dst: 처음부터 전부 제 잘못이었어요! 제가 틀렸어요! 우, 우리 이걸 바로잡을 수 있어요...! 모든 걸 예전처럼 되, 되돌릴 수 있어요!
Hollow Serenity#258.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#259.src: Please, Katarin! A-all I ask is that you forgive me!
Hollow Serenity#259.dst: 제발요, Katarin! 저, 전 용서만 받으면 돼요!
Hollow Serenity#259.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#260.src: ...You... You must really have a deathwish-
Hollow Serenity#260.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#261.src: ...Maybe I can... Forgive this. But I need something from you, as well...
Hollow Serenity#261.dst: ...어쩌면... 용서할 수도 있어요. 하지만 나도 당신한테 받을 게 있어요...
Hollow Serenity#261.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#262.src: ...Where is the gemstone? I'd... I'd like to know. And then... I could... forgive... this.
Hollow Serenity#262.dst: ...보석은 어디 있죠? 난... 알고 싶어요. 그러면... 난... 용서할... 수 있을 거예요.
Hollow Serenity#262.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#263.src: O-Oh! Is that all? Of course, my love, I can tell you!
Hollow Serenity#263.dst: 오, 오! 그거면 돼요? 물론이죠, 여보, 알려 줄게요!
Hollow Serenity#263.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#264.src: I-I placed it in the catacombs, right next to where-
Hollow Serenity#264.dst: 지, 지하 묘지에 뒀어요, 바로 옆에-
Hollow Serenity#264.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#265.src: W-What... W-WHAT I-IS THISS?? I-I C-CAN'T B-BREATHE! P-PLEASE!!
Hollow Serenity#265.dst: 뭐, 뭐야... 이, 이게 뭐야?? 수, 숨을 모, 못 쉬겠어! 제, 제발!!
Hollow Serenity#265.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#266.src: NO!! NO, NO NO NO NO. HUMAN, H-HELP ME!! KATARIN... K-KATARIIIIINNNNN!!!!
Hollow Serenity#266.dst: 안 돼!! 안 돼 안 돼. 인간, 사, 살려 줘!! KATARIN... K-KATARIIIIINNNNN!!!!
Hollow Serenity#266.speaker: Garvan

Hollow Serenity#270.src: Head to the Manor's catacombs at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Hollow Serenity#272.src: TELL ME WHERE IT IS, GARVAN! I KNOW YOU'RE STILL LISTENING!
Hollow Serenity#272.dst: 어디 있는지 말해, GARVAN! 아직 듣고 있는 거 알아!
Hollow Serenity#272.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#273.src: You knew where it was- Hmm... what did Garvan call you things...?
Hollow Serenity#273.dst: 넌 어디 있는지 알았지- 흠... Garvan이 너희를 뭐라고 불렀더라...?
Hollow Serenity#273.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#274.src: Right, a human. You knew... that it was just beneath this rubble?
Hollow Serenity#274.dst: 맞다, 인간. 넌 알았어... 그게 이 잔해 바로 밑에 있다는 걸?
Hollow Serenity#274.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#275.src: There it is... Thank you... Now this eternal hell will finally end. After so long...
Hollow Serenity#275.dst: 저기 있네... 고마워... 이제 이 영원한 지옥도 드디어 끝나. 이렇게 오랜 세월 끝에...
Hollow Serenity#275.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#276.src: Do you hear that? It's the ocean waves... The heavens... They're calling for me-
Hollow Serenity#276.dst: 들려? 파도 소리야... 하늘이... 날 부르고 있어-
Hollow Serenity#276.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#280.src: He's gone... All of this will finally be done...
Hollow Serenity#280.dst: 그이가 사라졌어... 이 모든 게 드디어 끝나...
Hollow Serenity#280.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#281.src: Thank you, stranger. Thank you for... everything.
Hollow Serenity#281.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#282.src: Now I'm... finally free. But... I suppose I still have unfinished business. Before I leave, I must know something.
Hollow Serenity#282.dst: 이제 난... 드디어 자유야. 하지만... 아직 끝내지 못한 일이 있나 봐. 떠나기 전에 알아야 할 게 있어.
Hollow Serenity#282.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#283.src: ...What has become of my daughter, Eileen? Has she suffered any more? Or did she escape?
Hollow Serenity#283.dst: ...내 딸 Eileen은 어떻게 됐어? 더 고통받았니? 아니면 도망쳤니?
Hollow Serenity#283.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#284.src: I must know. Is she okay?
Hollow Serenity#284.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#285.src: ...I see. That is... wonderful news. Thank you, human.
Hollow Serenity#285.dst: ...그렇구나. 그건... 정말 좋은 소식이야. 고마워, 인간.
Hollow Serenity#285.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#287.src: ...The pain is receding... The heavens are calling... for the final time...
Hollow Serenity#287.dst: ...고통이 가라앉고 있어... 하늘이 부르고 있어... 마지막으로...
Hollow Serenity#287.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#288.src: Goodbye... Thank you human, from the bottom of my heart.
Hollow Serenity#288.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#292.src: NO NO NO NO NO NO NO NOOOOO!!!!!!
Hollow Serenity#292.dst: 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼애애애!!!!!!
Hollow Serenity#292.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#293.src: TRAITOR!! I WILL MAKE YOU ALL SUFFFEEERRRR!!! (In High Gavellian)
Hollow Serenity#293.dst: 배신자!! 너희 모두 고통받게 해 주겠어어어!!! (High Gavellian으로)
Hollow Serenity#293.speaker: Katarin

Hollow Serenity#294.src: Bury Garvan's body in Katarin's incomplete grave.
Hollow Serenity#294.dst: Garvan의 시신을 Katarin의 미완성 무덤에 묻으세요.

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.src: You should put the mask on before you leave.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.dst: 떠나기 전에 가면을 쓰는 게 좋겠어.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#000.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#001.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.src: Oh, ho ho. What is this? A Human? What brings you to Gylia Watch - want to let your hair down a bit, I bet!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.dst: 오, 호호. 이게 뭐야? 인간? Gylia Watch엔 무슨 일로 왔어? 좀 놀다 가려는 거지, 그렇지!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#002.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.src: Of course you know who we are! The Gylia Watch was founded over {~} years ago in wake of the Villager victory in the war.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.dst: 당연히 우리가 누군지 알겠지! Gylia Watch는 {~}년도 더 전에 주민들이 전쟁에서 이긴 뒤 세워졌어.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#003.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.src: The Gerten war! Only the most famous war in all of modern Gavel! The might of the Villagers crushed those blasted Gerts - not that they were particularly hard to beat, heh.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.dst: Gerten 전쟁! 현대 Gavel에서 제일 유명한 전쟁이지! 주민들의 힘이 그 빌어먹을 Gert들을 짓밟았어. 뭐, 딱히 어려운 상대도 아니었지만, 헤.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#004.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.src: Gerts are stupid brutes, you see. The only thing they ever think about is food.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.dst: 알다시피 Gert는 멍청한 짐승들이야. 머릿속엔 오로지 먹을 것뿐이지.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#005.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.src: Get too close to one and it'll chomp your fingers off, quick as you like. And then the rest of you as well!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.dst: 너무 가까이 가면 손가락을 눈 깜짝할 새 뜯어 먹어. 그다음엔 나머지 몸도!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#006.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.src: The peace treaty keeps them inside their borders, and we get a delivery of supplies every month from {p} to send over to them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.dst: 평화 조약으로 놈들은 국경 안에 갇혀 있고, 우린 매달 {p}에서 물자를 받아 놈들한테 보내 줘.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#007.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.src: Of course, we have to keep some of the supplies for ourselves - you've seen how hard these men are working, they deserve a bit of a party!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.dst: 물론 물자 일부는 우리 몫으로 챙겨야지. 여기 사람들 얼마나 고생하는지 봤잖아, 파티 좀 할 자격은 있다고!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#008.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.src: The Watch keeps a lookout over the Gerten borders day and night... well, maybe not on poker nights!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.dst: 경비대는 밤낮으로 Gerten 국경을 감시해... 뭐, 포커 치는 밤은 빼고!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#009.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.src: Although... we have heard a couple of nasty rumors floating about - farmers disappearing from their houses and the such.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.dst: 그런데... 흉흉한 소문이 좀 돌더라고. 농부들이 집에서 사라진다든가 하는.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#010.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.src: If I really can't tempt you with a glass of wine and a round of poker, maybe you could go and check them out for us?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.dst: 와인 한 잔이랑 포커 한 판으로도 못 꼬시겠다면, 대신 가서 좀 알아봐 줄래?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#011.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.src: I'd send the men, but... well, I'd feel bad if one of them went and missed all the partying!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.dst: 우리 애들을 보낼 수도 있지만... 그러다 누가 파티를 놓치면 미안하잖아!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#012.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.src: Here, you should head over and talk to Jitak, they're one of the farmers that lodged a complaint. Their house is west of here, I'll write down the co-ordinates.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.dst: 자, Jitak한테 가서 얘기해 봐. 민원을 넣은 농부 중 하나야. 집이 여기서 서쪽인데, 좌표 적어 줄게.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#013.speaker: Cikal

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#014.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.src: If you are looking for a suit or something, I can't help you. Now is a very bad time.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.dst: 옷 같은 걸 찾으러 왔다면 도와줄 수 없어. 지금은 정말 때가 안 좋아.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#015.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.src: Oh, you're here on behalf of the Watch? Ha, even sending Humans to do their work is not beneath them.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.dst: 아, 경비대 대신 왔다고? 하, 인간한테 자기 일을 떠넘기는 것도 서슴지 않는군.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#016.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.src: All they do is sit up in that tower playing drinking games and act like they own this region!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.dst: 그놈들은 탑에 앉아서 술 게임이나 하면서 이 지역 주인인 양 굴어!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#017.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.src: I reported the fact there is clearly a Gert camp right in front of my house and they just ignored me! Now look, my pigs are all gone!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.dst: 우리 집 바로 앞에 Gert 야영지가 있다고 신고했는데 무시당했어! 이것 봐, 돼지가 다 없어졌잖아!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#018.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.src: I knew it was a mistake getting this property so close to gerten borders. See, gerts aren't the 'brutes' people insist, but...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.dst: Gerten 국경에 이렇게 가까운 땅을 산 게 실수였어. 사실 Gert는 사람들 말처럼 '짐승'은 아니지만...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#019.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.src: Well, they'll eat anything! Animals, fish, monsters, villagers, even humans! Biologically, they're just constantly hungry.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.dst: 뭐든 먹어! 동물, 물고기, 몬스터, 주민, 인간까지! 생물학적으로 늘 배가 고픈 거야.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#020.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.src: The watch is meant to keep them behind their borders...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.dst: 경비대가 원래 놈들을 국경 안에 묶어 둬야 하는데...
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#021.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.src: I even bought a golem to watch over them - Got it for a good price because of some incident down at the {p} factory.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.dst: 감시하라고 골렘까지 샀어. {p} 공장에서 무슨 사고가 있어서 싸게 샀지.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#022.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.src: But somehow the gerts are managing to avoid it! Look, if you're here from the watch, could you help me out?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.dst: 그런데 Gert들이 어떻게든 골렘을 피해 다녀! 이봐, 경비대에서 왔으면 좀 도와줄래?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#023.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.src: Go to the gert camp west of here and find out how they are doing all of this!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.dst: 여기서 서쪽 Gert 야영지에 가서 놈들이 어떻게 이러는지 알아내 줘!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#024.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.src: Inspect the Gerten Forwarding Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#025.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.src: Investigate the cave in the back of the camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#026.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#027.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.src: -Good job to all of you! I am proud to say we made the cave road very well.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.dst: -모두 잘했다! 우리 동굴 길 아주 잘 만들었다고 자랑스럽게 말한다.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#028.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.src: The town folk at Gylia steal the stuff meant for us for their party, and leave us high and dry!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.dst: Gylia 마을 사람들 우리 줄 물건 훔쳐서 파티한다. 우리는 쫄쫄 굶는다!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#029.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.src: But those dumb over fed town folk did not catch us when we dug our cave road right under their watch house.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.dst: 하지만 멍청하고 배부른 마을 사람들, 우리가 감시 집 바로 밑으로 동굴 길 팔 때 못 잡았다.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#030.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.src: With our new way to get to Gylia land we have more stuff than ever!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.dst: Gylia 땅 가는 새 길 생겨서 우리 물건 어느 때보다 많다!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#031.speaker: Gerten Chief Snaga

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#032.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#033.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.src: Human! You're back... and haven't been eaten by a Gert!
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#034.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.src: What did you discover in the camp?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#035.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.src: A tunnel?! Past Gerten borders? That must be how they're managing to get in and steal my livestock.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.dst: 터널?! Gerten 국경 너머로? 그걸로 들어와서 내 가축을 훔쳐 간 게 분명해.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#036.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.src: Look, human. The Watch aren't gonna do anything about this. Please... maybe you can help me.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.dst: 이봐, 인간. 경비대는 이 일에 손 하나 까딱 안 할 거야. 제발... 네가 도와줄 수 있을지도 몰라.
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#037.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.src: If you can disguise yourself as a Gert maybe you could sneak into their main camp and check out this tunnel?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.dst: Gert로 변장하면 놈들 본 야영지에 몰래 들어가서 그 터널을 살펴볼 수 있지 않을까?
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.quest: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
Hunger of the Gerts Part I#038.speaker: Jitak

Hunger of the Gerts Part I#039.src: Okay! As you can see, all Gerts wear a carved pumpkin on their head - something to do with their culture.

Ice Nations#014.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#015.src: Talk back to Adigard about Hallfred's response

Ice Nations#016.src: I should have expected that. Hallfred was always very greedy...
Ice Nations#016.dst: 그럴 줄 알았어야 했네. Hallfred는 늘 욕심이 많았지...
Ice Nations#016.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#017.src: We tried to make him understand that we do not have the treasure, without much success.
Ice Nations#017.dst: 보물이 우리에게 없다는 걸 이해시키려 했지만 소용없었네.
Ice Nations#017.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#018.src: ... You see, the reason why we became shipwrecked wasn't natural cause. We were attacked...
Ice Nations#018.dst: ... 사실 우리가 난파한 건 자연재해 때문이 아니었네. 습격을 받았지...
Ice Nations#018.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#019.src: By whom? The undead. Ghosts and demons navigating a monstrous ship. They got us by surprise.
Ice Nations#019.dst: 누구에게? 언데드일세. 괴물 같은 배를 모는 유령과 악마들. 기습을 당했지.
Ice Nations#019.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#020.src: I believe they also stole our treasure during the attack.
Ice Nations#020.dst: 그 습격 때 보물도 그들이 훔쳐 갔다고 생각하네.
Ice Nations#020.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#021.src: Would you help our nation come back together? Find this ship, and bring the treasure back to Hallfred so we can finally live in peace.
Ice Nations#021.dst: 우리 나라가 다시 하나가 되게 도와주겠나? 그 배를 찾아 보물을 Hallfred에게 가져다주면 마침내 평화가 올 걸세.
Ice Nations#021.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#022.src: Sail north. That is where they attacked us many years ago. It should be easy to find, I'm sure they are anchored there in glory... Thank you.
Ice Nations#022.dst: 북쪽으로 항해하게. 오래전 거기서 습격당했지. 찾기 쉬울 걸세, 분명 거기 당당히 정박해 있을 테니... 고맙네.
Ice Nations#022.speaker: Adigard

Ice Nations#023.src: Find the ghost ship and bring back [Ancient Treasure] to Hallfred

Ice Nations#024.src: Incredible! He actually delivered the treasure!
Ice Nations#024.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#025.src: I suppose that means the end of the war between our nations!
Ice Nations#025.dst: 그렇다면 우리 두 나라의 전쟁도 끝이로군!
Ice Nations#025.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#026.src: This is a great day! Here, take this as a reward for helping our nation.
Ice Nations#026.dst: 참으로 좋은 날일세! 자, 우리 나라를 도와준 보답으로 받게.
Ice Nations#026.speaker: Hallfred

Ice Nations#027.src: I'm sure you'll find a use for this helmet one day!
Ice Nations#027.dst: 이 투구는 언젠가 쓸모가 있을 걸세!
Ice Nations#027.speaker: Hallfred

Infested Plants#003.src: Meet up with Tasim at the entrance to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#004.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. Are you ready to continue on towards {p}?
Infested Plants#004.dst: 아, {u}! 여기 있었구나. 반가워. {p} 쪽으로 계속 갈 준비 됐어?
Infested Plants#004.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#006.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right? I can tell from your weird fashion sense. You folk are supposed to help people! So. Help!
Infested Plants#006.dst: 저-저기! 거기 둘! 병사들 맞지? 이상한 옷차림 보니 알겠네. 너희 같은 사람들은 남을 도와야 하잖아! 그러니까. 도와줘!

Infested Plants#007.src: Huh? Oh- yes, of course! What's your name? What do you need help with?
Infested Plants#007.dst: 응? 아- 그래, 물론이지! 이름이 뭐야? 뭘 도와줄까?
Infested Plants#007.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#008.src: I'm Ope! I was recently... uh... bit by a spider! And now I need your help to get a rare medicinal herb to heal me!
Infested Plants#008.dst: 난 Ope야! 얼마 전에... 어... 거미한테 물렸어! 그래서 날 고칠 귀한 약초를 구해 줘야 해!
Infested Plants#008.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#009.src: It only grows in an infested cave filled with creepy crawlies. And I'm clearly in no condition to go get it myself!
Infested Plants#009.dst: 그건 벌레가 득실대는 동굴에서만 자라. 그리고 난 보다시피 직접 갈 몸 상태가 아니야!
Infested Plants#009.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#010.src: Well, alright! We're here to help, after all, so... We'll get you that herb!
Infested Plants#010.dst: 음, 좋아! 우린 돕자고 온 거니까... 그 약초 구해 줄게!
Infested Plants#010.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#012.src: Follow Ope to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#014.src: Hm... There's two of you. Good! One of your can climb up into that cave, and the other can protect me from the crawly spiders down here!
Infested Plants#014.dst: 흠... 둘이구나. 잘됐네! 한 명은 저 동굴로 올라가고, 다른 한 명은 여기서 기어다니는 거미들로부터 날 지켜 줘!
Infested Plants#014.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#015.src: Alright! {u}, you can go into the cave, and I can defend Ope here while you do that.
Infested Plants#015.dst: 좋아! {u}, 넌 동굴로 들어가. 그동안 난 여기서 Ope를 지킬게.
Infested Plants#015.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#017.src: Locate the medicine in the spider cave behind Ope at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Infested Plants#017.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Ope 뒤편 거미 동굴에서 약초를 찾으세요.

Infested Plants#018.src: Exit the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the medicinal herb.

Infested Plants#019.src: There you are! It feels like we've been waiting for hours.
Infested Plants#019.dst: 왔구나! 몇 시간은 기다린 것 같아.
Infested Plants#019.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#020.src: It... really hasn't been that long. Maybe ten minutes at most.
Infested Plants#020.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#021.src: Well-... Anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very- uh, important! To cure me. Yep.
Infested Plants#021.dst: 음-... 아무튼! 약초 가져왔어? 그거 정말- 어, 중요하거든! 날 고치는 데. 응.
Infested Plants#021.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#023.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- I can, uh, offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time.
Infested Plants#023.dst: 아. 에메랄드가 다 떨어졌네. 음- 대신, 어, 조언을 해 줄게! 이 숲엔 찾을 게 많아. 보물 있는 동굴도 잔뜩 있지! 가 볼 만할걸.
Infested Plants#023.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#025.src: It has been a time, soldiers, but I truly must be going! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road! Go and speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#025.dst: 즐거웠어, 병사들. 근데 난 진짜 가 봐야 해! 여기서 {p}이(가) 가까우니 들러 봐! 큰길 따라 동쪽으로 쭉 가면 돼! 촌장한테 말해! 내 비용은 그 사람이 내 줄 거야!
Infested Plants#025.speaker: Ope

Infested Plants#028.src: That's... frustrating. He seemed shady from the start, I should have-... Well. What's done is done. Let's go speak to that mayor.
Infested Plants#028.dst: 정말... 짜증 나네. 처음부터 수상하더라니, 내가 좀-... 뭐. 이미 지난 일이지. 그 촌장한테 가 보자.
Infested Plants#028.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#029.src: Speak to Mayor Alvin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Infested Plants#030.src: Ah, travelers... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#030.dst: 아, 여행자분들... 우리 소박한 숲 마을에 잘 오셨어요. 머무르실 건가요, 지나가시는 길인가요?
Infested Plants#030.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#031.src: Probably the latter. Though, we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#031.dst: 아마 후자일 거예요. 그런데 Ope라는 사람을 만났는데, 촌장님을 찾아가라더군요.
Infested Plants#031.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#032.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with.
Infested Plants#032.dst: 아, Ope... 좋지 않은 만남이었나 보군요? 대신 사과드려요. 그 사람은... 상대하기 힘든 사람이에요.
Infested Plants#032.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#033.src: Here, I may offer you a small sum of emeralds as an apology. I hope he has not soured your opinion of our small town, here...
Infested Plants#033.dst: 자, 사과의 뜻으로 약간의 에메랄드를 드릴게요. 그 사람 때문에 우리 작은 마을 인상이 나빠지지 않았으면 해요...
Infested Plants#033.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#034.src: Oh... Thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay for a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#034.dst: 아... 감사합니다. 정말 친절하시네요. {p}(으)로 가기 전에 한동안 머무를 것 같아요.
Infested Plants#034.speaker: Tasim

Infested Plants#035.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay is.
Infested Plants#035.dst: 그럼 편히 지내세요! 얼마나 머무시든 여행자는 누구든 환영이에요.
Infested Plants#035.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Infested Plants#036.src: Oh, {u}! There you are. It's good to see you. I'd say we should keep heading towards {p}, but...
Infested Plants#036.dst: 아, {u}! 여기 있었구나. 반가워. {p} 쪽으로 계속 가야 할 것 같은데...

Infested Plants#037.src: It looks like we'll need to pass through the {p} first. I've heard the forest is crawling with spiders... and the undead are a danger, as always... but between you and me, we should be-
Infested Plants#037.dst: 먼저 {p}을(를) 지나가야겠어. 숲에 거미가 우글거린대... 언데드도 여전히 위험하고... 근데 우리 둘이면 괜찮-

Infested Plants#038.src: H-hey! You two! You're soldiers, right?

Infested Plants#040.src: Yep, I could tell from your weird fashion sense! You folk are supposed to help people, right? So. Help!
Infested Plants#040.dst: 그래, 그 이상한 옷차림 보니 알겠더라! 너희 같은 사람은 남을 도와야 하잖아? 그러니까. 도와줘!

Infested Plants#041.src: Well, sure- but who are you? Why are you out on your own, isn't it dangerous? Aren't the undead...
Infested Plants#041.dst: 음, 그래- 근데 넌 누구야? 왜 혼자 나와 있어, 위험하지 않아? 언데드가...

Infested Plants#042.src: I'm Ope! And the undead... eh, there's not as many of them around here. The spiders aren't picky 'bout who they go for.
Infested Plants#042.dst: 난 Ope야! 그리고 언데드는... 에, 이 근처엔 별로 없어. 거미들은 상대를 안 가리지만.

Infested Plants#043.src: Right... okay. That makes sense. What did you need help with?
Infested Plants#043.dst: 그렇구나... 알았어. 말이 되네. 뭘 도와줄까?

Infested Plants#044.src: I... uh... so, there's this rare medicinal herb that grows in these woods, right? And it's important. But the only place I know to find it is an infested cave, filled with creepy crawly spiders.
Infested Plants#044.dst: 난... 어... 그러니까, 이 숲에 귀한 약초가 자라거든? 그게 중요해. 근데 내가 아는 곳은 징그러운 거미가 우글대는 동굴 하나뿐이야.

Infested Plants#045.src: And, y'know, I- I'm no soldier! Can't just go in there and get it myself! So, I was hoping you could help me out.
Infested Plants#045.dst: 그리고, 알잖아, 난- 난 병사가 아니라고! 직접 들어가서 가져올 순 없어! 그래서 너희가 도와줬으면 해.

Infested Plants#046.src: Well... we came to Wynn to help out, after all. So... we can get you that herb!
Infested Plants#046.dst: 음... 우린 돕자고 Wynn에 온 거니까. 그래... 그 약초 구해 줄게!

Infested Plants#047.src: Great. Great! I'll bring you to the cave, and you can do the rest from there. Follow me!
Infested Plants#047.dst: 좋아. 좋아! 동굴까지 데려다줄 테니 나머진 너희가 해. 따라와!

Infested Plants#048.src: Well, here we are! That's the cave right over there- just climb up the rocks and jump into it. It's safe! Uh, probably.
Infested Plants#048.dst: 자, 다 왔어! 저기 바로 그 동굴이야- 바위를 타고 올라가서 뛰어들면 돼. 안전해! 어, 아마도.

Infested Plants#049.src: ...eek. There's a lot of spiders even up here... hey, since there's two of you- one of you can go get the herb, and the other can, uh... protect me from the crawly spiders?
Infested Plants#049.dst: ...으악. 여기 위에도 거미가 많네... 저기, 둘이니까- 한 명은 약초를 가져오고, 다른 한 명은, 어... 기어다니는 거미들로부터 날 지켜 줄래?

Infested Plants#050.src: That works for me. {u}, you go into the cave, and I'll defend Ope up here while you do that.
Infested Plants#050.dst: 난 좋아. {u}, 넌 동굴로 들어가. 그동안 난 여기서 Ope를 지킬게.

Infested Plants#051.src: Yep... good! Good, good! Good, uh, luck up there! Try not to get bitten too much by the spiders!
Infested Plants#051.dst: 응... 좋아! 좋아, 좋아! 거기서, 어, 행운을 빌어! 거미한테 너무 많이 물리지 마!

Infested Plants#052.src: ...ah- there you are!! What took you so long, it feels like we've been waiting for hours!
Infested Plants#052.dst: ...아- 왔구나!! 왜 이렇게 오래 걸렸어, 몇 시간은 기다린 것 같아!

Infested Plants#053.src: It-... mm. A-anyway! Do you have the herb? It's very important, yep.
Infested Plants#053.dst: 그게-... 음. 아-아무튼! 약초 가져왔어? 그거 진짜 중요해, 응.

Infested Plants#054.src: Come to think of it... I don't think you ever mentioned what you needed it for.
Infested Plants#054.dst: 그러고 보니... 그게 왜 필요한지 말한 적이 없는 것 같은데.

Infested Plants#055.src: Oh, I- eheh, it... I... uh, it's n-none of your business, actually.
Infested Plants#055.dst: 아, 난- 에헤, 그건... 난... 어, 사-사실 네가 알 바 아니야.

Infested Plants#056.src: I- I thank you kindly for your work, soldiers! Now, about your payment... let's see, what do I have...
Infested Plants#056.dst: 수- 수고해 줘서 정말 고마워, 병사들! 자, 보수 말인데... 보자, 뭐가 있더라...

Infested Plants#057.src: Oh. I seem to be out of emeralds. Well- then, I- I can offer some advice! There's lots to find in this forest. Plenty of other caves with valuables to explore! Might be worth your time!
Infested Plants#057.dst: 아. 에메랄드가 다 떨어졌네. 음- 그럼, 내- 내가 조언을 해 줄게! 이 숲엔 찾을 게 많아. 보물 있는 동굴도 잔뜩 있고! 가 볼 만할 거야!

Infested Plants#058.src: Wait, what? Hey, are you seriously not going to-
Infested Plants#058.dst: 잠깐, 뭐? 야, 설마 진짜로 안 줄-

Infested Plants#059.src: It has been a time soldiers, but I- I truly must be going! Important things to get to! We're near {p}, you should stop on by! Just keep going east down the main road!
Infested Plants#059.dst: 즐거웠어, 병사들. 근데 난- 난 진짜 가 봐야 해! 급한 일이 있거든! 여기서 {p}이(가) 가까우니 들러 봐! 큰길 따라 동쪽으로 쭉 가면 돼!

Infested Plants#060.src: You can, uh, go speak to the mayor! He can cover my expenses!
Infested Plants#060.dst: 촌장한테, 어, 말해 봐! 내 비용은 그 사람이 내 줄 거야!

Infested Plants#062.src: That's... frustrating. I really did just want to know... well. What's done is done. Let's just go talk to that mayor he mentioned.
Infested Plants#062.dst: 정말... 짜증 나네. 그냥 알고 싶었을 뿐인데... 뭐. 이미 지난 일이지. 그 사람이 말한 촌장한테 가 보자.

Infested Plants#063.src: I'm going to go on ahead. I'll meet you in {p}, it's just down the main road to the east.
Infested Plants#063.dst: 난 먼저 갈게. {p}에서 만나자. 큰길 따라 동쪽으로 가면 바로야.

Infested Plants#064.src: Ah, recruits... welcome to our humble forest town. Have you come to stay, or are you simply passing through?
Infested Plants#064.dst: 아, 신병분들... 우리 소박한 숲 마을에 잘 오셨어요. 머무르실 건가요, 지나가시는 길인가요?

Infested Plants#065.src: Just passing through, our destination is {p}. Though... we ran into a man named Ope, who directed us to speak with you.
Infested Plants#065.dst: 지나가는 길이에요. 목적지는 {p}이고요. 그런데... Ope라는 사람을 만났는데 촌장님을 찾아가라더군요.

Infested Plants#066.src: Oh, Ope... I take it your meeting with him went poorly? I must apologize for him, he is... a tough man to deal with sometimes.
Infested Plants#066.dst: 아, Ope... 좋지 않은 만남이었나 보군요? 대신 사과드려요. 그 사람은... 가끔 상대하기 힘든 사람이라서요.

Infested Plants#067.src: Oh... thank you. That's very kind of you. We'll probably stay a while, before we continue towards {p}.
Infested Plants#067.dst: 아... 감사합니다. 정말 친절하시네요. {p}(으)로 가기 전에 한동안 머무를 것 같아요.

Infested Plants#068.src: Then feel free to make yourselves at home! We welcome all travelers here, no matter how long their stay.
Infested Plants#068.dst: 그럼 편히 지내세요! 얼마나 머무시든 여행자는 누구든 환영이에요.

Jungle Fever#000.src: The only cure to this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*

Jungle Fever#001.src: Break into *cough* the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...

Jungle Fever#002.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we don't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
