Jungle Fever#003.src: I needed to make sure you could easily break into a bank. So i came here by myself to see if you could do it.

Jungle Fever#004.src: You've proven your ability of stealth and strength by breaking into this storage, we can start the real thing now.

Jungle Fever#005.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golems, who can kill anyone in one hit.

similar.text: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.

Jungle Fever#006.src: ..I mean *cough*.. I was too sick so i came back here.. *cough*

Jungle Fever#007.src: I feel so much better now, thank you for the cure!

Jungle Fever#008.src: Talk to Worid in the jungle village at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#009.src: Oh, I am so happy to see you! *cough*, I caught a very bad fever, and I really need help! *cough*
Jungle Fever#009.dst: 아, 만나서 정말 반가워! *콜록*, 지독한 열병에 걸려서 도움이 꼭 필요해! *콜록*
Jungle Fever#009.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#010.src: The only cure against this fever is to drink Liquid Emeralds! Yes, exactly! *cough*
Jungle Fever#010.dst: 이 열병을 낫게 하는 건 액체 에메랄드를 마시는 것뿐이야! 그래, 바로 그거! *콜록*
Jungle Fever#010.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#011.src: Do you think you could ask the Banker at {p} if he could give me, oh I don't know, [{~} Liquified Emeralds]?
Jungle Fever#011.dst: {p}의 은행원한테 가서, 글쎄, [{~} 액체 에메랄드]쯤 줄 수 있는지 물어봐 줄래?
Jungle Fever#011.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#012.src: If he has the audacity to *cough* say no... you will have to use brute force...
Jungle Fever#012.dst: 그 사람이 뻔뻔하게 *콜록* 거절하면... 힘으로 해결해야지...
Jungle Fever#012.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#013.src: Break into *cough* to the emerald storage, but don't take anything... come back to me immediately after, if you make it out alive, heheh...
Jungle Fever#013.dst: *콜록* 에메랄드 창고에 쳐들어가. 근데 아무것도 가져오진 말고... 살아 나오면 바로 나한테 와, 헤헤...
Jungle Fever#013.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#015.src: Talk to {p}'s Banker about the cure for Worid at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Jungle Fever#016.src: [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? He is crazy! Liquified Emeralds cannot cure anyone from anything, except being poor!
Jungle Fever#016.dst: [{~} 액체 에메랄드]요? 미쳤군요! 액체 에메랄드로는 아무 병도 못 고쳐요. 가난이라면 몰라도!
Jungle Fever#016.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#017.src: I will not participate in this pathetic fraud attempt!
Jungle Fever#017.dst: 이런 한심한 사기에 가담할 생각 없어요!
Jungle Fever#017.speaker: The Banker

Jungle Fever#019.src: Oh no! How will I ever cure my sickness without any Liquified Emeralds?... *cough*
Jungle Fever#019.dst: 안 돼! 액체 에메랄드 없이 내 병을 어떻게 고치라고?... *콜록*
Jungle Fever#019.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#020.src: We'll have to change our strategy, we won't ask for permission. It's to help me after all.
Jungle Fever#020.dst: 작전을 바꿔야겠어. 허락 따윈 안 구해. 어차피 날 돕는 일이잖아.
Jungle Fever#020.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#021.src: First, I need to make sure you can easily break into a bank. Try to enter {p}' Secret Stash.
Jungle Fever#021.dst: 우선 네가 은행에 쉽게 침입할 수 있는지 확인해야겠어. {p}의 비밀 창고에 들어가 봐.
Jungle Fever#021.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#022.src: When you're done, talk to me again. Be careful too, they might have some Guards.
Jungle Fever#022.dst: 끝나면 다시 말 걸어. 조심하고. 경비병이 있을지도 몰라.
Jungle Fever#022.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#024.src: What? You're here already. I thought you would take too long so I just went myself.
Jungle Fever#024.dst: 뭐? 벌써 왔어? 오래 걸릴 것 같아서 그냥 내가 직접 다녀왔는데.
Jungle Fever#024.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#025.src: My sickness? RIGHT. *cough* You should feel bad for forcing a sick man to do your job.
Jungle Fever#025.dst: 내 병? 아 맞다. *콜록* 아픈 사람한테 네 일을 시키다니 반성해야 할걸.
Jungle Fever#025.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#026.src: Anyway I see you proved yourself, we can start the real thing now.
Jungle Fever#026.dst: 아무튼 실력은 증명했으니 이제 진짜 일을 시작하자.
Jungle Fever#026.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#027.src: You see, {p} has a very well guarded emerald vault named "The Emerald Labyrinth".
Jungle Fever#027.dst: 있잖아, {p}에는 "에메랄드 미궁"이라는 삼엄한 에메랄드 금고가 있어.
Jungle Fever#027.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#028.src: It is guarded with tons of well trained Guard Golem, who can easily kill any adventurer.
Jungle Fever#028.dst: 잘 훈련된 경비 골렘이 잔뜩 지키고 있어서 어떤 모험가든 쉽게 죽일 수 있지.
Jungle Fever#028.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#029.src: The Banker in the secret vault must be completely bored out of his mind, and won't mind if you find him.
Jungle Fever#029.dst: 비밀 금고의 은행원은 지루해서 미칠 지경일 테니, 네가 찾아가도 싫어하진 않을 거야.
Jungle Fever#029.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#030.src: Good luck with that. Haha.. I mean, *cough*.
Jungle Fever#030.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#031.src: Infiltrate {p}'s Secret Emerald Labyrinth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] underground and find the Banker in the Emerald Room
Jungle Fever#031.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}] 지하에 있는 {p}의 비밀 에메랄드 미궁에 잠입해 에메랄드 방의 은행원을 찾으세요

Jungle Fever#032.src: Oh, uh! Somebody! It has been so long since I've seen someone!
Jungle Fever#032.dst: 오, 어! 사람이다! 사람 본 게 대체 얼마 만이야!
Jungle Fever#032.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#033.src: Liquified Emeralds? Of course, of course! I've got tons! Here, take them.
Jungle Fever#033.dst: 액체 에메랄드요? 물론이죠, 물론! 잔뜩 있어요! 자, 가져가요.
Jungle Fever#033.speaker: Almuj Banker

Jungle Fever#036.src: That is a lot of money, thank you very much, I will finally be able to... *cough* to cure myself!
Jungle Fever#036.dst: 큰돈이네, 정말 고마워. 드디어... *콜록* 내 병을 고칠 수 있겠어!
Jungle Fever#036.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#037.src: Here, take this part, you deserve it. I have to use most of the... *cough* money so I can heal, so I've instead paid you with a key.
Jungle Fever#037.dst: 자, 이건 네 몫이야. 받을 만해. 돈은 대부분... *콜록* 치료에 써야 해서, 대신 열쇠로 줄게.
Jungle Fever#037.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#038.src: I stole- *cough* I mean, borrowed it, from our tribe's leader. Apparently it was used to lock up a great evil.
Jungle Fever#038.dst: 우리 부족장한테서 훔- *콜록* 아니, 빌린 거야. 거대한 악을 가두는 데 썼다나 봐.
Jungle Fever#038.speaker: Worid

Jungle Fever#039.src: Good ridda- *cough* Er... luck. Yes, good luck, adventurer!
Jungle Fever#039.dst: 잘 뒈- *콜록* 어... 행운을. 그래, 행운을 빌어, 모험가!
Jungle Fever#039.speaker: Worid

King's Recruit#001.src: {#}Cast your Arrow Bomb Spell by clicking  LEFT -  RIGHT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow

similar.text: {#}Cast your Arrow Storm Spell by clicking  RIGHT -  LEFT -  RIGHT  while holding your Bow

King's Recruit#002.src: You three are going to make fine soldiers. Now, go on to {p}, the King is awaiting your arrival.

King's Recruit#003.src: Well, what are we waiting for?

King's Recruit#006.src: Hey, {u}! You alright in there? Looks like we hit something.
King's Recruit#006.dst: 이봐, {u}! 안에 괜찮아? 뭔가에 부딪힌 것 같아.

King's Recruit#007.src: Exit the caravan and talk to the Caravan Driver at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#008.src: Hm... I swear I hit this same darn boulder every time I make this trip. Sorry folks.
King's Recruit#008.dst: 흠... 이 길 올 때마다 꼭 이 빌어먹을 바위에 부딪힌단 말이지. 미안하오, 여러분.
King's Recruit#008.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#009.src: Ah. Does this mean we have to walk all the way to {p} from here?
King's Recruit#009.dst: 아. 그럼 여기서부터 {p}까지 걸어가야 한다는 거야?
King's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#010.src: Unfortunately so. Luckily, it's not that far from here. Just a straight path forward.
King's Recruit#010.dst: 안타깝지만 그렇소. 다행히 여기서 멀지 않소. 쭉 앞으로만 가면 되오.
King's Recruit#010.speaker: Caravan Driver

King's Recruit#011.src: Well, nothing to do but keep moving! Tasim, {u}, I'll race you to the gate!
King's Recruit#011.dst: 뭐, 계속 가는 수밖에! Tasim, {u}, 관문까지 누가 먼저 가나 시합이야!
King's Recruit#011.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#013.src: ... He's already gone. We'll have to catch up to him. {u}, lead the way.
King's Recruit#013.dst: ... 벌써 가 버렸네. 따라잡아야겠어. {u}, 앞장서 줘.
King's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#014.src: Walk down the path towards the gate to the Wynn Province at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
King's Recruit#014.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Wynn 지방 관문을 향해 길을 따라가세요.

King's Recruit#015.src: I don't suppose you know much about Wynn either, do you?
King's Recruit#015.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#016.src: Of course, the King of {p}'s been recruiting Fruma soldiers, but...
King's Recruit#016.dst: 물론 {p}의 왕이 Fruma 병사를 모집해 왔지만...
King's Recruit#016.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#017.src: That war of theirs must be getting pretty bad if they need this much support.
King's Recruit#017.dst: 이만큼 지원이 필요하다면 그 전쟁이 꽤 심각한가 봐.
King's Recruit#017.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#018.src: Oh, there's Aledar! And the gate, by the looks of it.
King's Recruit#018.dst: 아, Aledar가 저기 있네! 보아하니 관문도 있고.
King's Recruit#018.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#019.src: There you two are! You'll have to be faster than that if you want to stand a chance against the undead.
King's Recruit#019.dst: 드디어 왔네! 언데드를 상대하려면 그것보단 빨라야 할걸.
King's Recruit#019.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#020.src: Yes, yes, we'll be faster next time. So, is this the gate marking the border between Wynn and Fruma?
King's Recruit#020.dst: 그래, 그래, 다음엔 빨리 올게. 그래서, 이게 Wynn과 Fruma의 경계 관문이야?
King's Recruit#020.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#021.src: It looks like it, yep! Are you two ready for the start of our new lives?
King's Recruit#021.dst: 그런 것 같아! 둘 다 새 삶을 시작할 준비 됐어?
King's Recruit#021.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#022.src: {u}, why don't you do the honours? Go ahead and open that gate.
King's Recruit#022.dst: {u}, 영광은 네가 누려. 어서 저 관문을 열어 봐.
King's Recruit#022.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#023.src: Enter the Province of Wynn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#024.src: Well, what are we waiting for? Let's go ahead and explore this province.
King's Recruit#024.dst: 자, 뭘 기다려? 이 지방을 한번 둘러보자.
King's Recruit#024.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#025.src: Continue through the Wynn Province to the castle
King's Recruit#025.dst: Wynn 지방을 지나 성으로 계속 가세요

King's Recruit#026.src: So this is Wynn we've all been hearing about... It's beautiful.
King's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#027.src: I guess the war hasn't made it this far. This is what we'll be fighting to protect.
King's Recruit#027.dst: 전쟁이 여기까진 안 왔나 봐. 우리가 싸워서 지킬 곳이 바로 이거야.
King's Recruit#027.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#028.src: Hey, recruits! Come over here, I have something to tell you.
King's Recruit#028.dst: 이봐, 신병들! 이리 와, 할 말이 있다.
King's Recruit#028.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#030.src: A soldier? What are you doing all the way out here?
King's Recruit#030.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#031.src: There's a bit of trouble up ahead. They sent me out here to intercept new recruits.
King's Recruit#031.dst: 앞쪽에 문제가 좀 생겼다. 새 신병들을 붙잡으라고 날 여기 보냈지.
King's Recruit#031.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#032.src: If you want to survive out here, you're going to need this.
King's Recruit#032.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#035.src: Hopefully we won't have to use these just yet.
King's Recruit#035.dst: 당분간은 이걸 쓸 일이 없으면 좋겠네.
King's Recruit#035.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#036.src: Good luck out there, recruits! Just follow this path, and there will be a bridge up ahead.
King's Recruit#036.dst: 조심해라, 신병들! 이 길을 따라가면 앞에 다리가 나올 거다.
King's Recruit#036.speaker: Soldier

King's Recruit#038.src: Ah, this must be the bridge the soldier was talking about. But it certainly looks very...
King's Recruit#038.dst: 아, 이게 그 병사가 말한 다리인가 봐. 그런데 확실히 좀...
King's Recruit#038.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#039.src: Well, let's not keep the King of {p} waiting!
King's Recruit#039.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#043.src: That's what I was trying to warn you about! Let's just get off this bridge before the rest of it collapses...
King's Recruit#043.dst: 내가 경고하려던 게 그거였어! 나머지가 무너지기 전에 다리에서 내려가자...
King's Recruit#043.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#044.src: Well, how are we meant to get to the other side of this ravine now? Ugh. Another thing gone wrong, just like-...
King's Recruit#044.dst: 그럼 이 협곡을 이제 어떻게 건너지? 으. 또 일이 꼬였네, 꼭 그때처럼-...
King's Recruit#044.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#046.src: That's... weird. I was just thinking about something from before Wynn, but... it's gone. I can't remember.
King's Recruit#046.dst: 그게... 이상해. Wynn에 오기 전 일을 떠올리고 있었는데... 사라졌어. 기억이 안 나.
King's Recruit#046.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#047.src: Hm. I can't remember anything from Fruma either... {u}, how about you?
King's Recruit#047.dst: 흠. 나도 Fruma 일이 하나도 기억 안 나... {u}, 너는?
King's Recruit#047.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#048.src: Nothing. It can't be a coincidence we all lost our memories at the same time, right?
King's Recruit#048.dst: 아무것도. 다 같이 동시에 기억을 잃은 게 우연일 리 없잖아, 그렇지?
King's Recruit#048.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#049.src: No, but... We can worry about that later. For now, we need to find a way past this ravine. Aledar, {u}, you should look around for a way across. I'll keep looking here.
King's Recruit#049.dst: 그렇지, 하지만... 그건 나중에 걱정하자. 지금은 협곡을 건널 방법부터 찾아야 해. Aledar, {u}, 둘이 건널 길을 찾아봐. 난 여기서 계속 볼게.
King's Recruit#049.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#051.src: Search for another way across the ravine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#052.src: Woah! That sure did the trick, {u}. Good thinking!
King's Recruit#052.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#053.src: Hey, Tasim! Come over here, {u} found a way over!
King's Recruit#053.dst: 어이, Tasim! 이리 와, {u}이(가) 건널 길을 찾았어!
King's Recruit#053.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#055.src: Phew! We made it over safely this time at least.
King's Recruit#055.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#056.src: If we just continue forward, we should make it to {p} in no time!
King's Recruit#056.dst: 이대로 쭉 가면 금방 {p}에 도착할 거야!
King's Recruit#056.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#057.src: Hmm? What's that guard doing here? We should probably talk to them if we want to pass through.
King's Recruit#057.dst: 응? 저 경비병은 여기서 뭐 하지? 지나가려면 얘기해 봐야겠어.
King's Recruit#057.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#061.src: A group of corrupted have sieged this underpass. I can't let you enter without any armour.
King's Recruit#061.dst: 타락한 것들 무리가 이 지하 통로를 점거했다. 방어구 없이는 들여보낼 수 없다.
King's Recruit#061.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#062.src: Then what do we do? We have to get to {p}!
King's Recruit#062.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#063.src: Do you see that cave over there? Caves such as those often contain useful loot that can help keep you alive.
King's Recruit#063.dst: 저기 동굴 보이나? 그런 동굴엔 목숨을 지켜 줄 쓸 만한 전리품이 있곤 하지.
King's Recruit#063.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#064.src: If you enter the cave, you should be able to find some armour to protect you. After that return to me.
King's Recruit#064.dst: 동굴에 들어가면 몸을 지킬 방어구를 찾을 수 있을 거다. 그다음 내게 돌아와라.
King's Recruit#064.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#065.src: What do you say {u}? Let's go see what's in that cave.
King's Recruit#065.dst: 어때, {u}? 저 동굴에 뭐가 있는지 가 보자.
King's Recruit#065.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#066.src: Enter the cave and find some armour at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

King's Recruit#067.src: We should return to the guard to see if he'll let us through now!
King's Recruit#067.dst: 경비병한테 돌아가서 이제 지나가게 해 줄지 보자!
King's Recruit#067.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#069.src: So you found some armor, huh?
King's Recruit#069.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#070.src: Yes, a helmet! Will you let us pass now?
King's Recruit#070.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#071.src: Hold on there, recruit. Before you can equip a piece of armor you first have to identify it.
King's Recruit#071.dst: 잠깐, 신병. 방어구를 장착하려면 먼저 감정부터 해야 한다.
King's Recruit#071.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#072.src: And how do we do that?
King's Recruit#072.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#073.src: You can identify items at Item Identifiers. They exist in every city across the whole world, and we keep one here for convenience.
King's Recruit#073.dst: 아이템은 Item Identifier에게서 감정할 수 있다. 세상 모든 도시에 있고, 편의를 위해 여기도 한 명 두고 있지.
King's Recruit#073.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#074.src: Identify your helmet at the Item Identifier and then return to me with it equipped. After you've done that I'll let you pass.
King's Recruit#074.dst: Item Identifier에게 투구를 감정받고 장착한 채로 돌아와라. 그러면 지나가게 해 주지.
King's Recruit#074.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#076.src: I see you have your helmet on. Fantastic, you may now pass. Let me open this door for you.
King's Recruit#076.dst: 투구를 썼군. 훌륭하다, 이제 지나가도 좋다. 문을 열어 주지.
King's Recruit#076.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#077.src: Good luck in there recruits! Even with your armour it won't be so easy!
King's Recruit#077.dst: 안에서 행운을 빈다, 신병들! 방어구가 있어도 쉽지 않을 거다!
King's Recruit#077.speaker: Guard

King's Recruit#080.src: Wow, that guard wasn't joking. This place is crawling with the corrupt.
King's Recruit#080.dst: 와, 경비병 말이 농담이 아니었네. 여긴 타락한 것들이 득실거려.
King's Recruit#080.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#081.src: Well, we've got no choice but to make it through! Finally time for us to use these weapons we got. Let's go, {u}.
King's Recruit#081.dst: 뭐, 뚫고 가는 수밖에! 드디어 받은 무기를 써 볼 때야. 가자, {u}.
King's Recruit#081.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#082.src: {u}, you take the skeleton in the front. We'll handle the two zombies in the back!
King's Recruit#082.dst: {u}, 앞에 있는 스켈레톤을 맡아. 뒤에 좀비 둘은 우리가 처리할게!
King's Recruit#082.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#085.src: This path opened up, let's continue through the underpass.
King's Recruit#085.dst: 길이 열렸어. 지하 통로를 계속 지나가자.
King's Recruit#085.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#087.src: Over here! You're just what I needed!
King's Recruit#087.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#089.src: Finally, some backup! Wait a second... you're straight from Fruma aren't you?
King's Recruit#089.dst: 드디어 지원군이군! 잠깐... 너희 Fruma에서 막 온 거지?
King's Recruit#089.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#090.src: Oh well, this area should be clear by now. {p} is just up ahead, after all.
King's Recruit#090.dst: 뭐, 이 구역은 이제 정리됐을 거다. {p}도 바로 앞이니까.
King's Recruit#090.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#092.src: Quick, you have to use an ability!
King's Recruit#092.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#094.src: Wait, it's running away! We have to save the Lieutenant!
King's Recruit#094.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#096.src: Defeat the Goliath and free the Lieutenant.

King's Recruit#097.src: That sure was close... Thanks for the save, {u}!
King's Recruit#097.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#098.src: I think you three are going to make good soldiers - not many can handle themselves like you just did.
King's Recruit#098.dst: 너희 셋은 좋은 병사가 되겠어. 방금처럼 해내는 사람은 드물지.
King's Recruit#098.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#099.src: It seems that beast dropped something, you should check it out before heading to {p}.
King's Recruit#099.dst: 그 짐승이 뭔가 떨어뜨린 것 같다. {p}에 가기 전에 확인해 봐라.
King's Recruit#099.speaker: Lieutenant

King's Recruit#100.src: Pick up the loot dropped by the Goliath.

King's Recruit#101.src: That item looks rare! Maybe there's an identifier around here.
King's Recruit#101.dst: 희귀한 아이템 같아! 근처에 감정사가 있을지도.
King's Recruit#101.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#104.src: We... we made it! We really made it! Sure was a close call at the end.
King's Recruit#104.dst: 우리... 도착했어! 진짜 해냈어! 마지막엔 정말 아슬아슬했지만.
King's Recruit#104.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#105.src: ... Still think those corrupted don't stand a chance against you?
King's Recruit#105.dst: ... 아직도 타락한 것들이 너한텐 상대도 안 된다고 생각해?
King's Recruit#105.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#106.src: Ha ha. Very funny. Ah, {u}, there seems to be an identifier here for you to identify that rare helmet.
King's Recruit#106.dst: 하하. 퍽이나 웃기네. 아, {u}, 여기 감정사가 있으니 그 희귀한 투구를 감정받아.
King's Recruit#106.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#107.src: And a blacksmith too, you can sell your old helmet there for some emeralds.
King's Recruit#107.dst: 대장장이도 있네. 쓰던 투구는 거기 팔아서 에메랄드로 바꿔.
King's Recruit#107.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#108.src: Here it is, the end of our journey.
King's Recruit#108.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#109.src: The end of one adventure, but the beginning of another! Let's go inside and talk to the King!
King's Recruit#109.dst: 한 모험의 끝이자 또 다른 모험의 시작이지! 들어가서 왕과 얘기하자!
King's Recruit#109.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#111.src: Welcome to the Province of Wynn! By your ragged appearance, I gather your journey here must have been quite the adventure.
King's Recruit#111.dst: Wynn 지방에 온 것을 환영한다! 행색을 보아하니 오는 길이 꽤나 험난했던 모양이군.
King's Recruit#111.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#112.src: This, recruits, is the noble fort of {p}, one of the great cities of our province!
King's Recruit#112.dst: 신병들이여, 이곳은 우리 지방의 대도시 중 하나, 고귀한 요새 {p}이다!
King's Recruit#112.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#113.src: As soldiers of Wynn, it is your duty to stem the tide of corrupted monsters ravaging this land.
King's Recruit#113.dst: Wynn의 병사로서 이 땅을 유린하는 타락한 괴물의 물결을 막는 것이 그대들의 의무다.
King's Recruit#113.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#114.src: Although, you may want to gain some experience beforehand. Many lives are tragically lost every day...
King's Recruit#114.dst: 허나 그 전에 경험을 좀 쌓는 게 좋을 게다. 매일 수많은 목숨이 안타깝게 스러지니...
King's Recruit#114.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#115.src: Take this [{p} Teleportation Scroll] to aid you in your journey. Upon use, it will instantly bring you back to this city, wherever you may be.
King's Recruit#115.dst: 여정에 도움이 되도록 이 [{p} Teleportation Scroll]을 가져가게. 사용하면 어디에 있든 즉시 이 도시로 돌아올 수 있다네.
King's Recruit#115.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#116.src: With that, I must bid you farewell, more recruits may arrive at any time. Good luck out there, soldiers of Wynn!
King's Recruit#116.dst: 이만 작별해야겠군. 신병이 언제 또 올지 모르니. 행운을 빈다, Wynn의 병사들이여!
King's Recruit#116.speaker: King of Ragni

King's Recruit#117.src: So! Wynn, huh? It's pretty exciting to finally be here.
King's Recruit#117.dst: 자! Wynn이라, 응? 드디어 여기 오니 꽤 설레네.
King's Recruit#117.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#118.src: I can't wait to discover what it looks like for myself!
King's Recruit#118.dst: 직접 어떤 곳인지 빨리 보고 싶어!
King's Recruit#118.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#119.src: Ha, well, I think I'm going to head in the direction of {p} soon, although there seems to be something called {p} on the way...
King's Recruit#119.dst: 하, 난 곧 {p} 쪽으로 갈 생각이야. 가는 길에 {p}(이)라는 곳이 있는 것 같지만...
King's Recruit#119.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#120.src: Enough talking already! Let's get out there and help some people!
King's Recruit#120.speaker: Aledar

King's Recruit#121.src: And he's gone again... Well, I'm sure we'll be seeing him soon enough. For now, let's just see what Wynn really is like.
King's Recruit#121.dst: 또 가 버렸네... 뭐, 금방 다시 만나겠지. 일단 Wynn이 진짜 어떤 곳인지 보자.
King's Recruit#121.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#122.src: It's beautiful... Oh! I almost forgot to tell you, {u}.
King's Recruit#122.dst: 아름답다... 아! 깜빡하고 말 안 할 뻔했네, {u}.
King's Recruit#122.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#123.src: There's this handy item we were all given on our way here, the Content Book. It displays most things you can do in this world; Quests, Caves, and much, much more.
King's Recruit#123.dst: 오는 길에 다들 받은 편리한 물건이 있잖아, 콘텐츠 북. 이 세계에서 할 수 있는 것 대부분을 보여 줘. 퀘스트, 동굴, 그리고 훨씬 더 많은 것들.
King's Recruit#123.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#124.src: It also lets you track any content you want, which will create beacons for you to follow.
King's Recruit#124.dst: 원하는 콘텐츠를 추적할 수도 있어. 그러면 따라갈 신호기가 생겨.
King's Recruit#124.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#125.src: Here, why don't you try it out? Use your Content Book, and click on the highlighted quest.
King's Recruit#125.dst: 자, 한번 써 볼래? 콘텐츠 북을 열고 강조된 퀘스트를 클릭해 봐.
King's Recruit#125.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#126.src: There you go! I'm going to head towards {p}, at the end of the {p}.
King's Recruit#126.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#127.src: You should meet me there once you've gotten a little stronger. Well, see you around, {u}.
King's Recruit#127.dst: 좀 더 강해지면 거기서 만나. 그럼 또 보자, {u}.
King's Recruit#127.speaker: Tasim

King's Recruit#128.src: What are you waiting for recruits? Go identify your helmet at the  Item Identifier and then equip it in your helmet slot!
King's Recruit#128.dst: 뭘 기다리나, 신병들? 어서  Item Identifier에게 투구를 감정받고 투구 칸에 장착해라!

King's Recruit#129.src: Unless you'd rather stand around here all day, that's fine by me too.
King's Recruit#129.dst: 여기 온종일 서 있고 싶다면야, 그것도 상관없다.

King's Recruit#130.src: Well, what are you waiting for?

King's Recruit#131.src: Good luck in there, recruits! You're gonna need it...
King's Recruit#131.dst: 안에서 행운을 빈다, 신병들! 필요할 거다...
King's Recruit#131.speaker: Guard

Kingdom of Sand#000.src: ... Until now. I believe I've managed to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#000.dst: ... 지금까지는요. 근처 도적 무리가 가지고 있다는 걸 알아낸 것 같아요. 그게 뭔지 전혀 모를 거예요.

Kingdom of Sand#001.src: Oi! Remember, yer need to nab that journal from the big mansion in {p}, if yer want to get in with us.
Kingdom of Sand#001.dst: 어이! 잊지 마, 우리 패에 끼고 싶으면 {p}의 큰 저택에서 그 일지를 슬쩍해 와야 해.

Kingdom of Sand#003.src: Looks like this is the room the journal is kept in...

Kingdom of Sand#004.src: What yer waiting for, get in here!

Kingdom of Sand#005.src: Seems like there's a meeting going on...

Kingdom of Sand#006.src: Seems like that broken cart by the river might be worth checking out...
Kingdom of Sand#006.dst: 강가의 부서진 수레를 확인해 볼 만할 것 같다...

Kingdom of Sand#008.src: Seems like that note might give you a clue...

Kingdom of Sand#009.src: The sceptre hums with unmeasurable power, filled with a thousand years of Desert history.
Kingdom of Sand#009.dst: 홀이 헤아릴 수 없는 힘으로 웅웅 울린다. 사막의 천 년 역사가 깃들어 있다.

Kingdom of Sand#010.src: You should get this back to Junes as soon as possible.

Kingdom of Sand#012.src: I should get it to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#012.dst: 당장 {p}(으)로 가야겠어요. 고마워요, {u}. 이 은혜는 영원히 잊지 않을게요.

Kingdom of Sand#013.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you could learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#013.dst: 무덤을 탐험할 생각이세요? 제국에 대해 많은 걸 알 수 있겠지만... 조심하세요.

Kingdom of Sand#014.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and this lesser treasure I found nearby.
Kingdom of Sand#014.dst: 도와주신 데 드릴 게 별로 없지만, 이 에메랄드와 근처에서 찾은 작은 보물을 받아 주세요.

Kingdom of Sand#016.src: A {p} soldier! I imagine you're here to investigate the tomb up the hill?
Kingdom of Sand#016.dst: {p} 병사군요! 언덕 위 무덤을 조사하러 오셨나 봐요?
Kingdom of Sand#016.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#017.src: It's believed to house the remains of Prince Hashr, the son of the old Desert Emperor, but it's far too dangerous for me to explore personally.
Kingdom of Sand#017.dst: 옛 사막 황제의 아들 Hashr 왕자의 유해가 안치된 곳으로 알려져 있지만, 제가 직접 들어가기엔 너무 위험해요.
Kingdom of Sand#017.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#018.src: Instead I've been looking into a related legend - the Emperor's Sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#018.dst: 대신 관련된 전설을 조사하고 있었어요. 바로 황제의 홀이죠.
Kingdom of Sand#018.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#019.src: It was the source of his power, and potentially one of the most important artifacts in history.
Kingdom of Sand#019.dst: 황제가 지닌 힘의 원천이자, 어쩌면 역사상 가장 중요한 유물 중 하나예요.
Kingdom of Sand#019.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#020.src: When the Emperor was slain by his son, Hashr, it is said that the sceptre was lost amongst the raging sandstorm that followed.
Kingdom of Sand#020.dst: 황제가 아들 Hashr에게 살해당했을 때, 뒤이은 거센 모래폭풍 속에서 홀이 사라졌다고 해요.
Kingdom of Sand#020.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#021.src: ... Until now. I believe I have been able to trace its possession to a nearby group of bandits. They probably have no idea what they're sitting on.
Kingdom of Sand#021.dst: ... 지금까지는요. 근처 도적 무리가 가지고 있다는 걸 알아낸 것 같아요. 그게 뭔지 전혀 모를 거예요.
Kingdom of Sand#021.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#022.src: I'm not prepared to confront them myself, but... this artifact belongs in a museum, in the hands of careful and respectful researchers.
Kingdom of Sand#022.dst: 직접 맞설 자신은 없지만... 이 유물은 박물관에, 신중하고 경의를 갖춘 연구자들의 손에 있어야 해요.
Kingdom of Sand#022.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#023.src: I would be in your debt if you could try to retrieve it, for the sake of history.
Kingdom of Sand#023.dst: 역사를 위해 되찾아 주신다면 큰 신세를 지는 셈이에요.
Kingdom of Sand#023.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#024.src: Attempt to enter the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#026.src: Even if yer a crooked soldier, we can't jus let yer in.
Kingdom of Sand#026.dst: 네가 비뚤어진 병사라 해도 그냥 들여보낼 순 없지.
Kingdom of Sand#026.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#027.src: That is, unless yer got the password?
Kingdom of Sand#027.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#028.src: Didn’t think so. Now get lost, wasted enough of my t-
Kingdom of Sand#028.dst: 그럴 줄 알았다. 이제 꺼져, 내 시간 낭비 그만-
Kingdom of Sand#028.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#029.src: Now would you look at that... Even soldiers think they can waltz in ere.
Kingdom of Sand#029.dst: 아니 이것 좀 보게... 병사 나리까지 여기 슬렁슬렁 들어올 수 있는 줄 아네.
Kingdom of Sand#029.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#030.src: Having fun thinking of a password? Sorry to spoil your lunch, but there isn’t one!
Kingdom of Sand#030.dst: 암호 생각하느라 재밌냐? 김새게 해서 미안한데, 암호 같은 건 없어!
Kingdom of Sand#030.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#031.src: We could use a few more officials on the roster.
Kingdom of Sand#031.dst: 명단에 관리 몇 명쯤 더 있어도 좋겠는데.
Kingdom of Sand#031.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#032.src: If yer are on the liberal side of the law, talk to us outside.
Kingdom of Sand#032.dst: 법을 좀 느슨하게 보는 편이면 밖에서 우리랑 얘기하자고.
Kingdom of Sand#032.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#034.src: Looks like yer in. Look, there ain't a password cause we're meant to be the best thieves in the land, right?
Kingdom of Sand#034.dst: 들어올 생각 있나 보네. 봐, 암호가 없는 건 우리가 이 땅 최고의 도둑이어야 해서라고, 알겠냐?
Kingdom of Sand#034.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#035.src: So what good are words? Yer gotta give the guard somethin' stolen, aintcha!
Kingdom of Sand#035.dst: 말이 무슨 소용이야? 경비한테 훔친 물건을 줘야지, 안 그래!
Kingdom of Sand#035.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#036.src: And we just so happen to have the opportunity of a lifetime for you. {p} has gone soft see, a new Mayor is cleaning things up.
Kingdom of Sand#036.dst: 마침 너한테 딱 맞는 일생일대의 기회가 있지. {p}이(가) 물러졌거든. 새 시장이 싹 정리하고 있어.
Kingdom of Sand#036.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#037.src: Well, we can't have government not under our control. {p} will always be bandit capital.
Kingdom of Sand#037.dst: 우리 손아귀 밖의 정부는 곤란하지. {p}은(는) 영원히 도적의 수도여야 해.
Kingdom of Sand#037.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#038.src: So how about we give him a taste of his own medicine, and get hold of that journal he keeps? I'm sure that’ll dig up some dirt on him.
Kingdom of Sand#038.dst: 그러니 그놈한테 똑같이 되갚아 주자고. 그놈이 쓰는 일지를 손에 넣는 거야. 분명 약점이 나올 거야.
Kingdom of Sand#038.speaker: Geo

Kingdom of Sand#039.src: And by "we", we mean you. You'll have to sneak through the mansion and avoid guards.
Kingdom of Sand#039.dst: 그리고 "우리"란 너를 말하는 거다. 경비를 피해서 저택에 몰래 들어가야 해.
Kingdom of Sand#039.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#040.src: He keeps his journal in the highest room. Might need to distract some guards too. It's the biggest mansion in {p}, can't miss it.
Kingdom of Sand#040.dst: 일지는 제일 높은 방에 둬. 경비 몇은 따돌려야 할 거고. {p}에서 제일 큰 저택이니 못 찾을 리 없어.
Kingdom of Sand#040.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#041.src: Sneak into the highest room of the {p} Mansion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#042.src: Arh, there's the thief I saw a-sneakin' round the Mansion! Get them!
Kingdom of Sand#042.dst: 아하, 저택 주변을 몰래 기웃거리던 도둑이 저기 있다! 잡아라!
Kingdom of Sand#042.speaker: Mansion Guard

Kingdom of Sand#043.src: Yer know you could get kicked out of the army fer this.
Kingdom of Sand#043.dst: 이런 짓 하면 군대에서 쫓겨날 수도 있는 거 알지.
Kingdom of Sand#043.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#044.src: Heh, guess yer the real thing. Hop in, lets get out of ‘ere.
Kingdom of Sand#044.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#045.src: That journal is more valuable than any gem, you'll be able to get in fer sure.
Kingdom of Sand#045.dst: 그 일지는 어떤 보석보다 값져. 확실히 들어갈 수 있을 거야.
Kingdom of Sand#045.speaker: Tarek

Kingdom of Sand#046.src: Bring the journal from the {p} Mansion to the Vault Guard to enter the hideout.
Kingdom of Sand#046.dst: {p} 저택에서 가져온 일지를 금고 경비에게 주고 은신처에 들어가세요.

Kingdom of Sand#049.src: Oh, this is quite the password, "soldier". I think this will do nicely, on you go.
Kingdom of Sand#049.dst: 오, 이거 대단한 암호로군, "병사" 양반. 이 정도면 됐다, 들어가.
Kingdom of Sand#049.speaker: Vault Guard

Kingdom of Sand#050.src: Look for the sceptre within the bandit hideout at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#051.src: Right, then, you lot. Give me your reports.
Kingdom of Sand#051.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#052.src: Gold relieved from Mesa travellers last week counted just over {~} bars.
Kingdom of Sand#052.dst: 지난주 Mesa 여행자들한테서 덜어 낸 금은 {~}개가 조금 넘습니다.
Kingdom of Sand#052.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#054.src: We're working on exposing that blasted {p} Mayor with a stolen journal. {p} should be back under Creden Tibus control within the week.
Kingdom of Sand#054.dst: 훔친 일지로 그 빌어먹을 {p} 시장을 폭로하는 중입니다. {p}은(는) 이번 주 안에 Creden Tibus 손에 돌아올 겁니다.
Kingdom of Sand#054.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#056.src: Well... someone's been hanging around the old tomb. An archaeologist, looks like. I reckon she's lookin' for the sceptre.
Kingdom of Sand#056.dst: 저... 누가 옛 무덤 주변을 어슬렁거립니다. 고고학자 같아요. 홀을 찾는 것 같습니다.
Kingdom of Sand#056.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#057.src: Ah... that sceptre's too valuable for us to lose. Maybe we pay 'er a visit, persuade her to... stop lookin'.
Kingdom of Sand#057.dst: 아... 그 홀은 잃기엔 너무 귀하지. 한번 찾아가서, 설득해 볼까... 그만 찾으라고.
Kingdom of Sand#057.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#058.src: Right you are, boss. Good thing no one will think to look for it in that broken cart by the river, ey?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.dst: 맞습니다, 두목. 강가의 부서진 수레에서 그걸 찾을 생각은 아무도 못 하겠죠?!
Kingdom of Sand#058.speaker: Bandit

Kingdom of Sand#059.src: Shut it, you fool! What did I just say? Anyway, I'll decide what to do with this archaeologist. Dismissed!
Kingdom of Sand#059.dst: 닥쳐, 멍청아! 내가 방금 뭐라 했어? 됐고, 그 고고학자는 내가 알아서 한다. 해산!
Kingdom of Sand#059.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#062.src: We might be bandits, but we’re not stupid. That sceptre is left better off alone.
Kingdom of Sand#062.dst: 우리가 도적이긴 해도 멍청하진 않아. 그 홀은 건드리지 않는 게 좋아.
Kingdom of Sand#062.speaker: Bandit Leader

Kingdom of Sand#065.src: Return to the tomb and give Junes the sceptre at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Kingdom of Sand#066.src: Ah, {u}. I couldn't help myself - I simply had to see the tomb up close.
Kingdom of Sand#066.dst: 아, {u}. 참을 수가 없었어요. 무덤을 가까이서 꼭 보고 싶었거든요.
Kingdom of Sand#066.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#067.src: You have no idea how tempted I am to go inside, but I doubt I'd make it out alive.
Kingdom of Sand#067.dst: 들어가고 싶은 마음이 굴뚝같지만, 살아 나올 수 있을지 모르겠어요.
Kingdom of Sand#067.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#068.src: You... you found the sceptre? Oh! This is incredible! I can't believe it!
Kingdom of Sand#068.dst: 홀을... 찾으셨다고요? 오! 정말 놀라워요! 믿을 수가 없어요!
Kingdom of Sand#068.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#069.src: This artifact, it witnessed the rise and fall of the Empire, thousands of years ago. And you've just been... holding it, without gloves...
Kingdom of Sand#069.dst: 이 유물은 수천 년 전 제국의 흥망을 지켜봤어요. 그런데 그걸 그냥... 장갑도 없이 들고 계셨다니...
Kingdom of Sand#069.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#070.src: Under the circumstances, I think I can let that slide. But the things I could learn from studying it...
Kingdom of Sand#070.dst: 상황이 상황이니 넘어갈게요. 하지만 이걸 연구해서 알아낼 것들이란...
Kingdom of Sand#070.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#071.src: I should get to {p} right away. Thank you, {u}. You have my eternal gratitude.
Kingdom of Sand#071.dst: 당장 {p}(으)로 가야겠어요. 고마워요, {u}. 이 은혜는 영원히 잊지 않을게요.
Kingdom of Sand#071.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#072.src: Are you thinking of exploring the tomb? I'm sure you can learn so much about the Empire... but you best be careful.
Kingdom of Sand#072.dst: 무덤을 탐험할 생각이세요? 제국에 대해 많은 걸 알 수 있겠지만... 조심하세요.
Kingdom of Sand#072.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#073.src: There are nasty legends of what it holds. Silverfish, skeletons... even Prince Hashr himself. Make sure to gear up!
Kingdom of Sand#073.dst: 안에 뭐가 있는지 끔찍한 전설이 많아요. 좀벌레, 스켈레톤... Hashr 왕자 본인까지. 장비를 꼭 갖추세요!
Kingdom of Sand#073.speaker: Junes

Kingdom of Sand#074.src: I have little to offer you for your help, but please accept these emeralds, and a fossil bone I found around here.
Kingdom of Sand#074.dst: 도와주신 데 드릴 게 별로 없지만, 이 에메랄드와 근처에서 찾은 화석 뼈를 받아 주세요.
Kingdom of Sand#074.speaker: Junes

Lava Springs#002.src: This should be enough evidence. You should report back to Colonel Gailard.
Lava Springs#002.dst: 이 정도면 증거는 충분하다. Gailard 대령에게 보고해야겠다.

Lava Springs#003.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here named {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
Lava Springs#003.dst: 잠깐... 좋은 생각이 났네... 좋아, 잘 듣게 병사! 여기 북쪽에 {p}(이)라는 작은 마을이 있지? 거기 우릴 도와줄 치유사가 있네.

Lava Springs#004.src: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of the town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
Lava Springs#004.dst: 마을 한가운데 있는 중요한 우물 안에 틀어박혀 있지. 거기 들어가려면 암호가 필요하다네...

Lava Springs#005.src: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how stupid that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
Lava Springs#005.dst: ...타락한... 용암 온천...? 그게 얼마나 멍청하게 들리는지 알지? 뭐, 난 완전히 믿어.

Lava Springs#006.src: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report back to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
Lava Springs#006.dst: 자, 갈 데가 있지? 그렇지. 가서 대령한테 보고해, 병사. 참, 내가 안부 전하더라고 해 줘.

Lava Springs#007.src: You can feel your body heat adjusting as the potion courses through your body...
Lava Springs#007.dst: 물약이 온몸에 퍼지며 체온이 조절되는 게 느껴진다...

Lava Springs#008.src: Ye're a good ally, soldier! And a great help to the army, at that!
Lava Springs#008.dst: 자넨 좋은 전우일세, 병사! 게다가 군에도 큰 도움이 됐고!

Lava Springs#010.src: Oh, good, good! I bet'cha you're a {p} soldier, aren't ya? Listen up, soldier! I've got a task here that 'ye can help out with.
Lava Springs#010.dst: 오, 좋아, 좋아! 장담하는데 자네 {p} 병사지? 잘 듣게, 병사! 자네가 도와줄 일이 있네.
Lava Springs#010.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#011.src: Ya see that lava spring right there? It just went and popped up out of nowhere! The brass is real concerned about it, mhm?
Lava Springs#011.dst: 저기 용암 온천 보이나? 난데없이 불쑥 솟아났지 뭔가! 윗선에서 아주 걱정하고 있네, 응?
Lava Springs#011.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#012.src: They've been yappin' about it bein' related to the Corruption, and 'ye can bet that that means trouble. BAD trouble.
Lava Springs#012.dst: 다들 타락과 관련 있다고 떠들어 대는데, 그렇다면 틀림없이 골칫거리란 뜻이지. 아주 지독한 골칫거리.
Lava Springs#012.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#013.src: Now, this here Savannah has always had some Corruption lurkin' about, but not to the point where it can do this! It won't be safe around here if we don't do somethin' about it!
Lava Springs#013.dst: 이 사바나엔 원래 타락이 좀 도사리고 있었지만, 이런 짓을 할 정도는 아니었네! 손을 쓰지 않으면 이 근방은 위험해질 걸세!
Lava Springs#013.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#014.src: Anyways, high command ain't gonna provide support for this until they know there's actual Corruption, so we've gotta find some evidence around the springs, understand?
Lava Springs#014.dst: 아무튼 사령부는 진짜 타락이 있다는 걸 알기 전엔 지원을 안 보낼 테니, 온천 주변에서 증거를 찾아야 하네, 알겠나?
Lava Springs#014.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#015.src: Take a look around the springs, soldier! Find me some damn evidence around here! [{~} Pieces of Evidence] should be enough! Now, get movin'!
Lava Springs#015.dst: 온천 주변을 살펴보게, 병사! 빌어먹을 증거를 좀 찾아오란 말일세! [{~} Pieces of Evidence]면 충분할 걸세! 자, 움직여!
Lava Springs#015.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#016.src: Look for three pieces of corrupted evidence around the Lava Spring at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lava Springs#016.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 용암 온천 주변에서 타락의 증거 세 개를 찾으세요

Lava Springs#017.src: Go back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#018.src: Alright, good! Ya found some evidence, let me take a look at that!
Lava Springs#018.dst: 좋아, 잘했네! 증거를 찾았군, 어디 한번 보세!
Lava Springs#018.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#019.src: Oh... This is bad... very, VERY bad...
Lava Springs#019.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#020.src: This here is some physical corruption. If it's gettin' onto the surface, then 'ye can bet one of those weeds is spreadin' underground, right beneath the springs...
Lava Springs#020.dst: 이건 실체화된 타락일세. 이게 지표면까지 올라왔다면 틀림없이 그 잡초 한 줄기가 온천 바로 밑에서 퍼지고 있는 걸세...
Lava Springs#020.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#021.src: If ya could get underneath the spring, 'ye could probably sever whatever damn root is causing this, but... the heat would be sure to fry your skin off...
Lava Springs#021.dst: 온천 밑으로 들어갈 수만 있다면 원인인 빌어먹을 뿌리를 끊을 수 있겠지만... 그 열기에 살갗이 다 익어 버릴 걸세...
Lava Springs#021.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#022.src: Wait... I've got an idea... Alright, listen up soldier! There's a lil' town North of here called {p}, yeah? There's a healer person there that can help us out.
Lava Springs#022.dst: 잠깐... 좋은 생각이 났네... 좋아, 잘 듣게 병사! 여기 북쪽에 {p}(이)라는 작은 마을이 있지? 거기 우릴 도와줄 치유사가 있네.
Lava Springs#022.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#023.src: They're holed up inside of some important well in the center of town. There's a password ya need to hop into that place, though...
Lava Springs#023.dst: 마을 한가운데 있는 중요한 우물 안에 틀어박혀 있지. 거기 들어가려면 암호가 필요하다네...
Lava Springs#023.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#024.src: Don't have much to go on, but I'm pretty damn sure the password is Bob, or something. After the hero himself.
Lava Springs#024.dst: 아는 건 별로 없지만, 암호가 Bob인가 뭔가일 게 거의 확실하네. 그 영웅 이름을 딴 거지.
Lava Springs#024.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#025.src: Right, ye're headin' there to find a potion that can keep ya weak little hide safe from the heat, understand? Here, let me write down the location in that book of yours.
Lava Springs#025.dst: 자, 자네는 거기 가서 그 연약한 가죽을 열기로부터 지켜 줄 물약을 구해 오는 걸세, 알겠나? 자, 위치는 자네 책에 적어 주지.
Lava Springs#025.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#026.src: Talk to Gregor outside the {p} well at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#027.src: Hey, hey hey hey! Darling, what do you think you're doing? You can't just waltz in here without telling me the password!
Lava Springs#027.dst: 이봐, 이봐 이봐 이봐! 자기, 지금 뭐 하는 거야? 나한테 암호도 안 말하고 그냥 들어가면 안 되지!
Lava Springs#027.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#028.src: Hmm... Your face... confidence... it gleans with confidence... yet... you still haven't spoken to me since you arrived...
Lava Springs#028.dst: 흠... 그 얼굴... 자신감... 자신감이 넘쳐흘러... 그런데... 온 뒤로 나한테 한마디도 안 했지...
Lava Springs#028.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#029.src: Could it be... you know that the password is penguin eggs, but you're just too shy to talk? Yeah... yeah, that's gotta be it!
Lava Springs#029.dst: 설마... 암호가 펭귄 알인 걸 알면서 부끄러워서 말을 못 하는 거야? 그래... 그래, 분명 그거야!
Lava Springs#029.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#030.src: You've convinced me, little mute darling... You can enter the well. Go on, now!
Lava Springs#030.dst: 날 설득했어, 말 없는 귀염둥이... 우물에 들어가도 돼. 어서 가!
Lava Springs#030.speaker: Gregor

Lava Springs#031.src: Enter the {p} well and talk to the healer at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#032.src: G'day to you, friend. How can I help you?
Lava Springs#032.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#033.src: Hm? The Colonel sent you? what for?
Lava Springs#033.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#034.src: ...Corrupted... lava springs...? You realize how ridiculous that sounds, yeah? Well, I completely believe you.
Lava Springs#034.dst: ...타락한... 용암 온천...? 그게 얼마나 황당하게 들리는지 알지? 뭐, 난 완전히 믿어.
Lava Springs#034.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#035.src: Right, you said lava, sooo... You need a heat resistance potion, yes?
Lava Springs#035.dst: 그래, 용암이라고 했으니까... 열 저항 물약이 필요한 거지?
Lava Springs#035.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#036.src: Welp, you're in luck, kinda... I have a potion that can resist the heat of lava, but the brew will not let you swim in lava.
Lava Springs#036.dst: 음, 운이 좋은 편이네, 그럭저럭... 용암 열기를 견디는 물약은 있는데, 용암 속에서 헤엄칠 순 없어.
Lava Springs#036.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#037.src: Oh that works, you just need to enter a borehole that goes through the lava? Perfect
Lava Springs#037.dst: 아, 그럼 되겠다. 용암을 관통하는 시추공에 들어가기만 하면 된다고? 완벽해
Lava Springs#037.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#038.src: Anyways, if you ever need any more special brews, my assistant will be happy to sell some at a very affordable price.
Lava Springs#038.dst: 아무튼 특별한 물약이 더 필요하면, 내 조수가 아주 저렴한 가격에 기꺼이 팔 거야.
Lava Springs#038.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#039.src: Now, you have somewhere to be, right? Right. Go and report to the Colonel, soldier. Tell him I said hi, by the way.
Lava Springs#039.dst: 자, 갈 데가 있지? 그렇지. 가서 대령한테 보고해, 병사. 참, 내가 안부 전하더라고 해 줘.
Lava Springs#039.speaker: Nami The Healer

Lava Springs#040.src: Report back to Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lava Springs#041.src: Report! Ya got the potion yet, soldier? Good, drink it if ya haven't already!
Lava Springs#041.dst: 보고! 물약은 구했나, 병사? 좋아, 아직 안 마셨으면 마시게!
Lava Springs#041.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#042.src: Right, that's what I like to hear! Now, LOOK TO THE LEFT SOLDIER! There is a borehole out there we dug to try and hit the source of this weed.
Lava Springs#042.dst: 그래, 바로 그거야! 자, 왼쪽을 보게, 병사! 이 잡초의 근원을 노리고 우리가 판 시추공이 저기 있네.
Lava Springs#042.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#043.src: We found a pretty damn hot cave lying underneath the surface! If ya jumped into the borehole, 'ye could probably find the source of the Corruption and stop it.
Lava Springs#043.dst: 지표 밑에 엄청나게 뜨거운 동굴이 있더군! 시추공으로 뛰어들면 타락의 근원을 찾아 막을 수 있을 걸세.
Lava Springs#043.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#044.src: Now, the roots and spikes of Corruption are very sturdy, but we ain't never seen something like lava burstin' out of the ground.
Lava Springs#044.dst: 타락의 뿌리와 가시는 아주 튼튼하지만, 땅에서 용암이 솟구치는 건 한 번도 본 적이 없네.
Lava Springs#044.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#045.src: Had a small chat with the brass, earlier. They got a hunch that there's a heart to the Corruption that's pumpin' out all the lava!
Lava Springs#045.dst: 아까 윗선과 잠깐 얘기했는데, 용암을 뿜어내는 타락의 심장이 있다고 짐작하더군!
Lava Springs#045.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#046.src: That's gotta be our ticket, yeah? If 'ye destroy that, ya should be able to stop the spread of the lava! Now, get movin'! Head into the borehole, soldier!
Lava Springs#046.dst: 그게 우리 해답이겠지, 응? 그걸 부수면 용암이 퍼지는 걸 막을 수 있을 걸세! 자, 움직여! 시추공으로 들어가, 병사!
Lava Springs#046.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lava Springs#047.src: Drink the Potion of Obsidian Skin, then enter the lava spring through the borehole at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and look for a corrupted heart
Lava Springs#047.dst: Potion of Obsidian Skin을 마시고 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 시추공으로 용암 온천에 들어가 타락한 심장을 찾으세요

Lava Springs#048.src: Tell Colonel Gailard at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] that you destroyed the heart

Lava Springs#049.src: Hah! I knew ya'd give me results! Ye're pretty damn reliable, soldier! Here, take this for your trouble!
Lava Springs#049.dst: 하! 결과를 가져올 줄 알았네! 자넨 아주 믿음직한 병사야! 자, 수고비로 이걸 받게!
Lava Springs#049.speaker: Colonel Gailard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.src: Ah, one of you adventurin' types, huh? We see a lot of you around here... Going in and out as you please. Must be a nice life.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.dst: 아, 모험가 부류로군? 이 근처에서 많이 봐... 마음대로 드나들고 말이야. 좋은 인생이겠어.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#001.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.src: Though, if you could spare some time, the town could use you-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.dst: 그래도 시간 좀 낼 수 있으면 마을에 네 도움이 필요한데-
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#002.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.src: Wait, already?! It's only been a day since last! How insatiable are they...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.dst: 잠깐, 벌써?! 지난번 뒤로 겨우 하루인데! 얼마나 굶주린 거야...?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#003.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.src: THE UNDEAD HAVE OVERWHELMED THE GOLEMS! EVERY CITIZEN FOR THEMSELVES!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.dst: 언데드가 골렘을 압도했다! 모든 시민은 각자 살아남아라!!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#004.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.src: This is what I was talking about! We need your help with this! You Wynn folk are good at killing zombies, right?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.dst: 내가 말한 게 이거야! 이 일에 네 도움이 필요해! Wynn 사람들은 좀비 잘 잡잖아, 그렇지?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#005.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.src: We need help with this! Defend the town with us!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.dst: 도움이 필요해! 우리랑 같이 마을을 지켜 줘!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#006.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.src: The horde's retreating, but we have one citizen dead! Regroup at the square and prepare the pyres!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.dst: 무리가 물러간다. 하지만 시민 한 명이 죽었다! 광장에 집결해 화장단을 준비하라!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#007.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.src: Hey! Over here, you alright? Come talk to me, I can explain what just happened.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.dst: 이봐! 이쪽이야, 괜찮아? 이리 와, 방금 무슨 일인지 설명해 줄게.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#008.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#009.src: Check in with Burtur about the attack at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.src: Phew. That was a smaller horde, thankfully... Still, good thing you were there. That could have been worse.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.dst: 휴. 다행히 이번엔 작은 무리였어... 그래도 네가 있어서 다행이야. 더 나빠질 수도 있었어.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#010.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.src: Still, c'mon now... We have to burn the bodies. Can't leave the job half-done.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.dst: 그래도, 자 가자... 시체를 태워야 해. 일을 반만 하고 둘 순 없지.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#011.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.src: It's a bit sacrilegious, but necessary to do right now- otherwise they just keep coming back, like they do across the ridge in Kander.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.dst: 좀 불경하긴 해도 지금은 꼭 해야 해- 안 그러면 능선 너머 Kander처럼 자꾸 되살아나거든.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#012.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.src: The ones around here all come up from the river, though, and since it runs right through the town, well... You can see the problem.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.dst: 그런데 이 근처 것들은 다 강에서 올라와. 그 강이 마을을 관통하니까, 뭐... 문제가 뭔지 알겠지.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#013.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.src: Since we don't live in a reeking, pockmarked plain, we have to burn the bodies so any dead don't turn right around against us.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.dst: 우린 악취 나는 곰보 평원에 사는 게 아니니까, 죽은 자가 돌아서 우릴 덮치지 않게 시체를 태워야 해.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#014.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.src: Say your goodbyes, all. Irahe will be missed. Step away from the pyre!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.dst: 다들 작별 인사를 하라. Irahe를 잊지 않겠다. 화장단에서 물러서라!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#015.speaker: Gelibord Guard

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.src: Some conspiracy theorists think that the Lazarus Pit is the issue. It's an urban legend, a well of water that can revive the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.dst: 음모론자 몇몇은 Lazarus 구덩이가 문제라고 해. 죽은 자를 되살리는 우물이라는 도시 전설이지.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#016.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.src: Supposing that it's real, it would make some sense, at least- If it started feeding into the river or water tables, then we'd get the current goings-on.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.dst: 그게 진짜라면 적어도 말은 돼- 그게 강이나 지하수로 흘러들기 시작했다면 지금 같은 일이 생기겠지.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#017.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.src: Of course, no one knows where it is, since it's just rumors, but there's supposedly an "Order" of pit-keepers. Conveniently long dead, and buried in that small graveyard just north of here.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.dst: 물론 소문일 뿐이라 어딘지 아무도 몰라. 그런데 구덩이를 지키는 "교단"이 있었대. 공교롭게도 오래전에 죽어서 바로 북쪽 작은 묘지에 묻혀 있고.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#018.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.src: It's... probably just Referick having made the rounds to any drunk who would listen a while back, but it's also our only shot. If you could give it a search, and a yay or nay?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.dst: 아마... Referick이 예전에 들어 줄 술꾼마다 붙잡고 떠든 얘기겠지만, 우리한텐 유일한 기회야. 한번 찾아보고 맞는지 아닌지 알려 줄래?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#019.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.src: I'll stay back at the town square, in case the undead attack again. Give me a shout if you find something you aren't sure about.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.dst: 난 언데드가 또 올지 모르니 마을 광장에 남을게. 확신이 안 서는 걸 찾으면 불러.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#020.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.src: Have you checked out that small graveyard north of here yet? Remember, you're looking for any clues about that Lazarus Pit "Order."
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.dst: 북쪽 작은 묘지는 가 봤어? 기억해, 그 Lazarus 구덩이 "교단"에 관한 단서를 찾는 거야.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#021.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#022.src: Find the body of the Order's mage in {p}'s graveyard at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.src: Locate the chapel mentioned by the talisman, or return to Burtur for assistance.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#023.dst: 호부이 언급한 예배당을 찾거나, Burtur에게 돌아가 도움을 청하세요.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.src: Oh, you found something? Well color me shocked that there was any stock to Referick's ranting...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.dst: 오, 뭔가 찾았어? 허, Referick의 헛소리에 조금이라도 근거가 있었다니 놀랍네...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#024.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.src: Chapel of an ancient order? There's a chapel just northwest of here. I'd say investigate that! I have to stick around here in case of another attack, but...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.dst: 옛 교단의 예배당? 바로 북서쪽에 예배당이 하나 있어. 거길 조사해 봐! 난 또 습격이 있을까 봐 여기 있어야 하지만...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#025.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.src: Any luck searching out that chapel yet? The coordinates ought to be in your content book, right?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.dst: 예배당은 좀 찾아봤어? 좌표는 콘텐츠 북에 있을 거야, 그렇지?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#026.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#027.src: Investigate the Order's chapel northwest of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.src: Solve the crypt's riddle to 'bring the water of life anew' to the graves.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#028.dst: 지하 묘실의 수수께끼를 풀어 무덤에 '생명의 물을 다시 가져오세요'.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.src: Revive the people in the tombs with the Lazarus Water and complete their tasks.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#029.dst: Lazarus Water로 무덤 속 사람들을 되살리고 그들의 부탁을 들어주세요.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.src: Ugh. And who put YOU in charge of waking me up? Where's Gwendolyn, my maid? Incompetents- she was supposed to be buried with me too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.dst: 으. 누가 너더러 날 깨우라 했지? 내 하녀 Gwendolyn은 어디 있어? 무능한 것들- 그 애도 같이 묻혔어야지!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#030.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.src: What, you want to enter the crypt? Well, prove you're better than the funeral directors and do something right! The Ghastly Ghouls around here won't stop SCREAMING!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.dst: 뭐, 지하 묘실에 들어가고 싶다고? 그럼 장의사들보다 낫다는 걸 증명해 봐! 이 근처 끔찍한 구울들이 비명을 멈추질 않아!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#031.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.src: I want them gone! Get rid of, say, {~} Ghastly Ghouls. Then perhaps I'll give you the time of day, you strange, small-nosed lookyloo!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.dst: 다 없애 버려! 그래, 끔찍한 구울 {~}마리쯤. 그러면 상대해 줄 수도 있지, 이 이상한 코 작은 구경꾼아!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#032.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.src: Agh! Stop sneaking up on me! Have you killed those {~} Ghastly Ghouls I asked you to, yet?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.dst: 으악! 몰래 다가오지 마! 내가 말한 끔찍한 구울 {~}마리는 다 죽였어?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#033.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.src: Ah, my favorite little weird-small-nosed-person! The graveyard is so lovely when it's quiet- you really did do a good job!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.dst: 아, 내가 제일 좋아하는 코 작은 괴짜로군! 묘지는 조용할 때 정말 아름답지- 정말 잘해 줬어!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#035.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.src: As important as I am, you must still check with the other graves, though you certainly have my blessing to enter.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.dst: 내가 중요하긴 해도 다른 무덤들한테도 확인해야 해. 물론 들어가는 건 내가 허락하지.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#036.speaker: Lord Plaatic the Kind

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.src: My goodness! Ah, it feels good to stretch these old bones. It's not easy being cooped up in a coffin, you know.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.dst: 세상에! 아, 이 늙은 뼈를 펴니 좋네요. 관 속에 갇혀 있는 건 쉽지 않다고요.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#037.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.src: You want to get into the crypt? I suppose I could give you a hand... figuratively, I mean. Still, need to see if you can be trusted and all...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.dst: 지하 묘실에 들어가고 싶다고요? 손을 좀 빌려 드릴 수는 있죠... 비유적으로요. 그래도 믿을 만한지 봐야겠네요...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#038.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.src: Oh, right! My dear husband gave me the most beautiful wedding band, but it became lost when I carked it. Some rude shadowy thing- See if anyone ever marries THEM!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.dst: 아, 맞다! 사랑하는 남편이 정말 아름다운 결혼반지를 줬는데 제가 죽을 때 잃어버렸어요. 웬 무례한 그림자 같은 게- 그것들이랑 누가 결혼하나 봐요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#039.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.src: Bring it back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.dst: 찾아다 줄래요? 동쪽 늙은 리치의 탑 근처에서 죽었어요. 그래 주면 기꺼이 축복을 드릴게요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#040.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.src: Bring my wedding band back, could you? I died around that old lich's tower to the east. Do that, and I'll be happy to give you my blessing!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.dst: 결혼반지를 찾아다 줄래요? 동쪽 늙은 리치의 탑 근처에서 죽었어요. 그래 주면 기꺼이 축복을 드릴게요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#041.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.src: Oh, you found it! Wonderful! Just pop it on that fingerbone right there... Ah, it fits even better on the other hand!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.dst: 오, 찾았군요! 멋져요! 거기 손가락뼈에 끼워 주세요... 아, 다른 손에 더 잘 맞네요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#043.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.src: The crypt, you say? I can offer my blessing to enter, but you'll need to check with the other tombs as well. Farewell!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.dst: 지하 묘실이요? 들어가도록 축복해 드릴 순 있지만, 다른 무덤들에게도 확인해야 해요. 잘 가요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#044.speaker: Sir Pigglesworth the Thirty-Fifth

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.src: I oughta deck you for waking me up!! Don't you realize it's RUDE to re-animate the long-dead corpse of a murderer when he's trying to get his beauty death?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.dst: 날 깨웠으니 한 대 맞아야겠다!! 살인마가 미용 죽음 중인데 오래된 시체를 되살리는 게 무례한 줄 몰라?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#045.speaker: Uggword Pollywaggon the Murderous

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.src: Greetings! Thank goodness, that dreary old tomb was simply awful. No furniture, no natural light, not even a lick of paint! So drab, the whole thing.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.dst: 안녕하세요! 다행이다, 그 음침한 무덤은 정말 끔찍했어요. 가구도 없고 햇빛도 없고 페인트칠 하나 없어요! 온통 칙칙하다니까요.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#047.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.src: What's that? You want to get into the crypt? Well, of course I can help, if you just do one teensy little thing for me?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.dst: 뭐라고요? 지하 묘실에 들어가고 싶다고요? 물론 도와드릴 수 있죠, 아주 조그만 부탁 하나만 들어주신다면요?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#048.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.src: Could you feed my cat for me? I know Mrs. Fluffles must be so lonely after all these years. My old house is just south of here, over at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], just pop some food down for her? Thank you!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.dst: 제 고양이 밥 좀 줄래요? 오랜 세월 Mrs. Fluffles가 얼마나 외로웠을까요. 옛집이 바로 남쪽 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있어요. 먹이만 좀 놓아 주세요? 고마워요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#049.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.src: Please, kind adventurer! Feed Mrs. Fluffles for me. I'm sure she's just so lonely, in that big old house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.dst: 부탁해요, 친절한 모험가님! Mrs. Fluffles에게 밥 좀 주세요. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 크고 낡은 집에서 분명 외로울 거예요
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#050.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.src: So, is Mrs. Fluffles doing alright without me? Oh, I bet she was so affectionate, always such a softie!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.dst: 그래서, Mrs. Fluffles는 저 없이도 잘 지내요? 오, 분명 애교가 넘쳤겠죠, 늘 순둥이였거든요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#053.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.src: Oh, thank you so much! I was so worried that after my death she wouldn't be okay... What a relief!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.dst: 오, 정말 고마워요! 제가 죽은 뒤로 그 애가 잘못될까 봐 걱정했어요... 다행이에요!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#054.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.src: You have my blessing to enter the crypt! Make sure to check with the other graves as well though.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.dst: 지하 묘실에 들어가도록 축복할게요! 다른 무덤들에게도 꼭 확인하세요.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#055.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.src: W-wait, Mrs. Fluffles... She was...d-dead? No... It can't be! I left her a lifetime supply of food!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.dst: 자-잠깐, Mrs. Fluffles가... 주-죽었다고요? 아니... 그럴 리 없어요! 평생 먹을 음식을 남겨 뒀는데!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#056.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.src: You! You killed Mrs. Fluffles, it's the only explanation!! HOW COULD YOU DO SUCH A THING?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.dst: 당신! 당신이 Mrs. Fluffles를 죽였군요, 그것밖에 설명이 안 돼요!! 어떻게 그런 짓을?!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#057.speaker: Poclo Wabblebuff of Gelibord

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#059.src: Investigate the crypt's inner chamber at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.src: ... the Lazarus Pi... said to bring back the dead.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.dst: ... Lazarus 구덩... 죽은 자를 되살린다 하더라.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#060.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.src: Be warned, traveller, th... not truly alive agai... were before.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.dst: 경고하노니, 여행자여... 진정 되살아난 것이 아... 예전과 같지 않으니.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#061.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.src: ... In times of great need, one can find... at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#062.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.src: But know this... use for greed or self-ga... result in... worse than death.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.dst: 그러나 명심하라... 탐욕이나 사리사욕에 쓰면... 결과는... 죽음보다 끔찍하리라.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#063.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#064.src: Find the entrance to the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.src: Follow the path to the Lazarus pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and enter the Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#065.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Lazarus 구덩이까지 길을 따라가 구덩이에 들어가세요.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#066.src: Follow the cave to find the Lazarus Pit.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.src: Find a way to block off the water pillar in the Lazarus Pit.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#067.dst: Lazarus 구덩이의 물기둥을 막을 방법을 찾으세요.

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#068.src: Tell Burtur that you have blocked off the Lazarus Pit at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.src: Ah, you're back! We were getting a tad worried about you. Were you able to figure anything out in the chapel there?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.dst: 아, 돌아왔구나! 좀 걱정하던 참이야. 그 예배당에서 뭐 좀 알아냈어?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#069.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.src: Wait, you found the Lazarus Pit? AND blocked the flow into the river? Grook feathers you humans work quick! It's only been a few hours!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.dst: 잠깐, Lazarus 구덩이를 찾았다고? 게다가 강으로 흐르는 물까지 막았어? Grook 깃털이여, 인간들 일 빠르네! 몇 시간밖에 안 됐는데!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#070.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.src: Heck, I gotta pitch in and compensate you for that hard work! I know we're not the richest, but I hope you'll accept this...other way of paying, too!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.dst: 이런, 그 고생엔 나도 보상을 해야지! 우리가 부자는 아니지만, 이... 다른 방식의 보수도 받아 주면 좋겠어!
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#071.speaker: Burtur

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.src: ...loss, but those pure of heart found... untouched by the curse, and formed this Order.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.dst: ...잃었으나, 마음이 순수한 자들은... 저주에 물들지 않았고, 이 교단을 세웠다.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#072.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.src: For worry of the misuse... waters, malicious or not, our... shall be taken to the grave.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.dst: ...물이 악용될까 두려워, 악의가 있든 없든, 우리의... 무덤까지 가져가리라.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#073.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.src: Only one apart from our... of it, and they have... secrecy, even... immmortality.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.dst: 우리 외에 오직 한 명만이... 알고 있으며, 그들은... 비밀을, 심지어... 불멸까지.
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#074.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.src: The lich, Espera... keeper of the Order. We ...an outside influence will not...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.dst: 리치 Espera... 교단의 수호자. 우리는... 외부의 영향이 결코...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#075.speaker: Old Book

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.src: Looks like there's some debris blocking the path, but perhaps you could blast it away with a spell up close?
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#076.dst: 잔해가 길을 막고 있네요. 가까이서 주문으로 날려 버리면 되지 않을까요?

Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.src: There's some kind of door over on the east side, with a hole shaped like an amulet, but I can't seem to find anything that would fit in it...
Lazarus Pit (Quest)#077.dst: 동쪽에 무슨 문이 있는데, 부적 모양의 구멍이 나 있어. 그런데 거기 맞을 만한 걸 도무지 못 찾겠어...

Lexdale Witch Trials#000.src: You should follow the creature before it gets away!
Lexdale Witch Trials#000.dst: 그 생물이 달아나기 전에 쫓아가야 해!

Lexdale Witch Trials#001.src: See what's going on in the center of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 {p} 중심가에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 확인하세요.

Lexdale Witch Trials#002.src: We have an enemy amongst our own in {p}! This witch's illegal practice of magic threatens us!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.dst: 우리 {p} 안에 적이 숨어 있었습니다! 이 마녀의 불법 마법이 우리를 위협하고 있습니다!
Lexdale Witch Trials#002.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#003.src: Ms. Amira's home was found to be plagued by spreading Decay! We must kill the witch to protect our sanctity!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.dst: Amira 씨의 집이 번져 가는 쇠락에 시달리는 게 발견됐습니다! 우리의 신성함을 지키려면 마녀를 처단해야 합니다!
Lexdale Witch Trials#003.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#004.src: WAIT! Let me GO already! I told you what was happening!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.dst: 잠깐! 이거 좀 놔! 무슨 일인지 다 말했잖아!
Lexdale Witch Trials#004.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#005.src: The deceit of your dark magic won't work, Ms. Amira. Go quietly- leave us in peace!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.dst: 당신의 어둠의 마법으로 속이려 해도 소용없습니다, Amira 씨. 조용히 가시오- 우리를 평화롭게 놔두시오!
Lexdale Witch Trials#005.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#006.src: SHUT UP ALREADY! You can't just single people out like this!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.dst: 좀 닥쳐! 이렇게 아무나 콕 집어서 몰아가면 안 되지!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#006.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#007.src: Just hear me out for a second! It's not me, something infected my home! That's the reason it was so dark!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.dst: 잠깐만 내 말 좀 들어 봐! 내가 아니라 뭔가가 우리 집을 오염시켰어! 그래서 그렇게 어두웠던 거라고!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#007.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#008.src: My basement, some outlandish thing dug into it! Wherever it went, the area withered and decayed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.dst: 우리 집 지하실에 이상한 뭔가가 파고들었어! 그게 지나간 곳마다 시들고 썩어 버렸다고!
Lexdale Witch Trials#008.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#009.src: There's proof in my house that it wasn't me! It's the one that's decayed and barren! You'll see if you LOOK, you gorehound!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.dst: 내가 아니라는 증거가 우리 집에 있어! 썩고 황폐해진 건 그 집이야! 제대로 보기만 하면 알 거야, 이 피에 굶주린 놈아!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#009.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#010.src: Quit with the insults! We'll delay for now- If there's no proof of the witch's innocence she will be executed!
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.dst: 모욕은 그만하시오! 일단 미루겠소- 마녀의 무죄를 증명할 증거가 없으면 처형하겠소!
Lexdale Witch Trials#010.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#011.src: Explore the basement of the decayed and barren house.

Lexdale Witch Trials#012.src: Follow the creature down the tunnels.

Lexdale Witch Trials#013.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#014.src: Continue to follow the creature from the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lexdale Witch Trials#015.src: ...Further... intruders...? You are not of the worms... the parasites?
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.dst: ...또... 침입자...? 너는 벌레들의... 기생충들의 무리가 아니냐?
Lexdale Witch Trials#015.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#016.src: Another stranger... You must have witnessed the tunnels. They blight the stone, wither the roots, make lifeless the land...
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.dst: 또 다른 이방인... 터널을 보았겠지. 그것들은 돌을 병들게 하고, 뿌리를 시들게 하고, 땅을 죽음으로 물들인다...
Lexdale Witch Trials#016.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#017.src: And here, we starve in isolation. My people are lost, as the very earth itself warps and shifts.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.dst: 그리고 여기서 우리는 고립된 채 굶주린다. 대지가 뒤틀리고 움직이니 내 백성은 길을 잃었다.
Lexdale Witch Trials#017.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#018.src: The water, stagnant and gray. Nothing but those horrid magic scourges, and the worms themselves to sustain ourselves.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.dst: 물은 고여 잿빛이다. 저 끔찍한 마법의 재앙들과 벌레들 말고는 먹을 것이 없다.
Lexdale Witch Trials#018.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#019.src: We cannot escape, for the sun scourges us. There is no place to go, no place to burrow that they do not wait.
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.dst: 태양이 우리를 해치니 달아날 수도 없다. 갈 곳도, 그것들이 기다리지 않는 굴도 없다.
Lexdale Witch Trials#019.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#020.src: You... You... You have life. You have a heart, and muscle, and meat... To survive till this torture ends...
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.dst: 너는... 너는... 너에겐 생명이 있다. 심장이, 근육이, 살이 있다... 이 고통이 끝날 때까지 버티려면...
Lexdale Witch Trials#020.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#023.src: Wait... These earthquakes! IT'S THEM! AGHHHHHHHHHHH!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#023.speaker: Tunnel Dweller Chieftain

Lexdale Witch Trials#024.src: Dig yourself out of the dirt. Then go after the creature.
Lexdale Witch Trials#024.dst: 흙을 파고 빠져나온 뒤, 그 생물을 쫓아가세요.

Lexdale Witch Trials#025.src: Return to {p} and try to show the mayor the creature at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Lexdale Witch Trials#025.dst: {p}(으)로 돌아가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 시장에게 그 생물을 보여 주세요.

Lexdale Witch Trials#026.src: You're back. Did- Wait, what in the nine hells is THAT?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.dst: 돌아왔군요. 혹시- 잠깐, 대체 저건 뭐요?!
Lexdale Witch Trials#026.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#027.src: That! That was the thing in my basement!! I knew that human could find it! Thank you!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.dst: 저거! 저게 우리 집 지하실에 있던 놈이야!! 저 인간이라면 찾아낼 줄 알았어! 고마워!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#027.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#028.src: That thing was spreading the decay through my house! It's NOT witches or magic like you suddenly DECIDED one day!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.dst: 저놈이 우리 집에 쇠락을 퍼뜨렸다고! 당신이 어느 날 갑자기 정해 버린 마녀나 마법 따위가 아니라!!
Lexdale Witch Trials#028.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#029.src: ...Fine then. This... creature... bug... leach? This whatever- it- is... I'll accept your explanation.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.dst: ...좋소. 이... 생물... 벌레... 거머리? 이게 뭐든 간에... 그 설명을 받아들이겠소.
Lexdale Witch Trials#029.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#030.src: Step off the podium, Ms. Amira. You're innocent.
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.dst: 연단에서 내려오시오, Amira 씨. 당신은 무죄요.
Lexdale Witch Trials#030.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#031.src: Gah, finally! You're seeing sense! It's almost like something just... took you over one day and never left 'til now!
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.dst: 아, 드디어! 이제야 정신을 차렸네! 마치 뭔가가 어느 날 당신을... 사로잡았다가 지금까지 안 떠난 것 같더라!
Lexdale Witch Trials#031.speaker: Amira

Lexdale Witch Trials#032.src: ...hm. That... Mmh. Regardless. Human, you've proven yourself to be trustworthy. We'll keep our doors open for you.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.dst: ...흠. 그건... 음. 어쨌든. 인간이여, 당신은 믿을 만하다는 걸 증명했소. 우리의 문은 늘 열려 있을 것이오.
Lexdale Witch Trials#032.speaker: The Mayor

Lexdale Witch Trials#033.src: As for the... THING... Well... I'll be sure to inform the Gavel government.
Lexdale Witch Trials#033.dst: 그... 그것에 대해서는... 뭐... Gavel 정부에 꼭 알리겠소.
Lexdale Witch Trials#033.speaker: The Mayor

Lost in the Jungle#000.src: However... He also brought with him an odd purple gemstone. Our shaman saw it as a bad omen, but I was so caught up in the celebrations, I brushed it off.
Lost in the Jungle#000.dst: 그런데 이상한 보라색 보석도 함께 가져왔어요. 주술사는 불길한 징조라 했지만, 축제 분위기에 들떠 그냥 넘겼죠.

Lost in the Jungle#001.src: Hm, I just now am seeing a strange trail on the ground... it matches the color of the gemstone! It may take you to him, please, follow it!
Lost in the Jungle#001.dst: 음... 방금 땅에서 이상한 자국을 발견했어요... 그 보석과 같은 색이에요! 아들에게 이어질지도 몰라요, 부디 따라가 주세요!

Lost in the Jungle#002.src: You should talk to Aryn now...

Lost in the Jungle#003.src: Oh... My father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with the ferocity of our own!

Lost in the Jungle#004.src: But that is beside the point. You say you have destroyed the spirit, and it does not feel tainted any longer, so I will trust you.
Lost in the Jungle#004.dst: 하지만 그건 중요한 게 아니죠. 정령을 없앴고 더는 오염된 느낌이 없다고 하시니, 당신을 믿을게요.

Lost in the Jungle#006.src: Excuse me, traveller... I am dreadfully sorry to ask this of you, but I need your help.
Lost in the Jungle#006.dst: 실례합니다, 여행자님... 이런 부탁을 드려 정말 죄송하지만, 도움이 필요해요.
Lost in the Jungle#006.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#007.src: You see, my son, Aryn. Very recently, he underwent a traditional coming-of-age ceremony from our tribe.
Lost in the Jungle#007.dst: 제 아들 Aryn이 얼마 전에 우리 부족의 전통 성인식을 치렀어요.
Lost in the Jungle#007.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#008.src: He was tasked to enter the dangerous {p}, just south of here, and brave the wilderness for three days. He returned a true man, successful.
Lost in the Jungle#008.dst: 여기 바로 남쪽의 위험한 {p}에 들어가 사흘간 야생에서 버티는 것이 과제였죠. 아이는 성공해서 진정한 남자가 되어 돌아왔어요.
Lost in the Jungle#008.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#010.src: Strange happenings began around the village. Aryn walked about at night, talking to someone, but no one else was there with him.
Lost in the Jungle#010.dst: 마을 곳곳에서 이상한 일이 생기기 시작했어요. Aryn은 밤마다 돌아다니며 누군가와 이야기했지만, 곁엔 아무도 없었어요.
Lost in the Jungle#010.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#011.src: Just last sunrise, he vanished entirely. We sent out a search for him, but even our hardiest warriors could not venture deep into the jungle.
Lost in the Jungle#011.dst: 그리고 어제 해 뜰 무렵, 아이가 완전히 사라졌어요. 수색대를 보냈지만 가장 강인한 전사들도 정글 깊이 들어가지 못했어요.
Lost in the Jungle#011.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#012.src: We returned empty-handed, having lost our newest tribesman. The village is in terrible spirits, and I feel as though I am responsible.
Lost in the Jungle#012.dst: 우리는 가장 새로운 부족원을 잃고 빈손으로 돌아왔어요. 마을 분위기는 최악이고, 전부 제 책임인 것만 같아요.
Lost in the Jungle#012.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#013.src: You Wynn warriors, however... great stories are told of your exploits. Surely, you will be able to brave the jungle, yes?
Lost in the Jungle#013.dst: 하지만 Wynn의 전사들이라면... 당신들의 활약은 대단하다고 들었어요. 분명 정글에 들어갈 수 있겠죠?
Lost in the Jungle#013.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#014.src: I beg of you, please, find my son. I do not know quite where he is, but undoubtedly he has been taken quite a ways in...
Lost in the Jungle#014.dst: 제발 부탁이에요, 제 아들을 찾아 주세요. 정확히 어디 있는지는 모르지만, 분명 꽤 깊이 끌려갔을 거예요...
Lost in the Jungle#014.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#017.src: P-please, I beg of you spirit, let me go free! The tribesmen must be so worried-
Lost in the Jungle#017.dst: 제, 제발, 정령님, 절 놓아주세요! 부족 사람들이 무척 걱정할 거예요-
Lost in the Jungle#017.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#018.src: DO NOT RESIST, BOY! YOUR BODY IS MINE. I WAS TRAPPED IN THAT STONE FOR MILLENIA, AND NOW I AM FREE.
Lost in the Jungle#018.dst: 저항하지 마라, 꼬마야! 네 몸은 내 것이다. 나는 수천 년 동안 저 돌에 갇혀 있었고, 이제 자유다.
Lost in the Jungle#018.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#019.src: Aha, I hear someone coming! Surely a tribesman here to rescue me!
Lost in the Jungle#019.dst: 아, 누가 오는 소리가 들려요! 분명 저를 구하러 온 부족 사람이에요!
Lost in the Jungle#019.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#020.src: Oh! If so, the body of this warrior will be far better suited to my needs! Grant me your power, boy! I need to thrash them first to possess them!
Lost in the Jungle#020.dst: 오! 그렇다면 이 전사의 몸이 내게 훨씬 알맞겠군! 네 힘을 내놓아라, 꼬마야! 빙의하려면 먼저 두들겨 패야 하니까!
Lost in the Jungle#020.speaker: Aryn?

Lost in the Jungle#022.src: Make sure Aryn is safe at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#023.src: Hahah, take that, evil wraith! You'll never match the power of our tribe-
Lost in the Jungle#023.dst: 하하, 이거나 먹어라, 사악한 망령아! 우리 부족의 힘은 절대 못 따라온다-
Lost in the Jungle#023.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#024.src: W-wait, you aren't part of our tribe! Who are you, why did you come here?
Lost in the Jungle#024.dst: 자, 잠깐, 당신은 우리 부족이 아니잖아요! 누구세요, 여긴 왜 왔어요?
Lost in the Jungle#024.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#025.src: Oh... my father sent you? Well, I am very impressed, Wynn warrior. You fight with ferocity of our own!
Lost in the Jungle#025.dst: 오... 아버지가 보내셨다고요? 정말 감탄했어요, Wynn의 전사님. 우리 부족 못지않게 사납게 싸우시네요!
Lost in the Jungle#025.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#026.src: I...can't say the same for myself. That spirit completely overtook me, I still can't move right now...
Lost in the Jungle#026.dst: 저는... 그렇다고 말할 수가 없네요. 그 정령에게 완전히 사로잡혀서, 아직도 몸을 못 움직이겠어요...
Lost in the Jungle#026.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#027.src: For now, please. Take away this gemstone. It caused all this, I don't want to be near such a bad luck charm.
Lost in the Jungle#027.dst: 일단 부탁드려요. 이 보석을 가져가 주세요. 이게 전부 이렇게 만든 거예요, 이런 불운의 부적 곁엔 있기 싫어요.
Lost in the Jungle#027.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#028.src: Tell the tribe that I will return on my own. I made it back once, I can do it again once I am prepared.
Lost in the Jungle#028.dst: 부족에게 제가 알아서 돌아가겠다고 전해 주세요. 한 번 돌아왔으니, 준비되면 또 해낼 수 있어요.
Lost in the Jungle#028.speaker: Aryn

Lost in the Jungle#029.src: Bring the Mysterious Gemstone to Gracen at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost in the Jungle#030.src: Oh my... Aryn was possessed by a spirit residing within the gemstone?
Lost in the Jungle#030.dst: 세상에... Aryn이 보석 속에 깃든 정령에게 빙의됐다고요?
Lost in the Jungle#030.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#031.src: How shameful... Our shaman has never been wrong before, why did I disregard his warning...
Lost in the Jungle#031.dst: 부끄럽네요... 주술사는 한 번도 틀린 적이 없는데, 제가 왜 경고를 무시했을까요...
Lost in the Jungle#031.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#033.src: Looking at it now, this is actually quite a valuable stone. If crushed to dust, it can be used in special charms we make.
Lost in the Jungle#033.dst: 지금 보니 이건 꽤 귀한 돌이네요. 가루로 빻으면 우리가 만드는 특별한 부적에 쓸 수 있어요.
Lost in the Jungle#033.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#034.src: Here, allow me to grind this down for you. You can keep the shards for whatever purposes you may find for them in the future.
Lost in the Jungle#034.dst: 자, 제가 빻아 드릴게요. 조각은 가져가서 나중에 필요한 곳에 쓰세요.
Lost in the Jungle#034.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#035.src: Our tribe, and especially myself... We thank you for your service. We shall consider you one of our own, from this day forward.
Lost in the Jungle#035.dst: 우리 부족, 그리고 특히 저는... 당신의 도움에 감사드려요. 오늘부터 당신을 우리 부족의 일원으로 여기겠어요.
Lost in the Jungle#035.speaker: Gracen

Lost in the Jungle#036.src: In fact, if you'd like, you may even enter my house here whenever you'd like.
Lost in the Jungle#036.dst: 그리고 원하시면 언제든 여기 제 집에 들어오셔도 돼요.
Lost in the Jungle#036.speaker: Gracen

Lost Royalty#001.src: Oh, hello there! I had hoped not to bother you, adventurer, but this is urgent.
Lost Royalty#001.dst: 오, 안녕하세요! 폐를 끼치고 싶진 않았지만, 급한 일이에요, 모험가님.
Lost Royalty#001.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#002.src: You see, the king is very... erm, distracted, and you are just the kind of willing, able-bodied person I need.
Lost Royalty#002.dst: 그게, 왕께서 지금... 음, 경황이 없으시고, 당신은 딱 제게 필요한 의욕 있고 튼튼한 사람이거든요.
Lost Royalty#002.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#003.src: You see, the king's son has gone missing, and with him worrying so much, the problems of the city have festered unsolved.
Lost Royalty#003.dst: 사실 왕자님이 실종되셨어요. 왕께서 걱정만 하시니 도시의 문제들은 해결되지 못하고 곪아 가고 있죠.
Lost Royalty#003.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#004.src: We believe he was kidnapped by the splinter cell mercenaries in the jungle... Unfortunate, too. They used to be quite honourable.
Lost Royalty#004.dst: 정글의 분리파 용병들에게 납치된 것 같아요... 안타깝죠. 예전엔 꽤 명예로운 자들이었는데.
Lost Royalty#004.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#005.src: Well, anyway, they're usually spotted outside the run-down farm outside of town. Go there and see what they want in return for the young prince.
Lost Royalty#005.dst: 아무튼, 그들은 주로 마을 밖 허물어진 농장 근처에서 목격돼요. 거기 가서 왕자님을 돌려주는 대가로 뭘 원하는지 알아봐 주세요.
Lost Royalty#005.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#006.src: Talk to the Mercenary Leader in their hideout outside {p}
