Lost Royalty#006.dst: {p} 외곽의 은신처에 있는 용병 대장에게 말을 거세요

Lost Royalty#007.src: Excuse me?! What are you doing here, how did you find our secret hideout?
Lost Royalty#007.dst: 뭐야?! 여기서 뭐 하는 거지, 우리 비밀 은신처는 어떻게 찾았어?
Lost Royalty#007.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#008.src: Oh, you're here for the boy? A mighty fine steal, that one! The boy won't be leaving this establishment for free. I'll need some nice loot for him.
Lost Royalty#008.dst: 오, 그 꼬마 때문에 왔나? 그 녀석은 아주 괜찮은 수확이지! 공짜로는 못 내보내. 쓸 만한 전리품을 좀 가져와야겠어.
Lost Royalty#008.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#009.src: Ah, but what to have you fetch...oh, haha! This would be a perfect opportunity to obtain that... Alright, ears open!
Lost Royalty#009.dst: 아, 근데 뭘 가져오라고 할까... 오, 하하! 그걸 손에 넣을 절호의 기회로군... 좋아, 잘 들어!
Lost Royalty#009.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#010.src: There's a certain talisman that we aren't able to get to in the temple not far from here. It has special abilities that allow my men to be strengthened, see.
Lost Royalty#010.dst: 여기서 멀지 않은 신전에 우리가 못 가져오는 호부이 하나 있어. 내 부하들을 강화해 주는 특별한 힘이 있거든.
Lost Royalty#010.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#011.src: The guardians there pack quite the punch, and there's some nasty mechanism in the way that we just can't crack.
Lost Royalty#011.dst: 거기 수호자들은 꽤 세고, 길목엔 도저히 못 뚫는 고약한 장치가 있어.
Lost Royalty#011.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#012.src: The temple is found just across the waterway, in a crevice in the mountain. It used to be blocked until those WynnExcavation fellows tried digging there.
Lost Royalty#012.dst: 신전은 수로 바로 건너편 산 틈새에 있어. 원래 막혀 있었는데 WynnExcavation 녀석들이 거길 파헤쳤지.
Lost Royalty#012.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#013.src: You get that talisman in my hands, and the king's boy is yours. Now off you pip! I'm a very busy man.
Lost Royalty#013.dst: 그 호부을 내 손에 쥐여 주면 왕자는 네 거다. 자, 어서 가! 난 아주 바쁜 사람이야.
Lost Royalty#013.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#014.src: Go to the jungle temple and retrieve the talisman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Lost Royalty#015.src: Bring the talisman back to the Mercenary Leader.

Lost Royalty#016.src: You've gotten the talisman! I can't believe you actually got through that puzzle!
Lost Royalty#016.dst: 호부을 가져왔군! 그 퍼즐을 정말 풀었다니 믿기지 않는데!
Lost Royalty#016.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#017.src: At this point I would usually keep the kid and throw you out of here, but since you've done what I've asked in such a timely fashion, he's all yours.
Lost Royalty#017.dst: 보통 이쯤이면 꼬마는 잡아 두고 널 쫓아내겠지만, 부탁한 걸 이렇게 빨리 해 줬으니 녀석은 데려가.
Lost Royalty#017.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#018.src: When you get back to whoever asked you to do this, tell him to leave my men and I alone! We guildsmen lay down our lives every day, we don't need any more hostile onlookers!
Lost Royalty#018.dst: 이 일 시킨 놈한테 돌아가거든, 나와 내 부하들 좀 내버려 두라고 전해! 우린 매일 목숨 걸고 산다고, 적대적인 구경꾼은 더 필요 없어!
Lost Royalty#018.speaker: Mercenary Leader

Lost Royalty#019.src: Talk to the Prince of {p} in the jail cell

Lost Royalty#020.src: Report back to Yavlis with the news

Lost Royalty#021.src: Ah, finally! You're back. Did they let you bring him back? Those mercenaries have an awful habit of failing to honour their deals.
Lost Royalty#021.dst: 아, 드디어! 돌아오셨군요. 왕자님을 데려가게 해 줬나요? 그 용병들은 약속을 안 지키는 고약한 버릇이 있거든요.
Lost Royalty#021.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#022.src: Wait, the prince said what? He truly wants to be a mercenary? Oh my... then he must have escaped on his own.
Lost Royalty#022.dst: 잠깐, 왕자님이 뭐라고요? 정말 용병이 되고 싶으시대요? 세상에... 그럼 스스로 도망치신 거군요.
Lost Royalty#022.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#023.src: Alright then, if that's the path the king's son chooses to walk, then there's nothing we can do.
Lost Royalty#023.dst: 그래요, 그게 왕자님이 택한 길이라면 우리가 어쩔 수 없죠.
Lost Royalty#023.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#024.src: I can only hope that he chose to join them out of a will to protect the people, rather than simply brutishness or money.
Lost Royalty#024.dst: 단순한 폭력이나 돈이 아니라, 백성을 지키려는 마음으로 합류하셨기를 바랄 뿐이에요.
Lost Royalty#024.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Royalty#025.src: Such a shame that old guild has stooped to such a level. Well, we must thank you for your help. You can have the emerald ransom we had intended to pay.
Lost Royalty#025.dst: 그 오래된 길드가 이렇게까지 타락하다니 안타깝네요. 아무튼 도와주셔서 감사해요. 몸값으로 준비한 에메랄드를 드릴게요.
Lost Royalty#025.speaker: Yavlis

Lost Soles#000.src: Talk to Ferndor at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], make sure to bring Abysso Galoshes with you.
Lost Soles#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 Ferndor에게 말을 거세요. Abysso Galoshes를 꼭 가져가세요.

Lost Soles#001.src: Have you seen boots called Abysso Galoshes on your journey, a pirate stole them from us years ago! I could reward you if you could bring me the Abysso Galoshes and help us!
Lost Soles#001.dst: 여행 중에 Abysso Galoshes라는 부츠를 본 적 있나요? 몇 년 전 해적이 우리에게서 훔쳐 갔어요! Abysso Galoshes를 가져와 도와주시면 보답할게요!
Lost Soles#001.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#002.src: Bring back Abysso Galoshes, received during the quest Beneath the Depths.
Lost Soles#002.dst: 퀘스트 Beneath the Depths에서 받은 Abysso Galoshes를 가져오세요.

Lost Soles#003.src: I see you have the infamous galoshes with you. But do you know even half of the story of them?
Lost Soles#003.dst: 그 악명 높은 부츠를 가지고 계시군요. 하지만 그 이야기를 절반이라도 아세요?
Lost Soles#003.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#004.src: The boots were once owned by my ancestors, who decided to lock it away in this manor years ago.
Lost Soles#004.dst: 그 부츠는 원래 제 조상들의 것이었는데, 몇 년 전 이 저택에 봉인하기로 했죠.
Lost Soles#004.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#005.src: Nobody knows why they decided to hide the boots just after they got into my family's hands. I was told they were acquired from a strange man with pale grey skin.
Lost Soles#005.dst: 가문 손에 들어오자마자 왜 부츠를 숨겼는지는 아무도 몰라요. 잿빛 피부를 한 이상한 남자에게서 얻었다고만 들었어요.
Lost Soles#005.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#006.src: We think they hid the boots in some kind of basement in the manor. You can get to it by following the river to the waterfall, but you will need some kind of code to open it...
Lost Soles#006.dst: 저택 어딘가의 지하실에 숨긴 것 같아요. 강을 따라 폭포까지 가면 되지만, 열려면 무슨 암호가 필요할 거예요...
Lost Soles#006.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#007.src: I remember Grandon saying that he found a book which is apparently a diary from one of my ancestors. Ever since that filthy pirate raided our home and stole our treasures, weird things have been happening.
Lost Soles#007.dst: Grandon이 제 조상 중 한 분의 일기로 보이는 책을 찾았다고 했어요. 그 더러운 해적이 우리 집을 털고 보물을 훔쳐 간 뒤로 이상한 일들이 벌어지고 있어요.
Lost Soles#007.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#008.src: Grandon should already have finished reading it. If I allow you to enter my home, would you talk to him?
Lost Soles#008.dst: Grandon은 벌써 다 읽었을 거예요. 집에 들어가게 해 드리면 그와 이야기해 주실래요?
Lost Soles#008.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#009.src: There are strange things going on in this mansion and I hope that book reveals everything we need to know...
Lost Soles#009.dst: 이 저택에서 이상한 일이 벌어지고 있어요. 그 책에 우리가 알아야 할 모든 게 담겨 있으면 좋겠네요...
Lost Soles#009.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#010.src: I almost forgot to give you your boots back, I am not sure if I want to have them near me. Remember, it is imperative you find the {~} digit code to the basement.
Lost Soles#010.dst: 부츠 돌려드리는 걸 깜빡할 뻔했네요, 제 곁에 두고 싶진 않거든요. 꼭 지하실의 {~}자리 암호를 찾아야 해요.
Lost Soles#010.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#011.src: Visit the mansion dining room and ask Grandon about the book
Lost Soles#011.dst: 저택 식당에 가서 Grandon에게 책에 대해 물어보세요

Lost Soles#012.src: Ferndor sent you here, correct? That must mean you’re here to help find the hidden {~} digit code in the manor.
Lost Soles#012.dst: Ferndor가 보냈죠? 그럼 저택에 숨겨진 {~}자리 암호를 찾는 걸 도와주러 오신 거군요.
Lost Soles#012.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#013.src: The book is actually a diary written by our ancestors decades ago. It is actually very interesting, how they remodeled almost the whole house.
Lost Soles#013.dst: 그 책은 사실 수십 년 전 조상들이 쓴 일기예요. 집을 거의 통째로 개조한 이야기가 정말 흥미롭죠.
Lost Soles#013.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#014.src: Ferndor probably told you about the boots, right? The diary has some information about them...ah, here, on this page.
Lost Soles#014.dst: Ferndor가 부츠 얘기를 했죠? 일기에 그에 관한 내용이 좀 있어요... 아, 여기, 이 페이지요.
Lost Soles#014.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#015.src: Here...our family bought them from "a dark and mysterious humanoid creature" a long time ago.
Lost Soles#015.dst: 여기... 우리 가문은 오래전 "어둡고 수상한 인간형 생물"에게서 그걸 샀대요.
Lost Soles#015.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#016.src: The boots were apparently so valuable that the creature as part of the deal, said they put some kind of spell on them, but that was a lie.
Lost Soles#016.dst: 부츠가 워낙 귀해서, 그 생물은 거래 조건으로 무슨 주문을 걸어 뒀다고 했는데, 그건 거짓말이었어요.
Lost Soles#016.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#017.src: It was found that the boots themselves were horrendously powerful, imbued with dark magic that will deteriorate and decay everything around it over time.
Lost Soles#017.dst: 알고 보니 부츠 자체가 무시무시하게 강력했어요. 시간이 지나며 주변 모든 걸 썩게 하는 어둠의 마법이 깃들어 있었죠.
Lost Soles#017.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#018.src: They were given a special boot container with similar effects, but when the Galoshes are within the Container, they cancel each others' effects out.
Lost Soles#018.dst: 비슷한 효과를 지닌 특별한 부츠 보관함도 함께 받았는데, Galoshes를 보관함에 넣으면 서로의 효과가 상쇄돼요.
Lost Soles#018.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#019.src: They hid the boots in the mansion, along with the case. The writer of this diary wrote down some hints as to how to get them, maybe you can find out what they mean. Here, try this one:
Lost Soles#019.dst: 그들은 부츠를 보관함과 함께 저택에 숨겼어요. 일기를 쓴 사람이 찾는 법에 대한 힌트를 남겼는데, 무슨 뜻인지 알아내실지도요. 자, 이것부터 보세요:
Lost Soles#019.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#020.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way".
Lost Soles#020.dst: "홀 위의 얼굴이 가진 코가 더 무거워져야 길이 열린다".
Lost Soles#020.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#021.src: Hmm, all the hints appear in a chapter about this room, the dining hall. Any idea what this meant? It feels like it should be obvious, but I can't for the life of me figure this out.
Lost Soles#021.dst: 음, 힌트는 전부 이 방, 식당에 관한 장에 나와요. 무슨 뜻인지 아시겠어요? 뻔할 것 같은데 저는 도무지 모르겠어요.
Lost Soles#021.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#022.src: "The face above the hall owns the nose that needs to be heavier to open the way"
Lost Soles#022.dst: "홀 위의 얼굴이 가진 코가 더 무거워져야 길이 열린다"

Lost Soles#023.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings

Lost Soles#024.src: A room hidden underneath the big head? Why didn't I think of that!? I always wondered how self-centered they had to be to put that in, but who knew it actually had a valid purpose!
Lost Soles#024.dst: 큰 머리 밑에 숨겨진 방이요? 왜 그 생각을 못 했지!? 저걸 달아 놓다니 얼마나 자기중심적인가 했는데, 진짜 쓸모가 있었네요!
Lost Soles#024.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#025.src: So, there was a sign telling you to look for stone in the corner? Hm...intriguing!
Lost Soles#025.dst: 그럼 구석에서 돌을 찾으라는 표지판이 있었다고요? 흠... 흥미롭네요!
Lost Soles#025.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#026.src: Whoever placed down that sign might have a secret way up to the second floor. It hasn't been accessible for a fairly long while, not since the stairs collapsed. Except for Leacen, but she's a bit crazy...
Lost Soles#026.dst: 그 표지판을 둔 사람은 2층으로 가는 비밀 통로를 알지도 몰라요. 계단이 무너진 뒤로 꽤 오래 못 올라갔거든요. Leacen만 빼고요, 그 애는 좀 이상해서...
Lost Soles#026.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#027.src: Anyway, seems they guessed that we would have to search for a way to return the boots, and made preparations. Good thing, that.
Lost Soles#027.dst: 아무튼 조상들은 우리가 부츠를 돌려놓을 방법을 찾게 될 걸 예상하고 준비해 둔 것 같네요. 다행이에요.
Lost Soles#027.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#028.src: As I said, the stairs are all broken. I mean, I certainly couldn't climb up those rotten scraps of wood. Suppose it might be best to look for that stone, hm?
Lost Soles#028.dst: 말했듯이 계단은 다 부서졌어요. 저는 그 썩은 나무 조각을 타고 절대 못 올라가요. 그 돌을 찾는 게 제일 나을 것 같죠?
Lost Soles#028.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#029.src: But where could it be...oh? Is this a hint? I just noticed this on the next page.
Lost Soles#029.dst: 그런데 어디 있을까... 오? 이게 힌트인가? 다음 페이지에서 방금 발견했어요.
Lost Soles#029.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#030.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret".
Lost Soles#030.dst: "색이 다른 카펫이 식탁의 비밀을 드러낼 돌을 알려 주리라".
Lost Soles#030.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#031.src: "The carpet of different colour will show you the stone to reveal the tables secret"
Lost Soles#031.dst: "색이 다른 카펫이 식탁의 비밀을 드러낼 돌을 알려 주리라"

Lost Soles#032.src: Talk to Grandon and tell him about your findings

Lost Soles#033.src: Sheesh! Quite the engineers, these old fellows! Never would've imagined any of this in the house. Anyway, was there a message? What did it say?
Lost Soles#033.dst: 세상에! 옛 조상들, 대단한 기술자였네요! 집에 이런 게 있을 줄은 상상도 못 했어요. 그래서, 메시지가 있었나요? 뭐라고 써 있었어요?
Lost Soles#033.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#034.src: The hole nobody wanted? He can only mean the little rat hole in the back part of this hall. Though, it's more just a hole anymore, all the rats are gone.
Lost Soles#034.dst: 아무도 원치 않은 구멍? 이 홀 뒤쪽의 작은 쥐구멍밖에 없어요. 쥐가 다 사라져서 이젠 그냥 구멍이지만요.
Lost Soles#034.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#035.src: Well, details, details. We never checked it any more than just laying mouse traps, so I suppose there could be something in there given how complex these contraptions have been.
Lost Soles#035.dst: 뭐, 사소한 건 넘어가죠. 쥐덫 놓는 것 말고는 제대로 본 적이 없으니, 이 장치들이 이렇게 복잡한 걸 보면 뭔가 있을지도요.
Lost Soles#035.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#036.src: I would say, you look into the hole and then search on top of the blue flags!
Lost Soles#036.dst: 구멍 안을 살펴보고 파란 깃발 위를 찾아보세요!
Lost Soles#036.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#037.src: But if that's the way up to the second floor, what does the diary mean by this?
Lost Soles#037.dst: 그런데 그게 2층으로 가는 길이라면, 일기의 이 말은 무슨 뜻일까요?
Lost Soles#037.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#038.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"? Wait, that probably means the code to the basement! Come back to me at once when you've done that, I have more to tell you!
Lost Soles#038.dst: "벽의 지도 뒤로 무언가를 던지면 암호 한 조각이 드러난다"? 잠깐, 아마 지하실 암호 얘기일 거예요! 하고 나면 바로 돌아오세요, 더 할 얘기가 있어요!
Lost Soles#038.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#039.src: "Throw something behind the map on the wall to uncover a piece of the code"
Lost Soles#039.dst: "벽의 지도 뒤로 무언가를 던지면 암호 한 조각이 드러난다"

Lost Soles#040.src: You found a piece of the code!? Hahah, excellent! I must say, you've made more progress in a few minutes than I have in a few years! You humans really are something!
Lost Soles#040.dst: 암호 한 조각을 찾았다고요!? 하하, 훌륭해요! 몇 분 만에 제가 몇 년 걸려 한 것보다 더 해내셨네요! 인간들은 정말 대단해요!
Lost Soles#040.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#041.src: Now, the diary now says you must make your way to the second floor to find the other {~} digits of the code.
Lost Soles#041.dst: 이제 일기에 따르면 나머지 {~}자리 암호를 찾으려면 2층으로 가야 해요.
Lost Soles#041.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#042.src: Remember, to get up to the second floor you need to use the button in the rat hole to open the passage above the blue flags hanging from the ceiling.
Lost Soles#042.dst: 기억하세요, 2층에 가려면 쥐구멍 안의 버튼으로 천장에 걸린 파란 깃발 위의 통로를 열어야 해요.
Lost Soles#042.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#043.src: It doesn't say where they are, just that they're well hidden and that there are additional clues around the house. The other {~} digits should all be up there on the second floor! Maybe Leacen has seen something about them while she's been up there, as well.
Lost Soles#043.dst: 어디 있는지는 안 써 있고, 잘 숨겨져 있으며 집 곳곳에 단서가 더 있다고만 해요. 나머지 {~}자리는 전부 2층에 있을 거예요! Leacen이 위에 있을 때 뭔가 봤을지도 몰라요.
Lost Soles#043.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#044.src: Once you've found the whole code, head to the basement. Just follow the path and signs outside the manor once you have it.
Lost Soles#044.dst: 암호를 전부 찾으면 지하실로 가세요. 찾고 나면 저택 밖의 길과 표지판만 따라가면 돼요.
Lost Soles#044.speaker: Grandon

Lost Soles#045.src: Open the secret passage above the flags by reaching into the unwanted hole
Lost Soles#045.dst: 아무도 원치 않은 구멍에 손을 넣어 깃발 위의 비밀 통로를 여세요

Lost Soles#046.src: Bring back [{~} Boot Container] and [Abysso Galoshes] to Ferndor

Lost Soles#047.src: Darn, I thought for sure one of these books would open a secret shelf...oh, heya Humie. Did you manage to climb up the stairs too?
Lost Soles#047.dst: 에이, 이 책들 중 하나는 분명 비밀 책장을 열 줄 알았는데... 오, 안녕 인간. 너도 계단 타고 올라왔어?
Lost Soles#047.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#048.src: Oh wow, a secret passage! Not as impressive as gettin' to climb the way up, but still nice job! I'm guessing that you're looking for the code hints?
Lost Soles#048.dst: 와, 비밀 통로네! 기어 올라오는 것만큼 멋지진 않지만 그래도 잘했어! 암호 힌트 찾는 중이지?
Lost Soles#048.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#049.src: Yeah, I've been trying for a while too. I thought I was on to somethin' a couple of times, too! Like in here. Not one of these books opens a secret passage, can you believe it?
Lost Soles#049.dst: 응, 나도 한참 찾고 있었어. 몇 번은 뭔가 알아낸 줄 알았다니까! 여기처럼. 이 책들 중 비밀 통로 여는 게 하나도 없다니, 믿겨져?
Lost Soles#049.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#050.src: Plus, I lost my notebook, so I can't even write down my notes. I just put it on the pillow for two seconds, and then it disappeared!
Lost Soles#050.dst: 게다가 공책을 잃어버려서 메모도 못 해. 베개 위에 딱 2초 올려놨는데 사라졌다니까!
Lost Soles#050.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#051.src: Tell you what, Humie. You help us out, and I'll give you some information you might be interested in hearing. Sound good to you?
Lost Soles#051.dst: 이렇게 하자, 인간. 우리를 도와주면 네가 솔깃할 만한 정보를 알려 줄게. 어때?
Lost Soles#051.speaker: Leacen

Lost Soles#052.src: On the upper floor are some bedrooms, and a spiral staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. Head to the top of the staircase, which will take you to the roof of the manor. The sign can be found at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], at the edge of the roof, and says "{~} is the first".
Lost Soles#052.dst: 위층에는 침실 몇 개와 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 시작하는 나선 계단이 있습니다. 계단 꼭대기로 가면 저택 지붕이 나옵니다. 표지판은 지붕 가장자리 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있으며 "{~} is the first"라고 적혀 있습니다.
Lost Soles#052.speaker: First Digit

Lost Soles#053.src: The second digit's sign is the one you find in stage {~}, revealing that the second digit is {~} when you throw any item into the map near Grandon.
Lost Soles#053.dst: 두 번째 숫자의 표지판은 {~}단계에서 찾은 것으로, Grandon 근처 지도에 아무 아이템이나 던지면 두 번째 숫자가 {~}임을 알려 줍니다.
Lost Soles#053.speaker: Second Digit

Lost Soles#054.src: On the second floor, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], there is an iron door with a button next to it. Press the button to open the door and enter the small room; you should find a sign which reads "He told us that the blue flowers are special...". Back in the area outside the iron door, there is one blue flower on a high shelf next to a button at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The button opens up a ladder leading to a bedroom in the corner of the room, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]. The third sign is on the wall of the room the ladder leads to, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and says "{~} is the third".
Lost Soles#054.dst: 2층 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 옆에 버튼이 달린 철문이 있습니다. 버튼을 눌러 문을 열고 작은 방에 들어가면 "He told us that the blue flowers are special..."이라고 적힌 표지판이 있습니다. 철문 밖으로 돌아가면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 버튼 옆 높은 선반에 파란 꽃이 한 송이 있습니다. 이 버튼을 누르면 방 구석 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 침실로 이어지는 사다리가 열립니다. 세 번째 표지판은 사다리로 이어지는 방의 벽 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있으며 "{~} is the third"라고 적혀 있습니다.
Lost Soles#054.speaker: Third Digit

Lost Soles#055.src: On the third floor is a staircase that starts at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and leads to a walkway crossing over a hallway. Jumping off the walkway through a gap in the railings on the north side, you can get into a small hole with a sign saying "He always hid something underneath his pillow...". Drop back down to the Master Bedroom at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], and, as the clue suggests, throw an emerald on the pillow. This opens up a small room behind a high shelf, at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], leading to the final sign, which says "{~} is the fourth". Note that if you aren't quick enough to get into the room, you can throw an emerald over to the pillow while standing on top of the shelf.
Lost Soles#055.dst: 3층에는 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 시작해 복도 위를 가로지르는 통로로 이어지는 계단이 있습니다. 통로 북쪽 난간의 틈으로 뛰어내리면 "He always hid something underneath his pillow..."라고 적힌 표지판이 있는 작은 구멍에 들어갈 수 있습니다. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 안방으로 내려가 단서대로 베개 위에 에메랄드를 던지세요. 그러면 높은 선반 뒤 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 작은 방이 열리고, 마지막 표지판에 "{~} is the fourth"라고 적혀 있습니다. 방에 제때 들어가지 못했다면 선반 위에 서서 베개 쪽으로 에메랄드를 던져도 됩니다.
Lost Soles#055.speaker: Fourth Digit

Lost Soles#056.src: You found the container? I wish I would have gone with you...
Lost Soles#056.dst: 보관함을 찾으셨어요? 저도 같이 갈 걸 그랬네요...
Lost Soles#056.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#057.src: At least we can stop the manor's slow decay! Let me just put the boots into the container...
Lost Soles#057.dst: 적어도 저택이 서서히 썩어 가는 건 막을 수 있겠어요! 부츠를 보관함에 넣어 볼게요...
Lost Soles#057.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#058.src: That was easy. I still can not believe that such a small thing can cause so much trouble.
Lost Soles#058.dst: 간단하네요. 이렇게 작은 물건이 그렇게 많은 문제를 일으켰다니 아직도 믿기지 않아요.
Lost Soles#058.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#059.src: Well, I can not just let you stand there without a reward, right?
Lost Soles#059.dst: 자, 보상도 없이 그냥 서 계시게 할 순 없죠?
Lost Soles#059.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Soles#060.src: Here, how about some emeralds, and these boots? They're heirlooms given to my family by the Sodeta Guild who once owned this mansion. I promise they aren’t evil! Feel free to visit us at any time!
Lost Soles#060.dst: 여기, 에메랄드 좀 받으시고, 이 부츠도요. 한때 이 저택을 소유했던 Sodeta 길드가 우리 가문에 준 가보예요. 사악하지 않다고 약속해요! 언제든 놀러 오세요!
Lost Soles#060.speaker: Ferndor

Lost Tower#000.src: Hey, adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#000.dst: 안녕하세요, 모험가님! 잠깐 도와주실 수 있나요? 곤란한 일이 좀 생겼거든요.

Lost Tower#001.src: A long time ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#001.dst: 오래전 {p}이(가) 파괴되기 전, 우리 가문엔 강대한 힘을 지닌 장소와 존재에 대한 지식이 담긴 꽤 흥미로운 책이 있었어요.

Lost Tower#003.src: Hey adventurer! Would you mind helping me for a second? I have a bit of a problem on my hands.
Lost Tower#003.dst: 안녕하세요, 모험가님! 잠깐 도와주실 수 있나요? 곤란한 일이 좀 생겼거든요.
Lost Tower#003.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#004.src: A while ago, before {p} was destroyed, my family used to own quite an interesting book, that held knowledge of places and beings of great power.
Lost Tower#004.dst: 오래전 {p}이(가) 파괴되기 전, 우리 가문엔 강대한 힘을 지닌 장소와 존재에 대한 지식이 담긴 꽤 흥미로운 책이 있었어요.
Lost Tower#004.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#005.src: Unfortunately, a creature stole it from them during the attack that led to the destruction of {p}, and no one has seen it since.
Lost Tower#005.dst: 안타깝게도 {p}을(를) 파괴한 습격 때 어떤 생물이 그 책을 훔쳐 갔고, 그 뒤로 아무도 본 적이 없어요.
Lost Tower#005.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#006.src: If you are willing to help, bring me [{~} Book of the Bones], I believe this book is now between the hands of skeletons, in an old tower in {p}.
Lost Tower#006.dst: 도와주실 거라면 [{~} Book of the Bones]를 가져다주세요. 지금은 {p}의 오래된 탑에 있는 해골들 손에 있을 거예요.
Lost Tower#006.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#007.src: See if you can find this tower, one of the skeletons probably has the book somewhere in there.
Lost Tower#007.dst: 그 탑을 찾아보세요. 아마 안에 있는 해골 중 하나가 책을 가지고 있을 거예요.
Lost Tower#007.speaker: Laen

Lost Tower#008.src: Find the lost tower in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Lost Tower#009.src: Find the book in the tower, and bring it back to Laen.

Lost Tower#010.src: Bring back the book to Laen.

Lost Tower#011.src: Great! This will be very interesting to read, thank you!
Lost Tower#011.dst: 좋아요! 정말 흥미롭게 읽을 수 있겠어요, 고마워요!
Lost Tower#011.speaker: Laen

Maltic's Well#000.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of much importance to you humans, being a villager settlement, but...my son!

similar.text: New Quest Started: {p} Trouble

Maltic's Well#002.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!

similar.text: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!

Maltic's Well#003.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The... the Beast-That-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!!

Maltic's Well#004.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing this cowl, and have warts.

Maltic's Well#005.src: I cannot thank you enough for your help!

Maltic's Well#006.src: Talk to Rynend located in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Maltic's Well#007.src: Please help us! We called for a {p} guard days ago, but Humans tend to forget this little village.
Maltic's Well#007.dst: 제발 도와주세요! 며칠 전 {p} 경비병을 불렀는데, 인간들은 이 작은 마을을 잊곤 하죠.
Maltic's Well#007.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#008.src: Last week, an evil witch found refuge in our old well. Normally this wouldn't be a problem...
Maltic's Well#008.dst: 지난주에 사악한 마녀가 우리 오래된 우물에 숨어들었어요. 보통이라면 문제될 게 없는데...
Maltic's Well#008.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#009.src: But she's lured my child into the well! My only child! He was born in Wynn, that makes him a Wynn citizen!
Maltic's Well#009.dst: 그 마녀가 제 아이를 우물로 꾀어 들였어요! 하나뿐인 아이를요! Wynn에서 태어났으니 그 애도 Wynn 시민이에요!
Maltic's Well#009.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#010.src: Please do something! I know {p} isn't of importance to you humans, being a Villager settlement, but...my son!
Maltic's Well#010.dst: 제발 어떻게 좀 해 주세요! 주민 마을인 {p}이(가) 인간들에겐 중요하지 않다는 건 알지만... 제 아들이!
Maltic's Well#010.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#011.src: Investigate the old {p} well at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle] to Rynend
Maltic's Well#011.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 오래된 {p} 우물을 조사하고 [{~} Witch's Empty Bottle]을(를) Rynend에게 가져가세요

Maltic's Well#012.src: Help me! Someone! The witch is being mean!!
Maltic's Well#012.dst: 살려 주세요! 누구 없어요! 마녀가 못되게 굴어요!!
Maltic's Well#012.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#013.src: I wondered when they'd send the famous {p} guards. You'll never get me!
Maltic's Well#013.dst: 그 유명한 {p} 경비병은 언제 보내나 했지. 절대 날 못 잡을걸!
Maltic's Well#013.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#014.src: I don't know why they call me a witch. Magic is everywhere, you know. This one's father made fun of my looks, so I'll turn his son into a Grook!
Maltic's Well#014.dst: 왜 날 마녀라고 부르는지 모르겠어. 마법은 어디에나 있다고. 이 애 아빠가 내 외모를 놀렸으니, 아들을 Grook으로 만들어 주지!
Maltic's Well#014.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#015.src: Treat me like a witch, I'll act like one, darn it! You'll have to pass through my dastardly magical defenses to find me!
Maltic's Well#015.dst: 날 마녀 취급하면 마녀처럼 굴어 주겠어, 젠장! 날 찾으려면 내 사악한 마법 방어를 통과해야 할 거다!
Maltic's Well#015.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#016.src: Oh...drat. I never could get that spell right. Well, now you'll have to guess the way, um, you fool! Turn back now, for, uh...
Maltic's Well#016.dst: 오... 이런. 그 주문은 한 번도 제대로 된 적이 없어. 그, 그럼 길을 알아서 맞혀 봐, 이 바보야! 지금 돌아가, 왜냐하면, 어...
Maltic's Well#016.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#017.src: ...for if you choose the wrong door, you'll be sent to a beast, a beast most foul! The, um...the Beast-What-Eats-{p}-Guards-For-Brunch!! Totally!
Maltic's Well#017.dst: ...잘못된 문을 고르면 짐승에게 보내지니까, 아주 흉악한 짐승! 그, 음... {p} 경비병을 브런치로 먹는 짐승!! 진짜로!
Maltic's Well#017.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#018.src: Oh...didn't think that'd fool you. You know, I'm really not all that good at magic. I just like wearing pointy hats, and have warts.
Maltic's Well#018.dst: 오... 이건 안 통할 줄 알았어. 사실 나 마법 별로 못해. 그냥 뾰족한 모자 쓰는 게 좋고, 사마귀가 있을 뿐이야.
Maltic's Well#018.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#019.src: Maybe if the people of this village weren't so mean to me, I wouldn't have been forced to live here.
Maltic's Well#019.dst: 이 마을 사람들이 나한테 그렇게 못되게 굴지만 않았어도, 이런 데서 살 수밖에 없진 않았을 거야.
Maltic's Well#019.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#020.src: I know it's a crime, but his father and the rest of the villagers here hunt me like I'm a rabid dog!
Maltic's Well#020.dst: 범죄인 건 알지만, 이 애 아빠랑 다른 주민들이 날 미친개처럼 사냥하잖아!
Maltic's Well#020.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#021.src: I wasn't really going to turn this boy into a Grook. I doubt I could even make him grow one feather. I mean, watch...
Maltic's Well#021.dst: 진짜로 이 애를 Grook으로 만들 생각은 없었어. 깃털 하나도 못 자라게 할걸. 봐 봐...
Maltic's Well#021.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#023.src: ...oh my gosh it worked???? It worked, I did a spell for once in my miserable life!!
Maltic's Well#023.dst: ...세상에 됐어???? 됐다, 이 비참한 인생에 처음으로 주문을 성공했어!!
Maltic's Well#023.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#024.src: W-Wait, that's not good at all, you're gonna... No! You won't take me out of here alive!
Maltic's Well#024.dst: 자, 잠깐, 이건 전혀 안 좋잖아, 너 이제... 안 돼! 날 산 채로 못 데려갈 거야!
Maltic's Well#024.speaker: Witch

Maltic's Well#025.src: Thank you for saving me from the witch... She was nice at first and made me cookies, but I want to go home now.
Maltic's Well#025.dst: 마녀한테서 구해 줘서 고마워요... 처음엔 착해서 쿠키도 만들어 줬는데, 이제 집에 가고 싶어요.
Maltic's Well#025.speaker: Child

Maltic's Well#026.src: Oh my son! What happened down there? Erh, not a witch, you say?
Maltic's Well#026.dst: 오, 내 아들! 거기서 무슨 일이 있었나요? 에, 마녀가 아니라고요?
Maltic's Well#026.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#027.src: Preposterous! She wore a hat and had warts! I guess it's too late now... Thank you so much for your help.
Maltic's Well#027.dst: 말도 안 돼요! 모자를 쓰고 사마귀도 있었다고요! 이제 와서는 늦었겠죠... 도와주셔서 정말 고마워요.
Maltic's Well#027.speaker: Rynend

Maltic's Well#028.src: I have very little to offer you as reward... I hope my appreciation will be more than enough!
Maltic's Well#028.dst: 보답으로 드릴 게 별로 없어요... 제 감사한 마음으로 충분하길 바라요!
Maltic's Well#028.speaker: Rynend

Master Piece#000.src: Look in your content book! I wrote the locations of the legendary creatures.

Master Piece#001.src: This is...just a normal cow. This is supposed to be legendary?

Master Piece#002.src: ...Caissop seemed to be looking forward to this painting a lot...

Master Piece#003.src: ...well, if he's blind, maybe you can fudge the details to give him something better.

Master Piece#006.src: That sounds like a villager to you.

Master Piece#007.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he'll buy it.

Master Piece#008.src: This is just a normal sheep! Are none of these supposed creatures really legendary?

Master Piece#009.src: You'll need to lie about something to make a mundane sheep seem special...

Master Piece#010.src: It has large horns- no, say it's just one.

Master Piece#011.src: Clean white wool, instead of black...

Master Piece#012.src: A pure white sheep with one horn...?

Master Piece#013.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully that's good enough for him.

Master Piece#014.src: Snowy white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!

Master Piece#015.src: ...OH, NO, NO. YES! MORE COLOUR, MORE PAINT! I'M OUT OF RED!
Master Piece#015.dst: ... 오, 아니, 아니. 그래! 색을 더, 물감을 더! 빨강이 떨어졌어!

Master Piece#016.src: The creatures guarding these animals seem more legendary to you.

Master Piece#017.src: No way you can describe a pig fantastically. You'll have to outright make something up...

Master Piece#018.src: Pink is fine, it's a rare color...

Master Piece#019.src: ...what if you say it has wings?

Master Piece#020.src: Will he believe a flying pig?

Master Piece#021.src: Time to head back to Caissop. Hopefully he won't be able to tell something's amiss.

Master Piece#022.src: Talk to Caissop the artist, in his tent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#022.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 천막에 있는 화가 Caissop에게 말을 거세요

Master Piece#024.src: Oh sorry, I didn't notice you. Did you want an autograph?
Master Piece#024.dst: 아, 미안, 못 봤네. 사인 받으러 왔나?
Master Piece#024.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#025.src: Wait, no? Don't you know who I am?! It seems like you have no taste in art... I am Caissop, the legendary artist!
Master Piece#025.dst: 잠깐, 아니라고? 내가 누군지 몰라?! 예술 보는 눈이 없구먼... 난 Caissop, 전설의 화가라고!
Master Piece#025.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#026.src: Though, since you are not a fan... Perhaps you can help me? I am looking for a new assistant.
Master Piece#026.dst: 그래도 팬이 아니라니... 날 좀 도와주겠나? 새 조수를 구하고 있거든.
Master Piece#026.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#027.src: Excellent... I need your help to find three legendary creatures that are hiding in caves around the swamp.
Master Piece#027.dst: 훌륭해... 늪 주변 동굴에 숨어 있는 전설의 생물 세 마리를 찾는 걸 도와줘.
Master Piece#027.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#028.src: I actually know their location, but unfortunately, I am...blind.
Master Piece#028.dst: 사실 위치는 알고 있는데, 안타깝게도 난... 앞을 못 봐.
Master Piece#028.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#029.src: For me to do my work I need to imagine them! That's where you come in. I need you to find them and describe them to me!
Master Piece#029.dst: 작업을 하려면 그것들을 상상해야 해! 그래서 자네가 필요한 거야. 찾아가서 어떻게 생겼는지 설명해 줘!
Master Piece#029.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#030.src: Would you turn your back on a blind man?! I need you to give me an accurate description of them! Once you have found one, come back and describe it to me exactly!
Master Piece#030.dst: 앞 못 보는 사람을 외면할 건가?! 정확한 묘사가 필요해! 하나 찾으면 돌아와서 그대로 설명해 줘!
Master Piece#030.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#031.src: The first cave is up a hill with tall, thin-leafed flowers. They smell pink to me, and of this I am certain.
Master Piece#031.dst: 첫 번째 동굴은 가늘고 긴 잎의 꽃이 핀 언덕 위에 있어. 나한텐 분홍색 냄새가 나지, 이건 확실해.
Master Piece#031.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#032.src: Search for the first mythical creature in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Master Piece#032.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴에서 첫 번째 신화 속 생물을 찾으세요

Master Piece#033.src: Report back with the description of the brown, large-snouted creature to Caissop
Master Piece#033.dst: 갈색에 코가 큰 생물의 모습을 Caissop에게 설명하세요

Master Piece#034.src: Quick! Describe it to me! Go on!
Master Piece#034.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#035.src: Brown...big-nosed... A Villager Cow, you say!?
Master Piece#035.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#037.src: ...MH, NO, A LITTLE MORE RED!..... YES!
Master Piece#037.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#038.src: Haha! This is WONDERFUL! I'm not going to show it to you before it is finished!
Master Piece#038.dst: 하하! 이거 굉장해! 완성되기 전엔 안 보여 줄 거야!
Master Piece#038.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#039.src: Savor the ideas! So now, I need you to go to the second cave...
Master Piece#039.dst: 아이디어를 음미하라고! 자, 이제 두 번째 동굴로 가 줘...
Master Piece#039.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#040.src: It is down a road, with short, round-cupped flowers. Those ones smell orange to me!
Master Piece#040.dst: 길을 따라 내려가면 있어, 키 작고 동그란 잔 모양 꽃이 있는 곳. 나한텐 주황색 냄새가 나!
Master Piece#040.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#041.src: Hurry! I'll finish this animal while you are gone. OH, YES. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#041.dst: 서둘러! 자네가 없는 동안 이 동물을 완성할게. 오, 좋아. MUY MACHO.
Master Piece#041.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#042.src: Search for the second mythical beast in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#042.dst: [-{~},-{~}]의 동굴에서 두 번째 신화 속 짐승을 찾으세요

Master Piece#043.src: Report back with the description of the white, big-horned creature to Caissop
Master Piece#043.dst: 하얗고 큰 뿔이 달린 생물의 모습을 Caissop에게 설명하세요

Master Piece#044.src: You're here! Quick! Don't look at me, describe it!
Master Piece#044.dst: 왔구나! 어서! 날 보지 말고 설명해!
Master Piece#044.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#045.src: Snow white, a large horn... A Unicorn Sheep, you say?!
Master Piece#045.dst: 눈처럼 하얗고, 큰 뿔... 유니콘 양이라고?!
Master Piece#045.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#046.src: ...OH YES, THE WOOL IS REAL... MORE SWIPING... OH YES, BIEN!
Master Piece#046.dst: ...오 좋아, 이 양털은 진짜야... 좀 더 붓질... 오 좋아, BIEN!
Master Piece#046.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#047.src: ... THIS IS UNIQUE, REMARKABLE, YES. SUPERNATURAL!
Master Piece#047.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#048.src: The last creature! Red-smelling flowers, prickly thorns, hurry, mucho inspired!
Master Piece#048.dst: 마지막 생물! 빨간 냄새 나는 꽃, 뾰족한 가시, 서둘러, mucho inspired!
Master Piece#048.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#050.src: I'LL JUST USE MY BLOOD! OH! YES! ...INSPIRED! REMARKABLE! Huh? Why are you still here? Go! I need that last description!
Master Piece#050.dst: 내 피를 쓰면 돼! 오! 좋아! ...영감이 온다! 놀라워! 응? 왜 아직 여기 있어? 가! 마지막 묘사가 필요해!
Master Piece#050.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#051.src: Search for the third and last mythical animal in the cave at [-{~},-{~}]
Master Piece#051.dst: [-{~},-{~}]의 동굴에서 세 번째이자 마지막 신화 속 동물을 찾으세요

Master Piece#052.src: Report back with the description of the pink, flying creature to Caissop
Master Piece#052.dst: 분홍색에 날아다니는 생물의 모습을 Caissop에게 설명하세요

Master Piece#053.src: You're finally back! I just finished the last one. Go! Describe it!
Master Piece#053.dst: 드디어 왔군! 방금 마지막 거 끝냈어. 어서! 설명해!
Master Piece#053.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#056.src: ...OH YES, WINGS! EYES FROM HEAVEN! OH, YES.
Master Piece#056.dst: ...오 좋아, 날개! 천국의 눈! 오, 좋아.
Master Piece#056.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#057.src: Och, Perfect. The final touch and, done! You were so inspiring that I made two! One for you, and one for me!
Master Piece#057.dst: 오, 완벽해. 마지막 손질, 완성! 영감을 너무 줘서 두 개나 그렸어! 하나는 자네, 하나는 내 거!
Master Piece#057.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#058.src: You might want to hold onto that, big-town upper class Villagers pay through the roof for Caissop's work!
Master Piece#058.dst: 잘 간직해 둬, 대도시 상류층 주민들은 Caissop의 작품에 엄청난 돈을 내거든!
Master Piece#058.speaker: Caissop

Master Piece#059.src: Thank you for your assistance, what a rush! Good luck on your Gavel adventure!
Master Piece#059.dst: 도와줘서 고마워, 정말 짜릿했어! Gavel 모험에 행운을 빌어!
Master Piece#059.speaker: Caissop

Meaningful Holiday#000.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already out in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#000.dst: 올해 누군가를 돕고 싶다면, 우리 대표 Nick이 벌써 현장에서 한창 일하고 있어요.

Meaningful Holiday#002.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas.
Meaningful Holiday#002.dst: 미안하지만 죄다 팔렸어, 다들 크래프트마스 준비하느라 말이야.

Meaningful Holiday#003.src: I might have something on the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#003.dst: 다락에 뭐가 있을지도 몰라, 뭐든 찾으면 가져가. 얼마나 힘든지 아니까.

Meaningful Holiday#004.src: Did ye find anyfin in the attic?

Meaningful Holiday#005.src: Looks like I'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed meself.
Meaningful Holiday#005.dst: 음식이 싹 떨어졌나 보네. 나 먹을 것도 겨우 있어.

Meaningful Holiday#006.src: Oh, also, can you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#006.dst: 아, 그리고 터널 지나가는 길에 이 담요를 Margaret에게 전해 주실래요? 제 뒤쪽 길만 따라가면 돼요.

Meaningful Holiday#008.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have no where else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#008.dst: 아, 제발 저 좀 쫓아내지 마세요. 갈 데가 없어요!

Meaningful Holiday#009.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this craftmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#009.dst: 안녕! 방금 이 크래프트마스 트리 장식을 끝냈어요!

Meaningful Holiday#011.src: I've been wrapping presents all week long.

Meaningful Holiday#012.src: My hands are starting to hurt!

Meaningful Holiday#013.src: Get out before I call the guards!

Meaningful Holiday#014.src: Stealing is not in the Craftmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#014.dst: 훔치는 건 크래프트마스 정신이 아닌데... 그래도 잘 풀어 볼 수 있겠어요.

Meaningful Holiday#015.src: My siblings and I take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#015.dst: 저와 형제들은 크래프트마스에 사람들을 돌봐요. 제 구역은 {p} 사막이죠. 샌다클로스라고 불러도 돼요, 헤헤.

Meaningful Holiday#017.src: Hello, dear. My name is Haily. Nice to meet you.
Meaningful Holiday#017.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#018.src: This is the {p} Charity center. We're looking for volunteers to help the homeless this year.
Meaningful Holiday#018.dst: 여기는 {p} 자선 센터예요. 올해 노숙인을 도울 자원봉사자를 찾고 있어요.
Meaningful Holiday#018.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#019.src: If you want to help someone else this year, our boss Nick is already in the thick of it.
Meaningful Holiday#019.dst: 올해 누군가를 돕고 싶다면, 우리 대표 Nick이 벌써 한창 일하고 있어요.
Meaningful Holiday#019.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#020.src: He's a really special man. I'll write his location down for you in your book. Oh, remember this is charity work, so hopefully gratitude is a good enough reward for you.
Meaningful Holiday#020.dst: 정말 특별한 분이에요. 위치를 책에 적어 드릴게요. 아, 자선 활동이니까 감사의 마음이 충분한 보상이 되길 바라요.
Meaningful Holiday#020.speaker: Haily

Meaningful Holiday#021.src: Go talk to Haily's friend Nick at the poor area.
Meaningful Holiday#021.dst: 빈민가에 있는 Haily의 친구 Nick에게 말을 거세요.

Meaningful Holiday#022.src: Oh. Oh... Oh dear. There's more people here than ever.
Meaningful Holiday#022.dst: 아. 아... 이런. 사람이 그 어느 때보다 많네요.
Meaningful Holiday#022.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#023.src: Hm, are you just passing through? Oh! A volunteer!
Meaningful Holiday#023.dst: 음, 그냥 지나가시는 길인가요? 오! 자원봉사자군요!
Meaningful Holiday#023.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#024.src: You're the only one this year. Things have really changed. We used to have hundreds of volunteers this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#024.dst: 올해는 당신 한 명뿐이에요. 정말 많이 변했죠. 예전엔 이맘때면 자원봉사자가 수백 명이었는데.
Meaningful Holiday#024.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#025.src: The people here are starving. There's no two ways about it.
Meaningful Holiday#025.dst: 여기 사람들은 굶주리고 있어요. 달리 말할 방법이 없죠.
Meaningful Holiday#025.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#026.src: I don't know how we're going to feed everyone this year.
Meaningful Holiday#026.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#027.src: The man who runs the budget store used to be homeless... He knows the struggles they face.
Meaningful Holiday#027.dst: 할인 상점을 하는 분도 예전에 노숙인이었어요... 그들이 겪는 어려움을 알죠.
Meaningful Holiday#027.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#028.src: I'll look after things here. Can you go to the budget store? It's really close. Any food is gratefully received.
Meaningful Holiday#028.dst: 여긴 제가 볼게요. 할인 상점에 가 주실래요? 아주 가까워요. 어떤 음식이든 감사히 받을게요.
Meaningful Holiday#028.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#029.src: Go to the budget store and ask for food.

Meaningful Holiday#031.src: What can I do fer ye?
Meaningful Holiday#031.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#033.src: I'm sorry but everyfin is sold out, everyone is preparing for Craftmas lad.
Meaningful Holiday#033.dst: 미안하지만 죄다 팔렸어, 다들 크래프트마스 준비하느라 말이야.
Meaningful Holiday#033.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#034.src: I might have something in the attic, if you find anyfin, you can 'ave it. I know how difficult it gets.
Meaningful Holiday#034.dst: 다락에 뭐가 있을지도 몰라, 뭐든 찾으면 가져가. 얼마나 힘든지 아니까.
Meaningful Holiday#034.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#035.src: Look for food on the second floor.

Meaningful Holiday#036.src: Hm... This apple has seen betta days...
Meaningful Holiday#036.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#037.src: Looks like i'm fresh outta food. Barely got enough to feed myself.
Meaningful Holiday#037.dst: 음식이 싹 떨어졌나 보네. 나 먹을 것도 겨우 있어.
Meaningful Holiday#037.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#038.src: I wish I had something to give this year. I guess people are having a feast in the city.
Meaningful Holiday#038.dst: 올해는 뭐라도 줄 수 있으면 좋았을 텐데. 도시에선 잔치가 한창이겠지.
Meaningful Holiday#038.speaker: Flodur

Meaningful Holiday#039.src: Return to Nick and tell him the bad news.

Meaningful Holiday#041.src: I see. I was counting on him.
Meaningful Holiday#041.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#042.src: I can't be too upset. He donates so much the rest of the year.
Meaningful Holiday#042.dst: 너무 서운해할 순 없죠. 나머지 계절엔 정말 많이 기부하시거든요.
Meaningful Holiday#042.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#043.src: We may have to ask the farmers directly...
Meaningful Holiday#043.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#044.src: I know someone in {p} with a kind heart.
Meaningful Holiday#044.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#045.src: We've fallen out before, seems he didn't understand what a donation was.
Meaningful Holiday#045.dst: 예전에 사이가 틀어졌었죠, 기부가 뭔지 모르는 것 같더라고요.
Meaningful Holiday#045.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#046.src: There is a shortcut south from here, in a cave. Go through there.
Meaningful Holiday#046.dst: 여기서 남쪽 동굴에 지름길이 있어요. 그쪽으로 가세요.
Meaningful Holiday#046.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#047.src: Oh, also, could you give this blanket to Margaret while you're down in the tunnel? Just follow the road behind me.
Meaningful Holiday#047.dst: 아, 그리고 터널 지나가는 길에 이 담요를 Margaret에게 전해 주실래요? 제 뒤쪽 길만 따라가면 돼요.
Meaningful Holiday#047.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#048.src: Bring the blanket to the woman in the tunnel south of Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#048.dst: Nick 남쪽 터널에 있는 여성에게 담요를 가져다주세요.

Meaningful Holiday#049.src: Oh, please don't move me along. I have nowhere else to go!
Meaningful Holiday#049.dst: 아, 제발 저 좀 쫓아내지 마세요. 갈 데가 없어요!
Meaningful Holiday#049.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#050.src: Oh, a blanket for me? How sweet... From Nick, you say? He's always so kind... Thank you, as well.
Meaningful Holiday#050.dst: 어머, 저한테 담요를요? 고마워라... Nick이 보냈다고요? 늘 정말 친절하죠... 당신도 고마워요.
Meaningful Holiday#050.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#051.src: If you want to get to {p} quickly, just keep going through this tunnel. Some unfriendly homeless folks live around here too, so be careful. It's so sad, their state.
Meaningful Holiday#051.dst: {p}에 빨리 가려면 이 터널을 계속 따라가세요. 이 근처엔 불친절한 노숙인들도 살아서 조심하세요. 그 사람들 처지가 참 안타까워요.
Meaningful Holiday#051.speaker: Margaret

Meaningful Holiday#052.src: Continue the tunnel and find Nick's friend.
Meaningful Holiday#052.dst: 터널을 계속 지나 Nick의 친구를 찾으세요.

Meaningful Holiday#053.src: Welcome to my farm! Looking to buy some of my fresh crops?
Meaningful Holiday#053.dst: 우리 농장에 온 걸 환영해요! 신선한 작물 좀 사시게요?
Meaningful Holiday#053.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#054.src: Well, it seems you're out of luck. I've just sold the last of them from this harvest.
Meaningful Holiday#054.dst: 음, 운이 없으시네요. 이번 수확분은 방금 마지막까지 다 팔았어요.
Meaningful Holiday#054.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#055.src: It was all for that big Craftmas feast happening in {p}. Wish I could help you out, but I'm fresh out of food to sell you.
Meaningful Holiday#055.dst: 전부 {p}에서 열리는 크래프트마스 대잔치에 갔죠. 도와드리고 싶지만 팔 음식이 하나도 없어요.
Meaningful Holiday#055.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#056.src: Wait, I bet Nick sent you, didn't he? Well, he's coming up on your left. Remind him that this isn't a charity.
Meaningful Holiday#056.dst: 잠깐, Nick이 보냈죠? 마침 왼쪽에서 오네요. 여긴 자선 단체가 아니라고 좀 전해 주세요.
Meaningful Holiday#056.speaker: Reshad

Meaningful Holiday#058.src: We can't get any food? We're running out of options here...
Meaningful Holiday#058.dst: 음식을 하나도 못 구했다고요? 이제 방법이 별로 없는데...
Meaningful Holiday#058.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#059.src: Well, there's only one person left that we can appeal to at this time of year.
Meaningful Holiday#059.dst: 음, 이맘때 부탁할 수 있는 사람은 이제 딱 한 명 남았어요.
Meaningful Holiday#059.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#061.src: Explore the area and look for Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#062.src: Heya! I just finished decorating this christmas tree!
Meaningful Holiday#062.dst: 안녕! 방금 이 크리스마스 트리 장식을 끝냈어요!
Meaningful Holiday#062.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#064.src: He is right down the stairs to the right.
Meaningful Holiday#064.speaker: Elvura

Meaningful Holiday#065.src: Enter Santa's home and speak to him.
Meaningful Holiday#065.dst: Santa의 집에 들어가 그에게 말을 거세요.

Meaningful Holiday#067.src: The council all have their areas to care for. Yours is {p}. How you care for it is your responsibility.
Meaningful Holiday#067.dst: 위원회는 각자 돌볼 구역이 있어. 네 구역은 {p}이고. 어떻게 돌볼지는 네 책임이야.
Meaningful Holiday#067.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#068.src: There's five times more homeless and hungry than last year!
Meaningful Holiday#068.dst: 노숙인과 굶는 사람이 작년보다 다섯 배나 많아!
Meaningful Holiday#068.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#069.src: Nick, I know times are tough there, but-
Meaningful Holiday#069.dst: Nick, 거기 사정이 힘든 건 알지만-
Meaningful Holiday#069.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#070.src: Tough?! It's impossible! What happened to people's good will? I had one volunteer this year! ONE!
Meaningful Holiday#070.dst: 힘들다고?! 불가능하다니까! 사람들의 선의는 어디 갔어? 올해 자원봉사자가 한 명이었어! 한 명!
Meaningful Holiday#070.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#071.src: I'm sorry Nick. You could go to {p} and ask there, they have a feast big enough to feed an army!
Meaningful Holiday#071.dst: 미안해, Nick. {p}에 가서 부탁해 봐, 거긴 군대도 먹일 만한 잔치를 열고 있잖아!
Meaningful Holiday#071.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#072.src: Hmmm... Oh, sorry. I miscalculated your journey here. Good to see you.
Meaningful Holiday#072.dst: 흠... 아, 죄송해요. 오는 시간을 잘못 계산했네요. 반가워요.
Meaningful Holiday#072.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#073.src: I suppose you heard Santa and I. Our next location is {p}.
Meaningful Holiday#073.dst: Santa와 제 얘기 들으셨겠죠. 다음 목적지는 {p}예요.
Meaningful Holiday#073.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#074.src: Alright, that's settled then. Leave through the fireplace behind me, it will bring you directly to {p}. Good luck, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#074.dst: 좋아, 그럼 정해졌네. 내 뒤의 벽난로로 나가면 {p}(으)로 바로 갈 거야. 행운을 빌어, Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#074.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#075.src: Leave through the portal behind Santa.

Meaningful Holiday#077.src: Wow. The people here live in such grandure. I wonder if they know people are starving to the east.
Meaningful Holiday#077.dst: 와. 여기 사람들은 정말 호화롭게 사네요. 동쪽에서 사람들이 굶는 걸 알기나 할까요.
Meaningful Holiday#077.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#078.src: Let's ask around for some donations.
Meaningful Holiday#078.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#079.src: More importantly, let's hope they'll share a trifle of food.
Meaningful Holiday#079.dst: 무엇보다, 음식을 조금이라도 나눠 주길 바라야죠.
Meaningful Holiday#079.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#082.dst: 이 행사는 초대받은 사람만 올 수 있어.
Meaningful Holiday#082.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#083.src: You aren't even in a formal dress.
Meaningful Holiday#083.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#085.src: Food? You want food? Does this look like a charity to you?
Meaningful Holiday#085.dst: 음식? 음식을 달라고? 여기가 자선 단체로 보여?
Meaningful Holiday#085.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#086.src: Of course not! We have an obligation to feed our partygoers, not some poor scraps of men in the desert!
Meaningful Holiday#086.dst: 당연히 아니지! 우린 손님들을 대접할 의무가 있지, 사막의 거지 떼가 아니라!
Meaningful Holiday#086.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#087.src: Now get out of here before I call the security golems. And don't even think of stealing from the kitchen!
Meaningful Holiday#087.dst: 경비 골렘 부르기 전에 나가. 그리고 주방에서 훔칠 생각은 꿈도 꾸지 마!
Meaningful Holiday#087.speaker: Server

Meaningful Holiday#088.src: Steal the food from the kitchen and talk to Nick.
Meaningful Holiday#088.dst: 주방에서 음식을 훔친 뒤 Nick에게 말을 거세요.

Meaningful Holiday#089.src: Were you able to get any food?
Meaningful Holiday#089.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#090.src: You do?! I didn't expect them to be so generous, a whole crate?
Meaningful Holiday#090.dst: 구했다고요?! 그렇게 후할 줄은 몰랐는데, 한 상자나요?
Meaningful Holiday#090.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#093.src: Stealing is not in the christmas spirit... But I think I can make this work.
Meaningful Holiday#093.dst: 훔치는 건 크리스마스 정신이 아닌데... 그래도 잘 풀어 볼 수 있겠어요.
Meaningful Holiday#093.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#094.src: Go on ahead. I have a plan. Don't worry, I'll return all this food.
Meaningful Holiday#094.dst: 먼저 가세요. 제게 계획이 있어요. 걱정 마세요, 음식은 전부 돌려줄 거예요.
Meaningful Holiday#094.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#097.src: I know you are hungry. Because I am too.
Meaningful Holiday#097.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#098.src: But your dinner will not be served tonight.
Meaningful Holiday#098.dst: 하지만 오늘 밤 저녁 식사는 나오지 않습니다.
Meaningful Holiday#098.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#099.src: There will be no Craftmas feast this year!
Meaningful Holiday#099.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#101.src: The food on the table isn't enough to feed everyone here!
Meaningful Holiday#101.dst: 식탁 위 음식으로는 여기 있는 사람들을 다 못 먹인다고!
Meaningful Holiday#101.speaker: Guest

Meaningful Holiday#102.src: This one night, this one missed meal.
Meaningful Holiday#102.dst: 이 하룻밤, 이 한 끼를 거르는 것.
Meaningful Holiday#102.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#103.src: This is how thousands of people live every day.
Meaningful Holiday#103.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#104.src: Hungry, wondering when the food will be available.
Meaningful Holiday#104.dst: 배고픈 채로, 언제 음식이 생길지 모르는 채로.
Meaningful Holiday#104.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#105.src: And while you sit there with empty stomachs be thankful for what you have. Spare a thought for those who have not.
Meaningful Holiday#105.dst: 빈속으로 앉아 계신 동안, 가진 것에 감사하세요. 가지지 못한 이들도 생각해 주세요.
Meaningful Holiday#105.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#106.src: Hundreds of men, women and children, just like you, will not eat tonight, at all.
Meaningful Holiday#106.dst: 여러분과 똑같은 수백 명의 남자, 여자, 아이들이 오늘 밤 아무것도 먹지 못합니다.
Meaningful Holiday#106.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#107.src: All because this enormous feast was not enough. {p} bought all the food, cheap or expensive.
Meaningful Holiday#107.dst: 이 거대한 잔치로도 모자랐기 때문이죠. {p}이(가) 싸든 비싸든 음식을 전부 사들였습니다.
Meaningful Holiday#107.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#108.src: I'm here to remind you the real meaning of this day. To think of others..
Meaningful Holiday#108.dst: 저는 이날의 진정한 의미를 일깨우러 왔습니다. 남을 생각하는 마음이죠..
Meaningful Holiday#108.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#109.src: I will return your meal tonight, but while you eat it... I want you to remember every empty mouth it could have fed.
Meaningful Holiday#109.dst: 오늘 밤 식사는 돌려드리겠지만, 드시는 동안... 이 음식으로 채울 수 있었던 빈 입들을 모두 기억해 주세요.
Meaningful Holiday#109.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#110.src: Share what you have, be thankful for what you are given.
Meaningful Holiday#110.dst: 가진 것을 나누고, 받은 것에 감사하세요.
Meaningful Holiday#110.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#112.src: Well, looks like you came through yet again Nick.

Meaningful Holiday#113.src: I came to see if I could help out. But it looks like you've done it.
Meaningful Holiday#113.dst: 도울 일이 있나 보러 왔는데, 네가 벌써 해낸 것 같네.
Meaningful Holiday#113.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#114.src: Well, I guess there is only one thing left to do to complete this scene.
Meaningful Holiday#114.dst: 자, 이 장면을 완성하려면 남은 일은 딱 하나겠지.
Meaningful Holiday#114.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#115.src: Hope you all have a merry craftmas. Ho-ho!
Meaningful Holiday#115.speaker: Santa

Meaningful Holiday#117.src: It looks like my little speech brought the rich back down to earth.
Meaningful Holiday#117.dst: 제 짧은 연설이 부자들을 정신 차리게 했나 봐요.
Meaningful Holiday#117.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#118.src: They gave us half of their feast. Can you believe they still had leftovers?
Meaningful Holiday#118.dst: 잔치의 절반을 내줬어요. 그러고도 남았다니 믿어져요?
Meaningful Holiday#118.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#119.src: All of that food, going straight to waste.
Meaningful Holiday#119.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#120.src: They have no idea what they have, compared to these poor folks.
Meaningful Holiday#120.dst: 이 가난한 사람들에 비하면 자기들이 얼마나 가졌는지 몰라요.
Meaningful Holiday#120.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#121.src: You might be wondering why I know Santa. Well, he's my brother.
Meaningful Holiday#121.dst: 제가 Santa를 어떻게 아는지 궁금하시죠? 사실 형이에요.
Meaningful Holiday#121.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#122.src: Me and my siblings take care of people at Craftmas. My area is the {p} desert. I guess you could call me Sanda Claus, heh.
Meaningful Holiday#122.dst: 저와 형제들은 크래프트마스에 사람들을 돌봐요. 제 구역은 {p} 사막이죠. 샌다클로스라고 불러도 돼요, 헤헤.
Meaningful Holiday#122.speaker: Nick

Meaningful Holiday#123.src: It's people like you that keep the real meaning of this holiday alive. It gets harder every year as the meaning is distorted. Here is a personal gift from me. Thank you.
Meaningful Holiday#123.dst: 당신 같은 사람들 덕분에 이 명절의 진짜 의미가 살아 있어요. 의미가 왜곡될수록 해마다 더 힘들어지죠. 제 개인적인 선물이에요. 고마워요.
Meaningful Holiday#123.speaker: Nick

Memory Paranoia#001.src: Oh, a human? If I could beg your pardon a moment...could I talk to you about the mansion here?
Memory Paranoia#001.dst: 오, 인간이군요? 잠시 실례해도 될까요... 여기 저택에 대해 이야기를 좀 나눌 수 있을까요?
Memory Paranoia#001.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#002.src: It was not always so dilapidated. It once stood tall, a monument to the family of Caritat, who constructed it from the ground up.
Memory Paranoia#002.dst: 늘 이렇게 낡았던 건 아닙니다. 한때는 우뚝 서 있었죠. 바닥부터 이 집을 지은 Caritat 가문의 기념비로서요.
Memory Paranoia#002.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#003.src: The Caritats were unlike any other. Uncharacteristically selfless and helpful. Their wealth was everyone’s wealth as far as they were concerned.
Memory Paranoia#003.dst: Caritat 가문은 남달랐습니다. 드물게도 이타적이고 남을 잘 도왔죠. 그들에겐 자신의 부가 곧 모두의 부였습니다.
Memory Paranoia#003.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#004.src: But... Eventually... Erm, we’re not entirely sure what happened, only rumours have surfaced over the years, but...things took a turn, shall we say.
Memory Paranoia#004.dst: 하지만... 결국... 음, 무슨 일이 있었는지 정확히는 모릅니다. 수년간 소문만 돌았죠. 그러니까... 일이 틀어졌다고 해 두죠.
Memory Paranoia#004.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#005.src: Because, aah...how shall I put this... One day they were all...discovered dead. Murdered. By each other.
Memory Paranoia#005.dst: 왜냐하면, 아... 어떻게 말해야 할지... 어느 날 모두... 죽은 채 발견됐습니다. 살해당했죠. 서로에게.
Memory Paranoia#005.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#006.src: I am the last remaining descendant, Atisun Caritat. I was the only survivor of the... incident. I was only an infant when I was found by a passerby.
Memory Paranoia#006.dst: 저는 마지막 남은 후손, Atisun Caritat입니다. 그... 사건의 유일한 생존자죠. 지나가던 사람이 발견했을 때 전 갓난아기였습니다.
Memory Paranoia#006.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#007.src: Since, erm...since there was no one alive to report the incident, it wasn't discovered until days later when a traveller passing by took notice of the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#007.dst: 음... 사건을 알릴 산 사람이 없었기에, 며칠 뒤 지나가던 여행자가 저택을 눈여겨보고 나서야 발견됐습니다.
Memory Paranoia#007.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#008.src: I do not believe that my family simply went mad, but I do not know what happened. I want to know the truth. I think this mansion still holds the answers I'm looking for.
Memory Paranoia#008.dst: 가족이 그냥 미쳐 버렸다고는 믿지 않지만, 무슨 일이 있었는지는 모릅니다. 진실을 알고 싶어요. 이 저택에 제가 찾는 답이 아직 있을 겁니다.
Memory Paranoia#008.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#009.src: Yet, I am...scared of this place. It is the ruins of the life I should have had. The spirits of the dead are still there...cursed. I need someone else to uncover my heritage.
Memory Paranoia#009.dst: 하지만 저는... 이곳이 두렵습니다. 제가 누렸어야 할 삶의 폐허니까요. 죽은 자들의 영혼이 아직... 저주받은 채 있습니다. 제 가문의 내력을 밝혀 줄 사람이 필요합니다.
Memory Paranoia#009.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#010.src: Don't you worry, like my ancestors, I'm a generous man. If you help me, I will reward you handsomely. All you have to do, is go in there and find answers. I'm sure the past won't haunt us both.
Memory Paranoia#010.dst: 걱정 마세요, 저도 조상들처럼 너그러운 사람입니다. 도와주시면 후하게 보답하죠. 그저 들어가서 답을 찾아 주시면 됩니다. 과거가 우리를 괴롭히진 않을 겁니다.
Memory Paranoia#010.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#012.src: Learn the story of the Caritat Family.

Memory Paranoia#013.src: This check is made out to a charity for a lot of emeralds.
Memory Paranoia#013.dst: 자선 단체 앞으로 발행된 거액의 에메랄드 수표다.
Memory Paranoia#013.speaker: Check

Memory Paranoia#014.src: It's so nice that the Caritats are donating all of these supplies to the struggling people in the forest.
Memory Paranoia#014.dst: Caritat 가문이 이 물자를 전부 숲에서 힘겹게 사는 사람들에게 기부하다니 정말 멋져요.
Memory Paranoia#014.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#015.src: He seems to be very engrossed in his writing.
Memory Paranoia#015.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#016.src: I've heard about weird things happening around the house. People are saying the mansion might be haunted!
Memory Paranoia#016.dst: 집 주변에서 이상한 일이 생긴다고 들었어요. 저택에 귀신이 들렸을지도 모른대요!
Memory Paranoia#016.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#017.src: Ghosts? Preposterous! This mansion isn't haunted, don't believe those silly rumors!
Memory Paranoia#017.dst: 귀신? 말도 안 돼요! 이 저택에 귀신 같은 건 없어요, 그런 바보 같은 소문 믿지 마세요!
Memory Paranoia#017.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#019.src: Mister Caritat is always writing in that book, always so intensely. I wonder what he is writing.
Memory Paranoia#019.dst: Caritat 나리는 늘 그 책에 뭔가를 쓰세요, 늘 엄청 열중해서요. 뭘 쓰시는 걸까요.
Memory Paranoia#019.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#020.src: He won't even tell me what he's writing.
Memory Paranoia#020.dst: 나한테도 뭘 쓰는지 안 알려 줘.
Memory Paranoia#020.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#021.src: I'll bet he's writing insults about us. He can't be as nice as he appears.
Memory Paranoia#021.dst: 분명 우리 험담을 쓰고 있을 거예요. 보이는 것만큼 착할 리가 없어요.
Memory Paranoia#021.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#022.src: I accidentally dropped my Library Key down the drain, do you think my dad will be angry?
Memory Paranoia#022.dst: 실수로 Library Key를 배수구에 떨어뜨렸어. 아빠가 화내실까?
Memory Paranoia#022.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#023.src: No, Mister Caritat is very forgiving. I doubt he'd be upset, especially if it was an accident.
Memory Paranoia#023.dst: 아니요, Caritat 나리는 무척 너그러우세요. 실수였다면 더더욱 화내지 않으실 거예요.
Memory Paranoia#023.speaker: Maid

Memory Paranoia#024.src: I still want to find the key though, do you know where I should look?
Memory Paranoia#024.dst: 그래도 열쇠를 찾고 싶어. 어디를 찾아봐야 할까?
Memory Paranoia#024.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#025.src: Well, the drainage pipes have probably taken the key to the basement in the southeast corner of the mansion by now, that's most likely where it is.
Memory Paranoia#025.dst: 음, 지금쯤이면 배수관을 타고 저택 동남쪽 구석의 지하실까지 흘러갔을 거예요. 아마 거기 있을 겁니다.
Memory Paranoia#025.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#026.src: Enter the basement and recover the Library Key.

Memory Paranoia#028.src: Enter the hole in the wall.

Memory Paranoia#029.src: Timmy, is something bothering you? You have been acting so weird lately.
Memory Paranoia#029.dst: Timmy, 무슨 고민 있니? 요즘 행동이 너무 이상하구나.
Memory Paranoia#029.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#030.src: You cannot command me, mortal! You and all of your inferior species will bow to the darkness!
Memory Paranoia#030.dst: 내게 명령할 수 없다, 필멸자여! 너와 너의 열등한 종족은 모두 어둠 앞에 무릎 꿇으리라!
Memory Paranoia#030.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#031.src: I don't know what game you are playing, Timmy. But I will not stand for it any longer, snap out of it!
Memory Paranoia#031.dst: 무슨 장난인지 모르겠구나, Timmy. 하지만 더는 못 참는다, 정신 차려라!
Memory Paranoia#031.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#032.src: You shall pay for your insolence, mortal!
Memory Paranoia#032.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#033.src: Dark magic? What foul books have you been reading? And what's that in your hand?
Memory Paranoia#033.dst: 어둠의 마법? 대체 무슨 불경한 책을 읽은 거냐? 그리고 손에 든 건 뭐지?
Memory Paranoia#033.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#034.src: Casting spells with a black spoon? I'm going to get rid of this foul thing!
Memory Paranoia#034.dst: 검은 숟가락으로 주문을 건다고? 이 불경한 물건은 치워 버려야겠다!
Memory Paranoia#034.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#035.src: That is an item beyond you, mortal. Give it back to me this instant!
Memory Paranoia#035.dst: 그건 네가 감당할 수 없는 물건이다, 필멸자여. 당장 돌려내라!
Memory Paranoia#035.speaker: Timmy

Memory Paranoia#036.src: Return the spoon to the Kitchen.

Memory Paranoia#038.src: Attention, attention everyone! I have an announcement I'd like to make!
Memory Paranoia#038.dst: 주목, 모두 주목해 주세요! 발표할 것이 있습니다!
Memory Paranoia#038.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#039.src: My son, Timothy, has just turned eighteen today.
Memory Paranoia#039.dst: 제 아들 Timothy가 오늘 열여덟 살이 되었습니다.
Memory Paranoia#039.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#040.src: Now, there have been a few slight hiccups over the years, but we've made it through mostly in one piece.
Memory Paranoia#040.dst: 그간 자잘한 문제가 몇 번 있었지만, 대체로 무사히 이겨 냈습니다.
Memory Paranoia#040.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#041.src: And I'd like to say, I'm very proud of him. To Timothy, a new man!
Memory Paranoia#041.dst: 아들이 무척 자랑스럽습니다. 어른이 된 Timothy를 위하여!
Memory Paranoia#041.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#042.src: Thank you very much, Dad, and everyone here. Here's to more years of health-
Memory Paranoia#042.dst: 정말 고마워요, 아빠, 그리고 여러분. 앞으로도 건강한 날들을 위하여-
Memory Paranoia#042.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#043.src: Please, everyone stay calm. I'm sure it's just the cooks spilling something...
Memory Paranoia#043.dst: 모두 진정해 주세요. 분명 요리사들이 뭘 쏟았을 뿐일 겁니다...
Memory Paranoia#043.speaker: Mister Caritat

Memory Paranoia#045.src: Oh my god... what is that thing?!
Memory Paranoia#045.speaker: Baker

Memory Paranoia#046.src: Everyone out, now! We can't fight these things!
Memory Paranoia#046.dst: 다들 당장 나가! 우린 저것들이랑 못 싸워!
Memory Paranoia#046.speaker: Chef

Memory Paranoia#048.src: Speak to people who haven't fled from the disaster.

Memory Paranoia#049.src: My god...what is wrong with this place? No matter what I do, what I try...
Memory Paranoia#049.dst: 맙소사... 이곳은 대체 뭐가 잘못된 거지? 무엇을 해도, 무엇을 시도해도...
Memory Paranoia#049.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#050.src: How was any of that even possible? What are we going to tell their families?
Memory Paranoia#050.dst: 어떻게 그런 일이 가능했죠? 그 사람들 가족에게 뭐라고 말하죠?
Memory Paranoia#050.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#051.src: ...Timothy, I'm going to ask you something, and I need you to answer me honestly. Were you...were you responsible for this?
Memory Paranoia#051.dst: ...Timothy, 하나 물어볼 테니 솔직하게 대답해라. 네가... 네가 이 일을 벌인 거냐?
Memory Paranoia#051.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#052.src: No, of course not! I overcame that years ago, you know that, I can't believe you still suspect me of-
Memory Paranoia#052.dst: 아뇨, 당연히 아니죠! 그건 몇 년 전에 극복했어요, 아시잖아요. 아직도 절 의심하시다니-
Memory Paranoia#052.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#053.src: Ah, sir, we did find something rather unusual in the kitchen that might interest you? Maybe?
Memory Paranoia#053.dst: 아, 나리, 주방에서 꽤 특이한 걸 발견했는데 관심 있으실지도요? 아마도요?
Memory Paranoia#053.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#054.src: What- Out with it! What did you find?! Please, please tell me I'm wrong!!
Memory Paranoia#054.dst: 뭐- 어서 말해! 뭘 찾았지?! 제발, 제발 내가 틀렸다고 해 줘!!
Memory Paranoia#054.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#055.src: We found this charred-looking black spoon. I've worked here for years, and I've never seen any spoons of this style in the mansion.
Memory Paranoia#055.dst: 이 그을린 듯한 검은 숟가락을 찾았습니다. 여기서 수년간 일했지만 저택에서 이런 모양의 숟가락은 본 적이 없어요.
Memory Paranoia#055.speaker: Servant

Memory Paranoia#056.src: Wait, that spoon? I remember sneaking into your study that one time to get it, but how did it survive the fire?
Memory Paranoia#056.dst: 잠깐, 그 숟가락요? 예전에 서재에 몰래 들어가서 가져왔던 건데, 그게 어떻게 불에 안 탔지?
Memory Paranoia#056.speaker: Timothy

Memory Paranoia#057.src: Wait, you got it from my STUDY?! You...you idiot! Do you have any idea what you stupidly, yet inadvertently have done?! You must NEVER go in my study!!
Memory Paranoia#057.dst: 잠깐, 그걸 내 서재에서 가져왔다고?! 너... 이 멍청한 녀석! 멍청하게, 그것도 모르고 무슨 짓을 한 줄 알아?! 절대 내 서재에 들어가지 마라!!
Memory Paranoia#057.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#061.src: Speak with the Possessed Mr. Caritat.

Memory Paranoia#062.src: IT WHICH STARTED THE WAR SHALL RISE ONCE MORE. FROM THE REALM OF SHADOWS, DECEIT AND PAIN.
Memory Paranoia#062.dst: 전쟁을 일으킨 그것이 다시 일어나리라. 그림자와 기만과 고통의 영역으로부터.
Memory Paranoia#062.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#063.src: FOREVER TRAPPED, FROM WHENCE IT CAME. THROUGH THE WEAK POINT BETWEEN REALMS IT. WILL. RISE. AGAIN!
Memory Paranoia#063.dst: 그것이 온 곳에 영원히 갇혀 있었으나. 영역 사이의 약한 틈을 지나 그것은. 다시. 일어나리라!
Memory Paranoia#063.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#065.src: Bring the key to Timmy's bedroom.

Memory Paranoia#068.src: Bring the key to the Master Bedroom.

Memory Paranoia#073.src: FROM THE SOILS OF DOOM THE SERVANT LAID
Memory Paranoia#073.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#074.src: BREAK THROUGH THE REALMS TO THE LAND OF TRADE.
Memory Paranoia#074.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#075.src: CORRUPT THE WORLD WITH SEEDS OF PAIN
Memory Paranoia#075.speaker: Mr. Caritat

Memory Paranoia#078.src: Escape the flaming mansion through the back door.

Memory Paranoia#081.src: No, no! I said three feet left, you absolute...
Memory Paranoia#081.dst: 아니, 아니! 왼쪽으로 3피트라고 했잖아, 이 완전...
Memory Paranoia#081.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#082.src: Mr. Caritat! What are you doing?!
Memory Paranoia#082.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#083.src: What are you doing here, Elf? You need proper equipment to be on this site-
Memory Paranoia#083.dst: 여기서 뭐 하나, 엘프? 이 현장에 들어오려면 제대로 된 장비가 필요해-
Memory Paranoia#083.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#084.src: Mr Caritat, you can't build a house here!
Memory Paranoia#084.dst: Caritat 씨, 여기에 집을 지으면 안 돼요!
Memory Paranoia#084.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#085.src: I can do whatever I like here, I bought the land.
Memory Paranoia#085.dst: 여긴 내 마음대로 할 수 있어, 내가 산 땅이니까.
Memory Paranoia#085.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#086.src: You don't understand! This is where it came... this is where the darkness invaded!
Memory Paranoia#086.dst: 이해 못 하시는군요! 여기가 그게 온 곳... 어둠이 침입한 곳이라고요!
Memory Paranoia#086.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#087.src: Don't be preposterous. I'm building here to show the people that there's simply nothing to worry about!
Memory Paranoia#087.dst: 터무니없는 소리. 걱정할 건 전혀 없다는 걸 사람들에게 보여 주려고 여기 짓는 거야!
Memory Paranoia#087.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#088.src: Besides, even if there was something, now that Dullahan's gone, it'll go too.
Memory Paranoia#088.dst: 게다가 뭔가 있었다 해도, Dullahan이 사라졌으니 그것도 사라질 거야.
Memory Paranoia#088.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#089.src: What?! He wasn't the one causing all this, it was-
Memory Paranoia#089.dst: 뭐라고요?! 이 모든 걸 일으킨 건 그가 아니라-
Memory Paranoia#089.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#090.src: Well of course you would think that. You and him had some... history, didn't you?
Memory Paranoia#090.dst: 자네야 당연히 그렇게 생각하겠지. 자네와 그자는... 사연이 좀 있었잖나?
Memory Paranoia#090.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#091.src: I... Please, Mr Caritat. You don't understand what you're doing...
Memory Paranoia#091.dst: 저는... 제발요, Caritat 씨. 무슨 짓을 하시는지 모르세요...
Memory Paranoia#091.speaker: Lari

Memory Paranoia#092.src: I am securing some prime real-estate right here. Oh... Perhaps that is why you're here?
Memory Paranoia#092.dst: 나는 여기 최고급 부동산을 확보하는 중이야. 오... 혹시 그래서 온 건가?
Memory Paranoia#092.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#094.src: Trying to expand elven territories, are you?! Well, I'll be having none of that! Leave, before I have my men escort you!
Memory Paranoia#094.dst: 엘프 영토를 넓히려는 거로군?! 어림없지! 내 부하들이 끌어내기 전에 나가!
Memory Paranoia#094.speaker: Caritat Senior

Memory Paranoia#095.src: Hey! Human! Are you alright?! Please, calm down, quit flailing around, you're safe!
Memory Paranoia#095.dst: 이봐요! 인간! 괜찮습니까?! 제발 진정하세요, 그만 버둥거리세요, 이제 안전합니다!
Memory Paranoia#095.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#097.src: Oh thank goodness, you're back to us. I was so worried... er, you might not recall. Let me explain...
Memory Paranoia#097.dst: 오, 다행이다, 정신이 돌아왔군요. 정말 걱정했습니다... 어, 기억 안 나실 수도 있겠네요. 설명드리죠...
Memory Paranoia#097.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#098.src: It... it seemed like you were possessed. You stood in the hall for... I don't know how long. I couldn't snap you out of it, no matter what I tried.
Memory Paranoia#098.dst: 마치... 빙의된 것 같았습니다. 홀에 서서... 얼마나 오래였는지 모르겠어요. 무슨 짓을 해도 깨울 수가 없었습니다.
Memory Paranoia#098.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#099.src: Voices that weren't yours, you spoke out their moments and thoughts. The maids, my father... everyone. I... you said what I needed to hear.
Memory Paranoia#099.dst: 당신 것이 아닌 목소리로 그들의 순간과 생각을 말했어요. 하녀들, 제 아버지... 모두요. 저는... 제가 들어야 할 말을 해 주셨습니다.
Memory Paranoia#099.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#100.src: My great grandfather, wanting to prove to everyone that the forest was still good, built his mansion atop the very spot that was acclaimed to be the cause of the Decay.
Memory Paranoia#100.dst: 제 증조할아버지는 숲이 아직 괜찮다는 걸 모두에게 증명하려고, 쇠락의 원인이라 지목된 바로 그 자리에 저택을 지으셨습니다.
Memory Paranoia#100.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#101.src: My father tried to continue the traditions... but all of it was burned to ashes. I must consider myself lucky that I did not fall with them.
Memory Paranoia#101.dst: 아버지는 전통을 이으려 했지만... 모두 잿더미가 됐죠. 그들과 함께 쓰러지지 않은 걸 다행으로 여겨야겠지요.
Memory Paranoia#101.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#102.src: And what emerged from that spot? Who knows... but, whatever it was... the darkness must have lingered, and drove them all to madness.
Memory Paranoia#102.dst: 그럼 그 자리에서 나온 건 무엇이었을까요? 누가 알겠습니까... 하지만 그게 무엇이든... 어둠이 남아 모두를 광기로 몰았을 겁니다.
Memory Paranoia#102.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#103.src: I'm sorry you went through that ordeal... I would suggest seeing a healer as soon as possible.
Memory Paranoia#103.dst: 그런 고초를 겪게 해서 죄송합니다... 되도록 빨리 치유사를 찾아가 보세요.
Memory Paranoia#103.speaker: Atisun

Memory Paranoia#104.src: I will make sure no one enters this house again. It is cursed. Thank you for helping me.
Memory Paranoia#104.dst: 다시는 아무도 이 집에 들어오지 못하게 하겠습니다. 저주받은 곳이에요. 도와주셔서 감사합니다.
Memory Paranoia#104.speaker: Atisun

Misadventure on the Sea#000.src: Sitting on this stool will start Misadventure on the Sea.
Misadventure on the Sea#000.dst: 이 의자에 앉으면 '바다 위의 불운' 퀘스트가 시작됩니다.

Misadventure on the Sea#001.src: I'll take two {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#001.dst: {p} 위스키 두 잔 주게. 하나는 내 거, 하나는 이 친구 거.

Misadventure on the Sea#003.src: I'll wait for ya at the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#003.dst: 부두에서 기다리지. 걱정 마, 배는 못 보고 지나칠 수가 없으니까!

Misadventure on the Sea#005.src: They're a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#005.dst: 저쪽이 너무 정면으로 오는 것 같지 않나?

Misadventure on the Sea#006.src: I'm tryin' to steer the ship but it's not budging...

Misadventure on the Sea#007.src: Sounds like you're being dragged around...

Misadventure on the Sea#008.src: You pick up a small sign...

Misadventure on the Sea#010.src: So, there's quite a few bodies in there, and we never bothered throwin' em out!
Misadventure on the Sea#010.dst: 저 안에 시체가 꽤 많은데, 우린 한 번도 내다 버릴 생각을 안 했거든!

Misadventure on the Sea#011.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the bodies with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#011.dst: 가 봐, 말라붙은 피 닦을 스펀지도 줄게. 시체는 그냥 이걸로 후려치면 돼!

Misadventure on the Sea#013.src: You take a look inside the furnaces...

Misadventure on the Sea#015.src: An absurd amount of wood shavings, for some reason.

Misadventure on the Sea#016.src: Looks like the door that leads to the hold...

Misadventure on the Sea#017.src: It's locked. Probably because of the rat issue. Honip must have the key.
Misadventure on the Sea#017.dst: 잠겨 있다. 쥐 문제 때문이겠지. 열쇠는 Honip에게 있을 것이다.

Misadventure on the Sea#018.src: You find some notes on the table.

Misadventure on the Sea#019.src: There's mentions of... A human cannon? How does that make sense?
Misadventure on the Sea#019.dst: 뭔가 적혀 있다... 인간 대포? 그게 말이 되나?

Misadventure on the Sea#020.src: Apparently, only gunpowder is needed, as well as a fuse.

Misadventure on the Sea#021.src: This cannon is aiming slightly upwards, and it seems less powerful than the others.
Misadventure on the Sea#021.dst: 이 대포는 살짝 위를 향해 있고, 다른 대포들보다 약해 보인다.

Misadventure on the Sea#022.src: According to the notes you saw, it's probably the "human" cannon. This must be your escape route!
Misadventure on the Sea#022.dst: 본 메모대로라면 이게 그 "인간" 대포일 것이다. 이게 탈출구다!

Misadventure on the Sea#024.src: There are mentions of a hidden key in the hold...
Misadventure on the Sea#024.dst: 선창에 숨겨진 열쇠에 대한 내용이 있다...

Misadventure on the Sea#025.src: You should probably search the hold later, when possible.
Misadventure on the Sea#025.dst: 나중에 기회가 되면 선창을 뒤져 보는 게 좋겠다.

Misadventure on the Sea#026.src: You cleaned the bodies! You should talk to Honip on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#026.dst: 시체를 다 청소했다! 갑판에 있는 Honip과 대화해야겠다.

Misadventure on the Sea#027.src: 'ey! How's the cleaning? Don't forget to check everywhere, ya never know what you might find!
Misadventure on the Sea#027.dst: 어이! 청소는 잘 돼 가? 구석구석 확인하는 거 잊지 마, 뭐가 나올지 모르니까!

Misadventure on the Sea#028.src: You're done? Well good job! Honip's next to the helm if you're lookin' for him.
Misadventure on the Sea#028.dst: 다 했어? 잘했네! Honip 찾으면 키 옆에 있어.

Misadventure on the Sea#029.src: You've been running around the boat for a while now!
Misadventure on the Sea#029.dst: 너 한참 동안 배를 뛰어다니고 있잖아!

Misadventure on the Sea#031.src: Honip's probably waitin' for ya by now! Take these ladders next to me, he's up there.
Misadventure on the Sea#031.dst: Honip이 지금쯤 기다리고 있을걸! 내 옆 사다리로 올라가, 거기 있어.

Misadventure on the Sea#032.src: If you lose your sponge, Honip can give you a new one on the deck.
Misadventure on the Sea#032.dst: 스펀지를 잃어버리면 갑판에서 Honip이 새로 줄 거야.

Misadventure on the Sea#033.src: The only boat that will take ye directly to {p}.

Misadventure on the Sea#034.src: Hey! You aren't allowed on my ship!
Misadventure on the Sea#034.dst: 이봐! 내 배에 타면 안 돼!

Misadventure on the Sea#035.src: This hologram will teleport you back on the island to continue the quest or Reset your quest.
Misadventure on the Sea#035.dst: 이 홀로그램으로 섬에 돌아가 퀘스트를 계속하거나, 퀘스트를 초기화할 수 있습니다.

Misadventure on the Sea#036.src: Are you sure you wish to Reset your quest?

Misadventure on the Sea#037.src: Misadventure On The Sea has been reset!

Misadventure on the Sea#038.src: Maybe you could somehow use it..? There's no way to tell how dangerous it is. Probably very.
Misadventure on the Sea#038.dst: 어떻게든 이걸 쓸 수 있을지도..? 얼마나 위험한지 알 방법이 없다. 아마 아주 위험하겠지.

Misadventure on the Sea#039.src: It must be the one up you saw up there! That's got to be the way to escape!
Misadventure on the Sea#039.dst: 분명 아까 위에서 본 그거다! 저게 탈출구가 틀림없다!

Misadventure on the Sea#040.src: Who knows, maybe there's gunpowder in there?
Misadventure on the Sea#040.dst: 혹시 모르지, 저 안에 화약이 있을지도?

Misadventure on the Sea#041.src: Seems like it likes you now!

Misadventure on the Sea#042.src: Not done yet? Well, take your time!
Misadventure on the Sea#042.dst: 아직 안 끝났어? 뭐, 천천히 해!

Misadventure on the Sea#043.src: We sometimes hear unusually loud footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#043.dst: 가끔 이상하게 큰 발소리가 들리고, 아주 소름 끼치는 찍찍 소리도 나...

Misadventure on the Sea#044.src: Looks like this crate is filled with rat hair, with some eaten carrots.
Misadventure on the Sea#044.dst: 이 상자엔 쥐털이 가득하고, 갉아 먹은 당근이 좀 있는 것 같다.

Misadventure on the Sea#045.src: You defeated the rats! You should grab the gunpowder and the fuse before leaving.
Misadventure on the Sea#045.dst: 쥐들을 물리쳤다! 떠나기 전에 화약과 도화선을 챙겨야겠다.

Misadventure on the Sea#049.src: Looks like this crate is filled with even more rat hair!
Misadventure on the Sea#049.dst: 이 상자엔 쥐털이 더 잔뜩 들어 있는 것 같다!

Misadventure on the Sea#050.src: You picked up a dusty key!

Misadventure on the Sea#053.src: You got the fuse as well as the gunpowder. Looks like you can use that cannon now!
Misadventure on the Sea#053.dst: 화약과 도화선을 모두 챙겼다. 이제 저 대포를 쓸 수 있겠다!

Misadventure on the Sea#054.src: You put the gunpowder in the cannon and attach the fuse...

Misadventure on the Sea#055.src: Looks like it's fully functional. Make sure the pirates don't see you! Once you leave, you won't be able to come back.
Misadventure on the Sea#055.dst: 완전히 작동하는 것 같다. 해적들에게 들키지 않게 조심하자! 한번 떠나면 돌아올 수 없다.

Misadventure on the Sea#061.src: Huh? Something's approaching off in the distance...
Misadventure on the Sea#061.dst: 응? 저 멀리서 뭔가 다가오고 있다...

Misadventure on the Sea#062.src: Looks like they're headed toward the island! Is that..?
Misadventure on the Sea#062.dst: 섬 쪽으로 오는 것 같다! 저건..?

Misadventure on the Sea#063.src: Ah... Trust. Say, why don't I make it so you can travel to {p} for free? That way, if ya ever think o' doin' somethin' foolish like that again, ya can jus' take a trip on my ol' ship!
Misadventure on the Sea#063.dst: 아... 신뢰라. 그럼 이렇게 하지, {p}까지 공짜로 다닐 수 있게 해 주면 어때? 그러면 또 그런 바보짓을 하고 싶어질 때, 그냥 내 낡은 배를 타면 되잖아!

Misadventure on the Sea#065.src: Hello there soldier! What can I get you?
Misadventure on the Sea#065.dst: 어서 오게, 병사 양반! 뭘 드릴까?
Misadventure on the Sea#065.speaker: Barman

Misadventure on the Sea#066.src: I'll take {~} {p} Whiskeys. One for me, one for this chap.
Misadventure on the Sea#066.dst: {p} 위스키 {~}잔 주게. 하나는 내 거, 하나는 이 친구 거.
Misadventure on the Sea#066.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#068.src: So... I've seen ya around town. I saw how happy that guy was when you brought him some journal.
Misadventure on the Sea#068.dst: 그래서... 마을에서 널 몇 번 봤지. 네가 일지를 갖다주니까 그 녀석이 엄청 좋아하더군.
Misadventure on the Sea#068.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#070.src: So... Soldier. Are ya up for sailin' the ocean with me? I got a fancier boat than that seaskipper!
Misadventure on the Sea#070.dst: 그래서... 병사 양반. 나랑 바다 항해 한번 해 볼 텐가? 내 배는 연락선보다 훨씬 멋지다고!
Misadventure on the Sea#070.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#071.src: I figured you'd be interested in explorin' the waters!
