Misadventure on the Sea#071.dst: 바다 탐험에 관심 있을 줄 알았지!
Misadventure on the Sea#071.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#072.src: I'll wait for ya on the docks. Don't worry, ya can't miss the boat!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.dst: 부두에서 기다리지. 걱정 마, 배는 못 보고 지나칠 수가 없으니까!
Misadventure on the Sea#072.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#074.src: There you are! Ready? Follow me, the boat's over here!
Misadventure on the Sea#074.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#075.src: Look at this.. Magnificent! Much better than whatever the Seaskipper is using!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.dst: 이것 좀 봐.. 멋지지! 연락선이 쓰는 배보다 훨씬 낫다고!
Misadventure on the Sea#075.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#076.src: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop aboard!
Misadventure on the Sea#076.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#077.src: Then it's settled, we're goin' on an adventure!
Misadventure on the Sea#077.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#078.src: Buckle up, we got waves to catch.
Misadventure on the Sea#078.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#079.src: So... I should warn ya', this is actually my first time sailing...
Misadventure on the Sea#079.dst: 그런데... 미리 말해 두자면, 사실 항해는 이번이 처음이야...
Misadventure on the Sea#079.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#080.src: It doesn't seem too difficult though, a little to the left...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.dst: 그래도 별로 어려워 보이진 않는데, 왼쪽으로 조금...
Misadventure on the Sea#080.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#081.src: Hmm, looks like we're not the only ones out on the water today.
Misadventure on the Sea#081.dst: 흠, 오늘 바다에 나온 게 우리만은 아닌 것 같군.
Misadventure on the Sea#081.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#082.src: They are a bit too head on, don't you think?
Misadventure on the Sea#082.dst: 저쪽이 너무 정면으로 오는 것 같지 않나?
Misadventure on the Sea#082.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#083.src: I'm trying to steer the ship but it's not budging...
Misadventure on the Sea#083.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#087.src: I honestly, truly can't believe you fell for that. Let me sum it up for you...
Misadventure on the Sea#087.dst: 솔직히 그런 데 넘어갈 줄은 정말 몰랐다. 정리해 주지...
Misadventure on the Sea#087.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#088.src: Some extremely suspicious pirate comes up, offers you a drink, and leads you to his suspicious boat.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.dst: 엄청 수상한 해적이 다가와서 술을 사 주더니, 자기 수상한 배로 데려간다.
Misadventure on the Sea#088.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#089.src: Any normal person would've turned back by then. But what do you do? You hop on! Well, now you're stuck with us.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.dst: 보통 사람이면 그쯤에서 돌아섰겠지. 근데 넌? 냉큼 올라탔잖아! 자, 이제 우리랑 한배를 탄 거다.
Misadventure on the Sea#089.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#090.src: Let me make this quick. This boat needs renovation, and we want you to do it.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.dst: 짧게 말하지. 이 배는 수리가 필요하고, 그걸 네가 해 줘야겠다.
Misadventure on the Sea#090.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#091.src: Why? You're a soldier! All you do is take orders! Anyway, we'll need you to clean our stuff. Here, get out.
Misadventure on the Sea#091.dst: 왜냐고? 넌 병사잖아! 명령받는 게 일이지! 아무튼 우리 물건 청소를 맡아 줘야겠어. 자, 나가.
Misadventure on the Sea#091.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#093.src: I told you to stay back!
Misadventure on the Sea#093.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#095.src: So, there's quite a few skeletons in there, and we never bothered throwin' them out!
Misadventure on the Sea#095.dst: 저 안에 해골이 꽤 많은데, 우린 한 번도 내다 버릴 생각을 안 했거든!
Misadventure on the Sea#095.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#096.src: Go ahead, here's a sponge for the dried blood as well. Just wack the skeletons with it!
Misadventure on the Sea#096.dst: 가 봐, 말라붙은 피 닦을 스펀지도 줄게. 해골은 그냥 이걸로 후려치면 돼!
Misadventure on the Sea#096.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#097.src: If you need me, I'll be on the deck. And, uh, don't go in the hold. We've got a BIG rat problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#097.dst: 볼일 있으면 난 갑판에 있을 거야. 그리고, 어, 선창엔 들어가지 마. 쥐 문제가 아주 심각하거든.
Misadventure on the Sea#097.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#098.src: Also, for the sake of my crew, could you be more cooperative? I don't have an unlimited amount of these potions.
Misadventure on the Sea#098.dst: 그리고 내 선원들을 생각해서 좀 협조해 줄래? 이 물약도 무한정 있는 게 아니라고.
Misadventure on the Sea#098.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#099.src: Clean the bodies in the boat. Look for clues on how to escape at the same time. -Bodies cleaned: #/{~}
Misadventure on the Sea#099.dst: 배 안의 시체를 청소하세요. 동시에 탈출할 단서를 찾으세요. -청소한 시체: #/{~}

Misadventure on the Sea#100.src: Hey, so you're our personal guard, huh?
Misadventure on the Sea#100.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#102.src: That ladder leads to the hold, but right now it's locked... We've got a severe case of rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#102.dst: 저 사다리는 선창으로 이어지는데, 지금은 잠겨 있어... 쥐 문제가 심각하거든.
Misadventure on the Sea#102.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#103.src: Pep is just a treasure, ain't I right? I'm glad you're taking care of him too!
Misadventure on the Sea#103.dst: Pep은 정말 보물이지, 안 그래? 너도 걔를 챙겨 주니 다행이다!
Misadventure on the Sea#103.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#104.src: Honip has a pet chicken, weird right?
Misadventure on the Sea#104.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#105.src: I bet he got inspiration from that weird guy on his island...
Misadventure on the Sea#105.dst: 분명 자기 섬에 사는 그 이상한 녀석한테 영향받았을 거야...
Misadventure on the Sea#105.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#106.src: What? You murdered that guy's most prized chicken? You're an odd one, soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#106.dst: 뭐? 그 녀석이 제일 아끼는 닭을 죽였다고? 너도 참 별난 놈이다, 병사.
Misadventure on the Sea#106.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#107.src: Oh, uh... Don't worry about that, 'ay?
Misadventure on the Sea#107.dst: 아, 어... 그건 신경 쓰지 마, 응?
Misadventure on the Sea#107.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#109.src: Oh, that's my cannon! Pretty cool, right? I made it using a bunch of arm- Nevermind...
Misadventure on the Sea#109.dst: 아, 그건 내 대포야! 멋지지? 팔을 잔뜩 써서 만들- 아니, 됐어...
Misadventure on the Sea#109.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#111.src: He's a strong chicken alright, trust me on that one.
Misadventure on the Sea#111.dst: 튼튼한 닭이지, 그건 내 말을 믿어.
Misadventure on the Sea#111.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#113.src: I'm just goin' to... Wait here... With my cannons...
Misadventure on the Sea#113.dst: 난 그냥... 여기서 기다릴게... 내 대포들이랑...
Misadventure on the Sea#113.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#114.src: Talk to Honip on the deck to get your next task
Misadventure on the Sea#114.dst: 갑판에서 Honip과 대화하여 다음 일을 받으세요

Misadventure on the Sea#115.src: Hey! The boat's lookin' real nice now!
Misadventure on the Sea#115.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#116.src: I'll probably let you rest so- hold on.
Misadventure on the Sea#116.dst: 이제 좀 쉬게 해 줄까 하는데- 잠깐.
Misadventure on the Sea#116.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#117.src: Ho-Honip! One of the guys said he saw something really weird coming right for us!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.dst: 호-Honip! 누가 엄청 이상한 게 우리 쪽으로 곧장 온다고 했어요!
Misadventure on the Sea#117.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#120.src: We-we don't know! We can't exactly see it, but it seems huge!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.dst: 모-모르겠어요! 잘 보이진 않는데 엄청 커요!
Misadventure on the Sea#120.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#122.src: Uh... Where am I supposed to be looking at, exactly?
Misadventure on the Sea#122.dst: 어... 정확히 어디를 봐야 하는 건데?
Misadventure on the Sea#122.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#123.src: I swear, it felt like the whole ocean was getting crazy a second ago!
Misadventure on the Sea#123.dst: 맹세컨대, 방금 바다 전체가 미쳐 날뛰는 것 같았어요!
Misadventure on the Sea#123.speaker: Pirate

Misadventure on the Sea#124.src: If this is another one of your jokes...
Misadventure on the Sea#124.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#127.src: I don't know, this wasn't planned!
Misadventure on the Sea#127.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#128.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#128.dst: 병사, 이제 네가 활약할 때다! 주문이든 뭐든 써서 저놈을 쫓아내!
Misadventure on the Sea#128.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#133.src: I knew you had it in ya, haha!
Misadventure on the Sea#133.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#134.src: What a show! Come, I've got some things to tell ya!
Misadventure on the Sea#134.dst: 대단한 구경이었어! 이리 와, 할 얘기가 있어!
Misadventure on the Sea#134.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#135.src: I don't know where that creature came from, but thanks to you it's gone.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.dst: 저 괴물이 어디서 왔는지는 몰라도, 네 덕에 사라졌군.
Misadventure on the Sea#135.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#136.src: I've got something else for you to tackle. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.dst: 맡길 일이 하나 더 있어. 그게... 쥐 얘기야.
Misadventure on the Sea#136.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#137.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#137.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#138.src: I think we have quite a hellish problem on our hands.
Misadventure on the Sea#138.dst: 아무래도 골치 아픈 문제가 생긴 것 같아.
Misadventure on the Sea#138.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#139.src: I'm not sure what y'all find there, but these are NOT normal rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#139.dst: 거기서 뭘 찾을지는 몰라도, 그건 평범한 쥐가 아니야.
Misadventure on the Sea#139.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#140.src: So please, get in there... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#140.dst: 그러니 부탁인데, 들어가서... 싹 다 죽여 줘, 알겠지?
Misadventure on the Sea#140.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#141.src: I've got faith in ya. Here goes nothin'!
Misadventure on the Sea#141.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#142.src: Soldier, now's your time to shine! Scare it off with one of your spells or something!
Misadventure on the Sea#142.dst: 병사, 이제 네가 활약할 때다! 주문이든 뭐든 써서 저놈을 쫓아내!
Misadventure on the Sea#142.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#143.src: Just cast one of your fancy spells!
Misadventure on the Sea#143.dst: 그 멋진 주문이나 좀 써 봐!
Misadventure on the Sea#143.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#144.src: That was... Phew... That was something.
Misadventure on the Sea#144.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#145.src: Now, for an even bigger surprise...
Misadventure on the Sea#145.dst: 자, 이제 더 큰 깜짝 선물이...
Misadventure on the Sea#145.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#146.src: What the hell soldier?? What don't you get in the "soldier" part of your job?
Misadventure on the Sea#146.dst: 뭐 하는 거야, 병사?? '병사'라는 일에서 뭘 모르겠다는 거야?
Misadventure on the Sea#146.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#147.src: Come, let's figure some things out.
Misadventure on the Sea#147.dst: 이리 와, 몇 가지 정리 좀 하자.
Misadventure on the Sea#147.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#148.src: You've been a massive disappointment, y'know?
Misadventure on the Sea#148.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#149.src: But you can still redeem yourself.
Misadventure on the Sea#149.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#150.src: Follow me, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#150.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#151.src: I mentioned a rat problem earlier... It's, uh, not a small one.
Misadventure on the Sea#151.dst: 아까 쥐 문제 얘기했지... 그게, 어, 작은 문제가 아니야.
Misadventure on the Sea#151.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#152.src: We've got gunpowder to retrieve, so you're the one who's gonna clear the hold.
Misadventure on the Sea#152.dst: 화약을 되찾아야 하니, 선창은 네가 치워 줘야겠어.
Misadventure on the Sea#152.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#153.src: So get in there... and try to kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#153.dst: 그러니 들어가서... 최대한 다 죽여 봐, 알겠지?
Misadventure on the Sea#153.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#154.src: Don't be as bad as earlier. You're a soldier.
Misadventure on the Sea#154.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#157.src: I expected you to do somethin', soldier, not him!
Misadventure on the Sea#157.dst: 병사, 난 네가 뭘 해 주길 바랐지 저 녀석이 아니라고!
Misadventure on the Sea#157.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#159.src: I have another task for you. It's about... the rats.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.dst: 맡길 일이 하나 더 있어. 그게... 쥐 얘기야.
Misadventure on the Sea#159.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#160.src: See, I really don't think we have your usual type of problem.
Misadventure on the Sea#160.dst: 아무래도 흔한 쥐 문제가 아닌 것 같거든.
Misadventure on the Sea#160.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#161.src: Come to the hold, I'll explain on the way.
Misadventure on the Sea#161.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#162.src: We sometimes hear unusually load footsteps, along with some really eerie squeaking...
Misadventure on the Sea#162.dst: 가끔 이상하게 큰 발소리가 들리고, 아주 소름 끼치는 찍찍 소리도 나...
Misadventure on the Sea#162.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#163.src: That's why we're not too fond of goin' in... But our gunpowder there! We need it, as pirates!
Misadventure on the Sea#163.dst: 그래서 다들 들어가기 싫어하지... 근데 거기 화약이 있어! 해적한텐 필수라고!
Misadventure on the Sea#163.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#164.src: So, I need you to get in... and kill everything, alright?
Misadventure on the Sea#164.dst: 그러니 들어가서... 싹 다 죽여 줘, 알겠지?
Misadventure on the Sea#164.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#165.src: Here goes nothing. Snoo, ya stay there!
Misadventure on the Sea#165.dst: 에라, 모르겠다. 스누, 넌 거기 있어!
Misadventure on the Sea#165.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#166.src: Explore the hold and kill the rats

Misadventure on the Sea#167.src: Defeat the Colossal Rat in the hold

Misadventure on the Sea#168.src: Use the gunpowder and the fuse to activate the cannon and escape

Misadventure on the Sea#169.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#169.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#170.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#170.dst: 그 망할 도둑 쥐새끼들을 처리했다고? 거대... 쥐라고?
Misadventure on the Sea#170.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#171.src: Nicely done, I knew I could count on ya! C'mere, take these!
Misadventure on the Sea#171.dst: 잘했어, 믿을 만할 줄 알았지! 이리 와, 이거 받아!
Misadventure on the Sea#171.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#172.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#172.dst: 아무튼, 이제 가서 쉬든 뭘 하든 마음대로 해!
Misadventure on the Sea#172.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#173.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#173.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#174.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#174.dst: 그 망할 도둑 쥐새끼들을 처리했다고? 거대... 쥐라고?
Misadventure on the Sea#174.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#175.src: Well, shiver me timbers! You did redeem yourself soldier!
Misadventure on the Sea#175.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#176.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#176.dst: 아무튼, 이제 가서 쉬든 뭘 하든 마음대로 해!
Misadventure on the Sea#176.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#177.src: Hey there! Ya bringin' me good news?
Misadventure on the Sea#177.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#178.src: You took care of these damn thieving rodents? A... colossal rat you say?
Misadventure on the Sea#178.dst: 그 망할 도둑 쥐새끼들을 처리했다고? 거대... 쥐라고?
Misadventure on the Sea#178.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#179.src: That sounds absolutely terrifying! And ya did that alone! You know what, her', take these.
Misadventure on the Sea#179.dst: 완전 끔찍하게 들리는데! 그걸 혼자 해냈다고! 좋아, 자, 이거 받아.
Misadventure on the Sea#179.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#180.src: Anyway, for now, you can go rest and do whatever you want!
Misadventure on the Sea#180.dst: 아무튼, 이제 가서 쉬든 뭘 하든 마음대로 해!
Misadventure on the Sea#180.speaker: Honip

Misadventure on the Sea#181.src: Hey! What do you think you're doin'?!
Misadventure on the Sea#181.speaker: Pirate Guard

Misadventure on the Sea#183.src: No, but they did a great job in the hold! Some gunpowder went missing though.
Misadventure on the Sea#183.dst: 아뇨, 근데 선창 일은 아주 잘했어요! 화약이 좀 없어지긴 했지만.
Misadventure on the Sea#183.speaker: Seth

Misadventure on the Sea#187.src: Find out where you are and a way to flee the island
Misadventure on the Sea#187.dst: 자신이 어디 있는지 알아내고 섬을 빠져나갈 방법을 찾으세요

Misadventure on the Sea#188.src: 'ey there soldier! Looks like ya're in a bit of a pickle! How 'bout ya hop on?'
Misadventure on the Sea#188.dst: 어이 병사! 좀 곤란한 처지 같구먼! 타는 게 어때?
Misadventure on the Sea#188.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#189.src: Well... We're headed for {p}, the heart of the ocean! Which is safer than wherever you were, heh!
Misadventure on the Sea#189.dst: 음... 우린 바다의 심장, {p}로 가는 중이야! 네가 있던 곳보다야 안전하지, 헤!
Misadventure on the Sea#189.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#190.src: I was casually takin' a scenic detour when I saw you and your shiny equipment on that island.
Misadventure on the Sea#190.dst: 경치 구경하러 슬쩍 돌아가는데, 저 섬에 너랑 반짝이는 장비가 보이더라고.
Misadventure on the Sea#190.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#191.src: So, ya gotta tell me what happened!
Misadventure on the Sea#191.dst: 그러니 무슨 일인지 얘기 좀 해 봐!
Misadventure on the Sea#191.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#192.src: Oh, kidnapped by pirates I see! How unfortunate...
Misadventure on the Sea#192.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#193.src: I guess that'll show ya, tryin' to avoid using good ol' seaskipper! I'm the only trustworthy one 'round here.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.dst: 믿음직한 연락선을 피하려 들더니 꼴좋다! 이 근방에서 믿을 건 나뿐이라고.
Misadventure on the Sea#193.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#194.src: Well, I hope they weren't too bad with ya! Here, I'll make you travel to {p} for free as compensation.
Misadventure on the Sea#194.dst: 뭐, 너무 험하게 굴진 않았길 바라! 보상으로 {p}까지 공짜로 태워 주지.
Misadventure on the Sea#194.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Misadventure on the Sea#195.src: Anyway, I can see the shore off in the distance! Hang tight, we're almost there!
Misadventure on the Sea#195.dst: 아무튼, 저 멀리 해안이 보인다! 꽉 잡아, 거의 다 왔어!
Misadventure on the Sea#195.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Mixed Feelings#000.src: Speak to Javen at the Corkus Docks.

Mixed Feelings#001.src: Mo’in lad! We don’t get many Wynn folks round ‘ere.
Mixed Feelings#001.dst: 안녕한가, 젊은이! 여긴 Wynn 사람이 잘 안 오는데.
Mixed Feelings#001.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#002.src: Welcome to old Javen’s tavern, what can I do yer for?
Mixed Feelings#002.dst: 이 Javen 영감의 선술집에 온 걸 환영하네, 뭘 줄까?
Mixed Feelings#002.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#003.src: Let’s see... I can give ya some of the islands “Old Cork” Brew..
Mixed Feelings#003.dst: 어디 보자... 섬의 '올드 코르크' 맥주를 좀 줄 수 있지..
Mixed Feelings#003.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#004.src: Seems like you are in luck today, adventurer.
Mixed Feelings#004.dst: 오늘 운이 좋은 것 같군요, 모험가.

Mixed Feelings#005.src: My day's been long, and you also look like you could do with a drink or two.
Mixed Feelings#005.dst: 긴 하루였는데, 당신도 한두 잔 마시면 좋겠어 보이네요.

Mixed Feelings#006.src: There's no need to pay by yourself. Javen, we'll have two cups of the seasonal brew.
Mixed Feelings#006.dst: 직접 낼 필요 없어요. Javen, 계절 맥주 두 잔 주세요.

Mixed Feelings#008.src: Everything alright, lad? Looking a bit pale...
Mixed Feelings#008.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#010.src: Oh by the mighty founders, everything is ruined!
Mixed Feelings#010.dst: 오, 위대한 건국자들이시여, 다 엉망이 됐어!
Mixed Feelings#010.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#012.src: You did this! Yer mad in the head! Possessed or summet!
Mixed Feelings#012.dst: 자네 짓이야! 제정신이 아니었어! 뭐에 씌기라도 했나!
Mixed Feelings#012.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#013.src: Yer seem fine now though. What got inter ye lad? You went berserk like!
Mixed Feelings#013.dst: 지금은 멀쩡해 보이는데. 뭐에 홀렸던 건가, 젊은이? 완전 미쳐 날뛰었다고!
Mixed Feelings#013.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#014.src: It weren’t just here neither. You ran outta here and wrecked all sorts! You better go find the people you affected and apologise
Mixed Feelings#014.dst: 여기만 그런 것도 아니야. 뛰쳐나가서 온갖 걸 박살 냈지! 피해 본 사람들을 찾아가서 사과하는 게 좋을 거야
Mixed Feelings#014.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#015.src: Talk to the citizens around the docks.

Mixed Feelings#016.src: The whole aqueduct is ruined! The cities fresh water is just draining into the ocean...
Mixed Feelings#016.dst: 수로가 통째로 망가졌어! 도시의 깨끗한 물이 바다로 다 새고 있다고...
Mixed Feelings#016.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#017.src: Ah! It's you! Back to wreck the rest of the city's infrastructure?! You're meant to be a tourist!
Mixed Feelings#017.dst: 아! 너구나! 남은 도시 시설까지 부수러 왔냐?! 관광객이라며!
Mixed Feelings#017.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#018.src: Wait... Weren't your eyes red before? Were you ill? It was a bit scary.
Mixed Feelings#018.dst: 잠깐... 아까 눈이 빨갛지 않았어? 아팠던 거야? 좀 무서웠는데.
Mixed Feelings#018.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#019.src: Oh.. You don't even remember? Well.. If you want to help, I need it right now.
Mixed Feelings#019.dst: 어.. 기억도 안 난다고? 뭐.. 돕고 싶으면, 지금 당장 필요해.
Mixed Feelings#019.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#020.src: The system needs to be rebooted, which can only be done down in the sewers.
Mixed Feelings#020.dst: 시스템을 재가동해야 하는데, 그건 하수도 아래에서만 할 수 있어.
Mixed Feelings#020.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#021.src: Kind of a design flaw if you ask me.. But if you go down that trap door, you will find it in the sewers!
Mixed Feelings#021.dst: 내가 보기엔 설계 결함이지.. 아무튼 저 뚜껑문으로 내려가면 하수도에서 찾을 수 있어!
Mixed Feelings#021.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#022.src: You fixed it? Everything you broke? That's one hell of a twisted personality.
Mixed Feelings#022.dst: 고쳤어? 부순 걸 전부? 성격 한번 참 꼬였네.
Mixed Feelings#022.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#023.src: Corkus has been urging tourists and envoys from the other provinces to gain recognition.
Mixed Feelings#023.dst: Corkus는 인정을 받으려고 다른 지방의 관광객과 사절을 적극적으로 불러들이고 있어.
Mixed Feelings#023.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#024.src: There are others that blame any outsiders for the problems of the islands.. They say they are patriots.. but honestly...
Mixed Feelings#024.dst: 그런데 섬의 문제를 외지인 탓으로 돌리는 사람들도 있지.. 자기들은 애국자라는데.. 솔직히...
Mixed Feelings#024.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#025.src: They are just awful people. They want to do anything to make non Corkians look bad.
Mixed Feelings#025.dst: 그냥 끔찍한 인간들이야. Corkus 사람이 아닌 이들을 나쁘게 보이게 하려고 뭐든 하지.
Mixed Feelings#025.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#026.src: If I were you, I'd better start asking around to find out more about that!
Mixed Feelings#026.dst: 내가 너라면 그 일에 대해 여기저기 물어보기 시작하겠어!
Mixed Feelings#026.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#027.src: Speak to the other citizens around the docks.

Mixed Feelings#028.src: It’s THEM! Someone call the authorities! It’s the one who set my house on fire.
Mixed Feelings#028.dst: 그놈이다! 누가 경비대 좀 불러! 우리 집에 불 지른 놈이야.
Mixed Feelings#028.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#029.src: How could you do this and just come back all calm like? You were screaming your head off!
Mixed Feelings#029.dst: 그런 짓을 해 놓고 어떻게 태연하게 돌아와? 아까는 목이 터져라 소리 질렀잖아!
Mixed Feelings#029.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#030.src: My house is still burning! Wait… You say you don’t have any memory of any of this?
Mixed Feelings#030.dst: 우리 집이 아직 타고 있다고! 잠깐… 이 일이 전혀 기억 안 난다고?
Mixed Feelings#030.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#031.src: Look, if you’re serious, you have a chance to help make it better.
Mixed Feelings#031.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#032.src: There are valuables in a chest in there you must save before the whole place burns to the ground, get going!
Mixed Feelings#032.dst: 안에 귀중품이 든 상자가 있어. 집이 다 타 버리기 전에 꺼내 와야 해, 어서!
Mixed Feelings#032.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#033.src: You did it! So you weren't lying? Ugh, I guess you might just be trustworthy.
Mixed Feelings#033.dst: 해냈구나! 거짓말이 아니었네? 휴, 믿어도 될 사람인가 보다.
Mixed Feelings#033.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#034.src: You know about the 'patriots' of Corkus?
Mixed Feelings#034.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#035.src: Well this kind of maneuver is right up their alley.. It certainly made you look bad!
Mixed Feelings#035.dst: 이런 수법이 딱 그놈들 특기야.. 확실히 네가 나빠 보였지!
Mixed Feelings#035.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#036.src: Now that you bring it up, I did hear a group of Corkians quietly discussing something about framing tourists.
Mixed Feelings#036.dst: 그러고 보니, Corkus 사람 몇이 관광객에게 누명 씌우는 얘기를 수군대는 걸 들었어.
Mixed Feelings#036.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#037.src: I have no idea how they would make you do something against your will though...
Mixed Feelings#037.dst: 근데 어떻게 네 뜻을 거슬러 뭘 하게 만들었는지는 모르겠어...
Mixed Feelings#037.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#038.src: Talk to the final victim of your rampage.
Mixed Feelings#038.dst: 당신이 날뛰었을 때의 마지막 피해자와 대화하세요.

Mixed Feelings#039.src: Came back to wreck the rest of my work have you? Why aren't you all insane looking?
Mixed Feelings#039.dst: 내 남은 일거리까지 망치러 왔냐? 왜 이젠 미친 사람처럼 안 보이지?
Mixed Feelings#039.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#040.src: So now your story is you were not in control? It's easy to believe. You were mad!
Mixed Feelings#040.dst: 그러니까 이젠 제정신이 아니었다는 거야? 믿기 쉽네. 완전 미쳐 있었으니까!
Mixed Feelings#040.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#041.src: I don't know if you have some kind of condition.. but if you want to help, I need it to clean up the mess you made.
Mixed Feelings#041.dst: 무슨 병이 있는 건지 모르겠지만.. 돕고 싶으면 네가 벌인 난장판 치우는 데 손이 필요해.
Mixed Feelings#041.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#042.src: I need to replace all the cargo you destroyed.
Mixed Feelings#042.dst: 네가 부순 화물을 전부 채워 넣어야 해.
Mixed Feelings#042.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#043.src: All you gotta do is get those crates here and put them back on the boats. The limit is {~} for each boat, not more not less!
Mixed Feelings#043.dst: 저 상자들을 여기로 가져와서 배에 다시 실으면 돼. 배마다 {~}개가 한도야, 더도 덜도 말고!
Mixed Feelings#043.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#044.src: Some weights might not be needed, but be careful, I don't wanna go diving after you.
Mixed Feelings#044.dst: 추 몇 개는 필요 없을 수도 있어. 근데 조심해, 너 건지러 잠수하긴 싫으니까.
Mixed Feelings#044.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#045.src: You did it? ... -I mean, at last. Eh... I guess I was too fast with my judgement for once.
Mixed Feelings#045.dst: 해냈어? ... -그러니까, 드디어. 어... 이번만큼은 내가 너무 성급했나 보네.
Mixed Feelings#045.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#046.src: Hmm… As it happens I have seen some strange things around here.
Mixed Feelings#046.dst: 흠… 마침 이 근처에서 이상한 걸 좀 봤어.
Mixed Feelings#046.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#047.src: During the night I saw something moving across the cliffs.. Looked like a personal balloon.
Mixed Feelings#047.dst: 밤에 뭔가가 절벽을 따라 움직이더라.. 1인용 기구 같았어.
Mixed Feelings#047.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#048.src: It wouldn't have been out of the ordinary except there are occasional blood trails leading from the balloon...
Mixed Feelings#048.dst: 그것만이면 별일 아닌데, 가끔 그 기구에서 핏자국이 이어져 있더라고...
Mixed Feelings#048.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#049.src: If you really want to approach these people… I guess all you would need to do is follow the trail of blood.
Mixed Feelings#049.dst: 정말 그 사람들한테 접근하고 싶다면… 핏자국만 따라가면 될 거야.
Mixed Feelings#049.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#050.src: Can't say I recommend it but the trail starts near the aqueduct.
Mixed Feelings#050.dst: 권하진 않지만, 핏자국은 수로 근처에서 시작돼.
Mixed Feelings#050.speaker: Corkus City Citizen

Mixed Feelings#051.src: Follow the trail of blood and board the airship.

Mixed Feelings#053.src: Why are you here? I don't mean here and now, I mean why are you on our island?
Mixed Feelings#053.dst: 왜 여기 있지? 지금 이곳 말고, 왜 우리 섬에 왔느냐는 거다.
Mixed Feelings#053.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#054.src: You have of course found yourself in front of me because you were a pawn in our attempts to save this nation.
Mixed Feelings#054.dst: 당연히 내 앞에 서게 된 건, 네가 이 나라를 구하려는 우리 계획의 졸이었기 때문이지.
Mixed Feelings#054.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#055.src: I suppose I should apologize, but truth is you are the reason for this movement. Not you personally... but your people.
Mixed Feelings#055.dst: 사과해야겠지만, 사실 이 운동의 원인은 너다. 너 개인이 아니라... 너희 종족이.
Mixed Feelings#055.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#056.src: You... Look at yourself. You fight in a war you did not cause. You come from a land you don't even remember.
Mixed Feelings#056.dst: 너... 네 꼴을 봐라. 일으키지도 않은 전쟁에서 싸우고, 기억도 못 하는 땅에서 왔지.
Mixed Feelings#056.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#057.src: We ask ourselves why would we invite people from two lands of sin. Invite a nation of warring travellers and a nation of greedy merchants to our doors?
Mixed Feelings#057.dst: 우린 자문한다. 왜 두 죄악의 땅 사람들을 불러들이나? 싸움만 하는 여행자의 나라와 탐욕스런 상인의 나라를?
Mixed Feelings#057.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#058.src: The Corkian people are above such mundane capitalism and brutality. We work as a nation to better all.
Mixed Feelings#058.dst: Corkus 사람들은 그런 속된 자본주의와 야만을 초월한다. 우린 모두를 위해 나라로서 일한다.
Mixed Feelings#058.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#059.src: You have been a pawn your entire existence on this world. The worst part is you don't even know it.
Mixed Feelings#059.dst: 넌 이 세상에 존재한 내내 졸이었다. 최악은 그걸 모른다는 거지.
Mixed Feelings#059.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#060.src: Do you, for example - Know the name of your ultimate enemy? The reason for the war on your land?
Mixed Feelings#060.dst: 예를 들어 - 너희 궁극의 적의 이름을 아나? 너희 땅에서 전쟁이 벌어진 이유는?
Mixed Feelings#060.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#061.src: No? Didn't think so. I have no time for this. You served your purpose, even if you did try and redeem your barbaric behaviour... Kill them!
Mixed Feelings#061.dst: 모르나? 그럴 줄 알았다. 시간 낭비군. 네 야만적인 행동을 만회하려 했어도, 쓸모는 다했다... 죽여라!
Mixed Feelings#061.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#062.src: Fight and evade the waves of mobs until the timer runs out.
Mixed Feelings#062.dst: 시간이 끝날 때까지 몰려오는 몬스터 무리와 싸우며 피하세요.

Mixed Feelings#063.src: Tougher than I expected. You don’t mind if I interfere a bit, do you?
Mixed Feelings#063.dst: 생각보다 질기군. 내가 좀 끼어들어도 괜찮겠지?
Mixed Feelings#063.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#065.src: You may have won this fight, but you are still the loser in this situation.
Mixed Feelings#065.dst: 이 싸움은 이겼을지 몰라도, 이 상황에선 여전히 네가 패자다.
Mixed Feelings#065.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#066.src: Your eyes are still closed to the greater picture of it all. Corkus is the only place safe from it. I will make sure of it!
Mixed Feelings#066.dst: 넌 여전히 큰 그림을 못 보고 있다. 그것에서 안전한 곳은 Corkus뿐이다. 반드시 그렇게 만들겠다!
Mixed Feelings#066.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#067.src: There are still greater things in motion as we speak. Plans that will secure this island's safety.
Mixed Feelings#067.dst: 지금도 더 큰 일들이 움직이고 있다. 이 섬의 안전을 지킬 계획들이.
Mixed Feelings#067.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#068.src: Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… It’s all a joke. We all sit on the cusp of this reality, fighting only the prelude to the real war.
Mixed Feelings#068.dst: Fruma.. Gavel.. Wynn… 다 웃음거리다. 우린 모두 이 현실의 끝자락에서 진짜 전쟁의 서막만 치르고 있지.
Mixed Feelings#068.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#069.src: This is our farewell. I must depart before the short sighted government arrive. Good Luck with your struggle.
Mixed Feelings#069.dst: 이걸로 작별이다. 근시안적인 정부가 오기 전에 떠나야겠군. 네 발버둥에 행운을 빈다.
Mixed Feelings#069.speaker: Rensa

Mixed Feelings#071.src: Now look who we got over ‘ere! We were all wondering if you'd ever wake up.
Mixed Feelings#071.dst: 이게 누구신가! 자네가 깨어나긴 할지 다들 궁금해했지.
Mixed Feelings#071.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#072.src: Sorry we ever doubted ye. Weren't fair of us. What you drank was a rare brew designed to enrage and berserk someone.
Mixed Feelings#072.dst: 의심해서 미안하네. 우리가 공정하지 못했어. 자네가 마신 건 사람을 격분시켜 날뛰게 하는 희귀한 술이었네.
Mixed Feelings#072.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#073.src: Basically, it weren't yer fault lad. We never knew some Corkians were so closed minded.
Mixed Feelings#073.dst: 결국 자네 잘못이 아니었어, 젊은이. 속 좁은 Corkus 사람들이 있는 줄 몰랐네.
Mixed Feelings#073.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#074.src: Anyways! Look at what we got, thanks to you I acquired this little place!
Mixed Feelings#074.dst: 아무튼! 이것 좀 보게, 자네 덕에 이 작은 가게를 얻었다네!
Mixed Feelings#074.speaker: Javen

Mixed Feelings#075.src: By means of reparations have this on me. Yer always welcome round here.
Mixed Feelings#075.dst: 사과의 뜻으로 이건 내가 사지. 언제든 들르게.
Mixed Feelings#075.speaker: Javen

Murder Mystery#000.src: Looks like the symbol has something carved in on the back...
Murder Mystery#000.dst: 문양 뒷면에 뭔가 새겨져 있는 것 같다...

Murder Mystery#002.src: Stand back, human! This is a crime scene, under my authority. I cannot let you inside.
Murder Mystery#002.dst: 물러서게, 인간! 여긴 내 관할의 범죄 현장이네. 들여보낼 수 없어.
Murder Mystery#002.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#003.src: Although we are in need of some... assistance... and you are fairly experienced, are you not?
Murder Mystery#003.dst: 그래도 우리에겐... 도움이... 좀 필요하고, 자넨 경험이 꽤 많지 않나?
Murder Mystery#003.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#004.src: Well, straight to the point... do you think I might be able to hire you as a private investigator?
Murder Mystery#004.dst: 그럼 본론으로... 자네를 사설 탐정으로 고용할 수 있겠나?
Murder Mystery#004.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#005.src: To put it bluntly, the owner of this house, Eminar, was murdered a few days ago, and what few leads we had have all gone cold.
Murder Mystery#005.dst: 솔직히 말하면, 이 집 주인 Eminar가 며칠 전 살해됐는데, 몇 안 되던 단서도 다 끊겼네.
Murder Mystery#005.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#006.src: This is acting outside protocol, of course... but if you manage to catch the killer, I'm sure I could pull some strings and pay you for your work!
Murder Mystery#006.dst: 물론 규정 밖의 일이지... 하지만 범인을 잡아 준다면, 내가 손을 써서 보수를 꼭 챙겨 주지!
Murder Mystery#006.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#007.src: I'll make sure no one stops you inside the crime scene. Head inside the house and see if you can find anything helpful.
Murder Mystery#007.dst: 현장 안에서 아무도 자넬 막지 않게 하겠네. 집 안에 들어가 쓸 만한 게 있는지 찾아보게.
Murder Mystery#007.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#008.src: My soldiers and I will keep watch outside the house, and make sure you're not disturbed. Be careful in there!
Murder Mystery#008.dst: 나와 병사들이 집 밖을 지키며 방해받지 않게 하겠네. 안에서 조심하게!
Murder Mystery#008.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#009.src: Investigate the crime scene at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] for clues.

Murder Mystery#010.src: Ah, a human! A refreshing sight these days. You've come to see me, I presume? What brings you here?
Murder Mystery#010.dst: 아, 인간이군! 요즘 보기 드문 반가운 얼굴이오. 날 보러 온 거겠지? 무슨 일이오?
Murder Mystery#010.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#011.src: An investigation!? Eminar? That's... that's absurd. I've done nothing wrong.
Murder Mystery#011.dst: 수사라고!? Eminar? 그건... 말도 안 되오. 난 잘못한 게 없소.
Murder Mystery#011.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#012.src: Still, the poor man. Eminar and I were good friends, you know. If it could help find his killer, I may have some information for you... strictly off-record, of course...
Murder Mystery#012.dst: 그래도 불쌍한 친구. Eminar와 난 좋은 친구였소. 범인을 찾는 데 도움이 된다면 알려 줄 게 있을지도... 물론 철저히 비공식으로...
Murder Mystery#012.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#013.src: Well. You see, there's an underground gambling den hidden in the city's sewers. Only the elite can get in, and Eminar happened to be a frequent visitor.
Murder Mystery#013.dst: 그러니까. 도시 하수도에 숨겨진 지하 도박장이 있소. 상류층만 들어갈 수 있는데, Eminar가 단골이었지.
Murder Mystery#013.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#014.src: Once, he even brought me along with him.
Murder Mystery#014.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#015.src: Eminar, though, he often tried to cheat the other gamblers. I suppose it was only a matter of time before they had enough; most do not take cheating lightly.
Murder Mystery#015.dst: 그런데 Eminar는 다른 도박꾼들을 자주 속이려 했소. 결국 참다못할 날이 올 수밖에. 속임수를 가볍게 넘기는 자는 드무니까.
Murder Mystery#015.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#016.src: Back to the point, many of them, including poor Eminar, had a symbol built into the sides of their homes, shaped like a snake. A proof of membership, you could say.
Murder Mystery#016.dst: 본론으로 돌아가서, 불쌍한 Eminar를 포함해 많은 회원이 집 벽에 뱀 모양 문양을 박아 두었소. 회원 증표라 할 수 있지.
Murder Mystery#016.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#017.src: If you can find it, it will show you the way to get into the sewers. I'm sorry, I would tell you more if I knew more. But good luck with your investigation, sir.
Murder Mystery#017.dst: 그걸 찾으면 하수도로 가는 길이 보일 거요. 미안하오, 아는 게 더 있으면 말해 줄 텐데. 수사에 행운을 빌겠소.
Murder Mystery#017.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#018.src: Return to the victim's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find a snake symbol.
Murder Mystery#018.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 피해자 집으로 돌아가 뱀 문양을 찾으세요.

Murder Mystery#019.src: Find the gamblers in the {p} sewers.

Murder Mystery#020.src: How did ya find us down 'ere? I don't remember you... you're with the police, aren't ya? Here after Eminar, I suppose?
Murder Mystery#020.dst: 여기까진 어떻게 찾아왔냐? 처음 보는 얼굴인데... 경찰 쪽이지? Eminar 일로 왔나 보군?
Murder Mystery#020.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#021.src: Yeah, we've 'eard about what happened to him. Murders don't happen every day up there, ya know. And as it happened, I saw Eminar down here, not too long ago...
Murder Mystery#021.dst: 그래, 그 녀석 일은 들었지. 위에선 살인이 매일 나는 게 아니거든. 마침 얼마 전에 여기서 Eminar를 봤지...
Murder Mystery#021.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#022.src: Well... as long as I get a guarantee I won't be shut down, I'll help ya. This is a very profitable place, as I'm sure ya might've guessed.
Murder Mystery#022.dst: 뭐... 여길 안 닫겠다고 보장만 해 주면 도와주지. 짐작했겠지만, 여긴 돈이 아주 잘 벌리는 곳이거든.
Murder Mystery#022.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#023.src: He was brought down here by his friend one day. Rohem, it was. A fine customer, you understand. Never failed to pay his dues...
Murder Mystery#023.dst: 어느 날 친구가 그 녀석을 데려왔어. Rohem이었지. 좋은 손님이야, 알지? 빚 한 번 안 밀렸고...
Murder Mystery#023.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#024.src: But the day he brought Eminar 'round, though, it got ugly fast. Kept borrowing Rohem's emeralds and losing, till neither of em had anythin' left.
Murder Mystery#024.dst: 근데 Eminar를 데려온 날은 금방 험악해졌지. Rohem의 에메랄드를 계속 빌려 잃다가 둘 다 빈털터리가 됐어.
Murder Mystery#024.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#025.src: It was a good day for me, for obvious reasons, don'cha see! But Rohem was furious. Dead drunk, too, but what else is new!
Murder Mystery#025.dst: 뻔한 이유로 나한텐 좋은 날이었지! 근데 Rohem은 길길이 날뛰었어. 곤드레만드레 취했고, 뭐 늘 그랬지만!
Murder Mystery#025.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#026.src: Neither of 'em has been back since, though in Eminar's case, I can see why! And I hope that's enough for ya, 'cause that's all I got.
Murder Mystery#026.dst: 그 뒤로 둘 다 안 왔어. Eminar야 이유가 뻔하지만! 이 정도면 됐길 바란다, 아는 건 이게 다니까.
Murder Mystery#026.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#027.src: Now get out of 'ere; there's a back exit in the wall over there. Though, if ya ever fancy a game of 'jack, come back'n we'll be happy to serve ya!
Murder Mystery#027.dst: 이제 나가; 저쪽 벽에 뒷문이 있어. 그래도 블랙잭 한 판 생각나면 다시 와, 기꺼이 모셔 주지!
Murder Mystery#027.speaker: Valimare

Murder Mystery#028.src: Confront Rohem about the murder at house #{~} in {p}.

Murder Mystery#029.src: Ah... you again! You're back. I see that. I must admit, I did not expect you to return... so soon...
Murder Mystery#029.dst: 아... 또 당신이군! 돌아왔소. 보이오. 솔직히 이렇게... 빨리... 돌아올 줄은 몰랐소...
Murder Mystery#029.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#030.src: You really did find your way down there? Oh, that's... excellent... I hope the investigation is going well. Now if you'll just leave me be-
Murder Mystery#030.dst: 정말 거기까지 내려갔단 말이오? 오, 그거... 훌륭하군... 수사가 잘되길 바라오. 그럼 이제 날 좀 내버려-
Murder Mystery#030.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#031.src: Valimare? Bah! Why would you trust anything he says? He's a criminal! A scam artist! I mean, I did direct you to him, but...
Murder Mystery#031.dst: Valimare? 흥! 그놈 말을 왜 믿소? 범죄자요! 사기꾼이라고! 뭐, 그놈한테 보낸 건 나지만...
Murder Mystery#031.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#032.src: He- He's the one you should be arresting. Eminar was a danger to society, got what he deserved, the fool-
Murder Mystery#032.dst: 그- 체포할 건 그놈이오. Eminar는 사회에 위험한 자였으니 자업자득이지, 그 멍청이-
Murder Mystery#032.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#033.src: Wait! No! Don't turn me in! Can't you let me finish my drink in peace? Get out, get out, you can't prove anything!
Murder Mystery#033.dst: 잠깐! 안 돼! 넘기지 마시오! 술이나 편히 마시게 해 주면 안 되오? 나가, 나가, 증명 못 할 거요!
Murder Mystery#033.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#034.src: Besides, have you ever heard of a little thing called evidence? You don't have any proof!
Murder Mystery#034.dst: 게다가, 증거라는 걸 들어 보긴 했소? 증거가 하나도 없잖소!
Murder Mystery#034.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#035.src: Now, officer, if you don't have a proper warrant, I expect you to vacate my property immediately!
Murder Mystery#035.dst: 자, 경관 나리, 정식 영장이 없다면 당장 내 집에서 나가 주시오!
Murder Mystery#035.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#036.src: Find the murder weapon around Rohem's house at house #{~} in {p}.
Murder Mystery#036.dst: {p}의 {~}번 집, Rohem의 집 주변에서 흉기를 찾으세요.

Murder Mystery#037.src: Hi! I'm digging a hole in my garden, just like Mr. Rohem did last night!
Murder Mystery#037.dst: 안녕! 난 마당에 구멍 파고 있어, 어젯밤 Rohem 아저씨처럼!
Murder Mystery#037.speaker: Child

Murder Mystery#038.src: For the last time officer, would you either show me a warrant or get out of my- what are you doing in my garden?!
Murder Mystery#038.dst: 마지막으로 말하는데, 영장을 보이든가 내 집에서- 내 마당에서 뭘 하는 거요?!
Murder Mystery#038.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#039.src: A... a hatchet? I don't know what you mean, I- I've never seen that before in my life!
Murder Mystery#039.dst: 소... 손도끼? 무슨 소린지 모르겠소, 난- 난 그런 건 난생처음 보오!
Murder Mystery#039.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#040.src: Gah! Curse you, human! I might be headed to jail, but I can send you straight to hell!
Murder Mystery#040.dst: 크윽! 저주받을 인간! 감옥에 갈지언정, 널 곧장 지옥으로 보내 주마!
Murder Mystery#040.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#041.src: That's enough, Rohem! Stand down, or the guards will attack.
Murder Mystery#041.dst: 그만해, Rohem! 물러서, 안 그러면 경비병이 공격한다.
Murder Mystery#041.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#042.src: Augh! Fine, you've got me. But mark my words, this won't be the last you hear of me, human!
Murder Mystery#042.dst: 으윽! 좋아, 잡혔다. 하지만 명심해라, 인간. 내 이름을 듣는 게 이게 끝은 아닐 거다!
Murder Mystery#042.speaker: Rohem

Murder Mystery#043.src: Whatever you pale-faced walking cowlick. You're headed to {p} Penitentiary with a charge of first-class murder. Guards, take him away.
Murder Mystery#043.dst: 그러시든가, 이 창백한 뻗친 머리야. 1급 살인죄로 {p} 교도소행이다. 경비병, 끌고 가라.
Murder Mystery#043.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#044.src: As for you, human, please accept my immense gratitude. We probably wouldn't have caught that rat without you.
Murder Mystery#044.dst: 그리고 인간, 깊은 감사를 받아 주게. 자네 없이는 그 쥐새끼를 못 잡았을 걸세.
Murder Mystery#044.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#045.src: On behalf of the city of {p}, please accept these emeralds as compensation for your services. You were a fine detective today!
Murder Mystery#045.dst: {p} 시를 대표해, 수고의 대가로 이 에메랄드를 받아 주게. 오늘 자넨 훌륭한 탐정이었네!
Murder Mystery#045.speaker: Detective Lorias

Murder Mystery#046.src: Heya there! Fancy a quick game of blackjack?
Murder Mystery#046.dst: 어이 안녕! 블랙잭 한 판 어때?
Murder Mystery#046.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#048.src: Good stuff! Put ya money in the pot and I'll start the deal.
Murder Mystery#048.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#049.src: Not feelin' up to playin' right now? No worries, just drop by later!
Murder Mystery#049.dst: 지금은 할 기분 아냐? 괜찮아, 나중에 들러!
Murder Mystery#049.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#050.src: Not right now? No worries - come back another time!
Murder Mystery#050.dst: 지금은 말고? 괜찮아 - 다음에 또 와!
Murder Mystery#050.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#051.src: Ah, new to the game huh? No worries, lemme tell ya all about it!
Murder Mystery#051.dst: 아, 처음이구나? 괜찮아, 내가 다 알려 줄게!
Murder Mystery#051.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#052.src: The rules are simple! I deal two cards face up to ya both face down, and two cards to me, one face up and one face down.
Murder Mystery#052.dst: 규칙은 간단해! 너한텐 두 장을 뒷면으로 주고, 나는 두 장을 받아서 한 장은 앞면, 한 장은 뒷면으로 둬.
Murder Mystery#052.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#053.src: Ya can hit and get another card as many times as ya want, or stand and end ya turn. The aim is to get the value of your hand as close to {~} as possible!
Murder Mystery#053.dst: 히트하면 원하는 만큼 카드를 더 받고, 스탠드하면 턴이 끝나. 목표는 손패 합을 최대한 {~}에 가깝게 만드는 거야!
Murder Mystery#053.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#054.src: Number cards are worth what they say, all picture cards are worth {~}, and an ace can be worth either {~} or {~}, whichever works best for ya hand.
Murder Mystery#054.dst: 숫자 카드는 적힌 숫자대로, 그림 카드는 전부 {~}, 에이스는 {~}이나 {~} 중 손패에 유리한 쪽으로 쳐.
Murder Mystery#054.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#055.src: Go over {~} and that's it - you're bust! Stand with your current hand and it's my turn to hit or stand to try and beat your hand.
Murder Mystery#055.dst: {~}을 넘기면 끝 - 버스트야! 지금 손패로 스탠드하면, 내 차례에 히트나 스탠드로 네 손패를 이기려 하지.
Murder Mystery#055.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#056.src: And if ya get a blackjack - that's an ace and a picture card or a ten - ya automatically get double ya money back!
Murder Mystery#056.dst: 그리고 블랙잭 - 에이스에 그림 카드나 10 - 이 나오면 자동으로 판돈의 두 배를 돌려받아!
Murder Mystery#056.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Murder Mystery#057.src: Sound fair enough? Alrighty, just right-click me again to play!
Murder Mystery#057.dst: 공평하지? 좋아, 하려면 나를 다시 우클릭해!
Murder Mystery#057.speaker: Blackjack Dealer

Mushroom Man#000.src: I'm sorry, recruit, but that passage is blocked. We used to use it, but not anymore...

Mushroom Man#001.src: Halt! You cannot go down this cave, it is blocked.

Mushroom Man#002.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who we lost to spiders some time ago.

similar.text: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.

Mushroom Man#003.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken its toll on us both.

Mushroom Man#004.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.

Mushroom Man#005.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. I only wish he would show that side of himself to others.

Mushroom Man#006.src: {u}, hello! This place really is nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.

Mushroom Man#007.src: You need to be Woodcutting Lv. {~} to start this Mini-Quest.

Mushroom Man#008.src: We can kill spiders! Right, {u}? Come on, this is what we're here to do! We became soldiers to help the people of Wynn, didn't we? We'll help you get your mushrooms back, sir.
Mushroom Man#008.dst: 거미라면 죽일 수 있어요! 그렇지, {u}? 가자, 이러려고 온 거잖아! Wynn 사람들을 도우려고 병사가 된 거잖아? 버섯 되찾아 드릴게요.

Mushroom Man#009.src: H-hm. Good. I can't m-make my soup without... mushrooms. F-follow me, I'll take you to the-... the spiders. B-bad spiders.

Mushroom Man#010.src: Ah, you two must be the the recruits Aledar has been telling us all about. It's good to finally meet you, though I can't help but notice you seem to have arrived in a rush.

Mushroom Man#011.src: O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushrooms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-why wouldn't it b-be?
Mushroom Man#011.dst: 오-오! 아뇨, 아, 아무 일도 없어요. 저, 전혀요. 제 버-버-버섯은... 괜찮아요. 왜 무, 묻는 거죠? 다-... 다 조, 좋아요. 아, 안 좋을 이유가 있나요?

Mushroom Man#012.src: Soon... s-soon I will have my m-mushrooms again...
Mushroom Man#012.dst: 곧... 고, 곧 내 버-버섯을 되찾을 거야...

Mushroom Man#013.src: G-gah! D-don't you know it's rude to-... to e-eavesdrop?
Mushroom Man#013.dst: 으-으악! 여, 엿듣는 건 실례라는-... 거 모, 몰라요?

Mushroom Man#014.src: I-... this is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
Mushroom Man#014.dst: 이-... 큰일이다. 정말 큰일이야. 당장 촌장님께 알려야 해.

Mushroom Man#015.src: Right! Right. We've arrived from {p}, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
Mushroom Man#015.dst: 네! 네. {p}에서 왔습니다. 나쁜 소식과 지원 요청을 갖고요. 숲의 거미들이 적대적으로 변해 마을을 위협하고 있습니다.

Mushroom Man#016.src: And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with him.
Mushroom Man#016.dst: 그리고 Van 중위님이 타락한 요새 급습을 계획 중이에요! 병력이 늘면 분명 반기실 거예요.

Mushroom Man#018.src: {u}, hello! This place is really nice, isn't it? I'd like to stay a while longer before moving on towards {p}, but I'll be ready soon.
Mushroom Man#018.dst: {u}, 안녕! 여기 정말 좋지 않아? {p}로 가기 전에 좀 더 머물고 싶은데, 곧 준비될 거야.
Mushroom Man#018.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#019.src: In the meantime, I've been thinking about what we could do to help this place... I've maybe got something.
Mushroom Man#019.dst: 그동안 이곳을 도울 방법을 생각해 봤는데... 뭔가 있을지도 몰라.
Mushroom Man#019.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#020.src: Take a look at that villager over there. He's acting a little off, like he's got something going on. I wonder...
Mushroom Man#020.dst: 저기 저 주민 좀 봐. 좀 이상하게 행동하잖아, 무슨 일이 있는 것처럼. 혹시...
Mushroom Man#020.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#021.src: Alright, I've decided. I'm feeling a little restless, so let's go over there and see if there's anything we can help with!
Mushroom Man#021.dst: 좋아, 결정했어. 좀 좀이 쑤시니까, 저기 가서 도울 일이 있는지 보자!
Mushroom Man#021.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#022.src: Maybe we can leave this place better off than it was when we got here!
Mushroom Man#022.dst: 우리가 처음 왔을 때보다 여길 좀 더 낫게 만들고 떠날 수 있을지도!
Mushroom Man#022.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#023.src: Speak to the strange man at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#024.src: G-... Hi! H-how can I help you on this... this p-perfectly fine and n-n-normal day!
Mushroom Man#024.dst: 으-... 안녕하세요! 이, 이... 이렇게 너무나 멀쩡하고 펴, 평범한 날에 뭘 도와드릴까요!
Mushroom Man#024.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#025.src: Sorry to interrupt- we're soldiers traveling through this town, and you looked like the sort of person who might need the kind of help soldiers can provide. Anything we can help with?
Mushroom Man#025.dst: 방해해서 죄송해요- 저흰 이 마을을 지나는 병사인데, 병사의 도움이 필요해 보이셔서요. 도와드릴 일 있나요?
Mushroom Man#025.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#026.src: O-oh! No, t-there's nothing going on. Not a th-thing. My m-m-mushroms are... they're fine. Why are you a-asking? Ev-... everything is g-great. W-Why wouldn't it b-be?
Mushroom Man#026.dst: 오-오! 아뇨, 아, 아무 일도 없어요. 저, 전혀요. 제 버-버-버섯은... 괜찮아요. 왜 무, 묻는 거죠? 다-... 다 조, 좋아요. 아, 안 좋을 이유가 있나요?
Mushroom Man#026.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#027.src: ...O-okay, fine, y-you caught me! My mushrooms... my m-mushrooms aren't fine! T-they're bad, even! A-are you hap-... happy now?
Mushroom Man#027.dst: ...조-좋아요, 그래요, 드, 들켰네요! 제 버섯... 제 버-버섯이 안 괜찮아요! 오, 오히려 나빠요! 이, 이제 만-... 만족해요?
Mushroom Man#027.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#028.src: Ehm- no, but that's why we're here! Is there anything we can do to help your... uh. Your mushrooms?
Mushroom Man#028.dst: 어- 아뇨, 그래서 저희가 온 거예요! 뭐 도와드릴 게 있을까요... 어. 버섯에요?
Mushroom Man#028.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#029.src: Hm. One soldier, two s-soldier... Y-you look weak. I've s-seen str-... stronger. B-But- eheh, the- the s-stronger soldiers are... not here. Y-you'll be good enough. Maybe.
Mushroom Man#029.dst: 흠. 병사 하나, 병사 두-둘... 야, 약해 보이네요. 더 가-... 강한 사람도 봤는데. 그, 그래도- 헤헤, 그- 그 강한 병사들은... 여기 없죠. 다, 당신들로 될 거예요. 아마.
Mushroom Man#029.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#030.src: I- my favorite mushroom spot. I c-can't use it any-... anymore. Spiders. L-lots of spiders. They've t-t-taken over it... I can't get... mushrooms. Can y-you kill the s-s-spiders? Mushrooms.
Mushroom Man#030.dst: 제- 제일 좋아하는 버섯 자리. 이제 쓸 수가-... 없어요. 거미. 거, 거미가 잔뜩. 거길 차, 차, 차지했어요... 버섯을... 못 따요. 거-거-거미 좀 죽여 줄래요? 버섯.
Mushroom Man#030.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#032.src: H-hm. Good. I can't m-make soup without... mushrooms. F-follow me, I'll take you to the-... the spiders. B-bad spiders.
Mushroom Man#032.dst: 흐-흠. 좋아요. 버섯 없인... 수, 수프를 못 끓여요. 따, 따라와요, 거-... 거미한테 데려갈게요. 나, 나쁜 거미.
Mushroom Man#032.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#033.src: Follow Yahya to his infested mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#034.src: H-here we are. I- I can f-feel the m-m-mushrooms... from here. And the s-spiders! No-... no good.
Mushroom Man#034.dst: 여, 여기예요. 여기서도 버-버-버섯이... 느, 느껴져요. 거미도! 안-... 안 좋아요.
Mushroom Man#034.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#035.src: S-so! Mushrooms. Those-... those bad c-creepy c-crawly s-s-spiders... Kill them. P-please?
Mushroom Man#035.dst: 그, 그래서! 버섯. 저-... 저 나쁘고 오, 오싹하게 기, 기어다니는 거-거-거미들... 죽여 줘요. 제, 제발요?
Mushroom Man#035.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#036.src: We wouldn't have come here if we weren't planning to. Alright, {u}, let's clear out some spiders!
Mushroom Man#036.dst: 그럴 생각 없었으면 오지도 않았어요. 좋아, {u}, 거미 좀 치워 보자!
Mushroom Man#036.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#037.src: Clear out the spiders from Yahya's favorite mushroom patch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], then return and talk to Yahya.
Mushroom Man#037.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있는 Yahya의 버섯밭에서 거미를 없앤 뒤, 돌아가 Yahya와 대화하세요.

Mushroom Man#038.src: I-is it done? S-s-spiders... No m-more spiders? Is my m-m-mushroom patch cl-... cleared?
Mushroom Man#038.dst: 끄, 끝났어요? 거-거-거미... 이제 거미 없어요? 제 버-버-버섯밭 치, 치웠-... 치웠어요?
Mushroom Man#038.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#039.src: Looks cleared to me. These are... uh... some fine mushrooms!
Mushroom Man#039.dst: 제가 보기엔 깨끗해요. 이건... 어... 정말 좋은 버섯이네요!
Mushroom Man#039.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#040.src: Th-thank you soldiers! Th-that was-... I mean. I-it was f-fine, I g-... guess.
Mushroom Man#040.dst: 고-고마워요, 병사님들! 그-그건-... 그러니까. 괘, 괜찮았던 거, 가-... 같아요.
Mushroom Man#040.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#041.src: ...O-oh. Do I n-need to pay you... now? Heh. Is- is [{~} Emeralds] fine with y-you..?
Mushroom Man#041.dst: ...오-오. 이제 돈을 드, 드려야 하나요? 헤. [{~} 에메랄드]면 괜, 괜찮을까요..?
Mushroom Man#041.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#043.src: Oho okay, ok-... okay! It was a joke, don't get all ex-... ex-... excited. Here, just take-
Mushroom Man#043.dst: 오호 알았어요, 알-... 알았어요! 농담이에요, 너무 흥-... 흥-... 흥분하지 마요. 자, 그냥 받-
Mushroom Man#043.speaker: Yahya

Mushroom Man#047.src: I-... This is bad. This is really bad. We need to tell the Mayor, now.
Mushroom Man#047.dst: 이-... 큰일이다. 정말 큰일이야. 당장 촌장님께 알려야 해.
Mushroom Man#047.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#048.src: Return to Mayor Alvin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with news about the spiders.
Mushroom Man#048.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Alvin 촌장에게 돌아가 거미 소식을 전하세요.

Mushroom Man#049.src: Ah, hello travelers. You seem to be in a rush- has something happened?
Mushroom Man#049.dst: 아, 안녕하시오, 여행자들. 급해 보이는데- 무슨 일이 있소?
Mushroom Man#049.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#050.src: Yes! Yes, something- something has happened. We went with Yahya to help him with a problem he was having with spiders-
Mushroom Man#050.dst: 네! 네, 일이- 일이 생겼어요. Yahya의 거미 문제를 도우러 같이 갔는데-
Mushroom Man#050.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#051.src: Yes, yes, I know of Yahya's antics... He doesn't seem to be with you. Has he ran off on you, just as Ope did?
Mushroom Man#051.dst: 그래, 그래, Yahya의 소동은 알고 있소... 같이 안 온 것 같은데. Ope처럼 도망쳐 버렸소?
Mushroom Man#051.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#052.src: No- no. When we finished clearing out the spiders, we were swarmed- and they took him!
Mushroom Man#052.dst: 아뇨- 아니에요. 거미를 다 치웠더니 떼로 몰려와서- 그를 끌고 갔어요!
Mushroom Man#052.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#053.src: ...Oh. Oh, dear. That isn't good at all. If they're making moves such as this, unprovoked...
Mushroom Man#053.dst: ...오. 저런. 전혀 좋지 않군. 도발도 없이 그런 짓을 벌인다면...
Mushroom Man#053.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#054.src: You two are soldiers, yes? I would ask you to continue your travels to {p}. Find an Admiral Aegis- tell him our little village needs aid.
Mushroom Man#054.dst: 두 사람은 병사지요? {p}까지 여정을 계속해 주시오. Aegis 제독을 찾아- 우리 작은 마을에 지원이 필요하다고 전해 주시오.
Mushroom Man#054.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Mushroom Man#055.src: I-... of course. We'll set out immediately. Come on, {u}.
Mushroom Man#055.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#056.src: Travel to {p} to request the help of their military at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Mushroom Man#059.src: Another one of these? We've fought one of them before, we can do it again!
Mushroom Man#059.dst: 또 이런 거야? 전에도 한 마리 잡았잖아, 이번에도 할 수 있어!
Mushroom Man#059.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#060.src: Phew. I think that went about as well as it could have!
Mushroom Man#060.dst: 휴. 이 정도면 최선의 결과였던 것 같아!
Mushroom Man#060.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#061.src: We're both in one piece, the corrupted is dead... Good. That's good!
Mushroom Man#061.dst: 둘 다 멀쩡하고, 타락자는 죽었고... 좋아. 잘됐어!
Mushroom Man#061.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#062.src: Let's keep moving towards {p}. I don't think it's too much further, if we keep heading east from here.
Mushroom Man#062.dst: 계속 {p} 쪽으로 가자. 여기서 동쪽으로 쭉 가면 그리 멀지 않을 거야.
Mushroom Man#062.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#064.src: Why'd you just leave me there? If we couldn't fight that thing off together, what made you think I could do it alone?
Mushroom Man#064.dst: 왜 날 거기 두고 간 거야? 둘이서도 못 물리친 걸 나 혼자 할 수 있을 거라고 생각했어?
Mushroom Man#064.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#065.src: I managed to get away, but... still. What if I couldn't? Would you have just left me for dead?
Mushroom Man#065.dst: 간신히 빠져나오긴 했지만... 그래도. 못 빠져나왔으면? 그냥 죽게 내버려 뒀을 거야?
Mushroom Man#065.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#066.src: ...Whatever. I'm alive, you're alive... that's probably good enough. Let's go find Admiral Aegis
Mushroom Man#066.dst: ...됐어. 나도 살았고 너도 살았으니... 그거면 됐겠지. Aegis 제독을 찾으러 가자
Mushroom Man#066.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#067.src: ...Oh, {u}, you're awake! I was really worried there for a bit...
Mushroom Man#067.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#068.src: After you went down, I managed to hold my own long enough for some nearby soldiers to arrive and help. I can't thank Lieutenant Van enough.
Mushroom Man#068.dst: 네가 쓰러진 뒤에, 근처 병사들이 도우러 올 때까지 겨우 버텼어. Van 중위님께는 아무리 감사해도 모자라.
Mushroom Man#068.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#069.src: We, uh... brought you back here to rest up. Aledar's around here somewhere, I think.
Mushroom Man#069.dst: 우리가, 어... 쉬라고 널 여기로 데려왔어. Aledar도 이 근처 어딘가 있을 거야.
Mushroom Man#069.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#070.src: Oh, I spoke to Admiral Aegis about the spider problem already. He said he wants to speak to you about it, too. He should be downstairs
Mushroom Man#070.dst: 아, 거미 문제는 Aegis 제독님께 벌써 말씀드렸어. 너랑도 얘기하고 싶으시대. 아래층에 계실 거야
Mushroom Man#070.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#071.src: ...and that's how we managed to defeat that undead swarm, sir!
Mushroom Man#071.dst: ...그렇게 해서 그 언데드 무리를 물리쳤습니다, 제독님!
Mushroom Man#071.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#072.src: That's good to hear. Thank you for your work, Aledar. I'll speak to Lieutenant Van and see if he'd be willing to take you into his squad.
Mushroom Man#072.dst: 좋은 소식이군. 수고했네, Aledar. Van 중위에게 자네를 분대에 받아 줄 수 있을지 얘기해 보겠네.
Mushroom Man#072.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#073.src: Thank you for the opportunity, sir. I won't let you down-... Wait, is that- Tasim and {u}?
Mushroom Man#073.dst: 기회를 주셔서 감사합니다. 실망시키지 않겠-... 잠깐, 저건- Tasim이랑 {u}?
Mushroom Man#073.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#074.src: Aledar! We've finally made it to {p}. We've had... something of an adventure, getting here.
Mushroom Man#074.dst: Aledar! 드디어 {p}에 왔어. 여기 오기까지... 모험 비슷한 걸 겪었지.
Mushroom Man#074.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#075.src: Ah, you two must be the recruits Aledar has been telling us all about. It's good to finally meet you, though I can't help but notice you seem to have arrived in a rush.
Mushroom Man#075.dst: 아, 자네들이 Aledar가 줄곧 얘기하던 신병들이군. 드디어 만나 반갑네. 그런데 꽤 급히 온 것 같군.
Mushroom Man#075.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#076.src: Right! Right. We've arrived from Nivla Town, with bad news and a request for aid. The spiders of the forest have grown hostile, and threaten the town.
Mushroom Man#076.dst: 네! 네. Nivla 마을에서 왔습니다. 나쁜 소식과 지원 요청을 갖고요. 숲의 거미들이 적대적으로 변해 마을을 위협하고 있습니다.
Mushroom Man#076.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#077.src: One of their townsfolk was captured and taken away in front of our eyes. Mayor Alvin sent us here to request the aid of {p}' army.
Mushroom Man#077.dst: 주민 한 명이 저희 눈앞에서 붙잡혀 끌려갔습니다. Alvin 촌장님이 {p} 군의 지원을 요청하러 저희를 보냈어요.
Mushroom Man#077.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#078.src: Bad news, indeed. Very well, we will make preparations. For the time being, the two of you should rest and hone your skills. Captain Ragon here in the barracks would gladly offer some training.
Mushroom Man#078.dst: 정말 나쁜 소식이군. 좋네, 준비하겠네. 당분간 둘은 쉬면서 실력을 갈고닦게. 여기 병영의 Ragon 대장이 기꺼이 훈련을 해 줄 걸세.
Mushroom Man#078.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#079.src: Thank you, sir. But is there anything we could do to actually help?
Mushroom Man#079.dst: 감사합니다, 제독님. 그런데 저희가 실제로 도울 수 있는 일은 없을까요?
Mushroom Man#079.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#080.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I'd suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#080.dst: 열의가 넘치는군! 어디 보자... 서문 밖의 Fenor 대장이 도움을 구하고 있었을 걸세. 괜찮다면 그와 얘기해 보게.
Mushroom Man#080.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#081.src: And Lieutenant Van is planning a raid on a corrupt stronghold! I'm sure he'd be glad to have more forces with them.
Mushroom Man#081.dst: 그리고 Van 중위님이 타락한 요새 급습을 계획 중이에요! 병력이 늘면 분명 반기실 거예요.
Mushroom Man#081.speaker: Aledar

Mushroom Man#082.src: Yes, yes. Well, I must be off. If the threat of Nivla's spiders is growing... we must prepare accordingly. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, all three of you.
Mushroom Man#082.dst: 그래, 그래. 자, 난 가 봐야겠네. Nivla의 거미 위협이 커진다면... 그에 맞게 대비해야지. 셋의 앞으로의 활약을 기대하겠네.
Mushroom Man#082.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#083.src: ...so, Captain, what do you think? We'll need to start training soldiers more quickly, but I hope that won't be a problem.
Mushroom Man#083.dst: ...그래서 대장, 어떻게 생각하나? 병사 훈련을 서둘러야 하는데, 문제없길 바라네.
Mushroom Man#083.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#084.src: Of course, Admiral, I'll see what I can do.
Mushroom Man#084.speaker: Captain Ragon

Mushroom Man#085.src: Excellent. Now- ah, {u}. Good to see you're up and about again. You gave us quite a shock!
Mushroom Man#085.dst: 좋아. 그럼- 아, {u}. 다시 일어나 돌아다니니 다행이군. 우리를 꽤 놀라게 했네!
Mushroom Man#085.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#086.src: Van tells me that goliath the two of you faced was a dangerous foe. He was impressed you managed to damage it as much as you did, even if you ended up needing rescue.
Mushroom Man#086.dst: Van 말로는 자네 둘이 맞선 골리앗이 위험한 적이었다더군. 결국 구조가 필요했어도 그만큼 피해를 입힌 데 감탄했다네.
Mushroom Man#086.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#087.src: Now, to business. We've already begun planning for our assault on the spiders, but we'll need more well-trained soldiers. Captain Ragon here should be able to help you hone your skills.
Mushroom Man#087.dst: 자, 본론으로. 이미 거미 공격 계획을 짜기 시작했지만, 잘 훈련된 병사가 더 필요하네. 여기 Ragon 대장이 실력을 갈고닦는 걸 도와줄 걸세.
Mushroom Man#087.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#088.src: And if we wanted to help out, sir? I'm getting a little stir-crazy in here.
Mushroom Man#088.dst: 도와드리고 싶다면요, 제독님? 여기 있으니 좀 답답해서요.
Mushroom Man#088.speaker: Tasim

Mushroom Man#089.src: Enthusiastic, aren't you! Let me think... I believe Captain Fenor out by the west gate was looking for aid. If you're willing, I suggest you speak with him.
Mushroom Man#089.dst: 열의가 넘치는군! 어디 보자... 서문 밖의 Fenor 대장이 도움을 구하고 있었을 걸세. 괜찮다면 그와 얘기해 보게.
Mushroom Man#089.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#090.src: In addition, Lieutenant Van was highly impressed by your fight with the goliath! He told me to pass on that he'd appreciate your help in a raid he's planning on a nearby corrupted stronghold. I believe your friend Aledar was involved.
Mushroom Man#090.dst: 게다가 Van 중위가 골리앗과의 싸움에 크게 감탄했네! 근처 타락한 요새를 급습할 계획인데 자네가 도와주면 고맙겠다고 전해 달라더군. 자네 친구 Aledar도 함께한다고 들었네.
Mushroom Man#090.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Mushroom Man#091.src: With that, I must be off. We have many preparations to make, and the enemy never rests. I hope to hear of your future endeavors, both of you.
Mushroom Man#091.dst: 그럼 난 가 봐야겠네. 준비할 게 많고, 적은 쉬지 않으니까. 둘의 앞으로의 활약을 기대하겠네.
Mushroom Man#091.speaker: Admiral Aegis

Off the Rails#001.src: Tch... Another filthy poor... No, I won't give you any money.
Off the Rails#001.dst: 쯧... 또 지저분한 거지로군... 안 돼, 돈은 한 푼도 못 줘.
Off the Rails#001.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#002.src: I don't care if you're struggling to get by. In this world, you've gotta put in some work to make it through.
Off the Rails#002.dst: 먹고살기 힘들든 말든 내 알 바 아니야. 이 세상에선 버티려면 일을 해야 한다고.
Off the Rails#002.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#003.src: Besides, I've talked to enough of you hobos for one day. I'll be glad to take the Subway out of here.
Off the Rails#003.dst: 게다가 오늘은 너 같은 부랑자들이랑 떠들 만큼 떠들었어. 지하철 타고 여길 뜨면 속이 시원하겠군.
Off the Rails#003.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#004.src: ...Heh... That look on your face... You don't know about the Subway?
Off the Rails#004.dst: ...헤... 그 표정 좀 봐... 지하철을 모른다고?
Off the Rails#004.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#005.src: Wow, I thought taking a ride on that thing was the dream of every peasant around here, what with the way my proles are always going on about it.
Off the Rails#005.dst: 와, 우리 일꾼 놈들이 맨날 떠들어 대길래 저걸 한번 타 보는 게 이 동네 촌뜨기들의 꿈인 줄 알았는데.
Off the Rails#005.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#006.src: Well, it's an underground transport system that goes all over the province... Not that that matters for a beggar like you, of course. You'll never be able to afford a trip! Ha!
Off the Rails#006.dst: 뭐, 지방 곳곳을 오가는 지하 교통수단이지... 물론 너 같은 거지랑은 상관없는 얘기야. 평생 표 한 장 못 살 테니까! 하!
Off the Rails#006.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#007.src: Now, if you'll excuse me, my train to Auburn arrives in a few minutes. I have important business there. Nothing for you to worry about. Toodles!
Off the Rails#007.dst: 자, 실례 좀 하지. Auburn행 열차가 몇 분 뒤에 와. 거기서 중요한 일이 있거든. 네가 신경 쓸 일은 아니고. 잘 있어라!
Off the Rails#007.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#008.src: Turn in your subway pass at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Off the Rails#009.src: Hey! What are you doing? The rails aren't safe! If you want to get to the other side, take the overpass!
Off the Rails#009.dst: 이봐요! 뭐 하는 거예요? 선로는 위험해요! 건너편으로 가려면 육교로 가세요!
Off the Rails#009.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#010.src: Sigh... Welcome to the {p} subway station. Got a ticket?
Off the Rails#010.dst: 하아... {p} 지하철역에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 표 있어요?
Off the Rails#010.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#011.src: Alright... I'll stamp your hand to mark that you're allowed on the train. Give me a moment.
Off the Rails#011.dst: 좋아요... 열차에 타도 된다는 표시로 손에 도장을 찍어 줄게요. 잠깐만요.
Off the Rails#011.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#012.src: There. You should be good to go now.
Off the Rails#012.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#013.src: The train gets here in about fifteen minutes. Happy travels...
Off the Rails#013.dst: 열차는 15분쯤 뒤에 와요. 즐거운 여행 되세요...
Off the Rails#013.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#014.src: Wait for the train to arrive.

Off the Rails#016.dst: ..너, 너? 너도 이 열차를 기다리는 거야?
Off the Rails#016.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#017.src: Eheh... I must have had you all wrong. Let's, er, put aside our past grievances.
Off the Rails#017.dst: 에헤... 내가 완전히 오해했나 보군. 지난 일은, 어, 없던 걸로 하자고.
Off the Rails#017.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#018.src: Say, buddy, could you do your friend a favor? I've got a meeting in Auburn soon, I need to get on this train.
Off the Rails#018.dst: 이봐 친구, 친구 좋다는 게 뭐야, 부탁 하나만 들어줄래? 곧 Auburn에서 회의가 있어서 이 열차를 꼭 타야 하거든.
Off the Rails#018.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#019.src: What do you say you... Give me your space? Just tell the clerk over there that you'll sacrifice your spot for me.
Off the Rails#019.dst: 그러니까 네가... 자리를 양보하는 건 어때? 저기 직원한테 나를 위해 자리를 포기하겠다고만 말해 줘.
Off the Rails#019.speaker: Businessman

Off the Rails#023.src: (By the Queen... Must I really say this to every customer?)
Off the Rails#023.dst: (여왕님 맙소사... 손님마다 정말 이 말을 해야 하나?)
Off the Rails#023.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#024.src: Oh, hey, stranger. Looking for a chat? Sure, it'll help kill some time, I guess.
Off the Rails#024.dst: 아, 안녕하세요, 낯선 분. 얘기 좀 하시게요? 좋죠, 시간 때우기엔 딱이네요.

Off the Rails#025.src: The name's Malic, nice to meet you. I'm guessing you'll be taking the train to the same place as me? To {p}?
Off the Rails#025.dst: 전 Malic이에요, 반가워요. 저랑 같은 곳으로 가는 열차 타시는 거죠? {p}로요?
Off the Rails#025.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#026.src: I'm pretty excited about it. Around these parts, people never really get the opportunity to travel the Queen's Line. Too expensive for us, typically.
Off the Rails#026.dst: 꽤 설레요. 이 동네 사람들은 여왕선을 타 볼 기회가 거의 없거든요. 보통 우리한텐 너무 비싸요.
Off the Rails#026.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#027.src: It's always been a dream of mine to see what other parts of Fruma are like, though, so I... well, I saved up for a long time.
Off the Rails#027.dst: 그래도 Fruma의 다른 곳은 어떤지 보는 게 늘 꿈이었어요. 그래서... 음, 오랫동안 돈을 모았죠.
Off the Rails#027.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#028.src: Don't really know what the {p}'ll be like... I can't wait to find out. If it's anything like its Sovereign, it should be pretty great.
Off the Rails#028.dst: {p}이(가) 어떤 곳일지 잘은 모르겠지만... 빨리 보고 싶어요. 거기 군주님을 조금이라도 닮았다면 꽤 멋진 곳이겠죠.
Off the Rails#028.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#029.src: Heh. Enough yammering from me, though. You probably have your own stuff you wanna talk about, right? (After Malic's introduction)
Off the Rails#029.dst: 헤헤. 제 수다는 이쯤 할게요. 하고 싶은 얘기가 따로 있으시죠? (Malic 소개 후)
Off the Rails#029.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#030.src: Anything else you wanna talk about? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#030.dst: 또 하고 싶은 얘기 있어요? (선택지가 다시 나올 때)
Off the Rails#030.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#031.src: Hey again! Anything to say? (Subsequent conversations with Malic)
Off the Rails#031.dst: 또 봬요! 할 말 있어요? (이후 Malic과의 대화)
Off the Rails#031.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#032.src: Enough of this, though, or I'll get too excited. Anything else you wanna talk about? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#032.dst: 그만할게요, 안 그러면 너무 들뜨겠어요. 또 하고 싶은 얘기 있어요? ({p}에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#032.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#033.src: Sigh. Anything else you wanna talk about? (After asking about Soda)
Off the Rails#033.dst: 하아. 또 하고 싶은 얘기 있어요? (Soda에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#033.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#034.src: Oh, shoot. The train's here. I'll catch you later, I guess?
Off the Rails#034.dst: 아, 이런. 열차가 왔네요. 나중에 또 봬요?
Off the Rails#034.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#035.src: ...Wow... Fascinating... I wonder what the cat symbolizes...
Off the Rails#035.dst: ...와... 흥미롭다... 저 고양이는 뭘 상징하는 걸까...

Off the Rails#036.src: Oh, hi! Are you from around here? My name's Maddison, I'm a tourist from Aelumia.
Off the Rails#036.dst: 어머, 안녕하세요! 이 근처 분이세요? 전 Maddison이에요, Aelumia에서 온 관광객이에요.
Off the Rails#036.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#037.src: I've been travelling the Queen's Line all around Fruma to see what the rest of the province is like! It's been a fun time so far! ...Well, mostly...
Off the Rails#037.dst: 여왕선을 타고 Fruma 곳곳을 돌면서 지방의 다른 곳들을 구경하고 있어요! 지금까진 즐거웠어요! ...음, 대체로는요...
Off the Rails#037.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#038.src: This region has been... It's not quite what I expected. There's quite a unique culture here, though! Check out the cool wall art! You never see that back home!
Off the Rails#038.dst: 이 지역은... 기대했던 거랑 좀 달라요. 그래도 문화가 꽤 독특해요! 저 멋진 벽화 좀 보세요! 고향에선 절대 못 봐요!
Off the Rails#038.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#039.src: I'm really looking forward to seeing what makes {p} different- that's where I'm headed next. So far, everywhere has been really unique!
Off the Rails#039.dst: {p}은(는) 뭐가 다를지 정말 기대돼요. 거기가 다음 목적지거든요. 지금까지 가는 곳마다 정말 독특했어요!
Off the Rails#039.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#040.src: I'm just sad I'll miss their festival... The one here went... bad.
Off the Rails#040.dst: 거기 축제를 놓치는 게 아쉬울 뿐이에요... 여기 축제는... 엉망이었거든요.
Off the Rails#040.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#041.src: ...Anyway, is there anything you'd like to talk about? (After Maddison's introduction)
Off the Rails#041.dst: ...아무튼, 하고 싶은 얘기 있으세요? (Maddison 소개 후)
Off the Rails#041.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#042.src: ...Anything else you'd like to discuss? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#042.dst: ...또 나누고 싶은 얘기 있으세요? (선택지가 다시 나올 때)
Off the Rails#042.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#043.src: Hi again! Want to talk? (Subsequent conversations with Maddison)
Off the Rails#043.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#044.src: Oh, well... Anything else you'd like to discuss?(After asking about Maddison's trip)
Off the Rails#044.dst: 아, 뭐... 또 나누고 싶은 얘기 있으세요? (Maddison의 여행에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#044.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#045.src: Roughworks? Oh, right, that's what the people here call it. To me, it's the {p}.
Off the Rails#045.dst: Roughworks요? 아, 맞다, 여기 사람들은 그렇게 부르죠. 저한텐 {p}이에요.
Off the Rails#045.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#046.src: I always imagined this place being a bit... cleaner. Maybe the people here are just used to it being messy, though?
Off the Rails#046.dst: 여긴 좀 더... 깨끗할 줄 알았어요. 그래도 여기 사람들은 어수선한 게 익숙한 걸까요?
Off the Rails#046.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#047.src: A lot of the people I tried talking to were, well, not very nice. They didn't seem to like tourists all that much...
Off the Rails#047.dst: 말을 걸어 본 사람들 중 상당수가, 음, 별로 친절하지 않았어요. 관광객을 그리 반기지 않는 것 같더라고요...
Off the Rails#047.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#048.src: Overall, this... has probably been the low point of my trip. I think it's just not for me, really. But there were some parts I liked!
Off the Rails#048.dst: 전체적으로 보면 여긴... 이번 여행에서 제일 별로였던 것 같아요. 그냥 저랑 안 맞나 봐요. 그래도 좋았던 것도 있어요!
Off the Rails#048.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#049.src: I already mentioned the pretty murals, but there was a bunch of other cool stuff, too. Did you know the people here fight to resolve disputes?
Off the Rails#049.dst: 예쁜 벽화는 말했고, 다른 멋진 것도 많았어요. 여기 사람들이 싸움으로 분쟁을 해결한다는 거 알아요?
Off the Rails#049.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#050.src: ...Or, wait. You would, since you're from here, right? Or... no, you're dressed pretty different. Where are you from?
Off the Rails#050.dst: ...아, 잠깐. 여기 분이니까 당연히 알겠구나? 아니... 옷차림이 꽤 다르네요. 어디서 오셨어요?
Off the Rails#050.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#052.src: {p}'s beautiful. I've lived there my whole life, it's my home, it's precious to me.
Off the Rails#052.dst: {p}은(는) 아름다워요. 평생 거기서 살았고, 제 집이고, 제게 소중한 곳이에요.
Off the Rails#052.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#053.src: It's just... When you've lived somewhere for that long, it starts to feel... small. Samey. Especially when you're boxed in by those towering city walls.
Off the Rails#053.dst: 그냥... 한곳에 그렇게 오래 살면... 좁게 느껴져요. 늘 똑같고요. 특히 저 높은 성벽에 갇혀 있으면요.
Off the Rails#053.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#054.src: Don't get me wrong, I'm proud to live in the Queen's royal city, but... I needed something new. A change of pace. That's why I decided to go on this trip!
Off the Rails#054.dst: 오해는 마세요, 여왕님의 왕도에 사는 게 자랑스러워요. 하지만... 새로운 게 필요했어요. 기분 전환요. 그래서 여행을 떠났죠!
Off the Rails#054.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#055.src: I'm lucky enough to be the daughter of one of the University's best-paid professors, so I was able to afford such a privilege. Those tickets aren't cheap...
Off the Rails#055.dst: 운 좋게도 대학에서 제일 보수가 높은 교수 중 한 분의 딸이라 이런 호사를 누릴 수 있었어요. 표가 싸지 않거든요...
Off the Rails#055.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#056.src: ...Anyway, sorry, that was a bit of a tangent. Overall, Aelumia's great if you enjoy the city life, it just... gets boring, eventually.
Off the Rails#056.dst: ...아무튼, 죄송해요, 얘기가 좀 샜네요. 전체적으로 도시 생활을 좋아하면 Aelumia는 최고예요. 다만... 결국엔 질려요.
Off the Rails#056.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#057.src: So far, the trip's been pretty great! It's been really refreshing to see how different each region of Fruma is!
Off the Rails#057.dst: 지금까지 여행은 정말 좋았어요! Fruma의 지역마다 얼마나 다른지 보니 정말 새로웠어요!
Off the Rails#057.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#058.src: I've only been to the {p} and here, though. Both have been enlightening, in their own ways.
Off the Rails#058.dst: 그래도 가 본 곳은 {p}이랑 여기뿐이에요. 둘 다 나름대로 깨달음을 줬어요.
Off the Rails#058.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#059.src: The {p} may be the most beautiful place I've ever seen... Not that that's saying much. The landscapes were incredible, and oh, the flowers!
Off the Rails#059.dst: {p}은(는) 제가 본 곳 중 제일 아름다울지도 몰라요... 대단한 말은 아니지만요. 풍경이 굉장했고, 아, 꽃들도요!
Off the Rails#059.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#060.src: This place? It's... I guess I've come to learn that some people live by different standards to me, which is... interesting.
Off the Rails#060.dst: 여기요? 여긴... 저와 다른 기준으로 사는 사람들도 있다는 걸 배우게 됐어요. 그게... 흥미로워요.
Off the Rails#060.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#061.src: I'm a little sad the trip's coming to an end after the next stop... Fruma is so big, yet so small, isn't it?
Off the Rails#061.dst: 다음 역을 끝으로 여행이 끝나서 조금 아쉬워요... Fruma는 참 넓으면서도 좁죠?
Off the Rails#061.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#062.src: I hear people used to live in the {p} and the Penitence District, but they were moved out. I wish I could go back in time and experience their culture, too.
Off the Rails#062.dst: 옛날엔 {p}이랑 Penitence District에도 사람이 살았는데 다들 이주했대요. 과거로 가서 그 문화도 경험해 보고 싶어요.
Off the Rails#062.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#063.src: I think this might be the stop I'm most excited for!
Off the Rails#063.dst: 이번 역이 제일 기대되는 곳인 것 같아요!
Off the Rails#063.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#064.src: My dad teaches biology, and he's been all over the place studying the province's wildlife. His travels honestly inspired me to go on this journey.
Off the Rails#064.dst: 아빠가 생물학을 가르치는데, 지방의 야생 동물을 연구하느라 여기저기 다니셨어요. 솔직히 아빠의 여행에 영감을 받아 떠났어요.
Off the Rails#064.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#065.src: Growing up, he told me stories of his trips... {p} was always the place that stood out the most, of the ones he described.
Off the Rails#065.dst: 어릴 때 아빠가 여행 이야기를 해 주셨어요... 들려주신 곳들 중에서 {p}이(가) 늘 제일 인상적이었어요.
Off the Rails#065.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#066.src: It sounds like nothing you'd ever see anywhere else. Golden leaves, beautiful traditional architecture, and the kindest people...
Off the Rails#066.dst: 다른 데선 절대 볼 수 없는 곳 같아요. 황금빛 나뭇잎, 아름다운 전통 건축, 그리고 세상에서 제일 친절한 사람들...
Off the Rails#066.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#067.src: Needless to say, I've dreamed of going there my whole life. Of course, I also dreamed of going everywhere else, too. But Auburn most of all.
Off the Rails#067.dst: 말할 것도 없이 평생 거기 가는 꿈을 꿨어요. 물론 다른 곳도 전부 꿈꿨지만요. 그래도 Auburn이 제일이에요.
Off the Rails#067.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#068.src: Ah, them. I've not really spoken to either.
Off the Rails#068.dst: 아, 그 사람들요. 둘 다 제대로 얘기해 본 적은 없어요.
Off the Rails#068.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#069.src: I tried talking to the one with the funny shirt, but they didn't seem much for conversation.
Off the Rails#069.dst: 웃긴 셔츠 입은 사람한테 말을 걸어 봤는데, 대화할 생각이 별로 없어 보였어요.
Off the Rails#069.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#070.src: The other guy? He seems to be from around here, and, well...
Off the Rails#070.dst: 다른 남자요? 이 근처 사람 같은데, 음...
Off the Rails#070.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#071.src: ...I don't have anything against the people of this District, but their attitudes differ from mine, and...
Off the Rails#071.dst: ...이 구역 사람들한테 악감정은 없지만, 저랑 태도가 달라서...
Off the Rails#071.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#072.src: ...I'm just a little tired of being berated by them for coming here, okay?
Off the Rails#072.dst: ...여기 왔다고 욕먹는 게 좀 지쳤을 뿐이에요, 알겠죠?
Off the Rails#072.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#073.src: Oh! The train's here! ...Uh, Guess I should catch you later?
Off the Rails#073.dst: 어머! 열차가 왔어요! ...어, 나중에 또 봬요?
Off the Rails#073.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#076.src: You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.

Off the Rails#078.src: Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the {p} was like.
Off the Rails#078.dst: 으. 그러니까, 난 {p} 출신이야. 난... 거기가 싫어. 그래서 {p}은(는) 어떤지 보고 싶었지.
Off the Rails#078.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#079.src: Having been here yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
