Off the Rails#681.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#682.src: I'm travelling from my home, the {p}, to Auburn. Why? Well, I booked a ticket to go to the Festival of the Queen, but... for the wrong date.
Off the Rails#682.dst: 고향인 {p}에서 Auburn으로 가는 길이네. 왜냐고? 음, 여왕 축제에 가려고 표를 예매했는데... 날짜를 잘못 골랐지.
Off the Rails#682.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#683.src: I didn't want that money to go to waste, so I'm going to go and visit {p} anyway. There's probably some festival left to experience.
Off the Rails#683.dst: 그 돈을 날리긴 싫어서 어쨌든 {p}에 가 보기로 했네. 즐길 만한 축제가 좀 남아 있겠지.
Off the Rails#683.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#684.src: But enough about little old me. You are here to ask questions. Go on.
Off the Rails#684.dst: 이 늙은이 얘긴 이쯤 하지. 자네는 질문하러 왔지. 해 보게.
Off the Rails#684.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#685.src: Go ahead, now. Ask away. (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#685.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#686.src: What is it now? More questions? (Subsequent conversations with Cemor)
Off the Rails#686.dst: 이번엔 또 뭔가? 또 질문인가? (이후 Cemor와의 대화)
Off the Rails#686.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#687.src: What else have you to ask? (After asking about what Cemor saw before the murder)
Off the Rails#687.dst: 또 뭘 묻고 싶나? (살인 전에 Cemor가 본 것을 물은 후)
Off the Rails#687.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#688.src: But let us move on from that. Any more questions? (After asking about Constables)
Off the Rails#688.dst: 그 얘긴 이쯤 하세. 또 질문 있나? (치안대에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#688.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#689.src: Any more questions? (After asking about what Cemor is mad about)
Off the Rails#689.dst: 또 질문 있나? (Cemor가 화난 이유를 물은 후)
Off the Rails#689.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#690.src: Anywho, thank you for the food. Now, ask me questions if you have any, leave me to my meal otherwise. (After giving Cemor his meal)
Off the Rails#690.dst: 아무튼 식사 고맙네. 자, 질문이 있으면 하고, 없으면 식사하게 내버려 두게. (Cemor에게 식사를 준 후)
Off the Rails#690.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#691.src: I didn't see much at all, because I was in the bathroom for much of the time. There's only one thing I saw that could be of note.
Off the Rails#691.dst: 대부분 화장실에 있어서 거의 본 게 없네. 눈여겨볼 만한 건 딱 하나뿐이지.
Off the Rails#691.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#692.src: When I reached the back of the train, where the bathroom is located, I noticed the attendant, Telati.
Off the Rails#692.dst: 화장실이 있는 열차 맨 뒤에 갔을 때 승무원 Telati가 보였네.
Off the Rails#692.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#693.src: He was just stood around, up to... something. When he saw me enter, he seemed to panic and left the carriage. How suspicious.
Off the Rails#693.dst: 그냥 서서... 뭔가 꾸미고 있었지. 내가 들어오는 걸 보더니 당황해서 칸을 나가더군. 수상하기 짝이 없어.
Off the Rails#693.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#695.src: They're supposedly stronger than the regular divisional soldiers, but at least those divisional soldiers knew respect.
Off the Rails#695.dst: 일반 지역 부대 병사보다 강하다고들 하지만, 적어도 그 병사들은 예의를 알았네.
Off the Rails#695.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#696.src: The Constables are often from other regions, so they're not part of the local community- they're less friendly. This makes them HORRIBLE town guards.
Off the Rails#696.dst: 치안대는 대개 다른 지역 출신이라 지역 공동체에 속하지 않아서 덜 친절하지. 그래서 마을 경비로는 최악이야.
Off the Rails#696.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#697.src: I speak from experience. Our Sovereign, Majin, replaced the {p} guard with Constables a few years ago. Supposedly to better protect us.
Off the Rails#697.dst: 경험에서 하는 말일세. 우리 군주 Majin이 몇 년 전 {p} 경비대를 치안대로 바꿨지. 우릴 더 잘 지킨다나.
Off the Rails#697.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#698.src: Given his lack of improvements to the town besides that, I doubt that's the real reason. He just did it for the praise.
Off the Rails#698.dst: 그 외엔 마을을 전혀 개선하지 않은 걸 보면 진짜 이유는 아닐 걸세. 그냥 칭찬받으려고 한 거지.
Off the Rails#698.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#699.src: If he REALLY wanted to please us, he should have had some of those spangly Wings guard us. They don't do anything but stand around looking cool, anyway.
Off the Rails#699.dst: 정말 우릴 만족시키고 싶었다면 번쩍번쩍한 날개단을 붙여 줬어야지. 어차피 폼 잡고 서 있는 것 말곤 하는 일도 없잖나.
Off the Rails#699.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#700.src: They're the best of the best, and I'm sure they would serve us better than those unruly Constables. They have the decorum not to scoff in our faces.
Off the Rails#700.dst: 그들은 최정예니 제멋대로인 치안대보다 분명 우릴 더 잘 섬길 걸세. 우리 면전에서 비웃지 않을 품위도 있고.
Off the Rails#700.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#701.src: Yes, that's right- scoff in our faces. That's how little respect these Constables have for the nobility. It's ridiculous.
Off the Rails#701.dst: 그래, 맞네. 면전에서 비웃었지. 치안대가 귀족을 그 정도로밖에 존중하지 않는다네. 어처구니없지.
Off the Rails#701.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#702.src: A friend of mine, from House Krisa, was humiliated by a pair of rude Constables in {p} a while back. His handmade clothes were ruined! Covered in dye!
Off the Rails#702.dst: Krisa 가문의 친구가 얼마 전 {p}에서 무례한 치안대 둘에게 망신을 당했네. 손수 지은 옷이 망가졌지! 염료 범벅이 됐다고!
Off the Rails#702.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#703.src: He had one of his friends in House Liftal contact Majin about it, so I'm sure those fools got what they deserved... Heh.
Off the Rails#703.dst: 그 친구가 Liftal 가문 지인을 통해 Majin에게 연락했으니, 그 멍청이들은 응분의 대가를 치렀겠지... 흥.
Off the Rails#703.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#704.src: ...Anyway. All of this to say: Constables are no good. I am not fond of them.
Off the Rails#704.dst: ...아무튼. 결론은 이거네. 치안대는 쓸모없어. 난 그자들이 싫네.
Off the Rails#704.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#705.src: Ugh. It's that attendant, Telati. I asked him for a meal hours ago, and he STILL hasn't even STARTED on it!
Off the Rails#705.dst: 으. 그 승무원 Telati 말일세. 몇 시간 전에 식사를 주문했는데 아직 시작도 안 했어!
Off the Rails#705.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#706.src: ...Could you do me a favour go and ask him to get a move on? I'm tired of waiting here.
Off the Rails#706.dst: ...가서 서두르라고 좀 전해 주겠나? 여기서 기다리는 것도 지쳤네.
Off the Rails#706.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#707.src: You..? You made it? He reallu had you do it for him???
Off the Rails#707.dst: 자네가..? 자네가 만들었다고? 정말 대신 시켰단 말인가???
Off the Rails#707.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#708.src: Goodness... I'm going to be leaving a poor review of this train in the paper, and telling my friends of this disappointment...
Off the Rails#708.dst: 세상에... 신문에 이 열차 혹평을 남기고, 친구들한테도 이 실망스러운 일을 알려야겠군...
Off the Rails#708.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#709.src: ...Speaking of gossip, I thought of something I heard recently that might be useful to you...
Off the Rails#709.dst: ...소문 얘기가 나와서 말인데, 최근에 들은 것 중 자네한테 쓸모 있을 만한 게 생각났네...
Off the Rails#709.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#710.src: Yes, I heard from some friends that General Levi was being called to {p} by Sovereign Zhiraok.
Off the Rails#710.dst: 그래, 친구들한테 들었는데 Levi 장군이 Zhiraok 군주의 부름으로 {p}에 가는 중이었다더군.
Off the Rails#710.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#711.src: Of course, I'm sure you already knew that. My point is this- word was out about what was happening, so I bet whoever killed her had this insider information.
Off the Rails#711.dst: 물론 자네도 이미 알겠지. 요점은 이걸세. 무슨 일인지 소문이 났으니 그녀를 죽인 자는 분명 이 내부 정보를 알았을 거야.
Off the Rails#711.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#712.src: Truly curious... Who might know about that?
Off the Rails#712.dst: 참 흥미롭군... 누가 그걸 알 수 있었을까?
Off the Rails#712.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#714.src: Make an accusation at [-{~}, {~}, {~}], or seek more evidence.

Off the Rails#716.src: Hm. I suppose it makes enough sense. They were awfully quiet when we found the body.
Off the Rails#716.dst: 흠. 그럴듯하긴 하네. 시체를 발견했을 때 엄청 조용했지.
Off the Rails#716.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#717.src: I dunno, Maury. Something doesn't seem right about this.
Off the Rails#717.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#719.src: ...having seen what other parts of Fruma are like, maybe prison would be... an improvement...
Off the Rails#719.dst: ...Fruma의 다른 곳이 어떤지 보고 나니, 감옥이 오히려... 나을지도...
Off the Rails#719.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#720.src: Works for us, I guess. Just uh, go along with what we tell 'em, alright?
Off the Rails#720.dst: 우린 좋아. 그냥 어, 우리가 말하는 대로 맞춰 줘, 알았지?
Off the Rails#720.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#721.src: Good timin', too. The train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#721.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#723.src: Yeah, I suppose a university student could get their hands on the weird substances that were involved here. I see it.
Off the Rails#723.dst: 그래, 대학생이면 이번 일에 쓰인 이상한 물질을 손에 넣을 수 있겠지. 말 되네.
Off the Rails#723.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#724.src: But- but why would I kill a general? I don't want to hurt anyone!
Off the Rails#724.dst: 하, 하지만 제가 왜 장군을 죽여요? 전 아무도 해치고 싶지 않아요!
Off the Rails#724.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#725.src: Yeah, Maury, I don't really see a motivation here...
Off the Rails#725.dst: 그래, Maury, 동기가 딱히 안 보이는데...
Off the Rails#725.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#726.src: Hm... Well, whatever, we never were goin' off of actual guilt, anyway.
Off the Rails#726.dst: 흠... 뭐, 상관없어. 어차피 진짜 죄를 따져서 하는 것도 아니었잖아.
Off the Rails#726.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#727.src: Yeah, true, I guess this works.
Off the Rails#727.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#728.src: You're under arrest. We're about to arrive in {p}, and we'll be takin' ya straight to the local guard!
Off the Rails#728.dst: 넌 체포다. 곧 {p}에 도착하니 바로 지역 경비대로 넘길 거야!
Off the Rails#728.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#729.src: The {p} guy? That's who ya think did it?
Off the Rails#729.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#730.src: Yeah, what the heck? He was in the bathroom the whole time. This doesn't make sense...
Off the Rails#730.dst: 그래, 뭐야? 그 사람은 내내 화장실에 있었다고. 말이 안 되잖아...
Off the Rails#730.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#732.src: They are right...! It WAS I, Toxic Thistle of the Blossoming Blades, Fruma's deadliest vindicators!
Off the Rails#732.dst: 그들 말이 맞네...! 바로 나일세, 피어나는 칼날의 맹독 가시, Fruma에서 가장 치명적인 응징자!
Off the Rails#732.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#734.src: Behold, lapdogs, the beginning of our glorious revolution!
Off the Rails#734.dst: 보아라, 개들아, 우리의 영광스러운 혁명의 시작을!
Off the Rails#734.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#735.src: Even in arrest, I have won... My brethren who stand against the Queen shall be mobilized by this glorious act of violence...
Off the Rails#735.dst: 체포되어도 난 이겼다... 여왕에 맞서는 형제들이 이 영광스러운 폭력으로 들고일어날 것이다...
Off the Rails#735.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#736.src: The troubled people of Fruma shall wake to the fact that their rulers are not infallible gods; they shall at last understand that they alone bear the bridles of their own destiny...!
Off the Rails#736.dst: 고통받는 Fruma 백성들은 통치자가 무결한 신이 아님을 깨달을 것이다. 마침내 자신의 운명의 고삐는 오직 자신이 쥐고 있음을 이해하리라...!
Off the Rails#736.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#738.src: And executed so poetically, too! Think- a titan of House Takshah, slain by merely the poison of House Efelu- even a small Murex Mollusc takes down the mighty rhinoce-
Off the Rails#738.dst: 게다가 실로 시적인 처형 아닌가! 생각해 보게. Takshah 가문의 거인이 고작 Efelu 가문의 독에 쓰러지다니. 작은 Murex Mollusc도 거대한 코뿔-
Off the Rails#738.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#739.src: Well, actually, Murex Molluscs are noted for being quite large for a sn-
Off the Rails#739.dst: 음, 사실 Murex Mollusc는 달팽이치고 꽤 크기로 유명한-
Off the Rails#739.speaker: Demma

Off the Rails#741.src: Before you take me away, you must admit... my exploits are impressive, no?
Off the Rails#741.dst: 날 끌고 가기 전에 인정해야 할 걸세... 내 업적이 대단하지 않나?
Off the Rails#741.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#742.src: Er... No. I ain't paid enough to care about whatever revolution thing ya were just talkin' about.
Off the Rails#742.dst: 어... 아니. 네가 떠든 혁명인지 뭔지 신경 쓸 만큼 월급 안 받아.
Off the Rails#742.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#743.src: Yeah, do you really think any of this is gonna make a difference? Nobody cares about some general. None of this matters.
Off the Rails#743.dst: 그래, 진짜 이게 뭔가 달라질 거라고 생각해? 장군 하나 신경 쓰는 사람 없어. 다 부질없어.
Off the Rails#743.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#745.src: What does matter, though, is that you just made our job REAL easy fer us.
Off the Rails#745.dst: 근데 중요한 건, 네가 방금 우리 일을 엄청 쉽게 만들어 줬다는 거지.
Off the Rails#745.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#746.src: C'mon, punk, the train's arrivin' now. We're takin' you to the slammer.
Off the Rails#746.dst: 가자, 이 녀석아, 열차 도착한다. 감방으로 모셔 주지.
Off the Rails#746.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#748.src: I guess a guy like him could grow jaded against the system. He's a Roughworker, after all.
Off the Rails#748.dst: 저런 녀석이면 체제에 불만이 생길 만도 하지. 어쨌든 Roughworks 출신이니까.
Off the Rails#748.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#749.src: Yeah, and he's the only guy who could possibly have unlocked the door to the private cabin, so it makes sense, really.
Off the Rails#749.dst: 그래, 게다가 전용 객실 문을 열 수 있는 건 저 사람뿐이니 말이 되네.
Off the Rails#749.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#750.src: But... I would never kill one of the Queen's servants... Or anyone for that matter! Please! Have mercy!
Off the Rails#750.dst: 하지만... 전 여왕님의 종복을 죽일 리 없어요... 누구든요! 제발! 자비를!
Off the Rails#750.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#751.src: Heh. I don't think ya did it. But I don't care. We never were specifically lookin' to arrest the actual perpetrator.
Off the Rails#751.dst: 헤. 네가 했다고는 생각 안 해. 근데 상관없어. 원래 진범을 콕 집어 잡으려던 게 아니거든.
Off the Rails#751.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#752.src: Yeah, you're believable enough. We'll go with you.
Off the Rails#752.dst: 그래, 넌 충분히 그럴듯해. 너로 하자.
Off the Rails#752.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#753.src: Good timin', too! We're about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#753.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#755.dst: 안 돼! 그 사람이 그럴 리가...
Off the Rails#755.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#756.src: Yeah, I uh, don' see the angle on this one, pal..
Off the Rails#756.dst: 그래, 난 어, 이건 어떻게 된 건지 모르겠는데, 친구..
Off the Rails#756.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#757.src: Eh, Roughworkers are pretty disobedient. I think it makes enough sense.
Off the Rails#757.dst: 에, Roughworks 놈들은 꽤 말을 안 듣잖아. 충분히 말 되는 것 같은데.
Off the Rails#757.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#758.src: True... We never were arrestin' based on real guilt anyway, were we? We'll just go with this.
Off the Rails#758.dst: 그렇지... 어차피 진짜 죄를 따져서 잡는 것도 아니었잖아? 이걸로 하자.
Off the Rails#758.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#760.src: Heh. Tell it to Oru, bub.
Off the Rails#760.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#761.src: ...Is that something Oru does? Take questio-
Off the Rails#761.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#762.src: I DON'T KNOW, Harvin. It just sounded cool to say. And now you've ruined the moment.
Off the Rails#762.dst: 나도 몰라, HARVIN. 그냥 멋있게 들려서 한 말이야. 네가 분위기 다 망쳤잖아.
Off the Rails#762.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#763.src: ...Ech. Whatever. Train's about to arrive in {p}, let's get this guy to the slammer.
Off the Rails#763.dst: ...에휴. 됐다. 열차가 곧 {p}에 도착하니 이 녀석을 감방으로 데려가자.
Off the Rails#763.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#765.src: What? No! It couldn't have been her!
Off the Rails#765.dst: 뭐라고요? 안 돼요! 그 애일 리 없어요!
Off the Rails#765.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#766.src: Uh... Yeah, I don' see how it could've been her, bud.
Off the Rails#766.dst: 어... 그래, 저 애가 어떻게 했다는 건지 모르겠네, 친구.
Off the Rails#766.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#767.src: Do we care? We were going to arrest our detective here without evidence, anyway, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.dst: 그게 중요해? 어차피 증거도 없이 여기 탐정을 잡으려고 했잖아, Maury.
Off the Rails#767.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#768.src: I guess yer right, though it might be hard to spin an Aelumian as guilty... They're pretty well-behaved.
Off the Rails#768.dst: 네 말이 맞긴 한데, Aelumia 사람을 범인으로 몰기는 좀 어렵겠는걸... 다들 꽤 얌전하거든.
Off the Rails#768.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#769.src: ...This is ridiculous! You can't do this!
Off the Rails#769.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#770.src: Must I repeat myself? Do ya want to be put down as an accomplice? Quiet, you.
Off the Rails#770.dst: 두 번 말하게 할래? 공범으로 올라가고 싶어? 조용히 해.
Off the Rails#770.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#771.src: Hey, Maury... What if we arrested HIM instead. It'd be easier to explain, no?
Off the Rails#771.dst: 야, Maury... 차라리 저 남자를 잡는 건 어때? 설명하기 더 쉽잖아?
Off the Rails#771.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#773.src: ...you know what? Yes. Take me instead.
Off the Rails#773.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#775.src: Hands behind yer back, bub, the train's about to arrive in {p}.
Off the Rails#775.dst: 손 뒤로 해, 친구. 열차가 곧 {p}에 도착하니까.
Off the Rails#775.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#776.src: Come on, idiot. We're not going to let you accuse US, obviously.
Off the Rails#776.dst: 무슨 소리야, 멍청아. 당연히 우릴 지목하게 둘 리가 없지.
Off the Rails#776.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#777.src: Even if it WAS me, there'd be nothing ya could do about it. We're the ones with power here. Now go and select one of the passengers, come on.
Off the Rails#777.dst: 설령 나였다 해도 넌 아무것도 못 해. 여기서 힘 있는 건 우리야. 이제 승객 중에 하나 골라, 어서.
Off the Rails#777.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#778.src: ...You mean to suggest she... No, that's just not possible.
Off the Rails#778.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#779.src: Yeah, why would she? She had important business to do...
Off the Rails#779.dst: 그래, 장군님이 왜? 중요한 볼일이 있으셨는데...
Off the Rails#779.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#780.src: Well, Harvin, maybe she got tired of her job? That Majin bossin' her around all the time's gotta get tirin'...
Off the Rails#780.dst: 글쎄, Harvin, 일에 지치셨나 보지? 그 Majin한테 맨날 부려 먹히면 지칠 만도 하지...
Off the Rails#780.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#782.src: You know what? Even if she did do it, I don't care; we need someone to blame. Now COME ON! Accuse someone already, preferably alive this time!
Off the Rails#782.dst: 있잖아? 설령 장군님이 했대도 상관없어. 누군가한테 뒤집어씌워야 한다고. 그러니 어서! 누구든 지목해, 이번엔 산 사람으로!
Off the Rails#782.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#784.src: That guy we just arrested? He was STACKED! LOADED! We're gonna be vacationing in the {p} with this kind of money, haha!
Off the Rails#784.dst: 방금 잡은 그 녀석? 돈이 엄청 많더라! 완전 부자야! 이 돈이면 {p}에서 휴가 보내겠다, 하하!
Off the Rails#784.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#785.src: Don't tell Maury, but I felt like you deserved a small cut of the profits, Y'know, for figuring it out, and all.
Off the Rails#785.dst: Maury한텐 비밀인데, 너도 한몫 챙길 자격이 있는 것 같아서. 그러니까, 범인을 알아낸 대가로 말이야.
Off the Rails#785.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#786.src: HEY! HARVIN! Didn't I tell ya not to go and give 'em anything? Idiot!
Off the Rails#786.dst: 야! HARVIN! 저 사람한테 아무것도 주지 말라고 했지? 멍청아!
Off the Rails#786.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#787.src: ...Shoot. Guess that's my cue to leave.
Off the Rails#787.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#788.src: Got a ticket or train pass?
Off the Rails#788.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#789.src: A General's trian pass??? But... But you're not
Off the Rails#789.dst: 장군 전용 승차권??? 하지만... 하지만 당신은
Off the Rails#789.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#790.src: Okay, okay... Sorry for questioning you, General. Where would you like to go today?
Off the Rails#790.dst: 알겠어요, 알겠어요... 의심해서 죄송합니다, 장군님. 오늘은 어디로 가시겠어요?
Off the Rails#790.speaker: Ticket Collector

One Thousand Meters Under#000.src: Read the Help Wanted sign in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

One Thousand Meters Under#004.src: Oh, you're here about the job vacancy? Well, you're a little late.
One Thousand Meters Under#004.dst: 아, 구인 공고 보고 오셨어요? 음, 조금 늦으셨네요.
One Thousand Meters Under#004.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#005.src: There might still be time, just sneak in to the conference room behind me.
One Thousand Meters Under#005.dst: 아직 시간이 있을지도 몰라요. 제 뒤 회의실로 몰래 들어가세요.
One Thousand Meters Under#005.speaker: The Secretary

One Thousand Meters Under#006.src: Enter the conference room and listen to the scientist.

One Thousand Meters Under#008.src: I am Ynnos, one of the leading scientists in Gavel. You're here because... Well you read the help wanted sign.
One Thousand Meters Under#008.dst: 저는 Ynnos, Gavel 최고의 과학자 중 한 명입니다. 여러분이 여기 온 건... 뭐, 구인 공고를 봤기 때문이죠.
One Thousand Meters Under#008.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#009.src: Allow me to explain the situation we're in. It's a series of unfortunate events. I study the amazing properties of crystals and other geodes.
One Thousand Meters Under#009.dst: 지금 우리 상황을 설명하죠. 불운이 연달아 겹쳤습니다. 저는 수정과 다른 정동석의 놀라운 성질을 연구하고 있어요.
One Thousand Meters Under#009.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#010.src: I am funded by a private organization, however that seems to have stopped. So... We had to make cuts in the budget.
One Thousand Meters Under#010.dst: 한 민간 단체에서 자금을 받았는데, 그게 끊긴 것 같아요. 그래서... 예산을 줄여야 했죠.
One Thousand Meters Under#010.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#011.src: One of these, was using cheaper rope. While moving the crystal across {p}, well, it snapped. The crystal fell.
One Thousand Meters Under#011.dst: 그중 하나가 싼 밧줄을 쓴 거였어요. 수정을 옮겨 {p}을(를) 건너던 중, 뚝 끊어졌죠. 수정이 떨어졌습니다.
One Thousand Meters Under#011.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#012.src: I can not stress the value of that crystal. It had many unique properties that are allowing me to understand why the {p} float the way they do.
One Thousand Meters Under#012.dst: 그 수정이 얼마나 귀한지 말로 다 못 해요. 독특한 성질이 많아서, {p}이(가) 왜 그렇게 떠 있는지 이해하게 해 주었죠.
One Thousand Meters Under#012.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#013.src: They hold the very key to restoring this land to being whole once more... But it's gone.
One Thousand Meters Under#013.dst: 이 땅을 다시 온전하게 되돌릴 열쇠가 바로 거기 있어요... 그런데 사라졌습니다.
One Thousand Meters Under#013.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#014.src: Fortunately, I detected an impact. It's hit something down in the void. We're not sure what, however or how deep.
One Thousand Meters Under#014.dst: 다행히 충돌을 감지했어요. 공허 아래 무언가에 부딪혔죠. 그게 뭔지, 얼마나 깊은지는 모릅니다.
One Thousand Meters Under#014.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#015.src: Your mission will be to retrieve the crystal in a specially designed ship to withstand the void. We barely scraped it out of the budget, so try to bring it back in one piece.
One Thousand Meters Under#015.dst: 여러분의 임무는 공허를 견디도록 특수 설계한 배를 타고 수정을 회수하는 겁니다. 예산을 겨우 짜내 만든 배니까, 부디 멀쩡히 가져와 주세요.
One Thousand Meters Under#015.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#016.src: If you think you are not up for the challenge, leave now...
One Thousand Meters Under#016.dst: 이 도전을 감당할 자신이 없다면, 지금 떠나세요...
One Thousand Meters Under#016.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#017.src: When you think you are ready, exit the room behind me and meet me at the dock as soon as possible.
One Thousand Meters Under#017.dst: 준비됐다 싶으면 제 뒤쪽 출구로 나가서, 되도록 빨리 선착장에서 만납시다.
One Thousand Meters Under#017.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#019.src: Wait for the submarine to arrive at the void islands.
One Thousand Meters Under#019.dst: 잠수함이 공허 섬에 도착할 때까지 기다리세요.

One Thousand Meters Under#021.src: This is the ship's mechanic. There appears to be a fault on the lower deck. I request urgent assistance.
One Thousand Meters Under#021.dst: 기관사다. 아래 갑판에 고장이 난 것 같다. 긴급 지원을 요청한다.
One Thousand Meters Under#021.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#022.src: I wonder what the mechanic is doing?
One Thousand Meters Under#022.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#023.src: He has been screaming and crying for a while now. I hope everything is alright down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#023.dst: 아까부터 계속 소리 지르고 울고 있어. 아래는 별일 없으면 좋겠는데.
One Thousand Meters Under#023.speaker: Arlene

One Thousand Meters Under#024.src: Ah finally! One of the air pipes has shattered, we need to patch it up ASAP!
One Thousand Meters Under#024.dst: 아, 드디어! 공기관 하나가 깨졌어, 당장 막아야 해!
One Thousand Meters Under#024.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#025.src: Quick, head into the room behind me and line up the white glass with the blue blocks. I'll control things from here!
One Thousand Meters Under#025.dst: 어서 내 뒤 방으로 가서 흰 유리를 파란 블록에 맞춰 줘. 조작은 내가 여기서 할게!
One Thousand Meters Under#025.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#026.src: Take a nap in the resting room.

One Thousand Meters Under#027.src: Oh wow, thanks for the help! You should head up to the resting room and take a nap before we arrive at the first island.
One Thousand Meters Under#027.dst: 오, 도와줘서 고마워! 첫 섬에 도착하기 전에 휴게실에 올라가서 한숨 자 둬.
One Thousand Meters Under#027.speaker: Kantor

One Thousand Meters Under#028.src: Talk to the captain outside of the submarine.

One Thousand Meters Under#029.src: We have encountered out first island, {~}m down. Crew members, climb up the ladder and search the island for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#029.dst: 첫 번째 섬에 도착했다, 깊이 {~}m. 승무원들은 사다리를 올라가 섬에서 수정을 찾아라.
One Thousand Meters Under#029.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#030.src: We've arrived at the next void island.
One Thousand Meters Under#030.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#031.src: The void islands are really different from Gavel... Or are we still even in Gavel?
One Thousand Meters Under#031.dst: 공허 섬은 Gavel이랑 정말 다르군... 아니, 여기가 아직 Gavel이긴 한가?
One Thousand Meters Under#031.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#032.src: Anyway, let's explore the island, look for the void crystal, and return to {p}!
One Thousand Meters Under#032.dst: 아무튼 섬을 탐색해서 공허 수정을 찾고, {p}(으)로 돌아가자!
One Thousand Meters Under#032.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#033.src: Explore the island and look for the crystal.

One Thousand Meters Under#034.src: Return to the submarine and continue your journey.

One Thousand Meters Under#036.src: Oh my, what are these creatures!?
One Thousand Meters Under#036.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#037.src: They are attacking the windshield in the front room, it looks like it's about to break at any moment!
One Thousand Meters Under#037.dst: 앞쪽 방 앞유리를 공격하고 있어, 당장이라도 깨질 것 같다!
One Thousand Meters Under#037.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#038.src: Quick, you! Come into the cockpit and press on the window to scare them off!
One Thousand Meters Under#038.dst: 거기 자네, 빨리! 조종실로 와서 창문을 눌러 쫓아내!
One Thousand Meters Under#038.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#039.src: This is not good, the creatures destroyed part of the windshield.
One Thousand Meters Under#039.dst: 큰일이군, 저놈들이 앞유리 일부를 부숴 버렸어.
One Thousand Meters Under#039.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#040.src: We can't continue much longer with a broken windshield, we'll have to repair it at another island.
One Thousand Meters Under#040.dst: 앞유리가 깨진 채로는 오래 못 간다. 다른 섬에서 고쳐야겠어.
One Thousand Meters Under#040.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#041.src: Ynnos said the void has pockets of toxic gas... Go take a nap, I'll wake you up when we're there.
One Thousand Meters Under#041.dst: Ynnos 말로는 공허 곳곳에 독가스가 고여 있다더군... 가서 자 둬, 도착하면 깨우지.
One Thousand Meters Under#041.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#043.src: Meet up with the captain outside the submarine.

One Thousand Meters Under#044.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the second island, {~}m down. We cannot progress without making some emergency repairs.
One Thousand Meters Under#044.dst: 승무원들, 주목. 두 번째 섬에 도착했다, 깊이 {~}m. 긴급 수리 없이는 더 나아갈 수 없다.
One Thousand Meters Under#044.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#045.src: Crew, please disembark and search resources to help repair the ship. We need glass and some kind of glue.
One Thousand Meters Under#045.dst: 승무원들은 하선해서 배 수리에 쓸 자원을 찾아라. 유리와 접착제 같은 게 필요하다.
One Thousand Meters Under#045.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#046.src: The void creatures did heavy damage to our craft, we need to repair the submarine.
One Thousand Meters Under#046.dst: 공허 생물들 때문에 배가 크게 망가졌어. 잠수함을 고쳐야 해.
One Thousand Meters Under#046.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#047.src: I'm not sure what we'll find here, but we'll need some glue and glass...
One Thousand Meters Under#047.dst: 여기서 뭘 찾을진 모르지만, 접착제랑 유리가 필요해...
One Thousand Meters Under#047.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#048.src: I doubt we'll find those exact things, so get resourceful!
One Thousand Meters Under#048.dst: 딱 그 물건을 찾긴 어려울 테니, 머리를 좀 써 봐!
One Thousand Meters Under#048.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#049.src: Bring me [{~} Sand Substitutes] and [{~} Glue Substitutes], that should be enough.
One Thousand Meters Under#049.dst: [{~} Sand Substitutes], [{~} Glue Substitutes]를 가져와. 그 정도면 충분할 거다.
One Thousand Meters Under#049.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#050.src: Find [{~} Sand] and [{~} Glue] on the void island.

One Thousand Meters Under#051.src: Ech! What is this stuff? Well, this should do the trick.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.dst: 윽! 이게 뭐야? 뭐, 이거면 되겠지.
One Thousand Meters Under#051.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#052.src: Me and the mechanic will start repairing. It'll take a while, so enter the submarine and rest up.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.dst: 나랑 기관사가 수리를 시작하지. 시간이 걸리니 잠수함에 들어가 쉬어 둬.
One Thousand Meters Under#052.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#053.src: We'll continue the trip when we've repaired the ship.
One Thousand Meters Under#053.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#055.src: This is the mechanic, requesting urgent assistence in the basement!
One Thousand Meters Under#055.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#056.src: Toxic gas has leaked in through the submarine's vents, someone will have to manually close them.
One Thousand Meters Under#056.dst: 잠수함 환기구로 독가스가 새어 들어왔어. 누가 직접 닫아야 해.
One Thousand Meters Under#056.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#057.src: I'll control things from here, someone get down to the lowest level and close those vents!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.dst: 조작은 내가 여기서 할게. 누가 맨 아래층에 내려가서 환기구 좀 닫아 줘!
One Thousand Meters Under#057.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#058.src: Attention crew. We have arrived at the next island {~}m down.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.dst: 승무원들, 주목. 깊이 {~}m, 다음 섬에 도착했다.
One Thousand Meters Under#058.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#059.src: Disembark and start the search for the crystal.
One Thousand Meters Under#059.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#060.src: Let's hope it's here... I don't know how much more void my body can handle.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.dst: 이번엔 여기 있길... 내 몸이 공허를 얼마나 더 버틸지 모르겠어.
One Thousand Meters Under#060.speaker: Captain Olof

One Thousand Meters Under#061.src: Look out! {u}, we'll build a bridge to the other island whilst you defend us from the mobs!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.dst: 조심해! {u}, 우리가 저쪽 섬까지 다리를 놓을 테니 몹들을 막아 줘!
One Thousand Meters Under#061.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#063.src: Keep fighting! We're almost halfway to the other side!
One Thousand Meters Under#063.speaker: Jesp

One Thousand Meters Under#066.src: Return to the submarine and continue the journey.

One Thousand Meters Under#067.src: We didn't find the crystal here either. Maybe it just fell in the void?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.dst: 여기서도 수정을 못 찾았네. 그냥 공허로 떨어진 거 아냐?
One Thousand Meters Under#067.speaker: Rex

One Thousand Meters Under#068.src: No, it must have hit an island. The scientist said he detected a collision.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.dst: 아니, 분명 섬에 부딪혔어. 과학자가 충돌을 감지했다잖아.
One Thousand Meters Under#068.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#070.src: The ropes are snapping! Quick! Abandon ship!
One Thousand Meters Under#070.speaker: Manny

One Thousand Meters Under#071.src: Find a way out of the void.

One Thousand Meters Under#074.src: Someone dropped a boooook about you people! Warriors! Workers!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.dst: 누가 너희에 대한 채애애액을 떨어뜨렸지! 전사! 일꾼!
One Thousand Meters Under#074.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#075.src: Ah. Yoooou want to know about this place?
One Thousand Meters Under#075.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#076.src: Well... We were once Villagers. I think we still are, a bit.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.dst: 음... 우린 한때 주민이었다. 지금도 조금은 그렇겠지.
One Thousand Meters Under#076.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#077.src: For some reason, {~} years agoooo. The sky islands ruptured.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.dst: 무슨 이유에선지, {~}년 저어어언에. 하늘 섬들이 갈라졌다.
One Thousand Meters Under#077.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#078.src: Some stayed. Others fell. We somehow survived the fall into the vooooid.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.dst: 누구는 남고, 누구는 떨어졌지. 우린 어떻게인가 공허어어로 떨어지고도 살아남았다.
One Thousand Meters Under#078.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#079.src: How we have lived for so long, I doooo not know. But one thing we know for sure. The void provides.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.dst: 어떻게 이리 오래 살았는지는 모르겠다아아. 하지만 확실한 게 하나 있지. 공허는 베푼다.
One Thousand Meters Under#079.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#080.src: We are stuck here now. The void has forever changed our physiology.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.dst: 이제 우린 여기 갇혔다. 공허가 우리 몸을 영영 바꿔 놨지.
One Thousand Meters Under#080.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#081.src: The crystal yoooou are looking for fell on this island. But...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.dst: 너어어가 찾는 수정은 이 섬에 떨어졌다. 하지만...
One Thousand Meters Under#081.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#082.src: We need it. It will aid us for years.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.dst: 우린 그게 필요하다. 몇 년은 버티겠지.
One Thousand Meters Under#082.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#083.src: We have very limited resources here. That's why a power source like this is soooo valuable.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.dst: 여긴 자원이 아주 부족하다. 그래서 이런 동력원이 너어어무 귀하지.
One Thousand Meters Under#083.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#084.src: If you go to the east, you will find Rontaid, our chief scientist. He'll know what to doooo.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.dst: 동쪽으로 가면 우리 수석 과학자 Rontaid가 있다. 그라면 어떻게 할지 알 거다아아.
One Thousand Meters Under#084.speaker: Celuuse

One Thousand Meters Under#085.src: Talk to Rontaid outside the town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

One Thousand Meters Under#087.src: Well, looks like the book we found wasn't fiction after all!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.dst: 허, 우리가 주운 그 책이 지어낸 얘기가 아니었군!
One Thousand Meters Under#087.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#088.src: This crystal is going toooo be our saviour. I was trying to create one of my own, you know.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.dst: 이 수정은 우리를 구해 줄 거야아아. 사실 나도 직접 하나 만들어 보려던 참이었지.
One Thousand Meters Under#088.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#089.src: I think I have the formula, but we don't have what we need to make it.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.dst: 공식은 알아낸 것 같은데, 만들 재료가 없어.
One Thousand Meters Under#089.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#090.src: Instead of taking this crystal back, why don't I exchange it for the recipe?
One Thousand Meters Under#090.dst: 이 수정을 가져가는 대신, 제조법이랑 바꾸는 게 어때?
One Thousand Meters Under#090.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#091.src: That way, you can make however many crystals youuuu want, and we can keep this one.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.dst: 그러면 너어어는 수정을 원하는 만큼 만들고, 우린 이걸 가지면 되지.
One Thousand Meters Under#091.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#092.src: Here's the recipe, give it to a scientist or someone a bit...smarter than yourself. No offense.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.dst: 여기 제조법이야. 과학자나 너보다 좀... 똑똑한 사람한테 줘. 악의는 없어.
One Thousand Meters Under#092.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#093.src: A platform was lowered from the surface a while ago at your crash site, as well. If youuuu wish to return, follow this path, I made a shortcut.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.dst: 얼마 전 너희 추락 지점에 지상에서 발판도 내려왔어. 돌아가고 싶으며언, 이 길을 따라가. 지름길을 만들어 뒀지.
One Thousand Meters Under#093.speaker: Rontaid

One Thousand Meters Under#094.src: Return to the crash site by following the road.

One Thousand Meters Under#095.src: Return to the scientist and tell him the news.

One Thousand Meters Under#096.src: You survived! Where is everyone else?
One Thousand Meters Under#096.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#098.src: I knew some must have died... But all of them?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.dst: 몇 명은 죽었겠다 싶었지만... 전부 다요?
One Thousand Meters Under#098.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#099.src: Well... At least I don't have to pay them! Hah!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.dst: 뭐... 적어도 급료는 안 줘도 되겠네요! 하!
One Thousand Meters Under#099.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#100.src: ...That was heartless of me, I'm sorry. The rope we used was too weak to hold you down there.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.dst: ...제가 너무 매정했네요, 미안합니다. 우리가 쓴 밧줄이 너무 약해서 버티지 못했어요.
One Thousand Meters Under#100.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#101.src: My calculations didn't account for the void's physics, it seems.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.dst: 제 계산이 공허의 물리 법칙을 고려하지 못했나 봐요.
One Thousand Meters Under#101.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#102.src: At least we got you back in one piece. You can tell us what happened.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.dst: 그래도 당신은 멀쩡히 돌아왔군요. 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 주세요.
One Thousand Meters Under#102.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#104.src: Well I'll be damned. I'll start sending post down there! We can work together.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.dst: 이럴 수가. 거기로 우편을 보내기 시작해야겠어요! 같이 일할 수 있겠군요.
One Thousand Meters Under#104.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

One Thousand Meters Under#105.src: Better to keep everything that happened here a secret. I don't want to lose what little funding I have. This recipe is genius! Here, take this as well as your money.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.dst: 여기서 있었던 일은 전부 비밀로 하는 게 좋겠어요. 얼마 안 되는 자금마저 잃고 싶진 않거든요. 이 제조법은 천재적이군요! 자, 이것도 보수와 함께 받으세요.
One Thousand Meters Under#105.speaker: Scientist Ynnos

Out of my Mind#000.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumours seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be some mad scientist?

Out of my Mind#001.src: Let's go, I'll take you to the exit so that I don't waste your time any longer!
Out of my Mind#001.dst: 가자, 더는 시간 뺏지 않게 출구까지 데려다줄게!

Out of my Mind#002.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have just been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!

Out of my Mind#003.src: Oh the places I've been were wonderful! From the depths of the jungle to the lesser depths of the jungle to even my back garden, I've done my fair share of exploring, if I do say so myself!
Out of my Mind#003.dst: 아, 내가 가 본 곳들은 정말 멋졌어! 정글 깊숙한 곳부터 정글의 덜 깊은 곳, 심지어 우리 뒷마당까지, 탐험이라면 나도 꽤 했다고 자부해!

Out of my Mind#004.src: You are the first normal person I've seen recently, {u}. I went out recently and was met with some very rude remarks by some very rude townsfolk!
Out of my Mind#004.dst: {u}, 넌 요즘 내가 본 첫 번째 정상인이야. 최근에 나갔더니 아주 무례한 마을 사람들한테 아주 무례한 말을 들었지 뭐야!

Out of my Mind#005.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even there to hide from! Strange people.

Out of my Mind#006.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books for hours too! Here's one right now.

Out of my Mind#007.src: The ground is shaking... I thought that was supposed to happen later! Come back friend, I can't do this alone!
Out of my Mind#007.dst: 땅이 흔들려... 이건 나중에 일어날 일이었는데! 돌아와, 친구, 나 혼자선 못 해!

Out of my Mind#008.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shelf hitting you square in the head!

Out of my Mind#009.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping something heavier on your head for the second time.

Out of my Mind#010.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose were you want it to go and face.

Out of my Mind#011.src: Quick, head through the large door and stop the cause of all that shaking!

Out of my Mind#012.src: I don't know about you, Todd, but I feel we should make them our new honorary club member for finding such amazing things!

Out of my Mind#013.src: Ignore Viola, she's acting up today, probably because you've got the spotlight this time. However, I agree with Prentiss.

Out of my Mind#014.src: Welcome you to the club, new member! Here is your shiny new badge that you can parade around town to show off how cool you are to others with style.

Out of my Mind#015.src: You tell the group of kids your experiences of strange creatures, even stranger men as well as a hazy memory about... a coconut?
Out of my Mind#015.dst: 아이들에게 이상한 생물들, 그보다 더 이상한 사람들, 그리고... 코코넛에 대한 흐릿한 기억까지 겪은 일을 들려준다.

Out of my Mind#016.src: Speak with the {p} children in the treehouse.
Out of my Mind#016.dst: 나무 위 집에 있는 {p} 아이들과 이야기하세요.

Out of my Mind#017.src: Did ye two hear about some guy wandering around town? I've heard strange rumours about him...
Out of my Mind#017.dst: 너희 둘, 마을을 어슬렁대는 사람 얘기 들었어? 그 사람에 대한 이상한 소문을 들었거든...
Out of my Mind#017.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#018.src: Of course I have, he's the talk of the town! I heard he only brushes his teeth once a day and that he enjoys books about gardening!
Out of my Mind#018.dst: 당연히 들었지, 온 마을이 그 얘기인데! 그 사람은 하루에 이를 한 번만 닦고, 정원 가꾸기 책을 좋아한대!
Out of my Mind#018.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#019.src: I don't know, you guys, all these rumors seem a little far-fetched. What next? Will he suddenly turn out to be a mad scientist?
Out of my Mind#019.dst: 글쎄, 얘들아, 그 소문들 좀 억지 같지 않아? 다음엔 뭐야? 알고 보니 미친 과학자라도 된대?
Out of my Mind#019.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#020.src: Oh shush you, we're not living inside some storybook! Besides, if he *was* a mad scientist, wouldn't he be trying to take over the city like all mad scientists in stories do?
Out of my Mind#020.dst: 쉿, 조용히 해. 우리가 동화책 속에 사는 것도 아니잖아! 게다가 *정말* 미친 과학자라면, 이야기 속 미친 과학자들처럼 도시를 점령하려 들지 않겠어?
Out of my Mind#020.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#021.src: To me that doesn't sound all that strange compared to these other things I've been hearing, anyway... Something about labs and a "hermit".
Out of my Mind#021.dst: 내가 들은 다른 얘기들에 비하면 그건 별로 이상하지도 않아... 실험실이랑 "은둔자"에 대한 얘기도 있었거든.
Out of my Mind#021.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#022.src: I think that's a type of crab or something. Adults are right old weirdos sometimes.
Out of my Mind#022.dst: 그거 게 종류 아니야? 어른들은 가끔 진짜 괴짜라니까.
Out of my Mind#022.speaker: Prentiss

Out of my Mind#023.src: Hey, a stranger! How long have you been listening to us? Didn't your mom teach you any manners?
Out of my Mind#023.dst: 어, 낯선 사람이다! 언제부터 엿들은 거야? 엄마가 예의도 안 가르쳐 줬어?
Out of my Mind#023.speaker: Viola

Out of my Mind#025.src: Ignore my friends over there, they're always like that, but what Prentiss said was true. This might be our only chance to really know who this mystery man really is!
Out of my Mind#025.dst: 저기 내 친구들은 신경 쓰지 마, 맨날 저래. 그래도 Prentiss 말이 맞아. 그 수수께끼 남자가 누군지 알아낼 유일한 기회일지도 몰라!
Out of my Mind#025.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#026.src: It might be a good idea to look at that weird house next to those spooky ruins south-east of the city. We found this key you could try out, but if you lose it there are some spares in our base.
Out of my Mind#026.dst: 도시 남동쪽의 으스스한 폐허 옆에 있는 그 이상한 집을 살펴보는 게 좋겠어. 우리가 찾은 이 열쇠를 써 봐. 잃어버려도 기지에 여분이 있어.
Out of my Mind#026.speaker: Todd

Out of my Mind#027.src: Find the hidden door next to the gate near the Undergrowth Ruins outside {p}
Out of my Mind#027.dst: {p} 밖 덤불 유적 근처 관문 옆에 숨겨진 문을 찾으세요

Out of my Mind#028.src: Find a way inside the house at [-{~},-{~}]
Out of my Mind#028.dst: [-{~},-{~}]에 있는 집 안으로 들어갈 방법을 찾으세요

Out of my Mind#029.src: Explore the hidden lab in search of information

Out of my Mind#030.src: Hello stranger! Welcome to my humble wooden abode. Comfy, isn't it? I bet you'd like a cup of this coff-
Out of my Mind#030.dst: 안녕, 낯선 이여! 나의 소박한 나무 집에 온 걸 환영해. 아늑하지? 분명 이 커피 한 잔이 생각날 거야-
Out of my Mind#030.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#031.src: Oh yes, I am the affable Ariodo, friendly neighbourhood neighbour. What do you need me for?
Out of my Mind#031.dst: 아, 그래, 난 상냥한 Ariodo, 친절한 동네 이웃이지. 나한테 무슨 볼일이야?
Out of my Mind#031.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#032.src: Kidnappings? Poaching? Not brushing my teeth?! Who is this lowly person you're talking about... they don't seem like a nice fellow such as myself.
Out of my Mind#032.dst: 납치? 밀렵? 이를 안 닦는다고?! 대체 누굴 말하는 거야, 그런 저질을... 나처럼 좋은 사람은 아닌 것 같은데.
Out of my Mind#032.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#034.src: This is the room you came from. I call it the "Vivarium", creative name I came up with, right? It keeps my pets that aren't quite ready.
Out of my Mind#034.dst: 여긴 네가 들어온 방이야. "Vivarium"이라고 부르지. 내가 지었는데 창의적이지? 아직 준비가 덜 된 애완동물들이 있어.
Out of my Mind#034.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#035.src: Ready for what? Well that would ruin the surprise, wouldn't it? Can't have anyone finding out before the big event!
Out of my Mind#035.dst: 뭘 위한 준비냐고? 말하면 깜짝 선물이 망치잖아? 큰 행사 전에 누가 알아채면 안 되지!
Out of my Mind#035.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#036.src: Let us go now, time is precious.
Out of my Mind#036.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#037.src: So you must be thinking, how have you never met a fine fellow such as myself until now? To be quite honest, you must have been terribly unlucky, I used to travel the world, you know!
Out of my Mind#037.dst: 너 지금 이런 생각 하지? 어째서 나 같은 멋진 사람을 이제야 만났을까? 솔직히 넌 운이 지독히 나빴던 거야. 나 예전엔 세계를 여행했거든!
Out of my Mind#037.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#040.src: The last time I visited the town it was all empty too, but I could feel people were hiding in their homes, even on such a lovely day as then. There was no one even to hide from! Strange people.
Out of my Mind#040.dst: 지난번 마을에 갔을 때도 텅 비어 있었는데, 다들 집에 숨어 있는 게 느껴졌어. 그렇게 날씨 좋은 날에 말이야. 숨을 이유도 없는데! 이상한 사람들이야.
Out of my Mind#040.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#041.src: I'm just a normal guy, so why can't anyone appreciate me for once? I'm sure you do, right?
Out of my Mind#041.dst: 난 그냥 평범한 사람인데, 왜 아무도 날 알아주지 않을까? 넌 알아주지, 그렇지?
Out of my Mind#041.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#042.src: Here we are, the library! I could spend years in here, but who has time for that? I could talk about books hours too! Here's one right now.
Out of my Mind#042.dst: 다 왔다, 도서관이야! 여기서 몇 년이고 보낼 수 있지만 누가 그럴 시간이 있겠어? 책 얘기라면 몇 시간이고 할 수 있어! 마침 여기 한 권 있네.
Out of my Mind#042.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#043.src: This is 'The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Sweeney S. Greenville' and I must say it is a hidden gem among books! One day it just suddenly appeared in here so I couldn't resist reading it. So it starts off with Sweeney S. Greenville...
Out of my Mind#043.dst: 이건 'Sweeney S. Greenville의 장황하고 고통스러운 죽음'인데, 정말 숨은 명작이야! 어느 날 갑자기 여기 나타나서 안 읽을 수가 없었지. 이야기는 Sweeney S. Greenville이...
Out of my Mind#043.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#044.src: We're here now! Take the exit right in front of you, don't mind the corridor to the right, it's only decoration!
Out of my Mind#044.dst: 다 왔어! 바로 앞 출구로 나가. 오른쪽 복도는 신경 쓰지 마, 그냥 장식이야!
Out of my Mind#044.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#045.src: Maybe you can come back some day for a tea or coffee and a long talk about books, since I noticed you were very interested in my long-winded review! Have fun out there and don't forget, I'm always here for you!
Out of my Mind#045.dst: 언젠가 차나 커피 마시러 와서 책 얘기 길게 하자. 내 장황한 서평에 관심이 많아 보이던데! 밖에서 즐겁게 지내고, 잊지 마. 난 언제나 네 편이야!
Out of my Mind#045.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#047.src: Build a machine to hit your head and get back to normal
Out of my Mind#047.dst: 머리를 칠 기계를 만들어 원래대로 돌아오세요

Out of my Mind#048.src: Help me keep this door shut, or else my surprise will be ruined!
Out of my Mind#048.dst: 이 문 닫는 거 좀 도와줘, 안 그러면 내 깜짝 선물이 망한다고!
Out of my Mind#048.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#049.src: Just keep to the sides, it's safer that way.
Out of my Mind#049.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#050.src: Just stay here for one more momen...
Out of my Mind#050.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#051.src: Oh my, a ghost? Wait, is this just you, my trusty friend, playing a prank on me? No? Well that certainly is a problem!
Out of my Mind#051.dst: 세상에, 유령? 잠깐, 설마 나의 믿음직한 친구인 네가 장난치는 거야? 아니라고? 그럼 진짜 문제네!
Out of my Mind#051.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#052.src: If you remember, we were talking about keeping the door shut when suddenly something heavy fell off a shell hitting you square in the head!
Out of my Mind#052.dst: 기억나면 말인데, 우리가 문을 닫아 두자고 얘기하던 중에 갑자기 선반에서 무거운 게 떨어져 네 머리에 정통으로 맞았어!
Out of my Mind#052.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#053.src: I think I heard something about fighting fire with fire, so I think I have a way to get you back! You are a bit too heavy for me, so we need to think of a workaround.
Out of my Mind#053.dst: 불은 불로 다스린다는 말을 들은 것 같아. 그러니 널 되돌릴 방법이 있어! 근데 넌 나한테 좀 무거우니까, 다른 방법을 생각해야 해.
Out of my Mind#053.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#054.src: During the shaking, some of my machines broke apart, but we could use these to build something capable of dropping someting heavier on your head for the second time.
Out of my Mind#054.dst: 흔들릴 때 내 기계 몇 대가 부서졌는데, 이 부품으로 네 머리에 더 무거운 걸 한 번 더 떨어뜨릴 뭔가를 만들 수 있을 거야.
Out of my Mind#054.speaker: Ariodo

Out of my Mind#055.src: Surely by that logic everything has to go well, you know. Now let me explain how we can do this. First, choose what part you want to use to make our machine, then choose where you want it to go and face.
