Queen's Recruit#643.dst: 그래도... 신병들. 그 신병들. 그게 도저히 안 넘어가. 너무...
Queen's Recruit#643.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#645.src: Let's just get down there and fight. Usual spots, right?
Queen's Recruit#645.dst: 그냥 내려가서 싸우자. 늘 서던 자리, 맞지?
Queen's Recruit#645.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#648.src: No words. Let's fight. Just just a training battle. To... test our skills.
Queen's Recruit#648.dst: 말은 필요 없어. 싸우자. 그냥- 그냥 연습 전투야. 실력을... 시험하는 거지.
Queen's Recruit#648.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#652.src: I guess we know how tomorrow will turn out, then.
Queen's Recruit#652.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#653.src: No don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#653.dst: 아니- 부정하지 마. 내 말이 맞다는 거 우리 둘 다 알잖아.
Queen's Recruit#653.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#654.src: No- don't deny it. We both know I'm right.
Queen's Recruit#654.dst: 아니- 부정하지 마. 내 말이 맞다는 거 우리 둘 다 알잖아.
Queen's Recruit#654.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#656.src: She gave me a choice, you know?
Queen's Recruit#656.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#657.src: A choice. I don't know what to do with it. And... I'm afraid of taking either option.
Queen's Recruit#657.dst: 선택지. 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어. 그리고... 어느 쪽을 골라도 두려워.
Queen's Recruit#657.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#658.src: I... I need to think it over some more. And we both need to rest.
Queen's Recruit#658.dst: 난... 좀 더 생각해 봐야겠어. 그리고 우리 둘 다 쉬어야 해.
Queen's Recruit#658.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#659.src: Huh? I... yes. I think I am. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#659.dst: 응? 난... 응. 괜찮은 것 같아. 그냥 생각이 많아서.
Queen's Recruit#659.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#660.src: I'll... tell you in the morning. I just have a lot on my mind.
Queen's Recruit#660.dst: 아침에... 말해 줄게. 그냥 생각이 많아서.
Queen's Recruit#660.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#661.src: Ha. You're you're good. Oof. I'll be feeling that one for... for a while.
Queen's Recruit#661.dst: 하. 너- 너 잘하네. 윽. 이건 한동안... 한동안 욱신거리겠다.
Queen's Recruit#661.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#663.src: Why did it have to come to this? Why couldn't why couldn't we all have just been happy?
Queen's Recruit#663.dst: 왜 이렇게까지 된 걸까? 왜- 왜 우린 다 같이 행복할 수 없었을까?
Queen's Recruit#663.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#664.src: He he sent me a letter for that mission, you know. Did I tell you that? It's why I went back to Wynn.
Queen's Recruit#664.dst: 그가- 그가 그 임무 때문에 편지를 보냈었어. 말했던가? 그래서 Wynn에 돌아온 거야.
Queen's Recruit#664.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#665.src: And, it turns out he was already... already gone. And you were there, and I wasn't.
Queen's Recruit#665.dst: 그런데, 알고 보니 그는 이미... 이미 떠났더라. 넌 거기 있었고, 난 없었어.
Queen's Recruit#665.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#667.src: I want to blame you for it. I want to be able to be mad, to hate you. But... I can't. I just can't.
Queen's Recruit#667.dst: 네 탓을 하고 싶어. 화내고, 널 미워하고 싶어. 근데... 못 하겠어. 도저히 못 하겠어.
Queen's Recruit#667.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#668.src: I wish I could've been there. I wish I could've done it better. Maybe I could have or maybe it would've just gone the same way.
Queen's Recruit#668.dst: 내가 거기 있었으면 좋았을 텐데. 더 잘할 수 있었으면 좋았을 텐데. 어쩌면 그럴 수 있었을지도- 아니면 결국 똑같았을지도.
Queen's Recruit#668.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#670.src: And now we're both here in the place we were all exiled from! But he's he isn't. He's gone, and and we're still here.
Queen's Recruit#670.dst: 이제 우리 둘 다 우리가 쫓겨났던 곳에 와 있어! 근데 그는- 그는 없어. 떠났고, 그- 그런데 우린 아직 여기 있어.
Queen's Recruit#670.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#671.src: ...what am I supposed to do? What are we supposed to do? About all of this?
Queen's Recruit#671.dst: ...난 어떻게 해야 하지? 우린 어떻게 해야 해? 이 모든 걸?
Queen's Recruit#671.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#674.src: I asked a lot of questions. I didn't like all the answers, but... she left me with a choice.
Queen's Recruit#674.dst: 질문을 많이 했어. 답이 다 마음에 들진 않았지만... 선택지를 남겨 줬어.
Queen's Recruit#674.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#676.src: I don't know what to do. I need to... to... I need to think.
Queen's Recruit#676.dst: 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어. 난... 좀... 생각을 좀 해야겠어.
Queen's Recruit#676.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#677.src: Give me some space, please. I'll see you in the morning.
Queen's Recruit#677.dst: 혼자 있게 해 줘, 부탁이야. 아침에 보자.
Queen's Recruit#677.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#678.src: Return to your room and sleep for the night.

Queen's Recruit#680.src: Read the note Tasim left you before heading out.
Queen's Recruit#680.dst: 나가기 전에 Tasim이 남긴 쪽지를 읽으세요.

Queen's Recruit#681.src: Head to Her Majesty's office for her decision.
Queen's Recruit#681.dst: 여왕 폐하의 집무실로 가서 결정을 들으세요.

Queen's Recruit#683.src: You've already failed, you know. You did not meet her criteria for selection.
Queen's Recruit#683.dst: 넌 이미 실패했다, 알고 있나? 그녀의 선발 기준에 못 미쳤지.

Queen's Recruit#684.src: But is dismissing you outright an error? Certainly, you're powerful. Perhaps even more so than you should be, given the circumstances.
Queen's Recruit#684.dst: 하지만 널 바로 내치는 게 실수일까? 확실히 넌 강하다. 어쩌면 네 처지치고는 지나칠 만큼.

Queen's Recruit#685.src: Still. You lack the drive, the perspective. The dedication. The understanding.
Queen's Recruit#685.dst: 그래도. 넌 추진력이, 관점이 부족하다. 헌신이. 이해가.

Queen's Recruit#686.src: And, most critically - you're unpredictable. And that makes you dangerous.
Queen's Recruit#686.dst: 그리고 가장 결정적으로- 넌 예측할 수 없다. 그래서 위험하지.

Queen's Recruit#687.src: Ah! It seems Her Majesty and I have come to the same conclusion. Wonderful.
Queen's Recruit#687.dst: 아! 여왕 폐하와 내가 같은 결론에 이른 모양이군. 훌륭해.

Queen's Recruit#688.src: So, where does that leave you? Cast out, discarded?
Queen's Recruit#688.dst: 그럼, 넌 어떻게 되는 걸까? 쫓겨나고, 버려지고?

Queen's Recruit#689.src: All the unanswered questions. Will you choose to let go? Dismiss the possibilities?
Queen's Recruit#689.dst: 답 없는 질문이 이렇게나 많은데. 놓아 버리기로 할까? 가능성을 외면할까?

Queen's Recruit#690.src: And if not? What would you do for a glimpse of the truth? For a chance of receiving answers?
Queen's Recruit#690.dst: 아니라면? 진실을 엿보기 위해 뭘 할 수 있지? 답을 얻을 기회를 위해서라면?

Queen's Recruit#691.src: Hm. Whatever the case, the choice is yours. Perhaps you'll surprise me, after all! Wouldn't that be exciting?
Queen's Recruit#691.dst: 흠. 어쨌든 선택은 네 몫이다. 어쩌면 날 놀라게 할지도! 그러면 꽤 흥미롭겠군?

Queen's Recruit#692.src: {u}, under order of Her Majesty, you are to be escorted out of Fruma, effective immediately.
Queen's Recruit#692.dst: {u}, 여왕 폐하의 명에 따라, 너는 즉시 Fruma 밖으로 호송된다.
Queen's Recruit#692.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#693.src: Any defiance will be seen as an official threat against Fruma from the Wynn province. Comply, and no one will be hurt.
Queen's Recruit#693.dst: 거역하면 Wynn 지방이 Fruma에 가하는 공식 위협으로 간주한다. 따르면 아무도 다치지 않는다.
Queen's Recruit#693.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Queen's Recruit#694.src: You hold no power here. This choice is not yours. You will follow orders, or face the consequences.
Queen's Recruit#694.dst: 넌 여기서 아무 힘도 없다. 이건 네가 고를 일이 아니다. 명령에 따르든가, 대가를 치르든가.
Queen's Recruit#694.speaker: Gendarme Commander

Recipe For Disaster#000.src: Meet up with Chef Hamsey in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#001.src: Ah, bonjour! Welcome to my restaurant, allow me to lead you to your seat-
Recipe For Disaster#001.dst: Ah, bonjour! 제 레스토랑에 오신 걸 환영해요, 자리로 안내해 드리죠-
Recipe For Disaster#001.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#002.src: Oh do my eyes deceive me? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.dst: 어라, 제 눈이 잘못됐나요? Serais-ce possible?!
Recipe For Disaster#002.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#003.src: It is you... the novice soldier turned hero of legends! Who would have thought?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.dst: 당신이군요... 신참 병사에서 전설의 영웅이 된 분! 누가 알았겠어요?!
Recipe For Disaster#003.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#004.src: I have heard tales of your exploits across the lands, mon ami! Je suis honore! Someone like you sitting in my restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#004.dst: 각지에서 당신의 활약을 들었어요, mon ami! Je suis honore! 당신 같은 분이 제 레스토랑에 앉아 있다니!
Recipe For Disaster#004.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#005.src: Je suis, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! Famed across the lands for my flavors, as you are for your weapon!
Recipe For Disaster#005.dst: 그리고 저는, bien sur... Le Chef Hamsey! 당신이 무기로 유명하듯, 저는 맛으로 이름났죠!
Recipe For Disaster#005.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#006.src: I boast, I boast. Je peu t'offrir un plat... but perhaps I have a different proposition for us both.
Recipe For Disaster#006.dst: 자랑이 심했네요. Je peu t'offrir un plat... 하지만 우리 둘을 위한 다른 제안이 있어요.
Recipe For Disaster#006.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#007.src: You may have mastered the art of battle, my friend, but what of... L'Art de la Cuisine?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.dst: 전투의 기술은 통달했겠지만, 친구, 그럼... L'Art de la Cuisine은요?!
Recipe For Disaster#007.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#008.src: Follow me into the kitchen behind me, and I will tell you more.
Recipe For Disaster#008.dst: 제 뒤의 주방으로 따라오세요, 거기서 더 말씀드리죠.
Recipe For Disaster#008.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#009.src: Find Chef Hamsey in his kitchen.

Recipe For Disaster#010.src: Welcome to my kitchen! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.dst: 제 주방에 어서 오세요! C'est beau, non?
Recipe For Disaster#010.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#011.src: It may be on fire, but... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.dst: 불이 좀 났지만... que serais la Cuisine sans une touche de danger, eh?!
Recipe For Disaster#011.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#012.src: So, back to the challenge. What do you say to a bit of friendly competition, hehe?
Recipe For Disaster#012.dst: 자, 도전 얘기로 돌아가죠. 친선 요리 대결 한판 어때요, 헤헤?
Recipe For Disaster#012.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#013.src: You can work with one of my three best chefs on a dish and present it to me once you're done!
Recipe For Disaster#013.dst: 제 최고의 요리사 셋 중 한 명과 요리를 만들어서 완성되면 저한테 가져오세요!
Recipe For Disaster#013.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#014.src: I, of course, will judge your dish based on the twenty-nine Principes de Cuisine - texture, presentation, originality...
Recipe For Disaster#014.dst: 물론 저는 스물아홉 가지 Principes de Cuisine으로 심사하죠 - 식감, 플레이팅, 독창성...
Recipe For Disaster#014.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#015.src: ... aroma, magical ability... oh, and flavour!
Recipe For Disaster#015.dst: ... 향, 마법적 능력... 아, 그리고 맛!
Recipe For Disaster#015.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#016.src: S'il te plait! Go introduce yourself to each of my chefs and return once you have decided who to work with!
Recipe For Disaster#016.dst: S'il te plait! 요리사들에게 인사하고, 누구와 함께할지 정하면 돌아오세요!
Recipe For Disaster#016.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#017.src: Speak to all three chefs in Hamsey's kitchen.
Recipe For Disaster#017.dst: Hamsey의 주방에 있는 요리사 세 명과 모두 대화하세요.

Recipe For Disaster#018.src: Heya! You must be the adventurer that Hamsey told me about. You know, he was almost ecstatic, but don't tell him I said that!
Recipe For Disaster#018.dst: 안녕하세요! Hamsey가 말한 모험가시죠? 그분 거의 들떠서 난리였어요, 제가 말했다고는 하지 마세요!
Recipe For Disaster#018.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#019.src: Oh, a cook-off? How exciting! I'll gladly help you out. Maybe this way I can prove myself a bit more to the others...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.dst: 어, 요리 대결요? 신난다! 기꺼이 도울게요. 이러면 다른 사람들한테 저를 좀 더 증명할 수 있을지도...?
Recipe For Disaster#019.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#020.src: If we work together, we can make a Seasoned Voidroot Stew, how does that sound?
Recipe For Disaster#020.dst: 같이 하면 Seasoned Voidroot Stew를 만들 수 있어요, 어때요?
Recipe For Disaster#020.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#021.src: You need to talk to the other chefs before deciding what to make, though!
Recipe For Disaster#021.dst: 그래도 뭘 만들지 정하기 전에 다른 요리사들과도 얘기해 보세요!
Recipe For Disaster#021.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#022.src: Good friend of Hamsey's, are you? I'll believe it when - no, if - you somehow win this competition.
Recipe For Disaster#022.dst: Hamsey 절친이라고? 네가 이 대결에서 이기면 - 아니, 이긴다면 - 믿어 주지.
Recipe For Disaster#022.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#023.src: I don't need any amateurs like yourself getting in my way when I'm cooking up a storm!
Recipe For Disaster#023.dst: 한창 요리 솜씨 부릴 때 너 같은 아마추어가 방해하는 건 필요 없어!
Recipe For Disaster#023.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#024.src: Are you still here? Just... go chitchat to someone else, please.
Recipe For Disaster#024.dst: 아직 여기 있어? 그냥... 다른 데 가서 수다 떨어 줘.
Recipe For Disaster#024.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#025.src: Yo, dawg. Name's Frank. Hamsey said you guys go waaay back. Any friend of Hamsey's is good with me, man.
Recipe For Disaster#025.dst: 요, 친구. 난 Frank야. Hamsey가 너희 엄청 오래된 사이래. Hamsey 친구면 나한테도 친구지.
Recipe For Disaster#025.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#026.src: Nothin' too sure on what we're gonna cook yet, figure I'll dream somethin' up before the time comes.
Recipe For Disaster#026.dst: 뭘 요리할지는 아직 잘 모르겠어, 때가 되면 뭐든 떠오르겠지.
Recipe For Disaster#026.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#027.src: Thinkin' a pie, maybe? Not too much effort there, can't go far wrong, right?
Recipe For Disaster#027.dst: 파이는 어때? 손도 별로 안 가고, 크게 망칠 일도 없잖아?
Recipe For Disaster#027.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#028.src: Talk to Hamsey and choose a chef to work with.

Recipe For Disaster#029.src: Ah, you have introduced yourself to tous mes cuisiners? Who do you want to work with?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.dst: Ah, tous mes cuisiners와 인사를 나눴나요? 누구와 함께하고 싶어요?!
Recipe For Disaster#029.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#030.src: Ah, Brie! An excellent chef... and an even better cheese! I jest, I jest. You will work well together, I am certain.
Recipe For Disaster#030.dst: Ah, Brie! 훌륭한 요리사죠... 치즈로는 더 훌륭하고요! 농담이에요, 농담. 분명 잘 맞을 거예요.
Recipe For Disaster#030.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#031.src: Ah, Kale. One of my most talented chefs, though he can be stubborn at times!
Recipe For Disaster#031.dst: Ah, Kale. 가장 재능 있는 요리사 중 하나죠, 가끔 고집이 세지만요!
Recipe For Disaster#031.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#032.src: Frank! Whilst he may seem rather... relaxed, at times, I assure you he is a most capable chef!
Recipe For Disaster#032.dst: Frank! 가끔은 좀... 느긋해 보여도, 정말 유능한 요리사라고 장담해요!
Recipe For Disaster#032.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#033.src: Maitenant, mon ami, head over to your chef and start cooking!
Recipe For Disaster#033.dst: Maitenant, mon ami, 요리사에게 가서 요리를 시작하세요!
Recipe For Disaster#033.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#034.src: Talk to your chosen chef about the dish.

Recipe For Disaster#035.src: Heya again! So you decided to make the Seasoned Voidroot Stew with me? Hurray!
Recipe For Disaster#035.dst: 또 만났네요! 저랑 Seasoned Voidroot Stew를 만들기로 했어요? 만세!
Recipe For Disaster#035.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#036.src: It's not quite as easy as it might seem, but I think together we'll be able to handle it.
Recipe For Disaster#036.dst: 보기만큼 쉽진 않지만, 우리 둘이면 해낼 수 있을 거예요.
Recipe For Disaster#036.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#037.src: Like I said before, about proving myself... I'm the newest chef here at the kitchen and some of the other chefs disapprove of my ideas. This could be my chance!
Recipe For Disaster#037.dst: 아까 말한 증명 얘기요... 제가 이 주방 막내라서, 몇몇 요리사들이 제 아이디어를 안 좋아해요. 이번이 기회일지도 몰라요!
Recipe For Disaster#037.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#038.src: I've been perfecting the recipe for Voidroot Stew for months now and I finally have a chance to show everyone what I'm worth!
Recipe For Disaster#038.dst: Voidroot Stew 레시피를 몇 달째 다듬어 왔는데, 드디어 제 실력을 모두에게 보여 줄 기회예요!
Recipe For Disaster#038.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#039.src: The first one is some [Snail Slime] available on Snail Island! We only need one for this dish.
Recipe For Disaster#039.dst: 첫 번째는 Snail Island에서 구할 수 있는 [Snail Slime]이에요! 이 요리엔 하나면 돼요.
Recipe For Disaster#039.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#040.src: Next up, we need some [Voidroot], a super rare root found deep in the Void. I've heard someone in the {p} can take you down there.
Recipe For Disaster#040.dst: 다음은 [Voidroot]가 필요해요, 공허 깊은 곳에서 나는 아주 희귀한 뿌리죠. {p}에 거기로 데려다줄 사람이 있대요.
Recipe For Disaster#040.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#041.src: Lastly, we need some [Moonsalt], which is famously hard to obtain. Luckily, self-proclaimed 'Space Wizard' Astralaus should have some, so you can just pop over to his tower and ask for some!
Recipe For Disaster#041.dst: 마지막으로 [Moonsalt]가 필요한데, 구하기 어렵기로 유명해요. 다행히 자칭 '우주 마법사' Astralaus가 갖고 있을 테니, 그의 탑에 가서 좀 달라고 하면 돼요!
Recipe For Disaster#041.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#042.src: And that should do it! I'll give you a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and track your ingredients. Good luck!
Recipe For Disaster#042.dst: 그럼 다 됐어요! 레시피 북을 드릴게요, 우클릭하면 열려서 재료를 확인할 수 있어요. 행운을 빌어요!
Recipe For Disaster#042.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#043.src: Ugh. Stay out of my way, and we'll get along just fine.
Recipe For Disaster#043.dst: 하. 내 앞길만 막지 마, 그럼 잘 지낼 수 있어.
Recipe For Disaster#043.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#044.src: Make yourself useful and get me everything we need. I'm not in the mood for chit-chat.
Recipe For Disaster#044.dst: 쓸모 있게 굴어서 필요한 거 전부 구해 와. 수다 떨 기분 아니야.
Recipe For Disaster#044.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#045.src: I don't want my reputation tarnished by the likes of you...
Recipe For Disaster#045.dst: 너 같은 녀석 때문에 내 명성에 먹칠하고 싶진 않아...
Recipe For Disaster#045.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#046.src: Listen up, I'm *not* going to say this again. Take notes.
Recipe For Disaster#046.dst: 잘 들어, 두 번은 *안* 말해. 받아 적어.
Recipe For Disaster#046.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#047.src: The key ingredient in my amazing omelette is obviously the [Blue-Ring Grook Egg], which of course you didn't know.
Recipe For Disaster#047.dst: 내 끝내주는 오믈렛의 핵심 재료는 당연히 [Blue-Ring Grook Egg]지. 물론 넌 몰랐겠지만.
Recipe For Disaster#047.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#048.src: Secondly what we need is some [Snail Slime], which is at Snail Island, obviously. Any seasoned chef could tell you that.
Recipe For Disaster#048.dst: 두 번째로 필요한 건 [Snail Slime]이야, 당연히 Snail Island에 있지. 경험 있는 요리사면 다 알아.
Recipe For Disaster#048.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#049.src: Lastly you need a [Talking Mushroom] which is found on the swamp Sky Island, provided you have a functioning sense of sight.
Recipe For Disaster#049.dst: 마지막으로 [Talking Mushroom]이 필요해. 늪지 하늘 섬에 있어, 네 눈이 제대로 달려 있다면 말이지.
Recipe For Disaster#049.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#050.src: YOU FORGOT ALREADY?? I TOLD YOU TO TAKE NOTES!
Recipe For Disaster#050.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#051.src: Lucky for you, at least one of us here is competent. I wrote everything down in this recipe book. Right-click to open it. Now get me my ingredients and scram!
Recipe For Disaster#051.dst: 다행히 여기 한 명은 유능하지. 이 레시피 북에 다 적어 뒀어. 우클릭하면 열려. 이제 재료 구해 와, 얼른 가!
Recipe For Disaster#051.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#052.src: Thrilled to be workin' with you, dude! We'll blow Hamsey's mind.
Recipe For Disaster#052.dst: 너랑 같이 하게 돼서 신난다, 친구! Hamsey 깜짝 놀라게 해 주자.
Recipe For Disaster#052.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#053.src: Hmmm, now what kinda pie should we be bakin', here?
Recipe For Disaster#053.dst: 흐음, 그럼 어떤 파이를 구워 볼까?
Recipe For Disaster#053.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#054.src: Well, I might be a lil' lazy, but when it comes to cookin', I've got the eye. And to me, dude? You look like a real Skyhigh Pie kind of guy! Heheh.
Recipe For Disaster#054.dst: 내가 좀 게으르긴 해도, 요리에 관해선 보는 눈이 있거든. 내가 보기에 넌? 딱 Skyhigh Pie 스타일이야! 헤헤.
Recipe For Disaster#054.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#055.src: Welp, guess you know how to cook up a simple Skyhigh Pie, right? Off you go, I'll be waiting here when you have the ingredients.
Recipe For Disaster#055.dst: 자, 간단한 Skyhigh Pie 만드는 법은 알지? 다녀와, 재료 구하면 여기서 기다리고 있을게.
Recipe For Disaster#055.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#056.src: Hehe, just messin' with you, man! Shoulda seen your face.
Recipe For Disaster#056.dst: 헤헤, 장난이야, 친구! 네 표정 봤어야 했는데.
Recipe For Disaster#056.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#057.src: First, we're gonna need some kinda flour. A lil' [Sunrise Flour] aughtta do.
Recipe For Disaster#057.dst: 먼저 밀가루가 좀 필요해. [Sunrise Flour] 조금이면 될 거야.
Recipe For Disaster#057.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#058.src: A good-sized [Blue-Ring Grook Egg] should give us a lil' kick. Not as much as those grooks'll give you a kick if they see you pilfering their eggs, though!
Recipe For Disaster#058.dst: 큼직한 [Blue-Ring Grook Egg]면 맛에 한 방 더해 줄 거야. 알 훔치다 grook한테 들키면 너한테 날아올 한 방만큼은 아니지만!
Recipe For Disaster#058.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#059.src: Finally, the secret ingredient - A [Skyhigh Raspberry]. Real good stuff, but it's a fair way out. Guess a lil' walking never hurt anyone, huh? Not that I've ever bothered.
Recipe For Disaster#059.dst: 마지막으로 비밀 재료 - [Skyhigh Raspberry]. 진짜 좋은 건데, 좀 멀리 있어. 좀 걷는다고 안 죽잖아? 나야 가 본 적 없지만.
Recipe For Disaster#059.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#060.src: Huh, you've got a bad memory? Yeah, me too, man. Here's a Recipe Book, just right-click to open it up and check where to grab the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#060.dst: 어, 기억력이 나쁘다고? 나도 그래, 친구. 여기 레시피 북이야, 우클릭해서 열면 재료 구할 곳이 나와!
Recipe For Disaster#060.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#061.src: Return here once you've got them all. Peace out, dude!
Recipe For Disaster#061.dst: 다 구하면 여기로 와. 그럼 이따 봐, 친구!
Recipe For Disaster#061.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#063.src: Welcome to Astralus' Astral House! Can you get to the top by flipping gravity?
Recipe For Disaster#063.dst: Astralus의 별빛 저택에 온 걸 환영한다! 중력을 뒤집어 꼭대기까지 갈 수 있겠나?
Recipe For Disaster#063.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#064.src: Astronomical progress! But this is just the beginning!
Recipe For Disaster#064.dst: 천문학적인 진전이군! 하지만 이건 시작일 뿐이다!
Recipe For Disaster#064.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#065.src: ...And why did you come to my tower?
Recipe For Disaster#065.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#066.src: My Moonsalt? How absurd! I collected mine myself, you collect yours! It's only fair.
Recipe For Disaster#066.dst: 내 Moonsalt? 터무니없군! 내 건 내가 직접 모았으니 네 건 네가 모아! 그게 공평하지.
Recipe For Disaster#066.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#067.src: Darn humans, you never listen! I said... Get. It. Yourself.
Recipe For Disaster#067.dst: 빌어먹을 인간들, 도통 말을 안 들어! 말했잖나... 직. 접. 구. 해.
Recipe For Disaster#067.speaker: Astralus

Recipe For Disaster#068.src: What takes you here, strangeling? What namings do you have? Hu-man? We claim Humyn! Bad choose, pick elsewhere strangeling!
Recipe For Disaster#068.dst: 여기 왜 오심, 낯선이? 무슨 이름함 가짐? 휴-먼? 우리는 휴민 주장함! 나쁜 고름, 딴 데서 골라, 낯선이!
Recipe For Disaster#068.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#069.src: Investigating for helping? How many conveniences! Humyns requires assistancing! You observers, humyns failflies into large crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#069.dst: 도움 위해 조사함? 얼마나 많은 편리함! 휴민 도움함 필요함! 너 관찰자, 휴민 큰 구덩이바위로 추락실패함!
Recipe For Disaster#069.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#070.src: Burnmilk run out and one direction to retrieve it is moonsalt! We strike lucknugget and discover moonsalt on crater-rock!
Recipe For Disaster#070.dst: 불우유 떨어짐, 되찾는 한 방향은 moonsalt! 우리 행운덩이 쳐서 구덩이바위에서 moonsalt 발견함!
Recipe For Disaster#070.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#071.src: Refined moonsalt gives burnmilk for spacezoom! Inconveniencing, spacezoom destroyed. Humyns create miniscule Spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#071.dst: 정제 moonsalt는 우주쓩에 불우유 줌! 불편하게도, 우주쓩 부서짐. 휴민 아주작은 우주쓩 만듦!
Recipe For Disaster#071.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#072.src: Only singular humyn can fit in current spacezoom. If strangeling helps humyns will let strangeling in spacezoom. Humyns can create new spacezoom in given time!
Recipe For Disaster#072.dst: 지금 우주쓩엔 단수 휴민만 들어감. 낯선이 도우면 휴민이 낯선이 우주쓩에 태워 줌. 휴민 주어진 시간에 새 우주쓩 만들 수 있음!
Recipe For Disaster#072.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#073.src: Humyns currently residing on crater-rock, meaning waiting is not result of death!
Recipe For Disaster#073.dst: 휴민 현재 구덩이바위 거주함, 기다림은 죽음의 결과 아님 뜻함!
Recipe For Disaster#073.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#074.src: Moonsalt discovered in saltcave in north, strangeling follow path!
Recipe For Disaster#074.dst: Moonsalt 북쪽 소금동굴에서 발견함, 낯선이 길 따라감!
Recipe For Disaster#074.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#075.src: Just [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt] need for burnmilk, strangeling can grab any left over!
Recipe For Disaster#075.dst: 불우유엔 [{~} Unrefined Moonsalt]만 필요함, 남은 건 낯선이 가져가도 됨!
Recipe For Disaster#075.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#076.src: When strangeling has moonsalt, refine at device beside humyn and go zoom in spacezoom!
Recipe For Disaster#076.dst: 낯선이 moonsalt 가지면, 휴민 옆 장치에서 정제하고 우주쓩 타고 쓩 감!
Recipe For Disaster#076.speaker: Regular Humyn

Recipe For Disaster#077.src: Hello aaand welcome to the Racetrack of the Century!
Recipe For Disaster#077.dst: 안녕하세요오오, 세기의 경주장에 오신 걸 환영합니다!
Recipe For Disaster#077.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#078.src: One winner, one loser. And Usnail Bolt eats losers for breakfast.
Recipe For Disaster#078.dst: 승자 하나, 패자 하나. 그리고 Usnail Bolt는 패자를 아침으로 먹죠.
Recipe For Disaster#078.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#079.src: Breakfast? Wait, did I have breakfast? A little breckkie could be good fo-
Recipe For Disaster#079.dst: 아침? 잠깐, 나 아침 먹었나? 간단히 아침 좀 먹으면 좋을 텐-
Recipe For Disaster#079.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#080.src: Well, no matter. What do you say, adventurer? Enter the race against Usnail Bolt. The grand prize is some Snail Slime!
Recipe For Disaster#080.dst: 뭐, 상관없죠. 어때요, 모험가님? Usnail Bolt와 경주해 보세요. 1등 상품은 Snail Slime이에요!
Recipe For Disaster#080.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#082.src: Shame, could've been a great race. See you around, adventurer!
Recipe For Disaster#082.dst: 아쉽네요, 멋진 경주가 될 수 있었는데. 또 봐요, 모험가님!
Recipe For Disaster#082.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#083.src: Well well well... looks like Usnail Bolt has won this one. Again.
Recipe For Disaster#083.dst: 이런 이런 이런... Usnail Bolt가 이겼군요. 또요.
Recipe For Disaster#083.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#084.src: Not your lucky day, human. Oh well, you know the price for losing. Guards!
Recipe For Disaster#084.dst: 운이 없는 날이네요, 인간. 뭐, 지면 어떻게 되는지 알죠. 경비병!
Recipe For Disaster#084.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#085.src: Wowee! In what turned out to be an amazing race, the human has managed to steal the lead right out from Usnail Bolt's nose!
Recipe For Disaster#085.dst: 와우! 놀라운 경주 끝에, 인간이 Usnail Bolt의 코앞에서 선두를 가로챘습니다!
Recipe For Disaster#085.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#086.src: Here, human. Take this slime as your prize.
Recipe For Disaster#086.dst: 자, 인간. 상품으로 이 점액을 받아요.
Recipe For Disaster#086.speaker: Snail Race Supervisor

Recipe For Disaster#087.src: ISN'T THIS JUST ABSOLUTELY FANTASTIC. A HUMAN?! WHO WOULD HAVE GUESSED.
Recipe For Disaster#087.dst: 이거 정말 끝내주게 환상적이네. 인간?! 누가 알았겠어.
Recipe For Disaster#087.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#088.src: YOU'RE THE SEVENTH ONE PASSING ME TODAY AND YOU'RE NO DIFFERENT FROM THE OTHERS.
Recipe For Disaster#088.dst: 오늘 날 지나간 게 네가 일곱 번째인데, 다른 놈들이랑 다를 게 하나도 없네.
Recipe For Disaster#088.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#089.src: EVERY SINGLE ONE WITH THAT DOPEY SHEEPISH LOOK ON THEIR FACE, AS IF A TALKING MUSHROOM IS OUT OF THE BLUE.
Recipe For Disaster#089.dst: 하나같이 멍청하고 머쓱한 얼굴로, 말하는 버섯이 무슨 날벼락이라도 되는 것처럼 쳐다보지.
Recipe For Disaster#089.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#090.src: GIVE ME A BREAK, I'VE HAD ENOUGH OF JERKS PICKING ME UP AND DISRESPECTING ME LIKE THAT. PRIVATE SPACE, EVER HEARD OF IT?
Recipe For Disaster#090.dst: 좀 봐줘, 날 뽑아 들고 그렇게 무시하는 녀석들한테 질렸어. 사생활이라고, 들어는 봤어?
Recipe For Disaster#090.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#091.src: WHY DO I EVEN TRY. JUST LOOK AT YOU! THE EPITOME OF CLUELESS. WHAT NOW, GONNA TAKE ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS?
Recipe For Disaster#091.dst: 내가 뭘 기대하겠어. 너 좀 봐! 눈치 없음의 결정체네. 이번엔 뭐, 하늘 섬들을 누비는 황당한 모험에라도 끌고 가게?
Recipe For Disaster#091.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#092.src: I HOPE NOT, IF YOU WERE THINKING THAT. I'VE ALREADY LOST A STEM TODAY BECAUSE SOME DIMWIT TRIED TAKING A BITE OUT OF ME... LIVE!
Recipe For Disaster#092.dst: 그 생각이었다면 제발 아니길. 오늘 어떤 멍청이가 날 한입 베어 물려고 해서 줄기를 벌써 하나 잃었거든... 산 채로!
Recipe For Disaster#092.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#093.src: DON'T TELL ME, ARE YOU TAKING ME ON SOME LOONEY ADVENTURE ACROSS THE SKY ISLANDS? HOW LOVELY.
Recipe For Disaster#093.dst: 설마, 날 하늘 섬들을 누비는 황당한 모험에 끌고 가는 거야? 참 좋기도 하겠다.
Recipe For Disaster#093.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#094.src: A KITCHEN YOU SAY, WELL, IF IT'LL PUT ME OUT OF MY MISERY AS SOON AS POSSIBLE, THEN WHY NOT.
Recipe For Disaster#094.dst: 주방이라고, 뭐, 이 비참함을 빨리 끝내 준다면야, 안 될 거 없지.
Recipe For Disaster#094.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#095.src: WAIT, WHY ARE YOU STUFFING ME INTO YOUR BAG? HOW DO YOU EXPECT ME TO BREATHE IN HERE?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.dst: 잠깐, 왜 날 가방에 쑤셔 넣는 건데? 이 안에서 숨을 어떻게 쉬라고?!
Recipe For Disaster#095.speaker: Talking Mushroom

Recipe For Disaster#096.src: Hello there! I can see you knead you some sunrise flour, don't you?
Recipe For Disaster#096.dst: 안녕하세요! 해돋이 밀가루가 필요하시군요, 척 보면 빵 알죠!
Recipe For Disaster#096.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#097.src: It's needed rye away? Well no worries, friend!
Recipe For Disaster#097.dst: 빵리 필요하다고요? 걱정 마세요, 친구! 제가 반죽해 드리죠!
Recipe For Disaster#097.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#098.src: Well butter me up and call me toast, it seems I ran out of the stuff, there's none left.
Recipe For Disaster#098.dst: 이런, 빵 터질 노릇이네, 밀가루가 다 떨어져서 하나도 없어요.
Recipe For Disaster#098.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#099.src: I'm sorry if I see to just be loafing around, but at yeast I know how to make some more.
Recipe For Disaster#099.dst: 빈둥빵둥 노는 것처럼 보였다면 미안해요, 그래도 더 만드는 법은 제가 알죠.
Recipe For Disaster#099.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#100.src: Can you see that wheat field over there, next to the bakery? You can farm up some wheat and pop it on the mill.
Recipe For Disaster#100.dst: 빵집 옆에 저 밀밭 보이죠? 거기서 밀을 수확해서 방앗간에 넣으면 돼요.
Recipe For Disaster#100.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#101.src: Grab a scythe from the tool merchant next dough and get to work!
Recipe For Disaster#101.dst: 빵집 옆집 도구 상인에게 낫을 받아서 일을 시작하세요!
Recipe For Disaster#101.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#102.src: Make as much as you want, I've made all the bread I need for today already.
Recipe For Disaster#102.dst: 원하는 만큼 만드세요, 오늘 필요한 빵은 벌써 다 구웠거든요.
Recipe For Disaster#102.speaker: Baker

Recipe For Disaster#103.src: Howdy, pal! Looking for some Skyhigh Raspberries? They work great in a pie!
Recipe For Disaster#103.dst: 안녕, 친구! Skyhigh Raspberry 찾아요? 파이에 넣으면 최고예요!
Recipe For Disaster#103.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#104.src: If you're interested, it's just a small fee of {~} Emeralds to get access to the island.
Recipe For Disaster#104.dst: 관심 있으면, 섬에 들어가는 데 {~} 에메랄드만 내면 돼요.
Recipe For Disaster#104.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#105.src: A man's gotta make a living somehow, so I've set up a system of cannons to take you right up to the island they grow on!
Recipe For Disaster#105.dst: 먹고살아야 하니까, 산딸기가 자라는 섬까지 바로 보내 주는 대포 시스템을 만들었죠!
Recipe For Disaster#105.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#106.src: So, whaddya say? Small price for a little adventure, and as many raspberries as you can eat!
Recipe For Disaster#106.dst: 그래서, 어때요? 작은 모험에 소소한 값, 산딸기는 먹고 싶은 만큼!
Recipe For Disaster#106.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#107.src: Alrighty! Just head on over to that island beside me and jump in the cannon - it's perfectly safe, I promise!
Recipe For Disaster#107.dst: 좋아요! 제 옆 섬으로 가서 대포에 뛰어드세요 - 완전 안전해요, 약속해요!
Recipe For Disaster#107.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#108.src: Find your way up the island and grab as many raspberries as you want! When you're done just jump in the big cannon and come back to shore!
Recipe For Disaster#108.dst: 섬 위로 올라가서 산딸기를 원하는 만큼 따세요! 다 따면 큰 대포에 뛰어들어 해안으로 돌아오면 돼요!
Recipe For Disaster#108.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#109.src: Alrighty, no worries. Feel free to come back if you're ever in the mood for some!
Recipe For Disaster#109.dst: 좋아요, 괜찮아요. 먹고 싶어지면 언제든 다시 와요!
Recipe For Disaster#109.speaker: Raspberry Vendor

Recipe For Disaster#110.src: Present the ingredients to your chosen chef.

Recipe For Disaster#111.src: Have you got all the ingredients? Amazing!
Recipe For Disaster#111.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#112.src: Okay you set back and let me work on the cooking, just pass over the ingredients!
Recipe For Disaster#112.dst: 좋아요, 뒤로 물러서서 요리는 저한테 맡기세요, 재료만 넘겨주면 돼요!
Recipe For Disaster#112.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#113.src: Aha! That should do it! Hopefully I've done everything correctly... but wow, would you look at the color of that soup!
Recipe For Disaster#113.dst: 아하! 이러면 됐어요! 다 제대로 했으면 좋겠는데... 그런데 와, 이 수프 색깔 좀 봐요!
Recipe For Disaster#113.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#114.src: You should bring it over to Hamsey to see what he thinks!
Recipe For Disaster#114.dst: 이거 Hamsey한테 가져가서 어떻게 생각하는지 들어 봐요!
Recipe For Disaster#114.speaker: Brie

Recipe For Disaster#115.src: You got everything? Took you long enough.
Recipe For Disaster#115.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#116.src: Let's get started. Everyone else already finished. Stay back while I work my magic.
Recipe For Disaster#116.dst: 시작하자. 다른 사람들은 벌써 끝냈어. 내가 솜씨 부리는 동안 물러나 있어.
Recipe For Disaster#116.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#117.src: Mwah! My masterdish is finished. Present this to the chef, I'm sure he'll love it!
Recipe For Disaster#117.dst: 쪽! 내 걸작 요리 완성이다. 이거 셰프한테 가져가, 분명 좋아할 거야!
Recipe For Disaster#117.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#118.src: And be CAREFUL taking it over. That food could be worth HUNDREDS once I'm famous!
Recipe For Disaster#118.dst: 그리고 '조심해서' 가져가. 내가 유명해지면 이 요리는 '수백'은 나갈 거라고!
Recipe For Disaster#118.speaker: Kale

Recipe For Disaster#119.src: You got everything? Awesome stuff, dude.
Recipe For Disaster#119.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#120.src: I'll just take a smallll bit of this raspberry - chef's commission, eh? And let's get started!
Recipe For Disaster#120.dst: 이 산딸기 조오금만 먹을게 - 요리사 수수료 알지? 그럼 시작하자!
Recipe For Disaster#120.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#121.src: And we're all done. Hamsey's gonna love this.
Recipe For Disaster#121.dst: 다 됐다. Hamsey가 엄청 좋아할 거야.
Recipe For Disaster#121.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#122.src: Here you go, dawg. Pleasure working with you - show this to Hamsey and we'll see what he thinks. Make sure you don't "lose" any of it on the way over - you know what they say about your own supply!
Recipe For Disaster#122.dst: 여기 있어, 친구. 같이 해서 즐거웠어 - Hamsey한테 보여 주고 뭐라는지 보자. 가는 길에 조금이라도 "잃어버리면" 안 된다 - 자기 물건 손대면 어떻게 되는지 알지!
Recipe For Disaster#122.speaker: Frank

Recipe For Disaster#123.src: Talk to Hamsey with your finished dish.

Recipe For Disaster#124.src: Ah, you have finished your dish? Well, then, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.dst: Ah, 요리를 완성했나요? 그럼, il est temps de goûter!
Recipe For Disaster#124.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#125.src: Let us retreat to my private dining room... this way!
Recipe For Disaster#125.dst: 제 전용 식당으로 자리를 옮기죠... 이쪽이에요!
Recipe For Disaster#125.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#126.src: Meet Hamsey in the dining room at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recipe For Disaster#127.src: Welcome back, mon ami! I see you've return with a dish in hand!
Recipe For Disaster#127.dst: 어서 와요, mon ami! 요리를 들고 돌아왔군요!
Recipe For Disaster#127.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#128.src: A stew? Seems simple, but even the simplest things in life can be le meilleur!
Recipe For Disaster#128.dst: 스튜? 단순해 보이지만, 인생에서 가장 단순한 것도 le meilleur일 수 있죠!
Recipe For Disaster#128.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#129.src: Adventurer, are you sure you made this dish? It is so good I might as well close the restaurant!
Recipe For Disaster#129.dst: 모험가님, 정말 이걸 직접 만들었어요? 너무 맛있어서 레스토랑 문을 닫아야겠어요!
Recipe For Disaster#129.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#130.src: You never fail to surprise me, friend. Here, take this apron, an essential of any true chef.
Recipe For Disaster#130.dst: 늘 저를 놀라게 하는군요, 친구. 자, 이 앞치마를 받아요, 진정한 요리사의 필수품이죠.
Recipe For Disaster#130.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#131.src: I cannot help but notice that your dish is ready!
Recipe For Disaster#131.dst: 요리가 준비된 게 눈에 띄지 않을 수가 없군요!
Recipe For Disaster#131.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#132.src: Let me taste your dish and I will present you mine! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.dst: 당신 요리를 맛보고 제 요리를 보여 드리죠! Mon dieu, une omelette?
Recipe For Disaster#132.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#133.src: Je suis déçu, ami. I would prefer biting into a mule derrière! This thing... a Gert wouldn't touch it!
Recipe For Disaster#133.dst: Je suis déçu, ami. 차라리 노새 derrière를 깨물겠어요! 이건... Gert도 안 먹겠어요!
Recipe For Disaster#133.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#134.src: I see you haven't improved in the art of cuisine. Leave me be, and come back when you have learned what good food is!
Recipe For Disaster#134.dst: 요리 실력은 전혀 늘지 않았군요. 날 내버려 두고, 좋은 음식이 뭔지 알게 되면 돌아와요!
Recipe For Disaster#134.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#135.src: I see you've returned, and not empty handed. Please, show me what you've created!
Recipe For Disaster#135.dst: 돌아왔군요, 빈손도 아니고요. 자, 무엇을 만들었는지 보여 줘요!
Recipe For Disaster#135.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#136.src: A pie? Why, you must have been helped by Frank. He always has a thing for making pie!
Recipe For Disaster#136.dst: 파이? 이런, Frank가 도와줬군요. 그 친구는 파이 만드는 걸 좋아하거든요!
Recipe For Disaster#136.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#137.src: I can see that your compétences culinaires are very well developed!
Recipe For Disaster#137.dst: 당신의 compétences culinaires가 아주 잘 발달했군요!
Recipe For Disaster#137.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Recipe For Disaster#138.src: Though I will not truly call you a chef quite yet, you are très bien! Have this reward as congratulations!
Recipe For Disaster#138.dst: 아직 진정한 요리사라고 부를 순 없지만, 당신은 très bien! 축하의 의미로 이 보상을 받아요!
Recipe For Disaster#138.speaker: Chef Hamsey

Reclaiming the House#000.src: I need more firepower if I'm going...to get...

Reclaiming the House#001.src: Anyway, it's clear that I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.

Reclaiming the House#002.src: Wh- I'm shocked! In the middle there- they just caged the soldiers instead of killing them? That's...kind of a relief.
Reclaiming the House#002.dst: 뭐- 놀랍네! 저 가운데- 병사들을 죽이지 않고 가둬 두기만 했어? 그건... 좀 다행이네.

Reclaiming the House#003.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza there for us to take down on our own...

Reclaiming the House#004.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may not be an option...

Reclaiming the House#006.src: Oh, orc from mud bath. In, now!

Reclaiming the House#007.src: No enter for humans! This place belong to orcs!

Reclaiming the House#009.src: Ah... Took mud bath. Orc enter, quick!

Reclaiming the House#011.src: The Gavellian Army's sending reinforcements to our outpost, finally. Everything was getting too much to handle on our end.

Reclaiming the House#012.src: You Wynnic folks are way better suited than us for guard duty. Why don't you take over for me, huh?

Reclaiming the House#013.src: Join Elphaba on a mission in the Temporary Camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Reclaiming the House#014.src: Oh, a Wynnic soldier out here in the boondocks? Honestly, you're just what we need- I could use your help, if you're able?
Reclaiming the House#014.dst: 어, 이런 외진 곳에 Wynn 병사가? 솔직히 딱 필요한 사람이야- 괜찮다면 좀 도와줄 수 있어?
Reclaiming the House#014.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#015.src: Good, thank you. Let me lock down the camp before I give you the briefing, though.
Reclaiming the House#015.dst: 좋아, 고마워. 그래도 브리핑 전에 야영지부터 봉쇄할게.
Reclaiming the House#015.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#016.src: My name is Elphaba. I've been working with the Gavellian army for a good few years now.
Reclaiming the House#016.dst: 난 Elphaba야. Gavel 군대에서 일한 지 벌써 몇 년 됐어.
Reclaiming the House#016.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#017.src: I'm the commander of the {p} Outpost down ahead. It's a strategic fortress, placed to monitor the Orcish capital.
Reclaiming the House#017.dst: 저 앞 {p} 전초기지의 지휘관이야. 오크 수도를 감시하려고 세운 전략 요새지.
Reclaiming the House#017.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#018.src: It was safe for a long while, but especially in the past while the Orcs have gotten far bolder, more aggressive.
Reclaiming the House#018.dst: 오랫동안 안전했는데, 특히 요즘 들어 오크들이 훨씬 대담하고 공격적으로 변했어.
Reclaiming the House#018.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#019.src: They overwhelmed the outpost- we had to retreat and set up this camp to watch over the place we used to watch over them with!
Reclaiming the House#019.dst: 놈들이 전초기지를 휩쓸었어- 우린 후퇴해서, 놈들을 감시하던 그곳을 감시하려고 이 야영지를 세워야 했지!
Reclaiming the House#019.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#021.src: ...oh no. See, this is what I mean! The orcs are coming!
Reclaiming the House#021.dst: ...이런. 봐, 내 말이 이거야! 오크들이 온다!
Reclaiming the House#021.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#022.src: Brace yourself, soldier! Protect the camp!
Reclaiming the House#022.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#023.src: Kill the mobs raiding the Camp.

Reclaiming the House#024.src: This is the third attack in three days! How many reinforcements have they got?!
Reclaiming the House#024.dst: 사흘 동안 벌써 세 번째 공격이야! 증원이 대체 얼마나 되는 거야?!
Reclaiming the House#024.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#025.src: Gah! Their casters are strong, careful!
Reclaiming the House#025.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#026.src: Talk to Elphaba for information on the upcoming attack.
Reclaiming the House#026.dst: Elphaba와 대화해 다가올 공격에 대한 정보를 들으세요.

Reclaiming the House#027.src: Ugh, I think that was all of them... Come here now, I'll start up where we left off.
Reclaiming the House#027.dst: 으, 이제 다 처리한 것 같아... 이리 와, 아까 하던 얘기 계속할게.
Reclaiming the House#027.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#028.src: Not sure I could have done that myself. I'm lucky you came around when you did, soldier.
Reclaiming the House#028.dst: 나 혼자선 못 막았을 거야. 딱 그때 네가 와 줘서 다행이야, 병사.
Reclaiming the House#028.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#029.src: Anyway, it's clear I'm going to need more firepower if I'm going to have a shot at reclaiming that outpost.
Reclaiming the House#029.dst: 어쨌든, 저 전초기지를 되찾을 가망이라도 있으려면 화력이 더 필요한 게 분명해.
Reclaiming the House#029.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#030.src: You've certainly got the fighting chops, so I'd appreciate the aid, but we've got to come up with a plan, fast.
Reclaiming the House#030.dst: 싸움 실력은 확실하니 도와주면 고맙겠지만, 빨리 계획을 세워야 해.
Reclaiming the House#030.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#031.src: There's an old tower near the outpost- some old storage silo. It was built taller than the fort, so we might be able to spy on them from there.
Reclaiming the House#031.dst: 전초기지 근처에 오래된 탑이 있어- 낡은 저장고 탑이지. 요새보다 높게 지어져서 거기서 정찰할 수 있을지도 몰라.
Reclaiming the House#031.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#032.src: It's a risk though, since it's so close by, but we have no other options. Meet me at the tower southeast of here so we can survey the situation.
Reclaiming the House#032.dst: 워낙 가까워서 위험하긴 하지만, 다른 방법이 없어. 여기서 남동쪽에 있는 탑에서 만나서 상황을 살펴보자.
Reclaiming the House#032.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#033.src: Go to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#034.src: Soldier! I'm right behind you. You can see our outpost- and the tower I mentioned.
Reclaiming the House#034.dst: 병사! 바로 뒤에 있어. 우리 전초기지랑- 내가 말한 탑이 보이지.
Reclaiming the House#034.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#035.src: We need to find a way in. A lot of soldiers were caught unaware during the Orcs' assault, too.
Reclaiming the House#035.dst: 들어갈 방법을 찾아야 해. 오크들이 습격했을 때 방심하던 병사도 많았어.
Reclaiming the House#035.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#036.src: If there's any survivors in there, we should make rescuing them a priority.
Reclaiming the House#036.dst: 안에 생존자가 있다면 구출하는 걸 최우선으로 해야 해.
Reclaiming the House#036.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#037.src: After all, it means more manpower for us. We can't count on that being the case, though...
Reclaiming the House#037.dst: 결국 그만큼 우리 병력이 늘어나는 거니까. 그렇다고 기대할 수는 없지만...
Reclaiming the House#037.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#038.src: Come on, hurry inside before one of the orcs spots us!
Reclaiming the House#038.dst: 자, 오크한테 들키기 전에 서둘러 안으로 들어가!
Reclaiming the House#038.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#039.src: Enter to the watch tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to plan the attack.

Reclaiming the House#040.src: Alright, this is a pretty clear view. Let's see what's going on in there...
Reclaiming the House#040.dst: 좋아, 시야가 탁 트였네. 안에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 보자...
Reclaiming the House#040.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#042.src: There's definitely too many orcs in the plaza for us to take down on our own...
Reclaiming the House#042.dst: 광장에 오크가 너무 많아서 우리끼리는 절대 못 쓰러뜨려...
Reclaiming the House#042.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#043.src: ...but that cage is held up by those ropes. If we can cut them, the other soldiers should be able to help!
Reclaiming the House#043.dst: ...그런데 저 우리는 밧줄로 매달려 있어. 밧줄을 끊으면 다른 병사들이 도와줄 수 있을 거야!
Reclaiming the House#043.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#044.src: Alright, now I just need to figure out how we can both get in... There's sentries on the perimeter, so going over may no be an option...
Reclaiming the House#044.dst: 좋아, 이제 둘 다 들어갈 방법만 찾으면 돼... 외곽에 보초가 있으니, 넘어가는 건 안 될 것 같고...
Reclaiming the House#044.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#045.src: Maybe we can keep an eye out on their sentry patterns and look for an opening-
Reclaiming the House#045.dst: 보초들 움직임을 지켜보면서 빈틈을 찾을 수 있을지도-
Reclaiming the House#045.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#046.src: Humans on old tower! Junhur will shoot! This our place now, get out!!
Reclaiming the House#046.dst: 오래된 탑에 인간! Junhur 쏜다! 여기 이제 우리 땅, 나가!!
Reclaiming the House#046.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#047.src: Aw, not now! I knew this was a risk, no time to get out... Brace for impact!!
Reclaiming the House#047.dst: 아, 하필 지금! 위험할 줄 알았는데, 나갈 시간이 없어... 충격 대비해!!
Reclaiming the House#047.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#048.src: Old tower fall! Junhur is best cannon shooter!!
Reclaiming the House#048.dst: 오래된 탑 무너짐! Junhur 최고의 대포 사수!!
Reclaiming the House#048.speaker: Orc

Reclaiming the House#049.src: Agh, soldier!! Are you alright, where'd you fall?!
Reclaiming the House#049.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#050.src: Ah... Wow. You barely look scratched, you must've gotten really lucky.
Reclaiming the House#050.dst: 아... 와. 긁힌 데도 거의 없네, 운이 엄청 좋았나 봐.
Reclaiming the House#050.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#051.src: Not so much here... I'm pretty battered after that. At least one of us is in good condition...
Reclaiming the House#051.dst: 난 그렇지 못했어... 아까 그걸로 꽤 다쳤어. 한 명이라도 멀쩡해서 다행이지...
Reclaiming the House#051.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#052.src: Unfortunately, that means figuring a way in is up to you. We can't examine their sentry patterns from down here.
Reclaiming the House#052.dst: 안타깝게도, 들어갈 방법은 네가 찾아야 해. 여기 아래선 보초 움직임을 살필 수가 없어.
Reclaiming the House#052.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#053.src: I'll survive, sure, but I won't be able to walk around and defend myself for a while.
Reclaiming the House#053.dst: 죽진 않겠지만, 한동안은 걸어 다니거나 내 몸 하나 지키기도 힘들 거야.
Reclaiming the House#053.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#054.src: I hate leaving you on your own like this, but if it's any consolation, you should be tough enough, or lucky enough, to get through.
Reclaiming the House#054.dst: 이렇게 혼자 보내긴 싫지만, 위안이 될지 모르겠네. 넌 충분히 강하거나, 충분히 운이 좋으니 해낼 거야.
Reclaiming the House#054.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#055.src: Explore the perimeter of the outpost. Try to find a way in, but be careful, okay?
Reclaiming the House#055.dst: 전초기지 외곽을 살펴봐. 들어갈 길을 찾아 봐, 하지만 조심해, 알았지?
Reclaiming the House#055.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#056.src: Explore the outpost's surroundings to find another way in.
Reclaiming the House#056.dst: 전초기지 주변을 탐색해 다른 진입로를 찾으세요.

Reclaiming the House#057.src: Follow the trail of mud left by the orc. It leads to the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Reclaiming the House#057.dst: 오크가 남긴 진흙 자국을 따라가세요. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴로 이어집니다

Reclaiming the House#058.src: Enter the outpost while covered in mud.

Reclaiming the House#060.src: Cut the ropes to free the guards from the cage.
Reclaiming the House#060.dst: 밧줄을 끊어 우리에서 경비병들을 풀어 주세요.

Reclaiming the House#062.src: Good thinking with the mud disguise, soldier! They never suspected a thing, now come help us out over here!
Reclaiming the House#062.dst: 진흙 변장이라니 머리 잘 썼어, 병사! 놈들은 전혀 눈치 못 챘어, 이제 이쪽 좀 도와줘!
Reclaiming the House#062.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#063.src: Kill the Orcish Overtakers, we'll help keep the other ones off you!
Reclaiming the House#063.dst: Orcish Overtaker를 처치해, 다른 놈들은 우리가 막아 줄게!
Reclaiming the House#063.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#064.src: Open the gate with a spell

Reclaiming the House#065.src: The Overtakers are down, the other Orcs are flailing! Open the outpost's entrance with a spell now, we've got this under control!
Reclaiming the House#065.dst: Overtaker들이 쓰러졌고 다른 오크들은 우왕좌왕해! 이제 주문으로 전초기지 입구를 열어, 여긴 우리가 맡을게!
Reclaiming the House#065.speaker: Soldier

Reclaiming the House#067.src: Phew... That's some fine work there, soldier! The outpost is back under our control!
Reclaiming the House#067.dst: 휴... 훌륭한 솜씨였어, 병사! 전초기지를 되찾았어!
Reclaiming the House#067.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#068.src: Glad to see some more capable Wynnic hands over here. Though, I didn't catch your name. Would you mind?
Reclaiming the House#068.dst: 여기 유능한 Wynn 사람이 더 와서 다행이야. 그런데 이름을 못 들었네. 알려 줄래?
Reclaiming the House#068.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#069.src: {u}, huh? I'll remember that. You barely even needed my help, heh... Wish I hadn't been such a burden, but at least it worked out.
Reclaiming the House#069.dst: {u}, 그렇구나? 기억해 둘게. 내 도움은 거의 필요 없었네, 헤... 짐만 된 것 같아 아쉽지만, 어쨌든 잘 풀렸어.
Reclaiming the House#069.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#070.src: Here- it's some of my own personal spending money, as a thank-you gift.
Reclaiming the House#070.dst: 여기- 내 개인 용돈 좀 떼어 온 거야, 감사의 선물로.
Reclaiming the House#070.speaker: Elphaba

Reclaiming the House#071.src: Alright everyone, let's get this place ship-shape! Everything needs to be repaired in case of another attack!!
Reclaiming the House#071.dst: 자 모두, 여기를 말끔히 정비하자! 또 공격받을 때를 대비해서 전부 수리해야 해!!
Reclaiming the House#071.speaker: Elphaba

Recover the Past#000.src: Thanks again for your help. Now we can truly say creepers exist here in the ravines.
Recover the Past#000.dst: 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워. 이제야 이 협곡에 정말 크리퍼가 있다고 말할 수 있겠어.

Recover the Past#001.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the- you get the point.
Recover the Past#001.dst: 하지만 이 장치만 있으면... 그걸 바꿀 수 있어! 잃어버린 걸 되찾는 거지! 과거를 되찾- 무슨 말인지 알겠지.

Recover the Past#002.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need more to be certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#002.dst: 자, 난 피험자가 몹시 필요해... 너도 괜찮겠지만, 이게 제대로 작동하는지 확실히 하려면 더 있어야 해.

Recover the Past#003.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still here? Get going!
Recover the Past#003.dst: 그동안 난 여기서 조정을 하고 있겠어... 아직 완벽하진 않거든. 내 기억도 아직 많이 비어 있고... 음? 아직 여기 있어? 어서 가!

Recover the Past#004.src: Huh? Oh! I- ah, nothing to see here! Just... just having a look at my ship! That's all.
Recover the Past#004.dst: 응? 앗! 나- 어, 볼 거 없어! 그냥... 그냥 내 배 좀 보고 있었어! 그게 다야.

Recover the Past#005.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in that tower of his? Huh, good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#005.dst: Picard가 보냈다고? 자기 탑에 틀어박힌 그 양반? 흠, 드디어 연구를 끝냈나 보네. 근데 나한테 뭘 원하는 거지?

Recover the Past#006.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. And I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about-...
Recover the Past#006.dst: ... Fruma 시절 기억을 보자고? 글쎄, 잘 모르겠는데. 기억이 없으면 없는 이유가 있겠지. 그리고 난, 난 여기서 행복해! 알 필요 없다고-...

Recover the Past#007.src: Get me the part from that blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#007.dst: 그 대장간에서 부품 가져다주면 Picard의 탑까지 같이 갈게. 내 새끼를 이렇게 미완성으로 두고 갈 순 없잖아?

Recover the Past#008.src: Move the box out of the door to complete the puzzle!
Recover the Past#008.dst: 상자를 문 앞에서 치워 퍼즐을 완성하세요!

Recover the Past#010.src: You take a package out of the wreckage.

Recover the Past#011.src: You should return to Caid with the package before the blacksmith notices...
Recover the Past#011.dst: 대장장이가 눈치채기 전에 소포를 가지고 Caid에게 돌아가야겠다...

Recover the Past#013.src: Sure thing. Say- Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#013.dst: 그래. 근데- Caid. 이런 건 어떻게 계속 구하는 거야? 비싼 부품이 들어 있는데, 네 형편에 살 만한 물건은 아니잖아.

Recover the Past#014.src: Wait- what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't-
Recover the Past#014.dst: 잠깐- 뭐라고? Caid, 경비대 물건 훔친 거 아니라고 해 줘. 걔들이 가만있지 않을-

Recover the Past#015.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and to decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#015.dst: 추가 심문을 위해 감옥으로 데려가고, 처분을 결정하도록 해라.

Recover the Past#016.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there... I wonder what we'd see if we could-
Recover the Past#016.dst: 흠. 흠 흠 흠. 기억이 거기서 끊겼군... 더 볼 수 있다면 뭐가 보일지-

Recover the Past#017.src: Yes, so it would appear! But surely there's more beyond this point... perhaps, if I-
Recover the Past#017.dst: 그래, 그런 것 같군! 하지만 분명 이 너머에 더 있을 거야... 어쩌면, 내가-

Recover the Past#018.src: But that's of no importance now. What is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will revolutionize the world!
Recover the Past#018.dst: 하지만 그건 이제 중요하지 않아. 중요한 건 우리가 방금 본 거지! 생생하게 되살아난 기억! 이 장치는 정말 세상에 혁명을 일으킬 거야!

Recover the Past#019.src: I saw him heading into the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#019.dst: 얼마 전에 신전 쪽으로 가는 걸 봤어. 마음을 고쳐먹었을지도 모르지. Caid에게 앞장서, 바로 뒤따라갈게.

Recover the Past#020.src: I wouldn't dream of doing anything else!

Recover the Past#021.src: But- consider, Reynauld. Maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#021.dst: 그래도- 생각해 봐, Reynauld. 과거가 잊힌 데엔 이유가 있을지도 몰라.

Recover the Past#023.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's-... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#023.dst: 근처 공장 중 한 곳에서... 어, 부품을 좀 건져 왔어. 이게-... 아마 네가 필요한 걸 거야.

Recover the Past#024.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... I took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#024.dst: 아, 안 들켰어. 나, 어... 조심했어. 밤에 들어갔거든. 알지?

Recover the Past#025.src: I- hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#025.dst: 나- 흥. 알았어, 알았어, 좋아, 에- 에메랄드도 좀 얹을게. 거래 조건 좀 좋게.

Recover the Past#027.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your secrets.
Recover the Past#027.dst: 자네 공범인 공급책이 며칠 전에 잡혔네. 듣자 하니 자네 비밀을 털어놓기까지 고민도 거의 안 했다더군.

Recover the Past#028.src: Assistant! Assistant! Snap out of it!

Recover the Past#029.src: {u}!? What're you doing... here...? No, actually, better question- what is happening up here?
Recover the Past#029.dst: {u}!? 여기서 뭐 하는... 거야...? 아니, 더 중요한 건- 여기 위에서 대체 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는 거야?

Recover the Past#031.src: Science! Highly experimental and important science! That is what is taking place up here- and who are you, interrupting-
Recover the Past#031.dst: 과학이다! 고도로 실험적이고 중요한 과학! 여기 위에서 벌어지는 건 바로 그거야- 그런데 넌 누구길래, 감히 끼어들어-

Recover the Past#032.src: Doctor. Stop. Talking. Tasim, why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#032.dst: 박사. 입. 다물어. Tasim, 여긴 왜 왔어? Caid는 어디 있지?

Recover the Past#033.src: Right... the Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defences. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#033.dst: 맞다... 제독님이 {p}의 방어를 강화하라고 보내셨어. 다리에서 널 만날 줄 알았는데, Caid밖에 없더라.

Recover the Past#034.src: Urgh... that damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#034.dst: 으윽... 그 빌어먹을 도둑놈! 자리를 비우는 게 아니었는데... 다 실수였어... 젠장.

Recover the Past#035.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go. Tasim, {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#035.dst: 지체할 시간 없어. 가자. Tasim, {u}. {p}을(를) 구해야 해.

Recover the Past#036.src: ...hmph. Rather rude, the both of them. But fine, the circumstances warrant it, I suppose.
Recover the Past#036.dst: ...흥. 둘 다 꽤 무례하군. 하지만 뭐, 상황이 상황이니 이해해 주지.

Recover the Past#037.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. I'll need to think through our next steps...
Recover the Past#037.dst: 그 Tasim이라는 친구, 그도 Fruma 출신이겠지? 네 동료라면 우리 작은 실험에 끌어들여. 난 다음 단계를 곰곰이 생각해 봐야겠군...

Recover the Past#038.src: ... Well? What are you waiting for?! Go on, get out there! {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#038.dst: ... 뭐야? 뭘 기다리는 거야?! 어서, 나가 봐! {p}을(를) 구해야지!

Recover the Past#039.src: I'm trying to think, but... I've never...
Recover the Past#039.dst: 생각 중인데... 이런 건 한 번도...

Recover the Past#040.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming- we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#040.dst: Reynauld, 소용없어! 계속 몰려와- 우리... 뭔가... 다른 걸 해야 해, 안 그러면 못 버텨!

Recover the Past#041.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. The three of us alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#041.dst: 네 말이 맞아. 후퇴해서 {p}에 지원을 요청해야겠어. 우리 셋만으론 이걸 못 이겨!

Recover the Past#042.src: Caid! You made it! That was incredible- you're a hero!

Recover the Past#043.src: That's all well and good, but... what about your boat?

Recover the Past#044.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough... considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case.
Recover the Past#044.dst: 뭐, 상황을 생각하면... Caid는 꽤 괜찮아 보이네. 혹시 모르니 검진받게 데려갈게.

Recover the Past#045.src: Do you remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#045.dst: 기억나? Wynn에 막 들어섰을 때... Aledar도 같이 있었는데, 첫날부터 죽을 뻔했지! 밖에서 좀 더 조심하고 있으면 좋겠다...

Recover the Past#046.src: ... Oh, {u}, you've returned, and with a brand new subject! I take it {p} is now safe and sound? Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb, and-
Recover the Past#046.dst: ... 오, {u}, 돌아왔군, 그것도 새 피험자를 데리고! {p}은(는) 이제 무사한 거겠지? 훌륭해, 훌륭해. 자, 구슬 앞으로 올라와서-

Recover the Past#047.src: Hold on. I didn't get the chance to ask questions, when I walked in on this earlier. How safe is this procedure, exactly? Because from what I saw of Reynauld-
Recover the Past#047.dst: 잠깐만요. 아까 들어왔을 땐 물어볼 기회가 없었는데요. 이 절차, 정확히 얼마나 안전한 거죠? 제가 Reynauld한테서 본 걸로는-

Recover the Past#048.src: Now, now, settle down. Just because I didn't do any proper tests before this doesn't mean it isn't safe! I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#048.dst: 자, 자, 진정해. 전에 제대로 된 시험을 안 했다고 해서 안전하지 않은 건 아니야! 계산은 다 해 봤어! 전부 문제없다고!

Recover the Past#049.dst: 시험을 한 번도 안 해 봤다고요-?!

Recover the Past#050.src: You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?!

Recover the Past#051.src: ... Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but alright.
Recover the Past#051.dst: ... 좋아요. 제 기억을 봐도 돼요. 꼭 동의하는지는 모르겠지만... 알겠어요.

Recover the Past#053.src: My... magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#053.dst: 내... 마법이 버티기 힘들어하지만... 볼 게 더 있는 건 분명해! 출력을 올린다...

Recover the Past#054.src: ... It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#054.dst: ... 옳은 일이었어. 내가 도울 수 있는데 가만히 보고만 있을 순 없었어.

Recover the Past#055.src: You feel a faint tug as something tries to pull you out of the memory.
Recover the Past#055.dst: 무언가가 기억 밖으로 끌어내려는 듯, 희미하게 당기는 힘이 느껴진다.

Recover the Past#056.src: But there's more to see. You can't leave just yet.
Recover the Past#056.dst: 하지만 아직 볼 것이 남아 있다. 아직은 떠날 수 없다.

Recover the Past#057.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to-

Recover the Past#058.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents... would be useful.
Recover the Past#058.dst: 너는 신병이며, 전쟁에서 싸우기 위해 Wynn 지방으로 보내진다. 너는 네 특별한... 재능이... 쓸모 있으리라 여겨 입대했다.

Recover the Past#059.src: Wonderful. Take this one away. It looks like we'll be able to fit two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#059.dst: 좋군. 이자를 데려가라. 오늘 무리에 두 명은 더 태울 수 있겠군.

Recover the Past#060.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! We have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#060.dst: ... 알았어, 알았어. 정보를 더 얻긴 했지. 그래도 다시는 그러지 마! 얘기할 게 많아.

Recover the Past#061.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm-... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#061.dst: ... 흥. 인정하지, 난-... 이 정보를 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어.

Recover the Past#062.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us- what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#062.dst: 그리고 심문관... 뭐라고 생각해야 할지 모르겠어. 우리 모두- Wynn에 왔을 때 안다고 생각했던 것들... 전부 사실이 아니었어.

Recover the Past#063.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you-... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#063.dst: 나- 난 생각할 시간이 좀 필요해. 좀... 되돌아볼 시간. 부탁인데-... 이 얘긴 Aledar한테 하지 말아 줘.

Recover the Past#064.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll even run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#064.dst: 더 강해지면 너도 거기로 가 봐. 어쩌면 언젠가 다시 마주칠지도 모르지.

Recover the Past#065.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever- but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#065.dst: 그럼 당분간은 작별이네. 영원히는 아니고- 당분간만. 또 보자, {u}.

Recover the Past#068.src: Well. Bystander-turned-assis- you know what, I'll just call you my assistant- not quite the response I was looking for... a shame, too- I truly believe we were on to something.
Recover the Past#068.dst: 흠. 구경꾼에서 조수가- 아니, 됐다, 그냥 조수라고 부르지- 내가 기대한 반응은 아니군... 아쉽기도 하고- 정말로 뭔가 알아낼 참이었는데.

Recover the Past#069.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Recover the Past#069.dst: ...그는 모르고 있어. 네가 그 소식을 전해야 해.

Recover the Past#070.src: Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then-
Recover the Past#070.dst: 흥. 힘이 더 필요한 걸지도... 주문에 불어넣을 수 있는 마나의 양을 늘리면, 그러면-

Recover the Past#071.src: In the meantime, with our subject gone, we'll have to make do with another. There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#071.dst: 그동안, 피험자가 떠났으니 다른 사람으로 대신해야겠군. 오늘 정찰병 Reynauld가 근무 중인데, 너처럼 원래 Fruma 출신이야.

Recover the Past#073.src: It's puzzling, to be sure... if only we could see further. I'll get to work immediately- we must know more!
Recover the Past#073.dst: 확실히 수수께끼야... 더 멀리 볼 수만 있다면. 당장 작업에 들어가겠어- 더 알아내야 해!

Recover the Past#074.src: Use your Movement Keys to Preview your move, then press Jump to Confirm.
Recover the Past#074.dst: 이동 키로 움직임을 미리 보고, 점프 키를 눌러 확정하세요.

Recover the Past#076.src: Success! Success, success, SUCCESS! I'm a genius, the smartest man alive!
Recover the Past#076.dst: 성공이다! 성공, 성공, 성공이야! 난 천재야, 살아 있는 사람 중 제일 똑똑해!
Recover the Past#076.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#077.src: You there, random bystander! You have witnessed a magical marvel! I have just successfully restored my memories from years ago!
Recover the Past#077.dst: 거기, 지나가던 구경꾼! 너는 방금 마법의 기적을 목격했어! 방금 수년 전 내 기억을 복원하는 데 성공했거든!
Recover the Past#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#078.src: You look to be from Fruma, yes? So you know just as well as I that your memories of your life before have vanished. Poof. Gone!
Recover the Past#078.dst: 너도 Fruma 출신으로 보이는데, 맞지? 그럼 너도 나만큼 알겠군, 예전 삶의 기억이 사라졌다는 걸. 펑. 없어졌지!
Recover the Past#078.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#079.src: But with this device... we can change that! Restore what has been lost! Recover the you get the point.
Recover the Past#079.dst: 하지만 이 장치만 있으면... 그걸 바꿀 수 있어! 잃어버린 걸 되찾는 거지! 과거를 되찾- 무슨 말인지 알겠지.
Recover the Past#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#080.src: Now, I'm in great need of test subjects... You would do well as one, yes, but I need to be more certain this thing works.
Recover the Past#080.dst: 자, 난 피험자가 몹시 필요해... 너도 괜찮겠지만, 이게 제대로 작동하는지 더 확실히 해야 해.
Recover the Past#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#081.src: Listen here! I have a proposition to make. You'd like your memories back, yes? Bring me enough test subjects, and I can show you what you've lost!
Recover the Past#081.dst: 잘 들어! 제안이 하나 있어. 기억을 되찾고 싶지? 피험자를 충분히 데려오면, 네가 잃은 걸 보여 주지!
Recover the Past#081.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#082.src: Let's see, let's see... We need individuals originally from Fruma. There are a few of those around here.
Recover the Past#082.dst: 어디 보자, 어디 보자... 원래 Fruma 출신인 사람이 필요해. 이 근처에 몇 명 있지.
Recover the Past#082.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#083.src: You can start with the would-be sailor, Caid. You'll find him just past {p}- follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#083.dst: 선원 지망생 Caid부터 시작하면 돼. {p}을(를) 막 지나면 있어- 강에 닿을 때까지 길을 따라가.
Recover the Past#083.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#084.src: In the meantime, I'll be making adjustments here... It's not perfect just yet. I'm still missing large portions of my memory... Hm? You're still in here? Get going!
Recover the Past#084.dst: 그동안 난 여기서 조정을 하고 있겠어... 아직 완벽하진 않거든. 내 기억도 아직 많이 비어 있고... 음? 아직 여기 있어? 어서 가!
Recover the Past#084.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#085.src: Recover the sailor Caid near his boat at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#086.src: Well? I've given you an assignment, what are you still doing here? Go find the sailor Caid. You'll find him just past {p} follow the path until you reach the river.
Recover the Past#086.dst: 뭐야? 임무를 줬는데 아직 여기서 뭐 해? 선원 Caid를 찾아가. {p}을(를) 막 지나서 강에 닿을 때까지 길을 따라가면 있어.
Recover the Past#086.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#087.src: Huh? Oh! I ah, nothing to see here! Just... just taking a look at my good old ship!
Recover the Past#087.dst: 응? 앗! 나, 어, 볼 거 없어! 그냥... 그냥 내 오래된 배 좀 보고 있었어!
Recover the Past#087.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#088.src: Picard sent you? The guy cooped up in the tower? Huh. Good to know he's finally finished his work. But what could he want me for?
Recover the Past#088.dst: Picard가 보냈다고? 탑에 틀어박힌 그 양반? 흠. 드디어 연구를 끝냈나 보네. 근데 나한테 뭘 원하는 거지?
Recover the Past#088.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#089.src: ... Look at my memories from Fruma, huh? I'm not so sure 'bout that. If they're missing, they must be missing for a reason. I'm-I'm happy here! Don't need to know nothin' about...
Recover the Past#089.dst: ... Fruma 시절 기억을 보자고? 글쎄, 잘 모르겠는데. 기억이 없으면 없는 이유가 있겠지. 난, 난 여기서 행복해! 알 필요 없다고...
Recover the Past#089.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#090.src: ... Yeah, alright. I'll come with you to get my memory checked out. Just, do me a solid first, alright?
Recover the Past#090.dst: ... 그래, 알았어. 같이 가서 기억 좀 확인받을게. 그 전에 부탁 하나만 들어줄래?
Recover the Past#090.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#091.src: I'm something of a builder. Figured I'd try my hand at making a ship, and, here it is! Pretty good, right?
Recover the Past#091.dst: 내가 뭘 좀 만드는 사람이거든. 배를 한번 만들어 봤는데, 바로 이거야! 꽤 괜찮지?
Recover the Past#091.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#092.src: That's what I'm talkin' about, take that Reynauld! I knew someone would like it!
Recover the Past#092.dst: 바로 그거야, 들었냐 Reynauld! 좋아할 사람이 있을 줄 알았다니까!
Recover the Past#092.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#094.src: Hey! Heh, well you're not wrong. I cobbled it together using mostly junk I found laying around. Still, it's pretty impressive for a scrap heap, don't you think?
Recover the Past#094.dst: 야! 헤, 뭐 틀린 말은 아니지. 주변에 굴러다니던 고물로 대충 짜 맞췄거든. 그래도 고물 더미치고 꽤 대단하지 않아?
Recover the Past#094.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#095.src: You'll have to promise me you won't tell Reynauld but... Some of the more exotic components have been comin' from the guard's quarters. Nothing big! Just some stuff skimmed off the top...
Recover the Past#095.dst: Reynauld한테 말 안 한다고 약속해 줘... 좀 특이한 부품 몇 개는 경비대 숙소에서 가져왔어. 별거 아니야! 조금 떼어 온 것뿐...
Recover the Past#095.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#096.src: I only need one more part to finish it off, and well, you see... A shipment just arrived at the blacksmith's... You see where I'm going with this?
Recover the Past#096.dst: 마무리하려면 부품 하나만 더 있으면 되는데, 그게... 마침 대장간에 물건이 막 들어왔거든... 무슨 말인지 알겠지?
Recover the Past#096.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#097.src: Get me the part from the blacksmith's and I'll come with you to Picard's tower. I could hardly leave my baby alone unfinished like this now, could I?
Recover the Past#097.dst: 대장간에서 부품 가져다주면 Picard의 탑까지 같이 갈게. 내 새끼를 이렇게 미완성으로 두고 갈 순 없잖아?
Recover the Past#097.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#098.src: Steal the box from the Blacksmith's house at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#099.src: Have you gotten the box yet? It's at the blacksmith's, a short walk away from here in {p}. Just, don't get spotted!
Recover the Past#099.dst: 상자 가져왔어? 대장간에 있어, {p}에서 여기서 조금만 걸으면 돼. 그냥, 들키지만 마!
Recover the Past#099.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#100.src: Bring the package to Caid at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#101.src: ... You're back! How did it go? Here, I'll take the goods.
Recover the Past#101.dst: ... 돌아왔구나! 어떻게 됐어? 자, 물건은 내가 받을게.
Recover the Past#101.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#102.src: The blacksmith didn't see anything right? I'm a bit worried Reynauld is on my trail...
Recover the Past#102.dst: 대장장이가 아무것도 못 봤지? Reynauld가 날 쫓고 있는 것 같아서 좀 걱정이야...
Recover the Past#102.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#103.src: Ah, whatever! Finally, time to finish this ol' boat of mine!
Recover the Past#103.dst: 에이, 몰라! 드디어 내 낡은 배를 완성할 시간이다!
Recover the Past#103.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#104.src: There we go! Ta da! How's it look?
Recover the Past#104.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#105.src: That's right! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell. Wouldn't be the same without one.
Recover the Past#105.dst: 그렇지! 제대로 된 배라면 종이 있어야지. 없으면 영 느낌이 안 나.
Recover the Past#105.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#106.src: What's with the attitude! Every ship worth its salt's got to have a bell, you know? Do you think the Seaskipper'd be caught dead without one? Didn't think so!
Recover the Past#106.dst: 태도가 왜 그래! 제대로 된 배라면 종이 있어야 한다고, 알아? 연락선이 종도 없이 다닐 것 같아? 그럴 리가!
Recover the Past#106.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#107.src: Anyway... I guess you've fulfilled your end of the bargain, so I've got no choice but to fulfil mine!
Recover the Past#107.dst: 어쨌든... 네가 약속을 지켰으니, 나도 내 약속을 지킬 수밖에!
Recover the Past#107.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#108.src: Lead the way to Picard's tower! Let's see what's hiding in this big head o' mine.
Recover the Past#108.dst: Picard의 탑으로 앞장서! 내 큰 머릿속에 뭐가 숨어 있나 보자고.
Recover the Past#108.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#109.src: Bring Caid to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#109.dst: Caid를 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 탑에 있는 Picard 박사에게 데려가세요.

Recover the Past#111.src: Aha! You've returned! Good, good, this'll be a good test of my changes...
Recover the Past#111.dst: 아하! 돌아왔군! 좋아, 좋아, 내가 고친 걸 시험하기 딱 좋겠어...
Recover the Past#111.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#112.src: ... Right. And this is the doctor we're trusting with my memories?
Recover the Past#112.dst: ... 그래. 그러니까 이 박사한테 내 기억을 맡긴다는 거지?
Recover the Past#112.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#113.src: Now, now, don't underestimate my genius. You'll be fine! Probably. I'd give it a ninety-five, well, ninety percent chance. Now, step up here.
Recover the Past#113.dst: 자, 자, 내 천재성을 얕보지 마. 괜찮을 거야! 아마도. 성공률 95, 아니, 90퍼센트는 되지. 자, 여기 올라와.
Recover the Past#113.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#114.src: Alright... I trust you know what you're doing, doctor...
Recover the Past#114.dst: 알았어... 뭘 하는지 잘 알고 있길 바라, 박사...
Recover the Past#114.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#115.src: And now, all I need to do is... Activate the spell here, hit the switch there, and...
Recover the Past#115.dst: 이제, 남은 건... 여기서 주문을 발동하고, 저기 스위치를 누르고, 그리고...
Recover the Past#115.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#117.src: Right, let's see what we've got here... Edwin, can you check that other crate over there?
Recover the Past#117.dst: 좋아, 뭐가 들었나 볼까... Edwin, 저쪽 다른 상자 좀 확인해 줄래?
Recover the Past#117.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#118.src: Sure thing. Say Caid. How do you keep getting ahold of these things? There's expensive parts in these, and that seems a bit out of your price range.
Recover the Past#118.dst: 그래. 근데 Caid. 이런 건 어떻게 계속 구하는 거야? 비싼 부품이 들어 있는데, 네 형편에 살 만한 물건은 아니잖아.
Recover the Past#118.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#119.src: Well... Let's just say the latest resupply package for the guards is slightly lighter than it might otherwise be.
Recover the Past#119.dst: 음... 경비대의 최근 보급품 상자가 원래보다 살짝 가벼워졌다고만 해 두자.
Recover the Past#119.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#120.src: Wait what? Caid, please tell me you haven't been stealing from the guards. You know they won't
Recover the Past#120.dst: 뭐라고? Caid, 경비대 물건 훔친 거 아니라고 해 줘. 걔들이 가만있지 않을
Recover the Past#120.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#121.src: Edwin, relax. I'm barely skimming off the top of their supplies. They won't notice one or two missing packages out of thirty.
Recover the Past#121.dst: Edwin, 진정해. 보급품에서 아주 조금 떼어 낸 것뿐이야. 서른 상자 중에 한두 개 없어진 건 모를 거야.
Recover the Past#121.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#122.src: 'sides, I'm not scared of them. They're here to protect us, aren't they? I figure they'll just let me off with a warning, like they have all those other times.
Recover the Past#122.dst: 게다가 난 걔들 안 무서워. 우릴 지키러 온 거잖아? 전에도 그랬듯이 경고만 하고 넘어가 주겠지.
Recover the Past#122.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#123.src: If... if you say so. I guess you're right. They don't need all those supplies, really. And we can make much better use of these than they would!
Recover the Past#123.dst: 그... 그렇다면야. 네 말이 맞는 것 같아. 걔들한테 그 보급품이 다 필요한 것도 아니고. 우리가 훨씬 더 잘 쓸 수 있잖아!
Recover the Past#123.speaker: Edwin

Recover the Past#124.src: Exactly! I'm glad you agree. So, have you found anything goo
Recover the Past#124.dst: 바로 그거야! 동의해 줘서 다행이다. 그래서, 뭐 좋은 거라도 찾
Recover the Past#124.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#125.src: You two! Hold still, you're under arrest!
Recover the Past#125.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#127.src: E-Edwin! Get back here, you cowa
Recover the Past#127.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#128.src: That's enough out of you. You two, track down the accomplice.
Recover the Past#128.dst: 그만 떠들어라. 너희 둘은 공범을 추적해.
Recover the Past#128.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#131.src: Caid, you are being placed under arrest for repeated counts of theft of imperial property.
Recover the Past#131.dst: Caid, 너를 제국 재산 상습 절도 혐의로 체포한다.
Recover the Past#131.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#132.src: Your record shows you have received multiple warnings for previous acts. This was your final chance, and you have thoroughly wasted it.
Recover the Past#132.dst: 기록을 보니 이전 행위로 여러 번 경고를 받았더군. 이번이 마지막 기회였는데, 완전히 날려 버렸어.
Recover the Past#132.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#133.src: Take him to the prison for further questioning, and decide what shall be done with him.
Recover the Past#133.dst: 추가 심문을 위해 감옥으로 데려가고, 처분을 결정해라.
Recover the Past#133.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#134.src: Hey! Hello? Bystander-turned-assistant! Get yourself out of that trance, we need to talk.
Recover the Past#134.dst: 이봐! 여보세요? 구경꾼 겸 조수! 멍한 상태에서 빠져나와, 얘기 좀 해야겠어.
Recover the Past#134.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#135.src: Hm. Hm hm hm. The memory cut off there...I wonder what we'd see if we could
Recover the Past#135.dst: 흠. 흠 흠 흠. 기억이 거기서 끊겼군... 만약 우리가 볼 수 있다면 뭘
Recover the Past#135.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#137.src: Yes, it appears so... But perhaps, if I can increase the power, then... Yes! I'm a geniu
Recover the Past#137.dst: 그래, 그런 것 같군... 하지만 힘을 더 키울 수 있다면, 그럼... 그래! 난 천재
Recover the Past#137.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#138.src: That's all I am?! Just some thief... Is that all I'm good for?
Recover the Past#138.dst: 내가 겨우 그거라고?! 그냥 도둑놈... 그게 내가 할 줄 아는 전부야?
Recover the Past#138.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#141.src: Ah! Bystander-turned-assis you know what, I'll just call you my assistant. Finally out of your trance, I see.
Recover the Past#141.dst: 아! 구경꾼 겸 조- 됐다, 그냥 조수라고 부를게. 드디어 멍한 상태에서 벗어났구나.
Recover the Past#141.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#142.src: But that's of no importance now! What, however, is important is what we've just seen! Memories relived in vivid detail! Truly, this device will change the world!
Recover the Past#142.dst: 하지만 그건 이제 중요하지 않아! 중요한 건 우리가 방금 본 거지! 생생하게 되살아난 기억! 이 장치는 정말 세상을 바꿀 거야!
Recover the Past#142.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#143.src: ... Though, I will say. I am a little lost as to the timeline of events. Caid was arrested- so how did he find himself here in Wynn, as a soldier?
Recover the Past#143.dst: ... 그래도 말이야. 사건 순서가 좀 헷갈려. Caid는 체포됐는데- 어떻게 여기 Wynn에서 병사가 된 거지?
Recover the Past#143.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#144.src: We are in need of more subjects if we are to find out the truth of it! There is a Scout Reynauld on duty today, he is also from Fruma originally, just like yourself.
Recover the Past#144.dst: 진실을 알아내려면 피험자가 더 필요해! 오늘 정찰병 Reynauld가 근무 중인데, 그도 너처럼 원래 Fruma 출신이야.
Recover the Past#144.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#145.src: Yes, hm. You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}. I'm counting on you to convince him to join our experiment. In the name of science!
Recover the Past#145.dst: 그래, 흠. {p}(으)로 가는 다리 근처에 있을 거야. 우리 실험에 참여하도록 설득해 줘. 과학의 이름으로!
Recover the Past#145.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#146.src: Find Scout Reynauld near the bridge to the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#146.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p}(으)로 가는 다리 근처에서 정찰병 Reynauld를 찾으세요.

Recover the Past#147.src: Hm... Where does this barrier lie? Is this magic not strong enough to break through it? Maybe if I increase the power, then...
Recover the Past#147.dst: 흠... 이 장벽은 어디에 있는 거지? 이 마법으론 뚫기에 부족한가? 힘을 더 키우면, 그러면...
Recover the Past#147.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#148.src: Gah! Assistant! What are you doing here? Have you spoken to Scout Reynauld yet? You'll find him near the bridge to the {p}.
Recover the Past#148.dst: 악! 조수! 여기서 뭐 해? 정찰병 Reynauld랑은 얘기해 봤어? {p}(으)로 가는 다리 근처에 있을 거야.
Recover the Past#148.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#149.dst: 그냥... 날 좀 내버려 둬. 알았지?
Recover the Past#149.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#150.src: Ah, hello. What seems to be the matter? You look like you want something from me.
Recover the Past#150.dst: 아, 안녕. 무슨 일이지? 나한테 뭔가 원하는 게 있는 얼굴인데.
Recover the Past#150.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#151.src: Hm? The strange doctor wants to see me? To restore my memories? I can't say I really trust the man... but I am curious to see if it'll really work.
Recover the Past#151.dst: 음? 그 이상한 박사가 날 보자고? 기억을 복원하려고? 그 사람을 믿진 않지만... 정말 효과가 있을지는 궁금하군.
Recover the Past#151.speaker: Reynauld
