Recover the Past#152.src: Unfortunately, however, I must decline. I couldn't leave my station unattended. What if a corrupted assault were to appear? {p} would be left defenseless.
Recover the Past#152.dst: 하지만 안타깝게도 거절해야겠어. 초소를 비워 둘 순 없어. 타락한 무리가 습격해 오면? {p}은(는) 무방비 상태가 될 거야.
Recover the Past#152.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#153.src: Hm, well. If it's only for a little while, that might work. As long as you promise to help out if an attack does occur.
Recover the Past#153.dst: 흠, 그래. 잠깐 동안이라면 괜찮을지도. 정말 공격이 오면 도와주겠다고 약속만 해 준다면.
Recover the Past#153.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#154.src: Then it's settled. I'll go with you to meet the doctor. However, first we'll need someone to keep the watch. Did you have someone in mind?
Recover the Past#154.dst: 그럼 결정됐군. 박사를 만나러 같이 가지. 하지만 먼저 경계를 서 줄 사람이 필요해. 생각해 둔 사람 있어?
Recover the Past#154.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#155.src: Caid? That... crook. He's been stealing supplies, I know it. I just can't prove it. But, if you think he'll do, I'm sure it will be fine.
Recover the Past#155.dst: Caid? 그... 사기꾼. 보급품을 훔치고 있는 게 분명해. 증명을 못 할 뿐이지. 하지만 네가 그 사람이면 된다고 생각한다면, 괜찮겠지.
Recover the Past#155.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#156.src: Yes, fine, I understand you've taken issue with my methodology. But it works! This has worked thrice now!
Recover the Past#156.dst: 그래, 좋아, 내 방법론에 불만이 있다는 건 알겠어. 하지만 효과가 있잖아! 벌써 세 번이나 성공했다고!

Recover the Past#157.src: Sigh... all of that, and we still weren't able to see what comes next! I swear, I was able to see more when I looked at my own memories! It's ridicu-
Recover the Past#157.dst: 하아... 그렇게 해 놓고도 다음 장면을 못 봤잖아! 맹세컨대, 내 기억을 들여다볼 땐 더 많이 볼 수 있었다고! 이건 말도 안 ㄷ-

Recover the Past#158.src: I saw him heading to the temple not very long ago. Perhaps he's had a change of heart. You lead the way to Caid, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#158.dst: 얼마 전에 신전 쪽으로 가는 걸 봤어. 마음을 고쳐먹었을지도 모르지. Caid에게 앞장서, 바로 뒤따라갈게.
Recover the Past#158.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#160.src: Perhaps Caid's had a change of heart. You lead the way to him, I'll be right behind you.
Recover the Past#160.dst: Caid가 마음을 고쳐먹었을지도 모르지. 그에게 앞장서, 바로 뒤따라갈게.
Recover the Past#160.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#161.src: Convince Caid to keep watch over the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#162.src: Oh, it's you again. What do you want?
Recover the Past#162.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#163.src: It's us, and we'd like to ask something of you. Our mutual friend here is attempting to recruit me for some sort of experiment.
Recover the Past#163.dst: 우리야, 부탁할 게 있어. 여기 있는 우리 둘의 친구가 날 무슨 실험에 끌어들이려 하거든.
Recover the Past#163.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#164.src: Only, my participation would leave {p} undefended. So we're asking if you'd be willing to keep a watch over things while I'm otherwise preoccupied.
Recover the Past#164.dst: 그런데 내가 참여하면 {p}을(를) 지킬 사람이 없어. 그래서 내가 자리를 비운 동안 경계를 서 줄 수 있는지 묻는 거야.
Recover the Past#164.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#165.src: Really? You're asking me to guard {p}?
Recover the Past#165.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#166.src: Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not leave the security of {p} in the hands of a thie... someone like you. You weren't my first choice to say the least, or second, or third
Recover the Past#166.dst: 오해하지 마, 나도 {p}의 안전을 도둑... 너 같은 사람 손에 맡기고 싶진 않아. 넌 첫 번째 선택지도 아니었고, 두 번째도, 세 번째도
Recover the Past#166.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#169.src: You will? Well, that was easier than I expected. Remember if you see any signs of an imminent attack, run to that doctor's tower and alert us immediately. Leave the fighting to the professionals.
Recover the Past#169.dst: 하겠다고? 생각보다 쉽군. 명심해, 공격 징조가 조금이라도 보이면 박사의 탑으로 달려와서 바로 알려. 싸움은 전문가에게 맡기고.
Recover the Past#169.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#170.src: I wouldn't dream of anything else! But, consider Reynauld, that maybe the past is forgotten for a reason.
Recover the Past#170.dst: 딴생각은 꿈에도 안 해! 그래도 Reynauld, 과거가 잊힌 데엔 이유가 있을지도 모른다는 거 생각해 봐.
Recover the Past#170.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#171.src: Well, I suppose that settles that. Let's hurry to the doctor. I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#171.dst: 뭐, 그럼 정해졌군. 박사에게 서두르자. {p}의 안전을 저 손버릇 나쁜 녀석한테 필요 이상으로 맡겨 두고 싶지 않아.
Recover the Past#171.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#172.src: Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...

Recover the Past#173.src: Bring Reynauld to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#173.dst: Reynauld를 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 탑에 있는 Picard 박사에게 데려가세요.

Recover the Past#174.src: Let's hurry to the doctor, I don't want to leave {p}'s safety in that man's slippery fingers for any longer than I have to.
Recover the Past#174.dst: 박사에게 서두르자, {p}의 안전을 저 손버릇 나쁜 녀석한테 필요 이상으로 맡겨 두고 싶지 않아.
Recover the Past#174.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#176.src: Ah, assistant! Welcome back, and I see you've brought our next subject! Wonderful!
Recover the Past#176.dst: 아, 조수! 어서 와, 다음 피험자를 데려왔군! 훌륭해!
Recover the Past#176.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#178.src: Now, now, step forward. Don't be shy! Just step right up over here! Look directly into the orb, and concentrate on remembering.
Recover the Past#178.dst: 자, 자, 앞으로 나와. 부끄러워하지 말고! 바로 여기로 올라와! 구슬을 똑바로 보고, 기억하는 데 집중해.
Recover the Past#178.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#180.src: Yes, yes! Not to worry, the device has been extensively tested on Caid. Very quickly, I just need to activate this... cast a spell here... and...
Recover the Past#180.dst: 그럼, 그럼! 걱정 마, 이 장치는 Caid한테 충분히 시험했어. 금방 돼, 이것만 작동시키고... 여기서 주문을 걸고... 그리고...
Recover the Past#180.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#182.src: H-huh? Hey, who's there? Why are you knocking at this hour
Recover the Past#182.dst: 어, 어? 이봐, 누구야? 이 시간에 왜 문을 두드려
Recover the Past#182.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#184.src: Yes, it's me. Mind if I step inside?
Recover the Past#184.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#185.src: N-no, of course not- Uh. It would have been nice if, you know, you warned me you would be coming!
Recover the Past#185.dst: 아, 아니, 당연히 되지- 어. 오기 전에, 그러니까, 미리 말해 줬으면 좋았을 텐데!
Recover the Past#185.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#186.src: You know that isn't how this works. Now, where are the goods?
Recover the Past#186.dst: 일이 그렇게 돌아가는 게 아닌 거 알잖아. 자, 물건은 어디 있지?
Recover the Past#186.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#187.src: Right... always straight to business with you. Never oh, how was your week? Always just-...
Recover the Past#187.dst: 그래... 넌 늘 바로 본론이지. 한 번도 아, 이번 주는 어땠어? 같은 말은 없고. 늘 그냥-...
Recover the Past#187.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#188.src: Fine. It's up and over here.
Recover the Past#188.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#189.src: I salvaged some parts from... uh, one of the nearby factories. I hope it's... it's probably what you need.
Recover the Past#189.dst: 근처 공장 중 한 곳에서... 어, 부품을 좀 건져 왔어. 이게... 아마 네가 필요한 걸 거야.
Recover the Past#189.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#190.src: ... Hm. One of the factories, you say? And you're sure you weren't spotted doing it? If I were caught speaking to a known criminal, you know the consequences for both of us.
Recover the Past#190.dst: ... 흠. 공장 중 한 곳이라고? 그러다 들키지 않은 게 확실해? 내가 알려진 범죄자와 얘기하다 걸리면, 우리 둘 다 어떻게 되는지 알잖아.
Recover the Past#190.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#191.src: N-no. I wasn't spotted. I, uh... took precautions. Went in at night. You know.
Recover the Past#191.dst: 아, 안 들켰어. 나, 어... 조심했어. 밤에 들어갔거든. 알지?
Recover the Past#191.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#193.src: S-so... is that enough? I've gotten you what you asked for.
Recover the Past#193.dst: 그, 그래서... 이 정도면 돼? 달라는 건 다 가져왔잖아.
Recover the Past#193.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#194.src: Well... it is that, yes. But, Caid, you know the risk I take every time I come out here to speak with you. I'll need more than just the bare minimum to guarantee your safety.
Recover the Past#194.dst: 음... 그건 그렇지. 하지만 Caid, 너랑 얘기하러 여기 올 때마다 내가 무슨 위험을 감수하는지 알잖아. 네 안전을 보장하려면 최소한으론 부족해.
Recover the Past#194.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#195.src: I hmph. Okay, okay, fine, I'll- I'll add in some emeralds. To sweeten the deal.
Recover the Past#195.dst: 난 흥. 알았어, 알았어, 좋아, 에- 에메랄드도 좀 얹을게. 거래 조건 좀 좋게.
Recover the Past#195.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#196.src: Excellent. A pleasure doing business, as always. I'll be back in a few weeks.
Recover the Past#196.dst: 훌륭해. 언제나처럼 거래하기 즐거웠어. 몇 주 뒤에 다시 오지.
Recover the Past#196.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#198.src: Ah, Reynauld. Good to see you. Come in, come in.
Recover the Past#198.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#199.src: Might I ask what this meeting is for, sir?
Recover the Past#199.dst: 이번 면담은 무슨 일인지 여쭤도 되겠습니까, 대장님?
Recover the Past#199.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#200.src: Oh, nothing too special. I just wanted to have a quick chat about your performance.
Recover the Past#200.dst: 아, 별일은 아니네. 자네 근무 태도에 관해 잠깐 얘기하고 싶었을 뿐이야.
Recover the Past#200.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#201.src: You understand that those of us who serve Her Majesty in such well regarded positions have a certain... strict code of honor we must follow, yes?
Recover the Past#201.dst: 이렇게 존경받는 자리에서 여왕 폐하를 섬기는 우리에겐, 반드시 지켜야 할... 엄격한 명예 규율이 있다는 건 알겠지?
Recover the Past#201.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#202.src: Otherwise, how could we be certain our ranks are pure of any misdeeds? We must set an example for the people of our great province.
Recover the Past#202.dst: 그렇지 않으면 우리 대열에 어떤 비행도 없다고 어떻게 확신하겠나? 우리는 이 위대한 지방의 백성에게 본보기가 되어야 하네.
Recover the Past#202.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#203.src: Now, what do you think might happen if one of our own happened to... bend, or break that code of honour? What sort of a precedent would that set?
Recover the Past#203.dst: 자, 만약 우리 중 누군가가 그 명예 규율을... 굽히거나 어긴다면 어떻게 될 것 같나? 어떤 선례가 남겠나?
Recover the Past#203.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#205.src: It is with no great pleasure that I inform you that you, Reynauld, are to be stripped of your rank and arrested under charges of dishonour and conspiracy against Her Majesty.
Recover the Past#205.dst: 유감스럽게도 통보하네, Reynauld, 자네는 계급을 박탈당하고 불명예와 여왕 폐하에 대한 반역 모의 혐의로 체포된다.
Recover the Past#205.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#206.src: Your accomplice, the supplier, was caught the other day. I'm told he spent very little time grappling with the thought before choosing to spill your own secrets.
Recover the Past#206.dst: 자네 공범인 공급책이 며칠 전에 잡혔네. 듣자 하니 자네 비밀을 털어놓기까지 고민도 거의 안 했다더군.
Recover the Past#206.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#207.src: There is no place for your sort in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#207.dst: 우리 대열에 너 같은 자가 있을 자리는 없다, Reynauld. 이렇게 되어 유감이군.
Recover the Past#207.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#208.src: There is no place for your spot in our ranks, Reynauld. A shame it had to come to this.
Recover the Past#208.dst: 우리 대열에 너 같은 자가 있을 자리는 없다, Reynauld. 이렇게 되어 유감이군.
Recover the Past#208.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#209.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! There's more to discuss.
Recover the Past#209.dst: 조수! 정신 차려! 할 얘기가 더 있어.
Recover the Past#209.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#211.src: Marvelous! Assistant, you've done very well so far! We're closer than ever to uncovering the mystery of Fruma!
Recover the Past#211.dst: 놀랍군! 조수, 지금까지 아주 잘했어! Fruma의 수수께끼를 푸는 데 그 어느 때보다 가까워졌어!
Recover the Past#211.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#213.src: {u}!? Didn't think I'd stumble upon you all the way out here!
Recover the Past#213.dst: {u}!? 이런 먼 곳에서 널 마주칠 줄은 몰랐어!
Recover the Past#213.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#214.src: There's time for pleasantries later. Tasim? Why are you here? Where's Caid?
Recover the Past#214.dst: 인사는 나중에 해. Tasim? 여긴 왜 왔어? Caid는 어디 있지?
Recover the Past#214.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#215.src: The Admiral sent me to bolster {p}'s defenses. I was expecting to meet you at the bridge, but all I found was Caid.
Recover the Past#215.dst: 제독님이 {p}의 방어를 강화하라고 보내셨어. 다리에서 널 만날 줄 알았는데, Caid밖에 없더라.
Recover the Past#215.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#216.src: He said there was an assault on {p} gathering and that you were here, then he ran away.
Recover the Past#216.dst: {p}을(를) 노리는 습격이 모이고 있고 네가 여기 있다고 하더니, 도망쳐 버렸어.
Recover the Past#216.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#217.src: That damned thief! I knew I shouldn't have left... This was all a mistake... Damn.
Recover the Past#217.dst: 그 빌어먹을 도둑놈! 자리를 비우는 게 아니었는데... 다 실수였어... 젠장.
Recover the Past#217.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#218.src: There's no time to waste now. Let's go, Tasim and {u}. We need to save {p}.
Recover the Past#218.dst: 지체할 시간 없어. 가자, Tasim, {u}. {p}을(를) 구해야 해.
Recover the Past#218.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#219.src: That Tasim, he must be from Fruma as well? If he's a companion of yours, you should recruit him to this little experiment of ours. For science of course! Now, now, be off. {p} needs saving!
Recover the Past#219.dst: 그 Tasim이라는 친구, 그도 Fruma 출신이겠지? 네 동료라면 우리 작은 실험에 끌어들여. 물론 과학을 위해서! 자, 자, 어서 가. {p}을(를) 구해야지!
Recover the Past#219.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#220.src: Rush to defend {p} from the incursion at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Recover the Past#221.src: Assistant! What are you still doing here? Your friends seem to be in need of your assistance!
Recover the Past#221.dst: 조수! 아직 여기서 뭐 해? 네 친구들이 도움이 필요해 보이던데!
Recover the Past#221.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#222.src: Besides, this might be an opportunity to recruit that Tasim to our experiment! Hm, yes, he would certainly be an interesting specimen to examine!
Recover the Past#222.dst: 게다가 그 Tasim을 실험에 끌어들일 기회일지도 몰라! 흠, 그래, 분명 흥미로운 연구 대상이 될 거야!
Recover the Past#222.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#223.src: They'll be coming for this bridge any minute now. We will need to stand ready.
Recover the Past#223.dst: 놈들이 곧 이 다리로 몰려올 거야. 대비해야 해.
Recover the Past#223.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#225.src: Good answer, soldier. We'll take them down, no matter how many they throw at us!
Recover the Past#225.dst: 좋은 대답이다, 병사. 몇이 몰려오든 다 쓰러뜨리자!
Recover the Past#225.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#226.src: Do whatever you have to first, but be quick. The enemy might arrive at any moment.
Recover the Past#226.dst: 먼저 할 일이 있으면 해, 하지만 서둘러. 적이 언제 들이닥칠지 몰라.
Recover the Past#226.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#228.src: Tasim, you take the front, I'll provide cover from behind.
Recover the Past#228.dst: Tasim, 넌 앞을 맡아, 난 뒤에서 엄호할게.
Recover the Past#228.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#229.src: It would be my pleasure, Reynauld!
Recover the Past#229.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#230.src: Shouldn't be much longer now... If only Aledar was here, it'd be like old times again. Don't you think?
Recover the Past#230.dst: 이제 얼마 안 남았어... Aledar도 여기 있었다면 옛날 같았을 텐데. 안 그래?
Recover the Past#230.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#231.src: I have eyes on the target! Corrupted forces incoming!
Recover the Past#231.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#233.src: Damn it. That leader looks shielded! How do we take it down?
Recover the Past#233.dst: 젠장. 저 우두머리는 보호막이 있어! 어떻게 쓰러뜨리지?
Recover the Past#233.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#234.src: The spikes must be its weak point!
Recover the Past#234.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#235.src: You're right! Tasim, {u}. As long as you can keep the enemy away from me, I can line up a good shot at the spikes. That's our only chance at taking this thing down.
Recover the Past#235.dst: 맞아! Tasim, {u}. 적을 나한테서 떼어 놓기만 하면, 가시를 제대로 조준할 수 있어. 저걸 쓰러뜨릴 유일한 기회야.
Recover the Past#235.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#236.src: ... Ah. Turns out this might be a little tougher than expected. But, let's give it our all!
Recover the Past#236.dst: ... 아. 생각보다 좀 더 힘들겠는데. 그래도, 전력을 다하자!
Recover the Past#236.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#237.src: Just... a little more... to the right...
Recover the Past#237.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#238.src: That's it! It's got to be...
Recover the Past#238.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#239.src: Reynauld! What do we do now? We can't beat it like this...
Recover the Past#239.dst: Reynauld! 이제 어떡해? 이대론 못 이겨...
Recover the Past#239.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#240.src: I'm trying to think but... I've never...
Recover the Past#240.dst: 생각 중인데... 이런 건 한 번도...
Recover the Past#240.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#241.src: Tasim, {u}, you continue to hold them off. I'll think of something, anything...
Recover the Past#241.dst: Tasim, {u}, 계속 막아 줘. 내가 뭔가, 뭐라도 생각해 낼게...
Recover the Past#241.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#242.src: We can't give up now, not while {p} is still in danger!
Recover the Past#242.dst: 지금 포기할 순 없어, {p}이(가) 아직 위험하잖아!
Recover the Past#242.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#243.src: Reynauld, it's not working! They just keep coming we... have to do something... else, or we won't last!
Recover the Past#243.dst: Reynauld, 소용없어! 계속 몰려와, 우리... 뭔가... 다른 걸 해야 해, 안 그러면 못 버텨!
Recover the Past#243.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#244.src: You're right. We'll have to retreat, call for aid from {p}. Three men alone can't defeat this!
Recover the Past#244.dst: 네 말이 맞아. 후퇴해서 {p}에 지원을 요청해야겠어. 셋만으론 이걸 못 이겨!
Recover the Past#244.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#247.src: Caid, what are you doing here!? It's too dangerous, leave this one to the professionals!
Recover the Past#247.dst: Caid, 여기서 뭐 하는 거야!? 너무 위험해, 이건 전문가에게 맡겨!
Recover the Past#247.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#248.src: I'm done, I'm done letting my future slip out of my fingers!
Recover the Past#248.dst: 이제 됐어, 내 미래가 손가락 사이로 빠져나가게 두는 건 이제 끝이야!
Recover the Past#248.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#249.dst: Caid, 안 돼! 넌... 못 해, 그러다
Recover the Past#249.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#252.src: Now, Reynauld! Shoot! For goodness' sake, shoot! While it's distracted!
Recover the Past#252.dst: 지금이야, Reynauld! 쏴! 제발, 쏘라고! 한눈팔 때!
Recover the Past#252.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#253.src: It-It's coming down! Now's our chance!
Recover the Past#253.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#254.src: We did it... We really did it!
Recover the Past#254.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#258.src: Caid! You made it! You're a hero!
Recover the Past#258.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#259.src: That's all well and good but, what about your boat?
Recover the Past#259.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#260.src: I can always build another one, can't I?
Recover the Past#260.speaker: Caid

Recover the Past#261.src: Ha. But not using my belongings this time.
Recover the Past#261.dst: 하. 하지만 이번엔 내 물건은 쓰지 마.
Recover the Past#261.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#262.src: Well, Caid seems to be fine enough, considering the circumstances. I'll take him to get checked out, just in case. Thank you for your help, Tasim and {u}. And Caid too...
Recover the Past#262.dst: 뭐, 상황을 생각하면 Caid는 꽤 괜찮아 보이네. 혹시 모르니 검진받게 데려갈게. 도와줘서 고마워, Tasim, {u}. 그리고 Caid도...
Recover the Past#262.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#263.src: You must be wanting to take Tasim with you for your experiment. After all you've done today, I can hardly object. But, Tasim...
Recover the Past#263.dst: 실험하려고 Tasim을 데려가고 싶은 거겠지. 오늘 네가 해 준 걸 생각하면 반대할 수가 없군. 하지만, Tasim...
Recover the Past#263.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#264.src: Think carefully before looking into that crystal. For some, the past is filled with things they'd rather forget.
Recover the Past#264.dst: 그 수정을 들여다보기 전에 잘 생각해. 누군가에겐 과거가 잊고 싶은 일로 가득하니까.
Recover the Past#264.speaker: Reynauld

Recover the Past#265.src: Recovering memories from Fruma, huh... I guess that's something I'd be interested in. I've had a strange feeling about it, ever since we first realized we lost them.
Recover the Past#265.dst: Fruma의 기억을 되찾는다라... 나도 관심이 가네. 기억을 잃었다는 걸 처음 알았을 때부터 기분이 묘했거든.
Recover the Past#265.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#266.src: You were there, remember? We'd just barely entered Wynn and... Aledar was with us, and he almost went and died on his first day! I hope he's being more careful, out there...
Recover the Past#266.dst: 너도 거기 있었잖아, 기억나? Wynn에 막 들어섰을 때... Aledar도 같이 있었는데, 첫날부터 죽을 뻔했지! 밖에서 좀 더 조심하고 있으면 좋겠다...
Recover the Past#266.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#267.src: Well, anyway. Please, lead the way to the doctor. I'm intrigued to see what it's all about.
Recover the Past#267.dst: 뭐, 어쨌든. 박사에게 앞장서 줘. 대체 어떤 건지 궁금하네.
Recover the Past#267.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#268.src: Bring Tasim to Dr. Picard in his tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#268.dst: Tasim을 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 탑에 있는 Picard 박사에게 데려가세요.

Recover the Past#270.src: ... Oh, {u}, you're back with yet another subject I see! Excellent, excellent. Please, step up to the orb.
Recover the Past#270.dst: ... 오, {u}, 또 다른 피험자를 데려왔군! 훌륭해, 훌륭해. 자, 구슬 앞으로 올라와.
Recover the Past#270.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#271.src: So, doctor. You're certain this is safe? Reynauld warned me that
Recover the Past#271.dst: 그래서, 박사님. 정말 안전한 거죠? Reynauld가 경고하길
Recover the Past#271.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#272.src: Oh, yes, yes. We've tested it with two subjects before, haven't we, {u}? Besides, I've done the calculations! They all work out fine!
Recover the Past#272.dst: 아, 그럼, 그럼. 전에 두 명한테 시험해 봤잖아, 안 그래, {u}? 게다가 계산도 다 해 봤어! 전부 문제없다고!
Recover the Past#272.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#273.src: There's only the tiniest bit of instability. Hmph. Maybe it just needs more power... If I increase the amount of mana I'm able to put into the spell, then
Recover the Past#273.dst: 아주 약간 불안정할 뿐이야. 흥. 힘이 더 필요한 걸지도... 주문에 불어넣을 수 있는 마나의 양을 늘리면, 그러면
Recover the Past#273.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#274.src: Hold on. You want to put more magic into this, when it's already unstable?
Recover the Past#274.dst: 잠깐만요. 이미 불안정한데 마법을 더 넣겠다고요?
Recover the Past#274.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#275.src: Don't you want to know what your life was like before? Even if it's not what you want to see, isn't it better to know?
Recover the Past#275.dst: 예전 삶이 어땠는지 알고 싶지 않아? 보고 싶은 게 아니더라도, 아는 편이 낫지 않겠어?
Recover the Past#275.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#276.src: Fine. We can look at my memories. I don't know that I necessarily agree... but I'll do it.
Recover the Past#276.dst: 좋아요. 제 기억을 봐도 돼요. 꼭 동의하는지는 모르겠지만... 하겠습니다.
Recover the Past#276.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#277.src: Excellent, I'm glad to hear that! Now. Activating in three... two... one... go!
Recover the Past#277.dst: 훌륭해, 그 말을 들으니 기쁘군! 자. 작동까지 셋... 둘... 하나... 시작!
Recover the Past#277.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#278.src: All hands on deck! Arrest that insurgent!
Recover the Past#278.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#280.src: Grr... He couldn't have gotten far. All of you, search the city! Leave no corner unturned! Don't let him get away!
Recover the Past#280.dst: 크으... 멀리 못 갔을 거다. 전원, 도시를 수색해! 구석구석 다 뒤져! 놓치지 마라!
Recover the Past#280.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#281.src: I- oh, this is bad... What can I...
Recover the Past#281.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#282.src: ... Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's-...
Recover the Past#282.dst: ... 젠장. 다 젠장이야. 저 사람이 피 흘리며 죽게 내버려 둘 순 없어, 설령 그가-...
Recover the Past#282.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#283.src: ... You really shouldn't have gotten involved, you know.

Recover the Past#284.src: Besides, we have used the spell on two subjects already, and it has gone perfectly fine for both of them... eh, for the most part. There's only the slightest bit of instability.
Recover the Past#284.dst: 게다가 이미 두 명의 피험자에게 이 주문을 썼는데, 둘 다 아무 문제 없었어... 어, 대체로는. 아주 약간 불안정할 뿐이야.

Recover the Past#285.src: ...Damn it. Damn it all. I can't just let the man bleed out, even if he's...
Recover the Past#285.dst: ...젠장. 다 젠장이야. 저 사람이 피 흘리며 죽게 내버려 둘 순 없어, 설령 그가...
Recover the Past#285.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#287.src: It's fine, you'll be fine... I know what to do, even if I really shouldn't...
Recover the Past#287.dst: 괜찮아, 괜찮을 거야... 방법은 알아, 정말 그러면 안 되겠지만...
Recover the Past#287.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#288.src: G-gah! Wh-where am I? Who are you? I need to get
Recover the Past#288.dst: 으, 으악! 여, 여긴 어디야? 넌 누구야? 난 가야

Recover the Past#290.src: He's in here! And he has an accomplice! Arrest them both!
Recover the Past#290.dst: 여기 있다! 공범도 있어! 둘 다 체포해!
Recover the Past#290.speaker: Royal Captain

Recover the Past#291.src: My magic is struggling to keep hold... but it's clear there's more to see! Increasing power...
Recover the Past#291.dst: 내 마법이 버티기 힘들어하지만... 볼 게 더 있는 건 분명해! 출력을 올린다...
Recover the Past#291.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#292.src: So, what? I should have just let you bleed out in my home? Don't be ridiculous.
Recover the Past#292.dst: 그래서 뭐? 내 집에서 피 흘리며 죽게 내버려 뒀어야 했다고? 말도 안 되는 소리 하지 마.
Recover the Past#292.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#293.src: Yes! You should have! Because now, not only have I been arrested for crimes against the crown, but you've also been outed as one of the cursed. Wouldn't have happened if you had just... stood by.
Recover the Past#293.dst: 그래! 그랬어야지! 이제 난 왕실에 대한 죄로 체포됐고, 너까지 저주받은 자라는 게 들통났잖아. 네가 그냥... 가만히 있었으면 이런 일은 없었어.
Recover the Past#293.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#294.src: ...It was the right thing to do. I couldn't just stand by when there was something I could do to help.
Recover the Past#294.dst: ...옳은 일이었어. 내가 도울 수 있는데 가만히 보고만 있을 순 없었어.
Recover the Past#294.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#295.src: Well, a lot of good that's done us. You know no one gets out of here, right? When they take you, you're never heard from again! So, that's where we're at.
Recover the Past#295.dst: 그래, 참 많이도 도움이 됐다. 여기서 나가는 사람 없는 거 알지? 끌려가면 다시는 소식을 못 들어! 그러니, 우린 이 꼴이야.
Recover the Past#295.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#297.src: Tasim. It's your time. Follow me.
Recover the Past#297.speaker: Royal Guard

Recover the Past#298.src: Good luck out there, Tasim. You'll need it.
Recover the Past#298.dst: 밖에서 행운을 빈다, Tasim. 필요할 거야.
Recover the Past#298.speaker: Aledar

Recover the Past#299.src: See you on the other side, Aledar.
Recover the Past#299.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#300.src: Ahem. We're ready for the process. Prepare the Adjustor.
Recover the Past#300.dst: 에헴. 절차 준비가 끝났다. 조정기를 준비해라.
Recover the Past#300.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#301.src: The- the what? What are you going to do to
Recover the Past#301.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#302.src: Silence. Before we begin, I want to make one thing clear. We do not need your ilk in Fruma. We do not want your ilk in Fruma.
Recover the Past#302.dst: 조용. 시작하기 전에 한 가지 분명히 해 두지. Fruma엔 너 같은 부류가 필요 없다. Fruma는 너 같은 부류를 원치 않는다.
Recover the Past#302.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#303.src: What we will do with you today is a kindness, a mercy. If the world were to have its way, you would be far worse off. Remember that as we continue.
Recover the Past#303.dst: 오늘 우리가 네게 하는 일은 친절이자 자비다. 세상 뜻대로 했다면 넌 훨씬 비참했을 거다. 진행하는 동안 그걸 기억해라.
Recover the Past#303.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#305.src: You are a new recruit, being sent to the Wynn Province to fight in their war. You enlisted because you thought your unique... talents would be useful.
Recover the Past#305.dst: 너는 신병이며, 전쟁에서 싸우기 위해 Wynn 지방으로 보내진다. 너는 네 특별한... 재능이 쓸모 있으리라 여겨 입대했다.
Recover the Past#305.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#306.src: Fruma is nothing but a speck in your history. A fact set in stone, with details lost to the hypothetical past. You think of it fondly, but remember nothing.
Recover the Past#306.dst: Fruma는 네 역사 속 작은 점일 뿐이다. 돌에 새겨진 사실이되, 세부는 가정의 과거 속에 사라졌다. 너는 그곳을 그리워하지만, 아무것도 기억하지 못한다.
Recover the Past#306.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#307.src: You will fight in their war. You will live for it, you will die for it. You will be of Wynn forever, and Fruma will be glad to be rid of you.
Recover the Past#307.dst: 너는 그들의 전쟁에서 싸울 것이다. 그걸 위해 살고, 그걸 위해 죽을 것이다. 너는 영원히 Wynn의 사람이며, Fruma는 너를 떨쳐 내 기쁠 것이다.
Recover the Past#307.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#310.src: Must I repeat myself? Do you understand?
Recover the Past#310.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#311.src: I will ask once more. Is your directive understood?
Recover the Past#311.dst: 한 번 더 묻겠다. 지시를 이해했나?
Recover the Past#311.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#313.src: Wonderful. Take this one to the caravan. It looks like we'll be able to fit in two more for today's batch.
Recover the Past#313.dst: 좋군. 이자를 마차 행렬로 데려가라. 오늘 무리에 두 명은 더 태울 수 있겠군.
Recover the Past#313.speaker: Inquisitor

Recover the Past#318.src: Assistant! Snap out of it! You've gone in too deep, the memory is sucking you in!
Recover the Past#318.dst: 조수! 정신 차려! 너무 깊이 들어갔어, 기억이 널 빨아들이고 있다고!
Recover the Past#318.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#319.src: Good grief- there you are! Do you understand how dangerous that was?!
Recover the Past#319.dst: 맙소사- 돌아왔구나! 얼마나 위험했는지 알기나 해?!
Recover the Past#319.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#320.src: What do you think happens to me if one of my assistants gets trapped in their memories forever! Nothing good!
Recover the Past#320.dst: 내 조수가 기억 속에 영원히 갇히면 나한테 무슨 일이 생길 것 같아! 좋은 일은 없지!
Recover the Past#320.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#321.src: ... Fine, fine. It did give us more information. Don't do it again, though! Come on, come over here, we have much to discuss.
Recover the Past#321.dst: ... 알았어, 알았어. 정보를 더 얻긴 했지. 그래도 다시는 그러지 마! 자, 이리 와, 얘기할 게 많아.
Recover the Past#321.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#322.src: ... Hmph. I'll admit, I'm... I'm not sure what to do with this information.
Recover the Past#322.dst: ... 흥. 인정하지, 난... 이 정보를 어떻게 해야 할지 모르겠어.
Recover the Past#322.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#323.src: The memory restorification orb worked as well as I could expect for a single use... but, good grief, that was upsetting to watch.
Recover the Past#323.dst: 기억 복원화 구슬은 한 번 쓴 것치고 기대만큼 잘 작동했어... 하지만, 맙소사, 보기 괴로웠어.
Recover the Past#323.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#324.src: It stands to reason both Caid and Reynauld also experienced this... and my magic couldn't break through that wall...
Recover the Past#324.dst: Caid랑 Reynauld도 이걸 겪었다고 보는 게 맞겠지... 그리고 내 마법은 그 벽을 뚫지 못했어...
Recover the Past#324.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#325.src: Is this what they're doing to their criminals out there, in Fruma? Casting them out to fight in Wynn's war?
Recover the Past#325.dst: Fruma에선 범죄자들을 이렇게 다루는 건가? 쫓아내서 Wynn의 전쟁에서 싸우게 하는 거야?
Recover the Past#325.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#326.src: ... I'll have to think on how much I want to delve into memories. In any case! At the very start of this, I promised you we could view your memories.
Recover the Past#326.dst: ... 기억을 얼마나 파고들지 생각해 봐야겠어. 어쨌든! 처음에 네 기억을 보여 주겠다고 약속했었지.
Recover the Past#326.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#327.src: The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Just step up to the orb, like the others did.
Recover the Past#327.dst: 그 제안은 아직 유효해, 원한다면. 다른 사람들처럼 구슬 앞으로 올라오기만 하면 돼.
Recover the Past#327.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#328.src: Well? The offer still stands, if you'd like to take it. Simply step up to the orb, just like the others did.
Recover the Past#328.dst: 그래서? 그 제안은 아직 유효해, 원한다면. 다른 사람들처럼 구슬 앞으로 올라오기만 하면 돼.
Recover the Past#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#329.src: H-huh?! The orb! My beautiful memory restorification orb! It's ruined!
Recover the Past#329.dst: 어, 어?! 구슬! 내 아름다운 기억 복원화 구슬! 망가졌어!
Recover the Past#329.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#330.src: ... Oh, whatever. I have the blueprints stored somewhere around here. I can always make another... but still.
Recover the Past#330.dst: ... 에이, 몰라. 설계도는 이 근처 어딘가에 있어. 또 만들면 되지... 그래도 참.
Recover the Past#330.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#332.src: Oh! Oh, right! My apologies, I completely forgot to check in with you! Are you alright?
Recover the Past#332.dst: 아! 아, 맞다! 미안, 네 상태를 확인하는 걸 깜빡했어! 괜찮아?
Recover the Past#332.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#333.src: None of the other test subjects experienced this powerful a reaction... strange. It's almost like we're accessing memories that didn't exist.
Recover the Past#333.dst: 다른 피험자는 아무도 이렇게 강한 반응을 안 보였는데... 이상하군. 마치 존재하지 않던 기억에 접근한 것 같아.
Recover the Past#333.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#334.src: ... Well. Ehem. In any case, I'll need to continue my research. There's more to learn, I'm sure...
Recover the Past#334.dst: ... 흠. 에헴. 어쨌든, 연구를 계속해야겠어. 알아낼 게 더 있을 거야, 분명...
Recover the Past#334.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#335.src: As thanks for your help. Here, a reward. Ah, also... I believe your friend is just outside the tower. You might want to check in on him.
Recover the Past#335.dst: 도와준 보답이야. 자, 보상이다. 아, 그리고... 네 친구가 탑 바로 밖에 있는 것 같아. 가서 한번 살펴봐.
Recover the Past#335.speaker: Dr. Picard

Recover the Past#336.src: Find Tasim outside Dr. Picard's tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Recover the Past#336.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Picard 박사의 탑 밖에서 Tasim을 찾으세요.

Recover the Past#338.src: Cursed. He called me cursed. What does that mean for me...?
Recover the Past#338.dst: 저주받았다고. 그가 날 저주받았다고 했어. 그게 나한테 무슨 뜻일까...?
Recover the Past#338.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#339.src: And the Inquisitor... I don't know what to think. All of us what we thought we knew when we arrived in Wynn... None of it was true.
Recover the Past#339.dst: 그리고 심문관... 뭐라고 생각해야 할지 모르겠어. 우리 모두 Wynn에 왔을 때 안다고 생각했던 것들... 전부 사실이 아니었어.
Recover the Past#339.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#340.src: ... Did the two of us really meet through sheer random luck? He was running from something, and... fell straight into my life.
Recover the Past#340.dst: ... 우리 둘이 정말 순전히 우연으로 만난 걸까? 그는 뭔가에게서 도망치다가... 내 삶에 곧장 떨어졌지.
Recover the Past#340.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#341.src: I- I need some space to think. To... reflect. Can you... please don't tell Aledar about any of this.
Recover the Past#341.dst: 나- 난 생각할 시간이 좀 필요해. 좀... 되돌아볼 시간. 부탁인데... 이 얘긴 Aledar한테 하지 말아 줘.
Recover the Past#341.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#342.src: He doesn't need to know about all of this. He's- he's better off not knowing.
Recover the Past#342.dst: 그는 이걸 전부 알 필요 없어. 그는- 모르는 편이 나아.
Recover the Past#342.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#343.src: ... I'm going to head for the Gavel Province, I think. It's across the ocean, far enough from... From all of this.
Recover the Past#343.dst: ... 난 Gavel 지방으로 갈 생각이야. 바다 건너에 있으니, 충분히 멀지... 이 모든 것에서.
Recover the Past#343.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#344.src: When you get stronger, you should go there too. Maybe we'll run into each other, eventually.
Recover the Past#344.dst: 더 강해지면 너도 거기로 가 봐. 언젠가는 다시 마주칠지도 모르지.
Recover the Past#344.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#345.src: I guess this is goodbye for now, then. Not forever but for now. I'll see you around, {u}.
Recover the Past#345.dst: 그럼 당분간은 작별이네. 영원히는 아니고 당분간만. 또 보자, {u}.
Recover the Past#345.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#346.src: ... I'm just resting here, a little. I'll be on my way soon.
Recover the Past#346.dst: ... 여기서 잠깐 쉬고 있을 뿐이야. 곧 떠날 거야.
Recover the Past#346.speaker: Tasim

Recover the Past#347.src: It's the box Caid was talking about...

Redbeard's Booty#000.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever ye landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.

Redbeard's Booty#001.src: Do ye remember where to go?

Redbeard's Booty#002.src: No? The crew be loiterin' at Pirate Cove. I'll be along soon, don't ye worry!

Redbeard's Booty#003.src: You are not able to move but you still hear the ongoing conversation.

Redbeard's Booty#004.src: What? Another clue! This be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...

Redbeard's Booty#005.src: Talk with Marston in the ocean at [-{~} {~} -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#006.src: Ah, ahoy matey! Are ye here to get a glimpse of ol' Redbeard's sunken galleon as well?
Redbeard's Booty#006.dst: 아, 어이 친구! 너도 늙은 Redbeard의 가라앉은 갤리온을 구경하러 왔냐?
Redbeard's Booty#006.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#007.src: A fine ship it once was, aye? Accordin' to the stories, it sank in one o' the greatest sea battles in history! The cap'n sank beneath the waves, ne'er to be seen again!
Redbeard's Booty#007.dst: 한때는 멋진 배였지, 응? 이야기로는 역사상 가장 큰 해전에서 가라앉았다더군! 선장은 파도 아래로 가라앉아 다신 보이지 않았지!
Redbeard's Booty#007.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#008.src: ...Say. Have ye ever wanted to go on a real treasure hunt? Ye look like someone with an eye for treasure, aye?
Redbeard's Booty#008.dst: ...그런데 말이야. 진짜 보물찾기 해 보고 싶은 적 없냐? 보물 볼 줄 아는 눈을 가진 것 같은데, 응?
Redbeard's Booty#008.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#009.src: Good for ye then! I bought meself a real treasure map on Pirate Cove, a fine deal if ye ask me. And, if the jack wasn't fibbing, it leads to the feared Redbeard's real treasure!
Redbeard's Booty#009.dst: 그거 잘됐군! Pirate Cove에서 진짜 보물 지도를 샀거든, 내가 보기엔 헐값이야. 그놈이 거짓말 안 했다면, 이게 그 무시무시한 Redbeard의 진짜 보물로 이어진다고!
Redbeard's Booty#009.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#010.src: I ventured 'round, spied some fine jacks at the island, and I collected a crew to join me on me grand, fantastic voyage!
Redbeard's Booty#010.dst: 여기저기 돌다가 섬에서 쓸 만한 놈들을 봐 두고, 이 몸의 거창하고 끝내주는 항해에 함께할 선원을 모았지!
Redbeard's Booty#010.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#011.src: O' course, there always be room for another! Ye joinin'? We could use another hand.
Redbeard's Booty#011.dst: 물론 자리는 늘 하나 더 있지! 합류할래? 일손이 하나 더 있으면 좋겠는데.
Redbeard's Booty#011.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#012.src: Aye! Let's find the booty and bring back some doubloons! Here be that map I snagged. Swim or whatever you landlubbers do to get to Pirate Cove. It'll be the first house to the right when ye arrive.
Redbeard's Booty#012.dst: 좋아! 보물 찾아서 금화 좀 챙겨 오자고! 이게 내가 구한 지도다. 헤엄을 치든 뭍사람 방식대로 하든 Pirate Cove로 가. 도착하면 오른쪽 첫 번째 집이야.
Redbeard's Booty#012.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#013.src: Find Marston's crew on Pirate Cove at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Redbeard's Booty#014.src: And that be when ye will...
Redbeard's Booty#014.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#015.src: Cor lad...ye don' look like a pirate ta me, and I be but a young lass!
Redbeard's Booty#015.dst: 이런 꼬마야... 해적으론 안 보이는데. 난 그냥 젊은 아가씨고!
Redbeard's Booty#015.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#016.src: 's right, bucko. Who be ye, bargin' into our home in yer fancy armour 'n whatnot?
Redbeard's Booty#016.dst: 그렇지, 친구. 번쩍이는 갑옷 따위 입고 우리 집에 쳐들어온 넌 누구냐?
Redbeard's Booty#016.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#017.src: Ah, ye be accompanyin' Marston, eh? Well if ye insist on that, where be the man 'himself?
Redbeard's Booty#017.dst: 아, Marston이랑 같이 왔다고? 그렇게 우긴다면, 그 양반은 어디 있는데?
Redbeard's Booty#017.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#018.src: Comin' later? Hm. Well, more hands always be helpful. Let us go down to me ship, the Black Ring.
Redbeard's Booty#018.dst: 나중에 온다고? 흠. 뭐, 일손은 많을수록 좋지. 내 배 Black Ring으로 내려가자.
Redbeard's Booty#018.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#019.src: So he told ye about the plan? We'll bathe in doubloons when we get back! Ah, me fair lass will be so happy.
Redbeard's Booty#019.dst: 그 녀석이 계획 얘기했어? 돌아가면 금화로 목욕하게 될 거야! 아, 내 애인이 얼마나 좋아할까.
Redbeard's Booty#019.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#020.src: Hop aboard the Black Ring down at the dock of Pirate Cove.
Redbeard's Booty#020.dst: Pirate Cove 부두에서 Black Ring에 올라타세요.

Redbeard's Booty#022.src: Aha, quick on yer feet, lad! Ye got 'ere before us!
Redbeard's Booty#022.dst: 하, 발 빠른데, 꼬마! 우리보다 먼저 왔네!
Redbeard's Booty#022.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#024.src: How's about we wait up fer him? He's the one who's givin us the opportunity fer this hunt, anyways.
Redbeard's Booty#024.dst: 좀 기다려 주는 게 어때? 어차피 이번 보물찾기 기회를 준 게 그 녀석이잖아.
Redbeard's Booty#024.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#025.src: I be getting impatient... The whole crew is 'ere, 'cept fer him!
Redbeard's Booty#025.dst: 슬슬 참을성이 바닥나... 선원이 다 모였는데, 그 녀석만 없어!
Redbeard's Booty#025.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#026.src: Argh! Where be our mate? It be getting dark out! We will have to leave Marston at land.
Redbeard's Booty#026.dst: 으악! 우리 친구는 어디 간 거야? 날이 저문다고! Marston은 뭍에 두고 가야겠어.
Redbeard's Booty#026.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#027.src: Do ya have the map Marston bought?
Redbeard's Booty#027.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#028.src: Let us take a looksie at the map and see where to go.
Redbeard's Booty#028.dst: 지도 좀 보고 어디로 갈지 정하자.
Redbeard's Booty#028.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#029.src: It seems like one of these islands have the treasure... A'ight, yer in charge, landlubber! Set us on a course fer an island!
Redbeard's Booty#029.dst: 이 섬들 중 하나에 보물이 있는 것 같은데... 좋아, 네가 대장이다, 뭍사람! 섬으로 항로를 잡아!
Redbeard's Booty#029.speaker: Argus

Redbeard's Booty#030.src: Ahoy, this must be the booty. Fret not, Argus is keepin' the ship prepared so we can leave.
Redbeard's Booty#030.dst: 어이, 이게 그 보물이겠군. 걱정 마, Argus가 배를 준비해 둬서 바로 뜰 수 있어.
Redbeard's Booty#030.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#031.src: A'ight, let's us dig it up, jacks!
Redbeard's Booty#031.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#032.src: Aha, I see somethin' gleaming in there! Methinks we hit gold, lads.
Redbeard's Booty#032.dst: 하, 안에서 뭔가 번쩍인다! 금을 캔 것 같다, 얘들아.
Redbeard's Booty#032.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#033.src: Now Martim, knock the lubber out.
Redbeard's Booty#033.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#034.src: What? Another clue! The be just a wild grook hunt, where be the real booty?! No one ever got rich off a heap o' keys!! Maybe this 'ere jewel attached will sell...
Redbeard's Booty#034.dst: 뭐? 또 단서야! 순 헛수고잖아, 진짜 보물은 어디 있어?! 열쇠 무더기로 부자 된 놈은 없다고!! 여기 붙은 보석은 팔릴지도...
Redbeard's Booty#034.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#035.src: Wait, there be a clue on the key! Presented to the ruined Galleon, a true path forward will arise.
Redbeard's Booty#035.dst: 잠깐, 열쇠에 단서가 있어! 부서진 갤리온에 바치면, 참된 길이 열리리라.
Redbeard's Booty#035.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#036.src: Garh...I be losin' my patience. Argus arrived, let's ditch the lubber before they awake, hm? This island be hidden by magic, ain't no way they're gettin' found.
Redbeard's Booty#036.dst: 으... 참을성이 바닥난다. Argus가 왔으니, 깨기 전에 이 뭍사람은 버리고 가자, 응? 이 섬은 마법으로 숨겨져 있어서 절대 못 찾을 거야.
Redbeard's Booty#036.speaker: Martim

Redbeard's Booty#037.src: Arright! This key... We might be able to bring Redbeard 'imself back to life... He'll strike terror in the seas again, and we will be 'is crew!
Redbeard's Booty#037.dst: 좋아! 이 열쇠로... Redbeard 본인을 되살릴 수 있을지도 몰라... 그가 다시 바다를 공포에 떨게 하고, 우린 그의 선원이 되는 거야!
Redbeard's Booty#037.speaker: Karkun

Redbeard's Booty#038.src: Leave the hidden island and stop the pirates from stealing Redbeard's Booty.
Redbeard's Booty#038.dst: 숨겨진 섬을 떠나 해적들이 Redbeard의 보물을 훔치지 못하게 막으세요.

Redbeard's Booty#039.src: Talk to Marston about his crew at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Redbeard's Booty#040.src: Can't say I expected all that... Those dogs are quick, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#040.dst: 이렇게 될 줄은 몰랐는데... 그 개놈들 손이 빠르군, 응?
Redbeard's Booty#040.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#041.src: Fer a landlubber, ye sure are quick. When I got ta Pirate Cove, ye were already but a speck on the horizon.
Redbeard's Booty#041.dst: 뭍사람치고는 정말 빠르구먼. 내가 Pirate Cove에 갔을 땐 넌 벌써 수평선 위 점 하나였어.
Redbeard's Booty#041.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#042.src: Speakin' of, what'n the name o' Davy Jones' Locket happened out there?!
Redbeard's Booty#042.dst: 그건 그렇고, 대체 거기서 무슨 난리가 난 거야?!
Redbeard's Booty#042.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#043.src: Ye look a bit bruised! Reckon ye ran aground o' trouble with 'em too, eh?
Redbeard's Booty#043.dst: 좀 멍들었네! 너도 그놈들이랑 한바탕한 모양이지, 응?
Redbeard's Booty#043.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#044.src: Well, lad! Methinks ye oughta go in after 'em! We may be a rowdy lot, but a mutiny's somethin' ye don't tolerate.
Redbeard's Booty#044.dst: 자, 친구! 네가 쫓아가야겠다! 우리가 거친 무리긴 해도, 반란만큼은 용납 못 하지.
Redbeard's Booty#044.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#045.src: They don't deserve that treasure, lad! It ain't be mine either, since I missed ye. That gold be yours fer the takin...so take it!
Redbeard's Booty#045.dst: 그 보물은 그놈들 몫이 아니야, 친구! 널 놓쳤으니 내 것도 아니고. 그 금은 네가 가져갈 몫이야... 그러니 가져가!
Redbeard's Booty#045.speaker: Marston

Redbeard's Booty#046.src: Speakin' of...I ain't got much a penny ta my name, but I found this fish while ye were gone. I hear it sells for a decent haul, so here.
Redbeard's Booty#046.dst: 그건 그렇고... 가진 돈은 거의 없지만, 네가 없는 동안 이 물고기를 낚았어. 꽤 값이 나간다니까, 자.
Redbeard's Booty#046.speaker: Marston

Reincarnation#000.src: Talk to Batelu in Bob's Tomb.

Reincarnation#001.src: Hello adventurer! I see you want to solve the mystery of Bob's tomb also? Glad to meet you.
Reincarnation#001.dst: 안녕하세요, 모험가님! 당신도 Bob의 무덤의 수수께끼를 풀고 싶은가 보군요? 반가워요.
Reincarnation#001.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#002.src: My name is Batelu. Lately, I've been studying these strange symbols on the walls.
Reincarnation#002.dst: 제 이름은 Batelu예요. 요즘 벽에 있는 이 이상한 기호들을 연구하고 있죠.
Reincarnation#002.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#003.src: It's about Bob. Hopefully you do not believe the stories of his death, right? Bob couldn't have died so easily. Not to something so mundane as a wolf.
Reincarnation#003.dst: Bob에 관한 거예요. 설마 그가 죽었다는 이야기를 믿는 건 아니죠? Bob은 그렇게 쉽게 죽을 리 없어요. 늑대 같은 평범한 것에게는 더더욱요.
Reincarnation#003.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#004.src: He wasn't only strong, he was absolutely un-killable, a master in almost every skill.
Reincarnation#004.dst: 그는 강하기만 한 게 아니라 절대 죽지 않는 존재였어요. 거의 모든 기술의 달인이었죠.
Reincarnation#004.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#005.src: I believe he knew he was about to die. How? What of? Nobody knows, but he left this world prepared.
Reincarnation#005.dst: 그는 자기가 죽을 걸 알았던 것 같아요. 어떻게? 무엇 때문에? 아무도 모르지만, 준비를 마치고 떠났어요.
Reincarnation#005.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#006.src: You see, it says here Bob had three loyal animals. Before dying, he scattered them across the ocean.
Reincarnation#006.dst: 보세요, 여기 Bob에게 충실한 동물이 셋 있었다고 쓰여 있어요. 죽기 전에 그 동물들을 바다 곳곳에 흩어 놓았죠.
Reincarnation#006.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#007.src: I think those animals are the key to accessing his real tomb...
Reincarnation#007.dst: 그 동물들이 그의 진짜 무덤에 들어가는 열쇠인 것 같아요...
Reincarnation#007.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#008.src: You see that little gap right there? It's the entrance...
Reincarnation#008.dst: 저기 작은 틈 보이죠? 저게 입구예요...
Reincarnation#008.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#009.src: Unfortunately, nobody was able to remove the spell blocking it.
Reincarnation#009.dst: 안타깝게도 그걸 막은 주문을 푼 사람은 아무도 없어요.
Reincarnation#009.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#010.src: But I do. I know how to open the passage to Bob. This is where the animals come in useful...
Reincarnation#010.dst: 하지만 저는 알아요. Bob에게 가는 통로를 여는 법을요. 여기서 동물들이 쓸모가 있죠...
Reincarnation#010.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#011.src: I believe Bob did something to those animals. I think if we could reunite them in some way, we could open the passage.
Reincarnation#011.dst: Bob이 그 동물들에게 뭔가를 한 것 같아요. 어떻게든 그들을 다시 모으면 통로를 열 수 있을 거예요.
Reincarnation#011.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#012.src: Bring me {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, {~} Baab's Wool & {~} Mooington's Skin if you can find them.
Reincarnation#012.dst: 찾을 수 있다면 Cluckles' Favourite Feather {~}개, Baab's Wool {~}개, Mooington's Skin {~}개를 가져다주세요.
Reincarnation#012.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#013.src: I am sure that together, we can open the passage. Good luck.
Reincarnation#013.dst: 함께라면 분명 통로를 열 수 있을 거예요. 행운을 빌어요.
Reincarnation#013.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#014.src: Bring back {~} Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, and Mooington's Skin to Batelu.
Reincarnation#014.dst: Cluckles' Favourite Feather, Baab's Wool, Mooington's Skin을 {~}개씩 Batelu에게 가져가세요.

Reincarnation#015.src: Wonderful! We can now open the passage to the true tomb of Bob...
Reincarnation#015.dst: 훌륭해요! 이제 Bob의 진짜 무덤으로 가는 통로를 열 수 있어요...
Reincarnation#015.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#016.src: I am not worthy enough to enter it. I did not complete the task of the animals, merely read it. You shall go alone, be careful.
Reincarnation#016.dst: 저는 들어갈 자격이 없어요. 동물들의 과업을 완수한 게 아니라 읽었을 뿐이니까요. 혼자 가셔야 해요, 조심하세요.
Reincarnation#016.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#018.src: I am Bob, master of the arts of Wynn.
Reincarnation#018.dst: 나는 Bob, Wynn의 모든 기예의 달인이다.
Reincarnation#018.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#019.src: Let me explain why you are here.
Reincarnation#019.dst: 네가 왜 여기 있는지 설명해 주마.
Reincarnation#019.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#020.src: My animals, were my greatest allies in my travels through the world.
Reincarnation#020.dst: 내 동물들은 세상을 여행할 때 가장 든든한 동료였다.
Reincarnation#020.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#021.src: I travelled too far, mined too deep, and of course challenged what should not be challenged. My time in Wynn was coming to an end.
Reincarnation#021.dst: 너무 멀리 여행했고, 너무 깊이 파고들었으며, 물론 도전해선 안 될 것에 도전했지. Wynn에서의 내 시간은 끝나 가고 있었다.
Reincarnation#021.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#022.src: I knew so, too. But I refused to leave without giving the power i had attained to those worthy of it.
Reincarnation#022.dst: 나도 그걸 알았다. 하지만 내가 얻은 힘을 자격 있는 자에게 넘기지 않고 떠날 순 없었지.
Reincarnation#022.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#023.src: Using what ability I had left to me, I transferred my power to my animals, in three pieces. In the hope that those worthy to harness it will seek them out.
Reincarnation#023.dst: 남은 힘을 짜내 내 힘을 세 조각으로 나눠 동물들에게 옮겼다. 그 힘을 다룰 자격 있는 자가 그들을 찾아 나서길 바라며.
Reincarnation#023.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#024.src: The spell I placed on the door to this realm will only break to the one who collects my power. But it cannot have escaped your notice, you do not have my power.
Reincarnation#024.dst: 이 영역의 문에 건 주문은 내 힘을 모은 자에게만 풀린다. 하지만 너도 눈치챘겠지. 너에겐 내 힘이 없다.
Reincarnation#024.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#025.src: The truth is, you must pass a test, the ultimate test. Hone your skills you have learnt throughout your travels, and face me. Face me, and earn your place amongst soldiers of Wynn.
Reincarnation#025.dst: 사실, 너는 시험을, 궁극의 시험을 통과해야 한다. 여행하며 배운 기술을 갈고닦아 나와 맞서라. 나와 맞서 Wynn의 전사들 사이에 네 자리를 얻어라.
Reincarnation#025.speaker: Bob

Reincarnation#026.src: Bring back {~} Bob's Seal of Approval to Batelu.
Reincarnation#026.dst: Bob's Seal of Approval {~}개를 Batelu에게 가져가세요.

Reincarnation#027.src: Ah! You have returned! Tell me, what did you find within?
Reincarnation#027.dst: 아! 돌아왔군요! 말해 주세요, 안에서 뭘 찾았나요?
Reincarnation#027.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#028.src: ...You faced Bob himself in combat? And you triumphed? That's quite remarkable!
Reincarnation#028.dst: ...Bob 본인과 싸웠다고요? 그리고 이겼다고요? 정말 대단하네요!
Reincarnation#028.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#029.src: And he gave you his Seal of Approval... Hm. If that is the case, then there is something I may do for you.
Reincarnation#029.dst: 그리고 그가 인장을 줬다니... 흠. 그렇다면 제가 해 드릴 수 있는 게 있어요.
Reincarnation#029.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#030.src: Before Bob passed, he left his mythical weapons with a trusted friend. They were, so he said, to be kept for one who would be worthy to wield them...
Reincarnation#030.dst: Bob은 죽기 전에 믿을 만한 친구에게 신화 무기들을 맡겼어요. 그의 말로는, 그걸 휘두를 자격이 있는 자를 위해 보관하라고 했대요...
Reincarnation#030.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#031.src: Yes... Yes, I am certain. You have proven yourself worthy. Take this relic, the Stone of Myths, and bring it to the Temple of the Legends.
Reincarnation#031.dst: 네... 네, 확실해요. 당신은 자격을 증명했어요. 이 유물, 신화의 돌을 가지고 전설의 신전으로 가세요.
Reincarnation#031.speaker: Batelu

Reincarnation#032.src: Within, you will find a merchant who will offer you a weapon in exchange for it. I wish you luck with your future travels.
Reincarnation#032.dst: 안에 들어가면 그걸 받고 무기를 내줄 상인이 있을 거예요. 앞으로의 여정에 행운이 있길 바라요.
Reincarnation#032.speaker: Batelu

Revelations in Fall#000.src: They had the potential to be dangerous. Sometimes, they were. But more often than not, they were heroes. They used their power to protect people in need.
Revelations in Fall#000.dst: 그들은 위험해질 가능성이 있었어. 때로는 실제로 위험했지. 하지만 대개는 영웅이었어. 힘을 써서 도움이 필요한 사람들을 지켰지.

Revelations in Fall#002.src: Attend the meeting in the resistance camp at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#003.src: Hello, everyone. Thank you for being here today.
Revelations in Fall#003.dst: 다들 안녕. 오늘 와 줘서 고마워.
Revelations in Fall#003.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#004.src: It has been growing increasingly clear that there is very little we can do here to make a larger impact on Fruma.
Revelations in Fall#004.dst: 여기서는 Fruma에 더 큰 영향을 주기 어렵다는 게 점점 분명해지고 있어.
Revelations in Fall#004.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#005.src: We have been doing good for the people of Auburn! But our resources are limited, and our opportunities to take action are even more so.
Revelations in Fall#005.dst: 우린 Auburn 사람들을 위해 좋은 일을 해 왔어! 하지만 자원은 한정됐고, 행동할 기회는 더더욱 적어.
Revelations in Fall#005.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#006.src: Additionally, our risks of operation grow by the day. I do not regret taking in {u} as a member, but it's no secret that we risk more scrutiny by having them here.
Revelations in Fall#006.dst: 게다가 우리 활동의 위험은 날로 커지고 있어. {u}을(를) 일원으로 받아들인 걸 후회하진 않지만, 그들이 여기 있으면 더 주목받을 위험이 있다는 건 모두가 알아.
Revelations in Fall#006.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#007.src: Zeph and {u} learned yesterday that an Inquisitor is arriving in the area. We don't know what for exactly, but their presence further endangers our cause.
Revelations in Fall#007.dst: Zeph와 {u}이(가) 어제 알아냈는데, 심문관이 이 지역에 온대. 목적은 정확히 모르지만, 그 존재만으로도 우리 대의가 더 위험해져.
Revelations in Fall#007.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#008.src: At the festival, I received word from a contact in the Roughworks. There's a group similar to ours there, run by an old friend of mine they're called the Steel Feather.
Revelations in Fall#008.dst: 축제에서 Roughworks의 연락원에게 소식을 받았어. 거기에 우리와 비슷한 조직이 있는데, 내 옛 친구가 이끄는 Steel Feather라는 곳이야.
Revelations in Fall#008.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#009.src: They have resources we don't, and are situated in a much more favorable position. If we're able to cross through to the Roughworks, they've agreed to host us and help plan our next moves.
Revelations in Fall#009.dst: 그들에겐 우리에게 없는 자원이 있고, 훨씬 유리한 위치에 있어. Roughworks로 건너갈 수만 있다면 우릴 받아 주고 다음 행보를 같이 계획하기로 했어.
Revelations in Fall#009.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#010.src: So, what are our next moves? I don't know what you expect us to do there that we're not already able to do here.
Revelations in Fall#010.dst: 그래서, 다음 행보가 뭔데? 여기서 못 하는 걸 거기서 우리가 뭘 하길 바라는지 모르겠네.
Revelations in Fall#010.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#011.src: I'm still workshopping ideas, but they involve the Crown Festival. If we move quickly, we'll be able to catch it in the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#011.dst: 아직 구상 중이지만, 왕관 축제와 관련이 있어. 서두르면 Roughworks의 축제에 맞출 수 있어.
Revelations in Fall#011.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#012.src: Of course, traveling to a different district presents its own risks and dangers... if any of you wish to stay here, I will respect that decision.
Revelations in Fall#012.dst: 물론 다른 구역으로 가는 건 그 나름의 위험이 따르지... 여기 남고 싶은 사람이 있다면 그 결정을 존중할게.
Revelations in Fall#012.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#013.src: Ha! And leave you to strategize all on your own? I had foreseen something along these lines, so I have already made arrangements with my work. I will join you, miss.
Revelations in Fall#013.dst: 하! 그리고 너 혼자 작전을 짜게 두라고? 이런 일이 있을 줄 예상하고 일터에는 이미 말해 뒀어. 나도 함께하지, 아가씨.
Revelations in Fall#013.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#014.src: An I'm definitely not sitting this one out, are you kidding? I'll follow you wherever you go, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.dst: 그리고 난 절대 빠질 생각 없어, 농담해? 어디든 따라갈게, Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#014.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#015.src: I- I'll go too! Wh- what's the point of hav- having magic if I don't use it for our c- c- cause?
Revelations in Fall#015.dst: 나- 나도 갈래! 우, 우리 대- 대의에 안 쓸 거면 마법이 무- 무슨 소용이야?
Revelations in Fall#015.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#016.src: Eh. Don't see myself bein' much use out there, to tell you the truth, Synny. And I figure you need someone to hold down the fort while you're gone, anyhow. So I'll stay.
Revelations in Fall#016.dst: 에. 솔직히 난 밖에서 별 쓸모없을 것 같다, Synny. 그리고 너희가 없는 동안 누군가는 집을 지켜야지. 그러니 난 남으마.
Revelations in Fall#016.speaker: Kaio

Revelations in Fall#017.src: That would be appreciated, Kaio. I'll feel more comfortable leaving, knowing the LEaves in the Wind is safe in your care.
Revelations in Fall#017.dst: 그래 주면 고맙겠어, Kaio. 바람 속 잎새를 네가 지켜 준다니 마음 편히 떠날 수 있겠어.
Revelations in Fall#017.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#020.src: You'll... need my medicine. So I'll go...
Revelations in Fall#020.dst: 내... 약이 필요할 거야. 그러니 갈게...
Revelations in Fall#020.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#021.src: Sui... you can stay, if you want. I don't want to force you
Revelations in Fall#021.dst: Sui... 원하면 남아도 돼. 억지로 데려가고 싶진 않아
Revelations in Fall#021.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#022.src: N-no! I want to go with you! I just... I need to say goodbye to some people. Before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#022.dst: 아, 아니! 같이 갈래! 그냥... 인사할 사람들이 있어. 떠나기 전에.
Revelations in Fall#022.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#025.src: I'm forever in your debt. Thank you, again, for offering your help.
Revelations in Fall#025.dst: 평생 갚지 못할 빚을 졌어. 도와준다고 해 줘서 다시 한번 고마워.
Revelations in Fall#025.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#026.src: In Wynn, we have stories of people who could use magic like you. It came naturally to them, and they didn't need a focus for it.
Revelations in Fall#026.dst: Wynn에는 너처럼 마법을 쓰는 사람들 이야기가 있어. 그들에겐 타고난 능력이라 매개체가 필요 없었지.

Revelations in Fall#027.src: Sigh... I wish I could disagree. But you're right, I need you to join us.
Revelations in Fall#027.dst: 하아... 반박하고 싶지만. 네 말이 맞아, 네가 함께해야 해.
Revelations in Fall#027.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#028.src: I still need to make preparations before we leave- namely, arranging passage across the border. I have a contact that I can... hopefully convince to help.
Revelations in Fall#028.dst: 떠나기 전에 준비할 게 남았어- 바로 국경 통행 문제지. 연락책이 하나 있는데... 도와주게 설득할 수 있길 바라.
Revelations in Fall#028.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#029.src: You- you can't pos- possibly mean
Revelations in Fall#029.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#030.src: Yes, Zeph, I do. It will be fine.
Revelations in Fall#030.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#031.src: As for the rest of you, you should make your own preparations. I don't know how long the window of opportunity will be, so make the most of the time left.
Revelations in Fall#031.dst: 나머지는 각자 준비해. 기회가 얼마나 갈지 모르니까, 남은 시간을 잘 써.
Revelations in Fall#031.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#032.src: Hmn... Zeph, why the concern? We all know miss Syndra knows what she's doing! If she claims to have the situation covered, then I see no reason to doubt her!
Revelations in Fall#032.dst: 흠... Zeph, 왜 걱정해? Syndra 아가씨가 뭘 하는지 다 알잖아! 알아서 한다고 했으면 의심할 이유가 없지!
Revelations in Fall#032.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#034.src: Ah, no matter! Come now, other children... and {u}, of course! Let us all take some time to say our goodbyes. We don't know when we'll be back, after all!
Revelations in Fall#034.dst: 아, 상관없어! 자, 다른 아이들... 그리고 물론 {u}도! 다 같이 작별 인사할 시간을 갖자. 언제 돌아올지 모르니까!
Revelations in Fall#034.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#035.src: If we'll be back at all...
Revelations in Fall#035.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#036.src: Sui... we will be back. I'll make sure of it! And you know I always keep my word for matters such as these.
Revelations in Fall#036.dst: Sui... 우린 돌아올 거야. 내가 꼭 그렇게 할게! 이런 일엔 내가 늘 약속을 지키는 거 알잖아.
Revelations in Fall#036.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#037.src: We'll be fine, Sui. We always are.
Revelations in Fall#037.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#039.src: Talk with Zeph outside the base at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#041.src: I don't know if I- I'm ready for this.
Revelations in Fall#041.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#042.src: But I have to be! I... I have to.
Revelations in Fall#042.dst: 그래도 해야 해! 난... 해야만 해.
Revelations in Fall#042.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#044.src: So... I r- really don't trust the Sovereign, and I- I- I'm afraid he might do s- so- something to Syndra.
Revelations in Fall#044.dst: 그게... 난 군주를 저- 정말 못 믿겠어, 그, 그가 Syndra한테 무- 무슨 짓을 할까 봐 무서워.
Revelations in Fall#044.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#045.src: It- it's silly, but... if y- you and I can fi- find a way over the wall without having to ask him d- directly, we could avoid a- a potential con- conflict.
Revelations in Fall#045.dst: 바- 바보 같지만... 너- 너랑 내가 그한테 지- 직접 부탁 안 하고 벽을 넘을 방법을 차- 찾으면, 추- 충돌을 피할 수 있잖아.
Revelations in Fall#045.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#046.src: And besides, it's not like I have a- any- anything better to do...
Revelations in Fall#046.dst: 게다가 딱- 딱히 할 일도 없고...
Revelations in Fall#046.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#047.src: So! L- let's head into town, and s- s- see if we can
Revelations in Fall#047.dst: 그러니까! 마- 마을로 가서, 우리가 할 수 있는지 보- 보자
Revelations in Fall#047.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#048.src: Um... excuse me, s-sorry to interrupt I overheard you were... going into town?
Revelations in Fall#048.dst: 음... 저기, 끼- 끼어들어서 미안한데 마을에... 간다고 들었어?
Revelations in Fall#048.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#049.src: Sui! Y- yeah, we were pl- planning on it.
Revelations in Fall#049.dst: Sui! 으- 응, 그럴 생- 생각이야.
Revelations in Fall#049.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#050.src: If... if it wouldn't be too much trouble... could I maybe go with you? I, ah... have some people I want to... say goodbye to.
Revelations in Fall#050.dst: 혹시... 폐가 안 된다면... 나도 같이 가도 될까? 나, 아... 작별 인사할 사람들이 있어서.
Revelations in Fall#050.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#051.src: Oh... the people at the R- Re- the Red Fox?
Revelations in Fall#051.dst: 아... 레- 레- Red Fox 사람들?
Revelations in Fall#051.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#052.src: It's... a restaurant I, um, frequent. The owners are... nice. I wanted to thank them, for, ha, everything.
Revelations in Fall#052.dst: 거긴... 내가, 음, 자주 가는 식당이야. 주인분들이... 친절해. 하, 그동안 다 고마웠다고 하고 싶어.
Revelations in Fall#052.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#053.src: It's built atop one of th- the tallest tr- trees in {p}, too... so it'll w- wo- work for my idea too. It's jus- just outside {p}'s gates.
Revelations in Fall#053.dst: {p}에서 제일 높은 나- 나무 위에 지었으니까... 내 계획에도 딱- 딱 맞아. {p} 성문 바- 바로 밖이야.
Revelations in Fall#053.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#054.src: Head to the Red Fox treetop café at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Revelations in Fall#054.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Red Fox 나무 위 카페로 가세요.

Revelations in Fall#055.src: L- let's all meet up at the Re- Red Fox café. It's just ou- out- outside the {p} Gates.
Revelations in Fall#055.dst: 다- 다 같이 레- Red Fox 카페에서 만나자. {p} 성문 바- 바- 바로 밖이야.
Revelations in Fall#055.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#057.src: So, wh- what do you think? It's a n- nice view from up here, is- isn't it?
Revelations in Fall#057.dst: 그래서, 어- 어때? 여기서 보는 경치 조- 좋지, 그- 그렇지?
Revelations in Fall#057.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#058.src: I... bring the others here quite often. They, um, serve the best food in {p}...

Revelations in Fall#058.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#059.src: Yeah... I'll m- mi- miss our late-night snack runs. Heh.
Revelations in Fall#059.dst: 응... 밤에 간식 먹으러 오던 거 그- 그리- 그리울 거야. 헤.

Revelations in Fall#061.src: S- Sui, do you... want us t- to stay? We can
Revelations in Fall#061.dst: S- Sui, 우리가... 남아 주- 줄까? 우린
Revelations in Fall#061.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#062.src: N-no! No, no, it's... fine. I'll go find Chen on my own. You two, um, hand something you were going to do, right?
Revelations in Fall#062.dst: 아, 아니! 아니, 아니, 괜찮... 아. Chen은 혼자 찾아갈게. 너희 둘은, 음, 할 일 있었잖아, 그치?

Revelations in Fall#063.dst: 있긴... 어, 네- 네가 괜찮다면, Sui. 이따 보- 보자?

Revelations in Fall#064.src: Y... yes. Um, good... good luck!
Revelations in Fall#064.dst: 으... 응. 음, 잘... 잘 다녀와!
Revelations in Fall#064.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#065.src: ...okay. Well, {u}, the re- reason we came here... from up h- he- from up here, we have good access to the r- roof- rooftops.
Revelations in Fall#065.dst: ...좋아. 자, {u}, 여기 온 이- 이유는... 여기 위- 위에서, 지- 지붕으로 쉽게 갈 수 있거든.

Revelations in Fall#066.dst: 벽을 너- 너- 넘을 수 있는지 보고 싶어. 지- 지붕으로만 다니면 의심을 피- 피할 수 있을 거야...
Revelations in Fall#066.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#069.src: Ah, Sui! What a pleasure to see you as always!

Revelations in Fall#070.src: Hi, Chen... is, um, business going well?
Revelations in Fall#070.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#071.src: Hum, as well as one can hope, I would say! The Festival does always bring a rush of customers. So, should I prepare the usual for you?
Revelations in Fall#071.dst: 흠, 바랄 수 있는 만큼은 잘되지! 축제 땐 늘 손님이 몰리거든. 그래, 늘 먹던 걸로 준비해 줄까?
Revelations in Fall#071.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#072.src: Oh. Um... that's very kind of you, but, no, not today. Thank you.
Revelations in Fall#072.dst: 아. 음... 정말 고맙지만, 아니, 오늘은 괜찮아. 고마워.
Revelations in Fall#072.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#073.src: Very well, very well. Well, since you're here, might I ask if you've had a thought about my job offer?
Revelations in Fall#073.dst: 그래, 그래. 그럼 온 김에 묻자꾸나, 내 일자리 제안은 생각해 봤니?
Revelations in Fall#073.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#074.src: You basically know our menu inside and out by this point, so I do truly think you'd be a great fit.
Revelations in Fall#074.dst: 이제 우리 메뉴는 속속들이 알고 있으니, 넌 정말 딱 맞을 거라고 생각한단다.
Revelations in Fall#074.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#076.src: Okay, so... just f- fo- follow the green trails !
Revelations in Fall#076.dst: 좋아, 그러니까... 초록색 길만 따- 따- 따라가!

Revelations in Fall#077.src: If you g- get lost, meet me back here.
Revelations in Fall#077.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#080.src: Do you, uh, w- want to take a break?
Revelations in Fall#080.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#081.src: Alright, g- good luck! Just re- remember to follow the green trail.
Revelations in Fall#081.dst: 좋아, 해- 행운을 빌어! 초록색 길만 따라가는 거 기- 기억해.
Revelations in Fall#081.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#082.src: I- I'll follow you soon, I'm just w- war- warming up a bit first.
Revelations in Fall#082.dst: 나- 나도 곧 따라갈게, 먼저 모- 몸 좀 풀고.
Revelations in Fall#082.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#084.src: Just re- return here when you're ready to st- start again.
Revelations in Fall#084.dst: 다시 시- 시작할 준비 되면 여기로 돌아와.
Revelations in Fall#084.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#085.src: Ha, I- I guess you got here b- be- before me this time!
Revelations in Fall#085.dst: 하, 이번엔 네가 머- 먼저 왔구나!
Revelations in Fall#085.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#088.src: Aah! I... I... th- that was... c- cl- close.
Revelations in Fall#088.dst: 으악! 나... 나... 바- 방금... 아- 아슬아슬했어.
Revelations in Fall#088.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#089.src: That was... th- that was m- magic, wasn't it...? It was l- li- it was like my whole body was... w- was en- engulfed by a, a g- ge- gentle breeze...
Revelations in Fall#089.dst: 방금... 그- 그거 마- 마법이었지...? 마치- 마치 온몸이... 부- 부드러운 바람에 가- 감싸인 것 같았어...
Revelations in Fall#089.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#090.src: I... ha. Th- that was- e- e- exhilarating, but... b- but... Th- there- there's no way we c- ca- we can get across these r- ro- rooftops... one c- cl- one close call is enough f- for me.
Revelations in Fall#090.dst: 나... 하. 그- 그거- 짜- 짜릿했지만... 하- 하지만... 이 지- 지붕들로는 저- 절대 못 건너가... 한 번 아- 아슬아슬했으면 나- 난 충분해.
Revelations in Fall#090.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#091.src: Ugh... l- let's just... get back to the R- Red Fox...
Revelations in Fall#091.dst: 으... 그- 그냥... Red Fox로 돌아가자...
Revelations in Fall#091.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#092.src: Return to The Red Fox and talk to Zeph at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#093.src: I just... I- I- I don't like it. I don't like that S- Syn- Syndra's putting herself in- in danger like that!
Revelations in Fall#093.dst: 난 그냥... 싫- 싫어. S- Syn- Syndra가 저렇게 위- 위험에 뛰어드는 게 싫다고!
Revelations in Fall#093.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#094.src: I... I owe her a lot. If it weren't for her, I- I- I'd still be st- stuck on the... the st- str- streets. It's thanks to her that I'm still... here.
Revelations in Fall#094.dst: 난... Syndra한테 빚이 많아. 그녀가 아니었으면 난 아- 아직도... 거- 거리에 있었을 거야. 내가 아직... 여기 있는 건 그녀 덕분이야.
Revelations in Fall#094.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#095.src: Yeah... I, uh, grew up in a- a small village. S- someone was accused of being c- cursed, and... my people refused to h- ha- hand them over without a- a- wi- without a fight.
Revelations in Fall#095.dst: 응... 난, 어, 자- 작은 마을에서 자랐어. 누- 누가 저주받았다는 누명을 쓰고, 우리 마을 사람들은 싸- 싸움 없이는 그 사람을 내- 내주지 않겠다고 했어.
Revelations in Fall#095.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#096.src: ...actually, wh- where is she? I th- thought she'd wait for us before...
Revelations in Fall#096.dst: ...그런데, 그- 그녀는 어디 있지? 우릴 기다릴 줄 아- 알았는데...
Revelations in Fall#096.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#097.src: Ah, Zeph, is that you I hear?
Revelations in Fall#097.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#098.src: Oh, h- hey Chen. I need to get going, but have you seen Sui? We were g- go- going to meet up here.
Revelations in Fall#098.dst: 아, 아- 안녕 Chen. 가 봐야 하는데, Sui 봤어? 여기서 마- 만나기로 했거든.
Revelations in Fall#098.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#099.src: Yes, Sui... she left not long ago. The poor girl, clearly something is weighing on her...
Revelations in Fall#099.dst: 그래, Sui... 조금 전에 나갔단다. 불쌍한 아이, 뭔가 마음에 걸리는 게 있는 게 분명해...
Revelations in Fall#099.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#100.src: I believe she would have gone to the pond to the southeast... that is where she usually goes when she needs some air.
Revelations in Fall#100.dst: 아마 남동쪽 연못으로 갔을 거야... 바람 쐬고 싶을 때 늘 가는 곳이거든.
Revelations in Fall#100.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#101.src: Oh, I s- see. Th- thank you for the help!
Revelations in Fall#101.dst: 아, 그- 그렇구나. 도- 도와줘서 고마워!
Revelations in Fall#101.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#102.src: Of course, anything for you children. Stop by again soon, would you? I'll make you all the family platter, on the house.
Revelations in Fall#102.dst: 물론이지, 너희를 위해서라면 뭐든. 곧 또 들르렴? 가족 모둠 요리를 대접하마, 공짜로.
Revelations in Fall#102.speaker: Red Fox Owner

Revelations in Fall#103.src: I... y- yeah, we... we will! Thanks for the off- offer.
Revelations in Fall#103.dst: 나... 으- 응, 우리... 올게! 제- 제안 고마워.
Revelations in Fall#103.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#105.src: {u}, can I ask you a f- fa- favour?
Revelations in Fall#105.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#106.src: Could you ch- check on Sui for me, p- please? I... I don't know h- how to help her, right now...
Revelations in Fall#106.dst: 나 대신 Sui 좀 사- 살펴봐 줄래? 난... 지금은 어- 어떻게 도와야 할지 모르겠어...
Revelations in Fall#106.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#107.src: S- some- something's on her mind, but... b- but she won't tell me about it. I've tr- tried asking, but...
Revelations in Fall#107.dst: 무- 무슨 고민이 있는데... 나- 나한텐 말을 안 해. 물어는 봤- 봤는데...
Revelations in Fall#107.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#108.src: ...but if you ask, ma- maybe she'll tell you? I- I don't know. It's worth a try, at- at least, r- r- right?
Revelations in Fall#108.dst: ...네가 물어보면 마- 말해 줄지도? 나- 나도 몰라. 저- 적어도 해 볼 만하잖아, 그- 그렇지?
Revelations in Fall#108.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#109.src: Th- thanks, {u}. Chen said she w- was at the pond to the southeast.
Revelations in Fall#109.dst: 고- 고마워, {u}. Chen이 그러는데 남동쪽 연못에 있대.
Revelations in Fall#109.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#110.src: Meet up with Sui near the pond at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#112.src: O-oh, {u}! I didn't... um, expect to see you here.
Revelations in Fall#112.dst: 어- 어, {u}! 여기서... 음, 볼 줄은 몰랐어.
Revelations in Fall#112.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#113.src: Oh... right. I just... needed some air. It's, hah, kind of a lot. L-leaving Auburn, I mean! I've never... known anywhere else.
Revelations in Fall#113.dst: 아... 맞아. 그냥... 바람 좀 쐬고 싶었어. 하, 좀 벅차서. A- Auburn을 떠나는 거 말이야! 다른 곳은... 전혀 몰라.
Revelations in Fall#113.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#115.src: Can I... tell you something? I was... I wanted to talk to you, earlier, but, um, I... I couldn't build up the courage.
Revelations in Fall#115.dst: 저기... 얘기 하나 해도 돼? 아까... 너랑 얘기하고 싶었는데, 음, 난... 용기가 안 났어.
Revelations in Fall#115.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#117.src: S-sorry, I should just... go for it. It- it might be easier if I just, show you, hah...
Revelations in Fall#117.dst: 미- 미안, 그냥... 말해야지. 그냥, 보여 주는 게 더 쉬울지도, 하...
Revelations in Fall#117.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#118.src: You're the first, um, cursed one I've ever... seen. And- and everyone being so kind, about, all of it...
Revelations in Fall#118.dst: 넌, 음, 내가 처음... 본 저주받은 자야. 그리고- 그리고 다들 그 모든 걸, 너무 너그럽게 받아들여서...
Revelations in Fall#118.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#119.src: And, I thought, maybe... maybe you could... help. Me. W-with figuring it all out.
Revelations in Fall#119.dst: 그래서, 혹시... 네가... 도와줄 수 있을까 했어. 나를. 이 모든 걸 이- 이해하는 걸.
Revelations in Fall#119.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#121.src: But... I don't use, um, a focus. To... to control water. S-so, that means I'm, one of the... d-dangerous ones. That's... th-that's what Mora said, um, earlier.
Revelations in Fall#121.dst: 하지만... 난, 음, 매개체 없이... 물을 다뤄. 그- 그러니까 난... 위- 위험한 쪽이라는 거지. 그게... 그- 그게 아까 Mora가, 음, 한 말이야.
Revelations in Fall#121.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#122.dst: 너- 넌 그걸 알 수 없잖아!
Revelations in Fall#122.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#125.src: Oh... g-good. That's- that's good. I'm glad.
Revelations in Fall#125.dst: 아... 다- 다행이다. 그거- 그거 다행이야. 기뻐.
Revelations in Fall#125.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#126.src: Oh... that's, ha, a big thing to do for someone. B-breaking into a province? I can't imagine, um, doing something like that...
Revelations in Fall#126.dst: 아... 그건, 하, 누군가를 위해 하기엔 엄청난 일이네. 지- 지방에 잠입하다니? 난 상상도 못 하겠어, 음, 그런 일은...
Revelations in Fall#126.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#128.src: I'm just... scared. I'm scared that- that if I try to use it, then, I'll, h-hurt someone...
Revelations in Fall#128.dst: 난 그냥... 무서워. 내가 그걸 쓰려고 하면- 그러면, 내가, 누, 누군가를 다치게 할까 봐...
Revelations in Fall#128.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#129.src: I'm... not very brave, haha. I didn't, really, join the resistance because... because I wanted to stand up against the crown!
Revelations in Fall#129.dst: 난... 별로 용감하지 않아, 하하. 내가 저항군에 들어온 건, 사실... 왕실에 맞서고 싶어서가 아니었어!
Revelations in Fall#129.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#130.src: Something like that, it feels... impossible.
Revelations in Fall#130.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#131.src: ... I'm only here because I followed Mora. He's the brave one! N-not- not me. I just, ha, had nowhere else to go.
Revelations in Fall#131.dst: ... 난 Mora를 따라와서 여기 있을 뿐이야. 용감한 건 오빠지! 나- 난- 내가 아니라. 난 그냥, 하, 갈 데가 없었어.
Revelations in Fall#131.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#132.src: And- and everyone else is so, excited about m-ma-magic! Even, um, Mora. And here I am, too afraid to- to even try!
Revelations in Fall#132.dst: 그리고- 그리고 다들 마- 마- 마법에 들떠 있어! 음, Mora까지도. 그런데 난, 너무 무서워서- 시도조차 못 해!
Revelations in Fall#132.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#134.src: Yeah, but... it- it wouldn't feel, um, right. If the rest of my family is going, then, ha, how could I not go with them?
Revelations in Fall#134.dst: 응, 하지만... 그- 그건, 음, 옳지 않은 것 같아. 다른 가족이 다 가는데, 하, 내가 어떻게 안 가?
Revelations in Fall#134.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#135.src: What if... something happened to them- to you - and, and, and- and I wasn't, there? I'd... I'd never f-forgive myself!
Revelations in Fall#135.dst: 만약... 그들에게- 너에게 무슨 일이 생겼는데, 그, 그, 그런데- 내가, 거기 없었다면? 난... 난 절대 나, 날 용서 못 할 거야!
Revelations in Fall#135.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#136.src: So... s-so, even if I'm scared... I can't stay behind.
Revelations in Fall#136.dst: 그래서... 그- 그래서, 무서워도... 남을 순 없어.
Revelations in Fall#136.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#137.src: ...I'm, um, not much of a fighter. But I'm still good with m-medicine, and healing. So... I can help.
Revelations in Fall#137.dst: ...난, 음, 싸움은 잘 못해. 하지만 야- 약이랑 치료는 여전히 자신 있어. 그러니까... 도울 수 있어.
Revelations in Fall#137.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#138.src: Let's... get back home. I should tell Zeph I'm alright.
Revelations in Fall#138.dst: 우리... 집에 가자. Zeph한테 괜찮다고 말해야겠어.
Revelations in Fall#138.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#139.src: Return to the Leaves in the Wind at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#140.src: Thank you for listening to me.
Revelations in Fall#140.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#141.src: I... I want to help. I'm just... scared.
Revelations in Fall#141.dst: 나... 나도 돕고 싶어. 그냥... 무서워.
Revelations in Fall#141.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#142.src: Hrmm... ah, {u}, just the leaf I was looking to find!
Revelations in Fall#142.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#143.src: I am nearly finished with preparations for our expedition. Supplies packed, goodbyes said, and so on and so forth.
Revelations in Fall#143.dst: 원정 준비가 거의 끝났어. 짐도 싸고, 작별 인사도 하고, 기타 등등 말이지.
Revelations in Fall#143.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#144.src: There is... one last thing, however. If I may ask you for a favor?
Revelations in Fall#144.dst: 그런데... 마지막으로 하나 남았어. 부탁 하나 해도 될까?
Revelations in Fall#144.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#145.src: Excellent! I thank you for your time.
Revelations in Fall#145.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#146.src: ...ah, a busy day, I take it? I promise it will be quick, if you would hear me out.
Revelations in Fall#146.dst: ...아, 바쁜 날인가 보군? 들어만 준다면 금방 끝날 거라고 약속하지.
Revelations in Fall#146.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#147.src: I had mentioned previously, your words on magic had resonated with me! I have been taking some time to practice, with the aid of cursory knowledge of military blessings.
Revelations in Fall#147.dst: 전에 말했듯이, 마법에 관한 네 말이 마음에 와닿았어! 군대 축복에 대한 얕은 지식의 도움을 받아 틈틈이 연습하고 있었지.
Revelations in Fall#147.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#148.src: But such training will do me little good in a true combat scenario. So, in the interest of improvement, I would ask for a sparring match against you!
Revelations in Fall#148.dst: 하지만 그런 훈련은 실전에선 별 도움이 안 될 거야. 그래서 실력을 키우려고, 너한테 대련을 청하고 싶어!
Revelations in Fall#148.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#149.src: It will help me to spot and shore up my weaknesses. Perhaps it will do the same for you!
Revelations in Fall#149.dst: 내 약점을 찾아서 보완하는 데 도움이 될 거야. 너한테도 그럴지 모르고!
Revelations in Fall#149.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#150.src: Come, follow me to our sparring arena!
Revelations in Fall#150.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#153.src: Oof... you are very talented, I must say!
Revelations in Fall#153.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#154.src: No wonder miss Syndra is so invested in you, having battled you herself!
Revelations in Fall#154.dst: Syndra 아가씨가 직접 싸워 봤으니, 너한테 그렇게 공을 들일 만하지!
Revelations in Fall#154.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#155.src: Now, tell me, how did I perform?
Revelations in Fall#155.dst: 자, 말해 봐, 내 실력은 어땠어?
Revelations in Fall#155.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#156.src: Really! In the moment, it did not feel like I stood much of a chance, but I suppose I am still learning to wield it!
Revelations in Fall#156.dst: 정말! 그땐 승산이 거의 없는 것 같았는데, 아직 다루는 법을 배우는 중인가 보군!
Revelations in Fall#156.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#157.src: It is odd, though. I have only learned of it recently, yet it fels as though the magic has been with me all along! It is like... muscle memory, I suppose? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#157.dst: 그런데 이상해. 알게 된 건 최근인데, 마법이 처음부터 내 안에 있었던 것 같아! 마치... 근육의 기억처럼? 생각할 게 많군.
Revelations in Fall#157.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#158.src: Ha! No need to sugarcoat it. I have always specialized in heavy attacks, so I struggle against swift opponents. Rarely have I managed to best Zeph in a spar!
Revelations in Fall#158.dst: 하! 포장할 필요 없어. 난 늘 무거운 공격이 특기라, 빠른 상대에게 약하지. 대련에서 Zeph를 이긴 적이 거의 없다니까!
Revelations in Fall#158.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#159.src: Perhaps therein lies the value of this magic... finding methods to raise area of effect, or slow targets down? Much to think about.
Revelations in Fall#159.dst: 어쩌면 그게 이 마법의 가치일지도... 범위를 넓히거나 상대를 느리게 하는 방법을 찾는 거지? 생각할 게 많군.
Revelations in Fall#159.speaker: Mora
