Revelations in Fall#160.src: An excellent question, though I have no true answers. Perhaps some of what I had learned from military sources has stuck with me?
Revelations in Fall#160.dst: 좋은 질문이지만, 확실한 답은 없어. 어쩌면 군대 쪽에서 배운 게 몸에 남아 있는 걸까?
Revelations in Fall#160.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#161.src: I do trust it will come to Zeph with time. He is persistent! That trait will serve him well for these purposes.
Revelations in Fall#161.dst: Zeph도 시간이 지나면 해낼 거라고 믿어. 끈기가 있거든! 그런 성격은 이런 일에 큰 도움이 될 거야.
Revelations in Fall#161.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#162.src: Hey, Mora! Have you seen- oh, there you are. I've been looking for you.
Revelations in Fall#162.dst: 야, Mora! 혹시 못 봤- 아, 거기 있었구나. 한참 찾았잖아.
Revelations in Fall#162.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#163.src: I had a friend... he was also from Fruma, and he was "cursed." And he was also struggling with that label, like you.
Revelations in Fall#163.dst: 내게 친구가 있었어... 그도 Fruma 출신이었고, "저주받은 자"였지. 그리고 너처럼 그 딱지 때문에 힘들어했어.

Revelations in Fall#164.src: But he found ways to make peace with it. He used his abilities to strengthen himself and his allies. He made a difference.
Revelations in Fall#164.dst: 하지만 그는 그걸 받아들이는 법을 찾았어. 자기 능력으로 자신과 동료들을 강하게 만들었지. 세상을 바꿨어.

Revelations in Fall#165.src: Alright, {u}, come with me. We are SORTING through our problems before we leave.
Revelations in Fall#165.dst: 좋아, {u}, 따라와. 떠나기 전에 우리 문제를 "정리"하자고.
Revelations in Fall#165.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#166.src: Come on, come on! To the giant tree stump, I don't have all day!
Revelations in Fall#166.dst: 빨리, 빨리! 거대한 그루터기로 가, 하루 종일 기다릴 순 없어!
Revelations in Fall#166.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#167.src: ... Ah. Oh dear. She appears to be in a mood today! I suppose that would make sense, given...
Revelations in Fall#167.dst: ... 아. 이런. 오늘 기분이 안 좋은가 보군! 뭐, 그럴 만도 하지, 그러니까...
Revelations in Fall#167.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#168.src: Hmm, how should I put it...? Ah, nevermind. You'd best follow her to the tree, see what she wants.
Revelations in Fall#168.dst: 흠, 뭐라고 해야 할까...? 아, 됐어. 나무까지 따라가서 뭘 원하는지 보는 게 좋겠어.
Revelations in Fall#168.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#169.src: Keep an eye on her for me, would you? Make sure she gets home safely.
Revelations in Fall#169.dst: 날 대신해 그녀를 지켜봐 줄래? 무사히 집에 오도록 말이야.
Revelations in Fall#169.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#170.src: Find Rex at the old tree stump at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#171.src: Keep an eye on Rex, would you? I haven't seen her this worked up in a while...
Revelations in Fall#171.dst: Rex 좀 지켜봐 줄래? 저렇게 흥분한 건 오랜만이야...
Revelations in Fall#171.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#172.src: Good, you came. Took you long enough!
Revelations in Fall#172.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#173.src: So, here's the deal! You are a problem.
Revelations in Fall#173.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#174.src: Sure, you've proven yourself a hundred times over! Over and over and over again, you've shown you're on our side.
Revelations in Fall#174.dst: 그래, 넌 백 번도 넘게 증명했지! 몇 번이고 몇 번이고, 우리 편이라는 걸 보여 줬어.
Revelations in Fall#174.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#175.src: And that's great! That's great and all! But. But but but but but! You're still. From. Wynn.
Revelations in Fall#175.dst: 그건 좋아! 아주 좋다고! 하지만. 하지만 하지만 하지만! 넌 여전히. Wynn. 출신이야.
Revelations in Fall#175.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#176.src: Or... originally from Fruma, whatever. That's actually the problem! If you were just from Wynn, maybe it wouldn't be so bad!
Revelations in Fall#176.dst: 아니면... 원래는 Fruma 출신이든, 뭐든. 사실 그게 문제야! 그냥 Wynn 출신이었으면 이렇게까지 나쁘진 않았을 텐데!
Revelations in Fall#176.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#177.src: There's oh so many people from Fruma who were shipped off to Wynn! They really like sending off the problem children whenever they can't deal with them anymore.
Revelations in Fall#177.dst: Fruma에서 Wynn으로 보내진 사람이 얼마나 많은데! 감당 못 할 말썽꾸러기는 틈만 나면 보내 버리는 게 취미라니까.
Revelations in Fall#177.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#178.src: So I get it! I do! It makes sense! But still... still, why, why... why does it get to be YOU here, and not- not...!
Revelations in Fall#178.dst: 그러니 이해해! 정말로! 말이 돼! 하지만... 그래도, 왜, 왜... 왜 여기 있는 게 너고, 그- 그가 아닌...!
Revelations in Fall#178.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#181.src: Oh, don't look at me like that.
Revelations in Fall#181.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#182.src: So I had a brother, right? And sure, he was an idiot sometimes, but- but he was the only one there who really understood me.
Revelations in Fall#182.dst: 나한테 오빠가 있었거든? 가끔 바보 같긴 했지만- 거기서 날 진짜 이해해 준 건 오빠뿐이었어.
Revelations in Fall#182.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#183.src: He's the one who carved my bow for me. He heard I was interested in archery, so he... when everyone else told me to just focus on schoolwork, he helped me learn.
Revelations in Fall#183.dst: 내 활도 오빠가 깎아 줬어. 내가 활쏘기에 관심 있다는 걸 듣고... 다들 공부나 하라고 할 때, 오빠는 배우게 도와줬어.
Revelations in Fall#183.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#184.src: He really hated all the rules we had up there. So he liked to break them. A lot. And eventually, the crown got sick of it. Packed him up, sent him to the Roughworks.
Revelations in Fall#184.dst: 오빠는 거기 규칙을 전부 정말 싫어했어. 그래서 어기는 걸 좋아했지. 엄청. 결국 왕실이 질려 버렸어. 짐 싸서 Roughworks로 보냈지.
Revelations in Fall#184.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#185.src: The worst part was, our parents agreed to it! Said it'd be good for him, to get some real hard work!
Revelations in Fall#185.dst: 최악은 우리 부모님이 동의했다는 거야! 제대로 고생 좀 하면 좋을 거라면서!
Revelations in Fall#185.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#186.src: I never liked it there anyway. It took me a while to build up the courage, but eventually I stole some of our money and bought a ticket to take me there.
Revelations in Fall#186.dst: 어차피 난 거기가 싫었어. 용기 내는 데 좀 걸렸지만, 결국 집 돈을 좀 훔쳐서 거기 가는 표를 샀어.
Revelations in Fall#186.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#187.src: I didn't pack a whole lot. I guess I expected to find him and live with him! Stupid. Should've thought ahead more.
Revelations in Fall#187.dst: 짐은 많이 안 챙겼어. 오빠를 찾아서 같이 살 줄 알았나 봐! 멍청하게. 더 생각했어야 했는데.
Revelations in Fall#187.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#188.src: He wasn't there, obviously. Heard from some of his friends that he kept being stupid over there. Got caught by the crown, and they decided to stop giving him second chances.
Revelations in Fall#188.dst: 당연히 오빠는 없었어. 친구들한테 들으니 거기서도 계속 바보짓을 했대. 왕실에 잡혔고, 더는 기회를 안 주기로 했대.
Revelations in Fall#188.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#189.src: So, he's gone! He promised he'd see me again someday, and and of course he didn't follow through. I guess I wasn't important enough to remember.
Revelations in Fall#189.dst: 그래서, 오빠는 없어! 언젠가 다시 보자고 약속했는데, 그리고 당연히 안 지켰지. 기억할 만큼 내가 중요하진 않았나 봐.
Revelations in Fall#189.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#190.src: Yes, I know. I just... I guess I just hoped I'd be an exception.
Revelations in Fall#190.dst: 그래, 알아. 그냥... 나만은 예외이길 바랐나 봐.
Revelations in Fall#190.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#192.src: I haven't been very fair to you, have I? It's not your fault you're here and he isn't.
Revelations in Fall#192.dst: 너한테 별로 공정하지 않았지? 네가 여기 있고 오빠가 없는 건 네 잘못이 아닌데.
Revelations in Fall#192.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#194.src: So... sorry. For all of that.
Revelations in Fall#194.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#196.src: Give me some time, would you? I need to... I don't know. I just need some space.
Revelations in Fall#196.dst: 시간 좀 줄래? 난... 모르겠어. 그냥 혼자 있을 시간이 필요해.
Revelations in Fall#196.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#198.src: Okay. I... won't take too long. Nobody ever comes here, anyway.
Revelations in Fall#198.dst: 알았어. 난... 오래 안 걸릴 거야. 어차피 여긴 아무도 안 와.
Revelations in Fall#198.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#199.src: Return to the camp and finish packing up at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Revelations in Fall#201.src: I just hope he's still out there, somewhere...
Revelations in Fall#201.dst: 그냥 오빠가 어딘가에 아직 살아 있길 바랄 뿐이야...
Revelations in Fall#201.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#202.src: Th- there you are! We, uh, got worried s- some- something bad might've happened.
Revelations in Fall#202.dst: 여- 여기 있었구나! 우린, 어, 무- 무슨 나쁜 일이라도 생긴 줄 알고 걱정했어.
Revelations in Fall#202.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#203.src: I... I mean... th- they got worried.
Revelations in Fall#203.dst: 내, 내 말은... 쟤- 쟤들이 걱정했다고.
Revelations in Fall#203.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#205.src: We were just talking. Gods, you guys and your overeager imaginations...
Revelations in Fall#205.dst: 그냥 얘기한 거야. 맙소사, 너희랑 너희의 넘치는 상상력이란...
Revelations in Fall#205.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#207.src: I am afraid not. We have heard nothing since the meeting this morning.
Revelations in Fall#207.dst: 유감스럽게도 없어. 오늘 아침 회의 이후로 아무 소식도 못 들었어.
Revelations in Fall#207.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#208.dst: 음... 그럼, 우리... 짐 풀어야 해?
Revelations in Fall#208.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#209.src: Let us just continue to place our trust in Syndra, as we have done many times before! She can handle herself.
Revelations in Fall#209.dst: 늘 그래왔듯이 Syndra를 계속 믿어 보자! 그녀는 스스로를 지킬 수 있어.
Revelations in Fall#209.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#210.src: Ugh! I knew t- tr- trusting the Sovereign w- was a mistake! We n- n- need to go
Revelations in Fall#210.dst: 으! 군주를 미- 믿는 게 실수라는 거 알- 알았어! 우리가 가- 가- 가야
Revelations in Fall#210.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#211.src: Excuse me- the Sovereign? What do you mean the S-
Revelations in Fall#211.dst: 잠깐- 군주? 그게 무슨 말이야, 군-
Revelations in Fall#211.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#213.src: Sigh... I'm just a little too late, I see.
Revelations in Fall#213.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#214.src: Well, since it's out in the open, I might as well explain myself. Firstly, I owe you all an apology for this.
Revelations in Fall#214.dst: 뭐, 다 드러났으니 해명하는 게 낫겠어. 우선, 이 일은 다들에게 사과할게.
Revelations in Fall#214.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#216.src: Mora, it's alright. I was going to reveal this secret anyway.
Revelations in Fall#216.dst: Mora, 괜찮아. 어차피 이 비밀은 밝힐 생각이었어.
Revelations in Fall#216.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#217.src: The contact I mentioned earlier today - it's the Sovereign Zhiraok.
Revelations in Fall#217.dst: 오늘 아까 말한 연락책- 그게 Zhiraok 군주야.
Revelations in Fall#217.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#219.src: What?! How long have you been- wait, Mora, you knew?
Revelations in Fall#219.dst: 뭐?! 대체 언제부터- 잠깐, Mora, 너 알았어?
Revelations in Fall#219.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#220.src: It was a secret kept out of necessity. As for how long... let's say a while, and leave it at that. But we're leaving the {p}, so I see no need to keep it hidden anymore.
Revelations in Fall#220.dst: 어쩔 수 없이 지킨 비밀이었어. 얼마나 됐냐면... 좀 됐다고만 해 두자. 하지만 {p}을(를) 떠나니, 더는 숨길 필요가 없겠지.
Revelations in Fall#220.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#221.src: I know you all worry about me... and I did not want to add another variable to stress over today. I apologize.
Revelations in Fall#221.dst: 다들 날 걱정하는 거 알아... 오늘 걱정거리를 하나 더 얹고 싶지 않았어. 미안해.
Revelations in Fall#221.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#223.src: Yes, I have them. Zhiraok provided me with enough for all of us. We'll need to move fast, though I want to cross into the Roughworks before he suspects what's going on.
Revelations in Fall#223.dst: 응, 받았어. Zhiraok가 우리 모두 쓸 만큼 줬어. 그래도 서둘러야 해. 그가 눈치채기 전에 Roughworks로 건너가고 싶어.
Revelations in Fall#223.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#224.src: ...s- so you're safe? It all w- went fine?
Revelations in Fall#224.dst: ...그- 그럼 넌 안전한 거지? 다 자- 잘 된 거지?
Revelations in Fall#224.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#225.src: Yes, Zeph, I am safe. Are you all packed? Crossing the border will take some time, so we need to start going to {p} now.
Revelations in Fall#225.dst: 그래, Zeph, 난 안전해. 짐은 다 쌌어? 국경을 넘는 데 시간이 걸리니까, 지금 {p}(으)로 출발해야 해.
Revelations in Fall#225.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#226.src: Come on, let's hurry. Let us leave this chapter behind.
Revelations in Fall#226.dst: 자, 서두르자. 이 장은 뒤로하고 떠나자.
Revelations in Fall#226.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#227.src: Walk through the gate to the Roughworks at in {p}.
Revelations in Fall#227.dst: {p}의 에 있는 Roughworks로 가는 성문을 통과하세요.

Revelations in Fall#229.src: I-I a-am ready for this. I have to be.
Revelations in Fall#229.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#230.src: I guess this is really happening...
Revelations in Fall#230.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#232.src: Let's meet up at the gate to the Roughworks and walk through together!
Revelations in Fall#232.dst: Roughworks로 가는 성문에서 만나서 같이 통과하자!
Revelations in Fall#232.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#233.src: Oh... there you are. The, um, line was really long when we got here, so, we... started queuing.
Revelations in Fall#233.dst: 아... 왔구나. 우리가 왔을 때, 음, 줄이 정말 길어서... 먼저 줄을 섰어.
Revelations in Fall#233.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#234.src: Everything's... fine, so far. I think. I... hope.
Revelations in Fall#234.dst: 지금까진... 다 괜찮아. 아마. 그러길... 바라.
Revelations in Fall#234.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#236.dst: 아- 앗! 죄- 죄송해요, 죄송, 저
Revelations in Fall#236.speaker: Sui

Revelations in Fall#239.src: All good. Keep it moving. NEXT!
Revelations in Fall#239.speaker: Passport Officer

Revelations in Fall#244.src: We're through. That went... smoothly enough.
Revelations in Fall#244.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#248.src: Enough of that, children. Miss Syndra, we've reached the Roughworks, yes?
Revelations in Fall#248.dst: 그만들 하렴, 아이들아. Syndra 아가씨, Roughworks에 도착한 거지?
Revelations in Fall#248.speaker: Mora

Revelations in Fall#249.src: We have. We'll follow the plan regroup outside {p}, the city in the region. We need to move quickly, I don't know how much time we have before
Revelations in Fall#249.dst: 그래. 계획대로 이 지역의 도시 {p} 밖에서 다시 모이자. 서둘러야 해, 얼마나 시간이 남았는지 모르니까
Revelations in Fall#249.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#250.src: Zero, Syndra. You've got zero time.
Revelations in Fall#250.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#251.src: ... Sovereign. Fast and efficient as always, I see.
Revelations in Fall#251.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#252.src: Naturally, you completely miscalculated, thinking you could sneak by like this. An unwanted variable isn't an unexpected one.
Revelations in Fall#252.dst: 당연하지, 이렇게 몰래 빠져나갈 수 있다고 생각하다니 완전히 계산 착오야. 달갑지 않은 변수가 예상 못 한 변수는 아니거든.
Revelations in Fall#252.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#253.src: It was worth a shot, even if unlikely.
Revelations in Fall#253.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#254.src: What garbage. Translating yourself into the Roughworks completely nulls the crown's pact... As if you wouldn't be spotted.
Revelations in Fall#254.dst: 헛소리. 네가 Roughworks로 평행이동하면 왕실 협약은 완전히 0이 돼... 들키지 않을 줄 알았나.
Revelations in Fall#254.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#255.src: I'm the one who really miscalculated though! Your angle was so obvious, but I just kept overlooking it. Kept trusting you. Kept hoping you'd settle, you'd terminate this sequence.
Revelations in Fall#255.dst: 하지만 진짜 계산 착오를 한 건 나야! 네 속셈은 뻔했는데, 계속 못 본 척했어. 계속 믿었지. 네가 수렴하길, 이 수열을 끝내길 계속 바랐어.
Revelations in Fall#255.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#256.src: And here you are...associating with a mass murderer! The cursed that caused the Torann massacre!! What kind of lowest-order logic is this?! What were you THINKING?!
Revelations in Fall#256.dst: 그런데 이렇게... 대량 학살범이랑 어울리다니! Torann 학살을 일으킨 저주받은 자랑!! 이게 무슨 최하위 논리야?! 대체 무슨 생각이었어?!
Revelations in Fall#256.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#258.src: Isn't it obvious, Sovereign? I want Her Majesty dethroned. I want her empire to crumble.
Revelations in Fall#258.dst: 뻔하지 않나요, 군주님? 난 여왕 폐하가 왕좌에서 끌려 내려오길 원해요. 그녀의 제국이 무너지길 원하죠.
Revelations in Fall#258.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#259.src: Your job was to infiltrate, not sum to the resistance!! Since when did you switch to the other side of the equation?! You're subtracting your only chance, you're You're wasting everything I've done for you!
Revelations in Fall#259.dst: 네 임무는 잠입이었지, 저항군에 더해지는 게 아니었어!! 언제부터 등식 반대편으로 넘어간 거야?! 네 유일한 기회를 빼 버리고 있어, 넌- 내가 너한테 해 준 걸 전부 날리고 있다고!
Revelations in Fall#259.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#260.src: So after everything She did to me, you expected me to just go along with it?! To accept the scraps I was left with, to forgive and forget?!
Revelations in Fall#260.dst: 그녀가 내게 한 짓을 다 겪고도, 내가 그냥 순순히 따를 줄 알았어요?! 남은 부스러기에 만족하고, 용서하고 잊으라고?!
Revelations in Fall#260.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#261.src: Maybe you were the fool all along, Zhiraok, for believing it.
Revelations in Fall#261.dst: 어쩌면 처음부터 바보는 당신이었나 보죠, Zhiraok. 그걸 믿었으니.
Revelations in Fall#261.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#263.src: ...so it was all imaginary? Nothing real? I cared about you, as a friend. A confidant. Did you? Or...was I just a convenient tool for you?
Revelations in Fall#263.dst: ...그럼 전부 허수였어? 진짜는 없었고? 난 친구로서 널 아꼈어. 속을 터놓는 사이로. 넌? 아니면... 난 그저 편리한 도구였나?
Revelations in Fall#263.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#265.src: Does it...matter. ...ha. Does it matter!! Do you know how much weight you carried in my day to day operations? I wonder how much I carried in yours!!
Revelations in Fall#265.dst: 그게... 중요하냐고. ...하. 그게 중요하냐고!! 내 하루하루 업무에서 네 비중이 얼마나 컸는지 알아? 네 쪽에선 내 비중이 얼마였을까!!
Revelations in Fall#265.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#266.src: It doesn't make me happy to do this. Your resistance is under arrest for the crime of conspiracy against the crown and your cursed, slated for execution.
Revelations in Fall#266.dst: 이러는 게 기쁘진 않아. 네 저항군은 왕실 반역 음모죄로 체포한다. 그리고 네 저주받은 자는 처형 대상이야.
Revelations in Fall#266.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#267.src: I can still pull some strings, Syndra. Round this all out. I might be able to keep you as part of the remainder if you turn yourself in. We can still
Revelations in Fall#267.dst: 아직 손을 쓸 수 있어, Syndra. 전부 반올림해서 정리하자. 자수하면 널 나머지에 남겨 둘 수 있을지도 몰라. 우린 아직
Revelations in Fall#267.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#268.src: We won't give in without a fight!
Revelations in Fall#268.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#269.src: ...why...do I even bother. A cursed compared to me...absolute trash. Let's get this over with.
Revelations in Fall#269.dst: ...내가... 왜 신경을 쓰지. 나에 비하면 저주받은 자 따위... 완전 쓰레기지. 빨리 끝내자.
Revelations in Fall#269.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#272.src: S- Syndra, are- are y- you
Revelations in Fall#272.speaker: Zeph

Revelations in Fall#278.src: Let's move. Everyone, remember the meeting point, just
Revelations in Fall#278.dst: 움직이자. 다들, 집결 지점 기억해, 그냥
Revelations in Fall#278.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#279.src: Are we really glossing over you killing a Sovereign????
Revelations in Fall#279.dst: 군주를 죽인 걸 진짜 그냥 넘어가자고????
Revelations in Fall#279.speaker: Rex

Revelations in Fall#280.src: Yes, Rex, because he won't stay down for long- that's why we need to move, now!
Revelations in Fall#280.dst: 그래, Rex, 오래 쓰러져 있지 않을 테니까- 그래서 당장 움직여야 해!
Revelations in Fall#280.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#281.src: Split up, stay safe, don't get caught. We meet in three days now, GO!
Revelations in Fall#281.dst: 흩어져, 몸조심하고, 잡히지 마. 사흘 뒤에 만나, 지금, 가!
Revelations in Fall#281.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#282.src: Sovereign Zhiraok, sir! You have a visitor here!
Revelations in Fall#282.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#283.src: Send them in, and if you could process these files, please-and-thank-you? I need the inquisitor to weigh in on the problem.
Revelations in Fall#283.dst: 들여보내. 그리고 이 서류 처리 좀 해 줄 수 있을까, 부탁하고 고마워? 이 문제에 대해 심문관 의견이 필요해.
Revelations in Fall#283.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#284.src: I have a finite value of time for this, so let's keep this short
Revelations in Fall#284.dst: 이 일에 쓸 시간 값은 유한하니까, 짧게 하자
Revelations in Fall#284.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#286.src: Hello, Sovereign. Sorry to interrupt you during your working hours once again.
Revelations in Fall#286.dst: 안녕하세요, 군주님. 또 근무 시간에 방해해서 미안해요.
Revelations in Fall#286.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#287.src: I'll add it to the tally! Bringing the trouble straight to my office, too You've got me nervous with the number of times it's happened recently.
Revelations in Fall#287.dst: 그것도 합계에 더해 두지! 게다가 골칫거리를 내 사무실까지 들고 오다니. 요즘 그 횟수 때문에 불안해 죽겠어.
Revelations in Fall#287.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#288.src: Let's cut to the chase, then. Tell me what your angle Ugh. What your request is.
Revelations in Fall#288.dst: 그럼 본론으로 가자. 네 속셈이 뭔지- 으. 네 요청이 뭔지 말해.
Revelations in Fall#288.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#289.src: Don't hold it in, you'll get an ulcer. I'll make this quick- I need passage to the Roughworks. For myself and five others.
Revelations in Fall#289.dst: 참지 마세요, 속병 나요. 짧게 말할게요- Roughworks로 가는 통행이 필요해요. 나 자신과 다른 다섯 명 몫으로요.
Revelations in Fall#289.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#290.src: ...you're really asking me to square the circle here. Why do you need to do this, go there? And so suddenly? Why?
Revelations in Fall#290.dst: ...나보고 원을 정사각형으로 만들라는 거네. 왜 이래야 하는데, 왜 거길 가? 그것도 이렇게 갑자기? 왜?
Revelations in Fall#290.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#291.src: I... I need to find her. I don't know how much more time I'll have to try.
Revelations in Fall#291.dst: 나... 그녀를 찾아야 해요. 얼마나 더 시도할 시간이 남았는지 모르겠어요.
Revelations in Fall#291.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#292.src: I know, I know!! Quit being obtuse, you know the consequences if you break the mandate, for both of us!!
Revelations in Fall#292.dst: 알아, 안다고!! 둔한 척 그만해, 명령을 어기면 우리 둘 다 어떻게 되는지 알잖아!!
Revelations in Fall#292.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#294.src: ...Is that all I get? What about the other five?
Revelations in Fall#294.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#296.src: Of course. You and your strays. Why can't you just... There has to be another solution, if we If you I
Revelations in Fall#296.dst: 그렇겠지. 너랑 네 떠돌이들. 왜 그냥... 다른 해가 있을 거야, 우리가 만약 네가 내가
Revelations in Fall#296.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#298.src: ...why do I even bother. Fine. You want it so badly, fine!! You know what this will take. Just... Remember. Remember what I've done for you.
Revelations in Fall#298.dst: ...내가 왜 신경을 쓰지. 좋아. 그렇게 원하면, 좋다고!! 대가가 뭔지 알지. 그냥... 기억해. 내가 너한테 해 준 걸 기억해.
Revelations in Fall#298.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#299.src: Thank you, Zhiraok. I won't let your kindness go to waste.
Revelations in Fall#299.dst: 고마워요, Zhiraok. 당신의 친절을 헛되이 하지 않을게요.
Revelations in Fall#299.speaker: Syndra

Revelations in Fall#300.src: Sovereign Zhiraok! Inquisitor Renn has some concerns
Revelations in Fall#300.dst: Zhiraok 군주님! Renn 심문관께서 우려하시는 게
Revelations in Fall#300.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#301.src: Xao, I need you to clear my schedule. There's a higher priority now, he can wait.
Revelations in Fall#301.dst: Xao, 내 일정 좀 비워 줘. 지금 더 우선인 일이 있어, 그는 기다리면 돼.
Revelations in Fall#301.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#302.src: Oh! Um, of course! If you insist, sir!! Inquisitor Renn won't be happy, but your orders are top
Revelations in Fall#302.dst: 아! 음, 물론이죠! 그렇게 말씀하신다면요, 군주님!! Renn 심문관께서 싫어하시겠지만, 군주님 명령이 최우선
Revelations in Fall#302.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#303.src: No, you're right, I'm being irrational. You're always right. Clear everything but that, it's fine. I'll get back to it later. Unexpected variables, extenuating circumstances...
Revelations in Fall#303.dst: 아니, 네 말이 맞아, 내가 비이성적이었어. 넌 늘 옳지. 그것만 빼고 다 비워, 괜찮아. 나중에 다시 볼게. 예상 못 한 변수, 참작할 사정...
Revelations in Fall#303.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#304.src: Sov ...Zhi-Zhi? Is everything okay? You...you look rattled, was it something she said? Should I have not brought her
Revelations in Fall#304.dst: 군- ...Zhi-Zhi? 괜찮으세요? 흔들려 보이세요, 그녀가 뭐라고 했나요? 그녀를 들이지 말았어야
Revelations in Fall#304.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#305.src: You didn't do anything wrong. She gave me a prime opportunity anyway. A warning before throwing my sequence out of line.
Revelations in Fall#305.dst: 넌 잘못한 거 없어. 어차피 그녀가 소수 같은 기회를 줬으니까. 내 수열을 흐트러뜨리기 전에 경고를 해 준 셈이지.
Revelations in Fall#305.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#306.src: Xao, I trust you. I need to leave Auburn in your care for a bit while I solve this. Please. Can you handle that?
Revelations in Fall#306.dst: Xao, 널 믿어. 이 문제를 푸는 동안 잠시 Auburn을 맡아 줘. 부탁이야. 할 수 있겠어?
Revelations in Fall#306.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Revelations in Fall#307.src: ...oh my, I... It's an honor! I won't let you down, sir!! I'll keep things ship-shape! But, why do you need me for this?
Revelations in Fall#307.dst: ...어머나, 저... 영광이에요! 실망시키지 않을게요, 군주님!! 빈틈없이 관리할게요! 그런데 왜 제가 필요하세요?
Revelations in Fall#307.speaker: Xao

Revelations in Fall#308.src: ...I need to converge at the Roughworks, handle her work for a while. That, and the next Crown Festival is soon. I feel like...it'd be a disservice to miss it.
Revelations in Fall#308.dst: ...Roughworks로 수렴해서 한동안 그녀의 일을 처리해야 해. 그리고 곧 다음 왕관 축제야. 그걸 놓치면... 직무 태만일 것 같아.
Revelations in Fall#308.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Rise of the Quartron#000.src: I think I'll write an anonymous letter instead. If those rumors about the factory are true, keeping myself secret might be important...

Rise of the Quartron#001.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, they're getting bold...

Rise of the Quartron#002.src: Dado won't budge about the topic. Maybe Nasea has an idea to get him to confess.

Rise of the Quartron#003.src: Come back when you have a solid lead on the missing quartz.

Rise of the Quartron#004.src: You press the flower up against his nose while he's laughing. Dado gets a big whiff of the petals, and immediately his expression goes slack.

Rise of the Quartron#005.src: ...uh. Okay, I have no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...

Rise of the Quartron#006.src: Use the small rail here, push that button on the post. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.

Rise of the Quartron#008.src: Aah, they're really tough!! Don't let them take down more of my buddies!

Rise of the Quartron#009.src: Why are we fighting face-to-face?! They're destroying us!!

Rise of the Quartron#010.src: What the hell are humans made of?! Overwhelm them!! We hardly have any guys left!

Rise of the Quartron#011.src: The door is locked. There has to be a way to get in...

Rise of the Quartron#012.src: Looks like someone's notebook. You open to a page that looks interesting...

Rise of the Quartron#013.src: I've finally cracked it- a functional model for my magnum opus, the Harnort Quartron! I even amaze myself, yes yes!

Rise of the Quartron#014.src: The mech is both made of and has functions to break apart quartz. We'll be able to salvage every bit from the rubble of {p}'s committee building...

Rise of the Quartron#015.src: The fools in the committee will see their error when their rooms get blown apart in front of them! They'll see my brilliance!

Rise of the Quartron#016.src: Large-scale mechs that even Corkus's machines pale in comparison to, the possibilities for them are so much more than just warfare...

Rise of the Quartron#017.src: But my subordinates need to hurry with the quartz shipments. The Karoc manager may catch onto us if we don't...and I regret thieving enough already.

Rise of the Quartron#018.src: The quartz is charged! Use this to overcharge the door and destroy it!

Rise of the Quartron#019.src: There's a charging slot in the machine.

Rise of the Quartron#020.src: The door is locked shut, and there's no keyhole anyplace.

Rise of the Quartron#021.src: It's made of quartz, it looks like...the sign says not to overcharge the quartz.

Rise of the Quartron#022.src: Nasea mentioned that overcharging quartz was dangerous...maybe overcharging the door will destroy it.

Rise of the Quartron#023.src: Is there a way to charge quartz anyplace nearby?

Rise of the Quartron#024.src: ...so it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#024.dst: ...결국 이렇게 됐군. 난 경비들 이름을 다 알았다. 목표를 위해 아무도 해치지 않았어.

Rise of the Quartron#025.src: One life for a hundred is a fair trade!!

Rise of the Quartron#026.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You...YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#026.dst: 아악! 반응이 없어?! 너- 너... 너! 네가 미래를 파괴했어! 내 미래를! Gavel의 미래를!!!

Rise of the Quartron#027.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to go get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.

Rise of the Quartron#028.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or mugged, and ran off to the east ridge.

Rise of the Quartron#029.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... ...I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#029.dst: ...음. 응. ... ...그래, 계속해. 어, 좋아, 믿어 줄게... 증거가 없었으면 절대 안 믿었을 거야.

Rise of the Quartron#030.src: Okay, so I'll cut you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do just one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.

Rise of the Quartron#032.src: Shipment {~}A and {~}B, fully accounted for... shipments {~}C and {~}A...missing {~} of quartz content?!
Rise of the Quartron#032.dst: {~}A랑 {~}B 화물, 수량 확인 완료... {~}C랑 {~}A 화물... 석영이 {~}만큼 없어?!
Rise of the Quartron#032.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#033.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, thy're getting bold...
Rise of the Quartron#033.dst: 으, 점점 심해지잖아! 이렇게 많이 없어진 적은 없었어... 누군진 몰라도 점점 대담해지네...
Rise of the Quartron#033.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#034.src: Ugh, go AWAY! Quit hovering over my shoulder like that- wait, a Human? Since when did you get here?
Rise of the Quartron#034.dst: 으, 저리 가! 어깨 너머로 그렇게 기웃거리지 좀- 잠깐, 인간? 언제 여기 왔어?
Rise of the Quartron#034.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#035.src: What, you like listening to the melodious sound of my voice or something? Or do you intend to help out?
Rise of the Quartron#035.dst: 뭐야, 내 아름다운 목소리라도 듣고 싶은 거야? 아니면 도와줄 생각이야?
Rise of the Quartron#035.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#036.src: Well, I'm flattered either way, and I could certainly use the help. Quartz is going missing from my shipments.
Rise of the Quartron#036.dst: 뭐, 어느 쪽이든 기분은 좋네. 도움이 필요하긴 해. 내 화물에서 석영이 자꾸 사라지거든.
Rise of the Quartron#036.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#037.src: Obviously one of the laborers is siphoning it to someplace, and I can't have that happening. So, be a private eye, humie.
Rise of the Quartron#037.dst: 분명 일꾼 중 하나가 어딘가로 빼돌리는 거야. 그냥 둘 순 없지. 그러니까 탐정 노릇 좀 해 봐, 인간.
Rise of the Quartron#037.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#038.src: This is actually pretty dire- quartz has some magicality to it, see. It likes to soak up magic power, which means it can be weaponized.
Rise of the Quartron#038.dst: 이거 꽤 심각해- 석영엔 마력이 좀 있거든. 마력을 빨아들이는 성질이 있어서 무기로 쓸 수 있어.
Rise of the Quartron#038.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#039.src: We tend not to use it for weapons since it can overcharge, but that's neither here nor there, is it?
Rise of the Quartron#039.dst: 과부하가 걸릴 수 있어서 보통 무기엔 안 쓰지만, 그건 지금 중요한 게 아니지?
Rise of the Quartron#039.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#040.src: Every siphoned shipment has gone through Dado. Interrogate him! He hangs out past the big red tent, near the house with red flags.
Rise of the Quartron#040.dst: 빼돌려진 화물은 전부 Dado를 거쳤어. 걔를 추궁해! 빨간 큰 천막 너머, 빨간 깃발 달린 집 근처에 있어.
Rise of the Quartron#040.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#041.src: Talk to Dado and see if he is the culprit.

Rise of the Quartron#042.src: Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
Rise of the Quartron#042.dst: 좋아, 이건 P 구역으로 가고... 이봐, 난 {p}에 보낼 배송을 나누느라 바빠. 딴 사람 괴롭혀, 알았지?
Rise of the Quartron#042.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#043.src: ...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
Rise of the Quartron#043.dst: ...뭐. 네가... 내가... 푸흡... 푸하하하하! 오, 하필 인간이 그런 말을 하다니 웃기네!
Rise of the Quartron#043.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#044.src: "Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
Rise of the Quartron#044.dst: "오, 돈 받고 살인하는 용병 종족인 내가, 7년 차 베테랑 일꾼인 너를 불법 행위로 고발하겠다!" 와, 이 위선자!
Rise of the Quartron#044.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#045.src: I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
Rise of the Quartron#045.dst: 화도 안 난다! 하지만, 그래, 이 괴짜야. 사람 잘못 짚었어, 놀랐지! 머리는 제대로 돌아가는 거야?
Rise of the Quartron#045.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#046.src: I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
Rise of the Quartron#046.dst: 머릿속 전선이 꼬였나 보지? 마을로 쪼르르 돌아가서 푼돈 벌게 남의 Wybel이나 잡아.
Rise of the Quartron#046.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#047.src: Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.
Rise of the Quartron#047.dst: Nasea에게 돌아가 Dado의 반응을 알려 주세요.

Rise of the Quartron#048.src: I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
Rise of the Quartron#048.dst: 대충 찍어 보자면, 도둑질했냐고 좋게 물어봤더니 아무 답도 안 나왔다는 거지.
Rise of the Quartron#048.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#049.src: What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
Rise of the Quartron#049.dst: 뭐, 그렇게 쫓아냈다고? 참나, 재수 없는 놈인 건 알았지만, 진짜? 그건 너무했다.
Rise of the Quartron#049.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#050.src: We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
Rise of the Quartron#050.dst: 입을 열게 해야 해... 화물이 계속 사라지면 거래처들이 딴 데로 갈 거라고!
Rise of the Quartron#050.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#051.src: We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
Rise of the Quartron#051.dst: 유죄를 증명해야 해... 잠깐, 나한테 아이디어를 물으러 온 거야? 그래서 도와 달라고 한 거잖아! 진짜 원점이야?
Rise of the Quartron#051.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#053.src: I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
Rise of the Quartron#053.dst: 나... 여긴 웬일이야, 어... Larry? 너도 석영이 없어졌어??
Rise of the Quartron#053.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#054.src: Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
Rise of the Quartron#054.dst: 아, 저는... Lari예요. 아뇨, 석영 화물은 잘 도착했어요...
Rise of the Quartron#054.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#055.src: But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
Rise of the Quartron#055.dst: 하지만 효과가 거의 없었어요. 안타깝게도 당신 생각은 막다른 길이었죠.
Rise of the Quartron#055.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#056.src: Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
Rise of the Quartron#056.dst: 뭐, 그냥 아이디어일 뿐이라고 경고했잖아. 난 광산 관리자지, 정화 마법사가 아니야. 그걸 내 탓으로 돌리지 마.
Rise of the Quartron#056.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#057.src: I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
Rise of the Quartron#057.dst: 그런 뜻은 아니었어요. 도와줘서 고마웠어요, 운명이 다른 계획을 가졌을 뿐...
Rise of the Quartron#057.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#058.src: ...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
Rise of the Quartron#058.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#059.src: Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
Rise of the Quartron#059.dst: 뭐, 어떤 의미론. 누가 석영을 빼돌리는데, 용의자가 이 10톤짜리 갑옷을 보고도 겁을 안 먹어서 막혔어. 좋은 생각 있어?
Rise of the Quartron#059.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#060.src: ...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
Rise of the Quartron#060.dst: ...사실, 방법이 있어요. 엘프 식물학에 이 근처에서 자라는 꽃이 나와요. "Tattytale" 꽃이죠.
Rise of the Quartron#060.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#061.src: It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
Rise of the Quartron#061.dst: 꽃잎 냄새를 맡은 사람은 의지가 약해져서 질문에 순순히 답해요. 썩... 유쾌하진 않지만, 필요하다면 어쩔 수 없겠죠.
Rise of the Quartron#061.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#062.src: There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
Rise of the Quartron#062.dst: 서쪽 산에 거미가 들끓고 거미줄로 뒤덮인 동굴이 있어요. 안타깝게도 {p} 밖에서 그 꽃이 자라는 유일한 곳이에요.
Rise of the Quartron#062.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#063.src: Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Rise of the Quartron#063.dst: Nasea, 도움이 안 됐으니 석영은 돌려 드렸어요. 도와줘서 고마워요... 그럼 두 분, 안녕히.
Rise of the Quartron#063.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#065.src: Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.
Rise of the Quartron#065.dst: Tattytale 꽃으로 Dado의 자백을 받아 내세요.

Rise of the Quartron#066.src: Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
Rise of the Quartron#066.dst: 야, 모두가 제일 싫어하는 사냥개잖아! 이리 와! 에메랄드 줄까? 우리 집 파리나 다 잡아 와! 이리 와, 멍멍!
Rise of the Quartron#066.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#067.src: Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#067.dst: 어머, 꽃이네. 참 다정하기도 해라! 미안하지만 난 사이코나 아첨엔 안 넘어가, 헤헤헤!
Rise of the Quartron#067.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#068.src: I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
Rise of the Quartron#068.dst: 나... 헉... 이게 뭐 하는 짓이야?! 네 꽃이 싫다고 삐진- 뭐? 석영으로 뭘 하냐고?
Rise of the Quartron#068.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#069.src: Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
Rise of the Quartron#069.dst: 어, 뻔하잖아? 야근하면서 Popo한테 올려 보내지, 당연히. 그럼 어디로 보내겠어?
Rise of the Quartron#069.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#070.src: What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
Rise of the Quartron#070.dst: 뭐- Popo는 어디로 보내냐고? 음... 몰라. 누군진 몰라도 엄청난 부자야. 화물 하나당 우리 집값보다 많이 준다니까!
Rise of the Quartron#070.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#071.src: Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
Rise of the Quartron#071.dst: 왜 그런 걸- 뭐? Popo가 어디 있냐고? 어, 청록색 깃발 근처 수레 선로 육교에서 만나자고 했어.
Rise of the Quartron#071.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#072.src: This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
Rise of the Quartron#072.dst: 첫 만남이 될 참이라 난 그 녀석 얼굴을 모르고, 그 녀석도 날 본 적 없어.
Rise of the Quartron#072.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#073.src: ...uh. Okay, I haave no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...
Rise of the Quartron#073.dst: ...어. 좋아, 내가 왜 그걸 다 말했는지 모르겠네... 음, 근데 그 꽃 더 있어? 사실 진짜 좋았는데...
Rise of the Quartron#073.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#074.src: Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.
Rise of the Quartron#074.dst: 광산 수레 언덕을 올라가 Popo를 찾으세요.

Rise of the Quartron#075.src: Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
Rise of the Quartron#075.dst: 아, 네가 바로- 잠깐, 아니다. 다른 사람을 기다리고 있었거든.
Rise of the Quartron#075.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#076.src: Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#076.dst: 잠깐, 네가 Dado라고? 인간이 오크보다 머리가 좋긴 한가 보네, 헤하!
Rise of the Quartron#076.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#077.src: Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
Rise of the Quartron#077.dst: 좋아, 본론. 네가 기지로 가서 설명을 듣는 동안 난 바쁜 척하며 엄호할게. 자세한 건 거기서 들어.
Rise of the Quartron#077.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#078.src: You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
Rise of the Quartron#078.dst: 너 엄청 튀긴 하는데, 다행히 인간들은 이상한 데 기어들어 가는 걸 좋아하니까 크게 어색해 보이진 않을 거야.
Rise of the Quartron#078.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#079.src: Use the small rail here, flick the lever. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.
Rise of the Quartron#079.dst: 여기 작은 선로를 타고 레버를 당겨. 의심받기는커녕... 그냥 인간다운 짓 하는 걸로 보일 거야.
Rise of the Quartron#079.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#080.src: Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.
Rise of the Quartron#080.dst: 광산 수레를 타고 도적 저택으로 가세요.

Rise of the Quartron#081.src: Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
Rise of the Quartron#081.dst: 수레에 타, 출발한다! 근데 자연스럽게 행동해!
Rise of the Quartron#081.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#082.src: Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
Rise of the Quartron#082.dst: 흥미롭군, 인간이 우리 계획에 휘말렸어. 인력이 이렇게 빨리 다양해질 줄은 몰랐는데.
Rise of the Quartron#082.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#083.src: Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#083.dst: 설명할 시간이군, 오 난 이거 설명하는 게 정말 좋아! 내 얘기가 꽤 흥미로울 거다, 그렇고말고!
Rise of the Quartron#083.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#084.src: You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
Rise of the Quartron#084.dst: 보다시피 석영은 강력한 마법 재료다- 다들 아는 것 이상으로! 마력을 흡수하고 다룰 수 있지, 하지만 그 이상은? 알아내야만 했지!
Rise of the Quartron#084.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#085.src: The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
Rise of the Quartron#085.dst: 연구 부서의 멍청이들은 연구를 더 진행하자고 했다고 날 쫓아냈다. 발전을 두려워하는 과학자가 어디 있나?!
Rise of the Quartron#085.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#086.src: But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#086.dst: 하지만 목을 조르던 이사회가 없으니, 내 연구는 바라던 곳에, 아니 그 이상에 닿았지, 그렇고말고!
Rise of the Quartron#086.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#087.src: Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
Rise of the Quartron#087.speaker: Guard

Rise of the Quartron#089.src: Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Rise of the Quartron#089.dst: Harnort! 내가 Dado야! 이 미친놈이 날 털어 정보를 캐냈어! 우리 둘 다 끝장이야!
Rise of the Quartron#089.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#090.src: Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
Rise of the Quartron#090.dst: 경비!! 경비!! 잡아! 막아! 묶어, 뭐라도 해!! 이 중요한 순간에 우리 연구가 헛되게 할 순 없어!!
Rise of the Quartron#090.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#091.src: HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
Rise of the Quartron#091.dst: 하! 그 끝내주- 끔찍한 꽃을 보여 준 대가다! 난 간다!
Rise of the Quartron#091.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#092.src: Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.

Rise of the Quartron#094.src: You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
Rise of the Quartron#094.dst: 너... 그들의 희생을 헛되게 두지 않겠다! {p}은(는) 석영의 진짜 힘을 봐야 해! 반드시 보여 주고 말겠어.
Rise of the Quartron#094.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#095.src: My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
Rise of the Quartron#095.dst: 내 Quartron이 미래다! 그들은 봐야 해! 음모도, 도둑질도, 끊어진 관계도 전부 가치가 있었을 거다!
Rise of the Quartron#095.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#096.src: But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#096.dst: 그런데 넌- 넌 가만두질 못했지. 끼어들어서 필연을 막겠다고 백 명의 목숨을 냉정하게 내던졌어!
Rise of the Quartron#096.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#097.src: One live for a hundred is a fair trade!!
Rise of the Quartron#097.dst: 백 명을 위해 하나 죽는 건 공정해!!
Rise of the Quartron#097.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#098.src: Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.
Rise of the Quartron#098.dst: Quartron을 쓰러뜨리고 Nasea에게 돌아가 소식을 전하세요.

Rise of the Quartron#100.src: The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
Rise of the Quartron#100.dst: 백 명 넘는 이들의 미래를!! 무모하게 파괴하는 너희 인간은 지옥불에 타야 해!
Rise of the Quartron#100.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#101.src: The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
Rise of the Quartron#101.dst: 폭발 에너지가 벽 속 석영을 과부하시키고 있다... 이 실험실 전체가 이제 죽음의 덫이야! 모두를 위해- 가만히 앉아서 그냥 죽어!!
Rise of the Quartron#101.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#102.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.
Rise of the Quartron#102.dst: ...설명할 게 한가득이겠지. 먼저 넌 그 Tattle 꽃인지 뭔지 가지러 가서 사라졌어.
Rise of the Quartron#102.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#103.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or nugged, and ran off to the east ridge.
Rise of the Quartron#103.dst: 그러더니 Dado가 약에 취했다느니 뭐라느니 소리치면서 여길 뛰어가더니 동쪽 능선으로 달아났어.
Rise of the Quartron#103.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#104.src: Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
Rise of the Quartron#104.dst: 그러고는 돌아와서 그 꽃 더 찾았냐고 묻더라. 그렇게 횡설수설하는데 산 전체가 흔들렸어.
Rise of the Quartron#104.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#105.src: So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
Rise of the Quartron#105.dst: 그러니까 털어놔. 내 석영이 어디로 가는지 알아보랬더니, 일꾼 하나를 중독자로 만들고 산사태까지 일으켰잖아!!
Rise of the Quartron#105.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#107.src: A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
Rise of the Quartron#107.dst: 군사용 석영 기계라니... 으. 그 녀석 참 대단한 물건이네. 결국 네 잘못은 아니었나 보다.
Rise of the Quartron#107.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#108.src: I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
Rise of the Quartron#108.dst: 경비대를 불러서 그 경비들이랑 전부 잡아들일게. ...표정이 왜 그래? 거기 아무도 없을 거라는 표정이네. 아무튼...
Rise of the Quartron#108.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#109.src: Okay, so I'll out you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do justt one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.
Rise of the Quartron#109.dst: 좋아, 간단히 거래하자. 이걸 알아낸 대가는 지금 주고, 하나만 더 해 주면 뭔가 더 줄게.
Rise of the Quartron#109.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#110.src: Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
Rise of the Quartron#110.dst: 노란 깃발 너머 승강기를 타고 사유지로 들어가. 내가 허락할게. 위에서 만나자.
Rise of the Quartron#110.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#111.src: Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.
Rise of the Quartron#111.dst: 광산 수레 선로 끝에서 Nasea와 합류하세요.

Rise of the Quartron#113.src: This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
Rise of the Quartron#113.dst: 여긴 새 채굴 구역인데, 벽에 좀 부딪혔어. 그러니까... 자갈 벽에.
Rise of the Quartron#113.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#114.src: So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
Rise of the Quartron#114.dst: 그러니 이 구역을 뚫어 주면 광산이랑 거기서 찾은 건 네 거야.
Rise of the Quartron#114.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#115.src: I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
Rise of the Quartron#115.dst: 근데 난 가 봐야 해, 할 일이 산더미거든. 흠. 네가 보여 준 코어가 반지 모양으로 접힌 것 같네. 진짜 첨단 기술인데 난 못 쓰니까 가져가.
Rise of the Quartron#115.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#116.src: Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
Rise of the Quartron#116.dst: 그럼 이걸로 끝이네! 여기 보수야. 또 보자.
Rise of the Quartron#116.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#093.src: ...so, it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#093.dst: ...결국 이렇게 됐군. 난 경비들 이름을 다 알았다. 목표를 위해 아무도 해치지 않았어.
Rise of the Quartron#093.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#099.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You... YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#099.dst: 아악! 반응이 없어?! 너- 너... 너! 네가 미래를 파괴했어! 내 미래를! Gavel의 미래를!!!
Rise of the Quartron#099.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#106.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#106.dst: ...음. 응. ... ...그래, 계속해. 어, 좋아, 믿어 줄게... 증거가 없었으면 절대 안 믿었을 거야.
Rise of the Quartron#106.speaker: Nasea

Rogue Wyrmling#000.dst: 다시는 이 얘기 하지 마... 낯선 이여.

Royal Trials#001.src: Back off! No'ne enters 'til the pirate queen is chosen. What's a landwalker like you doin' here?
Royal Trials#001.dst: 물러서! 해적 여왕이 뽑히기 전엔 아무도 못 들어가. 너 같은 뭍사람이 여긴 웬일이야?
Royal Trials#001.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#002.src: Participate? Are ye crazy? Ain't no way a landlubber is wearing the crown.
Royal Trials#002.dst: 참가? 미쳤냐? 뭍놈이 왕관을 쓸 리가 없잖아.
Royal Trials#002.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#003.src: Off with ya now! Before I call the gals to gut you. And dun' go wandering around chatting to any skyraiders!
Royal Trials#003.dst: 썩 꺼져! 동료들 불러서 배를 갈라 버리기 전에. 그리고 딴 하늘 약탈자들한테 말 걸고 다니지 마!
Royal Trials#003.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#005.src: Yer wantin' to be pirate queen, ye? Don' worry, I can help ye.
Royal Trials#005.dst: 해적 여왕이 되고 싶다고? 걱정 마, 내가 도와주지.
Royal Trials#005.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#006.src: Y'see, the other pirates ain't fit for the role. They're dumb 'n weak. All they've got is looks.
Royal Trials#006.dst: 봐, 다른 해적들은 그 자리에 안 어울려. 멍청하고 약해빠졌지. 얼굴 말곤 가진 게 없어.
Royal Trials#006.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#007.src: Yer got the lot! Looks and talent.
Royal Trials#007.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#008.src: Y'know, the guard, she's dumb too. A simple disguise will fool 'er. Issue is, ye dun' look like a skyraider at all!
Royal Trials#008.dst: 그 경비병도 멍청하거든. 간단한 변장이면 속아. 문제는, 넌 하늘 약탈자처럼 하나도 안 보인다는 거지!
Royal Trials#008.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#009.src: Yer in luck, though. A skyraider will sell anything for a price - just look around the town and see if ye can persuade anyone to part with their outfit.
Royal Trials#009.dst: 그래도 운이 좋아. 하늘 약탈자는 값만 맞으면 뭐든 팔거든. 마을을 돌면서 옷을 넘겨줄 사람을 설득해 봐.
Royal Trials#009.speaker: Hrona

Royal Trials#010.src: Look around the skyraider town at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find a pirate outfit.
Royal Trials#010.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 하늘 약탈자 마을을 둘러보고 해적 옷을 구하세요

Royal Trials#011.src: Aye? A landwalker, wanderin' around our base? Whatcha' want?
Royal Trials#011.dst: 응? 뭍사람이 우리 기지를 돌아다녀? 뭘 원하는데?
Royal Trials#011.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#013.src: ... aye, I suppose I could be tempted to pass it on to ye... for a price.
Royal Trials#013.dst: ... 흠, 넘겨줄 마음이 생길 수도 있지... 값만 맞으면.
Royal Trials#013.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#014.src: Here, these are what I'd trade it to ye for.
Royal Trials#014.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#015.src: If yer thinkin' emeralds... [{~} Emerald Blocks] seems like a fair price, heh.
Royal Trials#015.dst: 에메랄드로 하겠다면... [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]면 공정한 값이지, 헤.
Royal Trials#015.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#016.src: Of course, if you're running low on funds, how about ye grab me [{~} Dragonling Eggs] instead? Y'know, the ingredient. I'm 'oping to raise some 'o the lil critters!
Royal Trials#016.dst: 물론 돈이 모자라면, 대신 [Dragonling 알 {~}개]를 구해 오는 건 어때? 그 재료 말이야. 그 꼬맹이들을 좀 키워 보고 싶거든!
Royal Trials#016.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#017.src: But if neither of them tickle ye fancy... I've always wanted [{~} Shiny Shell] - they're just so sparkly! Ye can find them in the cave south-east of here, beside the ladders.
Royal Trials#017.dst: 둘 다 마음에 안 들면... 난 늘 [{~} Shiny Shell]이 갖고 싶었어. 엄청 반짝이거든! 여기 남동쪽 동굴, 사다리 옆에서 찾을 수 있어.
Royal Trials#017.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#018.src: Ye can get me one o' those three, landwalker, and ye can have my outfit!
Royal Trials#018.dst: 셋 중 하나만 갖다주면, 뭍사람, 내 옷은 네 거야!
Royal Trials#018.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#019.src: Give an item to Egpla at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Royal Trials#020.src: So, landwalker, are ye ready to pay up? I can see emeralds in ye pocket, hand 'em over.
Royal Trials#020.dst: 그래서, 뭍사람, 낼 준비는 됐어? 주머니에 에메랄드가 보이는데, 내놔.
Royal Trials#020.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#021.src: Alrigh'! Those're exactly what I've been lookin' for. Give it here, lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#021.dst: 좋아! 딱 내가 찾던 거야. 이리 줘 봐, 좀 보자...
Royal Trials#021.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#022.src: Aye, landwalker! Is that the sparkle of a shiny shell I spot in ye pocket?! Lemme have a look...
Royal Trials#022.dst: 오, 뭍사람! 주머니에서 반짝이는 게 Shiny Shell 아니야?! 좀 보자...
Royal Trials#022.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#023.src: Alright, landwalker. Ye can have me outfit. 'ere, lemme just get changed inside.
Royal Trials#023.dst: 좋아, 뭍사람. 내 옷 가져가. 잠깐, 안에서 갈아입고 올게.
Royal Trials#023.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#024.src: Here ye go, landlubber. I hope ye get some kinda use out of it, whatever ye want it for.
Royal Trials#024.dst: 여기 있다, 뭍놈. 뭐에 쓰려는진 몰라도 쓸모가 있길 바라.
Royal Trials#024.speaker: Egpla

Royal Trials#026.src: Another contestant, eh? That outfit looks a bit funny on ye, but I'll let yer in. Hurry up!
Royal Trials#026.dst: 또 참가자야? 옷이 좀 어색하긴 한데, 들여보내 주지. 서둘러!
Royal Trials#026.speaker: Skyraider Guard

Royal Trials#028.src: Ugh! Ye can't be the queen, ye can barely fly an airship!
Royal Trials#028.dst: 흥! 네가 여왕일 리가 없지, 비행선도 제대로 못 모는 게!
Royal Trials#028.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#029.src: No! I'll be the queen! I'm much more qualified than any of you sky rats!
Royal Trials#029.dst: 아니! 여왕은 나야! 너희 하늘 쥐새끼들보다 내가 훨씬 자격 있어!
Royal Trials#029.speaker: Angry Contestant

Royal Trials#030.src: Listen to the Trials Overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#031.src: Gather round, ladies. The next Queen is about to be selected!
Royal Trials#031.dst: 다들 모여라, 아가씨들. 다음 여왕을 뽑을 시간이다!
Royal Trials#031.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#032.src: As ye know, our previous queen suffered a... nasty fate, murdered on her very own airship by a Wynn soldier.
Royal Trials#032.dst: 알다시피 우리 전 여왕은... 험한 꼴을 당했지. 자기 비행선에서 Wynn 병사한테 살해당했어.
Royal Trials#032.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#033.src: But in the ashes of her honor, a new queen shall rise! Three trials. That's what ye all face now.
Royal Trials#033.dst: 하지만 그 명예의 잿더미에서 새 여왕이 일어설 거다! 시련은 셋. 그게 이제 너희가 맞설 상대다.
Royal Trials#033.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#034.src: Only one, who passes all trials laid before her, will pass and gain the title of Skyraider Queen.
Royal Trials#034.dst: 모든 시련을 통과한 단 한 명만이 하늘 약탈자 여왕의 칭호를 얻는다.
Royal Trials#034.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#035.src: Now, I introduce ye all to the first trial, to test yer capability at a vital skill for queenship - combat!
Royal Trials#035.dst: 자, 첫 번째 시련을 소개하지. 여왕에게 꼭 필요한 능력을 시험한다. 바로 전투다!
Royal Trials#035.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#037.src: Defeat the armory room of the combat challenge.

Royal Trials#038.src: Defeat the brig room of the combat challenge.

Royal Trials#039.src: Defeat the cockpit room of the combat challenge.

Royal Trials#040.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#041.src: Arr, that weeded out the weak. A queen must be strong to lead.
Royal Trials#041.dst: 하, 약한 것들은 걸러졌군. 여왕은 강해야 이끌 수 있지.
Royal Trials#041.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#042.src: Now, to the second challenge - the task of flight! Ye can't be a queen if ye can't fly yer airship!
Royal Trials#042.dst: 이제 두 번째 시련, 비행이다! 제 비행선도 못 모는 자는 여왕이 될 수 없어!
Royal Trials#042.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#043.src: Make sure ye bring yer eyes, girls, one false move and death awaits.
Royal Trials#043.dst: 눈 똑바로 뜨고 가라, 아가씨들. 한 번 실수하면 죽음이다.
Royal Trials#043.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#044.src: This task should get rid of the rest of ye unworthy.
Royal Trials#044.dst: 이번 걸로 남은 자격 미달들은 다 떨어질 거다.
Royal Trials#044.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#046.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#047.src: Well lookie here, an amateur made it through her flight.
Royal Trials#047.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#048.src: Well let’s see how you hold up in the final task ladies.
Royal Trials#048.dst: 그럼 마지막 시련에서 얼마나 버티는지 보자고, 아가씨들.
Royal Trials#048.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#049.src: Yer ain’ a pirate at all if ye can't steal, but this is different.
Royal Trials#049.dst: 훔칠 줄 모르면 해적도 아니지만, 이번엔 달라.
Royal Trials#049.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#050.src: This is the real deal. Stealin’ from a highly secure mansion.
Royal Trials#050.dst: 진짜배기다. 경비가 삼엄한 저택에서 훔쳐 오는 거지.
Royal Trials#050.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#051.src: Yer job is to steal a priceless treasure from the richest family in the sky.
Royal Trials#051.dst: 하늘에서 제일 부자인 가문의 값진 보물을 훔쳐라.
Royal Trials#051.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#052.src: We'll be waiting with a getaway airship at the extraction point, everyone else'll left behind.
Royal Trials#052.dst: 탈출 지점에서 도주용 비행선으로 기다리마. 늦는 놈은 두고 간다.
Royal Trials#052.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#053.src: Remember, this be the real thing, and the consequences of failure will be severe. Good luck, ladies.
Royal Trials#053.dst: 기억해, 이건 실전이고 실패하면 대가가 혹독하다. 행운을 빈다, 아가씨들.
Royal Trials#053.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#054.src: This here is the garden you we'll tunnel into, and yer'll 'ave to find a way into the Mansion, maybe yer can just ask nicely, heh.
Royal Trials#054.dst: 여기가 우리가 굴을 파고 들어갈 정원이다. 저택에 들어갈 방법은 알아서 찾아. 공손히 부탁해 보든가, 헤.
Royal Trials#054.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#055.src: Then yer'll have to sneak through these corridors to reach the treasure - and don't let the guards find yer, or they'll lock yer up and throw away the key.
Royal Trials#055.dst: 그다음엔 이 복도를 몰래 지나 보물까지 가야 해. 경비병한테 들키지 마라. 가둬 놓고 열쇠를 버릴 테니까.
Royal Trials#055.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#056.src: This, o' course, is the mythical treasure that yer gonna want to grab and get outta here, stat. I'm sure there'll be some extra defenses, though.
Royal Trials#056.dst: 이게 바로 너희가 낚아채서 당장 튀어야 할 전설의 보물이다. 물론 추가 방어 장치가 좀 있겠지만.
Royal Trials#056.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#057.src: And finally yer'll have to escape outta this window right 'ere - I'll be waitin' with an airship to carry all of ye out.
Royal Trials#057.dst: 마지막으로 바로 이 창문으로 빠져나와라. 비행선을 대 놓고 너희를 전부 태워 가마.
Royal Trials#057.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#059.src: Aye', think ye ready to try grabbin' that treasure, eh? Just 'ead outta this hole and try to find yer way into the mansion.
Royal Trials#059.dst: 그 보물 훔치러 갈 준비됐다고? 이 구멍으로 나가서 저택에 들어갈 길을 찾아 봐.
Royal Trials#059.speaker: Skyraider

Royal Trials#060.src: Sneak past the guards and steal the treasure.

Royal Trials#061.src: Oi', you! Whatcha' think yer' doin' sneakin' around these parts? This be a restricted area! Yer' headed to the jail cell!
Royal Trials#061.dst: 어이, 너! 여기서 뭘 몰래 기어 다녀? 여긴 출입 금지 구역이다! 감방으로 가라!
Royal Trials#061.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#062.src: Get the treasure to the trials overseer outside of the mansion's window.
Royal Trials#062.dst: 보물을 들고 저택 창문 밖의 시련 감독관에게 가세요

Royal Trials#063.src: Aye', men! Tha' treasure has been stolen! Prepare the defenses!
Royal Trials#063.dst: 어이, 다들! 보물을 도둑맞았다! 방어 태세!
Royal Trials#063.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#064.src: Aye, we caught the nasty thief! We'll be lockin' him up till' he rots!
Royal Trials#064.dst: 하, 이 더러운 도둑을 잡았다! 썩을 때까지 가둬 두마!
Royal Trials#064.speaker: Mansion Guard

Royal Trials#065.src: Ah, I thought yer might be the first one back. Yer got a queenly look about ye...
Royal Trials#065.dst: 아, 네가 제일 먼저 돌아올 줄 알았다. 여왕다운 기운이 있거든...
Royal Trials#065.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#066.src: Head to the airship behind me, lassie. We'll wait a second before the others.
Royal Trials#066.dst: 내 뒤의 비행선으로 가라, 아가씨. 다른 녀석들을 잠깐 기다리자.
Royal Trials#066.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#067.src: Exit the Mansion onto the airship outside.

Royal Trials#068.src: Listen to the trials overseer's speech.

Royal Trials#069.src: Aha! I figured it'd be ye to win o'er the rest of that lot… Ye've earned the proper sovereignty of bein' our ruler, our queen of the Skyraiders.
Royal Trials#069.dst: 하! 나머지를 이길 건 너일 줄 알았지... 넌 우리의 통치자, 하늘 약탈자의 여왕이 될 자격을 제대로 얻었다.
Royal Trials#069.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#070.src: Don't be worryin', we got this airship armoured somethin' heavy, and we’re miles away from their cannons… Nothin' to be afraid of, we're safe in this ship.
Royal Trials#070.dst: 걱정 마, 이 비행선은 장갑을 두껍게 둘렀고 놈들 대포에서 몇 마일은 떨어졌어... 겁낼 거 없다, 이 배에선 안전해.
Royal Trials#070.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#071.src: But, first things first, let’s take a look inside that fancy box ye got, see what mythical treasures lay guarded behind those grubby guardsmen, shall we?
Royal Trials#071.dst: 하지만 우선, 네가 가져온 그 화려한 상자 안을 보자고. 그 꾀죄죄한 경비병들이 지키던 전설의 보물이 뭔지 말이야.
Royal Trials#071.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#073.src: I hafta wonder now if this weren't bein' guarded for a bit of a nefarious reason. This be... Quite the weapon. It'd be deadly if this got used.
Royal Trials#073.dst: 이렇게 꽁꽁 지킨 데엔 흉악한 이유가 있었던 것 같군. 이건... 대단한 무기다. 쓰이면 끔찍한 일이 벌어질 거야.
Royal Trials#073.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#074.src: Well, thanks to ye, us Skyraiders might have it now, but using this weapon against civilization would be beyond terrible. We might be pirates but we ain't heartless!
Royal Trials#074.dst: 네 덕에 이제 우리 하늘 약탈자가 가졌을지 몰라도, 이 무기를 문명에 쓰는 건 너무 끔찍한 짓이지. 해적이라도 인정머리는 있다고!
Royal Trials#074.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#075.src: I think we'll just have to keep this locked up nice n' tight once we get back. We'll be sure to tie this little cataclysm-in-a-box down much safer th'n those idiot men did.
Royal Trials#075.dst: 돌아가면 이걸 꽁꽁 잠가 둬야겠어. 이 상자 속 재앙은 그 멍청한 사내놈들보다 훨씬 단단히 묶어 두마.
Royal Trials#075.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#076.src: Aha! Just gettin' back now. Let's head down and start the ceremony, shall we?
Royal Trials#076.dst: 하! 이제 막 도착했군. 내려가서 즉위식을 시작할까?
Royal Trials#076.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#077.src: I am pleased to introduce our {~}th Skyraider Queen. Fer the sake of our people, let her reign last more than two weeks.
Royal Trials#077.dst: 우리의 {~}번째 하늘 약탈자 여왕을 소개하게 되어 기쁘다. 우리 백성을 위해, 이번엔 2주는 넘게 버티길.
Royal Trials#077.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#078.src: I, on behalf on the rest of the Skyraider people, have the honor of decoratin' you with the highest decoration of the Skyraiders, The Queen's Headpiece.
Royal Trials#078.dst: 하늘 약탈자 백성을 대표해, 하늘 약탈자 최고의 영예, The Queen's Headpiece를 네게 수여하는 영광을 누리겠다.
Royal Trials#078.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#079.src: Please use your sovereignty to lead us to the riches we deserve.
Royal Trials#079.dst: 부디 네 통치로 우리가 마땅히 누릴 부로 이끌어 다오.
Royal Trials#079.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#081.src: Yer Majesty. What an honour to have such a beautiful queen.
Royal Trials#081.dst: 폐하. 이토록 아름다운 여왕을 모시다니 영광입니다.
Royal Trials#081.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#082.src: Now, we must crown ye, and give you yer reward.
Royal Trials#082.dst: 이제 왕관을 씌워 드리고, 보상을 드려야겠군요.
Royal Trials#082.speaker: Trials Overseer

Royal Trials#083.src: Benefits of being a queen I 'spose.
Royal Trials#083.dst: 여왕이 되면 이런 게 좋은 거겠죠.
Royal Trials#083.speaker: Trials Overseer

Shattered Minds#001.src: Aha, perfect! You'll be perfect! Lucky a human decided to come here!
Shattered Minds#001.dst: 아하, 완벽해! 딱 좋아! 마침 인간이 여기 와 주다니 운이 좋네!
Shattered Minds#001.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#002.src: I'll get to the point- I want you to go get something for me, and then bring it back here. Simple, right?
Shattered Minds#002.dst: 본론만 말할게. 뭘 좀 가져다줬으면 해. 그리고 여기로 가져오는 거지. 간단하지?
Shattered Minds#002.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#003.src: When you do that, I'm going to fix it up and try something out on you. Something magically enlightening!
Shattered Minds#003.dst: 그러면 내가 그걸 손질해서 너한테 뭘 좀 시험해 볼 거야. 마법으로 깨달음을 주는 거!
Shattered Minds#003.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#004.src: Oh, don't give me that look, it should be perfectly safe! Unless you've been mired in darkness for the past however many years...
Shattered Minds#004.dst: 아, 그런 눈으로 보지 마. 완전히 안전할 거야! 지난 몇 년 동안 어둠에 푹 빠져 살았던 게 아니라면...
Shattered Minds#004.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#005.src: Anyway, what I need is a specific kind of mushroom that grows close by, the Bluecap Mushroom.
Shattered Minds#005.dst: 아무튼, 필요한 건 근처에 자라는 특별한 버섯, 파란갓 버섯이야.
Shattered Minds#005.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#006.src: They grow underground- in a cave out the gate northwest of here. I'll even pay you if you bring it back, so what have you got to lose?
Shattered Minds#006.dst: 땅속에서 자라. 여기 북서쪽 문을 나가면 있는 동굴에. 가져오면 돈도 줄게. 손해 볼 거 없잖아?
Shattered Minds#006.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#007.src: Bring Likeru the mushrooms from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shattered Minds#008.src: Figure out how to get out of the cave, and return to Likeru.
Shattered Minds#008.dst: 동굴에서 빠져나갈 방법을 찾아 Likeru에게 돌아가세요

Shattered Minds#009.src: Looks like someone rolled about the air fuzz too much, so indeed hello! A light hello to yourself, {u}, and a greetings to Professor Eih, which is me!
Shattered Minds#009.dst: 누가 공중 솜털에 너무 굴렀나 보군, 그러니 정말로 안녕! {u}에게 가벼운 인사를, 그리고 Eih 교수, 즉 나에게도 인사를!

Shattered Minds#010.src: I don't rhyme all the instances, I feel the need to say. But what do you say? Very little! But I bet you're wondering where you are.
Shattered Minds#010.dst: 매번 운을 맞추진 않는다고 말해 둬야겠군. 그런데 넌 뭐라고 할 텐가? 거의 아무 말도! 하지만 여기가 어딘지 궁금하겠지.
Shattered Minds#010.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#011.src: I am no gambling man, but the chips are down and it is time to play {~}-Pickup with the puzzle pieces, and I'll eat my bowtie if you aren't ready.
Shattered Minds#011.dst: 난 도박꾼은 아니지만 판돈은 걸렸고, 이제 퍼즐 조각으로 {~}조각 줍기 놀이를 할 때다. 준비 안 됐다면 내 나비넥타이를 먹지.
Shattered Minds#011.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#012.src: The betting pool says the way to go is the opposite of in front, so that leaves someplace we can't talk about in front of the kids as your path!
Shattered Minds#012.dst: 판돈 풀이 말하길 갈 길은 앞의 반대라니, 네 길은 애들 앞에선 말 못 할 그곳이다!
Shattered Minds#012.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#013.src: I will be around! Or asquare, as it were. Technically amultiplesquares, replete with alines! And abevels! And other some such things like-
Shattered Minds#013.dst: 난 근처에 있을 거다! 아니, 근처 사각형인가. 엄밀히는 근처 여러 사각형, 근처 선분 가득! 근처 경사면도! 그리고 기타 등등-
Shattered Minds#013.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#014.src: The punks scramble like eggs, and your skillet is sizzling! Certainly the heat in the kitchen is too much- so where is the fire extinguisher?
Shattered Minds#014.dst: 불량배들은 달걀처럼 휘저어지고, 네 프라이팬은 지글지글! 부엌은 확실히 너무 뜨겁다- 그럼 소화기는 어디 있지?
Shattered Minds#014.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#015.src: It won't rocket you! The hole in the shape of a door looms out of your transparent grasp- frogs can't skip leg day, so be froggy! Bounce and jump!
Shattered Minds#015.dst: 날려 보내진 않는다! 문 모양 구멍이 투명한 손아귀 너머로 어른거린다- 개구리는 하체 운동을 못 빼먹지, 개구리가 되어라! 튀고 뛰어라!
Shattered Minds#015.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#016.src: Swoosh and sprint! Speed and non-slip shoes! With a CLICK upon me I give you all but one, as much as you need!
Shattered Minds#016.dst: 휙휙, 질주! 속도와 미끄럼 방지 신발! 날 딸깍 누르면 하나 빼고 다 주지, 필요한 만큼!
Shattered Minds#016.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#017.src: The colors! Shimmering as a prism- oh, no one likes those things. The writing is on the wall, but the window mugs it for pocket change! The inhumanity!
Shattered Minds#017.dst: 색깔들! 프리즘처럼 반짝- 아, 아무도 그런 건 안 좋아하지. 벽에 글씨가 써 있는데, 창문이 푼돈 때문에 털어 가는군! 이 무슨 비인간적인!
Shattered Minds#017.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#018.src: Use your eyes as ears and hear what I shall write! The cockpit is missing ground control and the cornfields all look the same in endless rows!
Shattered Minds#018.dst: 눈을 귀 삼아 내가 쓸 말을 들어라! 조종실엔 관제탑이 없고, 옥수수밭은 끝없는 줄이 다 똑같구나!
Shattered Minds#018.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#019.src: So Eih, esquire professor PhD, will provide the coordinates in helpfully non-literal fashion, and one's joystick shall lead the holder to bliss!
Shattered Minds#019.dst: 그러니 Eih, 교수 나리 박사께서 친절히 비유적으로 좌표를 주실 테니, 조종간이 쥔 자를 극락으로 이끌리라!
Shattered Minds#019.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#020.src: At one's boots, the colors paint themselves towards an orientation. Above one's head, the lights match and fling you the same!
Shattered Minds#020.dst: 발치에서 색깔들이 방향을 향해 스스로 칠해진다. 머리 위에선 불빛이 짝을 맞춰 널 같은 쪽으로 던진다!
Shattered Minds#020.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#021.src: I'm all out of airplane food, but the goal is more than peanuts- it's progress, just opposite our position. Fly well!
Shattered Minds#021.dst: 기내식이 다 떨어졌지만 목표는 땅콩 몇 알 이상이다- 진전이지, 우리 위치 정반대에. 잘 날아라!
Shattered Minds#021.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#022.src: WOW. Just, WOW! Your brain being frazzled doesn't excuse this failure! Time is money and we're swimming in a river called DEBT!
Shattered Minds#022.dst: 와. 그냥, 와! 뇌가 지쳤다고 이 실패가 용서되진 않아! 시간은 돈이고 우린 빚이라는 강에서 헤엄치는 중이라고!
Shattered Minds#022.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#023.src: I'm just going to stand here and you're gonna go into the teleporters I'm NOT in, and you're gonna like it!
Shattered Minds#023.dst: 난 여기 서 있을 테니 넌 내가 없는 순간이동기로 들어가라, 그리고 좋아하게 될 거다!
Shattered Minds#023.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#024.src: Explore the strange forest to find Likeru.

Shattered Minds#025.src: Hey, look to your left for a moment.

Shattered Minds#026.src: I hope you've got a note pad with you, if you want me to teach you the ways of a master you'll need to write a lot down!
Shattered Minds#026.dst: 공책 챙겨 왔길 바란다. 대가의 길을 배우고 싶다면 받아 적을 게 많거든!
Shattered Minds#026.speaker: Steve

Shattered Minds#027.src: It doesn't matter that we're on a {~}-match losing streak, we'll never give up!
Shattered Minds#027.dst: {~}연패 중이면 어때, 우린 절대 포기 안 해!
Shattered Minds#027.speaker: Erd

Shattered Minds#028.src: C'mon Beakmeister, we've ventured together for years now! Why won't you listen to me?
Shattered Minds#028.dst: 제발, Beakmeister, 우리 몇 년을 같이 모험했잖아! 왜 내 말을 안 들어?
Shattered Minds#028.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#029.src: I don't think she's even listening to me anymore. She's a free spirit!
Shattered Minds#029.dst: 이제 내 말은 아예 안 듣는 것 같아. 자유로운 영혼이거든!
Shattered Minds#029.speaker: Flamingo Rider

Shattered Minds#030.src: Familiar to the nursing home, with no IV in sight! Phenomenal, and now my gambling metaphors will be apropos!
Shattered Minds#030.dst: 요양원엔 익숙한데 링거는 하나도 안 보이는군! 경이롭다, 이제야 내 도박 비유가 딱 맞겠어!
Shattered Minds#030.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#031.src: A solid, {~} pure, statue-made-out-of-tons-of-things what looks like me! I call it, “Ill Of The Ooze, Young!” And it begets your path amongst the lilypads.
Shattered Minds#031.dst: 튼튼하고 {~} 순수한, 온갖 걸 수 톤 쌓아 만든 나를 닮은 조각상! 이름하여 '진흙의 병, 젊은이!' 그게 연잎 사이로 네 길을 낳는다.
Shattered Minds#031.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#032.src: Likeru? No, no, she can’t find you here- her eyes deceive her. But I won't! Not any more than the film reel degrades, and the theater is ahead!
Shattered Minds#032.dst: Likeru? 아니, 그녀는 여기서 널 못 찾아- 눈이 그녀를 속이거든. 하지만 난 안 속이지! 필름이 닳는 것 이상으론, 그리고 극장은 바로 앞이다!
Shattered Minds#032.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#033.src: Now, don't tell the kids about this one either! The way forward is through my masterpiece- but I can't imagine a gullet glorious!
Shattered Minds#033.dst: 자, 이것도 애들한텐 비밀이다! 앞길은 내 걸작을 지나야 해- 하지만 영광스러운 목구멍이라니 상상이 안 되는군!
Shattered Minds#033.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#034.src: Enter the giant frog and escape.

Shattered Minds#035.src: Don't come any closer... I don't want to have to fight...
Shattered Minds#035.dst: 가까이 오지 마... 싸우고 싶지 않아...

Shattered Minds#036.src: I-I'm warning you. You'll stand no match against me...
Shattered Minds#036.dst: 겨, 경고했어. 넌 내 상대가 안 돼...

Shattered Minds#038.src: There we are! Snapped out of it! Though perhaps writing in the mud was better- Soon it will dry.
Shattered Minds#038.dst: 자, 됐다! 정신이 돌아왔군! 진흙에 쓰는 편이 나았을지도- 곧 마를 테니.
Shattered Minds#038.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#039.src: Without the static of the fungal caps, the radio station will be off-air- and the device unplugged!
Shattered Minds#039.dst: 버섯갓의 잡음이 없으면 라디오 방송은 끊기고- 장치는 플러그가 뽑힌다!
Shattered Minds#039.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#040.src: Scratch it in your eyelids- the lightbulb screwed between the arches, and the feather-duster's sunset shades will reveal my deepest compatriot. Quick now, wake!
Shattered Minds#040.dst: 눈꺼풀에 새겨라- 아치 사이에 끼운 전구, 먼지떨이의 노을빛이 나의 가장 깊은 동포를 드러내리라. 어서, 깨어나라!
Shattered Minds#040.speaker: Professor Eih

Shattered Minds#041.src: Ugh. Rats chewing the roots. They've their place, it simply isn't here. Neither is your place in the koi pond, stranger.
Shattered Minds#041.dst: 으. 쥐들이 뿌리를 갉아. 녀석들도 있을 곳이 있지만 여긴 아니야. 네가 있을 곳도 이 잉어 연못은 아니고, 이방인.
Shattered Minds#041.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#042.src: I believe Likeru tossed you into the deep end without meaning, so to speak. I understand your being overwhelmed, but still...
Shattered Minds#042.dst: Likeru가 뜻 없이 널 깊은 물에 던진 모양이군, 말하자면. 당황한 건 이해하지만, 그래도...
Shattered Minds#042.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#043.src: Speaking of which, it might behoove you to let her know you've recovered. Though, should you need rest, you may take it here.
Shattered Minds#043.dst: 그러고 보니, 네가 회복했다고 그녀에게 알리는 게 좋겠어. 쉬어야 한다면 여기서 쉬어도 되고.
Shattered Minds#043.speaker: Elder Berusia

Shattered Minds#045.src: Ehm. Okay, that was...a bad idea. Should NOT have done that with a human. Uh, noted for the futu- oh, you're actually alright?!
Shattered Minds#045.dst: 음. 그래, 그건... 나쁜 생각이었어. 인간한테 하면 절대 안 됐어. 어, 다음을 위해 기록- 어, 너 멀쩡해?!
Shattered Minds#045.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#046.src: You came back and just leapt into the koi pond! I thought you'd drowned down there!
Shattered Minds#046.dst: 돌아오자마자 잉어 연못에 뛰어들었잖아! 거기서 빠져 죽은 줄 알았어!
Shattered Minds#046.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#047.src: I guess the spores from the Bluecaps got to you before you could bring them back. I wonder what you saw?
Shattered Minds#047.dst: 가져오기 전에 파란갓 버섯 포자에 당했나 봐. 뭘 봤는지 궁금하네?
Shattered Minds#047.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#048.src: You reacted like you were crazy when I tried to talk with you... You were supposed to get visions of the light! A deep connection!
Shattered Minds#048.dst: 말을 걸었더니 미친 사람처럼 굴더라... 원래는 빛의 환영을 봐야 했어! 깊은 교감!
Shattered Minds#048.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#049.src: Wait, maybe it's cause of that portal...the signals got mixed? I'll have to look into this more...but hey, I got the Bluecap, anyways, so...
Shattered Minds#049.dst: 잠깐, 그 차원문 때문일지도... 신호가 섞였나? 더 조사해 봐야겠어... 그래도 파란갓 버섯은 얻었으니...
Shattered Minds#049.speaker: Likeru

Shattered Minds#050.src: Here, your payment- and a little extra I whipped up too. Um, really sorry about all that!
Shattered Minds#050.dst: 자, 네 보수야. 그리고 내가 만든 덤도 좀. 음, 그 일은 정말 미안해!
Shattered Minds#050.speaker: Likeru

Shrouded in Mist#004.src: Would you like to challenge Sovereign Zhiraok again?

Shrouded in Mist#005.src: New Chapter Started: Amongst the Canopy

Shrouded in Mist#006.src: There's a thin layer of dust on top of the bed.
Shrouded in Mist#006.dst: 침대 위에 먼지가 얇게 쌓여 있다.

Shrouded in Mist#007.src: The monitor is keeping the machine running.

Shrouded in Mist#008.src: Maybe something sharp can break it...

Shrouded in Mist#009.src: - Entry {~}: Stayed in and slept all day. Was very tired.
Shrouded in Mist#009.dst: - {~}번째 기록: 종일 집에서 잤다. 몹시 피곤했다.

Shrouded in Mist#010.src: - Entry {~}: Slept in. Boss wasn't happy with me, has me working extra shifts next week.
Shrouded in Mist#010.dst: - {~}번째 기록: 늦잠. 사장이 언짢아하며 다음 주에 추가 근무를 시켰다.

Shrouded in Mist#013.src: The entries stop after this point...

Shrouded in Mist#014.src: This must be where Nisen lives...

Shrouded in Mist#015.src: Group up with the remaining members at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Shrouded in Mist#020.src: About what? What could you possibly be thinking about right-
Shrouded in Mist#020.dst: 뭘? 지금 이 상황에 무슨 생각을-
Shrouded in Mist#020.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#021.src: I don't know, Yusanu! Maybe about what to do next? How we can- h-how we-
Shrouded in Mist#021.dst: 몰라, Yusanu! 다음에 뭘 할지? 우리가 어떻게- 어, 어떻게-
Shrouded in Mist#021.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#022.src: There's nothing we can do! We're stuck in unfamiliar territory, all lone, our family and friends all captured, or- or worse-
Shrouded in Mist#022.dst: 할 수 있는 게 없어! 낯선 땅에 우리끼리 갇혔고, 가족도 친구도 다 잡혀갔거나, 아니- 더 나쁘게-
Shrouded in Mist#022.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#024.src: Urgh! I can't believe I let her convince me stealing this... this thing was worth it! If I hadn't, then... then our agreement wouldn't have fallen through, and none of this would have-
Shrouded in Mist#024.dst: 으! 그 녀석 말에 넘어가서 이걸... 이딴 걸 훔칠 가치가 있다고 믿다니! 안 훔쳤으면... 협상도 안 틀어지고, 이런 일도 없었을-
Shrouded in Mist#024.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#025.src: Don't you dare pin this on Rex. You heard what that Sovereign said, they- th-they knew what we were planning for ages!
Shrouded in Mist#025.dst: 감히 Rex 탓으로 돌리지 마. 그 군주가 한 말 들었잖아, 그놈들- 오, 오래전부터 우리 계획을 알고 있었다고!
Shrouded in Mist#025.speaker: Sui

Shrouded in Mist#026.src: ...then maybe it'd have been best if you left us out of it.
Shrouded in Mist#026.speaker: Yusanu

Shrouded in Mist#031.src: Woah woah woah woah woah! Alright, let's all take a step back, shall we?
Shrouded in Mist#031.dst: 워워워워워! 자자, 다들 한 걸음씩 물러서죠?

Shrouded in Mist#032.src: Owls! Step down! Bit of a leap, jumping straight to violence- we reserve that for the obviously crown-aligned, eheheh.
Shrouded in Mist#032.dst: 올빼미들! 물러서! 바로 폭력으로 뛰어드는 건 좀 성급하죠. 그건 대놓고 왕실 편인 놈들한테나 쓰는 거예요, 에헤헤.

Shrouded in Mist#033.src: Allow me to introduce myself! The name's Rurie, member of the Canopy, captain of the Owls division! Apologies for the roughhousing, seems everyone's a little enthusiastic today, eh?
Shrouded in Mist#033.dst: 제 소개를 하죠! 이름은 Rurie, Canopy의 일원이자 올빼미 부대 대장이에요! 거칠게 굴어서 미안해요, 오늘 다들 좀 들떴나 봐요?
Shrouded in Mist#033.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#035.src: Questions, questions! I'm afraid it's our turn first- I've called the owls off for a time, but don't think you're off the hook just yet, young lady!
Shrouded in Mist#035.dst: 질문, 질문! 유감이지만 우리 차례가 먼저예요. 올빼미들은 잠깐 물렸지만, 아직 풀려난 줄 알면 안 돼요, 아가씨!
Shrouded in Mist#035.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#036.src: ...captain, are you certain about this? For all we know, they could be spies-
Shrouded in Mist#036.dst: ...대장님, 정말 괜찮겠습니까? 저들이 첩자일 수도 있습니다-
Shrouded in Mist#036.speaker: Owl Fighter

Shrouded in Mist#037.src: Ah ah ah! Trust in the process, my friend. Spies or not, information is valuable.
Shrouded in Mist#037.dst: 아아아! 절차를 믿어요, 친구. 첩자든 아니든, 정보는 값지거든요.
Shrouded in Mist#037.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#038.src: Besides! We know how to... ah, deal with spies, as it were. Risk factor is minimal!
Shrouded in Mist#038.dst: 게다가! 우린 첩자를... 음, 다루는 법을 알잖아요. 위험 요소는 최소예요!
Shrouded in Mist#038.speaker: Rurie

Shrouded in Mist#039.src: So... what, are you also resisting-
