Solidarity of Steel#203.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#204.src: In truth, looks may be deceiving. Everyone here is resisting in whatever ways they can manage, but few are willing to put as much of themselves into it as your group.
Solidarity of Steel#204.dst: 사실 겉보기와는 다르다네. 여기 모두 각자 할 수 있는 방식으로 저항하지만, 자네 일행만큼 자신을 내던지려는 이는 드물지.
Solidarity of Steel#204.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#205.src: Most of them are simply trying to live without the watchful eye of the monarchy. Our safe haven takes in people who are at risk. People who can't work, who have been thrown out of their homes...
Solidarity of Steel#205.dst: 대부분은 그저 왕실의 감시를 피해 살아가려는 거네. 우리 피난처는 위태로운 이들을 받아들이지. 일할 수 없는 이들, 집에서 쫓겨난 이들...
Solidarity of Steel#205.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#206.src: But we are not helpless. The brothers and I are all ready to help, however we can. And the rest of the Steel Feather will still offer support from the sidelines. We have infrastructure, and we have resources.
Solidarity of Steel#206.dst: 하지만 우리가 무력한 건 아니야. 나와 형제들은 할 수 있는 한 도울 준비가 됐네. Steel Feather의 다른 이들도 뒤에서 지원할 걸세. 시설도 있고, 자원도 있지.
Solidarity of Steel#206.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#207.src: I've also suggested that you might offer to teach the basics of magic to those who are interested-
Solidarity of Steel#207.dst: 관심 있는 사람들에게 마법 기초를 가르쳐 주면 어떻겠냐고도 제안했어요-
Solidarity of Steel#207.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#208.src: Yes, yes, but I do not believe we need curses or blessings to resist. As I've told you several times before in our correspondences, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#208.dst: 그래, 그래, 하지만 저항하는 데 저주나 축복이 필요하다곤 생각하지 않네. 편지로도 몇 번이나 말했잖나, Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#208.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#209.src: And as I've told you in response, I see no reason not to make use of all the tools available!
Solidarity of Steel#209.dst: 그리고 저도 답장에 썼죠, 쓸 수 있는 도구를 다 쓰지 않을 이유가 없다고요!
Solidarity of Steel#209.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#210.src: Syndra, I have been firm on this point for a reason. We have done well for ourselves thus far.
Solidarity of Steel#210.dst: Syndra, 내가 이 점에서 단호한 데엔 이유가 있네. 지금까지 우리 힘으로도 잘해 왔어.
Solidarity of Steel#210.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#211.src: As an example- Yusanu has grown quite proficient with machinery. He has constructed weaponry, tools- even my leg is his creation!
Solidarity of Steel#211.dst: 예를 들자면- Yusanu는 기계를 아주 능숙하게 다루게 됐지. 무기도, 도구도 만들었고- 내 다리도 그 녀석 작품이라네!
Solidarity of Steel#211.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#212.src: ... I simply think that-... Sigh. Fine. Quill, we should get to discussing the reason we came here.
Solidarity of Steel#212.dst: ... 제 말은 그냥-... 하아. 알겠어요. Quill, 우리가 여기 온 이유를 얘기해야겠어요.
Solidarity of Steel#212.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#213.src: Yes, I rather think we should. {u}, in the meantime, why don't you take a look around the station? Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#213.dst: 그래, 그게 좋겠군. {u}, 그동안 역을 한번 둘러보는 게 어떤가? 이곳과 사람들에게 익숙해지게.
Solidarity of Steel#213.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#214.src: Explore the Steel Feather train station at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#215.src: Take a look around the station! Familiarize yourself with the area and the people.
Solidarity of Steel#215.dst: 역을 한번 둘러보게! 이곳과 사람들에게 익숙해지게.
Solidarity of Steel#215.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#216.src: Hoho! So they return! Tell us, how did it go?
Solidarity of Steel#216.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#218.src: Ah, we all knew the stakes going in! Worry not, friend, your sacrifice will not be forgotten any time soon!
Solidarity of Steel#218.dst: 아, 다들 각오하고 들어간 거잖아요! 걱정 마요, 친구, 당신의 희생은 쉽게 잊히지 않을 거예요!
Solidarity of Steel#218.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#219.src: Hey! E- e- enough with the theatrics!
Solidarity of Steel#219.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#220.src: Excellent! You have successfully defied the odds, friend!
Solidarity of Steel#220.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#221.src: Zeph didn't believe you'd make it, you know.
Solidarity of Steel#221.dst: 있잖아, Zeph는 네가 해낼 거라고 안 믿었어.
Solidarity of Steel#221.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#222.src: Wh- what, n- no I- I didn't- Sui!! D- don't- don't believe a word- a word she says, o- okay?
Solidarity of Steel#222.dst: 뭐, 뭐, 아, 아니, 난- 안 그랬- Sui!! 쟤, 쟤 말 한마디도- 한마디도 믿지 마, 아, 알았지?
Solidarity of Steel#222.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#223.src: Wh- what were they talking about, anyway?
Solidarity of Steel#223.dst: 그, 그래서 둘이 무슨 얘기 했는데?
Solidarity of Steel#223.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#224.src: Oh, so it was as boring as I predicted.
Solidarity of Steel#224.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#225.src: Don't call that boring, Rex! It's... nice for her to relax for a little, isn't it?
Solidarity of Steel#225.dst: 지루하다고 하지 마, Rex! Syndra가... 잠깐이라도 쉬는 건 좋은 거잖아?
Solidarity of Steel#225.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#226.src: It can be both boring and a nice thing, can it not? The nice things often tend towards the boring end of the spectrum, in any case.
Solidarity of Steel#226.dst: 지루하면서 좋은 일일 수도 있지 않나요? 어차피 좋은 일은 대개 지루한 쪽에 가깝지요.
Solidarity of Steel#226.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#227.src: So, still n- nothing about the plans... when is she go- go- going to tell us anything?
Solidarity of Steel#227.dst: 그래서 계, 계획 얘기는 여, 여전히 없고... 대체 언, 언제 말해 준대?
Solidarity of Steel#227.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#228.src: Have patience, young Leaf. She will tell us when it is time! Now, Sui and I have had the opportunity to explore, but you three have not! So, go on! Look around, talk to people.
Solidarity of Steel#228.dst: 참을성을 가져요, 젊은 잎새. 때가 되면 말해 줄 거예요! 자, Sui와 전 둘러볼 기회가 있었지만 셋은 아직이죠! 그러니 가요! 둘러보고, 사람들과 얘기해요.
Solidarity of Steel#228.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#230.src: Ah. You're all back already? Man, I totally lost track of time there... there's so much to do.
Solidarity of Steel#230.dst: 아. 벌써 다 돌아왔어? 이런, 시간 가는 줄도 몰랐네... 할 일이 너무 많아.
Solidarity of Steel#230.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#231.src: So, what's up? Sorry I couldn't talk to you more earlier- I'm the one who makes sure everything runs smoothly here.
Solidarity of Steel#231.dst: 그래서, 무슨 일이야? 아까 더 얘기 못 해서 미안- 여기가 잘 돌아가게 챙기는 게 나거든.
Solidarity of Steel#231.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#232.src: Most of the infrastructure was here already, but I basically fixed it all up myself... with some help, of course. But now I'm in charge of maintaining all of it!
Solidarity of Steel#232.dst: 시설 대부분은 원래 있었는데, 거의 다 내가 직접 고쳤어... 물론 도움은 좀 받았지. 그리고 이젠 그 전부를 유지 보수하는 게 내 담당이야!
Solidarity of Steel#232.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#233.src: It's not usually this... hectic. We had some stuff break down recently, and I'm the oooonly one who can deal with it!
Solidarity of Steel#233.dst: 평소엔 이렇게... 정신없진 않아. 최근에 뭐가 좀 고장 났는데, 처리할 수 있는 사람이 나 하나뿐이거든!
Solidarity of Steel#233.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#235.src: ... Still don't have time to chat, sorry! I'm nearly done, though, I'll be out in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#235.dst: ... 여전히 얘기할 시간이 없네, 미안! 그래도 거의 끝나 가, 금방 나갈게.
Solidarity of Steel#235.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#238.src: Hah! Yeah, yeah, maybe. I was hoping to tease him some more.
Solidarity of Steel#238.dst: 하! 그래, 그래, 그럴지도. 좀 더 놀려 주고 싶었는데.
Solidarity of Steel#238.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#239.src: He's a fun guy! But the boy's gotta learn how to tease back... it's no fun if it's one-side, y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#239.dst: 재밌는 녀석이야! 근데 그 녀석도 받아칠 줄 알아야지... 한쪽만 놀리면 재미없잖아, 알지?
Solidarity of Steel#239.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#240.src: ...what? Ey, don't look at me like that! It's all for fun at the end of the day. If he tells me to quit it, I'll quit it.
Solidarity of Steel#240.dst: ...뭐? 야, 그런 눈으로 보지 마! 결국 다 재미로 하는 거야. 그만하라고 하면 그만할게.
Solidarity of Steel#240.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#242.src: I'll... go over there later. Eventually! ... Maybe.
Solidarity of Steel#242.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#243.src: Eheh. Wouldn't want to overstay my welcome, y'know? I've got things to do, anyway...
Solidarity of Steel#243.dst: 에헤. 너무 오래 눌러앉으면 민폐잖아, 알지? 어차피 나도 할 일이 있고...
Solidarity of Steel#243.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#244.src: ...so, you exploring? That's good! I'd show you around, but... eheh, I'm uh, working on a little something right now.
Solidarity of Steel#244.dst: ...그래서, 둘러보는 중이야? 좋지! 구경시켜 주고 싶은데... 에헤, 지금 뭘 좀, 어, 만드는 중이라.
Solidarity of Steel#244.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#245.src: Yo, quit trying to sneak a peak at it! No spoilers! You'll see it tonight, if I get it done.
Solidarity of Steel#245.dst: 야, 몰래 보려고 하지 마! 스포 금지! 다 만들면 오늘 밤에 보게 될 거야.
Solidarity of Steel#245.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#247.src: Hm. I suppose you're used to invading personal space?
Solidarity of Steel#247.dst: 흠. 남의 공간에 들어오는 게 익숙한가 보지?
Solidarity of Steel#247.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#248.src: Don't worry, I'm not upset. I appreciate the effort in familiarizing yourself with this place.
Solidarity of Steel#248.dst: 걱정 마, 화난 거 아니야. 여기 익숙해지려고 애쓰는 건 고맙게 생각해.
Solidarity of Steel#248.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#249.src: Did you have a question, or are you just looking around?
Solidarity of Steel#249.dst: 물어볼 게 있어, 아니면 그냥 둘러보는 거야?
Solidarity of Steel#249.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#250.src: Oh, has he done something again? Of course he has... I apologize for my brother's actions.
Solidarity of Steel#250.dst: 아, 걔가 또 뭘 했어? 당연히 했겠지... 동생 일은 내가 사과할게.
Solidarity of Steel#250.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#251.src: He's... hard to keep a handle on. Energetic, impulsive... I do love him, but do I ever wish he would cause less trouble.
Solidarity of Steel#251.dst: 걔는... 감당하기 힘들어. 넘치는 기운에, 충동적이고... 사랑하긴 하지만, 말썽 좀 덜 부렸으면 정말 좋겠어.
Solidarity of Steel#251.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#253.src: Ah. Then I apologize for my assumption.
Solidarity of Steel#253.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#254.src: He's... I might be too hard on him sometimes. He does help out a lot around here, he does- just... like I said. Energetic and impulsive.
Solidarity of Steel#254.dst: 걔는... 내가 가끔 너무 엄하게 대하는지도 몰라. 여기서 도움도 많이 되고, 정말로- 그냥... 말했듯이. 기운 넘치고 충동적이야.
Solidarity of Steel#254.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#255.src: You'll get used to his personality, with time. Everyone does.
Solidarity of Steel#255.dst: 시간이 지나면 걔 성격에도 익숙해질 거야. 다들 그래.
Solidarity of Steel#255.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#256.src: But in any case, I'll speak with him about it. He should know better than to bother our guests.
Solidarity of Steel#256.dst: 그래도 어쨌든 걔랑 얘기해 볼게. 손님을 귀찮게 하면 안 된다는 것쯤은 알아야지.
Solidarity of Steel#256.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#257.src: I have to get back to work. I'll see you around.
Solidarity of Steel#257.dst: 난 일하러 가 봐야 해. 또 보자.
Solidarity of Steel#257.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#258.src: Hm? My role? That's a bit of a complex question, actually. In the Steel Feather... I don't do much.
Solidarity of Steel#258.dst: 응? 내 역할? 사실 좀 복잡한 질문이야. Steel Feather에서... 난 하는 게 별로 없어.
Solidarity of Steel#258.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#259.src: But I work as a consulting detective for the crown, in the city. I perform investigations for them, but I also gather information for us - keeping tabs on the military, and such.
Solidarity of Steel#259.dst: 대신 도시에서 왕실의 자문 탐정으로 일해. 왕실을 위해 수사를 하지만, 우리를 위해 정보도 모으지 - 군의 동향을 살피는 식으로.
Solidarity of Steel#259.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#260.src: Besides, the pay's... decent enough. A few emeralds in my pocket helps all of us down here. Unfortunately, we can't produce everything ourselves.
Solidarity of Steel#260.dst: 게다가 보수도... 그럭저럭 괜찮아. 내 주머니의 에메랄드 몇 개가 여기 모두에게 도움이 돼. 안타깝게도 전부 자급할 순 없거든.
Solidarity of Steel#260.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#261.src: But speaking of my work, I... am actually busy preparing for a meeting right now. {p}'s Commander wants us on the lookout for... something, he hasn't told us yet.
Solidarity of Steel#261.dst: 근데 일 얘기가 나와서 말인데... 사실 지금 회의 준비로 바빠. {p} 사령관이 뭘... 경계하라는데, 아직 뭔지 안 알려 줬어.
Solidarity of Steel#261.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#262.src: But it's my duty to find out, so into the city I will go. If you'll excuse me, I'll get back to preparing now.
Solidarity of Steel#262.dst: 그래도 알아내는 게 내 임무니까 도시로 가야지. 실례할게, 다시 준비하러 가 봐야 해.
Solidarity of Steel#262.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#263.src: Return to the main room at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#265.src: Nothing beyond what I'd written in our letters.
Solidarity of Steel#265.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#266.src: Alright... thank you, Quill. Just a little longer, then I-
Solidarity of Steel#266.dst: 알겠어요... 고마워요, Quill. 조금만 더, 그러면 제가-
Solidarity of Steel#266.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#267.src: Ah, {u}! What do you think of our home? It took a great deal of planning to get the station up and running, but I feel we've done a good-
Solidarity of Steel#267.dst: 아, {u}! 우리 집은 어떤가? 역을 돌아가게 하려고 계획을 무척 많이 세웠지만, 꽤 잘해 낸 것-
Solidarity of Steel#267.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#270.src: I overheard... an altercation... between a woma-... and a- ...dier...
Solidarity of Steel#270.dst: 들었어요... 말다툼을... 어떤 여... 그리고 병...
Solidarity of Steel#270.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#271.src: Calm yourself, Jiro. Take a breath, and repeat
Solidarity of Steel#271.dst: 진정하게, Jiro. 숨 한번 쉬고, 다시 말해 보게
Solidarity of Steel#271.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#272.src: A woman is being kicked out... again! I don't know the details, but I think she didn't reach her quota for the month.
Solidarity of Steel#272.dst: 어떤 여자가 쫓겨나고 있어요... 또요! 자세한 건 모르지만, 이번 달 할당량을 못 채운 것 같아요.
Solidarity of Steel#272.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#274.src: Living Block {~} - through the southwestern tunnel.
Solidarity of Steel#274.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#278.src: We're heading out. Rescue mission. Yuman, where's Yulie?
Solidarity of Steel#278.dst: 우리 나간다. 구출 작전이야. Yuman, Yulie 형은?
Solidarity of Steel#278.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#279.src: He has a meeting in the city today, remember? He told all of us this morning.
Solidarity of Steel#279.dst: 형 오늘 도시에서 회의 있잖아, 기억 안 나? 아침에 다 말했는데.
Solidarity of Steel#279.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#280.src: ...Right. Right, he did say- alright. We'll have to go in blind, then. Not ideal, but it can't be helped-
Solidarity of Steel#280.dst: ...맞다. 맞아, 그랬지- 좋아. 그럼 아무 정보 없이 가야겠네. 안 좋지만 어쩔 수 없-
Solidarity of Steel#280.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#281.src: Damn it! Not now, of all times to-
Solidarity of Steel#281.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#282.src: What's going on? Is something wrong?
Solidarity of Steel#282.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#283.src: No, no, nothing's- it's nothing bad... I hope. I just need to... check what triggered the alarm. Ugh, can anything go right today...
Solidarity of Steel#283.dst: 아니, 아니, 별거- 나쁜 일은 아니야... 아마도. 그냥... 경보가 왜 울렸는지 봐야 해. 으, 오늘은 뭐 하나 제대로 되는 게 없네...
Solidarity of Steel#283.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#284.src: Hey, bro, don't worry about it. I'll handle it! You take care of whatever you need to, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#284.dst: 야, 형, 걱정 마. 내가 처리할게! 형은 형 할 일 해, 알았지?
Solidarity of Steel#284.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#285.src: ...Okay. Okay, thanks, Yuman. I owe you one.
Solidarity of Steel#285.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#286.src: Hey, one of these days I'll collect on all those ones you owe me! Don't think you can dodge that just cause you're my bro!
Solidarity of Steel#286.dst: 야, 언젠간 형이 진 신세 싹 다 받아 낼 거야! 형이라고 그냥 넘어갈 생각 마!
Solidarity of Steel#286.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#287.src: Will you n- ne- need help? {u} and I can join if y- if you need us.
Solidarity of Steel#287.dst: 도, 도움 필요해? 피, 필요하면 {u}랑 나도 같이 갈게.
Solidarity of Steel#287.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#288.src: Was just about to ask the same thing! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, you all listen to my orders 'till this is sorted! Got it?
Solidarity of Steel#288.dst: 나도 그거 물어보려던 참이야! Jiro, Zeph, {u}, 이 일 끝날 때까지 다들 내 명령 따라! 알았지?
Solidarity of Steel#288.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#290.src: You forgot the "sir" at the end, there! Anyway, let me grab my guitar, and let's head out!
Solidarity of Steel#290.dst: 끝에 '대장님'을 빼먹었네! 어쨌든 기타 좀 챙기고 출발하자!
Solidarity of Steel#290.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#292.src: Don't ask, you'll find out later. We need to get moving now.
Solidarity of Steel#292.dst: 묻지 마, 나중에 알게 돼. 지금 당장 움직여야 해.
Solidarity of Steel#292.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#294.src: Follow Yuman to the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#296.src: I hope Yuman doesn't annoy them to death...
Solidarity of Steel#296.dst: Yuman이 저 애들을 귀찮게 해서 죽이지나 않길 바라네...
Solidarity of Steel#296.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#297.src: Th- through here! Yuman and Jiro are s- sc- scouting up ahead.
Solidarity of Steel#297.dst: 이, 이쪽이야! Yuman이랑 Jiro가 앞에서 정, 정찰 중이야.
Solidarity of Steel#297.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#298.src: Find the woman in trouble at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#299.src: I see them up a- a- ahead... Let's join up with them. Fo- follow me!
Solidarity of Steel#299.dst: 앞에 저, 저기 보여... 합류하자. 따, 따라와!
Solidarity of Steel#299.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#301.src: Alright, lady! Time's up! It's time to get going.
Solidarity of Steel#301.dst: 자, 아가씨! 시간 다 됐어! 이제 나가야지.
Solidarity of Steel#301.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#302.src: We need to clean up this filthy apartment of yours for whoever's next in line. We've got a tight schedule, so don't make this harder than it needs to be, alright?
Solidarity of Steel#302.dst: 다음 차례를 위해 이 더러운 집을 치워야 하거든. 일정이 빡빡하니까, 괜히 일 번거롭게 만들지 마, 알았어?
Solidarity of Steel#302.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#303.src: W-w-wait! I still need to pack! You haven't given me enough time!
Solidarity of Steel#303.dst: 자, 자, 잠깐만요! 아직 짐도 못 쌌어요! 시간을 충분히 안 줬잖아요!
Solidarity of Steel#303.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#304.src: You received an eviction notice last night, detailing the protocol, didn't you? You've had plenty of time already, lady.
Solidarity of Steel#304.dst: 어젯밤에 절차가 적힌 퇴거 통지서 받았잖아, 안 그래? 시간은 충분했어, 아가씨.
Solidarity of Steel#304.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#305.src: Unless what you mean to say is you take issue with the system? We've got a formal complaints department, lady, but I don't think you'd enjoy paying them a visit.
Solidarity of Steel#305.dst: 아니면 이 제도에 불만이 있다는 뜻인가? 정식 민원 부서도 있긴 한데, 아가씨, 거긴 가 봐야 좋을 거 없을걸.
Solidarity of Steel#305.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#306.src: N-n-no! No, it- it's fine! I-I-I just- I'm just saying th-that- I just need a couple of minutes... Please!
Solidarity of Steel#306.dst: 아, 아, 아니요! 아니, 괜, 괜찮아요! 저, 저, 저는 그냥- 그, 그냥- 몇 분만 있으면 돼요... 제발요!
Solidarity of Steel#306.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#307.src: Sigh. I did warn you, lady. Guess we're doing things the hard way, then.
Solidarity of Steel#307.dst: 하아. 경고했지, 아가씨. 그럼 힘으로 해야겠군.
Solidarity of Steel#307.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#309.src: I'm sorry! I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm-
Solidarity of Steel#309.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#310.src: Disrespecting the crown is a serious crime, y'know. Alright, boys, you know what to do.
Solidarity of Steel#310.dst: 왕실을 모욕하는 건 중죄야, 알지? 자, 얘들아, 할 일은 알지.
Solidarity of Steel#310.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Solidarity of Steel#311.src: Hey! We n- ne- need to hel- help her!
Solidarity of Steel#311.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#312.src: Quiet! It's not protocol, we need to wait until the coast's clear, or else-
Solidarity of Steel#312.dst: 조용히! 규칙에 어긋나, 주변이 조용해질 때까지 기다려야 해, 안 그러면-
Solidarity of Steel#312.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#313.src: But th- they're going to beat her! We c- can- we c- can't just let that-
Solidarity of Steel#313.dst: 하지만 저, 저 사람들 때리려고 하잖아! 그냥 보고만 이, 있을- 그냥 둘 순 없-
Solidarity of Steel#313.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#314.src: You're new here, so you get a pass for not knowing, but we cannot draw attention towards us.
Solidarity of Steel#314.dst: 넌 처음이니까 모르는 건 봐주겠는데, 우리가 주목을 끌면 안 돼.
Solidarity of Steel#314.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#315.src: Yeah, man! If the guards get a whiff of what we're doing, we're toast! The only reason we have the station is 'cause they don't know about it!
Solidarity of Steel#315.dst: 그래! 경비들이 우리 하는 일 냄새라도 맡으면 끝장이야! 역을 지키고 있는 것도 걔들이 모르니까 가능한 거라고!
Solidarity of Steel#315.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#317.src: M- m- maybe hiding is enough f- f- for you, but I c- ca- can't just let someone get h- hur- hurt!
Solidarity of Steel#317.dst: 수, 숨는 걸로 너, 너넨 충분할지 몰라도, 난 누가 다, 다치는 걸 그, 그냥 둘 수 없어!
Solidarity of Steel#317.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#318.src: S- so-... so sc- screw your cover! She n- n- needs help, so I- I'm going to h- he- help!
Solidarity of Steel#318.dst: 그, 그러니까-... 위장 따위 알, 알 게 뭐야! 저 사람 도, 도움이 필요하니까 난 도, 도울 거야!
Solidarity of Steel#318.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#319.src: Hey, don't!-... Damn it. Man, how am I gonna explain this to...
Solidarity of Steel#319.dst: 야, 하지 마!-... 젠장. 이걸 어떻게 설명하냐...
Solidarity of Steel#319.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#320.src: Defeat the soldiers attacking the woman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#321.src: Fine, man! Can't just let you fight alone, can we? Let's just get this over with...
Solidarity of Steel#321.dst: 알았어! 너 혼자 싸우게 둘 순 없잖아? 빨리 끝내자...
Solidarity of Steel#321.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#323.src: ..Okay. I th- th- I think the coast is clear. She sh- sh- should be-
Solidarity of Steel#323.dst: ..좋아. 이, 이제 주변은 조, 조용한 것 같아. 그 사람은 아, 아마-
Solidarity of Steel#323.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#324.src: What the hell was that? What were you thinking?!
Solidarity of Steel#324.dst: 방금 그게 대체 뭐야? 무슨 생각이었어?!
Solidarity of Steel#324.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#326.src: No, I really think I should-
Solidarity of Steel#326.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#327.src: Jiro. We've got other things to worry about, man. Cool it till we're back at the station, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#327.dst: Jiro. 신경 쓸 게 따로 있잖아. 역에 돌아갈 때까진 참아, 응?
Solidarity of Steel#327.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#330.src: Wh-who are you people? What are- what are you doing here?
Solidarity of Steel#330.dst: 누, 누구세요? 여기서- 여기서 뭐 하는 거예요?
Solidarity of Steel#330.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#331.src: One can learn so much of the community's spirit by surveying the boards. See what they're worried of, see the way they support each other, see their culture...
Solidarity of Steel#331.dst: 게시판을 살펴보면 공동체의 정신을 많이 알 수 있지. 무엇을 걱정하는지, 어떻게 서로 돕는지, 그들의 문화까지...

Solidarity of Steel#332.src: Donated {~} IA by Sovereign Zhiraok after vandalization of previous noticeboard.
Solidarity of Steel#332.dst: 이전 게시판 훼손 후 Zhiraok 군주가 IA {~}년에 기증함.

Solidarity of Steel#333.src: Said it was the Sovereign's problem, but I know the real reason. He just didn't want to go into The Flush.
Solidarity of Steel#333.dst: 군주 문제라고 했지만 진짜 이유는 난 알아. 그냥 배수로에 들어가기 싫었던 거야.

Solidarity of Steel#334.src: You don't know us, and we don't know you. But we're here to help. I'm Yuman, and these are-
Solidarity of Steel#334.dst: 우릴 모르고, 우리도 당신을 몰라요. 그래도 도우러 왔어요. 난 Yuman, 이쪽은-
Solidarity of Steel#334.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#335.src: Why... why would you... help me...?
Solidarity of Steel#335.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#336.src: 'Cause... that's what people like us should do.
Solidarity of Steel#336.dst: 왜냐면... 우리 같은 사람은 그래야 하니까요.
Solidarity of Steel#336.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#337.src: No! N-n-no... people like us should just do as we're told and not get involved in things that aren't ours!
Solidarity of Steel#337.dst: 아니요! 아, 아, 아니요... 우리 같은 사람은 시키는 대로만 하고, 남의 일엔 끼어들면 안 돼요!
Solidarity of Steel#337.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#339.src: If I just follow orders, at least I'll survive! I might lose my apartment, and maybe everything I've built for myself, and all the things I've managed to keep for myself, but- but- but at least I'll be alive!
Solidarity of Steel#339.dst: 명령만 따르면 적어도 살아남잖아요! 집을 잃고, 어쩌면 내가 일군 모든 것도, 간신히 지켜 온 것들도 다 잃겠지만- 그래도- 그래도 적어도 살아 있을 거예요!
Solidarity of Steel#339.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#340.src: ...I hear you. Trust me, Aihan, I really do.
Solidarity of Steel#340.dst: ...무슨 말인지 알아요. 믿어요, Aihan, 정말 알아요.
Solidarity of Steel#340.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#341.src: Can I tell you a story?
Solidarity of Steel#341.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#343.src: Long, long ago, when I was just a little kid, I lost my ma. Dad's out of the picture, so... my bros had to put in the work to take care of me, even though they were just kids too.
Solidarity of Steel#343.dst: 아주 오래전, 내가 꼬맹이였을 때 엄마를 잃었어요. 아빠는 없었고... 그래서 형들이 날 돌봐야 했죠, 자기들도 애였는데.
Solidarity of Steel#343.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#344.src: But, y'know, being kids... they couldn't do enough. Failed to meet their quotas, just like you. Got kicked out, had to live on the streets.
Solidarity of Steel#344.dst: 근데, 알잖아요, 애들이니까... 역부족이었죠. 당신처럼 할당량을 못 채웠고, 쫓겨나서 길바닥에서 살았어요.
Solidarity of Steel#344.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#345.src: You want to know the reason we made it through that? It was 'cause someone reached out a helping hand. Gave us a place to stay, to work without the threat of not meeting expectations. To live, man.
Solidarity of Steel#345.dst: 우리가 어떻게 버텼는지 알아요? 누군가 손을 내밀어 줬기 때문이에요. 지낼 곳을 줬고, 기대에 못 미칠까 떨지 않고 일할 곳을 줬죠. 살아갈 곳을요.
Solidarity of Steel#345.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#346.src: So... please. Accept the hand that's offered to you, 'kay? You can come with us and talk to the boss, and if what we have isn't enough for you... no one will force you to stay. But give it a try, please?
Solidarity of Steel#346.dst: 그러니까... 제발요. 내민 손을 잡아 줘요, 네? 같이 가서 대장이랑 얘기해 보고, 우리가 가진 게 부족하다 싶으면... 아무도 붙잡지 않아요. 그래도 한번 해 봐요, 네?
Solidarity of Steel#346.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#348.src: Not to ruin the moment, Yuman, but we've got more soldiers coming our way! We've got to get moving soon!
Solidarity of Steel#348.dst: 분위기 깨서 미안한데, Yuman, 병사들이 더 몰려오고 있어! 빨리 움직여야 해!
Solidarity of Steel#348.speaker: Jiro

Solidarity of Steel#349.src: Damn... alright. Aihan, will you trust me?
Solidarity of Steel#349.dst: 젠장... 알았어. Aihan, 날 믿어 줄래요?
Solidarity of Steel#349.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#351.src: Okay... okay. Thank you. {u}, could you help her pack her stuff? Zeph, Jiro, help me prepare an escape route.
Solidarity of Steel#351.dst: 좋아... 좋아요. 고마워요. {u}, 짐 싸는 것 좀 도와줄래? Zeph, Jiro, 탈출로 준비하는 거 도와줘.
Solidarity of Steel#351.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#352.src: W-wait! I... I don't know what I'm packing!
Solidarity of Steel#352.dst: 자, 잠깐만요! 저... 뭘 싸야 할지 모르겠어요!
Solidarity of Steel#352.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#353.src: Right. Uh... don't bring anything heavy. We have food and cookware where we're going...
Solidarity of Steel#353.dst: 맞다. 어... 무거운 건 가져오지 마요. 가는 곳에 음식이랑 조리 도구는 있으니까...
Solidarity of Steel#353.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#354.src: Bring something to with, something that ... and maybe some form of {u}, if you've got any.
Solidarity of Steel#354.dst: 쓸 만한 거 하나, 뭔가 할 ... 거 하나, 그리고 있으면 {u} 같은 것도요.
Solidarity of Steel#354.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#356.src: I... I can't think straight... this is all moving so fast... please- please, can you help me?
Solidarity of Steel#356.dst: 저... 머리가 안 돌아가요... 다 너무 빨리 일어나서... 제발- 제발, 좀 도와줄래요?
Solidarity of Steel#356.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#358.src: Grab that backpack and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#358.dst: 저 배낭을 챙기고... 괜찮아 보이는 걸로 아무거나 골라...
Solidarity of Steel#358.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#359.src: You've probably seen most of the station by now. Time to head back.
Solidarity of Steel#359.dst: 이제 역은 거의 다 둘러봤을 것이다. 돌아갈 시간이다.

Solidarity of Steel#360.src: Grab that and... pick whatever you think works...
Solidarity of Steel#360.dst: 그거 챙기고... 괜찮다 싶은 건 아무거나 골라 줘요...
Solidarity of Steel#360.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#361.src: We have to hurry but I just can't think!
Solidarity of Steel#361.dst: 서둘러야 하는데 아무 생각이 안 나요!
Solidarity of Steel#361.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#362.src: Pack something to help Aihan some form of a piece of and something to

Solidarity of Steel#363.src: {u}, h- h- hurry! We don't have m- mu- much time!
Solidarity of Steel#363.dst: {u}, 서, 서, 서둘러! 시간이 벌, 별로 없어!
Solidarity of Steel#363.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#365.src: Where- where are you going? D-d-don't leave me here!
Solidarity of Steel#365.dst: 어디- 어디 가요? 여, 여기 두고 가지 마요!
Solidarity of Steel#365.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#366.src: Did you get everything? Can we go?
Solidarity of Steel#366.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#367.src: Okay... No one's here yet. Let's go!
Solidarity of Steel#367.dst: 좋아요... 아직 아무도 안 왔어요. 가요!
Solidarity of Steel#367.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#369.src: We're out of time, we have to get moving! Come on, come on!
Solidarity of Steel#369.dst: 시간 없어, 움직여야 해! 빨리, 빨리!
Solidarity of Steel#369.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#370.src: Up the ladder, into the tunnel! Go, go, go!
Solidarity of Steel#370.dst: 사다리 타고 터널로! 가, 가, 가!
Solidarity of Steel#370.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#371.src: Yuman... c- co- come on. Let's go.
Solidarity of Steel#371.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#374.src: Man... that was a really stupid thing for you to do. Like, astronomically stupid, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#374.dst: 야... 방금 그건 진짜 멍청한 짓이었어. 완전, 우주급으로 멍청했다고, 알아?
Solidarity of Steel#374.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#376.src: But I get it. I get it, y'know? If I didn't have to be a leader there, I'd've probably done the same thing!
Solidarity of Steel#376.dst: 그래도 이해해. 이해한다고, 알지? 거기서 내가 리더만 아니었으면 나도 똑같이 했을 거야!
Solidarity of Steel#376.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#377.src: Difference is, my bros can hold me back from that impulse. Guess I wasn't able to do that, here...
Solidarity of Steel#377.dst: 다른 점은, 우리 형들은 그 충동을 붙잡아 준다는 거지. 난 여기서 그걸 못 했네...
Solidarity of Steel#377.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#378.src: Hate to disappoint 'em, y'know? Bit late now, though. What's done is done, can't take it back.
Solidarity of Steel#378.dst: 형들 실망시키긴 싫은데, 알지? 이제 좀 늦었지만. 엎질러진 물이지, 되돌릴 순 없어.
Solidarity of Steel#378.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#379.src: It'll be alright. Worse things've happened. Aihan's safe, that's all that matters! We'll deal with the rest as it comes.
Solidarity of Steel#379.dst: 괜찮을 거야. 더한 일도 있었어. Aihan은 무사하잖아, 그게 제일 중요해! 나머진 닥치면 처리하자.
Solidarity of Steel#379.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#380.src: I- I should've... I should've l-lis- listened to you. But, s- s- seeing the way they- they were treating her... I was j- j- just so... angry. How dare th- they look down on p- p- people like that?!
Solidarity of Steel#380.dst: 내, 내가... 네 말을 드, 들었어야 했는데. 근데, 저, 저 사람들이 그 사람을- 그렇게 대하는 걸 보니까... 너무... 화가 났어. 어, 어떻게 사람을 그렇게 깔볼 수가 있어?!
Solidarity of Steel#380.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#381.src: Yeah... I hear you. Hear you loud and clear. It's not right, is it? But that's what we're working to fix down here, man. Gotta do what little you can, yeah?
Solidarity of Steel#381.dst: 그래... 알아. 아주 잘 알지. 옳지 않잖아, 그치? 그래도 그걸 바로잡으려고 우리가 여기서 애쓰는 거야. 할 수 있는 만큼은 해야지, 그치?
Solidarity of Steel#381.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#382.src: Let's get going. They'll be expecting us. Wouldn't want to keep 'em waiting.
Solidarity of Steel#382.dst: 가자. 다들 기다릴 거야. 오래 기다리게 하면 안 되지.
Solidarity of Steel#382.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#383.src: ...We should f- f- follow them in.
Solidarity of Steel#383.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#384.src: Head back to the Steel Feather through the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#385.src: Report what happened to The Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Solidarity of Steel#387.src: Would- w- would it be weird to say it's a r- r- relief to find out he has a ser- a- a serious side to him?
Solidarity of Steel#387.dst: 그, 그 녀석한테도 진, 진지한 면이 있다는 걸 알고 나니까 좀 안, 안심된다고 하면 이상할까?
Solidarity of Steel#387.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#388.src: Not- n- not that this is how I'd have w- w- wanted to find out...
Solidarity of Steel#388.dst: 이, 이런 식으로 알고 싶었던 건 아, 아니지만...
Solidarity of Steel#388.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#390.src: Jiro and I got her settled. Quill's giving her the rundown as we speak.
Solidarity of Steel#390.dst: Jiro랑 내가 자리 잡아 줬어. 지금 Quill이 설명해 주고 있어.
Solidarity of Steel#390.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#391.src: You should... probably avoid Jiro for now, yeah? He's not exactly... happy.
Solidarity of Steel#391.dst: 넌... 당분간 Jiro는 피하는 게 좋을 거야, 응? 별로... 기분이 안 좋거든.
Solidarity of Steel#391.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#392.src: Right... Got it. So- s- so... how does it wor- work now? Should we re- record this mission s- somewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#392.dst: 알았어... 그래. 그, 그럼... 이제 어떻게 해? 이번 임무를 어, 어디에 기록해야 해?
Solidarity of Steel#392.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#393.src: Yep, yep! Normally I'd go to Quill, but he's busy. Let's see if we can find Yusanu first- he'll... understand. Probably. More than Yulie, at least. I trust him to keep it quiet for now, at least... y'know?
Solidarity of Steel#393.dst: 그래, 그래! 보통은 Quill한테 가는데, 지금 바빠. Yusanu 형부터 찾아보자- 형은... 이해해 줄 거야. 아마. 적어도 Yulie 형보단. 당분간 입도 다물어 줄 거고... 알지?
Solidarity of Steel#393.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#395.src: Yuman, I swear. Yusanu should know better than to let you take the lead on these sorts of things! What were you thinking?
Solidarity of Steel#395.dst: Yuman, 진짜. Yusanu도 이런 일에 널 앞장세우면 안 된다는 것쯤은 알아야지! 무슨 생각이었어?
Solidarity of Steel#395.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#396.src: Woah, woah, woah! That's a lot of accusations out of nowhere, bro! What gives?
Solidarity of Steel#396.dst: 워, 워, 워! 갑자기 웬 비난이 이렇게 쏟아져, 형! 무슨 일인데?
Solidarity of Steel#396.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#397.src: What gives? You know what gives- a whole squadron of housing enforcers turns up dead on the job, and you expect that to go over quietly?
Solidarity of Steel#397.dst: 무슨 일이냐고? 알잖아- 주택 단속반 한 분대가 작전 중에 몰살당했는데, 조용히 넘어갈 줄 알았어?
Solidarity of Steel#397.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#398.src: Ahhh. That. Well, you know how it is. Things happen, right?
Solidarity of Steel#398.dst: 아아. 그거. 뭐, 알잖아. 일이 생길 수도 있지, 그치?
Solidarity of Steel#398.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#399.src: You-... at least pretend to take this seriously, would you? Of all people, you should know what this is going to lead to.
Solidarity of Steel#399.dst: 너-... 최소한 진지한 척이라도 해 줄래? 이게 어떤 결과로 이어질지 누구보다 네가 잘 알잖아.
Solidarity of Steel#399.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#400.src: It- it was- was- it wasn't his f- f- fault, I-
Solidarity of Steel#400.dst: 그, 그건- 그게- 그 녀석 자, 잘못이 아니야, 내가-
Solidarity of Steel#400.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#401.src: Hey, princess, it's alright. Don't need you to cover for me, 'kay?
Solidarity of Steel#401.dst: 야, 공주님, 괜찮아. 날 감싸 줄 필요 없어, 알았지?
Solidarity of Steel#401.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#402.src: So what's the plan then, Yulie? Meeting to talk about it, as always?
Solidarity of Steel#402.dst: 그래서 계획은 뭔데, Yulie 형? 늘 그랬듯 회의?
Solidarity of Steel#402.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#403.src: Sigh... as soon as Quill gets Aihan sorted, yes. It shouldn't take long, so everyone's gathered in advance.
Solidarity of Steel#403.dst: 하아... Quill이 Aihan 일을 정리하는 대로, 응. 오래 안 걸릴 테니 다들 미리 모여 있어.
Solidarity of Steel#403.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#405.src: Hey! What happened out there? Everyone's acting weird about it.
Solidarity of Steel#405.dst: 야! 밖에서 무슨 일 있었어? 다들 반응이 이상해.
Solidarity of Steel#405.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#406.src: We ended up f- fight- fighting some soldiers to save the w- w- the woman we went there for...
Solidarity of Steel#406.dst: 우리가 가서 구하려던 여, 여자를 구하느라 병사 몇 명이랑 싸, 싸우게 됐어...
Solidarity of Steel#406.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#407.src: Huh. Is that all? I thought it'd be way worse.
Solidarity of Steel#407.dst: 흠. 그게 다야? 훨씬 심각한 줄 알았네.
Solidarity of Steel#407.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#408.src: Yeah... they- th- they're worried about it dr- draw- drawing attention...
Solidarity of Steel#408.dst: 응... 다들 그, 그게 이목을 끌까 봐 거, 걱정하는 거야...
Solidarity of Steel#408.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#410.src: Still helping out in the kitchen, preparing for dinner! Worry not, I will catch her up once the meeting concludes.
Solidarity of Steel#410.dst: 아직 주방에서 저녁 준비를 돕고 있어요! 걱정 마요, 회의가 끝나면 제가 알려 줄게요.
Solidarity of Steel#410.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#411.src: Ah, hello everybody. Apologies for the delay.
Solidarity of Steel#411.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#413.src: She hasn't quite decided yet, but she has agreed to stay the night. She's in a bad state of mind, the poor woman. Some rest will do her good.
Solidarity of Steel#413.dst: 아직 확실히 정하진 않았지만, 오늘 밤은 묵기로 했네. 마음이 많이 상했어, 가엾게도. 좀 쉬면 나아질 걸세.
Solidarity of Steel#413.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#414.src: But that leads us well to the reason this meeting was called. The retrieval process went... poorly, I take it?
Solidarity of Steel#414.dst: 하지만 그게 이 회의를 연 이유와도 이어지지. 구출 과정이... 순탄치 않았다고 들었네만?
Solidarity of Steel#414.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#415.src: Poorly is an understatement. The military is on high alert now! Everyone entering or leaving {p} this evening was questioned- if I hadn't used our tunnel, I'd still be stuck in line there!
Solidarity of Steel#415.dst: 순탄치 않은 정도가 아니에요. 군이 지금 비상 경계 중이에요! 오늘 저녁 {p}에 드나든 사람은 전부 검문당했어요- 우리 터널을 안 썼으면 아직도 줄 서 있었을 거예요!
Solidarity of Steel#415.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#416.src: This is an unmitigated disaster. Yuman, what do you have to say for yourself? You should know better by now, we need to-
Solidarity of Steel#416.dst: 이건 완전한 재앙이야. Yuman, 할 말 있어? 이제 좀 알 때도 됐잖아, 우린-
Solidarity of Steel#416.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#417.src: H- hey! It- it- it's not- it's n- not his f- f- fault! I'm the- the one who-
Solidarity of Steel#417.dst: 야, 야! 그, 그, 그건- 그 녀석 자, 잘못이 아니야! 내, 내가-
Solidarity of Steel#417.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#418.src: Nah, the blame falls on me. I was the leader, so anything that happened is my responsibility. I should've... been more firm about it.
Solidarity of Steel#418.dst: 아냐, 내 탓이야. 내가 리더였으니까 무슨 일이 생겼든 내 책임이지. 좀 더... 단호했어야 했어.
Solidarity of Steel#418.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#419.src: None of this would have happened if I'd been there... damn it. The timing couldn't have been worse. This is all my-
Solidarity of Steel#419.dst: 내가 거기 있었으면 이런 일은 없었을 텐데... 젠장. 타이밍이 최악이었어. 이게 다 내-
Solidarity of Steel#419.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#420.src: Okay, that's enough. You're all acting stupid! Who cares whose fault it was? Either way, it already happened, so let's figure out what we're going to do about it.
Solidarity of Steel#420.dst: 좋아, 그만. 다들 바보같이 굴고 있어! 누구 잘못인지가 뭐가 중요해? 어차피 일어난 일이니 이제 어쩔지나 생각하자.
Solidarity of Steel#420.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#422.src: And I'm not done! You're all acting like it's the end of the world that some soldiers are dead. So what? Soldiers die all the time.
Solidarity of Steel#422.dst: 아직 안 끝났어! 병사 몇 명 죽은 게 무슨 세상 끝난 것처럼 구네. 그래서 뭐? 병사는 맨날 죽어.
Solidarity of Steel#422.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#423.src: They don't die like this, though. We don't have the luxury of being able to wave off the crown's attention! If they find out what we're doing down here, we're done for.
Solidarity of Steel#423.dst: 그래도 이런 식으론 안 죽어. 우린 왕실의 관심을 무시할 여유가 없어! 여기서 뭘 하는지 들키면 우린 끝이야.
Solidarity of Steel#423.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#424.src: But they haven't found out yet, have they? You have options still. For example- you're on the detective force! If suspicions arise, couldn't you just lead them elsewhere?
Solidarity of Steel#424.dst: 근데 아직 안 들켰잖아? 아직 방법이 있어. 예를 들어- 넌 탐정단 소속이잖아! 의심이 생기면 다른 데로 돌리면 되지 않아?
Solidarity of Steel#424.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#425.src: Besides. If staying hidden means having to look away as innocent people get harmed- what kind of a resistance does that make you? What's the point of any of it?
Solidarity of Steel#425.dst: 게다가. 숨어 지내는 대가가 무고한 사람이 다치는 걸 외면하는 거라면- 그게 무슨 저항군이야? 그럼 다 무슨 의미가 있어?
Solidarity of Steel#425.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#426.src: Rex... take care with your words. Don't say anything you'll-
Solidarity of Steel#426.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#427.src: What's the POINT?! The POINT is all the people we ALREADY have down here who we need to protect! Quill, please, back me up here.
Solidarity of Steel#427.dst: 무슨 의미냐고?! 의미는 이미 여기 있는 사람들이야! 우리가 지켜야 할 사람들! Quill, 제발 내 편 좀 들어 줘요.
Solidarity of Steel#427.speaker: Yulie

Solidarity of Steel#428.src: ... No, Yulie, Rex has a point. Even if it was phrased harshly... we have been rather passive in our battle thus far. We've let people get hurt, even if only for the sake of our safety.
Solidarity of Steel#428.dst: ... 아니, Yulie, Rex 말에도 일리가 있네. 말이 거칠긴 했지만... 우린 지금껏 꽤 소극적으로 싸워 왔지. 우리 안전을 위해서라지만, 사람들이 다치게 뒀어.
Solidarity of Steel#428.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#429.src: We have had our reasons... and we have done good work, to the best of our ability. But if we are afraid to act, how will anything ever change for the better?
Solidarity of Steel#429.dst: 우리에게도 이유는 있었고... 힘닿는 데까지 좋은 일을 해 왔지. 하지만 행동하기를 두려워한다면, 어떻게 세상이 나아지겠나?
Solidarity of Steel#429.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#431.src: You are not wrong to feel frustration, Yulie. I, too, wish this had been handled with more care... but something like this was bound to happen eventually. We will survive this, as we have survived other hardships before.
Solidarity of Steel#431.dst: 답답한 마음이 드는 게 잘못은 아니네, Yulie. 나도 더 신중하게 처리됐으면 했지... 하지만 이런 일은 언젠가 일어나기 마련이었어. 전에도 고비를 넘겼듯 이번에도 이겨 낼 걸세.
Solidarity of Steel#431.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#433.src: ...But let's lighten the mood a little! Dinner should almost be ready. Yuman, you told me earlier today you were working on a new song. Would you still like to perform it tonight?
Solidarity of Steel#433.dst: ...자, 분위기 좀 풀어 보세! 저녁이 거의 다 됐을 거야. Yuman, 아까 새 노래를 만들고 있다고 했지. 오늘 밤에 여전히 공연하고 싶나?
Solidarity of Steel#433.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#434.src: Huh? Oh, yeah, yeah man! I can do that, for sure.
Solidarity of Steel#434.dst: 네? 아, 네, 네! 당연히 할 수 있죠.
Solidarity of Steel#434.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#435.src: Ahem. Before we depart, if I may- while we are all gathered here, I believe it could be beneficial to lay out some relevant information.
Solidarity of Steel#435.dst: 흠흠. 해산하기 전에, 괜찮다면- 다들 모인 김에 관련된 정보를 좀 정리해 두면 좋을 것 같아요.
Solidarity of Steel#435.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#436.src: Most of us are new to the Roughworks, so getting to know the lay of the land could help.
Solidarity of Steel#436.dst: 우리 대부분 Roughworks가 처음이니, 이곳 사정을 알아 두면 도움이 될 거예요.
Solidarity of Steel#436.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#437.src: Right, of course. I'd been meaning to suggest something similar earlier, before... this situation came up.
Solidarity of Steel#437.dst: 맞아, 물론이지. 나도 아까 비슷한 제안을 하려 했는데... 이 일이 터지기 전에.
Solidarity of Steel#437.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#438.src: Certainly, we could do that! What would you like to know?
Solidarity of Steel#438.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#439.src: Ah, yes. Her name is Soosu. It's hard to say much about her... she's rather reclusive, staying cooped up in her mansion, working away.
Solidarity of Steel#439.dst: 아, 그래. 이름은 Soosu일세. 그녀에 대해선 말하기 어렵네... 꽤 은둔하는 편이라 저택에 틀어박혀 일만 하거든.
Solidarity of Steel#439.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#440.src: She's the opposite of Zhiraok, in that way. Ideally, we'll avoid drawing her attention. We'll have plenty to worry about already without adding her to the list.
Solidarity of Steel#440.dst: 그 점에선 Zhiraok와 정반대죠. 가능하면 그녀의 눈에 띄지 않는 게 좋아요. 신경 쓸 게 이미 많은데 그녀까지 더할 순 없죠.
Solidarity of Steel#440.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#441.src: That'd be for the best, yeah. She's... kind of a genius. She singlehandedly brought forth the Industrial Age, over a century ago! Most of the machinery you see in Fruma probably traces its origin back to her in some way.
Solidarity of Steel#441.dst: 그게 제일 좋겠어요, 응. 그녀는... 일종의 천재예요. 한 세기도 더 전에 혼자서 산업 시대를 열었어요! Fruma에서 보는 기계 대부분은 어떤 식으로든 그녀에게서 시작됐을 거예요.
Solidarity of Steel#441.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#442.src: Ha! Yeah, yeah, figures you'd know all that, bro. Nerd.
Solidarity of Steel#442.dst: 하! 그래, 그래, 형이면 그런 거 다 알지. 범생이.
Solidarity of Steel#442.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#443.src: Wh- that's just written history, Yuman. If you're going to make fun of me, at least do it right.
Solidarity of Steel#443.dst: 뭐- 그건 그냥 기록된 역사야, Yuman. 놀릴 거면 제대로 놀려.
Solidarity of Steel#443.speaker: Yusanu

Solidarity of Steel#444.src: How about her blessing? If we do run into her, we'll want to know what to watch out for.
Solidarity of Steel#444.dst: 그녀의 축복은요? 혹시 마주치면 뭘 조심해야 할지 알아야죠.
Solidarity of Steel#444.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#445.src: I don't know the specifics... but what I do know is that it allows her to mold matter at will. To what extent, or with what limits... hard to say. Still, that uncertainty is dangerous. Be careful.
Solidarity of Steel#445.dst: 자세한 건 모르네... 다만 물질을 마음대로 빚어낼 수 있다는 건 알지. 어느 정도까지, 어떤 한계가 있는지는... 모르겠군. 그래도 그 불확실함이 위험하지. 조심하게.
Solidarity of Steel#445.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#446.src: Very well! Then let us adjourn for dinner.
Solidarity of Steel#446.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#447.src: Speak to Sui at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and watch Yuman's performance.

Solidarity of Steel#448.src: Yuman's performance is about to start. You should grab a bite from Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#448.dst: 곧 Yuman 공연이 시작해요. Sui한테 가서 뭐라도 좀 먹어요!
Solidarity of Steel#448.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#449.src: Oh, {u}! I feel like I've barely seen you around here...
Solidarity of Steel#449.dst: 아, {u}! 여기서 너 거의 못 본 것 같아...
Solidarity of Steel#449.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#450.src: I, um... Mora told me about what happened. On your mission. I'm... glad you were able to help that woman.
Solidarity of Steel#450.dst: 나, 음... Mora한테 들었어. 임무에서 있었던 일. 난... 그 여자를 도울 수 있어서 다행이야.
Solidarity of Steel#450.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#451.src: I, ha, kind of wish I could've been there, to help. Though, I don't... really know what I could have done, there.
Solidarity of Steel#451.dst: 나, 하, 나도 거기서 같이 도왔으면 좋았을 텐데. 그래도, 내가... 거기서 뭘 할 수 있었을지는 모르겠어.
Solidarity of Steel#451.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#452.src: S-so maybe it's a good thing! That I've been, um, busy, cooking. For the Steel Feather. There's, ha, a lot of people here!
Solidarity of Steel#452.dst: 그, 그러니까 오히려 잘된 걸지도! 내가, 음, 요리하느라 바빴던 게. Steel Feather를 위해서. 여기, 하, 사람이 정말 많거든!
Solidarity of Steel#452.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#453.src: But I've been learning new recipes, and getting to know new people! Oh, right, you're probably here for, um, the food. Here! Please have some.
Solidarity of Steel#453.dst: 그래도 새 요리법도 배우고, 새로운 사람들도 알게 됐어! 아, 맞다, 아마, 음, 밥 먹으러 왔지. 자! 좀 먹어.
Solidarity of Steel#453.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#454.src: ...oh, hi! Are you here for some food?
Solidarity of Steel#454.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#455.src: Ah, n-no, I- well, yes, I'd love some food, but I'm here to- to thank {u}.
Solidarity of Steel#455.dst: 아, 아, 아니요, 저- 음, 네, 밥도 먹고 싶지만, {u}한테- 고맙다고 하러 왔어요.
Solidarity of Steel#455.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#456.src: Don't- don't sell yourself short! I don't... f-fully understand yet, but, fighting the guards like... like that is dangerous, and- and I know why some people wouldn't want to...
Solidarity of Steel#456.dst: 자, 자기를 너무 낮추지 마요! 아직... 다, 다 이해한 건 아니지만, 그렇게- 그렇게 경비랑 싸우는 건 위험하잖아요, 그리고- 왜 다들 안 하려는지도 알아요...
Solidarity of Steel#456.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#458.src: We- no, no, no, this- this won't work, I can't- you need to pack different things, I can't go with- with this, pleas
Solidarity of Steel#458.dst: 우리- 아니, 아니, 아니, 이- 이건 안 돼, 난 못- 다른 걸 챙겨야 해, 난 이- 이걸로는 못 가, 제발

Solidarity of Steel#459.src: There's an inscription, but it's written in a language you can't understand.
Solidarity of Steel#459.dst: 글귀가 새겨져 있지만, 알아볼 수 없는 언어로 쓰여 있다.

Solidarity of Steel#460.src: It's the poster you stuck on advertising the Pishlas Hot Springs.
Solidarity of Steel#460.dst: 당신이 붙여 둔 Pishlas Hot Springs 홍보 포스터다.

Solidarity of Steel#461.src: But you did anyway, and- and- and it means a lot.
Solidarity of Steel#461.dst: 그런데도 해 줬잖아요, 그, 그게- 정말 큰 의미예요.
Solidarity of Steel#461.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#462.src: It, um, sounds like it was a really bad situation. So I'm glad you got out alright.
Solidarity of Steel#462.dst: 그거, 음, 정말 안 좋은 상황이었던 것 같아. 무사히 빠져나와서 다행이야.
Solidarity of Steel#462.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#463.src: H-ha... yes. They've been... p-pushy before, but they've never been this- this- this, ah, violent.
Solidarity of Steel#463.dst: 하, 하... 네. 전에도... 강, 강압적이긴 했지만, 이렇게- 이렇게- 이렇게, 아, 폭력적인 적은 없었어요.
Solidarity of Steel#463.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#464.src: Y-yes, I am. It's... new, and- and different, but everyone here has been so kind, and...
Solidarity of Steel#464.dst: 네, 네, 맞아요. 여기는... 새롭고, 그, 그리고 낯설지만, 다들 너무 친절하고...
Solidarity of Steel#464.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#465.src: It's a little- a little strange... It almost feels like- like- like I don't deserve it! Because, I- I- I haven't... w-worked for it.
Solidarity of Steel#465.dst: 좀- 좀 이상해요... 거의- 거의- 제가 이럴 자격이 없는 것 같아요! 왜냐면, 저, 저, 저는 아직... 이, 일한 게 없잖아요.
Solidarity of Steel#465.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#466.src: Um... I don't really, know, what it's like to live here... but where I'm from, people help each other. You shouldn't have to earn the right to live.
Solidarity of Steel#466.dst: 음... 여기서 사는 게, 어떤지는, 잘 모르지만... 내가 온 곳에선 서로 도와. 살 권리를 벌어야 할 필요는 없어.
Solidarity of Steel#466.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#467.src: Y-you must be from a much n-nicer place than- than here.
Solidarity of Steel#467.dst: 정, 정말 여기보다- 여기보다 훨씬 조, 좋은 데서 왔나 봐요.
Solidarity of Steel#467.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#468.src: Ha... it's k-kind of ridiculous, looking back. Stupid- s-stupid quotas... ouch...
Solidarity of Steel#468.dst: 하... 돌아보면 좀 우, 우스워요. 멍청한- 머, 멍청한 할당량... 아야...
Solidarity of Steel#468.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#469.src: You want to know my story?

Solidarity of Steel#471.src: Oh, it- it's nothing. Just, heavy m-machinery. Hurt my shoulder when- when I went in. It- it's r-really my fault, I, I, I sh-should have been m-more careful...
Solidarity of Steel#471.dst: 아, 벼, 별거 아니에요. 그냥, 무거운 기, 기계에. 들어갈 때- 어깨를 다쳤어요. 사, 사실 제 잘못이에요, 제, 제, 제가 더 조, 조심했어야 했는데...
Solidarity of Steel#471.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#472.src: Um... I- I can, ha, I can help you.
Solidarity of Steel#472.dst: 음... 내, 내가, 하, 도와줄 수 있어.
Solidarity of Steel#472.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#473.dst: 당신이... 할 수 있어요? 어, 어떻게요?
Solidarity of Steel#473.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#474.src: Just... sigh. Follow me, and- and trust me.
Solidarity of Steel#474.dst: 그냥... 하아. 따라와, 그리고- 그리고 날 믿어.
Solidarity of Steel#474.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#477.src: H-hey! I- I only have this shirt, I c- I can't- I-
Solidarity of Steel#477.dst: 저, 저기요! 저, 저 이 셔츠밖에 없어요, 이거- 이건 안-
Solidarity of Steel#477.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#480.src: How did- how did you do that?
Solidarity of Steel#480.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#483.src: I-... th-thank you. I didn't... I didn't know cursed ones could be- could be nice.
Solidarity of Steel#483.dst: 저-... 고, 고마워요. 몰랐어요... 저주받은 자도- 친절할 수 있다는 걸.
Solidarity of Steel#483.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#484.src: Um... I sh-should go. Thank you for- for the food, and- and- and for... healing my shoulder. I- I really appreciate it.
Solidarity of Steel#484.dst: 음... 이, 이만 가 볼게요. 음식도- 고맙고, 그리고- 그리고... 어깨 고쳐 준 것도요. 정, 정말 고마워요.
Solidarity of Steel#484.speaker: Aihan

Solidarity of Steel#487.src: It's fine. It's what I expected. I'm... glad I could help.
Solidarity of Steel#487.dst: 괜찮아. 예상했던 거야. 난... 도울 수 있어서 기뻐.
Solidarity of Steel#487.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#488.src: I- I guess so! Ha... at least she, um, wasn't scared. Just... nervous.
Solidarity of Steel#488.dst: 그, 그런가 봐! 하... 적어도, 음, 무서워하진 않았어. 그냥... 긴장했을 뿐.
Solidarity of Steel#488.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#489.src: I'll, um, catch up with the rest of you, later.
Solidarity of Steel#489.dst: 난, 음, 나중에 다들 있는 데로 갈게.
Solidarity of Steel#489.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#490.src: Go join the others. Uh, I'll join you in a bit.
Solidarity of Steel#490.dst: 다른 사람들한테 가 있어. 어, 나도 곧 갈게.
Solidarity of Steel#490.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#491.src: {u}, it's nice of you to join us. Have you had dinner yet?
Solidarity of Steel#491.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#492.src: It's good, isn't it? Quill tells me she's managed to fit right in with the other cooks here.
Solidarity of Steel#492.dst: 맛있죠? Quill 말로는 여기 요리사들이랑 금방 잘 어울렸대요.
Solidarity of Steel#492.speaker: Syndra

Solidarity of Steel#493.src: So, {u}, are you also w- wait- waiting for Yuman's performance?
Solidarity of Steel#493.dst: 그래서, {u}, 너도 Yuman 공연 기, 기다리는 중이야?
Solidarity of Steel#493.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#494.src: I have heard great things about his musical talents! Though, ah, I have also heard this his variety, ah, leaves something to be desired.
Solidarity of Steel#494.dst: 음악 재능이 대단하다는 얘길 들었어요! 그런데, 아, 곡 가짓수는, 아, 좀 아쉽다고도 들었지요.
Solidarity of Steel#494.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#495.src: Then worry not, for you have been reminded just now, hoho!
Solidarity of Steel#495.dst: 그럼 걱정 마요, 방금 제가 알려 드렸으니까요, 호호!
Solidarity of Steel#495.speaker: Mora

Solidarity of Steel#496.src: Hey, maybe he's written a song about you, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#496.dst: 야, 어쩌면 너에 대한 노래를 썼을지도 몰라, Zeph!
Solidarity of Steel#496.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#497.src: Wh- wh- what?! R- Rex, no h- he-... that's n- not-... wh- why would he ev- even-
Solidarity of Steel#497.dst: 뭐, 뭐, 뭐라고?! R, Rex, 아니, 걔- 그건 아, 아니-... 왜, 왜 걔가 굳이-
Solidarity of Steel#497.speaker: Zeph

Solidarity of Steel#498.src: Ha! Relax, relax, I'm just teasing ya.
Solidarity of Steel#498.speaker: Rex

Solidarity of Steel#499.src: Ahem... Attention, attention! Everyone, gather around!
Solidarity of Steel#499.dst: 흠흠... 주목, 주목! 여러분, 모여 주게!
Solidarity of Steel#499.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#500.src: I am heartened to see so many of you joining us for dinner today. It feels as though it has been a while since we've had such a large attendance!
Solidarity of Steel#500.dst: 오늘 이렇게 많은 이들이 저녁을 함께해 주니 참 기쁘네. 이렇게 많이 모인 건 꽤 오랜만인 것 같군!
Solidarity of Steel#500.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#501.src: There is of course news to deliver... but first! We begin by thanking our cooks for the meal.
Solidarity of Steel#501.dst: 물론 전할 소식이 있네... 하지만 먼저! 식사를 준비해 준 요리사들에게 감사부터 하세.
Solidarity of Steel#501.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#502.src: We're all familiar with Fletch's talents, but dinner wouldn't have been possible without the help of one of our new arrivals: Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#502.dst: Fletch의 솜씨는 다들 잘 알겠지만, 새로 온 이의 도움이 없었다면 오늘 저녁은 불가능했을 걸세. 바로 Sui!
Solidarity of Steel#502.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#503.src: Oh...! It, ha, it- um. It was nothing. T'was my pleasure! To- to help.
Solidarity of Steel#503.dst: 아...! 그, 하, 그- 음. 별거 아니었어요. 제가 좋아서 한걸요! 도, 도울 수 있어서.
Solidarity of Steel#503.speaker: Sui

Solidarity of Steel#504.src: No need to be shy, my dear!
Solidarity of Steel#504.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#505.src: Dinner aside, let's get to the announcements!
Solidarity of Steel#505.dst: 저녁 얘긴 이쯤 하고, 공지 사항으로 넘어가세!
Solidarity of Steel#505.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#506.src: Today, we have had not one, but seven new arrivals! In addition to Sui, please welcome Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, and Syndra!
Solidarity of Steel#506.dst: 오늘은 한 명도 아니고 일곱 명이나 새로 왔네! Sui와 더불어 Aihan, Mora, Rex, Zeph, {u}, Syndra를 환영해 주게!
Solidarity of Steel#506.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#507.src: Now, I'm certain news has spread of our... altercation, shall we say, with the crown's military. I assure you, all is under control! The Steel Feather remains secure and hidden.
Solidarity of Steel#507.dst: 그리고 왕실 군대와의... 말하자면 충돌 소식이 이미 퍼졌을 걸세. 장담하건대, 모든 건 통제되고 있네! Steel Feather는 여전히 안전하고 숨겨져 있어.
Solidarity of Steel#507.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#508.src: It does mean expeditions out of the station will be at higher risk for a time. We will have updated guidelines available in the morning for those of you who volunteer.
Solidarity of Steel#508.dst: 다만 당분간 역 밖으로 나가는 원정은 위험이 더 커지네. 자원하는 이들을 위해 내일 아침 새 지침을 준비해 두겠네.
Solidarity of Steel#508.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#509.src: But in lighter news, we have restocked candy bars and sodas at the ticket shops! Make sure to trade for some before they run out - remember the rules, one of each per person.
Solidarity of Steel#509.dst: 그리고 좋은 소식으로, 매표소 상점에 초코바와 탄산음료가 다시 들어왔네! 떨어지기 전에 교환해 두게 - 규칙은 알지, 1인당 종류별로 하나씩.
Solidarity of Steel#509.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#510.src: Well then! Barring any surprises at this very moment, that is all for today's report. As he has volunteered himself today, I will hand over the stage to Yuman.
Solidarity of Steel#510.dst: 자, 그럼! 지금 당장 무슨 일이 터지지 않는 한, 오늘 보고는 여기까지네. 오늘은 본인이 자원했으니, 무대를 Yuman에게 넘기겠네.
Solidarity of Steel#510.speaker: Quill

Solidarity of Steel#511.src: Heeeeeelllllooooo people of the Steel Feather!
Solidarity of Steel#511.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#512.src: Good to see you all as always- ey, Taio, lookin' good! Mei, love what you've done with the hair! Jin, my man!
Solidarity of Steel#512.dst: 다들 여전히 반가워- 어이, Taio, 멋진데! Mei, 머리 바꾼 거 완전 좋아! Jin, 내 친구!
Solidarity of Steel#512.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#513.src: Ah... I guess I can introduce my song. It's a new one! You guys won't be able to tease me for being an artist with only one song anymore, haha!
Solidarity of Steel#513.dst: 아... 노래 소개를 해 볼까. 신곡이야! 이제 노래 한 곡뿐인 아티스트라고 놀리진 못할걸, 하하!
Solidarity of Steel#513.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#514.src: I've been working on this one for a while. Never could find a way to end it, though... 'till now, that is. Finally managed to find some inspiration.
Solidarity of Steel#514.dst: 이 곡은 꽤 오래 붙잡고 있었어. 근데 끝을 어떻게 맺어야 할지 도무지 몰랐지... 지금까진. 드디어 영감이 좀 왔어.
Solidarity of Steel#514.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#515.src: Well, enough talking from me. Here it goes!
Solidarity of Steel#515.speaker: Yuman

Solidarity of Steel#517.src: Hm hm hm! Look who it is!
Solidarity of Steel#517.speaker: ??? (Sovereign Soosu)

Solidarity of Steel#520.src: Happy to see you again, Flowers.
Solidarity of Steel#520.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#522.src: You need to subtract some of this security. It shouldn't need to take twenty minutes to get through just the gate. We need to talk, an hour ago.
Solidarity of Steel#522.dst: 이 보안은 좀 빼. 문 하나 통과하는 데 20분이 걸리면 안 되지. 얘기 좀 해야겠다, 한 시간 전에.
Solidarity of Steel#522.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#523.src: Wow, mister loudmouth, big words for someone who wasn't supposed to be here for a few more weeks! What gives?! You're interrupting my flow!
Solidarity of Steel#523.dst: 와, 떠버리 씨, 몇 주 뒤에나 올 사람이 말은 크게 하네! 뭔데?! 내 흐름 끊고 있잖아!
Solidarity of Steel#523.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Solidarity of Steel#524.src: Your sche- Are you taking lessons from Oru? This provincial emergency has a much greater value than your charter, Sovereign, so I'm summing to the equatio- nnh.
Solidarity of Steel#524.dst: 네 일정- Oru한테 과외라도 받나? 이 지방 비상사태는 네 헌장보다 값이 훨씬 커, 군주. 그러니 방정식에 더하겠- 읏.
Solidarity of Steel#524.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Solidarity of Steel#525.src: I've changed my schedule to come here early and track down a defector- Syndra, and her set of insurgents. You've heard the name, right?
Solidarity of Steel#525.dst: 일정을 바꿔 일찍 와서 배신자를 쫓는 중이다- Syndra와 그 반란 무리를. 이름은 들어 봤지?
Solidarity of Steel#525.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Stable Story#000.src: I see you don't have any grain on you. Here, take these [{~} Wheat Grains] and use them to feed your new buddy.

Stable Story#001.src: I wish you luck in the horse training career, young friend! Make me and Betty proud!

Stable Story#002.src: Howdy! Lookin' to hitch a ride off to {p}? Well, lucky you! The wagon's been fixed up all nice and new!
Stable Story#002.dst: 안녕! {p}까지 마차 타고 가려고? 운이 좋네! 마차를 새것처럼 싹 고쳐 놨거든!

Stable Story#003.src: Just hop on aboard, and I'll get you to {p} in a jiffy!

Stable Story#004.src: Ain't far to {p} from here! We'll be there in a jiffy, just you wait.
Stable Story#004.dst: 여기서 {p}까지 멀지 않아! 금방 도착하니까 기다려 봐.

Stable Story#005.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses- Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#005.dst: 평소라면 이 말들 값을 비싸게 받지- 실례지만 네가 감당 못 할 값으로.

Stable Story#006.src: So, let's cut a deal- They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#006.dst: 그러니 거래하자- 놈들이 마구간 열쇠를 훔쳐 갔어. {p}에 있는 내 헛간에 가서...

Stable Story#007.src: And return that key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#007.dst: 그 열쇠를 되찾아 오면, 내 말 한 마리를 너그러이 내어 주지. 이 거래, 네 생각보다 훨씬 달콤할걸...

Stable Story#008.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah- who knows!? Life is full of mysteries, huh?
Stable Story#008.dst: 흠. 소라고? 아- 누가 알겠어!? 인생은 수수께끼투성이잖아?

Stable Story#009.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise on Betty I will-
Stable Story#009.dst: 어쨌든. 저 위의 위대한 소님께 맹세컨대, Betty 몸에 멍 자국 하나라도 보이면 내가-

Stable Story#010.src: Ah! I can't just hand you a horse without telling you how to care for that beautiful creature, can I?
Stable Story#010.dst: 아! 그 아름다운 녀석을 어떻게 돌보는지 알려 주지도 않고 말을 넘길 순 없지, 안 그래?

Stable Story#011.src: Those rich {p} folk have no respect for horses, let me tell you!
Stable Story#011.dst: 내 말하는데, {p}의 부자들은 말을 전혀 존중하지 않는다고!

Stable Story#012.src: Now! Right Click the Feeder and place your [Horse Saddle] in there.

Stable Story#013.src: Use the [{~} Wheat Grains] I gave you earlier to feed your new friend.
Stable Story#013.dst: 아까 준 [{~} 밀 곡물]로 새 친구에게 먹이를 줘.

Stable Story#014.src: Just Right Click the Feeder again.

Stable Story#015.src: Horses are sensitive creatures, you see. They don't grow strong over night, they require patience and a good stable diet.
Stable Story#015.dst: 알다시피 말은 예민한 동물이야. 하룻밤 새 튼튼해지지 않아. 인내심과 꾸준하고 좋은 먹이가 필요하지.

Stable Story#016.src: However, you also need to take them out on walks so they get some well needed exercise, otherwise they will never reach their full potential.
Stable Story#016.dst: 하지만 산책도 시켜서 꼭 필요한 운동을 하게 해 줘야 해. 안 그러면 잠재력을 끝까지 끌어내지 못할 거야.

Stable Story#017.src: I almost forgot! If you really want to master the art of a horse trainer you can breed two horses using the Feeder.
Stable Story#017.dst: 깜빡할 뻔했네! 말 조련사의 기술을 제대로 익히고 싶다면, 여물통으로 말 두 마리를 교배할 수 있어.

Stable Story#018.src: Anyway! I wish you luck on your horse training career!
Stable Story#018.dst: 어쨌든! 네 말 조련 인생에 행운을 빌어!

Stable Story#020.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers! Preferably with no friends or family, but I'm not picky!
Stable Story#020.dst: 튼튼한 모험가 구함! 친구나 가족이 없으면 더 좋고. 뭐, 까다롭게 굴진 않아!
Stable Story#020.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#021.src: You see, I'm a horse merchant. Make my living selling these beauties to adventurers like you.
Stable Story#021.dst: 난 말 장수야. 이 멋진 녀석들을 너 같은 모험가한테 팔아서 먹고살지.
Stable Story#021.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#022.src: I work at this barn, selling the horses I raise in {p} out here to rich {p} folk.
Stable Story#022.dst: {p}에서 키운 말을 이 헛간에서 {p}의 부자들한테 팔고 있어.
Stable Story#022.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#023.src: Until these rabble-rousing troublemakers blew a tunnel through my barn and smuggled MY horses out.
Stable Story#023.dst: 그런데 말썽꾼들이 헛간 밑으로 터널을 뚫고 내 말들을 빼돌렸지 뭐야.
Stable Story#023.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#024.src: Usually, I'd be charging a high price for these horses Not to be rude, but one you couldn't afford.
Stable Story#024.dst: 평소라면 이 말들 값을 비싸게 받지. 실례지만 네가 감당 못 할 값으로.
Stable Story#024.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#025.src: So, let's cut a deal They stole my stable key. If you can go to my barn in {p}...
Stable Story#025.dst: 그러니 거래하자. 놈들이 마구간 열쇠를 훔쳐 갔어. {p}에 있는 내 헛간에 가서...
Stable Story#025.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#026.src: And return the key to me, I'll so charitably bestow upon you one of my horses. This deal is sweeter than you realize, too...
Stable Story#026.dst: 열쇠를 되찾아 오면, 내 말 한 마리를 너그러이 내어 주지. 이 거래, 네 생각보다 훨씬 달콤할걸...
Stable Story#026.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#027.src: Betty'll be there to help! Strong as she is, don't you DARE let them touch her!
Stable Story#027.dst: Betty가 거기서 도와줄 거야! 힘은 세지만 놈들이 손대게 두면 가만 안 둬!
Stable Story#027.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#028.src: I'll be making my way to {p} myself to ensure Betty's safety.
Stable Story#028.dst: Betty가 무사한지 나도 직접 {p}에 가 볼 거야.
Stable Story#028.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#029.src: Now, best be on your way. {p} is a fair bit down the {p} from here, off to the east.
Stable Story#029.dst: 자, 이제 가 봐. {p}은(는) 여기서 {p}을(를) 따라 동쪽으로 꽤 가야 해.
Stable Story#029.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#030.src: Bring back [{~} Stable Key] to Enkser from the tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Stable Story#030.dst: [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}]의 터널에서 [{~1} Stable Key]를 찾아 Enkser에게 가져가세요

Stable Story#031.src: Hey, have you found my [{~} Stable Key] yet? It should be somewhere in {p} to the east.
Stable Story#031.dst: 이봐, 내 [{~} Stable Key] 찾았어? 동쪽 {p} 어딘가에 있을 텐데.
Stable Story#031.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#032.src: Looking for able-bodied adventurers, preferably with no friends or
Stable Story#032.dst: 튼튼한 모험가 구함, 되도록 친구도 가족도
Stable Story#032.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#033.src: Hey, it's you! Got my barn key yet?
Stable Story#033.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#034.src: Ah, god bless. And I presume Betty did all the work while you just lounged around.
Stable Story#034.dst: 아, 다행이다. 보나 마나 Betty가 다 하고 넌 빈둥거렸겠지.
Stable Story#034.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#035.src: Hm. Cows, huh? Ah who knows!? Life is full of mysterious, huh?
Stable Story#035.dst: 흠. 소라고? 아, 누가 알겠어!? 인생은 수수께끼투성이잖아?
Stable Story#035.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#036.src: Either way. As the great bovine above is my witness if I see the smallest bruise I will
Stable Story#036.dst: 어쨌든. 저 위의 위대한 소님께 맹세컨대, 멍 자국 하나라도 보이면 내가
Stable Story#036.speaker: Enkser

Stable Story#037.src: Nevermind all that. A horse I promised, and a horse you shall have. Much thanks to you.
Stable Story#037.dst: 됐다, 그 얘긴 그만. 말을 약속했으니 말을 줘야지. 정말 고마워.
Stable Story#037.speaker: Enkser

Star Thief#000.src: [{~}/{~}] Thief: .... I can't control myself...fjfjfj This rock...

Star Thief#001.src: Look into the rumors of strange weather near the Imal Inn at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Star Thief#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Imal Inn 근처에서 이상한 날씨에 대한 소문을 조사하세요.

Star Thief#002.src: Find the meteor's crash site at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#003.src: Hey you! Human. What are you doing here?
Star Thief#003.dst: 거기 당신! 인간. 여기서 뭐 하는 거죠?
Star Thief#003.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#004.src: Under Villager law any extra terrestrial or extra voidal entities are prohibited and owned by the state.
Star Thief#004.dst: 주민 법에 따라 외계나 공허에서 온 물체는 모두 금지 품목이며 국가 소유예요.
Star Thief#004.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#005.src: Seeing as you are new to the land, I can't see you being prosecuted, especially a {p} Guard.
Star Thief#005.dst: 이 땅에 처음 왔으니 기소되진 않겠죠. 더구나 {p} 경비병이라면요.
Star Thief#005.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#006.src: This meteor is different to what we've seen before. We suspect that direct contact with the meteor is dangerous.
Star Thief#006.dst: 이 운석은 전에 본 것들과 달라요. 직접 접촉하면 위험하다고 보고 있죠.
Star Thief#006.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#007.src: The magical radiation doesn't seem to be affecting you at all though. Do you not feel anything? Perhaps you could help me locate it.
Star Thief#007.dst: 그런데 마력 방사선이 당신한텐 전혀 영향이 없나 봐요. 아무 느낌 없어요? 운석 찾는 걸 도와줄 수 있겠네요.
Star Thief#007.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#008.src: Explore the cave that the meteor crashed into.

Star Thief#011.src: Follow the trail leading off to the east from the cave.

Star Thief#012.src: Explore the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the insane thief.
Star Thief#012.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴을 탐험하고 미쳐 버린 도둑을 처치하세요.

Star Thief#013.src: .̸.̴.̵.̴ I can't control myself...f̸j̷f̴j̵f̵j̴ This rock...
Star Thief#013.dst: .... 나 자신을 통제 못 하겠어...fjfjfj 이 돌이...
Star Thief#013.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#014.src: What is... this feeling... No I won't listen..
Star Thief#014.dst: 이건 뭐지... 이 느낌은... 아니, 듣지 않겠어..
Star Thief#014.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#015.src: I can't... control... my mind... e̴n̴d̴ ̷m̶e̷.̷
Star Thief#015.dst: 통제가... 안 돼... 내 정신이... end me.
Star Thief#015.speaker: Thief

Star Thief#016.src: Bring back the piece of meteor to the secret agent at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Star Thief#017.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? Why on earth are you holding some?!
Star Thief#017.dst: 또 만났네요. 저 아래서 운석 찾았어요? 대체 왜 그걸 들고 있는 거예요?!
Star Thief#017.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#018.src: I see. This material is incredibly rare and magically powerful. Meteors fall all over Gavel and come in a variety of colours and potency.
Star Thief#018.dst: 그렇군요. 이 물질은 굉장히 희귀하고 마력이 강해요. 운석은 Gavel 곳곳에 떨어지는데 색도 위력도 제각각이죠.
Star Thief#018.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#019.src: We don't fully understand them, but we know they are dangerous. Every scientist who has studied them has lost their minds.
Star Thief#019.dst: 완전히 이해하진 못했지만 위험하다는 건 알아요. 운석을 연구한 과학자는 전부 미쳐 버렸거든요.
Star Thief#019.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#020.src: The meteors hold many secrets and powers, maybe the ones we need to end your war. Thank you, here's a small reward for helping us.
Star Thief#020.dst: 운석엔 수많은 비밀과 힘이 있어요. 당신들 전쟁을 끝낼 힘일지도 모르죠. 고마워요, 도와준 보답이에요.
Star Thief#020.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#021.src: Hello again. Did you find the meteor down there? No? Maybe go back and try to find it?
Star Thief#021.dst: 또 만났네요. 저 아래서 운석 찾았어요? 못 찾았다고요? 돌아가서 다시 찾아보는 게 어때요?
Star Thief#021.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#022.src: Remember... Just follow the white trail leading to the cave!
Star Thief#022.dst: 기억해요... 동굴로 이어진 하얀 흔적만 따라가면 돼요!
Star Thief#022.speaker: Agent

Star Thief#023.src: I can't... control... my mind... end me.
Star Thief#023.dst: 통제가... 안 돼... 내 정신이... 날 죽여 줘.

Supply and Delivery#002.src: Oh, you're one of those {p} soldiers. If I can give some advice?

Supply and Delivery#003.src: You should pick up some items from the Accessory Merchant in town! They might really help you out.

Supply and Delivery#004.src: Normally you can only find accessories in rare cave loot, so a merchant like ours is actually a rarity.

Supply and Delivery#005.src: What? Don't look at me like that! We had a perfectly fair interaction which we both benefited from. I got the plant, and you... well. You gained experience?

Supply and Delivery#006.src: So either you run the supplies to {p}... or we both run away and start new lives, and we avoid the consequences of our actions!
