Supply and Delivery#076.dst: 마을에 돌아오면 그 애랑 얘기 좀 해야겠어요... 아, 물론 수고하셨으니 보답을 드려야죠.
Supply and Delivery#076.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#077.src: I hope these emeralds will suffice. Additionally... we recently fixed up one of our broken carts, which makes the trip to {p} and back.
Supply and Delivery#077.dst: 이 에메랄드면 충분하길 바라요. 그리고... 최근에 고장 난 마차 하나를 고쳤는데, {p}까지 오가요.
Supply and Delivery#077.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#078.src: You may feel free to use it whenever you like! As thanks for all you have done for us.
Supply and Delivery#078.dst: 언제든 편하게 이용하세요! 저희를 위해 해 주신 모든 일에 대한 감사예요.
Supply and Delivery#078.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#079.src: He's... difficult. He's the son of my sister, who was unfortunately killed by spiders some time ago.
Supply and Delivery#079.dst: 그 애는... 다루기 어려워요. 제 누나 아들인데, 누나는 얼마 전 안타깝게도 거미에게 목숨을 잃었어요.
Supply and Delivery#079.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#080.src: With his father out of the picture, I had to take him in. He's a grown man now, yes, but... I fear the loss has taken a toll on us both.
Supply and Delivery#080.dst: 아버지도 없어서 제가 데려다 키웠죠. 이제 어엿한 어른이지만... 그 상실이 저희 둘 모두에게 상처를 남긴 것 같아요.
Supply and Delivery#080.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#081.src: I truly hope he will cease with these ridiculous ploys sometime soon... but I can't bring myself to do more than give him a stern talking to.
Supply and Delivery#081.dst: 그 애가 곧 이런 터무니없는 수작을 그만두길 바라요... 하지만 따끔하게 타이르는 것 이상은 차마 못 하겠어요.
Supply and Delivery#081.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#082.src: He's a good man, truly. I believe that with my whole heart. It's alright if you don't feel the same way, though. I will not force you to interact with him if you do not wish to.
Supply and Delivery#082.dst: 정말 좋은 사람이에요. 진심으로 그렇게 믿어요. 그래도 생각이 다르셔도 괜찮아요. 원치 않으시면 그 애와 어울리라고 강요하지 않을게요.
Supply and Delivery#082.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#083.src: Oh, dear... I suppose it must have been fifteen years ago that I took the position, when the old mayor stepped down.
Supply and Delivery#083.dst: 어머나... 이 자리를 맡은 게 열다섯 해 전쯤이었을 거예요. 전 촌장님이 물러나셨을 때요.
Supply and Delivery#083.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#084.src: He was a kind man, always looking out for the townsfolk. Though, by the time he retired, it was clear he was growing restless in our little town.
Supply and Delivery#084.dst: 마을 사람들을 늘 챙기던 친절한 분이었어요. 하지만 은퇴하실 즈음엔 우리 작은 마을을 답답해하시는 게 보였죠.
Supply and Delivery#084.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#085.src: Well, as soon as he passed down the position to me, he immediately traveled to {p} and enlisted in their army! I hear he's in the business of training soldiers these days.
Supply and Delivery#085.dst: 그런데 저한테 자리를 넘기자마자 곧장 {p}에 가서 입대하셨어요! 요즘은 병사들을 훈련시키신다더군요.
Supply and Delivery#085.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#086.src: Ah, but I've tried lived up to his legacy. I like to think I've done well in my time as mayor!
Supply and Delivery#086.dst: 아, 그래도 전 그분의 뜻을 이어가려 애썼어요. 촌장으로서 잘해 왔다고 생각하고 싶네요!
Supply and Delivery#086.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Supply and Delivery#087.src: A fine day for passing through! I hope you enjoy your stay.
Supply and Delivery#087.dst: 지나가기 좋은 날이네요! 즐겁게 머물다 가세요.
Supply and Delivery#087.speaker: Mayor Alvin

Taking the Tower#000.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been here to help!

Taking the Tower#001.src: We did it! Let's get back to Lieutenant Van and tell him the news.

Taking the Tower#002.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Item Upgrader!
Taking the Tower#002.dst: 아, 잠깐. 먼저 들를 데가 있어. 아이템 강화사한테 따라와!

Taking the Tower#003.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to  Water damage!
Taking the Tower#003.dst: 듣자 하니 탑 꼭대기 두목이  물 피해에 약하대!

Taking the Tower#004.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#004.dst: 무기에 여러 원소 파우더를 넣을 수 있어. 그러면 원래 못 주던 속성의 피해를 줄 수 있지.

Taking the Tower#005.src: In this case, you can apply a  Water powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#005.dst: 이번엔  물 파우더를 넣으면 돼. 그럼 탑에 있는 타락한 적들에게 무기가 더 잘 먹힐 거야!

Taking the Tower#006.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and Hold the powder, then Right Click on your weapon. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#006.dst: ...요점은- 자. 이 원소 파우더를 받아서 손에 든 채로 무기를 우클릭해. 끝나면 알려 줘!

Taking the Tower#008.src: You see this Item Upgrader? It can be used to upgrade powders to high tiers.
Taking the Tower#008.dst: 이 아이템 강화사 보여? 파우더를 더 높은 등급으로 강화할 수 있어.

Taking the Tower#009.src: It can also remove powders from your items, if you need to- don't worry, you'll get your powders back!
Taking the Tower#009.dst: 필요하면 아이템에서 파우더를 빼낼 수도 있어- 걱정 마, 파우더는 돌려받으니까!

Taking the Tower#010.src: ...Anyway, Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p}- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#010.dst: ...어쨌든, Van 중위님이랑 다른 사람들은 {p}의 집들 옆에 있어- 오는 길에 봤을 거야.

Taking the Tower#011.src: It doesn't much matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#011.dst: 누가 하든 별 상관없다, 해내기만 하면. 기회가 보이면- 가라!

Taking the Tower#012.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here! Understood?
Taking the Tower#012.dst: 후퇴해야 하거나 타락자들을 처치하면 여기로 다시 모여라! 알겠나?

Taking the Tower#013.src: Hey, {u}, there you are! Come on, let's climb that tower!
Taking the Tower#013.dst: 야, {u}, 여기 있었구나! 가자, 저 탑에 올라가자!

Taking the Tower#014.src: They have, lieutenant! {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#014.dst: 네, 중위님! {u}와(과) 제가 꼭대기에 올라가 타락자를 쓰러뜨렸습니다.

Taking the Tower#015.src: Speak to Aledar in the {p} Barracks at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#016.src: Oh, {u}! Hey! It's good to see you and Tasim again. Hope you didn't have too many adventures without me!
Taking the Tower#016.dst: 오, {u}! 안녕! 너랑 Tasim을 다시 보니 반갑다. 나 빼고 모험 너무 많이 한 건 아니지?
Taking the Tower#016.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#017.src: Tasim's gone off to the training room, if you were looking for him. He's really jumping straight into it, which... is good! We all need to get stronger so we can defend the province.
Taking the Tower#017.dst: Tasim 찾는 거면 훈련실에 갔어. 아주 제대로 뛰어들었더라, 그건... 좋은 거지! 이 지방을 지키려면 우리 모두 더 강해져야 하니까.
Taking the Tower#017.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#018.src: Tasim told me all about the corrupted force you took out. I wish I could have been there to help!
Taking the Tower#018.dst: 네가 타락한 병력을 해치웠다고 Tasim이 다 얘기해 줬어. 나도 거기서 도왔으면 좋았을 텐데!
Taking the Tower#018.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#019.src: ...Oh! Since you're here- I was about to head out to join Lieutenant Van's squad to take back a tower overtaken by corrupteds. You should come with us, too!
Taking the Tower#019.dst: ...아! 마침 잘 왔다- 타락자들에게 점령된 탑을 되찾으러 Van 중위님 분대에 합류하려던 참이었어. 너도 같이 가자!
Taking the Tower#019.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#020.src: Well? What do you think? Want to get some real combat experience? It shouldn't take long.
Taking the Tower#020.dst: 어때? 진짜 전투 경험 좀 쌓아 볼래? 오래 안 걸릴 거야.
Taking the Tower#020.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#021.src: Perfect. Well, no time better than the present! Let's get going.
Taking the Tower#021.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#022.src: Oh, wait. There's a stop we've got to make first. Follow me to the Powder Master!
Taking the Tower#022.dst: 아, 잠깐. 먼저 들를 데가 있어. 파우더 장인한테 따라와!
Taking the Tower#022.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#024.src: Well, I'll still be here for a while. If you change your mind, let me know!
Taking the Tower#024.dst: 난 한동안 여기 있을 거야. 마음 바뀌면 말해 줘!
Taking the Tower#024.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#025.src: Hey, you're back! Have you changed you mind? Want to join a raid on a corrupted tower?
Taking the Tower#025.dst: 어, 돌아왔네! 마음 바뀌었어? 타락한 탑 공격에 같이 갈래?
Taking the Tower#025.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#026.src: Follow Aledar to the Powder Master at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Taking the Tower#027.src: Alright, so. There's something I've been told about the tower we're going to be attacking which we can prepare for!
Taking the Tower#027.dst: 좋아, 그러니까. 우리가 공격할 탑에 대해 들은 게 있는데, 미리 대비할 수 있어!
Taking the Tower#027.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#028.src: Apparently, the big bad at the top of the tower is weak to damage! And so, here we are at the Powder Master.
Taking the Tower#028.dst: 듣자 하니 탑 꼭대기 두목이  피해에 약하대! 그래서 파우더 장인한테 온 거야.
Taking the Tower#028.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#029.src: You can apply various elemental powders to your weapons here, which lets them deal types of damage they might not have been able to before.
Taking the Tower#029.dst: 여기선 무기에 여러 원소 파우더를 넣을 수 있어. 그러면 원래 못 주던 속성의 피해를 줄 수 있지.
Taking the Tower#029.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#030.src: In this case, you can apply a powder, so that your weapon will be more effective against the corrupted enemies at the tower!
Taking the Tower#030.dst: 이번엔  파우더를 넣으면 돼. 그럼 탑에 있는 타락한 적들에게 무기가 더 잘 먹힐 거야!
Taking the Tower#030.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#031.src: I, uh... don't remember the whole elemental speech off the top of my head. If you want to know more about those, you'll have to talk to Captain Ragon in the barracks. He has a whole course about it!
Taking the Tower#031.dst: 나, 어... 원소 설명을 전부 외우진 못했어. 더 알고 싶으면 병영에 있는 Ragon 대장님께 가 봐. 그걸로 강의를 통째로 하시거든!
Taking the Tower#031.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#032.src: ...The point is- here. Take this elemental powder and talk to the Powder Master to apply it. Let me know when you're done!
Taking the Tower#032.dst: ...요점은- 자. 이 원소 파우더를 받아서 파우더 장인한테 넣어 달라고 해. 끝나면 알려 줘!
Taking the Tower#032.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#033.src: Apply a Water Powder to your weapon, then let Aledar know at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#033.dst: 무기에 물 파우더를 넣은 뒤 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Aledar에게 알리세요.

Taking the Tower#034.src: Got the powder on your weapon? Good, that means we're ready.
Taking the Tower#034.dst: 무기에 파우더 넣었어? 좋아, 그럼 준비 끝이야.
Taking the Tower#034.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#035.src: Lieutenant Van and the others are by that bunch of houses in the {p} Suburbs- you probably saw it on your way in.
Taking the Tower#035.dst: Van 중위님이랑 다른 사람들은 {p} 교외의 집들 옆에 있어. 오는 길에 봤을 거야.
Taking the Tower#035.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#036.src: Lead the way! I'll be right behind you.
Taking the Tower#036.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#037.src: Meet up with Lieutenant Van's squad near the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Taking the Tower#037.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 분노의 탑 근처에서 Van 중위의 분대와 합류하세요.

Taking the Tower#038.src: Ah, Aledar! Good to see you here. Who's this with you?
Taking the Tower#038.dst: 아, Aledar! 여기서 보니 반갑군. 같이 온 사람은 누군가?
Taking the Tower#038.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#039.src: This is {u}, sir. They're here to join our assault, if you'll allow it.
Taking the Tower#039.dst: {u}입니다, 중위님. 허락해 주시면 공격에 합류하려 합니다.
Taking the Tower#039.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#040.src: Hm... Well, I don't see why not. The more the merrier, that's what I say.
Taking the Tower#040.dst: 흠... 뭐, 안 될 것도 없지. 많을수록 좋다는 게 내 지론일세.
Taking the Tower#040.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#041.src: If everyone's here, we can begin. Here's the plan! We'll need to fight off some of the forces near the base of the tower, so that someone can climb to the top.
Taking the Tower#041.dst: 다 모였으면 시작하지. 작전은 이렇다! 탑 아래쪽 적들을 물리쳐서 누군가 꼭대기까지 올라갈 수 있게 해야 한다.
Taking the Tower#041.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#042.src: It doesn't matter who does the job, so long as it gets done. If you see an opportunity- go for it!
Taking the Tower#042.dst: 누가 하든 상관없다, 해내기만 하면. 기회가 보이면- 가라!
Taking the Tower#042.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#043.src: If you need to retreat, or the corrupteds are slain, regroup here!| Understood?
Taking the Tower#043.dst: 후퇴해야 하거나 타락자들을 처치하면 여기로 다시 모여라!| 알겠나?
Taking the Tower#043.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#046.src: Good. Alright soldiers, let's take back that tower!
Taking the Tower#046.dst: 좋다. 자, 병사들이여, 저 탑을 되찾자!
Taking the Tower#046.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#047.src: Go on, head for the tower! If we're lucky, we'll be able to clear out the corrupteds who have taken over it.
Taking the Tower#047.dst: 가라, 탑으로 향해라! 운이 좋으면 탑을 차지한 타락자들을 쓸어버릴 수 있을 거다.
Taking the Tower#047.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#048.src: Assault the Raging Tower at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and defeat the monster at the top.
Taking the Tower#048.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 분노의 탑을 공격하고 꼭대기의 괴물을 처치하세요.

Taking the Tower#049.src: Alright. It's time to take on the tower! We've got this, {u}.
Taking the Tower#049.dst: 좋아. 탑을 칠 시간이야! 우린 할 수 있어, {u}.
Taking the Tower#049.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#050.src: Report back to Lieutenant Van about your success at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taking the Tower#051.src: We did it, we killed the corrupted! Come on, let's get back to Lieutenant Van with the news!
Taking the Tower#051.dst: 해냈어, 타락자를 쓰러뜨렸어! 가자, Van 중위님께 소식 전하러!
Taking the Tower#051.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#052.src: It seems everyone has returned. Well? Have the corrupted forces been vanquished?
Taking the Tower#052.dst: 다들 돌아온 것 같군. 어떤가? 타락한 병력은 물리쳤나?
Taking the Tower#052.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#053.src: They have, lieutenant. {u} and I reached the top and defeated the corrupted.
Taking the Tower#053.dst: 네, 중위님. {u}와(과) 제가 꼭대기에 올라가 타락자를 쓰러뜨렸습니다.
Taking the Tower#053.speaker: Aledar

Taking the Tower#054.src: Fine work, soldiers! Another great victory for the {p} army. With the leader killed, it shouldn't be too difficult to clear out the rest of them.
Taking the Tower#054.dst: 훌륭하다, 병사들! {p} 군의 또 하나의 대승이군. 우두머리가 죽었으니 나머지를 쓸어내는 건 어렵지 않을 거다.
Taking the Tower#054.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#055.src: I'll let the Admiral know of your victory today, soldiers. And- here, some payment for your work.
Taking the Tower#055.dst: 오늘의 승리는 제독님께 보고하겠네, 병사들. 그리고- 자, 수고의 대가일세.
Taking the Tower#055.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#056.src: The two of you have a promising future. I look forward to serving with you in the future!
Taking the Tower#056.dst: 자네 둘은 장래가 촉망되는군. 앞으로 함께 복무하길 기대하겠네!
Taking the Tower#056.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taking the Tower#058.src: We'll take care of the remaining stragglers, don't you worry. Thank you for your work today, soldier.
Taking the Tower#058.dst: 남은 잔당은 우리가 처리할 테니 걱정 말게. 오늘 수고 많았네, 병사.
Taking the Tower#058.speaker: Lieutenant Van

Taproot#000.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light II - Taproot

similar.text: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light

Taproot#001.src: I have to follow the trail! I...I have to know what he's telling me!

Taproot#002.src: {u}...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.

similar.text: ...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.

Taproot#003.src: To end this "Mayor's" life... To snuff out one whose heart aches is painful.
Taproot#003.dst: 이 시장의 목숨을 끊는다면... 아파하는 심장을 꺼뜨림은 고통스럽다.

similar.text: The door has been opened...

Taproot#006.src: The cog is missing a piece...

Taproot#007.src: Maybe there is something you can use around. Might be good to backtrack.

Taproot#008.src: The piece of metal fit in the cog...

Taproot#009.src: You should follow Lari. There has to be something you can do.
Taproot#009.dst: Lari를 따라가야 한다. 분명 뭔가 할 수 있는 일이 있을 것이다.

Taproot#011.src: ...oh. {u}, you're back. Ehm...I have to say, I'm...rather busy at the moment.
Taproot#011.speaker: Lari

Taproot#012.src: I have...important things to do. This accursed Decay...I have to end it. This all needs to stop.
Taproot#012.dst: 해야 할...중요한 일이 있어. 이 저주받은 쇠락...끝내야 해. 이 모든 걸 멈춰야 해.
Taproot#012.speaker: Lari

Taproot#013.src: I am thankful for your aid with the...the Grootslang, but I do not believe you will be able to help with this- Simply a matter of scale.
Taproot#013.dst: 그...그루트슬랭 일은 도와줘서 고마워. 하지만 이번엔 네가 도울 수 있을 것 같지 않아- 그냥 규모의 문제야.
Taproot#013.speaker: Lari

Taproot#014.src: I apologize, but I need to focus on my task here. If, perhaps, you could come back another time? And, I do mean that sincerely...
Taproot#014.dst: 미안하지만 여기 일에 집중해야 해. 혹시, 다음에 다시 와 줄래? 진심으로 하는 말이야...
Taproot#014.speaker: Lari

Taproot#015.src: I can't even recall how many attempts this will make...but all my knowledge has gone into this. This must work.
Taproot#015.dst: 이게 몇 번째 시도인지도 기억 안 나...하지만 내 모든 지식을 쏟아부었어. 이번엔 꼭 성공해야 해.
Taproot#015.speaker: Lari

Taproot#016.src: Follow Lari to the black spot next to her camp.
Taproot#016.dst: Lari를 따라 야영지 옆의 검은 반점으로 가세요.

Taproot#017.src: ...I suppose I can't fault you for being curious. You may have seen a large, dark-looking patch of ground on your way here- I am trying to tend to it once more.
Taproot#017.dst: ...궁금해하는 걸 탓할 순 없겠지. 오는 길에 크고 어두운 땅을 봤을 거야- 그걸 다시 한번 돌보려는 중이야.
Taproot#017.speaker: Lari

Taproot#018.src: It is...the most obvious stain of the decay, and very intense...if I can scrub this out, the rest should follow.
Taproot#018.dst: 그건...쇠락의 가장 뚜렷한 얼룩이고, 아주 짙어...이걸 씻어 낼 수 있다면, 나머지도 따라올 거야.
Taproot#018.speaker: Lari

Taproot#019.src: This concoction of mine should...do the trick!
Taproot#019.speaker: Lari

Taproot#020.src: It...it's working!! I can feel it, the land is reacting positively!
Taproot#020.dst: 효...효과가 있어!! 느껴져, 땅이 반응하고 있어!
Taproot#020.speaker: Lari

Taproot#021.src: I...I... It was...it was working, a-and... Agh, why can't I get this RIGHT?!
Taproot#021.dst: 나...나... 효과가...있었는데, 그, 그런데... 아악, 왜 제대로 못 하는 거야?!
Taproot#021.speaker: Lari

Taproot#022.src: How many decades have I been doing this? How much time have I wasted, just...flailing like this?!
Taproot#022.dst: 이 일을 몇십 년이나 해 왔지? 얼마나 많은 시간을...이렇게 허우적대며 버린 거야?!
Taproot#022.speaker: Lari

Taproot#023.src: Look, {u}, I...I don't know what you expect to do against this. The Wyrm was one thing, but...this is beyond your comprehension.
Taproot#023.dst: 이봐, {u}, 난...네가 이걸 상대로 뭘 할 수 있을지 모르겠어. 그루트슬랭과는 달라...이건 네 이해를 넘어서.
Taproot#023.speaker: Lari

Taproot#024.src: I think you sh... Should...w-what is... Now, of all times? As I fail?!
Taproot#024.dst: 내 생각엔 네가... 해야... 뭐, 뭐지... 하필 지금? 내가 실패한 때에?!
Taproot#024.speaker: Lari

Taproot#025.src: The road, look! He's contacting me! A-are you finally giving me the answers I've asked for?
Taproot#025.dst: 길을 봐! 그분이 날 부르고 있어! 드, 드디어 내가 청한 답을 주는 거야?
Taproot#025.speaker: Lari

Taproot#026.src: Follow the trail of magic leading from the black spot.
Taproot#026.dst: 검은 반점에서 이어지는 마법의 흔적을 따라가세요.

Taproot#027.src: Talk to Lari outside the weird gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Taproot#028.src: ...I followed you seeking answers...and here, I am presented with more questions. Why did he bring us here?
Taproot#028.dst: ...답을 찾아 널 따라왔는데...여기선 의문만 더 생기네. 그분은 왜 우릴 여기로 데려온 거지?
Taproot#028.speaker: Lari

Taproot#029.src: This gate has appeared, immovable and impassable, since the moment that...that everything started.
Taproot#029.dst: 이 문은...모든 게 시작된 그 순간부터 나타났어. 움직이지도, 지나가지도 못해.
Taproot#029.speaker: Lari

Taproot#030.src: I don't...is he trying to remind me of what's at stake? Did he want to show y- No, that's...he wouldn't know you...but then, what IS this about?!
Taproot#030.dst: 모르겠어...무엇이 걸려 있는지 일깨우려는 걸까? 너한테 보여 주려- 아니, 그건...그분은 널 모를 텐데...그럼 대체 이건 뭐야?!
Taproot#030.speaker: Lari

Taproot#031.src: Rrgh... ANSWER ME! PLEASE! I've begged you for so long to answer!
Taproot#031.dst: 으윽... 대답해! 제발! 그렇게 오래 대답해 달라고 빌었잖아!
Taproot#031.speaker: Lari

Taproot#032.src: You gave me my task and your light but never told me what to DO! I've tried everything I can think of!!
Taproot#032.dst: 나한테 임무와 빛을 줬으면서 뭘 해야 하는지는 한 번도 안 알려 줬어! 생각나는 건 다 해 봤다고!!
Taproot#032.speaker: Lari

Taproot#033.src: Tell me! Please, just t-tell me already!! I don't know how much longer I can stand this!!
Taproot#033.dst: 말해 줘! 제발, 이제 그만 말, 말해 줘!! 얼마나 더 버틸 수 있을지 모르겠어!!
Taproot#033.speaker: Lari

Taproot#034.src: I...a-another one? Where are you leading me now?
Taproot#034.dst: 나...또, 또 하나? 이번엔 날 어디로 이끄는 거야?
Taproot#034.speaker: Lari

Taproot#035.src: It...the gateway...? Are you...I can't understand! Why this, again?
Taproot#035.dst: 그...관문...? 설마...이해가 안 돼! 왜 또 이거야?
Taproot#035.speaker: Lari

Taproot#036.src: You showed me this before... At first, when you first contacted me. I made the choice...
Taproot#036.dst: 전에도 이걸 보여 줬잖아... 처음, 네가 처음 내게 닿았을 때. 난 선택을 했어...
Taproot#036.speaker: Lari

Taproot#037.src: Must I make it again? Is that it, do I need to prove myself to you once more?
Taproot#037.dst: 또 선택해야 해? 그런 거야, 다시 한번 너한테 증명해야 해?
Taproot#037.speaker: Lari

Taproot#038.src: I...what? You...you present me with this, but refuse to let me do what you want?
Taproot#038.dst: 나...뭐? 넌...이걸 보여 주고선, 네가 원하는 걸 못 하게 막는 거야?
Taproot#038.speaker: Lari

Taproot#039.src: ...please, can you investigate the doorway? There must be something wrong that I don't understand.
Taproot#039.dst: ...제발, 저 문 좀 조사해 줄래? 내가 모르는 뭔가가 잘못된 게 분명해.
Taproot#039.speaker: Lari

Taproot#042.src: My pulse... Human. I must inquire to you. I present you a test. Guide your attention to those you see.
Taproot#042.dst: 나의 맥동이여... 인간. 네게 묻겠다. 시험을 내리노라. 눈앞의 이들에게 주의를 기울여라.

Taproot#043.src: I must see the rhythm your heart beats. Listen well.
Taproot#043.dst: 네 심장이 뛰는 박자를 보아야겠다. 잘 들어라.

Taproot#044.src: This has gone far enough. I can't do this anymore! I can't give you any more and I refuse to apologize for it!
Taproot#044.dst: 이만하면 됐어. 더는 못 하겠어! 더 줄 것도 없고, 사과할 생각도 없어!
Taproot#044.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#045.src: You know our deal. Remember what good you are doing by following the plans I've laid out for you.
Taproot#045.dst: 우리 거래는 알잖아. 내가 짜 준 계획을 따르면서 얼마나 좋은 일을 하는지 떠올려 봐.
Taproot#045.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#046.src: Are you going to let your emotions cloud your judgment? You're a smarter man than that, Mr. Mayor.
Taproot#046.dst: 감정에 판단을 흐리게 둘 건가? 당신은 그보다 똑똑한 사람이잖아, 시장 나리.
Taproot#046.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#047.src: You can't possibly believe that throwing away the lives of innocent people is right! I can't go on with this on my conscience!
Taproot#047.dst: 무고한 사람들 목숨을 내버리는 게 옳다고 믿을 리 없잖아! 이런 걸 양심에 얹고 계속할 순 없어!
Taproot#047.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#048.src: Detective Hart WILL be hearing from me, and he'll be hearing everything. We can't keep sacrificing our own like this!
Taproot#048.dst: Hart 탐정은 반드시 내 얘기를 듣게 될 거야, 전부 다. 우리 사람들을 이렇게 계속 희생시킬 순 없어!
Taproot#048.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#049.src: Our golems have single-handedly turned the tide of the Humans' corruption war. You would save ten here and sentence a thousand to die overseas?
Taproot#049.dst: 우리 골렘이 혼자 힘으로 인간들의 타락 전쟁 판도를 뒤집었어. 여기 열 명 살리자고 바다 건너 천 명을 죽게 할 건가?
Taproot#049.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#050.src: You're a sick, twisted man, Urelix. I will not abide by this a moment longer.
Taproot#050.dst: 넌 병들고 뒤틀린 인간이야, Urelix. 이 짓은 한순간도 더 못 참아.
Taproot#050.speaker: Mayor

Taproot#051.src: My pulse, you must decide. Three paths diverge upon your road.
Taproot#051.dst: 나의 맥동이여, 네가 정해야 한다. 네 길 위에 세 갈래 길이 갈린다.

Taproot#052.src: You may leave. The rays of fate will see to destiny unfolding.
Taproot#052.dst: 떠나도 좋다. 운명의 빛살이 정해진 운명을 펼쳐 내리라.

Taproot#053.src: You may end this "Mayor's" life. Blood upon your hands in many ways.
Taproot#053.dst: 이 "시장"의 목숨을 끊어도 좋다. 여러모로 네 손에 피가 묻으리라.

Taproot#055.src: You may end the life of Urelix. Heartbeats ceased by a bleeding heart.
Taproot#055.dst: Urelix의 목숨을 끊어도 좋다. 피 흘리는 마음이 심장 박동을 멈추리라.

Taproot#056.src: Which way does your heart beat? How will you cast your light? Can you see?
Taproot#056.dst: 네 심장은 어느 쪽으로 뛰느냐? 네 빛을 어찌 비추겠느냐? 보이느냐?

Taproot#058.src: My pulse... The blood of a bleeding heart has poisoned me. Even if you believe the sun should shine elsewhere, you must direct it yourself.
Taproot#058.dst: 나의 맥동이여... 피 흘리는 마음의 피가 나를 중독시켰다. 해가 다른 곳을 비춰야 한다고 믿더라도, 네 손으로 이끌어야 한다.

Taproot#059.src: You must realize what is needed. You must see light through my lens.
Taproot#059.dst: 무엇이 필요한지 깨달아야 한다. 내 렌즈로 빛을 보아야 한다.

Taproot#060.src: To leave... As destiny unfolds, the sun shall set.

Taproot#062.src: To end the life of Urelix... The shadows of war shall engulf all.
Taproot#062.dst: Urelix의 목숨을 끊는다면... 전쟁의 그림자가 모든 것을 삼키리라.

Taproot#063.src: My pulse, there is only one choice. You must do what is required, I beg of you.
Taproot#063.dst: 나의 맥동이여, 선택은 하나뿐이다. 해야 할 일을 하라, 부탁한다.

Taproot#064.src: Ah, you recognize necessity. That couldn't have been pleasant...but what's needed isn't pleasant, in the end.
Taproot#064.dst: 아, 필요를 아는군. 유쾌하진 않았겠지...하지만 결국 필요한 일은 유쾌하지 않은 법이야.
Taproot#064.speaker: Dr. Urelix

Taproot#067.src: ...I didn't think you would be able to help, but I had to ask. So...was this for nothing?
Taproot#067.dst: ...네가 도울 수 있을 거라곤 생각 안 했지만, 물어봐야 했어. 그럼...이게 다 헛수고였어?
Taproot#067.speaker: Lari

Taproot#068.src: Wait...y-you...had a choice? He gave you the choice too?! A-Already?!
Taproot#068.dst: 잠깐...너, 너한테...선택권이 있었어? 그분이 너한테도 선택을 줬다고?! 벌, 벌써?!
Taproot#068.speaker: Lari

Taproot#069.src: Wh- I don't understand! You...you just arrived to Gavel! You haven't seen its decline! Felt its pain!
Taproot#069.dst: 뭐- 이해가 안 돼! 넌...넌 이제 막 Gavel에 왔잖아! 쇠퇴를 본 적도! 아픔을 느낀 적도 없잖아!
Taproot#069.speaker: Lari

Taproot#070.src: What did you do?! The gate is opening? YOU did this?! I know your heart is in the right place, but you're a stranger to this land!
Taproot#070.dst: 무슨 짓을 한 거야?! 문이 열려? 네가 이런 거야?! 네 마음이 옳은 건 알지만, 넌 이 땅에선 이방인이야!
Taproot#070.speaker: Lari

Taproot#071.src: I...I...rrrgh... AAAAGH!! This isn't fair!! I've worked for decades and the light just...throws me to the wayside?!
Taproot#071.dst: 나...나...으으윽... 아아아악!! 불공평해!! 수십 년을 애썼는데 빛은 그냥...날 길가에 내던지는 거야?!
Taproot#071.speaker: Lari

Taproot#072.src:
Lari
PLEASE! Just let me in!
Taproot#072.speaker: Lari

Taproot#073.src: My pulse, you must leave her be. Her heart's emotions have overpowered her mind's judgement. She must learn to separate them as you have.
Taproot#073.dst: 나의 맥동이여, 그녀를 내버려 두어라. 마음의 감정이 머리의 판단을 짓눌렀다. 너처럼 둘을 떼어 놓는 법을 배워야 한다.

Taproot#074.src: Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#074.speaker: Lari

Taproot#075.src: Why do you want this human to enter the Taproot?! What's special about them, what's their connection? What have they done that I haven't?! Tell me, please! Let me be useful!!
Taproot#075.dst: 왜 이 인간을 Taproot에 들이려는 거야?! 뭐가 특별해, 무슨 연관이 있는데? 내가 못 한 걸 저 인간이 뭘 했는데?! 말해 줘, 제발! 나도 쓸모 있게 해 줘!!
Taproot#075.speaker: Lari

Taproot#078.src: Your heartbeat beats in time with mine. Your mind is unclouded, despite the fury you have been steeped in. My pulse, you are needed.
Taproot#078.dst: 네 심장이 내 심장과 같은 박자로 뛴다. 분노에 잠겼음에도 네 정신은 흐려지지 않았다. 나의 맥동이여, 네가 필요하다.

Taproot#079.src: Your eyes cannot see the scope of the realms. You must allow me to shed light upon them- You must see the connections.
Taproot#079.dst: 네 눈은 영역들의 전모를 볼 수 없다. 내가 빛을 비추게 하라- 그 연결을 보아야 한다.

Taproot#080.src: Light... Dark... We oppose. I am light. It is dark. Our places reflect this land...and it is plain- The sun is setting. Light is fading
Taproot#080.dst: 빛... 어둠... 우리는 대립한다. 나는 빛이다. 그것은 어둠이다. 우리의 자리는 이 땅을 비춘다...그리고 분명하다- 해가 저문다. 빛이 사그라든다

Taproot#081.src: The land you visit warps with the slow siphoning of my light, my blood. It becomes outlandish and strange- Oppressive and alien.
Taproot#081.dst: 네가 찾는 땅은 나의 빛, 나의 피가 서서히 빨려 나가며 뒤틀린다. 기괴하고 낯설게- 숨 막히고 이질적으로 변한다.

Taproot#082.src: Perhaps you should try interacting with this thing?

Taproot#083.src: As dusk approaches- As darkness spreads- My heart slows and stops. My pulse, you are needed. You shall be as one with me, and you shall see.
Taproot#083.dst: 황혼이 다가오며- 어둠이 퍼지며- 내 심장은 느려지다 멎는다. 나의 맥동이여, 네가 필요하다. 너는 나와 하나가 되어, 보게 되리라.

Taproot#084.src: {p} needs life anew- A new pulse. It need you.
Taproot#084.dst: {p}에는 새 생명이 필요하다- 새로운 맥동이. 네가 필요하다.

Taproot#086.src: Our light is synchronous! You may see what I must have you see...
Taproot#086.dst: 우리의 빛이 맞닿았다! 내가 보여 주어야 할 것을 볼 수 있으리라...

Taproot#087.src: Follow the road. You must witness the reason behind my trial.
Taproot#087.dst: 길을 따라라. 내 시험의 이유를 목격해야 한다.

Taproot#088.src: See my memories. The memories of the realm. See...and be enlightened.
Taproot#088.dst: 내 기억을 보아라. 이 영역의 기억을. 보고...깨우쳐라.

Taproot#089.src: Witness it... The Equinox. Learn why you are needed, my pulse.
Taproot#089.dst: 목격하라... Equinox를. 네가 왜 필요한지 배워라, 나의 맥동이여.

Taproot#092.src: My light...I won't let you down!
Taproot#092.speaker: Lari

Taproot#093.dst: 너! 넌 여기 있으면 안 돼!
Taproot#093.speaker: Lari

Taproot#094.src: Wah! Back away, I don't want to hurt you!
Taproot#094.dst: 왁! 물러서, 널 다치게 하고 싶지 않아!
Taproot#094.speaker: Lari

Taproot#095.src: I can do this... Orphion, lend me your voice!
Taproot#095.dst: 할 수 있어... Orphion, 목소리를 빌려줘!
Taproot#095.speaker: Lari

Taproot#096.src: Return to your realm in peace!
Taproot#096.speaker: Lari

Taproot#097.src: Your power is blinded by light. You cannot win!
Taproot#097.dst: 네 힘은 빛에 눈이 멀었어. 넌 못 이겨!
Taproot#097.speaker: Lari

Taproot#098.src: Peace, strange creature! You must be peaceful!
Taproot#098.speaker: Lari

Taproot#099.src: Why isn't this working? Even Orphion's voice...
Taproot#099.speaker: Lari

Taproot#100.src: It's scarring the land... I need to end this, quickly...
Taproot#100.dst: 땅에 상처를 내고 있어... 빨리 끝내야 해...
Taproot#100.speaker: Lari

Taproot#101.src: His light... This power... I can do this!
Taproot#101.dst: 그분의 빛... 이 힘... 할 수 있어!
Taproot#101.speaker: Lari

Taproot#102.src: The embodiment of light supports me!
Taproot#102.speaker: Lari

Taproot#103.src: You cannot fight the focus of pure light!
Taproot#103.dst: 순수한 빛의 초점엔 맞설 수 없어!
Taproot#103.speaker: Lari

Taproot#104.src: Be done! I bind you with Orphion's light!
Taproot#104.speaker: Lari

Taproot#106.src: Lari... A conflicted heart failed to channel my light. She refused to battle.
Taproot#106.dst: Lari... 갈등하는 마음은 내 빛을 이끌지 못했다. 그녀는 싸우길 거부했다.

Taproot#107.src: The vile intruder was weak... But every opportunity to strike, exchanged for words to the deaf.
Taproot#107.dst: 사악한 침입자는 약했다... 허나 공격할 기회마다, 귀머거리에게 말을 거는 데 써 버렸다.

Taproot#108.src: My pulse... It pains me. Her light simply fails to shine where it is needed, and so we are here.
Taproot#108.dst: 나의 맥동이여... 괴롭구나. 그녀의 빛은 필요한 곳을 비추지 못하니, 우리가 여기 있는 것이다.

Taproot#109.src: The Realm of Light needs life anew- A new pulse. It needs you.
Taproot#109.dst: 빛의 영역에는 새 생명이 필요하다- 새로운 맥동이. 네가 필요하다.

Taproot#110.src: Talk to Lari outside the Taproot gate.

Taproot#111.src: I... I...hope you'll forgive me, {u}. My anger wasn't with you. I...j-just...
Taproot#111.dst: 나... 나...용서해 줬으면 해, {u}. 너한테 화난 게 아니었어. 난...그, 그냥...
Taproot#111.speaker: Lari

Taproot#112.src: I work for untold years, trying to save this province, to save a Realm... All to so little avail. To the sound of silence from the one I'm trying to help.
Taproot#112.dst: 헤아릴 수 없는 세월 동안 이 지방을, 한 영역을 구하려 애썼어... 거의 소용없었지. 돕고 싶은 분은 침묵뿐이었고.
Taproot#112.speaker: Lari

Taproot#113.src: And then, you appear, and... I still haven't ever been in there. I'd...I'd ask what it was like, but it's...probably private, right?
Taproot#113.dst: 그런데 네가 나타났고... 난 아직도 거기 들어가 본 적이 없어. 어땠는지...묻고 싶지만, 그건...사적인 일이겠지?
Taproot#113.speaker: Lari

Taproot#114.src: At...at least I have an ally now, r-right? But...I'm afraid that... N-no, it's silly, you don't need to hear me fretting.
Taproot#114.dst: 적...적어도 이제 동료가 생긴 거지, 그, 그렇지? 하지만...두려운 건... 아, 아니야, 바보 같은 소리야, 내 걱정까지 들을 필요 없어.
Taproot#114.speaker: Lari

Taproot#115.src: I... I promise I can still be useful. I'll... I'll find a way. I promise you. I'll...get out of your way, for now.
Taproot#115.dst: 나... 나도 아직 쓸모 있을 수 있어, 약속해. 방법을... 방법을 찾을게. 약속해. 일단은...비켜 줄게.
Taproot#115.speaker: Lari

Taproot#116.src:
Lari
Please... You can't DO this to me!!
Taproot#116.dst:
Lari
제발... 나한테 이러면 안 돼!!
Taproot#116.speaker: Lari

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.src: Talk to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends, close to {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#000.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} 근처, 전설의 신전 입구에 있는 Kelight에게 말을 거세요

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.src: I see you want to enter this mighty temple! Do not deny it, I see it in your eyes.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.dst: 이 위대한 신전에 들어가고 싶은 모양이군! 부정하지 마, 눈에 다 보이니까.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#001.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.src: It is only natural, after all, to want to join the esteemed ranks of the Legends, such as myself!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.dst: 당연한 일이지. 나 같은 고귀한 전설들의 반열에 들고 싶은 건!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#002.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.src: You will need to prove yourself by fighting a powerful beast, hidden deep in this cave beside me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.dst: 내 옆 이 동굴 깊숙이 숨은 강력한 짐승과 싸워 자격을 증명해야 해.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#003.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.src: However, as a Legend, I am very busy, autographs and the sort, and that's not to mention my guard duty! Let me see if you are even worth my time.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.dst: 하지만 전설인 난 무척 바쁘거든. 사인 요청이라든가 말이야. 경비 임무는 말할 것도 없고! 네가 내 시간을 쓸 가치가 있는지 보자.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#004.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.src: Hm... At a glance, you don't look anything special! Why, you may as well be a common soldier, for all I can imagine!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.dst: 흠... 얼핏 봐선 전혀 특별해 보이지 않는군! 아무리 봐도 그냥 평범한 병사 같은데!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#005.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.src: Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.dst: 말해 봐, 내가 왜 너한테 이런 기회를 줘야 하지? 지금까진 전혀 감명받지 못했거든.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#006.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.src: You're stubborn? Hah! Don't make me laugh. Do you think you are the first to attempt entry without anything great to show for it?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.dst: 고집이 세다고? 하! 웃기지 마. 내세울 것 하나 없이 들어가려 한 게 네가 처음인 줄 알아?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#007.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.dst: 당연히 아니지. 이제 가 봐. 정말 대단한 걸 보여 줄 수 있을 때 돌아와.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#008.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.src: ...And? Surely you do not hope to bribe me, do you? What use would I have for whatever meager wealth you have?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.dst: ...그래서? 설마 날 매수하려는 건 아니겠지? 네 쥐꼬리만 한 재산이 나한테 무슨 소용이야?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#009.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.src: I'm a Legend! I have everything I could possibly need for the rest of my life! Now, run along. Return when you have something concrete to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.dst: 난 전설이야! 평생 필요한 건 전부 가졌다고! 자, 가 봐. 확실한 걸 보여 줄 수 있을 때 돌아와.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#010.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.src: Ha! You? A Legend?! What a joke. You aren't the first to have tried that, by the way. I know each and every member of our ranks, and you are not one of them.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.dst: 하! 네가? 전설이라고?! 웃기는군. 그런 수를 쓴 게 네가 처음도 아니야. 우리 반열의 전원을 다 아는데, 넌 거기 없어.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#011.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.src: Ah, truly, being a gatekeeper of the Temple is an entertaining position. Run along, now. Return when you have something real to show me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.dst: 아, 신전 문지기란 참 재미있는 자리야. 자, 가 봐. 진짜 보여 줄 게 생기면 돌아와.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#012.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.src: Hmph. Ridiculous. I don't need you to convince me of anything! Clearly, you are nothing but a pretender.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.dst: 흥. 어이없군. 네가 날 설득할 필요는 없어! 보아하니 넌 사기꾼일 뿐이야.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#013.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.dst: 이제 가 봐. 보여 줄 게 없으면 내 시간 낭비하지 마!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#014.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.dst: ...하지만- 아. 아직도 여기 있으니. 어쩌면- 아니, 아니, 말도 안 돼, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#017.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.dst: 왜 이래, Kelight, 이러지 마. 침묵 작전 따위에 넘어가면 안 되지...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#019.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.dst: 아, 좋아. 흥미가 생겼어. 너한테 뭐가 특별한 거지? 평범한 병사로 보이는데, 그런데도...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#021.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.dst: 좋아. 시험에 도전하는 걸 허락하지. 그러면 자격을 증명할 수 있을지도 모르니까.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#022.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.dst: 근처 동굴 깊숙이 비할 데 없는 짐승이 숨어 있어. 타락했지, 그래. 하지만 전에 만난 적들과는 차원이 달라.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#023.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.dst: 소문에 따르면 그놈은 네더 포털에 처음 발을 들인 광부 중 하나였다더군... 물론 전설인 나는 보통 그런 건 무시하지만.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#024.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.src: In any case, its power cannot be underestimated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.dst: 어쨌든 그 힘을 얕봐선 안 돼. 동굴에 들어가기만 해도 크게 약해지거든. 최고의 장비를 갖췄어도 말이야!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#025.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light which is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.dst: 가까이 가면 금세 타락해 버리니 보호 수단이 필요해. 그 짐승이 온 영역과 같은 곳에서 온 빛만이 효과가 있지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#026.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.dst: 그러니 전설이 되는 여정의 첫걸음은... 네더를 연구하는 내 친구를 찾아가는 거야.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#027.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.dst: 이름은 Jorkin이고, 그 영역에 대해선 내가 아는 누구보다 잘 알아. {p} 근처, {p}에서 그를 찾아 도움을 청해. 내가 보냈다고 해.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#028.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.src: Find a way to get Kelight to allow you entry into the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#029.dst: Kelight가 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 전설의 신전에 들여보내 주도록 방법을 찾으세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.src: So you return! Very interesting. That certainly puts you a level beyond any others who have tried... But it is not enough.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.dst: 돌아왔군! 아주 흥미로워. 시도했던 다른 이들보다는 확실히 한 수 위야... 하지만 부족해.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#030.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.src: So? Tell me, why should I bother giving you this chance? Because thus far, I'm not impressed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.dst: 그래서? 말해 봐, 내가 왜 너한테 이런 기회를 줘야 하지? 지금까진 전혀 감명받지 못했거든.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#031.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#032.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.src: Of course you aren't. Run along, now. Return when you have something truly impressive to show for yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.dst: 당연히 아니지. 이제 가 봐. 정말 대단한 걸 보여 줄 수 있을 때 돌아와.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#033.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.src: So you are! And so am I. You will not get past me that easily, I'm afraid.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.dst: 그렇군! 나도 그래. 그렇게 쉽게 날 지나가진 못할 거다.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#034.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.src: Off you go, then. Don't come back unless you have something to show!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.dst: 그럼 가 봐. 보여 줄 게 없으면 돌아오지 마!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#035.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.src: Yes, I'm starting to get that impression. You are such a headache, you know that?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.dst: 그래, 나도 슬슬 그런 느낌이 들어. 너 정말 골칫거리야, 알아?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#036.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.src: Fine! Fine. I'll give you a chance. I'm certain you won't succeed, but anything to get you to stop bothering me.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.dst: 좋아! 좋아. 기회를 주지. 성공 못 할 게 뻔하지만, 네가 날 그만 귀찮게 한다면야 뭐든.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#038.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#039.src: Ahem. Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
