Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.dst: 흥. 어이없군. 네가 날 설득할 필요는 없어! 보아하니 넌 사기꾼일 뿐이야.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#049.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.src: Run along, now. If you don't have anything to show for yourself, don't waste my time!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.dst: 이제 가 봐. 보여 줄 게 없으면 내 시간 낭비하지 마!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#050.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.src: ...But- ah. Since you are still here. Perhaps- no, no, don't be ridiculous, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.dst: ...하지만- 아. 아직도 여기 있으니. 어쩌면- 아니, 아니, 말도 안 돼, Kelight.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#053.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.src: Come on, Kelight, don't do this, you can't just let them get you with the silent treatment...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.dst: 왜 이래, Kelight, 이러지 마. 침묵 작전 따위에 넘어가면 안 되지...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#055.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.src: Oh, fine. You've got me interested. What is special about you? You look like a common soldier, and yet...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.dst: 아, 좋아. 흥미가 생겼어. 너한테 뭐가 특별한 거지? 평범한 병사로 보이는데, 그런데도...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#057.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.src: Very well. I will allow you to attempt the trial. Perhaps, then, you will be able to prove yourself.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.dst: 좋아. 시험에 도전하는 걸 허락하지. 그러면 자격을 증명할 수 있을지도 모르니까.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#058.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.src: Hidden deep within a nearby cave is a beast beyond compare. Corrupted, yes, but nothing like the foes you may have faced before.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.dst: 근처 동굴 깊숙이 비할 데 없는 짐승이 숨어 있어. 타락했지, 그래. 하지만 전에 만난 적들과는 차원이 달라.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#059.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.src: Rumor has it this creature was one of the miners which first ventured into the Nether Portal... Of course, as a Legend, I would usually disregard such things.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.dst: 소문에 따르면 그놈은 네더 포털에 처음 발을 들인 광부 중 하나였다더군... 물론 전설인 나는 보통 그런 건 무시하지만.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#060.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.src: In any case, its power cannot be underestimated. Simply entering its cave will greatly weaken you, even with the best equipment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.dst: 어쨌든 그 힘을 얕봐선 안 돼. 동굴에 들어가기만 해도 크게 약해지거든. 최고의 장비를 갖췄어도 말이야!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#061.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.src: Getting close to it would quickly corrupt you, which is why you will need protection. Only a light which is from the same realm from which the beast arrived will do the trick.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.dst: 가까이 가면 금세 타락해 버리니 보호 수단이 필요해. 그 짐승이 온 영역과 같은 곳에서 온 빛만이 효과가 있지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#062.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.src: As such, your very first step on your journey to become a Legend will be... to visit a friend of mine who studies the Nether.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.dst: 그러니 전설이 되는 여정의 첫걸음은... 네더를 연구하는 내 친구를 찾아가는 거야.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#063.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.src: His name is Jorkin, and he knows more about that realm than anyone else I know. Find him near the {p}, in {p}, and request his aid. Tell him I sent you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.dst: 이름은 Jorkin이고, 그 영역에 대해선 내가 아는 누구보다 잘 알아. {p} 근처, {p}에서 그를 찾아 도움을 청해. 내가 보냈다고 해.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#064.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.src: Talk to Jorkin in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] about Light Dust.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#065.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p}에 있는 Jorkin에게 Light Dust에 대해 물어보세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.src: Ah, hello soldier. What brings you to my humble abode today?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.dst: 아, 안녕하세요 병사님. 오늘은 무슨 일로 누추한 제 집에 오셨나요?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#066.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.src: Oh my. You...you want to attack HIM? Th-that horrid beast! Are you mad?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.dst: 세상에. 그...그놈을 공격하겠다고요? 그, 그 끔찍한 짐승을! 미쳤어요?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#067.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.src: Urgh, Kelight keeps sending adventurers like you to their deaths with his asinine tasks!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.dst: 으, Kelight는 멍청한 임무로 당신 같은 모험가들을 계속 죽으러 보내요!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#068.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.src: Fine. If you're really so determined to walk to your death, I can tell you where to go.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.dst: 좋아요. 정말 죽으러 가겠다고 굳게 마음먹었다면, 어디로 가야 할지 알려 드리죠.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#069.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.src: Down in the Roots, there is a cave full of the Light Dust you'll need.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.dst: Roots 아래에 필요한 Light Dust로 가득한 동굴이 있어요.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#070.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.src: Powerful corrupteds live in that cave, so be very careful retrieving it, and bring it back to me once you find it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.dst: 그 동굴엔 강력한 타락자들이 살아요. 가져올 때 조심하고, 찾으면 저한테 가져오세요.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#071.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.src: Find the lightdust cavern located near the Portal at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#072.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 포털 근처에 있는 Light Dust 동굴을 찾으세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.src: Retrieve [{~} Light Dust] from the cave at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring it back to Jorkin at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#073.dst: [{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}]의 동굴에서 [{~1} Light Dust]를 구해 [-{~5}, {~6}, -{~7}]의 Jorkin에게 가져가세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.src: You have the Light Dust, then? Hand it here, I want to see something.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.dst: Light Dust 가져왔나요? 이리 줘 봐요, 확인할 게 있어요.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#074.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.src: Ah, just as I thought. Even this light has been tainted by Corruption. Sorry, looks like you can't fight him, go home.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.dst: 아, 역시 그렇군요. 이 빛조차 타락에 오염됐어요. 미안하지만 그놈과는 못 싸우겠네요, 집에 가세요.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#075.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.src: ...urgh, there's no fooling you, is there? You really are committed to trying to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.dst: ...으, 당신은 못 속이겠군요? 정말 그놈과 싸우기로 작정했네요.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#077.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.src: Well, I wasn't lying when I said the Light Dust was corrupted, but there is a way to purify it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.dst: Light Dust가 타락했다는 건 거짓말이 아니었어요. 하지만 정화할 방법은 있어요.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#078.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.src: An old acquaintance of mine, Rayshyroth, has a method. He lives on {p}.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.dst: 제 오랜 지인 Rayshyroth가 방법을 알아요. {p}에 살죠.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#079.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.src: He knows even more about that...thing, than I do in my years of studying the Nether. Maybe he'll be able to talk you out of this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.dst: 그 사람은 그...존재에 대해 제가 몇 년간 네더를 연구한 것보다 더 많이 알아요. 어쩌면 당신을 말려 줄지도 모르죠.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#080.speaker: Jorkin

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.src: Visit Rayshyroth on {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to purify the dust
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#081.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p}에 있는 Rayshyroth를 찾아가 Light Dust를 정화하세요

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.src: Oh? Well, greetings. What brings you to our quiet lonely island, let alone all the way up here?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.dst: 오? 어서 오게. 이 조용하고 외딴 섬에, 그것도 이 높은 곳까지 무슨 일로 왔나?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#082.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.src: ...I see. Yes, the corruption of the blasted Nether Portal is rather potent. I'm not surprised this would need purification.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.dst: ...그렇군. 그래, 그 망할 네더 포털의 타락은 꽤 강력하지. 정화가 필요한 것도 놀랍지 않네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#083.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.src: Well, I can certainly do it, but I'll need the materials to do so. Shouldn't be anything you can't handle by now, right?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.dst: 물론 해 줄 수 있지만 재료가 필요하네. 지금의 자네라면 감당 못 할 일은 아닐 걸세, 그렇지?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#084.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.src: You see, below my house here, there is a wellspring from which a powerful magic flux generates.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.dst: 보게, 이 집 아래에는 강력한 마력의 흐름이 솟아나는 샘이 있네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#085.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.src: It creates a unique magic vapor if disrupted, which I can use to purify the dust for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.dst: 그걸 흐트러뜨리면 특별한 마법 증기가 생기는데, 그걸로 이 가루를 정화해 줄 수 있지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#086.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.src: I would say, given how badly corrupted this is, I will need at least [{~} Sky Vapor] for the task.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.dst: 이렇게 심하게 타락했으니, 적어도 [{~} Sky Vapor]는 있어야겠군.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#087.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#088.src: Find the cave on {p} where the Sky Flux gathers at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#089.src: Give [{~} Sky Vapor] to Rayshyroth at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.src: Aha, you're back with the Sky Vapor! Sorry about the climb, even I find it rather inconvenient at times.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.dst: 아하, Sky Vapor를 가져왔군! 오르막은 미안하네, 나도 가끔은 꽤 불편하거든.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#090.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.src: While I perform the ritual to purify this, I'd like to ask you something. Do you know, exactly, what it is you'll be fighting?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.dst: 정화 의식을 하는 동안 하나 묻고 싶네. 자네가 싸울 상대가 정확히 뭔지 알고 있나?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#091.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.src: Don't look so surprised, I know exactly what you need Light Dust for. The corruption warding helmet...to allow you to fight the Corrupter of Worlds.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.dst: 놀란 표정 짓지 말게, Light Dust가 왜 필요한지 다 아네. 타락을 막는 투구...세계의 타락자와 싸우기 위한 거지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#092.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.src: Yes, yes. I imagine that Kelight didn't bother telling you that was his title. I also surmise that you were given few details of how he came to be...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.dst: 그래, 그래. Kelight는 그게 그놈의 칭호라는 것도 말 안 해 줬겠지. 그놈이 어떻게 생겨났는지도 거의 못 들었을 테고...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#093.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.src: The beast now known as the Corrupter of Worlds used to be a simple mining captain, during the expeditions that uncovered the Nether Portal. He was the first to enter that wicked realm.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.dst: 지금 세계의 타락자라 불리는 짐승은, 네더 포털을 발견한 탐사 때 평범한 채굴 대장이었네. 그 사악한 영역에 처음 들어간 자였지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#094.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.src: The poor man was never heard from again...well, that is until the corrupted hordes began to pour from the Nether, with him leading the pack. A bit ironic, isn't it? Led the miners in life, the corrupteds in death.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.dst: 가엾은 자는 그 뒤로 소식이 끊겼네...타락한 무리가 네더에서 쏟아져 나오기 전까진 말이야. 그 선두에 그가 있었지. 좀 아이러니하지 않나? 살아선 광부를, 죽어선 타락자를 이끌다니.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#095.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.src: His mining crew there lasted hardly minutes. He personally slaughtered every single one of his original crew, and thousands more. The energies of the Nether have made him monstrously powerful.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.dst: 그곳에서 그의 채굴대는 몇 분도 못 버텼네. 원래 대원 전원을 제 손으로 학살했고, 그 뒤로도 수천 명을 더 죽였지. 네더의 기운이 그를 괴물처럼 강하게 만들었네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#096.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.src: ...although, the stories differ. Some say that Bak'al was the first to enter the portal, and the Corrupter of Worlds was simply a beast from the Nether. But the unclear truth doesn't change his strength.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.dst: ...다만 이야기는 제각각이네. 포털에 처음 들어간 건 Bak'al이고, 세계의 타락자는 그저 네더의 짐승이라는 말도 있지. 하지만 진실이 모호하다고 그의 힘이 달라지진 않네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#097.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.src: Just remember that no one, aside from that snooty Kelight, will think less of you should you choose not to fight him.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.dst: 그 거만한 Kelight 말고는, 자네가 싸우지 않기로 한다고 해서 자네를 낮게 볼 사람은 없다는 것만 기억하게.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#098.speaker: Rayshyroth

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.src: Show the [Purified Light Dust] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#099.dst: [Purified Light Dust]를 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 전설의 신전 입구에 있는 Kelight에게 보여 주세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.src: Hah. Took you long enough. This is the light dust, I presume?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.dst: 하. 꽤 오래 걸렸군. 이게 Light Dust겠지?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#100.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.src: I'll hold onto this for now. While it is a vital ingredient for your protection, it is not enough on its own.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.dst: 일단 내가 맡아 두지. 네 보호에 꼭 필요한 재료지만, 이것만으론 부족해.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#101.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.src: You'll need an item to focus the magic around yourself, preferably something you'd wear. Hm... How about a helmet? Certainly, it'd do wonders for your poor sense of style.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.dst: 네 주위로 마력을 모아 줄 물건이 필요해. 되도록 몸에 착용하는 것으로. 흠... 투구는 어때? 네 형편없는 패션 감각에도 큰 도움이 되겠지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#102.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.src: Ahem. As for creating it... I know only one man capable of crafting a piece of armor good enough to ensure your safety.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.dst: 에헴. 그걸 만드는 건... 네 안전을 보장할 만한 방어구를 만들 수 있는 사람은 딱 한 명 알아.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#103.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.src: Unfortunately, he will be hard to reach. His name was Garull, and he was the finest craftsman I'd ever met! A bit on the eccentric side, though.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.dst: 안타깝게도 만나기 어려울 거야. 이름은 Garull, 내가 만나 본 최고의 장인이었지! 좀 괴짜이긴 했지만.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#104.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.src: He was always ranting and raving about Creepers... he really thought they were real, can you imagine? What complete and utter nonsense.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.dst: 늘 크리퍼 얘기만 떠들어 댔어... 그게 진짜 있다고 믿었다니까, 상상이 가? 완전히 말도 안 되는 소리지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#105.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.src: When I suggested the notion to be absurd, he seemed upset by my comments, and stopped visiting. Truly, I did not know what I did wrong. What a ridiculous man.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.dst: 내가 터무니없는 생각이라고 하자 기분이 상했는지 더는 찾아오지 않았어. 정말이지 내가 뭘 잘못했는지 모르겠어. 참 이상한 사람이야.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#106.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.src: As it stands, I have no idea where you could find him. He spoke of wanting to research the Pigman Ravines several times, though none of our rank had ever seen him there.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.dst: 지금으로선 어디서 찾을 수 있을지 전혀 모르겠어. 피그맨 협곡을 연구하고 싶다고 몇 번 말했지만, 우리 중 누구도 거기서 그를 본 적은 없어.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#107.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.src: In any case, it is somewhere to begin your search! Should you manage to find him, and convince him to craft you the helmet, return here and we can proceed.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.dst: 어쨌든 찾기 시작할 곳은 되겠지! 그를 찾아서 투구를 만들어 달라고 설득하면, 여기로 돌아와. 그럼 진행하지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#108.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.src: Find Garull, the Creeper obsessed craftsman, somewhere in the {p} located around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#109.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] 부근의 {p} 어딘가에서 크리퍼에 집착하는 장인 Garull을 찾으세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.src: GWUH! Oh god, don't scare me like that! Who... Who even are you?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.dst: 으악! 세상에, 그렇게 놀라게 하지 말게! 대체... 대체 자넨 누군가?!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#110.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.src: Ah, you were sent from Kelight for a protection helmet? I can do that, sure, but there's a few complications.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.dst: 아, Kelight가 보호 투구 때문에 자넬 보냈다고? 물론 만들 수 있지만, 몇 가지 문제가 있네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#111.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.src: See, I usually use something called Touroto Hide to make my armor. It's extremely resilient, magic resistant and tough to break.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.dst: 보게, 난 보통 Touroto Hide라는 걸로 방어구를 만드네. 아주 질기고, 마법에 강하고, 잘 찢어지지 않지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#112.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.src: But, this also makes the Touroto themselves almost impossible to kill. Getting Touroto Hide is extremely difficult. I do know of a black market for it in {p}, but...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.dst: 하지만 그 때문에 Touroto 자체를 죽이기가 거의 불가능하네. Touroto Hide를 구하기가 무척 어렵지. {p}에 암시장이 있긴 하지만...
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#113.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.src: They only sell useless Old Touroto Hide, gotten from ones that died of old age. It's almost no better than just plain leather.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.dst: 거기선 늙어 죽은 놈에게서 얻은 쓸모없는 Old Touroto Hide만 파네. 평범한 가죽보다 나을 게 거의 없지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#114.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.src: So, for me to craft you this helmet, I'll need you to bring me not just the [Old Touroto Hide], but also the means to restore it to its previous power. Do listen up, there's a lot to tell you!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.dst: 그러니 이 투구를 만들려면 [Old Touroto Hide]뿐 아니라 원래의 힘을 되살릴 수단도 가져와야 하네. 잘 듣게, 할 말이 많으니!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#115.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.src: There's the [Aseado Leaf], grown someplace in the {p}... it has powerful medicinal qualities, supposedly able to reverse aging.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.dst: [Aseado Leaf]라는 게 있는데, {p} 어딘가에서 자란다네... 약효가 강력해서 노화를 되돌릴 수 있다고들 하지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#116.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.src: Then, a [Maro's Eye Jewel], which is an amazing magical focus from...well, where else, the {p}. Using its dust, I'll be able to return its magical resilience manually.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.dst: 그리고 [Maro의 눈 보석]. 아주 놀라운 마법 초점인데...어디서 났겠나, 당연히 {p}지. 그 가루로 마법 저항력을 직접 되살릴 수 있네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#117.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.src: Finally, I'll need a [Coral of Nelfors], which can be found in the {p}. This is what I need to use to enchant the hide to be magically resistant.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.dst: 마지막으로 [Coral of Nelfors]가 필요하네. {p}에서 찾을 수 있지. 가죽에 마법 저항을 부여하는 데 쓸 걸세.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#118.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.src: I wrote all that down in your content book. If you can get it all, come back to see me, but don't be so sneaky about coming up to me please!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.dst: 전부 자네 콘텐츠 북에 적어 뒀네. 다 구하면 다시 찾아오게. 하지만 제발 그렇게 몰래 다가오지는 말게!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#119.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.src: Bring the [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro's Eye Jewel], and [Coral of Nelfors] to Garull in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#120.dst: [Old Touroto Hide], [Aseado Leaf], [Maro의 눈 보석], [Coral of Nelfors]를 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴에 있는 Garull에게 가져가세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.src: Thank you for listening to me about not being so quiet coming over here. I'm guessing you've got everything?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.dst: 조용히 다가오지 말라는 부탁을 들어줘서 고맙네. 다 구해 온 것 같군?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#121.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.src: Alright, this should go quickly. For however pompous Kelight is, he's right in sending you to me to craft this.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.dst: 좋아, 금방 끝날 걸세. Kelight가 아무리 거만해도, 이걸 만들라고 자넬 내게 보낸 건 옳았네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#122.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.src: Now, I want to warn you about something. I've heard stories about the enemy you need this helmet to face, none of them good.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.dst: 자, 하나 경고하고 싶네. 이 투구를 쓰고 맞설 적에 대한 이야기를 들었는데, 좋은 얘기는 하나도 없었네.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#123.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.src: While I have seen people return from killing the "beast" he talks about, it isn't often. Be very careful, should you choose to fight it.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.dst: 그가 말하는 "짐승"을 죽이고 돌아온 사람을 보긴 했지만 흔치 않네. 싸우기로 한다면 정말 조심하게.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#124.speaker: Garull

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.src: Bring the [Helmet of the Legends] to Kelight at the entrance of the Temple of the Legends at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#125.dst: [Helmet of the Legends]를 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 전설의 신전 입구에 있는 Kelight에게 가져가세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.src: ...Hm? Oh, it's you again. Did you actually manage to find the blighter? Good to know he isn't dead, at least.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.dst: ...흠? 아, 또 너군. 정말 그 괴짜를 찾아냈어? 적어도 죽진 않았다니 다행이군.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#126.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.src: You have the helmet, I presume? Hand it over, here. I'll quickly apply the light dust. Then, you'll be able to enter the cave.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.dst: 투구를 가져왔겠지? 이리 줘. Light Dust를 얼른 입혀 주지. 그러면 동굴에 들어갈 수 있을 거야.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#127.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.src: Hopefully you'll do better than that last group that tried to fight him. Six fighters strong... never came back.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.dst: 지난번에 그놈과 싸우러 간 무리보단 잘하길 바라. 전사 여섯이었는데... 아무도 돌아오지 않았지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#128.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.src: ...Well, good luck! I'm certain you'll either succeed, or you'll fail spectacularly. Either or, really.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.dst: ...뭐, 행운을 빌어! 넌 성공하거나, 아주 화려하게 실패하겠지. 둘 중 하나야, 정말로.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#129.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.src: Bring me concrete proof of your triumph over the beast, and I will grant you passage into the Temple of the Legends! Do be quick, would you?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.dst: 짐승을 이겼다는 확실한 증거를 가져오면 전설의 신전에 들어가게 해 주지! 서둘러 줄래?
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#130.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.src: Kill the Corrupter of Worlds in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring proof of its death to Kelight at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#131.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴에서 세계의 타락자를 처치하고 죽음의 증거를 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Kelight에게 가져가세요.

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.src: Even one so brave and powerful as myself could not possibly survive against-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.dst: 나처럼 용감하고 강한 사람조차 도저히 살아남을 수 없는데-
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#133.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.src: Er... I mean, of course you were able to defeat the beast! I believed in you from the very start!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.dst: 어... 내 말은, 당연히 네가 그 짐승을 이길 줄 알았지! 처음부터 믿었다고!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#134.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.src: ...Ehm. I suppose you are welcome in the Temple of the Legends, now! You have... certainly proven yourself. My apologies for misjudging you. Feel proud of your accomplishment!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.dst: ...에헴. 이제 전설의 신전에 들어와도 좋아! 넌... 확실히 자격을 증명했어. 얕봐서 미안하군. 네 업적을 자랑스러워해!
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#135.speaker: Kelight

Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.src: Hm? What are these oddities you have with you? Curious, yet useless. Allow me to dispose of them for you.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.dst: 흠? 네가 가진 이 이상한 물건들은 뭐지? 신기하지만 쓸모없군. 내가 처리해 주지.
Temple of the Legends (Quest)#136.speaker: Kelight

Tempo Town Trouble#001.src: But... There's probably some kind of wacky magic keeping it shut, since I can't get it open at all!
Tempo Town Trouble#001.dst: 그런데... 아무리 해도 안 열리는 걸 보면 뭔가 괴상한 마법으로 잠겨 있나 봐!

Tempo Town Trouble#002.src: The monster you just killed was known as a Time Trouble. They're odd creatures that were forced into a day-long temporal loop by some fools long ago.
Tempo Town Trouble#002.dst: 자네가 방금 죽인 괴물은 시간 말썽꾼이라 불리네. 오래전 어떤 멍청이들이 하루짜리 시간 고리에 가둬 버린 기묘한 생물이지.

Tempo Town Trouble#003.src: Oh, he actually showed his face after you took care of the thing? What, did you beat him to the punch or something?
Tempo Town Trouble#003.dst: 아, 그걸 처리하고 나서야 그 사람이 나타났다고요? 뭐예요, 선수를 치신 거예요?

Tempo Town Trouble#004.src: Wait... What? He was...trying to seal the thing away, instead of killing it, and...you destroying it broke the seal?
Tempo Town Trouble#004.dst: 잠깐... 뭐라고요? 그 사람은... 죽이는 대신 봉인하려 했는데... 그걸 부수니까 봉인이 깨졌다고요?

Tempo Town Trouble#005.src: ...hm. Well, this is a bit awkward- I don't have a reward ready for you. Making this place took a lot of money... Hopefully gratitude is enough- thank you, sincerely!
Tempo Town Trouble#005.dst: ...흠. 그런데 좀 민망하네요- 드릴 보상이 없어요. 여길 만드느라 돈이 많이 들어서... 감사 인사로 충분하길 바라요- 진심으로 고마워요!

Tempo Town Trouble#007.src: Hey, excuse me! I'm in need of- ...yeah, just walk right by me. Maybe I shoulda gone to {p} for help, these people here have enough problems...
Tempo Town Trouble#007.dst: 저기, 실례합니다! 도움이 필요한데- ...그래, 그냥 지나가라. {p}에 도움을 청하러 갈 걸 그랬나, 여기 사람들도 문제가 한가득인데...
Tempo Town Trouble#007.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#008.src: Don't suppose you'd be willing to help, huh? Bet you're busy- Wait, you've got spare time? Criminy, only took a week of asking! Good to meet ya.
Tempo Town Trouble#008.dst: 도와줄 생각은 없겠지? 바쁘겠지- 잠깐, 시간 있다고? 세상에, 일주일 내내 부탁한 보람이 있네! 반가워.
Tempo Town Trouble#008.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#009.src: Alright, My name is Tyko, and I got asked to find a capable soldier for- well, lemme explain. So, I'm from a place called {p}, by {p}. It's a recent establishment.
Tempo Town Trouble#009.dst: 좋아, 난 Tyko고, 유능한 병사를 찾아 달라는 부탁을 받았어- 음, 설명할게. 난 {p}(이)라는 곳에서 왔는데, {p} 옆이야. 생긴 지 얼마 안 됐지.
Tempo Town Trouble#009.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#010.src: I'm buddies with the mayor- he set up {p} as kind of a homeless shelter for people whose homes got ruined by corrupted attacks, since {p} doesn't seem corrupted.
Tempo Town Trouble#010.dst: 촌장이랑 친구인데- 타락자 습격으로 집을 잃은 사람들을 위해 {p}을(를) 일종의 쉼터로 세웠어. {p}은(는) 타락 안 된 것 같았거든.
Tempo Town Trouble#010.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#011.src: Some old guy with jaundice or something swings by, some kind of keeper- Says to set up on a ridge overlooking a lake. So, we did! Everything was going well for a bit.
Tempo Town Trouble#011.dst: 황달인지 뭔지 걸린 노인이 들렀는데, 무슨 관리인이라나- 호수가 내려다보이는 능선에 자리 잡으래. 그래서 그랬지! 한동안은 다 순조로웠어.
Tempo Town Trouble#011.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#012.src: And then some freaky time monster starts showing up in the middle of the night and tries to bust down our doors! We were told that ridge was safe, but that was clearly a lie.
Tempo Town Trouble#012.dst: 그런데 웬 괴상한 시간 괴물이 한밤중에 나타나서 문을 부수려는 거야! 그 능선이 안전하다고 들었는데, 새빨간 거짓말이었지.
Tempo Town Trouble#012.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#013.src: So, that's why I'm here. No one at {p} is tough enough to kill that thing, so I ran over here to ask for some backup. Glad I ran into ya!
Tempo Town Trouble#013.dst: 그래서 여기 온 거야. {p}엔 그놈을 죽일 만큼 센 사람이 없어서 지원을 구하러 달려왔지. 만나서 다행이다!
Tempo Town Trouble#013.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#014.src: Lemme write down the coordinates for ya in your book. I'm gonna stick around and see if anyone else feels like helping.
Tempo Town Trouble#014.dst: 네 책에 좌표 적어 줄게. 난 좀 더 남아서 도와줄 사람이 또 있는지 볼 거야.
Tempo Town Trouble#014.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#015.src: The coordinates to where you need to go should be in your book. Help us out, yeah?
Tempo Town Trouble#015.dst: 가야 할 곳 좌표는 네 책에 있을 거야. 좀 도와줘, 응?
Tempo Town Trouble#015.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#017.src: Hello- Welcome to {p}, friend! Established only two months ago, I'm proud to provide aid to those displaced by corrupted raids.
Tempo Town Trouble#017.dst: 안녕하세요- {p}에 오신 걸 환영해요, 친구! 두 달 전에 세워졌는데, 타락자 습격으로 터전을 잃은 분들을 돕고 있어서 자랑스러워요.
Tempo Town Trouble#017.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#018.src: Come to think of it, you look like a {p} representative... Can I bother you to deliver some paperwork to the castle about getting officially established here?
Tempo Town Trouble#018.dst: 그러고 보니 {p} 대표처럼 보이시네요... 여기 정식 설립에 관한 서류를 성에 전해 주실 수 있을까요?
Tempo Town Trouble#018.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#019.src: ...Repeat that? ...OH! Oh, no wonder you- Agh, my mind's all over the place from stress, I'm so relieved he found help finally!
Tempo Town Trouble#019.dst: ...다시 말씀해 주시겠어요? ...아! 아, 그래서- 아이고, 스트레스로 정신이 없네요. 드디어 도와줄 분을 찾았다니 정말 다행이에요!
Tempo Town Trouble#019.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#020.src: Alright, Tyko told you about the monster, right? We were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there weren't any dangerous creatures here!
Tempo Town Trouble#020.dst: 좋아요, Tyko가 괴물 얘기는 했죠? Martyn이라는 노인이 여긴 위험한 생물이 없다고 이 능선에 자리 잡으라고 했거든요!
Tempo Town Trouble#020.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#021.src: Oh, not that kind of soldier? That's too bad... But- oh, this is a shot in the dark, but... maybe you'd be the type of soldier to take out a monster for us?
Tempo Town Trouble#021.dst: 아, 그런 병사는 아니라고요? 아쉽네요... 하지만- 아, 밑져야 본전인데... 혹시 저희 대신 괴물을 처치해 주실 수 있는 병사인가요?
Tempo Town Trouble#021.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#022.src: You- you would!? Oh, thank goodness you arrived when you did! You see- we were told by that old man Martyn to settle on this ridge because there apparently weren't any dangerous creatures here!
Tempo Town Trouble#022.dst: 해, 해 주신다고요!? 아, 마침 딱 와 주셔서 정말 다행이에요! 그게요- Martyn이라는 노인이 여긴 위험한 생물이 없다며 이 능선에 자리 잡으라고 했거든요!
Tempo Town Trouble#022.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#023.src: But every night, the same monster emerges from one of the ruins, and tries to smash the buildings down! Every single night, at the same time!
Tempo Town Trouble#023.dst: 그런데 매일 밤 같은 괴물이 유적에서 나와 건물을 부수려고 해요! 매일 밤, 똑같은 시간에요!
Tempo Town Trouble#023.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#024.src: The guards are getting run ragged, and I refuse to be responsible for any deaths when I'm trying to save these folks!
Tempo Town Trouble#024.dst: 경비병들은 녹초가 됐고, 이 사람들을 구하려는 제가 누군가의 죽음에 책임질 순 없어요!
Tempo Town Trouble#024.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#025.src: We found the ruin it came out of, too- Er, one of the folks here, Doug, did! Here, let me write down the location for you- no, no, I insist, let me do it!
Tempo Town Trouble#025.dst: 괴물이 나온 유적도 찾았어요- 어, 여기 사는 Doug가요! 자, 위치를 적어 드릴게요- 아뇨, 아뇨, 제가 할게요!
Tempo Town Trouble#025.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#026.src: There's the coordinates in case you forget, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#026.dst: 잊으실까 봐 좌표를 드렸지만, 바로 언덕 위 신전 안이에요! 제발, 제발 서둘러서 그 끔찍한 괴물을 처리해 주세요!
Tempo Town Trouble#026.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#027.src: The coordinates are in your book, but it's in the temple just up the hill! Please, please hurry and take care of that horrible monster!
Tempo Town Trouble#027.dst: 좌표는 책에 있지만, 바로 언덕 위 신전 안이에요! 제발, 제발 서둘러서 그 끔찍한 괴물을 처리해 주세요!
Tempo Town Trouble#027.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#029.src: Grr... I KNOW I saw that beast go in here, where the heck is it?!
Tempo Town Trouble#029.dst: 크윽... 그 짐승이 여기 들어가는 걸 분명히 봤는데, 대체 어디 간 거야?!
Tempo Town Trouble#029.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#030.src: Hey soldier, does that disk look like some type of door to you?
Tempo Town Trouble#030.dst: 어이 병사, 저 원반 무슨 문처럼 보이지 않아?
Tempo Town Trouble#030.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#031.src: I saw some creature that I've been tracking for a few days disappear around here, and I think it's somewhere behind this disk...
Tempo Town Trouble#031.dst: 며칠째 쫓던 생물이 이 근처에서 사라졌는데, 이 원반 뒤 어딘가에 있는 것 같아...
Tempo Town Trouble#031.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#032.src: There's probably some kind of wacky magic keeping it shut, since I can't get it open at all!
Tempo Town Trouble#032.dst: 아무리 해도 안 열리는 걸 보면 뭔가 괴상한 마법으로 잠겨 있나 봐!
Tempo Town Trouble#032.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#033.src: Hey, you're able to use magic, right? Maybe using one of your fancy spells on the disk will get it open?
Tempo Town Trouble#033.dst: 야, 너 마법 쓸 줄 알지? 그 멋진 주문 하나 원반에 쓰면 열릴지도?
Tempo Town Trouble#033.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#034.src: Stand on the disk and cast any spell. That should probably get it open, then we can finally kill that freak of nature lurking inside of there!
Tempo Town Trouble#034.dst: 원반 위에 서서 아무 주문이나 써 봐. 그럼 열릴 거야. 그러면 드디어 안에 숨은 그 괴물을 잡을 수 있어!
Tempo Town Trouble#034.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#035.src: Let's see... What kind of secrets do these odd temples house?
Tempo Town Trouble#035.dst: 어디 보자... 이 이상한 신전들엔 어떤 비밀이 있을까?
Tempo Town Trouble#035.speaker: Scout

Tempo Town Trouble#036.src: Use spells to break open the temple at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Tempo Town Trouble#037.src: What was going through your noggin, {u}?
Tempo Town Trouble#037.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#038.src: Do you have any idea what you were doing? Bashing around that room I just sealed off for good?
Tempo Town Trouble#038.dst: 자네가 뭘 했는지 알기나 하나? 내가 막 영영 봉인한 방에서 난리를 치다니?
Tempo Town Trouble#038.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#039.src: You need to be careful, soldier! This Valley's secrets are NOT to be meddled with.
Tempo Town Trouble#039.dst: 조심해야 하네, 병사! 이 계곡의 비밀은 함부로 건드리는 게 아니야.
Tempo Town Trouble#039.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#040.src: I assume the mayor of that place called {p} sent you here. You are going to have to tell that lad that his problems just got worse.
Tempo Town Trouble#040.dst: {p}(이)라는 곳의 촌장이 자넬 보냈겠지. 그 친구한테 문제가 더 커졌다고 전해야 할 걸세.
Tempo Town Trouble#040.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#041.src: The monster you killed was known as a Time Trouble. They're odd creatures that were forced into a day-long temporal loop by some fools long ago.
Tempo Town Trouble#041.dst: 자네가 죽인 괴물은 시간 말썽꾼이라 불리네. 오래전 어떤 멍청이들이 하루짜리 시간 고리에 가둬 버린 기묘한 생물이지.
Tempo Town Trouble#041.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#042.src: The only way to keep them at bay effectively is to seal them, like I just did here. But now, that stunt you just pulled sent ripples across the entire Valley. Now, every single Time Trouble is responding to this one's termination!
Tempo Town Trouble#042.dst: 놈들을 제대로 막는 유일한 방법은 방금 내가 한 것처럼 봉인하는 거네. 그런데 자네가 벌인 짓이 계곡 전체에 파문을 일으켰어. 이제 모든 시간 말썽꾼이 이놈의 죽음에 반응하고 있네!
Tempo Town Trouble#042.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#043.src: Now, one Time Trouble I can handle, but this? I can't keep them all at bay... and now, you went and awakened every single one of those critters.
Tempo Town Trouble#043.dst: 시간 말썽꾼 하나라면 감당하지만, 이건? 전부 막을 순 없네... 그런데 자네가 그놈들을 하나도 빠짐없이 깨워 버렸지.
Tempo Town Trouble#043.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#044.src: I can fix this seal, so you'll have one less to deal with, but the rest of the Troubles will have to be taken down daily with brute force.
Tempo Town Trouble#044.dst: 이 봉인은 고칠 수 있으니 상대할 놈은 하나 줄겠지만, 나머지 말썽꾼들은 매일 힘으로 쓰러뜨려야 하네.
Tempo Town Trouble#044.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#045.src: You're going to have to deal with those, soldier. I have far too much to take care of in this valley.
Tempo Town Trouble#045.dst: 그놈들은 자네가 처리해야 하네, 병사. 난 이 계곡에서 돌볼 일이 너무 많아.
Tempo Town Trouble#045.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#046.src: They'll have to be exterminated every single day. Now, I'm sure the work won't be thankless, perhaps you'll be rewarded by the townsfolk of {p} for taking care of them.
Tempo Town Trouble#046.dst: 놈들은 매일 섬멸해야 하네. 그래도 헛수고는 아닐 걸세. 놈들을 처리해 주면 {p} 주민들이 보상해 줄지도 모르지.
Tempo Town Trouble#046.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#047.src: Now please, be careful in the Valley. I already have to look after one person, nevermind the mess of time that the Olm were so-
Tempo Town Trouble#047.dst: 그러니 부디 계곡에선 조심하게. 이미 돌봐야 할 사람이 하나 있는데다, Olm이 저질러 놓은 시간의 난장판은 말할 것도-
Tempo Town Trouble#047.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#048.src: ...I digress, I'm just rambling again. Now, let me bring us back outside this temple, and you should head back to that shanty town.
Tempo Town Trouble#048.dst: ...이야기가 샜군, 또 횡설수설했어. 자, 신전 밖으로 데려다줄 테니 자넨 그 판자촌으로 돌아가게.
Tempo Town Trouble#048.speaker: Old Man Martyn

Tempo Town Trouble#049.src: Report back to the mayor in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Tempo Town Trouble#050.src: You're back! I heard some kind of weird chime coming from the temple on the hill- is that a good sign?
Tempo Town Trouble#050.dst: 돌아오셨군요! 언덕 위 신전에서 이상한 종소리가 들렸는데- 좋은 징조인가요?
Tempo Town Trouble#050.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#051.src: You did?! Oh, thank goodness... Honestly, Martyn told us he would deal with it, but then he just disappeared off into nowhere!
Tempo Town Trouble#051.dst: 해내셨다고요?! 아, 다행이다... 솔직히 Martyn이 자기가 처리하겠다더니, 그대로 어디론가 사라져 버렸거든요!
Tempo Town Trouble#051.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#052.src: Oh, he actually showed his face after you took care of that thing? What, did you beat him to the punch or something?
Tempo Town Trouble#052.dst: 아, 괴물을 처리하고 나서야 그 사람이 나타났다고요? 뭐예요, 선수를 치신 거예요?
Tempo Town Trouble#052.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#053.src: Wait... What? He was... trying to seal the thing away, instead of killing it, and... you destroying it broke the seal?
Tempo Town Trouble#053.dst: 잠깐... 뭐라고요? 그 사람은... 죽이는 대신 봉인하려 했는데, 그걸 부수니까 봉인이 깨졌다고요?
Tempo Town Trouble#053.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#054.src: And now there's more of them? Why didn't he just tell us?! Now they'll need to be stopped every day to keep them in check!!
Tempo Town Trouble#054.dst: 그래서 이제 더 많아졌다고요? 왜 미리 말 안 해 준 거예요?! 이제 매일 막아야 억누를 수 있잖아요!!
Tempo Town Trouble#054.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#055.src: Gah, this is a disaster... It isn't your fault, you didn't know- Wait, what's that boxy thing you have? A [Time Fragment]? ...oh, so the monster dropped it.
Tempo Town Trouble#055.dst: 아, 큰일이네... 당신 잘못은 아니에요, 몰랐으니까- 잠깐, 그 네모난 건 뭐예요? [Time Fragment]? ...아, 괴물이 떨어뜨렸군요.
Tempo Town Trouble#055.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#056.src: Interesting... One of the townsfolk likes to collect those sorts of things! He's that Mysterious Merchant just behind me.
Tempo Town Trouble#056.dst: 흥미롭네요... 마을 사람 중에 그런 걸 모으는 사람이 있어요! 제 바로 뒤에 있는 수수께끼의 상인이에요.
Tempo Town Trouble#056.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#057.src: Go talk with him about those! He might give you something worth your while if you trade them with him.
Tempo Town Trouble#057.dst: 가서 그걸로 얘기해 보세요! 교환하면 쓸 만한 걸 줄지도 몰라요.
Tempo Town Trouble#057.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#058.src: ...also, while you were away, that strange magic stone up on the hill started glowing. We're not sure what to do with it, really! Might be worth your attention.
Tempo Town Trouble#058.dst: ...그리고 안 계신 동안 언덕 위의 이상한 마법석이 빛나기 시작했어요. 어떻게 해야 할지 정말 모르겠어요! 한번 살펴볼 만할지도요.
Tempo Town Trouble#058.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#059.src: ...though, this is a bit awkward- I don't have a reward ready for you. Making this place took a lot of money... Hopefully gratitude is enough- thank you, sincerely!
Tempo Town Trouble#059.dst: ...그런데 좀 민망하네요- 드릴 보상이 없어요. 여길 만드느라 돈이 많이 들어서... 감사 인사로 충분하길 바라요- 진심으로 고마워요!
Tempo Town Trouble#059.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#060.src: Heya! Heard from the mayor that you helped out the town! Can't thank you enough for that.
Tempo Town Trouble#060.dst: 안녕! 촌장한테 들었는데 마을을 도와줬다며! 정말 고마워.
Tempo Town Trouble#060.speaker: Tyko

Tempo Town Trouble#061.src: Oh hey, it's you! I hope you've been keeping those Time Troubles at bay.
Tempo Town Trouble#061.dst: 아, 당신이군요! 그 시간 말썽꾼들을 잘 막고 계시길 바라요.
Tempo Town Trouble#061.speaker: Homeless Mayor

Tempo Town Trouble#062.src: Oh, hey! I hope that monster wasn't too difficult for you to defeat.
Tempo Town Trouble#062.dst: 오, 안녕! 그 괴물 쓰러뜨리는 게 너무 힘들진 않았길 바라.
Tempo Town Trouble#062.speaker: Scout

The Bigger Picture#000.src: Talk to Psilo in the mushroom cave.
The Bigger Picture#000.dst: 버섯 동굴에 있는 Psilo에게 말을 거세요.

The Bigger Picture#001.src: Welcome, large human! What's that look for, never seen a Gnome before?! My house may look small, but it's perfect for me!
The Bigger Picture#001.dst: 어서 와요, 커다란 인간! 그 표정은 뭐예요, 노움은 처음 봐요?! 우리 집이 작아 보여도 저한텐 딱 맞아요!
The Bigger Picture#001.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#002.src: I actually need some help, you see Razorice plague my home! They are similar to the rats of your province, but vicious and deadly to Gnomes!
The Bigger Picture#002.dst: 사실 도움이 필요해요. Razorice가 우리 집을 들쑤시고 있거든요! 당신네 지방의 쥐 같은 녀석들인데, 사납고 노움에겐 치명적이에요!
The Bigger Picture#002.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#003.src: An easy fix exists for it though. There are many magical mushrooms in this cave and a rare one called Subtraxerim Utilium is the one we need.
The Bigger Picture#003.dst: 그래도 쉬운 해결책이 있어요. 이 동굴엔 마법 버섯이 많은데, 그중 희귀한 Subtraxerim Utilium이 필요해요.
The Bigger Picture#003.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#004.src: It emits a sleeping spore that will knock the Razorice out long enough to kill them! I've seen one in the cave but every time I go to get it, I fall asleep!
The Bigger Picture#004.dst: 잠드는 포자를 뿜어서 Razorice를 한참 기절시키니까 그 틈에 해치울 수 있죠! 동굴에서 하나 봤는데, 가지러 갈 때마다 제가 잠들어 버려요!
The Bigger Picture#004.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#005.src: I left a trail of spores from the location. Since you're so big, you won't fall asleep! Please retrieve some mushroom for me.
The Bigger Picture#005.dst: 그 자리부터 포자 흔적을 남겨 뒀어요. 당신은 덩치가 크니 잠들지 않을 거예요! 버섯 좀 가져다주세요.
The Bigger Picture#005.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#006.src: I think I left a trail of rainbow spores last time I tried to collect some, just follow the colours through the cave to find the mushroom!
The Bigger Picture#006.dst: 지난번에 따러 갔을 때 무지개색 포자 흔적을 남긴 것 같아요. 동굴에서 그 색을 따라가면 버섯이 나올 거예요!
The Bigger Picture#006.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#007.src: Find the Subtraxerim Utilium mushroom in the cave and bring it back to Psilo.
The Bigger Picture#007.dst: 동굴에서 Subtraxerim Utilium 버섯을 찾아 Psilo에게 가져가세요.

The Bigger Picture#009.src: Did you find any? Wait, something is different about you. Have you gotten smaller? Oh my...
The Bigger Picture#009.dst: 찾았어요? 잠깐, 뭔가 달라졌는데요. 작아졌나요? 세상에...
The Bigger Picture#009.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#011.src: I’m really sorry about this, I didn't think the mushroom would have a different effect on humans! But what did I expect from a mushroom that changes colour?!
The Bigger Picture#011.dst: 정말 미안해요, 버섯이 인간한테는 다르게 작용할 줄 몰랐어요! 하긴 색이 바뀌는 버섯한테 뭘 기대했겠어요?!
The Bigger Picture#011.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#012.src: Do not panic. I have a mushroom in my house that wakes people up; logic says that if the sleeping mushroom shrinks you, then this one should make you grow again!
The Bigger Picture#012.dst: 당황하지 마세요. 우리 집에 잠을 깨우는 버섯이 있어요. 잠드는 버섯이 몸을 줄였으니, 논리적으로 그건 다시 키워 줄 거예요!
The Bigger Picture#012.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#013.src: Oh my, you are still shrinking before my eyes. You must hurry to the mushroom. Be careful, though! The Razorice will probably hunt you!
The Bigger Picture#013.dst: 세상에, 눈앞에서 계속 줄어들고 있어요. 어서 그 버섯으로 가요. 그래도 조심해요! Razorice가 당신을 노릴 거예요!
The Bigger Picture#013.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#014.src: I keep it on the top shelf, so you will probably have to fight them at some point... If you kill them while you^re there, we can kill two birds with one stone! Just follow the cheese crumbs to find them!
The Bigger Picture#014.dst: 버섯은 맨 위 선반에 있으니 어차피 녀석들과 싸우게 될 거예요... 가는 김에 해치우면 일석이조죠! 치즈 부스러기를 따라가면 녀석들이 있어요!
The Bigger Picture#014.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#015.src: Good luck! Oh and, do watch out for my pet zombie.
The Bigger Picture#015.dst: 행운을 빌어요! 아, 그리고 제 애완 좀비 조심하세요.
The Bigger Picture#015.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#016.src: Find the mushroom in Psilo's house.

The Bigger Picture#017.src: Get to the mouse nest by following the cheese trail and get rid of the pest.
The Bigger Picture#017.dst: 치즈 흔적을 따라 쥐 둥지로 가서 해충을 없애세요.

The Bigger Picture#018.src: Get to the blue mushroom and return to normal size.
The Bigger Picture#018.dst: 파란 버섯에 닿아 원래 크기로 돌아오세요.

The Bigger Picture#019.src: Give Psilo the good news about the mice.
The Bigger Picture#019.dst: Psilo에게 쥐를 해치웠다는 좋은 소식을 전하세요.

The Bigger Picture#020.src: What the... my house! What did you do?!
The Bigger Picture#020.dst: 이게 무슨... 우리 집! 뭘 한 거예요?!
The Bigger Picture#020.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#021.src: Springy plant? Bookshelf levers? Razorice king?! Hold on a moment, slow down and tell me properly.
The Bigger Picture#021.dst: 통통 튀는 식물? 책장 레버? Razorice 왕?! 잠깐만요, 천천히 제대로 말해 봐요.
The Bigger Picture#021.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#022.src: I see. Well, at least you handled those damned Razorice, and I can actually live in my house again - not that it'll offer much shelter now you've blown a hole in the side of it!
The Bigger Picture#022.dst: 그렇군요. 뭐, 적어도 그 망할 Razorice는 처리했으니 다시 집에서 살 수 있겠네요. 옆에 구멍을 뚫어 놔서 비바람은 제대로 못 막겠지만요!
The Bigger Picture#022.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#023.src: Ah, I suppose that's alright. The mushroom will grow back over to cover it - and righto, your reward!
The Bigger Picture#023.dst: 아, 그래도 괜찮아요. 버섯이 다시 자라서 덮을 테니까요. 자, 보상이에요!
The Bigger Picture#023.speaker: Psilo

The Bigger Picture#024.src: Here, take some of our Gnome gold, we have plenty to go around. And sorry about the whole you-getting-shrunk thing, but hey, being small isn't so bad! See you around, human!
The Bigger Picture#024.dst: 여기, 우리 노움 금화 좀 가져가요, 넉넉하거든요. 몸이 줄어든 건 미안해요. 그래도 작은 것도 나쁘지 않죠! 또 봐요, 인간!
The Bigger Picture#024.speaker: Psilo

The Breaking Point#000.src: Hey, keep up! We need to get this part into the machine as quickly as we can!
The Breaking Point#000.dst: 이봐, 따라와! 이 부품을 최대한 빨리 기계에 넣어야 해!

The Breaking Point#001.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to Kandon Beda with that capacitor as quick as possible.

The Breaking Point#009.src: Hmph. And who exactly are you? This site is off-limits to civilians.
The Breaking Point#009.dst: 흠. 그런데 넌 누구지? 여긴 민간인 출입 금지 구역이다.

The Breaking Point#010.src: Adventurer. Of course. Well, as it stands, we're doing rather dangerous work here. I'll have to ask you to-
The Breaking Point#010.dst: 모험가라. 그렇겠지. 보다시피 여기선 꽤 위험한 일을 하고 있다. 그러니 부탁인데-

The Breaking Point#015.dst: 으윽... 병사들, 수칙대로 해! 챙길 수 있는 건 챙기고 못 챙기는 건 버려! 그리고- 너! 널 잊은 건 아니다. 이게 수습되는 대로-

The Breaking Point#021.dst: 제가 고칠- 아뇨, 당연히 못 고치죠! 저 혼자선 무리예요, 여긴 제대로 된 장비도 없다고요! 으, 지난번 이후로 얼마나 지났죠?

The Breaking Point#028.src: ... Sorry. I'm sorry, I didn't mean that. General, to answer your question... The stabilizer itself is damaged, but you should have what's needed to repair it here.
The Breaking Point#028.dst: ... 미안. 미안해, 그런 뜻이 아니었어. 장군님, 질문에 답하자면... 안정 장치 자체가 손상됐지만, 수리에 필요한 건 여기 다 있을 거예요.

The Breaking Point#029.src: The issue is that the controls look like they're fried! And we don't have any replacement parts stored here. We'll have to travel back to Corkus, and...
The Breaking Point#029.dst: 문제는 제어 장치가 타 버린 것 같다는 거예요! 여긴 교체 부품도 없고요. Corkus까지 다녀와야 하는데...

The Breaking Point#030.dst: ... 좋다. 너. 모험가라고 했지? 장비도 제법 갖춘 것 같군. 그럼 Rhay와 함께 Corkus로 가서 필요한 일을 돕도록.

The Breaking Point#032.dst: 잠깐만요, 장군님-... 네. 알겠어요. 그렇다면... 준비할 시간을 줄게. 열기구를 타고 Corkus로 갈 거니까 거기서 만나. 낭비할 시간이 없어.

The Breaking Point#033.src: And I will... return to the library. I trust... you will succeed... But we must... prepare for the... worst.

The Breaking Point#046.src: Yes, exactly. It's been malfunctioning for a long time now, and it's starting to tear the canyon apart. That's where we come in.

The Breaking Point#047.src: Well... To start with, it's an ancient thing. It was built long before even the doguns can remember, and they've lived in this region for thousands of years.

The Breaking Point#047.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#048.src: According to Ineos, the doguns used to be responsible for keeping it calm, but ever since the dwarves came in and started their war, that knowledge has been lost to time.
The Breaking Point#048.dst: Ineos 말로는 원래 Dogun이 저걸 진정시키는 역할을 했는데, 드워프가 들어와 전쟁을 벌인 뒤로 그 지식이 잊혀 버렸대.
The Breaking Point#048.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#049.src: Which is... a problem! {p} has been malfunctioning for hundreds of years, and it's reaching its breaking point. If we don't stop it, it'll tear the canyon apart.
The Breaking Point#049.dst: 그게... 문제야! {p}은(는) 수백 년째 고장 난 채로 한계점에 다다르고 있어. 막지 못하면 협곡이 찢어질 거야.
The Breaking Point#049.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#050.src: Oh? So you've traveled the canyon, then. Yeah, then you've seen how the canyon twists and changes.
The Breaking Point#050.dst: 오? 그럼 협곡을 돌아다녀 봤구나. 그래, 그럼 협곡이 뒤틀리고 변하는 걸 봤겠네.
The Breaking Point#050.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#051.src: It destroys peoples' homes, it traps them deep within the maze-like valleys... And, more recently, it has been tearing a hole into the void.
The Breaking Point#051.dst: 사람들 집을 부수고, 미로 같은 골짜기 깊숙이 가둬 버리지... 게다가 최근엔 공허에 구멍까지 뚫고 있어.
The Breaking Point#051.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#052.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try to keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#052.dst: 이건 아주 오래된 물건이고, 어떻게 작동하는지도 몰라. 우리가 할 수 있는 건 이게 한계점에 이르지 않게 막아서, 협곡이 {p}와(과) 같은 운명을 맞지 않게 하는 것뿐이야.
The Breaking Point#052.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#053.src: This thing is ancient, and we don't know how it works. The best we can do is try and keep it from reaching its breaking point, and prevent the canyon from meeting the same fate as the {p}.
The Breaking Point#053.dst: 이건 아주 오래된 물건이고, 어떻게 작동하는지도 몰라. 우리가 할 수 있는 건 이게 한계점에 이르지 않게 막아서, 협곡이 {p}와(과) 같은 운명을 맞지 않게 하는 것뿐이야.
The Breaking Point#053.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#054.src: So, Gavel's government contacted us in Corkus some time ago, requesting our help to deal with this threat.
The Breaking Point#054.dst: 그래서 얼마 전 Gavel 정부가 Corkus에 있는 우리에게 연락해서 이 위협에 대처할 도움을 요청했어.
The Breaking Point#054.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#055.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified that Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#055.dst: 의회도 동의했고, 우리는 오래전 거상을 잠재웠던 Dogun 마법을 재현할 기계를 설계하기 시작했지.
The Breaking Point#055.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#056.src: Our council agreed, and we got to work designing a machine that could replicate the dogun magic that pacified the Colossus long ago.
The Breaking Point#056.dst: 의회도 동의했고, 우리는 오래전 거상을 잠재웠던 Dogun 마법을 재현할 기계를 설계하기 시작했지.
The Breaking Point#056.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#057.src: We've had Ineos' help on that front. He and I have been working here in {p} to ensure things are running smoothly. Which... evidently, they are not.
The Breaking Point#057.dst: 그 일엔 Ineos가 도와줬어. 그와 난 {p}에서 모든 게 잘 돌아가도록 일해 왔지. 근데... 보다시피 전혀 아니네.
The Breaking Point#057.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#058.src: ... We'll be fine! We're going to meet up with my husband at Corkus, and he'll know what to do. He always does.
The Breaking Point#058.dst: ... 괜찮을 거야! Corkus에서 남편을 만날 건데, 그 사람은 어떻게 할지 알 거야. 늘 그랬거든.
The Breaking Point#058.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#059.src: Our people there will be able to get us the parts we need to repair the device. This... this isn't the first it's exploded. I had hoped that this time we would have gotten it stable, but...
The Breaking Point#059.dst: 거기 사람들이 장치 수리에 필요한 부품을 구해 줄 거야. 이게... 폭발한 게 처음은 아니야. 이번엔 안정시킬 수 있길 바랐는데...

The Breaking Point#060.dst: 하지만, 뭐! 통제는 하고 있어. 거상이 활동하는 동안에도 늘 금방 고쳐서 계속 돌아가게 했거든.

The Breaking Point#061.src: Oh! Yeah. He's the one responsible for the design and production of this device. He's got a talent for designing these sorts of things, without him... well, we'd be in a much worse situation than we are now.
The Breaking Point#061.dst: 아! 응. 이 장치를 설계하고 만든 게 그 사람이야. 이런 걸 설계하는 데 재능이 있거든. 그 사람이 없었으면... 지금보다 훨씬 나쁜 상황이었을 거야.
The Breaking Point#061.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#062.src: I'll be glad to see him again. It's been a while since I last had to travel to Corkus, and... Well, I'm confident he'll know what to do here. He always does.
The Breaking Point#062.dst: 다시 만나면 반가울 거야. Corkus에 가 본 지도 꽤 됐고... 뭐, 그 사람은 어떻게 할지 알 거라고 믿어. 늘 그랬거든.

The Breaking Point#063.src: ... Right! Hey, it looks like we're almost there. We'll be able to get this all sorted out, and we'll be back to {p} in no time.
The Breaking Point#063.dst: ... 그래! 이봐, 거의 다 온 것 같아. 이 일을 전부 해결하고 금방 {p}(으)로 돌아갈 수 있을 거야.
The Breaking Point#063.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#065.dst: 좋아, 그냥 들어가자. 남편이 이 근처 어딘가에 있을 텐데...

The Breaking Point#067.src: I... You two know each other?

The Breaking Point#069.src: They just showed up at {p} and agreed to help us with... - Why didn't you bring this up earlier?
The Breaking Point#069.dst: {p}에 불쑥 나타나서 우리를 돕겠다고... 왜 이 얘기를 미리 안 했어?
The Breaking Point#069.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#070.src: It must have...- right. Well, if anything that makes you even more qualified to help us out, I guess! I can't believe I didn't recognize you...?
The Breaking Point#070.dst: 분명...- 그렇지. 뭐, 그렇다면 우릴 도울 자격이 더 충분하다는 거겠지! 내가 널 못 알아봤다니...?
The Breaking Point#070.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#071.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maitenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#071.dst: 좋아, 그래, 다시 질문으로 - 너희 둘 벌써 여기서 뭐 해? 다음 정기 점검까지 며칠 더 남지 않았어?
The Breaking Point#071.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#072.src: Okay, right, back to the question - what are you two doing here already? There's another few days or so until our next routine maintenance, isn't there?
The Breaking Point#072.dst: 좋아, 그래, 다시 질문으로 - 너희 둘 벌써 여기서 뭐 해? 다음 정기 점검까지 며칠 더 남지 않았어?
The Breaking Point#072.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#073.src: I did send you an invite! I gave it to... you know, that that one captain who ferries people around! But then you didn't show up to the wedding, so I guess it didn't reach you...
The Breaking Point#073.dst: 초대장 보냈다니까! 그... 사람들 태워 나르는 그 선장한테 맡겼어! 근데 결혼식에 안 왔으니 못 받았나 봐...
The Breaking Point#073.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#074.src: Look, you're a hard person to reach! You've been all over the world at this point, including {p} of all places- speaking of, why are you two here?
The Breaking Point#074.dst: 봐, 너 연락하기 진짜 힘들어! 이미 온 세상을 다 돌아다녔잖아, 하필 {p}까지- 그나저나 둘은 왜 여기 온 거야?
The Breaking Point#074.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#076.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an undetected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#076.dst: 맞아! 맞아. 잠깐 딴생각을 했네... 어, {p}에서 문제가 생겼어. 감지 못한 지진이 일어나서 장치가 크게 망가졌어.
The Breaking Point#076.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#077.src: Right! Right. Got a little distracted there... Uh, we've run into a problem back at {p}. We experienced an unexpected seismic event, and the device was heavily damaged.
The Breaking Point#077.dst: 맞아! 맞아. 잠깐 딴생각을 했네... 어, {p}에서 문제가 생겼어. 예상치 못한 지진이 일어나서 장치가 크게 망가졌어.
The Breaking Point#077.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#078.src: We should be able to finish most of the repairs with what materials we have there, but we're missing a Magmaflux Capacitor for the control panel.
The Breaking Point#078.dst: 수리는 대부분 거기 있는 재료로 할 수 있는데, 제어판에 들어갈 마그마플럭스 축전기가 없어.
The Breaking Point#078.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#079.src: ... Oh. That's going to be a problem. We haven't had an opportunity to make more parts yet - it hasn't been long enough since our last maitenance. So... I'm not sure what we-
The Breaking Point#079.dst: ... 아. 그건 문제네. 아직 부품을 더 만들 기회가 없었어. 지난 점검 이후로 얼마 안 됐거든. 그러니까... 어떻게 해야 할지-
The Breaking Point#079.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#080.src: I overheard the conversation from over there- good to see you Rhay, by the way- But. We may not have any capacitors left up here, but I know where you can get one.
The Breaking Point#080.dst: 저쪽에서 얘기 들었어- 그나저나 반가워, Rhay- 아무튼. 여기엔 축전기가 안 남았을지 몰라도, 구할 수 있는 곳은 알아.
The Breaking Point#080.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#081.src: We repurposed this factory for our needs, but it was built here to process resources from the mines below.
The Breaking Point#081.dst: 이 공장은 우리 필요에 맞게 개조했지만, 원래는 아래 광산의 자원을 처리하려고 지은 거야.
The Breaking Point#081.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#082.src: Though it was discontinued, it's still very likely that there are still miner mechs down there- and some of the more powerful models made use of very similar circuits to the capacitors we use today.
The Breaking Point#082.dst: 지금은 가동을 멈췄지만, 아래엔 아직 채굴 기계병이 남아 있을 가능성이 커. 고성능 모델 중엔 요즘 축전기와 아주 비슷한 회로를 쓴 것도 있었어.
The Breaking Point#082.speaker: Nodise

The Breaking Point#083.src: ... You're right! If they're still down there, we should be able to scrap one of the bots and reuse its circuits. {u}, we can send you down into the mines to find what we need, while we prepare up here!
The Breaking Point#083.dst: ... 맞아! 아직 아래에 있다면, 봇 하나를 분해해서 회로를 재활용할 수 있을 거야. {u}, 네가 광산에 내려가서 필요한 걸 찾아 줘. 우린 위에서 준비할게!
The Breaking Point#083.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#084.src: Alright... Good luck down there! Find the bot, destroy it, and bring the capacitor back up! Just step on the platform in the middle of the factory when you're ready.
The Breaking Point#084.dst: 좋아... 조심해! 봇을 찾아 부수고 축전기를 가져와! 준비되면 공장 한가운데 발판에 올라서.
The Breaking Point#084.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#085.src: Okay. That's fine, just make it quick! You know we can't waste any time here.
The Breaking Point#085.dst: 좋아. 괜찮은데, 빨리 끝내! 여기서 시간 낭비할 여유 없는 거 알지.
The Breaking Point#085.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#086.src: Retrieve the part from the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#092.src: DIVERTING ALL AVAILABLE UNITS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#092.dst: 모든 가용 유닛을 침입자 저지에 투입.
The Breaking Point#092.speaker: Mining Robots

The Breaking Point#093.src: THIS IS A RESTRICTED AREA. REQUESTING AUTHORISATION FOR USE OF LETHAL FORCE AGAINST INTRUDER...
The Breaking Point#093.dst: 이곳은 제한 구역. 침입자에 대한 치명적 무력 사용 승인을 요청...
The Breaking Point#093.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#095.src: DIVERTING MINER MECHS TO HALT INTRUDER.
The Breaking Point#095.speaker: The Mother Drill

The Breaking Point#096.src: Return to the hot air balloon at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with the Magmaflux Capacitor.

The Breaking Point#097.src: Amazing work! I'll get us back to {p} with that capacitor as quick as possible.
The Breaking Point#097.dst: 훌륭해! 그 축전기를 가지고 최대한 빨리 {p}(으)로 돌아가도록 하지.
The Breaking Point#097.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#098.src: Good to see you again, {u}. Good luck with the colossus. And Rhay... come home as soon as you can.
The Breaking Point#098.dst: 다시 만나서 반가웠어, {u}. 거상 일 잘 해결하길 바랄게. 그리고 Rhay... 최대한 빨리 집에 와.
The Breaking Point#098.speaker: Maxie

The Breaking Point#100.src: Return to General Elix with the Corkian Stabiliser
The Breaking Point#100.dst: Corkus 안정 장치를 가지고 Elix 장군에게 돌아가세요

The Breaking Point#101.src: Well... that went better than expected, really. I still can't believe you didn't tell me you already knew Maxie.
The Breaking Point#101.dst: 음... 솔직히 생각보다 잘 풀렸네. 네가 Maxie를 이미 안다는 걸 말 안 했다니 아직도 믿기지 않아.
The Breaking Point#101.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#102.src: Oh, wow. It looks like they've managed to fix up the machine pretty well, all things considered. Just this part left to get it running again...
The Breaking Point#102.dst: 오, 와. 이것저것 따져 보면 기계를 꽤 잘 고쳐 놨네. 이 부품만 있으면 다시 돌아갈 거야...
The Breaking Point#102.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#103.src: Hmph. Rhay, there you are. Seeing as you've returned, I gather everything went smoothly at Corkus?
The Breaking Point#103.dst: 흠. Rhay, 왔군. 돌아온 걸 보니 Corkus 일은 순조로웠나 보지?
The Breaking Point#103.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#104.src: Smoothly enough, General! We have what we need to repair the control panel. We'll be able to get the stabilizer running again!
The Breaking Point#104.dst: 충분히 순조로웠어요, 장군님! 제어판 수리에 필요한 걸 구했어요. 안정 장치를 다시 가동할 수 있어요!
The Breaking Point#104.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#105.src: Well?! What are you waiting for? Finish the repairs, we can't afford to lose any time with this damned Colossus looming over us.
The Breaking Point#105.dst: 그래서?! 뭘 기다리나? 수리를 끝내라. 저 망할 거상이 코앞에 버티고 있으니 한시도 낭비할 수 없다.
The Breaking Point#105.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#106.src: Yes, sir! Alright. {u}, just slot the capacitor in right... there. I'll make sure it runs smoothly.
The Breaking Point#106.dst: 네, 장군님! 좋아. {u}, 축전기를 바로... 거기에 끼워. 잘 돌아가는지는 내가 확인할게.
The Breaking Point#106.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#107.src: There we are. Now, let's get this thing running again! Walder, keep an eye on stability! And... Rhay. You're confident this will work?
The Breaking Point#107.dst: 됐군. 자, 이놈을 다시 가동하자! Walder, 안정도를 지켜봐! 그리고... Rhay. 이게 통할 거라고 확신하나?
The Breaking Point#107.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#108.src: I-I'm sure. This is our last chance. We have to hold out hope that the stabilizer will hold.
The Breaking Point#108.dst: 화, 확신해요. 이게 마지막 기회예요. 안정 장치가 버텨 줄 거라는 희망을 붙잡아야 해요.
The Breaking Point#108.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#109.src: Alright, alright... It's now or never... Hold, stabilizer, hold!
The Breaking Point#109.dst: 좋아, 좋아... 지금 아니면 끝이야... 버텨, 안정 장치, 버텨!
The Breaking Point#109.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#110.src: ... Oh. That's... that's it, then. It's over. We failed.
The Breaking Point#110.dst: ... 아. 이걸로... 끝이구나. 다 끝났어. 우린 실패했어.
The Breaking Point#110.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#111.src: I... am sorry, Rhay. I had... hoped it would work. In truth... I do not have... a plan... either.
The Breaking Point#111.dst: 미안... 하네, Rhay. 나도... 통하길 바랐네. 사실... 나에게도... 계획은... 없네.
The Breaking Point#111.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#112.src: The Elders... would have known... what to do... But they are... long gone. Nothing but... ruins remain.
The Breaking Point#112.dst: 장로들이라면... 어떻게 할지... 알았을 텐데... 하지만 그분들은... 오래전에 사라졌네. 남은 건... 폐허뿐이지.
The Breaking Point#112.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#113.src: The Elders... They were... the greatest... of doguns. As old... as the oldest stones... and wise... as the earth itself...
The Breaking Point#113.dst: 장로들은... Dogun 중에서... 가장 위대한... 분들이었네. 가장 오래된 돌만큼... 늙었고... 대지만큼... 지혜로웠지...
The Breaking Point#113.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#114.src: They were capable... of magic... beyond what any... of us could achieve. They alone... could calm our... Protector.
The Breaking Point#114.dst: 그분들은... 우리 누구도... 이를 수 없는... 마법을 부렸네. 오직 그분들만이... 우리의... 수호자를 진정시킬 수 있었지.
The Breaking Point#114.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#115.src: They were... sealed away. Frozen in... the deepest... of ice. When the dwarves... slew Garaheth... the Elders... fell with him.
The Breaking Point#115.dst: 그분들은... 봉인되었네. 가장 깊은... 얼음 속에... 얼어붙었지. 드워프가... Garaheth를 죽였을 때... 장로들도... 함께 쓰러졌네.
The Breaking Point#115.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#116.src: Such atrocities... The war... My people... But it is not... to dwell on, now. There are... more important... things at hand.
The Breaking Point#116.dst: 그런 만행이... 그 전쟁이... 내 동족이... 하지만 지금은... 곱씹을 때가 아니네. 더 중요한... 일이... 눈앞에 있으니.
The Breaking Point#116.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#117.src: I... I did not... know of this. My people... are free? How long... has it been... since I have seen... my home?
The Breaking Point#117.dst: 나는... 나는... 몰랐네. 내 동족이... 자유롭다고? 내가... 고향을... 본 지... 얼마나 된 건가?
The Breaking Point#117.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#118.src: You... Adventurer. We must... speak to my people. Our chieftain... will know... how we may free... the Elders.
The Breaking Point#118.dst: 자네... 모험가여. 우리는... 내 동족과 이야기해야 하네. 우리 족장이라면... 장로들을... 풀어 줄 방법을... 알 걸세.
The Breaking Point#118.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#119.src: If there's a chance... We have to take it. Ineos, {u}, take the balloon. We'll do what we can here. Now, go! There's no time to waste!
The Breaking Point#119.dst: 기회가 있다면... 잡아야지. Ineos, {u}, 열기구를 타라. 여긴 우리가 할 수 있는 걸 하겠다. 어서 가! 낭비할 시간이 없다!
The Breaking Point#119.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#120.src: It looks like Ozoth's body is trying to prevent you from getting the Everflame!
The Breaking Point#120.dst: Ozoth의 몸이 당신이 영원의 불꽃을 얻지 못하게 막으려는 것 같다!

The Breaking Point#121.src: Meet Ineos and Rhay at the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Breaking Point#122.src: I have never... seen the Heights... from above. I wonder... if their glow... holds the same strength... it does from below...
The Breaking Point#122.dst: 나는... 고원을... 위에서 본 적이... 없네. 저 빛이... 위에서도... 아래에서 보던 만큼... 강할지... 궁금하군...
The Breaking Point#122.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#123.src: I only hope... the Elders... are not gone... for good. We greatly need... their wisdom.
The Breaking Point#123.dst: 그저 바랄 뿐이네... 장로들이... 영영... 사라진 게 아니기를. 우리에겐... 그분들의 지혜가... 절실하네.
The Breaking Point#123.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#124.src: Ah... I believe us... to be landing...
The Breaking Point#124.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#125.src: Travel to {p} with Ineos via the Hot Air Balloon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Breaking Point#126.src: ... Hello. What a... strange sight... to see you landing... at our village... in such a contraption...
The Breaking Point#126.dst: ... 안녕하신가. 참으로... 기묘한 광경이군... 그런 장치를 타고... 우리 마을에... 내려오다니...
The Breaking Point#126.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#127.src: And... is that... Ineos? We thought... the dwarves... had turned you into rubble...
The Breaking Point#127.dst: 그리고... 저건... Ineos인가? 우리는... 드워프가... 자네를 돌무더기로 만든 줄 알았네...
The Breaking Point#127.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#128.src: I escaped... It is a long... story, Korzim. We do not... have time. Where is... your father?
The Breaking Point#128.dst: 탈출했네... 긴... 이야기지, Korzim. 우리에겐... 시간이 없네. 자네... 아버지는 어디 계신가?
The Breaking Point#128.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#129.src: He is... below. They are... freeing the frozen... in New Taloka. Why do you... wish to speak... with him?
The Breaking Point#129.dst: 아버지는... 아래에 계시네. New Taloka에서... 얼어붙은 이들을... 풀어 주고 있지. 왜... 아버지를 찾는 건가?
The Breaking Point#129.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#130.src: The Protector... is angered. We must find... the Elders. They will know... how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#130.dst: 수호자께서... 분노하셨네. 우리는... 장로들을 찾아야 하네. 그분들은... 진정시킬 방법을... 아실 걸세.
The Breaking Point#130.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#131.src: The... Protector... I understand. I will... bring you two... to him. Sidio... Raetin... I leave you two... in charge.
The Breaking Point#131.dst: 수호자... 께서... 알겠네. 내가... 두 사람을... 아버지께 데려가지. Sidio... Raetin... 여기는... 둘에게 맡기겠네.
The Breaking Point#131.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#132.src: Now, let us travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#132.dst: 자, 가세... 불꽃을 지나... 돌을 지나...
The Breaking Point#132.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#133.src: Speak to {p}'s King and the Dogun Chieftain at New Taloka at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#133.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 New Taloka에서 {p}의 왕과 Dogun 족장에게 말을 거세요

The Breaking Point#134.src: We are... here. Taloka was... one of the first to fall... in the war. We have been... working with the dwarves... to restore it.
The Breaking Point#134.dst: 도착... 했네. Taloka는... 전쟁에서... 가장 먼저 무너진 곳 중 하나였지. 우리는... 드워프와 함께... 복구하고 있네.
The Breaking Point#134.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#138.src: Very well. Begin on three. One... Two... Three!
The Breaking Point#138.dst: 좋네. 셋에 시작하지. 하나... 둘... 셋!
The Breaking Point#138.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#139.src: Beginning reheating cycle! Stand back from the subject.
The Breaking Point#139.speaker: Dwarven Technician

The Breaking Point#140.src: ... Where... am... I? How long... has it... been...?
The Breaking Point#140.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#141.src: ...Dwarf... You... you froze me... I will... I will...!
The Breaking Point#141.dst: ...드워프... 네놈이... 날 얼렸지... 가만두지... 가만두지 않겠다...!
The Breaking Point#141.speaker: Unsealed Dogun

The Breaking Point#142.src: Calm yourself... Delg. Our war... has ended. We are... freed. You have been... freed.
The Breaking Point#142.dst: 진정해라... Delg. 우리의 전쟁은... 끝났다. 우리는... 자유다. 너도... 풀려났다.
The Breaking Point#142.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#143.src: ... Freedom? Hundreds... of years... of war... And we are... free?
The Breaking Point#143.dst: ... 자유? 수백... 년의... 전쟁... 끝에... 우리가... 자유라고?
The Breaking Point#143.speaker: Dogun Delg

The Breaking Point#144.src: Yes. We are free... to roam our home... once more. Edac... Escort Delg... and help him re-adjust... to the heights.
The Breaking Point#144.dst: 그렇다. 우리는 다시... 고향을... 누빌 수 있다. Edac... Delg를 데려가... 고원에... 다시 적응하게... 도와라.
The Breaking Point#144.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#145.src: Ah, {u}! It's good to see you again. We haven't seen you around here since... since the end of it.
The Breaking Point#145.dst: 아, {u}! 다시 보니 반갑군. 그... 그 일이 끝난 뒤로 이 근처에서 통 못 봤는데.
The Breaking Point#145.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#146.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed bretheren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#146.dst: 그렇다. 우리는... 지난 몇 주 동안... 열심히 일했다. Taloka는 곧... 다시 일어설 것이다. 그리고 봉인되었던... 많은 동포들이... 되살아났다.
The Breaking Point#146.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#147.src: Yes. We have been... hard at work... these past weeks. Taloka will soon... stand once more. And many... of our sealed brethren... have been returned to life.
The Breaking Point#147.dst: 그렇다. 우리는... 지난 몇 주 동안... 열심히 일했다. Taloka는 곧... 다시 일어설 것이다. 그리고 봉인되었던... 많은 동포들이... 되살아났다.
The Breaking Point#147.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#149.src: You use the grappling hook to swing back to the King in a dazzling feat of trapeze consisting of mid-air flips and acrobatic flourishes.
The Breaking Point#149.dst: 갈고리를 이용해 왕에게 되돌아간다. 공중제비와 곡예를 곁들인 눈부신 공중그네 묘기였다.

The Breaking Point#150.src: Ah, but we can talk more about that later. Tell me, what brings you here today? Is there something you need from us?
The Breaking Point#150.dst: 아, 그 얘기는 나중에 더 하지. 말해 보게, 오늘은 무슨 일로 왔나? 우리에게 필요한 거라도 있나?
The Breaking Point#150.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#151.src: The situtation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#151.dst: 상황이... 심각하다. 위대한 수호자께서... 너무 오랫동안... 홀로 남겨지셨다. 우리에게는... 장로들의... 지혜가 필요하다. 그들이 어디에... 봉인되어 있는지 아는가?
The Breaking Point#151.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#152.src: The situation... is dire. The Great Protector... has been left alone... for far too long. We need... the wisdom... of our Elders. Do you know... where they are sealed?
The Breaking Point#152.dst: 상황이... 심각하다. 위대한 수호자께서... 너무 오랫동안... 홀로 남겨지셨다. 우리에게는... 장로들의... 지혜가 필요하다. 그들이 어디에... 봉인되어 있는지 아는가?
The Breaking Point#152.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#153.src: The Elders?! Yes, we know where they are sealed. However, retrieving them is no simple task. It would take us years to break past the defenses, and we have countless other doguns to release first.
The Breaking Point#153.dst: 장로들?! 그래, 어디 봉인됐는지는 알고 있네. 하지만 꺼내는 건 쉬운 일이 아니야. 방어를 뚫는 데만 몇 년은 걸릴 테고, 먼저 풀어 줄 Dogun도 셀 수 없이 많네.
The Breaking Point#153.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#155.src: Ineos... I want our Elders free... as much as you do. But our Protector... has stood firm... for hundreds of years. It can stand... for another-
The Breaking Point#155.dst: Ineos... 나도 너만큼... 장로들이 풀려나길 바란다. 하지만 수호자께서는... 수백 년을... 굳건히 버텨 오셨다. 앞으로도... 버틸 수-
The Breaking Point#155.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#156.src: No... Has it truly... fallen this far..?
The Breaking Point#156.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#157.src: ... That was your Protector? How powerful is it, if it can reach this far?
The Breaking Point#157.dst: ... 저게 자네들 수호자인가? 여기까지 닿을 정도라니, 얼마나 강한 건가?
The Breaking Point#157.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#158.src: If the Protector... could shake even the Heights... It could destroy... half of this province.
The Breaking Point#158.dst: 수호자께서... 고원마저 뒤흔들 수 있다면... 이 지방의... 절반을... 파괴할 수도 있네.
The Breaking Point#158.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#159.src: Draani... the Elders must be freed. They alone... would know how to calm it.
The Breaking Point#159.dst: Draani... 장로들을 풀어 줘야 한다. 오직 그분들만이... 진정시킬 방법을 아신다.
The Breaking Point#159.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#160.src: Yes... I understand. Very well. {u}, I will take you to the Elders' vault. I hold the keys to open the way forward. Paku, gather your people. See if anyone has alternative solutions.
The Breaking Point#160.dst: 그래... 알겠네. 좋아. {u}, 장로들의 금고로 데려가겠네. 길을 여는 열쇠는 내가 갖고 있지. Paku, 동족을 모으게. 다른 해결책이 있는지 알아보게.
The Breaking Point#160.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#161.src: We will... search for one. I cannot... promise that one exists.
The Breaking Point#161.dst: 찾아... 보겠다. 있다고... 약속할 수는 없다.
The Breaking Point#161.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#162.src: {u}, let us go. It sounds as if we have very little time to waste.
The Breaking Point#162.dst: {u}, 가세. 들어 보니 낭비할 시간이 거의 없는 것 같군.
The Breaking Point#162.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#163.src: I will make preparations, and meet you at the Vault of Ice.
The Breaking Point#163.dst: 준비를 해 두고 얼음 금고에서 만나겠네.
The Breaking Point#163.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#164.src: Enter the Dogun Vault within the lower Freezing Heights at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Breaking Point#164.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Freezing Heights 아래쪽에 있는 Dogun 금고로 들어가세요

The Breaking Point#165.src: ... Ahem. This is the entrance, then. One of our most closely guarded secrets... I was hoping not to have to confront this reminder for a while yet...
The Breaking Point#165.dst: ... 흠흠. 여기가 입구일세. 우리가 가장 철저히 지켜 온 비밀 중 하나지... 이 기억과는 한동안 마주치지 않길 바랐건만...
The Breaking Point#165.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#166.src: But it seems we don't have much choice now. I have the keys, let's go inside.
The Breaking Point#166.dst: 하지만 이제는 선택의 여지가 없는 것 같군. 열쇠는 내게 있으니 들어가세.
The Breaking Point#166.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#167.src: Unlock the Dogun Vault to find the Elders.
The Breaking Point#167.dst: Dogun 금고의 잠금을 풀고 장로들을 찾으세요.

The Breaking Point#168.src: Rather cold in here, isn't it? A vault carved into a drake's True Ice... I suppose my ancestors hoped to seal these doguns in here forever. I'll be glad to disappoint them.
The Breaking Point#168.dst: 꽤 춥지 않나? 드레이크의 True Ice를 깎아 만든 금고라니... 선조들은 이 Dogun들을 영원히 가둬 둘 생각이었나 보군. 기꺼이 실망시켜 드리지.
The Breaking Point#168.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#169.src: Quickly, then, let us proceed to the primary door. I pray the Elders will be responsive to our situation with the Colossus.
The Breaking Point#169.dst: 자, 서둘러 정문으로 가세. 장로들이 거상에 관한 우리 사정에 귀 기울여 주길 비네.
The Breaking Point#169.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#170.src: In any case... Let me see if I can open this second gate. It should be as simple as...
The Breaking Point#170.dst: 아무튼... 이 두 번째 문을 열 수 있나 보세. 이렇게만 하면...
The Breaking Point#170.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#171.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I have never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#171.dst: 흠. 그건... 안 통했군. 이 마법은 오래된 것이라, 제대로 배울 시간을 낸 적이 없었지... 좋아. 다른 방법이 있네.
The Breaking Point#171.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#172.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other side of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#172.dst: 내 기억이 맞다면, 이 틈 건너편에 수동 제어 장치가 있을 걸세.
The Breaking Point#172.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#173.src: Hm. That... didn't work. This magic is old, and I never took the time to learn it properly... Alright. We have alternatives.
The Breaking Point#173.dst: 흠. 그건... 안 통했군. 이 마법은 오래된 것이라, 제대로 배울 시간을 낸 적이 없었지... 좋아. 다른 방법이 있네.
The Breaking Point#173.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#174.src: If my memory serves correctly, there should be a manual override on the other end of this chasm.
The Breaking Point#174.dst: 내 기억이 맞다면, 이 협곡 반대편 끝에 수동 제어 장치가 있을 걸세.
The Breaking Point#174.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#176.src: The issue is that treacherous pool of lava on the way... and I don't think my knees are up to the task of jumping over it all.
The Breaking Point#176.dst: 문제는 가는 길에 있는 위험한 용암 웅덩이인데... 내 무릎으로는 그걸 다 뛰어넘기 힘들 것 같네.
The Breaking Point#176.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#177.src: I would never usually do this, but these are desperate times. Here, take my Trusty Grappling Hook. It should help you get over to the switch.
The Breaking Point#177.dst: 평소라면 절대 안 하겠지만, 지금은 비상시국이니. 자, 내 믿음직한 Grappling Hook을 받게. 스위치까지 가는 데 도움이 될 걸세.
The Breaking Point#177.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#178.src: It has limitations, though. It will only be able to latch onto those blue rocks on the walls - and I'll be taking it back once you're finished, thank you very much!
The Breaking Point#178.dst: 다만 한계가 있네. 벽에 있는 파란 바위에만 걸 수 있지. 그리고 다 쓰면 돌려받을 걸세, 고맙네!
The Breaking Point#178.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#179.src: Hey, {u}! Looks like you're doing good so far, but if you get stuck remember you can jump and then grapple mid-air, that might help on some of those trickier platforms!
The Breaking Point#179.dst: 이보게, {u}! 지금까지 잘하고 있군. 막히면 점프한 뒤 공중에서 갈고리를 걸 수 있다는 걸 기억하게. 까다로운 발판에서 도움이 될 걸세!
The Breaking Point#179.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#180.src: Looks like that unlocked it, {u}! Get yourself back over here and I'll open the door.
The Breaking Point#180.dst: 그걸로 잠금이 풀린 것 같군, {u}! 이쪽으로 돌아오게, 문을 열겠네.
The Breaking Point#180.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#181.src: There we are! Excellent work. You used that hook like a true expert! Ah, reminds me of the time-...
The Breaking Point#181.dst: 됐네! 훌륭하군. 갈고리를 진짜 전문가처럼 다루는군! 아, 옛날 생각이 나는군-...
The Breaking Point#181.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#182.src: ...Ahem. Excellent work, indeed. With the override activated, I should be able to do the rest of the work to open the gate.
The Breaking Point#182.dst: ...흠흠. 정말 훌륭했네. 제어 장치가 작동했으니 나머지 문 여는 작업은 내가 할 수 있을 걸세.
The Breaking Point#182.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#183.src: First, though, I'll be having that grappling hook back! Think of what could happen if you had free reign of that all over.
The Breaking Point#183.dst: 하지만 먼저 그 갈고리는 돌려받겠네! 자네가 그걸 아무 데서나 마음대로 쓰면 무슨 일이 벌어질지 생각해 보게.
The Breaking Point#183.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#184.src: And so... I believe we have gone as far as we can.
The Breaking Point#184.dst: 그리고... 우리가 갈 수 있는 곳은 여기까지인 것 같군.
The Breaking Point#184.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#185.src: This is True Ice, {u}. It has scarred this part of the Heights for centuries, ever since it was created by an ice dragon in my ancestors' conquest.
The Breaking Point#185.dst: 이건 True Ice일세, {u}. 선조들의 정복 때 얼음 용이 만들어 낸 뒤로 수백 년간 고원의 이 일대에 상처로 남아 있지.
The Breaking Point#185.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#186.src: It cannot be melted or burned through by any means. It is why this location was chosen for their tomb. I'm afraid there is nothing more we can do.
The Breaking Point#186.dst: 어떤 방법으로도 녹이거나 태워 뚫을 수 없네. 그래서 이곳이 그들의 무덤으로 선택된 거지. 유감이지만 더 할 수 있는 게 없네.
The Breaking Point#186.speaker: King Draani
