The Breaking Point#187.src: At the end of the war, I imagine.
The Breaking Point#187.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#188.src: As the final dogun settlements fell, and as Garaheth was slain for the first time, my ancestors must have sealed them deep in this ice.
The Breaking Point#188.dst: 마지막 Dogun 정착지가 무너지고 Garaheth가 처음 죽임을 당했을 때, 선조들이 그들을 이 얼음 깊숙이 봉인했을 걸세.
The Breaking Point#188.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#189.src: The... actions of the Dwarves after winning the war are well documented. I would not be surprised if our accounts describe this imprisonment as a great victory.
The Breaking Point#189.dst: 전쟁에서 이긴 뒤 드워프가... 한 일은 기록이 잘 남아 있네. 우리 기록이 이 감금을 위대한 승리로 묘사한다 해도 놀랍지 않을 걸세.
The Breaking Point#189.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#190.src: The Dwarves, of course. Who else?
The Breaking Point#190.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#191.src: I believe it was General Algard of the Dwarven army to order the Elders' imprisonments.
The Breaking Point#191.dst: 장로들의 감금을 명령한 건 드워프 군의 Algard 장군이었을 걸세.
The Breaking Point#191.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#192.src: He was lauded as a hero, naturally. Now... we must reap the consequences of such a decision.
The Breaking Point#192.dst: 당연히 영웅으로 칭송받았지. 이제... 우리가 그 결정의 대가를 치러야 하네.
The Breaking Point#192.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#193.src: True Ice is a material that cannot be melted or burned through by any means. Not even dogun magic has been able to make a dent.
The Breaking Point#193.dst: True Ice는 어떤 방법으로도 녹이거나 태워 뚫을 수 없는 물질일세. Dogun 마법으로도 흠집 하나 못 냈지.
The Breaking Point#193.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#194.src: ... I imagine why this location was chosen to hold the elders. A prison from which they would never be able to escape.
The Breaking Point#194.dst: ... 왜 이곳에 장로들을 가뒀는지 알 것 같네. 절대 빠져나올 수 없는 감옥이니.
The Breaking Point#194.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#195.src: It is known for it to form naturally under extreme conditions... But the ice here is nowhere near natural.
The Breaking Point#195.dst: 극한 환경에서 자연적으로 생긴다고 알려져 있지... 하지만 여기 얼음은 전혀 자연적이지 않네.
The Breaking Point#195.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#196.src: It was formed by an Ice Drake's Breath partway through the war- and, well, as you can see, it has remained here ever since.
The Breaking Point#196.dst: 전쟁 중에 얼음 드레이크의 숨결로 생겨났지- 그리고, 뭐, 보다시피 그 뒤로 계속 여기 남아 있네.
The Breaking Point#196.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#197.src: Just another remnant of our past mistakes, I suppose...
The Breaking Point#197.dst: 우리가 과거에 저지른 실수의 흔적 중 하나일 뿐이겠지...
The Breaking Point#197.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#198.src: Ahem. In any case- as I said, True Ice is impossible to break through, even with the most scorching flames.
The Breaking Point#198.dst: 흠흠. 아무튼- 말했듯이 True Ice는 아무리 뜨거운 불꽃으로도 뚫을 수 없네.
The Breaking Point#198.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#199.src: I... I suppose that a dragon's breath might be able to melt it. That logic does make sense.
The Breaking Point#199.dst: 나... 나도 용의 숨결이라면 녹일 수 있을지도 모른다고 생각하네. 논리적으로는 말이 되지.
The Breaking Point#199.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#200.src: We have little knowledge of what dragons were like, though. As they went extinct, that information became... useless. And so, it was lost.
The Breaking Point#200.dst: 하지만 용이 어땠는지는 거의 알려진 게 없네. 멸종한 뒤로 그런 지식은... 쓸모가 없어졌지. 그래서 잊혔고.
The Breaking Point#200.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#201.src: If anyone would know more about dragons, it would be the doguns.
The Breaking Point#201.dst: 용에 대해 더 아는 자가 있다면, Dogun일 걸세.
The Breaking Point#201.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#202.src: But none of that matters. All the dragons are gone, after all. We still have no options.
The Breaking Point#202.dst: 하지만 다 소용없는 얘기지. 어쨌든 용은 전부 사라졌으니. 여전히 방법이 없네.
The Breaking Point#202.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#203.src: Why, they died out. As Gavellian civilizations grew in size, the ferocity and size of a dragon was simply too much of a threat.
The Breaking Point#203.dst: 그야, 멸종했지. Gavel 문명이 커지면서 용의 사나움과 덩치는 너무 큰 위협이 됐거든.
The Breaking Point#203.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#204.src: Some were hunted. Some died of starvation. Eggs were taken from nests and shattered over boulders for the birds to feed on.
The Breaking Point#204.dst: 일부는 사냥당했고, 일부는 굶어 죽었네. 알은 둥지에서 꺼내져 바위에 깨뜨려 새들의 먹이가 됐지.
The Breaking Point#204.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#205.src: Now all that are left are dragonlings - echoes of their once-great ancestors, with barely enough flames to singe your armor.
The Breaking Point#205.dst: 이제 남은 건 새끼 용뿐일세. 한때 위대했던 선조의 메아리로, 갑옷을 그을릴 불꽃조차 겨우 뿜지.
The Breaking Point#205.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#207.src: A living dragon... You've done quite a lot, haven't you? Stopped a war, moved a dragon...
The Breaking Point#207.dst: 살아 있는 용이라니... 자네 참 많은 일을 했군? 전쟁을 막고, 용을 옮기고...
The Breaking Point#207.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#208.src: Well... if there is a living dragon at {p}... Then we still have hope! {u}, we must ask for its help.
The Breaking Point#208.dst: 그렇다면... {p}에 살아 있는 용이 있다면... 아직 희망이 있네! {u}, 그 용에게 도움을 청해야 하네.
The Breaking Point#208.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#209.src: Let us return to the others. I asked them to wait outside of {p}... perhaps they'll be able to confirm that a dragon's breath would do the job.
The Breaking Point#209.dst: 다른 이들에게 돌아가세. {p} 밖에서 기다리라고 했으니... 용의 숨결이 통할지 확인해 줄 수 있을 걸세.
The Breaking Point#209.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#210.src: Indeed. The fire dragons that sided with them during the war. I'm sure you've come across the skeleton just outside Freezing Heights?
The Breaking Point#210.dst: 그렇다네. 전쟁 중 그들 편에 섰던 화염 용들이지. Freezing Heights 바로 밖에 있는 해골은 봤을 테지?
The Breaking Point#210.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#211.src: Yes, well... the Dwarves needed a counter to the sheer power of a fire dragon in battle, and so they resorted to enslaving dragons and drakes of other elements.
The Breaking Point#211.dst: 그래, 음... 드워프는 전장에서 화염 용의 압도적인 힘에 맞설 수단이 필요했네. 그래서 다른 속성의 용과 드레이크를 노예로 부렸지.
The Breaking Point#211.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#212.src: Like the Ice Drake that created this vault, and encased the Elders in the truest of ice.
The Breaking Point#212.dst: 이 금고를 만들고 장로들을 가장 순수한 얼음에 가둔 얼음 드레이크처럼 말일세.
The Breaking Point#212.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#213.src: ... Well, there was this excellent novel of about one of those creatures from the Shiar, who had to travel to the Heights with this ring he had inherited-
The Breaking Point#213.dst: ... 음, Shiar 출신의 그런 생물에 관한 훌륭한 소설이 있었지. 물려받은 반지를 들고 고원까지 여행해야 했던-
The Breaking Point#213.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#214.src: But I confess, these questions seem almost irrelevant. We have a more pressing issue at hand, {u}.
The Breaking Point#214.dst: 하지만 솔직히 이런 질문은 지금 별 의미가 없네. 더 급한 문제가 있잖나, {u}.
The Breaking Point#214.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#215.src: This ice is harder than obsidian itself. The crystals which form the material are bonded by ancient magic.
The Breaking Point#215.dst: 이 얼음은 흑요석보다도 단단하네. 이 물질을 이루는 결정은 고대 마법으로 결합되어 있지.
The Breaking Point#215.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#216.src: Shattering it with such tools isn't an option. Perhaps there is a weapon that could break through, somewhere deep in our armory- after all, this vault had to be carved somehow...
The Breaking Point#216.dst: 그런 도구로 깨뜨리는 건 불가능하네. 무기고 깊숙한 곳에 뚫을 수 있는 무기가 있을지도 모르지. 어쨌든 이 금고도 뭔가로 깎아 냈을 테니...
The Breaking Point#216.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#217.src: However, given the circumstances, I don't think we have the time to search for it. Even if we started now, our armory is enormous. It would take weeks to find what we need.
The Breaking Point#217.dst: 하지만 상황을 보면 그걸 찾을 시간이 없을 것 같네. 지금 시작해도 무기고가 워낙 넓어서, 필요한 걸 찾는 데 몇 주는 걸릴 걸세.
The Breaking Point#217.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#218.src: The lava of the Heights is nothing more than molten rock. Just a remnant of the shaping of these caverns.
The Breaking Point#218.dst: 고원의 용암은 녹은 바위에 불과하네. 이 동굴들이 생겨날 때 남은 찌꺼기일 뿐이지.
The Breaking Point#218.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#219.src: It's not nearly hot enough to melt True Ice. If it could, the Freezing Heights would have faded long ago.
The Breaking Point#219.dst: True Ice를 녹이기엔 턱없이 뜨겁지 않네. 그게 가능했다면 Freezing Heights는 오래전에 사라졌겠지.
The Breaking Point#219.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#220.src: My... uhm... green is nice, I suppose? Though perhaps not very Dwarven...
The Breaking Point#220.dst: 내... 음... 초록색이 좋지 않나 싶네? 드워프다운 색은 아닐지 몰라도...
The Breaking Point#220.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#221.src: Red, then. Or orange! ...Although my bedsheets are the most wonderful shade of navy blue...
The Breaking Point#221.dst: 그럼 빨간색. 아니면 주황색! ...그래도 내 침대 시트의 남색이 제일 멋지긴 하지...
The Breaking Point#221.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#222.src: Breakfast... I had some eggs, I suppose. Though, I had no idea that breakfast would be my last, did I..?
The Breaking Point#222.dst: 아침... 달걀을 좀 먹었던 것 같네. 그게 마지막 아침일 줄은 몰랐지, 안 그런가..?
The Breaking Point#222.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#223.src: Hm... Had I known, maybe I would have chosen differently. Maybe I would have-... nevermind.
The Breaking Point#223.dst: 흠... 알았다면 다른 걸 골랐을지도. 어쩌면 나는-... 아닐세.
The Breaking Point#223.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#224.src: Regroup at outside {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to figure out how to free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#224.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} 밖에서 합류해 장로들을 풀어 줄 방법을 찾으세요.

The Breaking Point#225.src: ... so this is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#225.dst: ... 그래서 우리가 이런 상황에 처해 있네. Paku, 어떻게 생각하나? 그런 계획이 통하겠나?
The Breaking Point#225.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#226.src: ... so that is the situation we find ourselves in. Paku, what do you think? Would such a plan work?
The Breaking Point#226.dst: ... 그래서 우리가 이런 상황에 처해 있네. Paku, 어떻게 생각하나? 그런 계획이 통하겠나?
The Breaking Point#226.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#227.src: Hm... You may be correct... Draani. The magic in... a dragon's breath... was very potent. And to think... mighty Ozoth had survived... all these years...
The Breaking Point#227.dst: 흠... 네 말이 맞을지도... 모른다, Draani. 용의 숨결에 깃든... 마법은... 무척 강력했다. 강대한 Ozoth가... 지금껏... 살아 있었다니...
The Breaking Point#227.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#228.src: If Ozoth is alive... we must seek her help. If the doguns ask... for her aid, she will... give it.
The Breaking Point#228.dst: Ozoth가 살아 있다면... 그녀에게 도움을 청해야 하네. Dogun이 청한다면... 그녀는... 도와줄 걸세.
The Breaking Point#228.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#229.src: Well, that's as good a plan as any. {u}, you'll travel to seek this dragon's counsel, along with... Ineos, was it? Good luck.
The Breaking Point#229.dst: 뭐, 그만한 계획도 없지. {u}, 이 용의 조언을 구하러 가게. 함께 갈 이는... Ineos였던가? 행운을 비네.
The Breaking Point#229.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#230.src: You should... take the Trading Tunnel... {u}. I will put the coordinates... in your Quest Book.
The Breaking Point#230.dst: 교역 터널을... 이용하게... {u}. 좌표는... 퀘스트 북에... 적어 두겠네.
The Breaking Point#230.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#231.src: Use the {p} trading tunnel at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to travel to {p}.

The Breaking Point#232.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] in an attempt to speak with her.

The Breaking Point#233.src: Ah... it is... good to... see you. We must... proceed to Ozoth... with all haste.
The Breaking Point#233.dst: 아... 다시... 보니... 반갑네. 서둘러... Ozoth에게... 가야 하네.
The Breaking Point#233.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#234.src: Ozoth the Dragon... Endless Kindler... we have come... to ask for your aid.
The Breaking Point#234.dst: 용 Ozoth여... 끝없는 점화자여... 우리는... 도움을 청하러... 왔습니다.
The Breaking Point#234.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#236.src: We are searching... for a way... to melt the truest... of ice. The fate... of Gavel... hangs in the balance.
The Breaking Point#236.dst: 우리는... 가장 순수한... 얼음을 녹일... 방법을 찾고 있습니다. Gavel의... 운명이... 위태롭습니다.
The Breaking Point#236.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#237.src: Doguns... and Dragons... our fates have been entwined... for centuries. We call on you now... Endless Kindler... to save this province.
The Breaking Point#237.dst: Dogun과... 용은... 수백 년간... 운명을 함께해 왔습니다. 이제... 끝없는 점화자여... 이 지방을 구해 주십시오.
The Breaking Point#237.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#239.src: I... see. ... Ozoth tells me... that an Everflame... will free the Elders.
The Breaking Point#239.dst: 그렇군... Ozoth가 말하길... 영원의 불꽃이... 장로들을 풀어 줄 거라네.
The Breaking Point#239.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#241.src: The Endless Kindler... is willing to part... with hers. You must... retrieve it... from her stomach.
The Breaking Point#241.dst: 끝없는 점화자께서... 자신의 것을... 내어 주시겠다네. 자네가... 그녀의 뱃속에서... 꺼내 와야 하네.
The Breaking Point#241.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#243.src: I would advise you... not to think... too much about this. When... you are ready... enter Ozoth's mouth and retrieve... the flame.
The Breaking Point#243.dst: 이 일에 대해서는... 너무 깊이... 생각하지 않길... 권하네. 준비가... 되면... Ozoth의 입으로 들어가... 불꽃을 꺼내 오게.
The Breaking Point#243.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#244.src: Descend into Ozoth's belly to retrieve an Everflame.
The Breaking Point#244.dst: Ozoth의 뱃속으로 내려가 영원의 불꽃을 가져오세요.

The Breaking Point#245.src: Travel to {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] with an Everflame.

The Breaking Point#246.src: {u}! Have you retrieved... the Eternal Flame?
The Breaking Point#246.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#248.src: Excellent. Endless Kindler... thank you... for your sacrifice. I will ensure... that your flame... is returned to you.
The Breaking Point#248.dst: 훌륭하네. 끝없는 점화자여... 희생에... 감사드립니다. 당신의 불꽃이... 반드시... 돌아오게 하겠습니다.
The Breaking Point#248.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#250.src: Ozoth apologises... if it was a bit hot... in there.
The Breaking Point#250.dst: Ozoth가... 안이 좀... 뜨거웠다면... 미안하다고 하네.
The Breaking Point#250.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#251.src: Now, {u}... I was never the best... at the ancient magic... but I hope I have enough skill... to take us the short route back...
The Breaking Point#251.dst: 자, {u}... 나는 고대 마법에... 능한 편은... 아니었지만... 지름길로 돌아갈 만한... 실력은 있기를 바라네...
The Breaking Point#251.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#252.src: You have returned! Is there news from {p}? Did the dragon offer aid?
The Breaking Point#252.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#253.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Eternal Flame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#253.dst: 그녀는 해냈다... Ozoth는 이 지방을 위해... 큰 희생을 했다... 하지만 우리에게는 얼음을 녹일... 영원의 불꽃이 있다.
The Breaking Point#253.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#254.src: She did... Ozoth has made a great sacrifice... for this province... but we have an Everflame... to melt the ice.
The Breaking Point#254.dst: 그녀는 해냈다... Ozoth는 이 지방을 위해... 큰 희생을 했다... 하지만 우리에게는 얼음을 녹일... 영원의 불꽃이 있다.
The Breaking Point#254.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#255.src: Well done... both of you. I will ensure... that the doguns thank her... properly. The dwarves would do well... to do the same.
The Breaking Point#255.dst: 잘했다... 둘 다. Dogun이 그녀에게... 제대로... 감사하도록 하겠다. 드워프도... 그리하는 게 좋을 것이다.
The Breaking Point#255.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#256.src: Yes, yes, but there's no time to worry about that now. Quick, let's get back to the-
The Breaking Point#256.dst: 그래, 그래, 하지만 지금은 그걸 걱정할 때가 아닐세. 어서 돌아가-
The Breaking Point#256.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#257.src: Be wary... of the Elders... Draani. It is unlikely they will react well... after their imprisonment. It is vital... you explain the situation... to them.
The Breaking Point#257.dst: 장로들을... 조심해라... Draani. 감금을 겪은 뒤라... 좋게 반응할 리 없다. 반드시... 그분들께... 상황을 설명해야 한다.
The Breaking Point#257.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#258.src: I would join you... both... but the ice is inhospitable... to my kind. I wish the both of you... the best of luck.
The Breaking Point#258.dst: 나도... 둘과... 함께 가고 싶지만... 그 얼음은 우리 종족에게... 가혹하다. 둘 모두에게... 행운을 빈다.
The Breaking Point#258.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#259.src: ...right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#259.dst: ...그래. 그렇지. 뭐, 피할 방법은 없군. 가세, {u}. 장로들을 해동하고 우리 말을 듣게 해야 하네. 불꽃을 가져오게, 금고에서 만나지.
The Breaking Point#259.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#260.src: ... right. Yes. Well, there's no getting around it. Come, {u}. We must unfreeze the Elders and get them to listen to us. Bring the flame, I will meet you at the Vault.
The Breaking Point#260.dst: ... 그래. 그렇지. 뭐, 피할 방법은 없군. 가세, {u}. 장로들을 해동하고 우리 말을 듣게 해야 하네. 불꽃을 가져오게, 금고에서 만나지.
The Breaking Point#260.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#261.src: Return to the Dogun Vault at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to free the Dogun Elders.
The Breaking Point#261.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Dogun 금고로 돌아가 Dogun 장로들을 풀어 주세요.

The Breaking Point#262.src: Well then, what are we waiting for! Let's free these elders, shall we?
The Breaking Point#262.dst: 자, 뭘 기다리나! 장로들을 풀어 드리세, 어떤가?
The Breaking Point#262.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#263.src: Just bring the Everflame to each of the cells, and melt through that True Ice.
The Breaking Point#263.dst: 영원의 불꽃을 각 감방에 가져가서 True Ice를 녹여 뚫기만 하면 되네.
The Breaking Point#263.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#264.src: Excellent! We've done it! Now we just need to explain the situation-...
The Breaking Point#264.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#266.src: ...Ah. I suppose I did not... think this through. Ehm. Elders, I must apo-
The Breaking Point#266.dst: ...아. 이 일을 제대로... 생각하지 않았군. 음. 장로님들, 사죄를 드-
The Breaking Point#266.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#267.src: Dwarf... Hm. The crimes... of your ancestors... must be repaid.
The Breaking Point#267.dst: 드워프... 흠. 네 선조들의... 죄는... 갚아야 할 것이다.
The Breaking Point#267.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#268.src: However. We have... heard you speak. We have... learned of... the Protector's state.
The Breaking Point#268.dst: 하지만. 우리는... 너희의 말을 들었다. 수호자의... 상태를... 알게 되었다.
The Breaking Point#268.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#269.src: We will... settle your debt... later. This situation... is a more pressing... concern. The Protector... must be calmed.
The Breaking Point#269.dst: 너희의 빚은... 나중에... 청산하겠다. 지금 상황이... 더 급한... 문제다. 수호자를... 진정시켜야 한다.
The Breaking Point#269.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#270.src: ...Yes. You. Human. That was... dragonfire... was it not?
The Breaking Point#270.dst: ...그렇다. 너. 인간. 그것은... 용의 불꽃... 아니더냐?
The Breaking Point#270.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#271.src: Then allow me... to borrow it. Its strength... will allow us... to restore ours. Now... Who now holds... the title... of Chieftain?
The Breaking Point#271.dst: 그렇다면... 내가 빌리겠다. 그 힘이면... 우리 힘을... 되찾을 수 있다. 그런데... 지금 족장의... 자리는... 누가 맡고 있느냐?
The Breaking Point#271.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#272.src: A-ah! Paku is now the Dogun Chieftain. He would be at... At Taloka.
The Breaking Point#272.dst: 아, 아! 지금은 Paku가 Dogun 족장입니다. 그는... Taloka에 있을 겁니다.
The Breaking Point#272.speaker: King Draani

The Breaking Point#273.src: Very well... We shall travel... through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#273.dst: 좋다... 떠나자... 불꽃을 지나... 돌을 지나...
The Breaking Point#273.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#274.src: ...The Elders... after all this time... to see you, again... in the flesh...
The Breaking Point#274.dst: ...장로님들... 이토록 오랜 세월 끝에... 다시... 직접 뵙다니...
The Breaking Point#274.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#275.src: Greetings, Paku. We have much... to discuss. But first... we must travel... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#275.dst: 반갑다, Paku. 나눌 이야기가... 많다. 하지만 먼저... 수호자에게... 가야 한다.
The Breaking Point#275.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#276.src: Join us... Ineos and Paku. There is... very little time... to waste.
The Breaking Point#276.dst: 함께 가자... Ineos, Paku. 낭비할... 시간이... 거의 없다.
The Breaking Point#276.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#277.src: Now, let us travel... (The following part of the line is High Gavellian) Through flame... and through stone...
The Breaking Point#277.dst: 자, 떠나자... (이어지는 대사는 High Gavellian) 불꽃을 지나... 돌을 지나...
The Breaking Point#277.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#278.src: Korzim... my son... join us. The Elders must see... to the Protector.
The Breaking Point#278.dst: Korzim... 내 아들아... 함께 가자. 장로들께서... 수호자를 살피셔야 한다.
The Breaking Point#278.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#279.src: Iscor... Astal... Desint... it has been... too long. I will come.
The Breaking Point#279.dst: Iscor... Astal... Desint... 너무... 오래되었군요. 저도 가겠습니다.
The Breaking Point#279.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#280.src: Earth and flame... fire and stone... transport us through your form! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#280.dst: 대지와 불꽃이여... 불과 돌이여... 너희의 몸으로 우리를 옮겨라! (High Gavellian으로)
The Breaking Point#280.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#282.src: There's no time! I can feel the damned ground cracking beneath my feet, we have to turn to the final option. We've had demolition mages on standby the past few days, our only choice is to-
The Breaking Point#282.dst: 시간이 없다! 발밑에서 망할 땅이 갈라지는 게 느껴진다. 최후의 수단을 써야 해. 며칠째 폭파 마법사들을 대기시켜 뒀으니, 유일한 선택은-
The Breaking Point#282.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#283.src: Rhay. Elix. My Elders... have been freed. They are here... to help... the Protector.
The Breaking Point#283.dst: Rhay. Elix. 내 장로들께서... 풀려나셨네. 그분들이... 수호자를... 도우러... 오셨네.
The Breaking Point#283.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#284.src: Join us... brave ones. You will see... that your efforts to save this Province... have not been in vain.
The Breaking Point#284.dst: 함께 가자... 용감한 자들이여. 이 지방을 구하려던... 너희의 노력이... 헛되지 않았음을... 보게 될 것이다.
The Breaking Point#284.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#285.src: Flames of the earth... take us to the Great Protector... to make our plea! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#285.dst: 대지의 불꽃이여... 위대한 수호자에게 데려가라... 우리의 간청을 전하도록! (High Gavellian으로)
The Breaking Point#285.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#286.src: Travel to the Canyon Colossus at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to attempt to calm it.

The Breaking Point#288.src: Hmph. Foolish dwarves... This is what has come...of your needless war... You are fortunate...to have freed us now...
The Breaking Point#288.dst: 흥. 어리석은 드워프들... 이것이... 쓸데없는 전쟁이... 낳은 결과다... 지금 우리를 풀어 준 걸... 다행으로 여겨라...
The Breaking Point#288.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#289.src: Desint... Iscor... I will prepare... the ritual. Defend me... as I do so.
The Breaking Point#289.dst: Desint... Iscor... 나는... 의식을 준비하겠다. 그동안... 나를 지켜라.
The Breaking Point#289.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#290.src: Human. We will pull the Protector... away from the brink. That is all we can do now. All the power... we can muster.
The Breaking Point#290.dst: 인간. 우리가 수호자를... 벼랑 끝에서 끌어내겠다. 지금 할 수 있는 건 그것뿐이다. 모을 수 있는... 모든 힘으로.
The Breaking Point#290.speaker: Elder Desint

The Breaking Point#291.src: You must enter... these sacred grounds. Battle through it to the end... Knock some sense... into it.
The Breaking Point#291.dst: 너는... 이 성지로... 들어가야 한다. 끝까지 싸워 나가... 정신을... 차리게 해라.
The Breaking Point#291.speaker: Elder Iscor

The Breaking Point#292.src: Adventurer... We are counting...on you. We will try to...support you however we can.
The Breaking Point#292.dst: 모험가여... 자네에게... 달렸네. 우리도... 할 수 있는 한... 돕겠네.
The Breaking Point#292.speaker: Ineos

The Breaking Point#293.src: We'll do the best we can out here! I have some ideas already...
The Breaking Point#293.dst: 우린 밖에서 최선을 다할게! 벌써 몇 가지 생각이 있어...
The Breaking Point#293.speaker: Rhay

The Breaking Point#294.src: Rhay, this isn't the time. Human. We have your back. You can do this.
The Breaking Point#294.dst: Rhay, 지금은 그럴 때가 아니다. 인간. 뒤는 우리가 맡는다. 넌 해낼 수 있다.
The Breaking Point#294.speaker: General Elix

The Breaking Point#295.src: You have faced...worse odds before...have you not? You will face them...again.
The Breaking Point#295.dst: 자네는... 더 나쁜 상황도... 겪어 보지 않았나? 이번에도... 이겨 낼 걸세.
The Breaking Point#295.speaker: Korzim

The Breaking Point#296.src: It is done. Desint... Iscor... Take your postions. We must... hold it back.
The Breaking Point#296.dst: 끝났다. Desint... Iscor... 자리를 잡아라. 우리가... 붙잡아 두어야 한다.
The Breaking Point#296.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#297.src: Great Protector, lord of stone, hear our burning call. Your fury clouds your vision, your anger burns and twists our home. (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#297.dst: 위대한 수호자여, 돌의 군주여, 우리의 타오르는 부름을 들으소서. 분노가 눈을 가리고, 격노가 우리의 터전을 태우고 뒤틀고 있나이다. (High Gavellian으로)
The Breaking Point#297.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#298.src: We, the doguns, who now hold the final flame of a fallen god... We will hold you back. We will keep this land intact! (In High Gavellian)
The Breaking Point#298.dst: 쓰러진 신의 마지막 불꽃을 지닌 우리 Dogun이... 당신을 막아서겠나이다. 이 땅을 지켜 내겠나이다! (High Gavellian으로)
The Breaking Point#298.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#299.src: We will... hold it from here... human. Now... go! We will not... be able to hold it... for long...
The Breaking Point#299.dst: 우리가... 여기서 붙잡아 두겠다... 인간. 이제... 가라! 오래... 버티지는... 못한다...
The Breaking Point#299.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#300.src: This crystal...will let you harness...our flame. Use it...to break through...its defenses.
The Breaking Point#300.dst: 이 수정이... 우리의 불꽃을... 다루게 해 줄 것이다. 그것으로... 저것의 방어를... 뚫어라.
The Breaking Point#300.speaker: Elder Astal

The Breaking Point#301.src: ... Before you go. I will offer you... these powerful relics. Our people... have held them for... longer than I have lived. They may... help you on your quest.
The Breaking Point#301.dst: ... 떠나기 전에. 이 강력한 유물들을... 주겠다. 우리 동족이... 내가 산 세월보다... 오래 간직해 온 것이다. 네 여정에... 도움이 될 것이다.
The Breaking Point#301.speaker: Chieftain Paku

The Breaking Point#302.src: I cannot give you something as unique as what Paku has offered, but I can still lend you a sum from our treasury. Use it as you must, so long as you can calm that thing. Good luck.
The Breaking Point#302.dst: Paku가 준 것만큼 특별한 건 줄 수 없지만, 국고에서 얼마쯤 빌려줄 수는 있네. 저것을 진정시킬 수만 있다면 마음대로 쓰게. 행운을 비네.
The Breaking Point#302.speaker: King Draani

The Canary Calls#001.src: Find out what's happening at the {p} coal mine at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#002.src: Phew... Everyone make it out alright? That was...one hell of a sprint. I'm absolutely knackered.
The Canary Calls#002.dst: 휴... 다들 무사히 나왔지? 진짜... 죽어라 뛰었네. 완전 녹초야.
The Canary Calls#002.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#003.src: I'm not sure, mate. I left a bunch of my stuff down there. Who knows if I'll get it back.
The Canary Calls#003.dst: 글쎄다, 친구. 내 물건 잔뜩 두고 왔는데. 다시 찾을 수 있을지 모르겠어.
The Canary Calls#003.speaker: Micho

The Canary Calls#004.src: Forget about that, what are we gonna tell the chief? That chopsy old fool is gonna kill us if he sees us not working.
The Canary Calls#004.dst: 그건 잊어. 반장한테 뭐라고 하지? 일 안 하는 거 보면 그 입 험한 영감이 우릴 죽일 거야.
The Canary Calls#004.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#005.src: Oi, you! Listen, there was some kind of explosion down in the mines. We're not sure what it is or where it came from, but it surely didn't sound good.
The Canary Calls#005.dst: 어이, 거기! 들어 봐, 탄광 아래서 폭발 같은 게 있었어. 뭔지, 어디서 났는지 모르지만 소리가 영 안 좋았어.
The Canary Calls#005.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#006.src: The four of us were the only blokes down in the mines, so everyone should be out safely. But I reckon we can't go back if this issue isn't resolved.
The Canary Calls#006.dst: 탄광 아래엔 우리 넷뿐이었으니 다들 무사히 나왔을 거야. 근데 이 문제가 안 풀리면 다시 못 들어가.
The Canary Calls#006.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#007.src: You must go to the chief and tell him about the situation. Head down this mineshaft and turn left, and he should be there.
The Canary Calls#007.dst: 반장한테 가서 상황을 전해 줘. 이 갱도로 내려가서 왼쪽으로 돌면 반장이 있을 거야.
The Canary Calls#007.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#008.src: Just, uh... Make sure not to mention us by name. Now, if you'll excuse us, we'll...be on our way.
The Canary Calls#008.dst: 그리고, 어... 우리 이름은 꼭 빼 줘. 그럼 우린 이만... 가 볼게.
The Canary Calls#008.speaker: Daffyd

The Canary Calls#009.src: Turn left from the mine's entrance and speak to the chief at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Canary Calls#009.dst: 탄광 입구에서 왼쪽으로 돌아 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 반장과 대화하세요.

The Canary Calls#010.src: That's right, keep it moving! The whole of {p} is going to run out of coal at this pace!
The Canary Calls#010.dst: 그래, 손 멈추지 마! 이 속도면 {p} 전체에 석탄이 동나겠다!
The Canary Calls#010.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#011.src: Eh? What do you want? Only registered miners are allowed beyond this point. Speak up or get off the premises.
The Canary Calls#011.dst: 응? 무슨 용건이야? 여기부턴 등록된 광부만 들어갈 수 있어. 할 말 있으면 하고 아니면 나가.
The Canary Calls#011.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#012.src: ...An explosion? In the mines? Just now?
The Canary Calls#012.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#013.src: EMERGENCY BREAK TIME, YOU GERBILS! EVERYONE COME AND MEET ME BY THE ENTRANCE! NOW!!!
The Canary Calls#013.dst: 긴급 휴식이다, 이 게르빌 녀석들아! 전원 입구로 모여! 당장!!!
The Canary Calls#013.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#014.src: Alright, you lot better listen bloody carefully. An explosion has been reported in the mines. You all know what that means, yes?
The Canary Calls#014.dst: 좋아, 다들 똑똑히 들어. 탄광에서 폭발이 있었다는 보고가 들어왔다. 그게 무슨 뜻인지 알지?
The Canary Calls#014.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#019.src: No, you bunch of ingrates! One of you needs to take the ol' canary down to the mines and see whatever the hell's going on.
The Canary Calls#019.dst: 아니, 이 배은망덕한 놈들아! 누구 하나가 카나리아를 데리고 내려가서 무슨 일인지 봐야 해.
The Canary Calls#019.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#020.src: Now, which one of you blokes would be willing to-
The Canary Calls#020.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#022.src: Right then. I guess that leaves you, young lad. What do you say? Want a job?
The Canary Calls#022.dst: 그렇군. 그럼 남은 건 너뿐이구나, 젊은이. 어때? 일자리 필요해?
The Canary Calls#022.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#023.src: Very good! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#023.dst: 아주 좋아! 그럼 따라와, 우리 깃털 달린 마스코트를 소개해 주지.
The Canary Calls#023.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#024.src: You sure? I'll pay a lot, and it won't be dangerous. Even if it is, you've got all that armor on you!
The Canary Calls#024.dst: 정말? 돈 두둑이 줄게, 위험하지도 않아. 위험해도 너한텐 그 갑옷이 있잖아!
The Canary Calls#024.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#025.src: That's the spirit! Come on then, let me introduce you to our little feathered mascot.
The Canary Calls#025.dst: 바로 그거야! 그럼 따라와, 우리 깃털 달린 마스코트를 소개해 주지.
The Canary Calls#025.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#026.src: You'll get a bloody mountain of emeralds, god damn it! This is a once in a lifetime opportunity! Do you want it or not?
The Canary Calls#026.dst: 빌어먹을 에메랄드를 산더미만큼 받는다고! 평생 한 번 올 기회야! 할 거야, 말 거야?
The Canary Calls#026.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#027.src: Good. Now, hurry up and follow me.
The Canary Calls#027.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#028.src: You know what? This is ridiculous. The whole of {p} is at danger, and you're playing games with ME?! I know you can do it. Follow me. Now.
The Canary Calls#028.dst: 있잖아, 이건 말도 안 돼. {p} 전체가 위험한데 나랑 장난해?! 넌 할 수 있어. 따라와. 당장.
The Canary Calls#028.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#029.src: Scared speechless, eh? Don't worry, it'll be an easy job. Come on, follow me to the canary's cage.
The Canary Calls#029.dst: 겁먹어서 말도 안 나와? 걱정 마, 쉬운 일이야. 자, 카나리아 새장까지 따라와.
The Canary Calls#029.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#030.src: Meet our canary! She's such a beaut.
The Canary Calls#030.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#031.src: You see, whenever we hear news of an explosion we always bring our canary with us to check it out. They can detect potential gases much earlier than we can.
The Canary Calls#031.dst: 폭발 소식이 들리면 우린 늘 카나리아를 데리고 확인하러 가. 카나리아는 가스를 우리보다 훨씬 먼저 알아채거든.
The Canary Calls#031.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#032.src: Let me just get the key and-
The Canary Calls#032.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#033.src: WAIT, WHAT? WHERE'S THE BLOODY KEY? WHICH ONE OF YOUR LOT IS RESPONSIBLE?! I SWEAR I'M GONNA...
The Canary Calls#033.dst: 잠깐, 뭐야? 빌어먹을 열쇠 어디 갔어? 어느 놈 짓이야?! 맹세컨대 내가...
The Canary Calls#033.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#034.src: ...Listen up, lad. Take this toothpick I've been chewing on. I need you to pick the cage's lock. It's a little wet, but it should do the trick. Understood? Good, now hurry up!
The Canary Calls#034.dst: ...잘 들어, 젊은이. 내가 씹던 이쑤시개를 줄게. 이걸로 새장 자물쇠를 따 줘. 좀 축축하지만 될 거야. 알겠지? 좋아, 서둘러!
The Canary Calls#034.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#036.src: Doing just fine, lad. Almost there...
The Canary Calls#036.dst: 잘하고 있어, 젊은이. 거의 다 됐어...
The Canary Calls#036.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#037.src: Little old birdie is getting quite excited! Keep it up.
The Canary Calls#037.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#038.src: Right then, lad! It's time to begin the-
The Canary Calls#038.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#039.src: OW! Bloody hell! Those are some freakishly sharp claws! What are you playing at-
The Canary Calls#039.dst: 아야! 빌어먹을! 발톱 한번 섬뜩하게 날카롭네! 뭐 하자는-
The Canary Calls#039.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#040.src: Well, I think she likes you, lad. Doesn't like me, apparently.
The Canary Calls#040.dst: 음, 널 좋아하는 것 같네, 젊은이. 나는 싫어하나 봐.
The Canary Calls#040.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#041.src: I was going to feed her, but I suppose you can do the honors. Or not, seeing as she's been particularly troublesome...
The Canary Calls#041.dst: 내가 먹이를 주려 했는데 그 영광은 너한테 양보하지. 아니면 말고. 오늘따라 유난히 말썽이니까...
The Canary Calls#041.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#042.src: Anyway, do as you please. I'll be waiting by the elevator in the mineshaft. Hurry up, and don't make me wait!
The Canary Calls#042.dst: 아무튼, 마음대로 해. 갱도 승강기 옆에서 기다리지. 서둘러, 기다리게 하지 마!
The Canary Calls#042.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#043.src: Head to the mine elevator at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canary Calls#044.src: Right then, lad! I suppose you might want to know more about this job.
The Canary Calls#044.dst: 좋아, 젊은이! 이 일에 대해 좀 더 알고 싶겠지.
The Canary Calls#044.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#045.src: As I said before, when unknown explosions occur in the mines, that's usually a sign that something bad happened.
The Canary Calls#045.dst: 아까 말했듯이, 탄광에서 정체 모를 폭발이 나면 보통 뭔가 안 좋은 일이 생겼다는 뜻이야.
The Canary Calls#045.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#046.src: Most of the time, an awfully putrid gas appears. This is where our canary comes in. Once she verifies that a gas is present, we decide whether or not to temporarily close the mine.
The Canary Calls#046.dst: 대개 지독하게 썩은 냄새 나는 가스가 나와. 여기서 카나리아가 나서지. 가스가 있다고 확인되면 탄광을 잠시 닫을지 정해.
The Canary Calls#046.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#047.src: I presume you met Daffyd and his group, correct? Thankfully, they were the only ones down in the mines.
The Canary Calls#047.dst: Daffyd 일행은 만났지? 다행히 탄광 아래엔 그 녀석들뿐이었어.
The Canary Calls#047.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#048.src: ...Wait, where the hell even are they? Did I not tell them to...
The Canary Calls#048.dst: ...잠깐, 그 녀석들 대체 어디 갔어? 내가 분명...
The Canary Calls#048.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#049.src: Eh, doesn't matter. Lad, point is, I want you to check whether the gas is still there, if at all.
The Canary Calls#049.dst: 에이, 상관없어. 젊은이, 요점은 가스가 아직 남아 있는지 확인해 달라는 거야.
The Canary Calls#049.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#050.src: We'll use the elevator behind me to get down to the mines. Just let me pull this here lever to activate it...
The Canary Calls#050.dst: 내 뒤의 승강기로 탄광에 내려갈 거야. 이 레버만 당겨서 작동시키면...
The Canary Calls#050.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#051.src: ...WHY ISN'T THIS BLOODY CONTRAPTION WORKING??! WORK, WORK, GOD DAMN IT!!
The Canary Calls#051.dst: ...이 빌어먹을 고물은 왜 안 움직여??! 움직여, 움직이라고, 젠장!!
The Canary Calls#051.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#052.src: Must've been Daffyd and his group... No worries, lad. I've got, uh... a last resort, so to speak.
The Canary Calls#052.dst: Daffyd 일행 짓이겠군... 걱정 마, 젊은이. 나한텐, 어... 말하자면 최후의 수단이 있어.
The Canary Calls#052.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#053.src: You'll need to ride a minecart down into the mines. Thing is, we haven't used them to transport people in...years.
The Canary Calls#053.dst: 광차를 타고 탄광에 내려가야 해. 문제는 사람 태운 지가... 몇 년 됐다는 거지.
The Canary Calls#053.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#054.src: Why? Erm, well... See for yourself.
The Canary Calls#054.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#055.src: Our transporter minecarts are manual. Miners around here prefer automatic.
The Canary Calls#055.dst: 우리 운반용 광차는 수동이야. 여기 광부들은 자동을 좋아하거든.
The Canary Calls#055.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#056.src: For you, it should be no issue controlling it. There's instructions attached to the gear stick.
The Canary Calls#056.dst: 너라면 조작하는 데 문제없을 거야. 변속 레버에 설명서가 붙어 있어.
The Canary Calls#056.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#057.src: Now then, go into the mineshaft, following the rails behind me. You'll be able to summon a minecart there.
The Canary Calls#057.dst: 자, 내 뒤의 선로를 따라 갱도로 들어가. 거기서 광차를 부를 수 있어.
The Canary Calls#057.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#058.src: Use the rails to get to the gas leakage.
The Canary Calls#058.dst: 선로를 이용해 가스 누출 지점으로 가세요.

The Canary Calls#059.src: Follow the rail tracks and find a way to escape the mine
The Canary Calls#059.dst: 선로를 따라가 탄광을 빠져나갈 방법을 찾으세요

The Canary Calls#060.src: Continue further in the mine to find a way out.
The Canary Calls#060.dst: 탄광 더 깊이 들어가 출구를 찾으세요.

The Canary Calls#063.src: I am but a figment of your imagination. To you, I am not real.
The Canary Calls#063.dst: 난 당신 상상의 산물일 뿐. 당신에겐 진짜가 아니죠.
The Canary Calls#063.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#064.src: The mysterious force that brought death upon me... It changed me.
The Canary Calls#064.dst: 내게 죽음을 가져온 그 기묘한 힘이... 날 바꿔 놓았어요.
The Canary Calls#064.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#065.src: So too will it change you. I will make that happen. Just for you.
The Canary Calls#065.dst: 당신도 바꿔 놓을 거예요. 내가 그렇게 만들게요. 당신만을 위해.
The Canary Calls#065.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#066.src: No need to thank me. It is the least I can do.
The Canary Calls#066.dst: 고마워할 필요 없어요. 이 정도는 해야죠.
The Canary Calls#066.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#067.src: Moments like these are cherished. Savor the moment with me. Would you like to die with me?
The Canary Calls#067.dst: 이런 순간은 소중하죠. 나와 함께 음미해요. 나와 함께 죽을래요?
The Canary Calls#067.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#068.src: I see. So you want to make this an unforgettable experience. I appreciate the thoughtfulness.
The Canary Calls#068.dst: 그렇군요. 잊지 못할 경험으로 만들고 싶은 거군요. 그 배려, 고마워요.
The Canary Calls#068.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#070.src: I was hoping we could stay for a little longer. If that is your choice, then so be it.
The Canary Calls#070.dst: 조금 더 머물길 바랐는데. 그게 당신의 선택이라면, 그렇게 하죠.
The Canary Calls#070.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#071.src: See you on the other side.
The Canary Calls#071.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#072.src: I would be more than glad to. Sit back and relax.
The Canary Calls#072.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#074.src: Mine could have been better. Cramped up in a cage all day, then suddenly witnessing my death in front of an incompetent human.
The Canary Calls#074.dst: 난 별로였어요. 종일 새장에 갇혀 있다가, 무능한 인간 앞에서 갑자기 내 죽음을 봤거든요.
The Canary Calls#074.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#075.src: You couldn't even save me. How pathetic.
The Canary Calls#075.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#076.src: So, anyway, do you come here often?
The Canary Calls#076.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#077.src: Oh, wait. This is your first time. As well as your last time. That's very poetic. Do you want to become a poet?
The Canary Calls#077.dst: 아, 잠깐. 이번이 처음이죠. 그리고 마지막이고요. 참 시적이네요. 시인이 되고 싶어요?
The Canary Calls#077.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#078.src: I know a good poem. Want to hear it?
The Canary Calls#078.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#086.src: You will lose a lot of things,
The Canary Calls#086.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#101.src: The most average Joe I've seen,
The Canary Calls#101.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#103.src: How was that? It was beautiful, wasn't it?
The Canary Calls#103.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#104.src: Silence is bliss. You must not have very many friends.
The Canary Calls#104.dst: 침묵은 금이죠. 친구가 별로 없나 봐요.
The Canary Calls#104.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#105.src: That's okay. I am your friend. Am I your friend? Please say yes. I'm very lonely.
The Canary Calls#105.dst: 괜찮아요. 내가 친구예요. 내가 친구 맞죠? 그렇다고 해 줘요. 너무 외로워요.
The Canary Calls#105.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#106.src: I had friends too, once. They were all taken by a bunch of selfish coal miners. Then died to their incompetence.
The Canary Calls#106.dst: 나도 한때 친구가 있었어요. 다들 이기적인 광부들한테 끌려갔다가 그들의 무능 탓에 죽었죠.
The Canary Calls#106.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#107.src: But you are different. You are not like the others. I like you. I love you. I love you so much.
The Canary Calls#107.dst: 하지만 당신은 달라요. 다른 이들과 달라요. 당신이 좋아요. 사랑해요. 정말 사랑해요.
The Canary Calls#107.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#122.src: I will give you another chance to redeem yourself.
The Canary Calls#122.dst: 스스로를 구원할 기회를 한 번 더 줄게요.
The Canary Calls#122.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#123.src: So kindly, I will tell you again.
The Canary Calls#123.dst: 친절하게 한 번 더 말해 줄게요.
The Canary Calls#123.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#125.src: Let's do a little warm-up, shall we?
The Canary Calls#125.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#126.src: Liked the dance party? Those moves were so utterly terrible, I may as well dub them 'The '.
The Canary Calls#126.dst: 댄스파티 즐거웠어요? 동작이 너무 형편없어서 ' '라고 이름 붙여도 되겠네요.
The Canary Calls#126.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#127.src: Let's do something I like to call, 'The Canary'.
The Canary Calls#127.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#128.src: Hands off those, if you would be so kind.
The Canary Calls#128.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#130.src: It fẽ̵̻̗̤̠̦͋ͯlt nice the fi̶̘͇͓̮̙̲̯ͮͅrst time, but no̠̪͓̙͚̻ͮ̕w it's...diffẽ̵̻̗̤̠̦͋ͯrent.
The Canary Calls#130.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#132.dst: 좋아요, 대체 누가 이걸 여기 둔 거죠?
The Canary Calls#132.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#133.dst: 난 이미 죽었는데, 이게 어떻게 가능하죠?
The Canary Calls#133.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#135.src: Indeed, you are the one who can destroy the Colossus. (In High Gavellian)
The Canary Calls#135.dst: 그래요, 당신이 거상을 파괴할 자예요. (고등 Gavel어)
The Canary Calls#135.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#139.src: You are about to enter the cruel, real world.
The Canary Calls#139.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#140.src: Kill me now, so we can spend our final moments together in bliss.
The Canary Calls#140.dst: 지금 날 죽여요. 마지막 순간을 함께 행복하게 보내게.
The Canary Calls#140.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#141.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#141.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#144.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#144.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#146.src: Kill me now or you'll live to regret it.
The Canary Calls#146.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#147.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#147.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#149.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy {p}.
The Canary Calls#149.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#150.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#150.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#152.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy Gavel.
The Canary Calls#152.dst: 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 Gavel을 부숴요.
The Canary Calls#152.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#153.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#153.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#155.src: Kill me now or I'll ruin every single province.
The Canary Calls#155.dst: 지금 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 모든 지방을 망칠 거예요.
The Canary Calls#155.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#156.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#156.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#158.src: Kill me now or I'll destroy the world.
The Canary Calls#158.dst: 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 세상을 부숴요.
The Canary Calls#158.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#159.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#159.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#161.src: Okay so you don't care about the world. In that case, kill me now or I'll kill your friends.
The Canary Calls#161.dst: 좋아요, 세상엔 관심 없군요. 그럼 지금 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 당신 친구들을 죽일 거예요.
The Canary Calls#161.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#162.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#162.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#165.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#165.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#167.src: Kill me now or I'll do LITERALLY ANYTHING!
The Canary Calls#167.dst: 지금 날 죽여요, 안 그럼 진짜 무슨 짓이든 할 거예요!
The Canary Calls#167.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#168.src: Fantastic. You are the pinnacle of humankind.
The Canary Calls#168.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#170.src: No no. No no no no no. No. It's too late.
The Canary Calls#170.dst: 안 돼. 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼. 늦었어요.
The Canary Calls#170.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#171.src: I just wanted to play again. Oh well.
The Canary Calls#171.dst: 다시 놀고 싶었을 뿐. 뭐, 됐어요.
The Canary Calls#171.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#172.src: At least I'll be in your memories. Forever. And ever.
The Canary Calls#172.dst: 적어도 난 당신 기억 속에 있을 거예요. 영원히. 영원토록.
The Canary Calls#172.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#175.src: Keep performing CPR, they're almost awake!
The Canary Calls#175.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#176.src: No way! I actually did it! I saved their life!
The Canary Calls#176.dst: 말도 안 돼! 내가 진짜 해냈어! 목숨을 구했다고!
The Canary Calls#176.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#177.src: We better get a raise for this!
The Canary Calls#177.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#178.src: What the?! Who the hell let you in my house?
The Canary Calls#178.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#180.src: No, you can't. Get outta here before I start lowering your salary.
The Canary Calls#180.dst: 아니, 못 해. 월급 깎기 전에 나가.
The Canary Calls#180.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#183.src: Well then, lad! Despite their incompetence, they still managed to save your skin.
The Canary Calls#183.dst: 자, 젊은이! 무능한 녀석들이지만 그래도 네 목숨은 건졌군.
The Canary Calls#183.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#184.src: Come speak to me for a quick debriefing.
The Canary Calls#184.dst: 간단히 보고 좀 하게 이리 와.
The Canary Calls#184.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#186.src: I sent my miners down to save you as soon as we felt that earthquake. It was so strong that I genuinely thought the world was ending.
The Canary Calls#186.dst: 지진이 느껴지자마자 광부들을 내려보냈어. 너무 강해서 진짜 세상이 끝나는 줄 알았다니까.
The Canary Calls#186.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#187.src: I'm jolly sorry for forcing you to take on this job. This whole situation was completely unexpected.
The Canary Calls#187.dst: 억지로 이 일을 맡겨서 정말 미안하다. 이번 일은 완전히 예상 밖이었어.
The Canary Calls#187.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#188.src: Typically, gases are cleared up almost instantly. This time, however, it seemed to have been a lot more potent... But how?
The Canary Calls#188.dst: 보통 가스는 거의 바로 걷히는데. 이번엔 훨씬 독했던 것 같아... 대체 왜?
The Canary Calls#188.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#189.src: ...{p}. It stirs once more. That thing... It has already caused too much hardship for this area to handle.
The Canary Calls#189.dst: ...{p}. 그게 또 꿈틀대는군. 그놈은... 이 일대가 감당 못 할 만큼 고난을 안겼어.
The Canary Calls#189.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#190.src: It must be destroyed, once and for all. How will that happen, I do not know. But you...
The Canary Calls#190.dst: 그놈은 완전히 부숴야 해. 어떻게 할지는 모르겠다. 하지만 너라면...
The Canary Calls#190.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#191.src: ...No, it's nothing. Until that thing is dealt with, deeper parts of this mine must be closed down. The supply of coal will decrease, but it must be done.
The Canary Calls#191.dst: ...아니, 아무것도 아냐. 그놈을 처리할 때까지 탄광 깊은 곳은 폐쇄해야 해. 석탄 공급은 줄겠지만 어쩔 수 없지.
The Canary Calls#191.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#192.src: Tell you what, lad! I'll give you, and only you, permission to access parts of the mine, right where we mine our world-famous {p} coal.
The Canary Calls#192.dst: 이렇게 하지, 젊은이! 너한테만 탄광 일부 구역 출입을 허락하마. 세계적으로 유명한 {p} 석탄을 캐는 곳이야.
The Canary Calls#192.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#193.src: Consider yourself a part-time {p} coal miner. You've earned it, lad.
The Canary Calls#193.dst: 이제 넌 {p}의 파트타임 석탄 광부야. 그럴 자격 있어, 젊은이.
The Canary Calls#193.speaker: Chief Clight

The Canary Calls#196.src: Is this the height of your skill?
The Canary Calls#196.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#198.src: Are you even playing the game?
The Canary Calls#198.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#199.src: Go ahead. Run right into it.
The Canary Calls#199.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#200.src: Was that you, or will you blame that on lag?
The Canary Calls#200.dst: 당신 실수예요, 아니면 렉 탓할 거예요?
The Canary Calls#200.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#202.src: Even a snail could dodge that.
The Canary Calls#202.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#204.src: Nice going bozo, you fell off.
The Canary Calls#204.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#205.dst: 흥미로운 전술이네요! 한 번 더 해요.
The Canary Calls#205.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#206.src: Nice try, but that won't work.
The Canary Calls#206.speaker: Canary

The Canary Calls#207.src: Hey up! Aren't you that Wynn soldier we've heard about? You look proper tough, is all.
The Canary Calls#207.dst: 어이! 소문난 그 Wynn 병사 아냐? 아주 튼튼해 보여서 말이야.
The Canary Calls#207.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#208.src: No, this is definitely them! The name's {u}, right?
The Canary Calls#208.dst: 아냐, 확실히 그 사람이야! 이름이 {u} 맞지?
The Canary Calls#208.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#209.src: Woah, this kid's a soldier? I wish I had that kind of job... I'd imagine it's much better than this crap.
The Canary Calls#209.dst: 와, 이 꼬마가 병사라고? 나도 그런 일 하고 싶다... 이 거지 같은 일보단 훨씬 낫겠지.
The Canary Calls#209.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#210.src: Yeah, I really hate this job, man. That and the chief makes me pull my hair out... In fact, I already went bald because of it!
The Canary Calls#210.dst: 그러게, 이 일 진짜 싫어. 그거랑 반장 때문에 머리를 쥐어뜯어... 그래서 벌써 대머리가 됐다고!
The Canary Calls#210.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#211.src: Dude, the chief scares the crap out of me. I'm surprised that I still have this job. Looks like we might lose it if the mines ain't restored fast enough.
The Canary Calls#211.dst: 야, 반장 진짜 무서워. 아직 안 잘린 게 신기해. 탄광이 빨리 복구 안 되면 일자리 잃을지도 몰라.
The Canary Calls#211.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#212.src: I-I don't want to lose this job, man! I've got a wife and two goldfish!
The Canary Calls#212.dst: 이, 일자리 잃기 싫어! 아내랑 금붕어 두 마리가 있다고!
The Canary Calls#212.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#213.src: Easy, Ryan. We won't lose it. We're in this together. will take care of it.
The Canary Calls#213.dst: 진정해, Ryan. 안 잃어. 우린 한배야.  해결해 줄 거야.
The Canary Calls#213.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#214.src: Our very lives are in your hands, soldier. Good luck, and be careful. The mines are quite treacherous even for people like you.
The Canary Calls#214.dst: 우리 목숨이 네 손에 달렸어, 병사. 행운을 빌고, 조심해. 탄광은 너 같은 사람한테도 꽤 위험해.
The Canary Calls#214.speaker: Thesead Coal Miner

The Canary Calls#215.src: We still can't believe we found you. I'm proper shocked.
The Canary Calls#215.dst: 널 찾았다는 게 아직도 안 믿겨. 진짜 놀랐어.
The Canary Calls#215.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#216.src: We had to use that blasted archaic minecart system because the elevator was still busted.
The Canary Calls#216.dst: 승강기가 아직 고장이라 그 빌어먹을 낡은 광차를 타야 했어.
The Canary Calls#216.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#217.src: Everyone was exhausted from it. But just when all hope was seemingly lost, we found you laying on the ground.
The Canary Calls#217.dst: 다들 지쳐 버렸지. 그런데 희망이 다 사라진 것 같을 때, 네가 바닥에 누워 있는 걸 찾았어.
The Canary Calls#217.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#218.src: You were violently twitching about, as if you were possessed by something. It was scary.
The Canary Calls#218.dst: 뭔가에 씐 것처럼 심하게 경련하고 있었어. 무서웠다니까.
The Canary Calls#218.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#219.src: Whatever the effects of that gas are, we want absolutely none of it. I'm never stepping foot inside of that bloody mine ever again.
The Canary Calls#219.dst: 그 가스가 무슨 효과든 우린 절대 엮이기 싫어. 다시는 그 빌어먹을 탄광에 발도 안 들일 거야.
The Canary Calls#219.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canary Calls#220.src: For the sake of our jobs and {p}, the Colossus must be stopped.
The Canary Calls#220.dst: 우리 일자리와 {p}을(를) 위해, 거상을 막아야 해.
The Canary Calls#220.speaker: Thesead Miner

The Canyon Guides#001.src: Welcome to the Bantisu Temple, wandering human. We aid travelers such as yourself in navigating the capricious canyon walls.
The Canyon Guides#001.dst: Bantisu 사원에 오신 것을 환영합니다, 방랑하는 인간이여. 저희는 변덕스러운 협곡에서 길을 찾도록 여행자를 돕습니다.
The Canyon Guides#001.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#002.src: We commune with the wind, and she gives us her sight. Wherever the breeze blows, we may see.
The Canyon Guides#002.dst: 저희는 바람과 교감하고, 바람은 저희에게 시야를 줍니다. 바람이 닿는 곳이라면 볼 수 있지요.
The Canyon Guides#002.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#003.src: You appear to be quite strong, and well-kept by your wits. Might we ask you to aid us, then?
The Canyon Guides#003.dst: 꽤 강하고 지혜로워 보이시는군요. 그렇다면 저희를 도와주시겠습니까?
The Canyon Guides#003.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#004.src: You see, a lost man is staking out in a camp on the nearby cliff faces. It pains us to see him, but we are unable to reach him.
The Canyon Guides#004.dst: 실은 길 잃은 사람 하나가 근처 절벽의 야영지에 틀어박혀 있습니다. 안타깝지만 저희는 그에게 갈 수 없습니다.
The Canyon Guides#004.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#005.src: The canyon creatures there are ruthless, and we are not suited to physical combat. We would be able to reach him, but we would be stranded ourselves.
The Canyon Guides#005.dst: 그곳 협곡 생물들은 무자비하고, 저희는 싸움에 맞지 않습니다. 가는 건 가능하나 저희마저 발이 묶일 겁니다.
The Canyon Guides#005.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#006.src: We ask you to guide Seluc to us. We shall send you to him, and you will bring him here. If you wish to help, you will be rewarded for your time.
The Canyon Guides#006.dst: Seluc을 이리로 인도해 주십시오. 그에게 보내 드릴 테니 데려와 주십시오. 도와주신다면 보답하겠습니다.
The Canyon Guides#006.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#007.src: Find Seluc in his camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canyon Guides#008.src: Who's that? Am I finally being rescued!?
The Canyon Guides#008.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#009.src: Wait, a human! Ugh, I shouldn't have gotten my hopes up. What did you do, take a day off cliff diving?
The Canyon Guides#009.dst: 잠깐, 인간이잖아! 으, 괜히 기대했네. 뭐야, 오늘은 절벽 다이빙 쉬는 날이야?
The Canyon Guides#009.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#010.src: If you really did intend to rescue me, you've assuredly wasted both our time.
The Canyon Guides#010.dst: 진짜 날 구하러 왔다면 우리 둘 다 시간 낭비한 거야.
The Canyon Guides#010.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#011.src: If you really want to make yourself useful, get a Bantisu monk over here! You're good at that, right? Fetching things and people?
The Canyon Guides#011.dst: 진짜 쓸모 있고 싶으면 Bantisu 수도승 하나 데려와! 그런 거 잘하잖아? 물건이랑 사람 가져오는 거?
The Canyon Guides#011.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#013.src: You're trying to kill me, aren't you?! What, can't take hearing the truth? Now my coat is drenched, and! AND!
The Canyon Guides#013.dst: 날 죽이려는 거지?! 뭐, 진실은 못 듣겠다 이거야? 코트가 다 젖었잖아, 그리고! 그리고!
The Canyon Guides#013.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#014.src: These Jinko are going to pounce any second now!! I haven't got a weapon, were you expecting me to rush off and get into a rumble?!
The Canyon Guides#014.dst: Jinko들이 당장이라도 덮치겠어!! 무기도 없는데 내가 뛰쳐나가 싸우길 바랐어?!
The Canyon Guides#014.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#015.src: Kill them! Kill then now! And get me OUT OF HERE! You got me into this mess, now get me out!!
The Canyon Guides#015.dst: 죽여! 당장 죽여! 그리고 날 여기서 꺼내! 네가 이렇게 만들었으니 꺼내 줘!!
The Canyon Guides#015.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#017.src: Ugh, all that danger got me flustered. I'm sweating in this coat...and it's all soaked already. Let me just...
The Canyon Guides#017.dst: 으, 위험해서 정신없었네. 코트 속이 땀범벅이야... 이미 다 젖었는데. 그냥...
The Canyon Guides#017.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#018.src: ...set that aside. Congratulations, human! I'm probably never getting that coat back, and it cost me a pretty sum. Thanks for nothing.
The Canyon Guides#018.dst: ...치워 두자. 축하한다, 인간! 저 코트는 아마 못 찾겠지, 꽤 비싼 건데. 참 고맙다.
The Canyon Guides#018.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#019.src: All this walking...I'm taking a break here. You forced me to jump off a cliff, I get to force you to slow down. It's only fair! Besides that...
The Canyon Guides#019.dst: 걷기만 하고... 여기서 좀 쉴래. 날 절벽에서 뛰어내리게 했으니 난 널 늦추게 할 거야. 공평하지! 게다가...
The Canyon Guides#019.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#020.src: I only even came here just to see the view. At least that can't be ruined. Still, some vacation this turned out to be...
The Canyon Guides#020.dst: 경치나 보러 온 거였어. 적어도 그건 못 망치겠지. 그래도 참 대단한 휴가가 됐네...
The Canyon Guides#020.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#021.src: Wait, what in the world- What's going on?!
The Canyon Guides#021.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#023.src: NO ONE TELLS ME ANYTHING! The brochure didn't mention earthquakes, YOU didn't tell me either, but what was I expecting from a human anyways?!
The Canyon Guides#023.dst: 아무도 말을 안 해 줘! 안내 책자에 지진 얘긴 없었고 너도 말 안 했지. 인간한테 뭘 기대했겠어?!
The Canyon Guides#023.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#024.src: I'm not a carrot! You'd better get me out of h- ...wait, wait, those...
The Canyon Guides#024.dst: 난 당근이 아니야! 빨리 꺼내- ...잠깐, 잠깐, 저건...
The Canyon Guides#024.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#025.src: H-Hobgoblins. Hobgoblins HOBGOBLINS THERE'S HOBGOBLINS!! KILL THEM! AAAAH! AAH! AAAAAAH!
The Canyon Guides#025.dst: 호, 홉고블린. 홉고블린 홉고블린이다 홉고블린!! 죽여! 으아아! 아아! 으아아아!
The Canyon Guides#025.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#026.src: Sweet baby bovine I just saw my life flash before my eyes. Ugh...now pull me up. I'm stuck. But easy on the goods, I'm NOT a carrot I'll remind you!
The Canyon Guides#026.dst: 맙소사, 방금 주마등이 스쳤어. 으... 이제 끌어올려. 끼었어. 살살 해, 다시 말하지만 난 당근이 아니야!
The Canyon Guides#026.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#027.src: Great. I'm SO grateful to be covered in mud and hobgoblin blood, and to be lacking my coat, AND to be stuck with a human.
The Canyon Guides#027.dst: 좋네. 진흙과 홉고블린 피 범벅에 코트도 없고, 인간이랑 붙어 다니게 돼서 정말 감사하다.
The Canyon Guides#027.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#028.src: Just get me out of here already. See, if an actual Bantisu monk had come down I'd probably be at home already, sipping tea by the fire!
The Canyon Guides#028.dst: 그냥 빨리 꺼내 줘. 진짜 Bantisu 수도승이 왔으면 지금쯤 집에서 난롯가에 차나 마시고 있겠지!
The Canyon Guides#028.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#029.src: I know you humans are reckless, but I'd have expected you to have SOME concern, since you supposedly wanted to rescue me.
The Canyon Guides#029.dst: 인간이 무모한 건 알지만, 날 구하러 왔다며 조금은 신경 써 줄 줄 알았어.
The Canyon Guides#029.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#030.src: Ugh, my feet are killing me. Maybe this hike wouldn't be so bad if SOMEONE hadn't knocked me into the lake and made me lose my shoes!
The Canyon Guides#030.dst: 으, 발 아파 죽겠어. 누가 날 호수에 빠뜨려서 신발 잃게만 안 했어도 이 길이 이렇게 나쁘진 않았을걸!
The Canyon Guides#030.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#034.src: ...perfect. Just GREAT! The only available path to the temple, and now it's blocked off! Just my luck!!
The Canyon Guides#034.dst: ...완벽하네. 정말 대단해! 사원으로 가는 유일한 길이 막혔어! 내 운이 그렇지!!
The Canyon Guides#034.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#035.src: ...wait. You're reckless and willing to endanger your life, right? There's no way that I could possibly use them, but I see some ledges.
The Canyon Guides#035.dst: ...잠깐. 넌 무모하고 목숨도 막 걸잖아? 난 절대 못 쓰겠지만, 저기 턱이 좀 보이네.
The Canyon Guides#035.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#036.src: See, just to the side of the rockslide? There's some ledges to jump around on.
The Canyon Guides#036.dst: 봐, 낙석 바로 옆에? 뛰어다닐 만한 턱이 있잖아.
The Canyon Guides#036.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#037.src: Find a way to get Seluc past the blockage.
The Canyon Guides#037.dst: Seluc이 장애물을 넘어가게 할 방법을 찾으세요.

The Canyon Guides#038.src: ...of course it's a ladder. I'm going to be feeling this climb for weeks...
The Canyon Guides#038.dst: ...당연히 사다리지. 이거 오르면 몇 주는 쑤시겠네...
The Canyon Guides#038.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#039.src: Huff...puff... Well...huff... Wait, there's...there's no way down to the other side! Huff...what a waste!!
The Canyon Guides#039.dst: 헉...헉... 음...헉... 잠깐, 반대편으로... 내려갈 길이 없잖아! 헉...헛고생했네!!
The Canyon Guides#039.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#040.src: Can you do ANYTHING right?! There's no way I'm jumping down there, you maniac!
The Canyon Guides#040.dst: 하나라도 제대로 하는 게 있어?! 저기로 뛰어내릴 리가 없잖아, 이 미친놈아!
The Canyon Guides#040.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#042.src: You...had better count yourself lucky I haven't broken any bones over this. Agh...but that doesn't mean I'm not aching all over!!
The Canyon Guides#042.dst: 너... 뼈 하나 안 부러진 걸 다행으로 알아. 아으... 그렇다고 온몸이 안 쑤신다는 건 아니야!!
The Canyon Guides#042.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#043.src: When I said you were reckless, I was hoping that maybe you'd keep that side of yourself away from other people!!
The Canyon Guides#043.dst: 무모하다고 할 때, 그런 면은 남한테 안 쓰길 바랐다고!!
The Canyon Guides#043.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#045.src: At least we're nearly at the temple now. Come on Seluc, silver linings, silver linings. You're nearly away from this freak...
The Canyon Guides#045.dst: 그래도 사원이 거의 다 왔어. 힘내 Seluc, 좋게 생각하자, 좋게. 이 괴짜랑도 곧 끝이야...
The Canyon Guides#045.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#046.src: Okay, you know what? No. You've put me through QUITE a lot here, human, so you're going to do me a favor and I'm not going to move another step til it's done.
The Canyon Guides#046.dst: 그래, 있잖아? 안 돼. 인간, 네 탓에 고생 좀 했으니 부탁 하나 들어줘. 그 전엔 한 발짝도 안 움직여.
The Canyon Guides#046.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#047.src: I paid two weeks wages for that coat you soaked. I'm not leaving here without it, and I'm way too tired to walk back down.
The Canyon Guides#047.dst: 네가 적신 그 코트, 2주치 품삯이야. 그거 없인 안 가, 그리고 도로 내려가기엔 너무 지쳤어.
The Canyon Guides#047.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#048.src: So you're going back down to the bottom of the ridge, and you're going to get me my coat. It's the least you could do.
The Canyon Guides#048.dst: 그러니까 네가 능선 아래로 내려가서 내 코트를 가져와. 그 정도는 해야지.
The Canyon Guides#048.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#049.src: And be quick about it! I feel like these quakes are going to make the whole mountain collapse. That looks like it opened up a hole straight to the bottom!
The Canyon Guides#049.dst: 그리고 빨리 해! 이 지진에 산 전체가 무너질 것 같아. 저기 바닥까지 곧장 구멍이 뚫린 것 같은데!
The Canyon Guides#049.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#050.src: Retrieve the coat Seluc left behind at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Canyon Guides#052.src: Took you long enough, coat-fetcher! I'm practically frostbitten up here!
The Canyon Guides#052.dst: 오래도 걸렸네, 코트 셔틀! 여기서 동상 걸리는 줄 알았어!
The Canyon Guides#052.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#053.src: You see, I was just speaking to Gana about your dirt-poor imitation of their job! You ought to be ashamed- I had to get up here all on my own!
The Canyon Guides#053.dst: 마침 Gana한테 네가 이분들 일을 얼마나 형편없이 흉내 냈는지 말하던 참이야! 부끄러운 줄 알아- 난 혼자 올라왔다고!
The Canyon Guides#053.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#054.src: ...hm. I will say, there are many lost around the canyon, Seluc- it may have been a long time before we were able to help you.
The Canyon Guides#054.dst: ...흠. 말씀드리자면, 협곡엔 길 잃은 이가 많습니다, Seluc- 당신을 돕기까지 오래 걸렸을지도 모릅니다.
The Canyon Guides#054.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#055.src: Anyway! Give me that coat. The monks here are going to provide me some hospitality then guide me out of these wretched canyon walls.
The Canyon Guides#055.dst: 아무튼! 코트 내놔. 여기 수도승들이 날 대접하고 이 지긋지긋한 협곡에서 데리고 나가 줄 거야.
The Canyon Guides#055.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#056.src: This is goodbye then, human, I won't be missing you. Shoo!
The Canyon Guides#056.dst: 그럼 작별이다, 인간. 보고 싶진 않을 거야. 훠이!
The Canyon Guides#056.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#057.src: ...He did not really guide himself here. Did he.
The Canyon Guides#057.dst: ...그는 스스로 길을 찾아온 게 아니군요. 그렇죠.
The Canyon Guides#057.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#058.src: ...uh. ...dang it, why you gotta did that.
The Canyon Guides#058.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#059.src: Let this be a lesson to you, Seluc. You cannot lie to those who see with the wind. Now show your gratitude towards this kind human.
The Canyon Guides#059.dst: 교훈으로 삼으십시오, Seluc. 바람으로 보는 자에게 거짓말은 통하지 않습니다. 이 친절한 분께 감사하십시오.
The Canyon Guides#059.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#060.src: That's right! See, Gana? After all that, at least the human isn't a liar.
The Canyon Guides#060.dst: 맞아! 봤지, Gana? 그래도 이 인간은 거짓말쟁이는 아니라고.
The Canyon Guides#060.speaker: Seluc

The Canyon Guides#061.src: ...Well, 'coat fetcher', getting this man his coat is still a fine deed. And for that, you shall be rewarded.
The Canyon Guides#061.dst: ...그럼, '코트 셔틀'님, 이분께 코트를 찾아 드린 건 훌륭한 일입니다. 그에 대한 보상을 드리지요.
The Canyon Guides#061.speaker: Gana

The Canyon Guides#062.src: As thanks, we will also grant you access to our Bantisu Air Boosters. Magical clouds of air found around the canyon. I hope they are of assistance to you.
The Canyon Guides#062.dst: 감사의 뜻으로 Bantisu Air Booster도 쓰실 수 있게 해 드리겠습니다. 협곡 곳곳에 있는 마법 공기 구름입니다. 도움이 되길 바랍니다.
The Canyon Guides#062.speaker: Gana

The Corrupted Village#000.src: Did you do what I asked? No? Check your content book.
The Corrupted Village#000.dst: 부탁한 건 했어요? 아직요? 콘텐츠 북을 확인해 봐요.

The Corrupted Village#001.src: HEY! YOU! What are you looking at? You want to go do ya?!
The Corrupted Village#001.dst: 야! 너! 뭘 봐? 한판 붙어 볼래?!

The Corrupted Village#002.src: I swear if you don't leave right now, I am going to PUMMEL YOUR FACE INTO THE GROUND.
The Corrupted Village#002.dst: 맹세하는데, 당장 안 꺼지면 네 얼굴을 땅바닥에 처박아 버릴 거야.

The Corrupted Village#004.src: We were performing our usual routines when suddenly an unknown explosion caused a massive cave-in at the entrance to our main mining supply area.
The Corrupted Village#004.dst: 평소처럼 작업하던 중, 갑자기 정체불명의 폭발이 일어나 주 채굴 보급 구역 입구가 크게 무너졌습니다.

The Corrupted Village#005.src: Something must be done to remove the debris, we cannot easily continue our mining operations without our supplies.
The Corrupted Village#005.dst: 잔해를 치울 방법을 찾아야 합니다. 보급품 없이는 채굴 작업을 계속하기 어렵습니다.

The Corrupted Village#006.src: There also may be people trapped on the other side, and I would hate to lose even more miners to these catastrophes.
The Corrupted Village#006.dst: 반대편에 갇힌 사람이 있을지도 모릅니다. 이런 참사로 광부를 더 잃고 싶지 않습니다.

The Corrupted Village#007.src: Maybe we could use the Wrecking Ball to demolish the debris, but if we don't act soon...
The Corrupted Village#007.dst: 철거용 쇠공으로 잔해를 부술 수 있을지도 모르지만, 서두르지 않으면...

The Corrupted Village#008.src: How to Use the Explosive-Cloaker Machine:

The Corrupted Village#010.src: - Insert explosive item into the hole of the INPUT slot of the machine.
The Corrupted Village#010.dst: - 폭발성 아이템을 장치의 INPUT 슬롯 구멍에 넣으세요.

The Corrupted Village#011.src: - Wait while the machine temporarily disables the item's explosive property.
The Corrupted Village#011.dst: - 장치가 아이템의 폭발성을 잠시 없애는 동안 기다리세요.

The Corrupted Village#012.src: - Take item out of OUTPUT slot.

The Corrupted Village#013.src: - Can be very useful for disabling explosive properties of unstable ores found in caves.
The Corrupted Village#013.dst: - 동굴에서 발견되는 불안정한 광석의 폭발성을 없애는 데 매우 유용합니다.

The Corrupted Village#014.src: Orikal takes the materials you retrieved and puts them in a container. He mutters some words in an unknown language, and suddenly the container turns into some sort of Magical TNT.
The Corrupted Village#014.dst: Orikal이 가져온 재료를 받아 용기에 넣는다. 알 수 없는 언어로 몇 마디 중얼거리자, 갑자기 용기가 일종의 마법 TNT로 변한다.

The Corrupted Village#015.src: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe. Here, take this for your help.
The Corrupted Village#015.dst: 그런데 뭐랑 연결된 걸까요? 그건 다음에 알아보죠. 중요한 건 마을이 안전하다는 거예요. 자, 도와준 보답이에요.

The Corrupted Village#016.src: Speak to Orikal outside the {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#017.src: Go away! I know you're angry but there's nothing to gain her-
The Corrupted Village#017.dst: 저리 가! 화난 건 알지만 여기서 얻을 건 없-
The Corrupted Village#017.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#018.src: Oh, you seem calm. What are you doing here? Bit close to the portal for a soldier isn't it?
The Corrupted Village#018.dst: 아, 차분해 보이네요. 여긴 무슨 일이죠? 병사치곤 포털에 너무 가깝지 않나요?
The Corrupted Village#018.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#019.src: I see, you were sent to aid the public. Perfect.
The Corrupted Village#019.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#020.src: I am Orikal, I'm trying to stop everyone here from killing each other.
The Corrupted Village#020.dst: 난 Orikal이에요. 여기 사람들이 서로 죽이지 못하게 막는 중이죠.
The Corrupted Village#020.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#021.src: Do you see all these spikes? I believe they are the thing spreading corruption.
The Corrupted Village#021.dst: 이 가시들 보여요? 이게 타락을 퍼뜨리는 것 같아요.
The Corrupted Village#021.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#022.src: Corruption does not affect humans like other beings. It’s much much slower, more like an infection of the mind to us.
The Corrupted Village#022.dst: 타락은 인간에겐 다른 존재와 다르게 작용해요. 훨씬 느리고, 우리에겐 정신의 감염에 가깝죠.
The Corrupted Village#022.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#023.src: Could you inspect the peak of the spike in the village for me? It might give me valuable insight. Thanks!
The Corrupted Village#023.dst: 마을에 있는 가시 꼭대기를 조사해 줄래요? 중요한 단서가 될지도 몰라요. 고마워요!
The Corrupted Village#023.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#024.src: Examine the nearby corrupted spike to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Corrupted Village#025.src: Climb the spike to see if you can find anything useful about it's existance.
The Corrupted Village#025.dst: 가시에 올라가 그 존재에 관해 쓸 만한 걸 찾을 수 있는지 보세요.

The Corrupted Village#026.src: Report back to Orikal about your observations.

The Corrupted Village#027.src: That was quick... did you find anything?
The Corrupted Village#027.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#028.src: Really, nothing? You didn't even feel anything?
The Corrupted Village#028.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#029.src: How can it be just a spike? It must be spreading corruption somehow.
The Corrupted Village#029.dst: 어떻게 그냥 가시일 수 있죠? 어떻게든 타락을 퍼뜨리고 있을 텐데.
The Corrupted Village#029.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#030.src: Then perhaps my second theory was correct. I will have to send you underground.
The Corrupted Village#030.dst: 그럼 두 번째 가설이 맞나 봐요. 당신을 지하로 보내야겠어요.
The Corrupted Village#030.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#031.src: There are old cave systems around here from the mining days. I sent two men down to excavate the spike, can you go down and help?
The Corrupted Village#031.dst: 이 근처엔 채광 시절의 오래된 동굴이 있어요. 가시를 파내라고 두 사람을 보냈는데, 내려가서 도와줄래요?
The Corrupted Village#031.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#032.src: The entrance is a little to the northeast. In fact, you should have passed it on your way to the spike.
The Corrupted Village#032.dst: 입구는 북동쪽으로 조금 가면 있어요. 사실 가시로 가는 길에 지나쳤을 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#032.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#033.src: Find the excavators inside the nearby cave to the northeast at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#033.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}], 북동쪽 근처 동굴 안에서 굴착꾼들을 찾으세요.

The Corrupted Village#034.src: Find the excavators inside the cave.

The Corrupted Village#035.src: This is insane, why are we here?! We're looking for corruption you know that right?
The Corrupted Village#035.dst: 미친 짓이야, 우리가 왜 여기 있어?! 우리 타락을 찾고 있는 거 알지?
The Corrupted Village#035.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#036.src: Calm down. All we have to do is keep digging. Besides, he did say he'd pay us a lot, so stop being mad.
The Corrupted Village#036.dst: 진정해. 계속 파기만 하면 돼. 게다가 돈 많이 준다고 했잖아, 그만 화내.
The Corrupted Village#036.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#037.src: Forget it, I don't care anymore, just prime the explosive and get clear of the blast!
The Corrupted Village#037.dst: 됐어, 이제 신경 안 써. 폭약 장전하고 폭발 범위에서 벗어나!
The Corrupted Village#037.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#038.src: Well, that did the trick. Let's take a look.
The Corrupted Village#038.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#040.src: It almost looks like a giant spike... Woah. How deep does this thing go?
The Corrupted Village#040.dst: 거대한 가시처럼 보이는데... 와. 이거 얼마나 깊이 박힌 거야?
The Corrupted Village#040.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#041.src: Well, you know what? We did our job, so honestly I don't care. Let's get out of he-
The Corrupted Village#041.dst: 있잖아, 우린 할 일 했으니 솔직히 상관없어. 여기서 나가-
The Corrupted Village#041.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#042.src: Orikal? We're done! Pay up! I want out. This place is getting to me.
The Corrupted Village#042.dst: Orikal? 다 끝났어! 돈 내놔! 난 빠질래. 이곳은 사람을 미치게 해.
The Corrupted Village#042.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#043.src: I came when I heard the explosion. I thought you'd hurt yourselves.
The Corrupted Village#043.dst: 폭발 소리 듣고 왔어요. 다친 줄 알았네요.
The Corrupted Village#043.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#044.src: Well, I'll be darned. The spike goes this far down? And it looks like it goes even deeper than this!
The Corrupted Village#044.dst: 이럴 수가. 가시가 여기까지 내려와? 게다가 더 깊이 이어지는 것 같아요!
The Corrupted Village#044.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#045.src: Well, I don't know about you, but I say we blow it to shreds! That oughta get rid of this spike!
The Corrupted Village#045.dst: 너희는 모르겠지만, 난 산산조각 내자고 하겠어! 그럼 이 가시도 없어지겠지!
The Corrupted Village#045.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#046.src: For once, I agree. I'll do it, you guys just get clear.
The Corrupted Village#046.dst: 이번만은 동의해요. 내가 할 테니 다들 물러나요.
The Corrupted Village#046.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#047.src: ...Wow, that did nothing. We're going to need something MUCH more powerful than TNT...
The Corrupted Village#047.dst: ...와, 아무 소용 없네요. TNT보다 훨씬 강한 게 필요하겠어요...
The Corrupted Village#047.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#048.src: Oh yeah? And just what would you have in mind?
The Corrupted Village#048.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#049.src: Well, it's sorta complicated. That's why I've decided to give our new friend here the job of acquiring this explosive.
The Corrupted Village#049.dst: 음, 좀 복잡해요. 그래서 그 폭약을 구하는 일은 여기 새 친구한테 맡기기로 했죠.
The Corrupted Village#049.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#050.src: Oh yeah, we were so busy with this spike, we forgot to address you! Sorry about that.
The Corrupted Village#050.dst: 아 맞다, 가시에 정신 팔려서 인사도 못 했네! 미안해.
The Corrupted Village#050.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#051.src: Well if you don't need us anymore then we'll just be on our way... WITH our money! So hand it over please.
The Corrupted Village#051.dst: 이제 우리 필요 없으면 갈게... 돈은 챙겨서! 그러니 내놔.
The Corrupted Village#051.speaker: Alfonse

The Corrupted Village#052.src: Alright, fine. Here's your pay. Thank you for your help.
The Corrupted Village#052.dst: 좋아요, 알았어요. 여기 보수예요. 도와줘서 고마워요.
The Corrupted Village#052.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#053.src: Gah! That's hardly anything! I'm not even surprised. Let's just go.
The Corrupted Village#053.dst: 으! 이게 뭐야, 쥐꼬리잖아! 놀랍지도 않다. 그냥 가자.
The Corrupted Village#053.speaker: Roy

The Corrupted Village#054.src: Anyway, come meet me back at my tent, friend. We will discuss what to do then.
The Corrupted Village#054.dst: 아무튼 친구, 내 천막으로 와요. 거기서 어떻게 할지 얘기하죠.
The Corrupted Village#054.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#055.src: Exit the cave and speak to Orikal in his tent about his plan for destroying the spike.
The Corrupted Village#055.dst: 동굴을 나와 천막에 있는 Orikal과 가시 파괴 계획에 대해 대화하세요.

The Corrupted Village#056.src: Okay. I happen to know a recipe for creating an extremely lethal magical explosive.
The Corrupted Village#056.dst: 좋아요. 마침 엄청나게 치명적인 마법 폭약 제조법을 알고 있어요.
The Corrupted Village#056.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#057.src: There are {~} main ingredients you will need to get me: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and a [Switch Fuse] to activate it.
The Corrupted Village#057.dst: 필요한 주재료는 {~}가지예요: [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], 그리고 작동시킬 [Switch Fuse].
The Corrupted Village#057.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#058.src: There used to be a small mining camp a little east of this town. It's abandoned now, but you should still be able to find what you need there.
The Corrupted Village#058.dst: 이 마을 동쪽에 작은 채광 야영지가 있었어요. 지금은 버려졌지만 필요한 건 찾을 수 있을 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#058.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#059.src: It's not the big ol' abandoned mines, mind you. It's a smaller camp, in fact you should be able to see it from this village.
The Corrupted Village#059.dst: 그 커다란 버려진 광산 말고요. 더 작은 야영지인데, 사실 이 마을에서도 보일 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#059.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#060.src: Best of luck! Oh, and also, try not to die please. These ingredients do indeed promote environmental hazards.
The Corrupted Village#060.dst: 행운을 빌어요! 아, 그리고 제발 죽지 마요. 이 재료들은 정말로 주변을 위험하게 만들거든요.
The Corrupted Village#060.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#061.src: Find [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], and [Switch Fuse] for the TNT at the mining camp at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Corrupted Village#061.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 채광 야영지에서 TNT에 쓸 [Stabilized Corrupted Ore], [Incendiary Fluid], [Switch Fuse]를 찾으세요.

The Corrupted Village#062.src: You got 'em all! Excellent, this is exactly what we need.
The Corrupted Village#062.dst: 다 구했네요! 훌륭해요, 딱 필요한 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#062.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#063.src: Alright, stand back. I have actually never made this before, so let's hope I don't cause a disaster.
The Corrupted Village#063.dst: 좋아요, 물러나요. 사실 이거 처음 만들어 보니까 사고 안 나길 빌어요.
The Corrupted Village#063.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#064.src: Phew, glad nothing tragic happened there. This should be it, now go take it back down to the spike and destroy it once and for all!
The Corrupted Village#064.dst: 휴, 끔찍한 일 없어서 다행이에요. 이거면 돼요, 가시로 가져가서 완전히 끝장내 줘요!
The Corrupted Village#064.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#065.src: Bring the explosive to the spike in the cave and use it to destroy the spike.
The Corrupted Village#065.dst: 폭약을 동굴 속 가시로 가져가 가시를 파괴하세요.

The Corrupted Village#066.src: Report to Orikal about your success.

The Corrupted Village#067.src: Oh, do you feel that? It's like a buzzing in my ears I never knew about has just vanished.
The Corrupted Village#067.dst: 아, 느껴져요? 몰랐던 귓가의 윙윙거림이 방금 사라진 것 같아요.
The Corrupted Village#067.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#068.src: I think that worked you know. It seems the power of the spike comes from the root...
The Corrupted Village#068.dst: 성공한 것 같아요. 가시의 힘은 뿌리에서 나오나 봐요...
The Corrupted Village#068.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#069.src: But what is it connected to? That's for another day. The main thing is the village is safe.
The Corrupted Village#069.dst: 그런데 뭐랑 연결된 걸까요? 그건 다음에 알아보죠. 중요한 건 마을이 안전하다는 거예요.
The Corrupted Village#069.speaker: Orikal

The Corrupted Village#070.src: Here, take this for your help. I found this potato in one of the houses around here, and I sure as heck don't want it!
The Corrupted Village#070.dst: 자, 도와준 보답이에요. 이 근처 집에서 찾은 감자인데, 난 정말 필요 없거든요!
The Corrupted Village#070.speaker: Orikal

The Cursed One#000.src: For all that the festival revolves around the crown, I've always appreciated its representation of our culture.
The Cursed One#000.dst: 축제가 왕실 중심으로 돌아가긴 해도, 우리 문화를 보여 준다는 점은 늘 좋았어요.

The Cursed One#001.src: Good job friend! You showed those mudkins!
