The Cursed One#445.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#446.src: Ha! It's alright. Neither have I.
The Cursed One#446.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#447.src: Every year... every single year, the crown hosts these festivals. Starting here, and moving around in a ring around the province.
The Cursed One#447.dst: 해마다... 한 해도 빠짐없이 왕실은 이런 축제를 열어요. 여기서 시작해서 지방을 한 바퀴 돌죠.
The Cursed One#447.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#448.src: The festival's a holiday, a day of rest, of celebration. What a gift it is, not needing to work for a time! How generous.
The Cursed One#448.dst: 축제는 휴일이에요, 쉬고 기념하는 날. 잠시 일을 안 해도 되다니 이 얼마나 큰 선물인가요! 참 너그럽기도 하지.
The Cursed One#448.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#449.src: I can't stand it here... Every year, I convince myself I can bear it. The reminder it brings, of memories long passed. Every year, I'm proven wrong.
The Cursed One#449.dst: 여긴 견딜 수가 없어요... 해마다 견딜 수 있다고 스스로를 설득해요. 오래전 기억을 떠올리게 하니까. 그리고 해마다 틀렸다는 걸 알게 되죠.
The Cursed One#449.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#450.src: ...Ah. It's time. The main event is about to begin.
The Cursed One#450.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#451.src: Why, Her Majesty's annual speech, of course! It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown if she didn't make an appearance, would it?
The Cursed One#451.dst: 물론 여왕 폐하의 연례 연설이죠! 여왕이 모습을 안 드러내면 왕관 축제라고 할 수 없잖아요?
The Cursed One#451.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#452.src: Ha! No, no. Of course not. It wouldn't be a Festival of the Crown without a speech from Her Majesty herself, would it?
The Cursed One#452.dst: 하! 아뇨, 아뇨. 당연히 아니죠. 여왕 폐하가 직접 연설하지 않으면 왕관 축제라고 할 수 없잖아요?
The Cursed One#452.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#453.src: Now... observe. Behold our enemy, take note of how she presents herself, what she says, what she doesn't say.
The Cursed One#453.dst: 자... 잘 봐요. 우리 적을 보고, 어떻게 자신을 내보이는지, 무슨 말을 하고 무슨 말을 안 하는지 눈여겨봐요.
The Cursed One#453.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#454.src: Ah... beloved people of the {p}! What a joy, what an honor it is to stand amongst you once again.
The Cursed One#454.dst: 아... 사랑하는 {p}의 백성 여러분! 다시 여러분 사이에 설 수 있다니 참으로 기쁘고 영광입니다.
The Cursed One#454.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#455.src: Some will claim the stunning {p} to be our most beautiful region, with its vibrant blossoming trees and grand historic castles...
The Cursed One#455.dst: 누군가는 화사하게 꽃 핀 나무와 웅장한 옛 성이 있는 {p}(이)야말로 가장 아름다운 지역이라 하겠지요...
The Cursed One#455.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#456.src: But I've always held a special regard for this place. The leaves and their warm shades, blowing in the soft breeze... all the woes of the world would be worth this sight.
The Cursed One#456.dst: 하지만 저는 늘 이곳을 각별히 여겨 왔습니다. 따스한 빛깔의 잎사귀가 산들바람에 흩날리는 모습... 세상의 모든 근심과도 바꿀 만한 풍경이지요.
The Cursed One#456.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#457.src: If I were able, perhaps I could stay here year-round! Ah, but alas... work in the Citadel keeps us all occupied!
The Cursed One#457.dst: 할 수만 있다면 일 년 내내 이곳에 머물고 싶군요! 아, 하지만 아쉽게도... 성채의 일이 우리 모두를 바쁘게 하니까요!
The Cursed One#457.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#458.src: We have many plans for the coming year. Increased imports from the other regions, easier access to travel for all, and additional openings in military positions!
The Cursed One#458.dst: 다가오는 해에도 계획이 많습니다. 다른 지역으로부터의 수입 확대, 모두를 위한 더 쉬운 이동, 그리고 군직 추가 모집까지!
The Cursed One#458.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#459.src: More will be revealed soon. Now, some words from your beloved Sovereign.
The Cursed One#459.dst: 곧 더 많은 걸 공개하겠습니다. 이제, 여러분이 사랑하는 군주의 말씀입니다.
The Cursed One#459.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#460.src: ...ah. The one thing I miscalculated. The mic height. Oh well- Testing, testing, one two three...
The Cursed One#460.dst: ...아. 내가 유일하게 잘못 계산한 것. 마이크 높이. 뭐 어때- 테스트, 테스트, 하나 둘 셋...
The Cursed One#460.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#461.src: Welcome one and all! I'm your Sovereign, Zhiraok. It's an honor to be here before you all again today.
The Cursed One#461.dst: 모두 환영합니다! 여러분의 군주, Zhiraok입니다. 오늘 다시 여러분 앞에 서게 되어 영광입니다.
The Cursed One#461.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#462.src: Two decades of work in the {p}. Twenty years. It feels like I've been here for so much longer this place, these people, really have become my home.
The Cursed One#462.dst: {p}에서 일한 지 이십 년. 스무 해입니다. 훨씬 더 오래 있었던 것 같네요 이곳, 이 사람들이 정말 제 집이 되었습니다.
The Cursed One#462.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#463.src: My duty is not just to serve the Crown, but also to serve you. To make your lives better, to raise this region we live in to new heights.
The Cursed One#463.dst: 제 의무는 왕실을 섬기는 것만이 아니라 여러분을 섬기는 것입니다. 여러분의 삶을 낫게 하고, 우리가 사는 이 지역을 새로운 높이로 끌어올리는 것.
The Cursed One#463.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#464.src: Whether that's by increasing production of Liff Leaves to share our resources and knowledge the province over, which we owe to your hard work...
The Cursed One#464.dst: 여러분의 노고 덕분에, Liff 잎 생산을 늘려 우리 자원과 지식을 지방 전역에 나누는 일이든...
The Cursed One#464.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#465.src: ...or through sharpening our infrastructure to exponentiate your quality of life, in thanks for what you do!
The Cursed One#465.dst: ...여러분의 노고에 보답하여, 기반 시설을 다듬어 삶의 질을 지수적으로 높이는 일이든!
The Cursed One#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#466.src: I'd be here all day listing the improvements over the last year, but I'll summarize Multiple major road improvements, countless new job opportunities, multiplying guard patrols to keep you safe...
The Cursed One#466.dst: 지난 한 해의 개선을 다 늘어놓으면 하루가 다 갈 테니 요약하겠습니다 주요 도로 여러 곳 개선, 셀 수 없는 새 일자리, 여러분의 안전을 위한 경비 순찰 배가...
The Cursed One#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#467.src: The place we came from twenty years ago is unrecognizable now. My vow is that twenty years ahead, I can say the same thing for how much more we, together, improve our home.
The Cursed One#467.dst: 이십 년 전 우리가 출발한 곳은 이제 알아볼 수도 없습니다. 제 맹세는, 이십 년 뒤에도 우리가 함께 우리 집을 얼마나 더 낫게 했는지 똑같이 말하는 것입니다.
The Cursed One#467.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#468.src: 'til the day we sum up to the grandeur of {p}- Thank you all! Enjoy the festivities!
The Cursed One#468.dst: 우리가 모여 {p}의 위엄에 이르는 그날까지- 모두 감사합니다! 축제를 즐기십시오!
The Cursed One#468.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#469.src: What fine work Sovereign Zhiraok has done for our province! Truly, there could have been no better choice to fill that role!
The Cursed One#469.dst: Zhiraok 군주가 우리 지방을 위해 참으로 훌륭히 일해 주었군요! 그 자리에 이보다 나은 선택은 없었을 겁니다!
The Cursed One#469.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#470.src: The {p} flourishes under his governance, and I could not be more pleased by the progress he has made.
The Cursed One#470.dst: {p}은(는) 그의 통치 아래 번영하고 있으며, 그가 이룬 발전에 저는 더없이 기쁩니다.
The Cursed One#470.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#471.src: One final message before we conclude. These past years, we have seen fewer and fewer reports of the cursed - a sign of our strength as a people.
The Cursed One#471.dst: 마치기 전에 마지막으로 전할 말이 있습니다. 지난 몇 년간 저주받은 자에 대한 보고가 점점 줄었습니다 - 우리 백성의 강인함을 보여 주는 징표지요.
The Cursed One#471.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#472.src: And it is all thanks to you! Your diligent reporting of suspicious activity makes all the difference in keeping our province safe.
The Cursed One#472.dst: 그리고 이는 모두 여러분 덕분입니다! 수상한 활동을 성실히 신고해 주신 덕에 우리 지방이 안전하게 지켜지고 있습니다.
The Cursed One#472.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#473.src: We must stand strong, together! We will not allow this evil its victory, we will not let our province fall like so many others have beyond our walls!
The Cursed One#473.dst: 우리는 함께 굳건히 서야 합니다! 이 악이 승리하게 두지 않을 것이며, 성벽 너머 수많은 곳처럼 우리 지방이 무너지게 두지 않을 것입니다!
The Cursed One#473.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#474.src: With that, let the celebrations begin!
The Cursed One#474.speaker: Her Majesty

The Cursed One#476.src: Did anything stand out to you?
The Cursed One#476.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#477.src: Indeed, it is. It's quite puzzling, isn't it? It's a sort of reverence she never displays elsewhere.
The Cursed One#477.dst: 맞아요. 꽤 알쏭달쏭하죠? 다른 데선 절대 보이지 않는 일종의 경외심이에요.
The Cursed One#477.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#478.src: And if there's one thing I'm certain she's being truthful about, it's this. Which only makes it all the stranger.
The Cursed One#478.dst: 그리고 여왕이 진실을 말한다고 확신하는 게 하나 있다면, 바로 이거예요. 그래서 더 이상하죠.
The Cursed One#478.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#479.src: Yes, yes... improvements. Life has improved since he ascended to that position. I'll give him that. He's invested in Auburn.
The Cursed One#479.dst: 그래요, 그래요... 개선이죠. 그가 그 자리에 오른 뒤로 삶이 나아진 건 인정해요. Auburn에 공을 들였죠.
The Cursed One#479.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#480.src: But he is still working under the crown. Don't forget that. For every improvement he has made, there's another he has left ignored.
The Cursed One#480.dst: 하지만 여전히 왕실 밑에서 일해요. 그걸 잊지 마요. 개선 하나를 할 때마다, 외면한 문제도 하나씩 있어요.
The Cursed One#480.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#481.src: No, I suppose they wouldn't. Better to leave the public unaware of such failures.
The Cursed One#481.dst: 아뇨, 그러진 않겠죠. 그런 실패는 대중이 모르는 게 낫다고 여길 테니.
The Cursed One#481.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#482.src: But rest assured that internally, they have not forgotten. They will keep searching for you.
The Cursed One#482.dst: 하지만 내부적으론 잊지 않았다고 확신해도 돼요. 계속 당신을 찾을 거예요.
The Cursed One#482.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#483.src: Yes... the cursed. The crown needs to keep the people afraid. If there's another enemy out there that the crown supposedly protects them from...
The Cursed One#483.dst: 그래요... 저주받은 자. 왕실은 백성이 계속 두려워하게 해야 해요. 왕실이 지켜 준다는 또 다른 적이 밖에 있다면...
The Cursed One#483.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#484.src: There's a reason they want people to believe the outside world is destroyed. Any contact could break the illusion.
The Cursed One#484.dst: 바깥세상이 멸망했다고 믿게 하려는 데는 이유가 있어요. 조금만 접촉해도 환상이 깨질 수 있으니까.
The Cursed One#484.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#485.src: They'll be closing out the festival soon... so, our work here is done. We should be leaving before the crowd thins enough for us to be spotted.
The Cursed One#485.dst: 곧 축제를 마무리할 거예요... 그러니 여기서 할 일은 끝났어요. 사람들이 흩어져 우리가 눈에 띄기 전에 떠나야 해요.
The Cursed One#485.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#486.src: I've scheduled a meeting for tomorrow I'd like for you to attend. It'll be about our next steps, now that the crown has moved on. I'll see you there.
The Cursed One#486.dst: 내일 회의를 잡았는데 당신도 와 줬으면 해요. 왕실이 떠났으니 다음 단계에 대한 회의예요. 거기서 봐요.
The Cursed One#486.speaker: Syndra

The Cursed One#488.src: I think I've had just about enough of people sneaking into my office. Care to knock next time?
The Cursed One#488.dst: 사람들이 내 집무실에 몰래 드나드는 건 이제 질렸어. 다음엔 노크 좀 해 줄래?
The Cursed One#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#489.src: Mmn. It's more interesting this way. I have news from the capital - your request for additional troops has been granted. Reassignments should come through by the end of the week.
The Cursed One#489.dst: 음. 이쪽이 더 재밌거든. 수도에서 소식이 왔어 - 병력 증원 요청이 승인됐어. 주말까지는 재배치가 이뤄질 거야.

The Cursed One#490.src: Well, that'll solve some problems. But that's not the whole message, is it? What obtuse remark has he got for me this time?
The Cursed One#490.dst: 뭐, 그럼 문제 몇 개는 풀리겠군. 근데 그게 전부는 아니지? 이번엔 그가 또 무슨 둔각 같은 소리를 했나?
The Cursed One#490.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#491.src: Merely a reminder to... "get your act together," as it were.

The Cursed One#492.src: Get my act toge That floundering fractal's developed less in his quadrant in a hundred-fifty years than I've done in two, in the last ten!
The Cursed One#492.dst: 정신 좀 차리 그 허우적대는 프랙탈은 자기 사분면에서 150년간, 내가 지난 10년 중 2년 동안 한 것보다도 발전을 못 했는데!
The Cursed One#492.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#493.src: I Ugh, focus, Z... He's not even here, don't let him get under your skin...
The Cursed One#493.dst: 나 으, 집중해, Z... 여기 있지도 않잖아, 신경 긁히게 두지 마...
The Cursed One#493.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#494.src: I'll get off that tangent. If that was all you had to say, it'd be a waste of your time. What do you need to say that a courier can't send in a letter?
The Cursed One#494.dst: 접선은 그만 타지. 그 말만 하러 왔다면 네 시간 낭비일 테고. 전령이 편지로 못 전할 말이 뭐야?
The Cursed One#494.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#495.src: The intruder. Does your administration believe it can get the situation under control?
The Cursed One#495.dst: 침입자. 네 행정부가 사태를 통제할 수 있다고 믿나?

The Cursed One#496.src: There it is. Listen, I've got their number, alright? There's no way in or out of the district where they won't be detected. We'll track them down.
The Cursed One#496.dst: 그 얘기군. 들어, 그놈 값은 이미 구했어, 알았어? 이 구역엔 들키지 않고 드나들 길이 없어. 추적해 낼 거야.
The Cursed One#496.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#497.src: Though unlike some people, my ego isn't so massive I can't recognize when an ally can be of use. Your types have an expertise here, so if you could spare a set or two of eyes it'd be much appreciated.
The Cursed One#497.dst: 그래도 누구와 달리 내 자존심은 동맹이 쓸모 있을 때를 못 알아볼 만큼 크진 않아. 그쪽이 이 분야 전문이니, 눈 한두 쌍만 빌려주면 정말 고맙겠어.
The Cursed One#497.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#498.src: I'll see what I can do. There happens to be an ongoing operation in the area already, we can discuss redirecting the agent once it's concluded.
The Cursed One#498.dst: 알아보지. 마침 이 지역에서 진행 중인 작전이 있으니, 끝나면 요원 재배치를 논의하자.

The Cursed One#499.src: One last thing- the identity of the intruder has been made clear to you already, yes?
The Cursed One#499.dst: 마지막으로- 침입자의 정체는 이미 분명히 전달됐겠지?

The Cursed One#500.src: Mhm. Like I said, I've got their number.
The Cursed One#500.dst: 음. 말했잖아, 그놈 값은 이미 구했다고.
The Cursed One#500.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Cursed One#501.src: Then you will understand Her Majesty's order not to speak of this ordeal to our newest. Ascension is a difficult process, and it would be... unwise to add additional distractions to it.
The Cursed One#501.dst: 그렇다면 이 일을 우리 최신 멤버에게 말하지 말라는 여왕 폐하의 명령도 이해하겠지. 승천은 힘든 과정이고, 거기에 방해 요소를 더하는 건... 현명하지 않아.

The Cursed One#502.src: Wouldn't want to distract a hard worker like him, right. But if that's everything, Spymaster? My to-do list is getting more added by the minute.
The Cursed One#502.dst: 그렇게 성실한 친구를 방해하면 안 되지, 그래. 근데 그게 다야, 첩보 대장? 내 할 일 목록이 분 단위로 늘고 있거든.
The Cursed One#502.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Dark Descent#000.src: Hello there, chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#000.dst: 반갑네, 친구! 옛 {p} 연대 사람을 이런 데서 볼 줄은 몰랐네.

The Dark Descent#001.src: I... there... too many... th-thousands, at... at least...
The Dark Descent#001.dst: 저... 저기... 너무 많습니다... 수, 수천... 적어도...

The Dark Descent#003.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace!
The Dark Descent#003.dst: 제발, 그만해요! 누군지 몰라도 나와 내 가족을 내버려 둬요!

The Dark Descent#004.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! I'm afraid they have already joined me, down below.
The Dark Descent#004.dst: 아, 좀 더 일찍 말하지 그랬느냐! 안타깝게도 그들은 이미 저 아래에서 나와 함께 있구나.

The Dark Descent#005.src: Y-you... I thought they... oh, gods, no...
The Dark Descent#005.dst: 다, 당신... 그들이... 오, 신들이시여, 안 돼...

The Dark Descent#006.src: Hush, now. You and your family will make fine additions to my legion.
The Dark Descent#006.dst: 쉿, 조용히. 너와 네 가족은 내 군단의 훌륭한 일원이 될 게다.

The Dark Descent#007.src: Wha... you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone!
The Dark Descent#007.dst: 뭐... 그 말은... 아, 안 돼요, 제발! 아무도 해치고 싶지 않아요!

The Dark Descent#008.src: How naive. Fear not. You will rise again, and then you will serve my purpose.
The Dark Descent#008.dst: 순진하구나. 두려워 마라. 넌 다시 일어나 내 뜻을 받들게 될 게다.

The Dark Descent#010.src: How easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master?
The Dark Descent#010.dst: 이곳이 얼마나 쉽게 무너졌는지? 내가 얼마나 빨리 주인이 됐는지?

The Dark Descent#011.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think to enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
The Dark Descent#011.dst: 지상에서도 간신히 막아 내는 주제에, 내 영역에 들어와 저승에서 나에게 도전하겠다고?

The Dark Descent#012.src: So enter the mouth of my skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
The Dark Descent#012.dst: 그러니 내 해골의 입으로 들어오너라, 병사여. 땅 밑으로 내려오거라. 다음 만남이 기대되는구나, 크헤헤헤...

The Dark Descent#013.src: Looks like the only way to go is into the skull...
The Dark Descent#013.dst: 해골 안으로 들어가는 것 말고는 길이 없는 것 같다...

The Dark Descent#014.src: You were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#014.dst: 자네는 노망난 할멈처럼 비틀거리고, 눈은 크림처럼 허옇고, Charon인가 뭔가를 계속 중얼거렸다네.

The Dark Descent#015.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a success!
The Dark Descent#015.dst: 그자가 자네를 한 바퀴 끌고 다녔나 보군? 뭐, 확실히 죽지는 않았으니, 이번 작전은 성공이라 해도 되겠네!

The Dark Descent#016.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#016.dst: 준비되면 깊은 곳으로 내려가는 원정에 함께해 주게. 그러면 정말 기쁘겠네, 친구!

The Dark Descent#017.src: How foolish. You might think you are strong, adventurer, but you have no idea what you are about to face...
The Dark Descent#017.dst: 어리석구나. 스스로 강하다 여길지 모르나, 모험가여, 네가 무엇과 맞서게 될지 전혀 모르는구나...

The Dark Descent#018.src: Simply marvellous work, chap! You've made it this far, so no time to fill your boots. Be prepared, we are about to fight Charon's undead army.
The Dark Descent#018.dst: 정말 훌륭했네, 친구! 여기까지 왔으니 방심할 때가 아닐세. 각오하게, 이제 Charon의 언데드 군대와 싸울 걸세.

The Dark Descent#019.src: We've lost a lot of good men on the way here, but I believe we can still throw a heavy punch.
The Dark Descent#019.dst: 여기까지 오는 길에 좋은 병사를 많이 잃었지만, 아직 한 방 세게 먹일 수 있다고 믿네.

The Dark Descent#020.src: You've earned a lot of respect from the boys this fight, better than all of us I'd say. For this fight, I'll let you direct the army.
The Dark Descent#020.dst: 이번 싸움에서 자네는 병사들에게 큰 존경을 얻었네. 감히 말하지만 우리 누구보다 낫더군. 이번 싸움에선 자네가 군대를 지휘하게.

The Dark Descent#021.src: Don't take it as a promotion though, old bean. It's only for this fight, although you'll be getting a medal of valor if I can wangle it! Charon's army is remarkably strong, we need as much help as we can get.
The Dark Descent#021.dst: 그렇다고 승진이라 생각하진 말게, 친구. 이번 싸움에만 해당하네. 물론 내가 잘 손써 보면 무공 훈장도 받게 될 걸세! Charon의 군대는 놀랄 만큼 강하니, 받을 수 있는 도움은 다 받아야 하네.

The Dark Descent#022.src: Aey- careful now, {u}, the cretin must be lurking around here somewhere.
The Dark Descent#022.dst: 어이- 조심하게, {u}. 그 비열한 놈이 이 근처 어딘가에 숨어 있을 걸세.

The Dark Descent#023.src: I see you've brought aid, you aren't as foolish as I thought.

The Dark Descent#024.src: Tell me, how do you plan to defeat an army that cannot die!?
The Dark Descent#024.dst: 말해 보거라, 죽지 않는 군대를 어떻게 물리칠 셈이냐!?

The Dark Descent#026.src: Aha, chap! Wonderful, the {p} regiment's gotten its representative down 'ere. All rested up, I suppose, so let me give you an earful.
The Dark Descent#026.dst: 아하, 친구! 훌륭하군, {p} 연대의 대표가 여기까지 내려왔구먼. 푹 쉬었을 테니, 할 얘기를 잔뜩 해 주지.

The Dark Descent#027.src: Those blighting zombies are all over the place. I tell ya, this skull's been giving the folk in {p} the collywobbles. Just as I thought, they're all coming from here.
The Dark Descent#027.dst: 그 망할 좀비들이 사방에 널렸네. 내 말하는데, 이 해골 때문에 {p} 사람들이 벌벌 떨고 있다네. 생각했던 대로, 놈들은 전부 여기서 나오고 있어.

The Dark Descent#028.src: Now, I don't wish to alarm you old bean, but I believe we are in front of the literal gates to hell.
The Dark Descent#028.dst: 자, 겁주려는 건 아니지만, 친구, 우린 지금 말 그대로 지옥의 문 앞에 서 있는 것 같네.

The Dark Descent#029.src: Not to worry chuck! Don't look so glum, I've called for aid from the nearby towns. Once they get here we'll give them a good kicking, and you've already gotten out of there before, ain't ya?
The Dark Descent#029.dst: 걱정 말게, 친구! 그렇게 울상 짓지 말고. 근처 마을에 지원을 요청해 뒀네. 그들이 오면 놈들을 호되게 혼내 주자고. 게다가 자넨 전에도 거기서 빠져나온 적이 있지 않나?

The Dark Descent#030.src: Now is finally our chance to take down his army... It will be a jolly difficult battle, knowing our opponent and what he's managed, even away from his lair.
The Dark Descent#030.dst: 드디어 그자의 군대를 무너뜨릴 기회일세... 상대가 누군지, 소굴 밖에서도 무슨 짓을 해냈는지 생각하면 무척 힘든 싸움이 되겠지.

The Dark Descent#031.src: Still, early days to say what he could be like in person! I'll take another route, but we'll meet in front of his door, right after crossing the river. Good luck, old bean!
The Dark Descent#031.dst: 그래도 그자가 직접 어떨지는 아직 모르는 일이지! 난 다른 길로 가겠네. 강을 건너자마자 그자의 문 앞에서 만나세. 행운을 비네, 친구!

The Dark Descent#033.src: I have an entire undead army at my service. Do you really think you stand a chance?
The Dark Descent#033.dst: 내 휘하에는 언데드 군대 전체가 있다. 정말 승산이 있다고 생각하나?

The Dark Descent#035.src: Ah, hello there chap! I must say, I didn't expect to see a part of the old {p} regiment over 'ere.
The Dark Descent#035.dst: 아, 반갑네, 친구! 옛 {p} 연대 사람을 이런 데서 볼 줄은 몰랐네.
The Dark Descent#035.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#036.src: I am General Graken, leader of the {p} militia. Charmed to meet you!
The Dark Descent#036.dst: 나는 {p} 민병대를 이끄는 Graken 장군일세. 만나서 반갑네!
The Dark Descent#036.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#037.src: You've seen all the bloody zombies faffing about everywhere, yes? They're all seeming to come from this massive skull.
The Dark Descent#037.dst: 사방에서 어슬렁대는 망할 좀비들 봤겠지? 전부 저 거대한 해골에서 나오는 것 같네.
The Dark Descent#037.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#038.src: I'm putting together a crack team for an expedition inside, but we haven't got any bleedin' idea what's down there!
The Dark Descent#038.dst: 안으로 들어갈 정예 원정대를 꾸리는 중인데, 저 아래 뭐가 있는지 도통 모르겠네!
The Dark Descent#038.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#039.src: If you're up for it, chap, we could absolutely do with some recon 'round the old town, look for clues and the like.
The Dark Descent#039.dst: 자네만 괜찮다면, 옛 마을을 정찰하며 단서 같은 걸 좀 찾아 주면 정말 고맙겠네.
The Dark Descent#039.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#040.src: I took a gander earlier, and one of the ol' houses caught my eye - it had a bloomin' great skull right over the door!
The Dark Descent#040.dst: 아까 둘러봤는데, 낡은 집 하나가 눈에 띄더군. 문 바로 위에 큼지막한 해골이 달려 있었네!
The Dark Descent#040.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#041.src: I didn't have time to look in proper, but I'd start the investigation there, chap.
The Dark Descent#041.dst: 제대로 볼 틈은 없었지만, 나라면 거기서부터 조사를 시작하겠네.
The Dark Descent#041.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#042.src: It's just south of here. The house still had solid wood boarding in it, despite the age, so look lively, chum!
The Dark Descent#042.dst: 여기서 바로 남쪽일세. 오래됐는데도 판자가 아직 튼튼하니, 정신 바짝 차리게!
The Dark Descent#042.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#044.src: Oh, sod it, I knew I was forgetting something! Steady there, chum! I'm on my way!
The Dark Descent#044.dst: 아이고, 뭔가 잊은 게 있더라니! 버티게, 친구! 지금 가네!
The Dark Descent#044.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#045.src: Drat! Too late, it seems. Yes, I forgot to mention the floor was in poor condition. Up here! You took quite the tumble, are you alright?
The Dark Descent#045.dst: 이런! 늦은 모양이군. 그래, 바닥 상태가 엉망이라는 말을 깜빡했네. 여기 위일세! 제대로 굴러떨어졌는데, 괜찮은가?
The Dark Descent#045.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#046.src: Well, there's some good news, I suppose. Still though, seems I sent you a ticket to a bit of a sticky wicket! Do you see a way out anywhere down there?
The Dark Descent#046.dst: 뭐, 좋은 소식도 있긴 하군. 그래도 자네를 꽤 곤란한 데로 보내 버린 것 같네! 거기 아래 나갈 길이 보이나?
The Dark Descent#046.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#047.src: There's a tunnel? Aha, spiffing! I suggest you take it immediately. I'll have to return to my post now, post-haste!
The Dark Descent#047.dst: 터널이 있다고? 아하, 훌륭하군! 당장 그리로 가게. 난 이제 서둘러 내 자리로 돌아가야겠네!
The Dark Descent#047.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#048.src: Good luck, chum! Now, back, you cads! Back I say!
The Dark Descent#048.dst: 행운을 비네, 친구! 자, 물러서라, 이 악당들아! 물러서라니까!
The Dark Descent#048.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#049.src: Keheh... Come further, little human... Step into the shadows...
The Dark Descent#049.dst: 크헤헤... 더 들어오너라, 작은 인간아... 그림자 속으로 발을 들여라...

The Dark Descent#050.src: Explore the tunnel in the basement of the house.

The Dark Descent#053.src: Scout! Report your findings, immediately! How many corrupteds are coming?
The Dark Descent#053.dst: 척후병! 당장 보고해라! 타락한 놈들이 얼마나 오고 있나?
The Dark Descent#053.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#054.dst: 저... 저기... 너무 많습니다... 수, 수천... 적어도...
The Dark Descent#054.speaker: Scout

The Dark Descent#055.src: Thousands...? This is far worse than I expected. Men! Prepare for-
The Dark Descent#055.dst: 수천...? 예상보다 훨씬 심각하군. 전원! 전투 준비-
The Dark Descent#055.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#057.src: Wait, w-what's going on? What's happening to you?!
The Dark Descent#057.dst: 잠깐, 무, 무슨 일이지? 너 왜 그러는 거야?!
The Dark Descent#057.speaker: Soldier

The Dark Descent#058.src: Please, stop this! Whoever you are, leave me and my family in peace! What did we ever do to deserve this?!
The Dark Descent#058.dst: 제발, 그만해요! 누군지 몰라도 나와 내 가족을 내버려 둬요! 우리가 대체 뭘 잘못했다고 이래요?!
The Dark Descent#058.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#059.src: Ah, but if you had only said so sooner! They have already left this mortal coil...oh, what a shame.
The Dark Descent#059.dst: 아, 좀 더 일찍 말하지 그랬느냐! 그들은 이미 이승을 떠났는데... 오, 참 안됐구나.

The Dark Descent#060.dst: 다, 당신... 그들이... 오, 신이여, 안 돼...
The Dark Descent#060.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#061.src: Hush now. I will ensure that you and your family are reunited. You will even be able to partake in...keheh...family outings, under my watchful eye...
The Dark Descent#061.dst: 쉿, 조용히. 너와 네 가족을 반드시 다시 만나게 해 주마. 내 눈길 아래서... 크헤헤... 가족 나들이도 즐길 수 있을 게다...

The Dark Descent#062.src: Wha...you mean... N-no, please! I don't want to hurt anyone! I don't want to die!!
The Dark Descent#062.dst: 뭐... 그 말은... 아, 안 돼요, 제발! 아무도 해치고 싶지 않아요! 죽고 싶지 않아요!!
The Dark Descent#062.speaker: Lost Soul

The Dark Descent#063.src: Aha, naive girl. How cute, you believe you have a choice in the matter. What you want, is not what I need.
The Dark Descent#063.dst: 아하, 순진한 아가씨. 선택권이 있다고 믿다니 귀엽구나. 네가 원하는 건 내게 필요한 게 아니다.

The Dark Descent#065.src: Do you see how easily this place fell? How quickly I became its master? And how I could simply dispose of you without a second thought?
The Dark Descent#065.dst: 이곳이 얼마나 쉽게 무너졌는지 보이느냐? 내가 얼마나 빨리 주인이 됐는지? 너 따위는 생각할 것도 없이 치워 버릴 수 있다는 것도?

The Dark Descent#066.src: Hundreds slaughtered in mere moments... only to rise again as my soldiers in infinite amounts.
The Dark Descent#066.dst: 눈 깜짝할 새 수백이 도륙당했다... 끝없는 내 병사로 다시 일어서기 위해서.

The Dark Descent#067.src: You can barely keep them at bay on the surface, and yet you think you can enter my own domain, to challenge me in the Underworld?
The Dark Descent#067.dst: 지상에서도 간신히 막아 내는 주제에, 내 영역에 들어와 저승에서 나에게 도전할 수 있다고 생각하느냐?

The Dark Descent#068.src: You will fail, and I will be free to string your body up like a puppet and make you dance for me.
The Dark Descent#068.dst: 너는 실패할 것이고, 나는 네 몸을 꼭두각시처럼 매달아 내 앞에서 춤추게 할 것이다.

The Dark Descent#069.src: So enter the mouth of the skull, soldier, make your way below the ground. I look forward to our next meeting, keheheh...
The Dark Descent#069.dst: 그러니 해골의 입으로 들어오너라, 병사여. 땅 밑으로 내려오거라. 다음 만남이 기대되는구나, 크헤헤헤...

The Dark Descent#071.src: Return the ruby to Graken at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Dark Descent#072.src: Return to your world, now. And if you still want to challenge me... I'll be waiting.
The Dark Descent#072.dst: 이제 네 세계로 돌아가라. 그래도 내게 도전하고 싶다면... 기다리고 있으마.

The Dark Descent#073.src: Hey! Come on, come over here! Quit milling about with the zombies, chap!
The Dark Descent#073.dst: 이봐! 어서, 이리 오게! 좀비들이랑 어슬렁대지 말고, 친구!
The Dark Descent#073.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#074.src: Oi! Hallo?! Chum? Why're you wandering round all bog-eyed? Come back to me now!
The Dark Descent#074.dst: 어이! 여보게?! 친구? 왜 멍한 눈으로 헤매고 있나? 어서 정신 차리게!
The Dark Descent#074.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#075.src: Come on, pip pip! Let's see a bit more colour in your eyes- There we are! Back now, chap?
The Dark Descent#075.dst: 자, 힘내게! 눈에 생기가 좀 돌아야지- 옳지! 돌아왔나, 친구?
The Dark Descent#075.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#076.src: Capital! You had me quite worried for a spot, there. Do bubble about just what went on down there, mm?
The Dark Descent#076.dst: 훌륭해! 잠깐 꽤 걱정했다네. 거기 아래서 무슨 일이 있었는지 얘기 좀 해 보게, 응?
The Dark Descent#076.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#077.src: But, you were stumbling about like a senile biddy, eyes blank as cream, and you kept muttering something about a Charon.
The Dark Descent#077.dst: 그런데 자네는 노망난 할멈처럼 비틀거리고, 눈은 크림처럼 허옇고, Charon인가 뭔가를 계속 중얼거렸다네.
The Dark Descent#077.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#078.src: I'm supposing he was the one who took you for a spin there? Well, you certainly haven't carked it, so I might call this operation a jolly good success!
The Dark Descent#078.dst: 그자가 자네를 한 바퀴 끌고 다녔나 보군? 뭐, 확실히 죽지는 않았으니, 이번 작전은 대성공이라 해도 되겠네!
The Dark Descent#078.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#079.src: Your discoveries fit in jolly-well with what we already know - and I'm convinced. To stop all these bleedin' zombos, we're going to have to go down under.
The Dark Descent#079.dst: 자네가 알아낸 건 우리가 아는 것과 딱 맞아떨어지네. 확신이 섰어. 이 망할 좀비들을 막으려면 지하로 내려가야 하네.
The Dark Descent#079.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#080.src: Preliminary expeditions have brought back some real nasty bits, brains and such - but also some fancy-as-you-like jewellery!
The Dark Descent#080.dst: 선발 원정대가 뇌 같은 아주 고약한 것들을 가져왔지만, 꽤 근사한 장신구도 가져왔다네!
The Dark Descent#080.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#081.src: Take some with you, remind you what we're up against. But keep your eyes on the prize!
The Dark Descent#081.dst: 몇 개 가져가게. 우리가 뭘 상대하는지 잊지 않도록. 하지만 목표에서 눈을 떼지 말게!
The Dark Descent#081.speaker: General Graken

The Dark Descent#082.src: When you're ready, I'd be chuffed to have you along again in the expedition down into the depths, old bean!
The Dark Descent#082.dst: 준비되면 깊은 곳으로 내려가는 원정에 다시 함께해 주게. 그러면 정말 기쁘겠네, 친구!
The Dark Descent#082.speaker: General Graken

The Envoy Part I#000.src: It's an independant island to the west. In fact... If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#000.dst: 서쪽에 있는 독립된 섬이에요. 사실... 가 보고 싶다면...

The Envoy Part I#001.src: The boat is down at the dock.

The Envoy Part I#002.src: It's really hard to miss. Just hop on!
The Envoy Part I#002.dst: 못 보고 지나칠 수가 없어요. 그냥 타요!

The Envoy Part I#003.src: And don't get me sterted on our architectur'!

The Envoy Part I#004.src: Mo'in, Wynn traveller! Come speak to me.
The Envoy Part I#004.dst: Mo'in, Wynn의 여행자! 이리 와서 얘기해요.

The Envoy Part I#005.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#005.dst: 북쪽에선 무기와 물약을 살 수 있어요. 관문을 지나 계속 가면 원주민 Avos를 만나게 돼요.

The Envoy Part I#006.src: West, you can buy armour, and there is another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#006.dst: 서쪽에선 방어구를 살 수 있고, 물약 상점으로 가는 입구도 하나 더 있어요.

The Envoy Part I#007.src: Something is going on at the diner, you should hurry.
The Envoy Part I#007.dst: 식당에서 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있어요, 서둘러요.

The Envoy Part I#008.src: Psst! You! Over here, behind the logs!

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you!

The Envoy Part I#010.src: The diner is being raided by mechs...

The Envoy Part I#011.src: You don't know, huh? Of course you don't. Let me explain.

The Envoy Part I#012.src: The name's Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#012.dst: 그런데 내 이름은 Maxie예요. 만나서 반가워요.

The Envoy Part I#013.src: This town is usually full of life...

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Look... I know you're a stranger, but... If you want to help, talk to me.
The Envoy Part I#014.dst: 저기... 외지인인 건 알지만... 돕고 싶다면 나한테 말해요.

The Envoy Part I#015.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic...

The Envoy Part I#016.dst: 안 돼... 다, 다시 해 볼게요..!

The Envoy Part I#018.src: Look, I-I'm sorry for slowing you down. It's just...
The Envoy Part I#018.dst: 저, 저기, 발목 잡아서 미안해요. 그냥...

The Envoy Part I#019.src: Oh, two paths. Well, I'm not sure which way it is, so let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#019.dst: 아, 길이 두 개네요. 어느 쪽인지 모르겠으니 나눠서 가요. 난 오른쪽으로 갈게요.

The Envoy Part I#020.src: Mo'in. Sorry, had a problem with the-

The Envoy Part I#022.src: Don't worry about the guards, they're disabled for now. Follow me!
The Envoy Part I#022.dst: 경비병은 걱정 마요, 지금은 작동을 멈췄어요. 따라와요!

The Envoy Part I#023.src: We saw a mech… A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#023.dst: 기계병을 봤어요... 새 기계병을! 달라 보였어요, 마치 거기서 만든-

The Envoy Part I#024.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by themselves.
The Envoy Part I#024.dst: 우리 손님이... 혼자서 Despermech 여럿을 해치웠어요.

The Envoy Part I#025.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#025.dst: 레벨 {~}이 되면 우리 집으로 와요. 들어올 수 있게 열쇠 줄게요. 공장에 쳐들어갈 준비를 해야 해요.

The Envoy Part I#031.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#031.dst: 전 이 동네 사람이 아니에요. 사실 Corkus에서 왔어요.
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#032.src: It's an independent island to the west. In fact.. If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#032.dst: 서쪽에 있는 독립된 섬이에요. 사실.. 가 보고 싶다면...
The Envoy Part I#032.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#033.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#033.dst: Wynn의 대표를 찾고 있어요. Corkus를 경험하고 싶다면 부두의 C.S.S Wavebreaker로 가세요. 가게 되면 Corkus를 즐기세요!
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.
The Envoy Part I#034.dst: {p} 부두에서 C.S.S Wavebreaker 선장에게 말을 거세요.

The Envoy Part I#036.src: The only boat that'll take ye directly to {p}.
The Envoy Part I#036.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#037.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#039.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#039.dst: 내 배에 잘 왔네, Corkus까지 곧장 데려다주지.
The Envoy Part I#039.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#040.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#040.dst: 믿게, Gavel이나 Wynn보다 훨씬 굉장한 곳이야. 기계도 있다네!
The Envoy Part I#040.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#041.src: And don't get me started on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#041.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#042.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#045.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#045.dst: Wynn의 병사가 우리 섬을 찾아 주다니 큰 영광이에요.
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#046.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#046.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#047.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#048.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#048.dst: 우리가 처음 Corkus에 온 건 {~}년 전이에요.
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#049.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#049.dst: Corkus 사람들은 당신처럼 원래 Fruma 출신이에요...
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#051.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#051.dst: Fruma에서 왔으니, 당연히 마법은 전혀 몰랐죠.
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#052.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#052.dst: 곧 우리만의 마법을 발전시켰어요. 희귀한 전자기 마법의 힘이죠.
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#053.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#053.dst: 기계를 만들 수 있게 해 주는, 어려운 현대 마법 분야예요.
The Envoy Part I#053.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#054.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#054.dst: 아, 벌써 도착했네요. 우리 섬의 수도, {p}에 오신 걸 환영해요.
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#055.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#056.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#056.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#057.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you will continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#057.dst: 북쪽에선 무기와 물약을 살 수 있어요. 관문을 지나 계속 가면 원주민 Avos를 만날 거예요.
The Envoy Part I#057.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#058.src: West, you can buy armor, and another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#058.dst: 서쪽에선 방어구를 살 수 있고, 물약 상점 입구도 하나 더 있어요.
The Envoy Part I#058.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#059.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#059.dst: 남쪽에는 은행, 파우더 상점, 두루마리 상점, 그리고 우리만의 파우더 교환소가 있어요!
The Envoy Part I#059.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#060.dst: 아! 파우더 교환소 말이 나와서 말인데, 이걸 좀 드릴게요.
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#061.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#061.dst: 계속 가죠... 남쪽 관문은 {p}(으)로 이어져요. 가는 길에 지나칠 수도 있는 게-
The Envoy Part I#061.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#062.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#062.dst: 음, 아무것도 아니에요. 사실, 선물이 있어요.
The Envoy Part I#062.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#063.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#063.dst: The Five Gears Diner에서 섬의 손님들을 대접하고 있어요.
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#064.dst: 서쪽 관문을 지나 식당으로 가서 무료 만찬을 즐기세요!
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#065.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#065.dst: The Five Gears Diner 쪽으로 걸어가세요.

The Envoy Part I#069.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you.
The Envoy Part I#069.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#070.src: The diner is being raided by mechs..
The Envoy Part I#070.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#071.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#071.dst: 뭘 하기 전에, 여기서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 설명해야겠어요...
The Envoy Part I#071.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#072.src: My name is Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#072.dst: 그런데 내 이름은 Maxie예요. 만나서 반가워요.
The Envoy Part I#072.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#073.src: This town is usually full of life.
The Envoy Part I#073.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#077.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#077.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#078.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#078.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#079.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#079.dst: 없애 보려 했지만 공장이 계속 더 만들어 내요.
The Envoy Part I#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#080.dst: Corkus 최대의 실패예요. 반드시 막아야 해요.
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#082.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#083.dst: 외지인인 건 알지만, 돕고 싶다면 나한테 말해요.
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#086.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#086.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#088.dst: 으악! 가장 기본적인 주문도 못 하다니!
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#091.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#091.dst: 당신 앞에서 쓸모없는 모습만 보여서 미안해요...
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#092.src: Electromagic is different from your magic.. I'm not very good at it...
The Envoy Part I#092.dst: 전자기 마법은 당신들 마법과 달라요.. 난 별로 잘하지 못해요...
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#095.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.

The Envoy Part I#100.src: Mo'in. Sorry had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#100.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#101.src: ...What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?!
The Envoy Part I#101.dst: ...저기 고철 더미 위에 있는 기계병은 대체 뭐예요?!
The Envoy Part I#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#102.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#102.dst: 평범한 Despermech는 절대 아니에요... 새것처럼 보여요!
The Envoy Part I#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#103.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#103.dst: 공장이 돌아가던 시절 이후로 저런 건 본 적이 없어요...
The Envoy Part I#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#104.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#104.dst: 뭐라도 해야 해요! 길은 내가 뚫어 줄게요. 내가 할 수 있는 건 그것뿐이에요, 난... 다리를... 다쳤어요.
The Envoy Part I#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#108.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#108.dst: 괜찮아요? 다행이다. 우리가 만났던 입구에서 봐요. {p}에 보고해야 해요!
The Envoy Part I#108.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#109.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.
The Envoy Part I#109.dst: The Five Gears Diner 입구에서 Maxie에게 말을 거세요.

The Envoy Part I#110.src: Don't worry about the guards, they are disabled for now. Follow me.
The Envoy Part I#110.dst: 경비병은 걱정 마요, 지금은 작동을 멈췄어요. 따라와요.
The Envoy Part I#110.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#111.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#111.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#112.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.

The Envoy Part I#114.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
The Envoy Part I#114.dst: Beltrude, 문제가 생겼어요! 공장이 가동 중이에요!
The Envoy Part I#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#115.src: We saw a mech... A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#115.dst: 기계병을 봤어요... 새 기계병을! 달라 보였어요, 마치 거기서 만든-
The Envoy Part I#115.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#116.src: What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
The Envoy Part I#116.dst: 무슨 헛소리예요! 손님 앞에서 그런 얘기를 하면 안 되죠!
The Envoy Part I#116.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#117.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by himself.
The Envoy Part I#117.dst: 우리 손님이... 혼자서 Despermech 여럿을 해치웠어요.
The Envoy Part I#117.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#118.src: And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
The Envoy Part I#118.dst: 기본적인 전자기 마법도 못 하는 사람 말을 우리가 왜 믿어야 하죠?
The Envoy Part I#118.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#119.src: Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
The Envoy Part I#119.dst: Maxie 말은 듣지 마세요. 즐겁게 지내세요.
The Envoy Part I#119.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#120.src: They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#120.dst: 당신이 있으면 저 사람들은 아무것도 인정 안 할 거예요. Wynn과 동맹을 맺고 싶어 하거든요.
The Envoy Part I#120.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#121.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you can get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#121.dst: 레벨 {~}이 되면 우리 집으로 와요. 들어올 수 있게 열쇠 줄게요. 공장에 쳐들어갈 준비를 해야 해요.
The Envoy Part I#121.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#000.src: Try following the trail outside the castle, it might lead you to the key.
The Envoy Part II#000.dst: 성 밖의 흔적을 따라가 보자. 열쇠가 있는 곳으로 이어질지도 모른다.

The Envoy Part II#001.src: Just follow the road to the north to find my friend. Watch out, she doesn't like humans much.
The Envoy Part II#001.dst: 북쪽으로 난 길을 따라가면 내 친구를 찾을 수 있어. 조심해, 그녀는 인간을 별로 안 좋아하거든.

The Envoy Part II#002.src: You need the key before you leave!

The Envoy Part II#004.src: The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factory's operations.
The Envoy Part II#004.dst: 원래는 두 종족이 공장 운영에서 똑같은 역할을 맡는다는 구상이었어요.

The Envoy Part II#005.src: We need those keys to get in and shut down the factory once more.
The Envoy Part II#005.dst: 들어가서 공장을 다시 멈추려면 그 열쇠들이 필요해요.

The Envoy Part II#006.src: The Corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
The Envoy Part II#006.dst: Corkus 사람들은 열쇠를 쉽게 내주지 않을 테니, Avos부터 시작해요.

The Envoy Part II#007.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief, but... The border's closed due to tensions.
The Envoy Part II#007.dst: 족장에게 부탁하는 게 최선인데... 긴장 상태라 국경이 닫혔어요.

The Envoy Part II#008.src: Fortunately, there's a catapult that can help us in a village north-west of here. Let's meet there!
The Envoy Part II#008.dst: 다행히 여기서 북서쪽 마을에 도움이 될 투석기가 있어요. 거기서 만나요!

The Envoy Part II#009.src: I knew it! There was something here we could use!
The Envoy Part II#009.dst: 그럴 줄 알았어요! 쓸 만한 게 있었네요!

The Envoy Part II#010.src: I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you'll have to go alone.
The Envoy Part II#010.dst: 발사하려면 내가 전자기 마법을 써야 해서, 당신 혼자 가야 해요.

The Envoy Part II#013.src: I'm so jealous of the chief, he gets to live in the fanciest house on the hill!
The Envoy Part II#013.dst: 족장님이 너무 부러워, 언덕 위 제일 멋진 집에 살잖아!

The Envoy Part II#014.src: Hmm, no gears or goggles... You are no Corkian Human.
The Envoy Part II#014.dst: 흠, 톱니바퀴도 고글도 없고... 넌 Corkus 인간이 아니구나.

The Envoy Part II#015.src: We saw your battle with "Mech X" at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
The Envoy Part II#015.dst: 부두에서 "Mech X"와 싸우는 걸 위에서 봤네. 자네는 믿을 만한 것 같군.

The Envoy Part II#016.src: Can't you humans see I'm meditating?
The Envoy Part II#016.dst: 명상 중인 거 안 보이나, 인간들아?

The Envoy Part II#017.src: I don't see why we're helping humans...

The Envoy Part II#018.src: You should head back to Maxie with the key.

The Envoy Part II#019.src: Excellent! I'll hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
The Envoy Part II#019.dst: 좋아요! 일단 내가 보관할게요. 이제 Corkus 쪽 열쇠를 구하는 데 집중해요.

The Envoy Part II#020.src: They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I... I honestly don't know how to get in there.
The Envoy Part II#020.dst: 성 안 금고에 보관하고 있어요. 저... 솔직히 어떻게 들어가야 할지 모르겠어요.

The Envoy Part II#021.src: It's in the castle and to the right. There's {~} guards there at all times, you can't miss it.
The Envoy Part II#021.dst: 성 안에서 오른쪽이에요. 항상 경비병 {~}명이 지키고 있으니 못 찾을 리 없어요.

The Envoy Part II#022.src: Something has happened in the vault.

The Envoy Part II#023.src: Don't go in there, it's under control.

The Envoy Part II#024.src: The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow the trail.
The Envoy Part II#024.dst: 기계병들이 어째선지 농작물을 뒤집어쓰고 있어서 흔적이 잘 남았어요. 공장과 진심으로 싸울 생각이면 흔적을 따라가세요.

The Envoy Part II#025.src: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here...
The Envoy Part II#025.dst: Mo'in. 저 위에 저 사람 보여요? 내가 온 뒤로 꼼짝도 안 했어요...

The Envoy Part II#026.src: ...I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.

The Envoy Part II#028.src: That model was a S-{~}... It's warned the others. Let's go.
The Envoy Part II#028.dst: S-{~} 모델이었어요... 다른 놈들한테 알렸어요. 가요.

The Envoy Part II#030.src: You did?! Great! Now we need to meet at the factory. The real hard part begins.
The Envoy Part II#030.dst: 해냈어요?! 좋아요! 이제 공장에서 만나요. 진짜 어려운 건 지금부터예요.

The Envoy Part II#031.src: You hear a distant rumbling sound...

The Envoy Part II#032.src: An engraving on the pillar reads: Reunite three wise creatures to open the way.
The Envoy Part II#032.dst: 기둥에 새겨진 글: 지혜로운 세 생물을 다시 모으면 길이 열리리라.

The Envoy Part II#033.src: You dare intrude on me while I am sculpting?! You shall pay with your life!
The Envoy Part II#033.dst: 감히 내가 조각하는 중에 방해를 해?! 목숨으로 갚게 해 주마!

The Envoy Part II#034.src: Another miserable whelp has come to steal my knowledge? I won't let you!
The Envoy Part II#034.dst: 또 가련한 애송이가 내 지식을 훔치러 왔느냐? 그렇겐 안 된다!

The Envoy Part II#035.src: So... You've managed to make it past my family. Pathetic aren't they?
The Envoy Part II#035.dst: 그래서... 내 가족을 지나쳐 왔구나. 한심한 놈들이지?

The Envoy Part II#036.src: Let me show you a real challenge!

The Envoy Part II#037.src: Use Maxie's house key to enter Maxie's house
The Envoy Part II#037.dst: Maxie의 집 열쇠로 Maxie의 집에 들어가세요

The Envoy Part II#040.src: Talk to Maxie on the first floor.

The Envoy Part II#041.src: Mo'in. I've been researching everything I can about the factory.
The Envoy Part II#041.dst: Mo'in. 공장에 대해 알아낼 수 있는 건 다 조사하고 있었어요.
The Envoy Part II#041.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#042.src: To get in we need two keys. One from the Avos and one from Corkians.
The Envoy Part II#042.dst: 들어가려면 열쇠가 두 개 필요해요. 하나는 Avos, 하나는 Corkus 사람들에게 있어요.
The Envoy Part II#042.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#043.src: The idea was that both species had equal roles in the factories operantions.
The Envoy Part II#043.dst: 원래는 두 종족이 공장 운영에서 똑같은 역할을 맡는다는 구상이었어요.
The Envoy Part II#043.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#044.src: We need those keys in get in and shut down the factory once more.
The Envoy Part II#044.dst: 들어가서 공장을 다시 멈추려면 그 열쇠들이 필요해요.
The Envoy Part II#044.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#045.src: The corkians won't give up their key very easily, so we should start with the Avos.
The Envoy Part II#045.dst: Corkus 사람들은 열쇠를 쉽게 내주지 않을 테니, Avos부터 시작해요.
The Envoy Part II#045.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#046.src: Our best bet is to ask the chief. However, because of tensions the border is closed.
The Envoy Part II#046.dst: 족장에게 부탁하는 게 최선이에요. 하지만 긴장 상태라 국경이 닫혔어요.
The Envoy Part II#046.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#048.src: I knew it! There was something here we could use.
The Envoy Part II#048.dst: 그럴 줄 알았어요! 쓸 만한 게 있었네요.
The Envoy Part II#048.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#049.src: I'll have to use electromagic to make it launch, so you will have to go alone.
The Envoy Part II#049.dst: 발사하려면 내가 전자기 마법을 써야 해서, 당신 혼자 가야 해요.
The Envoy Part II#049.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#050.src: Find the Avos chief. Ask for the factory key.
The Envoy Part II#050.dst: Avos 족장을 찾아서 공장 열쇠를 달라고 해요.
The Envoy Part II#050.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#052.src: Press the button when you're ready.
The Envoy Part II#052.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#055.src: Locate the Avos Chief by asking the Avos citizens. Avos Chief is at -{~}, -{~}
The Envoy Part II#055.dst: Avos 주민들에게 물어 Avos 족장을 찾으세요. Avos 족장은 -{~}, -{~}에 있습니다

The Envoy Part II#056.src: Hmm no gears or goggles.. You are no Corkian Human.
The Envoy Part II#056.dst: 흠, 톱니바퀴도 고글도 없고.. 넌 Corkus 인간이 아니구나.
The Envoy Part II#056.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#057.src: The chief said your people are welcome here.
The Envoy Part II#057.dst: 족장님께서 너희 종족은 여기서 환영이라고 하셨다.
The Envoy Part II#057.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#058.src: You must be here to see him.
The Envoy Part II#058.speaker: Avos Shaman

The Envoy Part II#060.src: Mo'in, soldier. I have been expecting you.
The Envoy Part II#060.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#061.src: You can't catapult yourself into a village full of bird people and not get noticed.
The Envoy Part II#061.dst: 새 종족이 사는 마을에 투석기로 날아들고서 안 들킬 순 없지.
The Envoy Part II#061.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#062.src: We know what you are here for, however. The Avos factory key.
The Envoy Part II#062.dst: 하지만 자네가 온 이유는 알고 있네. Avos의 공장 열쇠지.
The Envoy Part II#062.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#063.src: We saw your battle with “Mech X” at the docks from above. I believe we can trust you.
The Envoy Part II#063.dst: 부두에서 “Mech X”와 싸우는 걸 위에서 봤네. 자네는 믿을 만한 것 같군.
The Envoy Part II#063.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#064.src: The key you seek is hidden deep within our most protected temple.
The Envoy Part II#064.dst: 자네가 찾는 열쇠는 우리가 가장 삼엄하게 지키는 신전 깊숙이 숨겨져 있네.
The Envoy Part II#064.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#065.src: Follow the road north of here to reach the temple. Speak to the grandmaster and she will allow you entry.
The Envoy Part II#065.dst: 여기서 북쪽 길을 따라가면 신전이 나오네. 대주술사에게 말하면 들여보내 줄 걸세.
The Envoy Part II#065.speaker: Chief Avos

The Envoy Part II#066.src: Talk to the chief's friend at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Envoy Part II#067.src: Eh, It's the warrior. I have my orders, but still say this is a bad idea.
The Envoy Part II#067.dst: 흥, 그 전사로군. 명령은 받았지만, 그래도 나쁜 생각이라고 본다.
The Envoy Part II#067.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#068.src: We hid this key for the purpose that it would never be used again.
The Envoy Part II#068.dst: 이 열쇠를 숨긴 건 다시는 쓰이지 않게 하려는 거였다.
The Envoy Part II#068.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#069.src: The creatures we summoned down there are hostile to all. Even Avos.
The Envoy Part II#069.dst: 저 아래에 소환한 것들은 누구에게나 적대적이다. Avos에게도.
The Envoy Part II#069.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#070.src: I can't say I have high hopes for you.
The Envoy Part II#070.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#071.src: Meet me round the back of my house and I shall show you the way.
The Envoy Part II#071.dst: 내 집 뒤편으로 오면 길을 알려 주마.
The Envoy Part II#071.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#072.src: Meet the grandmaster behind her house and get over the gap and enter the temple.
The Envoy Part II#072.dst: 대주술사를 집 뒤에서 만나고, 틈을 건너 신전에 들어가세요.

The Envoy Part II#073.src: I'll make the bridge for you.
The Envoy Part II#073.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#074.src: I don't see why we’re helping humans...
The Envoy Part II#074.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#075.src: You all act the same to me. Anyway, there you go.
The Envoy Part II#075.dst: 내 눈엔 너희 다 똑같다. 아무튼, 자 됐다.
The Envoy Part II#075.speaker: Grandmaster Shaman

The Envoy Part II#076.src: Find the key inside the temple.

The Envoy Part II#077.src: You cannot have the key. Prepare for destruction.
The Envoy Part II#077.dst: 열쇠는 줄 수 없다. 파멸을 각오해라.
The Envoy Part II#077.speaker: Key Temple Dragon

The Envoy Part II#078.src: Return to Maxie in his house with the first key.
The Envoy Part II#078.dst: 첫 번째 열쇠를 가지고 Maxie의 집으로 돌아가세요.

The Envoy Part II#079.src: You're back, and you have the key!
The Envoy Part II#079.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#080.src: Excellent. I will hold onto that for now. Let's focus on getting the Corkian's Key.
The Envoy Part II#080.dst: 좋아요. 일단 내가 보관할게요. 이제 Corkus 쪽 열쇠를 구하는 데 집중해요.
The Envoy Part II#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#081.src: They keep it in a vault inside the castle. I honestly don't know how to get in there.
The Envoy Part II#081.dst: 성 안 금고에 보관하고 있어요. 솔직히 어떻게 들어가야 할지 모르겠어요.
The Envoy Part II#081.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#082.src: I think first we should just go and scout out the vault itself and work it out.
The Envoy Part II#082.dst: 일단 금고부터 가서 살펴보고 방법을 찾아야 할 것 같아요.
The Envoy Part II#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#085.src: Uh- No need to worry! We accidentally...
The Envoy Part II#085.speaker: Bertil

The Envoy Part II#086.src: Blew a hole in the wall! Yep!
The Envoy Part II#086.speaker: Reiva

The Envoy Part II#087.src: Stop. Maxie, was right. I'm sorry. Mech X pierced the vault like it was nothing and took the key.
The Envoy Part II#087.dst: 그만. Maxie 말이 맞았어요. 미안해요. Mech X가 금고를 가볍게 뚫고 열쇠를 가져갔어요.
The Envoy Part II#087.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#088.src: The mechs were covered in farm produce for some reason and left a convenient trail. If you are serious about fighting the factory, follow it.
The Envoy Part II#088.dst: 기계병들이 어째선지 농작물을 뒤집어쓰고 있어서 흔적이 잘 남았어요. 공장과 진심으로 싸울 생각이면 그걸 따라가세요.
The Envoy Part II#088.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part II#089.src: Look for the hidden mech base.

The Envoy Part II#090.src: Psst! Over here, in the field!
The Envoy Part II#090.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#091.src: Mo'in. See that guy up there? He hasn't moved an inch since I got here.
The Envoy Part II#091.dst: Mo'in. 저 위에 저 사람 보여요? 내가 온 뒤로 꼼짝도 안 했어요.
The Envoy Part II#091.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#092.src: I don't think he's actually a farmer. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#092.dst: 진짜 농부는 아닌 것 같아요. 따라와요.
The Envoy Part II#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#093.src: HELLO... I AM A... HUMAN... FARMER.
The Envoy Part II#093.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#094.src: DO YOU... HAVE... ANY BUSINESS... WITH ME?
The Envoy Part II#094.speaker: Farmer

The Envoy Part II#095.src: Nice try, mech! Not convincing enough for me!
The Envoy Part II#095.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#096.src: REPORT... COVER HAS BEEN COMPROMISED... TWO UNAUTHORIZED INTRUDERS... OUTSIDE OF BASE.
The Envoy Part II#096.dst: 보고... 위장 발각... 미승인 침입자 둘... 기지 외부.
The Envoy Part II#096.speaker: S-63 Mech

The Envoy Part II#099.src: That model was a S-{~}, meaning it has warned the others. Follow me.
The Envoy Part II#099.dst: S-{~} 모델이었어요, 다른 놈들한테 알렸다는 뜻이죠. 따라와요.
The Envoy Part II#099.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#101.src: Stand back, I'll open the door.
The Envoy Part II#101.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#102.src: I think we can safely assume this is the right place.
The Envoy Part II#102.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#103.src: You storm in and find what we need. I'll cover you from out here.
The Envoy Part II#103.dst: 당신이 쳐들어가서 필요한 걸 찾아요. 난 밖에서 엄호할게요.
The Envoy Part II#103.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#104.src: You need to find and destroy that new factory mech.
The Envoy Part II#104.dst: 공장에서 새로 만든 그 기계병을 찾아서 부숴야 해요.
The Envoy Part II#104.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#105.src: Retrieve the key from the base.

The Envoy Part II#107.src: Corkus has to suffer... They shut down the Factory, locked us up in there. Once we have both keys we can open it and you are NOT getting this one.
The Envoy Part II#107.dst: Corkus는 고통받아야 한다... 놈들은 공장을 닫고 우릴 가뒀다. 열쇠 두 개만 모으면 열 수 있다. 이건 절대 못 가져간다.
The Envoy Part II#107.speaker: Mech X

The Envoy Part II#108.src: Find Maxie and give him the key.

The Envoy Part II#109.src: Mo'in. Did you get the key?
The Envoy Part II#109.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#110.src: Follow the northwestern road and enter the factory from the west side. I will meet you there.
The Envoy Part II#110.dst: 북서쪽 길을 따라가서 서쪽으로 공장에 들어가요. 거기서 만나요.
The Envoy Part II#110.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#111.src: Find Maxie outside the factory at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Envoy Part II#112.src: Mo'in. Are you sure you are ready?
The Envoy Part II#112.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#113.src: This won't be your average fight. The factory is cutting edge. Run by a being of pure electromagic.
The Envoy Part II#113.dst: 평범한 싸움이 아닐 거예요. 공장은 최첨단이고, 순수한 전자기 마법으로 된 존재가 운영해요.
The Envoy Part II#113.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#114.src: The smartest man on Corkus, Cerid spent years making a being smarter even than he is...
The Envoy Part II#114.dst: Corkus에서 제일 똑똑한 Cerid가 몇 년에 걸쳐 자기보다 더 똑똑한 존재를 만들었죠...
The Envoy Part II#114.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#115.src: Now it runs the factory with a twisted sense of morality. It's easy to see why it was shut down.
The Envoy Part II#115.dst: 지금은 그게 뒤틀린 도덕관으로 공장을 돌려요. 왜 공장을 멈췄는지 알 만하죠.
The Envoy Part II#115.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#116.src: Also.. I- I made you these boots using my magic. It turns out I am pretty good at making stuff.
The Envoy Part II#116.dst: 그리고.. 저, 제 마법으로 이 장화를 만들었어요. 알고 보니 난 물건 만드는 데 꽤 소질이 있더라고요.
The Envoy Part II#116.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part II#117.src: I just wanted to say thanks, too. I really feel like I made a difference fighting with you. When you are ready, just walk up to the factory doors.
The Envoy Part II#117.dst: 고맙다는 말도 하고 싶었어요. 당신과 함께 싸우면서 정말 뭔가 해낸 기분이었어요. 준비되면 공장 문으로 걸어가요.
The Envoy Part II#117.speaker: Maxie

The Feathers Fly Part I#000.src: Visit the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires completion of The Envoy Part II)

The Feathers Fly Part I#001.src: Oh?! Hold on, is anyone there..!

The Feathers Fly Part I#002.src: Why hello there! Whatcha doin' here? I'm Ava!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.dst: 어머, 안녕! 여기서 뭐 해? 난 Ava야!
The Feathers Fly Part I#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#003.src: Want a quick job? How 'bout helpin' me out?! That was perfect timing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.dst: 잠깐 일 좀 할래? 나 좀 도와줄래?! 딱 좋은 타이밍이야!
The Feathers Fly Part I#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#004.src: Y'see, while the other Avos hate it, I just find electromagic so fascinating!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.dst: 있지, 다른 Avos는 싫어하지만 난 전자기 마법이 너무 매력적이야!
The Feathers Fly Part I#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#005.src: Look, I think I got a breakthrough invention. If it works... Oh man...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.dst: 봐, 획기적인 발명을 해낸 것 같아. 이게 성공하면... 와...
The Feathers Fly Part I#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#006.src: I just need to harness some nature magic, and there's an amazing source in the chief's hut. Ya comin'?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.dst: 자연 마법을 좀 끌어오기만 하면 되는데, 족장님 오두막에 엄청난 원천이 있거든. 올 거지?
The Feathers Fly Part I#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#007.src: Don't you worry about rewards! I got you! See ya' there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.dst: 보상은 걱정 마! 내가 챙겨 줄게! 거기서 봐!
The Feathers Fly Part I#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#009.src: Hey! You showed up! Listen up, here's the plan...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.dst: 헤이! 왔구나! 잘 들어, 계획은 이래...
The Feathers Fly Part I#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#010.src: There's a small museum inside the hut with all kinds of trophies.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.dst: 오두막 안에 온갖 전리품을 모아 둔 작은 전시실이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#011.src: Our chief is quite the talkative fella, and I can guarantee he'd love to tell you stories.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.dst: 우리 족장님은 꽤 수다쟁이라서, 분명 너한테 옛날얘기를 신나게 해 줄 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part I#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#012.src: That should keep him and his guards busy. And that's where I come in!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.dst: 그러면 족장님이랑 경비병들이 바빠지겠지. 그때 내가 나서는 거야!
The Feathers Fly Part I#012.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#013.src: I'll take that chance to sneak behind the throne, where our sacred totem is. I'm not stealing it, don't worry!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.dst: 그 틈에 신성한 토템이 있는 왕좌 뒤로 몰래 들어갈게. 훔치려는 건 아니니까 걱정 마!
The Feathers Fly Part I#013.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#014.src: I'm a little clumsy, but I'm sure I can count on ya'! No matter what, keep the chief busy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.dst: 내가 좀 덤벙대지만, 너만 믿을게! 무슨 일이 있어도 족장님을 붙잡아 둬!
The Feathers Fly Part I#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#017.src: So, what brings you here, hm?
The Feathers Fly Part I#017.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#018.src: Oh, you want to learn more about us... Of course, of course!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.dst: 오, 우리에 대해 더 알고 싶다고... 물론, 물론이지!
The Feathers Fly Part I#018.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#019.src: We have a room where I can show you some of our history.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.dst: 우리 역사를 좀 보여 줄 수 있는 방이 있네.
The Feathers Fly Part I#019.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#020.src: You're in luck, I'm in a good mood. Follow me then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.dst: 운이 좋군, 오늘 기분이 좋거든. 그럼 따라오게.
The Feathers Fly Part I#020.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#022.src: It's alright, these books aren't important... Be careful though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.dst: 괜찮네, 그 책들은 중요하지 않아... 그래도 조심하게.
The Feathers Fly Part I#022.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#024.src: It's one of a kind! We planted it eons ago. It has never ever grown an inch. Or moved.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.dst: 세상에 하나뿐인 나무일세! 아득한 옛날에 심었지. 한 치도 자란 적이 없어. 움직인 적도.
The Feathers Fly Part I#024.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#025.src: Never died or anything either. For all we know, it might predate your corruption too!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.dst: 죽은 적도 없고. 어쩌면 자네들의 타락보다도 오래됐을지 모르지!
The Feathers Fly Part I#025.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#026.src: Oh, this is quite the important tome.
The Feathers Fly Part I#026.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#027.src: This book has a signature from all Avos chiefs ever since we discovered ink!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.dst: 우리가 잉크를 발견한 이래 모든 Avos 족장의 서명이 담긴 책이지!
The Feathers Fly Part I#027.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#029.src: It's a custom for every Avos chief to keep their feathers somewhere. I guess I left that here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.dst: Avos 족장은 누구나 자기 깃털을 어딘가에 보관하는 풍습이 있네. 여기에 두고 온 모양이군.
The Feathers Fly Part I#029.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#031.src: Though, we don't really have the time to sit down and read all of it, do we?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.dst: 하지만 앉아서 전부 읽을 시간은 없겠지, 안 그런가?
The Feathers Fly Part I#031.speaker: Avos Chief

The Feathers Fly Part I#033.src: Someone broke in? But why? Anyone can use our totem...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.dst: 누가 침입했다고? 왜? 토템은 누구나 쓸 수 있는데...
The Feathers Fly Part I#033.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#034.src: I don't get it. They could've just asked...
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.dst: 이해가 안 되는군. 그냥 부탁하면 됐을 텐데...
The Feathers Fly Part I#034.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#035.src: Report back to Ava in the Workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#036.src: Oh, hey! Thanks for earlier. You were a big help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.dst: 아, 안녕! 아까 고마웠어. 큰 도움이 됐어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#036.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#037.src: Truth is, anyone can use that totem. They just don't like me very much.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.dst: 사실 그 토템은 누구나 쓸 수 있어. 다들 날 별로 안 좋아할 뿐이지.
The Feathers Fly Part I#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#038.src: Anyway, we got what we needed, and it's promising! Now onto the next part...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.dst: 아무튼 필요한 건 챙겼고, 가능성이 보여! 이제 다음 단계로...
The Feathers Fly Part I#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#039.src: Y'see, I managed to bottle up some of our magic, but I still need corkian stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.dst: 있지, 우리 마법을 병에 좀 담긴 했는데, 아직 Corkus 물건이 필요해.
The Feathers Fly Part I#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#040.src: Fortunately for us, there's a shop outside the city. Though, things might get complicated...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.dst: 다행히 도시 밖에 가게가 하나 있어. 그런데 일이 좀 복잡해질지도...
The Feathers Fly Part I#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#041.src: A bunch of Corkians aren't too fond of... Us. I just think you should come along with me, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.dst: Corkus 사람들 중엔 우리를... 별로 안 좋아하는 이들이 많거든. 그러니까 네가 같이 가 주면 좋겠어, 알지?
The Feathers Fly Part I#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#042.src: Here, I wrote the coords into that book of yours. It's a bit far, so come on out and I'll give you a lift!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.dst: 자, 네 책에 좌표를 적어 뒀어. 좀 머니까 밖으로 나와, 태워 줄게!
The Feathers Fly Part I#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#043.src: Meet Ava near the Corkian shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#044.src: Alright, if you want a lift, tell me, or you could just walk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.dst: 좋아, 태워 주길 원하면 말해. 아니면 걸어가도 되고!
The Feathers Fly Part I#044.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#045.src: Not sure why you'd do that when I'm right here though!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.dst: 내가 바로 여기 있는데 왜 걸어가는지는 모르겠지만!
The Feathers Fly Part I#045.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#046.src: Alright, buckle up, we're taking off!
The Feathers Fly Part I#046.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#047.src: Still holding on? We're almost there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#047.dst: 아직 잘 붙어 있어? 거의 다 왔어!
The Feathers Fly Part I#047.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#048.src: Here we are! Enjoyed the lift? I'm a great form of fast travel, right?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.dst: 도착! 비행 즐거웠어? 나 꽤 괜찮은 빠른 이동 수단이지?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#049.src: Well, this was my first time using this magic magnet on people, but...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.dst: 음, 이 마법 자석을 사람한테 써 본 건 처음이지만...
The Feathers Fly Part I#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#050.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.dst: 여기가 그 가게야! 여기서 강화된 잠재력 마이크로칩을 살 수 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part I#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#051.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#052.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.dst: 인간이랑 같이 있으면 분명 하나 팔아 주겠지?
The Feathers Fly Part I#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#053.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#054.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.dst: 아니면 그냥 가 버려도 되고, 그것도 괜찮아...
The Feathers Fly Part I#054.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#055.src: Ah, finally! I could've taken you there y'know!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.dst: 아, 드디어! 내가 태워 줄 수도 있었는데!
The Feathers Fly Part I#055.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#056.src: Honestly, I just wanted to test something on you... Oh well!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.dst: 솔직히 너한테 뭘 좀 시험해 보고 싶었을 뿐이야... 뭐, 됐어!
The Feathers Fly Part I#056.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#057.src: This is the shop! I think we can buy an Enhanced Potential Microchip here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.dst: 여기가 그 가게야! 여기서 강화된 잠재력 마이크로칩을 살 수 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part I#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#058.src: I need you to accompany me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#058.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#059.src: If I'm with a human, surely they'll sell one, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.dst: 인간이랑 같이 있으면 분명 하나 팔아 주겠지?
The Feathers Fly Part I#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#060.src: You go first, I'll follow you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#061.src: Hmpf. What are you doing in here, Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.dst: 흥. 여기서 뭐 하는 거냐, Avo?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#061.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#063.src: So-uh, I was, y'know, wonderin' if you had any-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.dst: 그러니까-어, 혹시, 알잖아, 여기 그런 게 있나 해서-
The Feathers Fly Part I#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#066.src: There's NO WAY I'm selling anythin' to an Avo! Shoo! Get out!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.dst: Avo한테는 절대로 아무것도 안 팔아! 훠이! 나가!
The Feathers Fly Part I#066.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#069.src: I am NOT giving up! To hell with all this!
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.dst: 절대 포기 안 해! 이딴 거 다 집어치워!
The Feathers Fly Part I#069.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#070.src: Here, go in yourself and ask. I'll cover the cost later.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.dst: 자, 네가 직접 들어가서 물어봐. 돈은 나중에 줄게.
The Feathers Fly Part I#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#071.src: I'll stand back. CLEARLY this guy is too STUCK up to- Ugh, I'm getting angry! Just go in again.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.dst: 난 뒤에 있을게. 딱 봐도 저 사람은 너무 콧대가 높아서- 으, 화나려고 해! 그냥 다시 들어가 봐.
The Feathers Fly Part I#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#072.src: Ask for an Enhanced Microchip at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#073.src: Huh?! I made myself clear! You were with her!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.dst: 뭐야?! 분명히 말했을 텐데! 너 그 애랑 같이 있었잖아!
The Feathers Fly Part I#073.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#074.src: I'm closing for today, I cannot stand this! OUT!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.dst: 오늘은 문 닫는다, 못 참겠어! 나가!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#074.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#075.src: Oh, and don't even think about even approaching MY shop!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.dst: 아, 그리고 내 가게엔 얼씬도 하지 마!
The Feathers Fly Part I#075.speaker: Shopkeeper

The Feathers Fly Part I#076.src: Find the control panel near the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#077.src: So you did come back! Hang tight!
The Feathers Fly Part I#077.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#078.src: Look, we need a plan. Talk to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.dst: 있잖아, 계획이 필요해. 나한테 말 걸어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#078.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#080.src: I'm... surprised he kicked you out, too. Maybe he's a patriot?
The Feathers Fly Part I#080.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#081.src: Well, anyway, we need a plan. I don't wanna wait this out.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.dst: 뭐, 아무튼 계획이 필요해. 이렇게 기다리긴 싫어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#081.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#082.src: Look, this guy has to have a control panel somewhere. Maybe we can neutralize the robots.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.dst: 봐, 저 사람 어딘가에 제어판이 있을 거야. 로봇들을 무력화할 수 있을지도 몰라.
The Feathers Fly Part I#082.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#083.src: That stuff hates water, y'know? So I'll go fetch some in the meantime.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.dst: 그런 건 물을 싫어하거든? 그러니까 그동안 내가 물을 좀 떠 올게.
The Feathers Fly Part I#083.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#084.src: I'd like to NOT get zapped by a forcefield, so I'll sneak inside once we're done with that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.dst: 역장에 감전되긴 싫으니까, 그게 끝나면 몰래 들어갈게.
The Feathers Fly Part I#084.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#085.src: Got it? Find the control panel. It should be somewhere around the house. Talk to me once you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.dst: 알았지? 제어판을 찾아. 집 근처 어딘가에 있을 거야. 준비되면 말 걸어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#085.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#086.src: Good luck, then! I'll be back once you find the control panel!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.dst: 그럼 행운을 빌어! 제어판을 찾으면 돌아올게!
The Feathers Fly Part I#086.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#087.src: Here we are! Good job! Alright, let's see...
The Feathers Fly Part I#087.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#088.src: Wait... Why are there... Buttons... Everywhere??
The Feathers Fly Part I#088.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#089.src: I feel like soaking everything would be quite the mistake.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.dst: 전부 적셨다간 큰 실수가 될 것 같아.
The Feathers Fly Part I#089.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#090.src: And none of them are labelled! What is that?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.dst: 게다가 이름표도 하나 없잖아! 이게 뭐야?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#090.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#091.src: Look, your choice. What should we neutralize first?
The Feathers Fly Part I#091.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#092.src: Left, huh? Well, let's see how that goes.
The Feathers Fly Part I#092.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#095.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.dst: 가운데... 제일 중요한 게 여기 있을 수도 있겠지. 이론상은. 기대는 안 하지만.
The Feathers Fly Part I#095.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#096.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.dst: 오! 생각보다 나쁘지 않네. 그리고... 뭐가 삐져나왔어, 잠깐만...
The Feathers Fly Part I#096.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#097.src: Haha!... Wait, that's not it. Urgh.
The Feathers Fly Part I#097.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#098.src: Hey, I'll just give that to you. Though, you probably don't know how to use it, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.dst: 이건 그냥 너 줄게. 근데 너 아마 쓰는 법 모를걸, 헤헤!
The Feathers Fly Part I#098.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#099.src: Looks like we got another shot. I still have some water left.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.dst: 한 번 더 기회가 있나 봐. 물이 아직 좀 남았어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#099.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#100.src: Center... I guess the most important stuff could be here. In theory. I wouldn't count on it.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.dst: 가운데... 제일 중요한 게 여기 있을 수도 있겠지. 이론상은. 기대는 안 하지만.
The Feathers Fly Part I#100.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#101.src: Huh! This wasn't that bad. And... I see something poking out, hold on...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.dst: 오! 생각보다 나쁘지 않네. 그리고... 뭐가 삐져나왔어, 잠깐만...
The Feathers Fly Part I#101.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#102.src: Haha! I think that's what we're looking for!
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.dst: 하하! 이게 우리가 찾던 거 같아!
The Feathers Fly Part I#102.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#103.src: Look, I still want to make it up to the guy. I really don't want to be the villain of his story.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.dst: 있지, 그래도 저 사람한테 보상은 하고 싶어. 저 사람 이야기 속 악당이 되긴 정말 싫거든.
The Feathers Fly Part I#103.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#104.src: I'll meet you back at the Workshop. You can go on ahead.
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.dst: 작업장에서 다시 만나. 먼저 가도 돼.
The Feathers Fly Part I#104.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#105.src: Right, right. Stand back, just in case.
The Feathers Fly Part I#105.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#106.src: Oh wow. You got the right one, first try! How'd you know?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.dst: 와. 한 번에 맞는 걸 골랐네! 어떻게 알았어?
The Feathers Fly Part I#106.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#107.src: Well, good job. I still want to make it up to the poor guy though.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.dst: 뭐, 잘했어. 그래도 그 불쌍한 사람한테 보상은 하고 싶어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#108.src: Just meet me back at the Workshop, I'll be there!
The Feathers Fly Part I#108.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#109.src: Fight your way out of the shop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#110.src: Meet Ava in the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#112.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.dst: 내가 일으킨 말썽은 다 미안해... 이걸로 좀 갚아졌으면 좋겠다.
The Feathers Fly Part I#112.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#113.src: I hope 's alright... I managed to find the microchip right away, after all.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.dst: 괜찮았으면 좋겠네... 어쨌든 마이크로칩은 바로 찾았으니까.
The Feathers Fly Part I#113.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#114.src: ...Alright. Time to go. I'll wait for {u}, I guess.
The Feathers Fly Part I#114.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#116.src: Sorry about all the trouble I caused... I hope this makes it up to you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.dst: 내가 일으킨 말썽은 다 미안해... 이걸로 좀 갚아졌으면 좋겠다.
The Feathers Fly Part I#116.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#118.src: Oh, there you are! I felt sad leaving you behind!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.dst: 아, 거기 있었구나! 너 두고 가서 마음이 안 좋았어!
The Feathers Fly Part I#118.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#119.src: Say, if you need a lift, just tell me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.dst: 있지, 태워 주길 원하면 말만 해.
The Feathers Fly Part I#119.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#121.src: Alright, I'm dropping you off! Stick the landing!
The Feathers Fly Part I#121.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#122.src: I can't believe it! It's working! Look! Look at it!
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.dst: 믿을 수가 없어! 작동해! 봐! 이것 좀 봐!
The Feathers Fly Part I#122.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#123.src: A Growth Accelerator... Can you imagine the possibilities?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.dst: 성장 촉진기... 가능성이 얼마나 무궁무진한지 상상이 돼?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#124.src: We'll be able to... I don't know, help the poor, that's nice, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.dst: 이걸로... 글쎄, 가난한 사람들을 도울 수도 있겠지, 좋잖아?
The Feathers Fly Part I#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#125.src: But we're not done. Well, I'm not done. I'd still like your help.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.dst: 근데 아직 안 끝났어. 음, 내가 안 끝났지. 아직 네 도움이 필요해.
The Feathers Fly Part I#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#126.src: Look, let's try it out together, alright? Maybe I'll let you go afterwards?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.dst: 있지, 같이 시험해 보자, 응? 그다음엔 보내 줄지도?
The Feathers Fly Part I#126.speaker: Ava
