The Feathers Fly Part I#127.src: I'll join you outside. Once I'm sure this works, I'll be able to... Show it to them.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.dst: 밖에서 만나. 이게 확실히 작동하면, 그땐... 사람들한테 보여 줄 수 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#127.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#128.src: In theory, it should be easy to operate... I'm trusting you. Again. Sorry 'bout that.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.dst: 이론상 조작은 쉬울 거야... 널 믿을게. 또. 그건 미안.
The Feathers Fly Part I#128.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#129.src: Meet Ava outside of the Workshop and help her operate her machine at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#129.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 작업장 밖에서 Ava와 만나 기계 작동을 도우세요

The Feathers Fly Part I#130.src: Alright, it's just on the hill next to us, but I can bring you there if ya want!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.dst: 좋아, 바로 옆 언덕 위야. 원하면 태워 줄 수도 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part I#130.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#131.src: Just don't get too used to me, alright? Tell me when you're ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.dst: 그래도 너무 익숙해지진 마, 알았지? 준비되면 말해.
The Feathers Fly Part I#131.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#133.src: Or I guess you could just leave, that's cool too...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.dst: 아니면 그냥 가 버려도 되고, 그것도 괜찮아...
The Feathers Fly Part I#133.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#134.src: Alright, this should be good. Talk to me and I'll explain!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.dst: 좋아, 이 정도면 되겠다. 말 걸어, 설명해 줄게!
The Feathers Fly Part I#134.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#135.src: I'll do a quick rundown of how to operate this. It's not automatic yet.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.dst: 조작법을 간단히 설명할게. 아직 자동이 아니거든.
The Feathers Fly Part I#135.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#136.src: I'll give you a remote. You'll simply have to click in the right orders. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.dst: 리모컨을 줄게. 올바른 순서로 클릭하기만 하면 돼. 해 보면 알아!
The Feathers Fly Part I#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#137.src: You have to be quick, though! You can't just take all the time you want.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.dst: 대신 빨리 해야 해! 마냥 시간을 끌 순 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part I#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#138.src: I have no clue how stable all of this is, so we'll start slowly!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.dst: 이게 다 얼마나 안정적인지 전혀 모르니까, 천천히 시작하자!
The Feathers Fly Part I#138.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#139.src: I know this sounds a li'l scary, but you've shown yourself being capable.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.dst: 좀 무섭게 들리겠지만, 넌 능력을 증명했잖아.
The Feathers Fly Part I#139.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#140.src: Tell me when you're ready, I'll give you the remote then start the machine!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.dst: 준비되면 말해, 리모컨 주고 기계를 켤게!
The Feathers Fly Part I#140.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#142.src: Think of it like... Casting one of your spells. You're used to that, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.dst: 이렇게 생각해... 주문 하나 시전하는 거라고. 그건 익숙하지?
The Feathers Fly Part I#142.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#143.src: Let's start slowly! You have {~} seconds to fully charge it up!
The Feathers Fly Part I#143.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#146.src: Do you have ANY idea what it is we've just done?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.dst: 우리가 방금 뭘 해낸 건지 알기나 해?
The Feathers Fly Part I#146.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#147.src: I have to show that to the Chief. They WILL accept me! I cannot fail now!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.dst: 족장님한테 보여 줘야 해. 이번엔 꼭 날 받아 줄 거야! 지금 실패할 순 없어!
The Feathers Fly Part I#147.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#148.src: Tell you what, let's meet up at the Chief's hut. If you want me to take you there right now, you can just go ahead and tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.dst: 이렇게 하자, 족장님 오두막에서 만나. 지금 바로 태워 주길 원하면 그냥 말만 해!
The Feathers Fly Part I#148.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#149.src: Operate the machine with Ava for the Avos Chief at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part I#149.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에서 Avos 족장을 위해 Ava와 함께 기계를 작동하세요

The Feathers Fly Part I#151.src: It really is convenient being with me, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.dst: 나랑 같이 다니니까 진짜 편하지, 응?
The Feathers Fly Part I#151.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#152.src: On second thought... Isn't it too soon?
The Feathers Fly Part I#152.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#153.src: I-I think I want to turn back... I...
The Feathers Fly Part I#153.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#154.src: You should approach the Chief first. It... won't work if I do it. I'll come by afterwards.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.dst: 네가 먼저 족장님한테 가. 내가 하면... 안 통할 거야. 난 뒤따라갈게.
The Feathers Fly Part I#154.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#155.src: Ah, human! Welcome back. Good timing...
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.dst: 아, 인간! 다시 왔군. 마침 잘 왔네...
The Feathers Fly Part I#155.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#156.src: Did you happen to see... An oddly dressed Avo around here recently?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.dst: 혹시 최근에 이 근처에서... 옷차림이 이상한 Avo를 봤나?
The Feathers Fly Part I#156.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#157.src: We kicked that girl from the tribe, and we do have our reasons.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.dst: 그 아이는 부족에서 쫓아냈네. 그럴 만한 이유가 있었지.
The Feathers Fly Part I#157.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#158.src: I've heard reports of her snooping around recently. With a human, even.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.dst: 최근 그 애가 주변을 기웃거린다는 보고를 들었네. 인간과 함께 말일세.
The Feathers Fly Part I#158.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#159.src: And I believe... That this is no coincidence you're here.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.dst: 그리고 내 생각엔... 자네가 여기 온 게 우연이 아닌 것 같군.
The Feathers Fly Part I#159.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#160.src: I will be frank. You're with her, aren't you? I won't hurt you. I won't hurt her either.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.dst: 솔직히 말하지. 자네, 그 애와 한패지? 해치지 않겠네. 그 애도 해치지 않을 걸세.
The Feathers Fly Part I#160.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#161.src: She's not exactly welcome here. But she's never told you about that, did she?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.dst: 그 애는 여기서 환영받지 못하네. 그런 얘긴 자네한테 한 적 없지?
The Feathers Fly Part I#161.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#162.src: And I have nothing to hide, Chief.
The Feathers Fly Part I#162.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#163.src: STOP IT, you two! Let her talk!
The Feathers Fly Part I#163.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#164.src: You're all scared of change, and that's all there is to it. Now...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.dst: 다들 변화가 무서운 거예요, 그게 전부죠. 그럼...
The Feathers Fly Part I#164.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#165.dst: 제가... 뭘 좀 보여 드려도 될까요?
The Feathers Fly Part I#165.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#166.src: Hmpf. Let's see that broken atrocity of yours.
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.dst: 흥. 그 망가진 흉물 한번 보세.
The Feathers Fly Part I#166.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#168.src: This is it. I can't fail now... I really hope I can trust you.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.dst: 이거야. 지금 실패할 순 없어... 정말 널 믿어도 되면 좋겠다.
The Feathers Fly Part I#168.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#169.src: You have no idea how important this is to me.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.dst: 이게 나한테 얼마나 중요한지 넌 모를 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part I#169.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#170.src: It'll be slightly more difficult than last time, so get ready.
The Feathers Fly Part I#170.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#171.src: I'll give you the remote once you're ready!
The Feathers Fly Part I#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#172.src: Wait, are you sure this isn't dang-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.dst: 잠깐, 이거 위험하지 않은 게 확실-
The Feathers Fly Part I#172.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#175.src: Let's just give her a chance for now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#175.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#176.src: Why is she getting away with using such magic?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.dst: 저 애는 왜 저런 마법을 써도 무사한 겁니까?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#176.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#177.src: Oh I'm gonna charge this sapling like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.dst: 오, 이 묘목을 미친 듯이 충전해 줄 거야!
The Feathers Fly Part I#177.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#179.src: One last time soldier, and I'm counting on you to be quick!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.dst: 마지막이야, 전사! 빨리 해 줄 거라 믿어!
The Feathers Fly Part I#179.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#182.src: Wait... That's it?? No, this isn't right...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.dst: 잠깐... 이게 다야?? 아냐, 이건 뭔가 잘못됐어...
The Feathers Fly Part I#182.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#185.src: Chief! Have you seen what she just did?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.dst: 족장님! 저 애가 한 짓 보셨습니까?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#185.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#186.src: I-I didn't mean to! I told you to stand back!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.dst: 이, 일부러 그런 거 아니에요! 물러서라고 했잖아요!!
The Feathers Fly Part I#186.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#187.src: Under normal circumstances, I'd have sent you down the pit after cutting off your feathers.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.dst: 평소 같았으면 깃털을 자르고 구덩이 아래로 떨어뜨렸을 걸세.
The Feathers Fly Part I#187.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#188.src: But these are not normal circumstances. Soldier, may you come over here as well?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.dst: 하지만 지금은 평소가 아니지. 전사여, 자네도 이리 와 주겠나?
The Feathers Fly Part I#188.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#189.src: Talk to the Avos Chief with Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Feathers Fly Part I#190.src: So you fused OUR magic... With electromagic?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.dst: 그러니까 우리 마법을... 전자기 마법과 융합했다고?
The Feathers Fly Part I#190.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#191.src: I recognized extracts from the totem too. You're the one who stole from us, right?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.dst: 토템에서 추출한 것도 알아보겠군. 우리 것을 훔친 게 너지?
The Feathers Fly Part I#191.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#193.src: And on top of that, you used the Wynn warrior to fool us?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.dst: 게다가 Wynn의 전사를 이용해 우릴 속였다고?
The Feathers Fly Part I#193.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#194.src: And I'm sure you know why I did!
The Feathers Fly Part I#194.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#195.src: Do you have any idea how unstable this wretched electromagic is?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.dst: 이 빌어먹을 전자기 마법이 얼마나 불안정한지 알기나 하느냐?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#195.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#197.src: And you should NOT! Don't you understand? This is too dangerous!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.dst: 다뤄선 안 된다! 모르겠느냐? 너무 위험하다!
The Feathers Fly Part I#197.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#198.src: Should we kill her on the spot?! We almost died!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.dst: 당장 죽여 버릴까요?! 우리 죽을 뻔했습니다!
The Feathers Fly Part I#198.speaker: Avos Guard

The Feathers Fly Part I#199.src: No, don't kill her. I want her and the soldier in my hut, now.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.dst: 아니, 죽이지 마라. 저 애와 전사를 내 오두막으로 데려와라, 당장.
The Feathers Fly Part I#199.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#200.src: Ava. You can't keep going with this. Just stop. This is your final warning.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.dst: Ava. 이런 짓을 계속할 순 없다. 그만둬라. 마지막 경고다.
The Feathers Fly Part I#200.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#201.src: What do you even hope to accomplish? You used to be such a brilliant kid.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.dst: 대체 뭘 이루고 싶은 거냐? 넌 그렇게 뛰어난 아이였는데.
The Feathers Fly Part I#201.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#202.src: I just... wanna help people. You know that, I'm sure you understand!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.dst: 그냥... 사람들을 돕고 싶어요. 아시잖아요, 이해하실 거예요!
The Feathers Fly Part I#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#203.src: Have you seen the Factory? They tried to help people, and instead they killed hundreds!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.dst: 공장을 봤느냐? 그들도 사람들을 도우려 했지만, 오히려 수백 명을 죽였다!
The Feathers Fly Part I#203.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#204.src: Do you think you're able change the world?! Well, you can't, Ava! This is beyond you!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.dst: 네가 세상을 바꿀 수 있을 것 같으냐?! 못 한다, Ava! 네 능력 밖의 일이다!
The Feathers Fly Part I#204.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#205.src: So, for the last time. Stop all of this. I might reconsider your banishment then.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.dst: 그러니 마지막으로 말한다. 전부 그만둬라. 그러면 추방을 재고해 보마.
The Feathers Fly Part I#205.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#206.src: You... You're really serious about that, huh? You'll NEVER change, will you?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.dst: 당신... 정말 진심이군요? 절대 안 바뀌겠죠?!
The Feathers Fly Part I#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#207.src: Do you guys have ANY idea how archaic you all are?! A final warning??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.dst: 당신들이 얼마나 고리타분한지 알기나 해요?! 마지막 경고??
The Feathers Fly Part I#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part I#208.src: I can't believe you worked with her, soldier. Well, now you know to avoid her.
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.dst: 자네가 그 애와 손잡았다니 믿기지 않는군, 전사. 뭐, 이제 멀리해야 한다는 걸 알았겠지.
The Feathers Fly Part I#208.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part I#209.src: ...It appears she left some device on the floor. You might as well take them. And here, take these. We haven't had the chance to thank you regarding the Factory.
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.dst: ...그 애가 바닥에 무슨 장치를 두고 간 모양이군. 자네가 가져가게. 그리고 이것도 받게. 공장 일로 아직 고맙다는 말을 못 했으니.
The Feathers Fly Part I#209.speaker: Avos Chieftain

The Feathers Fly Part II#001.src: Oh... So you showed up! I'm glad, I really am!
The Feathers Fly Part II#001.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#002.src: It's time for me to show the Growth Accelerator to the Corkians.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.dst: 이제 Corkus 사람들에게 성장 촉진기를 보여 줄 때야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#002.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#003.src: Look, this time I'll really try and reward you well, alright?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.dst: 이번엔 진짜 보상 제대로 해 줄게, 알았지?
The Feathers Fly Part II#003.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#004.src: Anyway! I have a plan. You see, I definitely can't easily get in the city.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.dst: 아무튼! 계획이 있어. 난 도시에 쉽게 못 들어가거든.
The Feathers Fly Part II#004.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#005.src: The Corkians have a council where they deal with their issues. We can try getting an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.dst: Corkus 사람들은 의회에서 문제를 처리해. 거기서 알현을 신청해 볼 수 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#005.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#006.src: I know a way for me to get in the city. That's where you come in! There are some sentries to take care of.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.dst: 난 도시에 들어갈 방법이 있어. 네 차례는 여기부터야! 처리할 보초가 좀 있거든.
The Feathers Fly Part II#006.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#007.src: They're really old models though, somehow. I'll give you a jammer I made for this. Right-Click a robot to use it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.dst: 근데 어째선지 엄청 구형이야. 이걸 위해 만든 교란기를 줄게. 로봇에 우클릭해서 써!
The Feathers Fly Part II#007.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#008.src: Once you jam one robot, you'll have to jam all others within {~} seconds! So try to plan ahead and locate them all before jamming one!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.dst: 하나를 교란하면 {~}초 안에 나머지도 전부 교란해야 해! 교란하기 전에 전부 찾아 두고 계획을 세워!
The Feathers Fly Part II#008.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#009.src: Tell me once you're ready. I'll throw you in there. I'll join you afterwards. You'll see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.dst: 준비되면 말해. 널 거기 던져 넣고 나중에 따라갈게. 두고 봐!
The Feathers Fly Part II#009.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#010.src: Well then, first off, take this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#010.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#011.src: Now, just stand still... I gotta try something on you...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.dst: 자, 가만히 있어... 너한테 시험해 볼 게 있어...
The Feathers Fly Part II#011.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#012.src: Locate and jam all the robot sentries near the Corkus Clocktower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] within {~} seconds
The Feathers Fly Part II#012.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Corkus 시계탑 근처 로봇 보초를 모두 찾아 {~}초 안에 교란하세요

The Feathers Fly Part II#014.src: Thanks! These robots were harmless but hey, better safe than sorry right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.dst: 고마워! 해롭진 않은 로봇이었지만, 조심해서 나쁠 건 없잖아?
The Feathers Fly Part II#014.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#015.src: Anyway, we need to get ready to meet the Corkian Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.dst: 아무튼, Corkus 의회를 만날 준비를 해야 해.
The Feathers Fly Part II#015.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#016.src: And I think... I need a disguise. I don't like hiding myself, but I don't have a choice.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.dst: 그리고... 변장이 필요할 것 같아. 숨는 건 싫지만 어쩔 수 없지.
The Feathers Fly Part II#016.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#017.src: Thanks to some plans I got, I know where to find some. Follow me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.dst: 손에 넣은 도면 덕에 옷을 어디서 구할지 알아. 따라와!
The Feathers Fly Part II#017.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#018.src: Here we are! I'm pretty sure we can find some outfits in there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.dst: 다 왔다! 저 안에서 분명 옷을 찾을 수 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#018.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#019.src: I'll stand here to quickly hide in case anyone comes.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.dst: 누가 오면 바로 숨게 난 여기 서 있을게.
The Feathers Fly Part II#019.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#020.src: Just look around, and come back with what you think looks better!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.dst: 둘러보고 더 괜찮아 보이는 걸 가져와!
The Feathers Fly Part II#020.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#021.src: Yeah, I am letting you choose my outfit. Aren't you lucky? Go and get me the fanciest clothes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.dst: 그래, 내 옷을 네가 고르게 해 줄게. 운 좋지? 제일 멋진 옷으로 가져와!
The Feathers Fly Part II#021.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#022.src: Pick an outfit to fit in with the Corkians and bring it to Ava at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#022.dst: Corkus 사람들 사이에 섞일 옷을 골라 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Ava에게 가져가세요

The Feathers Fly Part II#023.src: I'm trusting you. We Avos aren't exactly into... Fashion. Then again, they're not into Electromagic either, so what do I know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.dst: 널 믿을게. 우리 Avos는 딱히... 패션엔 관심이 없거든. 뭐, 저쪽도 전자기 마법엔 관심 없으니 내가 뭘 알겠어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#023.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#026.src: I feel like... I'm about to go to work.
The Feathers Fly Part II#026.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#027.src: At the very least, I'll probably blend in very well!
The Feathers Fly Part II#027.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#028.src: Now, I'm gonna be completely honest about this, so don't panic, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.dst: 자, 솔직하게 말할 테니까 당황하지 마, 근데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#028.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#029.src: I have... absolutely NO idea how we could even get an audience.
The Feathers Fly Part II#029.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#030.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one from the Council.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.dst: 흩어져서 의회 알현을 받는 방법을 알아봐야 할 것 같아.
The Feathers Fly Part II#030.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#031.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything! I'll ask around. You should too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.dst: 필요하면 마을 중심에 있을게! 난 여기저기 물어볼게. 너도 그래!
The Feathers Fly Part II#031.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#032.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.dst: 마지막으로 하나만... 좀 이상한 질문이면 미안한데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#032.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#034.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.dst: {u}? 그렇구나... 좋은 이름이네. 그럼, 행운을 빌어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#034.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#037.src: I've already seen plenty of green in my lifetime, y'know.
The Feathers Fly Part II#037.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#038.src: Well, I know you folks sure do love money. Maybe we can get noticed with this...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.dst: 뭐, 너희가 돈을 좋아하는 건 알아. 이걸로 눈길을 끌 수 있을지도...
The Feathers Fly Part II#038.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#039.src: Hmm... You know, this could actually work!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.dst: 음... 있잖아, 이거 진짜 통할 수도 있겠어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#039.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#040.src: I have no idea how this audience things works but i could try to get people to notice me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.dst: 알현이 어떻게 돌아가는지는 모르지만 사람들 눈길은 끌어 볼 수 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#040.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#041.src: Well, we should split up and meet up later to see what information we have. Just ask around town!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.dst: 자, 흩어졌다가 나중에 만나서 정보를 맞춰 보자. 마을에서 물어보고 다녀!
The Feathers Fly Part II#041.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#042.src: I'll be around the town center if you got any information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#042.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#043.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if thats a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.dst: 마지막으로 하나만... 좀 이상한 질문이면 미안한데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#043.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#045.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#045.dst: {u}? 그렇구나... 좋은 이름이네. 그럼, 행운을 빌어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#045.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#048.src: Ya got good taste! I always wanted to explore the ocean, y'know?
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.dst: 안목 좋은데! 난 늘 바다를 탐험하고 싶었거든.
The Feathers Fly Part II#048.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#049.src: Hey, thanks for helping me out so much. You've been such a huge help!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.dst: 이봐, 이렇게 많이 도와줘서 고마워. 정말 큰 힘이 됐어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#049.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#050.src: Well, this isn't over, of course. And to tell you the truth...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.dst: 물론 아직 안 끝났어. 그리고 솔직히 말하면...
The Feathers Fly Part II#050.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#051.src: I, uh, have no idea how to get an audience... Sorry?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.dst: 나, 어... 알현을 어떻게 받는지 모르겠어... 미안?
The Feathers Fly Part II#051.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#052.src: I think we need to split up and try to find out how to get one.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.dst: 흩어져서 방법을 알아봐야 할 것 같아.
The Feathers Fly Part II#052.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#053.src: I'll be around the town center if ya need me for anything!
The Feathers Fly Part II#053.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#054.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#054.dst: 마지막으로 하나만... 좀 이상한 질문이면 미안한데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#054.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#056.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#056.dst: {u}? 그렇구나... 좋은 이름이네. 그럼, 행운을 빌어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#056.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#057.src: Oh, and check this mask out! Time to be Ava the human!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.dst: 아, 그리고 이 가면 좀 봐! 인간 Ava가 될 시간이야!
The Feathers Fly Part II#057.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#059.src: I feel like... I'm not even supposed to be wearing this.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.dst: 왠지... 이런 걸 쓰면 안 될 것 같은데.
The Feathers Fly Part II#059.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#060.src: This looks... Really, really cool though! ...Wait, where did you even find this?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.dst: 그래도 이거... 진짜 진짜 멋지다! ...잠깐, 이걸 어디서 찾았어?
The Feathers Fly Part II#060.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#061.src: I saw this dog, and... Well, that's besides the point. You'll tell me later!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.dst: 개를 봤는데... 뭐, 그건 중요한 게 아니고. 나중에 얘기해 줘!
The Feathers Fly Part II#061.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#062.src: Look, this audience thing is foreign to me but I feel like it won't really be an issue with this... thing.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.dst: 알현이란 건 낯설지만, 이... 물건이 있으면 별문제 없을 것 같아.
The Feathers Fly Part II#062.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#063.src: Well, we still need information on who to even talk to for that stuff... I'll ask around.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.dst: 그래도 이런 건 누구한테 말해야 하는지 알아봐야 해... 여기저기 물어볼게.
The Feathers Fly Part II#063.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#064.src: You should too! I'll be around the town center! Come by once you got enough information!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.dst: 너도 그래! 난 마을 중심에 있을게! 정보가 모이면 와!
The Feathers Fly Part II#064.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#065.src: One last thing, though... Sorry if that's a little weird but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#065.dst: 마지막으로 하나만... 좀 이상한 질문이면 미안한데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#065.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#067.src: {u}, huh? That's... A nice name. Well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#067.dst: {u}? 그렇구나... 좋은 이름이네. 그럼, 행운을 빌어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#067.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#068.src: Ask around {p} for a way to get an audience with the Council. Ava is at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Feathers Fly Part II#068.dst: {p}에서 의회 알현을 받을 방법을 물어보세요. Ava는 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]에 있습니다

The Feathers Fly Part II#070.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.dst: 좋아, 이게 딱히 합법적이진 않은데, 듣자 하니...
The Feathers Fly Part II#070.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#071.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.dst: 알현 초대장을 파는... 수상한 거래상이 있대.
The Feathers Fly Part II#071.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#072.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.dst: 다른 방법도 있겠지만, 그 녀석은 동쪽 성 안, 왼쪽 첫 번째 문에 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#072.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#073.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#073.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#074.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#074.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#075.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.dst: 그래그래, 바로 저 성을 지나가면 접수원이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#075.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#076.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.dst: 알현을 따낼 확률은 아주 낮아. 차라리 남의 초대장을 훔치는 게 빠를걸, 헤!
The Feathers Fly Part II#076.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#077.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.dst: 그러고 보니... 한 시간 전쯤 마을 반대편에서 그런 일이 있었던 것 같은데.
The Feathers Fly Part II#077.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#078.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.dst: 초대장 잃어버린 사람을 도와도 되고, 훔쳐도 되고. 내가 네 상사도 아니고! 자, 가! 내 식물 밟지 마!
The Feathers Fly Part II#078.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#080.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#080.dst: 그러니까, 뭐, 누구나 신청은 할 수 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#080.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#081.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.dst: 근데 진짜 대단해야 해. 기분 나쁘게 하려는 건 아닌데, 넌 어림없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#081.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#082.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.dst: 정 하고 싶으면 접수원은 성 안에 있어. 동쪽으로 쭉 가.
The Feathers Fly Part II#082.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#083.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.dst: 근데 말해 두는데, 미친 녀석들이 드나드는 통에 그 여자 기분이 좋을 날이 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#083.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#084.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#084.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#085.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.dst: 으... 네 기계 맞혀 볼게. 무기야? 뭘 쏘는데? 모래?
The Feathers Fly Part II#085.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#086.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.dst: 미안, 좀 짜증 나서. 정말 알현을 원하면 담당 접수원이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#086.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#087.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.dst: 딴 사람한테 물어봐. 난 그런 거 담당 아니야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#087.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#088.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#088.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#089.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.dst: 난 세상에서 가장 위대한 로봇 검을 벼려 왔지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#089.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#090.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.dst: 자, 접수원한테 가서 미친 듯이 감탄하게 만들어야 해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#090.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#091.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.dst: 끝내주지! 최악이면 죽고, 운 좋으면 팔만 부러질 거야!
The Feathers Fly Part II#091.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#092.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.dst: 동쪽 성 안에 있어. 그냥 쭉 걸어가면 결국 도착해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#092.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#093.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#093.dst: 안녕, 무슨 일이야? 나도 알아낸 게 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#093.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#094.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.dst: 음... 접수원을 찾아가면 알현을 허락해 줄 수도 있다는 거지. 알았어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#094.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#095.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?

The Feathers Fly Part II#100.dst: 분명 다른 방법도 있을 거야. 그 접수원이 한 예지! 성 맨 끝 방에 있다고 했지?

The Feathers Fly Part II#101.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#101.dst: 사실, 거기까지 같이 가길 원하면 따라갈게! 말만 해!

The Feathers Fly Part II#103.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.dst: 이봐 꼬마. 알현이라고? 에헤헤... 좋은 생각이 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#103.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#104.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.dst: 그거 따내기 어렵거든... 엄~청 어렵지... 근데 방법을 알아.
The Feathers Fly Part II#104.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#105.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.dst: 아주, 아주 간단해... [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]만 주면 내가 해결해 주지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#105.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#106.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#106.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#107.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.dst: 그 이상한 거래상을 찾았다고? 설마 생각하는 건 아니지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#107.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#108.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#108.dst: 그러니까... 사실 알현을 얻는 방법이긴 하네. 뭘 원한대?

The Feathers Fly Part II#109.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.dst: [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]? 그게 많아? 난 인간이 아니잖아! 뭐, 아무튼!
The Feathers Fly Part II#109.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#110.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.dst: 원하면 사도 되는데, 알현을 얻을 다른 방법이 분명 있어. 굳이 살 필요는 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#110.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#111.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#111.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#112.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.dst: 고맙구먼! 거래해서 즐거웠어, 케헤... 행운을 빌지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#112.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#114.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.dst: 진짜 너희들은 대체 왜 이래! 나 혼자 5분만 있게 해 줄 수 없어?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#114.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#115.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.dst: 어머 죄~송해라, 누가 여기 오라고 했어? 날 "감탄"시키러 왔나?
The Feathers Fly Part II#115.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#116.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#116.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#117.src: Come back when you actually have something of interest. Goodbye.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.dst: 볼만한 게 생기면 다시 와. 잘 가.
The Feathers Fly Part II#117.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#118.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#118.dst: 응? 거래상도 찾고 알현을 얻을 다른 방법도 찾았다고?

The Feathers Fly Part II#119.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#119.dst: [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]? 많은지 모르겠네. 네가 찾은 다른 방법을 해 보자! 뭔데?

The Feathers Fly Part II#120.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#120.dst: 알현 담당 접수원이 있다고? 편하네! 그럼 가서 얘기해 보자!

The Feathers Fly Part II#121.dst: 그게... 진짜 어렵대? 아... 도움이 안 되네. 그래도 시도는 해 볼까?

The Feathers Fly Part II#122.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#122.dst: 원하면 그 이상한 거래상한테 사도 되지만, 접수원도 만나 봐야 해. 같이 가길 원하면 말해.

The Feathers Fly Part II#123.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.dst: 좋아, 가자. 거래상은 피하자. 법을 어기는 건 절대 싫거든!
The Feathers Fly Part II#123.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#124.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.dst: 그 거래상이 저 안에 있다고? 계속 가자. 저긴 피하고.
The Feathers Fly Part II#124.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#125.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.dst: 잠깐잠깐잠깐 방금 내가 뭐라고 했- 난 조용히 있을게...
The Feathers Fly Part II#125.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#126.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.dst: 어이, [에메랄드 블록 {~}개] 아니면 없어! 걱정 마, 둘 다 알현 받게 해 줄게! 네 여자분 수줍음 많네! 믿어, 네 고충 이해해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#126.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#127.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#127.dst: 고맙구먼! 거래해서 즐거웠어, 케헤... 행운을 빌지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#127.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#132.dst: 보여 줄 거라도 있어? 이 시간엔 일하고 있어야 하는 거 아냐?!

The Feathers Fly Part II#133.src: No, it's just that I, well... Nevermind, I do have a thing to show, it's, uh...
The Feathers Fly Part II#133.dst: 아뇨, 그냥 제가, 그게... 아니에요, 보여 드릴 게 있어요, 그게, 어...

The Feathers Fly Part II#134.dst: 한마디도 더 하지 마! 들을 만큼 들었어! 너희 둘은 내 시간을 쓸 가치가 없어!

The Feathers Fly Part II#135.src: Go back to your minimum wage job or something, but stay OUT of my room.

The Feathers Fly Part II#135.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#136.src: The citizens said it was hard, huh? No kidding. Maybe we should've had something before strolling in.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.dst: 주민들이 어렵다고 했지? 농담이 아니었네. 들어가기 전에 뭔가 준비했어야 했나 봐.
The Feathers Fly Part II#136.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#137.src: Look, we'll figure out another approach. This can't end here! We need an audience invitation letter.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.dst: 다른 방법을 찾아보자. 여기서 끝낼 순 없어! 알현 초대장이 필요해.
The Feathers Fly Part II#137.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#138.src: I'll head back to the town center, so if you want to talk I'll see ya there!

The Feathers Fly Part II#149.dst: 이 여관은 한동안 공사 중이야... 훔친 물건 숨기기 딱 좋은 곳이지!

The Feathers Fly Part II#151.dst: 저쪽에 수상한 골목이 있는 것 같은데... 어쩌면...

The Feathers Fly Part II#169.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#170.src: Sounds good? Hopefully it does, because you don't really have much of a choice. Well, you can leave now.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.dst: 괜찮지? 괜찮아야 할 거야, 너희한테 선택권은 없으니까. 자, 이제 가도 돼.
The Feathers Fly Part II#170.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#171.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.dst: 우리가 진짜 진전을 보다니! 너무 신나!
The Feathers Fly Part II#171.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#172.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#172.dst: 좋아, 알현 전에 기계를 시험해 봐야 해. 좀 손봤거든!

The Feathers Fly Part II#173.dst: 태워다 주길 원하면 북쪽 입구로 와. 걷는 걸 좋아하면 공방으로 바로 가도 돼!

The Feathers Fly Part II#175.src: So, how do I find help...
The Feathers Fly Part II#175.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#176.src: I sure do love... Money. Totally!

The Feathers Fly Part II#178.dst: 좋아, 이게 딱히 합법적이진 않은데, 듣자 하니...

The Feathers Fly Part II#179.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#179.dst: 알현 초대장을 파는... 수상한 거래상이 있대.

The Feathers Fly Part II#180.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#180.dst: 다른 방법도 있겠지만, 그 녀석은 동쪽 성 안, 왼쪽 첫 번째 문에 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#180.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#181.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#181.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#182.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#182.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#183.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#183.dst: 그래그래, 바로 저 성을 지나가면 접수원이 있어.

The Feathers Fly Part II#184.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#184.dst: 알현을 따낼 확률은 아주 낮아. 차라리 남의 초대장을 훔치는 게 빠를걸, 헤!

The Feathers Fly Part II#185.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#185.dst: 그러고 보니... 한 시간 전쯤 마을 반대편에서 그런 일이 있었던 것 같은데.
The Feathers Fly Part II#185.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#186.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#186.dst: 초대장 잃어버린 사람을 도와도 되고, 훔쳐도 되고. 내가 네 상사도 아니고! 자, 가! 내 식물 밟지 마!
The Feathers Fly Part II#186.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#188.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#188.dst: 그러니까, 뭐, 누구나 신청은 할 수 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#188.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#189.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#189.dst: 근데 진짜 대단해야 해. 기분 나쁘게 하려는 건 아닌데, 넌 어림없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#189.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#190.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#190.dst: 정 하고 싶으면 접수원은 성 안에 있어. 동쪽으로 쭉 가.
The Feathers Fly Part II#190.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#191.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#191.dst: 근데 말해 두는데, 미친 녀석들이 드나드는 통에 그 여자 기분이 좋을 날이 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#191.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#192.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#192.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#193.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#193.dst: 으... 네 기계 맞혀 볼게. 무기야? 뭘 쏘는데? 모래?
The Feathers Fly Part II#193.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#194.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#194.dst: 미안, 좀 짜증 나서. 정말 알현을 원하면 담당 접수원이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#194.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#195.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#195.dst: 딴 사람한테 물어봐. 난 그런 거 담당 아니야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#195.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#196.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#196.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#197.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#197.dst: 난 세상에서 가장 위대한 로봇 검을 벼려 왔지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#197.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#198.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#198.dst: 자, 접수원한테 가서 미친 듯이 감탄하게 만들어야 해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#198.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#199.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#199.dst: 끝내주지! 최악이면 죽고, 운 좋으면 팔만 부러질 거야!
The Feathers Fly Part II#199.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#200.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#200.dst: 동쪽 성 안에 있어. 그냥 쭉 걸어가면 결국 도착해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#200.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#201.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#201.dst: 안녕, 무슨 일이야? 나도 알아낸 게 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#201.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#202.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#202.dst: 음... 접수원을 찾아가면 알현을 허락해 줄 수도 있다는 거지. 알았어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#202.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#203.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#203.dst: 그럼 들어가서 우리가 얼마나 멋진지 보여 주면 되는 거지?
The Feathers Fly Part II#203.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#204.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#204.dst: 괜찮아, 각오 같은 걸 보여 주기만 하면 될 거야.

The Feathers Fly Part II#205.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#205.dst: 아, 맞다, 나도 알아낸 게 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#205.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#206.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#206.dst: 알현 초대장을 파는 수상한 녀석이 있대!
The Feathers Fly Part II#206.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#207.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#207.dst: 동쪽 성 안, 왼쪽 첫 번째였던 것 같아. 근데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#207.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#208.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#208.dst: 분명 다른 방법도 있을 거야. 그 접수원이 한 예지! 성 맨 끝 방에 있다고 했지?
The Feathers Fly Part II#208.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#209.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#209.dst: 사실, 거기까지 같이 가길 원하면 따라갈게! 말만 해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#209.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#211.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#211.dst: 이봐 꼬마. 알현이라고? 에헤헤... 좋은 생각이 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#211.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#212.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.

The Feathers Fly Part II#213.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!

The Feathers Fly Part II#214.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#214.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#216.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?

The Feathers Fly Part II#217.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!

The Feathers Fly Part II#217.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#218.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#218.dst: 원하면 사도 되는데, 알현을 얻을 다른 방법이 분명 있어. 굳이 살 필요는 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#218.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#219.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#219.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#220.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#220.dst: 고맙구먼! 거래해서 즐거웠어, 케헤... 행운을 빌지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#220.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#224.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.

The Feathers Fly Part II#225.dst: 볼만한 게 생기면 다시 와. 잘 가.
The Feathers Fly Part II#225.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#226.src: Oh? You found the dealer as well as one other way to get an audience?
The Feathers Fly Part II#226.dst: 응? 거래상도 찾고 알현을 얻을 다른 방법도 찾았다고?

The Feathers Fly Part II#227.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks], huh? No clue if that's a lot. I'd say we should try your other way! What is it?
The Feathers Fly Part II#227.dst: [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]? 많은지 모르겠네. 네가 찾은 다른 방법을 해 보자! 뭔데?

The Feathers Fly Part II#228.src: There's a receptionist for audiences? How convenient! We should go talk to her then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#228.dst: 알현 담당 접수원이 있다고? 편하네! 그럼 가서 얘기해 보자!
The Feathers Fly Part II#228.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#229.src: It's difficult to get an audience? Well, it's worth a try, right? Maybe they'll see me as a wealthy lad!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.dst: 알현 받기가 어렵다고? 뭐, 해 볼 만하잖아? 부자로 봐줄지도 몰라!
The Feathers Fly Part II#229.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#230.src: Buy from that weird dealer if ya want, but we also should try to go see that receptionist. Tell me if you want me to follow you there.
The Feathers Fly Part II#230.dst: 원하면 그 이상한 거래상한테 사도 되지만, 접수원도 만나 봐야 해. 같이 가길 원하면 말해.
The Feathers Fly Part II#230.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#231.src: Alright, let's go then. I'd say we should avoid the dealer, I definitely don't want to get on the bad side of the law!
The Feathers Fly Part II#231.dst: 좋아, 가자. 거래상은 피하자. 법을 어기는 건 절대 싫거든!
The Feathers Fly Part II#231.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#232.src: So, that dealer is in there, huh? Let's make sure to keep going. And avoid that place.
The Feathers Fly Part II#232.dst: 그 거래상이 저 안에 있다고? 계속 가자. 저긴 피하고.
The Feathers Fly Part II#232.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#233.src: Wait wait wait what did I just tell yo- I'll just make myself small...
The Feathers Fly Part II#233.dst: 잠깐잠깐잠깐 방금 내가 뭐라고 했- 난 조용히 있을게...
The Feathers Fly Part II#233.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#234.src: 'ey, it's [{~} Emerald Blocks] or nothin'! Don't worry, I can get you two an audience! Your lady's quite shy I see! Believe me, I understand your struggle!
The Feathers Fly Part II#234.dst: 어이, [에메랄드 블록 {~}개] 아니면 없어! 걱정 마, 둘 다 알현 받게 해 줄게! 네 여자분 수줍음 많네! 믿어, 네 고충 이해해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#234.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#235.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#235.dst: 고맙구먼! 거래해서 즐거웠어, 케헤... 행운을 빌지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#235.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#238.src: Why hello there! Greetings! Welcome! You are looking splendid, dear!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.dst: 어머 안녕하세요! 반가워요! 어서 오세요! 정말 근사하시네요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#238.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#239.src: Oh?! T-thank you... That's the first time someone told me such a thing!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.dst: 어?! 고, 고마워요... 그런 말은 처음 들어 봐요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#239.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#240.src: Don't be silly dear, you're beautiful! Say, you're looking to be an investor, am I right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.dst: 무슨 그런 말씀을, 아름다우세요! 그런데, 투자자가 되실 분이죠?
The Feathers Fly Part II#240.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#241.src: ...Will that grant me an audience with the Council?
The Feathers Fly Part II#241.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#242.src: Why of course! Is that other person your assistant? Great!
The Feathers Fly Part II#242.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#243.src: I'd like you to show me you have what it takes to be a great investor, yes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.dst: 훌륭한 투자자가 될 자질이 있다는 걸 보여 주세요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#243.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#244.src: Just hand over a mere [{~} Liquified Emeralds] and it's settled!
The Feathers Fly Part II#244.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#245.src: I- We'll... see what we can do.
The Feathers Fly Part II#245.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#246.src: Look, I'm not good at being a human but even I know this is an absurd amount of money!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.dst: 난 인간 노릇은 서툴지만 이게 말도 안 되는 금액이란 건 알아!
The Feathers Fly Part II#246.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#247.src: Do you think she'd actually take it? I'm not sure. We might have to find another way...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.dst: 진짜 받을까? 모르겠어. 다른 방법을 찾아야 할지도...
The Feathers Fly Part II#247.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#248.src: I'll go back to the town center. It's up to you if you want to risk all that money, if you even have it! We'll figure something else out.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.dst: 난 마을 중심으로 돌아갈게. 그 돈을 걸지는 네가 정해, 있기나 하다면! 다른 방법도 찾아보자.
The Feathers Fly Part II#248.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#249.src: Oh, you're back! With the money I see! Surprising! I like you two!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.dst: 어머, 돌아오셨네요! 돈도 가져오셨고요! 놀라워요! 두 분 마음에 들어요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#249.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#250.src: What? Of course I'm not taking the money! I just wanted to know if you had what it takes!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.dst: 네? 당연히 돈은 안 받죠! 자질이 있는지 알고 싶었을 뿐이에요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#250.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#251.src: Now I'm sure you're not a scam. Let me see when the council's available...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.dst: 이제 사기꾼이 아닌 게 확실하네요. 의회 일정을 확인해 볼게요...
The Feathers Fly Part II#251.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#252.src: Thanks! I'll try not to disappoint you.
The Feathers Fly Part II#252.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#253.src: You are two lucky people! We do have a free spot!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.dst: 두 분 운이 좋으시네요! 마침 빈자리가 있어요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#253.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#254.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you! We'll see you there then!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.dst: 내일 아침 괜찮으시면 좋겠어요! 그럼 그때 봬요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#254.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#256.src: That's crazy! [{~} Liquified Emeralds]? Is that how the world works?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.dst: 말도 안 돼! [액체 에메랄드 {~}개]? 세상이 원래 이래?
The Feathers Fly Part II#256.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#257.src: It's just... I honestly don't care about listening to the law anymore.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.dst: 그냥... 솔직히 이제 법 따위 신경 안 써.
The Feathers Fly Part II#257.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#258.src: Let's just get that audience. For one, there's some girl panicking by the Armour Merchant! Maybe she could help?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.dst: 알현이나 따내자. 우선 방어구 상인 근처에서 허둥대는 여자가 있어! 도와줄지도 몰라?
The Feathers Fly Part II#258.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#259.src: As for another way, I don't know if you paid attention on our way to the receptionist, but...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.dst: 다른 방법은, 접수원한테 가는 길에 네가 눈여겨봤는지 모르겠지만...
The Feathers Fly Part II#259.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#260.src: There is apparently a dealer in there. He does charge money too, though. But surely not as much as that... wretched... lady! ...Sorry.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.dst: 저 안에 거래상이 있대. 그 사람도 돈을 받긴 해. 그래도 그... 지독한... 여자만큼은 아니겠지! ...미안.
The Feathers Fly Part II#260.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#261.src: I'm sure we can find a free alternative. I'm counting on ya! Just tell me if you want me to follow you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#261.dst: 공짜 방법도 분명 찾을 수 있어. 믿을게! 같이 가길 원하면 말해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#261.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#262.src: Let's hope we get this right. You lead, I follow!
The Feathers Fly Part II#262.dst: 이번엔 잘 되길 바라자. 네가 앞장서, 따라갈게!
The Feathers Fly Part II#262.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#263.src: Oh, please don't mention the word "audience" to me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#263.dst: 아, 제발 나한테 "알현"이란 말은 꺼내지도 마!
The Feathers Fly Part II#263.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#264.src: I-I just got my invitation stolen! I can't believe this!
The Feathers Fly Part II#264.dst: 초, 초대장을 도둑맞았어! 믿을 수가 없어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#264.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#265.src: I asked around, obviously no one knows anything! I'm trying to look for it...
The Feathers Fly Part II#265.dst: 여기저기 물어봤는데 당연히 아무도 몰라! 찾아보는 중이야...
The Feathers Fly Part II#265.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#266.src: This inn has been under renovation for a while now... It's quite the spot to hide a stolen item!
The Feathers Fly Part II#266.dst: 이 여관은 한동안 공사 중이야... 훔친 물건 숨기기 딱 좋은 곳이지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#266.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#267.src: But nooo, of course it's locked! Though it looks like we can access it from the back...
The Feathers Fly Part II#267.dst: 근데 당연히 잠겨 있잖아! 그래도 뒤쪽으로 들어갈 수 있을 것 같아...
The Feathers Fly Part II#267.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#268.src: It looks like there's some shady alleyway over there... Maybe...
The Feathers Fly Part II#268.dst: 저쪽에 수상한 골목이 있는 것 같은데... 어쩌면...
The Feathers Fly Part II#268.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#269.src: Ugh, sorry for ranting so much. I don't even know you. I'm sure there's a passage over there...
The Feathers Fly Part II#269.dst: 으, 너무 넋두리해서 미안. 모르는 사이인데. 분명 저쪽에 통로가 있을 거야...
The Feathers Fly Part II#269.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#270.src: Wait wait wait, I'm sure you're onto something but I'd rather not do anything fishy in town. Do what you wish, I'll hang around at the town center.
The Feathers Fly Part II#270.dst: 잠깐잠깐, 뭔가 알아낸 것 같지만 난 마을에서 수상한 짓은 하기 싫어. 알아서 해, 난 마을 중심에 있을게.
The Feathers Fly Part II#270.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#280.src: Oh! Why hello there you two! How may I be of assistance?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.dst: 어머! 두 분 안녕하세요! 무엇을 도와드릴까요?
The Feathers Fly Part II#280.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#281.src: Oh, uh, greetings! We have something for you!
The Feathers Fly Part II#281.dst: 아, 어, 안녕하세요! 드릴 게 있어요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#281.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#282.src: You're looking splendid dear! Now, are you-- Wait, you have a letter?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.dst: 정말 근사하시네요! 그럼, 혹시- 잠깐, 편지를 갖고 계세요?
The Feathers Fly Part II#282.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#283.src: That's... Unprecedented. Let me check when the council's available and book an audience...
The Feathers Fly Part II#283.dst: 이건... 전례가 없는 일인데. 의회 일정을 확인하고 알현을 잡아 줄게...
The Feathers Fly Part II#283.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#284.src: You two are extremely lucky. I can barely believe it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#284.dst: 너희 둘 운이 엄청 좋네. 믿기지가 않아.
The Feathers Fly Part II#284.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#285.src: I hope tomorrow morning is good for you, because the Council's somehow available at that time.
The Feathers Fly Part II#285.dst: 내일 아침 괜찮았으면 좋겠네. 어째선지 그때 의회가 비어 있거든.
The Feathers Fly Part II#285.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#286.src: You know miss, you look like you could've been a great investor. Oh well, good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.dst: 아가씨, 훌륭한 투자자가 되셨을 것 같은데. 아쉽네요, 행운을 빌어요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#286.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#287.src: If you want a tip, well... There's a new guy in the Council, so he might be easier to impress!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.dst: 팁을 드리자면... 의회에 새로 온 분이 있어서 감탄시키기 쉬울 거예요!
The Feathers Fly Part II#287.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#288.src: I can't believe we're actually progressing! This is so exciting!
The Feathers Fly Part II#288.dst: 우리가 진짜 진전을 보다니! 너무 신나!
The Feathers Fly Part II#288.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#289.src: Alright, we need to test the machine before the audience. I've made some tweaks!
The Feathers Fly Part II#289.dst: 좋아, 알현 전에 기계를 시험해 봐야 해. 좀 손봤거든!
The Feathers Fly Part II#289.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#290.src: Meet me near the northern entrance if ya want a lift. Alternatively, you can just go by the Workshop if you're into walking!
The Feathers Fly Part II#290.dst: 태워다 주길 원하면 북쪽 입구로 와. 걷는 걸 좋아하면 공방으로 바로 가도 돼!
The Feathers Fly Part II#290.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#295.src: Alright, so it's not really on the legal side of things, BUT apparently...
The Feathers Fly Part II#295.dst: 좋아, 이게 딱히 합법적이진 않은데, 듣자 하니...
The Feathers Fly Part II#295.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#296.src: There's some sort of... Shady dealer you can buy an audience invitation from?
The Feathers Fly Part II#296.dst: 알현 초대장을 파는... 수상한 거래상이 있대.
The Feathers Fly Part II#296.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#297.src: I'm sure there are other ways, but the dude should be in the castle to the east, first door to the left.
The Feathers Fly Part II#297.dst: 다른 방법도 있겠지만, 그 녀석은 동쪽 성 안, 왼쪽 첫 번째 문에 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#297.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#298.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#298.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#299.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#299.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#300.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#300.dst: 그래그래, 바로 저 성을 지나가면 접수원이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#300.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#301.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#301.dst: 알현을 따낼 확률은 아주 낮아. 차라리 남의 초대장을 훔치는 게 빠를걸, 헤!
The Feathers Fly Part II#301.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#302.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#302.dst: 그러고 보니... 한 시간 전쯤 마을 반대편에서 그런 일이 있었던 것 같은데.
The Feathers Fly Part II#302.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#303.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#303.dst: 초대장 잃어버린 사람을 도와도 되고, 훔쳐도 되고. 내가 네 상사도 아니고! 자, 가! 내 식물 밟지 마!
The Feathers Fly Part II#303.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#305.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#305.dst: 그러니까, 뭐, 누구나 신청은 할 수 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#305.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#306.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#306.dst: 근데 진짜 대단해야 해. 기분 나쁘게 하려는 건 아닌데, 넌 어림없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#306.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#307.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#307.dst: 정 하고 싶으면 접수원은 성 안에 있어. 동쪽으로 쭉 가.
The Feathers Fly Part II#307.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#308.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#308.dst: 근데 말해 두는데, 미친 녀석들이 드나드는 통에 그 여자 기분이 좋을 날이 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#308.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#309.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#309.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#310.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#310.dst: 으... 네 기계 맞혀 볼게. 무기야? 뭘 쏘는데? 모래?
The Feathers Fly Part II#310.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#311.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#311.dst: 미안, 좀 짜증 나서. 정말 알현을 원하면 담당 접수원이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#311.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#312.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#312.dst: 딴 사람한테 물어봐. 난 그런 거 담당 아니야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#312.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#313.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#313.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#314.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#314.dst: 난 세상에서 가장 위대한 로봇 검을 벼려 왔지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#314.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#315.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#315.dst: 자, 접수원한테 가서 미친 듯이 감탄하게 만들어야 해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#315.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#316.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#316.dst: 끝내주지! 최악이면 죽고, 운 좋으면 팔만 부러질 거야!
The Feathers Fly Part II#316.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#317.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#317.dst: 동쪽 성 안에 있어. 그냥 쭉 걸어가면 결국 도착해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#317.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#318.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#318.dst: 안녕, 무슨 일이야? 나도 알아낸 게 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#318.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#319.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#319.dst: 음... 접수원을 찾아가면 알현을 허락해 줄 수도 있다는 거지. 알았어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#319.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#320.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#320.dst: 그럼 들어가서 우리가 얼마나 멋진지 보여 주면 되는 거지?
The Feathers Fly Part II#320.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#321.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#321.dst: 괜찮아, 각오 같은 걸 보여 주기만 하면 될 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#321.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#322.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#322.dst: 아, 맞다, 나도 알아낸 게 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#322.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#323.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#323.dst: 알현 초대장을 파는 수상한 녀석이 있대!
The Feathers Fly Part II#323.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#324.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#324.dst: 동쪽 성 안, 왼쪽 첫 번째였던 것 같아. 근데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#324.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#325.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#325.dst: 분명 다른 방법도 있을 거야. 그 접수원이 한 예지! 성 맨 끝 방에 있다고 했지?
The Feathers Fly Part II#325.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#326.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#326.dst: 사실, 거기까지 같이 가길 원하면 따라갈게! 말만 해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#326.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#328.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#328.dst: 이봐 꼬마. 알현이라고? 에헤헤... 좋은 생각이 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#328.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#329.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#329.dst: 그거 따내기 어렵거든... 엄~청 어렵지... 근데 방법을 알아.
The Feathers Fly Part II#329.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#330.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#330.dst: 아주, 아주 간단해... [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]만 주면 내가 해결해 주지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#330.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#331.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#331.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#332.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#332.dst: 그 이상한 거래상을 찾았다고? 설마 생각하는 건 아니지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#332.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#333.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#333.dst: 그러니까... 사실 알현을 얻는 방법이긴 하네. 뭘 원한대?

The Feathers Fly Part II#409.dst: 다른 방법도 있겠지만, 그 녀석은 동쪽 성 안, 왼쪽 첫 번째 문에 있을 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#409.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#410.src: Do with that what you will. I guess I'll... Keep looking.
The Feathers Fly Part II#410.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#411.src: An audience? Oh, you're one of those, I see...
The Feathers Fly Part II#411.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#412.src: Yeah yeah, just go through the castle right there and you'll reach the receptionist.
The Feathers Fly Part II#412.dst: 그래그래, 바로 저 성을 지나가면 접수원이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#412.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#413.src: The chances you get one are really slim. You'd have more luck stealing the invitation from someone, heh!
The Feathers Fly Part II#413.dst: 알현을 따낼 확률은 아주 낮아. 차라리 남의 초대장을 훔치는 게 빠를걸, 헤!

The Feathers Fly Part II#414.src: Speaking of which... I think that actually just happened an hour ago on the opposite side of town.
The Feathers Fly Part II#414.dst: 그러고 보니... 한 시간 전쯤 마을 반대편에서 그런 일이 있었던 것 같은데.
The Feathers Fly Part II#414.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#415.src: Maybe you can help whoever lost their invitation. Maybe you can steal it. I'm not the boss of you! Now, shoo! Don't step on my plants!
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.dst: 초대장 잃어버린 사람을 도와도 되고, 훔쳐도 되고. 내가 네 상사도 아니고! 자, 가! 내 식물 밟지 마!
The Feathers Fly Part II#415.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#417.src: I mean, yeah, anyone can try getting one...
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.dst: 그러니까, 뭐, 누구나 신청은 할 수 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#417.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#418.src: You have to be real impressive though. Like, I don't wanna be mean, but you ain't gonna cut it.
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.dst: 근데 진짜 대단해야 해. 기분 나쁘게 하려는 건 아닌데, 넌 어림없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#418.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#419.src: If you really want to, the receptionist is in the castle. Just go east and don't stop.
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.dst: 정 하고 싶으면 접수원은 성 안에 있어. 동쪽으로 쭉 가.
The Feathers Fly Part II#419.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#420.src: Lemme tell ya though, with all the crazy lads goin' in, she's never in a good mood.
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.dst: 근데 말해 두는데, 미친 녀석들이 드나드는 통에 그 여자 기분이 좋을 날이 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#420.speaker: Gardener

The Feathers Fly Part II#421.src: Oh, hi there. Whatcha lookin' for? ...An audience? What?
The Feathers Fly Part II#421.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#422.src: Urgh... Let me guess what your machine is. Is it a weapon? What does it shoot? Sand?
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.dst: 으... 네 기계 맞혀 볼게. 무기야? 뭘 쏘는데? 모래?
The Feathers Fly Part II#422.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#423.src: Sorry, it's just a li'l annoying. If you really want an audience, there is a receptionist for that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.dst: 미안, 좀 짜증 나서. 정말 알현을 원하면 담당 접수원이 있어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#423.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#424.src: Ask others. I ain't the one for that kind of stuff.
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.dst: 딴 사람한테 물어봐. 난 그런 거 담당 아니야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#424.speaker: Corkus Jeweler

The Feathers Fly Part II#425.src: Oh, are you interested in getting an audience too?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#425.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#426.src: I've been forgin' away the greatest robotized swords the world shall ever see!
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.dst: 난 세상에서 가장 위대한 로봇 검을 벼려 왔지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#426.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#427.src: Look, ya gotta go up to the receptionist and impress her like crazy!
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.dst: 자, 접수원한테 가서 미친 듯이 감탄하게 만들어야 해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#427.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#428.src: It's great! Worst-case scenario, you die, but with enough luck only your arm gets broken!
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.dst: 끝내주지! 최악이면 죽고, 운 좋으면 팔만 부러질 거야!
The Feathers Fly Part II#428.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#429.src: She's inside the castle to the east, just go through and keep walkin', you'll get there eventually!
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.dst: 동쪽 성 안에 있어. 그냥 쭉 걸어가면 결국 도착해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#429.speaker: Weaponsmith

The Feathers Fly Part II#430.src: Hey, what's up? I do have somethin'!
The Feathers Fly Part II#430.dst: 안녕, 무슨 일이야? 나도 알아낸 게 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#430.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#431.src: Hmm... So we can go see a receptionist and they just might grant us an audience. Got it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.dst: 음... 접수원을 찾아가면 알현을 허락해 줄 수도 있다는 거지. 알았어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#431.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#432.src: So we go in, show her how cool we are, and I guess that'd work, huh?
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.dst: 그럼 들어가서 우리가 얼마나 멋진지 보여 주면 되는 거지?
The Feathers Fly Part II#432.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#433.src: That's fine, I'm sure you just have to show her your resolve or something.
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.dst: 괜찮아, 각오 같은 걸 보여 주기만 하면 될 거야.
The Feathers Fly Part II#433.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#434.src: Oh, right, I had something too!
The Feathers Fly Part II#434.dst: 아, 맞다, 나도 알아낸 게 있어!
The Feathers Fly Part II#434.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#435.src: There's apparently some sort of shady dude selling audience invitations!
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.dst: 알현 초대장을 파는 수상한 녀석이 있대!
The Feathers Fly Part II#435.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#436.src: I believe it's in the castle to the east, on the first left? Though...
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.dst: 동쪽 성 안, 왼쪽 첫 번째였던 것 같아. 근데...
The Feathers Fly Part II#436.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#437.src: I'm sure there are other ways to go about this. Like that receptionist, for one! So she's in the last room of the castle, right?
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.dst: 분명 다른 방법도 있을 거야. 그 접수원이 한 예지! 성 맨 끝 방에 있다고 했지?
The Feathers Fly Part II#437.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#438.src: In fact, if you want me to follow you there, I can do that! Just tell me!
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.dst: 사실, 거기까지 같이 가길 원하면 따라갈게! 말만 해!
The Feathers Fly Part II#438.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#440.src: Hey kid. An audience, huh? Eheheh... I do have an idea...
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.dst: 이봐 꼬마. 알현이라고? 에헤헤... 좋은 생각이 있지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#440.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#441.src: Y'know, it's hard to get one... Reeeaaal hard... But I know a way.
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.dst: 그거 따내기 어렵거든... 엄~청 어렵지... 근데 방법을 알아.
The Feathers Fly Part II#441.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#442.src: It's really, really simple... Ya just gotta hand me [{~} Emerald Blocks] and I'll work it out!
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.dst: 아주, 아주 간단해... [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]만 주면 내가 해결해 주지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#442.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#443.src: ...eheheh... Well, you know where to find me if you're up to it!
The Feathers Fly Part II#443.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#444.src: So you found that weird dealer? Surely you're not thinking of...
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.dst: 그 이상한 거래상을 찾았다고? 설마 생각하는 건 아니지...
The Feathers Fly Part II#444.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#445.src: I mean... Actually, that'd be a way to get an audience, for sure. What does he want?
The Feathers Fly Part II#445.dst: 그러니까... 사실 알현을 얻는 방법이긴 하네. 뭘 원한대?

The Feathers Fly Part II#446.src: [{~} Emerald Blocks]? Is that a lot? I'm not human, y'know! Well, anyway!
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.dst: [에메랄드 블록 {~}개]? 그게 많아? 난 인간이 아니잖아! 뭐, 아무튼!
The Feathers Fly Part II#446.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#447.src: Buy that if you want, but I'm certain there are other ways to obtain an audience. You don't really have to buy that.
The Feathers Fly Part II#447.dst: 원하면 사도 되는데, 알현을 얻을 다른 방법이 분명 있어. 굳이 살 필요는 없어.
The Feathers Fly Part II#447.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#448.src: Well, I'll just... Keep looking then.
The Feathers Fly Part II#448.speaker: Ava

The Feathers Fly Part II#449.src: Why thank you! 't was a pleasure doing business with you keheh... Good luck!
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.dst: 고맙구먼! 거래해서 즐거웠어, 케헤... 행운을 빌지!
The Feathers Fly Part II#449.speaker: Corkus Citizen

The Feathers Fly Part II#451.src: Seriously what is it with you people! Can't I be left alone for FIVE MINUTES?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.dst: 진짜 너희들은 대체 왜 이래! 나 혼자 5분만 있게 해 줄 수 없어?!
The Feathers Fly Part II#451.speaker: Receptionist

The Feathers Fly Part II#452.src: Oh excuuuuse me, did someone tell you to come here? Are you going to "impress" me?
The Feathers Fly Part II#452.dst: 어머 죄~송해라, 누가 여기 오라고 했어? 날 "감탄"시키러 왔나?

The Feathers Fly Part II#453.src: Well, let me tell ya', you FAILED.
The Feathers Fly Part II#453.speaker: Receptionist
