The Price of Ingenuity#463.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#464.src: Hello, we're meant to run! Are you even taking this seriously?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.dst: 저기요, 우리 도망쳐야 하거든! 진지하게 하는 거 맞아?!
The Price of Ingenuity#464.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#465.src: ...you're smart enough that I shouldn't need to reiterate this! I know you are! Please, take the problem seriously!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.dst: ...넌 똑똑하니까 같은 말 되풀이할 필요도 없어야지! 똑똑한 거 알아! 제발, 이 문제를 진지하게 받아들여!
The Price of Ingenuity#465.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#466.src: A set of criminals is in your quadrant, the Cursed behind the Torann massacre is with them, they're infil-
The Price of Ingenuity#466.dst: 범죄자 무리가 네 사분면에 있어. Torann 학살의 저주받은 자도 함께고, 놈들이 잠입-
The Price of Ingenuity#466.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#467.src: Oh my god, Z, I get it!!! All you do is yap yap yap yap YAP!!! Give me some room to think!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#467.dst: 세상에, Z, 알겠다고!!! 넌 맨날 떠들고 떠들고 떠들고 또 떠들어!!! 생각할 틈 좀 줘!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#467.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#468.src: Bla bla criminals, bla bla cursed one!!!! Yes, I know how important it is! Flowers, hold this steady for me, won't you?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.dst: 어쩌고 범죄자, 저쩌고 저주받은 자!!!! 그래, 얼마나 중요한지 알아! Flowers, 이것 좀 꽉 잡아 줄래?
The Price of Ingenuity#468.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#469.src: As long as your focus is on the solutions, not your... But, Soosu, I haven't heard anything from you. There was key information I had to learn offhand!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.dst: 해답에 집중만 한다면야, 네... 하지만 Soosu, 너한테선 아무 소식도 못 들었어. 핵심 정보를 딴 데서 주워들어야 했다고!
The Price of Ingenuity#469.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#470.src: One of your commanders summarized the topic for me. I should've heard it from you! So...what's your angle? It feels like you're ignoring the issue.
The Price of Ingenuity#470.dst: 네 지휘관 하나가 요약해 주더군. 너한테 직접 들었어야지! 그래서... 속셈이 뭐야? 문제를 외면하는 것 같아.
The Price of Ingenuity#470.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#471.src: ...Soosu? Soosu, are you listening? I asked you a question!
The Price of Ingenuity#471.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#472.src: Hm? Yeah, yeah, sure. Hey, could you fetch me some bolts?
The Price of Ingenuity#472.dst: 응? 그래, 그래, 알았어. 저기, 볼트 좀 갖다줄래?
The Price of Ingenuity#472.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#473.src: ...fine, sure- But please, we have to round this out, Soosu. You have to get involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#473.dst: ...좋아, 그래- 하지만 제발, 이 일은 매듭지어야 해, Soosu. 너도 나서야 해.
The Price of Ingenuity#473.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#475.src: Oh, right, about Flowers. Could you go check if his body picked up any parts while walking that I could use?
The Price of Ingenuity#475.dst: 아, 맞다, Flowers 말인데. 걸어 다니다가 몸에 내가 쓸 만한 부품이 붙었는지 좀 봐 줄래?
The Price of Ingenuity#475.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#477.src: I knew letting you work in here was irrational. There's such a greater sum of problems than your toys! You're acting like a child, but you aren't one!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.dst: 여기서 일하게 둔 게 비합리적이었어. 네 장난감보다 풀 문제의 총합이 훨씬 크다고! 애처럼 굴지만 넌 애가 아니야!
The Price of Ingenuity#477.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#478.src: I know you can do such good work if you just apply yourself! Why are you just ignoring a high-ranking defector and a Cursed exponentiating each others' threat?!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.dst: 마음만 먹으면 훌륭하게 해낼 수 있잖아! 고위 탈영자와 저주받은 자가 서로의 위협을 거듭제곱하는데 왜 외면해?!
The Price of Ingenuity#478.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#480.src: Do you think you're better than me, Zhiraok?
The Price of Ingenuity#480.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#481.src: Oh, look at Soosu, always so inattentive and clueless, always ignoring the needs of her district, always cooped up in her laboratory.
The Price of Ingenuity#481.dst: 오, Soosu 좀 봐, 맨날 산만하고 아무것도 모르고, 자기 구역은 나 몰라라, 맨날 연구실에 틀어박혀 있네.
The Price of Ingenuity#481.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#482.src: Who even cares about the work she does? The projects she's assigned?! Who even cares that she knows, she knows, she KNOWS!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#482.dst: 그 여자가 하는 일 누가 신경이나 써? 맡은 프로젝트는?! 그 여자가 안다는 걸, 안다는 걸, '안다는' 걸 누가 신경 써!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#482.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#483.src: ...Hm! Maybe you are better, Z. If you weren't, maybe we wouldn't be here right now!!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.dst: ...흥! 네가 더 나은지도 모르지, Z. 안 그랬으면 우리가 지금 이 꼴은 아니었을 테니까!!
The Price of Ingenuity#483.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#484.src: I... ... ...I'm sorry Soosu. That...that wasn't my angle, I didn't mean t-
The Price of Ingenuity#484.dst: 나... ... ...미안해, Soosu. 그건... 그런 의도가 아니었어, 그럴 생각은-
The Price of Ingenuity#484.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#485.src: But you did! Hand me cog C-{~}, would you?
The Price of Ingenuity#485.dst: 근데 했잖아! C-{~}번 톱니 좀 건네줄래?
The Price of Ingenuity#485.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#486.src: ...alright. I just want to reach the end of this sequence as fast as possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#486.dst: ...알았어. 이 수열의 끝에 최대한 빨리 닿고 싶을 뿐이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#486.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#487.src: That makes two of us. I'm working on it. You can stop bugging me about it!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.dst: 나도 마찬가지야. 하고 있다고. 그만 좀 들볶아!!
The Price of Ingenuity#487.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#488.src: ...maybe I should've been paying more attention. I didn't realize her project was putting so much weight on your shoulders. And I promised to help, too...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.dst: ...내가 더 신경 썼어야 했는데. 그 여자 프로젝트가 네 어깨를 이렇게 짓누르는 줄 몰랐어. 돕겠다고 약속까지 했는데...
The Price of Ingenuity#488.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

The Price of Ingenuity#489.src: Preliminary results suggest significantly improved utilization of energy, and reduced pollution. (Cleaner air? May help.)
The Price of Ingenuity#489.dst: 예비 결과에 따르면 에너지 활용도가 크게 향상되고 오염이 줄었다. (공기가 깨끗해지면? 도움이 될지도.)

The Price of Ingenuity#491.src: Return to the Steel Feather through Yusanu's tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
The Price of Ingenuity#491.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Yusanu 터널을 통해 Steel Feather로 돌아가세요.

The Price of Ingenuity#492.src: ...what was that?! What were they DOING there?!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.dst: ...방금 뭐였어?! 저 사람들이 거기서 뭘 한 거야?!
The Price of Ingenuity#492.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#493.src: I- I- I don't know! A surprise visit? I didn't... I didn't think...
The Price of Ingenuity#493.dst: 나- 나- 나도 몰라! 깜짝 방문? 난... 그럴 줄은...
The Price of Ingenuity#493.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#494.src: So, "letting off some steam", huh?! Oh, sure, bring Sovereign Zhiraok along with you!! Why not!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#494.dst: 그러니까, '화풀이할 때'라고?! 아, 그래, Zhiraok 군주도 데려오시지!! 왜 안 되겠어!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#494.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#495.src: We almost got caught! We- oh god, we... we almost got caught...
The Price of Ingenuity#495.dst: 하마터면 잡힐 뻔했어! 우리- 세상에, 우리... 잡힐 뻔했다고...
The Price of Ingenuity#495.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#496.src: ...what are we doing? Why did- why did we do that? That was so...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.dst: ...우리 뭐 하는 거지? 왜- 왜 그런 짓을 했지? 그건 너무...
The Price of Ingenuity#496.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#497.src: You're asking ME?! Yeah, Rex, why did we do that?!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.dst: 그걸 '나'한테 물어?! 그래, Rex, 우리 왜 그랬을까?!
The Price of Ingenuity#497.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#498.src: Stop. Just... stop, for a second. I need to... think.
The Price of Ingenuity#498.dst: 그만. 그냥... 잠깐만 그만해. 생각 좀... 해야겠어.
The Price of Ingenuity#498.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#499.src: ...damn it. Damn it, damn it, damn it! Stupid, impulsive... ugh!!
The Price of Ingenuity#499.dst: ...젠장. 젠장, 젠장, 젠장! 멍청하고, 충동적이고... 으!!
The Price of Ingenuity#499.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#501.src: No, I... I'm not. I'm sorry, I- I should know better by now...
The Price of Ingenuity#501.dst: 아니, 난... 안 괜찮아. 미안, 나- 이젠 좀 알 때도 됐는데...
The Price of Ingenuity#501.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#502.src: It... doesn't matter. It's too late to take it back. We can... we can use it as a trump card. Yusanu, please tell me you can figure out what it is.
The Price of Ingenuity#502.dst: 그건... 상관없어. 되돌리기엔 늦었어. 이걸... 비장의 카드로 쓸 수 있어. Yusanu, 이게 뭔지 알아낼 수 있다고 해 줘.
The Price of Ingenuity#502.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#503.src: I... I don't know. I never got to work too closely with it, so... I have no idea what it is. If I work with it, maybe I can get somewhere. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#503.dst: 나... 모르겠어. 가까이서 다뤄 본 적이 없어서... 뭔지 전혀 몰라. 직접 연구해 보면 뭔가 알아낼지도. 하지만...
The Price of Ingenuity#503.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#504.src: Good enough, I guess. Come on, let's get back. I need to... find Mora. And you need to tell everyone what you've been up to.
The Price of Ingenuity#504.dst: 그 정도면 됐어. 가자, 돌아가자. 난... Mora를 찾아야 해. 그리고 넌 그동안 뭘 했는지 모두한테 말해야 하고.
The Price of Ingenuity#504.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#505.src: You collectively decide that leaving Flowers be is probably best for everyone involved.
The Price of Ingenuity#505.dst: Flowers는 그냥 두는 게 모두에게 가장 좋겠다고 함께 결론을 내렸다.

The Price of Ingenuity#506.src: These vents are broken, and were blocked off for a reason. Proceeding further will be dangerous!
The Price of Ingenuity#506.dst: 이 환풍구들은 고장 나 있고, 막아 둔 데는 이유가 있다. 더 나아가면 위험하다!

The Price of Ingenuity#507.src: ...so just hiding what we did today isn't an option?
The Price of Ingenuity#507.dst: ...오늘 한 일을 그냥 숨기는 건 안 돼?
The Price of Ingenuity#507.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#508.src: And let it come back to bite us later down the line? No thanks. Let's go.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.dst: 그러다 나중에 뒤통수 맞으라고? 사양할게. 가자.
The Price of Ingenuity#508.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#509.src: Really, Rex, are you... alright? I don't think I've ever seen-
The Price of Ingenuity#509.dst: 진짜, Rex, 너... 괜찮아? 이런 모습은 처음 보-
The Price of Ingenuity#509.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#510.src: Don't. Don't push it. Not right now.
The Price of Ingenuity#510.dst: 하지 마. 몰아붙이지 마. 지금은 안 돼.
The Price of Ingenuity#510.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#511.src: Hey! You three, where the heck have you been all day?!
The Price of Ingenuity#511.dst: 야! 너희 셋, 하루 종일 대체 어디 있었어?!
The Price of Ingenuity#511.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#513.src: Yes, it's rather curious! I happened to speak to Syndra, and apparently there were no such "important tasks" assigned to you! She seemed rather clueless about the whole matter!
The Price of Ingenuity#513.dst: 그래요, 참 궁금하군요! 마침 Syndra와 얘기했는데, 그런 '중요한 일'은 맡긴 적이 없다더군요! 전혀 모르는 눈치였어요!
The Price of Ingenuity#513.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#515.src: You know what happened, Mora. I- I messed up. Again.
The Price of Ingenuity#515.dst: 무슨 일인지 알잖아, Mora. 나- 또 망쳤어. 또.
The Price of Ingenuity#515.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#516.src: Huh? What do you mean, agai-
The Price of Ingenuity#516.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#517.src: Ah, Yuman, would you mind taking Yusanu along with you to go tell the others we'll be a little late to the meeting? I believe there will be some additional news today.
The Price of Ingenuity#517.dst: 아, Yuman, Yusanu를 데리고 다른 사람들한테 우리가 회의에 좀 늦는다고 전해 줄래요? 오늘 추가 소식이 있을 것 같네요.
The Price of Ingenuity#517.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#518.src: Uh... sure, I guess. Yus, can you tell me what's up while we walk?
The Price of Ingenuity#518.dst: 어... 뭐, 그래. Yus 형, 가면서 무슨 일인지 말해 줄래?
The Price of Ingenuity#518.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#521.src: It's... bad. We stole something important from the Sovereign's workshop. It's... a long story. Yusanu should tell his part of it. But...
The Price of Ingenuity#521.dst: 그게... 나빠. 군주 작업장에서 중요한 걸 훔쳤어. 그건... 얘기가 길어. Yusanu가 자기 몫을 말해야 해. 하지만...
The Price of Ingenuity#521.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#522.src: I see. I apologize, Rex, I should have been more attentive.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.dst: 그렇군요. 미안해요, Rex. 내가 더 신경 썼어야 했는데.
The Price of Ingenuity#522.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#523.src: No! No, it's not your fault, I should have- I should have known I was being impulsive, I... I wasn't thinking straight.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.dst: 아니! 아니야, 네 잘못 아니야. 내가- 내가 충동적인 걸 알아챘어야 했어, 난... 제정신이 아니었어.
The Price of Ingenuity#523.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#524.src: Ah. Of course, you don't know. I should have informed you the last time this happened...
The Price of Ingenuity#524.dst: 아. 당연히 모르겠군요. 지난번 이런 일이 있었을 때 알려 줬어야 했는데...
The Price of Ingenuity#524.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#525.src: Rex has these... ah, "moods," sometimes, wherein she gets... overly excitable and impulsive. Many a time have they led her into trouble.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.dst: Rex는 가끔... 아, '기분'이 있어요. 그럴 땐... 지나치게 흥분하고 충동적이 되지요. 그 때문에 곤경에 빠진 적이 많아요.
The Price of Ingenuity#525.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#526.src: Ugh, I should know better by now! Especially here, especially now, when...
The Price of Ingenuity#526.dst: 으, 이젠 좀 알 때도 됐는데! 특히 여기서, 특히 지금, 이럴 때...
The Price of Ingenuity#526.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#527.src: Well, what is done is done, and nevertheless, we must press on. Let's join the others for the meeting. Syndra has something important to tell us.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.dst: 뭐, 이미 벌어진 일이고, 그래도 우린 나아가야 해요. 회의하러 모두와 합류하죠. Syndra가 중요한 할 말이 있대요.
The Price of Ingenuity#527.speaker: Mora

The Price of Ingenuity#528.src: Attend the meeting in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Price of Ingenuity#529.src: There you are! Mora, Rex, what's going-
The Price of Ingenuity#529.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#530.src: Syndra, I believe that can wait. We've, ah, held up dinner long enough, I believe. If everyone is here, we should begin. First- Yusanu, what was it you had to tell us?
The Price of Ingenuity#530.dst: Syndra, 그건 나중에 해도 될 것 같아요. 저녁을, 아, 너무 오래 미뤘으니까요. 다 모였으면 시작하죠. 먼저- Yusanu, 할 말이 뭐였죠?
The Price of Ingenuity#530.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#531.src: ...sigh. Before I begin, I need to make it clear- I was doing what I thought was best for the Steel Feather.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.dst: ...하아. 시작하기 전에 분명히 할게- 난 Steel Feather를 위해 최선이라고 생각한 일을 했어.
The Price of Ingenuity#531.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#532.src: Yeah, man, good start... really instills confidence.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.dst: 그래, 시작 좋네... 아주 믿음이 간다.
The Price of Ingenuity#532.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#533.src: Yuman, please... let me get through this. Don't interrupt.
The Price of Ingenuity#533.dst: Yuman, 제발... 끝까지 말하게 해 줘. 끼어들지 마.
The Price of Ingenuity#533.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#534.src: So. So, so,so... The... the reason the crown has left us alone down here is because I have been working with Sovereign Soosu.
The Price of Ingenuity#534.dst: 그러니까. 그러니까, 그러니까... 왕실이 여기 아래 우릴 내버려 둔 이유는... 내가 Soosu 군주와 일해 왔기 때문이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#534.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#537.src: The reason we've been able to stay under the radar for so long is because of this, Yulie.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.dst: 우리가 이렇게 오래 눈에 안 띄고 지낸 게 이것 때문이야, Yulie 형.
The Price of Ingenuity#537.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#538.src: The reason we can live here, leave our home, make use of the city's electricity... it's because of my collaboration.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.dst: 우리가 여기 살고, 집을 떠나고, 도시 전기를 쓸 수 있는 건... 내 협력 덕분이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#538.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#539.src: She said she saw potential in me. Told me that if I helped her in her workshops, then... then you all would be safe down here.
The Price of Ingenuity#539.dst: 그 여자가 나한테 잠재력이 있대. 작업장에서 자길 도우면... 너희 모두 여기서 안전할 거라고 했어.
The Price of Ingenuity#539.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#540.src: I didn't tell anybody because I knew you wouldn't get it. You'd think it was stupid, and risky, and a bad idea. Working with... with someone responsible for our problems.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.dst: 아무한테도 말 안 한 건 너희가 이해 못 할 걸 알아서야. 멍청하고 위험하고 나쁜 생각이라고 했겠지. 우리 문제의 책임자와... 일하는 거니까.
The Price of Ingenuity#540.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#541.src: And I knew it was risky. I did. But I thought that if I were to mess up, only I would be punished. You all would be safe.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.dst: 위험한 것도 알았어. 알았다고. 그래도 내가 실수하면 벌받는 건 나뿐일 거라 생각했어. 너희는 안전할 거라고.
The Price of Ingenuity#541.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#542.src: ...now. I understand emotions are running high right now. I would ask everyone to take a step back, think through it logically, and remain c-
The Price of Ingenuity#542.dst: ...자. 다들 감정이 격해진 건 알아요. 모두 한 발 물러서서 논리적으로 생각하고, 침착함을 유-
The Price of Ingenuity#542.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#543.src: Are you insane, Yusanu?! Of all the secrets you could have been keeping-
The Price of Ingenuity#543.dst: 미쳤어, Yusanu?! 숨길 비밀이 그렇게 많은데 하필-
The Price of Ingenuity#543.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#545.src: No, I don't think I will! Is that what the alarms were about? How long has this been going on? What was running through your head when you decided-
The Price of Ingenuity#545.dst: 아니, 그만 안 해! 경보도 그것 때문이었어? 언제부터 이랬어? 그렇게 결정할 때 무슨 생각이었-
The Price of Ingenuity#545.speaker: Yulie

The Price of Ingenuity#546.src: As if you haven't been doing the same thing this whole time! Trying to put all the weight on your own shoulders, not getting help from anyone else!!
The Price of Ingenuity#546.dst: 형도 여태 똑같이 했잖아! 혼자 다 짊어지려 하고, 누구 도움도 안 받고!!
The Price of Ingenuity#546.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#547.src: So- so, y'know, I'm a little mad. He should have talked to us about it! But... he's telling us now. He's asking for help now.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.dst: 그러니까- 그러니까, 나도 좀 화나. 우리한테 얘기했어야지! 근데... 지금 말하고 있잖아. 지금 도와 달라고 하잖아.
The Price of Ingenuity#547.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#551.src: After yesterday's run-in with the soldiers... Soosu is demanding I hand over whoever's responsible. I... I can't do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.dst: 어제 병사들이랑 부딪친 뒤로... Soosu가 책임자를 넘기라고 요구해. 난... 그렇게 못 해.
The Price of Ingenuity#551.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#552.src: Rex and {u} caught me talking to her today. That's why... that's why I'm telling you.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.dst: 오늘 Rex랑 {u}이(가) 내가 그 여자랑 얘기하는 걸 봤어. 그래서... 그래서 말하는 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#552.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#553.src: ...yeah. I convinced him to stop working with her, and to tell you all about it.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.dst: ...응. 그 여자랑 그만 일하고 다 털어놓으라고 설득했어.
The Price of Ingenuity#553.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#554.src: We also... stole an important gadget she and Yusanu were working on. Something the Queen was very invested in.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.dst: 그리고... 그 여자랑 Yusanu가 만들던 중요한 장치를 훔쳤어. 여왕이 크게 공들이던 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#554.speaker: Rex

The Price of Ingenuity#555.src: I don't know what it is or what it does. I don't know what it's for. All I know is that the Queen needs it finished. It's all she's had Soosu working on for... months.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.dst: 그게 뭔지, 뭘 하는지 몰라. 어디 쓰는 건지도 몰라. 아는 건 여왕이 완성을 원한다는 것뿐이야. 몇 달째 Soosu한테 그것만 시켰어.
The Price of Ingenuity#555.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#556.src: I'll try to figure out what it is in my spare time. Maybe it'll help us! I... hope it will.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.dst: 틈날 때 뭔지 알아내 볼게. 도움이 될지도 몰라! 나... 그러길 바라.
The Price of Ingenuity#556.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#557.src: Yulie, Yuman... I owe you a better apology. I can talk to you in private later, but... right now, we should continue with the meeting.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.dst: Yulie 형, Yuman... 제대로 사과할게. 나중에 따로 얘기할 수 있지만... 지금은 회의를 계속해야 해.
The Price of Ingenuity#557.speaker: Yusanu

The Price of Ingenuity#559.src: ...that was certainly a lot. Fortunately, angering the Sovereign may not ultimately matter. If all goes according to plan... the crown will fall at the end of the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.dst: ...정말 많은 일이 있었군. 다행히 군주를 화나게 한 건 결국 상관없을지도 몰라. 계획대로라면... 축제 끝에 왕실은 무너질 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#559.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#560.src: My goal, as always, has been to find a way to destroy the crown's influence and to free our province. I believe this upcoming festival is an opportunity to do just that.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.dst: 내 목표는 늘 그랬듯 왕실의 영향력을 무너뜨리고 우리 지방을 해방할 방법을 찾는 거야. 다가오는 축제가 바로 그 기회라고 믿어.
The Price of Ingenuity#560.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#561.src: During the Crown Festival, Her Majesty will die.
The Price of Ingenuity#561.dst: 왕관 축제 기간에 여왕 폐하는 죽는다.
The Price of Ingenuity#561.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#562.src: Settle down, everyone, settle down! Please, allow Syndra to continue.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.dst: 진정해요, 다들, 진정해요! 제발, Syndra가 계속 말하게 해 줘요.
The Price of Ingenuity#562.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#563.src: It will not be easy. But if we strike when her guard is down, and catch her by surprise, I believe it is possible.
The Price of Ingenuity#563.dst: 쉽진 않을 거야. 하지만 방심한 틈을 노려 기습하면 가능하다고 믿어.
The Price of Ingenuity#563.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#564.src: I'll be splitting you all into several groups, and will assign tasks that must be completed before the festival.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.dst: 너희를 몇 조로 나누고, 축제 전에 끝내야 할 임무를 맡길 거야.
The Price of Ingenuity#564.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#565.src: The decision Quill and I have come to is that I alone will be going for the kill. That way, if anything goes wrong... no one else faces the consequences.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.dst: Quill과 내린 결정은, 처치는 나 혼자 맡는다는 거야. 그러면 뭔가 잘못돼도... 다른 누구도 대가를 치르지 않아.
The Price of Ingenuity#565.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#566.src: I'll go over the details tomorrow. I think... we've had enough excitement today. Please, hold your complaints until then, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.dst: 자세한 건 내일 말할게. 오늘은... 소란이 충분했던 것 같아. 불만도 그때까지 참아 줘.
The Price of Ingenuity#566.speaker: Syndra

The Price of Ingenuity#567.src: Ahem. Yes, indeed. I suppose we should be getting to dinner, as well.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.dst: 흠흠. 네, 그렇죠. 우리도 이제 저녁 먹으러 가야겠네요.
The Price of Ingenuity#567.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#568.src: Yuman... this may be unfair of me to ask, but would you be willing to play us a song tonight? We will not have many days left together.
The Price of Ingenuity#568.dst: Yuman... 부탁하기 미안하지만, 오늘 밤 한 곡 연주해 줄래요? 함께할 날이 많이 남지 않았으니까요.
The Price of Ingenuity#568.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#569.src: Yeah... yeah, man, of course. I can do that.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.dst: 네... 네, 물론이죠. 할 수 있어요.
The Price of Ingenuity#569.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#570.src: Then let us enjoy the remainder of our company!
The Price of Ingenuity#570.speaker: Quill

The Price of Ingenuity#572.src: Hey, everyone! Man, uh... small crowd today, huh?
The Price of Ingenuity#572.dst: 안녕, 다들! 이야, 어... 오늘 관객이 좀 적네?
The Price of Ingenuity#572.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#573.src: Oh, man, is that Jiro I see? Hey, man! I didn't, uh... expect to see ya.
The Price of Ingenuity#573.dst: 오, 저거 Jiro 아니야? 어이, 반가워! 난, 어... 네가 올 줄은 몰랐어.
The Price of Ingenuity#573.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#575.src: Uh, just, you didn't seem super happy with me after... after yesterday. With the- soldier thing.
The Price of Ingenuity#575.dst: 어, 그냥, 어제 일 이후로... 나한테 기분이 별로 안 좋아 보여서. 그- 병사 일 말이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#575.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#576.src: ... Oh! Yeah. No worries. Water under the bridge.
The Price of Ingenuity#576.dst: ... 아! 그거. 신경 쓰지 마. 다 지난 일이야.
The Price of Ingenuity#576.speaker: Jiro

The Price of Ingenuity#577.src: If... if you say so! Don't think you've heard this one before, so tell me how you like it!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.dst: 그, 그렇다면야! 이 곡은 처음 들어 볼 거야, 어떤지 말해 줘!
The Price of Ingenuity#577.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#578.src: But first... Yus. Yusanu. Look, I... I'm not one to hold grudges. So I don't need any more apologies from you! I get it.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.dst: 근데 먼저... Yus 형. Yusanu. 봐, 난... 뒤끝 있는 사람 아니야. 그러니까 더 사과 안 해도 돼! 이해해.
The Price of Ingenuity#578.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#579.src: I just... want you to trust us more, 'kay? You and Yulie both, haha! 'Cause... I want to help!
The Price of Ingenuity#579.dst: 그냥... 우릴 좀 더 믿어 줬으면 해, 알았지? 형이랑 Yulie 형 둘 다, 하하! 왜냐면... 나도 돕고 싶거든!
The Price of Ingenuity#579.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#580.src: I had a think, and yeah. It sucks you didn't tell us. But your deal with Soosu- it saved us! Gave us a home, gave us a future!
The Price of Ingenuity#580.dst: 생각해 봤는데, 그래. 말 안 해 준 건 서운해. 그래도 Soosu랑 한 거래가- 우릴 살렸어! 집도 주고, 미래도 줬잖아!
The Price of Ingenuity#580.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#581.src: So... this song's dedicated to you. Hope you like it.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.dst: 그러니까... 이 노래는 형한테 바칠게. 마음에 들면 좋겠다.
The Price of Ingenuity#581.speaker: Yuman

The Price of Ingenuity#582.src: No... no no no no no, where is it, where IS IT?! I can't... I need to find it, I-
The Price of Ingenuity#582.dst: 안 돼... 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼, 어디 있어, 어디 있냐고?! 난... 찾아야 해, 난-
The Price of Ingenuity#582.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#584.src: EEP! Y- your Majesty, I- I- I wasn't expecting you until... tomorrow. Wh- what're you doing here?
The Price of Ingenuity#584.dst: 히익! 폐- 폐하, 저- 저- 내일에나... 오실 줄 알았어요. 여- 여긴 어쩐 일로?
The Price of Ingenuity#584.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#585.src: My schedule freed up, so I decided to check in early. Is something wrong, Sovereign?
The Price of Ingenuity#585.dst: 일정이 비어서 일찍 들러 보기로 했다. 무슨 문제라도 있느냐, 군주?
The Price of Ingenuity#585.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#587.src: Don't bother. How incompetent must you be, to have lost it from your own workshop?!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.dst: 됐다. 얼마나 무능하면 자기 작업장에서 그걸 잃어버린단 말이냐?!
The Price of Ingenuity#587.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#588.src: I- I- I don't understand how, my golems haven't been disturbed! They didn't detect anything!
The Price of Ingenuity#588.dst: 어- 어- 어떻게 된 건지 모르겠어요, 골렘들은 멀쩡해요! 아무것도 감지 못 했다고요!
The Price of Ingenuity#588.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#589.src: Perhaps if you focused more on efficiency instead of playing around with your toys, this could have been prevented.
The Price of Ingenuity#589.dst: 장난감 놀이 대신 효율에 좀 더 신경 썼다면 막을 수 있었겠지.
The Price of Ingenuity#589.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#590.src: I'll- I'll fix this, I promise! I promise I promise I promise, I can fix it! I can... I can restart! I still have all the research notes, and I-
The Price of Ingenuity#590.dst: 제- 제가 해결할게요, 약속해요! 약속해요 약속해요 약속해요, 고칠 수 있어요! 처음부터... 다시 할 수 있어요! 연구 노트가 다 있고, 전-
The Price of Ingenuity#590.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#591.src: Enough. I have been lenient with your performance maintaining your district, because I had faith there would be results.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.dst: 그만. 결과가 나오리라 믿었기에 네 구역 관리 실적에 관대했거늘.
The Price of Ingenuity#591.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#592.src: Restarting the Resonance Weaver project... it cannot be done. That artifact I entrusted you with... that magic is a lost art. It cannot be replicated.
The Price of Ingenuity#592.dst: 공명 직조기 프로젝트를 다시 시작한다니... 불가능하다. 내가 맡긴 그 유물... 그 마법은 잊힌 기술이다. 복제할 수 없어.
The Price of Ingenuity#592.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#593.src: N- no, I have the notes, I- I know how it works, I can do it, just- just give me a chance! I can fix this!
The Price of Ingenuity#593.dst: 아- 아니에요, 노트가 있어요, 전- 원리를 알아요, 할 수 있어요, 그냥- 기회만 주세요! 고칠 수 있어요!
The Price of Ingenuity#593.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Price of Ingenuity#594.src: I must prepare for the festival. I will expect your presence there, as usual. Please... clean yourself up before that.
The Price of Ingenuity#594.dst: 나는 축제를 준비해야 한다. 늘 그렇듯 참석하길 기대하마. 그리고... 그 전에 몸단장부터 하거라.
The Price of Ingenuity#594.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#597.src: Consider our agreement null. You have failed me. You will continue your service as Sovereign indefinitely... with your blessing intact.
The Price of Ingenuity#597.dst: 우리 약속은 없던 것으로 하마. 넌 날 실망시켰다. 앞으로도 무기한 군주직을 이어 가거라... 네 축복을 지닌 채로.
The Price of Ingenuity#597.speaker: Her Majesty

The Price of Ingenuity#598.src: ...what? No- no, no no no, you- you can't, you can't, you can't!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.dst: ...네? 안- 안 돼, 안 돼 안 돼, 그- 그럴 순 없어요, 없어요, 없어요!!!!
The Price of Ingenuity#598.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.src: I see another lost soul has found their way to The {p}!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#000.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.src: I can't say I am overwhelmed by your appearance. Here, the birth of many powerful and magical monsters take place.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.dst: 네 몰골이 그리 대단해 보이진 않는군. 이곳에선 강력하고 마법적인 괴물이 수없이 태어난다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#001.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.src: Gavel's governments can not stop Mistress Qira. I doubt you can either.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.dst: Gavel의 정부들도 Qira 님을 막지 못한다. 너도 마찬가지겠지.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#002.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.src: If you want to meet her, you will have to defeat each division of her army.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.dst: 그분을 만나고 싶다면 그분 군대의 모든 부대를 쓰러뜨려야 한다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#003.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.src: Although powerful, she is not without honour. After every floor you complete, you will receive a token for a reward from the shop. Good luck, adventurer-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.dst: 강대하시지만 명예를 모르는 분은 아니다. 층을 하나 끝낼 때마다 상점 보상과 바꿀 증표를 받게 될 거다. 행운을 빈다, 모험가-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#004.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.src: Wh- Oh, Mistress, am I? My apologies...
The Qira Hive (Quest)#005.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.src: Begin, the Thunder Division! Strike quickly and move on, for those within will warp your very mind should you stray for too long!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.dst: 시작하라, 번개 부대! 재빨리 치고 나아가라. 너무 오래 머물면 안에 있는 것들이 네 정신을 비틀어 버릴 테니!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#006.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.src: Heeheehahaaah! I see you! You humans have such easily influenced minds, but I'll settle for beating you within an inch of your life! Come through, come through!!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#007.dst: 히히히하하핫! 보인다! 너희 인간들 머리는 참 쉽게 휘둘린단 말이야. 그래도 오늘은 반쯤 죽여 놓는 걸로 봐줄게! 들어와, 들어와!!!

The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.src: Feh, you're no fun, you little cheater! I was supposed to beat you, not the other way around!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.dst: 칫, 재미없어, 이 꼬마 사기꾼! 내가 널 이겨야 했는데, 거꾸로 됐잖아!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#008.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.src: I hate you so much. Just get out and talk to that idiot servant already!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.dst: 너 진짜 싫어. 빨리 나가서 그 멍청한 하인한테나 가 버려!!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#009.speaker: Psychomancer

The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.src: You have completed the Thunder floor? How surprising. They were some of Mistress Qira's earliest successes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.dst: 번개 층을 끝냈다고? 뜻밖이군. Qira 님의 가장 초기 성공작들이었는데.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#010.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.src: I agree, Mistress. As promised, here is a Thunder Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#011.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.src: Take it to the shop to claim your prize. It is located at the base of the Hive. The servant there will have important information for you regarding your prizes.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.dst: 상점에 가져가서 상품을 받아라. 상점은 Hive 맨 아래에 있다. 그곳 하인이 상품에 관해 중요한 걸 알려 줄 거다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#012.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.src: I doubt you are still worth Mistress's time, however. She has much to tend to here, as you might guess.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.dst: 하지만 네가 아직도 주인님의 시간을 쓸 가치가 있는지는 모르겠군. 짐작하겠지만 그분은 여기서 돌볼 일이 많다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#013.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.src: She made a deal with Gavel's people long ago, after they foolishly attempted to lay siege to our Hive.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.dst: 오래전 Gavel 사람들이 어리석게도 우리 Hive를 포위하려 했고, 그 뒤 그분은 그들과 협정을 맺었다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#014.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.src: She could continue her unethical and possibly evil work...and in return, she would allow the people of Gavel to remain undisturbed by her.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.dst: 그분은 비윤리적이고 어쩌면 사악한 연구를 계속할 수 있고... 그 대가로 Gavel 사람들에겐 손대지 않기로 했지.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#015.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.src: Next you must tackle the Air division, featuring some of her tougher creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.dst: 다음은 바람 부대다. 그분의 피조물 중 더 강한 것들이 있지.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#016.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.src: Begin, the Air Division! Fight freely with the wind, for the coming storm shall claim you for my own if you cannot spread your wings here!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.dst: 시작하라, 바람 부대! 바람과 함께 자유롭게 싸워라. 여기서 날개를 펴지 못하면 다가올 폭풍이 너를 내 것으로 삼으리라!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#017.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.src: Well, nice work getting this far! Don't tell anyone, but I'm gonna pull my punches here, okay? I'm rooting for you, so let's have fun with this! Come on through!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#018.dst: 와, 여기까지 오다니 잘했어! 아무한테도 말하지 마. 나 여기선 살살 할게, 알았지? 널 응원하니까 재밌게 해 보자! 어서 들어와!

The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.src: Heehee, maybe I didn't need to hold back after all? You did really well, really well!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.dst: 히히, 역시 봐줄 필요가 없었나? 정말 잘했어, 정말 잘했어!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#019.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.src: A lot of people say I'm the roughest we have to offer, so you've got this! I'm sorry you have to go talk to Yansur of all people now, though.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.dst: 다들 내가 우리 중에 제일 거칠다고 하니까, 넌 할 수 있어! 근데 하필 이제 Yansur랑 얘기해야 하다니 안됐다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#020.speaker: Gale

The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.src: Hrm, perhaps we have underestimated you. The creations of Air have defeated thousands, particularly-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.dst: 흠, 우리가 너를 얕봤는지도 모르겠군. 바람의 피조물은 수천 명을 쓰러뜨렸다, 특히-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#021.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.src: ...yes. Here is the promised Air Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#022.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.dst: 상점에 보상이 준비돼 있다. 상점 하인과 아직 얘기하지 않았다면 다음에 갈 때 꼭 해라.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#023.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.src: You still have a long way to go. It is not easy to gain an audience with Mistress Qira.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.dst: 갈 길이 아직 멀다. Qira 님을 알현하기란 쉽지 않다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#024.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.src: Your next objective is to clear the Earth division. Some of the most powerful, raw creatures ever hatched.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.dst: 다음 목표는 대지 부대 격파다. 지금껏 부화한 것 중 가장 강하고 원초적인 생물들이지.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#025.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.src: Begin, the Earth Division! You must withstand both sheer force and deadly toxins! Be quick on your feet, or you will return to the dust of the earth!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.dst: 시작하라, 대지 부대! 압도적인 힘과 치명적인 독을 모두 견뎌라! 발을 재게 놀려라, 아니면 땅의 먼지로 돌아가리라!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#026.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.src: Creatures of the earth were not enough for you... Mistress's most rawly powerful... Destroyed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.dst: 대지의 생물로도 부족했나... 주인님의 가장 원초적인 강자들이... 전멸이라니.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#027.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.src: Well, here is your Earth Voucher.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#028.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.dst: 상점에 보상이 준비돼 있다. 상점 하인과 아직 얘기하지 않았다면 다음에 갈 때 꼭 해라.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#029.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.src: It is impressive to see how far you have come. Many have failed at this point.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.dst: 여기까지 온 건 인상적이군. 많은 자가 여기서 무너졌다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#030.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.src: It is of no consequence, however, for the Water division is your next challenge. I am sure you will not succeed.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.dst: 하지만 상관없다. 다음 도전은 물 부대니까. 넌 분명 성공하지 못할 거다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#031.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.src: Begin, the Water Division! If you will not withstand the crashing waves, the creatures that lurk within shall ensure you never emerge from the abyss!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.dst: 시작하라, 물 부대! 몰아치는 파도를 견디지 못한다면, 그 안에 숨은 생물들이 너를 영영 심연에서 못 나오게 하리라!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#032.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.src: You have been judged worthy enough to face me in combat. However, I know your strength, and I do not believe it enough to defeat me. Come forth now. Make your attempt to prove me wrong.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#033.dst: 너는 나와 겨룰 자격이 있다고 판정받았다. 허나 나는 네 힘을 안다. 그 힘으로 나를 이길 수 없다고 본다. 이제 나서라. 내가 틀렸음을 증명해 보아라.

The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.src: Seems my judgment was incorrect. In this case, however, it is refreshing to see.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.dst: 내 판단이 틀렸던 모양이군. 허나 이번만큼은 신선하구나.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#034.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.src: Continue forwards, honourable human. Perhaps your intellect and respect will rub off on that insufferable Yansur.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.dst: 계속 나아가라, 고결한 인간이여. 네 지혜와 예의가 저 견딜 수 없는 Yansur에게도 옮기를.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#035.speaker: Oceanic Judge

The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.src: Impossible. Not even the most tactically advanced monsters could defeat you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.dst: 말도 안 돼. 전술이 가장 뛰어난 괴물들도 너를 못 이기다니.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#036.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.dst: 상점에 보상이 준비돼 있다. 상점 하인과 아직 얘기하지 않았다면 다음에 갈 때 꼭 해라.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#038.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.src: We are intrigued by your determination... But we are not worried. We do not expect you to make it past the next floor.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.dst: 네 결의가 흥미롭긴 하다... 하지만 걱정은 없다. 네가 다음 층을 넘으리라곤 생각하지 않으니.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#039.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.src: Now you must face some of the toughest creatures of Mistress Qira's imagination!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.dst: 이제 Qira 님의 상상력이 빚은 가장 강한 생물들과 맞서야 한다!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#040.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.src: You must now face the division of Fire, and it will be sure to burn you.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.dst: 이번엔 화염 부대다. 분명히 너를 태워 버릴 거다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#041.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.src: Begin, the Fire Division! Summon your courage, and brave the heat of the volcanoes and blow away in the breeze!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.dst: 시작하라, 화염 부대! 용기를 끌어모아 화산의 열기를 견뎌라, 아니면 바람에 날려 가라!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#042.speaker: Qira

The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.src: Impressive, making it this far. I am your final test. Let us fight fairly, then. An honourable end to your challenge is only fitting, whether that be triumph or defeat. Come forward and face me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#043.dst: 여기까지 오다니 대단하군. 내가 마지막 시험이다. 그럼 정정당당히 싸우자. 승리든 패배든, 네 도전에는 명예로운 끝이 어울린다. 앞으로 나와 나를 마주하라.

The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.src: Defeat feels strange, after so long. You fought valiantly, and with great zeal, however. It would be a lie to say I am disappointed. Impart these traits onto Mistress's servant, if you would, and claim your final prize.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.dst: 오랜만의 패배는 낯설군. 허나 너는 용맹하고 열정적으로 싸웠다. 실망했다고 하면 거짓말이겠지. 괜찮다면 이 자질을 주인님의 하인에게도 전하고, 마지막 상품을 받아라.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#044.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.src: All that is left is to talk to Mistress's servant, and claim your final prize. Surely he will not be as great an obstacle as I was.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.dst: 남은 건 주인님의 하인과 얘기하고 마지막 상품을 받는 것뿐이다. 그자는 나만큼 큰 장애물은 아닐 테지.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#045.speaker: Solar Vanguard

The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.src: This is unprecedented. You have defeated some of the most recent and powerful creations.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.dst: 전례가 없는 일이군. 가장 최근의 가장 강력한 피조물들을 쓰러뜨리다니.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#046.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.src: Here you are then, the Fire Voucher!
The Qira Hive (Quest)#047.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.src: The shop has your reward prepared. If you have not talked to the servant at the shop, do so next you go there.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.dst: 상점에 보상이 준비돼 있다. 상점 하인과 아직 얘기하지 않았다면 다음에 갈 때 꼭 해라.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#048.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.src: This is unorthodox, as no one has made it this far. But I suppose this means that you have earned an audience with-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.dst: 여기까지 온 자가 없으니 이례적인 일이다. 하지만 이건 네가 알현할 자격을 얻었다는 뜻이겠지-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#049.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.src: Hah! Incredible! Mistress wishes to battle you herself! You astound me.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.dst: 하! 믿을 수 없군! 주인님이 직접 너와 싸우고 싶어 하신다! 놀랍구나.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#050.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.src: Be warned, however. This will be your toughest battle yet. Mistress Qira is the most feared being in Gavel.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.dst: 하지만 경고하지. 지금까지 중 가장 힘든 싸움이 될 거다. Qira 님은 Gavel에서 가장 두려운 존재니까.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#051.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.src: You will die...but consider it the greatest honour to die by her hand.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.dst: 넌 죽을 거다... 하지만 그분 손에 죽는 걸 최고의 영광으로 여겨라.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#052.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.src: How cowardly! After defeating so many in the Hive, and receiving such praise, you've the gall to upstand Mistress's request?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.dst: 비겁하기도 하지! Hive에서 그렇게 많이 쓰러뜨리고 칭찬까지 받아 놓고, 감히 주인님의 청을 뿌리치다니?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#053.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.src: I had begun to think highly of you, but after such a disgusting display-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.dst: 너를 높이 보기 시작했는데, 이런 역겨운 꼴을 보고 나니-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#054.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.src: Wha...that- No, that can't possibly be correct, you are-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.dst: 뭐...그건- 아니, 그럴 리가 없다, 너는-
The Qira Hive (Quest)#055.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.src: ...Masterful...Have we been cooped up in this Hive so long that our army is outdated?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.dst: ...훌륭하군... 우리가 Hive에 너무 오래 틀어박혀 군대가 낡아 버린 건가?
The Qira Hive (Quest)#056.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.src: To be defeated by a human of Wynn... I am not sure whether to be disappointed or amazed. Our ultimate challenge has been bested.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.dst: Wynn의 인간에게 패하다니... 실망해야 할지 감탄해야 할지 모르겠군. 우리의 최종 시련이 깨졌다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#057.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.src: Here is your voucher, then. The back room in the shop will have your rewards. If you still have not talked to the servant at the shop...well. You should know by now.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.dst: 그럼 교환권이다. 상점 뒷방에 보상이 있다. 아직도 상점 하인과 얘기하지 않았다면... 뭐. 이쯤이면 알겠지.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#058.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.src: Mistress...if I may tell the tale? She was once called upon to help stop the decay of the forest.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.dst: 주인님... 이야기를 해도 되겠습니까? 그분은 한때 숲의 쇠락을 막아 달라는 부탁을 받으셨다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#059.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.src: With her boundless knowledge and magic, she surely could have cured it. But she declined.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.dst: 그분의 끝없는 지식과 마법이라면 분명 고칠 수 있었다. 하지만 거절하셨지.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#060.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.src: She instead chose to create, obsessed with preparing for some sort of war.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.dst: 대신 창조를 택하셨다. 어떤 전쟁에 대비하는 데 집착하시면서.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#061.speaker: Yansur

The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.src: Mistress never elaborated, but it seems like she knows something we don't.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.dst: 주인님은 자세히 말씀하신 적 없지만, 우리가 모르는 걸 아시는 것 같다.
The Qira Hive (Quest)#062.speaker: Yansur

The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.src: ... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.dst: ... Achara... 내가 너한테 한 짓을 속죄할 수 있을 것 같지 않아. 사과로는 턱없이 부족해.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#002.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.src: As infuriating as what you did was, you were following orders... I had every right to be angry, but to try and take your life was ten steps too far.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.dst: 네가 한 일에 화가 났던 건 맞지만, 넌 명령을 따랐을 뿐이야... 화낼 권리는 있었어도, 네 목숨을 빼앗으려 한 건 너무 지나쳤어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#003.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.src: Even though it is not enough, I will say I am sorry for the pain I caused you. The Guardian was right, in the end.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.dst: 부족하겠지만 그래도 말할게. 네게 준 고통, 정말 미안해. 결국 수호자님 말씀이 옳았어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#004.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.src: Without you carrying out Orphion's will, we would not be here. You truly are necessary in this, and I believe I have finally made peace with that.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.dst: 네가 Orphion의 뜻을 따르지 않았다면 우린 여기까지 못 왔을 거야. 넌 정말 꼭 필요한 존재야. 이제야 그걸 받아들인 것 같아.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#005.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.src: It has been a long time since I had a partner willing to help me in this way. I was unused to it, I suppose... Still.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.dst: 이렇게 기꺼이 도와주는 동료는 정말 오랜만이야. 익숙하지 않았나 봐... 그래도.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#006.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.src: If you'll be willing to aid me, it would be a great relief. It has been a thousand years since I entered the Realm of Light...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.dst: 네가 도와준다면 정말 든든할 거야. 내가 빛의 영역에 들어간 지 벌써 천 년이 지났어...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#007.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.src: I can only hope things have not changed much. I remember how it was, right down to the last petal...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.dst: 많이 변하지 않았기만 바랄 뿐이야. 그곳 모습은 마지막 꽃잎 하나까지 기억하거든...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#008.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#009.src: Walk towards the portal with Lari.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.src: Wait a moment, {u}. I have one more thing I would like to say before we enter.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.dst: 잠깐만, {u}. 들어가기 전에 하나 더 할 말이 있어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#010.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.src: I... I need to thank you. For helping, as you have. For staying by me as you have. There was one other before you like that...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.dst: 나... 너한테 고마워. 이렇게 도와줘서. 이렇게 내 곁에 있어 줘서. 너 전에도 그런 사람이 딱 한 명 있었어...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#011.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.src: I promise that you will not meet the same fate as him. I will fight with you to the bitter end, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.dst: 넌 그 사람과 같은 운명을 맞지 않을 거야, 약속해. 끝까지 너와 함께 싸울게, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#012.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.src: It's time, then. To visit Orphion.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.dst: 그럼 때가 됐어. Orphion을 만나러 가자.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#013.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#014.src: Jump into the portal after Lari.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#015.src: Talk to Lari at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] in the Realm of Light.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.src: Welcome to the Realm of Light then, {u}. Once you've re-oriented yourself, come over here.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.dst: 그럼 빛의 영역에 온 걸 환영해, {u}. 정신 좀 차리면 이쪽으로 와.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#016.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.src: It's so much smaller than it used to be! There used to be many more landmasses, all connected to each other...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.dst: 예전보다 훨씬 작아졌어! 전엔 땅덩어리가 훨씬 많았고, 전부 서로 이어져 있었는데...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#017.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.src: I feel... I feel everything in here. With Orphion's light, I can tap into the very core of the realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.dst: 느껴져... 여기 모든 게 느껴져. Orphion의 빛으로 이 영역의 핵심에 닿을 수 있어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#018.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.src: And I can feel disturbances. There are dark creatures here, where there should be none!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.dst: 그리고 이상한 기운도 느껴져. 있어선 안 될 어둠의 생물들이 여기 있어!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#019.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.src: I mean, even look at this creature. The light emanating from it is-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.dst: 그러니까, 이 생물만 봐도 그래. 이 녀석에게서 나오는 빛이-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#020.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.src: Wait. Wh... Why is it attacking you!?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.dst: 잠깐. 뭐... 왜 널 공격하는 거야!?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#021.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.src: Its mind was addled by darkness. Poor thing was terrified... Nothing for it though.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.dst: 어둠에 정신이 흐려졌던 거야. 불쌍하게도 겁에 질렸었어... 어쩔 수 없었지만.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#022.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.src: I suppose your more ruthless nature is a good thing, in this case. We each will need to fight, if this is as widespread as it feels.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.dst: 이번엔 네 냉정한 성격이 오히려 다행인 것 같아. 느껴지는 만큼 퍼져 있다면 우리 둘 다 싸워야 할 테니까.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#023.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.src: I'll have to prepare myself for that... Being willing to take action will not make it any easier on my conscience.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.dst: 마음의 준비를 해야겠어... 행동할 각오를 한다고 양심이 편해지는 건 아니니까.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#024.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.src: But I will set that aside, until the day this all becomes a memory. We'll both need to seek the Nexus of Light, Orphion's home. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.dst: 하지만 이 모든 게 추억이 되는 날까진 접어 둘게. 우린 Orphion의 거처, 빛의 넥서스를 찾아야 해. 따라와!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#025.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.src: Follow Lari to Orphion's Nexus of Light at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Realm of Light (Quest)#026.dst: Lari를 따라 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 오르피온의 빛의 넥서스로 가세요

The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.src: I should have expected this. With the connections severed, of course the bridge to the Nexus would be gone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.dst: 이럴 줄 알았어야 했는데. 연결이 끊겼으니 넥서스로 가는 다리도 당연히 사라졌겠지.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#027.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.src: This must be because of that horrid parasite... The Guardian of the Forest informed me of the situation afterwards.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.dst: 분명 그 끔찍한 기생체 탓이야... 숲의 수호자님이 나중에 상황을 알려 주셨어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#028.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.src: The gap may be too far for me to carry you over... Is there a way I can bypass this, I wonder?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.dst: 너무 멀어서 널 안고 건너긴 힘들 것 같아... 우회할 방법이 없을까?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#029.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.src: Perhaps I can try to bridge the gap myself. Let's see if this will work.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.dst: 내가 직접 틈을 이어 볼까. 되는지 보자.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#030.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.src: ...hm. That ought to have worked! Is the Nexus too far to reach?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.dst: ...흠. 됐어야 하는데! 넥서스가 너무 먼 건가?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#032.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.src: There has to be some way over... Maybe the direct method is- Hm? Another creature?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.dst: 건너갈 방법이 있을 거야... 어쩌면 정면으로- 응? 또 다른 생물?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#033.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.src: This one doesn't seem hostile, {u}... I'll try and talk with it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.dst: 이 녀석은 적대적이지 않은 것 같아, {u}... 말을 걸어 볼게.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#034.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.src: Its mind is whole, but it's wary of your presence. You should stay back, just in case.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.dst: 정신은 멀쩡한데 널 경계하고 있어. 혹시 모르니 뒤로 물러나 있어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#035.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.src: So tell me, achara. What is it you sought me for?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.dst: 그럼 말해 봐, achara. 날 찾아온 이유가 뭐야?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#036.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.src: Ahh, I see. You wish to see your master once more as well...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.dst: 아아, 그렇구나. 너도 네 주인을 다시 보고 싶은 거구나...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#037.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.src: The monoliths? Are they what's severed the connections?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#038.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.src: Ahh, I understand. I assure you, we will fix this!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.dst: 아아, 알겠어. 약속할게, 우리가 고칠 거야!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#039.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.src: It said that the connections to the rest of the realm were severed intentionally by Orphion, in order to protect them.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.dst: 영역의 다른 곳과의 연결은 Orphion이 그곳들을 지키려고 일부러 끊은 거래.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#040.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.src: Two monoliths on this landmass controlled the connections, and they are being drained of their light- As such, they closed the bridges.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.dst: 이 땅에 있는 모놀리스 두 개가 연결을 조종하는데, 빛이 빠져나가고 있대- 그래서 다리를 닫은 거고.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#041.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.src: The light is still there- But it must be drawn back out. We have our task ahead of us now, achara. We need to go to the first monolith. Follow me!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.dst: 빛은 아직 남아 있어- 다만 다시 끌어내야 해. 이제 할 일이 생겼어, achara. 첫 번째 모놀리스로 가야 해. 따라와!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#042.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#043.src: Search for the monolith Lari was talking about at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.src: I never knew the monoliths kept the realm together as they did. You can see that it is inactive, yes?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.dst: 모놀리스가 이렇게 영역을 붙들고 있는 줄은 몰랐어. 멈춰 있는 거 보이지?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#044.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.src: There should be bright bands of color going along it, and light pouring from it. This is where we play our roles, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.dst: 원래는 밝은 색띠가 둘러져 있고 빛이 쏟아져 나와야 해. 이제 우리가 나설 차례야, {u}!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#045.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.src: It may be getting drained, but there is certainly still light within it, and if that parasite is battling Orphion we should be able to recharge it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.dst: 빛이 빠져나가고 있긴 해도 안에 분명 남아 있어. 그 기생체가 Orphion과 싸우는 중이라면 다시 채울 수 있을 거야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#046.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.src: I'll tap into the monolith... You'll need to enter it, and find its core. I'll send a part of Orphion's light with you to activate it once you do.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.dst: 내가 모놀리스와 연결할게... 넌 안으로 들어가서 핵을 찾아. 찾으면 Orphion의 빛 일부를 보내서 활성화할게.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#047.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.src: The damage here is minor- Nothing that can't be fixed, thankfully.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.dst: 여기 손상은 가벼워- 다행히 못 고칠 정도는 아니야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#049.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.src: Its aura is lowered- Now your soul must enter. I will keep you safe, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.dst: 기운이 약해졌어- 이제 네 영혼이 들어가야 해. 내가 지켜 줄게, {u}.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#050.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.src: Allow my magic to open your senses... Good luck, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.dst: 내 마법으로 감각을 열어 줄게... 행운을 빌어, achara.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#051.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#053.src: Find a way to fill the monolith with light.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#054.src: Follow Lari to the next monolith at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.src: Welcome back, {u}. I had few troubles dealing with the creatures trying to get close. Did you have issues inside?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.dst: 돌아왔구나, {u}. 다가오려는 생물들은 별로 어렵지 않게 처리했어. 안에서 문제는 없었어?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#055.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.src: The light is starting to pulse out from the monolith again, so I would say you've succeeded. I suppose we do make a decent team?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.dst: 모놀리스에서 빛이 다시 고동치기 시작했으니 성공한 것 같아. 우리 꽤 괜찮은 팀인가 봐?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#056.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.src: Look! The colours are returning to the monolith! It's definitely reactivated. I'll run ahead and get to the other monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.dst: 봐! 모놀리스에 색이 돌아오고 있어! 확실히 다시 작동해. 먼저 다른 모놀리스로 달려갈게.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#057.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.src: Follow the path! The way there is up the big cliff where we first entered the Realm.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.dst: 길을 따라와! 우리가 처음 영역에 들어온 큰 절벽 위로 가면 돼.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#058.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.src: I'm unsure if you can feel the light returning from the monolith, but I can. I almost feel reborn, with all this energy!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.dst: 모놀리스에서 빛이 돌아오는 게 너도 느껴지는지 모르겠지만, 난 느껴져. 이 힘에 다시 태어난 기분이야!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#059.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.src: The rift ahead ought to take us to the second monolith, but it doesn't seem to be working, and I'm unsure why.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.dst: 앞의 틈새가 두 번째 모놀리스로 데려다줘야 하는데, 작동을 안 해. 이유를 모르겠어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#060.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.src: See? It's inert, which is... Odd. These aren't connected to the energy of the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.dst: 봤지? 멈춰 있어. 그건... 이상해. 이것들은 모놀리스의 힘과 연결돼 있지 않거든.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#061.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.src: It shouldn't be inactive as it is. There's some dark influence around here, but I can't seem to place it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.dst: 이렇게 멈춰 있을 리가 없어. 근처에 어둠의 기운이 있는데 어딘지 모르겠어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#062.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.src: My only guess is that it's interfering with the rift's energy. I've already scoured the hill though- No dark patches to be seen.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.dst: 내 추측으론 그게 틈새의 힘을 방해하는 것 같아. 그런데 언덕은 이미 샅샅이 뒤졌어- 어둠의 흔적은 없었어.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#063.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.src: Do you think you could take a second look-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.dst: 네가 한 번 더 살펴봐 줄 수-
The Realm of Light (Quest)#064.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.src: ...maybe you won't need to, after all. That was...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#065.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.src: We've found the disturbance... Even beyond this, I'll need to charge the rift with energy to activate it.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.dst: 원인을 찾았어... 그래도 틈새를 작동시키려면 힘을 채워 넣어야 해.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#068.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.src: Go in peace, tortured ones! Be at one with the light!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.dst: 편히 가렴, 고통받던 이들아! 빛과 하나가 되렴!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#069.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.src: Get the rest of them, {u}! I'll charge the rift!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.dst: 나머지를 맡아 줘, {u}! 난 틈새를 충전할게!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#070.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.src: Defeat the darkened creatures and progress to the monolith.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#071.dst: 어둠에 물든 생물들을 처치하고 모놀리스로 나아가세요.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.src: Thank you, achara. The rift is charged again- Just walk into it!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.dst: 고마워, achara. 틈새가 다시 충전됐어- 그냥 걸어 들어가면 돼!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#072.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.src: The process here should be roughly the same. I bring down the barrier, you enter and charge it with the light I provide.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.dst: 여기서도 절차는 거의 같아. 내가 장벽을 내리면 네가 들어가서 내가 준 빛으로 채우는 거야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#074.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.src: I'll need to focus the energies of the monoliths to reconnect the Nexus of Light to the mainland here, so you'll be alone.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.dst: 넥서스를 이곳 본토에 다시 이으려면 모놀리스들의 힘을 모아야 해서, 이번엔 너 혼자 가야 해.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#075.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.src: I'll leave a barrier around you. Few creatures live on these cliffs, but best to be certain, of course.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.dst: 네 주위에 장벽을 쳐 둘게. 이 절벽엔 생물이 별로 없지만 확실히 해 두는 게 좋지.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#076.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.src: Once you're done, meet me at the cliff near the Nexus. If we're to free Orphion from the parasite, having you along would be a great help.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.dst: 끝나면 넥서스 근처 절벽에서 만나. Orphion을 기생체에게서 구하려면 네가 함께해 주는 게 큰 힘이 될 거야.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#077.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.src: Good luck, achara. I will see you soon.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#078.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.src: There. The connection to the Nexus is established, and so we'll cross.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#081.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.src: Wait! Something... Something's not quite right...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#082.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.src: Interfere?! You're one of the dark!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#084.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.src: You're the one trespassing in realms not your own!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.dst: 남의 영역을 침범한 건 바로 너야!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#085.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.src:
Lari:
{u}. I think. I found someone.
Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.dst:
Lari:
{u}. 있잖아. 누굴 찾았어.
죽어 마땅한 녀석을. 도와줄래?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#086.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.src: Continue up the road towards Orphion's Nexus of Light.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#087.dst: 오르피온의 빛의 넥서스를 향해 길을 따라 계속 올라가세요.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.src: {u}!! Stay back! I'm keeping up but he'll destroy you if you get close!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.dst: {u}!! 물러나! 난 버티고 있지만 가까이 오면 저놈이 널 죽일 거야!!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#088.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.src: AGH, ENOUGH OF THIS! You aren't allowed here, foul thing!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.dst: 으아, 이제 그만! 넌 여기 있으면 안 돼, 더러운 것!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#089.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.src: No! You won't run- I'll kill you before that!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.dst: 안 돼! 도망 못 가- 그 전에 죽여주겠어!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#091.speaker: Lari

The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light
The Realm of Light (Quest)#092.dst: 새 퀘스트 시작: 빛의 영역 V - 빛의 영역

The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.src: Or something that another person wants you to see?
The Realm of Light (Quest)#094.dst: 아니면 다른 누군가가 너에게 보여 주고 싶은 것?

The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.src: You. Elf girl. You are to be eliminated.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#096.dst: 너. 엘프 계집. 너는 제거 대상이다.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.src: Fool. The Beast quakes with our influence. This land is ours.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#097.dst: 어리석은 것. 짐승은 우리의 영향으로 떨고 있다. 이 땅은 우리의 것이다.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.src: I will not waste my time with that specimen. Now. Face death.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#098.dst: 그 표본에게 시간을 낭비하지 않겠다. 자. 죽음을 맞이해라.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.src: You shall not. Surely your god will smile seeing me leave.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#100.dst: 그럴 수 없을 것이다. 내가 떠나는 걸 보면 너의 신도 웃겠지.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.src: YOU DON'T GET TO TALK ABOUT ORPHION LIKE THAT!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#101.dst: 네가 감히 Orphion을 그렇게 말하지 마!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.src: We have already won. Your peon is outmatched.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#102.dst: 우리는 이미 이겼다. 너의 졸개는 상대가 되지 않는다.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.src: It's not over... IT CAN'T BE, DON'T YOU- TAKE THIS!
The Realm of Light (Quest)#103.dst: 아직 안 끝났어... 끝날 리 없어, 감히- 이거나 받아라!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#104.src: There's a faint buzzing in your ears...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.src: I have a slight idea of where I'm headed, but... If I'm able to handle him, then maybe I'm powerful enough for this.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#105.dst: 어디로 가는지 어렴풋이 알 것 같지만... 그 녀석을 상대할 수 있다면 이 정도는 감당할 만큼 강한 거겠지.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.src: I've never been one to say goodbyes, but thank you for everything. I know you'll find people just as strong as you are to rescue Orphion in my place.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#106.dst: 작별 인사는 잘 못 하지만, 전부 고마웠어. 너라면 나 대신 Orphion을 구할 만큼 강한 사람들을 찾을 거야.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.src: I- I see the end of this... Tunnel. There's- Wait...
The Realm of Light (Quest)#107.dst: 나- 이... 터널의 끝이 보여. 저기- 잠깐...

The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.src: {u}... Achara... I do not believe I can ever atone for what I have done to you. An apology simply isn't enough.
The Realm of Light (Quest)#109.dst: {u}... Achara... 내가 너한테 한 짓을 속죄할 수 있을 것 같지 않아. 사과로는 턱없이 부족해.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#110.src: You need to defeat the mob before you can progress!

The Realm of Light (Quest)#111.src: If you were to look into a mirror... what would you see?

The Realm of Light (Quest)#112.src: Though... I feel something on the other side. It seems incredibly... Foul. I can't tell what it is, let's be careful.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#113.src: {u}. I think. I found someone. Who deserves to be killed. Help me out?

The Realm of Light (Quest)#114.src: {u}... I apologize for leaving you like that. I felt like this was my only chance at defeating this plague - by attacking its core.

The Realm of Light (Quest)#115.src: By the light what is that thing?! S-Stay away f-

The Scarred Springs#000.src: Talk to Maripe at Pishlas at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#001.src: Oh! Well, hello there, tourist! I have to assume you're a tourist, anyways. That doesn't look like local dress, anyways. I suppose you've heard about the hot springs!
The Scarred Springs#001.dst: 오! 안녕하세요, 관광객님! 아무튼 관광객이시겠죠. 옷차림이 이 동네 사람 같지가 않으니까요. 온천 얘기 듣고 오셨나 봐요!
The Scarred Springs#001.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#002.src: Well, ah...unfortunately, Pishlas is closed for renovations. You see, it's been closed for a long time... My family has run it for generations, but trouble started.
The Scarred Springs#002.dst: 그게, 음... 안타깝게도 Pishlas는 보수 공사 중이라 문을 닫았어요. 사실 닫은 지 꽤 오래됐어요... 저희 집안이 대대로 운영했는데, 문제가 생겼거든요.
The Scarred Springs#002.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#003.src: With my mother having been stricken ill for so long, my father and all our family, we've had to abandon this place to care for her. It's fallen into disrepair.
The Scarred Springs#003.dst: 어머니가 오랫동안 편찮으셔서, 아버지랑 온 가족이 간호하느라 이곳을 떠나야 했어요. 그래서 다 망가져 버렸죠.
The Scarred Springs#003.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#004.src: She's well enough now that she doesn't need someone looking after her every hour, so I'm taking it on myself to return this place to its former glory!
The Scarred Springs#004.dst: 이제 어머니가 좀 나아지셔서 늘 곁에 누가 있을 필요는 없어요. 그래서 제가 직접 이곳을 옛 모습으로 되돌리려고요!
The Scarred Springs#004.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#005.src: It's been hard work...and it should be opening soon- but I'm not quite done. Again, I'm so sorry you came all this way for nothing.
The Scarred Springs#005.dst: 힘든 일이었어요... 곧 다시 열 수 있을 텐데- 아직 다 끝나진 않았어요. 아무튼 괜히 먼 길 오시게 해서 정말 죄송해요.
The Scarred Springs#005.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#006.src: I- excuse me? You want to...
The Scarred Springs#006.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#007.src: That'd... That'd be absolutely fantastic!! I've been working alone on this for months now!! I'm NEARLY done, but-
The Scarred Springs#007.dst: 그건... 그건 정말 최고예요!! 몇 달째 혼자 하고 있었거든요!! 거의 다 됐는데, 그게-
The Scarred Springs#007.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#008.src: Come on, come on! I'll show you around! Let's go, let's go!!
The Scarred Springs#008.dst: 어서요, 어서! 구경시켜 드릴게요! 가요, 가요!!
The Scarred Springs#008.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#009.src: Hopefully you'll be able to visit before you have to go home then!
The Scarred Springs#009.dst: 돌아가시기 전에 한번 들르실 수 있으면 좋겠네요!
The Scarred Springs#009.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#010.src: Okay, okay, what's next on the list... C'mon, think like Sovereign Zhiraok!
The Scarred Springs#010.dst: 좋아, 좋아, 목록에 다음이 뭐더라... 자, Zhiraok 군주님처럼 생각하자!
The Scarred Springs#010.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#011.src: Let Maripe show you around at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#012.src: Okay, so! These are the main pools- Frankly, I have no idea how all these frogs got here, given the bog is clear across the whole forest...
The Scarred Springs#012.dst: 자, 여기요! 여기가 주 온천탕이에요- 솔직히 이 개구리들이 어떻게 왔는지 모르겠어요. 늪은 숲 반대편 끝에 있는데...
The Scarred Springs#012.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#013.src: But they've got to go. Sure, they're cute, but no one's going to want to take a soak with them... Or with all these fallen leaves in the pools.
The Scarred Springs#013.dst: 그래도 내보내야 해요. 귀엽긴 한데, 개구리랑 같이 몸 담그고 싶은 사람은 없을 거예요... 탕에 떨어진 낙엽도요.
The Scarred Springs#013.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#014.src: The side pool over here is just as important to clean out. Need to have clear pools for the guests! And maybe even for the Sovereign!
The Scarred Springs#014.dst: 이쪽 옆 탕도 똑같이 청소해야 해요. 손님을 위해 물이 깨끗해야죠! 어쩌면 군주님도 오실지 몰라요!
The Scarred Springs#014.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#015.src: I've already put a lot of time into fixing up these huts. I do carpentry work. These used to be in so much worse shape... I'm a little glad my grandparents didn't end up seeing it like this.
The Scarred Springs#015.dst: 이 오두막들 고치는 데 이미 시간을 많이 들였어요. 제가 목수 일을 하거든요. 예전엔 훨씬 엉망이었어요... 할머니 할아버지가 그 꼴을 못 보셔서 조금은 다행이에요.
The Scarred Springs#015.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#016.src: I have such fond memories of playing around here when I was younger... What would they think, seeing it fall apart? That thought has been giving me motivation this whole time.
The Scarred Springs#016.dst: 어릴 때 여기서 놀던 좋은 추억이 많아요... 여기가 무너지는 걸 보셨다면 뭐라고 하셨을까요? 그 생각이 계속 원동력이 됐어요.
The Scarred Springs#016.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#017.src: It'd be a disgrace to let Pishlas fall completely apart. Even Sovereign Zhiraok agreed! Did you know he dropped by, when I was first starting- Oh, wait! There's one other place!
The Scarred Springs#017.dst: Pishlas가 완전히 무너지게 두는 건 수치예요. Zhiraok 군주님도 동의하셨어요! 제가 막 시작했을 때 들르셨다는 거 아세요- 아, 잠깐! 한 곳이 더 있어요!
The Scarred Springs#017.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#018.src: The teahouse! Refreshments, hot drinks, a place to sit out of the water... This is one of the big remaining projects. I'll take care of this- but, back about the Sovereign?
The Scarred Springs#018.dst: 찻집이요! 다과랑 따뜻한 음료, 물 밖에서 앉아 쉴 곳... 남은 큰 작업 중 하나예요. 여긴 제가 할게요- 그런데, 군주님 얘기였죠?
The Scarred Springs#018.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#019.src: He visited one day, while I was starting on fixing the place, and he told me this would be a fantastic community service! Since it's been so long since Pishlas has been usable, I mean.
The Scarred Springs#019.dst: 제가 막 고치기 시작했을 때 하루는 오셔서, 이게 훌륭한 지역 봉사가 될 거라고 하셨어요! Pishlas를 못 쓴 지 너무 오래됐으니까요.
The Scarred Springs#019.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#020.src: This used to be a big community center. Losing it was a blow to all Auburn residents... He's promised some great things if I can clean this all up! So let's get to it!
The Scarred Springs#020.dst: 여긴 원래 큰 마을 모임터였어요. 잃고 나서 Auburn 주민 모두가 타격을 입었죠... 다 정리하면 좋은 걸 주겠다고 약속하셨어요! 그럼 시작해요!
The Scarred Springs#020.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#021.src: You go gather up the frogs! There's a pond to the you can drop them off at. Then...the leaves! Pick them out of the pools. Then...then come back and we'll see where we're at!
The Scarred Springs#021.dst: 개구리들을 모아 주세요! 저쪽에 놓아줄 연못이 있어요. 그다음엔... 낙엽! 탕에서 건져 내 주세요. 그다음... 그다음 돌아오시면 진행 상황을 봐요!
The Scarred Springs#021.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#023.src: How's it coming? Still working on this. Will be for a bit, but I'm energized! Maybe I can get this done today, even! Uh...right, right! Frogs!
The Scarred Springs#023.dst: 어떻게 돼 가요? 전 아직 이거 하는 중이에요. 좀 걸리겠지만 힘이 넘쳐요! 오늘 다 끝낼지도 몰라요! 어... 맞다, 맞다! 개구리!
The Scarred Springs#023.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#024.src: Okay, there were five, and you're holding... Alright, so there's left to get!
The Scarred Springs#024.dst: 좋아요, 다섯 마리였고 지금 들고 계신 게... 그럼 남은 걸 잡아 주세요!
The Scarred Springs#024.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#025.src: Release the frogs at the pond in the back at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#026.src: Woah! That...that's sure a way to carry the frogs, haha! Y- Pfffkhhhaaahahahaa!! You look- Wahaha, that's fantastic!! Oh, Ohhkay, okay, right!
The Scarred Springs#026.dst: 우와! 그거... 그것도 개구리 나르는 방법이긴 하네요, 하하! 푸- 푸흐하하하하!! 그 모습- 와하하, 최고예요!! 아, 좋아요, 좋아, 알겠어요!
The Scarred Springs#026.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#027.src: There's a pond to the of Pishlas here you can drop them off at! Now, g-get out of here, eheheh! I gotta concentrate, and there's frogs on y- heehehahahahaaah!!
The Scarred Springs#027.dst: Pishlas 쪽에 놓아줄 연못이 있어요! 자, 어, 얼른 가세요, 에헤헤! 집중해야 하는데 몸에 개구리가- 히히히하하하하!!
The Scarred Springs#027.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#028.src: Pick up all the leaf piles around [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Scarred Springs#029.src: Okay, frogs are dealt with, now the leaves! There were ten big patches out there I saw. Get in there and scoop them up- Uh, lemme see. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.dst: 좋아요, 개구리는 해결했고 이제 낙엽이에요! 밖에서 큰 무더기 열 개를 봤어요. 들어가서 건져 내 주세요- 어, 어디 보자. ...
The Scarred Springs#029.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#030.src: Okay, you got left! Hopefully once you do, I'll be all done over here, and we'll go from there!
The Scarred Springs#030.dst: 좋아요, 남았어요! 그걸 끝내실 때쯤 저도 여기 다 끝냈으면 좋겠네요. 그다음 계속해요!
The Scarred Springs#030.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#032.src: Okay, there! And STAY in, you darn board... So, how's the work going?
The Scarred Springs#032.dst: 좋아, 됐다! 거기 딱 붙어 있어, 이 망할 판자야... 그래서, 일은 어떻게 돼 가요?
The Scarred Springs#032.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#033.src: Frogs dealt with, check...and leaves out of the water, check! Which, ah...well, that means now I need you to get some leaves...to put IN the water, eheh!
The Scarred Springs#033.dst: 개구리 해결, 체크... 낙엽 건지기, 체크! 그러니까, 음... 이번엔 잎을 좀... 물에 넣을 잎을 구해 주셨으면 해요, 에헤!
The Scarred Springs#033.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#034.src: What I mean by that, is that I need fresh tea for the teahouse! I've already got some food stowed away for refreshments, but I'll need some drinks to go along with that.
The Scarred Springs#034.dst: 무슨 말이냐면, 찻집에 쓸 신선한 차가 필요해요! 다과용 음식은 이미 챙겨 뒀는데, 곁들일 음료가 있어야 하거든요.
The Scarred Springs#034.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#035.src: I might be done in this building, but there's still plenty of things for me to take care of, so I've got to stay behind and really...really focus in on this!
The Scarred Springs#035.dst: 이 건물은 거의 끝났는데 아직 처리할 게 많아서, 전 여기 남아서 정말... 정말 집중해야 해요!
The Scarred Springs#035.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#036.src: It's just that...a lot of this isn't heavy work, but there's just so many tasks on the list that I don't know where to start, so I just can't get it going. You taking care of the other things is helping with that!
The Scarred Springs#036.dst: 그게... 대부분 힘든 일은 아닌데 목록에 할 일이 너무 많아서 어디서부터 시작할지 몰라 손을 못 대고 있었어요. 다른 일을 맡아 주시니까 큰 도움이 돼요!
The Scarred Springs#036.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#037.src: So, uh, anyway! There's a teahouse off to the northwest, up on a ridge. I know the owner- her name's Marseled, and she makes the best tea in the whole forest!
The Scarred Springs#037.dst: 그래서, 음, 아무튼! 북서쪽 능선 위에 찻집이 있어요. 주인이랑 아는 사이인데- 이름은 Marseled고, 숲 전체에서 차를 제일 잘 만들어요!
The Scarred Springs#037.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#038.src: So, your job is to head there for a big bulk order, and then bring it back! I'll ask her about paying it off later, since we trade favors a lot. Tell her I sent you!
The Scarred Springs#038.dst: 그러니까 거기 가서 대량 주문을 하고 가져오시면 돼요! 돈은 나중에 제가 얘기할게요, 서로 자주 도와주는 사이라서요. 제가 보냈다고 하세요!
The Scarred Springs#038.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#040.src: Okay, dust busted, cobwebs cleared, lanterns in the middle of being lit- Oh, hey! Did you get the tea?
The Scarred Springs#040.dst: 좋아, 먼지 털고, 거미줄 치우고, 등불은 켜는 중이고- 오, 안녕하세요! 차 구해 오셨어요?
The Scarred Springs#040.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#041.src: Marseled's teahouse is off to the northwest, up on the ridge. If you need the exact spot, look in your !
The Scarred Springs#041.dst: Marseled의 찻집은 북서쪽 능선 위에 있어요. 정확한 위치가 필요하면 확인해 보세요!
The Scarred Springs#041.speaker: Maripe

The Scarred Springs#042.src: Welcome, traveler, to my humble teahouse. My name is Marseled. It is always a pleasure to see a new customer.
The Scarred Springs#042.dst: 어서 오세요, 여행자님. 누추한 찻집에 잘 오셨어요. 전 Marseled예요. 새 손님은 언제나 반갑답니다.
The Scarred Springs#042.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#043.src: So, what can I do for you?
The Scarred Springs#043.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#044.src: Oh, is that so? Why, that's wonderful! He's spoken with me a few times about working on old Pishlas there. If he wants fresh stock for drinks, he must be confident that it's nearly finished!
The Scarred Springs#044.dst: 어머, 그래요? 세상에, 정말 잘됐네요! 그 옛 Pishlas를 고치고 있다고 몇 번 얘기했었죠. 음료용 새 찻잎을 원한다면 거의 다 끝났다고 확신하나 봐요!
The Scarred Springs#044.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#045.src: Admittedly, though, I'm facing some...difficulties. I've not got quite enough to fill up an order like he'll need. You see, ah...there's...
The Scarred Springs#045.dst: 그런데 사실 제가 좀... 곤란한 상황이에요. 그 사람이 원하는 주문을 채울 만큼 물량이 없거든요. 그게, 음... 그러니까...
The Scarred Springs#045.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#046.src: It's COCKROACHES! Filthy, ugly, disgusting COCKROACHES!! They keep getting all over the mushrooms and on the tea leaves and I CAN'T touch them, I can't I can't I CAN'T!!
The Scarred Springs#046.dst: 바퀴벌레 때문이에요! 더럽고, 못생기고, 역겨운 바퀴벌레!! 자꾸 버섯이랑 찻잎에 들러붙는데 전 도저히 못 만지겠어요, 못 해요 못 해요 못 한다고요!!
The Scarred Springs#046.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#047.src: They aren't even harming the plants or anything, but I go out to harvest them and they race up to me and crawl all over my feet and up my leggings and aahghguhgughuguhhhh!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.dst: 식물을 해치는 것도 아닌데, 수확하러 나가면 저한테 달려와서 발을 타고 레깅스 안으로 기어올라서 으아아으으아아아!!!
The Scarred Springs#047.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#048.src: I hate them I hate them I hate them, I hate them so much! I- Er. Um. S-sorry. I...shouldn't act so ill-mannered in front of my customers.
The Scarred Springs#048.dst: 싫어요 싫어요 싫어요, 너무너무 싫어요! 저- 어. 음. 죄, 죄송해요. 손님 앞에서... 이렇게 무례하게 굴면 안 되는데.
The Scarred Springs#048.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#049.src: The musrooms are right out front and the leaves are down the side of the hill. and should be enough to get me started again.
The Scarred Springs#049.dst: 버섯은 바로 앞에 있고 찻잎은 언덕 비탈 아래에 있어요. 그거면 다시 시작하기에 충분할 거예요.
The Scarred Springs#049.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#050.src: I do hate to ask, but...if you could go out and harvest some of the ingredients for me? And deal with the pests? I've tried, but every time I just...panic.
The Scarred Springs#050.dst: 부탁하기 정말 죄송하지만... 나가서 재료를 좀 수확해 주실 수 있을까요? 해충도 처리해 주시고요? 해 봤는데 매번... 기겁해 버려서요.
The Scarred Springs#050.speaker: Marseled

The Scarred Springs#051.src: If you could take care of that problem for me, I'll be able to fill out the order for Maripe... And, hopefully, I won't wake the whole of {p} shrieking over a roach in my pants.
