The Strong Survive#514.src: If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
The Strong Survive#514.dst: 점심을 다 먹었으면 식당에서 Effal 모집관님이 다음 과제로 데리러 오길 기다려요.
The Strong Survive#514.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#515.src: And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#515.dst: Effal 모집관님이 이미 당신 조를 데리러 왔었다면... 지금쯤 결투실에서 함께 있어야 해요.
The Strong Survive#515.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#516.src: This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
The Strong Survive#516.dst: 이것이 오늘 마지막 훈련이다. 다른 신병과의 일대일 근접전이다.
The Strong Survive#516.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#517.src: The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
The Strong Survive#517.dst: 규칙은 전날과 같다. 훈련용 검이 없으면 탁자에서 챙기고, 준비되면 큰 문으로 들어가라.
The Strong Survive#517.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#518.src: I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is somthing I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
The Strong Survive#518.dst: 오늘은 처리할 일이 있어 과제를 감독할 수 없다. 다른 교관에게 맡겼으니, 결투실에서 기다리고 있을 거다.
The Strong Survive#518.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#519.src: Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
The Strong Survive#519.dst: 이제 가서 결투를 시작해라. 행운을 빈다, 신병들.
The Strong Survive#519.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#520.src: Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
The Strong Survive#520.dst: 다음 방에 들어가 오늘의 마지막 과제를 완수하세요.

The Strong Survive#521.src: Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
The Strong Survive#521.dst: 너무 심각하게 받아들이지 마라. 좋은 병사가 된다는 게 늘 이기는 것만은 아니다.
The Strong Survive#521.speaker: Recruiter Alena

The Strong Survive#522.src: Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
The Strong Survive#522.dst: Ferreo 사령관님이 너와 얘기하고 싶어 하신다. 기다리시게 하지 마.
The Strong Survive#522.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#523.src: Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
The Strong Survive#523.dst: 내가 이 말 했다고 하지 마. 이 과제에선 우리 오빠 Robin이 나보다 유리해.
The Strong Survive#523.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#524.src: As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
The Strong Survive#524.dst: 그래도 내가 오빠랑 붙지만 않으면 오빠는 그걸 모를 거야. 그래서 먼저 가라고 한 거지.
The Strong Survive#524.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#525.src: Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
The Strong Survive#525.dst: 내가 상대를 이기고 오빠가 지면, 내가 더 세다고 믿을지도 몰라!
The Strong Survive#525.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#527.src: I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
The Strong Survive#527.dst: 아직 결투는 시작하지 마라. 상대가 아직 오지 않았다. 함께 기다리지.
The Strong Survive#527.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#528.src: There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
The Strong Survive#528.dst: 왔군, Arnol. 점심때 소란을 피웠다고 들었다. 그런 일은 여기서 용납되지 않는다는 걸 알게 될 거다.
The Strong Survive#528.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#529.src: This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
The Strong Survive#529.dst: Arnol, 이자가 네 결투 상대다. 둘이 친구라지? 이 결투가 둘 모두에게 값진 교훈이 될 거다.
The Strong Survive#529.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#530.src: Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
The Strong Survive#530.dst: 값진 교훈이요? 무슨 뜻이죠, 사령관님? 함정인가요? 친구와 결투해서 뭘 어쩌라는 거죠?
The Strong Survive#530.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#531.src: You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#531.dst: 상관의 명령에 토를 달 만큼 어리석진 않을 텐데, Arnol. 이제 둘 다 결투실로 들어가라.
The Strong Survive#531.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#533.src: Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
The Strong Survive#533.dst: 앞으로 나서라, 결투를 시작한다. 둘 중 하나라도 봐주면, 필요한 만큼 몇 번이고 다시 시킬 거다.
The Strong Survive#533.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#534.src: You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
The Strong Survive#534.dst: 예상보다 잘했다, Arnol. 하지만 결과는 여전히 내가 생각한 대로군.
The Strong Survive#534.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#535.src: Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
The Strong Survive#535.dst: 제가 질 걸 아셨다면 이 결투는 대체 무슨 의미였죠! 저를 더 망신 주려고요? 이미 충분히 하지 않으셨나요?!
The Strong Survive#535.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#536.src: Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
The Strong Survive#536.dst: 네 오만함은 정말 끝이 없구나. 몇 번을 더 벌해야 여기 일을 진지하게 받아들이겠나?
The Strong Survive#536.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#537.src: You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with in private.
The Strong Survive#537.dst: 넌 구제불능이 되어 가고 있다, Arnol. 이제 가라. 따로 나눌 얘기가 있다.
The Strong Survive#537.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#538.src: Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
The Strong Survive#538.dst: 네 친절은 그에게 전혀 도움이 안 된다. Arnol은 강해지기 전에 고통을 알아야 하는데, 너희 우정이 그걸 막고 있다.
The Strong Survive#538.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#539.src: For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
The Strong Survive#539.dst: 둘 모두를 위해서, 그와의 관계를 끊어라.
The Strong Survive#539.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#540.src: Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#540.dst: 결투실을 나간 뒤 [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 병영으로 가서 잠자리에 드세요.

The Strong Survive#541.src: Do not take my advice for granted.
The Strong Survive#541.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#542.src: Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
The Strong Survive#542.dst: 이 과제들이 시시한 건 나뿐이야? 병사가 되는 거랑 별 상관 없어 보이는데.
The Strong Survive#542.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#543.src: Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
The Strong Survive#543.dst: 에이, 뭐 어때. 그래도 좀 재밌긴 하니까 그건 인정. 다른 신병들이 덜 심각하게 받아들였으면 좋겠어.
The Strong Survive#543.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#544.src: Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
The Strong Survive#544.dst: 잘했어, 순위 올리겠다는 약속을 지켰네! Ferreo 사령관님도 Olissy 모집관님도 자랑스러워하실 거야.
The Strong Survive#544.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#545.src: I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know must be constantly trying to improve!
The Strong Survive#545.dst: 첫 순위의 창피함을 원동력 삼아 오늘 과제에 더 힘썼어. 처음에 못했던 게 오히려 다행이야. 이제 늘 발전하려 애써야 한다는 걸 알았거든!
The Strong Survive#545.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#546.src: I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
The Strong Survive#546.dst: 지금 같은 약속을 할게. 내일 내 순위는 지금보다 더 높을 거야!
The Strong Survive#546.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#547.src: I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
The Strong Survive#547.dst: 실패했어... 이제 절대 날개 기사단 병사가 못 될 거야...
The Strong Survive#547.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#548.src: Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
The Strong Survive#548.dst: 좀 과장하는 거 아니야? 난 네가 잘했다고 생각해. 꼴찌도 아니잖아.
The Strong Survive#548.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#549.src: Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
The Strong Survive#549.dst: 넌 말하기 쉽지... 넌 이미 날개 기사단 조고, 뭘 위해 노력할 필요도 없었어. 그냥 타고났잖아! 넌 실패자가 어떤 기분인지 절대 모를 거야!
The Strong Survive#549.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#550.src: I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
The Strong Survive#550.dst: 벌써 둘째 날이 끝났다니 믿기지 않아. 신병일 때를 즐겨 둬. 앞으론 더 힘들어질 뿐이야.
The Strong Survive#550.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#551.src: You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
The Strong Survive#551.dst: 살얼음판이야, Priscilla... 어제보다 하나도 안 늘었잖아! 약골을 달고 다니면 사람들이 뭐라 생각하겠어?
The Strong Survive#551.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#552.src: Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top {~} tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#552.dst: 제발, Lynn! 한 번만 더 기회를 줘! 내일은 꼭 {~}위 안에 들게!
The Strong Survive#552.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#553.src: Make it top {~}! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
The Strong Survive#553.dst: {~}위 안으로 해! 못 하면... 다시는 너랑 말 안 해!
The Strong Survive#553.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#554.src: Top {~}!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top {~} tomorrow, I promise!
The Strong Survive#554.dst: {~}위 안?! 그건... 어... 좋아, 내일 {~}위 안에 들게, 약속해!
The Strong Survive#554.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#555.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#555.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#556.src: You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
The Strong Survive#556.dst: 오늘 일정은 끝났어요. 남은 과제는 없어요.
The Strong Survive#556.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#557.src: Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
The Strong Survive#557.dst: 이제 푹 쉬어요, 그럴 자격 있어요. 다음 방에 들어가자마자 정면 맞은편 방으로 가서, 거기서 왼쪽 방으로 들어가요.
The Strong Survive#557.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#559.src: You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
The Strong Survive#559.dst: 넌 내 시간을 쓸 가치가 없어. 부탁인데 저리 가.
The Strong Survive#559.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#560.src: I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
The Strong Survive#560.dst: 오늘 점심 일은 덮어 둘 수 있다. 너나 Arnol이 첫날 내 결투에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 어떻게 알아냈는지만 말해라.
The Strong Survive#560.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#561.src: I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
The Strong Survive#561.dst: 난 쉽게 속지 않는다. 너희가 조언을 구하러 왔다는 지어낸 얘기는 안 믿는다.
The Strong Survive#561.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#562.src: You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
The Strong Survive#562.dst: 이 제안을 진지하게 받아들이는 게 좋을 거다. 난 적으로 두고 싶은 부류가 아니다.
The Strong Survive#562.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#563.src: It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
The Strong Survive#563.dst: 요행이야. 네가 딱 1점 차로 날 이긴 건 그것밖에 설명이 안 돼! 아무 의미 없다고!
The Strong Survive#563.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#564.src: Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
The Strong Survive#564.dst: 그래그래... 계속 그렇게 믿어. 그래도 속으론 내가 이겼다는 거 알잖아. 절대 잊게 두지 않을 거야!
The Strong Survive#564.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#565.src: They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
The Strong Survive#565.dst: 저 둘 한참째 저러네. 내일은 누가 이길 것 같아?
The Strong Survive#565.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#566.src: I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
The Strong Survive#566.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#567.src: I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
The Strong Survive#567.dst: 그런 일은 없길 바라. 누가 더 나은지 밤새 싸울 테니까.
The Strong Survive#567.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#568.src: Could this day have gone any worse?
The Strong Survive#568.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#569.src: The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
The Strong Survive#569.dst: 명예로운 Ferreo 사령관님은 Adder가 동료 신병을 곤죽으로 만드는데도 가만히 있었어요...
The Strong Survive#569.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#570.src: The instructors of the esteemed {p} recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
The Strong Survive#570.dst: 명망 높은 {p} 신병 과정의 교관들은 우릴 제대로 훈련시킬 생각이 없어 보여요...
The Strong Survive#570.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#571.src: And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
The Strong Survive#571.dst: 그리고 가문의 명예를 높인다는 생각도 의심스러워지기 시작했어요...
The Strong Survive#571.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#572.src: At least I'm not alone though...
The Strong Survive#572.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#573.src: Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
The Strong Survive#573.dst: 몰래 돌아다니며 Ferreo 사령관의 계획에 대한 정보를 더 찾으세요.

The Strong Survive#574.src: You found all of my diary entries, well done.
The Strong Survive#574.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#575.src: It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
The Strong Survive#575.dst: 숨긴 지 워낙 오래돼서, 그런 게 있었다는 것도 잊어 가던 참이야.
The Strong Survive#575.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#576.src: Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
The Strong Survive#576.dst: 훈장 같은 건 기대하지 마. 그래도 일기에 대해 궁금한 건 좀 답해 줄 수 있어.
The Strong Survive#576.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#577.src: It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in {p}.
The Strong Survive#577.dst: Ferreo 사령관의 마지막 모욕이었지. 그래서 내가 여기 {p}에서 경비병 노릇을 하는 거야.
The Strong Survive#577.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#578.src: After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
The Strong Survive#578.dst: 신병 과정을 수료했을 때, 내 평균 순위는 현장 대장이나 사령관 밑에 들어가기엔 너무 낮았어.
The Strong Survive#578.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#579.src: So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
The Strong Survive#579.dst: 그래서 Ferreo가 직접 나서서 날 받아 주더니, 여기 배치해 썩게 뒀지. 일종의 벌인 것 같아...
The Strong Survive#579.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#580.src: I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
The Strong Survive#580.dst: 솔직히 잘 모르겠어. 너처럼 눈치 빠른 신병이 찾아서 내 실수를 되풀이하지 않길 바랐는지도.
The Strong Survive#580.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#581.src: It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
The Strong Survive#581.dst: 그냥 심심해서였을 수도 있고. 병사가 된 뒤 그걸 숨길 때 무슨 생각을 했는지 기억이 안 나.
The Strong Survive#581.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#582.src: Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have though after reading them...
The Strong Survive#582.dst: 마음 깊은 곳에선... Ferreo 사령관이 그 기록을 찾길 바랐는지도 몰라. 읽고 나서 무슨 생각을 했을까...
The Strong Survive#582.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#583.src: I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
The Strong Survive#583.dst: 그걸 물어볼 줄 알았어. 놀랍게도, 맞아, Ferreo 사령관이 성공한 진실을 알아냈어. 비밀 같은 건 없어. 더 위대해지겠다는 맹렬한 결의 하나로 해낸 거야.
The Strong Survive#583.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#584.src: When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in {p}. Not living, just, surviving.
The Strong Survive#584.dst: Ferreo 사령관은 젊을 때 가진 게 없었어. {p}의 부랑자였지. 사는 게 아니라, 그냥 살아남는 거였어.
The Strong Survive#584.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#585.src: Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
The Strong Survive#585.dst: 가끔 Fruma 군이 찾아오면 마을 사람들이 다 모여 구경했어. Ferreo는 다들 그들의 용맹을 얼마나 사랑하고 칭송하는지 봤지.
The Strong Survive#585.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#586.src: He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
The Strong Survive#586.dst: 그도 그렇게 칭송받고 사랑받고 싶었던 거야. 그래서 그 자리에 오르는 걸 목표로 삼고, 앞을 막는 수많은 장애물을 넘었어.
The Strong Survive#586.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#587.src: Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
The Strong Survive#587.dst: 순전한 힘과 기량으로 금세 날개 기사단 사령관이 됐고, 그 과정에서 군 기록들을 갈아 치웠지.
The Strong Survive#587.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#588.src: There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
The Strong Survive#588.dst: 그가 더 나아가 군주가 되려 한다는 소문도 있었어. 당시엔 그 자리가 전부 차 있었는데도...
The Strong Survive#588.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#589.src: He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
The Strong Survive#589.dst: 마침내 그는 꿈꾸던 명성과 존경을 손에 넣었어. 하지만 더 높이 오를 수 있다는 가능성이 그를 괴롭혔겠지.
The Strong Survive#589.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#590.src: Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
The Strong Survive#590.dst: 아는 사람은 많지 않지만, 지금 직위를 받기 직전에 Ferreo 사령관은 Majin 군주와 여왕을 만났어.
The Strong Survive#590.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#591.src: We can only speculate at what the discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of {p}. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
The Strong Survive#591.dst: 무슨 얘기를 했는지는 짐작만 할 뿐이지만, 그 직후 Majin이 Ferreo 사령관을 {p}의 수장으로 임명했어. 내 추측으론 야심 때문에 벌을 받은 거야...
The Strong Survive#591.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#592.src: Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.
The Strong Survive#592.dst: 훈련 잘 받아, 신병. 나보다는 진지하게 임하길 권해.
The Strong Survive#592.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#593.src: Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
The Strong Survive#593.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#595.src: I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
The Strong Survive#595.dst: 어제 한밤중에 네가 일어나 몰래 돌아다니는 소리를 듣고 의심하기 시작했다.
The Strong Survive#595.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#596.src: And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#596.dst: 그리고 어째선지 내 첫 결투의 결과까지 알아냈지... 내릴 수 있는 결론은 하나, 네가 Ferreo 사령관님을 염탐해 왔다는 거다.
The Strong Survive#596.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#597.src: For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
The Strong Survive#597.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#598.src: But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
The Strong Survive#598.dst: 하지만... 난 도전할 상대를 찾고 있었다. 지금까지 훈련은 시시했지. 저항군 첩자가 얼마나 하는지 보고 싶군.
The Strong Survive#598.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#599.src: If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land {~} hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
The Strong Survive#599.dst: 결투에서 날 이기면 Ferreo 사령관님께 보고하지 않겠다. 먼저 상대에게 {~}번 적중시키는 쪽이 승자다.
The Strong Survive#599.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#600.src: As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
The Strong Survive#600.dst: 성의의 표시로 첫 일격은 맞아 주지.
The Strong Survive#600.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#601.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
The Strong Survive#601.dst: 끙 소리와 분노 입자가 보이면 Adder가 에스톡을 휘두릅니다. 이 공격을 완벽히 막으면 기절시켜 반격할 수 있습니다.
The Strong Survive#601.speaker: Swipe

The Strong Survive#602.src: Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.
The Strong Survive#602.dst: 분노 입자 없이 끙 소리만 나면 Adder가 옆으로 뜁니다.
The Strong Survive#602.speaker: Sidestep

The Strong Survive#603.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#603.dst: 끙 소리와 분노 입자, 파란 입자가 보이면 Adder가 에스톡을 겨누고 앞으로 돌진합니다. 이 공격은 돌진 시작과 정점에서 한 번씩, 두 번 피해를 줍니다. 마지막 타격을 완벽히 막으면 기절시킬 수 있습니다.
The Strong Survive#603.speaker: Lunge

The Strong Survive#604.src: Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the {u} for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#604.dst: 분노 입자와 초록 입자가 보이면 Adder가 몇 초 동안 {u}에게 달려오며 앞쪽으로 에스톡을 연달아 휘두릅니다. 마지막 타격을 완벽히 막으면 기절시킬 수 있습니다.
The Strong Survive#604.speaker: Swipe Chain

The Strong Survive#605.src: Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
The Strong Survive#605.dst: 말도 안 돼... 그 모든 걸 겪고도 난 아직 강하지 않다니...
The Strong Survive#605.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#607.src: Make your way through the vents.

The Strong Survive#608.src: We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
The Strong Survive#608.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#609.src: We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
The Strong Survive#609.dst: 신병 중에 첩자가 있고 누군지도 아는데, 그 전령은 Majin 군주님이 오실 때까지 아무것도 하지 말라니!?
The Strong Survive#609.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#610.src: I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
The Strong Survive#610.dst: 사령관님, 지금은 신중해야 한다고 봅니다. 그 첩자가 전령 말대로 강하다면... 우리 모두 끝장날 수도 있습니다...
The Strong Survive#610.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#611.src: Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
The Strong Survive#611.dst: 그래, 네 말이 맞겠지. 하지만 Majin 군주님이 오셔서 내가 첩자를 신병 과정에 들였다는 걸 아시면... 내 모든 노력이 물거품이 될까 두렵다...
The Strong Survive#611.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#612.src: I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...
The Strong Survive#612.dst: 이대로 쉽게 포기하진 않겠다. Majin 군주님을 기다리며 손 놓고 있지도 않을 거다...
The Strong Survive#612.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#613.src: I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
The Strong Survive#613.dst: Effal을 반역죄로 즉시 Wynn에 추방해라. 첩자를 들였으니 그 대가를 치러야 한다. 모집관 자리엔 경비병 아무나 앉혀. 누구라도 그놈보단 유능할 거다.
The Strong Survive#613.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#614.src: Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#614.dst: 이 명을 다른 경비병과 모집관들에게 전하라. Effal은 내일까지 Fruma를 떠나야 한다!
The Strong Survive#614.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#615.src: Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
The Strong Survive#615.dst: 그리고 사령관님, 말씀드릴 문제가 하나 더 있습니다. 애초에 이 늦은 밤에 집무실로 찾아온 이유입니다.
The Strong Survive#615.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#616.src: Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
The Strong Survive#616.dst: 어제 계획은 완벽하게 진행됐습니다. 군의관에게 확인했더니 Katze는 집으로 보내야 한답니다.
The Strong Survive#616.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#617.src: Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
The Strong Survive#617.dst: 훌륭하다. 내일 Adder를 Arnol과 결투시켜라. 가문 이름으로 그 나약함을 더는 덮을 수 없을 거다!
The Strong Survive#617.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#618.src: Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
The Strong Survive#618.dst: 사령관님... 정말 이게 최선입니까? 첩자가 Arnol에게 호감을 가진 것 같습니다. 이러다 보복을 부를까 두렵습니다...
The Strong Survive#618.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#619.src: Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
The Strong Survive#619.dst: 저주받은 자 하나 화나게 하는 게 그렇게 두렵나, Strumon? 게다가 그때쯤이면 Majin 군주님이 도착하실 테니 괜한 걱정이다.
The Strong Survive#619.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#620.src: Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
The Strong Survive#620.dst: 사령관님, 모집관님, 처리하셔야 할 급한 일이 있습니다. 저를 따라오십시오!
The Strong Survive#620.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#621.src: Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#621.dst: 환기구 나사를 푼 뒤, [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 병영으로 돌아가 Arnol을 깨우세요.

The Strong Survive#623.src: What is this about, {u}? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
The Strong Survive#623.dst: 무슨 일이에요, {u}? 왜 이렇게 새벽같이 깨워요?
The Strong Survive#623.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#624.src: What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
The Strong Survive#624.dst: 뭐라고요!? 전 Adder한테 상대도 안 돼요! 붙었다간 죽을지도 몰라요! 하긴 Ferreo 사령관이 이런 짓을 할 거란 건 예상했어야 했는데...
The Strong Survive#624.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#625.src: If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, {u}?
The Strong Survive#625.dst: 지금 이걸 알려 준 걸 보면, 이 난장판에서 절 도울 방법이 있겠죠. 계획이 뭐예요, {u}?
The Strong Survive#625.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#626.src: Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
The Strong Survive#626.dst: 흐음... 좋아요, 믿을게요. 아무도 깨기 전에 가요.
The Strong Survive#626.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#627.src: Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
The Strong Survive#627.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#629.src: Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Strong Survive#630.src: We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
The Strong Survive#630.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#631.src: Alright, I'll try to stay close.
The Strong Survive#631.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#633.src: Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
The Strong Survive#633.dst: 이상하네... 근무 중인 경비병이 하나도 없어요...
The Strong Survive#633.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#637.src: Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
The Strong Survive#637.dst: 어딜 가나? 둘 다 가도 좋다고 한 기억은 없는데.
The Strong Survive#637.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#638.src: I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
The Strong Survive#638.dst: 이쯤이면 둘 다 알 줄 알았다. 여기선 불복종을 용납하지 않는다. 반역도 마찬가지고...
The Strong Survive#638.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#639.src: Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
The Strong Survive#639.dst: Arnol은 네가 첩자인 걸 아나? 그가 저항군과 공모한다는 걸 가족이 알면 어떻게 생각할지 상상해 봐라.
The Strong Survive#639.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#641.src: I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
The Strong Survive#641.dst: 그는 가족에게 맡기겠다. 하지만 너는... 너를 처단할 책임이 내게 주어졌다.
The Strong Survive#641.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#643.src: There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
The Strong Survive#643.dst: Fruma에 너와 너 같은 것들을 위한 희망은 없다!
The Strong Survive#643.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#644.src: I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
The Strong Survive#644.dst: 난 결투에서 져 본 적이 없다. 네가 그걸 바꾸게 둘 거라 착각하지 마라!
The Strong Survive#644.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#645.src: I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
The Strong Survive#645.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#647.src: That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
The Strong Survive#647.dst: 그만해요, 사령관. 상대가 안 되는 게 뻔하잖아요.
The Strong Survive#647.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#648.src: Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
The Strong Survive#648.dst: 고마워요... 그 모든 일 뒤에도 절 챙겨 줘서요. 그럴 이유도 없었는데...
The Strong Survive#648.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#649.src: I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
The Strong Survive#649.dst: 평생 목적 없이 떠돌았어요... 하지만 이제 제 목적이 뭔지 알아요. 당신 덕분에요...
The Strong Survive#649.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#650.src: My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
The Strong Survive#650.dst: 제 목적은 Ferreo 사령관 같은 폭군이 마땅한 최후를 맞게 하는 거예요. 당신의 목표도 그런 것 같네요.
The Strong Survive#650.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#651.src: I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
The Strong Survive#651.dst: 이제 혼자 떠나야 해요. 언젠가 다시 만나길 바라요. 그때까진 더 강해져 있을게요!
The Strong Survive#651.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#652.src: I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
The Strong Survive#652.dst: 저주받은 자는 사악하다고 배우며 자랐는데, 당신은 도움만 줬어요. 그것도 또 하나의 거짓말이었나 봐요...
The Strong Survive#652.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#653.src: Are you a recruit as well? You certainly look strong. I imagine you must have a lot of experience.
The Strong Survive#653.dst: 당신도 신병이에요? 확실히 강해 보이네요. 경험이 많겠죠.
The Strong Survive#653.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#654.src: I am a bit newer to this than you, but I may still be able to offer you some insights if you're curious.
The Strong Survive#654.dst: 난 당신보다 좀 신참이지만, 궁금하다면 그래도 몇 가지 알려 줄 수 있어요.
The Strong Survive#654.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#655.src: Well... A carriage rode me halfway to {p}, then it broke down and I had to walk the rest of the way. When I finally arrived the King himself was there to greet me and made me a recruit.
The Strong Survive#655.dst: 음... 마차 타고 {p}까지 반쯤 왔는데, 고장 나서 나머진 걸어왔어요. 겨우 도착하니 왕이 직접 맞아 주시고 신병으로 삼아 주셨죠.
The Strong Survive#655.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#656.src: I can't seem to remember anything before that though... It probably wasn't too important, what's important is my new job as a recruit!
The Strong Survive#656.dst: 그 전 일은 하나도 기억이 안 나지만... 별로 중요하진 않았겠죠. 중요한 건 신병이라는 새 일이니까요!
The Strong Survive#656.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#657.src: I wonder if the King will give me a promotion soon...
The Strong Survive#657.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#658.src: No... I can't say I have ever seen you before... Are you a fan or something?
The Strong Survive#658.dst: 아뇨... 당신을 본 기억은 없는데요... 혹시 팬이에요?
The Strong Survive#658.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#659.src: I didn't imagine having fans already but that's great! I'm already on the path of becoming the most famous person in Wynn!
The Strong Survive#659.dst: 벌써 팬이 생길 줄은 몰랐는데, 잘됐네요! 난 벌써 Wynn에서 제일 유명한 사람이 되는 길을 걷고 있어요!
The Strong Survive#659.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#660.src: Waiting? I'm not waiting for anything! I'm just resting... That's all!
The Strong Survive#660.dst: 기다리냐고요? 아무것도 안 기다려요! 그냥 쉬는 중이에요... 그게 다예요!
The Strong Survive#660.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#661.src: It's tiring doing so much work out there. Plus I need to give the other recruits and guards a chance to prove themselves, I shouldn't hog all of the glory!
The Strong Survive#661.dst: 밖에서 일을 너무 많이 해서 피곤하거든요. 게다가 다른 신병이랑 경비병한테도 증명할 기회를 줘야죠. 영광을 독차지하면 안 되잖아요!
The Strong Survive#661.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#662.src: You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine out there. Just because you look stronger doesn't mean I'm weak!
The Strong Survive#662.dst: 내 걱정은 안 해도 돼요. 밖에서 잘 지낼 거예요. 당신이 더 강해 보인다고 내가 약한 건 아니라고요!
The Strong Survive#662.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#663.src: You're the one who should be worried... Worried about me surpassing you of course!
The Strong Survive#663.dst: 걱정해야 할 건 당신이에요... 물론 내가 당신을 앞지를까 봐서요!
The Strong Survive#663.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#664.src: But hey, we're on the same side, so let's both keep fighting out there! For the King!
The Strong Survive#664.dst: 그래도 우린 같은 편이니, 밖에서 둘 다 계속 싸워요! 왕을 위하여!
The Strong Survive#664.speaker: Effal

The Thanos Depository#000.src: Thank you again...soldier. For helping us make peace...
The Thanos Depository#000.dst: 다시 한번 고맙네...병사여. 우리가 평화를 이루도록 도와줘서...

The Thanos Depository#002.src: Please take a track controller before entering the rail line.
The Thanos Depository#002.dst: 선로에 들어가기 전에 궤도 조종기를 하나 가져가 주세요.

The Thanos Depository#004.src: This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
The Thanos Depository#004.dst: 이건 완전히 재앙이야... 회수팀에 더는 문제가 없길 빌 뿐이야.
The Thanos Depository#004.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#005.src: I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
The Thanos Depository#005.dst: 내 탓으로 또 사람이 죽는다면 평생 떨쳐 내지 못할 거야.
The Thanos Depository#005.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#006.src: But I must do what it takes to prevent {p} from any more disaster.
The Thanos Depository#006.dst: 하지만 {p}에 더는 재앙이 닥치지 않게 할 수 있는 건 다 해야 해.
The Thanos Depository#006.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#008.src: Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
The Thanos Depository#008.dst: Atila, 돌아왔군! 솔직히 말해 봐, 성공했나? 더는 희생을 감당할 여유가 없어.
The Thanos Depository#008.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#010.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
The Thanos Depository#010.dst: 승강기는 용이 누워 있는 곳으로 곧장 이어집니다. 언제 잠드는지 모르니 도박이나 마찬가지예요.
The Thanos Depository#010.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#011.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble...
The Thanos Depository#011.dst: 그 승강기는 용이 누워 있는 곳으로 곧장 이어져. 언제 잠드는지 모르니, 도박이나 마찬가지지...
The Thanos Depository#011.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#012.src: It's a great feat what you've accomplished. The dwarven defense system was thought to be impeccable. We'll need to rethink our security!
The Thanos Depository#012.dst: 당신은 정말 대단한 일을 해냈네. 드워프의 방어 체계는 완벽하다고 여겨졌지. 보안을 다시 생각해 봐야겠어!

The Thanos Depository#013.src: So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
The Thanos Depository#013.dst: 그럼 정말 금고를 지나가야 하는군. 하지만 방어 체계가 엉망이 된 지금은...
The Thanos Depository#013.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#015.src: Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
The Thanos Depository#015.dst: 신경 쓰지 마. 처음부터 다시 계획을 세워 보자고.
The Thanos Depository#015.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#016.src: Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
The Thanos Depository#016.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#017.src: You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
The Thanos Depository#017.dst: 거기, 인간! 여긴 무슨 일인가? 이리 와서 얘기 좀 하지.
The Thanos Depository#017.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#018.src: What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
The Thanos Depository#018.dst: 여긴 무슨 일인가? 출입 금지 구역이야. 지금 금고는 아주 위험하다고.
The Thanos Depository#018.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#019.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#019.dst: 다시 보니, 이봐, 자네 장비 꽤 고급이잖아? 이름이 뭔가?
The Thanos Depository#019.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#020.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#020.dst: 다시 보니, 이봐, 자네 장비 꽤 고급이잖아? 이름이 뭔가?
The Thanos Depository#020.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#021.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
The Thanos Depository#021.dst: ...그 이름 어디서 들었더라... 아, 기억났다! 자네가 그 Qira라는 여자를 쓰러뜨린 사람이지?
The Thanos Depository#021.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#022.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
The Thanos Depository#022.dst: ...그 이름 어디서 들었더라... 아, 기억났다! 자네가 그 Dogun 사태 해결을 도운 사람이지?
The Thanos Depository#022.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#023.src: I see, I haven't seen you around before.
The Thanos Depository#023.dst: 그렇군, 이 근처에선 처음 보는 얼굴이야.
The Thanos Depository#023.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#024.src: Nevertheless, {p} is in danger. To put it simply, a dragon is living uninvited in our depository.
The Thanos Depository#024.dst: 아무튼 {p}이(가) 위험에 처했네. 간단히 말해, 용 한 마리가 허락도 없이 우리 보관소에 살고 있어.
The Thanos Depository#024.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#025.src: Perhaps, you've seen its lair above our city. Normally she leaves us unharmed, but one day she suddenly made her way in to this vault.
The Thanos Depository#025.dst: 도시 위에 있는 둥지를 봤을지도 모르겠군. 평소엔 우릴 해치지 않는데, 어느 날 갑자기 이 금고로 들어와 버렸어.
The Thanos Depository#025.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#026.src: My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
The Thanos Depository#026.dst: 내 좋은 친구 Atila가 정찰대를 이끌고 있는데, 용이 알을 품고 있다는 걸 알아냈지.
The Thanos Depository#026.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#027.src: We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
The Thanos Depository#027.dst: 막대한 대가를 치르며 알을 훔쳐 둥지로 돌려놓으려 했어. 그러면 떠날지도 모르니까... 하지만 들었다시피 잘 풀리지 않고 있지.
The Thanos Depository#027.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#028.src: I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it's all worth your trouble.
The Thanos Depository#028.dst: 보통 낯선 이에게 이런 부탁은 안 하지만, 우린 한계에 다다랐어. 도와줄 수 있겠나? 수고한 만큼 꼭 보답하지.
The Thanos Depository#028.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#029.src: So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
The Thanos Depository#029.dst: 도와주겠다고!? 정말 고맙네! 한순간도 헛되지 않게 해 주지!
The Thanos Depository#029.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#030.src: You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#030.dst: 보관소에 가려면 내 뒤에 있는 이 방을 지나가야 해. 다른 입구는 딱 용이 있는 곳밖에 없거든...
The Thanos Depository#030.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#031.src: You have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#031.dst: 보관소에 가려면 내 뒤에 있는 이 방을 지나가야 해. 다른 입구는 딱 용이 있는 곳밖에 없거든...
The Thanos Depository#031.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#032.src: The people of {p} have everlasting gratitude, soldier.

The Thanos Depository#034.src: Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
The Thanos Depository#034.dst: Atila가 금고 내부 구조를 좀 알고 있어. 행운을 비네, 성공을 기도하지. 자네의 용기가 {p}에 힘이 될 걸세.
The Thanos Depository#034.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#035.src: Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
The Thanos Depository#035.dst: 아, 역시 안 될 일이었나 보군...
The Thanos Depository#035.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#036.src: Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
The Thanos Depository#036.dst: 뭐, 다시 만나게 되면 언제든 도움은 고맙게 받겠네... 처음부터 다시 계획을 세워야겠군...
The Thanos Depository#036.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#039.src: Find a way through the depository.

The Thanos Depository#040.src: Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository
The Thanos Depository#040.dst: 광차를 타고 보관소 더 깊숙이 들어가세요

The Thanos Depository#041.src: Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.

The Thanos Depository#043.src: Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
The Thanos Depository#043.dst: 오, 세상에!! 죽은 줄 알았어! 용이 시체를 올려 보내는 줄 알았다고!
The Thanos Depository#043.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#044.src: You really got it!? Hurry, then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...
The Thanos Depository#044.dst: 정말 가져왔어!? 그럼 서둘러, 둥지는 이 동굴 위쪽이야! 어쩌면 {p}도 드디어 시름을 덜겠군...
The Thanos Depository#044.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#045.src: Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [{~},-{~}].

The Thanos Depository#047.src: She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
The Thanos Depository#047.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#048.src: {u}! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
The Thanos Depository#048.dst: {u}! 여기야... Atila한테 소식 듣고 최대한 빨리 왔네!
The Thanos Depository#048.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#049.src: You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, {p} no longer has to live in fear.
The Thanos Depository#049.dst: 자넨 영웅이야! 용이 도시에서 떠났으니 {p}도 더는 두려움 속에 살지 않아도 되네.
The Thanos Depository#049.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#050.src: I've prepared your reward. The people of {p} will remember your contribution for years to come.
The Thanos Depository#050.dst: 보상은 준비해 뒀네. {p} 사람들은 자네의 공헌을 오래도록 기억할 걸세.
The Thanos Depository#050.speaker: Coulmis

The Ultimate Weapon#001.src: I'm glad you came along, I could do with a little help if you're not too busy.
The Ultimate Weapon#001.dst: 잘 와 줬어. 너무 바쁘지 않다면 도움이 좀 필요하거든.
The Ultimate Weapon#001.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#002.src: I'm Dodegar Bandysnoot, the world famous Hobbit swordsmith! Perhaps you've heard of me?
The Ultimate Weapon#002.dst: 난 Dodegar Bandysnoot, 세계적으로 유명한 호빗 도검 장인이야! 들어 봤지?
The Ultimate Weapon#002.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#003.src: No? Oh... Well, I've had an idea about how I could make the best weapon that the world has ever seen!
The Ultimate Weapon#003.dst: 아니라고? 아... 뭐, 세상에 없던 최고의 무기를 만들 아이디어가 떠올랐거든!
The Ultimate Weapon#003.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#004.src: But, I need some help getting the special resources to make it.
The Ultimate Weapon#004.dst: 그런데 그걸 만들 특별한 재료를 구하는 데 도움이 필요해.
The Ultimate Weapon#004.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#005.src: You'll help?! Excellent! We shall gather enough resources to make one for each of us!
The Ultimate Weapon#005.dst: 도와준다고?! 좋아! 우리 둘 몫을 만들 만큼 재료를 모으자고!
The Ultimate Weapon#005.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#006.src: So firstly, I need some living wood for the handle, [{~} Enchanted Stick] should be enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#006.dst: 우선 손잡이에 쓸 살아 있는 나무가 필요해. [{~} 마법 막대기]면 충분할 거야.
The Ultimate Weapon#006.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#007.src: The wood sprites located across the river to the west, in a big tree trunk, have magical properties! The handle can then mold to the user's hand! One shouldn't be too hard to come across!
The Ultimate Weapon#007.dst: 서쪽 강 건너 커다란 나무 둥치에 사는 나무 정령들에겐 마력이 있어! 그러면 손잡이가 쓰는 사람 손에 맞춰지지! 하나쯤은 어렵지 않게 구할 거야!
The Ultimate Weapon#007.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#008.src: I hope you are prepared, this will be your best quest yet!
The Ultimate Weapon#008.dst: 준비됐길 바라. 지금까지 한 퀘스트 중 최고가 될 거야!
The Ultimate Weapon#008.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#009.src: Collect [{~} Enchanted Stick] from Wood Sprites at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and return them to Dodegar
The Ultimate Weapon#009.dst: [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}]의 나무 정령에게서 [{~1} 마법 막대기]를 모아 Dodegar에게 가져가세요

The Ultimate Weapon#010.src: Wow! You got the wood I needed, thanks!
The Ultimate Weapon#010.dst: 와! 필요한 나무를 구해 왔네, 고마워!
The Ultimate Weapon#010.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#011.src: While I'm making the handle, could you help me with the blade?
The Ultimate Weapon#011.dst: 내가 손잡이를 만드는 동안 칼날 좀 도와줄래?
The Ultimate Weapon#011.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#012.src: Since we want this weapon to be as good as possible we need to find some sacred Hobbit metal!
The Ultimate Weapon#012.dst: 최고의 무기를 만들려면 신성한 호빗 금속을 찾아야 해!
The Ultimate Weapon#012.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#013.src: The hobbit village, The Shiar, is really close! Follow the southern road. My brother Gogedar should be there!
The Ultimate Weapon#013.dst: 호빗 마을 Shiar가 아주 가까워! 남쪽 길을 따라가. 내 동생 Gogedar가 거기 있을 거야!
The Ultimate Weapon#013.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#014.src: Dodegar needs [{~} Sacred Hobbit Metal] from the Shiar at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
The Ultimate Weapon#014.dst: Dodegar에게 [-{~2}, {~3}, -{~4}]의 Shiar에서 [{~1} 신성한 호빗 금속]이 필요합니다

The Ultimate Weapon#015.src: My brother you say... Trying to create a weapon...
The Ultimate Weapon#015.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#017.src: Oh he needs Sacred Hobbit Metal!?
The Ultimate Weapon#017.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#019.src: Sorry can't help you. I don't really know what that is.
The Ultimate Weapon#019.dst: 미안, 못 도와주겠어. 그게 뭔지 잘 모르거든.
The Ultimate Weapon#019.speaker: Gogedar

The Ultimate Weapon#022.src: Dodegar? Does not really ring a bell I'm afraid.
The Ultimate Weapon#022.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#023.src: Oh! Gogedar's brother, why didn't you tell me that.
The Ultimate Weapon#023.dst: 아! Gogedar의 형이구나, 진작 말하지 그랬어.
The Ultimate Weapon#023.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#024.src: Sacred Hobbit Metal... This is a metal forged by master blacksmith hobbits within our village. It is a bit expensive to get by but holds great potential, if used properly.
The Ultimate Weapon#024.dst: 신성한 호빗 금속... 우리 마을의 대장장이 호빗 장인들이 벼려 낸 금속이야. 구하기엔 좀 비싸지만 제대로 쓰면 잠재력이 엄청나지.
The Ultimate Weapon#024.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#026.src: I don't have any. Maybe ask my nephew's brother Alegdar?
The Ultimate Weapon#026.dst: 난 없어. 내 조카의 형 Alegdar한테 물어봐.
The Ultimate Weapon#026.speaker: Togedar

The Ultimate Weapon#029.src: I actually don't know much about... anything.
The Ultimate Weapon#029.dst: 사실 난 아는 게... 아무것도 없어.
The Ultimate Weapon#029.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#030.src: I kind of just... stand around here.
The Ultimate Weapon#030.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#031.src: Everyone I have ever met just calls me annoying and useless. So I decided to stop trying.
The Ultimate Weapon#031.dst: 만나는 사람마다 나더러 짜증 나고 쓸모없대. 그래서 노력하는 걸 그만뒀어.
The Ultimate Weapon#031.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#032.src: You know, life is hard. We all just have to fight through, and then eventually, we might become happy.
The Ultimate Weapon#032.dst: 있잖아, 인생은 힘들어. 다들 버텨 내다 보면 언젠간 행복해질지도 몰라.
The Ultimate Weapon#032.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#033.src: Right sorry... Ask Balegar for any information. He is way smarter.
The Ultimate Weapon#033.dst: 아, 미안... 정보는 Balegar한테 물어봐. 나보다 훨씬 똑똑하거든.
The Ultimate Weapon#033.speaker: Alegdar

The Ultimate Weapon#035.src: My cousin's nephew's dad has had a rough year... I feel bad for him.
The Ultimate Weapon#035.dst: 내 사촌의 조카의 아빠가 올해 힘들었대... 딱하더라.
The Ultimate Weapon#035.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#037.src: I have nooooo clue about that metal. I heard it was just a valuable as a normal rock.
The Ultimate Weapon#037.dst: 그 금속은 저어어언혀 모르겠어. 그냥 평범한 돌만큼 값지다던데.
The Ultimate Weapon#037.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#038.src: Maybe my cousin Reyoretrsed knows anything about it.
The Ultimate Weapon#038.dst: 내 사촌 Reyoretrsed라면 뭐라도 알지 몰라.
The Ultimate Weapon#038.speaker: Balegar

The Ultimate Weapon#041.src: You are wondering how my name is pronounced? What a rude question.
The Ultimate Weapon#041.dst: 내 이름을 어떻게 읽는지 궁금하다고? 무례한 질문이군.
The Ultimate Weapon#041.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#042.src: Ray-ore-tree-sed, obviously. What is a human doing here?
The Ultimate Weapon#042.dst: 당연히 레이-오어-트리-세드지. 인간이 여기서 뭐 해?
The Ultimate Weapon#042.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#043.src: You are wondering if I have Sacred whatever metal?
The Ultimate Weapon#043.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#044.src: I'm {~}. Now if you excuse me, I am busy standing still. Go bother Richard or something.
The Ultimate Weapon#044.dst: 난 {~}살이야. 이제 실례할게, 가만히 서 있느라 바쁘거든. Richard나 가서 귀찮게 해.
The Ultimate Weapon#044.speaker: Reyoretrsed

The Ultimate Weapon#046.src: I've been trying to tell you that I have what you need.
The Ultimate Weapon#046.dst: 네가 찾는 거 나한테 있다고 계속 말하려 했잖아.
The Ultimate Weapon#046.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#047.src: You humans really need to practice your communication skills, please.
The Ultimate Weapon#047.dst: 너희 인간들은 제발 소통하는 법 좀 연습해.
The Ultimate Weapon#047.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#048.src: Anyway, here. Take it! This metal is just a scam anyway, nothing special with it.
The Ultimate Weapon#048.dst: 아무튼, 자. 가져가! 어차피 이 금속은 사기야, 특별할 것도 없어.
The Ultimate Weapon#048.speaker: Richard

The Ultimate Weapon#049.src: Return to Dodegar with the metal.

The Ultimate Weapon#050.src: I hope it wasn't too much of an issue to get!
The Ultimate Weapon#050.dst: 구하는 데 너무 고생하지 않았길 바라!
The Ultimate Weapon#050.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#051.src: ... I forgot a step. I can't attach a blade without a binder material.
The Ultimate Weapon#051.dst: ...한 단계를 잊었네. 접합 재료 없이는 칼날을 붙일 수 없어.
The Ultimate Weapon#051.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#052.src: I need the nectar of a native flower of the forest to attach it. [{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus] would do the trick.
The Ultimate Weapon#052.dst: 칼날을 붙이려면 숲에 자생하는 꽃의 꿀이 필요해. [{~} Diplacus Aurantiacus]면 될 거야.
The Ultimate Weapon#052.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#053.src: Finding the flower can be rather difficult, here's a riddle on how to find it.
The Ultimate Weapon#053.dst: 그 꽃은 찾기가 꽤 어려워. 찾는 방법을 알려 줄 수수께끼가 여기 있어.
The Ultimate Weapon#053.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#054.src: On the side of a hut, hidden inside a hole. Resting in a forest of light, without plight. Whatever that would mean.
The Ultimate Weapon#054.dst: 오두막 옆면, 구멍 속에 숨어 있네. 빛의 숲에서 걱정 없이 쉬고 있네. 무슨 뜻인지는 모르겠지만.
The Ultimate Weapon#054.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#055.src: Find the Diplacus Aurantiacus by following the riddle to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Ultimate Weapon#056.src: Hold up! This feels waaay, toooo easy.
The Ultimate Weapon#056.dst: 잠깐! 이건 너어어무 쉬운 것 같은데.
The Ultimate Weapon#056.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#057.src: If I'm going to give you this amazingly, incredible, showstopping, crazy item particulary for free, you need to at least work for it!
The Ultimate Weapon#057.dst: 이 놀랍고 믿기지 않고 끝내주고 미친 아이템을 무료로 줄 거라면, 적어도 노력은 해야지!
The Ultimate Weapon#057.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#060.src: This looks so much better! Anyway, bring me that flower now!
The Ultimate Weapon#060.dst: 훨씬 낫네! 아무튼, 이제 그 꽃을 가져와!
The Ultimate Weapon#060.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#061.src: Talk to Dodegar with the Diplacus Aurantiacus.
The Ultimate Weapon#061.dst: Diplacus Aurantiacus를 가지고 Dodegar에게 말을 거세요.

The Ultimate Weapon#062.src: Took you a while, did it not?
The Ultimate Weapon#062.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#063.src: It's starting to look pretty amazing! Just like it's supposed to I'm sure!
The Ultimate Weapon#063.dst: 점점 끝내주게 보이기 시작하네! 분명 원래 이런 모습일 거야!
The Ultimate Weapon#063.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#064.src: Maybe this will actually work out. Either way, last ingredient we need!
The Ultimate Weapon#064.dst: 어쩌면 진짜 잘될지도 몰라. 어쨌든 마지막 재료가 필요해!
The Ultimate Weapon#064.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#065.src: So to finalize and apply some magical properties to this uniquely amazing item we need something known as Luster Blood.
The Ultimate Weapon#065.dst: 이 독보적으로 멋진 아이템을 마무리하고 마력을 입히려면 광택의 피라는 게 필요해.
The Ultimate Weapon#065.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#066.src: The only known creature in the west, probably in the whole world, if I'm being frank, is known as the Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld, not sure where the name comes from.
The Ultimate Weapon#066.dst: 서쪽에서, 솔직히 말하면 아마 전 세계에서 유일하게 알려진 생물이 Glow Dust Leaf Beetle of the Underworld라는 녀석이야. 이름은 어디서 왔는지 모르겠어.
The Ultimate Weapon#066.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#067.src: I happen to know that this beetle lives in a cave in the eastern ravine thingy! If you walk straight east, you should stumble upon it, I promise!
The Ultimate Weapon#067.dst: 마침 그 딱정벌레가 동쪽 협곡 어딘가의 동굴에 산다는 걸 알고 있지! 동쪽으로 쭉 걸어가면 틀림없이 마주칠 거야, 약속해!
The Ultimate Weapon#067.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#068.src: Oh! Almost forgot to mention, about {~} Luster Blood is probably enough.
The Ultimate Weapon#068.dst: 아! 말하는 걸 깜빡할 뻔했네. 광택의 피는 {~}개쯤이면 충분할 거야.
The Ultimate Weapon#068.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#069.src: Find the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and bring back [{~} Luster Blood] and bring it back to Dodegar.
The Ultimate Weapon#069.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴을 찾아 [{~} 광택의 피]를 Dodegar에게 가져가세요.

The Ultimate Weapon#070.src: Do not step any closer... Or I will be forced to obliterate you!
The Ultimate Weapon#070.dst: 더 다가오지 마라... 그렇지 않으면 널 없애 버릴 수밖에 없다!

The Ultimate Weapon#071.src: The final component! It is finally here!
The Ultimate Weapon#071.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#073.src: Do you see how it's glowing, sparkling and... and radiating!
The Ultimate Weapon#073.dst: 이게 빛나고, 반짝이고... 광채를 뿜는 거 보여?
The Ultimate Weapon#073.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#074.src: You don't? Uhm... maybe you need glasses humie.
The Ultimate Weapon#074.dst: 안 보인다고? 음... 인간, 안경이 필요한가 본데.
The Ultimate Weapon#074.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#075.src: As promised! Here you go! Always happy to practice the art of weapon creation.
The Ultimate Weapon#075.dst: 약속대로야! 자, 받아! 무기 제작 기술을 연습하는 건 언제나 즐거워.
The Ultimate Weapon#075.speaker: Dodegar

The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.src: The metal is rather rare so I don't know if you can even find it...
The Ultimate Weapon#000~1.dst: 그 금속은 꽤 희귀해서 네가 찾을 수 있을지 모르겠어...

The Worm Holes#000.src: Soon Gavel will open a museum for my art...

The Worm Holes#001.src: New Quest Started: Realm of Light I - The Worm Holes

similar.text: New Quest Started: Realm of Light V - The Realm of Light

The Worm Holes#002.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.

similar.text: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.

The Worm Holes#003.src: So this is the site... siochain do d'anamacha i mait...

The Worm Holes#004.src: Even if I am alone on that front...though I understand you are taught differently where you come from. I do not envy you, though I still thank you for your aid thus far.
The Worm Holes#004.dst: 그런 생각을 하는 게 나 혼자뿐이라 해도... 네 고향에선 다르게 배운다는 것도 알아. 네가 부럽진 않지만, 지금까지 도와준 건 고마워.

The Worm Holes#008.src: It looked like it escaped! Did you see where it went?

similar.text: ...y-you... ... I...y-you're still alright? I...*hic* I...

The Worm Holes#012.src: New Questline Started: The Realm of Light
The Worm Holes#012.dst: 새 퀘스트 라인 시작: 빛의 영역

The Worm Holes#013.src: Find out what's going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#014.src: Arrighty fellers, let's get this wrapped up now! 'ere's plenty more holes where this one came from!
The Worm Holes#014.dst: 좋아 다들, 이제 여기 마무리하자고! 이런 구멍은 아직 한참 남았어!
The Worm Holes#014.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#016.src: The scaffolds are crackin'! Everyone, get offa there, now!!
The Worm Holes#016.dst: 비계가 갈라진다! 다들 당장 거기서 내려와!!
The Worm Holes#016.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#018.src: Aw, hell... I knew this project was a bust from the start...there goes Willam and Clint cause a' this!
The Worm Holes#018.dst: 아, 젠장... 처음부터 이 공사는 글렀다고 생각했어... 이것 때문에 Willam이랑 Clint가 갔구먼!
The Worm Holes#018.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#019.src: I gotta get someone tough enough to get down there...hm? Hey, a human! Git on over here!
The Worm Holes#019.dst: 저 아래 내려갈 만큼 튼튼한 녀석이 필요한데... 응? 어이, 인간이잖아! 이리 와 봐!
The Worm Holes#019.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#020.src: I gotta ask, how much 'a that didja see, Wynn feller? Wasn't pretty, and I'm in charge a' them folks, so I gotta take responsibility fer that.
The Worm Holes#020.dst: 하나 묻자, 방금 거 얼마나 봤나, Wynn 친구? 보기 좋은 꼴은 아니었지. 내가 저 사람들 책임자니까 책임을 져야 해.
The Worm Holes#020.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#021.src: Th' mayor of {p} there saw these holes poppin' up, and hired us out to cover 'em up. Thing is, the ground's too unstable to build.
The Worm Holes#021.dst: 저기 {p} 시장이 이 구멍들이 생기는 걸 보고 메우라고 우릴 고용했지. 문제는 땅이 너무 불안정해서 뭘 지을 수가 없어.
The Worm Holes#021.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#022.src: It's gettin' real worrying round here. They only started openin' up recently, and there've been quakes too. Feels like the place is gonna collapse!
The Worm Holes#022.dst: 이 근처가 점점 걱정스러워. 구멍은 최근에야 생기기 시작했고, 지진도 있었어. 이러다 여기 통째로 무너질 것 같다고!
The Worm Holes#022.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#023.src: I think we oughta head down there and figure out what 'n heck's goin' on, and you're the best armed outta any of us, being human 'n all.
The Worm Holes#023.dst: 저 아래 내려가서 대체 무슨 일인지 알아봐야 할 것 같아. 인간이니 우리 중에 네가 제일 무장이 잘돼 있고.
The Worm Holes#023.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#024.src: Think y'all could head down 'n see if you can rustle up any leads? There's a path down just to the left of the hole.
The Worm Holes#024.dst: 내려가서 단서 좀 찾아봐 줄 수 있겠나? 구멍 바로 왼쪽에 내려가는 길이 있어.
The Worm Holes#024.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#025.src: Go down the hole and look for what's causing this and return to Malo at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] with proof.
The Worm Holes#025.dst: 구멍 아래로 내려가 원인을 찾고 증거를 가지고 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Malo에게 돌아가세요.

The Worm Holes#026.src: What in tarnation...? The heck did you find down there, soldier?
The Worm Holes#026.dst: 이게 대체 뭐야...? 저 아래서 뭘 찾은 거야, 병사?
The Worm Holes#026.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#027.src: Oh, it was just the skin, huh? Dang...was hopin' you'd've seen what it was, cause I got no clue 'bout this.
The Worm Holes#027.dst: 아, 그냥 허물이었어? 젠장... 정체를 봤길 바랐는데. 난 이게 뭔지 전혀 모르겠거든.
The Worm Holes#027.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#028.src: Urgh. Only gal I know who might have an idea 'bout this is that durn elf lady...
The Worm Holes#028.dst: 으. 이걸 알 만한 여자는 그 빌어먹을 엘프 아가씨밖에 없는데...
The Worm Holes#028.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#029.src: She's got purple hair and's been wanderin' round like she knows everything. Yeah, she's a bright penny but she ain't gotta be so uppity ta all of us 'bout it.
The Worm Holes#029.dst: 보라색 머리에, 다 아는 척하면서 여기저기 돌아다니지. 그래, 똑똑하긴 한데 우리한테 그렇게 잘난 척할 필요는 없잖아.
The Worm Holes#029.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#030.src: She put up a camp just east of here. She'll prob'ly react better to you than me, so I'll go to the authorities and see if they have any leads.
The Worm Holes#030.dst: 여기서 바로 동쪽에 야영지를 차렸어. 나보단 너한테 더 잘 대해 줄 거야. 난 당국에 가서 단서가 있나 알아보지.
The Worm Holes#030.speaker: Malo

The Worm Holes#031.src: Look for Lari and ask what is going on at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

The Worm Holes#032.src: ...Haven’t we met? I have witnessed your presence in Gavel more than once.
The Worm Holes#032.dst: ...우리 만난 적 있지 않아? Gavel에서 네 존재를 여러 번 목격했어.
The Worm Holes#032.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#033.src: I am Lari. I might have greeted you properly before if I were not so busy, which reminds me. You have a reason to be here, yes?
The Worm Holes#033.dst: 난 Lari야. 이렇게 바쁘지 않았다면 전에 제대로 인사했을 텐데, 그러고 보니. 여기 온 이유가 있지?
The Worm Holes#033.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#034.src: Hm...I believe I know what you have found, by your description. That dead skin too, is proof enough, I would say.
The Worm Holes#034.dst: 흠... 설명을 들어 보니 네가 뭘 찾았는지 알 것 같아. 그 허물도 충분한 증거고.
The Worm Holes#034.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#035.src: The creature which shed that skin is known as a Grootslang. Though large, they are rather peaceful. Gentle giants, I believe the saying is?
The Worm Holes#035.dst: 그 허물을 벗은 생물은 그루트슬랭이야. 덩치는 크지만 꽤 온순해. 온화한 거인이라고들 하지?
The Worm Holes#035.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#036.src: This horrid Decay...it affects their habitats underground. They are seeking shelter closer to the surface. I have been trying to scrub the Decay without success...
The Worm Holes#036.dst: 이 끔찍한 쇠락이... 땅속의 서식지에 영향을 주고 있어. 그래서 지표 가까이로 피난처를 찾는 거야. 쇠락을 씻어 내려 했지만 소용없었어...
The Worm Holes#036.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#037.src: Wait... More holes appeared just today? There...there were deaths?! W-where, when?!
The Worm Holes#037.dst: 잠깐... 오늘 구멍이 더 생겼다고? 그럼... 사람이 죽었어?! 어, 어디서, 언제?!
The Worm Holes#037.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#038.src: No, no...! I refuse to be responsible for any more deaths... Human, tell me your name, please.
The Worm Holes#038.dst: 안 돼, 안 돼...! 더는 누구의 죽음도 책임질 수 없어... 인간, 이름을 알려 줘.
The Worm Holes#038.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#039.src: {u}, then... Let us head to the site. {u}. I need to fix this... Please, help me get to the root of this problem so I may soothe the land's pain.
The Worm Holes#039.dst: {u}, 그렇구나... 현장으로 가자. {u}. 이걸 바로잡아야 해... 이 땅의 고통을 달랠 수 있게 문제의 근원을 찾도록 도와줘.
The Worm Holes#039.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#041.src: So this is the site... [Gavellian Spell]...
The Worm Holes#041.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#042.src: Here. Allow me to provide at least one person safe passage into the pit.
The Worm Holes#042.dst: 자. 적어도 한 사람은 안전하게 구덩이로 내려보내 줄게.
The Worm Holes#042.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#043.src: Have faith- Jump in. I will carry you down slowly.
The Worm Holes#043.dst: 날 믿어- 뛰어내려. 천천히 내려가게 해 줄게.
The Worm Holes#043.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#044.src: Take the lead. If we can find any further evidence of the Grootslangs around here, it will aid in my understanding.
The Worm Holes#044.dst: 앞장서. 이 근처에서 그루트슬랭의 흔적을 더 찾으면 이해하는 데 도움이 될 거야.
The Worm Holes#044.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#045.src: Hm? This wall looks like it's been disturbed recently...
The Worm Holes#045.dst: 응? 이 벽, 최근에 누가 건드린 것 같은데...
The Worm Holes#045.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#046.src: I can hear it...but where is it crawling...?
The Worm Holes#046.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#047.src: That's the mother Wyrm! She must be what is making the holes. We need to follow her!
The Worm Holes#047.dst: 어미 웜이야! 구멍을 만드는 게 저 녀석인가 봐. 따라가야 해!
The Worm Holes#047.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#048.src: Never mind the spiders, we need to keep following the Wyrm!
The Worm Holes#048.dst: 거미는 신경 쓰지 마, 계속 웜을 따라가야 해!
The Worm Holes#048.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#049.src: Ah...ehm, {u}? I've... Um, this is...a bit difficult to say, but...
The Worm Holes#049.dst: 아... 저기, {u}? 나... 음, 이건... 말하기 좀 어렵지만...
The Worm Holes#049.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#050.src: I...do not believe we need to fight, or to kill, here? The creatures are native to here, we are invading their space.
The Worm Holes#050.dst: 나는... 여기서 싸우거나 죽일 필요는 없다고 생각해. 이 생물들은 원래 여기 살아. 우리가 침입한 거야.
The Worm Holes#050.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#051.src: Why should they be attacked for merely existing in their territory? Even if they are animals, I believe that you can solve these problems without killing.
The Worm Holes#051.dst: 자기 영역에 존재한다는 이유만으로 공격받아야 해? 동물이라 해도, 넌 죽이지 않고도 해결할 수 있다고 믿어.
The Worm Holes#051.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#052.src: I...understand you may not have the same powers as myself... And I, ah...am not free of guilt, either. But I think you could stand to take a peaceful stance.
The Worm Holes#052.dst: 나는... 네게 나 같은 힘이 없다는 건 알아... 그리고 나도, 아... 죄가 없는 건 아니야. 그래도 평화로운 태도를 취해 볼 수 있을 것 같아.
The Worm Holes#052.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#054.src: Your methods are...disagreeable, but you still have a sense of right to you, I feel... Well, the tunnel diverges here. We'll need to split apart.
The Worm Holes#054.dst: 네 방식엔... 동의할 수 없지만, 그래도 옳고 그름을 아는 사람 같아... 자, 굴이 여기서 갈라져. 따로 가야겠어.
The Worm Holes#054.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#055.src: I'll go to the right, so you ought to continue to the left here. I will meet up with you again soon, hopefully.
The Worm Holes#055.dst: 난 오른쪽으로 갈게, 넌 여기서 왼쪽으로 계속 가. 곧 다시 만나길 바라.
The Worm Holes#055.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#058.src: Aah! {u}! Don't...don't make any sudden movements.
The Worm Holes#058.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#059.src: This Grootslang is uncharacteristically aggressive... She's scared, being so close to the surface. Stay behind me, please.
The Worm Holes#059.dst: 이 그루트슬랭, 평소답지 않게 사나워... 지표에 너무 가까워서 겁먹은 거야. 내 뒤에 있어 줘.
The Worm Holes#059.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#061.src: Do not approach it! The power of the Wyrm is far too much for you!
The Worm Holes#061.dst: 다가가지 마! 웜의 힘은 너한테 너무 벅차!
The Worm Holes#061.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#062.dst: 자, 잠깐, 또? [Gavellian Spell]- 아, 비켜!
The Worm Holes#062.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#063.src: {u}!! You're unharmed, yes? She's scared and in pain!
The Worm Holes#063.dst: {u}!! 다친 데 없지? 저 녀석, 겁먹고 아파하고 있어!
The Worm Holes#063.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#064.src: I have to get it right this time... I'm going to talk her down, stay there!
The Worm Holes#064.dst: 이번엔 제대로 해야 해... 내가 진정시킬게, 거기 있어!
The Worm Holes#064.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#065.src: You must be calm, I beg you. Retreat to the earth- You harm those above!
The Worm Holes#065.dst: 제발 진정해. 땅속으로 돌아가- 위에 있는 이들이 다치고 있어!
The Worm Holes#065.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#066.src: The earth rotting... I take full responsibility, but does the grass above not rot also?
The Worm Holes#066.dst: 땅이 썩어 가는 건... 전부 내 책임이야. 하지만 위의 풀도 썩어 가잖아?
The Worm Holes#066.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#067.src: I wish to soothe your pain, but you must allow me to aid you- You must listen!
The Worm Holes#067.dst: 네 고통을 달래 주고 싶어. 그러니 날 도와줄 수 있게 해 줘- 내 말 들어!
The Worm Holes#067.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#068.src: What does this violence solve? Be calm, please!
The Worm Holes#068.dst: 이런 폭력으로 뭐가 해결돼? 제발 진정해!
The Worm Holes#068.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#069.src: {u}, it won't budge... There's something in its mind rejecting me. Distract it- but don't approach! It will kill you if you get close. Just...be loud!
The Worm Holes#069.dst: {u}, 꿈쩍도 안 해... 뭔가가 머릿속에서 날 거부하고 있어. 주의를 끌어- 다가가진 마! 가까이 가면 죽어. 그냥... 시끄럽게 해!
The Worm Holes#069.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#072.src: Can you hear me?! I'll get her to...to...s-something! Spit you up, I don't know! Just...please, d-don't die!
The Worm Holes#072.dst: 내 말 들려?! 저 녀석이... 뭐, 뭐라도 하게 할게! 뱉어 내게 하든, 모르겠어! 그러니까... 제발, 주, 죽지 마!
The Worm Holes#072.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#073.src: W-We have... We have not laid a blow against you! It is not right for you to do the same!
The Worm Holes#073.dst: 우, 우린... 우린 너한테 한 대도 안 때렸어! 네가 그러는 건 옳지 않아!
The Worm Holes#073.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#074.src: You would wound and consume everything in your rage? Even knowing the consequences?
The Worm Holes#074.dst: 분노에 휩쓸려 모든 걸 다치게 하고 삼킬 거야? 결과를 알면서도?
The Worm Holes#074.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#075.src: Your hunger cannot be sated with this fruitless destruction! I beg of you, let them out!
The Worm Holes#075.dst: 이런 헛된 파괴로는 굶주림을 채울 수 없어! 제발, 그들을 내보내 줘!
The Worm Holes#075.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#076.src: You know th- W-wait...where did you... AAAH!
The Worm Holes#076.dst: 너도 알잖- 자, 잠깐... 어디서... 으아아!
The Worm Holes#076.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#078.src: I tried...w-why does no one listen to me? Why won't a-anything change for me?
The Worm Holes#078.dst: 노력했는데... 왜 아무도 내 말을 안 들어? 왜 나한텐 아, 아무것도 안 변해?
The Worm Holes#078.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#079.src: She...she's been eating dark parasites. They're wracking her insides and h-hurting her head...
The Worm Holes#079.dst: 저 녀석... 어둠의 기생충을 먹어 왔어. 그게 속을 갉아먹고 머리를 아, 아프게 해...
The Worm Holes#079.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#080.src: I...i-it's so d-dark... I c-can't breathe... This...th-this can't be the end...
The Worm Holes#080.dst: 나... 너, 너무 어, 어두워... 수, 숨을 못 쉬겠어... 이게... 이, 이게 끝일 리 없어...
The Worm Holes#080.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#081.src: I...n-no, I can't die in here... I-I'm needed still... You're n-needed still! I... I...
The Worm Holes#081.dst: 나... 아, 안 돼, 여기서 죽을 순 없어... 나, 난 아직 필요해... 너도 아, 아직 필요하고! 나... 나...
The Worm Holes#081.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#082.src: I n-need... Or... O-Or... C-Concentrate, Lari... You can do this...
The Worm Holes#082.dst: 피, 필요한 건... 아니면... 아, 아니면... 지, 집중해, Lari... 할 수 있어...
The Worm Holes#082.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#084.src: LET US OUT! LET US OUT OF HERE! DON'T LET US DIE LIKE THIS! I'M BEGGING YOU, PLEASE!!
The Worm Holes#084.dst: 내보내 줘! 여기서 내보내 줘! 이렇게 죽게 두지 마! 제발 부탁이야!!
The Worm Holes#084.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#085.src: ...I...oh no... It's...d-d... I... I j-just... I just w-wanted out... Ohhh...n-no...
The Worm Holes#085.dst: ...안 돼... 주, 죽었어... 난 그, 그냥 나가고 싶었을 뿐인데... 아, 안 돼...
The Worm Holes#085.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#086.src: ...w-we're...leaving. I...I c-can't look at this any more...
The Worm Holes#086.dst: ...이, 이제... 가자. 나... 더는 못 보, 보겠어...
The Worm Holes#086.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#088.src: I'm...I'm so sorry, {u}. If I'd...I don't... I don't even know what else I could have d-done...
The Worm Holes#088.dst: 정말... 정말 미안해, {u}. 내가 만약... 난... 내가 달리 뭘 할 수 있었을지도 모르겠어...
The Worm Holes#088.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#089.src: There...it didn’t feel like there was...anything left to it... But, if I’d just been quicker, then... Would it...would it even have made a difference?
The Worm Holes#089.dst: 거긴... 남은 게... 아무것도 없는 것 같았어... 그래도 내가 좀 더 빨랐다면... 그럼... 달라지긴 했을까?
The Worm Holes#089.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#090.src: ...some savior I am... I need to be better, but what else even is there that...ugh, I'm going in circles...
The Worm Holes#090.dst: ...구원자는 무슨... 더 잘해야 하는데, 달리 뭐가... 으, 같은 생각만 맴돌아...
The Worm Holes#090.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#092.src: ...I...I can't believe this. This is...does destiny just hate me? What have I done to deserve this?!
The Worm Holes#092.dst: ...나... 믿을 수가 없어. 이건... 운명이 날 미워하는 걸까? 내가 뭘 잘못했길래?!
The Worm Holes#092.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#093.src: The Mother Wyrm laid eggs... Eggs infested with parasites! Every single one is going to be born berserk!!
The Worm Holes#093.dst: 어미 웜이 알을 낳았어... 기생충에 감염된 알을! 하나하나가 전부 미쳐 날뛰는 채로 태어날 거야!!
The Worm Holes#093.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#094.src: You saw how strong the mother was...an infestation like this could cause the entire region of Gavel to collapse in a quake...
The Worm Holes#094.dst: 어미가 얼마나 강했는지 봤잖아... 이렇게 감염이 퍼지면 Gavel 지역 전체가 지진으로 무너질지도 몰라...
The Worm Holes#094.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#095.src: They...they need to be stopped, but...I can't do it. I c-can't kill... I'm sorry, I just can't!
The Worm Holes#095.dst: 저것들... 막아야 하는데... 난 못 해. 난 주, 죽일 수 없어... 미안, 도저히 못 하겠어!
The Worm Holes#095.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#096.src: Bring a group... Even Whelps can be a terror if they're enraged. Just...p-please, take care of this quickly.
The Worm Holes#096.dst: 사람들을 데려와... 새끼라도 분노하면 무시무시할 수 있어. 그러니... 제, 제발 빨리 처리해 줘.
The Worm Holes#096.speaker: Lari

The Worm Holes#097.src: You deserve the best... But that's more than I can give...so here. Take these. I'll move along.
The Worm Holes#097.dst: 넌 최고의 보상을 받을 자격이 있지만... 내가 줄 수 있는 건 이게 다야... 자, 이거 받아. 난 이만 갈게.
The Worm Holes#097.speaker: Lari

Through the Pipes#001.src: You're a lifesaver, {u}. I cannot thank you enough!

Through the Pipes#002.src: WAIT! MY ART BAG IS MISSING! Did I accidentally drop it somewhere?
Through the Pipes#002.dst: 잠깐! 내 미술 가방이 없어! 어디 떨어뜨렸나?

Through the Pipes#003.src: Do you want us to sink?!

similar.text: So you want us to sneak in?

Through the Pipes#004.src: What's your name... {u}? Great, I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#004.dst: 이름이... {u}라고? 좋아, 나도 그 멍청이를 계속 찾아보지. 행운을 비네!

Through the Pipes#006.src: Maybe it's best to continue forward...

Through the Pipes#008.src: You hear someone in the distance.

Through the Pipes#009.src: I'm so glad you found it! I don't know what I would do if I lost Soosu's gift and my bag!
Through the Pipes#009.dst: 찾아 줘서 정말 다행이에요! Soosu에게 줄 선물이랑 가방을 잃어버렸으면 어쩔 뻔했는지!

Through the Pipes#010.src: You are? Excellent! Let's see what you've created.

Through the Pipes#012.src: Are you sure you want to leave the dock?

Through the Pipes#015.src: You pull the hook off of the grapple. It might be useful later.
Through the Pipes#015.dst: 갈고리에서 고리를 떼어 냈다. 나중에 쓸모가 있을지도 모른다.

Through the Pipes#017.src: You must be on your raft to use this.
Through the Pipes#017.dst: 뗏목 위에 있어야 사용할 수 있다.

Through the Pipes#018.src: Find a way to open that gate. I don't want to be on this raft for any longer!
Through the Pipes#018.dst: 저 수문을 열 방법을 찾아요. 이 뗏목에 더는 있고 싶지 않아요!

Through the Pipes#020.src: Huh, this isn't- really what I expected.
Through the Pipes#020.dst: 어, 이건- 생각했던 거랑 좀 다르네요.

Through the Pipes#021.src: Are you sure you want to reset your raft?

Through the Pipes#022.src: Maybe there's something you could build to get across...
Through the Pipes#022.dst: 건너갈 수 있게 뭔가 만들 수 있을지도...

Through the Pipes#023.src: That looks like enough leaf litter. You should return to the generator to fuel it now.
Through the Pipes#023.dst: 낙엽은 이만하면 충분해 보인다. 이제 발전기로 돌아가 연료를 넣자.

Through the Pipes#025.src: Especially considering how rarely Soosu shows up in public, this festival might be my only opportunity this year...
Through the Pipes#025.dst: Soosu가 사람들 앞에 나서는 일이 워낙 드무니, 이번 축제가 올해 유일한 기회일지도 몰라요...

Through the Pipes#026.src: You should let Fichu know you're done.

Through the Pipes#027.src: The board crumbles under your step. Maybe there's another way to the other side.
Through the Pipes#027.dst: 발밑의 판자가 부서진다. 건너편으로 가는 다른 길이 있을지도 모른다.

Through the Pipes#028.src: Talk with the citizen in despair at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Through the Pipes#029.src: H-Hey, you! Have you seen a raccoon anywhere?
Through the Pipes#029.dst: 저, 저기요! 혹시 어디서 너구리 못 봤어요?
Through the Pipes#029.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#030.src: I spent all my free time making a gift for Soosu, and that devil snatched it from me! It would be a shame if I never got the chance to give it to her...
Through the Pipes#030.dst: 여가 시간을 다 들여 Soosu에게 줄 선물을 만들었는데, 그 악마 같은 녀석이 낚아채 갔어요! 선물을 못 주게 되면 너무 아쉬울 거예요...
Through the Pipes#030.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#031.src: This might be a big ask, but- do you think you could help me?
Through the Pipes#031.dst: 무리한 부탁일지도 모르지만- 도와줄 수 있어요?
Through the Pipes#031.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#032.src: Y-You will? I knew there was still some good left in this world!
Through the Pipes#032.dst: 도, 도와준다고요? 세상에 아직 좋은 사람이 있을 줄 알았어요!
Through the Pipes#032.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#033.src: Right! Last time I saw that raccoon, it was running into an alleyway south of the town center. It can't have gone too far!
Through the Pipes#033.dst: 좋아요! 마지막으로 봤을 때 그 너구리는 마을 중심 남쪽 골목으로 달려갔어요. 멀리 가진 못했을 거예요!
Through the Pipes#033.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#034.src: I will resume searching for that fool as well. Best of luck to you!
Through the Pipes#034.dst: 나도 그 녀석을 계속 찾아볼게요. 행운을 빌어요!
Through the Pipes#034.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#035.src: ...I get it. If you change your mind, come and talk with me again.
Through the Pipes#035.dst: ...알겠어요. 마음이 바뀌면 다시 말 걸어 줘요.
Through the Pipes#035.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#036.src: Yes! A raccoon! You've seen them before- surely? They're rampant around here!
Through the Pipes#036.dst: 네! 너구리요! 본 적 있죠- 당연히? 이 근처에 널렸는데!
Through the Pipes#036.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#038.src: You know, those furry gray creatures with the weird striped tails?
Through the Pipes#038.dst: 그 왜, 이상한 줄무늬 꼬리가 달린 털북숭이 회색 동물 있잖아요?
Through the Pipes#038.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#039.src: ...I hope you know what a raccoon is.
Through the Pipes#039.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#041.src: Oh- you're back! Are you able to help me now?
Through the Pipes#041.dst: 아- 돌아왔네요! 이제 도와줄 수 있어요?
Through the Pipes#041.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#043.src: I really think it would be better if we split up to search, don't you agree?
Through the Pipes#043.dst: 흩어져서 찾는 게 훨씬 나을 것 같은데, 그렇지 않아요?
Through the Pipes#043.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#044.src: If you forgot, you should try searching south of the town center. But you do you, I suppose...
Through the Pipes#044.dst: 잊어버렸으면 마을 중심 남쪽을 찾아봐요. 뭐, 알아서 하겠지만요...
Through the Pipes#044.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#047.src: Enter the drainage hole at to continue the search.

Through the Pipes#048.src: Dive deeper into the sewer network.

Through the Pipes#050.src: Find a way to get across the flooded section of the sewer.
Through the Pipes#050.dst: 하수도의 물에 잠긴 구역을 건널 방법을 찾으세요.

Through the Pipes#051.src: Huh, is there someone down there?

Through the Pipes#053.src: Continue chasing the raccoon through the sewers.

Through the Pipes#054.src: You aren't getting away from me now!

Through the Pipes#055.src: Encounter a familiar face in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#056.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#060.src: {u}! You're here! I was wondering where you went!
Through the Pipes#060.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#061.src: I've been chasing that raccoon the whole time! What in the world have you been up to?
Through the Pipes#061.dst: 난 계속 그 너구리를 쫓고 있었어요! 대체 뭘 하고 있었던 거예요?
Through the Pipes#061.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#062.src: Whatever. I'm struggling to keep up the chase at this rate. But fortunately, I have just the thing that'll help you!
Through the Pipes#062.dst: 됐어요. 이 속도로는 따라가기 벅차요. 그래도 다행히 도움이 될 만한 물건이 있어요!
Through the Pipes#062.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#064.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#064.dst: 망가졌어! 이래서야 그 도둑을 어떻게 따라잡아요?
Through the Pipes#064.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#065.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#065.dst: ...다 헛수고인가 봐요. 고쳐 보고 싶으면 해 봐도 되지만, 그럴 가치는 없어요.
Through the Pipes#065.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#066.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#066.dst: 난 저쪽으로 가서 그 골칫덩이를 잡을 수 있나 볼게요. 당신은 반대쪽으로 가요. 곧 다시 만나요.
Through the Pipes#066.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#067.src: Encounter the stranger in the sewers.

Through the Pipes#068.src: Ah ha! I've got you now, thief!

Through the Pipes#073.src: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Through the Pipes#073.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#074.src: Ah, exploring the sewers? That's fun! I've basically been to every corner of {p}'s sewers.
Through the Pipes#074.dst: 아, 하수도 탐험이요? 재밌죠! 난 {p} 하수도는 구석구석 거의 다 가 봤어요.
Through the Pipes#074.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#075.src: Say, is there any chance you stumbled upon that raccoon earlier? That pest snatched something of value from me!
Through the Pipes#075.dst: 그런데 혹시 아까 너구리 못 봤어요? 그 골칫덩이가 내 소중한 물건을 채 갔거든요!
Through the Pipes#075.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#076.src: I was making a gift for Sovereign Soosu, but then that fiend just ran off with it! Horrible, isn't it?
