Through the Pipes#076.dst: Soosu 군주님께 드릴 선물을 만들고 있었는데, 그 악당이 들고 튀었어요! 끔찍하죠?
Through the Pipes#076.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#077.src: Especially with how soon the festival is... I wouldn't want to miss my only opportunity this year!
Through the Pipes#077.dst: 특히 축제가 코앞인데... 올해 유일한 기회를 놓치고 싶지 않아요!
Through the Pipes#077.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#078.src: I could really use your help, and hey I have just the tool you'll want for exploring the sewers!
Through the Pipes#078.dst: 도움이 정말 필요해요. 그리고 마침 하수도 탐험에 딱 필요한 도구가 있어요!
Through the Pipes#078.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#080.src: It's broken! How will I ever catch up with that crook at this rate?
Through the Pipes#080.dst: 망가졌어! 이래서야 그 도둑을 어떻게 따라잡아요?
Through the Pipes#080.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#081.src: ...Maybe this is all a lost cause. You can try fixing it, I guess, but it's not worth it.
Through the Pipes#081.dst: ...다 헛수고인가 봐요. 고쳐 보고 싶으면 해 봐도 되지만, 그럴 가치는 없어요.
Through the Pipes#081.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#082.src: I'm going that direction to see if I can catch that pest. What's your name... {u}? You go the other way, we'll meet again soon.
Through the Pipes#082.dst: 난 저쪽으로 가서 그 골칫덩이를 잡을 수 있나 볼게요. 이름이... {u}? 당신은 반대쪽으로 가요. 곧 다시 만나요.
Through the Pipes#082.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#083.src: Find a safe way past the flooded rail tunnels.
Through the Pipes#083.dst: 물에 잠긴 철도 터널을 안전하게 지나갈 방법을 찾으세요.

Through the Pipes#084.src: Whew! I didn't mean to let go-
Through the Pipes#084.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#086.src: Perfect, I know where we are, and there isn't much further that foolish raccoon can run. We could corner it!
Through the Pipes#086.dst: 좋아요, 여기가 어딘지 알아요. 멍청한 너구리가 더 도망칠 데도 별로 없어요. 몰아넣을 수 있겠어요!
Through the Pipes#086.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#087.src: Now, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#087.dst: 문제는 다음 구역을 어떻게 지나갈지 전혀 모르겠다는 거예요. 기억하기론 물에 푹 잠겨 있어요.
Through the Pipes#087.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#088.src: {u}! OH NO! I didn't mean to drop that on you
Through the Pipes#088.dst: {u}! 이런! 그걸 당신 위로 떨어뜨리려던 건 아니었어요
Through the Pipes#088.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#089.src: W-why were you standing there? Out of all places?
Through the Pipes#089.dst: 왜, 왜 거기 서 있었어요? 하필 거기에?
Through the Pipes#089.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#090.src: ...Okay. You seem to be alright. Sorry, I didn't realize you were standing right there!
Through the Pipes#090.dst: ...좋아요. 괜찮아 보이네요. 미안해요, 거기 서 있는 줄 몰랐어요!
Through the Pipes#090.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#091.src: Alright, at least we're regrouped now. Try not to stand under any more heavy objects, alright?
Through the Pipes#091.dst: 자, 적어도 다시 모였네요. 앞으로 무거운 물건 밑엔 서 있지 마요, 알았죠?
Through the Pipes#091.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#092.src: Moving forward, the problem is, I have no idea how to traverse this next area. It's heavily flooded if I can recall.
Through the Pipes#092.dst: 앞으로 가는 게 문제인데, 다음 구역을 어떻게 지나갈지 전혀 모르겠어요. 기억하기론 물에 푹 잠겨 있어요.
Through the Pipes#092.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#093.src: You'll need to find some way for us to cross. Too many people have gotten the worst of diseases by wading through that water- eugh.
Through the Pipes#093.dst: 건너갈 방법을 찾아야 해요. 저 물을 헤치고 가다가 몹쓸 병에 걸린 사람이 너무 많거든요- 으.
Through the Pipes#093.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#094.src: Right! Let me know when you figure something out. I'll scout around, never had an excuse to explore this area before!
Through the Pipes#094.dst: 좋아요! 방법을 찾으면 알려 줘요. 난 주변을 살펴볼게요. 이 구역은 탐험할 핑계가 없었거든요!
Through the Pipes#094.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#095.src: Huh? What's all this stuff? Did someone forget their construction equipment?
Through the Pipes#095.dst: 응? 이게 다 뭐죠? 누가 공사 장비를 두고 갔나?
Through the Pipes#095.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#096.src: I guess the maintenance crews never bother to pack up their equipment. Maybe you can use this stuff for something.
Through the Pipes#096.dst: 보수반이 장비를 치우는 법이 없나 봐요. 이걸로 뭔가 할 수 있을지도 몰라요.
Through the Pipes#096.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#097.src: Check back in with me when you're done!
Through the Pipes#097.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#098.src: Navigate through the end of the sewer network with Fichu.

Through the Pipes#101.src: I'd appreciate it if you added a seat for me.
Through the Pipes#101.dst: 내 자리도 하나 만들어 주면 고맙겠어요.
Through the Pipes#101.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#105.src: Bet no one's been here for a while.
Through the Pipes#105.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#106.src: Wonder where that raccoon is now...
Through the Pipes#106.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#107.src: Soosu needs to see that state of this place...
Through the Pipes#107.dst: Soosu가 이곳 상태를 좀 봐야 하는데...
Through the Pipes#107.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#109.src: What else do you think we'll find?
Through the Pipes#109.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#110.src: I've heard a few stories about this place. Mostly bad ones...
Through the Pipes#110.dst: 이곳에 관한 이야기를 몇 개 들었어요. 대부분 안 좋은 얘기...
Through the Pipes#110.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#111.src: I hope that raccoon hasn't gone too far...
Through the Pipes#111.dst: 그 너구리가 너무 멀리 가지 않았으면...
Through the Pipes#111.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#114.src: This raft looks fragile, be careful!
Through the Pipes#114.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#119.src: You know what you're doing, right?
Through the Pipes#119.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#121.src: Ah! I almost fell out of my seat.
Through the Pipes#121.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#123.src: Are you even capable of not hitting something?
Through the Pipes#123.dst: 뭐에 안 부딪히고 갈 수는 있는 거예요?
Through the Pipes#123.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#124.src: One more hit and I'm taking over!
Through the Pipes#124.dst: 한 번만 더 부딪히면 내가 몰 거예요!
Through the Pipes#124.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#125.src: I don't trust you sailing this thing!
Through the Pipes#125.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#127.src: It can't possibly be that hard!
Through the Pipes#127.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#128.src: Make sure to be careful, okay?
Through the Pipes#128.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#129.src: No wonder everyone avoids this place...
Through the Pipes#129.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#131.src: You know where you're going, right?
Through the Pipes#131.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#132.src: When I get that raccoon, oh man...
Through the Pipes#132.dst: 그 너구리 잡기만 해 봐, 진짜...
Through the Pipes#132.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#133.src: How long have I even spent chasing that fool...
Through the Pipes#133.dst: 그 녀석 쫓느라 대체 얼마나 시간을 쓴 거지...
Through the Pipes#133.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#135.src: Keep an eye out for dangers!
Through the Pipes#135.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#136.src: Make sure we're staying on track.
Through the Pipes#136.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#137.src: Maybe rats are better than raccoons after all.
Through the Pipes#137.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#138.src: I regret getting on this raft.
Through the Pipes#138.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#142.src: I cannot wait to get off...
Through the Pipes#142.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#144.src: I really don't want to insult you, but-
Through the Pipes#144.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#150.src: Ah! What will we do now?!
Through the Pipes#150.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#152.src: Hmm, is the raft broken? We haven't moved for a while.
Through the Pipes#152.dst: 음, 뗏목이 고장 났나? 한참 동안 안 움직였어요.
Through the Pipes#152.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#153.src: Are you... going to have us move?
Through the Pipes#153.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#156.src: I'm not sure why you think this place is interesting enough to stop at.
Through the Pipes#156.dst: 여기가 멈출 만큼 흥미로운 곳인지 모르겠네요.
Through the Pipes#156.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#160.src: The raccoon is probably long gone at this point, thanks to your delay.
Through the Pipes#160.dst: 당신이 꾸물대서 너구리는 이미 멀리 갔을 거예요.
Through the Pipes#160.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#163.src: How long were we waiting for?
Through the Pipes#163.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#164.src: Huh? What are you doing with that?!
Through the Pipes#164.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#165.src: You're going to sink us with that!
Through the Pipes#165.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#167.src: IS THAT AN EXPLOSIVE?! ARE YOU MAD!
Through the Pipes#167.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#168.src: HELP US! WE'RE GOING TO DROWN!
Through the Pipes#168.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#169.src: OH NO! GET ME OFF OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#169.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#172.src: Why did you think this was a good idea?!
Through the Pipes#172.dst: 대체 왜 이게 좋은 생각이라고 생각했어요?!
Through the Pipes#172.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#173.src: I gotta get off of this thing!
Through the Pipes#173.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#174.src: That's the exit! Go past this gate, then I never want to board anything sailed by you again!
Through the Pipes#174.dst: 저기가 출구야! 이 문만 지나가면, 두 번 다시 네가 모는 건 아무것도 안 탈 거야!

Through the Pipes#175.src: I gotta get off this thing!
Through the Pipes#175.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#176.src: Hey- maybe we should've been a bit further away from that train?
Through the Pipes#176.dst: 저기- 그 열차에서 좀 더 떨어져 있어야 하지 않았을까요?
Through the Pipes#176.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#179.src: Agh! Sorry, just got scared by that.
Through the Pipes#179.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#180.src: AHHHHH! THIS WAS A HORRIBLE IDEA!
Through the Pipes#180.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#181.src: OUT OF ALL ROUTES YOU TOOK, ONE OF THEM INCLUDED A TRAIN!
Through the Pipes#181.dst: 그 많은 길 중에 하필 열차 다니는 길로 오다니!
Through the Pipes#181.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#183.src: Huh? AH! THERE'S A TRAIN! GET OUT OF HERE!
Through the Pipes#183.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#186.src: YOU REALLY THINK THIS FLIMSY RAFT IS GOING TO SURVIVE A TRAIN?!
Through the Pipes#186.dst: 이 허술한 뗏목이 열차를 버틸 거라고 생각해요?!
Through the Pipes#186.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#187.src: YOU FOOL! We barely missed being hit!
Through the Pipes#187.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#188.src: Oh my- we survived! YOU ARE AN IDIOT! DON'T DO THAT AGAIN!
Through the Pipes#188.dst: 세상에- 살았다! 당신 바보예요! 다신 그러지 마요!
Through the Pipes#188.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#189.src: This looks like the halfway point!
Through the Pipes#189.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#190.src: You'll need to find a way to open that gate, since I don't see any other way past.
Through the Pipes#190.dst: 저 수문을 열 방법을 찾아야 해요. 다른 길은 안 보이거든요.
Through the Pipes#190.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#191.src: If I'm remembering correctly, just past this gate should be our destination!
Through the Pipes#191.dst: 제 기억이 맞다면, 이 수문만 지나면 목적지예요!
Through the Pipes#191.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#192.src: Phew, we survived. That was a bit rough, but at least we made it.
Through the Pipes#192.dst: 휴, 살았다. 좀 험했지만 적어도 도착했네요.
Through the Pipes#192.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#193.src: However, I think I'll definitely be avoiding boats for now...
Through the Pipes#193.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#194.src: We made it! You did a pretty good job navigating, I knew I could trust you!
Through the Pipes#194.dst: 도착했어요! 조종 꽤 잘했어요, 믿을 수 있을 줄 알았어요!
Through the Pipes#194.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#195.src: Alright, let's chase down that raccoon once and for all!
Through the Pipes#195.dst: 좋아요, 이번엔 그 너구리를 끝까지 쫓아가요!
Through the Pipes#195.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#196.src: I hope my prediction is right, and there really is no further it can run from here.
Through the Pipes#196.dst: 제 예상이 맞아서, 여기서 더는 도망칠 데가 없으면 좋겠네요.
Through the Pipes#196.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#198.src: Huh?! LOOK! It's the raccoon, that's it!
Through the Pipes#198.dst: 응?! 봐요! 그 너구리예요, 저 녀석!
Through the Pipes#198.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#201.src: Ah ha! Now you're cornered, you little imp!
Through the Pipes#201.dst: 아하! 이제 독 안에 든 쥐다, 이 꼬마 악당아!
Through the Pipes#201.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#202.src: Before you do anything, we need a way to take the gift back!
Through the Pipes#202.dst: 뭘 하기 전에, 선물을 되찾을 방법부터 생각해야 해요!
Through the Pipes#202.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#204.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#204.dst: 그리고 봐요! 드디어 선물을 되찾았어요! 우리라면 할 수 있을 줄 알았어요.
Through the Pipes#204.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#205.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#205.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#206.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#206.dst: 멀쩡해요! 여왕님 감사합니다! 안 그랬으면 어쩔 뻔했는지...
Through the Pipes#206.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#207.src: {u}, from the very start, you have been a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#207.dst: {u}, 처음부터 당신은 정말 큰 도움이 됐어요. 그 노고에 뭐라 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요!
Through the Pipes#207.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#208.src: ...You don't think that was a little too brutal, do you?

Through the Pipes#209.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#209.dst: {u}, 처음부터 당신은 정말 큰 도움이 됐어요. 그 노고에 뭐라 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요!
Through the Pipes#209.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#210.src: Without your help, I don't even know if I could have caught that raccoon on my own!
Through the Pipes#210.dst: 당신이 없었으면 혼자서 그 너구리를 잡을 수 있었을지도 모르겠어요!
Through the Pipes#210.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#211.src: As a reward, I have an extra gift just for you! Thank you again for your incredible help!
Through the Pipes#211.dst: 보답으로 당신만을 위한 선물을 하나 더 준비했어요! 엄청난 도움, 다시 한번 고마워요!
Through the Pipes#211.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#212.src: And look! We finally got the gift back! I knew we could do it.
Through the Pipes#212.dst: 그리고 봐요! 드디어 선물을 되찾았어요! 우리라면 할 수 있을 줄 알았어요.
Through the Pipes#212.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#213.src: Hopefully this is still intact after all of that...
Through the Pipes#213.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#214.src: It survived! Thank the queen! I don't know what I would do otherwise...
Through the Pipes#214.dst: 멀쩡해요! 여왕님 감사합니다! 안 그랬으면 어쩔 뻔했는지...
Through the Pipes#214.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#215.src: {u}, from the very start, you were a massive help. I cannot thank you enough for your efforts!
Through the Pipes#215.dst: {u}, 처음부터 당신은 정말 큰 도움이 됐어요. 그 노고에 뭐라 감사해야 할지 모르겠어요!
Through the Pipes#215.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#216.src: Not only did you safely get us through a flooded tunnel with that creation of yours, but you came more prepared than I could have expected!
Through the Pipes#216.dst: 당신이 만든 걸로 물에 잠긴 터널을 무사히 지나게 해 줬을 뿐 아니라, 생각보다 훨씬 준비를 잘해 왔더라고요!
Through the Pipes#216.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#217.src: A cage... a ring to use as a distraction... and even a firecracker. Where did you even find all this stuff?
Through the Pipes#217.dst: 새장... 주의를 끌 반지... 게다가 폭죽까지. 대체 이런 걸 다 어디서 찾았어요?
Through the Pipes#217.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#218.src: And on top of all of that, you found my art supplies bag! That bag itself is more important to me than the gift we were chasing after!
Through the Pipes#218.dst: 게다가 내 미술 도구 가방까지 찾아 줬잖아요! 그 가방은 우리가 쫓던 선물보다 나한테 더 소중해요!
Through the Pipes#218.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#219.src: Speaking of that, I would like to give you Soosu's gift as a token of appreciation. I believe you're more deserving of it.
Through the Pipes#219.dst: 그러니까 감사의 표시로 Soosu에게 줄 선물을 당신에게 주고 싶어요. 당신이 더 받을 자격이 있는 것 같아요.
Through the Pipes#219.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#220.src: Don't worry, I've already brainstormed a better design. I think Soosu will like this next one even more!
Through the Pipes#220.dst: 걱정 마요, 더 좋은 디자인을 이미 구상해 뒀어요. Soosu도 다음 걸 더 좋아할 거예요!
Through the Pipes#220.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#221.src: Don't go so close! You might scare it off again!
Through the Pipes#221.dst: 너무 가까이 가지 마요! 또 놀라서 도망칠지도 몰라요!
Through the Pipes#221.speaker: Fichu

Through the Pipes#222.src: Thank you again for the help! I couldn't have done it without you.
Through the Pipes#222.dst: 도와줘서 다시 한번 고마워요! 당신 없이는 못 했을 거예요.
Through the Pipes#222.speaker: Fichu

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.src: I challenge you to reach the final floor!
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#002.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.src: Have you got what it takes to conquer it?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#003.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.src: Perhaps you would like to know the layout of the tower first? Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.dst: 먼저 탑의 구조를 알고 싶으냐? 흐흐흐흐...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#004.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.src: There are {~} floors in this tower, each with ten levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.dst: 이 탑에는 {~}개 층이 있고, 층마다 열 단계가 있다.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#005.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.src: Each floor has nine regular levels and one boss level.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.dst: 각 층은 일반 단계 아홉 개와 보스 단계 하나로 되어 있지.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#006.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.src: To pass a regular level, you must collect five tokens from the challenge on that level, and one token from boss levels.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.dst: 일반 단계를 통과하려면 그 단계의 도전에서 증표 다섯 개를, 보스 단계에서는 증표 하나를 모아야 한다.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#007.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.src: After you beat a whole floor, you will return here and you can begin the next one...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.dst: 한 층을 모두 깨면 이곳으로 돌아와 다음 층을 시작할 수 있다...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#008.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.src: So, what do you say? Hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#009.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.src: Turn left and head to the first floor...if you dare...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.dst: 왼쪽으로 돌아 첫 번째 층으로 가거라... 감히 그럴 용기가 있다면...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#010.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.src: Well done, adventurer, you have successfully completed this floor! You may proceed.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.dst: 잘했다, 모험가여. 이 층을 무사히 완료했다! 계속 나아가도 좋다.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#011.speaker: Floormaster

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.src: You have completed my tower, I see...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#012.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.src: Did you enjoy Death? Many challengers certainly did. Her power is... unmatched, hehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.dst: Death는 즐거웠느냐? 많은 도전자가 즐겼지. 그녀의 힘은... 비할 데가 없다, 흐흐흐...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#013.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.src: And you... You are unlike all of them, yes? Few have managed to ascend these floors.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.dst: 그리고 너는... 그들과는 다르구나, 그렇지? 이 층들을 오른 자는 드물다.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#014.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.src: A tower of madness, fueled by Death herself... Quite a challenge, yes?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.dst: Death가 직접 불어넣은 광기의 탑... 꽤 대단한 도전이지, 그렇지?
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#015.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.src: You have joined us now, champion... Few can claim this victory as their own. Fewer still have held their mind.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.dst: 이제 너도 우리와 함께다, 챔피언... 이 승리를 차지한 자는 드물고, 정신을 지킨 자는 더 드물다.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#016.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.src: For this honor... A reward, for you. You have truly earned it... Hehehehe...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.dst: 이 영광을 기념하여... 너에게 보상을 주마. 정말로 그럴 자격이 있다... 흐흐흐흐...
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#017.speaker: Ankou

Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.src: I need five tokens from the enemies in this room as evidence that you are strong enough to ascend.
Tower of Ascension (Quest)#019.dst: 이 방의 적들에게서 증표 다섯 개를 가져와라. 네가 오를 만큼 강하다는 증거로.

Tribal Aggression#000.src: My tribe worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#000.dst: 우리 부족 일은 우리가 알아서 하오, 이방인.

Tribal Aggression#001.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find it, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#001.dst: 분명 토템을 숨겼겠지만, 찾아낼 수 있다면 돌아오길 기다리겠소!

Tribal Aggression#002.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt to steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#002.dst: 바라건대 우리 두 야영지가 다시는 토템을 훔치려 서로의 땅을 밟지 않고 평화롭게 살았으면 하오.

Tribal Aggression#003.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#003.dst: 그, 그것이 토템이오? 이런, 올빼미가 내 곁을 떠난 지 참 오래되었소. 그런데 독수리 토템과 올빼미 토템이 같은 신비한 힘을 지녔는지 궁금하구려.

Tribal Aggression#004.src: Have you gotten our totem back yet? The Eagle camp is across the river, on the other side of the canyon.
Tribal Aggression#004.dst: 우리 토템은 되찾아 왔나? 독수리 부족 야영지는 강 건너, 협곡 반대편에 있다.

Tribal Aggression#006.src: My tribes worries our own business, stranger.
Tribal Aggression#006.dst: 우리 부족 일은 우리가 알아서 하오, 이방인.
Tribal Aggression#006.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#007.src: Oh, my apologies, I did not realize you are a warrior of the province! We would be grateful of your help.
Tribal Aggression#007.dst: 오, 실례했소. 이 지방의 전사인 줄 몰랐구려! 도와준다면 감사하겠소.
Tribal Aggression#007.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#008.src: Our sacred owl totem that we worship was stolen by the cunning Eagle Tribe many years ago. Its magical properties used to bring prosperity to our camp.
Tribal Aggression#008.dst: 우리가 섬기는 신성한 올빼미 토템을 오래전 교활한 독수리 부족이 훔쳐 갔소. 그 마력이 우리 야영지에 번영을 가져다주었는데.
Tribal Aggression#008.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#009.src: However, the Eagle tribe are not victorious, we possess their mystic eagle totem, but alas, I do not know who was the original thief.
Tribal Aggression#009.dst: 하지만 독수리 부족도 이긴 게 아니오. 그들의 신비한 독수리 토템이 우리에게 있으니. 다만 누가 먼저 훔쳤는지는 모르겠소.
Tribal Aggression#009.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#010.src: We have been at war for years now, despite being neighbors. Without our totem, our rivalry will continue for ages and peace will never again be felt in our hearts.
Tribal Aggression#010.dst: 이웃이면서도 수년째 전쟁 중이오. 토템이 없으면 이 반목은 영원히 이어질 것이고, 우리 마음에 평화가 다시 찾아오지 않을 것이오.
Tribal Aggression#010.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#011.src: Retrieve our totem, and the blessing of the Owl spirit will be with you.
Tribal Aggression#011.dst: 우리 토템을 되찾아 주면 올빼미 영혼의 축복이 그대와 함께할 것이오.
Tribal Aggression#011.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#012.src: Now, enter the Eagle Camp across the river, you may have to search the camp, I'm sure they have hidden our totem!
Tribal Aggression#012.dst: 자, 강 건너 독수리 부족 야영지로 들어가시오. 야영지를 뒤져야 할지도 모르오. 분명 토템을 숨겨 두었을 테니!
Tribal Aggression#012.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#013.src: Enter the Eagle Camp and talk to Favian
Tribal Aggression#013.dst: 독수리 부족 야영지에 들어가 Favian에게 말을 거세요

Tribal Aggression#014.src: Greetings, what brings you to the noble Eagle tribe?
Tribal Aggression#014.dst: 반갑소. 고귀한 독수리 부족에겐 무슨 일로 왔소?
Tribal Aggression#014.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#015.src: You seek the Owl totem? The cursed Owl tribe trying to retain their lost dignity again.
Tribal Aggression#015.dst: 올빼미 토템을 찾는다고? 저주받은 올빼미 부족이 또 잃어버린 체면을 되찾으려 하는군.
Tribal Aggression#015.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#016.src: Why should we give you their totem back? They stole our source of enlightenment all those years ago.
Tribal Aggression#016.dst: 왜 우리가 그들의 토템을 돌려줘야 하오? 그 옛날 우리의 깨달음의 원천을 훔쳐 간 건 그들이오.
Tribal Aggression#016.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#017.src: Tell you what, if you can retrieve our Eagle Totem, I will allow you to go return the Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#017.dst: 이렇게 하지. 우리 독수리 토템을 되찾아 오면, 올빼미 토템을 돌려주러 가게 해 주겠소.
Tribal Aggression#017.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#018.src: I'm sure they hid the totem, but if you are able to find, I await your return!
Tribal Aggression#018.dst: 분명 토템을 숨겼겠지만, 찾아낼 수 있다면 돌아오길 기다리겠소!
Tribal Aggression#018.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#019.src: Bring back the Eagle Totem from the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#019.dst: 올빼미 부족 야영지에서 독수리 토템을 되찾아 오세요

Tribal Aggression#020.src: Wonderful! You may now enter the cave to retrieve the blasted Owl totem.
Tribal Aggression#020.dst: 훌륭하오! 이제 동굴에 들어가 그 빌어먹을 올빼미 토템을 가져가도 좋소.
Tribal Aggression#020.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#021.src: Be careful, there are Eagle guardians in the cave, be prepared traveller.
Tribal Aggression#021.dst: 조심하시오. 동굴엔 독수리 수호자들이 있으니 대비하시오, 여행자여.
Tribal Aggression#021.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#022.src: Once you get the totem, you may return it to its original tribe.
Tribal Aggression#022.dst: 토템을 손에 넣으면 원래 부족에게 돌려줘도 좋소.
Tribal Aggression#022.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#023.src: Hopefully, we two camps will never set foot on another's land in an attempt steal back the totems, and live in peace.
Tribal Aggression#023.dst: 바라건대 우리 두 야영지가 다시는 토템을 훔치려 서로의 땅을 밟지 않고 평화롭게 살았으면 하오.
Tribal Aggression#023.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#024.src: Anyways, hurry up, even the thought of the two totems sharing the same space makes me sick.
Tribal Aggression#024.dst: 아무튼 서두르시오. 두 토템이 한 곳에 있다는 생각만 해도 속이 뒤집히니.
Tribal Aggression#024.speaker: Favian

Tribal Aggression#025.src: Retrieve the Owl Totem and return it to the Owl Camp
Tribal Aggression#025.dst: 올빼미 토템을 되찾아 올빼미 부족 야영지에 돌려주세요

Tribal Aggression#026.src: I-Is that, the totem? My, it has been a long time since the owl has been with me. Though I wonder if the Eagle and the Owl totem possess the same mystic powers.
Tribal Aggression#026.dst: 그, 그것이 토템이오? 이런, 올빼미가 내 곁을 떠난 지 참 오래되었소. 그런데 독수리 토템과 올빼미 토템이 같은 신비한 힘을 지녔는지 궁금하구려.
Tribal Aggression#026.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#027.src: To think, such a long war could end so quickly and by the help of a single person.
Tribal Aggression#027.dst: 이토록 긴 전쟁이 한 사람의 도움으로 이렇게 빨리 끝날 줄이야.
Tribal Aggression#027.speaker: Caras

Tribal Aggression#028.src: Many thanks to you! I shall keep my promise, please accept this reward, and may the Owl be forever with you.
Tribal Aggression#028.dst: 정말 고맙소! 약속을 지키겠소. 이 보상을 받아 주시오. 올빼미가 영원히 그대와 함께하길.
Tribal Aggression#028.speaker: Caras

Troubled Tribesmen#002.src: Hey! Aren't these people fascinating? They sure smell bad, though! What? That Tribesman said my name?! Amazing! I've been trying to communicate with them for weeks.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.dst: 이봐요! 이 사람들 정말 흥미롭지 않아요? 냄새는 고약하지만요! 뭐라고요? 저 부족민이 내 이름을 불렀어요?! 굉장해! 몇 주째 소통하려고 애쓰는 중이거든요.
Troubled Tribesmen#002.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#003.src: He sure seems like a distressed little fellow. He keeps pointing to that huge tree right there. A {p} keeper once told me it's possible to speak with them.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.dst: 무척 괴로워하는 꼬마 같네요. 계속 저기 커다란 나무를 가리켜요. {p}의 관리인이 저들과 대화할 수 있다고 한 적이 있어요.
Troubled Tribesmen#003.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#004.src: He told me that within the woods there is a Shaman who will grant certain people permission to speak their language. I did some traveling through the jungle and actually found him!
Troubled Tribesmen#004.dst: 숲속에 특정한 사람에게 저들의 언어를 쓰게 해 주는 샤먼이 있다더군요. 정글을 좀 돌아다녔더니 진짜로 찾았어요!
Troubled Tribesmen#004.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#005.src: But despite my efforts, he just sat in silence with his eyes closed. He must of known I wasn't a threat because he was totally exposed. He had no interest in speaking with me, though.
Troubled Tribesmen#005.dst: 그런데 아무리 애써도 눈을 감은 채 말없이 앉아만 있었어요. 완전히 무방비였던 걸 보면 내가 위협이 아니란 걸 알았나 봐요. 나랑 얘기할 생각은 없었지만요.
Troubled Tribesmen#005.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#006.src: Say, who knows, maybe the Shaman will talk to you. It would greatly assist my research if you could help me talk to them. So why don't you give it a shot?
Troubled Tribesmen#006.dst: 그런데, 혹시 샤먼이 당신하고는 얘기할지도 몰라요. 저들과 대화하게 도와주면 연구에 큰 도움이 될 거예요. 한번 해 볼래요?
Troubled Tribesmen#006.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#007.src: Follow this path to the north. Keep going past the pond and the path will split to the West and to the East. Take the West path, and you will see the Shaman.
Troubled Tribesmen#007.dst: 이 길을 따라 북쪽으로 가요. 연못을 지나면 길이 서쪽과 동쪽으로 갈라져요. 서쪽 길로 가면 샤먼이 보일 거예요.
Troubled Tribesmen#007.speaker: Krattson

Troubled Tribesmen#009.src: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb bas.
Troubled Tribesmen#009.dst: Oui ryja y bufanvim vaam ypuid oui, cdnyhkan. So baubma yna eh tyhkan. Bmayca, dyga drec yht ramb bas.
Troubled Tribesmen#009.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#010.src: I have cast a spell on you. If you can understand me, you are pure of heart.
Troubled Tribesmen#010.dst: 그대에게 주문을 걸었소. 내 말을 알아듣는다면 그대는 마음이 순수한 자요.
Troubled Tribesmen#010.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#011.src: This spell will allow those of true spirit to speak and comprehend our language. I have entrusted you with this because of my connection with our sacred tree, who we call Entamis.
Troubled Tribesmen#011.dst: 이 주문은 참된 영혼을 지닌 자가 우리 말을 하고 이해하게 해 주오. 이를 그대에게 맡긴 건 우리가 Entamis라 부르는 신성한 나무와 내가 이어져 있기 때문이오.
Troubled Tribesmen#011.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#012.src: I am the shaman of my tribe. I sit here every day with my eyes closed and carefully monitor Entamis' wavelengths. She has not been responding to my calls as of late...
Troubled Tribesmen#012.dst: 나는 우리 부족의 샤먼이오. 매일 여기 눈을 감고 앉아 Entamis의 파동을 세심히 살피지. 그런데 요즘 그녀가 내 부름에 응답하지 않소...
Troubled Tribesmen#012.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#013.src: Dear human, your presence emits warmth and trust. Please go speak with my apprentice, Ka L'argwit. He is to take my place as shaman when I pass from this life.
Troubled Tribesmen#013.dst: 인간이여, 그대에게선 따스함과 믿음이 느껴지오. 내 제자 Ka L'argwit와 이야기해 주시오. 내가 이승을 떠나면 그가 샤먼 자리를 잇게 될 것이오.
Troubled Tribesmen#013.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#014.src: He would know if anything is causing our beautiful tree discomfort. The spell I have cast on you will allow you to speak with him.
Troubled Tribesmen#014.dst: 무엇이 우리의 아름다운 나무를 괴롭히는지 그라면 알 것이오. 내가 건 주문으로 그와 대화할 수 있을 것이오.
Troubled Tribesmen#014.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#015.src: Now, please go seek out Ka L'argwit.
Troubled Tribesmen#015.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#018.src: Thank you for coming. We haven't but moments. The monster's name is Aenara. He's a fiendish monster of corruption.
Troubled Tribesmen#018.dst: 와 주어 고맙습니다. 시간이 얼마 없어요. 괴물의 이름은 Aenara. 타락의 흉악한 괴물입니다.
Troubled Tribesmen#018.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#019.src: He unleashed egg pods that host a variety of magic draining insects. They are eating me alive and replacing my magic with evil magic. Soon I will die.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.dst: 놈이 마력을 빨아먹는 온갖 벌레가 든 알주머니를 퍼뜨렸어요. 벌레들이 날 산 채로 먹으며 내 마력을 사악한 마력으로 바꾸고 있어요. 곧 죽을 거예요.
Troubled Tribesmen#019.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#020.src: You mustn't let me be reborn a creature of evil...
Troubled Tribesmen#020.dst: 내가 사악한 존재로 다시 태어나게 두어선 안 됩니다...
Troubled Tribesmen#020.speaker: Entamis

Troubled Tribesmen#021.src: Kill Aenara and bring an Insect of Corruption to Shaman Inrekei.
Troubled Tribesmen#021.dst: Aenara를 처치하고 타락의 벌레를 샤먼 Inrekei에게 가져가세요.

Troubled Tribesmen#022.src: Hello again. I am grateful you returned. You don't need to say anything, though. I can no longer sense Entamis. I know she has died..
Troubled Tribesmen#022.dst: 다시 보는구려. 돌아와 줘서 고맙소. 하지만 아무 말 하지 않아도 되오. 더는 Entamis가 느껴지지 않소. 그녀가 죽었음을 아오..
Troubled Tribesmen#022.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#023.src: You still have managed to prevent her corrupted magic to spread any further. And for that, my people are forever in your debt.
Troubled Tribesmen#023.dst: 그래도 그대는 그녀의 타락한 마력이 더 퍼지는 걸 막아 주었소. 그 일로 우리 부족은 영원히 그대에게 빚을 졌소.
Troubled Tribesmen#023.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#024.src: This insect appears to be the queen. I'll need to perform a ritual to kill it permanently. But never mind that, I can do that in my own time.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.dst: 이 벌레가 여왕인 듯하오. 완전히 죽이려면 의식을 치러야 하오. 하지만 그건 신경 쓰지 마시오, 내가 틈날 때 하면 되니.
Troubled Tribesmen#024.speaker: Inrekei

Troubled Tribesmen#025.src: Please take this. It is but a small gift. Your currency means nothing to us. In times of peril, few step forward and risk their lives to save those they do not know.
Troubled Tribesmen#025.dst: 이걸 받아 주시오. 작은 선물일 뿐이오. 그대들의 화폐는 우리에게 아무 의미가 없소. 위기의 순간에 모르는 이를 위해 목숨을 거는 자는 드물다오.
Troubled Tribesmen#025.speaker: Inrekei

True Colours#001.src: - Subjects require sustenance based on the form they are currently using.
True Colours#001.dst: - 피험체는 현재 취한 형태에 따라 필요한 영양이 다르다.

True Colours#002.src: - Leave no gaps in the cell. Subjects may transform into small creatures in order to escape.
True Colours#002.dst: - 감방에 틈을 남기지 말 것. 피험체가 작은 생물로 변신해 탈출할 수 있다.

True Colours#005.src: The cabinet is locked. A label reads: Project Hallowground.
True Colours#005.dst: 보관함이 잠겨 있다. 라벨에 적힌 글: Hallowground 계획.

True Colours#009.src: Feel free to take the zipline up to the canopy.

True Colours#012.src: Alright, enough games. Now, dance for me! Hehehahehah!
True Colours#012.dst: 좋아, 장난은 이만. 이제 날 위해 춤춰라! 히히하히하!

True Colours#014.src: Changelings are a great asset to any army. They are proven excellent spies.
True Colours#014.dst: 변신자는 어느 군대에게나 큰 자산이다. 뛰어난 첩자임이 입증되었다.

True Colours#015.src: - Provide subjects with daily stimulus. Enquire with instructors on current curriculum.
True Colours#015.dst: - 피험체에게 매일 자극을 줄 것. 현재 교육 과정은 교관에게 문의할 것.

True Colours#017.src: - Yusanu. Wanted. Will be held until Sovereign Majin arrives.
True Colours#017.dst: - Yusanu. 수배자. Majin 군주가 도착할 때까지 구금.

True Colours#018.src: ...and she needed help. Needed someone powerful - someone from Fruma, but who had also seen... well, all of it. The world, and their impact on it.
True Colours#018.dst: ...그리고 그녀에겐 도움이 필요했다. 강한 누군가가 - Fruma 출신이면서도... 음, 그 모든 걸 본 사람이. 이 세계와, 그들이 세계에 끼친 영향을.

True Colours#020.src: Their biology makes them easily adaptable to any situation, they can easily become heat resistant or cold resistant.
True Colours#020.dst: 그들의 생체 구조는 어떤 상황에도 쉽게 적응하게 해 주어, 쉽게 열이나 추위에 강해질 수 있다.

True Colours#022.src: ...there has to be a key around here somewhere.

True Colours#023.src: Meet up with The Canopy at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#024.src: {u}! Did you hear? They- they finished, um, sorting through the reports!
True Colours#024.dst: {u}! 들었어? 그, 그 사람들이, 음, 보고서 정리를 끝냈대!
True Colours#024.speaker: Sui

True Colours#025.src: Azael says he has news about everyone from the Roughworks!
True Colours#025.dst: Azael이 Roughworks 사람들 전부에 대한 소식이 있대!
True Colours#025.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#026.src: Indeed... indeed. Ehm... where to begin...
True Colours#026.speaker: Azael

True Colours#027.src: Outsiders, I would... temper your expectations.
True Colours#027.dst: 외부인들, 너무... 기대하지 않는 게 좋아요.
True Colours#027.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#029.src: I am afraid we are sorely lacking in good news. The Owls have returned with reports of a rather sudden influx of prisoners taken to Deraj Prison following the festival.
True Colours#029.dst: 유감스럽게도 좋은 소식이 거의 없소. 올빼미들이 보고하길, 축제 이후 갑자기 많은 죄수가 Deraj 감옥으로 끌려갔다 하오.
True Colours#029.speaker: Azael

True Colours#031.src: No... no, no, it- it can't be, there- there has to be another explanation...
True Colours#031.dst: 아니... 아니, 아니야, 그, 그럴 리 없어, 부, 분명 다른 이유가 있을 거야...
True Colours#031.speaker: Sui

True Colours#032.src: Ah, Gravity's Monolith... it truly is a sight to behold, dark carved stone and burning crimson lights shining deep in the southern wastes...
True Colours#032.dst: 아, 중력의 모놀리스... 정말 볼만한 광경이죠. 남쪽 황무지 깊숙이 빛나는 검은 조각석과 타오르는 진홍빛 불빛...
True Colours#032.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#033.src: A shame it's inescapable, or I'd love to pay a visit. It's true, what they say- there is no escaping its pull once it gets a hold of you!
True Colours#033.dst: 빠져나올 수 없다는 게 아쉽네요, 아니면 꼭 가 보고 싶은데. 소문이 사실이에요- 한번 붙잡히면 그 끌어당기는 힘에서 못 벗어나요!
True Colours#033.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#034.src: I... I've, I've heard the rumors... are- are they really true?
True Colours#034.dst: 나... 나, 나도 소문은 들었어... 그, 그게 정말 사실이야?
True Colours#034.speaker: Sui

True Colours#035.src: As far as we can tell. We don't have a single record of a successful escape attempt. Supposedly, the Warden's blessing keeps the prisoners in line.
True Colours#035.dst: 우리가 아는 한은요. 탈옥에 성공한 기록이 단 하나도 없어요. 교도소장의 축복이 죄수들을 꼼짝 못 하게 한다더군요.
True Colours#035.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#037.src: Cileon, goodness! There's no need for the dramatics! What they mean to say, dear friends, is that none who enter are ever heard from again!
True Colours#037.dst: Cileon, 세상에! 그렇게 극적으로 말할 필요는 없잖아요! 친애하는 친구들, 들어간 사람한테서 다시는 소식이 없다는 뜻이에요!
True Colours#037.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#038.src: Gravity's Monolith, they call it... an inescapable pull, drawing you deeper and deeper into its clutches the more you try to break free!
True Colours#038.dst: 사람들은 중력의 모놀리스라 부르죠... 벗어나려 애쓸수록 점점 더 깊이 끌어당기는 피할 수 없는 힘!
True Colours#038.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#039.src: Oh, you're one to talk about dramatics. But he's right. I wouldn't get your hopes up.
True Colours#039.dst: 어머, 극적인 걸로 따지면 당신이 할 말은 아니죠. 그래도 그 말이 맞아요. 기대는 안 하는 게 좋아요.
True Colours#039.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#040.src: Unfortunately, it would seem we also lack the details on who specifically has been sent there.
True Colours#040.dst: 안타깝게도 정확히 누가 그곳에 보내졌는지도 자세히 알지 못하오.
True Colours#040.speaker: Azael

True Colours#041.src: Sigh. Azael, sir, it's cruel to leave them in the dark. You need to tell them.
True Colours#041.dst: 하아. Azael 님, 모르게 두는 건 잔인해요. 말해 줘야 해요.
True Colours#041.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#043.src: I suppose you are right, captain. It is regarding the older woman among your party... Syndra, was it?
True Colours#043.dst: 그대 말이 맞는 것 같군, 대장. 그대들 일행 중 나이 든 여인에 관한 것이오... Syndra라고 했던가?
True Colours#043.speaker: Azael

True Colours#044.src: It would seem that Her Majesty has made her into a statement.
True Colours#044.dst: 여왕 폐하께서 그녀를 본보기로 삼으신 것 같소.
True Colours#044.speaker: Azael

True Colours#046.src: She was publicly executed during the festival, as a way to send a message.
True Colours#046.dst: 축제 기간에 공개 처형됐어요. 경고를 보내려고요.
True Colours#046.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#047.src: Subtle as a brick, aren't you?
True Colours#047.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#048.src: I apologize. This must be a shock. It is my understanding she was something of a leader to you all.
True Colours#048.dst: 사과하오. 충격이 크겠지. 내가 알기로 그녀는 그대들에게 지도자 같은 존재였다지.
True Colours#048.speaker: Azael

True Colours#049.src: So it would seem. My, it has been an age since Her Majesty last performed such an act... how interesting, that she would deem it necessary.
True Colours#049.dst: 그런 듯하군. 여왕 폐하께서 그런 일을 하신 게 대체 언제 적인지... 그럴 필요가 있다고 보셨다니, 흥미롭군.
True Colours#049.speaker: Azael

True Colours#050.src: But rest assured that her death will not be for nought. She fought like a true warrior, to the bitter end.
True Colours#050.dst: 하지만 그녀의 죽음이 헛되진 않을 것이오. 그녀는 마지막까지 진정한 전사처럼 싸웠소.
True Colours#050.speaker: Azael

True Colours#051.dst: 나....... 아- 아니야, 나.... 그... 그 사람이 그, 그럴 리가.... 나.... 나-
True Colours#051.speaker: Sui

True Colours#053.src: Yes, a fine idea, Cileon. Space - that we certainly can provide!
True Colours#053.dst: 네, 좋은 생각이에요, Cileon. 자리 비켜 주기라면 얼마든지요!
True Colours#053.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#054.src: Ugh. Fine. Captains, let's talk plans. Come on.
True Colours#054.dst: 하. 알았어요. 대장들, 계획 얘기하죠. 가요.
True Colours#054.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#055.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#057.src: I... I didn't think she could... how...?
True Colours#057.dst: 나... 나는 그 사람이 그렇게... 어떻게...?
True Colours#057.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#058.src: She... she d-died, and we... w-we all got separated. She died and... she's d-dead. D-dead dead... dead. She's... dead.
True Colours#058.dst: 그 사람... 주, 죽었고, 우린... 우, 우린 다 흩어졌어. 죽었어... 주, 죽었다고. 주, 죽었어... 죽었어. 그 사람... 죽었어.
True Colours#058.speaker: Sui

True Colours#059.src: And the others... to Deraj? What... what are we going to do now?
True Colours#059.dst: 그리고 다른 사람들은... Deraj로? 우리... 우리 이제 어떡해?
True Colours#059.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#060.src: N-no, we... we can't. You... you heard Rurie. There's no escaping once they take you there...
True Colours#060.dst: 아, 안 돼, 우린... 못 해. 너... 너도 Rurie 말 들었잖아. 거기 끌려가면 못 빠져나온대...
True Colours#060.speaker: Sui

True Colours#061.src: I... I've lost too many people to th-that place. So many friends, c-captured and... and taken...
True Colours#061.dst: 나... 난 거, 거기에 너무 많은 사람을 잃었어. 수많은 친구가 붙, 붙잡혀서... 끌려갔어...
True Colours#061.speaker: Sui

True Colours#063.src: {u}, are you really considering this?! You can't just- just- throw yourself into a suicide mission!
True Colours#063.dst: {u}, 진짜 그걸 생각하는 거야?! 그냥- 그냥- 자살행위에 뛰어들면 안 돼!
True Colours#063.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#064.src: ...fine. Fine! Just... make sure you c-come back. The three of us, we... we're all that's, ha, left.
True Colours#064.dst: ...알았어. 알았다고! 그냥... 꼭 도, 돌아와. 우리 셋, 우리... 하, 남은 건 우리뿐이야.
True Colours#064.speaker: Sui

True Colours#066.src: I need to get back to work. Keep trying to align the resonances... maybe if I get it to work, it'll actually help us...
True Colours#066.dst: 난 다시 일해야겠어. 공명 정렬을 계속 시도해 볼게... 제대로 작동하면 진짜 도움이 될지도 몰라...
True Colours#066.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#067.src: ...{u}, um. You should... tell Master Azael what you're doing. Before you... go.
True Colours#067.dst: ...{u}, 음. Azael 님한테... 뭘 할지 말해 두는 게 좋겠어. 떠나기... 전에.
True Colours#067.speaker: Sui

True Colours#068.src: Say good bye to Master Azael before heading to the Deraj Prison at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#068.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Deraj 감옥으로 가기 전에 Azael 님에게 작별 인사를 하세요.

True Colours#069.src: Stupid... resonance core. Pink, green, blue, white, gold... what am I supposed to even do with this?!
True Colours#069.dst: 멍청한... 공명 핵. 분홍, 초록, 파랑, 하양, 금색... 이걸로 대체 뭘 하라는 거야?!
True Colours#069.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#072.src: I must apologize once more for being so blunt with the news. I am often told I am lacking in that kind of sensitivity.
True Colours#072.dst: 소식을 그리 직설적으로 전한 것을 다시 한번 사과하오. 그런 섬세함이 부족하다는 말을 자주 듣소.
True Colours#072.speaker: Azael

True Colours#073.src: Worry not, that is what you have us captains for! In addition to all the, ah, other stuff we do!
True Colours#073.dst: 걱정 마세요, 그러라고 우리 대장들이 있는 거죠! 그 밖의, 어, 다른 일들도 하지만요!
True Colours#073.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#074.src: ... Say, are the other two... taking it well? I notice they haven't joined you.
True Colours#074.dst: ...그런데, 나머지 둘은... 괜찮나요? 같이 오지 않았네요.
True Colours#074.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#075.src: Pardon me? Did I hear that correctly? You did hear all I said about Gravity's Monolith, right? Inescapable pull... so on and so forth?
True Colours#075.dst: 뭐라고요? 제가 제대로 들었나요? 중력의 모놀리스에 대해 제가 한 말 다 들었죠? 피할 수 없는 힘... 기타 등등?
True Colours#075.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#076.src: Are you truly certain about this decision? Have you thought this through?
True Colours#076.dst: 정말 이 결정에 확신이 있소? 충분히 생각해 보았소?
True Colours#076.speaker: Azael

True Colours#077.src: ... Well, if you truly wish to risk your life for a one in a million chance of a miracle, then who am I to interfere?
True Colours#077.dst: ...좋소, 백만분의 일의 기적을 위해 목숨을 걸겠다면, 내가 무슨 자격으로 막겠소?
True Colours#077.speaker: Azael

True Colours#078.src: Ah, but might I? See, I have actually been plotting assorted plans for breaking in myself over the years! Though, of course, master Azael has always forbidden me from trying...
True Colours#078.dst: 아, 그럼 저도 가도 될까요? 사실 저도 몇 년 동안 직접 쳐들어갈 온갖 계획을 짜 왔거든요! 물론 Azael 님이 늘 금지하셨지만...
True Colours#078.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#080.src: Hmph! Good reason or not, the plots exist! Whether or not they are viable is anyone's guess... but nonetheless- would you allow me to join-
True Colours#080.dst: 흥! 이유가 있든 없든 계획은 있어요! 실현 가능한지는 아무도 모르지만... 그래도- 저도 같이 가게-
True Colours#080.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#081.src: Absolutely not. If they truly wish, the outsiders are permitted to throw their lives away. You, on the other hand, I cannot afford to lose.
True Colours#081.dst: 절대 안 되오. 외부인들이 진정 원한다면 목숨을 버리는 것도 허락하겠소. 하지만 그대를 잃을 수는 없소.
True Colours#081.speaker: Azael

True Colours#082.src: Oh, you're no fun. Fine, fine, I will stay if I must. Well in that case, once you return, I will demand a full report on what it's like in there!
True Colours#082.dst: 아, 재미없으시네. 알았어요, 알았어, 남으라면 남죠. 그럼 돌아오면 안이 어떤지 전부 보고해 줘야 해요!
True Colours#082.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#083.src: What's the food like in there? How about entertainment? Perhaps even a dossier on that Warden, Oru? I can go on!
True Colours#083.dst: 음식은 어때요? 오락거리는? 교도소장 Oru에 대한 자료는요? 더 말할 수도 있어요!
True Colours#083.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#084.src: Enough, Captain Rurie. {u}, there is a bridge in the south-eastern corner of the {p} that crosses directly to the prison's entrance.
True Colours#084.dst: 그만하시오, Rurie 대장. {u}, {p} 남동쪽 구석에 감옥 입구로 곧장 이어지는 다리가 있소.
True Colours#084.speaker: Azael

True Colours#085.src: If you truly intend on seeing this through, stay on guard. The bridge is typically guarded by dozens of soldiers.
True Colours#085.dst: 정말 끝까지 해낼 생각이라면 경계를 늦추지 마시오. 보통 수십 명의 병사가 다리를 지키오.
True Colours#085.speaker: Azael

True Colours#086.src: Good luck on your adventure, new friend! Just remember, no point in dying over this, eh? No shame in turning back if the going gets tough!
True Colours#086.dst: 모험에 행운을 빌어요, 새 친구! 기억해요, 이런 일로 죽을 필요는 없잖아요? 힘들면 돌아오는 건 부끄러운 게 아니에요!
True Colours#086.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#088.src: Ah, a prison break... what a shame I cannot join. Is there anything more fun than such a daring mission?
True Colours#088.dst: 아, 탈옥이라니... 같이 못 가서 아쉽네요. 이렇게 대담한 임무보다 재밌는 게 있을까요?
True Colours#088.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#089.src: Captain Rurie, I still need you to fill out many information reports. You have five of them to catch up on already.
True Colours#089.dst: Rurie 대장, 아직 작성할 정보 보고서가 많소. 이미 밀린 것만 다섯 건이오.
True Colours#089.speaker: Azael

True Colours#090.src: Oh, paperwork... My greatest nemesis. Well, if I must!
True Colours#090.dst: 아, 서류 작업... 제 최대의 숙적. 뭐, 해야 한다면야!
True Colours#090.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#091.src: {u}. It's been... awhile since we've really had the chance to talk, hasn't it?
True Colours#091.dst: {u}. 제대로 이야기할 기회가 생긴 게... 꽤 오랜만이지 않나?
True Colours#091.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#092.src: {u}. It's been... a while since we've really had the chance to talk, hasn't it?
True Colours#092.dst: {u}. 제대로 이야기할 기회가 생긴 게... 꽤 오랜만이지 않나?
True Colours#092.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#093.src: They expected you might try the prison. I just... cleared out the guards temporarily. So we could have some privacy.
True Colours#093.dst: 네가 감옥에 올지도 모른다고 예상하더라. 난 그냥... 잠깐 경비병들을 치웠어. 둘이서만 얘기하려고.
True Colours#093.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#094.src: You've probably heard as much already, but the prison isn't an option. Especially not from this side- there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#094.dst: 이미 들었겠지만, 감옥은 방법이 못 돼. 특히 이쪽에선- 사방에 경비병이 있어.
True Colours#094.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#095.src: And even if you could get in... the Warden's not someone you want to mess with. Take it as a warning from a friend.
True Colours#095.dst: 들어간다 해도... 교도소장은 건드리면 안 되는 상대야. 친구로서 하는 경고로 받아들여.
True Colours#095.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#096.src: I'd hope so! But being on different sides of this conflict makes that hard, doesn't it?
True Colours#096.dst: 나도 그러길 바라! 하지만 이 싸움에서 서로 다른 편에 서 있으니 쉽지 않잖아?
True Colours#096.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#097.src: And it's not like I'm the one who's been going on a killing spree through Fruma! I've heard what you did at {p}. Was that really necessary?
True Colours#097.dst: 게다가 Fruma를 휩쓸며 살육을 벌인 건 내가 아니잖아! {p}에서 네가 한 일 들었어. 정말 그래야만 했어?
True Colours#097.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#098.src: Knock them out, then!! Use nonlethal force, if it's really necessary - I know you're capable of it!!
True Colours#098.dst: 그럼 기절시키면 되잖아!! 정말 필요하면 죽이지 않고 제압해 - 너라면 할 수 있잖아!!
True Colours#098.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#099.src: And what do you mean by that?
True Colours#099.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#101.src: Yes! I have!! You're right, things are bad here in Fruma. I'm not blind to any of it. You of all people should know how deeply familiar I am with all the Crown has done!
True Colours#101.dst: 그래! 봤어!! 네 말이 맞아, Fruma는 상황이 나빠. 나도 모르는 척하는 거 아니야. 왕실이 한 짓을 내가 얼마나 잘 아는지 누구보다 네가 알잖아!
True Colours#101.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#102.src: "Cursed..." Have you learned what it means by now? Horrible, uncontrollable power, so they say. None of them really believe it.
True Colours#102.dst: "저주받은..." 이제 그게 무슨 뜻인지 알았어? 끔찍하고 통제할 수 없는 힘이라고들 하지. 진짜 믿는 사람은 없어.
True Colours#102.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#103.src: Just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored. I hate it! But I still agreed to this voluntarily, and you want to know why?
True Colours#103.dst: 백성을 통제하고 모든 마법을 가둬 감시하려는 수단일 뿐이야. 난 그게 싫어! 그래도 자원해서 받아들였지. 왜인지 알아?
True Colours#103.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#104.src: Because in this position, I can actually DO something about it! They've given me authority, and yes there are obligations attached, but I can CHANGE things!
True Colours#104.dst: 이 자리에 있으면 실제로 뭔가를 할 수 있으니까! 권한을 받았고, 그래, 의무도 따르지만 난 바꿀 수 있어!
True Colours#104.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#105.src: ...of course, it's not like I've had the chance! From the moment I recovered from... from ascension, all I've been hearing about is what you've been up to!!
True Colours#105.dst: ...물론 아직 기회는 없었지! 승... 승천에서 회복한 순간부터 들리는 건 전부 네가 벌인 일뿐이었으니까!!
True Colours#105.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#106.src: Fighting your way back into the province, and for what? For me?! I didn't ASK you to do that!
True Colours#106.dst: 싸워서 이 지방으로 돌아오다니, 뭘 위해서? 나를 위해?! 그래 달라고 한 적 없어!
True Colours#106.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#107.src: And aiding a resistance group? I- ugh, okay, look, I get it. I actually do. They... they seem like nice people. They do.
True Colours#107.dst: 게다가 저항 조직을 돕다니? 나- 으, 알았어, 봐, 이해해. 진짜로. 그 사람들... 좋은 사람들 같아. 정말로.
True Colours#107.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#108.src: ...I just wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
True Colours#108.dst: ...그냥 일이 그렇게 되지 않았으면 좋았을 텐데.
True Colours#108.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#109.src: I know! I know! But it was your side that instigated it!!
True Colours#109.dst: 알아! 안다고! 하지만 먼저 일을 벌인 건 너희 쪽이잖아!!
True Colours#109.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#110.src: And I did try to warn you! I didn't want that to happen, obviously! But... sigh. I didn't get to you quick enough.
True Colours#110.dst: 그리고 난 경고하려고 했어! 당연히 그런 일이 일어나길 원하지 않았어! 하지만... 하아. 제때 너한테 가지 못했지.
True Colours#110.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#111.src: Look, I'm... I'm sorry. I wish nobody had to die. I wish a lot of things could have been handled differently.
True Colours#111.dst: 봐, 난... 미안해. 아무도 죽지 않았으면 했어. 많은 일이 다르게 처리됐으면 좋았을 텐데.
True Colours#111.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#112.src: ...I've gotten off track. This isn't what I wanted to talk to you about at all.
True Colours#112.dst: ...얘기가 샜네. 이런 얘길 하려던 게 전혀 아니었는데.
True Colours#112.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#113.src: The crown has soldiers out looking for your group... you, specifically. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to... explain things.
True Colours#113.dst: 왕실이 너희 일행을... 특히 너를 찾으려고 병사를 풀었어. 여왕 폐하께서 너와 이야기하고 싶어 하셔. 그러니까... 사정을 설명하려고.
True Colours#113.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#114.src: I... I guess so. I guess you've finally made an impression on her.
True Colours#114.dst: 나... 그런가 봐. 드디어 그분께 강한 인상을 남겼나 보네.
True Colours#114.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#115.src: I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was... but that doesn't mean I have to like it.
True Colours#115.dst: 그 대회가 왜 그렇게 치러졌는지 이제 이해해... 그렇다고 마음에 들어야 하는 건 아니지만.
True Colours#115.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#116.src: Look... you should hear her out.
True Colours#116.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#118.src: She's like us, you know? She was... forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn't escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
True Colours#118.dst: 그분도 우리랑 같아, 알아? 싫어하는 역할을... 강요당하고, 벗어날 수 없는 곳에 갇혔어. 자기 뜻과 전혀 상관없는 존재가 되어 버렸지.
True Colours#118.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#119.src: And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom...
True Colours#119.dst: 그리고 결국 그분은... 탈출구를 찾았어. 아니, 직접 탈출구를 만들었지. 자유의 가능성이라면 뭐든 할퀴고 밀치고 싸워서...
True Colours#119.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#120.src: She made Fruma, for herself, and- and yes! Yes, she's responsible for what happened to us! I know!! Trust me, I have not forgotten!!
True Colours#120.dst: 자신을 위해 Fruma를 만들었고, 그- 그래! 그래, 우리에게 일어난 일은 그분 책임이야! 알아!! 믿어, 잊지 않았어!!
True Colours#120.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#121.src: But... but it's so rare to find someone who understands. Who knows what it's like. Who- who forged her own path forward! If she could do it, then...
True Colours#121.dst: 하지만... 이해해 주는 사람을 만나기는 정말 드물어. 그게 어떤 건지 아는 사람. 스스로- 스스로 앞길을 개척한 사람! 그분이 해냈다면...
True Colours#121.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#123.src: I know you won't leave your friends. It's why I didn't bring the soldiers I was assigned... I was instructed to bring you in by force if you didn't come willingly, after all.
True Colours#123.dst: 네가 친구들을 두고 떠나지 않을 거란 걸 알아. 그래서 배정된 병사들을 안 데려왔어... 순순히 안 따라오면 강제로 데려오라는 명령이었거든.
True Colours#123.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#124.src: I just... I need you to understand. Just as you have your reasons for what you've done, so do I.
True Colours#124.dst: 난 그냥... 네가 이해해 줬으면 해. 네가 한 일에 이유가 있듯이 나도 그래.
True Colours#124.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#125.src: Sigh... You remember what she said, don't you? A ceaseless, meaningless war, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#125.dst: 하아... 그분이 한 말 기억하지? 우리 힘을 넘어선 세력들이 벌이는 끝없고 무의미한 전쟁?
True Colours#125.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#126.src: Haven't you seen the symptoms, the consequences? Light and Dark and the War they leave in their wake?
True Colours#126.dst: 그 징후와 결과를 못 봤어? 빛과 어둠... 그리고 그들이 남기고 간 전쟁?
True Colours#126.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#127.src: If one side wins, everything ends. Fruma, Wynn, Gavel- nothing will matter if they get what they want.
True Colours#127.dst: 한쪽이 이기면 모든 게 끝나. Fruma, Wynn, Gavel- 그들이 원하는 걸 얻으면 아무것도 의미 없어.
True Colours#127.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#128.src: That's... what the tournament was for. She wanted someone powerful, who was from Fruma, but who had also seen... all of it.
True Colours#128.dst: 그게... 그 대회의 목적이었어. 강하고, Fruma 출신이면서, 그 모든 걸... 본 사람을 원했지.
True Colours#128.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#131.src: I'll let you get back to your friends. I'll even take my soldiers and leave. This one last time, I'll... I'll let you go.
True Colours#131.dst: 친구들한테 돌아가게 해 줄게. 병사들도 데리고 떠날게. 이번 한 번만, 내가... 널 보내 줄게.
True Colours#131.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#132.src: I have another warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p}- Gikyo... they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They're preparing an attack.
True Colours#132.dst: 경고가 하나 더 있어. {p}의 군주- Gikyo가... 수관의 은신처를 알아. 공격을 준비하고 있어.
True Colours#132.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#133.src: You should have more than enough time to warn everybody this time around. I- I know what happened with Syndra was... was awful, but...
True Colours#133.dst: 이번엔 모두에게 경고할 시간이 충분할 거야. 나- Syndra 일은... 끔찍했다는 거 알아, 하지만...
True Colours#133.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#134.src: ...if Gikyo captures you, your friends will wish what happens to them was as quick as what Her Majesty did. Trust me.
True Colours#134.dst: ...Gikyo한테 잡히면, 네 친구들은 차라리 여왕 폐하께 당한 것처럼 빨리 끝나길 바랄 거야. 믿어.
True Colours#134.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#135.src: Now... go. Save the friends you have left. While you still can.
True Colours#135.dst: 이제... 가. 남은 친구들을 구해. 아직 할 수 있을 때.
True Colours#135.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#137.src: Not as much as you'd think. I've only just recovered enough to start doing things around here.
True Colours#137.dst: 생각만큼은 아니야. 이제 겨우 회복해서 여기서 일을 시작할 수 있게 됐어.
True Colours#137.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#138.src: Imagine my surprise when I found you were the one responsible for all the commotion. That you were even in Fruma in the first place!
True Colours#138.dst: 이 모든 소동의 장본인이 너라는 걸 알았을 때 얼마나 놀랐는지 상상해 봐. 애초에 네가 Fruma에 있다는 것부터!
True Colours#138.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#139.src: Sigh... look. They thought you might try the prison even though it isn't really an option. Especially not from this side there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#139.dst: 하아... 봐. 감옥은 사실 방법이 못 되는데도 네가 올지도 모른다고 예상하더라. 특히 이쪽은 사방에 경비병이 있어.
True Colours#139.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#140.src: ...They thought you might try the prison even though it isn't really an option. Especially not from this side there are guards everywhere.
True Colours#140.dst: ...감옥은 사실 방법이 못 되는데도 네가 올지도 모른다고 예상하더라. 특히 이쪽은 사방에 경비병이 있어.
True Colours#140.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#141.src: Usually, at least. I've cleared them out temporarily, so that we could have some privacy.
True Colours#141.dst: 적어도 평소엔. 둘이서만 얘기하려고 잠깐 치워 뒀어.
True Colours#141.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#142.src: We didn't really get to talk back at the festival, after all. You... probably have questions.
True Colours#142.dst: 축제에선 제대로 얘기를 못 했잖아. 너... 물어보고 싶은 게 있겠지.
True Colours#142.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#145.src: Sigh... she mentioned it to you too, didn't she? That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#145.dst: 하아... 그분이 너한테도 말했지? 우리 힘을 넘어선 세력들이 벌이는, 이 세계를 둘러싼 끝없는 전쟁?
True Colours#145.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

similar.text: The crate is empty...

True Colours#147.src: I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did, too- and more. Once you know what to look for, it's everywhere. Light and Dark... and the War they leave in their wake.
True Colours#147.dst: Gavel에서 그것을 언뜻 보았다... 너도 보았겠지- 그 이상도. 무엇을 봐야 할지 알게 되면, 그것은 어디에나 있다. 빛과 어둠... 그리고 그들이 남기고 간 전쟁.
True Colours#147.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#148.src: The list goes on with various... odd statistics.

True Colours#151.src: It's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse. They're beyond our means to stop, so... the best we can do is keep them at balance.
True Colours#151.dst: 그들이 교착 상태이기에 그나마 이 정도로 끝난 것이다. 우리 힘으로는 막을 수 없으니... 우리가 할 수 있는 최선은 균형을 유지시키는 것뿐이다.

True Colours#152.src: She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
True Colours#152.dst: 그분 말로는 서로 교착 상태라서 그나마 이 정도라는데... 난 그 말을 믿어.
True Colours#152.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#153.src: ...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
True Colours#153.dst: ...그리고 선택지가 있었어. 그분과 손잡고 그 전쟁에서 어느 쪽도 너무 우위에 서지 못하게 돕거나... 아니면... 거절하거나.
True Colours#153.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#154.src: To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that that he's-
True Colours#154.dst: 그냥 남들한테 맡기고, 잊어버리고 내 삶을 살고, 그리고 그리고 어떻게 그럴 수 있었겠어, 그가 그렇게-
True Colours#154.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#156.src: At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
True Colours#156.dst: 적어도 여기선... 뭔가 바꿀 수 있어. 그 전쟁에서도, Fruma에서도.
True Colours#156.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#157.src: If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
True Colours#157.dst: 어차피 이 자리에 있을 거라면... 적어도 변화를 밀어붙일 수 있어.
True Colours#157.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#159.src: Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
True Colours#159.dst: 그렇다고 Fruma에 있는 게 쉬워진 건 아니지만, 하. 여기 있는 모든 게... 음. 알잖아.
True Colours#159.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#160.src: ...I am. I'm not sure how to feel about it still, honestly.
True Colours#160.dst: ...맞아. 솔직히 아직도 어떻게 받아들여야 할지 모르겠어.
True Colours#160.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#161.src: There's... two parts to it. Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
True Colours#161.dst: 여기엔... 두 가지 면이 있어. 권한을 갖고 병사를 지휘하는 건... 이상해. 언젠가 익숙해질지 모르겠어.
True Colours#161.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#162.src: I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
True Colours#162.dst: 그런 힘을 가져 본 적이 없거든. 사람들한테 뭘 하라고 하면... 그냥 하는 거야.
True Colours#162.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#163.src: I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
True Colours#163.dst: 진짜 변화를 밀어붙이고 상황을 개선할 목소리가 생겼는데... 어떻게 보면 거저 얻은 것 같아.
True Colours#163.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#164.src: I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
True Colours#164.dst: 난 예전이랑 똑같아! 그런데 이 칭호를 받자마자 갑자기 사람들이 내 말을 들어.
True Colours#164.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#165.src: ... I don't like that that's all it took.
True Colours#165.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#168.src: It's a strange feeling. Not... unpleasant, exactly, but not comfortable, either. A constant weight on my shoulder, reminding me of what I've signed up for.
True Colours#168.dst: 이상한 느낌이야. 딱히... 불쾌한 건 아니지만 편하지도 않아. 내가 무엇에 서명했는지 일깨우는, 어깨 위의 끝없는 무게.
True Colours#168.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#169.src: It's always there, a... a small push to react to things I haven't noticed yet, that I wouldn't notice without it.
True Colours#169.dst: 늘 거기 있어, 그... 내가 아직 못 알아챈, 그게 없으면 못 알아챌 일에 반응하게 하는 작은 떠밀림.
True Colours#169.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#170.src: And the more focus I put on it, the stronger it gets. More overwhelming to keep track of, but... stronger.
True Colours#170.dst: 집중할수록 더 강해져. 따라가기 벅차지만... 더 강해.
True Colours#170.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#171.src: ...I try not to use it unless I have to.
True Colours#171.dst: ...꼭 필요할 때가 아니면 안 쓰려고 해.
True Colours#171.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#173.src: She mentioned it to you too, didn't she?
True Colours#173.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#174.src: That ceaseless war over our world, fought by forces beyond our power?
True Colours#174.dst: 우리 힘을 넘어선 세력들이 벌이는, 이 세계를 둘러싼 끝없는 전쟁?
True Colours#174.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#175.src: I caught glimpses of it in Gavel... I'm sure you did too and more.
True Colours#175.dst: Gavel에서 그걸 언뜻 봤어... 너도 봤겠지, 그 이상도.
True Colours#175.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#176.src: She says it's only because of their stalemate that they haven't done worse, and... I believe it.
True Colours#176.dst: 그분 말로는 서로 교착 상태라서 그나마 이 정도라는데... 난 그 말을 믿어.
True Colours#176.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#177.src: ...and there was the choice. Join her, and help ensure neither side in that war gets too much of an advantage... or... don't.
True Colours#177.dst: ...그리고 선택지가 있었어. 그분과 손잡고 그 전쟁에서 어느 쪽도 너무 우위에 서지 못하게 돕거나... 아니면... 거절하거나.
True Colours#177.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#178.src: To just leave it up to other people, and forget about it and live my life, and and how could I have possibly done that, knowing that that he's
True Colours#178.dst: 그냥 남들한테 맡기고, 잊어버리고 내 삶을 살고, 그리고 그리고 어떻게 그럴 수 있었겠어, 그가 그렇게
True Colours#178.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#180.src: At least, here... I could make a difference. Both in that war, and in Fruma.
True Colours#180.dst: 적어도 여기선... 뭔가 바꿀 수 있어. 그 전쟁에서도, Fruma에서도.
True Colours#180.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#181.src: If I was in this position anyway... at least I could push for change.
True Colours#181.dst: 어차피 이 자리에 있을 거라면... 적어도 변화를 밀어붙일 수 있어.
True Colours#181.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#183.src: Not that that's made actually being in Fruma any easier, ha. Everything here is a reminder of... well. You know.
True Colours#183.dst: 그렇다고 Fruma에 있는 게 쉬워진 건 아니지만, 하. 여기 있는 모든 게... 음. 알잖아.
True Colours#183.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#184.src: …sigh. I thought… I thought I had it all figured out, but you being here is making things harder than I’d like.
True Colours#184.dst: ...하아. 난... 다 정리됐다고 생각했는데, 네가 여기 있으니 생각보다 더 힘들어.
True Colours#184.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#185.src: Ha. Well… sort of, but not really. You’ve learned what it really means by now, then? Horrible, uncontrollable power… so they say.
True Colours#185.dst: 하. 글쎄... 어느 정도는, 아니 사실 아니야. 이제 그게 진짜 무슨 뜻인지 알았어? 끔찍하고 통제할 수 없는 힘... 이라고들 하지.
True Colours#185.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#186.src: It's all paper-thin, in the end. It's just a means to control the people, to keep all magic contained and monitored.
True Colours#186.dst: 결국 다 종잇장처럼 얇은 거야. 백성을 통제하고 모든 마법을 가둬 감시하려는 수단일 뿐이지.
True Colours#186.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#187.src: ...and knowing that it was all manufactured, that there was never anything actually... wrong...
True Colours#187.dst: ...그게 다 꾸며낸 거였고, 실은 아무것도... 잘못된 게 없었다는 걸 알고 나니...
True Colours#187.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#188.src: To some extent, it's a relief but more than that it makes me angry. This was weighing on me for so long, and for it to mean... nothing, in the end?
True Colours#188.dst: 어느 정도는 안심이 되지만 그보다 화가 나. 그렇게 오랫동안 날 짓눌렀는데, 결국... 아무 의미도 없었다고?
True Colours#188.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#189.src: ...just another thing I want to change in Fruma. If I get the chance, that is.
True Colours#189.dst: ...Fruma에서 바꾸고 싶은 게 또 하나 생겼네. 기회가 온다면 말이야.
True Colours#189.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#190.src: ...you being here is only making it harder for me to do anything about it of course.
True Colours#190.dst: ...물론 네가 여기 있으면 그걸 바꾸기가 더 어려워질 뿐이지만.
True Colours#190.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#192.src: They didn’t want us here. We were… disposable soldiers, just a resource to keep Wynn standing.
True Colours#192.dst: 그들은 우리가 여기 있는 걸 원하지 않았어. 우린... 버려도 되는 병사, Wynn을 지탱할 자원일 뿐이었지.
True Colours#192.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#193.src: But now, all of a sudden… Now, they’ve changed their mind.
True Colours#193.dst: 그런데 이제 와서 갑자기... 이제 와서 마음을 바꿨어.
True Colours#193.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#194.src: But I can’t just… forget. I had my memories discarded, and was shipped off to Wynn, for something beyond my control.
True Colours#194.dst: 하지만 그냥... 잊을 수는 없어. 기억을 빼앗기고 Wynn으로 보내졌어, 내가 어쩔 수 없는 일 때문에.
True Colours#194.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#195.src: For something I’ve learned to appreciate over time. For something that was never really a curse!!
True Colours#195.dst: 시간이 지나며 소중히 여기게 된 것 때문에. 애초에 저주도 아니었던 것 때문에!!
True Colours#195.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#197.src: I did some digging when I got here, you know? I went looking for anyone I might have known here, before……
True Colours#197.dst: 여기 와서 좀 알아봤어, 알아? 전에 여기서 알았을지도 모르는 사람을 찾아봤어, 그 전에......
True Colours#197.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#198.src: No one. Not a single person who knew me. Not a single person left to miss me, or even notice my absence!
True Colours#198.dst: 아무도 없었어. 날 아는 사람이 한 명도. 날 그리워하거나 내가 없어진 걸 알아챌 사람조차 한 명도 없었어!
True Colours#198.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#199.src: I had my self stripped away from me, and it doesn’t even matter! Because there was nothing here for me anyway!!
True Colours#199.dst: 나 자신을 빼앗겼는데, 그게 아무 상관도 없어! 어차피 여기엔 날 위한 게 아무것도 없었으니까!!
True Colours#199.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#201.src: I can’t imagine the same for Aledar. He must have had… someone.
True Colours#201.dst: Aledar도 그랬을 거라곤 상상이 안 돼. 그에겐... 누군가 있었겠지.
True Colours#201.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#202.src: I guess it doesn’t matter. He’s gone anyway, isn’t he?
True Colours#202.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#203.src: Why? Because you've been causing the crown problems ever since you broke in.
True Colours#203.dst: 왜냐고? 네가 쳐들어온 뒤로 계속 왕실을 골치 아프게 했으니까.
True Colours#203.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#204.src: Nobody will listen to anything not related to you... and for good reason! You massacred a fort of soldiers, you've killed Sovereign Zhiraok twice now...
True Colours#204.dst: 다들 너 말고는 아무 얘기도 안 들으려 해... 그럴 만도 하지! 요새 하나를 통째로 몰살하고, Zhiraok 군주를 벌써 두 번이나 죽였잖아...
True Colours#204.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#206.src: Fine. You've killed Sovereign Zhiraok once, and... helped a second time...?
True Colours#206.dst: 좋아. Zhiraok 군주를 한 번 죽였고, 두 번째는... 도왔다고...?
True Colours#206.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#207.src: ...okay. And that isn't to mention the plot to kill the Queen.
True Colours#207.dst: ...알았어. 여왕 암살 음모는 말할 것도 없고.
True Colours#207.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#208.src: I...ugh. I wish it hadn't gone the way it did.
True Colours#208.dst: 난... 으. 일이 그렇게 되지 않았으면 좋았을 텐데.
True Colours#208.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#209.src: I know. I know. I tried to warn you, to get you to call it off, but...sigh. It doesn't matter now. It's already done.
True Colours#209.dst: 알아. 안다고. 경고해서 그만두게 하려 했는데... 하아. 이제 상관없어. 이미 끝난 일이야.
True Colours#209.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#210.src: ...I'm sorry about the rest of your friends. The Leaves in the Wind. They... they seem like nice people.
True Colours#210.dst: ...나머지 친구들 일은 유감이야. 바람 속 잎새. 그 사람들... 좋은 사람들 같았어.
True Colours#210.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#212.src: I've gotten off track. I had something I needed to tell you.
True Colours#212.dst: 얘기가 샜네. 너한테 꼭 할 말이 있었어.
True Colours#212.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#213.src: The crown has soldiers out looking for you. Her Majesty wants to speak with you, to...explain things.
True Colours#213.dst: 왕실이 널 찾으려고 병사를 풀었어. 여왕 폐하께서 너와 이야기하고 싶어 하셔. 사정을... 설명하려고.
True Colours#213.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#214.src: I… I guess so. I guess you’ve finally made an impression on her.
True Colours#214.dst: 나... 그런가 봐. 드디어 그분께 강한 인상을 남겼나 보네.
True Colours#214.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#215.src: I now understand why that tournament was handled the way it was… but that doesn’t mean I have to like it.
True Colours#215.dst: 그 대회가 왜 그렇게 치러졌는지 이제 이해해... 그렇다고 마음에 들어야 하는 건 아니지만.
True Colours#215.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#216.src: …I think you should hear her out, but that’s your choice to make. I just thought you should know.
True Colours#216.dst: ...그분 얘기를 들어 봤으면 하지만, 선택은 네 몫이야. 그냥 알아 둬야 할 것 같았어.
True Colours#216.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#217.src: …okay. I can do that. Who first?
True Colours#217.dst: ...좋아. 그 정도는 할 수 있어. 누구부터?
True Colours#217.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#218.src: ...me? I... I guess I'm one now, too. I'm still not sure how to feel about it, honestly. There's... two parts to it.
True Colours#218.dst: ...나? 나... 이제 나도 그중 하나겠지. 솔직히 아직도 어떻게 받아들여야 할지 모르겠어. 여기엔... 두 가지 면이 있어.
True Colours#218.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#219.src: Having authority and commanding soldiers, feels... strange. I don't know if I'll ever be used to it.
True Colours#219.dst: 권한을 갖고 병사를 지휘하는 건... 이상해. 언젠가 익숙해질지 모르겠어.
True Colours#219.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#220.src: I've never had that sort of power before. To be able to tell people what to do, and... have them just, do it.
True Colours#220.dst: 그런 힘을 가져 본 적이 없거든. 사람들한테 뭘 하라고 하면... 그냥 하는 거야.
True Colours#220.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#221.src: I have a voice that can actually push for change, and improve things, and... it feels unearned, in a way.
True Colours#221.dst: 진짜 변화를 밀어붙이고 상황을 개선할 목소리가 생겼는데... 어떻게 보면 거저 얻은 것 같아.
True Colours#221.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#222.src: I'm still the same as I was before! But now, with this title given to me, suddenly people will actually listen to me.
True Colours#222.dst: 난 예전이랑 똑같아! 그런데 이 칭호를 받자마자 갑자기 사람들이 내 말을 들어.
True Colours#222.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#223.src: ... I don't like that that's all it took.
True Colours#223.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#226.src: It's a strange feeling. Not... unpleasant, exactly, but not comfortable, either. A constant weight on my shoulder, reminding me of what I've signed up for.
True Colours#226.dst: 이상한 느낌이야. 딱히... 불쾌한 건 아니지만 편하지도 않아. 내가 무엇에 서명했는지 일깨우는, 어깨 위의 끝없는 무게.
True Colours#226.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#227.src: It's always there, a... a small push to react to things I haven't noticed yet, that I wouldn't notice without it.
True Colours#227.dst: 늘 거기 있어, 그... 내가 아직 못 알아챈, 그게 없으면 못 알아챌 일에 반응하게 하는 작은 떠밀림.
True Colours#227.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#228.src: And the more focus I put on it, the stronger it gets. More overwhelming to keep track of, but... stronger.
True Colours#228.dst: 집중할수록 더 강해져. 따라가기 벅차지만... 더 강해.
True Colours#228.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#229.src: ...I try not to use it unless I have to.
True Colours#229.dst: ...꼭 필요할 때가 아니면 안 쓰려고 해.
True Colours#229.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#231.src: He’s… probably the best of them all. He does genuinely care about his district’s well-being I’ve seen the stuff he’s done over {~} years.
True Colours#231.dst: 그는... 아마 그중 최고일 거야. 자기 구역의 안녕을 진심으로 챙기거든. {~}년 동안 그가 한 일을 봐 왔어.
True Colours#231.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#232.src: When I was ascending… he was the only one who bothered telling me what to expect ahead of time.
True Colours#232.dst: 내가 승천할 때... 앞으로 뭘 겪을지 미리 알려 준 사람은 그뿐이었어.
True Colours#232.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#233.src: …he’s not perfect. Nobody in these positions of power is. But he’s the best Fruma has to offer.
True Colours#233.dst: ...완벽하진 않아. 권력자 중에 완벽한 사람은 없지. 그래도 Fruma에선 그가 최선이야.
True Colours#233.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#235.src: I still feel like I don’t entirely understand… I don’t know. Whatever it was she was working on which you stole, by the way it was important.
True Colours#235.dst: 아직도 완전히 이해가 안 가... 모르겠어. 어쨌든 네가 훔친 그 여자가 하던 일, 그거 중요한 거였어.
True Colours#235.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#236.src: …Zhiraok says she neglected her district, and left it on him to pick up the slack. Was that because of the project, or… did she just not care?
True Colours#236.dst: ...Zhiraok 말로는 그 여자가 자기 구역을 방치해서 뒤처리를 떠맡았대. 그 계획 때문이었을까, 아니면... 그냥 신경을 안 쓴 걸까?
True Colours#236.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#237.src: I don’t know. And, now… she’s gone, either way.
True Colours#237.dst: 모르겠어. 그리고 이제... 어쨌든 그 여자는 없어.
True Colours#237.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#239.src: Eugh. He’s... frustrating. I mean we both saw him during that tournament, right? He really thinks he’s better than everyone else around him.
True Colours#239.dst: 으. 그는... 짜증 나. 그 대회에서 우리 둘 다 봤잖아, 그렇지? 자기가 주변 누구보다 잘났다고 진심으로 믿어.
True Colours#239.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#240.src: What’s annoying is that he actually has the skill to back those claims up! There’s a reason he leads the military, after all. Apparently, he even taught himself magic!
True Colours#240.dst: 짜증 나는 건 그걸 뒷받침할 실력이 진짜 있다는 거야! 괜히 군대를 이끄는 게 아니지. 게다가 마법도 독학했대!
True Colours#240.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#241.src: …truth be told, I’m not unfamiliar with dealing with this kind of person. You’ve seen Kymer. I just… wish it didn’t get to me as much as it does.
True Colours#241.dst: ...사실 이런 사람 상대하는 게 처음은 아니야. Kymer 봤잖아. 그냥... 이렇게까지 신경 쓰이지 않았으면 좋겠어.
True Colours#241.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#244.src: I don’t know much about them. I’ve only met them a few times, but they’re… off-putting. I get the sense this is all just a game for them.
True Colours#244.dst: 그들에 대해선 잘 몰라. 몇 번 만나 봤을 뿐인데... 정이 안 가. 그들한텐 이게 다 게임인 것 같아.
True Colours#244.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#245.src: …to tell you the truth… they scare me. I don’t think there’s a boundary they’re unwilling to cross, in order to achieve results.
True Colours#245.dst: ...솔직히 말하면... 그들이 무서워. 결과를 위해서라면 넘지 않을 선이 없는 것 같아.
True Colours#245.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#246.src: You might end up running into them while you’re here. If you do… be careful, alright?
True Colours#246.dst: 여기 있다 보면 마주칠지도 몰라. 그러면... 조심해, 알았지?
True Colours#246.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#248.src: He’s… dangerous. I’ve only met him once, when I was ascending, but once was enough.
True Colours#248.dst: 그는... 위험해. 승천할 때 딱 한 번 만났는데, 한 번이면 충분했어.
True Colours#248.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#249.src: In terms of sheer brute power, he has the most of any of the Sovereigns. You can feel it radiating off of him. He could crush you with barely a second thought, if he wanted.
True Colours#249.dst: 순수한 힘으로만 따지면 군주 중에 제일 강해. 그 힘이 뿜어져 나오는 게 느껴져. 마음만 먹으면 망설임도 없이 널 짓밟을 수 있어.
True Colours#249.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#250.src: …luckily he stays at Gravity’s Monolith for the most part. He won’t be a problem if you just… stay away.
True Colours#250.dst: ...다행히 대부분 중력의 모놀리스에 있어. 그냥... 멀리하면 문제 될 일은 없어.
True Colours#250.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#251.src: I would recommend you stay away. Take it as a warning from a friend.
True Colours#251.dst: 멀리하는 걸 권할게. 친구로서 하는 경고로 받아들여.
True Colours#251.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#254.src: There’s… nothing much to say. Not because I don’t want to, but because I just don’t know that much about her.
True Colours#254.dst: ...별로 할 말이 없어. 말하기 싫어서가 아니라, 그 여자에 대해 아는 게 별로 없어서.
True Colours#254.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#255.src: She keeps her secrets to herself. I’ve only even spoken to her a few times, and all of it was about…
True Colours#255.dst: 비밀을 혼자만 간직하거든. 몇 번 얘기해 본 게 다고, 그것도 전부...
True Colours#255.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#258.src: It’s what I received the blessing for.
True Colours#258.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#259.src: I… don’t want to talk about it, right now. It won’t matter until all of this resolves, either way.
True Colours#259.dst: 난... 지금은 그 얘기 하고 싶지 않아. 어차피 이 모든 게 해결되기 전엔 중요하지 않아.
True Colours#259.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#262.src: She’s done awful, horrible things. All of Fruma’s problems trace themselves back to her, in some way.
True Colours#262.dst: 그분은 끔찍하고 무서운 짓을 저질렀어. Fruma의 모든 문제는 어떻게든 그분에게로 거슬러 올라가.
True Colours#262.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#263.src: But… there’s more to her than that.
True Colours#263.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#264.src: She’s like us, you know? She was… forced into a role she hated, trapped somewhere she couldn’t escape. She was made into something entirely outside of her control.
True Colours#264.dst: 그분도 우리랑 같아, 알아? 싫어하는 역할을... 강요당하고, 벗어날 수 없는 곳에 갇혔어. 자기 뜻과 전혀 상관없는 존재가 되어 버렸지.
True Colours#264.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#265.src: And eventually, she... she found a way out. Or, rather, she made her own way out. Clawed and pushed and fought for any possibility of freedom…
True Colours#265.dst: 그리고 결국 그분은... 탈출구를 찾았어. 아니, 직접 탈출구를 만들었지. 자유의 가능성이라면 뭐든 할퀴고 밀치고 싸워서...
True Colours#265.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#267.src: …it’s rare to find someone who understands, you know? Of course, I’ve had you, and… and Aledar, but it’s isolating. Even others from Fruma, they just… don’t get it.
True Colours#267.dst: ...이해해 주는 사람을 만나기는 드물어, 알아? 물론 너도 있고... Aledar도 있었지만, 외로워. Fruma 출신들조차... 이해를 못 해.
True Colours#267.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#268.src: So to have found someone who knows what it’s like, who managed to forge her own path forward… that connection feels worth holding onto.
True Colours#268.dst: 그래서 그게 어떤 건지 알고, 스스로 앞길을 개척해 낸 사람을 만났으니... 그 유대는 붙잡을 가치가 있는 것 같아.
True Colours#268.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#270.src: I should be going. And… you should get back to your friends.
True Colours#270.dst: 난 가 봐야겠어. 그리고... 너도 친구들한테 돌아가.
True Colours#270.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#271.src: Before I do… I have a warning for you, too. The Sovereign of the {p} Gikyo… they know where the Canopy is hiding out. They’re preparing an attack of some kind.
