True Colours#271.dst: 가기 전에... 경고가 하나 있어. {p}의 군주 Gikyo가... 수관의 은신처를 알아. 뭔가 공격을 준비하고 있어.
True Colours#271.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#272.src: …you should be able to warn everybody in time this time around. Make sure nobody gets captured. If they do… it- it won’t be pretty.
True Colours#272.dst: ...이번엔 제때 모두에게 경고할 수 있을 거야. 아무도 잡히지 않게 해. 잡히면... 그, 그건 끔찍할 거야.
True Colours#272.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#273.src: Now… go. Save the friends you still have left with you.
True Colours#273.dst: 이제... 가. 아직 곁에 남은 친구들을 구해.
True Colours#273.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

True Colours#276.src: {u}, you're... you're back. Does... does that mean you...?
True Colours#276.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#277.src: You're... you're alone. Where, um... where are they?
True Colours#277.dst: 혼자... 혼자네. 음... 다른 사람들은 어디 있어?
True Colours#277.speaker: Sui

True Colours#282.src: How do you know? H-how is it compromised?
True Colours#282.dst: 어떻게 알아? 어, 어떻게 들킨 거야?
True Colours#282.speaker: Sui

True Colours#283.src: That... did he really do the same thing twice?! Ugh, why is he even helping us?
True Colours#283.dst: 그게... 진짜 똑같은 짓을 두 번이나 했다고?! 으, 대체 왜 우릴 돕는 거야?
True Colours#283.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#285.src: Hey hey, Sui and Yusanu! The creature has begun to speak! Isn't it a miracle?
True Colours#285.dst: 이봐요, Sui, Yusanu! 그 생물이 말을 하기 시작했어요! 기적 아닌가요?
True Colours#285.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#286.src: Oh, you return! That was... a rather quick excursion. Well, how was it then? Simple in-and-out break-in?
True Colours#286.dst: 어머, 돌아왔군요! 꽤... 빠른 외출이었네요. 그래서, 어땠어요? 간단히 들어갔다 나왔나요?
True Colours#286.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#287.src: Though I hadn't spotted any new arrivals, so... perhaps not.
True Colours#287.dst: 새로 온 사람은 못 봤으니... 아닌가 보네요.
True Colours#287.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#288.src: I see, I see. Ran into too many guards, I suppose? It may be for the best, in any case - we've ourselves a talking changeling!
True Colours#288.dst: 그렇군요, 그렇군요. 경비병이 너무 많았나 봐요? 어쨌든 차라리 잘됐는지도 몰라요 - 말하는 변신자가 생겼거든요!
True Colours#288.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#289.src: Now, as I was saying - you all should come and take a listen, it really is very-
True Colours#289.dst: 자, 아까 말했듯이 - 다들 와서 들어 봐요, 정말 아주-
True Colours#289.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#290.src: Oh dear! Why didn't you lead with that?! Goodness, that's a problem and a half... I'll have to inform Fuhue.
True Colours#290.dst: 어머나! 왜 그걸 먼저 말 안 했어요?! 세상에, 이건 보통 문제가 아니네요... Fuhue한테 알려야겠어요.
True Colours#290.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#291.src: She just so happens to be questioning the prisoner as we speak, in fact! The little lizard has happened to spill some... rather interesting secrets.
True Colours#291.dst: 마침 지금 그녀가 포로를 심문하는 중이에요! 그 작은 도마뱀이 꽤... 흥미로운 비밀을 털어놨거든요.
True Colours#291.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#292.src: Come along, kiddos! Let's give it a look, shall we?
True Colours#292.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#297.src: It's shut up now, but it was speaking just a moment ago. Don't worry, I'll be able to get it talking again.
True Colours#297.dst: 지금은 입을 다물었지만 방금 전까진 말하고 있었어요. 걱정 마요, 다시 말하게 만들 수 있어요.
True Colours#297.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#298.src: You'll want to hear what it says. It's relevant to your current concerns.
True Colours#298.dst: 무슨 말을 하는지 들어 보고 싶을 거예요. 지금 걱정하는 일과 관련 있거든요.
True Colours#298.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#299.src: Well alright, Fuhue, take it away!
True Colours#299.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#300.src: Hm! Seems to have done the trick.
True Colours#300.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#302.src: What? Magic? I don't know what that word means.
True Colours#302.dst: 뭐요? 마법? 그게 무슨 말인지 모르겠는데요.
True Colours#302.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#303.src: They refer to curses or blessings, captain.
True Colours#303.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#304.src: Oh! No, no, certainly not. It's a simple talisman. They're a traditional art, passed down to us through generations of the Canopy.
True Colours#304.dst: 아! 아뇨, 아뇨, 절대 아니에요. 그냥 호부예요. 수관에서 대대로 전해 내려온 전통 기술이죠.
True Colours#304.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#305.src: I believe Master Azael explained it to Yusanu the other day? By inscribing specific glyphs in certain patterns, they can be ignited for varying powerful effects.
True Colours#305.dst: Azael 님이 며칠 전에 Yusanu한테 설명해 주셨죠? 특정 문양을 특정 패턴으로 새기면, 불을 붙여 다양한 강력한 효과를 낼 수 있어요.
True Colours#305.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#306.src: Through experimentation, we've determined which glyphs yield which results, though there's more we still don't know! As a matter of fact-
True Colours#306.dst: 실험을 통해 어떤 문양이 어떤 결과를 내는지 알아냈지만, 아직 모르는 게 더 많아요! 사실-
True Colours#306.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#307.src: Fuhue, I appreciate the enthusiasm, I do, but shouldn't we return to the matter at hand?
True Colours#307.dst: Fuhue, 열정은 높이 사요, 정말로. 그런데 본론으로 돌아가야 하지 않을까요?
True Colours#307.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#308.src: Yes. Of course. That's enough on talismans for now. Everyone, hurry up and take a look.
True Colours#308.dst: 네. 물론이죠. 호부 얘기는 이만하죠. 다들, 얼른 와서 봐요.
True Colours#308.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#309.src: I am an ordinary citizen! This is a crime!
True Colours#309.speaker: Changeling

True Colours#311.src: Ah, I see now. This one hadn't made it very far in its training. That would explain why it was so easy to capture.
True Colours#311.dst: 아, 이제 알겠네요. 이 녀석은 훈련을 별로 받지 못했어요. 그래서 이렇게 쉽게 잡혔나 봐요.
True Colours#311.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#316.src: It- it knows! It knows their names, so- so does it know where-
True Colours#316.dst: 그, 그게 알아! 이름을 알잖아, 그, 그럼 어디 있는지도-
True Colours#316.speaker: Sui

True Colours#317.src: No mention of my brothers... or anyone else from the Steel Feather...
True Colours#317.dst: 내 형제들 얘긴 없어... Steel Feather 사람들도 아무도...
True Colours#317.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#318.src: Oh... I- I didn't even... realize. I didn't even think... I- I'm sorry.
True Colours#318.dst: 아... 난, 난 생각도... 못 했어. 미처 생각을... 미, 미안해.
True Colours#318.speaker: Sui

True Colours#319.src: It's... fine. I just... wish I could know for sure they're still alive out there.
True Colours#319.dst: 괜... 괜찮아. 그냥... 다들 살아 있는지 확실히 알고 싶을 뿐이야.
True Colours#319.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#320.src: Hey, little man, lighten up! The way I see it, it's incredibly likely they've split the two groups.
True Colours#320.dst: 이봐요 꼬마 친구, 기운 내요! 제가 보기엔 두 무리를 갈라놨을 가능성이 아주 커요.
True Colours#320.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#321.src: Yes. It's a very common psychological torture technique! Splitting up groups of people does a number on one's-
True Colours#321.dst: 맞아요. 아주 흔한 심리 고문 기법이죠! 사람들을 갈라놓으면 정신이-
True Colours#321.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#322.src: Fuhue, really, do you think this is the time? Given our audience?
True Colours#322.dst: Fuhue, 정말, 지금이 그럴 때예요? 듣는 사람들 생각도 좀 하고요?
True Colours#322.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#324.src: Now, importantly, all changelings receive training here in the {p}! The crown has a special fort up on the eastern mountainside for it.
True Colours#324.dst: 자, 중요한 건 모든 변신자가 바로 여기 {p}에서 훈련을 받는다는 거예요! 왕실이 동쪽 산비탈에 전용 요새를 뒀거든요.
True Colours#324.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#325.src: Oh! Oh, we can organize a raid on the fort, gather information and find-
True Colours#325.dst: 아! 아, 그 요새를 습격해서 정보를 모으고 찾아내면-
True Colours#325.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#326.src: News? What news? I haven't heard anything from the owls yet this morning, and...
True Colours#326.dst: 소식이요? 무슨 소식요? 오늘 아침엔 올빼미들한테서 아무 연락도 못 받았는데...
True Colours#326.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#327.src: Did I forget? Forget what? Goodness, what am I missing...
True Colours#327.dst: 제가 잊었다고요? 뭘요? 세상에, 뭘 빠뜨린 거지...
True Colours#327.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#328.src: Oh! Oh, dear, right! Right right right! I remember now!
True Colours#328.dst: 아! 아, 세상에, 맞다! 맞다 맞다 맞다! 이제 기억나요!
True Colours#328.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#329.src: The crown knows our location, huh?
True Colours#329.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#330.src: Again?! Gah!!! Barely get a month's rest before we have to move again...
True Colours#330.dst: 또요?! 아악!!! 한 달도 못 쉬고 또 옮겨야 하다니...
True Colours#330.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#331.src: Ugh! I guess I'll go gather all our paperwork and emergency rations...
True Colours#331.dst: 하! 그럼 서류랑 비상 식량이나 챙기러 가야겠네요...
True Colours#331.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#332.src: I'll summon the owls and deploy them to begin evacuations. I'll have to track down Cileon as well...
True Colours#332.dst: 올빼미들을 불러 대피를 시작하게 할게요. Cileon도 찾아내야 하고...
True Colours#332.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#333.src: You know they're just going to stay behind to take out as many soldiers as possible, right?
True Colours#333.dst: 그 사람 어차피 남아서 병사를 최대한 많이 처리할 거 알잖아요?
True Colours#333.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#334.src: Cocky bastard... of course they will.
True Colours#334.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#335.src: Anyway! Kiddos, I'll meet you up at the top of this tree! That's where the Owls' headquarters are!
True Colours#335.dst: 아무튼! 얘들아, 이 나무 꼭대기에서 만나요! 거기가 올빼미들의 본부거든요!
True Colours#335.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#336.src: Rurie, I can't deal with all this paperwork on my own! Hand me two of your workers.
True Colours#336.dst: Rurie, 이 서류를 나 혼자선 못 해요! 당신 일꾼 둘만 넘겨요.
True Colours#336.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#339.src: Ah! Of course. That'll do. Well, chop chop outsiders. Pack up here!
True Colours#339.dst: 아! 그러죠. 그거면 됐어요. 자, 서둘러요 외부인들. 여기 정리해요!
True Colours#339.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#341.src: Head to the meet up place at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#342.src: These talismans... the colors, pink green blue white gold... the shapes... there's something. There's something.
True Colours#342.dst: 이 호부들... 색깔, 분홍 초록 파랑 하양 금색... 모양들... 뭔가 있어. 분명 뭔가 있어.
True Colours#342.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#343.src: I'm getting close, I can feel it. I just need... a little more time.
True Colours#343.dst: 거의 다 왔어, 느낌이 와. 그냥... 시간이 조금만 더 있으면 돼.
True Colours#343.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#344.src: They keep talking like we aren't here...
True Colours#344.speaker: Sui

True Colours#345.src: It's... it's okay. I know they're alive. There's hope! There's hope, there's hope, there's hope.
True Colours#345.dst: 괜... 괜찮아. 다들 살아 있어. 희망이 있어! 희망이 있어, 희망이 있어, 희망이 있어.
True Colours#345.speaker: Sui

True Colours#347.src: Ugh! I need to get to my lists. I can't think straight!
True Colours#347.dst: 하! 목록부터 봐야겠어요. 생각이 정리가 안 돼요!
True Colours#347.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#348.src: Well, it's a good thing we have the emergency shelter! A shame it's in a cave. Sigh...
True Colours#348.dst: 뭐, 비상 대피소가 있어서 다행이죠! 동굴에 있는 게 아쉽지만. 하아...
True Colours#348.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#351.src: Well well well well! And there they all are!
True Colours#351.dst: 이런 이런 이런 이런! 다들 모였네요!
True Colours#351.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#352.src: Greetings are in order to the little doves! Ready to get moving then?
True Colours#352.dst: 작은 비둘기들에게 인사를 건네야죠! 그럼 출발할 준비됐나요?
True Colours#352.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#354.src: Owls? Why, yes, of course - but you, dear friends, are doves. The small and defenseless, in dire need of aid...
True Colours#354.dst: 올빼미요? 그야 당연하죠 - 하지만 친애하는 친구들, 그대들은 비둘기예요. 작고 무방비해서 도움이 절실한...
True Colours#354.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#355.src: Captain, if we're all in order, shouldn't we get moving? We're to lead them to the next hideout.
True Colours#355.dst: 대장, 다 모였으면 슬슬 출발해야 하지 않습니까? 다음 은신처까지 안내해야 합니다.
True Colours#355.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#356.src: Right you are! Right you are, indeed. Then to the north we shall fly, little doves and silent owls!
True Colours#356.dst: 맞아요! 정말 맞는 말이에요. 그럼 북쪽으로 날아가죠, 작은 비둘기들과 조용한 올빼미들이여!
True Colours#356.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#357.src: Meet up with Sui, Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#358.src: And so we fly forth, birds of the flock! Onwards we go!
True Colours#358.dst: 자 날아가자, 무리의 새들이여! 앞으로 전진!
True Colours#358.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#361.src: Oof! My goodness, they don't make these things quite like they used to! Since when have the ziplines been so... exhilerating?
True Colours#361.dst: 어이쿠! 세상에, 요즘 물건은 예전 같지가 않네요! 집라인이 언제부터 이렇게... 짜릿해졌죠?
True Colours#361.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#362.src: Not the most graceful landing, captain.
True Colours#362.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#363.src: Oh, what do you know?! Why don't you try to land gracefully in a- in- in a-... see how you do!!
True Colours#363.dst: 아, 뭘 안다고요?! 그럼 직접 우아하게 착지해 보시든가- 어- 어디- ...얼마나 잘하나 봅시다!!
True Colours#363.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#364.src: Ahem. Shall we get moving then? Over the hills and down the road, to the meet up spot we go!
True Colours#364.dst: 흠흠. 그럼 출발할까요? 언덕을 넘고 길을 따라, 회합 장소로 갑시다!
True Colours#364.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#365.src: ...{u}, Yusanu. When we get to safety, we... we should talk about what to do next.
True Colours#365.dst: ...{u}, Yusanu. 안전한 곳에 닿으면, 우리... 다음에 뭘 할지 얘기해야 해.
True Colours#365.speaker: Sui

True Colours#366.src: Rex, Zeph... Mora... if- if they're here, then... then...
True Colours#366.dst: Rex, Zeph... Mora... 그, 그 사람들이 여기 있다면, 그럼... 그럼...
True Colours#366.speaker: Sui

True Colours#367.src: Don't worry, Sui, I... I get it. We'll do whatever we can to get your brother out of there. Promise.
True Colours#367.dst: 걱정 마, Sui, 나... 이해해. 네 오빠 꺼내려고 할 수 있는 건 다 할게. 약속해.
True Colours#367.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#368.src: Speaking of the prodigal son and his companions, are we! My my, what a tragic tale... but perhaps I have an inkling of their present whereabouts.
True Colours#368.dst: 돌아온 탕아와 그 동료들 얘기군요! 저런 저런, 참으로 비극적인 이야기죠... 그런데 지금 어디 있는지 어렴풋이 짐작이 가요.
True Colours#368.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#369.src: You- you do? Why... why didn't you tell us sooner?!
True Colours#369.dst: 저, 정말요? 왜... 왜 더 일찍 말 안 했어요?!
True Colours#369.speaker: Sui

True Colours#370.src: Ah ah! Sensitive information is for sensitive ears alone. I believed it best to wait for better circumstances... too many unknown faces back at the Canopy.
True Colours#370.dst: 아아! 민감한 정보는 민감한 귀에만 가는 법. 더 나은 때를 기다리는 게 낫다고 봤죠... 수관엔 낯선 얼굴이 너무 많거든요.
True Colours#370.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#371.src: Well, silent owls? Fly forth, update the others at the hideout on our whereabouts! I'll keep an eye on our little doves as we discuss matters further.
True Colours#371.dst: 자, 조용한 올빼미들? 날아가서 은신처 사람들에게 우리 행방을 알려요! 난 얘기를 더 나누며 작은 비둘기들을 지켜볼게요.
True Colours#371.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#372.src: ...you're the boss, Captain. If you say so.
True Colours#372.speaker: Canopy Owl

True Colours#373.src: And I do say so! Well, chop chop, get it moving, wouldn't you?
True Colours#373.dst: 당연히 그렇죠! 자, 서둘러요, 어서 움직여야죠?
True Colours#373.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#374.src: Ah... authority is its own sort of treat, isn't it?
True Colours#374.dst: 아... 권위란 것도 나름의 즐거움이죠, 안 그래요?
True Colours#374.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#375.src: Rurie, you said you had a lead. What is it?
True Colours#375.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#376.src: So impatient! So so impatient. Yes, fine, there is a military outpost just to the east, a flap of the wings as the bird flies! I will take you there.
True Colours#376.dst: 성급하기도 하지! 참 성급해요. 좋아요, 동쪽에 군사 전초기지가 있어요, 새라면 날개 한 번 칠 거리죠! 제가 데려다줄게요.
True Colours#376.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#377.src: Uh... isn't that dangerous? You said that's where all the ch-
True Colours#377.dst: 어... 위험하지 않아요? 거기가 바로 변-
True Colours#377.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#378.src: Yes well not everything can be so easy, can it?! Be brave! Take risks! Et cetera, et cetera.
True Colours#378.dst: 그야 모든 일이 쉬울 순 없잖아요?! 용감해져요! 위험을 감수해요! 기타 등등, 기타 등등.
True Colours#378.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#379.src: And with all the guards and soldiers and riffraff mobilized to the Canopy, it certainly will be simpler to sneak in! You do want to save your brother do you not?
True Colours#379.dst: 게다가 경비병이며 병사며 잡것들이 죄다 수관으로 몰려갔으니 잠입하기가 훨씬 쉽겠죠! 오빠를 구하고 싶지 않아요?
True Colours#379.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#380.src: ...still. We- we aren't much of fighters! If... if we get caught...
True Colours#380.dst: ...그래도요. 우, 우린 싸움을 잘 못해요! 만약... 잡히면...
True Colours#380.speaker: Sui

True Colours#381.src: I- we can't, keep putting all the work on {u}'s shoulders. We need a better plan!
True Colours#381.dst: 우, 우린 계속 {u}한테만 짐을 떠넘길 순 없어요. 더 나은 계획이 필요해요!
True Colours#381.speaker: Sui

True Colours#382.src: Alas, it is now or it is never. Tick tock tick tock, time's running out, little doves! Onwards we shall fly, to save friend and family alike!
True Colours#382.dst: 아쉽게도 지금이 아니면 기회는 없어요. 째깍째깍, 시간이 없어요, 작은 비둘기들! 친구도 가족도 구하러 날아갑시다!
True Colours#382.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#386.src: A problem? No... no, no no, there is no problem here! All is just as it should be.
True Colours#386.dst: 문제요? 아뇨... 아뇨, 아뇨 아뇨, 아무 문제 없어요! 모든 게 있어야 할 대로죠.
True Colours#386.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#387.src: Are... are you- are you sure? You're... you're starting to scare me, Rurie.
True Colours#387.dst: 저... 저, 정말요? 슬슬... 무서워지려고 해요, Rurie.
True Colours#387.speaker: Sui

True Colours#388.src: H- huh?! Wh- what's going on?!
True Colours#388.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#391.src: Th- thank you, Sui, that... I don't... you- you're really, uh, getting the hang of that ice stuff, aren't you?
True Colours#391.dst: 고, 고마워, Sui, 그거... 나 참... 너, 너 그 얼음 다루는 거, 어, 진짜 늘었구나?
True Colours#391.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#392.src: I... I didn't even... do that intentionally. It was... reflexive...
True Colours#392.dst: 나... 난 일부러... 한 것도 아니야. 그냥... 반사적으로...
True Colours#392.speaker: Sui

True Colours#393.src: B-but, more... more importantly- what happened? Where's- where's Rurie?
True Colours#393.dst: 그, 그보다... 더 중요한 건- 무슨 일이야? Rurie는- Rurie는 어디 있어?
True Colours#393.speaker: Sui

True Colours#397.src: Those... those must have been changelings!
True Colours#397.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#398.src: Oho! Impressive stuff. Simple pieces of paper in appearance... but they pack a punch. Rather useful!
True Colours#398.dst: 오호! 훌륭하네요. 겉보기엔 그냥 종잇조각인데... 위력이 상당해요. 꽤 쓸 만하군요!
True Colours#398.speaker: Fuhue

True Colours#399.src: Easier than expected. Should use more- eugh, no no no, don't like this one at all.
True Colours#399.dst: 생각보다 쉬웠다. 더 써야겠- 으윽, 아니 아니 아니, 이건 영 마음에 안 들어.
True Colours#399.speaker: Cileon

True Colours#400.src: Ah, much improved! Now this - what an enjoyable form it has been, yes yes yes! The drama, the intrigue! Perhaps it would do to use it more, hm hm hm!
True Colours#400.dst: 아, 훨씬 낫군! 이건 - 참으로 즐거운 모습이었어, 그래 그래 그래! 그 극적인 맛, 그 음모! 앞으로 더 써도 좋겠어, 흠 흠 흠!
True Colours#400.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#401.src: Who am I? Why, I am Captain Rurie, leader of the owls! Master of the mists, eyes and ears of the trees - runaway FOOL from higher lands!!!!
True Colours#401.dst: 내가 누구냐고? 아니 난 올빼미들의 우두머리, Rurie 대장이지! 안개의 주인, 숲의 눈과 귀 - 높은 땅에서 도망친 멍청이!!!!
True Colours#401.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#402.src: Oh but no no no, I should think you have it figured out by now! Is it not obvious?
True Colours#402.dst: 아 아니 아니 아니, 지금쯤이면 눈치챘을 텐데! 뻔하지 않아?
True Colours#402.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#403.src: What a delight! This before you is the form of the Ranger {p}, Sovereign to these secretive little ants! The name it was given is Gikyo.
True Colours#403.dst: 참 즐겁군! 네 앞의 이 모습은 {p}의 레인저, 이 은밀한 작은 개미들의 군주다! 주어진 이름은 Gikyo.
True Colours#403.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#404.src: To think there has been a struggle to take you in so far yet the task proved simple and easy! How delightful! The Sovereign Forest will be furious!
True Colours#404.dst: 여태 너를 잡으려 그리 애썼는데 이리 간단하고 쉬울 줄이야! 참 즐겁군! Sovereign Forest가 길길이 뛰겠어!
True Colours#404.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#405.src: But that is enough talk and secrets spilling. It is time, crown's wanted! Time for you to go...
True Colours#405.dst: 하지만 말도 비밀도 충분히 흘렸다. 때가 됐어, 왕실의 수배자여! 이제 갈 시간이다...
True Colours#405.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#406.src: Talk to Sui and Yusanu. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#406.dst: Sui와 Yusanu에게 말을 거세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#408.src: Is this really it, then? Ordeal after ordeal and this is where it leads?
True Colours#408.dst: 결국 이게 끝이야? 고비를 넘고 또 넘어서 도착한 곳이 여기야?
True Colours#408.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#409.src: Will it ever end? What's the point? The crown's after us now, and- and they're not going to stop!! Why- why even try?!
True Colours#409.dst: 끝나긴 할까? 무슨 의미가 있어? 이젠 왕실이 우릴 쫓고, 그, 그들은 멈추지 않을 거야!! 왜, 왜 애를 써?!
True Colours#409.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#410.src: Yusanu! Y-you need to... to get yourself together! Please, d-don't lose your head now... n-not here, of all places.
True Colours#410.dst: Yusanu! 너, 너 정신... 정신 좀 차려! 제발, 지, 지금 무너지면 안 돼... 하, 하필 여기선.
True Colours#410.speaker: Sui

True Colours#411.src: I... ha, I- I know it feels hard. Im-impossible, even! A-and maybe I'm, I'm just putting on a brave face... I- I want to lie down and j-just wait for the, the inevitable, as much as you do!!
True Colours#411.dst: 나... 하, 나, 나도 힘든 거 알아. 부, 불가능해 보이는 것도! 그, 그리고 어쩌면 나도 괜찮은 척하는 걸지도... 나, 나도 너만큼 드러누워서 그, 그냥 피할 수 없는 걸 기다리고 싶어!!
True Colours#411.speaker: Sui

True Colours#412.src: But... b-but not now. We're- we're here, a-and they're so close. Mora, Rex, Zeph... we- we have some hope! S-so... don't give up. Not now!
True Colours#412.dst: 하지만... 지, 지금은 안 돼. 우린, 우린 여기 있고, 그, 그들은 아주 가까워. Mora, Rex, Zeph... 우, 우린 희망이 있어! 그, 그러니까... 포기하지 마. 지금은 안 돼!
True Colours#412.speaker: Sui

True Colours#414.src: ...okay. Then... where do we start? They... they took all of our belongings... and you can't cast spells without your weapon, can you?
True Colours#414.dst: ...알았어. 그럼... 어디서부터 시작해? 그들이... 우리 물건을 다 가져갔잖아... 넌 무기 없으면 주문 못 쓰지?
True Colours#414.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#415.src: I... I still have my magic. I can... I can try.
True Colours#415.dst: 나... 난 아직 마법이 있어. 내가... 내가 해 볼게.
True Colours#415.speaker: Sui

True Colours#417.src: N-not... that. I... ugh, why is this so hard all of a sudden...?
True Colours#417.dst: 그, 그거... 말고. 나... 으, 왜 갑자기 이렇게 어렵지...?
True Colours#417.speaker: Sui

True Colours#418.src: Oh, sh- shut up! I- I'm trying, okay!
True Colours#418.dst: 아, 조, 조용히 해! 나, 나 노력 중이야!
True Colours#418.speaker: Sui

True Colours#420.src: ...oh. Oh, oh- I think I know a way out!
True Colours#420.dst: ...아. 아, 아- 나갈 방법을 알 것 같아!
True Colours#420.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#421.src: Look, this- this appears to be tempered glass!
True Colours#421.dst: 봐, 이건- 이건 강화 유리인 것 같아!
True Colours#421.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#422.src: Um... I... I have no idea what that means.
True Colours#422.dst: 음... 난... 그게 무슨 말인지 전혀 모르겠어.
True Colours#422.speaker: Sui

True Colours#423.src: No, look- it's one of the inventions I assisted Soosu with. I didn't know what its purpose was at the time, but... I guess this fits.
True Colours#423.dst: 아니, 봐- 내가 Soosu를 도와 만든 발명품 중 하나야. 그땐 용도를 몰랐는데... 이제 보니 이거였나 봐.
True Colours#423.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#424.src: Tempered glass is incredibly strong and durable. It resists most attempts to break it, except - except for striking the edge of the glass with a sharp object.
True Colours#424.dst: 강화 유리는 엄청나게 단단하고 튼튼해. 웬만한 방법으론 안 깨져, 딱 하나 - 날카로운 걸로 유리 가장자리를 치는 것만 빼고.
True Colours#424.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#425.src: And, Sui! If you could make an icicle with your magic... and strike the edge...
True Colours#425.dst: 그리고 Sui! 네 마법으로 고드름을 만들어서... 가장자리를 치면...
True Colours#425.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#426.src: ...then we could get out? I... m-maybe. But, y-you just saw me- um, nearly flood our cell with... sewage...
True Colours#426.dst: ...그럼 나갈 수 있어? 나... 어, 어쩌면. 근데, 너, 너도 방금 봤잖아- 음, 하마터면 감방을... 오수로 채울 뻔한 거...
True Colours#426.speaker: Sui

True Colours#427.src: Sui. You were the one just giving me a pep talk. Come on, you can do it!
True Colours#427.dst: Sui. 방금 나한테 기운 내라고 한 건 너야. 자, 넌 할 수 있어!
True Colours#427.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#428.src: ...okay. Okay, you- you're right! I can... I can do this. I can.
True Colours#428.dst: ...알았어. 알았어, 네, 네 말이 맞아! 난... 난 할 수 있어. 할 수 있어.
True Colours#428.speaker: Sui

True Colours#430.src: I- ha, I, I did it!!
True Colours#430.speaker: Sui

True Colours#431.src: That's the first step! We've got the sharp object, now... aim for the corner!
True Colours#431.dst: 첫 단계 성공! 날카로운 건 생겼으니, 이제... 모서리를 노려!
True Colours#431.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#432.src: It- it worked! Ha... hahaha... oh, it worked...
True Colours#432.dst: 되, 됐어! 하... 하하하... 아, 됐어...
True Colours#432.speaker: Sui

True Colours#433.src: Find Captain Rurie. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#433.dst: Rurie 대장을 찾으세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#434.src: L-let's go, then! Let's find the others, and- and get out of here!
True Colours#434.dst: 그, 그럼 가자! 다른 사람들을 찾아서, 여, 여기서 나가자!
True Colours#434.speaker: Sui

True Colours#435.src: Well! Hoo hoo, my little friends!
True Colours#435.dst: 어이! 후 후, 나의 작은 친구들!
True Colours#435.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#437.src: Uh... duh? That devilish snake got the drop on me when I went up to the owls' nest! Those changelings certainly do not play fair, let me tell you...
True Colours#437.dst: 어... 당연하죠? 올빼미 둥지에 올라갔다가 그 악랄한 뱀한테 당했어요! 그 변신자들, 정말 반칙만 쓴다니까요...
True Colours#437.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#438.src: How... how can we know for sure it's, um, really him?
True Colours#438.dst: 어떻게... 어떻게 저게, 음, 진짜인지 확신해?
True Colours#438.speaker: Sui

True Colours#439.src: What?! Is it not obvious that I am who I say I- oh, whatever, something something it's protocol. Fine.
True Colours#439.dst: 뭐요?! 내가 나라는 게 뻔하지 않- 아, 됐어요, 뭐 어쩌고 규정이라 이거죠. 좋아요.
True Colours#439.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#440.src: Hm... I don't think changelings have access to memories, do they? Rurie, where did we first meet?
True Colours#440.dst: 음... 변신자는 기억까진 못 읽죠? Rurie, 우리 처음 만난 데가 어디였죠?
True Colours#440.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#441.src: Yes, finally, some sense! It was in that cave! My owls and I captured you as leverage, and if I do recall correctly, you nearly cried like a little baby! Ah, memories...
True Colours#441.dst: 그래요, 드디어 말이 통하네! 그 동굴이었죠! 나랑 올빼미들이 인질로 당신들을 잡았고, 내 기억이 맞다면 당신은 아기처럼 울 뻔했죠! 아, 추억이여...
True Colours#441.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#443.src: Finally! Now then, time for us to get moving!
True Colours#443.dst: 드디어! 자 그럼, 이제 움직일 시간이에요!
True Colours#443.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#444.src: THEY LEFT YOUR KNIVES ON YOU?!
True Colours#444.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#445.src: Oh, no, no no no. They certainly did take them, alright! Seems they missed a few in my boots, though! Lucky me!
True Colours#445.dst: 아, 아뇨, 아뇨 아뇨. 분명히 다 가져갔죠! 근데 부츠 안에 있던 몇 자루는 놓쳤나 봐요! 운이 좋죠!
True Colours#445.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#446.src: Now, I simply couldn't help but overhear you little loudmouths, so I came up with a plan while you were debating whether I was real or not!
True Colours#446.dst: 자, 이 시끄러운 꼬마들 얘기가 안 들릴 수가 없더군요. 그래서 내가 진짜인지 따지는 동안 계획을 하나 세웠죠!
True Colours#446.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#447.src: Yusanu. That device of yours is quite important, isn't it? I'll help you fetch it - hopefully add a few more to my kill list along the way, eh?
True Colours#447.dst: Yusanu. 그 장치가 꽤 중요하죠? 되찾는 걸 내가 도울게요 - 가는 길에 내 처치 목록도 몇 개 늘리면 좋고요, 어때요?
True Colours#447.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#448.src: And Sui... go find your family. Important to hold onto those you love, isn't it? You and {u} can handle this, I'm sure, but... be careful.
True Colours#448.dst: 그리고 Sui... 가족을 찾아요. 사랑하는 이를 붙드는 건 중요하니까요, 그렇죠? 당신과 {u}면 해낼 거예요, 분명히. 다만... 조심해요.
True Colours#448.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#450.src: Well then! Let's skedaddle, kiddos! Good luck out there!
True Colours#450.dst: 자 그럼! 튀자고요, 얘들아! 밖에서 행운을 빌어요!
True Colours#450.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#451.src: Let's... try and find our stuff. We, ha, can't really handle a whole fort of changelings without your weapon, can we?
True Colours#451.dst: 우리... 짐부터 찾아보자. 하, 네 무기도 없이 요새 가득한 변신자를 상대할 순 없잖아?
True Colours#451.speaker: Sui

True Colours#452.src: Find your weapon before you proceed further. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#452.dst: 더 나아가기 전에 무기를 찾으세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#453.src: Hey! We can't leave without our belongings.
True Colours#453.dst: 야! 짐도 없이 갈 순 없어.
True Colours#453.speaker: Sui

True Colours#456.src: I... I hope so, but... I'm not sure. The ocean still feels... off. Like, like a step to the left.
True Colours#456.dst: 나... 그러길 바라는데... 잘 모르겠어. 바다가 아직... 이상해. 뭐랄까, 한 발짝 왼쪽으로 어긋난 느낌.
True Colours#456.speaker: Sui

True Colours#457.src: I... don't really, I don't have anything worth grabbing, here...
True Colours#457.dst: 난... 딱히, 여기 챙길 만한 건 없어...
True Colours#457.speaker: Sui

True Colours#458.src: Uh, I found this map... come here.
True Colours#458.dst: 어, 이 지도 찾았어... 이리 와 봐.
True Colours#458.speaker: Sui

True Colours#460.src: "{p}, Changeling Facility." So... this whole place is, um, probably crawling with them.
True Colours#460.dst: "{p}, 변신자 시설." 그럼... 이 일대는, 음, 아마 그것들 천지겠네.
True Colours#460.speaker: Sui

True Colours#461.src: This... this m-might be, um, harder than I thought it might be. B-but! I can't give up. They're so close... where are they...?
True Colours#461.dst: 이건... 이건 생각보다, 음, 더 어, 어려울지도 몰라. 그, 그래도! 포기 못 해. 이렇게 가까운데... 어디 있는 걸까...?
True Colours#461.speaker: Sui

True Colours#463.src: And the Sovereign's office looks like it's at the very back of the building...
True Colours#463.dst: 그리고 군주 집무실은 건물 맨 안쪽인 것 같아...
True Colours#463.speaker: Sui

True Colours#464.src: There's a, another block of cells right outside. If we're careful enough... maybe we can avoid a confrontation with the Sovereign.
True Colours#464.dst: 바, 바로 밖에 감방 구역이 하나 더 있어. 충분히 조심하면... 군주랑 정면으로 부딪히는 건 피할 수 있을지도.
True Colours#464.speaker: Sui

True Colours#465.src: ...th-thanks for being here, {u}. I... I would've given up a long time ago if you weren't.
True Colours#465.dst: ...여, 여기 있어 줘서 고마워, {u}. 네가 없었으면... 난 진작에 포기했을 거야.
True Colours#465.speaker: Sui

True Colours#466.src: Continue exploring the Changeling Camp and look for your friends. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#466.dst: 변신자 야영지를 계속 탐색하며 친구들을 찾으세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#467.src: Continue to the Officer's Quarters in the southern wing. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#467.dst: 남쪽 구역의 장교 숙소로 계속 가세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#468.src: Here for a duel?! I love duels?! I love fighting?! I love life?!
True Colours#468.dst: 결투하러 왔나?! 난 결투가 좋아?! 싸움이 좋아?! 인생이 좋아?!

True Colours#469.src: C-careful! That's... Sovereign Gikyo's office up ahead. Let's, um, try and avoid them.
True Colours#469.dst: 조, 조심해! 저 앞이... Gikyo 군주 집무실이야. 음, 최대한 피해서 가자.
True Colours#469.speaker: Sui

True Colours#471.src: No... n-no, no no no, no- no...
True Colours#471.dst: 아니... 아, 아니, 아니 아니 아니...
True Colours#471.speaker: Sui

True Colours#472.src: It's... it's a ticket. From the... Steel Feather... the ones... Quill gave us...
True Colours#472.dst: 이건... 이건 표야. 그... Steel Feather... Quill이... 우리한테 준...
True Colours#472.speaker: Sui

True Colours#474.src: There- ha, there, th-there's no way s-some-someone could, ha, survive... this...
True Colours#474.dst: 이건- 하, 이건, 누, 누구도, 하, 살아남을 수... 없어... 이런 건...
True Colours#474.speaker: Sui

True Colours#475.src: How... h-how dare they... how DARE they?! Th-they have to pay for this, {u}, they- they have to!!
True Colours#475.dst: 어떻게... 가, 감히... 감히 어떻게?! 대, 대가를 치러야 해, {u}, 반, 반드시!!
True Colours#475.speaker: Sui

True Colours#476.src: Come on... come on, come on, we- we need to confront Gikyo, we- come on!!
True Colours#476.dst: 가자... 가자, 가자, 우, 우린 Gikyo랑 맞서야 해, 어, 어서!!
True Colours#476.speaker: Sui

True Colours#477.src: Head to Sovereign Gikyo's office to confront them. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#477.dst: Gikyo 군주와 맞서러 집무실로 가세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#480.src: Well well, look who has stumbled on in! If it is not the crown's number one wanted and the silly weak sister! Were you not locked up?
True Colours#480.dst: 이런 이런, 누가 굴러들어 왔나! 왕실 제일의 수배자와 어리석고 나약한 여동생 아닌가! 갇혀 있지 않았나?
True Colours#480.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#481.src: No... you... wh- what did you... what did you DO?!
True Colours#481.dst: 아니... 너... 무, 무슨 짓을... 무슨 짓을 한 거야?!
True Colours#481.speaker: Sui

True Colours#482.src: Hehehehahaha! Oh, this? Why it's the prodigal son of course! Go on, say hello to your little sister, big brother!!
True Colours#482.dst: 헤헤헤하하하! 아, 이거? 당연히 돌아온 탕아지! 자, 여동생한테 인사해야지, 오빠!!
True Colours#482.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#483.src: You should know I did offer the opportunity to speak, yes yes indeed! If only he would have spat up all those deep deep secrets on your group... could his pain have been avoided?
True Colours#483.dst: 말할 기회는 분명히 줬다는 걸 알아야 해, 그래 그래 정말로! 너희 무리의 깊고 깊은 비밀을 다 뱉어 냈더라면... 이 고통은 피할 수 있었을까?
True Colours#483.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#484.src: But but but but but sad as it is, he refused to say a word! What a shame indeed, indeed. A long deep dark painful agonizing death it was!
True Colours#484.dst: 그런데 그런데 그런데 그런데, 안타깝게도 한마디도 안 하더군! 참으로 아쉬워, 아쉬워. 길고 깊고 어둡고 고통스럽고 괴로운 죽음이었지!
True Colours#484.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#485.src: Well since you are here and the rest are taken it would seem it was for naught! I have every little dove just where I want them, yes yes I do.
True Colours#485.dst: 너도 여기 왔고 나머지도 잡혔으니 다 헛수고였나 보군! 작은 비둘기들 전부 내가 원하는 자리에 있어, 그래 그래 그렇지.
True Colours#485.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#486.src: Yes! Shooty girl and wind boy! Rex and Zeph I believe it was?
True Colours#486.dst: 그래! 활 쏘는 계집애와 바람 꼬마! Rex와 Zeph였던가?
True Colours#486.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#487.src: Wind boy was always crying and screaming... how pathetic. But shooty girl... yes shooty girl was a delight.
True Colours#487.dst: 바람 꼬마는 늘 울고 비명만 질렀지... 참 한심해. 하지만 활 쏘는 계집애는... 그래 그 애는 즐거웠어.
True Colours#487.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#488.src: Never let out a word no matter the pain! The ones like her are always the most most most fun to crack, yes they are.
True Colours#488.dst: 아무리 아파도 한마디도 안 뱉더군! 그런 애들이 늘 가장 가장 가장 부수는 재미가 있지, 그래 그렇고말고.
True Colours#488.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#489.src: Alas... all good things must come to an end it would seem! The killjoy Sovereign {p}, swooping in and ruining ALL my fun...
True Colours#489.dst: 아아... 좋은 일에는 끝이 있는 법인가! 흥을 깨는 {p} 군주가 날아들어 내 재미를 전부 망쳐 놨지...
True Colours#489.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#490.src: Noooo Gikyo you cannot keep your prisoners no matter how much you wish, no no no, the people {p} demand their girl returned and well who am I to stand against them?
True Colours#490.dst: 안 되지 Gikyo, 아무리 원해도 죄수를 계속 둘 순 없어, 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼, {p} 사람들이 자기네 아이를 돌려 달라는데 내가 무슨 수로 맞서겠나?
True Colours#490.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#491.src: And so ended the fun that was being had! But I had the last laugh, ehehehaha. The Athassa girl could take one and not both of the companions! A choice? A choice!
True Colours#491.dst: 그렇게 한창이던 재미가 끝났지! 하지만 마지막에 웃은 건 나야, 에헤헤하하. Athassa 계집애는 동료 둘 중 하나만 데려갈 수 있었거든! 선택? 선택!
True Colours#491.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#492.src: Oh the noble hero that he was, he chose to stay! What a bore. But what a joy! What a joy joy joy joy joy!
True Colours#492.dst: 고귀한 영웅답게 그는 남기를 택했지! 참 지루해. 하지만 참 기뻐! 기뻐 기뻐 기뻐 기뻐 기뻐!
True Colours#492.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#493.src: And now where is he? Bleeding out, dying, fading, vanishing with each and every passing moment! And it would seem perhaps he is the lucky one!
True Colours#493.dst: 그래서 지금 그는 어디 있지? 피 흘리고, 죽어 가고, 흐려지고, 매 순간 사라져 가지! 어쩌면 그가 운 좋은 쪽인지도!
True Colours#493.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#494.src: Well then! Would you care to join him in this dance? To the end of days - yours end HERE and NOW!
True Colours#494.dst: 그럼! 너도 이 춤에 끼겠나? 세상 끝날 때까지 - 네 끝은 지금 여기다!
True Colours#494.speaker: Sovereign Gikyo

True Colours#495.src: Defeat Sovereign Gikyo. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#495.dst: Gikyo 군주를 물리치세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#496.src: Check up on Sui. If you need to return to the camp, go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
True Colours#496.dst: Sui의 상태를 살피세요. 야영지로 돌아가려면 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]로 가세요.

True Colours#497.src: He's... he's my brother... give... give him... back...
True Colours#497.speaker: Sui

True Colours#500.src: He's dead. He's... dead he's dead he's dead, but so is that BASTARD!!!
True Colours#500.dst: 죽었어. 오빠가... 죽었어 죽었어 죽었어, 근데 저 개자식도 죽었어!!!
True Colours#500.speaker: Sui

True Colours#501.src: And it... it... it doesn't even matter. I killed them, and... and... and what now? M- Mora, he's- he's still...
True Colours#501.dst: 근데 그게... 그게... 아무 의미도 없어. 내가 죽였는데... 그래서... 이제 뭐? Mo- Mora는, 오빠는- 여전히...
True Colours#501.speaker: Sui

True Colours#504.src: No?? Then what do you CALL this?! Rex and Zeph are gone and Mora is- h-he's... he... he's...
True Colours#504.dst: 아니라고?? 그럼 이걸 뭐라고 해?! Rex랑 Zeph는 사라졌고 Mora는- 오, 오빠는... 오빠는...
True Colours#504.speaker: Sui

True Colours#505.src: We... we weren't fast enough... we took too long to get here, a-and now... and now...
True Colours#505.dst: 우린... 우린 충분히 빠르지 않았어... 여기 오는 데 너무 오래 걸렸고, 그, 그래서 이제... 이제...
True Colours#505.speaker: Sui

True Colours#506.src: I already GOT revenge, {u}!! I didn't... I didn't know I... it- it happened so fast, and... and... I killed them. I got revenge and... and I still feel hollow.
True Colours#506.dst: 난 이미 복수했어, {u}!! 난... 난 몰랐어 내가... 그, 그렇게 순식간이었고, 그리고... 그리고... 내가 죽였어. 복수했는데... 그런데도 속이 텅 빈 것 같아.
True Colours#506.speaker: Sui

True Colours#507.src: He's... gone. He's gone, and- a-and I can't... I can't get him back...
True Colours#507.dst: 오빠는... 갔어. 가 버렸고, 그, 그리고 난... 되돌릴 수 없어...
True Colours#507.speaker: Sui

True Colours#509.src: We- we need to g-get out of here, I- I- I can't... I can't be here. I can't... I c-can't look at him.
True Colours#509.dst: 우, 우린 여기서 나, 나가야 해, 난- 난- 못... 여기 못 있겠어. 난... 오빠를 못 보겠어.
True Colours#509.speaker: Sui

True Colours#511.src: ...this is all my fault, isn't it?
True Colours#511.speaker: Sui

True Colours#512.src: I- I- all I've been DOING this whole time has been crying, worrying, and- and- and being USELESS!
True Colours#512.dst: 난- 난- 그동안 한 거라곤 울고, 걱정하고, 그, 그, 그리고 아무 쓸모도 없던 것뿐이야!
True Colours#512.speaker: Sui

True Colours#513.src: I was so afraid of my cur-... why, why, WHY can't I break that habit?! Magic. Magic magic magic magic MAGIC!!
True Colours#513.dst: 난 내 저주가 너무 무서워서- ...왜, 왜, 왜 이 버릇을 못 고칠까?! 마법. 마법 마법 마법 마법 마법!!
True Colours#513.speaker: Sui

True Colours#514.src: I was so afraid that I never even tried!! If I had, if I- I- if I'd have learned more, been stronger...
True Colours#514.dst: 너무 무서워서 시도조차 안 했어!! 했더라면, 내가- 내가- 더 배웠더라면, 더 강했더라면...
True Colours#514.speaker: Sui

True Colours#515.src: I... I could have... I could have saved him. I could have protected him, I could have healed him, I could have-
True Colours#515.dst: 난... 난 구할 수... 오빠를 구할 수 있었어. 지킬 수도, 치료할 수도, 난 할 수-
True Colours#515.speaker: Sui

True Colours#516.src: But no, of COURSE NOT!! Because I'm worthless and useless and can't help ANYONE!!
True Colours#516.dst: 하지만 아니지, 당연히 아니야!! 난 하찮고 쓸모없고 아무도 못 도우니까!!
True Colours#516.speaker: Sui

True Colours#518.src: Rex and Zeph are- they're still out there. {u}, {u}, we can still save them. We- we know where they are!!
True Colours#518.dst: Rex랑 Zeph는- 아직 살아 있어. {u}, {u}, 아직 구할 수 있어. 우, 우린 어디 있는지 알잖아!!
True Colours#518.speaker: Sui

True Colours#519.src: We just... we just need to find the {p} Sovereign. He has them, he- he has to. He... he has to.
True Colours#519.dst: 그냥... {p} 군주만 찾으면 돼. 그자가 데리고 있어, 분, 분명히. 분명... 그럴 거야.
True Colours#519.speaker: Sui

True Colours#520.src: ...let's go. We can't- we can't let this happen again.
True Colours#520.dst: ...가자. 이런 일이- 다시는 이런 일이 생기게 둘 순 없어.
True Colours#520.speaker: Sui

True Colours#521.src: Meet up with Yusanu and Captain Rurie at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

True Colours#523.src: Hello, dear friends! I see you have returned to us safe and sound!
True Colours#523.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#524.src: We found everything we were looking for, and- and more!! Plans, Sui, plans!! Of Deraj prison!!
True Colours#524.dst: 찾던 걸 전부 찾았어, 그, 그 이상도!! 설계도야, Sui, 설계도!! Deraj 감옥의!!
True Colours#524.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#525.src: It would seem our dear Changeling Sovereign worked closely with the prison's warden... for what purpose remains unclear, though I imagine something changeling-adjacent?
True Colours#525.dst: 우리의 친애하는 변신자 군주가 감옥의 교도소장과 긴밀히 일한 모양이에요... 무슨 목적인지는 아직 모르지만, 변신자와 관련된 일이겠죠?
True Colours#525.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#526.src: Sui, with- with these plans, we could... we could stand a chance of breaking everyone out! We could- we could get them all back!
True Colours#526.dst: Sui, 이, 이 설계도가 있으면... 다들 탈출시킬 승산이 있어! 우린- 우린 전부 되찾을 수 있어!
True Colours#526.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#532.src: They're gone, Yusanu! Mora's- Mora's dead.
True Colours#532.dst: 다 사라졌어, Yusanu! Mora는- Mora는 죽었어.
True Colours#532.speaker: Sui

True Colours#533.src: The Sovereign, they... they killed him.
True Colours#533.speaker: Sui

True Colours#535.src: Just... gone. Taken to the {p}. But, Mora is- he's-
True Colours#535.dst: 그냥... 사라졌어. {p}(으)로 끌려갔대. 근데 Mora는- 오빠는-
True Colours#535.speaker: Sui

True Colours#536.src: So. So, I- I'm glad you have hope! For... for getting your people back! Good for you!!
True Colours#536.dst: 그래. 그래, 너, 넌 희망이 있어서 좋겠다! 네... 네 사람들을 되찾을 희망! 잘됐네!!
True Colours#536.speaker: Sui

True Colours#537.src: Emotions are... certainly running high right now, aren't they! Why don't we, ah, regroup with the rest of the Canopy, and... take some time?
True Colours#537.dst: 감정이... 지금 많이 격해졌네요! 우리, 어, 수관 사람들과 다시 합류해서... 시간을 좀 갖는 게 어때요?
True Colours#537.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#538.src: Take. Some Time? No. No, I'm done taking time. I'm done crying, I'm done worrying! I'm so... so... angry! At the Crown, at myself, at- at Mora!!!!
True Colours#538.dst: 시간을. 갖자고요? 아뇨. 시간 갖는 건 이제 끝이에요. 우는 것도, 걱정하는 것도 끝! 난 너무... 너무... 화가 나요! 왕실한테, 나 자신한테, 그, 그리고 Mora한테!!!!
True Colours#538.speaker: Sui

True Colours#539.src: At all of you for treating me like I can't handle anything myself!!!
True Colours#539.dst: 나 혼자선 아무것도 못 한다는 듯 대하는 여러분 전부한테!!!
True Colours#539.speaker: Sui

True Colours#540.src: S-Sui, please, I- I understand, but-
True Colours#540.dst: S-Sui, 제발, 나, 나도 알아, 근데-
True Colours#540.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#541.src: DO YOU?! Do you understand?! Because it SOUNDS like everything's all just fine for you! Your brothers are still alive! You even have a plan to get them back!!
True Colours#541.dst: 알아?! 정말 안다고?! 내가 듣기엔 넌 전부 다 괜찮아 보이는데! 네 형제들은 살아 있잖아! 심지어 되찾을 계획까지 있고!!
True Colours#541.speaker: Sui

True Colours#542.src: Rex and Zeph, they... they need me. Need us! And... and I'm not letting anyone else get hurt, or- or- or d-die, not if I can stop it!!
True Colours#542.dst: Rex랑 Zeph는... 내가 필요해. 우리가 필요해! 그, 그리고 더는 아무도 다치거나, 그, 그, 주, 죽게 두지 않을 거야, 내가 막을 수 있다면!!
True Colours#542.speaker: Sui

True Colours#543.src: The Crown... the Sovereigns... the Queen... they'll pay. They'll pay for everything they've done to me, and my- m-my... my family...
True Colours#543.dst: 왕실... 군주들... 여왕... 대가를 치를 거야. 나한테, 그리고 내- 내... 내 가족한테 한 짓 전부에 대해...
True Colours#543.speaker: Sui

True Colours#545.src: And how exactly do you expect to be able to take vengeance in your current state, Sui? I beg of you, please rest before doing something so extreme!
True Colours#545.dst: 그런데 지금 그 상태로 어떻게 복수를 하겠다는 거죠, Sui? 부탁이에요, 그렇게 극단적인 일을 벌이기 전에 좀 쉬어요!
True Colours#545.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#546.src: Every minute I waste is another chance for something to go wrong!!! "Fading with each and every passing moment..."
True Colours#546.dst: 1분을 허비할 때마다 일이 틀어질 기회가 늘어난다고요!!! "매 순간 사라져 가지..."
True Colours#546.speaker: Sui

True Colours#547.src: If- if only we were there sooner, then- th-then... so- so, no. No, I can't rest! I will be getting my family back!
True Colours#547.dst: 우, 우리가 조금만 빨랐다면, 그, 그럼... 그, 그러니까, 아뇨. 못 쉬어요! 난 가족을 되찾을 거예요!
True Colours#547.speaker: Sui

True Colours#548.src: Sui, we... we can't just storm off into a new district without a plan! The Canopy, they- they can help us! And Soosu's device, I'm so close to a breakthrough, I just need-
True Colours#548.dst: Sui, 우린... 계획도 없이 새 구역으로 쳐들어갈 순 없어! 수관 사람들이- 우릴 도울 수 있잖아! 그리고 Soosu의 장치도 거의 다 왔어, 조금만-
True Colours#548.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#549.src: Then stay behind, Yusanu. I... I don't need you, anyway.
True Colours#549.dst: 그럼 남아, Yusanu. 난... 어차피 네가 필요 없어.
True Colours#549.speaker: Sui

True Colours#551.src: I said, I don't NEED you, Yusanu! What have you even done this whole time we've been in the {p}?! Taken as hostage, tinkering with- with- with that STUPID device!
True Colours#551.dst: 네가 필요 없다고 했어, Yusanu! 우리가 {p}에 있는 동안 넌 대체 뭘 했는데?! 인질로 잡히고, 그, 그, 그 멍청한 장치나 만지작거리고!
True Colours#551.speaker: Sui

True Colours#552.src: YOU haven't had to do any of the work! YOU didn't have to- to run random tasks without explanation! YOU didn't have to- to f-fight and k- k- kill a Sovereign! You... you...
True Colours#552.dst: 넌 아무 일도 안 해도 됐잖아! 넌 설명도 없이 잡일을 뛸 필요도 없었고! 넌 싸, 싸우고 군주를 주, 주, 죽일 필요도 없었어! 너... 너...
True Colours#552.speaker: Sui

True Colours#555.src: Is... is there nothing I can say to convince you not to go?
True Colours#555.dst: 가지 말라고... 설득할 방법은 정말 없어?
True Colours#555.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#557.src: Fine. I... I can't follow you, Sui, I can't. I'm going to stay with the Canopy... I'm going to save everyone from Deraj... and I'm going to keep working.
True Colours#557.dst: 알았어. 난... 널 따라갈 수 없어, Sui, 못 해. 난 수관에 남을 거야... Deraj에서 다들 구해 낼 거고... 연구도 계속할 거야.
True Colours#557.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#558.src: ...well, this doesn't have to be goodbye for good, does it? We shall go our separate paths, for a time, then link back together further down the line!
True Colours#558.dst: ...뭐, 이게 영영 이별일 필요는 없잖아요? 한동안 각자의 길을 가다가, 훗날 다시 만나면 되죠!
True Colours#558.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#560.src: Hm. If you're set on this path, you'll surely be dealing with the {p} Sovereign. Ah, Majin of House Thalas... what a delightfully horrible man he is.
True Colours#560.dst: 흠. 그 길을 갈 작정이면 분명 {p} 군주를 상대하게 될 거예요. 아, Thalas 가문의 Majin... 참 유쾌하게도 끔찍한 남자죠.
True Colours#560.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#561.src: Experience? Ha! Hahahaha! Yes, I suppose you could say that! Goodness. Experience.
True Colours#561.dst: 경험이냐고요? 하! 하하하하! 네, 그렇게 말할 수도 있죠! 세상에. 경험이라.
True Colours#561.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#562.src: A word of warning... he's an easy man to underestimate. All confidence, bluster, so insufferable you could hardly believe there's anything beneath it all!
True Colours#562.dst: 미리 경고하자면... 얕보기 쉬운 남자예요. 자신감에 허풍뿐이라, 그 밑에 뭐가 있으리라곤 믿기 힘들 만큼 견디기 어렵죠!
True Colours#562.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#563.src: But his self-proclaimed "number one" position amongst the Sovereigns isn't just for show! His confidence, his demeanour... all of it is earned. As much as one may wish otherwise!
True Colours#563.dst: 하지만 군주들 중 스스로 "제일"이라 칭하는 자리가 허세만은 아니에요! 그 자신감도, 그 태도도... 전부 스스로 얻은 거죠. 아니길 바라고 싶어도요!
True Colours#563.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#564.src: And there's nothing he loves more than to exert his influence over those beneath him. Which would be, ah... everybody?
True Colours#564.dst: 그리고 아랫사람에게 영향력을 휘두르는 것만큼 좋아하는 게 없어요. 아랫사람이라 하면, 어... 전부겠죠?
True Colours#564.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#565.src: ... If he has my family, then... it doesn't matter. I won't let him get in my way.
True Colours#565.dst: ...그자가 내 가족을 데리고 있다면... 상관없어요. 내 앞을 막게 두지 않을 거예요.
True Colours#565.speaker: Sui

True Colours#566.src: Ooh, frightening. Well, I've said my piece. The rest shall be up to you!
True Colours#566.dst: 오, 무섭네요. 자, 할 말은 다 했어요. 나머진 그대들 몫이에요!
True Colours#566.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#567.src: If you ever have need of us again, we'll have set up camp in the cave we first met. You remember the one, yes? Where I-
True Colours#567.dst: 우리가 다시 필요하면, 처음 만났던 그 동굴에 야영지를 차려 둘게요. 기억하죠? 내가 거기서-
True Colours#567.speaker: Rurie

True Colours#568.src: Sui, I... I'm sorry for Mora. I hope you can... I hope you can save the others. I really do. Please... don't get yourself killed.
True Colours#568.dst: Sui, 나... Mora는 정말 유감이야. 네가... 다른 사람들은 꼭 구했으면 좋겠어. 진심이야. 제발... 죽지는 마.
True Colours#568.speaker: Yusanu

True Colours#569.src: ...I- I'm not planning on it. Bye, Yusanu.
True Colours#569.dst: ...그, 그럴 생각 없어. 잘 가, Yusanu.
True Colours#569.speaker: Sui

Tunnel Trouble#000.src: May the woman who died here in tonight's raid rest in peace. Though we did not know her name, her memory will live on through her son.

Tunnel Trouble#001.src: Now, here's where you come in- I need you to clear out that cave route so we can use it once more! Good luck, soldier!
Tunnel Trouble#001.dst: 그래서 자네가 필요하네 - 그 동굴 길을 치워서 다시 쓸 수 있게 해 주게! 행운을 비네, 병사!

Tunnel Trouble#002.src: I can see the other side! Just a little bit more...

Tunnel Trouble#003.src: [!] Right-Click the gates of the cow pens to open them and free the cows!

Tunnel Trouble#004.src: Go free those cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...

Tunnel Trouble#005.src: Looks like you freed the cows successfully! You should return to Drale, before-

Tunnel Trouble#006.src: An intruder! What are you doing with my cows!? Guard golem! Attack!
Tunnel Trouble#006.dst: 침입자다! 내 소한테 무슨 짓이야!? 경비 골렘, 공격!

Tunnel Trouble#007.src: You've defeated Bylvis' Guard Golem! You're in the clear now, and the cows are saved! You should return to Drale.

Tunnel Trouble#008.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with the help! Cows, to me!

Tunnel Trouble#009.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while you do that, I'll be searching for a better career.

Tunnel Trouble#011.src: Talk to Captain Fenor in front of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#011.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} 앞에 있는 Captain Fenor에게 말을 거세요.

Tunnel Trouble#012.src: Ah! You must be a new recruit! Well, I've got a mission for you.
Tunnel Trouble#012.dst: 오! 자네가 새로 온 신병이로군! 마침 자네에게 맡길 임무가 있네.
Tunnel Trouble#012.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#013.src: There's an old cave behind me. It was used in the Corruption Wars...
Tunnel Trouble#013.dst: 내 뒤에 오래된 동굴이 있네. 타락 전쟁 때 쓰던 곳이지...
Tunnel Trouble#013.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#014.src: We used it for quick and easy travel between {p} and {p}. It’s been abandoned for years.
Tunnel Trouble#014.dst: {p}에서 {p}까지 빠르게 오가는 데 썼네. 버려진 지 여러 해가 됐지.
Tunnel Trouble#014.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#015.src: This cave could prove to be very useful for future recruits who need to travel between {p} and {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#015.dst: {p}에서 {p}까지 오가야 하는 앞날의 신병들에게 이 동굴은 아주 요긴할 거야.
Tunnel Trouble#015.speaker: Captain Fenor

Tunnel Trouble#017.src: Enter the cave behind Captain Fenor at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Tunnel Trouble#017.dst: [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Captain Fenor 뒤에 있는 동굴로 들어가세요.

Tunnel Trouble#018.src: ...Oh! Shoot, is it time to get to work already?
Tunnel Trouble#018.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#020.src: Uh... well, to start, we'll need to clear that debris. Just... give it a shove, or something. That'll probably do it.
Tunnel Trouble#020.dst: 어... 일단 저 잔해부터 치워야 해. 그냥... 한번 밀어 봐. 아마 그걸로 될 거야.
Tunnel Trouble#020.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#021.src: Help Miner Linton remove the debris blocking the path.

Tunnel Trouble#022.src: Pretty easy, huh? Hey, maybe you can just go on ahead, and do the rest yourself?
Tunnel Trouble#022.dst: 쉽지? 야, 그냥 네가 먼저 가서 나머지도 알아서 하면 안 될까?
Tunnel Trouble#022.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#023.src: ...Yeah, no, I should probably do my job. Let me grab my pickaxe, and we can keep going forward.
Tunnel Trouble#023.dst: ...아니다, 나도 내 일은 해야지. 곡괭이만 챙기고 계속 가자.
Tunnel Trouble#023.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#024.src: Clear the cave of possible roadblocks.
Tunnel Trouble#024.dst: 동굴에서 길을 막을 만한 것들을 치우세요.

Tunnel Trouble#025.src: Oh, come on... Hey, soldier, do your job! Get rid of those monsters, would you?
Tunnel Trouble#025.dst: 아, 진짜... 야, 병사, 네 일 좀 해! 저 괴물들 좀 치워 줄래?
Tunnel Trouble#025.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#027.src: A cave-in? Really? More work for me... I'll make us a way through, just keep fighting those corrupteds!
Tunnel Trouble#027.dst: 붕괴? 진짜? 또 일이 늘었네... 길은 내가 뚫을 테니 넌 저 타락자들이나 계속 상대해!
Tunnel Trouble#027.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#028.src: Halfway there... Ugh, I knew I should have brought explosives...
Tunnel Trouble#028.dst: 절반 왔다... 으, 폭약을 챙겼어야 했는데...
Tunnel Trouble#028.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#029.src: I can see the other side! Just a little more...
Tunnel Trouble#029.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#030.src: There we go, I've made us a hole! Get over here, quickly!
Tunnel Trouble#030.dst: 좋아, 구멍 뚫었다! 얼른 이리로 넘어와!
Tunnel Trouble#030.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#031.src: ...Oh, come on. You've got to be kidding me. Another cave-in? Really?
Tunnel Trouble#031.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#032.src: And of course it's bigger than the last one. What's my pickaxe going to do against this thing?!
Tunnel Trouble#032.dst: 게다가 당연하다는 듯 지난번보다 더 크네. 이런 걸 내 곡괭이로 어쩌라고?!
Tunnel Trouble#032.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#033.src: Really should have thought to bring explosives. Well, soldier, we tried our best! Nobody'll blame us if we give up now.
Tunnel Trouble#033.dst: 진짜 폭약을 챙겼어야 했어. 뭐, 병사, 우린 최선을 다했잖아! 지금 포기해도 아무도 뭐라 안 해.
Tunnel Trouble#033.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#034.src: ...What? Don't look at me like that. Fine, we can- huh? Do you hear that? Over there, to the right.
Tunnel Trouble#034.dst: ...뭐? 그런 눈으로 보지 마. 알았어, 그럼- 어? 저 소리 들려? 저쪽, 오른편.
Tunnel Trouble#034.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#035.src: Oh, uh... Hi... Well, this is a little awkward... I'll just... Go.
Tunnel Trouble#035.dst: 아, 어... 안녕하세요... 좀 어색하네요... 저는 그냥... 갈게요.

Tunnel Trouble#036.src: ...You know what? I'm not going to ask. As far as I'm concerned, that didn't happen.
Tunnel Trouble#036.dst: ...있잖아, 난 안 물어볼래. 내 기준에선 방금 일은 없었던 거야.
Tunnel Trouble#036.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#037.src: Right, of course you want to check it out. Fine! Go ahead. I'll just... sit here and twiddle my thumbs 'till you're back.
Tunnel Trouble#037.dst: 그래, 넌 당연히 가 보고 싶겠지. 알았어! 가 봐. 난 그냥... 여기 앉아서 네가 올 때까지 손가락이나 만지작거릴게.
Tunnel Trouble#037.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#038.src: Investigate the small hole to the right of the large pile of debris.
Tunnel Trouble#038.dst: 커다란 잔해 더미 오른쪽의 작은 구멍을 조사하세요.

Tunnel Trouble#039.src: Oh... Didn't expect you to follow me... Well, um... Hi! This will sound mad but...
Tunnel Trouble#039.dst: 아... 따라올 줄은 몰랐어요... 그, 음... 안녕하세요! 미친 소리로 들리겠지만...
Tunnel Trouble#039.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#040.src: I'm Drale, and I'm on a mission to free these cows from the enslavement of {p}.
Tunnel Trouble#040.dst: 저는 Drale이고, 이 소들을 {p}의 노예살이에서 해방시키려는 중이에요.
Tunnel Trouble#040.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#041.src: Those farmers stole those cows. They are sacred animals. Now they're about to turn them into steak! If you were to help me, maybe I could help you...
Tunnel Trouble#041.dst: 저 농부들이 소들을 훔쳤어요. 소는 신성한 동물이라고요. 그런데 이제 스테이크로 만들려 해요! 저를 도와주시면, 저도 도와드릴 수 있어요...
Tunnel Trouble#041.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#042.src: Go free those innocent cows from enslavement! Qu-quickly! Before that farmer gets back...
Tunnel Trouble#042.dst: 저 죄 없는 소들을 노예살이에서 풀어 주세요! 빠, 빨리요! 농부가 돌아오기 전에...
Tunnel Trouble#042.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#043.src: Where are you going? Come here and talk to me first.
Tunnel Trouble#043.dst: 어디 가세요? 먼저 이리 와서 얘기부터 해요.
Tunnel Trouble#043.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#044.src: Free the cows without being seen by the farmer.
Tunnel Trouble#044.dst: 농부에게 들키지 않고 소들을 풀어 주세요.

Tunnel Trouble#045.src: Go free the cows from the farmers before they're taken to the slaughterhouse! Oh man, the slaughterhouse...
Tunnel Trouble#045.dst: 도축장에 끌려가기 전에 농부들한테서 소들을 구해 주세요! 아 진짜, 도축장이라니...
Tunnel Trouble#045.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#046.src: Ah, good to see my cows are all in tip-top shape! Welp, time to- gah!
Tunnel Trouble#046.dst: 오, 내 소들 상태가 아주 좋구먼! 자, 그럼- 억!
Tunnel Trouble#046.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#049.src: Golem! No! That cost me thousands of emeralds!
Tunnel Trouble#049.dst: 골렘! 안 돼! 에메랄드 수천 개짜리였는데!
Tunnel Trouble#049.speaker: Bylvis

Tunnel Trouble#050.src: Return to Drale about your success.

Tunnel Trouble#051.src: Thank you so much, but we're not done yet. We need to get these cows out the province.
Tunnel Trouble#051.dst: 정말 고마워요, 하지만 아직 안 끝났어요. 이 소들을 지방 밖으로 내보내야 해요.
Tunnel Trouble#051.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#052.src: There's a small opening behind me. Go through it and help me get these cows on a raft to Gavel!
Tunnel Trouble#052.dst: 제 뒤에 작은 통로가 있어요. 그리로 가서 소들을 Gavel행 뗏목에 태우는 걸 도와주세요!
Tunnel Trouble#052.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#053.src: Help Drale push the raft with the cows out to sea.
Tunnel Trouble#053.dst: Drale을 도와 소들을 실은 뗏목을 바다로 밀어내세요.

Tunnel Trouble#054.src: There's the raft! Help me push it for the cows!
Tunnel Trouble#054.dst: 뗏목이 저기 있어요! 소들을 위해 같이 밀어 줘요!
Tunnel Trouble#054.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#055.src: And, that should do it! Be free, my friends! A new life awaits!
Tunnel Trouble#055.dst: 자, 이제 됐어요! 자유로워져요, 친구들! 새 삶이 기다려요!
Tunnel Trouble#055.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#056.src: Again, thank you so much for what you have done this day. These cows deserve a better life than being farm animals.
Tunnel Trouble#056.dst: 오늘 해 주신 일, 다시 한번 정말 고마워요. 이 소들은 가축으로 사는 것보다 나은 삶을 누릴 자격이 있어요.
Tunnel Trouble#056.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#057.src: ...Oh! Right! You were busy with something before you came to help me, weren't you? Hm... I think I might be able to help you with that as well! Let's go back to the tunnel!
Tunnel Trouble#057.dst: 아! 맞다! 저를 도우러 오기 전에 하던 일이 있었죠? 음... 그것도 제가 도울 수 있을 것 같아요! 터널로 돌아가요!
Tunnel Trouble#057.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#058.src: Return to Miner Linton back in the abandoned cave.

Tunnel Trouble#059.src: Oh, good, you're back. It's been, like, an hour! What were you even doing for that long!
Tunnel Trouble#059.dst: 오, 돌아왔네. 한 시간은 걸린 것 같은데! 대체 그동안 뭘 한 거야!
Tunnel Trouble#059.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#060.src: ...You helped some crazy cow-obsessed lunatic steal some cows? I don't think you're allowed to do that. There's a law against that, or something.
Tunnel Trouble#060.dst: ...소에 미친 이상한 놈을 도와서 소를 훔쳤다고? 그거 하면 안 되는 거 아냐? 그런 걸 막는 법이 있을 텐데.
Tunnel Trouble#060.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#061.src: Eh. Not that I really care, either way. I've certainly done worse.
Tunnel Trouble#061.dst: 뭐. 어느 쪽이든 딱히 상관은 없어. 나도 더한 짓 해 봤고.
Tunnel Trouble#061.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#062.src: Well then! Ready to call it quits? We're definitely not going to make any progress, so we might as we-
Tunnel Trouble#062.dst: 자 그럼! 이제 접을 준비 됐어? 어차피 진전은 없을 테니 그냥 이만-
Tunnel Trouble#062.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#063.src: Hello again, friend! I'm here with help! Cows, to me!
Tunnel Trouble#063.dst: 또 만났네요, 친구! 도움을 데려왔어요! 소들아, 이리로!
Tunnel Trouble#063.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#065.src: Since you helped me with my problem, I thought I should repay that favor by helping you!
Tunnel Trouble#065.dst: 제 문제를 도와주셨으니, 저도 그 은혜를 갚아야죠!
Tunnel Trouble#065.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#066.src: Welp, see ya! Oh, and nice to meet you, miner! Now, let's get going my cows!
Tunnel Trouble#066.dst: 자, 그럼 안녕! 아, 광부님도 반가웠어요! 가자, 내 소들아!
Tunnel Trouble#066.speaker: Drale

Tunnel Trouble#067.src: ...I- huh. You saw that too, right? I didn't just imagine that?
Tunnel Trouble#067.dst: ...나- 어. 너도 봤지? 나 혼자 헛것 본 거 아니지?
Tunnel Trouble#067.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#068.src: You know what? I think I quit. I think this has finally pushed me to my limit! I didn't know that I had one, but apparently I do!
Tunnel Trouble#068.dst: 있잖아, 나 그만둘래. 이걸로 드디어 내 한계에 온 것 같아! 나한테 한계가 있는 줄도 몰랐는데, 있긴 있었나 봐!
Tunnel Trouble#068.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#069.src: You can... go on ahead. Tell whoever's on the other end that we succeeded. And while we do that, I'll be searching for a better career.
Tunnel Trouble#069.dst: 넌... 먼저 가. 반대편에 있는 사람한테 우리가 성공했다고 전해 줘. 그동안 난 더 나은 일자리나 알아볼게.
Tunnel Trouble#069.speaker: Miner Linton

Tunnel Trouble#071.src: Speak to Sergeant Klafson next to the {p} entrance of the cave.
Tunnel Trouble#071.dst: 동굴의 {p} 쪽 입구 옆에 있는 Sergeant Klafson에게 말을 거세요.

Tunnel Trouble#072.src: Recruit, Captain Fenor told me to meet you here, said if you came out on this side of that tunnel then you completed your mission!
Tunnel Trouble#072.dst: 신병, Captain Fenor께서 여기서 자네를 맞으라 하셨네. 터널 이쪽으로 나왔다면 임무를 완수한 거라고!
Tunnel Trouble#072.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Tunnel Trouble#073.src: You did a great deed today, soldier! We can now use this cave to travel easily between {p} and {p}! Great job!
Tunnel Trouble#073.dst: 오늘 큰일을 해냈네, 병사! 이제 이 동굴로 {p}에서 {p}까지 쉽게 오갈 수 있어! 잘했네!
Tunnel Trouble#073.speaker: Sergeant Klafson

Underice#002.src: I'm having trouble with the fish in our lake recently and I am sure the problem lies within the lake itself.
Underice#002.dst: 요즘 우리 호수의 물고기에 문제가 생겼는데, 원인은 분명 호수 안에 있어요.
Underice#002.speaker: Fredris

Underice#003.src: I would like to commission you to investigate, but since it's freezing cold in our lake you need something to protect you. I heard the people in {p} on the coast of Wynn have something that can help you.
Underice#003.dst: 조사를 의뢰하고 싶지만, 우리 호수는 얼어붙을 만큼 차가워서 몸을 지킬 게 필요해요. Wynn 해안의 {p} 사람들이 도움이 될 물건을 갖고 있다고 들었어요.
Underice#003.speaker: Fredris

Underice#004.src: Would you mind coming back with a [Breathing Helmet I]? I think that should be everything you need.
Underice#004.dst: [Breathing Helmet I]을 구해 와 주시겠어요? 그거면 필요한 건 다 될 거예요.
Underice#004.speaker: Fredris

Underice#005.src: Return to {p} and bring Fredris a [Breathing Helmet I]

Underice#006.src: What is this thing supposed to be? You know, I would really appreciate your help, but this [Breathing Helmet I] does not look like it's going to keep you protected.
Underice#006.dst: 이게 대체 뭔가요? 도와주시는 건 정말 고맙지만, 이 [Breathing Helmet I]은 당신을 지켜 줄 것처럼 보이지 않아요.
Underice#006.speaker: Fredris

Underice#007.src: Would you mind heading to our local armour merchant and buying one of our [Breathing Helmet II]? I don't want you to drown. Just come back with the helmet and I will tell you about my problem.
Underice#007.dst: 우리 마을 방어구 상인에게 가서 [Breathing Helmet II]을 하나 사 오시겠어요? 물에 빠져 죽는 건 원치 않아요. 투구를 가져오면 제 문제를 말씀드릴게요.
Underice#007.speaker: Fredris

Underice#008.src: Buy a [Breathing Helmet II] and find the underwater cave
Underice#008.dst: [Breathing Helmet II]을 사고 수중 동굴을 찾으세요

Underice#009.src: Explore the cave underneath the frozen lake in {p}

Underice#010.src: Who are you? You don't look like one of those villagers we stole the fi... Wait, they didn't send you to retrieve "their" fish, did they?
Underice#010.dst: 당신 누구죠? 우리가 생선을 훔친 그 주민들 같진 않은데... 잠깐, 설마 "자기들" 물고기를 되찾으러 보낸 건 아니죠?
Underice#010.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#011.src: For years we let them share the lake with us, the actual inhabitants of it, we were modest and took what we needed, we let them catch the rest. But then they went too far, they caught too much.
Underice#011.dst: 여러 해 동안 우리는 이 호수의 진짜 주민이면서도 그들과 호수를 나눠 썼어요. 필요한 만큼만 잡고 나머지는 그들 몫으로 뒀죠. 그런데 도를 넘더군요, 너무 많이 잡았어요.
Underice#011.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#012.src: We didn't have enough to eat, we were forced to steal their fish, we would have starved otherwise. And now they want their fish, our fish back? We can't do that, I hope you understand.
Underice#012.dst: 먹을 게 부족해 그들의 물고기를 훔칠 수밖에 없었어요. 안 그랬으면 굶어 죽었겠죠. 그런데 이제 그들의, 아니 우리의 물고기를 돌려 달라고요? 그건 못 해요, 이해해 주길 바라요.
Underice#012.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#013.src: However, we don't have to fight over the fish in the lake, we just need a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], that would be enough, nothing else. We never wanted to steal the fish.
Underice#013.dst: 하지만 호수의 물고기를 두고 싸울 필요는 없어요. [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] 한 마리면 충분해요, 다른 건 필요 없어요. 우리도 훔치고 싶지 않았어요.
Underice#013.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#014.src: If you want to help us and the villagers, just follow the stream that flows into this lake to the south, you will find the best fishing ground there. The pufferfish should be around there too.
Underice#014.dst: 우리와 주민들을 돕고 싶다면, 이 호수로 흘러드는 남쪽 물줄기를 따라가 보세요. 거기 최고의 낚시터가 있어요. 복어도 그 근처에 있을 거예요.
Underice#014.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#015.src: Follow the river south to find the fishing dock
Underice#015.dst: 강을 따라 남쪽으로 가서 낚시 선착장을 찾으세요

Underice#016.src: Oh you look a bit lost, let me help you, I've lived here for a long time, I know every corner and every snowflake.
Underice#016.dst: 좀 헤매는 것 같군요, 제가 도울게요. 여기 오래 살아서 구석구석, 눈송이 하나까지 다 알아요.
Underice#016.speaker: Gernald

Underice#017.src: You're searching for a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]? Hmm I heard that name before, my friend, Strato, told me about it years ago. If I remember correctly it is infinite, you can feed every single person in all the provinces from this single fish.
Underice#017.dst: [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]을 찾는다고요? 음, 그 이름 들어 봤어요. 오래전에 친구 Strato가 얘기해 줬죠. 제 기억이 맞다면 그건 끝이 없어요. 그 한 마리로 모든 지방 사람을 전부 먹일 수 있대요.
Underice#017.speaker: Gernald

Underice#018.src: Sadly Strato is no longer alive. He used to work and live at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}. We always met here, caught fish and told each other stories. I really miss those times...
Underice#018.dst: 안타깝게도 Strato는 이제 없어요. {p} 북서쪽 벌목 야영지에서 일하며 살았죠. 우린 늘 여기서 만나 물고기를 잡고 이야기를 나눴어요. 그 시절이 정말 그립네요...
Underice#018.speaker: Gernald

Underice#019.src: Maybe you can find some sort of bait there, he had some of the best bait I have ever seen. You should be able to acquire some and throw it in water, maybe that will attract the pufferfish.
Underice#019.dst: 거기서 미끼를 구할 수 있을지도 몰라요. 그 친구는 제가 본 것 중 최고의 미끼를 갖고 있었죠. 좀 구해서 물에 던져 보세요. 복어가 끌려올지도 모르죠.
Underice#019.speaker: Gernald

Underice#020.src: Can I ask you something? As you might see I'm not the richest guy, or the youngest. If you manage to catch that fish, could you hand it over? I know we just met but you seem like somebody who would help an old man.
Underice#020.dst: 하나 물어봐도 될까요? 보다시피 저는 부자도 아니고 젊지도 않아요. 그 물고기를 잡게 되면 저에게 넘겨주시겠어요? 방금 만난 사이지만, 당신은 노인을 도와줄 사람 같아 보여서요.
Underice#020.speaker: Gernald

Underice#021.src: Obtain the bait at the woodcutting camp northwest of {p}, use it to catch the fish and then give it to Calamaro or Gernald
Underice#021.dst: {p} 북서쪽 벌목 야영지에서 미끼를 얻고, 그것으로 물고기를 잡아 Calamaro나 Gernald에게 주세요

Underice#022.src: Just look at those fish, I told you they love this bait.
Underice#022.dst: 저 물고기들 좀 봐요, 이 미끼를 좋아한다니까요.
Underice#022.speaker: Gernald

Underice#023.src: There it comes, the [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], I can't believe it!
Underice#023.speaker: Gernald

Underice#024.src: You decided to give me the fish? I wish Strato was still around, he would be so amazed. I can't show you how much this means to me, but take this little gift, please, promise me to never change.
Underice#024.dst: 물고기를 저에게 주시는 건가요? Strato가 살아 있었다면 정말 놀랐을 텐데. 이게 얼마나 큰 의미인지 다 보여 줄 순 없지만, 이 작은 선물을 받아 주세요. 지금 그대로여 달라고 약속해 줘요.
Underice#024.speaker: Gernald

Underice#025.src: You found a pufferfish! Who would have thought such a small thing could solve our problem. I will start bringing back the fish immediately, but first we will have a nice hot soup. Please take this as payback for your services.
Underice#025.dst: 복어를 찾았군요! 이렇게 작은 게 우리 문제를 풀 줄 누가 알았겠어요. 당장 물고기를 돌려보내기 시작할게요. 다만 먼저 뜨끈한 국부터 끓여야겠어요. 수고해 준 값으로 이걸 받아 주세요.
Underice#025.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#026.src: You can trade it at the shop right over there, it's hard to miss. I will give you a last advise, you don't want to eat that slimy fish.
Underice#026.dst: 저기 있는 가게에서 바꿀 수 있어요, 못 보고 지나칠 리 없죠. 마지막으로 조언 하나, 그 미끈한 물고기는 먹지 않는 게 좋아요.
Underice#026.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#027.src: Meet up with Fredris in {p} and claim your reward

Underice#028.src: Oh you are done with whatever you were doing? I heard you ran around the whole place, I don't know if you were the right person to ask for help...
Underice#028.dst: 아, 뭘 하든 다 끝냈나요? 온 동네를 뛰어다녔다고 들었어요. 당신에게 도움을 청한 게 맞았는지 모르겠네요...
Underice#028.speaker: Fredris

Underice#029.src: I will just ask the next one who comes around, no need to have you run around all day. Take this, I appreciate your effort.
Underice#029.dst: 그냥 다음에 오는 사람에게 부탁할게요, 하루 종일 뛰어다니게 할 필요는 없죠. 이거 받아요, 애써 줘서 고마워요.
Underice#029.speaker: Fredris

Underice#030.src: A real disaster! I can't believe this is happening to me!
Underice#030.dst: 완전 재앙이에요! 나한테 이런 일이 생기다니!
Underice#030.speaker: Fredris

Underice#031.src: I've been fishing for the last few days and I caught nothing! Zilch! This isn't normal!
Underice#031.dst: 며칠째 낚시를 했는데 한 마리도 못 잡았어요! 한 마리도! 이건 정상이 아니에요!
Underice#031.speaker: Fredris

Underice#032.src: I spent my entire life fishing in this area! I wish I could dive under this ice to fix the problem myself...
Underice#032.dst: 평생 이 근방에서 낚시를 했어요! 얼음 밑으로 들어가 직접 해결할 수 있으면 좋으련만...
Underice#032.speaker: Fredris

Underice#033.src: Do you think you could help me? You might actually be exactly what I need!
Underice#033.dst: 저를 도와줄 수 있겠어요? 딱 제가 찾던 사람일지도 몰라요!
Underice#033.speaker: Fredris

Underice#034.src: Enter my shack, there you will find the entrance... Good luck!
Underice#034.dst: 제 오두막으로 들어가면 입구가 있어요... 행운을 빌어요!
Underice#034.speaker: Fredris

Underice#035.src: Explore under the ice to find a cause to the fish problem. You'll need the Breathing Helmet for this.
Underice#035.dst: 얼음 아래를 탐험해 물고기 문제의 원인을 찾으세요. 이때 Breathing Helmet이 필요합니다.

Underice#036.src: Talk to Squidward in the Squid Village.

Underice#037.src: Have I seen any fish? No, of course not! I don't even know what a fish looks like!
Underice#037.dst: 물고기를 봤냐고? 당연히 못 봤지! 난 물고기가 어떻게 생겼는지도 몰라!
Underice#037.speaker: Squidward

Underice#038.src: Who could be stealing all those fish? I wonder! Actually...
Underice#038.dst: 누가 그 물고기를 다 훔쳤을까? 참 궁금하네! 사실은...
Underice#038.speaker: Squidward

Underice#039.src: I'm sure Calamaro did it! He's just that kind of guy. He lives in that house down there.
Underice#039.dst: 분명 Calamaro 짓이야! 걔가 딱 그런 놈이거든. 저 아래 저 집에 살아.
Underice#039.speaker: Squidward

Underice#040.src: Find Calamaro in the Squid Village.

Underice#041.src: Me? Stealing fish? You are out of your mind! It's obviously Kroken who is stealing them!
Underice#041.dst: 내가? 물고기를 훔쳐? 제정신이 아니군요! 훔치는 건 누가 봐도 Kroken이에요!
Underice#041.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#042.src: He lives right on top of that waterfall right there, if you want to go talk to him.
Underice#042.dst: 얘기하고 싶으면, 저기 저 폭포 바로 위에 살고 있어요.
Underice#042.speaker: Calamaro

Underice#043.src: Find Kroken in the Squid Village.

Underice#044.src: Do I look like someone who steals fish?
Underice#044.speaker: Kroken

Underice#045.src: It's obvious that Squidward did it, he has tons of crates full of fish!
Underice#045.dst: 누가 봐도 Squidward 짓이지, 물고기 가득한 상자가 산더미야!
Underice#045.speaker: Kroken

Underice#047.src: Okay, okay, fine! It was me all along... I know, what a shock, right?
Underice#047.dst: 알았어, 알았어! 처음부터 나였어... 그래, 엄청 충격이지?
Underice#047.speaker: Squidward

Underice#048.src: Okay, I got a proposition for you. Bring me [{~} Raw Fish] and I will stop, deal?
Underice#048.dst: 좋아, 제안 하나 하지. [{~} Raw Fish]를 가져오면 그만둘게, 어때?
Underice#048.speaker: Squidward

Underice#050.src: Bring back {~} Raw Fish to Squidward.

Underice#052.src: You can trust me, I won't touch the fish in the frozen lake anymore!
Underice#052.dst: 날 믿어도 돼, 이제 얼음 호수 물고기엔 손 안 댈게!
Underice#052.speaker: Squidward

Underice#053.src: Talk to Fredris to collect your reward.

Underice#054.src: Your story really doesn't make sense. Villagers living in a squid village under the lake? Pff!
Underice#054.dst: 당신 얘기는 정말 말이 안 돼요. 호수 밑 오징어 마을에 주민들이 산다고요? 참나!
Underice#054.speaker: Fredris

Underice#055.src: However, if you can garantee me that my problem is gone, I'll trust you.
Underice#055.dst: 그래도 제 문제가 사라졌다고 장담한다면, 믿어 볼게요.
Underice#055.speaker: Fredris

Underice#056.src: Thank you for your help. Here, take these...
Underice#056.speaker: Fredris

Underice#057.src: Have you found the issue yet? I'm still waiting!

Underice#058.src: Have you seen that weird structure near the lake? I heard quite a lot of stories about it, but nobody is sure about what you can find there.
Underice#058.dst: 호수 근처에 있는 그 이상한 건물 봤어요? 그에 관한 이야기를 꽤 많이 들었는데, 거기서 뭘 찾을 수 있는지는 아무도 확실히 몰라요.

Underice#059.src: However we don't have to fight over the fish in the lake, we just need a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish], that would be enough, nothing else. We never wanted to steal the fish.
Underice#059.dst: 하지만 호수의 물고기를 두고 싸울 필요는 없어요. [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish] 한 마리면 충분해요, 다른 건 필요 없어요. 우리도 훔치고 싶지 않았어요.

Underice#060.src: You're searching a [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]? Hmm I heard that name before, my friend, Strato, told me about it years ago. If I remember correctly it is infinite, you can feed every single person in all the provinces from this single fish.
Underice#060.dst: [Mythic Everlasting Pufferfish]을 찾는다고요? 음, 그 이름 들어 봤어요. 오래전에 친구 Strato가 얘기해 줬죠. 제 기억이 맞다면 그건 끝이 없어요. 그 한 마리로 모든 지방 사람을 전부 먹일 수 있대요.

Underice#061.src: Maybe you can find some sort of bait there, he had some of the best bait I have ever seen. You should be able to acquire some and throw it in the water, maybe that will attract the pufferfish.
Underice#061.dst: 거기서 미끼를 구할 수 있을지도 몰라요. 그 친구는 제가 본 것 중 최고의 미끼를 갖고 있었죠. 좀 구해서 물에 던져 보세요. 복어가 끌려올지도 모르죠.

Underice#062.src: You decided to give me the fish? I wish Strato was still around, he would be so amazed. I can't show you how much this means to me, but take this little gift please, promise me to never change.
Underice#062.dst: 물고기를 저에게 주시는 건가요? Strato가 살아 있었다면 정말 놀랐을 텐데. 이게 얼마나 큰 의미인지 다 보여 줄 순 없지만, 이 작은 선물을 받아 주세요. 지금 그대로여 달라고 약속해 줘요.

Underice#063.src: I wish we could have avoided this whole scenario.
Underice#063.dst: 이 모든 상황을 피할 수 있었으면 좋았을 텐데요.

Undersupply#000.src: Investigate the river settlement's water troubles at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#001.src: Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
Undersupply#001.dst: 오호, 그런 옷차림은 정말 오랜만에 보는구먼! {p} 사람이지, 안 그런가? 꽤나 호화롭게 살았겠구먼.
Undersupply#001.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#002.src: 's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
Undersupply#002.dst: 여기 댐 그늘 아래는 좀 더 소박하다네. 자네 같은 사람이 여기까지 올 줄은 몰랐지만, 불평은 아닐세. 세상 구경 다니는 건 훌륭한 일이지!
Undersupply#002.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#003.src: Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
Undersupply#003.dst: 안타깝게도 여긴 술집인데 물이 말랐네. 술이야 있지만, 그걸 마시면 들어간 것보다 더 많은 물이 빠져나가지. 사람을 바짝 말려 버린다네. 지금은 남는 물도 없고. 위험하지 않겠나?
Undersupply#003.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#004.src: The dam opens up every month or so to let out some water for us, but is passes through a noble manor, past the hill, rationed out to the rest of the forest.
Undersupply#004.dst: 댐은 한 달에 한 번쯤 열려서 물을 조금 내려보내지. 그런데 그 물이 언덕 너머 귀족 저택을 거쳐 숲 나머지에 배급된다네.
Undersupply#004.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#005.src: It's so little though, nowadays. The children are going thirsty. The muck in the riverbeds is more mud than water- so even if ya boil it out like I do, what you get is foul trifles.
Undersupply#005.dst: 그런데 요즘은 양이 너무 적어. 아이들이 목말라하고 있네. 강바닥에 남은 건 물보다 진흙에 가까워서, 나처럼 끓여 봐야 나오는 건 역겨운 찌꺼기뿐이지.
Undersupply#005.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#006.src: Didn't used to be like this, though. Ain't sure what's changed, but I'm just an old geezer. I've lived my life enough- it's what it's doing to the kids that has me worried. ...say, stranger.
Undersupply#006.dst: 예전엔 이렇지 않았는데. 뭐가 달라졌는지는 모르겠네, 난 그저 늙은이일 뿐이니. 내 인생은 충분히 살았어- 걱정되는 건 아이들이지. ...이보게, 낯선 양반.
Undersupply#006.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#007.src: If you're touring about here, you'll probably see the manor soon enough. If ya could get them to spare us some more water a while, I'll give ya a discount! How's about it?
Undersupply#007.dst: 이 근방을 둘러본다면 머잖아 그 저택도 보게 될 걸세. 저들이 우리에게 물을 좀 더 내주게 해 준다면, 자네한테 할인을 해 주지! 어떤가?
Undersupply#007.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#008.src: Ain't quite sure how you would go about convincing the nobles to let out more water for us, I admit. If I did, I'd take the trek up the hill myself- even in spite of my creaky ol' back.
Undersupply#008.dst: 솔직히 그 귀족들을 어떻게 설득해야 물을 더 내줄지는 나도 모르겠네. 알았다면 이 삐걱대는 허리를 끌고서라도 내가 직접 언덕을 올랐겠지.
Undersupply#008.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#009.src: Even if it's just getting them to put a word in to the Sovereign. I imagine that come-lately Zhiraok would do something about it all. I swear that man doesn't know what sleep is...
Undersupply#009.dst: 군주께 말 한마디만 넣어 줘도 좋으련만. 새로 온 그 Zhiraok이라면 뭐라도 해 줄 것 같은데. 그 양반은 잠이 뭔지도 모르는 게 분명해...
Undersupply#009.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#010.src: I can appreciate a young'un with some spark in their eyes, but he needs to learn to slow down! What's that saying about the brightest candle burning twice as fast?
Undersupply#010.dst: 눈빛에 불꽃이 있는 젊은이는 나도 좋아하네만, 그 친구는 좀 늦추는 법을 배워야 해! 가장 밝은 초가 두 배로 빨리 탄다는 말, 그게 뭐였더라?
Undersupply#010.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#011.src: Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
Undersupply#011.dst: 어머나! 누구세요? 그렇게 환상적인 장비를 걸치고! 경비병은 분명 아니고- 저런 건 처음 봐요! 어머, 세상에...
Undersupply#011.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#012.src: Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
Undersupply#012.dst: 설마... 혹시 당신이...새 군주가 나셨다는 소문을 바람결에 들었거든요. 우리 군주님 차림은 좀 달랐으니, 어쩌면-
Undersupply#012.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#013.src: No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
Undersupply#013.dst: 아니라고요? 흠! 그렇다 해도 낯선 분을 더 잘 대접하고 싶지만, 지금은 이 달에서 가장 궁핍한 때예요- 제가 본 중에 가장 심하죠.
Undersupply#013.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#014.src: *cough* Oh dear, excuse me. My throat is simply so dry... My children need the water more than I, but I would darn a dozen robes for but a glass now.
Undersupply#014.dst: *콜록* 어머, 실례했어요. 목이 너무 말라서요... 물은 저보다 아이들에게 더 필요하지만, 한 잔만 준다면 지금 옷 열두 벌이라도 기워 드릴 텐데.
Undersupply#014.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#015.src: The dam opens every month or so- I assume you wouldn't know, stranger. The water is rationed to us by the nobles in a manor over the hill.
Undersupply#015.dst: 댐은 한 달에 한 번쯤 열려요- 낯선 분은 모르시겠죠. 물은 언덕 너머 저택의 귀족들이 우리에게 배급해 줘요.
Undersupply#015.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#016.src: This time of year is usually dry, but the amount of water we have received lately has been less and less. I wonder what is happening...
Undersupply#016.dst: 이맘때는 원래 건조하지만, 요즘 받는 물의 양이 갈수록 줄고 있어요. 대체 무슨 일일까요...
Undersupply#016.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#017.src: This kind lumberer has been visiting and passing out bottles, and without him I am certain my children wouldn't have made it. I'm unsure how much longer I can keep my family healthy...
Undersupply#017.dst: 친절한 나무꾼 한 분이 찾아와 물병을 나눠 주는데, 그분이 없었다면 제 아이들은 버티지 못했을 거예요. 가족을 얼마나 더 건강히 지킬 수 있을지 모르겠어요...
Undersupply#017.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#018.src: Oh, if only those nobles could spare more for us... Perhaps I could speak with them- but then, who would watch over my children here?
Undersupply#018.dst: 아, 그 귀족들이 조금만 더 나눠 준다면... 제가 직접 말해 볼까도 싶지만- 그러면 여기 아이들은 누가 보나요?
Undersupply#018.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#019.src: So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger.
Undersupply#019.dst: 그래서...식사와 따뜻한 차로 맞이하고 싶지만... 그럴 수가 없어요. 정말 죄송해요, 낯선 분.
