Undersupply#019.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#020.src: I beg your pardon for it. I cannot spare the hospitality. Even my gardens I've had to abandon... My great-grandmother's flowers have wilted.
Undersupply#020.dst: 너그러이 봐 주세요. 대접할 여유가 없네요. 정원까지 버려둘 수밖에 없었어요... 증조할머니의 꽃들도 다 시들었죠.
Undersupply#020.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#021.src: My son had the idea to press the flowers so they would not be gone forever...But as it is, the risk of losing the rest of my family for the drought... I can't bear it!
Undersupply#021.dst: 아들이 꽃을 눌러 말려 두자고 했어요, 영영 사라지지 않게요...하지만 이대로면 가뭄에 남은 가족까지 잃을 수도 있어요... 견딜 수 없어요!
Undersupply#021.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#022.src: ...it may be rude to ask, but...could you ask the nobles of the manor, perhaps? To spare a drop or two extra? I'd be forever indebted to you...
Undersupply#022.dst: ...실례인 줄 알지만...혹시 저택의 귀족들에게 부탁해 주시겠어요? 한두 방울만 더 내달라고요? 평생 은혜를 잊지 않을게요...
Undersupply#022.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#023.src: Whoa. That is positively outlandish dress. You...couldn't be a crown guard, can you be? That's simply so far out of uniform...so are you from the {p}, maybe?
Undersupply#023.dst: 와. 참으로 별난 옷차림이군요. 설마...왕실 근위병은 아니시죠? 제복과는 너무 동떨어졌는데...그럼 혹시 {p}에서 오셨나요?
Undersupply#023.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#024.src: But then, why would you be here? The Festival...isn't that soon over in {p}? Why come all the way over here? I've hardly anything to trade, even.
Undersupply#024.dst: 그런데 왜 여기까지 오셨나요? 축제...곧 {p}에서 열리지 않나요? 굳이 이 먼 데까지? 저는 팔 물건조차 거의 없는데요.
Undersupply#024.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#025.src: It's the dry season, you know. End of the month, I'm sure you- ehm, wait. Perhaps, since you live atop the dam, that isn't the case? Oh, what I would do for that luxury!
Undersupply#025.dst: 지금은 건기잖아요. 월말이라 아마 당신도- 어, 잠깐. 댐 위쪽에 사신다면 사정이 다르려나요? 아, 그런 호사라면 무엇이든 하겠어요!
Undersupply#025.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#026.src: Well, to the point- I've nothing to sell but dry herbs. A sad state for our village, when the apothecary cannot even make medicine, but every bit of water has to go towards necessities.
Undersupply#026.dst: 본론을 말하자면- 제가 팔 수 있는 건 마른 약초뿐이에요. 약재상이 약도 못 만드는 마을이라니 서글프죠. 물 한 방울까지 생필품에 써야 하니까요.
Undersupply#026.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#027.src: We've been receiving less and less. Some generous folks have been sharing, but that does only so far. A glass here and there cannot revitalize my poor garden.
Undersupply#027.dst: 받는 양이 갈수록 줄고 있어요. 인심 좋은 분들이 나눠 주긴 하지만 거기까지죠. 여기 한 잔 저기 한 잔으로는 제 가련한 정원을 되살릴 수 없어요.
Undersupply#027.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#028.src: If you want to find something more suited to the luxuries you might be used to, perhaps visit the manor over the hill? They do ration out the water to us, as well.
Undersupply#028.dst: 익숙하신 호사에 더 어울리는 물건을 찾으신다면, 언덕 너머 저택에 가 보시는 건 어때요? 우리에게 물을 배급하는 것도 그분들이고요.
Undersupply#028.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#029.src: ...far be it from me to make demands of a visitor, but... Should you visit, could you put in a word with them? A kindness begets a kindness, after all.
Undersupply#029.dst: ...손님에게 뭘 요구할 처지는 아니지만... 가시게 되면 저희 얘기 좀 전해 주시겠어요? 친절은 친절을 부르는 법이니까요.
Undersupply#029.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#030.src: I've lived here all my life, I have. And I've always been learned to make everything stretch, to be diligent and frugal, but with things as they are, those skills fail me.
Undersupply#030.dst: 저는 평생 여기서 살았어요. 뭐든 아껴 늘려 쓰고 부지런하고 검소하라 배웠죠. 그런데 사정이 이러니 그 재주도 소용이 없네요.
Undersupply#030.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#031.src: People could fall ill without my services, could die, and I would hate to see our families broken apart, but I may have no choice but to leave if this keeps up.
Undersupply#031.dst: 제가 없으면 사람들이 병들고 죽을 수도 있어요. 가족이 흩어지는 건 정말 보고 싶지 않지만, 이대로라면 떠날 수밖에 없을지도요.
Undersupply#031.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#032.src: Oh, but I'm sure a sightseer like yourself doesn't want to hear the qualms of a man such as myself. Do enjoy the sights of our humble forest, would you?
Undersupply#032.dst: 아, 관광객께서 저 같은 사람의 푸념을 듣고 싶진 않으시겠죠. 저희 소박한 숲의 경치나 즐기고 가세요, 네?
Undersupply#032.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#033.src: Oho, now that's some dress I've not seen in many a moon! You're one of those {p} folk, aren't ya? Quite some luxury ya must've lived with.
Undersupply#033.dst: 오호, 그런 옷차림은 정말 오랜만에 보는구먼! {p} 사람이지, 안 그런가? 꽤나 호화롭게 살았겠구먼.
Undersupply#033.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#034.src: 's a bit more humble down here in the shadow of the dam. Surprised someone like you would take the trip, but it ain't a complaint. Getting about to see the world is a fine endeavor!
Undersupply#034.dst: 여기 댐 그늘 아래는 좀 더 소박하다네. 자네 같은 사람이 여기까지 올 줄은 몰랐지만, 불평은 아닐세. 세상 구경 다니는 건 훌륭한 일이지!
Undersupply#034.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#035.src: Unfortunately, the bar here's dry. Sure, I got alcohol, but you drink that, and you'll be passing more water than ya took in. Dries you right out, and right now we haven't got any water to spare. Dangerous, y'know?
Undersupply#035.dst: 안타깝게도 여긴 술집인데 물이 말랐네. 술이야 있지만, 그걸 마시면 들어간 것보다 더 많은 물이 빠져나가지. 사람을 바짝 말려 버린다네. 지금은 남는 물도 없고. 위험하지 않겠나?
Undersupply#035.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#036.src: With the manor over the hill there barely letting out water for us anymore, it's all getting so much tougher. Kills me to see the children struggling like this...
Undersupply#036.dst: 언덕 너머 저택이 이제 물을 거의 안 내주니 살기가 훨씬 팍팍해졌네. 아이들이 저렇게 고생하는 걸 보면 속이 다 타는구먼...
Undersupply#036.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#037.src: Oh, my! Who are you? In such fantastical equipment! Certainly not a guard- I've never seen anything like it! Oh me, oh my...
Undersupply#037.dst: 어머나! 누구세요? 그렇게 환상적인 장비를 걸치고! 경비병은 분명 아니고- 저런 건 처음 봐요! 어머, 세상에...
Undersupply#037.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#038.src: Unless... Are you, perhaps...I have heard whispers on the wind of a new Sovereign? I have seen our Sovereign dress rather differently, so maybe-
Undersupply#038.dst: 설마... 혹시 당신이...새 군주가 나셨다는 소문을 바람결에 들었거든요. 우리 군주님 차림은 좀 달랐으니, 어쩌면-
Undersupply#038.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#039.src: No? You aren't? Hm! Well, be that as it may, I do wish I could welcome you more hospitably, stranger, but we are in the lean time of the month- the leanest I have seen.
Undersupply#039.dst: 아니라고요? 흠! 그렇다 해도 낯선 분을 더 잘 대접하고 싶지만, 지금은 이 달에서 가장 궁핍한 때예요- 제가 본 중에 가장 심하죠.
Undersupply#039.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#040.src: So...as much as I would like to welcome you with a meal and a hot cup of tea... I simply can't. I am just so sorry for this, stranger- there is barely enough water for my own family to drink.
Undersupply#040.dst: 그래서...식사와 따뜻한 차로 맞이하고 싶지만... 그럴 수가 없어요. 정말 죄송해요, 낯선 분- 식구들이 마실 물조차 빠듯하거든요.
Undersupply#040.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#041.src: Oh, if only those nobles could spare more for us... Perhaps I could speak with them- but then, who would watch over my children here?
Undersupply#041.dst: 아, 그 귀족들이 조금만 더 나눠 준다면... 제가 직접 말해 볼까도 싶지만- 그러면 여기 아이들은 누가 보나요?
Undersupply#041.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#042.src: Whoa. That is positively outlandish dress. You...couldn't be a crown guard, can you be? That's simply so far out of uniform...so are you from the {p}, maybe?
Undersupply#042.dst: 와. 참으로 별난 옷차림이군요. 설마...왕실 근위병은 아니시죠? 제복과는 너무 동떨어졌는데...그럼 혹시 {p}에서 오셨나요?
Undersupply#042.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#043.src: But then, why would you be here? The Festival...isn't that soon over in {p}? Why come all the way over here? I've hardly anything to trade, even.
Undersupply#043.dst: 그런데 왜 여기까지 오셨나요? 축제...곧 {p}에서 열리지 않나요? 굳이 이 먼 데까지? 저는 팔 물건조차 거의 없는데요.
Undersupply#043.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#044.src: It's the dry season, you know. End of the month, I'm sure you- ehm, wait. Perhaps, since you live atop the dam, that isn't the case? Oh, what I would do for that luxury!
Undersupply#044.dst: 지금은 건기잖아요. 월말이라 아마 당신도- 어, 잠깐. 댐 위쪽에 사신다면 사정이 다르려나요? 아, 그런 호사라면 무엇이든 하겠어요!
Undersupply#044.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#045.src: Either way... It is difficult here. Perhaps I ought petition the Sovereeign to increase the rations. I'm sure he would listen, given how much he has helped in the past twenty years, or so.
Undersupply#045.dst: 어찌 됐든... 여긴 살기 힘들어요. 배급을 늘려 달라고 군주께 청원해야 할지도 모르겠네요. 지난 이십 년쯤 그렇게 많이 도와주셨으니 분명 들어주실 거예요.
Undersupply#045.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#046.src: Hrm. Can't even wash my clothes with the streams this claggy and slow... What a dilemma.
Undersupply#046.dst: 흠. 개울이 이렇게 걸쭉하고 느려서야 빨래도 못 하겠군... 참 난감하네.
Undersupply#046.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#047.src: I'm telling you, the guards in the dam are putting something in the water to turn the frogs gigantic!
Undersupply#047.dst: 내 말이 맞다니까, 댐의 경비병들이 물에 뭘 타서 개구리를 거대하게 만든다고!
Undersupply#047.speaker: Doyel

Undersupply#048.src: I've seen one with my own eyes, wandering about! Soon enough they'll send them to eat us!
Undersupply#048.dst: 내 두 눈으로 돌아다니는 걸 봤어! 머잖아 우릴 잡아먹으라고 풀어놓을 거야!
Undersupply#048.speaker: Doyel

Undersupply#049.src: What? Selling the house? What do you- Oh, that!
Undersupply#049.dst: 네? 집을 판다고요? 무슨 소리- 아, 그거요!
Undersupply#049.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#050.src: No, no, a salesman sold me a 'For Sale' sign, in case I wanted to sell something. I wasn't sure where else to put it, is all.
Undersupply#050.dst: 아니에요, 어떤 외판원이 뭔가 팔 때 쓰라고 '판매 중' 팻말을 팔았거든요. 달리 둘 데가 없어서 거기 놔둔 것뿐이에요.
Undersupply#050.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#051.src: It's dry enough here that I have considered it, though...
Undersupply#051.dst: 하긴 여기가 하도 메말라서 생각은 해 봤어요...
Undersupply#051.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#052.src: Make your way to the manor and question them. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#053.src: Welcome to the manor. Have the townspeople sent you?
Undersupply#053.dst: 저택에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 마을 사람들이 보냈습니까?
Undersupply#053.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#054.src: As I had expected. In that case, let me walk you to the masters.
Undersupply#054.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#055.src: Still- allow me to lead you to the masters.
Undersupply#055.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#056.src: Ah, haha! Hayn, who might this be? Ostentatious dress, I must declare! Is this a tourist come to tour the manor, mayhaps?
Undersupply#056.dst: 아, 하하! Hayn, 이분은 누구신가? 참으로 화려한 옷차림이로군! 혹시 저택을 구경하러 온 관광객인가?
Undersupply#056.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#057.src: Ohh... I see! The locals sent you. Then, allow me to enlighten you on the matter. You see, the Crown has entrusted us to manage the water supplied from the dam.
Undersupply#057.dst: 오오... 그렇군! 마을 사람들이 보냈구려. 그렇다면 이 일을 설명해 드리지. 왕실이 댐에서 내려오는 물의 관리를 우리에게 맡겼다네.
Undersupply#057.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#058.src: All potable water in the forest comes through us- it is our responsibility to ensure the rations we are given are spread to where it is most needed.
Undersupply#058.dst: 숲의 모든 식수는 우리를 거쳐 가지- 주어진 배급을 가장 필요한 곳으로 돌리는 것이 우리의 책임일세.
Undersupply#058.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#059.src: With the Crown Festival in {p} being about this time, the water must go there! Additionally, with all the new construction recently, there have been more places to ration out to.
Undersupply#059.dst: 이맘때 {p}에서 왕관 축제가 열리니 물은 그리로 가야 하네! 게다가 요즘 새로 짓는 곳이 많아 배급할 데도 늘었지.
Undersupply#059.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#060.src: We, too, have taken a smaller share than normal. The village down there, unfortunately, has been the lowest priority for some months now. I have petitioned the Sovereign for more water...
Undersupply#060.dst: 우리도 평소보다 적은 몫을 받고 있다네. 안타깝게도 저 아래 마을은 몇 달째 우선순위가 가장 낮았지. 물을 더 달라고 군주께 청원은 넣어 두었네만...
Undersupply#060.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#061.src: ...but that will not solve the problem here and now. Neither would a gulp here, or a bottle there. It does break my heart, it truly does! But we must take our responsibilities seriously.
Undersupply#061.dst: ...그것으로 지금 당장의 문제가 풀리진 않아. 여기 한 모금, 저기 한 병도 마찬가지고. 가슴이 아프다네, 정말이야! 하지만 우리는 책임을 엄중히 여겨야 하지.
Undersupply#061.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#062.src: ...Hm. Hm, hm, hm... But perhaps...what if...
Undersupply#062.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#063.src: Oh, do speak up! I hear you turning over an idea in your head, good Sir!
Undersupply#063.dst: 오, 말해 보시게! 머릿속에서 생각을 굴리는 소리가 들리는군, 경!
Undersupply#063.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#064.src: Well, perhaps it is a foolish thought. But, if they were to tinker with the dam's systems and let out more water for all of us earlier than the next month? Tide us over 'til the Nasin gets his head on straight?
Undersupply#064.dst: 어리석은 생각일지도 모릅니다. 하지만 누군가 댐의 장치를 만져서 다음 달보다 일찍 모두에게 물을 더 내보낸다면요? Nasin 가문 사람이 정신을 차릴 때까지 버틸 수 있지 않겠습니까?
Undersupply#064.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#065.src: Hm! Foolish indeed! Quite unlike you, I must say- only us and the highest ranks of the military have access to the dam! Why, we would be suspects number one, two, and three!
Undersupply#065.dst: 흠! 과연 어리석군! 자네답지 않은 말이야- 댐에 들어갈 수 있는 건 우리와 군 최고위층뿐일세! 그러면 우리가 용의자 일 번, 이 번, 삼 번이 아닌가!
Undersupply#065.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#066.src: And what if we were to...have some scofflaw break into the mansion, and lift the key, good Master? Why, we would be helpless bystanders, free of responsibility and suspicion.
Undersupply#066.dst: 그러면 어떤...무법자가 저택에 침입해 열쇠를 훔쳐 간다면 어떻겠습니까, 주인님? 우리는 그저 무력한 구경꾼이 되어 책임도 혐의도 없게 되지요.
Undersupply#066.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#067.src: ...you mean, to have this traveler pose as a thief, and steal the key to the dam?
Undersupply#067.dst: ...그러니까 이 여행자를 도둑으로 꾸며 댐 열쇠를 훔치게 하자는 말인가?
Undersupply#067.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#068.src: Hahaha!! There is wisdom I have known from you for so long! What a magnificient idea! It would not be without risk for you, traveler, but we all stand to gain!
Undersupply#068.dst: 하하하!! 내가 오래도록 알아 온 그 지혜로구먼! 참으로 훌륭한 생각이야! 여행자여, 자네에게 위험이 없진 않겠지만 우리 모두가 득을 볼 걸세!
Undersupply#068.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#069.src: The dam is guarded heavily, and assuredly the Crown's military would pursue you...but if you were to succeed, we could have more than enough water 'til the Sovereign receives our petition!
Undersupply#069.dst: 댐은 경비가 삼엄하고 왕실 군대가 자네를 쫓을 것이 분명하네...하지만 성공한다면 군주께서 청원을 받으실 때까지 물이 넘치도록 남을 걸세!
Undersupply#069.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#070.src: That being said, should you take it upon yourself to do this, we must pretend to have never met! To keep suspicion away from us, you know. Still, our gratitude will abound!
Undersupply#070.dst: 다만 자네가 이 일을 맡는다면, 우리는 만난 적도 없는 척해야 하네! 혐의를 피하려면 말이지. 그래도 우리의 감사는 넘칠 걸세!
Undersupply#070.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#071.src: Hayn! Please bring the stranger to the rose, under which we have hidden the key. And good tidings to you!
Undersupply#071.dst: Hayn! 이 손님을 열쇠를 숨겨 둔 장미로 안내하게. 그럼 행운을 비네!
Undersupply#071.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#072.src: Take the key to the dam from under the rose. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#073.src: Now, away with you, 'scofflaw!' Ah, haha! I shall be looking forward to sharing a veritable tidal wave of water with the forest!
Undersupply#073.dst: 자, 어서 가게, '무법자'여! 아, 하하! 숲과 함께 진짜 해일 같은 물을 나눌 날이 기다려지는군!
Undersupply#073.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#074.src: We shall call for the guards only after you are well out of sight. Be sure to leave a scene- it may delay them for longer.
Undersupply#074.dst: 당신이 충분히 멀어진 뒤에야 경비병을 부르겠습니다. 현장은 반드시 어지럽혀 두십시오- 그편이 더 오래 시간을 벌어 줄 겁니다.
Undersupply#074.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#075.src: Do make a mess, please. The masters will want a convincing scene.
Undersupply#075.dst: 부디 어질러 놓으십시오. 주인들께는 그럴듯한 현장이 필요합니다.
Undersupply#075.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#076.src: If you've taken the key, take it to the entrance east of here.
Undersupply#076.dst: 열쇠를 가지셨다면 여기서 동쪽 입구로 가십시오.
Undersupply#076.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#077.src: Enter the Fruma Dam and find a way to make the water flow. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Undersupply#077.dst: Fruma Dam에 들어가 물이 흐르게 할 방법을 찾으세요. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#078.src: Hm... Then, once you have entered the dam, you should avoid returning here. I would hate to see you escape, but be caught returning to the scene of the crime.
Undersupply#078.dst: 흠... 그럼 댐에 들어간 뒤로는 이곳에 돌아오지 마십시오. 잘 달아나고도 범행 현장에 돌아오다 붙잡히는 꼴은 보고 싶지 않군요.
Undersupply#078.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#079.src: So this is the scene of the robbery, then. And you say they took the key to the dam?
Undersupply#079.dst: 여기가 도난 현장이라는 거군. 그리고 댐 열쇠를 가져갔다고?
Undersupply#079.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#081.src: This room is too open to guard effectively. Reverse psychology doesn't work on thieves- they'll check the obvious spots to cover their bases.
Undersupply#081.dst: 이 방은 너무 트여 있어 제대로 지킬 수 없다. 도둑에게 역심리 따위는 안 통해- 뻔한 자리부터 빠짐없이 뒤지거든.
Undersupply#081.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#082.src: By this point...they likely will have gone into the dam. I'll have to mobilize the forces and deal with them.
Undersupply#082.dst: 이쯤이면...이미 댐에 들어갔겠군. 병력을 동원해 처리해야겠다.
Undersupply#082.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#083.src: I'll be reporting this. You'll get a replacement key, but lose it again and you'll be relieved of your responsibilities. Consider this your one chance.
Undersupply#083.dst: 이 건은 보고하겠다. 대체 열쇠를 받겠지만, 또 잃어버리면 직무에서 해임될 것이다. 이번이 마지막 기회라고 여겨라.
Undersupply#083.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#085.src: So this was your plan! Here to sabotage the game... trying to steal water for yourself? Or did you mean to bring destruction? Cause a flood?
Undersupply#085.dst: 이게 네 계획이었군! 방해 공작을 하러 와서... 혼자 물을 훔치려 했나? 아니면 파괴가 목적이었나? 홍수를 일으키려고?
Undersupply#085.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#086.src: I'll not be letting you get away with such heinous crimes. Lay down your weapons!
Undersupply#086.dst: 이런 흉악한 죄를 저지르고 빠져나가게 두지 않겠다. 무기를 버려라!
Undersupply#086.speaker: Commander Balsura

Undersupply#087.src: Return to the settlement and tell them about your success. [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Undersupply#088.src: The water seems to be flowing! Isn't it too early this month? I have to get back and tell the others.
Undersupply#088.dst: 물이 흐르는 것 같은데! 이번 달은 너무 이르지 않나? 돌아가서 다들한테 알려야겠군.
Undersupply#088.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#089.src: Wonderful, wonderful! I've sent Hayn with your payment to the village. Now hurry, hurry, 'scofflaw!' You wouldn't want to be caught, after all that trouble!
Undersupply#089.dst: 훌륭해, 훌륭해! 자네 보수는 Hayn 편에 마을로 보냈네. 자, 어서, 어서 가게, '무법자'여! 그 고생을 하고 잡히면 안 되지 않겠나!
Undersupply#089.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#090.src: Hm! You'd best be going, else the guards may catch you. Our butler has gone away to the village with a dividend of payment. Do hurry there, would you?
Undersupply#090.dst: 흠! 어서 가시는 게 좋겠습니다, 안 그러면 경비병에게 잡힐 테니. 집사가 보수를 나눠 들고 마을로 갔습니다. 서둘러 가 보시지요.
Undersupply#090.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#091.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#091.dst: 세상에... 맙소사! 우물이!! 여러분, 우물이 차오르고 있어요!! 우리 아이들- 이제 물을 마실 수 있어요!!
Undersupply#091.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#092.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... But I will not complain of good fortune!
Undersupply#092.dst: 강물도 흐르고 있어요! 다음 배급 때가 되려면 아직 멀었는데... 그래도 행운을 두고 불평하진 않겠어요!
Undersupply#092.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#093.src: Seems like the stranger with that spark in their eyes did it! Have to give 'em that discount I mentioned. I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is.
Undersupply#093.dst: 눈에 불꽃이 있던 그 낯선 양반이 해낸 모양이구먼! 말했던 할인은 해 줘야지. 이제 술집을 제대로 다시 열 수 있겠어! 참 좋은 날이야.
Undersupply#093.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#094.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! Was this... That strange fellow in the Sovereign-like dress... Did they...?! They must have!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#094.dst: 세상에... 맙소사! 우물이!! 여러분, 우물이 차오르고 있어요!! 혹시... 군주 같은 차림의 그 낯선 분이... 설마?! 분명 그분일 거예요!! 우리 아이들- 이제 물을 마셔요!!
Undersupply#094.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#095.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... But I will not complain of good fortune!
Undersupply#095.dst: 강물도 흐르고 있어요! 다음 배급 때가 되려면 아직 멀었는데... 그래도 행운을 두고 불평하진 않겠어요!
Undersupply#095.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#096.src: I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
Undersupply#096.dst: 이제 술집을 제대로 다시 열겠구먼! 참 좋은 날이야. 이보게, 낯선 양반...
Undersupply#096.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#097.src: My... My land! The well!! Everyone, the well is filling!! My children- They'll have their water!!
Undersupply#097.dst: 세상에... 맙소사! 우물이!! 여러분, 우물이 차오르고 있어요!! 우리 아이들- 이제 물을 마실 수 있어요!!
Undersupply#097.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#098.src: The river flows, as well! It certainly is not yet the time of the month for another ration... Oh! It must have been that tourist! Perhaps they asked the manor to release some extra?
Undersupply#098.dst: 강물도 흐르고 있어요! 다음 배급 때가 되려면 아직 멀었는데... 아! 분명 그 관광객이었을 거예요! 저택에 물을 더 내달라고 부탁했나 봐요.
Undersupply#098.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#099.src: I'll get to open up the bar proper again! What a fine day this is. Say, stranger...
Undersupply#099.dst: 이제 술집을 제대로 다시 열겠구먼! 참 좋은 날이야. 이보게, 낯선 양반...
Undersupply#099.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#100.src: So then! I have to figure this was you! Got the manor to let out a little extra, did you?
Undersupply#100.dst: 자 그럼! 이건 자네가 한 일이겠구먼! 저택이 물을 좀 더 내놓게 만든 거지?
Undersupply#100.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#101.src: They have risked life and limb to enter the dam and allow the water to flow freely. Show your thanks, and do not report them.
Undersupply#101.dst: 이분은 목숨을 걸고 댐에 들어가 물이 자유로이 흐르게 했습니다. 감사를 표하시고, 신고하지는 마십시오.
Undersupply#101.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#102.src: The masters have sent me to hand out compensation for your dangerous actions.
Undersupply#102.dst: 주인들께서 위험한 일을 하신 보상을 전하라고 저를 보내셨습니다.
Undersupply#102.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#103.src: Wait, the ro- Why did you jump off th- The masters, wh- Are you from the manor?! Why did-
Undersupply#103.dst: 잠깐, 지붕- 왜 거기서 뛰어내- 주인들이라니, 무- 저택에서 오셨어요?! 어째서-
Undersupply#103.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#104.src: There was no more water for the masters to give. They have fixed the problem for all of us.
Undersupply#104.dst: 주인들께 더 내줄 물이 없었습니다. 이분이 우리 모두의 문제를 해결하셨습니다.
Undersupply#104.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#105.src: Even you were short? Gracious. Still...our gardens may now grow, our children may now drink... We can only give you our utmost thanks, stranger!
Undersupply#105.dst: 그쪽도 모자랐다고요? 저런. 그래도...이제 정원이 자라고 아이들이 물을 마실 수 있겠네요... 낯선 분, 그저 깊이 감사드릴 뿐이에요!
Undersupply#105.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#106.src: Thank ye traveler. I gotta get myself back to the bar. See ye around and stay safe!
Undersupply#106.dst: 고맙네, 여행자. 난 술집으로 돌아가야겠어. 또 보세, 몸조심하고!
Undersupply#106.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#107.src: Did the butler just jump off the roof!? W-whatever, I have to get home! Thank you!
Undersupply#107.dst: 방금 집사가 지붕에서 뛰어내린 건가요!? 어, 아무튼 저는 집에 가야 해요! 고마워요!
Undersupply#107.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#108.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#108.dst: 그 물이 저택에도 도움이 되겠죠? 어쩔 수 없죠, 적어도 숲 전체에 나눠 주기는 하니까요.
Undersupply#108.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#109.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#109.dst: 꽤 영리한 장사꾼들이에요, 그 수완은 저도 이해해요. 조만간 조언이라도 구해 볼까 봐요!
Undersupply#109.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#110.src: I must be going now. The guards won't forgive you for slaying Balsura, but hopefully you can keep from being caught. Good luck.
Undersupply#110.dst: 이만 가 봐야겠습니다. Balsura를 죽인 일을 경비대가 용서하진 않겠지만, 부디 붙잡히지 않으시길. 행운을 빕니다.
Undersupply#110.speaker: Butler Hayn

Undersupply#111.src: Hey traveler, remember my promise? Discounted water for life! What do ye say? Want some?
Undersupply#111.dst: 이보게 여행자, 내 약속 기억하나? 평생 물 할인! 어떤가? 좀 마시려나?
Undersupply#111.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#113.src: Pleasure doing business with ye! Jokes aside, thanks for all you've done.
Undersupply#113.dst: 거래해서 즐거웠네! 농담은 접고, 자네가 해 준 모든 일에 고맙네.
Undersupply#113.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#114.src: Guh, you must be pulling my leg...! ...Thanks for all you've done, traveler.
Undersupply#114.dst: 허, 날 놀리는 게로군...! ...해 준 모든 일에 고맙네, 여행자.
Undersupply#114.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#115.src: Hey traveler, good work out there. Whenever the heat's off ye, come visit me!
Undersupply#115.dst: 이보게 여행자, 바깥일 잘했네. 소동이 잦아들거든 언제든 찾아오게!
Undersupply#115.speaker: Barkeep Romu

Undersupply#116.src: You're still around, traveler! Stay safe, please! I don't know what I would do if you were caught!
Undersupply#116.dst: 여행자님, 아직 여기 계셨군요! 부디 조심하세요! 붙잡히기라도 하면 어쩌나 싶어요!
Undersupply#116.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#117.src: Although, if you ever need some water, feel free to stop by!
Undersupply#117.speaker: Mother Aris

Undersupply#118.src: The water helps out the manor too, eh? It can't be helped, atleast they deliver it around the whole forest.
Undersupply#118.dst: 그 물이 저택에도 도움이 되겠죠? 어쩔 수 없죠, 적어도 숲 전체에 나눠 주기는 하니까요.
Undersupply#118.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#119.src: They're pretty smart businessmen, I can understand the hustle. Maybe I'll ask them for advice some time soon!
Undersupply#119.dst: 꽤 영리한 장사꾼들이에요, 그 수완은 저도 이해해요. 조만간 조언이라도 구해 볼까 봐요!
Undersupply#119.speaker: Merchant Risch

Undersupply#120.src: Hrm. I got so used to the stream being slow that I lost my last robe to the water flow. What a dilemma.
Undersupply#120.dst: 흠. 개울이 느린 데 익숙해진 탓에 마지막 남은 옷을 물살에 떠내려 보냈군. 참 난감하네.
Undersupply#120.speaker: Duress

Undersupply#121.src: I really ought to put away that 'For Sale' sign so no one else gets confused...
Undersupply#121.dst: 저 '판매 중' 팻말은 치워야겠어요, 또 누가 헷갈리기 전에...
Undersupply#121.speaker: Ryde

Undersupply#122.src: Fine work, indeed! I might welcome you with a cup of tea, but I cannot abide by 'scofflaws' such as yourself- wink, wink! Now away with you! Ah, haha!
Undersupply#122.dst: 참으로 훌륭한 솜씨야! 차라도 대접하고 싶지만 자네 같은 '무법자'를 두고 볼 순 없지- 윙크, 윙크! 자, 어서 가게! 아, 하하!
Undersupply#122.speaker: Master Oshman

Undersupply#123.src: Hm. Hm, hm, hm... I should keep better track of the ledgers. If I had noticed earlier, petitioned earlier... But of course, a Nasin wouldn't have thought ahead... Hm...
Undersupply#123.dst: 흠. 흠, 흠, 흠... 장부를 더 꼼꼼히 챙겼어야 했어. 더 일찍 알아채고 더 일찍 청원했더라면... 하긴, Nasin 가문 사람이 앞일을 내다볼 리가... 흠...
Undersupply#123.speaker: Sir Hurlay

Undersupply#124.src: Stay out of trouble from now on. The beginning of strife is as when one lets out water.
Undersupply#124.dst: 앞으로는 말썽을 피하십시오. 다툼의 시작은 둑을 터뜨리는 것과 같습니다.
Undersupply#124.speaker: Butler Hayn

similar.text: I'm glad to see you again.

Underwater#001.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that our fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#001.dst: 그런데 최근 이 난파선에 작은 구멍이 뚫렸어요. 그 안에 우리 재물이 숨겨져 있다고들 하죠.

Underwater#002.src: Talk to Omango located at the North of {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#003.src: Hi, my name is Omango. I am a resident of the {p} village, on top of the hill.
Underwater#003.dst: 안녕하세요, 저는 Omango예요. 언덕 위 {p} 마을 주민이죠.
Underwater#003.speaker: Omango

Underwater#004.src: As you may know, our people came to your land years ago, and this is the ship they used.
Underwater#004.dst: 아시다시피 우리 민족은 오래전 당신들의 땅으로 왔고, 이게 그때 탄 배예요.
Underwater#004.speaker: Omango

Underwater#005.src: They brought lots of luxurious goods with them. Most of them got lost in the wreck.
Underwater#005.dst: 그들은 값비싼 물건을 잔뜩 가져왔어요. 대부분은 난파와 함께 사라졌지만요.
Underwater#005.speaker: Omango

Underwater#006.src: But recently, a small hole has opened in the shipwreck here. It is believed that fortune is hidden within it.
Underwater#006.dst: 그런데 최근 이 난파선에 작은 구멍이 뚫렸어요. 그 안에 재물이 숨겨져 있다고들 하죠.
Underwater#006.speaker: Omango

Underwater#007.src: Unfortunately, nobody has been able to explore it. It is too deep, no creature can survive underwater that long!
Underwater#007.dst: 안타깝게도 아무도 탐사하지 못했어요. 너무 깊어서 그렇게 오래 물속에서 버틸 생물이 없거든요!
Underwater#007.speaker: Omango

Underwater#008.src: However, my old friend Sayrr is a fisherman, and I know that he has a very special helmet...
Underwater#008.dst: 그런데 제 오랜 친구 Sayrr가 어부인데, 아주 특별한 투구를 갖고 있어요...
Underwater#008.speaker: Omango

Underwater#009.src: If you convince him to give you this helmet, and find the treasure, I'll give you a part of it!
Underwater#009.dst: 그 투구를 받아 내고 보물을 찾아오면, 제가 그 몫을 나눠 드릴게요!
Underwater#009.speaker: Omango

Underwater#010.src: Sayrr is out on his boat, but the cave next to me is a quick way over to where he does his fishing. Be careful on the way, though.
Underwater#010.dst: Sayrr는 배에 나가 있지만, 제 옆 동굴이 그가 낚시하는 곳으로 가는 지름길이에요. 가는 길엔 조심하세요.
Underwater#010.speaker: Omango

Underwater#011.src: When you finally have the helmet, explore the ship and bring me back [{~} Ancient Treasure]. Good luck.
Underwater#011.dst: 투구를 손에 넣거든 배를 탐사해서 [{~} Ancient Treasure]를 가져다주세요. 행운을 빌어요.
Underwater#011.speaker: Omango

Underwater#012.src: Go through the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find Sayrr on his boat on the other side
Underwater#012.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴을 지나 반대편 배 위에 있는 Sayrr를 찾으세요

Underwater#013.src: Why ya looking at me like that? Is it cause I'm small, eh? I'll have you know that I caught fish that were twice your size!
Underwater#013.dst: 왜 그런 눈으로 봐? 내가 작아서 그래, 응? 내가 네 두 배만 한 물고기도 잡아 봤다고!
Underwater#013.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#014.src: ...or, well, I used to be able to. Nothing's biting recently- wait a sec, why'd you hop on my boat anyways, stranger?
Underwater#014.dst: ...뭐, 예전엔 그랬지. 요즘은 통 안 물어- 잠깐, 낯선 양반, 대체 왜 내 배에 올라탄 거야?
Underwater#014.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#015.src: Ahah! Yes, I still have that old breathing helmet. You want it? You'll have to do something for me first.
Underwater#015.dst: 아하! 그래, 그 낡은 호흡 투구는 아직 있지. 갖고 싶어? 그럼 먼저 내 부탁을 하나 들어줘야 해.
Underwater#015.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#016.src: I'm sure you heard me, but the fish just aren't biting around here anymore! I need to make a living somehow! There's some fish in that cave, but...
Underwater#016.dst: 아까 들었겠지만, 이 근처엔 이제 물고기가 안 물어! 나도 먹고살아야 할 거 아냐! 저 동굴엔 물고기가 좀 있는데...
Underwater#016.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#017.src: ...it's a bit dangerous. Tell ya what, I'll give you my fishing rod, and you can go catch me, say, [{~} Gudgeon Meat] down there.
Underwater#017.dst: ...거긴 좀 위험해. 이렇게 하자, 내 낚싯대를 줄 테니 저 아래서 [{~} Gudgeon Meat] 정도만 잡아다 줘.
Underwater#017.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#018.src: The helmet will be all yours after that.
Underwater#018.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#019.src: Bring back [{~} Gudgeon Meat] found in the cave at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to Sayrr
Underwater#019.dst: [{~} Gudgeon Meat]를 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 동굴에서 구해 Sayrr에게 가져가세요

Underwater#020.src: Ah! Welcome back! Any luck with the fish?
Underwater#020.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#021.src: Great, and I'll thank you kindly. Here's your helmet, have fun with that.
Underwater#021.dst: 좋아, 정말 고맙다. 여기 투구, 재밌게 써.
Underwater#021.speaker: Sayrr

Underwater#022.src: Explore the crashed ship for a lost treasure at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Underwater#023.src: Break the crate and bring [{~} Old Treasure] to Omango at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Underwater#023.dst: 상자를 부수고 [{~} Old Treasure]를 [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Omango에게 가져가세요

Underwater#024.src: You got it! You found the treasure!
Underwater#024.speaker: Omango

Underwater#025.src: As promised, here's your part of the loot.
Underwater#025.speaker: Omango

Wrath of the Mummy#000.src: Do I know anything about Mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#000.dst: 미라를 아느냐고요? 당연하죠! 평생 미라만 연구했는걸요!

Wrath of the Mummy#001.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak, especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil. It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#001.dst: 미라는 결코 약한 존재가 아니에요, 특히 그놈은요. 악마 같고... 순수한 악이죠. 제가 마주친 것 중 가장 강한 개체에 쉽게 듭니다.

Wrath of the Mummy#002.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#002.dst: 아니면... 이봐. 내가 분홍 양털을 손에 넣고 싶어 벼르고 있었는데, 그걸 파는 유일한 가게에 방금 물건이 들어왔대.

Wrath of the Mummy#003.src: Or better yet, if you happen to have some of that pink wool on you. If you give it to me, well... the tomb is all yours.
Wrath of the Mummy#003.dst: 아니면 더 좋은 건, 네가 마침 분홍 양털을 좀 갖고 있는 거지. 그걸 주면, 뭐... 무덤은 네 마음대로 해.

Wrath of the Mummy#004.src: Either way, you can take my wagon over there to {p}, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#004.dst: 어쨌든 저기 내 수레를 타고 {p}에 가도 돼, 돌아올 땐 알아서 와야 하지만. [{~} Pink Wool]을 주면 통과시켜 줄게.

Wrath of the Mummy#005.src: Have you got me [{~} Pink Wool] yet!? You can get it from the shop in {p}.
Wrath of the Mummy#005.dst: [{~} Pink Wool] 구해 왔어!? {p}의 가게에서 살 수 있어.

Wrath of the Mummy#006.src: I don't know you, and you don't know me. Got it?
Wrath of the Mummy#006.dst: 난 널 모르고, 넌 날 몰라. 알겠지?

Wrath of the Mummy#007.src: Talk to Ormrod in the desert of {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#009.src: I live in this camp by choice. A curse follows me... and now trouble starts wherever I go. I left civilization and made camp in the desert, where I could do no more harm.
Wrath of the Mummy#009.dst: 저는 스스로 이 야영지에 살아요. 저주가 저를 따라다녀서... 제가 가는 곳마다 사달이 나죠. 그래서 문명을 떠나 더는 해를 끼치지 않을 사막에 자리를 잡았어요.
Wrath of the Mummy#009.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#010.src: I do miss the comforts of {p} some days, though... you look like a learned adventurer. If I asked you to investigate this curse, perhaps you could help me rid myself of it?
Wrath of the Mummy#010.dst: 그래도 어떤 날은 {p}의 안락함이 그립네요... 당신은 배운 모험가처럼 보이는군요. 이 저주를 조사해 달라고 부탁하면, 저를 벗어나게 해 줄 수 있을까요?
Wrath of the Mummy#010.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#011.src: It all started when I discovered an old tomb in the North of the desert. Upon entering it, the ground started shaking and I heard inhuman screams coming from deeper within.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.dst: 모든 건 제가 사막 북쪽에서 오래된 무덤을 발견하면서 시작됐어요. 안으로 들어서자 땅이 흔들리더니, 더 깊은 곳에서 사람의 것이 아닌 비명이 들려왔죠.
Wrath of the Mummy#011.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#012.src: I ran as fast as I could, learning later the tomb housed the remains of an ancient Mummy... which I accidentally awoke. If the Mummy could be put back to rest, perhaps the curse would go away.
Wrath of the Mummy#012.dst: 죽을힘을 다해 달아났고, 나중에야 그 무덤에 고대 미라의 유해가 있었다는 걸 알았어요... 제가 실수로 깨운 거죠. 그 미라를 다시 잠재울 수 있다면 저주도 사라질지 몰라요.
Wrath of the Mummy#012.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#013.src: I have heard of a scholar in {p}, Achper, who may know more about the tomb. I am reluctant to return to the city, in case my presence hurts anyone else.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.dst: {p}에 Achper라는 학자가 있는데 그 무덤에 대해 더 알지도 몰라요. 제 존재가 또 누군가를 다치게 할까 봐 도시로 돌아가긴 꺼려지네요.
Wrath of the Mummy#013.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#014.src: If you would truly like to help, you should start by talking to him.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.dst: 정말 돕고 싶다면, 먼저 그에게 말을 걸어 보세요.
Wrath of the Mummy#014.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#015.src: Talk to Achper in {p} about the curse at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#016.src: If I know about mummies? Of course! I've spent my entire life studying them!
Wrath of the Mummy#016.dst: 미라를 아느냐고요? 당연하죠! 평생 미라만 연구했는걸요!
Wrath of the Mummy#016.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#017.src: They usually are very hard to reach, hidden in their tomb... and they don't like being disturbed.
Wrath of the Mummy#017.dst: 보통은 무덤 깊이 숨어 있어 접근하기 어렵죠... 게다가 방해받는 걸 아주 싫어해요.
Wrath of the Mummy#017.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#018.src: I have heard of the curse that follows Ormrod, and the only way to remove its effects would be to kill the mummy.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.dst: Ormrod를 따라다니는 저주 얘기는 들었어요. 그 효과를 없애는 유일한 방법은 미라를 죽이는 겁니다.
Wrath of the Mummy#018.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#019.src: The tomb lies in the North of the desert, but be very careful!
Wrath of the Mummy#019.dst: 무덤은 사막 북쪽에 있어요, 하지만 아주 조심하세요!
Wrath of the Mummy#019.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#020.src: Mummies aren't known to be weak... especially that one. It's demonic... pure evil, It's easily one of the most powerful specimens I've encountered.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.dst: 미라는 결코 약한 존재가 아니에요... 특히 그놈은요. 악마 같고... 순수한 악이죠. 제가 마주친 것 중 가장 강한 개체에 쉽게 듭니다.
Wrath of the Mummy#020.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#021.src: On top of that, the Creden Tibus bandit clan have been ransacking the tombs around the desert. You might run into trouble with them, so be prepared.
Wrath of the Mummy#021.dst: 게다가 Creden Tibus 도적단이 사막 곳곳의 무덤을 털고 다녀요. 그들과 부딪칠 수도 있으니 준비하세요.
Wrath of the Mummy#021.speaker: Achper

Wrath of the Mummy#022.src: Attempt to enter the Mummy's tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Wrath of the Mummy#023.src: Stop! If you're thinking about looting the tomb, you're too late. The Creden Tibus have laid claim here, and you're not getting past.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.dst: 멈춰! 무덤을 털 생각이라면 이미 늦었어. 여긴 Creden Tibus가 차지했고, 넌 못 지나가.
Wrath of the Mummy#023.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#024.src: Mummy? Curse? I don't know anything about that, but I can't let you in - how do I know you won't just grab the gold?
Wrath of the Mummy#024.dst: 미라? 저주? 그런 건 하나도 몰라. 어쨌든 못 들여보내 - 네가 금을 안 챙긴다는 보장이 어딨어?
Wrath of the Mummy#024.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#025.src: Unless... look. I've been waiting to get my hands on some pink wool, and the only shop that sells it has just been restocked.
Wrath of the Mummy#025.dst: 아니면... 이봐. 내가 분홍 양털을 손에 넣고 싶어 벼르고 있었는데, 그걸 파는 유일한 가게에 방금 물건이 들어왔대.
Wrath of the Mummy#025.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#026.src: Trouble is, the shop's over in {p} and I'm stuck guarding this tomb. If you go and grab me some before it sells out, I can look the other way.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.dst: 문제는 그 가게가 {p}에 있고 난 여기 무덤을 지켜야 한다는 거지. 다 팔리기 전에 좀 구해다 주면, 못 본 척해 줄게.
Wrath of the Mummy#026.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#027.src: You can take my wagon over there, but you'll have to make your own way back. Give me [{~} Pink Wool] and I'll let you through.
Wrath of the Mummy#027.dst: 저기 내 수레를 타고 가도 돼, 돌아올 땐 알아서 와야 하지만. [{~} Pink Wool]을 주면 통과시켜 줄게.
Wrath of the Mummy#027.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#028.src: Use the bandit's wagon at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] to get to {p}.

Wrath of the Mummy#029.src: Bring back [{~} Pink Wool] to the bandit at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#030.src: Well, whaddya know? You got some Pink Wool! Okay, hand it here and I'll look the other way and let you into the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#030.dst: 야, 이것 봐라? 분홍 양털을 구해 왔네! 좋아, 이리 넘겨. 못 본 척하고 무덤에 들여보내 줄게.
Wrath of the Mummy#030.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#031.src: Just don't touch any of the gold, hmm? And if I were you, I wouldn't go in too deep.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.dst: 금엔 손대지 마, 알았지? 그리고 내가 너라면 너무 깊이는 안 들어가.
Wrath of the Mummy#031.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#032.src: The clan was going to explore further inside, but the sounds...
Wrath of the Mummy#032.dst: 우리 패거리도 더 안쪽까지 가 보려 했는데, 그 소리가...
Wrath of the Mummy#032.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#033.src: Anyway, I'll still let you inside if you want. Just remember, if anyone asks, this conversation never happened.
Wrath of the Mummy#033.dst: 아무튼 원하면 들여보내 줄게. 다만 누가 묻거든, 이 대화는 없었던 거야.
Wrath of the Mummy#033.speaker: Bandit

Wrath of the Mummy#034.src: Enter the tomb at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] and kill the Mummy.

Wrath of the Mummy#035.src: Bring [{~} Mummy's Bandage] to Ormrod at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Wrath of the Mummy#036.src: Hello, again... have you had any luck?
Wrath of the Mummy#036.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#037.src: Those are the Mummy's bandages?! You did it? My curse is finally lifted!
Wrath of the Mummy#037.dst: 그게 미라의 붕대인가요?! 해낸 거예요? 드디어 저주가 풀렸어요!
Wrath of the Mummy#037.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#038.src: I can't thank you enough! As a reward, take this rag I got from the Mummy when I entered the tomb.
Wrath of the Mummy#038.dst: 뭐라 감사해야 할지! 보답으로, 제가 무덤에 들어갔을 때 미라에게서 얻은 이 천을 받으세요.
Wrath of the Mummy#038.speaker: Ormrod

Wrath of the Mummy#039.src: I am not strong enough to wear it, but I'm sure you are! Take these emeralds too, that's the least I can do!
Wrath of the Mummy#039.dst: 저는 그걸 걸칠 만큼 강하지 않지만 당신은 분명 강하죠! 이 에메랄드도 받아요, 이 정도는 해야죠!
Wrath of the Mummy#039.speaker: Ormrod

WynnExcavation Site A#002.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh, and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#002.dst: 석판 하나 완성! Vade에게 돌려주세요. 아, 읽으면 안 돼요!

WynnExcavation Site A#003.src: A strange force pushes you back!

WynnExcavation Site A#004.src: What are you still doing over here? Go finish your assignment! It's written in your content book.
WynnExcavation Site A#004.dst: 아직 여기서 뭐 하냐? 가서 일 마저 끝내! 콘텐츠 북에 다 적혀 있잖아.

WynnExcavation Site A#006.src: Oh, hey kid. Wanna make some money?
WynnExcavation Site A#006.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#007.src: I need you to translate this ancient text.
WynnExcavation Site A#007.dst: 이 고대 문서를 번역해 오면 돼.
WynnExcavation Site A#007.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#008.src: Just run it down to the lab assistant, Tesha.
WynnExcavation Site A#008.dst: 실험실 조수 Tesha에게 갖다주기만 하면 돼.
WynnExcavation Site A#008.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#009.src: I'd take it myself, but I'm far too important for grunt work! The lab is up there in the tent, and don't you dare damage the translation!
WynnExcavation Site A#009.dst: 내가 직접 가도 되지만, 난 잡일이나 할 만큼 한가한 몸이 아니거든! 실험실은 저 위 천막이야, 번역본 망가뜨리기만 해 봐!
WynnExcavation Site A#009.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#010.src: Bring the Ancient Writing to Tesha in the tents at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
WynnExcavation Site A#010.dst: 고대 문서를 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 천막에 있는 Tesha에게 가져가세요

WynnExcavation Site A#013.src: Oh yes, the tablet I was waiting for!
WynnExcavation Site A#013.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#015.src: Oh my! This is quite interesting..
WynnExcavation Site A#015.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#016.src: Here, let me finish this up...
WynnExcavation Site A#016.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#018.src: One tablet complete! Return it to Vade. Oh and don't read it!
WynnExcavation Site A#018.dst: 석판 하나 완성! Vade에게 돌려주세요. 아, 읽으면 안 돼요!
WynnExcavation Site A#018.speaker: Tesha

WynnExcavation Site A#019.src: Return to Excavator Vade with the translated writing
WynnExcavation Site A#019.dst: 번역된 문서를 들고 발굴꾼 Vade에게 돌아가세요

WynnExcavation Site A#021.src: Oh right, you're that kid I sent out!
WynnExcavation Site A#021.dst: 아 맞다, 내가 보낸 그 꼬마구나!
WynnExcavation Site A#021.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#022.src: Well do you have the translated text or not?
WynnExcavation Site A#022.dst: 그래서 번역본은 가져온 거야, 만 거야?
WynnExcavation Site A#022.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#023.src: You do! Brilliant! Let's take a look at that...
WynnExcavation Site A#023.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#024.src: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#024.dst: "튀어나온 나무에 공물을 던져라, 각도가 맞으면 길이 열리리라"
WynnExcavation Site A#024.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#025.src: I wonder if it is talking about inside the temple... Oh, uh, I forgot you were here. Stay out of this kid, it's grown up business!
WynnExcavation Site A#025.dst: 이게 신전 안쪽 얘긴가... 아, 어, 네가 있는 걸 깜빡했네. 꼬마는 빠져, 이건 어른들 일이야!
WynnExcavation Site A#025.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#026.src: Solve this riddle in the tomb: "Throw tribute an item to the wood that stands out, the right angle will open the way"
WynnExcavation Site A#026.dst: 무덤에서 이 수수께끼를 푸세요: "튀어나온 나무에 공물을 던져라, 각도가 맞으면 길이 열리리라"

WynnExcavation Site A#028.src: Return and talk to Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#029.src: Hey kid, did you just come from the tomb?
WynnExcavation Site A#029.dst: 야 꼬마, 방금 무덤에서 나온 거야?
WynnExcavation Site A#029.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#030.src: I knew I shouldn't have been so lazy and got someone else to do the leg work!
WynnExcavation Site A#030.dst: 게으름 피우면서 남한테 심부름을 시키는 게 아니었어!
WynnExcavation Site A#030.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#031.src: Gosh, I can't tell my boss about this, he'll have my head! Literally! Wynn Excavation is not a group you want to betray, they are more powerful than you will ever know.
WynnExcavation Site A#031.dst: 이런, 상사한테 이걸 말할 순 없어, 내 목을 날릴 거라고! 진짜로! Wynn Excavation은 배신해서 좋을 조직이 아니야, 네가 아는 것보다 훨씬 강력하니까.
WynnExcavation Site A#031.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site A#032.src: YOU'D BETTER NOT HAVE TAKEN ANYTHING! THAT IS OFFICIAL WYNNEXCAVATION PROPERTY!
WynnExcavation Site A#032.dst: 아무것도 가져가지 않았기를 바란다! 그건 WYNNEXCAVATION의 공식 재산이야!
WynnExcavation Site A#032.speaker: Excavator Vade

WynnExcavation Site B#000.src: Hello there! We are working very hard here at this excavation site! We have one in {p} as well, I think you should check it out!

WynnExcavation Site B#001.src: Bring the Yellow Crystal Shard to Excavator Lykron at [{~}, {~}, -{~}] The entrance to the cave is at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
WynnExcavation Site B#001.dst: 노란 수정 조각을 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 발굴꾼 Lykron에게 가져가세요. 동굴 입구는 [{~}, {~}, -{~}]입니다.

WynnExcavation Site B#002.src: Good day! You're the person that helped us out in the desert aren't you? Excellent! Just the person I need! Can you help me out with a problem I have?
WynnExcavation Site B#002.dst: 안녕하세요! 사막에서 우릴 도와준 그분 맞죠? 훌륭해요! 딱 필요한 사람이에요! 제 문제 하나만 도와주시겠어요?
WynnExcavation Site B#002.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#003.src: Perfect! You see, we are supposed to be searching for some of the... uhhh... long lost ruins of ancient Wynn, just like in the desert!
WynnExcavation Site B#003.dst: 완벽해요! 그러니까 우리는... 어어... 고대 Wynn의 잃어버린 유적을 찾는 일을 하고 있어요, 사막에서처럼요!
WynnExcavation Site B#003.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#004.src: However, it seems no progress has been made recently; my workers have stopped working!
WynnExcavation Site B#004.dst: 그런데 최근엔 진전이 전혀 없어요. 인부들이 일을 멈춰 버렸거든요!
WynnExcavation Site B#004.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#005.src: The problem is, there are strange creatures down at the bottom of the cave disturbing them.
WynnExcavation Site B#005.dst: 문제는 동굴 밑바닥에 이상한 생물들이 있어서 그들을 방해한다는 거예요.
WynnExcavation Site B#005.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#006.src: I need you to go and kill them, but first you should go talk to one of my colleagues, he has more information for you.
WynnExcavation Site B#006.dst: 가서 그것들을 처치해 주세요. 다만 먼저 제 동료에게 가서 얘기해 보세요, 더 자세한 정보를 줄 거예요.
WynnExcavation Site B#006.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#007.src: He is located directly at the bottom of this cave, go speak to him, go on now! Off you go!
WynnExcavation Site B#007.dst: 그는 이 동굴 맨 아래에 있어요, 가서 말을 걸어 보세요, 어서요! 출발!
WynnExcavation Site B#007.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#008.src: Investigate the depths of the cave

WynnExcavation Site B#009.src: We know what you stole from us in the desert! Take THIS! You won't be escaping this dead end any time soon!
WynnExcavation Site B#009.dst: 사막에서 우리한테서 뭘 훔쳤는지 다 알아! 이거나 받아라! 이 막다른 길에서 쉽게는 못 빠져나갈걸!
WynnExcavation Site B#009.speaker: Flendar

WynnExcavation Site B#013.src: This door is closed; the mine entrance behind it isn't open at this time.
WynnExcavation Site B#013.dst: 이 문은 닫혀 있다. 뒤쪽 광산 입구는 지금 개방되지 않는다.
WynnExcavation Site B#013.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#014.src: I'm here to make sure no one uses the passage while the archaeologist works.
WynnExcavation Site B#014.dst: 고고학자가 작업하는 동안 아무도 이 통로를 쓰지 못하게 지키고 있다.
WynnExcavation Site B#014.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#015.src: You will have to find another exit if you want to get out!
WynnExcavation Site B#015.dst: 나가고 싶으면 다른 출구를 찾아야 할 거다!
WynnExcavation Site B#015.speaker: WynnExcavation Guard

WynnExcavation Site B#016.src: Baffling... What a puzzling situation I am in...
WynnExcavation Site B#016.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#017.src: I cannot open this door for some reason...
WynnExcavation Site B#017.dst: 무슨 영문인지 이 문이 열리지 않는군...
WynnExcavation Site B#017.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#018.src: We suspect the purple crystal is behind this door, but the descriptions in the scriptures don't match this door.
WynnExcavation Site B#018.dst: 보라 수정이 이 문 뒤에 있다고 보는데, 경전의 묘사가 이 문과 맞지 않아.
WynnExcavation Site B#018.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#019.src: They seem to describe another door, but all our evidence says otherwise.
WynnExcavation Site B#019.dst: 다른 문을 묘사한 것 같은데, 우리 증거는 모두 반대를 가리키지.
WynnExcavation Site B#019.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#020.src: The scriptures also say something about hidden within the rocks... But we removed them all!
WynnExcavation Site B#020.dst: 경전엔 바위 속에 숨겨져 있다는 말도 있는데... 우린 바위를 다 치웠다고!
WynnExcavation Site B#020.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#021.src: Well, the writing isn't actually all that clear. It could mean virtually anything, I think one of these words means hippo! Guess we'll have to find out!
WynnExcavation Site B#021.dst: 사실 글이 그리 명확하지도 않아. 거의 무슨 뜻으로든 읽히지, 이 단어 중 하나는 하마 같단 말이야! 결국 해 봐야 알겠군!
WynnExcavation Site B#021.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#022.src: Anyway, back to figuring out what needs to be done here... Wait, who are you, you're not an employee of WynnExcavation!
WynnExcavation Site B#022.dst: 아무튼, 여기서 뭘 해야 할지 다시 궁리해 보자... 잠깐, 넌 누구야, WynnExcavation 직원이 아니잖아!
WynnExcavation Site B#022.speaker: WynnExcavation Archaeologist

WynnExcavation Site B#024.src: I have to admit, I'm impressed. I genuinely thought our plan would be successful. Who knew that dead end had a secret exit.
WynnExcavation Site B#024.dst: 인정하죠, 감탄했어요. 우리 계획이 성공할 거라 진심으로 믿었는데. 그 막다른 길에 비밀 출구가 있을 줄이야.
WynnExcavation Site B#024.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#025.src: Not me apparently. We know what you took in the desert, you were just some kid expected to do a delivery job, who knew you'd take a shard of the crystal.
WynnExcavation Site B#025.dst: 난 몰랐죠. 사막에서 뭘 가져갔는지 우린 알아요. 그냥 심부름이나 할 꼬마인 줄 알았는데, 수정 조각을 챙겨 갈 줄이야.
WynnExcavation Site B#025.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#026.src: Don't pretend like you don't know what it is, you know as well as I do combining the four crystal shards is told to bring unlimited power!
WynnExcavation Site B#026.dst: 그게 뭔지 모르는 척하지 마요. 네 개의 수정 조각을 합치면 무한한 힘이 나온다는 걸 나만큼 잘 알잖아요!
WynnExcavation Site B#026.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#027.src: You will not interfere any longer. The location of the remaining crystals are known only to us; the fire and leaf crystals are safe.
WynnExcavation Site B#027.dst: 더는 방해하지 못할 거예요. 남은 수정의 위치는 우리만 알죠. 불의 수정과 잎의 수정은 안전합니다.
WynnExcavation Site B#027.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site B#028.src: I see that tricking you isn't the way to defeating you. If we ever meet again, we'll be using force and upping our security. Now I never want to see you again. Our socie- I mean company, will not tolerate your interference again.
WynnExcavation Site B#028.dst: 속임수로는 당신을 이길 수 없다는 걸 알겠군요. 다시 만나게 되면 무력을 쓰고 경비도 강화할 겁니다. 이제 두 번 다시 보고 싶지 않군요. 우리 결사- 아니, 회사는 당신의 간섭을 다시는 용납하지 않을 겁니다.
WynnExcavation Site B#028.speaker: Excavator Lykron

WynnExcavation Site C#000.src: I need you to bring me something. It should be written in your content book.

WynnExcavation Site C#001.src: I can't let you through without a pass.

WynnExcavation Site C#002.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C.

WynnExcavation Site C#003.src: May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far.

WynnExcavation Site C#004.src: The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.

WynnExcavation Site C#005.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult.

WynnExcavation Site C#006.src: Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that.

WynnExcavation Site C#007.src: We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.

WynnExcavation Site C#008.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved.

WynnExcavation Site C#009.src: However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations.

WynnExcavation Site C#010.src: The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.

WynnExcavation Site C#011.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location.

WynnExcavation Site C#012.src: All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.

WynnExcavation Site C#013.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The WynnExcavation "company" is not what they appear to be.

WynnExcavation Site C#014.src: For the last few years, they have been seeking a quartet of cosmic crystals that have been prominent across Wynn's history.

WynnExcavation Site C#015.src: Many different empires and societies in the province have held at least one of them since they were uncovered {~} years ago deep within Wynn's southern border, though none have ever combined all four.

WynnExcavation Site C#016.src: The ancient desert empire, the Twain brothers, and an unknown party that cast this volcano's crystal into the ocean are among those who have guarded even one of these Crystals over the years. Their value is nothing short of immeasurable.

WynnExcavation Site C#017.src: WynnExcavation heard about it, and of course, set out to gather these artifacts in their attempt to claim absolute power over the entire world. Do you understand? We CANNOT let them have those crystals.

WynnExcavation Site C#018.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. If we wish to stop them, then it's an essential step.

similar.text: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.

WynnExcavation Site C#019.src: I hope all of our troubles have been settled. Now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#019.dst: 우리 문제가 모두 해결되었기를 바라오. 그럼 실례하겠소, 참석할 회의가 있어서.

WynnExcavation Site C#020.src: Talk to Excavator Placardus at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site B)
WynnExcavation Site C#020.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 발굴꾼 Placardus에게 말을 거세요 (Site B의 조각 필요)

WynnExcavation Site C#021.src: All operations functional... Transportation on schedule... Oh. It's you. We've been looking for you.
WynnExcavation Site C#021.dst: 모든 작업 정상... 운송 일정대로... 오. 당신이군요. 계속 찾고 있었습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#021.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#022.src: Locating you was far harder than we thought, but here you are, having come right to us.
WynnExcavation Site C#022.dst: 당신을 찾는 건 생각보다 훨씬 어려웠는데, 이렇게 제 발로 찾아오셨군요.
WynnExcavation Site C#022.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#023.src: Now you're here, I'm not sure what to say. But I feel I must explain, we at WynnExcavation apologise for all our previous encounters.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.dst: 막상 오시니 무슨 말을 해야 할지 모르겠군요. 그래도 설명은 해야겠죠. WynnExcavation은 지난 모든 충돌에 대해 사과드립니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#023.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#024.src: We completely got off on the wrong foot. We are a company from Gavel which specialises in historic artifacts of great mystical importance.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.dst: 우리는 처음부터 완전히 어긋났습니다. 우리는 신비적으로 중요한 역사 유물을 전문으로 다루는 Gavel의 회사입니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#024.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#025.src: After our encounter in {p}, we naturally thought you were a black market salesperson trying to steal pieces of the artifact for monetary gain.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.dst: {p}에서 마주친 뒤로, 우리는 당연히 당신을 돈을 노리고 유물 조각을 훔치는 암시장 상인이라 여겼습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#025.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#026.src: So we instructed all of our employees in all of our sites to thwart you at any cost. Historical loss is a very important issue, especially with something so powerful.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.dst: 그래서 모든 현장의 직원에게 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 당신을 막으라고 지시했죠. 역사적 손실은 매우 중대한 문제입니다, 그토록 강력한 물건이라면 더욱요.
WynnExcavation Site C#026.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#027.src: But after hearing the stories of your travels in the province, we realised what had happened, and you mistook us for the enemy. This is obviously not the case.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.dst: 하지만 지방을 누비는 당신의 여행담을 듣고서야 무슨 일이 있었는지 알았습니다. 당신은 우리를 적으로 오해했죠. 물론 그렇지 않습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#027.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#028.src: I hope this clears everything up between us and we can both move our separate ways, now if you'll excuse me, I have a meeting to attend.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.dst: 이걸로 우리 사이의 오해가 풀리고 각자의 길을 갈 수 있기를 바랍니다. 그럼 실례하죠, 참석할 회의가 있어서요.
WynnExcavation Site C#028.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#029.src: Infiltrate the Excavation Meeting. The meeting is held in a diamond-pickaxe room, the portal being located to the left of the entrance to a large lava cave.
WynnExcavation Site C#029.dst: 발굴 회의에 잠입하세요. 회의는 다이아몬드 곡괭이가 있는 방에서 열리며, 포털은 거대한 용암 동굴 입구 왼쪽에 있습니다.

WynnExcavation Site C#030.src: I'm sorry. This is a private meeting.
WynnExcavation Site C#030.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#031.src: It is only my first day on the job, so I can't let you in without a pass. Sorry.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.dst: 오늘 첫 근무라서요, 통행증 없이는 들여보낼 수 없습니다. 죄송합니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#031.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#032.src: The door will be locked shortly.
WynnExcavation Site C#032.speaker: Guard Klerodor

WynnExcavation Site C#034.src: Hello and welcome, senior members of Wynn Excavation Site C. May the dark's gaze forever watch over us. I want to update you on our progress thus far. The fire relic crystal has been largely intact in the heart of the volcano for many years.
WynnExcavation Site C#034.dst: 환영합니다, Wynn Excavation C 현장의 고위 구성원 여러분. 어둠의 시선이 영원히 우리를 굽어보기를. 지금까지의 진척을 보고드리겠습니다. 불의 유물 수정은 오랜 세월 화산 심장부에서 거의 온전하게 남아 있었습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#034.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#035.src: Removing it will most likely cause a chain reaction and make things difficult. Fortunately, a mage from the other side of the ocean is here to counter that. We can expect to have it moved and be shipped over to the undisclosed location any day now.
WynnExcavation Site C#035.dst: 그것을 꺼내면 연쇄 반응이 일어나 일이 까다로워질 가능성이 큽니다. 다행히 바다 건너에서 온 마법사가 이를 막아 줄 겁니다. 머지않아 수정을 옮겨 비공개 장소로 운송할 수 있으리라 봅니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#035.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#036.src: I would also like to inform you that the crystals removed from our possession from sites B and A have not been retrieved. However, the culprit should no longer be interested in our operations. The lost crystals did not harness any raw magic, thus are not essential to the overall scheme.
WynnExcavation Site C#036.dst: 또한 B 현장과 A 현장에서 우리 손을 떠난 수정들은 아직 회수하지 못했음을 알려 드립니다. 다만 범인은 더 이상 우리 작전에 관심이 없을 겁니다. 잃어버린 수정들은 원시 마력을 품지 않아 전체 계획에 필수적이지 않습니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#036.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#037.src: Now, our short term goals are to move our equipment out of the heart of the volcano and start moving the fire stone for assimilation at the concealed location. All senior officers are responsible for their quadrants. Let's get this done efficiently and discreetly.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.dst: 이제 단기 목표는 화산 심장부에서 장비를 빼내고, 은닉 장소에서의 동화를 위해 불의 돌을 옮기기 시작하는 것입니다. 모든 고위 간부는 각자의 구역을 책임집니다. 효율적이고 은밀하게 처리합시다.
WynnExcavation Site C#037.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#039.src: The alarm has been set off! There is an unauthorized guest! Guards, seize them!
WynnExcavation Site C#039.dst: 경보가 울렸다! 허가받지 않은 손님이 있다! 경비, 잡아라!
WynnExcavation Site C#039.speaker: Chief Excavator Dranfor

WynnExcavation Site C#041.src: Explore the area and search for the traitor

WynnExcavation Site C#042.src: You. You are the one they are worried about.
WynnExcavation Site C#042.dst: 당신. 저들이 걱정하는 게 바로 당신이군.

WynnExcavation Site C#043.src: I am Amadel, leader of the rebellion.

WynnExcavation Site C#044.src: I know this is all a bit sudden, but I have some information you must hear.
WynnExcavation Site C#044.dst: 갑작스러운 건 알지만, 당신이 들어야 할 정보가 있소.
WynnExcavation Site C#044.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#045.src: Everything you have been told is a lie. The Wynn Excavation “company” are not what they appear to be.
WynnExcavation Site C#045.dst: 당신이 들은 모든 건 거짓이오. Wynn Excavation이라는 "회사"는 겉보기와 다르오.
WynnExcavation Site C#045.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#046.src: They are using that as a front and their reach stretches further than I even know.
WynnExcavation Site C#046.dst: 그건 위장일 뿐이고, 그들의 손길은 나도 모를 만큼 멀리 뻗어 있소.
WynnExcavation Site C#046.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#047.src: There is no higher authority than them, not even the kings. And their intentions are not good.
WynnExcavation Site C#047.dst: 그들 위에 있는 권력은 없소, 왕들조차도. 그리고 그들의 의도는 선하지 않소.
WynnExcavation Site C#047.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#048.src: They seek the ultimate power, a power hidden across Wynn by various civilizations over hundreds of years.
WynnExcavation Site C#048.dst: 그들은 궁극의 힘을 노리오. 수백 년에 걸쳐 여러 문명이 Wynn 곳곳에 숨긴 힘을.
WynnExcavation Site C#048.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#049.src: They heard about it, and of course, began to gather the ingredients to create something that would lead them to total domination of the province.
WynnExcavation Site C#049.dst: 그 소문을 듣고는 당연히, 지방을 완전히 지배하게 해 줄 무언가를 만들 재료를 모으기 시작했소.
WynnExcavation Site C#049.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#050.src: They've been on to me for some time. I can't tell you everything here, but first, you must gather parts of the crystal, like you did with the others. It is essential.
WynnExcavation Site C#050.dst: 그들은 한동안 나를 주시해 왔소. 여기서 전부 말할 순 없지만, 우선 지난번처럼 수정 조각을 모아야 하오. 반드시 필요한 일이오.
WynnExcavation Site C#050.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#051.src: The crystal is in the cave just inside the volcano past the base. Hurry, they are all off duty at the moment, the cave to the heart of the volcano is clear. Act swiftly, and good luck.
WynnExcavation Site C#051.dst: 수정은 기지를 지나 화산 안쪽 동굴에 있소. 서두르시오, 지금은 모두 근무를 쉬고 있어 화산 심장부로 가는 동굴이 비었소. 신속히 움직이길, 행운을 비오.
WynnExcavation Site C#051.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site C#052.src: Explore the depths of the volcano

WynnExcavation Site C#053.src: Escape the volcano with the crystal shard

WynnExcavation Site C#054.src: Report back to Excavator Placardus with a [Red Crystal Shard]
WynnExcavation Site C#054.dst: [Red Crystal Shard]를 들고 발굴꾼 Placardus에게 보고하세요

WynnExcavation Site C#055.src: You couldn't just take my polite word and leave it at that, could you?
WynnExcavation Site C#055.dst: 제 정중한 말을 그대로 받아들이고 물러설 수는 없었나 보군요?
WynnExcavation Site C#055.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#056.src: You had to go snooping around, meddle in things that are far beyond your comprehension. No matter. Something did come out of this, it would appear.
WynnExcavation Site C#056.dst: 굳이 여기저기 기웃거리며 당신의 이해를 한참 넘어선 일에 끼어들었죠. 상관없습니다. 덕분에 얻은 것도 있는 듯하니까요.
WynnExcavation Site C#056.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#057.src: You were caught, conversing with Amadel, who we now know to be a traitor, thanks to you. There are eyes everywhere, young hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#057.dst: 당신은 Amadel과 대화하다 발각됐습니다. 덕분에 그가 배신자라는 것도 알게 됐죠. 눈은 어디에나 있습니다, 젊은 영웅이여.
WynnExcavation Site C#057.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#058.src: I'm willing to bet he's already been... taken care of by senior staff.
WynnExcavation Site C#058.dst: 장담하건대 그는 이미... 고위 직원들에게 처리됐을 겁니다.
WynnExcavation Site C#058.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#059.src: We also now know you are operating in the dark. You know nothing of the crystals or their power, and you know not that even the crystals you possess are inconsequential to our plans.
WynnExcavation Site C#059.dst: 또한 당신이 아무것도 모른 채 움직인다는 것도 알게 됐습니다. 수정도, 그 힘도 전혀 모르고, 손에 넣은 수정조차 우리 계획엔 하찮다는 것도 모르죠.
WynnExcavation Site C#059.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#060.src: You're lucky you aren't dead. How you infiltrated us this far has shown nothing but beginner's luck for the province's new hero.
WynnExcavation Site C#060.dst: 죽지 않은 게 다행입니다. 여기까지 잠입한 것도 이 지방의 새 영웅이 누린 초심자의 행운일 뿐이죠.
WynnExcavation Site C#060.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site C#061.src: I suggest you leave, before the guards get here and you meet the same fate as Amadel. Our power is limitless; armies, resources, even royalty are on our side. Our gaze is everpresent. Now, get out of my sight!
WynnExcavation Site C#061.dst: 경비들이 오기 전에, Amadel과 같은 운명을 맞기 전에 떠나시길 권합니다. 우리의 힘엔 한계가 없습니다. 군대, 자원, 심지어 왕족까지 우리 편이죠. 우리의 시선은 어디에나 있습니다. 자, 내 눈앞에서 사라지시죠!
WynnExcavation Site C#061.speaker: Excavator Placardus

WynnExcavation Site D#000.src: I remember being told something by my adoptive father, and he was a king of {p} himself!
WynnExcavation Site D#000.dst: 양아버지께 들은 이야기가 기억나. 그분 자신이 {p}의 왕이셨거든!

WynnExcavation Site D#001.src: Talk to Royal Advisor Carlos in {p} Castle at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] (Requires shard from Site C)
WynnExcavation Site D#001.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 {p} 성에 있는 왕실 고문 Carlos에게 말을 거세요 (Site C의 파편 필요)

WynnExcavation Site D#002.src: His majesty Lord King of {p} is indisposed at this moment.
WynnExcavation Site D#002.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#003.src: He recieved a message and made his way frantically down to the panic room, which is somewhere inside of this throne room.
WynnExcavation Site D#003.dst: 전갈을 받으시더니 황급히 대피실로 내려가셨습니다. 이 왕좌의 방 어딘가에 있지요.
WynnExcavation Site D#003.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#004.src: He hasn't been seen since. Only the King knows how to get into the panic room, but I've had my suspicions about it for a while now.
WynnExcavation Site D#004.dst: 그 뒤로 아무도 못 뵈었습니다. 대피실에 들어가는 법은 폐하만 아시지만, 저도 한동안 나름의 짐작은 해 왔지요.
WynnExcavation Site D#004.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#005.src: He seemed to be expecting someone, but I'm fed up of waiting.
WynnExcavation Site D#005.dst: 누군가를 기다리시는 듯했지만, 저는 이제 기다리다 지쳤습니다.
WynnExcavation Site D#005.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#006.src: I managed to hear a few things he was muttering to himself just before he disappeared, though.
WynnExcavation Site D#006.dst: 다만 사라지시기 직전에 혼잣말하시던 걸 몇 마디 듣긴 했습니다.
WynnExcavation Site D#006.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#007.src: He mentioned something about a fourth crystal... a green one.
WynnExcavation Site D#007.dst: 네 번째 수정 얘기를 하셨습니다... 초록색이라고요.
WynnExcavation Site D#007.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#008.src: And then he said "The order of the crystals will open the way".Maybe it's a clue as to how to find him?
WynnExcavation Site D#008.dst: 그리고 "수정의 순서가 길을 열리라"라고 하셨지요. 그분을 찾을 단서일까요?
WynnExcavation Site D#008.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#009.src: Please, we need to find him, I'm sick of telling everyone he's indisposed!
WynnExcavation Site D#009.dst: 제발 그분을 찾아야 합니다. 부재중이시라고 둘러대기도 지쳤어요!
WynnExcavation Site D#009.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#010.src: Find the secret passageway inside of the throne room
WynnExcavation Site D#010.dst: 왕좌의 방 안에서 비밀 통로를 찾으세요

WynnExcavation Site D#011.src: Oh my, a secret passage has opened up beneath the throne! Quickly, head inside!
WynnExcavation Site D#011.dst: 세상에, 왕좌 아래 비밀 통로가 열렸습니다! 어서 들어가세요!
WynnExcavation Site D#011.speaker: Royal Advisor Carlos

WynnExcavation Site D#014.src: I am impressed you managed to find me. Someone of my intellect is not normally found when he hasn't the intention of being so.
WynnExcavation Site D#014.dst: 여기까지 찾아오다니 감탄스럽군. 나 정도 되는 지성은 들킬 생각이 없으면 보통은 들키지 않는 법인데.
WynnExcavation Site D#014.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#015.src: I suppose I at least owe you the truth for getting this far, not that it matters.
WynnExcavation Site D#015.dst: 여기까지 온 값으로 진실 정도는 들려줘야겠지. 이제 와서 달라질 건 없지만.
WynnExcavation Site D#015.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#016.src: WynnExcavation, the Gavel company is a fake, a facade. It's not real....
WynnExcavation Site D#016.dst: WynnExcavation, 그 Gavel 회사는 가짜다. 겉껍데기일 뿐....
WynnExcavation Site D#016.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#017.src: It's actually a secret society run by the high and mighty of Gavel.
WynnExcavation Site D#017.dst: 실은 Gavel의 높으신 분들이 굴리는 비밀 결사지.
WynnExcavation Site D#017.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#018.src: They have one goal, complete control.
WynnExcavation Site D#018.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#019.src: You can't compete with them, kid. I tried to at first, but they had turned my inner circle before getting to me.
WynnExcavation Site D#019.dst: 꼬마야, 넌 저들을 이길 수 없다. 나도 처음엔 맞섰지만, 저들은 내게 오기 전에 이미 측근들을 돌려놨더군.
WynnExcavation Site D#019.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#020.src: Though I cannot admit I fought hard, their ideals are admirable.
WynnExcavation Site D#020.dst: 치열하게 싸웠다고는 못 하겠지만, 저들의 이상은 훌륭하다.
WynnExcavation Site D#020.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#021.src: So I hope you will forgive me, I act only for the greater good of the world.
WynnExcavation Site D#021.dst: 그러니 용서하게. 나는 오직 세상의 더 큰 선을 위해 움직일 뿐이다.
WynnExcavation Site D#021.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#022.src: As you will not be leaving the city, I wish you a fond farewell. When you leave, you will be accused of treason and will be hunted. It is the only way...
WynnExcavation Site D#022.dst: 자네는 이 도시를 나가지 못할 테니, 여기서 작별을 고하지. 나가는 순간 반역죄로 몰려 쫓기게 될 걸세. 이 길밖에 없어...
WynnExcavation Site D#022.speaker: King of Troms

WynnExcavation Site D#024.src: Time is short, so I'll have to spare you the details, but let's just say I'm on your side.
WynnExcavation Site D#024.dst: 시간이 없어서 자세한 건 생략할게요. 그냥 제가 당신 편이라고만 알아 두세요.
WynnExcavation Site D#024.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#025.src: The King just placed you under arrest for treason. They've locked down the entire city.
WynnExcavation Site D#025.dst: 국왕이 방금 당신을 반역죄로 체포하라 명했어요. 도시 전체가 봉쇄됐고요.
WynnExcavation Site D#025.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#026.src: Both the front gate and the Passage are closed down. So we've created another exit for you.
WynnExcavation Site D#026.dst: 정문도 통로도 다 막혔어요. 그래서 우리가 다른 출구를 하나 뚫어 놨습니다.
WynnExcavation Site D#026.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#027.src: Just follow the path to your left around the city. Keep going until you see a villager next to a tunnel. We'll clear your name once you've escaped.
WynnExcavation Site D#027.dst: 왼쪽 길을 따라 도시를 빙 돌아가세요. 터널 옆에 선 주민이 보일 때까지 계속 가고요. 탈출하면 누명은 저희가 벗겨 드릴게요.
WynnExcavation Site D#027.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#028.src: You'll pass through the army headquarters on your way, so be prepared for a fight. I'm the only guard here to help you.
WynnExcavation Site D#028.dst: 가는 길에 군 본부를 지나게 되니 싸울 각오를 하세요. 여기서 도울 경비병은 저뿐이에요.
WynnExcavation Site D#028.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#029.src: Now run! We don't have another moment to waste!
WynnExcavation Site D#029.dst: 이제 뛰어요! 한순간도 낭비할 수 없어요!
WynnExcavation Site D#029.speaker: Troms Guard

WynnExcavation Site D#032.src: Take this, and run! You need to get out!
WynnExcavation Site D#032.dst: 이거 받고 뛰어! 여길 나가야 해!

WynnExcavation Site D#033.src: Head to those coordinates, there is no time to explain, now go! I'll close the tunnel behind you.
WynnExcavation Site D#033.dst: 그 좌표로 가. 설명할 시간 없어, 어서! 터널은 내가 뒤에서 막을게.

WynnExcavation Site D#034.src: I'VE FOUND THE TRAITOR! THEY'RE OVER HERE!

WynnExcavation Site D#035.src: Head to the location on the note

WynnExcavation Site D#037.src: I'm sorry, I can't let you in there.
WynnExcavation Site D#037.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#038.src: I can't let you in there, not until you have proven you are truly on our side.
WynnExcavation Site D#038.dst: 들여보낼 수 없어요. 정말 우리 편이라는 걸 증명하기 전까진.
WynnExcavation Site D#038.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#039.src: We never know who to believe anymore. Unfortunately there is no way for you to prove your loyalty.
WynnExcavation Site D#039.dst: 이젠 누굴 믿어야 할지 모르겠어요. 안타깝지만 당신이 충성을 증명할 방법은 없고요.
WynnExcavation Site D#039.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#040.src: Now if you would excuse me, I have to hunt for the lost map fragments of Dernel. I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#040.dst: 그럼 실례할게요. Dernel의 잃어버린 지도 조각을 찾아야 해서요. 저 눈들이 분명 관련이 있을 텐데...
WynnExcavation Site D#040.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#041.src: Find the three map fragments by following the eyes and return to Thomas.
WynnExcavation Site D#041.dst: 눈을 따라가 지도 조각 세 개를 찾아 Thomas에게 돌아가세요.

WynnExcavation Site D#042.src: I can't let you in, we're busy looking for an important document, I'm sure these eyes have something to do with it...
WynnExcavation Site D#042.dst: 들여보낼 수 없어요. 중요한 문서를 찾느라 바빠서요. 저 눈들이 분명 관련이 있을 거예요...
WynnExcavation Site D#042.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#043.src: Is that... The map fragments? You found them!
WynnExcavation Site D#043.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#044.src: Oh my, you better come in.
WynnExcavation Site D#044.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#045.src: There's not enough time! We need to combine those fragments with ours!
WynnExcavation Site D#045.dst: 시간이 없어요! 그 조각들을 우리 것과 합쳐야 해요!
WynnExcavation Site D#045.speaker: Traitor Thomas

WynnExcavation Site D#049.src: Welcome, friend. I knew you would figure it all out.
WynnExcavation Site D#049.dst: 어서 와요, 친구. 다 알아낼 줄 알았어요.
WynnExcavation Site D#049.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#050.src: You must be surprised to see me. The excavation crew at site C tried very hard to kill me.
WynnExcavation Site D#050.dst: 날 보고 놀랐겠죠. Site C의 발굴대가 날 죽이려고 무진 애를 썼거든요.
WynnExcavation Site D#050.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#051.src: They didn't succeed though. I got away, and I swiped a fragment of a map, and I found out what it's for.
WynnExcavation Site D#051.dst: 하지만 실패했죠. 난 빠져나왔고, 지도 조각 하나를 슬쩍해서 용도까지 알아냈어요.
WynnExcavation Site D#051.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#052.src: If you made it this far, you know Wynn Excavation are not what they seem. They want to harness Wynn's ancient power.
WynnExcavation Site D#052.dst: 여기까지 왔다면 Wynn Excavation의 실체를 알겠죠. 그들은 Wynn의 고대 힘을 원해요.
WynnExcavation Site D#052.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#053.src: They control our governments, authorities and seem to be {~} steps ahead of any of us that oppose them.
WynnExcavation Site D#053.dst: 정부도 당국도 그들 손아귀예요. 맞서는 우리보다 늘 {~}걸음 앞서 있죠.
WynnExcavation Site D#053.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#054.src: That is, unless we're able to beat the excavationists to the last crystal.
WynnExcavation Site D#054.dst: 발굴자들보다 먼저 마지막 수정을 손에 넣지 못한다면요.
WynnExcavation Site D#054.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#055.src: They cannot use a single shard of power without combining them all.
WynnExcavation Site D#055.dst: 전부 합치지 않으면 파편 하나의 힘도 못 써요.
WynnExcavation Site D#055.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#056.src: Here, I've combined the map fragments behind me. It looks it's deep in the jungle, I wonder where...
WynnExcavation Site D#056.dst: 자, 뒤에 지도 조각을 다 맞춰 놨어요. 정글 깊은 곳 같은데, 어디일까요...
WynnExcavation Site D#056.speaker: Traitor Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#057.src: WynnExcavation have done really horrible things, and I used to help...
WynnExcavation Site D#057.dst: WynnExcavation은 정말 끔찍한 짓을 저질렀어요. 나도 거들었었고...
WynnExcavation Site D#057.speaker: Traitor Buice

WynnExcavation Site D#058.src: WynnExcavation will be destroyed, no matter what!
WynnExcavation Site D#058.speaker: Traitor Jaynar

WynnExcavation Site D#063.src: Oh my. It's you. I can't say I'm surprised to see you, we thought you might be stupid enough to come here.
WynnExcavation Site D#063.dst: 이런. 너였군. 놀랍진 않아. 네가 여기까지 올 만큼 멍청할 거라 생각했거든.
WynnExcavation Site D#063.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#064.src: Stupid enough to come here, yet, smart enough to make it.
WynnExcavation Site D#064.dst: 여기 올 만큼 멍청하면서, 도착할 만큼은 똑똑했군.
WynnExcavation Site D#064.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#065.src: You were at every site, taking shards and attempting to thwart us.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.dst: 현장마다 나타나 파편을 챙기고 우릴 방해했지.
WynnExcavation Site D#065.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#066.src: This time we won, and you lost.
WynnExcavation Site D#066.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#067.src: What do your shards mean to us when we have all four crystals?
WynnExcavation Site D#067.dst: 수정 넷을 다 가진 우리에게 네 파편이 무슨 의미겠나?
WynnExcavation Site D#067.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#069.src: The boss wants to speak to you, I don't recommend keeping him waiting, he's not a patient man.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.dst: 우두머리가 널 보자신다. 기다리게 하지 마라, 인내심 있는 분이 아니니까.
WynnExcavation Site D#069.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#070.src: He'll be waiting for you, head through that door.
WynnExcavation Site D#070.dst: 저 문으로 들어가. 기다리고 계실 거다.
WynnExcavation Site D#070.speaker: Excavator Admin Uci

WynnExcavation Site D#071.src: My boss Uci is a bit of a mean guy, but hey the perks of minionship aren't bad!
WynnExcavation Site D#071.dst: 우리 상사 Uci는 좀 못됐지만, 뭐 부하 노릇 혜택은 나쁘지 않아요!
WynnExcavation Site D#071.speaker: Excavator Sean

WynnExcavation Site D#072.src: This leads deeper into this dungeon, but it seems like it has to be activated from the other side.
WynnExcavation Site D#072.dst: 이건 던전 더 깊은 곳으로 이어지는데, 반대편에서 작동시켜야 하는 것 같아요.
WynnExcavation Site D#072.speaker: WynnExcavation Scientist Azure

WynnExcavation Site D#080.src: Well, well. Looks like you've finally made it.
WynnExcavation Site D#080.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#081.src: You might be a little shocked to see me here...
WynnExcavation Site D#081.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#083.src: You finding that old fool in the desert, you surviving that fall.
WynnExcavation Site D#083.dst: 사막에서 그 늙은 바보를 만난 것도, 그 추락에서 살아남은 것도.
WynnExcavation Site D#083.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#084.src: You finding that notebook, and eventually meeting me.
WynnExcavation Site D#084.dst: 그 수첩을 찾은 것도, 끝내 날 만난 것도.
WynnExcavation Site D#084.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#085.src: Everything that you have done has been planned by the mastermind behind this organisation, me.
WynnExcavation Site D#085.dst: 네가 한 모든 일은 이 조직의 배후에 있는 주모자, 바로 내가 짜 둔 것이다.
WynnExcavation Site D#085.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#086.src: You don't get it, do you? We needed you. The otherworldly crystals are a powerful magic, but a dangerous one at that.
WynnExcavation Site D#086.dst: 아직 모르겠나? 우린 네가 필요했다. 이계의 수정은 강력한 마법이지만, 동시에 위험한 마법이지.
WynnExcavation Site D#086.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel

WynnExcavation Site D#087.src: We needed you, an unaware human with some form of pure intent to bring empowered shards here. Anyone else would have ran off with the shards, and turned against us. It's just how it all works. I don't expect you to understand.. Now. Enough talking.
WynnExcavation Site D#087.dst: 아무것도 모르면서 어떤 순수한 의도를 지닌 인간이 충전된 파편을 여기까지 가져와야 했다. 다른 자였다면 파편을 들고 달아나 우리에게 등을 돌렸겠지. 원래 그런 거다. 네가 이해하리라 기대하진 않아.. 자. 말은 이만하면 됐다.
WynnExcavation Site D#087.speaker: WynnExcavation Leader Amadel
